internal sealed class SR
{
	private static SR loader;

	[ThreadStatic]
	private static Dictionary<DynamicResourceString.ID, DynamicResourceString> _dynamicResourceStrings;

	private ResourceManager[] resources;

	private SR()
	{
		string text = "Infragistics.Windows.strings";
		string[] array = text.Split(';');
		int num = 0;
		string[] array2 = array;
		foreach (string text2 in array2)
		{
			if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
		}
		resources = new ResourceManager[num];
		Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
		int num2 = 0;
		string[] array3 = array;
		foreach (string text3 in array3)
		{
			if (text3 != null && text3.Length > 0)
			{
				resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text3, assembly);
			}
		}
	}

	public static DynamicResourceString GetDynamicResourceString(string name, object[] args, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		lock (typeof(SR))
		{
			DynamicResourceString.ID key = new DynamicResourceString.ID(culture, name, args);
			DynamicResourceString value = null;
			if (_dynamicResourceStrings == null)
			{
				_dynamicResourceStrings = new Dictionary<DynamicResourceString.ID, DynamicResourceString>();
			}
			else
			{
				_dynamicResourceStrings.TryGetValue(key, out value);
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				value = new InternalDynamicResourceString(ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer, culture, name, args);
				_dynamicResourceStrings.Add(key, value);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	private static SR GetLoader()
	{
		if (loader == null)
		{
			lock (typeof(SR))
			{
				if (loader == null)
				{
					loader = new SR();
				}
			}
		}
		return loader;
	}

	public static string GetString(string name)
	{
		return GetString(null, name);
	}

	public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetString(null, name, args);
	}

	public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
	{
		return GetString(culture, name, null);
	}

	public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
	}

	private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		string text = null;
		if (allowCustomizedStrings)
		{
			text = ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
		}
		if (text == null)
		{
			SR sR = GetLoader();
			if (sR == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
		}
		if (args != null && args.Length != 0 && text.Length > 2)
		{
			try
			{
				text = string.Format(null, text, args);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		ResourceManager[] array = resources;
		foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
		{
			string text = resourceManager.GetString(name, culture);
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name)
	{
		return GetUncustomizedString(null, name);
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetUncustomizedString(null, name, args);
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
	{
		return GetUncustomizedString(culture, name, null);
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: false, culture, name, args);
	}

	public static object GetObject(string name)
	{
		return GetObject(null, name);
	}

	public static object GetObject(CultureInfo culture, string name)
	{
		return GetLoader()?.GetObject(name, culture);
	}

	private object GetObject(string name, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		ResourceManager[] array = resources;
		foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
		{
			object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(name, culture);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return obj;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}
}
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
internal sealed class LocalizedCategoryAttribute : CategoryAttribute
{
	public LocalizedCategoryAttribute(string category)
		: base(category)
	{
	}

	protected override string GetLocalizedString(string value)
	{
		return SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, value);
	}
}
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
internal sealed class LocalizedDescriptionAttribute : DescriptionAttribute
{
	private bool loaded;

	public override string Description
	{
		get
		{
			if (!loaded)
			{
				loaded = true;
				base.DescriptionValue = SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, base.Description);
			}
			return base.Description;
		}
	}

	public LocalizedDescriptionAttribute(string description)
		: base(description)
	{
	}
}
internal sealed class InternalDynamicResourceString : DynamicResourceString
{
	internal InternalDynamicResourceString(ResourceCustomizer customizer, CultureInfo cultureInfo, string resourceName, object[] args)
		: base(customizer, cultureInfo, resourceName, args)
	{
	}

	protected override string GetStringFromResource(string resourceName, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		return SR.GetString(culture, resourceName, null);
	}
}

{
	internal static readonly ResourceCustomizer Customizer = new ResourceCustomizer();

	private ResourceCustomizerLocator()
	{
	}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public static class WidgetUtilities
	{
		public static object FromExternalObject(object externalObject)
		{
			if (!(externalObject is IWidgetExternalObject widgetExternalObject))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return widgetExternalObject.InternalObject;
		}

		public static object ToExternalObject(object internalObject)
		{
			if (!(internalObject is IWidgetInternalObject widgetInternalObject))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return widgetInternalObject.ExternalObject;
		}

		internal static object FromXFExternalObject(object externalObject)
		{
			if (!(externalObject is IXFWidgetExternalObject iXFWidgetExternalObject))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return iXFWidgetExternalObject.XFInternalObject;
		}

		internal static object ToXFExternalObject(object internalObject)
		{
			if (!(internalObject is IXFWidgetInternalObject iXFWidgetInternalObject))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return iXFWidgetInternalObject.XFExternalObject;
		}

		internal static object FromXfToNativeObject(object xfObject)
		{
			return ToExternalObject(FromXFExternalObject(xfObject));
		}

		internal static object FromNativeToXfObject(object nativeObject)
		{
			return ToXFExternalObject(FromExternalObject(nativeObject));
		}

		public static TOutput? Convert<TInput, TOutput>(TInput? input, Func<TInput, TOutput> conversion) where TInput : struct where TOutput : struct
		{
			if (!input.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return conversion(input.Value);
		}

		public static TOutput[] Convert<TInput, TOutput>(TInput[] input, Func<TInput, TOutput> converter)
		{
			if (input == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TOutput[] array = new TOutput[input.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < input.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = converter(input[i]);
			}
			return array;
		}
	}

	internal interface IMediator : IDisposable
	{
		object Source { get; }

		object Target { get; }
	}
	internal interface IXFMediator : IMediator, IDisposable
	{
		void SetSource(object newSource);
	}
	internal interface ICollectionMediator : IMediator, IDisposable
	{
		void UpdateFromSource();

		void UpdateFromTarget();
	}
	internal interface ICollectionWrapper
	{
		object InnerItems { get; }
	}
	internal static class ExternalObjectFactory
	{
		internal static readonly IDictionary<Type, Func<object, object>> Table = new ConcurrentDictionary<Type, Func<object, object>>();

		internal static readonly IDictionary<Type, Func<object, object>> XFTable = new ConcurrentDictionary<Type, Func<object, object>>();

		internal static readonly IDictionary<Type, Func<object, object>> NativeToXfTable = new ConcurrentDictionary<Type, Func<object, object>>();

		internal static readonly IDictionary<Type, Func<object, object>> XFToNativeTable = new ConcurrentDictionary<Type, Func<object, object>>();

		internal static readonly IDictionary<Type, Func<object, IXFMediator>> XfMediatorTable = new ConcurrentDictionary<Type, Func<object, IXFMediator>>();

		internal static object OnXfCollectionPropertyChanged<TMediator, TXfItem, TNativeItem>(ref TMediator mediator, IList<TXfItem> xfItems, IList<TNativeItem> nativeItems, bool updateFromXf, Func<IList<TXfItem>, IList<TNativeItem>, TMediator> createMediator, object context) where TMediator : class, ICollectionMediator
		{
			if (mediator != null)
			{
				if (mediator.Source == xfItems && mediator.Target == nativeItems)
				{
					if (!updateFromXf)
					{
						return xfItems;
					}
					return nativeItems;
				}
				mediator.Dispose();
				mediator = null;
			}
			if (updateFromXf)
			{
				nativeItems = ((xfItems == null) ? null : ((IList<TNativeItem>)NativeFromXf(xfItems, context)));
			}
			else
			{
				xfItems = ((nativeItems == null) ? null : ((IList<TXfItem>)XfFromNative(nativeItems, context)));
			}
			if (xfItems != null && nativeItems != null)
			{
				mediator = createMediator(xfItems, nativeItems);
				if (mediator != null)
				{
					if (updateFromXf)
					{
						mediator.UpdateFromSource();
					}
					else
					{
						mediator.UpdateFromTarget();
					}
				}
			}
			if (!updateFromXf)
			{
				return xfItems;
			}
			return nativeItems;
		}

		public static object NativeFromInternal(object internalObject)
		{
			if (internalObject != null && Table.TryGetValue(internalObject.GetType(), out var value))
			{
				return value(internalObject);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static object NativeFromXf(object xfObject, object context)
		{
			if (xfObject != null)
			{
				Type type = xfObject.GetType();
				while (type != null)
				{
					if (XFToNativeTable.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
					{
						return value(context);
					}
					type = type.BaseType;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static object XfFromInternal(object internalObject)
		{
			if (internalObject != null && XFTable.TryGetValue(internalObject.GetType(), out var value))
			{
				return value(internalObject);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static object XfFromNative(object nativeObject, object context)
		{
			if (nativeObject != null && NativeToXfTable.TryGetValue(nativeObject.GetType(), out var value))
			{
				return value(context);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static object GetOrCreateXf(object nativeObject, object context = null)
		{
			object obj = WidgetUtilities.FromNativeToXfObject(nativeObject);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = XfFromNative(nativeObject, context);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					CreateXfMediator(nativeObject)?.SetSource(obj);
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public static IXFMediator CreateXfMediator(object o)
		{
			IXFMediator result = null;
			if (o != null)
			{
				Type type = o.GetType();
				while (type != null)
				{
					if (XfMediatorTable.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
					{
						result = value(o);
						break;
					}
					type = type.BaseType;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal static class ConversionUtilities<TInternal, TPublic>
	{
		private static ConditionalWeakTable<IList<TInternal>, ObservableCollectionWrapper<TPublic>> _nativeReference = new ConditionalWeakTable<IList<TInternal>, ObservableCollectionWrapper<TPublic>>();

		private static ConditionalWeakTable<IList<TInternal>, ObservableCollectionWrapper<TPublic>>.CreateValueCallback _createNativeCallback = delegate(IList<TInternal> internalList)
		{
			if (internalList is IWidgetInternalObject)
			{
				return (ObservableCollectionWrapper<TPublic>)((IWidgetInternalObject)internalList).ExternalObject;
			}
			AdapterNotifyCollection<TPublic, TInternal> list = new AdapterNotifyCollection<TPublic, TInternal>(internalList, (TInternal i) => (TPublic)WidgetUtilities.ToExternalObject(i), (TPublic i) => (TInternal)WidgetUtilities.FromExternalObject(i));
			return new ObservableCollectionWrapper<TPublic>(list);
		};

		internal static ObservableCollectionWrapper<TPublic> GetPublicCollection(IList<TInternal> internalList)
		{
			if (internalList == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _nativeReference.GetValue(internalList, _createNativeCallback);
		}

		internal static IList<TInternal> GetInternalCollection(IList<TPublic> publicList)
		{
			if (publicList is IWidgetExternalObject)
			{
				return ((IWidgetExternalObject)publicList).InternalObject as IList<TInternal>;
			}
			if (publicList is ICollectionWrapper)
			{
				return ((ICollectionWrapper)publicList).InnerItems as IList<TInternal>;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public interface ISupportPositioning
	{
		IEnumerable<string> Before { get; }

		IEnumerable<string> After { get; }

		string Key { get; }
	}
	internal class PositionSorter
	{
		private IComparer<ISupportPositioning> _defaultComparer;

		private List<ISupportPositioning> _list;

		private Dictionary<string, IList<ISupportPositioning>> _map = new Dictionary<string, IList<ISupportPositioning>>();

		private Dictionary<ISupportPositioning, HashSet<ISupportPositioning>> _befores = new Dictionary<ISupportPositioning, HashSet<ISupportPositioning>>();

		private Dictionary<ISupportPositioning, HashSet<ISupportPositioning>> _afters = new Dictionary<ISupportPositioning, HashSet<ISupportPositioning>>();

		private Dictionary<ISupportPositioning, HashSet<ISupportPositioning>> _aggregatedBefores = new Dictionary<ISupportPositioning, HashSet<ISupportPositioning>>();

		private Dictionary<ISupportPositioning, HashSet<ISupportPositioning>> _aggregatedAfters = new Dictionary<ISupportPositioning, HashSet<ISupportPositioning>>();

		private bool _indeterminateOrderDetected;

		private PositionSorter()
		{
		}

		public static void Sort(List<ISupportPositioning> list, out bool isValid, IComparer<ISupportPositioning> defaultComparer = null)
		{
			PositionSorter positionSorter = new PositionSorter
			{
				_list = list,
				_defaultComparer = defaultComparer
			};
			isValid = positionSorter.Sort();
		}

		private void AggregateBefores(ISupportPositioning item, HashSet<ISupportPositioning> result)
		{
			foreach (ISupportPositioning item2 in _befores[item])
			{
				if (!result.Contains(item2))
				{
					result.Add(item2);
					AggregateBefores(item2, result);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AggregateAfters(ISupportPositioning item, HashSet<ISupportPositioning> result)
		{
			foreach (ISupportPositioning item2 in _afters[item])
			{
				if (!result.Contains(item2))
				{
					result.Add(item2);
					AggregateAfters(item2, result);
				}
			}
		}

		private int CompareHelper(ISupportPositioning x, ISupportPositioning y, int level = 0)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (_aggregatedBefores[x].Contains(y))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_aggregatedAfters[x].Contains(y))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (1 == level)
			{
				if (x.Key != y.Key)
				{
					_indeterminateOrderDetected = true;
				}
				if (_defaultComparer != null)
				{
					return _defaultComparer.Compare(x, y);
				}
				return 0;
			}
			return -CompareHelper(y, x, 1);
		}

		private HashSet<ISupportPositioning> GetBeforeAfterItems(ISupportPositioning item, bool getBefore)
		{
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = (getBefore ? item.Before : item.After);
			HashSet<ISupportPositioning> hashSet = new HashSet<ISupportPositioning>();
			if (enumerable != null)
			{
				hashSet.UnionWith(enumerable.Where((string ii) => _map.ContainsKey(ii)).SelectMany((string ii) => _map[ii]));
			}
			return hashSet;
		}

		private bool Sort()
		{
			bool result = true;
			foreach (ISupportPositioning item in _list)
			{
				if (!_map.TryGetValue(item.Key, out var value))
				{
					value = (_map[item.Key] = new List<ISupportPositioning>());
				}
				value.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (ISupportPositioning item2 in _list)
			{
				_befores[item2] = GetBeforeAfterItems(item2, getBefore: true);
				_afters[item2] = GetBeforeAfterItems(item2, getBefore: false);
			}
			foreach (ISupportPositioning item3 in _list)
			{
				foreach (ISupportPositioning item4 in _befores[item3])
				{
					_afters[item4].Add(item3);
				}
				foreach (ISupportPositioning item5 in _afters[item3])
				{
					_befores[item5].Add(item3);
				}
			}
			foreach (ISupportPositioning item6 in _list)
			{
				HashSet<ISupportPositioning> hashSet = new HashSet<ISupportPositioning>();
				HashSet<ISupportPositioning> hashSet2 = new HashSet<ISupportPositioning>();
				AggregateBefores(item6, hashSet);
				AggregateAfters(item6, hashSet2);
				_aggregatedBefores[item6] = hashSet;
				_aggregatedAfters[item6] = hashSet2;
				if (hashSet.Overlaps(hashSet2))
				{
					result = false;
				}
			}
			_list.Sort((ISupportPositioning x, ISupportPositioning y) => CompareHelper(x, y));
			_ = _indeterminateOrderDetected;
			return result;
		}
	}
	public enum ColorBlendMode
	{
		Normal,
		Multiply,
		Screen,
		Overlay,
		Darken,
		Lighten,
		ColorDodge,
		ColorBurn,
		HardLight,
		SoftLight,
		Difference,
		Exclusion,
		LinearBurn,
		LinearDodge,
		Subtract,
		Divide,
		PinLight,
		LinearLight,
		VividLight,
		HardMix
	}
	internal static class ColorUtilities
	{
		internal static class ChannelBlend
		{
			internal static float ColorBurn(float b, float s)
			{
				if (!(s > 0f))
				{
					return 0f;
				}
				return 1f - Math.Min((1f - b) / s, 1f);
			}

			internal static float ColorDodge(float b, float s)
			{
				if (!(s < 1f))
				{
					return 1f;
				}
				return Math.Min(b / (1f - s), 1f);
			}

			internal static float Darken(float b, float s)
			{
				return Math.Min(b, s);
			}

			internal static float Difference(float b, float s)
			{
				return Math.Abs(b - s);
			}

			internal static float Divide(float b, float s)
			{
				return b / s;
			}

			internal static float Exclusion(float b, float s)
			{
				return b + s - 2f * b * s;
			}

			internal static float HardLight(float b, float s)
			{
				if (!(s <= 0.5f))
				{
					return Screen(b, 2f * s - 1f);
				}
				return Multiply(b, 2f * s);
			}

			internal static float HardMix(float b, float s)
			{
				if (!(VividLight(b, s) < 0.5f))
				{
					return 1f;
				}
				return 0f;
			}

			internal static float Lighten(float b, float s)
			{
				return Math.Max(b, s);
			}

			internal static float LinearBurn(float b, float s)
			{
				return b + s - 1f;
			}

			internal static float LinearDodge(float b, float s)
			{
				return b + s;
			}

			internal static float LinearLight(float b, float s)
			{
				if (!(s <= 0.5f))
				{
					return LinearDodge(b, 2f * (s - 0.5f));
				}
				return LinearBurn(b, 2f * s);
			}

			internal static float Multiply(float b, float s)
			{
				return b * s;
			}

			internal static float Normal(float b, float s)
			{
				return s;
			}

			internal static float Overlay(float b, float s)
			{
				return HardLight(s, b);
			}

			internal static float PinLight(float b, float s)
			{
				if (!(s <= 0.5f))
				{
					return Lighten(b, 2f * (s - 0.5f));
				}
				return Darken(b, 2f * s);
			}

			internal static float Screen(float b, float s)
			{
				return b + s - b * s;
			}

			internal static float SoftLight(float b, float s)
			{
				if (!(s <= 0.5f))
				{
					return b + (2f * s - 1f) * (SoftLightD(b) - b);
				}
				return b - (1f - 2f * s) * b * (1f - b);
			}

			internal static float Subtract(float b, float s)
			{
				return b - s;
			}

			internal static float VividLight(float b, float s)
			{
				if (!(s <= 0.5f))
				{
					return ColorDodge(b, 2f * (s - 0.5f));
				}
				return ColorBurn(b, 2f * s);
			}

			private static float SoftLightD(float x)
			{
				if (!(x <= 0.25f))
				{
					return (float)Math.Sqrt(x);
				}
				return ((16f * x - 12f) * x + 4f) * x;
			}
		}

		private static readonly Func<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Color>[] _blendFunctions;

		static ColorUtilities()
		{
			int length = Enum.GetValues(typeof(ColorBlendMode)).Length;
			Func<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Color>[] array = new Func<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Color>[length];
			array[0] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.Normal);
			array[1] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.Multiply);
			array[2] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.Screen);
			array[3] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.Overlay);
			array[4] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.Darken);
			array[5] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.Lighten);
			array[6] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.ColorDodge);
			array[7] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.ColorBurn);
			array[8] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.HardLight);
			array[9] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.SoftLight);
			array[10] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.Difference);
			array[11] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.Exclusion);
			array[12] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.LinearBurn);
			array[13] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.LinearDodge);
			array[14] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.Subtract);
			array[15] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.Divide);
			array[16] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.PinLight);
			array[17] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.LinearLight);
			array[18] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.VividLight);
			array[19] = (System.Windows.Media.Color cB, System.Windows.Media.Color cS) => BlendChannels(cB, cS, ChannelBlend.HardMix);
			foreach (ColorBlendMode value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(ColorBlendMode)))
			{
				if (array[(int)value] == null)
				{
					array[(int)value] = delegate
					{
						throw new NotImplementedException();
					};
				}
			}
			_blendFunctions = array;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color BlendChannels(System.Windows.Media.Color backdrop, System.Windows.Media.Color source, Func<float, float, float> blendFunc)
		{
			if (backdrop.A == byte.MaxValue && source.A == byte.MaxValue)
			{
				return BlendChannelsOpaque(backdrop, source, blendFunc);
			}
			return BlendChannelsAlpha(backdrop, source, blendFunc);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color BlendChannelsOpaque(System.Windows.Media.Color backdrop, System.Windows.Media.Color source, Func<float, float, float> blendFunc)
		{
			float value = blendFunc(RgbByteToFloat(backdrop.R), RgbByteToFloat(source.R));
			float value2 = blendFunc(RgbByteToFloat(backdrop.G), RgbByteToFloat(source.G));
			float value3 = blendFunc(RgbByteToFloat(backdrop.B), RgbByteToFloat(source.B));
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, RgbFloatToByte(value), RgbFloatToByte(value2), RgbFloatToByte(value3));
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color BlendChannelsAlpha(System.Windows.Media.Color backdrop, System.Windows.Media.Color source, Func<float, float, float> blendFunc)
		{
			float num = RgbByteToFloat(backdrop.A);
			float num2 = RgbByteToFloat(source.A);
			float num3 = num + num2 - num * num2;
			float value = BlendChannelWithAlpha(RgbByteToFloat(backdrop.R), RgbByteToFloat(source.R), num, num2, num3, blendFunc);
			float value2 = BlendChannelWithAlpha(RgbByteToFloat(backdrop.G), RgbByteToFloat(source.G), num, num2, num3, blendFunc);
			float value3 = BlendChannelWithAlpha(RgbByteToFloat(backdrop.B), RgbByteToFloat(source.B), num, num2, num3, blendFunc);
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(RgbFloatToByte(num3), RgbFloatToByte(value), RgbFloatToByte(value2), RgbFloatToByte(value3));
		}

		private static float BlendChannelWithAlpha(float cB, float cS, float aB, float aS, float aR, Func<float, float, float> blendFunc)
		{
			return (1f - aS / aR) * cB + aS / aR * ((1f - aB) * cS + aB * blendFunc(cB, cS));
		}

		private static double CalculateSRgbBrightness(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return Math.Pow((double)(int)color.R / 255.0, 2.2) * 0.2126 + Math.Pow((double)(int)color.G / 255.0, 2.2) * 0.7152 + Math.Pow((double)(int)color.B / 255.0, 2.2) * 0.0722;
		}

		private static void Clamp(ref float value, float min, float max)
		{
			if (value < min)
			{
				value = min;
			}
			else if (value > max)
			{
				value = max;
			}
		}

		private static float Max(float f1, float f2, float f3)
		{
			return Math.Max(Math.Max(f1, f2), f3);
		}

		private static float Min(float f1, float f2, float f3)
		{
			return Math.Min(Math.Min(f1, f2), f3);
		}

		private static byte RgbFloatToByte(float value)
		{
			value = (float)Math.Round(value * 255f, 0, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
			if (value < 0f)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (value > 255f)
			{
				return byte.MaxValue;
			}
			return (byte)value;
		}

		private static float RgbByteToFloat(byte rgbChannel)
		{
			return (float)(int)rgbChannel / 255f;
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Media.Color CalculateForeground(System.Windows.Media.Color background, params System.Windows.Media.Color[] foregroundColors)
		{
			double num = CalculateSRgbBrightness(background);
			double num2 = -1.0;
			System.Windows.Media.Color result = Colors.Transparent;
			foreach (System.Windows.Media.Color color in foregroundColors)
			{
				double num3 = CalculateSRgbBrightness(color);
				double num4 = ((num3 > num) ? ((num3 + 0.05) / (num + 0.05)) : ((num + 0.05) / (num3 + 0.05)));
				if (num4 > num2)
				{
					num2 = num4;
					result = color;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Media.Color CalculateForeground(System.Windows.Media.Color background)
		{
			double num = CalculateSRgbBrightness(background);
			double num2 = 1.05 / (num + 0.05);
			double num3 = (num + 0.05) / 0.05;
			if (!(num3 > num2))
			{
				return Colors.White;
			}
			return Colors.Black;
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Media.Color? ColorFromObject(object value)
		{
			if (value is System.Windows.Media.Color)
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Color)value;
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				try
				{
					return (System.Windows.Media.Color)System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString((string)value);
				}
				catch (FormatException)
				{
				}
			}
			if (value is SolidColorBrush)
			{
				return ((SolidColorBrush)value).Color;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color Blend(System.Windows.Media.Color backdrop, System.Windows.Media.Color source, ColorBlendMode blendMode)
		{
			return _blendFunctions[(int)blendMode](backdrop, source);
		}
	}
	public class ColorBlendConverter : ValueConverterBase
	{
		public ColorBlendMode BlendMode { get; set; }

		public override object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color? color = ColorUtilities.ColorFromObject(parameter);
			if (!color.HasValue && parameter != null)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color? color2 = ColorUtilities.ColorFromObject(value);
			if (!color2.HasValue)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color3 = (color.HasValue ? ColorUtilities.Blend(color.Value, color2.Value, BlendMode) : color2.Value);
			if (targetType == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush))
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush
				{
					Color = color3
				};
			}
			return color3;
		}

		public override object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
		}
	}
	public class CalculatedForegroundConverter : ValueConverterBase
	{
		public override object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color? color = ColorUtilities.ColorFromObject(value);
			if (!color.HasValue)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color2 = ColorUtilities.CalculateForeground(color.Value);
			if (targetType == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush))
			{
				if (color2 == Colors.White)
				{
					return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White;
				}
				if (color2 == Colors.Black)
				{
					return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black;
				}
				return new SolidColorBrush
				{
					Color = color2
				};
			}
			return color2;
		}

		public override object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
		}
	}
	public class AlphaColorConverter : ValueConverterBase
	{
		public double Opacity { get; set; }

		public override object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color? color = ColorUtilities.ColorFromObject(value);
			if (!color.HasValue)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color2 = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb((byte)CoreUtilities.Clamp((double)(int)color.Value.A * Opacity, 0.0, 255.0), color.Value.R, color.Value.G, color.Value.B);
			if (targetType == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush))
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush
				{
					Color = color2
				};
			}
			return color2;
		}

		public override object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
		}
	}
	public class CoreUtilities

		internal class AggregateEnumerable<T> : IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
		{
			public class Enumerator : IEnumerator<T>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
			{
				private IEnumerator<IEnumerable<T>> _enumerables;

				private IEnumerator<T> _current;

				public T Current
				{
					get
					{
						if (_current == null)
						{
							return default(T);
						}
						return _current.Current;
					}
				}

				object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

				public Enumerator(params IEnumerable<T>[] enumerables)
					: this((IEnumerable<IEnumerable<T>>)enumerables)
				{
				}

				public Enumerator(IEnumerable<IEnumerable<T>> enumerables)
				{
					_enumerables = enumerables?.GetEnumerator();
				}

				public void Reset()
				{
					if (_enumerables != null)
					{
						_enumerables.Reset();
					}
					_current = null;
				}

				public bool MoveNext()
				{
					if (_current != null && _current.MoveNext())
					{
						return true;
					}
					while (_enumerables != null && _enumerables.MoveNext())
					{
						IEnumerable<T> current = _enumerables.Current;
						if (current != null)
						{
							_current = current.GetEnumerator();
							if (_current.MoveNext())
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
					return false;
				}

				public void Dispose()
				{
				}
			}

			private IEnumerable<IEnumerable<T>> _enumerables;

			public AggregateEnumerable(params IEnumerable<T>[] enumerables)
				: this((IEnumerable<IEnumerable<T>>)enumerables)
			{
			}

			public AggregateEnumerable(IEnumerable<IEnumerable<T>> enumerables)
			{
				_enumerables = enumerables;
			}

			public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
			{
				return new Enumerator(_enumerables);
			}

			IEnumerator<T> IEnumerable<T>.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return new Enumerator(_enumerables);
			}
		}

		internal class WildcardToRegexConverter
		{
			private enum ParseState
			{
				Initial,
				Bracket
			}

			private const string REGEX_SPECIAL_CHARS = "[]{}()\\.+*?^$";

			private string _wildcard;

			private StringBuilder _regex;

			private string _error;

			private bool _nonGreedy;

			private WildcardToRegexConverter(string wildcard)
			{
				_wildcard = wildcard;
				_regex = new StringBuilder(wildcard.Length);
			}

			public static Regex Convert(string wildcard, bool ignoreCase, bool matchWholeText = true)
			{
				Convert(wildcard, out var regex, out var options, out var error, matchWholeText);
				if (error == null)
				{
					if (ignoreCase)
					{
						options |= RegexOptions.IgnoreCase;
					}
					return new Regex(regex, options);
				}
				return null;
			}

			public static void Convert(string wildcard, out string regex, out RegexOptions options, out Exception error, bool matchWholeText = true)
			{
				if (wildcard == null || wildcard.Length == 0)
				{
					options = RegexOptions.None;
					regex = null;
					error = new Exception(SR.GetString("Filter_WildCard_Empty"));
					return;
				}
				WildcardToRegexConverter wildcardToRegexConverter = new WildcardToRegexConverter(wildcard);
				wildcardToRegexConverter._nonGreedy = !matchWholeText;
				wildcardToRegexConverter.Parse();
				if (wildcardToRegexConverter._error == null && wildcardToRegexConverter._regex.Length > 0)
				{
					regex = wildcardToRegexConverter._regex.ToString();
					if (matchWholeText)
					{
						regex = "^" + regex + "$";
					}
					options = RegexOptions.ExplicitCapture | RegexOptions.Singleline;
					error = null;
				}
				else
				{
					error = new Exception(wildcardToRegexConverter._error);
					options = RegexOptions.None;
					regex = null;
				}
			}

			private void Parse()
			{
				ParseState parseState = ParseState.Initial;
				int num = -1;
				StringBuilder regex = _regex;
				string wildcard = _wildcard;
				for (int i = 0; i < wildcard.Length; i++)
				{
					char c = wildcard[i];
					if (ParseState.Bracket == parseState && ']' == c)
					{
						ParseSet(1 + num, i - 1);
						parseState = ParseState.Initial;
					}
					else if (parseState == ParseState.Initial && '[' == c)
					{
						num = i;
						parseState = ParseState.Bracket;
					}
					else if (parseState == ParseState.Initial && '#' == c)
					{
						regex.Append("\\d");
					}
					else if (parseState == ParseState.Initial && '?' == c)
					{
						regex.Append('.');
					}
					else if (parseState == ParseState.Initial && '*' == c)
					{
						regex.Append(".*");
						if (_nonGreedy)
						{
							regex.Append('?');
						}
					}
					else if (parseState == ParseState.Initial)
					{
						if ("[]{}()\\.+*?^$".IndexOf(c) >= 0)
						{
							regex.Append('\\');
						}
						regex.Append(c);
					}
				}
			}

			private void ParseSet(int si, int ei)
			{
				StringBuilder regex = _regex;
				string wildcard = _wildcard;
				int length = regex.Length;
				regex.Append('[');
				if ('!' == wildcard[si])
				{
					if (si == ei)
					{
						_error = SR.GetString("Filter_WildCard_InvalidCharClass");
						return;
					}
					regex.Append('^');
					si++;
				}
				for (int i = si; i <= ei; i++)
				{
					char value = wildcard[i];
					if ("[]{}()\\.+*?^$".IndexOf(value) >= 0)
					{
						regex.Append('\\');
					}
					regex.Append(value);
				}
				regex.Append(']');
			}
		}

		internal class AntirecursionUtility
		{
			private struct ID
			{
				internal object _item;

				internal object _flagId;

				internal ID(object item, object flagId)
				{
					_item = item;
					_flagId = flagId;
				}

				internal static int GetHashCode(object o)
				{
					return o?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
				}

				public override int GetHashCode()
				{
					return GetHashCode(_item) ^ GetHashCode(_flagId);
				}

				public override bool Equals(object obj)
				{
					if (obj is ID iD && iD._item == _item && iD._flagId == _flagId)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			private Dictionary<ID, int> _map;

			private Dictionary<ID, int> Map
			{
				get
				{
					if (_map == null)
					{
						_map = new Dictionary<ID, int>();
					}
					return _map;
				}
			}

			public bool Enter(object item, object flagId, bool disallowMultipleEntries)
			{
				ID key = new ID(item, flagId);
				if (Map.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					if (disallowMultipleEntries)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					value = 0;
				}
				Map[key] = 1 + value;
				return true;
			}

			public void Exit(object item, object flagId)
			{
				ID key = new ID(item, flagId);
				if (_map != null && _map.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value--;
					if (value <= 0)
					{
						_map.Remove(key);
					}
					else
					{
						_map[key] = value;
					}
				}
			}

			public bool InProgress(object item, object flagId)
			{
				if (_map != null)
				{
					return _map.ContainsKey(new ID(item, flagId));
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal class TypedList<T> : IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
		{
			private IList _list;

			internal IList List => _list;

			public T this[int index]
			{
				get
				{
					return (T)_list[index];
				}
				set
				{
					_list[index] = value;
				}
			}

			public int Count => _list.Count;

			public bool IsReadOnly => _list.IsReadOnly;

			internal TypedList(IList list)
			{
				ValidateNotNull(list);
				_list = list;
			}

			public int IndexOf(T item)
			{
				return _list.IndexOf(item);
			}

			public void Insert(int index, T item)
			{
				_list.Insert(index, item);
			}

			public void RemoveAt(int index)
			{
				_list.RemoveAt(index);
			}

			public void Add(T item)
			{
				_list.Add(item);
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				_list.Clear();
			}

			public bool Contains(T item)
			{
				return _list.Contains(item);
			}

			public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
			{
				CoreUtilities.CopyTo((IEnumerable<T>)new TypedEnumerable<T>(_list), array, arrayIndex);
			}

			public bool Remove(T item)
			{
				int num = _list.IndexOf(item);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					_list.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				return num >= 0;
			}

			public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
			{
				return new TypedEnumerable<T>.Enumerator(_list.GetEnumerator());
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return _list.GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		internal class ObservableTypedList<T> : TypedList<T>, INotifyCollectionChanged, INotifyPropertyChanged
		{
			public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

			public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

			internal ObservableTypedList(IList list)
				: base(list)
			{
				if (list is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += OnCollectionChanged;
				}
				if (list is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged += OnCollectionPropertyChanged;
				}
			}

			private void OnCollectionPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, e);
			}

			private void OnCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged?.Invoke(this, e);
			}
		}

		internal static bool AreClose(System.Windows.Point pt1, System.Windows.Point pt2)
		{
			if (AreClose(pt1.X, pt2.X))
			{
				return AreClose(pt1.Y, pt2.Y);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool AreClose(System.Windows.Size x, System.Windows.Size y)
		{
			if (AreClose(x.Width, y.Width))
			{
				return AreClose(x.Height, y.Height);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static int BinarySearch(IList<DateRange> ranges, DateTime date)
		{
			Func<IList<DateRange>, int, DateRange> rangeProviderCallback = (IList<DateRange> list, int index) => ranges[index];
			return BinarySearchDateRange(ranges, rangeProviderCallback, date, ranges.Count);
		}

		internal static int BinarySearchDateRange<T>(IList<T> rangeProviders, Func<IList<T>, int, DateRange> rangeProviderCallback, DateTime date, int count)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = count - 1;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				num3 = (num + num2) / 2;
				DateRange dateRange = rangeProviderCallback(rangeProviders, num3);
				if (dateRange.Start > date)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (dateRange.End <= date)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num3;
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		public static Uri BuildEmbeddedResourceUri(Assembly assembly, string resourcePath)
		{
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("assembly");
			}
			if (resourcePath == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("resourcePath");
			}
			string fullName = assembly.FullName;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(fullName.Length + 15 + resourcePath.Length);
			stringBuilder.Append('/');
			stringBuilder.Append(fullName);
			stringBuilder.Append(";component/");
			stringBuilder.Append(resourcePath);
			return new Uri(stringBuilder.ToString(), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
		}

		}

		internal static TypeConverterInfo GetTypeConverterInfo(Type objectType, Type convertToType)
		{
			if (_lastInfoObjectType == objectType && _lastInfoConvertToType == convertToType)
			{
				return _lastTypeConverterInfo;
			}
			TypeConverter typeConverter = null;
			TypeConverter typeConverter2 = null;
			typeConverter = ((null != objectType) ? TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(objectType) : null);
			typeConverter2 = ((null != convertToType) ? TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(convertToType) : null);
			if (typeConverter != null || typeConverter2 != null)
			{
				bool isPrimitive = objectType.IsPrimitive;
				bool useConvertFromTypeConverterFirst = null != objectType && !isPrimitive;
				TypeConverterInfo typeConverterInfo = new TypeConverterInfo(typeConverter2, typeConverter, useConvertFromTypeConverterFirst);
				_lastInfoObjectType = objectType;
				_lastInfoConvertToType = convertToType;
				_lastTypeConverterInfo = typeConverterInfo;
				return typeConverterInfo;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static object ConvertDataValue(object valueToConvert, Type convertToType, IFormatProvider formatProvider, string format)
		{
			return ConvertDataValue(valueToConvert, convertToType, formatProvider, format, useTypeConverters: true);
		}

		internal static object ConvertDataValue(object valueToConvert, Type convertToType, IFormatProvider formatProvider, string format, bool useTypeConverters)
		{
			object obj = null;
			Type underlyingType = GetUnderlyingType(convertToType);
			if (IsNull(valueToConvert))
			{
				obj = valueToConvert;
			}
			else if (null != underlyingType)
			{
				if (valueToConvert.GetType() == underlyingType || underlyingType.IsInstanceOfType(valueToConvert))
				{
					return valueToConvert;
				}
				if (obj == null)
				{
					TypeConverterInfo typeConverterInfo = (useTypeConverters ? GetTypeConverterInfo(valueToConvert.GetType(), convertToType) : null);
					if (typeConverterInfo != null)
					{
						if (typeof(string) == underlyingType)
						{
							try
							{
								obj = ToString(valueToConvert, format, formatProvider, ignoreFormatIfEmpty: true);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
						for (int i = 0; i <= 1; i++)
						{
							if (obj == null && ((i == 0 && typeConverterInfo.useConvertFromTypeConverterFirst) || (1 == i && !typeConverterInfo.useConvertFromTypeConverterFirst)))
							{
								try
								{
									if (typeConverterInfo.convertFromTypeConverter != null && typeConverterInfo.convertFromTypeConverter.CanConvertFrom(valueToConvert.GetType()))
									{
										obj = typeConverterInfo.convertFromTypeConverter.ConvertFrom(null, formatProvider as CultureInfo, valueToConvert);
									}
								}
								catch (Exception)
								{
								}
							}
							if (obj != null || ((i != 0 || typeConverterInfo.useConvertFromTypeConverterFirst) && (1 != i || !typeConverterInfo.useConvertFromTypeConverterFirst)))
							{
								continue;
							}
							try
							{
								if (typeConverterInfo.convertToTypeConverter != null && typeConverterInfo.convertToTypeConverter.CanConvertTo(underlyingType))
								{
									obj = typeConverterInfo.convertToTypeConverter.ConvertTo(null, formatProvider as CultureInfo, valueToConvert, underlyingType);
								}
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (obj == null && typeof(Uri) == underlyingType)
				{
					try
					{
						obj = new Uri(valueToConvert.ToString());
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (obj == null && typeof(string) == underlyingType)
				{
					try
					{
						obj = ToString(valueToConvert, format, formatProvider, ignoreFormatIfEmpty: false);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				bool isEnum = underlyingType.IsEnum;
				if (obj == null && isEnum)
				{
					Type underlyingType2 = Enum.GetUnderlyingType(underlyingType);
					object value = valueToConvert;
					if (underlyingType2 != valueToConvert.GetType())
					{
						value = ConvertDataValue(valueToConvert, underlyingType2, formatProvider, format) ?? valueToConvert;
					}
					try
					{
						if (Enum.IsDefined(underlyingType, value))
						{
							if (valueToConvert is string)
							{
								try
								{
									obj = Enum.Parse(underlyingType, (string)valueToConvert, ignoreCase: false);
								}
								catch
								{
								}
							}
							if (obj == null)
							{
								obj = Enum.ToObject(underlyingType, valueToConvert);
							}
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (obj == null && valueToConvert is IConvertible)
				{
					string text = valueToConvert as string;
					if (lastNonConvertibleDataType != underlyingType || text == null)
					{
						if (obj == null)
						{
							try
							{
								obj = Convert.ChangeType(valueToConvert, underlyingType, formatProvider);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
								if (text != null && !typeof(IConvertible).IsAssignableFrom(underlyingType))
								{
									lastNonConvertibleDataType = underlyingType;
								}
							}
						}
						if (obj == null)
						{
							try
							{
								obj = Convert.ChangeType(valueToConvert, underlyingType);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (obj == null && typeof(string) == underlyingType)
				{
					try
					{
						if (obj == null)
						{
							obj = valueToConvert.ToString();
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		internal static bool IntersectsWith(Rect rect1, Rect rect2)
		{
			Rect rect3 = Rect.Intersect(rect1, rect2);
			if (rect3.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect3.Y == rect1.Bottom || rect3.Y == rect2.Bottom)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect3.X == rect1.Right || rect3.X == rect2.Right)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

			if (type.IsPrimitive || typeof(decimal) == type || typeof(string) == type || typeof(DateTime) == type || typeof(DayOfWeek) == type || typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color) == type || typeof(System.Drawing.Color) == type || typeof(Visual).IsAssignableFrom(type) || typeof(Animatable).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void Normalize(ref DateTime start, ref DateTime end)
		{
			if (end < start)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = start;
				start = end;
				end = dateTime;
			}
		}

		internal static double RoundToIntegralValue(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				double num = Math.Ceiling(value);
				if (value - num <= -0.5)
				{
					return num - 1.0;
				}
				return num;
			}
			double num2 = Math.Floor(value);
			if (value - num2 >= 0.5)
			{
				return num2 + 1.0;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		public static void SortMerge(object[] array, IComparer comparer)

		{
			SortMerge(array, tempArray, comparer, 0, array.Length - 1);
		}

		public static void SortMerge(object[] array, object[] tempArray, IComparer comparer, int si, int ei)
		{
			if (array == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("array");
			}
			if (comparer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("comparer");
			}
			if (tempArray == null)
			{
				tempArray = (object[])array.Clone();
			}
			else
			{
				Array.Copy(array, tempArray, array.Length);
			}
			SortMergeHelper(array, tempArray, new ComparerWrapper<object>(comparer), si, ei);
		}

		public static void SortMergeGeneric<T>(List<T> list, IComparer<T> comparer)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("list");
			}
			if (comparer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("comparer");
			}
			T[] array = list.ToArray();
			SortMergeGeneric(array, null, comparer);
			list.Clear();
			list.AddRange(array);
		}

		public static void SortMergeGeneric<T>(List<T> list, IComparer<T> comparer, int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("list");
			}
			if (comparer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("comparer");
			}
			T[] array = new T[1 + endIndex - startIndex];
			list.CopyTo(startIndex, array, 0, array.Length);
			SortMergeGeneric(array, null, comparer);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				list[startIndex + i] = array[i];
			}
		}

		public static void SortMergeGeneric<T>(T[] array, IComparer<T> comparer)
		{
			SortMergeGeneric(array, null, comparer);
		}

		public static void SortMergeGeneric<T>(T[] array, T[] tempArray, IComparer<T> comparer)
		{
			SortMergeGeneric(array, tempArray, comparer, 0, array.Length - 1);
		}

		public static void SortMergeGeneric<T>(T[] array, T[] tempArray, IComparer<T> comparer, int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			if (array == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("arr");
			}
			if (comparer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("comparer");
			}
			if (tempArray == null)
			{
				tempArray = (T[])array.Clone();
			}
			else
			{
				Array.Copy(array, tempArray, array.Length);
			}
			SortMergeHelper(array, tempArray, comparer, startIndex, endIndex);
		}

		private static void SortMergeHelper<T>(T[] arr, T[] tmpArr, IComparer<T> comparer, int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			T val = default(T);
			T val2 = default(T);
			int i;
			int num;
			if (endIndex - startIndex < 6)
			{
				for (i = 1 + startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
				{
					val = arr[i];
					for (num = i; num > startIndex; num--)
					{
						val2 = arr[num - 1];
						if (comparer.Compare(val, val2) >= 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						arr[num] = val2;
					}
					if (i != num)
					{
						arr[num] = val;
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			int num2 = (startIndex + endIndex) / 2;
			SortMergeHelper(tmpArr, arr, comparer, startIndex, num2);
			SortMergeHelper(tmpArr, arr, comparer, 1 + num2, endIndex);
			i = startIndex;
			num = 1 + num2;
			for (int j = startIndex; j <= endIndex; j++)
			{
				if (i <= num2)
				{
					val = tmpArr[i];
				}
				if (num <= endIndex)
				{
					val2 = tmpArr[num];
				}
				if (num > endIndex || (i <= num2 && comparer.Compare(val, val2) <= 0))
				{
					arr[j] = val;
					i++;
				}
				else
				{
					arr[j] = val2;
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static byte[] ReadData(Stream stream)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			stream.CopyTo(memoryStream);
			byte[] result = memoryStream.ToArray();
			memoryStream.Dispose();
			return result;
		}

		internal static string ToString(object value, string format, IFormatProvider provider, bool ignoreFormatIfEmpty)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (provider != null && provider.GetFormat(typeof(ICustomFormatter)) is ICustomFormatter customFormatter)
			{
				text = customFormatter.Format(format, value, provider);
			}
			if (text == null && value is IFormattable && (!ignoreFormatIfEmpty || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(format)))
			{
				text = ((IFormattable)value).ToString(format, provider);
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static bool IsEnumFlags(Type enumType)
		{
			object[] customAttributes = enumType.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(FlagsAttribute), inherit: true);
			if (customAttributes != null)
			{
				return customAttributes.Length != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void ValidateEnum(Type enumType, object enumVal)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(enumType, enumVal) && !IsEnumFlags(enumType))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(enumType.Name, (int)enumVal, enumType);
			}
		}

		internal static void ValidateEnum(string argumentName, Type enumType, object enumVal)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(enumType, enumVal) && !IsEnumFlags(enumType))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(argumentName, (int)enumVal, enumType);
			}
		}

		internal static bool AreClose(double value1, double value2)
		{
			if (value1 == value2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Math.Abs(value1 - value2) < 1E-10;
		}

		internal static bool LessThan(double x, double y)
		{
			if (x < y)
			{
				return !AreClose(x, y);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool GreaterThan(double x, double y)
		{
			if (x > y)
			{
				return !AreClose(x, y);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool LessThanOrClose(double x, double y)
		{
			if (!(x <= y))
			{
				return AreClose(x, y);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool GreaterThanOrClose(double x, double y)
		{
			if (!(x >= y))
			{
				return AreClose(x, y);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool AreEqual<T>(IList<T> items1, IList<T> items2, IEqualityComparer<T> comparer = null)
		{
			if (items1 == items2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (items1 == null || items2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (items1.Count != items2.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (comparer == null)
			{
				comparer = EqualityComparer<T>.Default;
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = items1.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!comparer.Equals(items1[i], items2[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static int BinarySearch<T>(IList<T> list, T item, IComparer<T> comparer, bool ignoreItem)
		{
			if (comparer == null)
			{
				comparer = Comparer<T>.Default;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = list.Count - 1;
			int num3 = 0;
			EqualityComparer<T> equalityComparer = ((!ignoreItem) ? null : EqualityComparer<T>.Default);
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				num3 = (num + num2) / 2;
				T val = list[num3];
				if (equalityComparer != null && equalityComparer.Equals(item, val))
				{
					if (num3 > num)
					{
						val = list[--num3];
					}
					else
					{
						if (num3 >= num2)
						{
							return num3;
						}
						val = list[++num3];
					}
				}
				int num4 = comparer.Compare(val, item);
				if (num4 > 0)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num3;
			}
			if (equalityComparer != null && num < list.Count - 1 && equalityComparer.Equals(item, list[num]))
			{
				return num;
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		internal static int BinarySearch<TItem, TComparison>(IList<TItem> items, Func<TItem, TComparison, int> comparer, TComparison value)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = items.Count - 1;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				num3 = (num + num2) / 2;
				TItem arg = items[num3];
				int num4 = comparer(arg, value);
				if (num4 > 0)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num3;
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		internal static double Clamp(double value, double min, double max)
		{
			if (value < min)
			{
				return min;
			}
			if (value > max)
			{
				return max;

		}

		internal static void CopyTo<T>(IEnumerable<T> source, T[] dest, int destStartIndex)
		{
			if (source is ICollection<T> collection)
			{
				collection.CopyTo(dest, destStartIndex);
				return;
			}
			foreach (T item in source)
			{
				dest[destStartIndex++] = item;
			}
		}

		internal static void CopyTo(IEnumerable source, Array dest, int destStartIndex)
		{
			foreach (object item in source)
			{
				dest.SetValue(item, destStartIndex++);
			}
		}

		internal static T GetFirstItem<T>(IEnumerable<T> e)
		{
			if (e != null)
			{
				using IEnumerator<T> enumerator = e.GetEnumerator();
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		internal static T GetFirstItem<T>(IEnumerable e, bool optimized)
		{
			if (e != null)
			{
				if (optimized)
				{
					if (e is IList<T> list)
					{
						if (list.Count <= 0)
						{
							return default(T);
						}
						return list[0];
					}
					if (e is IList list2)
					{
						if (list2.Count <= 0)
						{
							return default(T);
						}
						return (T)list2[0];
					}
				}
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator = e.GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						if (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							return (T)enumerator.Current;
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		internal static List<T> GetEnumValues<T>() where T : struct
		{
			return (from f in typeof(T).GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public)
				where f.IsLiteral
				select (T)f.GetValue(null)).ToList();
		}

		public static Type GetUnderlyingType(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type);
			if (underlyingType != null)
			{
				type = underlyingType;
			}
			return type;
		}

		public static object GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(WeakReference weakReference)
		{
			if (weakReference != null)

				try
				{
					return weakReference.Target;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool HasItems(IEnumerable e)
		{
			if (e != null)
			{
				if (e is ICollection)
				{
					return ((ICollection)e).Count > 0;
				}
				if (e != null)
				{
					{
						IEnumerator enumerator = e.GetEnumerator();
						try
						{
							if (enumerator.MoveNext())
							{
								object current = enumerator.Current;
								return true;
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
							if (disposable != null)
							{
								disposable.Dispose();
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("Collection is read-only.");
		}

		public static void RemoveAll<T>(List<T> list, T itemToRemove)
		{
			int num = RemoveAllHelper(list, itemToRemove);
			list.RemoveRange(num, list.Count - num);
		}

		public static void RemoveAll<T>(IList<T> list, T itemToRemove)
		{
			int num = RemoveAllHelper(list, itemToRemove);
			for (int num2 = list.Count - 1; num2 >= num; num2--)
			{
				list.RemoveAt(num2);
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveAll<T>(ObservableCollectionExtended<T> list, T itemToRemove)
		{
			list.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				int num = RemoveAllHelper(list, itemToRemove);
				list.RemoveRange(num, list.Count - num);
			}
			finally
			{
				list.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private static int RemoveAllHelper<T>(IList<T> list, T itemToRemove)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int count = list.Count;
			EqualityComparer<T> equalityComparer = EqualityComparer<T>.Default;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (equalityComparer.Equals(list[i], itemToRemove))
				{
					num++;
				}
				else if (num != 0)
				{
					list[i - num] = list[i];
				}
			}
			return count - num;
		}

		internal static void ValidateIsNotNegative(double value)

		internal static void ValidateNotNull(object value, string paramName)

	[TypeConverter(typeof(DateRangeConverter))]
	public struct DateRange : IEquatable<DateRange>, IComparable<DateRange>
	{
		private DateTime _start;

		private DateTime _end;

		private static readonly DateRange _Infinite = new DateRange(DateTime.MinValue, DateTime.MaxValue);

		public static DateRange Infinite => _Infinite;

		public bool IsEmpty => _start == _end;

		public DateTime Start
		{
			get
			{
				return _start;
			}
			set
			{
				_start = value;
			}
		}

		public DateTime End
		{
			get
			{
				return _end;
			}
			set
			{
				_end = value;
			}
		}

		public DateRange(DateTime date)
			: this(date, date)
		{
		}

		public DateRange(DateTime start, DateTime end)
		{
			_start = start;
			_end = end;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _start.GetHashCode() ^ _end.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DateRange)
			{
				return this == (DateRange)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DateRange range1, DateRange range2)
		{
			if (range1._start == range2._start)
			{
				return range1._end == range2._end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DateRange range1, DateRange range2)
		{
			return !(range1 == range2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(null);
		}

		public string ToString(string format)
		{
			return ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, format, allowConvertToUniversal: false);
		}

		public bool Contains(DateTime date)
		{
			DateRange dateRange = Normalize(this);
			if (date >= dateRange._start)
			{
				return date <= dateRange._end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(DateRange range)
		{
			range.Normalize();
			DateRange dateRange = Normalize(this);
			if (range._start >= dateRange._start)
			{
				return range._end <= dateRange._end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Intersect(DateRange range)
		{
			range.Normalize();
			DateRange dateRange = Normalize(this);
			if (dateRange._end < range._start || dateRange._start > range._end)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (range._start > dateRange._start)
			{
				_start = range._start;
			}
			else
			{
				_start = dateRange._start;
			}
			if (range._end < dateRange._end)
			{
				_end = range._end;
			}
			else
			{
				_end = dateRange._end;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IntersectsWith(DateRange range)
		{
			range.Normalize();
			DateRange dateRange = Normalize(this);
			if (!(dateRange._end < range._start))
			{
				return !(dateRange._start > range._end);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Offset(TimeSpan offset)
		{
			_start += offset;
			_end += offset;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void Normalize()
		{
			if (_end < _start)
			{
				DateTime start = _start;
				_start = _end;
				_end = start;
			}
		}

		public static DateRange Normalize(DateRange range)
		{
			range.Normalize();
			return range;
		}

		public void RemoveTime()
		{
			_start = _start.Date;
			_end = _end.Date;
		}

		internal static DateRange[] CombineRanges(params ICollection<DateRange>[] ranges)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ICollection<DateRange> collection in ranges)
			{
				num += collection.Count;
			}
			DateRange[] array = new DateRange[num];
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (ICollection<DateRange> collection2 in ranges)
			{
				collection2.CopyTo(array, num2);
				num2 += collection2.Count;
			}
			if (array.Length < 2)
			{
				return array;
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
			{
				array[k].Normalize();
			}
			Array.Sort(array);
			int num3 = -1;
			for (int l = 0; l < array.Length; l++)
			{
				DateRange dateRange = array[l];
				if (num3 >= 0 && dateRange.Start <= array[num3].End)
				{
					if (dateRange.End > array[num3].End)
					{
						array[num3].End = dateRange.End;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num3++;
					array[num3] = dateRange;
				}
			}
			Array.Resize(ref array, num3 + 1);
			return array;
		}

		internal bool ContainsExclusive(DateTime date)
		{
			if (date >= _start)
			{
				return date < _end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool Intersect(DateRange range, bool normalizeIntersection)
		{
			bool flag = !normalizeIntersection && _start > _end;
			if (!Intersect(range))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				CoreUtilities.Swap(ref _start, ref _end);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IntersectsWithExclusive(DateRange range)
		{
			range.Normalize();
			DateRange dateRange = Normalize(this);
			if (!(dateRange._end <= range._start))
			{
				return !(dateRange._start >= range._end);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static DateRange FromString(string value, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			culture = culture ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			string[] array = value.Split('-');
			if (array.Length >= 1 && array.Length <= 2)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string text in array2)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || text.Trim().Length == 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					bool flag2 = array.Length == 2;
					DateTime end = DateTime.MinValue;
					if (!DateTime.TryParseExact(array[0], "r", culture, DateTimeStyles.AllowWhiteSpaces | DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal, out var result))
					{
						if (!DateTime.TryParseExact(array[0], "d", culture, DateTimeStyles.AllowWhiteSpaces, out result))
						{
							result = DateTime.Parse(array[0], culture);
							if (flag2)
							{
								end = DateTime.Parse(array[1], culture);
							}
						}
						else if (flag2)
						{
							end = DateTime.ParseExact(array[1], "d", culture, DateTimeStyles.AllowWhiteSpaces);
						}
					}
					else if (flag2)
					{
						end = DateTime.ParseExact(array[1], "r", culture, DateTimeStyles.AllowWhiteSpaces | DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal);
					}
					if (!flag2)
					{
						end = result;
					}
					return new DateRange(result, end);
				}
			}
			string message = GetString("LE_InvalidDateRangeString", value);
			throw new FormatException(message);
		}

		internal static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return SR.GetString(name, args);
		}

		internal string ToString(CultureInfo culture, string format, bool allowConvertToUniversal)
		{
			culture = culture ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			bool flag = _start.TimeOfDay != TimeSpan.Zero || _end.TimeOfDay != TimeSpan.Zero;
			if (format == null)
			{
				format = (flag ? "r" : "d");
			}
			DateTime dateTime = _start;
			DateTime dateTime2 = _end;
			if (flag && allowConvertToUniversal)
			{
				dateTime = dateTime.ToUniversalTime();
				dateTime2 = dateTime2.ToUniversalTime();
			}
			if (dateTime == dateTime2)
			{
				return dateTime.ToString(format, culture);
			}
			return dateTime.ToString(format, culture) + "-" + dateTime2.ToString(format, culture);
		}

		public bool Equals(DateRange other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}

		public int CompareTo(DateRange other)
		{
			int num = DateTime.Compare(_start, other._start);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num = DateTime.Compare(_end, other._end);
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class DateRangeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(value, "value");
			string text = value as string;
			if (text == null)
			{
				GetConvertFromException(value);
			}
			return DateRange.FromString(text, culture);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(value, "value");
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(destinationType, "destinationType");
			if (!(value is DateRange))
			{
				GetConvertToException(value, destinationType);
			}
			DateRange dateRange = (DateRange)value;
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return dateRange.ToString(culture, null, allowConvertToUniversal: true);
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				if (dateRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					return new InstanceDescriptor(typeof(DateRange).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(DateTime) }), new object[1] { dateRange.Start });
				}
				return new InstanceDescriptor(typeof(DateRange).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(DateTime),
					typeof(DateTime)
				}), new object[2] { dateRange.Start, dateRange.End });
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(DateRange.GetString("LE_CannotConvertType", typeof(DateRange), CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(destinationType).FullName));
		}
	}
	internal class DeferredOperation
	{
		private DispatcherSynchronizationContext _pendingContext;

		private Action _deferredAction;

		private bool _isPerformingAction;

		internal bool IsOperationPending => _pendingContext != null;

		internal bool IsPerformingAction => _isPerformingAction;

		internal DeferredOperation(Action deferredAction)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(deferredAction);
			_deferredAction = deferredAction;
		}

		internal void InvokePendingOperation()
		{
			if (_pendingContext == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_pendingContext = null;
			bool isPerformingAction = _isPerformingAction;
			_isPerformingAction = true;
			try
			{
				_deferredAction();
			}
			finally
			{
				_isPerformingAction = isPerformingAction;
			}
		}

		internal void CancelPendingOperation()
		{
			if (_pendingContext != null)
			{
				_pendingContext = null;
			}
		}

		internal void StartAsyncOperation()
		{
			if (_pendingContext == null)
			{
				_pendingContext = new DispatcherSynchronizationContext();
				_pendingContext.Post(OnAsyncCallback, _pendingContext);
			}
		}

		private void OnAsyncCallback(object state)
		{
			if (state == _pendingContext)
			{
				InvokePendingOperation();
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class DependencyObjectNotifier : DependencyObject, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private PropertyChangedEventHandler _propertyChangedHandler;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged
		{
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.Synchronized)]
			add
			{
				_propertyChangedHandler = Delegate.Combine(_propertyChangedHandler, value) as PropertyChangedEventHandler;
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.Synchronized)]
			remove
			{
				_propertyChangedHandler = Delegate.Remove(_propertyChangedHandler, value) as PropertyChangedEventHandler;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			_propertyChangedHandler?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected void RaisePropertyChangedEvent(string propertyName)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(propertyName);
		}

		[Obsolete("Notifications for nested property has been deprecated. To raise a property change notification for a non-nested property, use the OnPropertyChanged method.", true)]
		protected void RaisePropertyChangedEvent(string propertyName, object nestedSender, PropertyChangedEventArgs nestedArgs)
		{
		}
	}

	internal static class DependencyPropertyUtilities
	{
		[Flags]
		internal enum MetadataOptionFlags
		{
			None = 0,
			BindsTwoWayByDefault = 1,
			Journal = 2
		}

		private static readonly object MissingValue = DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<Type, TypeConverter> _typeConverterCache;

		[Conditional("TYPECONVERTER_MISSING")]
		internal static void CoerceUsingTypeConverter<T>(ref T value, Type typeConverterType)
		{
			if ((object)typeof(T) == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_typeConverterCache == null)
			{
				_typeConverterCache = new Dictionary<Type, TypeConverter>();
			}
			if (!_typeConverterCache.TryGetValue(typeConverterType, out var value2))
			{
				try
				{
					value2 = (TypeConverter)Activator.CreateInstance(typeConverterType);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				_typeConverterCache[typeConverterType] = value2;
			}
			if (value2 != null && value2.CanConvertFrom(value.GetType()))
			{
				value = (T)value2.ConvertFrom(value);
			}
		}

		internal static PropertyMetadata CreateMetadata(object defaultValue)
		{
			return CreateMetadata(defaultValue, null);
		}

		internal static PropertyMetadata CreateMetadata(PropertyChangedCallback propertyChangeCallback)
		{
			return CreateMetadata(MissingValue, propertyChangeCallback);
		}

		internal static PropertyMetadata CreateMetadata(object defaultValue, PropertyChangedCallback propertyChangeCallback)
		{
			return CreateMetadata(defaultValue, propertyChangeCallback, MetadataOptionFlags.None);
		}

		internal static PropertyMetadata CreateMetadata(object defaultValue, PropertyChangedCallback propertyChangeCallback, MetadataOptionFlags flags)
		{
			FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions frameworkPropertyMetadataOptions = FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None;
			if (flags != MetadataOptionFlags.None)
			{
				if ((flags & MetadataOptionFlags.BindsTwoWayByDefault) == MetadataOptionFlags.BindsTwoWayByDefault)
				{
					frameworkPropertyMetadataOptions |= FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault;
				}
				if ((flags & MetadataOptionFlags.Journal) == MetadataOptionFlags.Journal)
				{
					frameworkPropertyMetadataOptions |= FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Journal;
				}
			}
			if (defaultValue == MissingValue)
			{
				if (frameworkPropertyMetadataOptions == FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None)
				{
					return new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(propertyChangeCallback);
				}
				return new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, frameworkPropertyMetadataOptions, propertyChangeCallback);
			}
			return new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(defaultValue, frameworkPropertyMetadataOptions, propertyChangeCallback);
		}

		internal static PropertyChangedCallback CreateTypeConverterCallbackWrapper<T>(PropertyChangedCallback callback)
		{
			return callback;
		}

		public static object GetDefaultValue(DependencyObject d, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			if (d != null)
			{
				return GetDefaultValue(d.GetType(), dp);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static object GetDefaultValue(Type type, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			PropertyMetadata propertyMetadata = dp.GetMetadata(type);
			if (propertyMetadata == null)
			{
				propertyMetadata = dp.DefaultMetadata;
			}
			object obj = propertyMetadata?.DefaultValue;
			if (DependencyProperty.UnsetValue == obj)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		internal static string GetName(DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			return dp.Name;
		}

		internal static string GetName(DependencyObject d, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			return dp.Name;
		}

		internal static Type GetType(DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			return dp.PropertyType;
		}

		internal static DependencyProperty Register(string name, Type propertyType, Type ownerType, object defaultValue, PropertyChangedCallback propertyChangeCallback)
		{
			PropertyMetadata metadata = ((propertyChangeCallback != null) ? CreateMetadata(defaultValue, propertyChangeCallback) : CreateMetadata(defaultValue));
			return Register(name, propertyType, ownerType, metadata, isAttached: false);
		}

		internal static DependencyProperty Register(string name, Type propertyType, Type ownerType, PropertyMetadata metadata)
		{
			return Register(name, propertyType, ownerType, metadata, isAttached: false);
		}

		private static DependencyProperty Register(string name, Type propertyType, Type ownerType, PropertyMetadata metadata, bool isAttached)
		{
			return isAttached ? DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached(name, propertyType, ownerType, metadata) : DependencyProperty.Register(name, propertyType, ownerType, metadata);
		}

		internal static DependencyProperty RegisterAttached(string name, Type propertyType, Type ownerType, PropertyMetadata metadata)
		{
			return Register(name, propertyType, ownerType, metadata, isAttached: true);
		}

		internal static DependencyPropertyKey RegisterAttachedReadOnly(string name, Type propertyType, Type ownerType, object defaultValue, PropertyChangedCallback changeCallback)
		{
			return RegisterReadOnly(name, propertyType, ownerType, defaultValue, changeCallback, isAttached: true);
		}

		internal static DependencyPropertyKey RegisterReadOnly(string name, Type propertyType, Type ownerType, object defaultValue, PropertyChangedCallback changeCallback)
		{
			return RegisterReadOnly(name, propertyType, ownerType, defaultValue, changeCallback, isAttached: false);
		}

		internal static DependencyPropertyKey RegisterReadOnly(string name, Type propertyType, Type ownerType, object defaultValue, PropertyChangedCallback changeCallback, bool isAttached)
		{
			PropertyMetadata propertyMetadata = CreateMetadata(defaultValue, changeCallback);
			return isAttached ? DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly(name, propertyType, ownerType, propertyMetadata) : DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly(name, propertyType, ownerType, propertyMetadata);
		}

		internal static void SetCurrentValue(DependencyObject d, DependencyProperty property, object newValue)
		{
			d.SetCurrentValue(property, newValue);
		}

		public static bool ShouldSerialize(DependencyObject d, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			object defaultValue = GetDefaultValue(d, dp);
			object value = d.GetValue(dp);
			return !object.Equals(defaultValue, value);
		}
