	internal class FileDownloader
	{
		private Uri _uri;

		private FileDownloadStatus _status;

		private byte[] _downloadedData;

		private Exception _error;

		private CancellationTokenSource _cancellationTokenSource;

		private WebRequest _request;

		private SynchronizationContext _syncContext;

		internal byte[] DownloadedData => _downloadedData;

		internal Exception Error => _error;

		internal FileDownloadStatus Status => _status;

		internal Uri Uri => _uri;

		internal FileDownloader(string uri, CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = null)
			: this((uri != null) ? new Uri(uri, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute) : null, cancellationTokenSource)
		{
		}

		internal FileDownloader(Uri uri, CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = null)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("uri");
			}
			_uri = uri;
			_cancellationTokenSource = cancellationTokenSource;
		}

		public void DownloadData(int millisecondsTimeout = -1)
		{
			ManualResetEventSlim resetEvent = new ManualResetEventSlim();
			BeginDownload(delegate
			{
				resetEvent.Set();
			}, millisecondsTimeout);
			if (!resetEvent.Wait(millisecondsTimeout))
			{
				_request = null;
				if (_status == FileDownloadStatus.Downloading)
				{
					_status = FileDownloadStatus.TimedOut;
					_error = new TimeoutException($"Download of '{_uri.ToString()}' timed out at {Math.Ceiling((double)millisecondsTimeout / 1000.0)} seconds");
				}
			}
		}

		public void DownloadDataAsync(Action<FileDownloader> completedCallback, int millisecondsTimeout = -1)
		{
			_syncContext = SynchronizationContext.Current;
			BeginDownload(completedCallback, millisecondsTimeout);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDownloadCompleted()
		{
		}

		private void BeginDownload(Action<FileDownloader> completedCallback, int millisecondsTimeout)
		{
			if (_status != FileDownloadStatus.NotStarted && _status != FileDownloadStatus.TimedOut)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Download already started");
			}
			if (_request != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Download already started");
			}
			_status = FileDownloadStatus.Downloading;
			CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = _cancellationTokenSource ?? new CancellationTokenSource();
			CancellationToken token = cancellationTokenSource.Token;
			if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
			{
				_status = FileDownloadStatus.Canceled;
				ProcessCompleted(completedCallback);
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				_request = WebRequest.Create(_uri);
				if (_request == null)
				{
					_status = FileDownloadStatus.Failed;
					_error = new Exception("Could not create WebRequest");
					ProcessCompleted(completedCallback);
					return;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception error)
			{
				_status = FileDownloadStatus.Failed;
				_error = error;
				ProcessCompleted(completedCallback);
				return;
			}
			_request.Timeout = millisecondsTimeout;
			token.Register(delegate
			{
				try
				{
					if (_request != null)
					{
						_request.Abort();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			});
			try
			{
				_request.BeginGetResponse(delegate(IAsyncResult r)
				{
					try
					{
						if (_request != null)
						{
							if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
							{
								_request = null;
								_status = FileDownloadStatus.Canceled;
							}
							else
							{
								using WebResponse webResponse = _request.EndGetResponse(r);
								_request = null;
								_downloadedData = CoreUtilities.ReadData(webResponse.GetResponseStream());
								_status = FileDownloadStatus.Complete;
							}
							ProcessCompleted(completedCallback);
						}
					}
					catch (Exception e2)
					{
						ProcessException(completedCallback, token, e2);
					}
				}, null);
			}
			catch (Exception e)
			{
				ProcessException(completedCallback, token, e);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessCompleted(Action<FileDownloader> completedCallback)
		{
			if (_syncContext != null)
			{
				_syncContext.Send(NotifyCompleted, completedCallback);
			}
			else
			{
				NotifyCompleted(completedCallback);
			}
		}

		private void NotifyCompleted(object completedCallback)
		{
			OnDownloadCompleted();
			if (completedCallback != null)
			{
				((Action<FileDownloader>)completedCallback)(this);
			}
		}

		private CancellationToken ProcessException(Action<FileDownloader> completedCallback, CancellationToken token, Exception e)
		{
			_request = null;
			if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
			{
				_status = FileDownloadStatus.Canceled;
			}
			else
			{
				_error = e;
				_status = FileDownloadStatus.Failed;
			}
			ProcessCompleted(completedCallback);
			return token;
		}
	}
	internal enum FileDownloadStatus
	{
		NotStarted,
		Downloading,
		Canceled,
		Failed,
		TimedOut,
		Complete
	}
	internal class GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty> : IEquatable<GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty>>
	{
		public readonly Func<TOwner, TProperty> Getter;

		public readonly Action<TOwner, TProperty> Setter;

		internal readonly string Name;

		internal readonly string DisplayName;

		public GetSetProxy(Func<TOwner, TProperty> getter, Action<TOwner, TProperty> setter, string name, string displayName)
		{
			Getter = getter;
			Setter = setter;
			Name = name;
			DisplayName = displayName;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals(obj as GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty>);
		}

		public bool Equals(GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty> other)
		{
			if (other != null && other.Getter == Getter && other.Setter == Setter && other.Name == Name)
			{
				return other.DisplayName == DisplayName;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (Getter != null)
			{
				num ^= Getter.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (Setter != null)
			{
				num ^= Setter.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (Name != null)
			{
				num ^= Name.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (DisplayName != null)
			{
				num ^= DisplayName.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	internal static class GetSetHelper
	{
		private class PropertyInfoWrapper<TOwner, TProperty>
		{
			private PropertyInfo _property;

			internal PropertyInfoWrapper(PropertyInfo property)
			{
				_property = property;
			}

			public TProperty GetValue(TOwner owner)
			{
				return (TProperty)_property.GetValue(owner, null);
			}

			public void SetValue(TOwner owner, TProperty property)
			{
				_property.SetValue(owner, property, null);
			}
		}

		private struct MemberNameKey : IEquatable<MemberNameKey>
		{
			public Type OwnerType;

			public string MemberName;

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is MemberNameKey)
				{
					return Equals((MemberNameKey)obj);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return OwnerType.GetHashCode() ^ MemberName.GetHashCode();
			}

			public bool Equals(MemberNameKey other)
			{
				if (other.OwnerType == OwnerType)
				{
					return string.CompareOrdinal(other.MemberName, MemberName) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static Dictionary<MemberInfo, object> CachedByMemberInfo = new Dictionary<MemberInfo, object>();

		private static Dictionary<MemberNameKey, object> CachedByMemberName = new Dictionary<MemberNameKey, object>();

		private static MethodInfo _displayAttributeGetNameMethod = null;

		private static bool _skipGetDisplayName;

		public static GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty> Get<TOwner, TProperty>(Expression<Func<TProperty>> getter) where TOwner : class
		{
			if (!(getter.Body is MemberExpression { Member: var member }))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidMemberExpression"), "getter");
			}
			if (!member.DeclaringType.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(TOwner)))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidMemberForTarget", member.Name, CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(typeof(TOwner)).FullName), "getter");
			}
			return Get<TOwner, TProperty>(member);
		}

		public static GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty> Get<TOwner, TProperty>(Expression<Func<TOwner, TProperty>> getter) where TOwner : class
		{
			if (!(getter.Body is MemberExpression memberExpression))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidMemberExpression"), "getter");
			}
			return Get<TOwner, TProperty>(memberExpression.Member);
		}

		public static GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty> Get<TOwner, TProperty>(string memberName) where TOwner : class
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(memberName, "memberName");
			MemberNameKey key = new MemberNameKey
			{
				OwnerType = typeof(TOwner),
				MemberName = memberName
			};
			if (!CachedByMemberName.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				MemberInfo member = GetMember<TOwner>(memberName);
				if (member == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidMemberForTarget", memberName, typeof(TOwner).FullName), "memberName");
				}
				value = (CachedByMemberName[key] = Get<TOwner, TProperty>(member));
			}
			return (GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty>)value;
		}

		public static GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty> Get<TOwner, TProperty>(MemberInfo member) where TOwner : class
		{
			if (!CachedByMemberInfo.TryGetValue(member, out var value))
			{
				value = (CachedByMemberInfo[member] = Create<TOwner, TProperty>(member));
			}
			return (GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty>)value;
		}

		private static GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty> Create<TOwner, TProperty>(MemberInfo memberInfo)
		{
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = memberInfo as PropertyInfo;
			ParameterExpression expression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(memberInfo.DeclaringType, "i");
			if (null != propertyInfo)
			{
				MemberExpression memberExpression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Property(expression, propertyInfo);
				return Create<TOwner, TProperty>(memberExpression, propertyInfo.CanRead, propertyInfo.CanWrite);
			}
			FieldInfo fieldInfo = memberInfo as FieldInfo;
			if (null != fieldInfo)
			{
				MemberExpression memberExpression2 = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Field(expression, fieldInfo);
				return Create<TOwner, TProperty>(memberExpression2, includeGetter: true, !fieldInfo.IsInitOnly && !fieldInfo.IsLiteral);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidMemberForTarget", memberInfo.Name, CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(typeof(TOwner)).FullName));
		}

		private static GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty> Create<TOwner, TProperty>(MemberExpression memberExpression, bool includeGetter, bool includeSetter)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(memberExpression, "memberExpression");
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TProperty);
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeFromHandle, "v");
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression2 = memberExpression.Expression as ParameterExpression;
			System.Linq.Expressions.Expression right = parameterExpression;
			System.Linq.Expressions.Expression expression = memberExpression;
			if (memberExpression.Type != typeFromHandle && typeFromHandle.IsAssignableFrom(memberExpression.Type))
			{
				right = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Convert(parameterExpression, memberExpression.Type);
				expression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Convert(expression, typeFromHandle);
			}
			Action<TOwner, TProperty> setter = null;
			Func<TOwner, TProperty> getter = null;
			try
			{
				setter = ((!includeSetter) ? null : System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<Action<TOwner, TProperty>>(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Assign(memberExpression, right), new ParameterExpression[2] { parameterExpression2, parameterExpression }).Compile());
				getter = ((!includeGetter) ? null : System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<Func<TOwner, TProperty>>(expression, new ParameterExpression[1] { parameterExpression2 }).Compile());
			}
			catch (MissingMemberException)
			{
				if (!(memberExpression.Member is PropertyInfo))
				{
					throw;
				}
				PropertyInfoWrapper<TOwner, TProperty> propertyInfoWrapper = new PropertyInfoWrapper<TOwner, TProperty>(memberExpression.Member as PropertyInfo);
				if (includeSetter)
				{
					setter = propertyInfoWrapper.SetValue;
				}
				if (includeGetter)
				{
					getter = propertyInfoWrapper.GetValue;
				}
			}
			MemberInfo member = memberExpression.Member;
			return new GetSetProxy<TOwner, TProperty>(getter, setter, member.Name, GetDisplayName(member));
		}

		private static string GetDisplayName(MemberInfo member)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!_skipGetDisplayName)
				{
					if (_displayAttributeGetNameMethod != null)
					{
						object[] customAttributes = member.GetCustomAttributes(_displayAttributeGetNameMethod.DeclaringType, inherit: true);
						if (customAttributes != null && customAttributes.Length != 0)
						{
							return _displayAttributeGetNameMethod.Invoke(customAttributes[0], Type.EmptyTypes) as string;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						object[] customAttributes2 = member.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: true);
						if (customAttributes2 != null && customAttributes2.Length != 0)
						{
							object[] array = customAttributes2;
							foreach (object obj in array)
							{
								if (!(obj.GetType().FullName != "System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.DisplayAttribute"))
								{
									try
									{
										_displayAttributeGetNameMethod = obj.GetType().GetMethod("GetName");
										return _displayAttributeGetNameMethod.Invoke(obj, Type.EmptyTypes) as string;
									}
									catch
									{
										_skipGetDisplayName = true;
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				object[] customAttributes3 = member.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DisplayNameAttribute), inherit: true);
				if (customAttributes3 != null && customAttributes3.Length != 0)
				{
					return ((DisplayNameAttribute)customAttributes3[0]).DisplayName;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static MemberInfo GetMember<TOwner>(string memberName)
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TOwner);
			MemberInfo memberInfo = typeFromHandle.GetProperty(memberName, BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy);
			if (null == memberInfo)
			{
				memberInfo = typeFromHandle.GetField(memberName, BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy);
				if (null == memberInfo)
				{
					memberInfo = typeFromHandle.GetProperty(memberName, BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy);
					if (null == memberInfo)
					{
						memberInfo = typeFromHandle.GetField(memberName, BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy);
					}
				}
			}
			return memberInfo;
		}
	}

	internal class ListenerList : List<object>
	{
		private class Enumerable : IEnumerable<object>, IEnumerable
		{
			private class Enumerator : IEnumerator<object>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
			{
				private IList _l;

				private int _index;

				private object _current;

				public object Current => _current;

				object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

				internal Enumerator(IList l)
				{
					_l = l;
					Reset();
				}

				public void Dispose()
				{
				}

				public bool MoveNext()
				{
					_current = null;
					while (_current == null && ++_index < _l.Count)
					{
						_current = GetItemHelper(_l[_index]);
					}
					return _current != null;
				}

				public void Reset()
				{
					_index = -1;
					_current = null;
				}
			}

			private IList _l;

			internal Enumerable(IList l)
			{
				_l = l;
			}

			public IEnumerator<object> GetEnumerator()
			{
				return new Enumerator(_l);
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private int _isTraversingList;

		private ListenerList(int capacity)
			: base(capacity)
		{
		}

		private static object CreateWeakRefHelper(object obj)
		{
			WeakReference weakReference = obj as WeakReference;
			if (weakReference == null)
			{
				weakReference = new WeakReference(obj);
			}
			return weakReference;
		}

		internal static object GetItemHelper(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is WeakReference weakReference)
			{
				return CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(weakReference);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public static object Add(object currentListener, object listener, bool useWeakReference)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(listener);
			object obj = (useWeakReference ? CreateWeakRefHelper(listener) : listener);
			if (currentListener == null)
			{
				return obj;
			}
			ListenerList listenerList = currentListener as ListenerList;
			if (listenerList != null)
			{
				listenerList.Add(obj);
			}
			else
			{
				listenerList = new ListenerList(2);
				listenerList.Add(currentListener);
				listenerList.Add(obj);
			}
			return listenerList;
		}

		public static object Remove(object currentListener, object listener)
		{
			ListenerList listenerList = currentListener as ListenerList;
			if (listenerList != null)
			{
				for (int num = listenerList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (listener == GetItemHelper(listenerList[num]))
					{
						if (listenerList._isTraversingList != 0)
						{
							ListenerList listenerList2 = new ListenerList(listenerList.Count);
							listenerList2.AddRange(listenerList);
							listenerList = listenerList2;
						}
						listenerList.RemoveAt(num);
						break;
					}
				}
				if (1 != listenerList.Count)
				{
					return listenerList;
				}
				return listenerList[0];
			}
			if (GetItemHelper(currentListener) == listener)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return currentListener;
		}

		public static IEnumerable<object> GetListeners(object currentListener)
		{
			if (currentListener is ListenerList l)
			{
				return new Enumerable(l);
			}
			if (currentListener != null)
			{
				return new object[1] { currentListener };
			}
			return new object[0];
		}

		public static void GetListeners(object currentListener, out IEnumerable<object> multiListeners, out object singleListener)
		{
			singleListener = null;
			multiListeners = null;
			if (currentListener is ListenerList l)
			{
				multiListeners = new Enumerable(l);
				return;
			}
			object itemHelper = GetItemHelper(currentListener);
			if (itemHelper != null)
			{
				singleListener = itemHelper;
			}
		}

		internal static void RaisePropertyChanged<TItem, TProperty>(object listeners, TItem sender, TProperty property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (listeners is ListenerList listenerList)
			{
				listenerList._isTraversingList++;
				try
				{
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = listenerList.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						((ITypedPropertyChangeListener<TItem, TProperty>)GetItemHelper(listenerList[i]))?.OnPropertyValueChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
					}
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					listenerList._isTraversingList--;
				}
			}
			if (listeners != null)
			{
				((ITypedPropertyChangeListener<TItem, TProperty>)GetItemHelper(listeners))?.OnPropertyValueChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
			}
		}

		internal static void RaiseValueChanged<TItem>(object listeners, TItem item)
		{
			if (listeners is ListenerList listenerList)
			{
				listenerList._isTraversingList++;
				try
				{
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = listenerList.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						((IValueChangeListener<TItem>)GetItemHelper(listenerList[i]))?.OnValueChanged(item);
					}
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					listenerList._isTraversingList--;
				}
			}
			if (listeners != null)
			{
				((IValueChangeListener<TItem>)GetItemHelper(listeners))?.OnValueChanged(item);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class TypedPropertyChangeListenerList<TItem, TProperty> : ITypedPropertyChangeListener<TItem, TProperty>
	{

		internal TypedPropertyChangeListenerList()
		{
		}

		internal void Add(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<TItem, TProperty> listener, bool useWeakReference)
		{
			_listeners = ListenerList.Add(_listeners, listener, useWeakReference);
		}

		internal void Remove(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<TItem, TProperty> listener)
		{
			_listeners = ListenerList.Remove(_listeners, listener);
		}

		public virtual void OnPropertyValueChanged(TItem sender, TProperty property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (_listeners != null)
			{
				ListenerList.RaisePropertyChanged(_listeners, sender, property, extraInfo);
			}
		}

		public void Compact()
		{
			WeakReference weakReference = _listeners as WeakReference;
			IList list = ((weakReference == null) ? (_listeners as IList) : null);
			PropertyChangeListenerList propertyChangeListenerList = ((list == null) ? (_listeners as PropertyChangeListenerList) : null);
			if (propertyChangeListenerList != null)
			{
				propertyChangeListenerList.Compact();
			}
			else if (list != null)
			{
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					object obj = list[num];
					bool flag = false;
					if (!flag && obj is WeakReference { Target: null })
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (!flag && obj is PropertyChangeListenerBase propertyChangeListenerBase)
					{
						object owner = propertyChangeListenerBase.GetOwner();
						if (!flag && owner is WeakReference { Target: null })
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						list.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				if (_listeners is ListenerList listenerList)
				{
					listenerList.TrimExcess();
				}
			}
			else if (weakReference != null)
			{
				object target = weakReference.Target;
			}
		}
	}

		{

				val.AddListener(listener, useWeakReference);
			}
		}

		{
			if (val is ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications supportPropertyChangeNotifications)

				supportPropertyChangeNotifications.RemoveListener(listener);
			}
			val = newVal;
			if (newVal is ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications supportPropertyChangeNotifications2)
			{
				supportPropertyChangeNotifications2.AddListener(listener, useWeakReference);
			}
		}

	internal class ListParser
	{
		[Flags]
		private enum State
		{
			Initial = 1,
			Escape = 2,
			QuoteOpened = 4,
			QuoteClosed = 8
		}

		private char[] _openQuoteChars;

		private char[] _closeQuoteChars;

		private char _escapeCharacter;

		private char _itemsSeparatorChar;

		private long _mask_allSpecialChars;

		private long _mask_openQuoteChars;

		private long _mask_closeQuoteChars;

		private long _mask_specialCharsWithinQuotes;

		private char[] _allSpecialChars;

		private char[] _specialCharsWithinQuotes;

		public ListParser(char openQuoteChar, char closeQuoteChar, char escapeCharacter, char itemsSeparatorChar)
			: this(new char[1] { openQuoteChar }, new char[1] { closeQuoteChar }, escapeCharacter, itemsSeparatorChar)
		{
		}

		public ListParser(char[] openQuoteChars, char[] closeQuoteChars, char escapeCharacter, char itemsSeparatorChar)
		{
			if (openQuoteChars.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Open quote chars not specified.");
			}
			if (openQuoteChars.Length != closeQuoteChars.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Open and close quote chars must match.");
			}
			_openQuoteChars = openQuoteChars;
			_closeQuoteChars = closeQuoteChars;
			_escapeCharacter = escapeCharacter;
			_itemsSeparatorChar = itemsSeparatorChar;
			_allSpecialChars = Aggregate<char>(openQuoteChars, closeQuoteChars, new char[2] { escapeCharacter, itemsSeparatorChar });
			_specialCharsWithinQuotes = Aggregate<char>(openQuoteChars, closeQuoteChars, new char[1] { escapeCharacter });
			_mask_allSpecialChars = CalcMask(_allSpecialChars);
			_mask_specialCharsWithinQuotes = CalcMask(_specialCharsWithinQuotes);
			_mask_openQuoteChars = CalcMask(_openQuoteChars);
			_mask_closeQuoteChars = CalcMask(_closeQuoteChars);
		}

		private void AddItemHelper(IList<string> itemList, StringBuilder sb, ref int lastEscapedIndexInSB, bool trimTrailingSpaces, bool skipEmptyItems)
		{
			if (trimTrailingSpaces)
			{
				TrimTrailingSpaces(sb, lastEscapedIndexInSB);
			}
			if (sb.Length > 0 || !skipEmptyItems)
			{
				itemList.Add(sb.ToString());
			}
			sb.Remove(0, sb.Length);
			lastEscapedIndexInSB = -1;
		}

		private static T[] Aggregate<T>(params IEnumerable<T>[] collections)
		{
			return new CoreUtilities.AggregateEnumerable<T>(collections).ToArray();
		}

		private void Append_EncloseInQuotes(StringBuilder sb, string item)
		{
			sb.Append(_openQuoteChars[0]);
			string value = EscapeString(item, withinQuotes: true, escapeLeadingAndTrailingWhiteSpace: false);
			sb.Append(value);
			sb.Append(_closeQuoteChars[0]);
		}

		private static long CalcMask(char[] arr)
		{
			long num = 1L;
			for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length; i++)
			{
				long num2 = num * (int)arr[i];
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
					continue;
				}
				num = 0L;
				break;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static bool ContainsCharHelper(char[] arr, char c, long mask)
		{
			if (mask % (int)c == 0L)
			{
				return Array.IndexOf(arr, c) >= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool DoesCharNeedEscaping(char c, bool withinQuotes)
		{
			if (!withinQuotes)
			{
				return DoesCharNeedEscaping(c);
			}
			return DoesCharNeedEscapingWithinQuotes(c);
		}

		private bool DoesCharNeedEscaping(char c)
		{
			return ContainsCharHelper(_allSpecialChars, c, _mask_allSpecialChars);
		}

		private bool DoesCharNeedEscapingWithinQuotes(char c)
		{
			return ContainsCharHelper(_specialCharsWithinQuotes, c, _mask_specialCharsWithinQuotes);
		}

		private char GetCorrespondingCloseQuoteChar(char openQuote)
		{
			char[] openQuoteChars = _openQuoteChars;
			for (int i = 0; i < openQuoteChars.Length; i++)
			{
				if (openQuote == openQuoteChars[i])
				{
					return _closeQuoteChars[i];
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Specified character is not an open quote character.");
		}

		private bool IsCloseQuoteChar(char c)
		{
			return ContainsCharHelper(_closeQuoteChars, c, _mask_closeQuoteChars);
		}

		private bool IsOpenQuoteChar(char c)
		{
			return ContainsCharHelper(_openQuoteChars, c, _mask_openQuoteChars);
		}

		private static void TrimTrailingSpaces(StringBuilder sb, int lastEscapedCharIndex)
		{
			int num = sb.Length - 1;
			while (num >= 0 && num > lastEscapedCharIndex && char.IsWhiteSpace(sb[num]))
			{
				sb.Remove(num, 1);
				num--;
			}
		}

		internal static ListParser CreateDefault(char separatorChar = ',')
		{
			char[] array = new char[2] { '\'', '"' };
			return new ListParser(array, array, '\\', separatorChar);
		}

		public void ConstructList(IEnumerable<string> items, bool separateEachItemBySpace, StringBuilder dest)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string item in items)
			{
				if (num > 0)
				{
					dest.Append(_itemsSeparatorChar);
					if (separateEachItemBySpace)
					{
						dest.Append(' ');
					}
				}
				dest.Append(EscapeString(item, withinQuotes: false, escapeLeadingAndTrailingWhiteSpace: true));
				num++;
			}
		}

		public string ConstructList(IEnumerable<string> items, bool separateEachItemBySpace)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			ConstructList(items, separateEachItemBySpace, stringBuilder);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public string EscapeString(string text, bool withinQuotes, bool escapeLeadingAndTrailingWhiteSpace)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = null;
			int i = 0;
			for (int num = text?.Length ?? 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (DoesCharNeedEscaping(c, withinQuotes) || (escapeLeadingAndTrailingWhiteSpace && (i == 0 || 1 + i == text.Length) && !withinQuotes && char.IsWhiteSpace(c)))
				{
					if (stringBuilder == null)
					{
						stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(text, 0, i, 2 * text.Length - i);
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(_escapeCharacter).Append(c);
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder?.Append(c);
				}
			}
			if (stringBuilder != null)
			{
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal int GetNextSeparator(string text, int startIndex)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int i = startIndex;
			for (int length = text.Length; i < length; i++)
			{
				if (!flag && _itemsSeparatorChar == text[i])
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public string NormalizeEscapement(string text, bool withinQuotes)
		{
			return EscapeString(UnEscapeString(text), withinQuotes, escapeLeadingAndTrailingWhiteSpace: true);
		}

		public void ParseList(string text, bool skipEmptyItems, IList<string> dest)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			State state = State.Initial;
			char c = '\0';
			int lastEscapedIndexInSB = -1;
			int i = 0;
			for (int length = text.Length; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c2 = text[i];
				if (State.Escape == (State.Escape & state))
				{
					lastEscapedIndexInSB = stringBuilder.Length;
					stringBuilder.Append(c2);
					state ^= State.Escape;
				}
				else if (_escapeCharacter == c2)
				{
					state |= State.Escape;
				}
				else if (State.QuoteOpened == (State.QuoteOpened & state) && c2 == c)
				{
					AddItemHelper(dest, stringBuilder, ref lastEscapedIndexInSB, trimTrailingSpaces: false, skipEmptyItems);
					state ^= State.QuoteOpened;
					state |= State.QuoteClosed;
				}
				else if (State.QuoteOpened != (State.QuoteOpened & state) && IsOpenQuoteChar(c2))
				{
					c = GetCorrespondingCloseQuoteChar(c2);
					state |= State.QuoteOpened;
					state &= ~State.QuoteClosed;
				}
				else if (State.QuoteClosed == (State.QuoteClosed & state) && _itemsSeparatorChar == c2)
				{
					state ^= State.QuoteClosed;
				}
				else if (State.QuoteClosed == (State.QuoteClosed & state))
				{
					state ^= State.QuoteClosed;
				}
				else if (State.Initial != state || !char.IsWhiteSpace(c2) || stringBuilder.Length != 0)
				{
					if (State.Initial == state && _itemsSeparatorChar == c2)
					{
						AddItemHelper(dest, stringBuilder, ref lastEscapedIndexInSB, trimTrailingSpaces: true, skipEmptyItems);
						state &= ~State.QuoteClosed;
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(c2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (State.Initial != state && State.Escape != state)
			{
				_ = 4;
			}
			if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				AddItemHelper(dest, stringBuilder, ref lastEscapedIndexInSB, trimTrailingSpaces: true, skipEmptyItems);
			}
		}

		public IList<string> ParseList(string text, bool skipEmptyItems)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			ParseList(text, skipEmptyItems, list);
			return list;
		}

		public string UnEscapeString(string text)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = null;
			int i = 0;
			for (int num = text?.Length ?? 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (_escapeCharacter == c)
				{
					if (stringBuilder == null)
					{
						stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(text, 0, i, text.Length - 1);
					}
					i++;
					if (i < text.Length)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(text[i]);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder?.Append(c);
				}
			}
			if (stringBuilder != null)
			{
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	public class ModifierKeysConverterEx : TypeConverter
	{
		private const char ModifierDelimiter = '+';

		private const ModifierKeys ModifierKeysFlag = ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift | ModifierKeys.Windows;

		private const ModifierKeys ModifierAltKey = ModifierKeys.Alt;

		private const string ModifierAltString = "Alt";

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			return sourceType == typeof(string);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				ModifierKeys modifierKeys = (ModifierKeys)value;
				if (!IsDefinedModifierKeys(modifierKeys))
				{
					throw new Exception(string.Concat("Invalid value ", (int)modifierKeys, " for ", typeof(ModifierKeys), " type"));
				}
				string text = "";
				if ((modifierKeys & ModifierKeys.Control) == ModifierKeys.Control)
				{
					text += MatchModifiers(ModifierKeys.Control);
				}
				if ((modifierKeys & ModifierKeys.Alt) == ModifierKeys.Alt)
				{
					if (text.Length > 0)
					{
						text += "+";
					}
					text += MatchModifiers(ModifierKeys.Alt);
				}
				if ((modifierKeys & ModifierKeys.Windows) == ModifierKeys.Windows)
				{
					if (text.Length > 0)
					{
						text += "+";
					}
					text += MatchModifiers(ModifierKeys.Windows);
				}
				if ((modifierKeys & ModifierKeys.Shift) == ModifierKeys.Shift)
				{
					if (text.Length > 0)
					{
						text += "+";
					}
					text += MatchModifiers(ModifierKeys.Shift);
				}
				return text;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(string.Concat("Cannot convert ModifierKeys to ", destinationType, " type"));
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			if (source is string)
			{
				string modifiersToken = ((string)source).Trim();
				ModifierKeys modifierKeys = GetModifierKeys(modifiersToken, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				return modifierKeys;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(string.Concat("Cannot convert ModifierKeys from ", source.GetType(), " type"));
		}

		private static ModifierKeys GetModifierKeys(string modifiersToken, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ModifierKeys modifierKeys = ModifierKeys.None;
			if (modifiersToken.Length != 0)
			{
				int num = 0;
				do
				{
					num = modifiersToken.IndexOf('+');
					string text = ((num < 0) ? modifiersToken : modifiersToken.Substring(0, num));
					text = text.Trim();
					text = text.ToUpper(culture);
					if (text == string.Empty)
					{
						break;
					}
					switch (text)
					{
					case "NONE":
						modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.None;
						break;
					case "CONTROL":
					case "CTRL":
						modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.Control;
						break;
					case "SHIFT":
						modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.Shift;
						break;
					case "ALT":
					case "MENU":
						modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.Alt;
						break;
					case "WINDOWS":
					case "WIN":
						modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.Windows;
						break;
					default:
						throw new NotSupportedException("Unsupported Modifier Key: " + text);
					}
					modifiersToken = modifiersToken.Substring(num + 1);
				}
				while (num != -1);
			}
			return modifierKeys;
		}

		public static bool IsDefinedModifierKeys(ModifierKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			if (modifierKeys != ModifierKeys.None)
			{
				return (modifierKeys & ~(ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift | ModifierKeys.Windows)) == 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static string MatchModifiers(ModifierKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			switch (modifierKeys)
			{
			case ModifierKeys.None:
				result = "None";
				break;
			case ModifierKeys.Control:
				result = "Ctrl";
				break;
			case ModifierKeys.Shift:
				result = "Shift";
				break;
			case ModifierKeys.Windows:
				result = "Windows";
				break;
			case ModifierKeys.Alt:
				result = "Alt";
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	public abstract class PropertyChangeNotifier : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private PropertyChangedEventHandler _propertyChangedHandler;

		protected bool HasListeners => _propertyChangedHandler != null;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged
		{
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.Synchronized)]
			add
			{
				bool hasListeners = HasListeners;
				if (!hasListeners)
				{
					OnFirstListenerAdding();
				}
				_propertyChangedHandler = Delegate.Combine(_propertyChangedHandler, value) as PropertyChangedEventHandler;
				if (HasListeners != hasListeners)
				{
					OnHasListenersChanged();
				}
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.Synchronized)]
			remove
			{
				bool hasListeners = HasListeners;
				_propertyChangedHandler = Delegate.Remove(_propertyChangedHandler, value) as PropertyChangedEventHandler;
				if (HasListeners != hasListeners)
				{
					OnHasListenersChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnFirstListenerAdding()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnHasListenersChanged()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			_propertyChangedHandler?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected void RaisePropertyChangedEvent(string propertyName)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(propertyName);
		}

		[Obsolete("Notifications for nested property has been deprecated. To raise a property change notification for a non-nested property, use the OnPropertyChanged method.", true)]
		protected void RaisePropertyChangedEvent(string propertyName, object nestedSender, PropertyChangedEventArgs nestedArgs)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class PropertyChangeNotifierExtended : PropertyChangeNotifier, ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications, ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>, IPropertyChangeListener, ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string>
	{
		private object _listeners;

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(propertyName);
			NotifyListeners(this, propertyName, null);
		}

		protected virtual bool SetField<T>(ref T member, T newValue, string propertyName)
		{
			if (EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(member, newValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			member = newValue;
			OnPropertyChanged(propertyName);
			return true;
		}

		internal void AddListener(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> listener, bool useWeakReference)
		{
			_listeners = ListenerList.Add(_listeners, listener, useWeakReference);
		}

		internal void NotifyListeners(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
		}

		internal virtual void OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (_listeners != null)
			{
				ListenerList.RaisePropertyChanged(_listeners, sender, property, extraInfo);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveListener(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> listener)
		{
			_listeners = ListenerList.Remove(_listeners, listener);
		}

		void ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>.AddListener(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> listener, bool useWeakReference)
		{
			AddListener(listener, useWeakReference);
		}

		void ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>.RemoveListener(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> listener)
		{
			RemoveListener(listener);
		}

		void ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string>.OnPropertyValueChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			NotifyListeners(sender, property, extraInfo);
		}
	}

	public interface ISupportRecycling

	}
	public interface IRecyclableElement
	{
		bool DelayRecycling { get; set; }

		System.Windows.Controls.Panel OwnerPanel { get; set; }
	}
	internal interface IRecyclableElementHost
	{
		void OnElementAttached(ISupportRecycling item, FrameworkElement element, bool isNewlyRealized);

		void OnElementReleased(ISupportRecycling item, FrameworkElement element, bool isRemoved);

		bool ShouldRemove(ISupportRecycling item, FrameworkElement element);
	}
	public class RecyclingManager
	{
		private class PanelInfo
		{
			private Dictionary<Type, List<FrameworkElement>> _availableControlsSpecific;

			private Dictionary<Type, List<FrameworkElement>> _usedControlsSpecific;

			private Dictionary<string, List<FrameworkElement>> _availableIdentifierControlsSpecific;

			private Dictionary<string, List<FrameworkElement>> _usedIdentifierControlsSpecific;

			private List<FrameworkElement> _recentlyRecycled;

			private Dictionary<FrameworkElement, ISupportRecycling> _itemForContainer;

			internal readonly System.Windows.Controls.Panel Panel;

			internal PanelInfo(System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel)
			{
				Panel = panel;
				_itemForContainer = new Dictionary<FrameworkElement, ISupportRecycling>();
			}

			public bool AttachElement(ISupportRecycling obj)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (obj.AttachedElement == null)
				{
					FrameworkElement element = null;
					List<FrameworkElement> value = null;
					List<FrameworkElement> value2 = null;
					Type recyclingElementType = obj.RecyclingElementType;
					if (recyclingElementType != null)
					{
						if (_availableControlsSpecific != null)
						{
							_availableControlsSpecific.TryGetValue(recyclingElementType, out value);
						}
						if (_usedControlsSpecific == null)
						{
							_usedControlsSpecific = new Dictionary<Type, List<FrameworkElement>>();
						}
						if (!_usedControlsSpecific.TryGetValue(recyclingElementType, out value2))
						{
							value2 = (_usedControlsSpecific[recyclingElementType] = new List<FrameworkElement>());
						}
					}
					else
					{
						string recyclingIdentifier = obj.RecyclingIdentifier;
						if (recyclingIdentifier == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (_availableIdentifierControlsSpecific != null)
						{
							_availableIdentifierControlsSpecific.TryGetValue(recyclingIdentifier, out value);
						}
						if (_usedIdentifierControlsSpecific == null)
						{
							_usedIdentifierControlsSpecific = new Dictionary<string, List<FrameworkElement>>();
						}
						if (!_usedIdentifierControlsSpecific.TryGetValue(recyclingIdentifier, out value2))
						{
							value2 = (_usedIdentifierControlsSpecific[recyclingIdentifier] = new List<FrameworkElement>());
						}
					}
					flag = AttachElement(obj, value, value2, out element);
					_itemForContainer[element] = obj;
					obj.AttachedElement = element;
					obj.OnElementAttached(element);
					if (Panel is IRecyclableElementHost recyclableElementHost)
					{
						recyclableElementHost.OnElementAttached(obj, element, flag);
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}

			private bool AttachElement(ISupportRecycling item, List<FrameworkElement> availableElements, List<FrameworkElement> usedElements, out FrameworkElement element)
			{
				if (availableElements != null)
				{
					int num = availableElements.Count - 1;
					for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						element = availableElements[num2];
						if (!(element is IRecyclableElement { DelayRecycling: not false }))
						{
							if (num2 < num)
							{
								availableElements[num2] = availableElements[num];
							}
							availableElements.RemoveAt(num);
							if (_recentlyRecycled != null)
							{
								_recentlyRecycled.Remove(element);
							}
							usedElements.Add(element);
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				element = item.CreateInstanceOfRecyclingElement();
				if (element is IRecyclableElement recyclableElement2)
				{
					recyclableElement2.OwnerPanel = Panel;
				}
				usedElements.Add(element);
				Panel.Children.Add(element);
				return true;
			}

			internal List<FrameworkElement> GetAvailableElements()
			{
				List<FrameworkElement> list = new List<FrameworkElement>();
				if (_availableControlsSpecific != null)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<Type, List<FrameworkElement>> item in _availableControlsSpecific)
					{
						list.AddRange(item.Value);
					}
				}
				if (_availableIdentifierControlsSpecific != null)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<FrameworkElement>> item2 in _availableIdentifierControlsSpecific)
					{
						list.AddRange(item2.Value);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}

			public ISupportRecycling ItemFromElement(FrameworkElement element)
			{
				_itemForContainer.TryGetValue(element, out var value);
				return value;
			}

			internal List<FrameworkElement> GetRecentlyAvailableElements(bool release)
			{
				List<FrameworkElement> list = new List<FrameworkElement>();
				if (_recentlyRecycled != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(_recentlyRecycled);
					if (release)
					{
						_recentlyRecycled.Clear();
					}
				}
				return list;
			}

			private static void OnElementReleased(ISupportRecycling item, FrameworkElement element)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					item.IsDirty = false;
					item.AttachedElement = null;
					item.OnElementReleased(element);
				}
			}

			public void ReleaseAll()
			{
				ReleaseAll(_availableControlsSpecific);
				ReleaseAll(_availableIdentifierControlsSpecific);
				ReleaseAll(_usedControlsSpecific);
				ReleaseAll(_usedIdentifierControlsSpecific);
			}

			public void ReleaseAll(string id)
			{
				ReleaseAll(_usedIdentifierControlsSpecific, id);
				ReleaseAll(_availableIdentifierControlsSpecific, id);
			}

			public void ReleaseAll(Type t)
			{
				ReleaseAll(_usedControlsSpecific, t);
				ReleaseAll(_availableControlsSpecific, t);
			}

			private void ReleaseAll<T>(Dictionary<T, List<FrameworkElement>> dictionary)
			{
				if (dictionary == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<T, List<FrameworkElement>> item in dictionary)
				{
					ReleaseAll(item.Value);
				}
			}

			private void ReleaseAll<T>(Dictionary<T, List<FrameworkElement>> dictionary, T key)
			{
				if (dictionary != null && dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					ReleaseAll(value);
				}
			}

			private void ReleaseAll(List<FrameworkElement> elements)
			{
				UIElementCollection children = Panel.Children;
				List<FrameworkElement> list = new List<FrameworkElement>(elements);
				foreach (FrameworkElement item in list)
				{
					if (_itemForContainer.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
					{
						_itemForContainer.Remove(item);
					}
					if (_recentlyRecycled != null)
					{
						_recentlyRecycled.Remove(item);
					}
					elements.Remove(item);
					children.Remove(item);
					if (item is IRecyclableElement recyclableElement)
					{
						recyclableElement.OwnerPanel = null;
					}
					if (value != null)
					{
						OnElementReleased(value, item);
					}
					if (Panel is IRecyclableElementHost recyclableElementHost)
					{
						recyclableElementHost.OnElementReleased(value, item, isRemoved: true);
					}
				}
			}

			internal void ReleaseAllAvailable()
			{
				ReleaseAll(_availableControlsSpecific);
				ReleaseAll(_availableIdentifierControlsSpecific);
			}

			public bool ReleaseElement(ISupportRecycling obj)
			{
				FrameworkElement attachedElement = obj.AttachedElement;
				if (attachedElement != null && obj.OnElementReleasing(attachedElement))
				{
					Type recyclingElementType = obj.RecyclingElementType;
					List<FrameworkElement> value = null;
					List<FrameworkElement> value2 = null;
					bool flag = obj.IsDirty;
					IRecyclableElementHost recyclableElementHost = Panel as IRecyclableElementHost;
					if (!flag && recyclableElementHost != null)
					{
						flag = recyclableElementHost.ShouldRemove(obj, attachedElement);
					}
					if (recyclingElementType != null)
					{
						if (_usedControlsSpecific != null && _usedControlsSpecific.TryGetValue(recyclingElementType, out value) && !flag)
						{
							Dictionary<Type, List<FrameworkElement>> dictionary = _availableControlsSpecific;
							if (dictionary == null)
							{
								dictionary = (_availableControlsSpecific = new Dictionary<Type, List<FrameworkElement>>());
							}
							if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(recyclingElementType, out value2))
							{
								value2 = (dictionary[recyclingElementType] = new List<FrameworkElement>());
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						string recyclingIdentifier = obj.RecyclingIdentifier;
						if (_usedIdentifierControlsSpecific != null && _usedIdentifierControlsSpecific.TryGetValue(recyclingIdentifier, out value) && !flag)
						{
							Dictionary<string, List<FrameworkElement>> dictionary2 = _availableIdentifierControlsSpecific;
							if (dictionary2 == null)
							{
								dictionary2 = (_availableIdentifierControlsSpecific = new Dictionary<string, List<FrameworkElement>>());
							}
							if (!dictionary2.TryGetValue(recyclingIdentifier, out value2))
							{
								value2 = (dictionary2[recyclingIdentifier] = new List<FrameworkElement>());
							}
						}
					}
					if (value != null)
					{
						int num = value.IndexOf(attachedElement);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							int num2 = value.Count - 1;
							if (num < num2)
							{
								value[num] = value[num2];
							}
							value.RemoveAt(num2);
							if (!flag)
							{
								value2.Add(attachedElement);
							}
							else
							{
								if (attachedElement is IRecyclableElement recyclableElement)
								{
									recyclableElement.OwnerPanel = null;
								}
								Panel.Children.Remove(attachedElement);
							}
						}
						_itemForContainer.Remove(attachedElement);
						OnElementReleased(obj, attachedElement);
						if (!flag)
						{
							List<FrameworkElement> list3 = _recentlyRecycled;
							if (list3 == null)
							{
								list3 = (_recentlyRecycled = new List<FrameworkElement>());
							}
							list3.Add(attachedElement);
						}
						recyclableElementHost?.OnElementReleased(obj, attachedElement, flag);
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static RecyclingManager _manager = new RecyclingManager();

		private static readonly DependencyProperty RecycleInfoProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("RecycleInfo", typeof(PanelInfo), typeof(RecyclingManager), new PropertyMetadata((object)null));

		public static RecyclingManager Manager => _manager;

		private RecyclingManager()
		{
		}

		private static PanelInfo GetRecycleInfo(System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel)
		{
			if (panel == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("panel");
			}
			PanelInfo panelInfo = (PanelInfo)panel.GetValue(RecycleInfoProperty);
			if (panelInfo == null)
			{
				panelInfo = new PanelInfo(panel);
				panel.SetValue(RecycleInfoProperty, panelInfo);
			}
			return panelInfo;
		}

		public bool AttachElement(ISupportRecycling obj, System.Windows.Controls.Panel parent)
		{
			return GetRecycleInfo(parent).AttachElement(obj);
		}

		public bool ReleaseElement(ISupportRecycling obj, System.Windows.Controls.Panel parent)
		{
			return GetRecycleInfo(parent).ReleaseElement(obj);
		}

		}

		public void ReleaseAll(System.Windows.Controls.Panel parent, string id)

			GetRecycleInfo(parent).ReleaseAll(id);
		}

		public void ReleaseAll(System.Windows.Controls.Panel parent, Type t)
		{
			GetRecycleInfo(parent).ReleaseAll(t);
		}

		internal void ReleaseAllAvailable(System.Windows.Controls.Panel parent)
		{
			GetRecycleInfo(parent).ReleaseAllAvailable();
		}

		public ISupportRecycling ItemFromElement(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element) as System.Windows.Controls.Panel;
			ISupportRecycling result = null;
			if (panel != null)
			{
				result = GetRecycleInfo(panel).ItemFromElement(element);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public List<FrameworkElement> GetRecentlyAvailableElements(System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel, bool release)
		{
			return GetRecycleInfo(panel).GetRecentlyAvailableElements(release);
		}

		public List<FrameworkElement> GetAvailableElements(System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel)
		{
			return GetRecycleInfo(panel).GetAvailableElements();
		}
	}
	internal class TypeResolverUtilities
	{
		internal static Type GetKnownType(string value)
		{
			string text = value.ToLowerInvariant();
			switch (value.ToLowerInvariant())
			{
			case "string":
				return typeof(string);
			case "bool":
			case "boolean":
				return typeof(bool);
			case "color":
				return typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
			case "datetime":
				return typeof(DateTime);
			case "decimal":
				return typeof(decimal);
			case "double":
				return typeof(double);
			case "float":
			case "single":
				return typeof(float);
			case "int16":
			case "short":
				return typeof(short);
			case "int":
			case "int32":
				return typeof(int);
			case "int64":
			case "long":
				return typeof(long);
			case "uint16":
			case "ushort":
				return typeof(ushort);
			case "uint":
			case "uint32":
				return typeof(uint);
			case "uint64":
			case "ulong":
				return typeof(ulong);
			case "byte":
				return typeof(byte);
			case "sbyte":
				return typeof(sbyte);
			case "char":
				return typeof(char);
			case "bool?":
			case "boolean?":
			case "nullable<bool>":
			case "nullable<boolean>":
				return typeof(bool?);
			case "color?":
			case "nullable<color>":
				return typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color?);
			case "datetime?":
			case "nullable<datetime>":
				return typeof(DateTime?);
			case "decimal?":
			case "nullable<decimal>":
				return typeof(decimal?);
			case "double?":
			case "nullable<double>":
				return typeof(double?);
			case "float?":
			case "single?":
			case "nullable<float>":
			case "nullable<single>":
				return typeof(float?);
			case "int16?":
			case "nullable<int16>":
			case "short?":
			case "nullable<short>":
				return typeof(short?);
			case "int?":
			case "int32?":
			case "nullable<int>":
			case "nullable<int32>":
				return typeof(int?);
			case "int64?":
			case "nullable<int64>":
			case "long?":
			case "nullable<long>":
				return typeof(long?);
			case "uint16?":
			case "nullable<uint16>":
			case "ushort?":
			case "nullable<ushort>":
				return typeof(ushort?);
			case "uint?":
			case "uint32?":
			case "nullable<uint>":
			case "nullable<uint32>":
				return typeof(uint?);
			case "uint64?":
			case "nullable<uint64>":
			case "ulong?":
			case "nullable<ulong>":
				return typeof(ulong?);
			case "byte?":
			case "nullable<byte>":
				return typeof(byte?);
			case "sbyte?":
			case "nullable<sbyte>":
				return typeof(sbyte?);
			case "char?":
			case "nullable<char>":
				return typeof(char?);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(name, null);
		}

		internal static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return SR.GetString(name, args);
		}

		internal static Type ResolveType(object owner, Type explicitType, string typeName, Type fallbackType, string stringTypePropertyName)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotEmpty(stringTypePropertyName, "stringTypePropertyName");
			if (explicitType != null)
			{
				return explicitType;
			}
			Type type = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(typeName))
			{
				type = GetKnownType(typeName);
				if (type == null)
				{
					type = Type.GetType(typeName);
					if (type == null && CoreUtilities.IsDebuggerLogging())
					{
						CoreUtilities.DebuggerLog(40, "Global", GetString("UnknownTypeName", typeName, owner, stringTypePropertyName) + Environment.NewLine);
					}
				}
			}
			return type ?? fallbackType;
		}
	}

		public static bool GetHasVisualStateGroups(System.Windows.Controls.Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(control);
			for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(control, i) is FrameworkElement frameworkElement && frameworkElement.TemplatedParent == control)
				{
					return DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(frameworkElement, VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroupsProperty).BaseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Default;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void GoToState(System.Windows.Controls.Control control, bool useTransitions, params string[] states)
		{
			if (states != null)
			{
				int num = states.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num && !VisualStateManager.GoToState(control, states[i], useTransitions); i++)
				{
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WeakEventHandler<TInstance, TEventSource, TEventArgs> where TInstance : class
	{
		private readonly WeakReference _weakInstance;

		private readonly WeakReference _weakEventSource;

		public TEventSource EventSource => (TEventSource)CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_weakEventSource);

		public TInstance Instance => CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_weakInstance) as TInstance;

		private Action<TInstance, object, TEventArgs> OnEventAction { get; set; }

		private Action<WeakEventHandler<TInstance, TEventSource, TEventArgs>, TEventSource> OnDetachAction { get; set; }

		public WeakEventHandler(TInstance instance, TEventSource eventSource, Action<TInstance, object, TEventArgs> onEventAction, Action<WeakEventHandler<TInstance, TEventSource, TEventArgs>, TEventSource> onDetachAction)
		{
			_weakInstance = new WeakReference(instance);
			_weakEventSource = new WeakReference(eventSource);
			OnEventAction = onEventAction;
			OnDetachAction = onDetachAction;
		}

		public void OnEvent(object source, TEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_weakInstance) is TInstance arg)
			{
				if (OnEventAction != null)
				{
					OnEventAction(arg, source, eventArgs);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Detach();
			}
		}

		public void Detach()
		{
			TEventSource arg = (TEventSource)CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_weakEventSource);
			if (OnDetachAction != null && _weakEventSource.IsAlive)
			{
				OnDetachAction(this, arg);
			}
			OnDetachAction = null;
		}
	}
	internal class WeakCollectionChangedHandler<TInstance> : WeakEventHandler<TInstance, INotifyCollectionChanged, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs> where TInstance : class
	{
		public WeakCollectionChangedHandler(TInstance instance, INotifyCollectionChanged eventSource, Action<TInstance, object, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs> onEventAction)
			: base(instance, eventSource, onEventAction, (Action<WeakEventHandler<TInstance, INotifyCollectionChanged, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs>, INotifyCollectionChanged>)delegate(WeakEventHandler<TInstance, INotifyCollectionChanged, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs> weakHandler, INotifyCollectionChanged evSource)
			{
				evSource.CollectionChanged -= weakHandler.OnEvent;
			})
		{
		}
	}
	internal class WeakPropertyChangedHandler<TInstance> : WeakEventHandler<TInstance, INotifyPropertyChanged, PropertyChangedEventArgs> where TInstance : class
	{
		public WeakPropertyChangedHandler(TInstance instance, INotifyPropertyChanged eventSource, Action<TInstance, object, PropertyChangedEventArgs> onEventAction)
			: base(instance, eventSource, onEventAction, (Action<WeakEventHandler<TInstance, INotifyPropertyChanged, PropertyChangedEventArgs>, INotifyPropertyChanged>)delegate(WeakEventHandler<TInstance, INotifyPropertyChanged, PropertyChangedEventArgs> weakHandler, INotifyPropertyChanged evSource)
			{
				evSource.PropertyChanged -= weakHandler.OnEvent;
			})
		{
		}
	}

	public class CommandBase : ICommand
	{
		public CommandSource CommandSource { get; set; }

		public ICommandTarget CurrentTarget { get; internal set; }

		public event EventHandler CanExecuteChanged;

		protected virtual void OnCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			if (this.CanExecuteChanged != null)
			{
				this.CanExecuteChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void Execute(object parameter)
		{
		}

		public virtual void Execute(CommandSource source, ICommandTarget target)
		{
		}
	}
	public static class CommandSourceManager
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static List<WeakReference> _commandTargets = new List<WeakReference>();

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<Type, ICollection<CommandSource>> _commands;

		private static Dictionary<Type, ICollection<CommandSource>> Commands
		{
			get
			{
				if (_commands == null)
				{
					_commands = new Dictionary<Type, ICollection<CommandSource>>();
				}
				return _commands;
			}
		}

		private static List<WeakReference> CommandTargets
		{
			get
			{
				if (_commandTargets == null)
				{
					_commandTargets = new List<WeakReference>();
				}
				return _commandTargets;
			}
		}

		public static void RegisterCommandTarget(ICommandTarget target)
		{
			CommandTargets.Add(new WeakReference(target));
		}

		public static void UnregisterCommandTarget(ICommandTarget target)
		{
			List<WeakReference> commandTargets = CommandTargets;
			for (int num = commandTargets.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				WeakReference weakReference = commandTargets[num];
				if (weakReference.Target == target)
				{
					commandTargets.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		public static Collection<ICommandTarget> GetTargets(ICommand command)
		{
			Collection<ICommandTarget> collection = new Collection<ICommandTarget>();
			foreach (WeakReference commandTarget2 in CommandTargets)
			{
				if (commandTarget2.IsAlive)
				{
					ICommandTarget commandTarget = (ICommandTarget)commandTarget2.Target;
					if (commandTarget.SupportsCommand(command))
					{
						collection.Add(commandTarget);
					}
				}
			}
			return collection;
		}

		public static void NotifyCanExecuteChanged(Type commandType)
		{
			if (!Commands.TryGetValue(commandType, out var value))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CommandSource item in value)
			{
				item.InvokeCommand(execute: false);
			}
		}

		internal static void RegisterCommandSource(CommandSource source, FrameworkElement elem)
		{
			ICommand command = source.Command;
			if (command != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.EventName))
			{
				source.SourceElement = elem;
				source.SourceElements.Add(elem);
				EventInfo eventInfo = elem.GetType().GetEvent(source.EventName);
				if (!(eventInfo != null))
				{
					throw new InvalidEventNameException(source.EventName, elem.GetType());
				}
				Action<object, EventArgs> action = source.EventFired;
				source.EventHandler = Delegate.CreateDelegate(eventInfo.EventHandlerType, source, action.Method);
				eventInfo.AddEventHandler(elem, source.EventHandler);
				Type type = command.GetType();
				if (!Commands.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
				{
					value = (Commands[type] = new WeakSet<CommandSource>());
				}
				value.Add(source);
				if (value.Count % 50 == 0)
				{
					((WeakSet<CommandSource>)value).Compact();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void UnregisterCommandSource(CommandSource source)
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement sourceElement in source.SourceElements)
			{
				EventInfo eventInfo = sourceElement.GetType().GetEvent(source.EventName);
				if (eventInfo != null)
				{
					eventInfo.RemoveEventHandler(sourceElement, source.EventHandler);
				}
			}
			ICommand command = source.Command;
			if (command != null)
			{
				Type type = command.GetType();
				if (Commands.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
				{
					value.Remove(source);
				}
			}
			source.EventHandler = null;
			source.SourceElement = null;
			source.SourceElements.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class CommandSourceCollection : CollectionBase<CommandSource>
	{
		private FrameworkElement _element;

		public FrameworkElement Element
		{
			get
			{
				return _element;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_element == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				FrameworkElement element = _element;
				_element = value;
				if (element != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				using IEnumerator<CommandSource> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					CommandSource current = enumerator.Current;
					CommandSourceManager.RegisterCommandSource(current, Element);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void AddItem(int index, CommandSource item)
		{
			if (Element != null)
			{
				CommandSourceManager.RegisterCommandSource(item, Element);
			}
			base.AddItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override bool RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			CommandSourceManager.UnregisterCommandSource(Items[index]);
			return base.RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected override void ResetItems()
		{
			foreach (CommandSource item in Items)
			{
				CommandSourceManager.UnregisterCommandSource(item);
			}
			base.ResetItems();
		}
	}

	public class Animation
	{
		private DispatcherTimer _timer;

		private bool _isPlaying;

		private double _prevValue;

		public int Duration { get; set; }

		public bool IsPlaying => _isPlaying;

		public int Time { get; set; }

		public EasingFunctionBase EasingFunction { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler<AnimationEventArgs> Tick;

		public event EventHandler Complete;

		public Animation()
		{
			EasingFunction = new SineEase();
			Duration = 8;
			_timer = new DispatcherTimer();
			_timer.Tick += timer_Tick;
			_timer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1.0);
		}

		public void Play()
		{
			Time = 0;
			_prevValue = 0.0;
			_timer.Start();
			_isPlaying = true;
		}

		public void Continue()
		{
			if (Time < Duration)
			{
				_timer.Start();
				_isPlaying = true;
			}
		}

		public void Stop()
		{
			_timer.Stop();
			_isPlaying = false;
		}

		private void timer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Time++;
			OnTick();
			if (Time == Duration)
			{
				Stop();
				OnComplete();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnTick()
		{
			double num = EasingFunction.Ease((double)Time / (double)Duration);
			if (Time == Duration)
			{
				num = 1.0;
			}
			if (this.Tick != null)
			{
				this.Tick(this, new AnimationEventArgs
				{
					Value = num,
					Difference = num - _prevValue
				});
			}
			_prevValue = num;
		}

		protected virtual void OnComplete()
		{
			if (this.Complete != null)
			{
				this.Complete(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}
	public class AnimationEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public double Value { get; internal set; }

		public double Difference { get; internal set; }
	}

			{

				elementType.ToString()
			}))
		{
		}

		public InvalidEventNameException(string message)
			: base(message)

		}

		public InvalidEventNameException(string message, Exception innerException)
			: base(message, innerException)
		{
		}
	}

		internal static System.Windows.Controls.Panel ResolveRootPanel()
		{
			UIElement uIElement = System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow;
			while (uIElement != null && !(uIElement is System.Windows.Controls.Panel))

			}
			return uIElement as System.Windows.Controls.Panel;

	internal static class PlatformProxy
	{
		internal class HitTestHelper
		{
			private List<UIElement> _hitElements = new List<UIElement>();

			public List<UIElement> HitResults => _hitElements;

			public HitTestFilterBehavior FilterCallback(DependencyObject target)
			{
				if (target is UIElement item)
				{
					_hitElements.Add(item);
				}
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
			}

			public HitTestResultBehavior ResultCallback(HitTestResult result)
			{
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
			}
		}

		internal static object GetFocusedElement(DependencyObject scopedElement)
		{
			DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(scopedElement);
			if (focusScope != null)
			{
				return FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(focusScope);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static UIElement GetRootVisual(DependencyObject scopedElement)
		{
			if (scopedElement == null)
			{
				return System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow;
			}
			UIElement result = scopedElement as UIElement;
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = scopedElement;
			while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
			{
				dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			while (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				if (dependencyObject is Visual || dependencyObject is Visual3D)
				{
					dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				}
				if (dependencyObject is UIElement)
				{
					result = (UIElement)dependencyObject;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static DependencyObject GetVisualParent(DependencyObject child)
		{
			if (child is Visual reference)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(reference);
				if (parent != null)
				{
					return parent;
				}
				if (child is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					return frameworkElement.Parent;
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (child is FrameworkContentElement frameworkContentElement)
			{
				return frameworkContentElement.Parent;
			}
			if (child is Visual3D reference2)
			{
				return VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(reference2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static double GetZoomFactor()
		{
			return 1.0;
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Size ResolveContainerSize()
		{
			return default(System.Windows.Size);
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<UIElement> GetElementsFromPoint(System.Windows.Point point, UIElement subtree)
		{
			HitTestHelper hitTestHelper = new HitTestHelper();
			VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(subtree, hitTestHelper.FilterCallback, hitTestHelper.ResultCallback, new PointHitTestParameters(point));
			return hitTestHelper.HitResults;
		}

		internal static bool IsVersionSupported(string version)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal static DependencyObject GetRootParent(DependencyObject element)
		{
			DependencyObject result = null;
			for (DependencyObject visualParent = GetVisualParent(element); visualParent != null; visualParent = GetVisualParent(visualParent))
			{
				result = visualParent;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static KeyboardNavigationMode GetTabNavigation(System.Windows.Controls.Control element)
		{
			return KeyboardNavigation.GetTabNavigation(element);
		}

		public static void SetTabNavigation(System.Windows.Controls.Control element, KeyboardNavigationMode mode)
		{
			KeyboardNavigation.SetTabNavigation(element, mode);
		}

		public static DependencyObject GetParent(DependencyObject child)
		{
			return GetParent(child, walkDirectParents: true);
		}

		public static DependencyObject GetParent(DependencyObject child, bool walkDirectParents)
		{
			if (!(child is Visual))
			{
				return LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(child);
			}
			DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(child);
			if (parent != null)
			{
				return parent;
			}
			if (walkDirectParents && child is FrameworkElement { Parent: not null } frameworkElement)
			{
				return frameworkElement.Parent;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class NullableEnumTypeConverter<T> : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string) || sourceType == typeof(T))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(T), value))
			{
				return Enum.Parse(typeof(T), value.ToString(), ignoreCase: true);
			}
			if (value is string s)
			{
				int result = -1;
				if (int.TryParse(s, out result))
				{
					return Enum.Parse(typeof(T), value.ToString(), ignoreCase: true);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class WeakReferenceHelper<T> where T : class
	{
		private readonly List<WeakReference> _values;

		public List<WeakReference> Values => _values;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (WeakReference value in _values)
				{
					if (value.IsAlive)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (WeakReference value in _values)
				{
					if (value.IsAlive)
					{
						num++;
					}
					if (num - 1 == index)
					{
						return (T)value.Target;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public WeakReferenceHelper()
		{
			_values = new List<WeakReference>();
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _values.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_values[i].Target == item)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			if (_values.Count == _values.Capacity)
			{
				CleanValues();
			}
			_values.Add(new WeakReference(item));
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<WeakReference> items)
		{
			if (items != null)
			{
				_values.AddRange(items);
			}
		}

		public T RemoveLast()
		{
			int num = _values.Count - 1;
			while (num >= 0)
			{
				WeakReference weakReference = _values[num];
				_values.RemoveAt(num);
				if (weakReference.Target is T result)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _values.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_values[i].Target == item)
				{
					_values.RemoveAt(i);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ForEach(Func<T, bool> action)
		{
			int num = 0;
			while (num < _values.Count)
			{
				WeakReference weakReference = _values[num];
				if (weakReference.Target is T arg)
				{
					if (!action(arg))
					{
						break;
					}
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					_values.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CleanValues()
		{
			for (int num = _values.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				WeakReference weakReference = _values[num];
				T val = weakReference.Target as T;
				if (val == null)
				{
					_values.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}
	}
