		public static string XamZoomSlider => "Infragistics.Controls.Navigation.XamZoomSlider";
	}
	public abstract class ThemeBase
	{
		private Dictionary<string, string> _mappings = new Dictionary<string, string>();

		private Dictionary<string, string> _mappingsSnapshot;

		private bool _isInitialized;

		protected Dictionary<string, string> Mappings
		{
			get
			{
				return _mappings;
			}
			set
			{
				_mappings = value;
			}
		}

		internal Dictionary<string, string> MappingsSnapshot
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_isInitialized)
				{
					Initialize();
				}
				return _mappingsSnapshot ?? (_mappingsSnapshot = new Dictionary<string, string>(Mappings));
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize()
		{
			ConfigureControlMappings();
			_isInitialized = true;
		}

		protected abstract void ConfigureControlMappings();

		public static string BuildLocationString(string assemblyFullName, string relativeSource)
		{
			return $"pack://application:,,,/{assemblyFullName};component/{relativeSource}";
		}
	}
	public static class ThemeManager
	{
		private static WeakList<ThemeResourceDictionary> _currentlyUsedThemeRDs = new WeakList<ThemeResourceDictionary>();

		private static List<string> _regiteredControls = new List<string> { ControlMappingKeys.MsCoreControls };

		private static ThemeBase _applicationTheme = null;

		private static readonly object RegisterAssemblyLock = new object();

		private static HashSet<Assembly> _assembliesPendingRegistration = new HashSet<Assembly>();

		private static HashSet<Assembly> _processedAssemblies = new HashSet<Assembly>();

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ThemeProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Theme", typeof(ThemeBase), typeof(ThemeManager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnThemeChanged));

		public static ThemeBase ApplicationTheme
		{
			get
			{
				return _applicationTheme;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_applicationTheme == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (_applicationTheme != null)
				{
					ThemeResourceDictionary themeResourceDictionary = _currentlyUsedThemeRDs.FirstOrDefault((ThemeResourceDictionary i) => i.Theme == _applicationTheme);
					if (themeResourceDictionary != null)
					{
						System.Windows.Application.Current.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Remove(themeResourceDictionary);
					}
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					ThemeResourceDictionary item = (_currentlyUsedThemeRDs.Any((ThemeResourceDictionary i) => i.Theme == value) ? _currentlyUsedThemeRDs.FirstOrDefault((ThemeResourceDictionary i) => i.Theme == value) : BuildThemeResourceForTheme(value));
					System.Windows.Application.Current.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(item);
				}
				_applicationTheme = value;
			}
		}

		private static void OnThemeChanged(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!(sender is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			ThemeBase newTheme = ((args.NewValue != null) ? ((ThemeBase)args.NewValue) : null);
			ThemeBase oldTheme = ((args.OldValue != null) ? ((ThemeBase)args.OldValue) : null);
			if (oldTheme != null)
			{
				ThemeResourceDictionary themeResourceDictionary = _currentlyUsedThemeRDs.FirstOrDefault((ThemeResourceDictionary i) => i.Theme == oldTheme);
				if (themeResourceDictionary != null)
				{
					frameworkElement.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Remove(themeResourceDictionary);
				}
			}
			if (newTheme != null)
			{
				ThemeResourceDictionary themeResourceDictionary2 = _currentlyUsedThemeRDs.FirstOrDefault((ThemeResourceDictionary i) => i.Theme == newTheme);
				if (themeResourceDictionary2 != null)
				{
					frameworkElement.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(themeResourceDictionary2);
					return;
				}
				ThemeResourceDictionary item = BuildThemeResourceForTheme(newTheme);
				frameworkElement.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public static ThemeBase GetTheme(DependencyObject element)
		{
			return (ThemeBase)element.GetValue(ThemeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetTheme(DependencyObject element, ThemeBase theme)
		{
			element.SetValue(ThemeProperty, theme);
		}

		public static void RegisterControl(Type type)
		{
			if (!_regiteredControls.Contains(type.FullName))
			{
				_regiteredControls.Add(type.FullName);
				OnAssemblyRegistered(type.Assembly);
				UpdateThemeDictionaries(type.FullName);
			}
		}

		internal static ThemeResourceDictionary BuildThemeResourceForTheme(ThemeBase newTheme)
		{
			ProcessPendingRegistrations();
			if (_currentlyUsedThemeRDs.Count % 50 == 0)
			{
				_currentlyUsedThemeRDs.Compact();
			}
			ThemeResourceDictionary themeResourceDictionary = new ThemeResourceDictionary(newTheme);
			_currentlyUsedThemeRDs.Add(themeResourceDictionary);
			string[] array = _regiteredControls.ToArray();
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			do
			{
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string controlTypeName in array2)
				{
					themeResourceDictionary.RegisterControl(controlTypeName);
				}
				list.AddRange(array);
				array = _regiteredControls.Except(list).ToArray();
			}
			while (array.Any());
			return themeResourceDictionary;
		}

		internal static void UpdateThemeDictionaries(string controlTypeName)
		{
			foreach (ThemeResourceDictionary currentlyUsedThemeRD in _currentlyUsedThemeRDs)
			{
				currentlyUsedThemeRD.RegisterControl(controlTypeName);
			}
		}

		internal static void UpdateStylingMsControlsForTheme(BuiltInThemeBase theme)
		{
			ThemeResourceDictionary themeResourceDictionary = _currentlyUsedThemeRDs.FirstOrDefault((ThemeResourceDictionary t) => t.Theme == theme);
			if (themeResourceDictionary != null)
			{
				if (theme.StyleMicrosoftControls)
				{
					themeResourceDictionary.RegisterControl(ControlMappingKeys.MsCoreControls);
				}
				else if (theme.MappingsSnapshot.Keys.Contains(ControlMappingKeys.MsCoreControls))
				{
					themeResourceDictionary.RemoveResourceDictionary(theme.MappingsSnapshot[ControlMappingKeys.MsCoreControls]);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnAssemblyRegistered(Assembly assembly)
		{
			lock (RegisterAssemblyLock)
			{
				if (!_processedAssemblies.Contains(assembly) && _assembliesPendingRegistration.Add(assembly) && _currentlyUsedThemeRDs.Count > 0)
				{
					ProcessPendingRegistrations();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ProcessPendingRegistrations()
		{
			lock (RegisterAssemblyLock)
			{
				Assembly[] array = _assembliesPendingRegistration.ToArray();
				_assembliesPendingRegistration.Clear();
				try
				{
					Assembly[] array2 = array;
					foreach (Assembly assembly in array2)
					{
						VerifyReferencesAreLoaded(assembly, _processedAssemblies);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyReferencesAreLoaded(Assembly assembly, HashSet<Assembly> processedAssemblies)
		{
			if (!processedAssemblies.Add(assembly))
			{
				return;
			}
			AssemblyName[] referencedAssemblies = assembly.GetReferencedAssemblies();
			foreach (AssemblyName assemblyName in referencedAssemblies)
			{
				string publicKeyToken = Utilities.GetPublicKeyToken(assemblyName.FullName);
				if (Utilities.HasSamePublicKey(publicKeyToken))
				{
					Assembly assembly2 = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.Load(assemblyName);
					VerifyReferencesAreLoaded(assembly2, processedAssemblies);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ThemeResourceDictionary : ResourceDictionary
	{
		private Dictionary<string, ResourceDictionary> _resourceDictionaryCache = new Dictionary<string, ResourceDictionary>();

		private Dictionary<string, ResourceDictionary> _alreadyMergedResourceDictionaries = new Dictionary<string, ResourceDictionary>();

		private List<string> _registeredControlNames = new List<string>();

		public ThemeBase Theme { get; set; }

		public ThemeResourceDictionary(ThemeBase theme)
		{
			Theme = theme;
		}

		public void RegisterControl(string controlTypeName)
		{
			if (!(controlTypeName == ControlMappingKeys.MsCoreControls) || !(Theme is BuiltInThemeBase { StyleMicrosoftControls: false }))
			{
				AddResourceDictionary(controlTypeName);
			}
		}

		internal static Uri BuildResourseUri(string relativeSource, string assemblyFullName)
		{
			return new Uri($"pack://application:,,,/{assemblyFullName};component/{relativeSource}", UriKind.Absolute);
		}

		internal ResourceDictionary AddResourceDictionary(string controlTypeName)
		{
			if (!Theme.MappingsSnapshot.ContainsKey(controlTypeName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = Theme.MappingsSnapshot[controlTypeName];
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_alreadyMergedResourceDictionaries.ContainsKey(text))
			{
				return _alreadyMergedResourceDictionaries[text];
			}
			ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = null;
			if (_resourceDictionaryCache.ContainsKey(text))
			{
				resourceDictionary = _resourceDictionaryCache[text];
			}
			else
			{
				resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary
				{
					Source = new Uri(text)
				};
				if (!_resourceDictionaryCache.ContainsKey(text))
				{
					_resourceDictionaryCache.Add(text, resourceDictionary);
				}
			}
			if (_alreadyMergedResourceDictionaries.ContainsKey(text))
			{
				return _alreadyMergedResourceDictionaries[text];
			}
			base.MergedDictionaries.Add(resourceDictionary);
			_alreadyMergedResourceDictionaries.Add(text, resourceDictionary);
			return resourceDictionary;
		}

		internal void RemoveResourceDictionary(string source)
		{
			if (_alreadyMergedResourceDictionaries.ContainsKey(source))
			{
				_alreadyMergedResourceDictionaries.Remove(source);
				base.MergedDictionaries.Remove(_resourceDictionaryCache[source]);
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Shared

	[ComVisible(false)]
	public sealed class ResourceCustomizer
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, string> customizedStrings;

		private static readonly object CustomizedStringsLock = new object();

		private static readonly object ResourceCustomizerListLock = new object();

		private static WeakList<ResourceCustomizer> _allCustomizers = new WeakList<ResourceCustomizer>();

		private int versionNumber;

		private PropertyChangedEventHandler _resourceCustomizationChanged;

		private static readonly object ResourceCustomizationChangedLock = new object();

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int CustomizedStringsVersion => versionNumber;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler ResourceCustomizationChanged
		{
			add
			{
				lock (ResourceCustomizationChangedLock)
				{
					_resourceCustomizationChanged = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(_resourceCustomizationChanged, value);
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				lock (ResourceCustomizationChangedLock)
				{
					_resourceCustomizationChanged = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(_resourceCustomizationChanged, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public ResourceCustomizer()
		{
			customizedStrings = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			lock (ResourceCustomizerListLock)
			{
				_allCustomizers.Add(this);
			}
		}

		public string GetCustomizedString(string name)
		{
			lock (CustomizedStringsLock)
			{
				customizedStrings.TryGetValue(name, out var value);
				return value;
			}
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChangedEvent(string resourceName)
		{
			_resourceCustomizationChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(resourceName));
		}

		internal static void RefreshLocalizedResources()
		{
			ResourceCustomizer[] array = null;
			lock (ResourceCustomizerListLock)
			{
				_allCustomizers.Compact();
				array = new ResourceCustomizer[_allCustomizers.Count];
				_allCustomizers.CopyTo(array, 0);
			}
			ResourceCustomizer[] array2 = array;
			foreach (ResourceCustomizer resourceCustomizer in array2)
			{
				resourceCustomizer.RaisePropertyChangedEvent(null);
			}
		}

		public void ResetAllCustomizedStrings()
		{
			lock (CustomizedStringsLock)
			{
				customizedStrings.Clear();
			}
			versionNumber++;
			RaisePropertyChangedEvent(null);
		}

		public void ResetCustomizedString(string name)
		{
			SetCustomizedString(name, null);
		}

		public void SetCustomizedString(string name, string customizedText)
		{
			lock (CustomizedStringsLock)
			{
				if (customizedText == null)
				{
					customizedStrings.Remove(name);
				}
				else
				{
					customizedStrings[name] = customizedText;
				}
			}
			versionNumber++;
			RaisePropertyChangedEvent(name);
		}
	}
	public abstract class DynamicResourceString : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public struct ID
		{
			private CultureInfo _cultureInfo;

			private string _resourceName;

			private object[] _args;

			private int _hashCode;

			public ID(CultureInfo cultureInfo, string resourceName, object[] args)
			{
				_cultureInfo = cultureInfo;
				_resourceName = resourceName;
				_args = args;
				_hashCode = 0;
				if (_cultureInfo != null)
				{
					_hashCode = _cultureInfo.GetHashCode() / 3;
				}
				if (_resourceName != null)
				{
					_hashCode += _resourceName.GetHashCode() / 3;
				}
				if (_args == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = _args.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					object obj = _args[i];
					if (obj != null)
					{
						_hashCode += obj.GetHashCode() / (3 * num);
					}
				}
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is ID iD))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (_cultureInfo != iD._cultureInfo)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (iD._resourceName != _resourceName)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (iD._args != _args && (iD._args == null || _args == null))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (iD._args == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (iD._args.Length != _args.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = iD._args.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (!object.Equals(iD._args[i], _args[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return _hashCode;
			}
		}

		private ResourceCustomizer _customizer;

		private CultureInfo _cultureInfo;

		private string _currentFormattedString;

		private string _currentUnformattedString;

		private string _resourceName;

		private object[] _args;

		public string Value
		{
			get
			{
				string text = _customizer.GetCustomizedString(_resourceName);
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = GetStringFromResource(_resourceName, _cultureInfo);
				}
				if (text == _currentUnformattedString)
				{
					return _currentFormattedString;
				}
				_currentUnformattedString = text;
				_currentFormattedString = text;
				if (_args != null)
				{
					try
					{
						_currentFormattedString = string.Format(_cultureInfo, text, _args);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return _currentFormattedString;
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected DynamicResourceString(ResourceCustomizer customizer, CultureInfo cultureInfo, string resourceName, object[] args)
		{
			if (resourceName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("resourceName");
			}
			if (customizer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("customizer");
			}
			_customizer = customizer;
			_cultureInfo = cultureInfo;
			_resourceName = resourceName;
			_args = args;
			_customizer.ResourceCustomizationChanged += OnResourceChanged;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("DynamicResourceString: ");
			stringBuilder.Append(Value);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected abstract string GetStringFromResource(string resourceName, CultureInfo culture);

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool DoPropertiesMatch(CultureInfo cultureInfo, string resourceName, object[] args)
		{
			if (_cultureInfo != cultureInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (resourceName != _resourceName)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (args != _args && (args == null || _args == null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (args == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (args.Length != _args.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = args.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(args[i], _args[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnResourceChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
			if (propertyName == null || propertyName == _resourceName)
			{
				string currentFormattedString = _currentFormattedString;
				if (currentFormattedString != Value)
				{
					this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Value"));
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Windows

	internal class CloneInfo
	{
		private object _rootSource;

		private Dictionary<object, object> _clonedObjects;

		private IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

		public object RootSource => _rootSource;

		public IServiceProvider ServiceProvider => _serviceProvider;

		internal CloneInfo(object rootSource)
		{
			_rootSource = rootSource;
			_clonedObjects = new Dictionary<object, object>();
			_serviceProvider = new XamlDesignerSerializationManager(null)
			{
				XamlWriterMode = XamlWriterMode.Expression
			};
		}

		public bool TryGetClonedObject(object source, out object clone)
		{
			return _clonedObjects.TryGetValue(source, out clone);
		}

		public void AddClone(object source, object clone)
		{
			_clonedObjects.Add(source, clone);
		}
	}
	internal class CloneManager
	{
		public object Clone(object source)
		{
			MarkupObject markupObjectFor = MarkupWriter.GetMarkupObjectFor(source);
			CloneInfo cloneInfo = new CloneInfo(source);
			return Clone(markupObjectFor, cloneInfo);
		}

		public virtual bool ShouldClone(object source)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual object Clone(MarkupObject mo, CloneInfo cloneInfo)
		{
			object clone = mo.Instance;
			if (clone == null || GetCloneBehavior(clone) == CloneBehavior.ShareInstance)
			{
				return clone;
			}
			if (cloneInfo.TryGetClonedObject(clone, out clone))
			{
				return clone;
			}
			clone = Activator.CreateInstance(mo.ObjectType);
			object instance = mo.Instance;
			cloneInfo.AddClone(instance, clone);
			foreach (MarkupProperty property in mo.Properties)
			{
				if (property.DependencyProperty != null && ShouldSkipProperty(property))
				{
					continue;
				}
				object obj = GetValue(instance, property);
				bool flag = obj is Visual || obj is ContentElement;
				if (obj != null && !(obj is string))
				{
					Type type = obj.GetType();
					if (!type.IsValueType)
					{
						CloneBehavior? cloneBehavior = null;
						PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = property.PropertyDescriptor;
						if (propertyDescriptor != null)
						{
							foreach (Attribute attribute in propertyDescriptor.Attributes)
							{
								if (attribute is CloneBehaviorAttribute cloneBehaviorAttribute)
								{
									cloneBehavior = cloneBehaviorAttribute.Behavior;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
						if (cloneBehavior.HasValue)
						{
							flag = cloneBehavior.Value == CloneBehavior.CloneObject;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (!ShouldClone(obj))
					{
						continue;
					}
					MarkupObject markupObjectFor = MarkupWriter.GetMarkupObjectFor(obj);
					obj = Clone(markupObjectFor, cloneInfo);
				}
				if (obj is MarkupExtension markupExtension)
				{
					obj = markupExtension.ProvideValue(cloneInfo.ServiceProvider);
				}
				if (property.DependencyProperty != null)
				{
					((DependencyObject)clone).SetValue(property.DependencyProperty, obj);
				}
				else if (property.PropertyDescriptor != null && !property.PropertyDescriptor.IsReadOnly)
				{
					property.PropertyDescriptor.SetValue(clone, obj);
				}
				else if (property.Items != null && property.PropertyType != typeof(string))
				{
					CloneItems(clone, property, cloneInfo);
				}
			}
			return clone;
		}

		protected virtual void CloneItems(object clone, MarkupProperty mp, CloneInfo cloneInfo)
		{
			if (mp.Items == null || mp.PropertyDescriptor == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object value = mp.PropertyDescriptor.GetValue(clone);
			if (!(value is IList list))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (MarkupObject item in mp.Items)
			{
				if (ShouldClone(item.Instance))
				{
					object value2 = Clone(item, cloneInfo);
					list.Add(value2);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual CloneBehavior GetCloneBehavior(object source)
		{
			if (source is DependencyObject)
			{
				return CloneBehavior.CloneObject;
			}
			return CloneBehavior.ShareInstance;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldSkipProperty(MarkupProperty property)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private static object GetValue(object source, MarkupProperty mp)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = source as DependencyObject;
			if (mp.DependencyProperty != null && dependencyObject != null)
			{
				object obj = dependencyObject.ReadLocalValue(mp.DependencyProperty);
				if (obj is Enum)
				{
					return obj;
				}
			}
			else if (mp.PropertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				object value = mp.PropertyDescriptor.GetValue(source);
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
			return mp.Value;
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(DeviceUnitLengthConverter))]
	public struct DeviceUnitLength : IEquatable<DeviceUnitLength>
	{
		private const int TwipsPerInch = 1440;

		private const int LogicalDpi = 96;

		private const double CentimetersPerInch = 2.54;

		private const int TwipsPerPoint = 20;

		private double _value;

		private DeviceUnitType _unit;

		public bool IsDeviceIndependentUnit => _unit == DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit;

		public bool IsPixel => _unit == DeviceUnitType.Pixel;

		public bool IsPoint => _unit == DeviceUnitType.Point;

		public bool IsTwip => _unit == DeviceUnitType.Twip;

		public DeviceUnitType UnitType
		{
			get
			{
				return _unit;
			}
			set
			{
				_unit = value;
			}
		}

		public double Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				ValidateUnitLengthValue(value);
				_value = value;
			}
		}

		public DeviceUnitLength(double value)
			: this(value, DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit)
		{
		}

		public DeviceUnitLength(double value, DeviceUnitType type)
		{
			ValidateUnitLengthValue(value);
			_value = value;
			_unit = type;
		}

		public double ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType unitType)
		{
			if (UnitType == unitType)
			{
				return Value;
			}
			double twips = ConvertToTwips(Value, UnitType);
			return ConvertFromTwips(twips, unitType);
		}

		internal static double ConvertFromTwips(double twips, DeviceUnitType targetUnit)
		{
			switch (targetUnit)
			{
			case DeviceUnitType.Centimeter:
				return twips / 1440.0 * 2.54;
			case DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit:
				return twips / 1440.0 * 96.0;
			case DeviceUnitType.Inch:
				return twips / 1440.0;
			case DeviceUnitType.Pixel:
			{
				double num = twips / 1440.0 * 96.0;
				return Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: true, null).M22 * num;
			}
			case DeviceUnitType.Point:
				return twips / 20.0;
			case DeviceUnitType.Twip:
				return twips;
			default:
				return twips;
			}
		}

		internal static double ConvertToTwips(double value, DeviceUnitType sourceUnit)
		{
			switch (sourceUnit)
			{
			case DeviceUnitType.Centimeter:
				return value / 2.54 * 1440.0;
			case DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit:
				return value / 96.0 * 1440.0;
			case DeviceUnitType.Inch:
				return value * 1440.0;
			case DeviceUnitType.Pixel:
				value = Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: false, null).M11 * value;
				return value / 96.0 * 1440.0;
			case DeviceUnitType.Point:
				return value * 20.0;
			case DeviceUnitType.Twip:
				return value;
			default:
				return value;
			}
		}

		internal static void ValidateUnitLengthValue(double value)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNan(value);
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotInfinity(value);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DeviceUnitLength)
			{
				return Equals((DeviceUnitLength)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _unit.GetHashCode() | _value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DeviceUnitLength length1, DeviceUnitLength length2)
		{
			if (length1._unit == length2._unit)
			{
				return length1._value.Equals(length2._value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DeviceUnitLength length1, DeviceUnitLength length2)
		{
			return !(length1 == length2);
		}

		public bool Equals(DeviceUnitLength other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	public class DeviceUnitLengthConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		private static Dictionary<DeviceUnitType, string> _suffixTable;

		static DeviceUnitLengthConverter()
		{
			_suffixTable = new Dictionary<DeviceUnitType, string>
			{
				[DeviceUnitType.Centimeter] = "cm",
				[DeviceUnitType.Inch] = "in",
				[DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit] = string.Empty,
				[DeviceUnitType.Pixel] = "px",
				[DeviceUnitType.Point] = "pt",
				[DeviceUnitType.Twip] = "twip"
			};
		}

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Utilities.IsNumericType(sourceType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("value");
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				return FromString(value as string, culture);
			}
			if (!Utilities.IsNumericType(value.GetType()))
			{
				throw GetConvertFromException(value);
			}
			object value2 = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(double), culture, null);
			double num = Convert.ToDouble(value2);
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return new DeviceUnitLength(0.0);
			}
			return new DeviceUnitLength(num);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("value");
			}
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("destinationType");
			}
			if (!(value is DeviceUnitLength deviceUnitLength))
			{
				throw GetConvertToException(value, destinationType);
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return ToString(deviceUnitLength, culture);
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(DeviceUnitLength).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(double),
					typeof(DeviceUnitType)
				});
				return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[2] { deviceUnitLength.Value, deviceUnitLength.UnitType }, isComplete: true);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		internal static DeviceUnitLength FromString(string strValue, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			DeviceUnitType unit = DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit;
			ParseUnit(ref strValue, out unit);
			return new DeviceUnitLength(Convert.ToDouble(strValue, culture), unit);
		}

		internal static string GetSuffix(DeviceUnitType unitType)
		{
			return _suffixTable[unitType];
		}

		internal static void ParseUnit(ref string strValue, out DeviceUnitType unit)
		{
			unit = DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DeviceUnitType, string> item in _suffixTable)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Value) && strValue.EndsWith(item.Value))
				{
					unit = item.Key;
					strValue = strValue.Substring(0, strValue.Length - item.Value.Length);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static string ToString(DeviceUnitLength length, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			string suffix = GetSuffix(length.UnitType);
			string text = Convert.ToString(length.Value, culture);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(suffix))
			{
				text += suffix;
			}
			return text;
		}
	}

	public struct DeviceUnitSize : IEquatable<DeviceUnitSize>
	{
		private double _width;

		private double _height;

		private DeviceUnitType _unit;

		public double Width
		{
			get
			{
				return _width;

			set

				SetValue(ref _width, value);
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				return _height;

			set
			{
				SetValue(ref _height, value);

		public DeviceUnitType UnitType
		{
			get
			{
				return _unit;
			}
			set
			{
				_unit = value;
			}
		}

		public DeviceUnitSize(double width, double height)
			: this(width, height, DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit)

		}

		public DeviceUnitSize(double width, double height, DeviceUnitType type)
		{
			DeviceUnitLength.ValidateUnitLengthValue(width);
			DeviceUnitLength.ValidateUnitLengthValue(height);
			_width = width;
			_height = height;
			_unit = type;
		}

		public DeviceUnitSize ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType unitType)
		{
			if (UnitType == unitType)
			{
				return this;

			return new DeviceUnitSize(DeviceUnitLength.ConvertFromTwips(DeviceUnitLength.ConvertToTwips(_width, _unit), unitType), DeviceUnitLength.ConvertFromTwips(DeviceUnitLength.ConvertToTwips(_height, _unit), unitType), unitType);
		}

		private static void SetValue(ref double member, double newValue)
		{
			DeviceUnitLength.ValidateUnitLengthValue(newValue);
			member = newValue;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DeviceUnitSize)
			{
				return Equals((DeviceUnitSize)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _unit.GetHashCode() ^ _width.GetHashCode() ^ _height.GetHashCode();
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DeviceUnitSize length1, DeviceUnitSize length2)
		{
			if (length1._unit == length2._unit && length1._width.Equals(length2._width))
			{
				return length1._height.Equals(length2._height);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DeviceUnitSize length1, DeviceUnitSize length2)
		{
			return !(length1 == length2);
		}

		public bool Equals(DeviceUnitSize other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	public class DeviceUnitSizeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Utilities.IsNumericType(sourceType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(value, "value");
			if (value is string)
			{
				string strValue = value as string;
				DeviceUnitLengthConverter.ParseUnit(ref strValue, out var unit);
				System.Windows.Size size = (System.Windows.Size)new System.Windows.SizeConverter().ConvertFromString(context, culture, strValue);
				if (size.IsEmpty)
				{
					throw GetConvertFromException(value);
				}
				return new DeviceUnitSize(size.Width, size.Height, unit);
			}
			if (!Utilities.IsNumericType(value.GetType()))
			{
				throw GetConvertFromException(value);
			}
			object value2 = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(double), culture, null);
			return new DeviceUnitLength(Convert.ToDouble(value2));
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(value, "value");
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(destinationType, "destinationType");
			if (!(value is DeviceUnitSize deviceUnitSize))
			{
				throw GetConvertToException(value, destinationType);
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(deviceUnitSize.Width, deviceUnitSize.Height);
				string text = new System.Windows.SizeConverter().ConvertToString(context, culture, size);
				return text + DeviceUnitLengthConverter.GetSuffix(deviceUnitSize.UnitType);
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(DeviceUnitLength).GetConstructor(new Type[5]
				{
					typeof(double),
					typeof(double),
					typeof(double),
					typeof(double),
					typeof(DeviceUnitType)
				});
				return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[3] { deviceUnitSize.Width, deviceUnitSize.Height, deviceUnitSize.UnitType }, isComplete: true);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(DeviceUnitThicknessConverter))]
	public struct DeviceUnitThickness : IEquatable<DeviceUnitThickness>
	{
		private double _left;

		private double _top;

		private double _right;

		private double _bottom;

		private DeviceUnitType _unit;

		public double Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				return _bottom;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ref _bottom, value);
			}
		}

		public double Left
		{
			get
			{
				return _left;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ref _left, value);
			}
		}

		public double Right
		{
			get
			{
				return _right;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ref _right, value);
			}
		}

		public double Top
		{
			get
			{
				return _top;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ref _top, value);
			}
		}

		public DeviceUnitType UnitType
		{
			get
			{
				return _unit;
			}
			set
			{
				_unit = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsUniform
		{
			get
			{
				if (CoreUtilities.AreClose(_left, _top) && CoreUtilities.AreClose(_left, _right))
				{
					return CoreUtilities.AreClose(_left, _bottom);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DeviceUnitThickness(double uniformLength)
			: this(uniformLength, DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit)
		{
		}

		public DeviceUnitThickness(double uniformLength, DeviceUnitType type)
		{
			DeviceUnitLength.ValidateUnitLengthValue(uniformLength);
			_left = (_right = (_top = (_bottom = uniformLength)));
			_unit = type;
		}

		public DeviceUnitThickness(double left, double top, double right, double bottom, DeviceUnitType type)
		{
			_unit = type;
			_left = (_top = (_right = (_bottom = 0.0)));
			Left = left;
			Top = top;
			Bottom = bottom;
			Right = right;
		}

		public DeviceUnitThickness ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType unitType)
		{
			if (UnitType == unitType)
			{
				return this;
			}
			double num = DeviceUnitLength.ConvertFromTwips(DeviceUnitLength.ConvertToTwips(_left, _unit), unitType);
			if (IsUniform)
			{
				return new DeviceUnitThickness(num, unitType);
			}
			return new DeviceUnitThickness(num, DeviceUnitLength.ConvertFromTwips(DeviceUnitLength.ConvertToTwips(_top, _unit), unitType), DeviceUnitLength.ConvertFromTwips(DeviceUnitLength.ConvertToTwips(_right, _unit), unitType), DeviceUnitLength.ConvertFromTwips(DeviceUnitLength.ConvertToTwips(_bottom, _unit), unitType), unitType);
		}

		private static void SetValue(ref double member, double newValue)
		{
			DeviceUnitLength.ValidateUnitLengthValue(newValue);
			member = newValue;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DeviceUnitThickness)
			{
				return Equals((DeviceUnitThickness)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _unit.GetHashCode() ^ _left.GetHashCode() ^ _right.GetHashCode() ^ _top.GetHashCode() ^ _bottom.GetHashCode();
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DeviceUnitThickness length1, DeviceUnitThickness length2)
		{
			if (length1._unit == length2._unit && length1._left.Equals(length2._left) && length1._right.Equals(length2._right) && length1._top.Equals(length2._top))
			{
				return length1._bottom.Equals(length2._bottom);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DeviceUnitThickness length1, DeviceUnitThickness length2)
		{
			return !(length1 == length2);
		}

		public bool Equals(DeviceUnitThickness other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	public class DeviceUnitThicknessConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Utilities.IsNumericType(sourceType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(value, "value");
			if (value is string)
			{
				string strValue = value as string;
				DeviceUnitLengthConverter.ParseUnit(ref strValue, out var unit);
				Thickness thickness = (Thickness)new ThicknessConverter().ConvertFromString(context, culture, strValue);
				return new DeviceUnitThickness(thickness.Left, thickness.Top, thickness.Right, thickness.Bottom, unit);
			}
			if (!Utilities.IsNumericType(value.GetType()))
			{
				throw GetConvertFromException(value);
			}
			object value2 = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(double), culture, null);
			return new DeviceUnitLength(Convert.ToDouble(value2));
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(value, "value");
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(destinationType, "destinationType");
			if (!(value is DeviceUnitThickness deviceUnitThickness))
			{
				throw GetConvertToException(value, destinationType);
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				if (deviceUnitThickness.IsUniform)
				{
					return DeviceUnitLengthConverter.ToString(new DeviceUnitLength(deviceUnitThickness.Left, deviceUnitThickness.UnitType), culture);
				}
				Thickness thickness = new Thickness(deviceUnitThickness.Left, deviceUnitThickness.Top, deviceUnitThickness.Right, deviceUnitThickness.Bottom);
				string text = new ThicknessConverter().ConvertToString(context, culture, thickness);
				return text + DeviceUnitLengthConverter.GetSuffix(deviceUnitThickness.UnitType);
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor;
				if (deviceUnitThickness.IsUniform)
				{
					constructor = typeof(DeviceUnitLength).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(double),
						typeof(DeviceUnitType)
					});
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[2] { deviceUnitThickness.Left, deviceUnitThickness.UnitType }, isComplete: true);
				}
				constructor = typeof(DeviceUnitLength).GetConstructor(new Type[5]
				{
					typeof(double),
					typeof(double),
					typeof(double),
					typeof(double),
					typeof(DeviceUnitType)
				});
				return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[5] { deviceUnitThickness.Left, deviceUnitThickness.Top, deviceUnitThickness.Right, deviceUnitThickness.Bottom, deviceUnitThickness.UnitType }, isComplete: true);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class ExpanderDecorator : Decorator
	{
		private System.Windows.Size _cachedChildActualSize = System.Windows.Size.Empty;

		private double _fromAnimationValue;

		private double _toAnimationValue;

		private DependencyProperty _propertyToAnimate;

		private bool _isAnimationActive;

		private Storyboard _storyboard;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand ToggleExpandedState;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsExpandedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		public bool IsExpanded
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsExpandedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsExpandedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public System.Windows.Controls.Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Controls.Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static ExpanderDecorator()
		{
			IsExpandedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsExpanded", typeof(bool), typeof(ExpanderDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsExpandedChanged, OnCoerceIsExpanded));
			OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation), typeof(ExpanderDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.OrientationHorizontalBox, null, OnCoerceOrientation));
			UIElement.ClipToBoundsProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ExpanderDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			ToggleExpandedState = new RoutedCommand("ToggleExpandedState", typeof(ExpanderDecorator));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(ExpanderDecorator), new CommandBinding(ToggleExpandedState, OnToggleExpandedState, OnQueryToggleExpandedState));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeSize);
			if (Child != null && IsExpanded && !_isAnimationActive)
			{
				_cachedChildActualSize = new System.Windows.Size(((FrameworkElement)Child).ActualWidth, ((FrameworkElement)Child).ActualHeight);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			if (Child != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Size availableSize = constraint;
				if (IsExpanded)
				{
					availableSize = ((Orientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical) ? new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, constraint.Height) : new System.Windows.Size(constraint.Width, double.PositiveInfinity));
				}
				Child.Measure(availableSize);
				return Child.DesiredSize;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new ExpanderDecoratorAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		private static object OnCoerceIsExpanded(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			if (target is ExpanderDecorator { IsLoaded: false } expanderDecorator && (bool)value)
			{
				if (expanderDecorator.Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					expanderDecorator.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					expanderDecorator.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void OnIsExpandedChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is ExpanderDecorator expanderDecorator)
			{
				if (!(bool)e.NewValue || !expanderDecorator.IsLoaded || !expanderDecorator.IsVisible)
				{
					expanderDecorator.AnimateSize((bool)e.NewValue);
				}
				else
				{
					expanderDecorator.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, new Utilities.MethodDelegate(expanderDecorator.BeginAnimateSizeForExpand));
				}
			}
		}

		private static object OnCoerceOrientation(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			ExpanderDecorator expanderDecorator = target as ExpanderDecorator;
			if (expanderDecorator != null && expanderDecorator.IsLoaded && !expanderDecorator.IsExpanded)
			{
				expanderDecorator.IsExpanded = true;
			}
			else if (expanderDecorator != null && !expanderDecorator.IsLoaded && !expanderDecorator.IsExpanded)
			{
				if ((System.Windows.Controls.Orientation)value == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					expanderDecorator.Height = 0.0;
					expanderDecorator.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					expanderDecorator.Width = 0.0;
					expanderDecorator.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void AnimateSize(bool newIsExpandedValue)
		{
			if (Child == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!base.IsLoaded || !base.IsVisible)
			{
				if (!newIsExpandedValue)
				{
					if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
					{
						base.Height = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						base.Width = 0.0;
					}
				}
				else if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
					BeginAnimation(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, null);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
					BeginAnimation(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, null);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (newIsExpandedValue)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
				InvalidateArrange();
				UpdateLayout();
			}
			double width = _cachedChildActualSize.Width;
			double height = _cachedChildActualSize.Height;
			if (double.IsInfinity(width))
			{
				width = Child.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(height))
			{
				height = Child.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			if (!newIsExpandedValue)
			{
				_toAnimationValue = 0.0;
				if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					_fromAnimationValue = height;
					_propertyToAnimate = FrameworkElement.HeightProperty;
				}
				else
				{
					_fromAnimationValue = width;
					_propertyToAnimate = FrameworkElement.WidthProperty;
				}
			}
			else if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				_fromAnimationValue = 0.0;
				_toAnimationValue = height;
				_propertyToAnimate = FrameworkElement.HeightProperty;
			}
			else
			{
				_fromAnimationValue = 0.0;
				_toAnimationValue = width;
				_propertyToAnimate = FrameworkElement.WidthProperty;
			}
			if (!double.IsInfinity(_fromAnimationValue) && !double.IsInfinity(_toAnimationValue))
			{
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = CreateDoubleAnimation(_fromAnimationValue, _toAnimationValue, new Duration(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.3)));
				_storyboard = new Storyboard();
				_storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation);
				string text = base.Name;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					NameScope.SetNameScope(this, new NameScope());
					text = "ExpDec";
					RegisterName(text, this);
				}
				Storyboard.SetTargetName(doubleAnimation, text);
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath(_propertyToAnimate));
				_storyboard.Completed += StoryboardCompleted;
				_isAnimationActive = true;
				_storyboard.Begin(this);
			}
		}

		private void BeginAnimateSizeForExpand()
		{
			if (IsExpanded)
			{
				AnimateSize(newIsExpandedValue: true);
			}
		}

		private DoubleAnimation CreateDoubleAnimation(double from, double to, Duration duration)
		{
			return new DoubleAnimation(from, to, duration);
		}

		private void StoryboardCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_storyboard != null)
			{
				_storyboard.Completed -= StoryboardCompleted;
			}
			_storyboard = null;
			_isAnimationActive = false;
			if (_toAnimationValue != 0.0)
			{
				BeginAnimation(_propertyToAnimate, null);
				ClearValue(_propertyToAnimate);
			}
		}

		private static void OnToggleExpandedState(object target, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (target is ExpanderDecorator expanderDecorator)
			{
				expanderDecorator.IsExpanded = !expanderDecorator.IsExpanded;
			}
		}

		private static void OnQueryToggleExpandedState(object target, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.CanExecute = true;
		}
	}

	internal class HwndSourceHelper
	{
		private class HwndSourceWrapper
		{
			private WeakReference _hs;

			private HwndSourceHook _hook;

			private WeakList<UIElement> _elementList;

			private bool _isEnabled;

			internal HwndSourceWrapper(HwndSource hs, HwndSourceHook hook)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(hs);
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(hook);
				_hs = new WeakReference(hs);
				_hook = hook;
				_elementList = new WeakList<UIElement>();
			}

			public void AddElement(UIElement element)
			{
				_elementList.Add(element);
				_elementList.Compact();
				VerifyIsEnabled();
			}

			public void RemoveElement(UIElement element)
			{
				_elementList.Remove(element);
				_elementList.Compact();
				VerifyIsEnabled();
			}

			private void VerifyIsEnabled()
			{
				bool flag = _elementList.Count > 0;
				if (_isEnabled != flag && CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_hs) is HwndSource hwndSource && !(hwndSource.IsDisposed && flag))
				{
					_isEnabled = flag;
					if (flag)
					{
						hwndSource.AddHook(_hook);
					}
					else
					{
						hwndSource.RemoveHook(_hook);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private WeakDictionary<HwndSource, HwndSourceWrapper> _sourceElements;

		private WeakList<UIElement> _noSourceList;

		private WeakDictionary<UIElement, int> _elementRefCount;

		private HwndSourceHook _hook;

		private static UIPermission _permission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);

		[SecurityCritical]
		public HwndSourceHelper(HwndSourceHook hook)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(hook, "hook");
			_permission.Demand();
			_hook = hook;
			_sourceElements = new WeakDictionary<HwndSource, HwndSourceWrapper>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: false);
			_noSourceList = new WeakList<UIElement>();
			_elementRefCount = new WeakDictionary<UIElement, int>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: false);
		}

		private void OnElementSourceChanged(object sender, SourceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UIElement element = sender as UIElement;
			RemoveElementFromSource(element, e.OldSource as HwndSource);
			AddElementToSource(element, e.NewSource as HwndSource);
		}

		private void AddElementToSource(UIElement element, HwndSource source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				_noSourceList.Add(element);
				return;
			}
			if (!_sourceElements.TryGetValue(source, out var value))
			{
				value = (_sourceElements[source] = new HwndSourceWrapper(source, _hook));
			}
			value.AddElement(element);
		}

		private void RemoveElementFromSource(UIElement element, HwndSource source)
		{
			HwndSourceWrapper value;
			if (source == null)
			{
				_noSourceList.Remove(element);
			}
			else if (_sourceElements.TryGetValue(source, out value))
			{
				value.RemoveElement(element);
			}
		}

		public void AddElement(UIElement element)
		{
			if (!_elementRefCount.TryGetValue(element, out var value) || value == 0)
			{
				PresentationSource.AddSourceChangedHandler(element, OnElementSourceChanged);
				AddElementToSource(element, PresentationSource.FromVisual(element) as HwndSource);
			}
			_elementRefCount[element] = value + 1;
			_elementRefCount.Compact(removeEntriesWithNullValues: true);
		}

		public void RemoveElement(UIElement element)
		{
			if (_elementRefCount.TryGetValue(element, out var value))
			{
				if (value == 1)
				{
					PresentationSource.RemoveSourceChangedHandler(element, OnElementSourceChanged);
					_elementRefCount.Remove(element);
					RemoveElementFromSource(element, PresentationSource.FromVisual(element) as HwndSource);
				}
				else
				{
					_elementRefCount[element] = value - 1;
				}
				_elementRefCount.Compact(removeEntriesWithNullValues: true);
			}
		}
	}

	public class Utilities : CoreUtilities
	{
		public delegate bool DependencyObjectSearchCallback<T>(T dependencyObject) where T : DependencyObject;

		private class SnapInfo
		{
			private WeakReference _rootVisual;

			private FrameworkElement _rootLoadElement;

			private WeakList<FrameworkElement> _loadedElements = new WeakList<FrameworkElement>();

			private bool _compactPending;

			private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey InfoPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("Info", typeof(SnapInfo), typeof(SnapInfo), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((object)null));

			internal static readonly DependencyProperty InfoProperty = InfoPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

			private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey OwnerPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("Owner", typeof(FrameworkElement), typeof(SnapInfo), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((object)null));

			internal static readonly DependencyProperty OwnerProperty = OwnerPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

			private SnapInfo(FrameworkElement rootLoadedElement)
			{
				if (rootLoadedElement == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_rootLoadElement = rootLoadedElement;
			}

			private static SnapInfo GetInfo(DependencyObject d)
			{
				return (SnapInfo)d.GetValue(InfoProperty);
			}

			private static void SetInfo(DependencyObject d, SnapInfo value)
			{
				d.SetValue(InfoPropertyKey, value);
			}

			private static FrameworkElement GetOwner(DependencyObject d)
			{
				return (FrameworkElement)d.GetValue(OwnerProperty);
			}

			private static void SetOwner(DependencyObject d, FrameworkElement value)
			{
				d.SetValue(OwnerPropertyKey, value);
			}

			private void AddDescendant(FrameworkElement snapToElement)
			{
				VerifyCompacted();
				_loadedElements.Add(snapToElement);
				if (_loadedElements.Count == 1)
				{
					DependencyObject ancestorForLoaded;
					DependencyObject rootVisual = GetRootVisual(_rootLoadElement, out ancestorForLoaded);
					if (rootVisual != null)
					{
						_rootVisual = new WeakReference(rootVisual);
						_rootLoadElement.LayoutUpdated += OnRootLayoutUpdated;
					}
					else
					{
						_rootVisual = null;
					}
				}
				snapToElement.RenderTransform = null;
			}

			private void CompactList(object param)
			{
				VerifyCompacted();
			}

			private void GetDeviceMatrixes(Visual rootVisual, out Matrix toDeviceMatrix, out Matrix fromDeviceMatrix)
			{
				toDeviceMatrix = GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: true, rootVisual);
				fromDeviceMatrix = GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: false, rootVisual);
			}

			private static DependencyObject GetRootVisual(DependencyObject descendant, out DependencyObject ancestorForLoaded)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = descendant;
				ancestorForLoaded = null;
				while (descendant != null)
				{
					if (descendant is Page || descendant is Frame)
					{
						ancestorForLoaded = descendant;
					}
					dependencyObject = descendant;
					descendant = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(descendant);
				}
				if (ancestorForLoaded == null)
				{
					ancestorForLoaded = dependencyObject;
				}
				return dependencyObject;
			}

			private void OnRootLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				if (_rootVisual == null || !(CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_rootVisual) is Visual visual))
				{
					return;
				}
				VerifyCompacted();
				GetDeviceMatrixes(visual, out var toDeviceMatrix, out var fromDeviceMatrix);
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _loadedElements.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _loadedElements[i];
					if (frameworkElement == null || !visual.IsAncestorOf(frameworkElement))
					{
						continue;
					}
					System.Windows.Point point = default(System.Windows.Point);
					try
					{
						GeneralTransform generalTransform = frameworkElement.TransformToAncestor(visual);
						if (generalTransform == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						point = generalTransform.Transform(default(System.Windows.Point));
						goto IL_009f;
					}
					catch (InvalidOperationException)
					{
					}
					continue;
					IL_0170:
					point = toDeviceMatrix.Transform(point);
					goto IL_017b;
					IL_017b:
					point.X = Math.Round(point.X);
					point.Y = Math.Round(point.Y);
					point = fromDeviceMatrix.Transform(point);
					GeneralTransform generalTransform2 = visual.TransformToDescendant(frameworkElement);
					if (generalTransform2 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					point = generalTransform2.Transform(point);
					Transform transform;
					TranslateTransform translateTransform;
					if (translateTransform != null && transform != null)
					{
						point = transform.Transform(point);
					}
					double x = point.X;
					double y = point.Y;
					bool flag;
					bool flag2;
					if (translateTransform != null)
					{
						flag = !CoreUtilities.AreClose(x, translateTransform.X);
						flag2 = !CoreUtilities.AreClose(y, translateTransform.Y);
					}
					if (x != 0.0 || y != 0.0)
					{
						if (translateTransform == null || translateTransform.IsSealed)
						{
							translateTransform = new TranslateTransform(x, y);
							frameworkElement.RenderTransform = translateTransform;
							continue;
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							translateTransform.X = x;
						}
						if (flag2)
						{
							translateTransform.Y = y;
						}
					}
					else if (translateTransform != null)
					{
						frameworkElement.RenderTransform = null;
					}
					continue;
					IL_009f:
					point = toDeviceMatrix.Transform(point);
					x = Math.Round(point.X) - point.X;
					y = Math.Round(point.Y) - point.Y;
					flag = !CoreUtilities.AreClose(x, 0.0);
					flag2 = !CoreUtilities.AreClose(y, 0.0);
					if (!flag && !flag2)
					{
						continue;
					}
					System.Windows.Point point2 = point;
					translateTransform = frameworkElement.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform;
					transform = VisualTreeHelper.GetTransform(frameworkElement);
					if (translateTransform != null && transform != null)
					{
						System.Windows.Point point3 = point;
						try
						{
							point = transform.Inverse.Transform(default(System.Windows.Point));
							GeneralTransform generalTransform3 = frameworkElement.TransformToAncestor(visual);
							if (generalTransform3 == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							point = generalTransform3.Transform(point);
							goto IL_0170;
						}
						catch (InvalidOperationException)
						{
						}
						continue;
					}
					goto IL_017b;
				}
			}

			private void RemoveDescendant(FrameworkElement snapToElement)
			{
				int num = _loadedElements.IndexOf(snapToElement);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					_loadedElements[num] = null;
				}
				_compactPending = true;
				_rootLoadElement.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, new SendOrPostCallback(CompactList), _loadedElements);
				snapToElement.ClearValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty);
			}

			private void VerifyCompacted()
			{
				if (_compactPending)
				{
					_compactPending = false;
					int count = _loadedElements.Count;
					_loadedElements.Compact();
					if (count > 0 && _loadedElements.Count == 0)
					{
						_rootLoadElement.LayoutUpdated -= OnRootLayoutUpdated;
					}
				}
			}

			internal static void Add(FrameworkElement fe)
			{
				DependencyObject ancestorForLoaded;
				DependencyObject rootVisual = GetRootVisual(fe, out ancestorForLoaded);
				if (ancestorForLoaded is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					SnapInfo snapInfo = GetInfo(ancestorForLoaded);
					if (snapInfo == null)
					{
						snapInfo = new SnapInfo(frameworkElement);
						SetInfo(ancestorForLoaded, snapInfo);
					}
					snapInfo.AddDescendant(fe);
					SetOwner(fe, frameworkElement);
				}
			}

			internal static void Remove(FrameworkElement fe)
			{
				FrameworkElement owner = GetOwner(fe);
				if (owner != null)
				{
					SnapInfo info = GetInfo(owner);
					fe.ClearValue(OwnerPropertyKey);
					info.RemoveDescendant(fe);
				}
			}
		}

			}

				accessMethod();

		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (map == null)
				{
					map = new Dictionary<TKey, TValue>();
				}
				map[key] = value;
			}
			return map;
		}

		public static void AnimateTranslateTransform(TranslateTransform translateTransform, double fromX, double toX, double fromY, double toY, int durationMilliseconds, bool autoReverse, EventHandler callbackHandler)
		{
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation(fromX, toX, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(durationMilliseconds), FillBehavior.HoldEnd);
			doubleAnimation.BeginTime = null;
			doubleAnimation.AutoReverse = autoReverse;
			doubleAnimation.AccelerationRatio = 0.5;
			doubleAnimation.DecelerationRatio = 0.5;
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation2 = new DoubleAnimation(fromY, toY, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(durationMilliseconds), FillBehavior.HoldEnd);
			doubleAnimation2.BeginTime = null;
			doubleAnimation2.AutoReverse = autoReverse;
			doubleAnimation2.AccelerationRatio = 0.5;
			doubleAnimation2.DecelerationRatio = 0.5;
			AnimationClock animationClock = doubleAnimation.CreateClock();
			AnimationClock animationClock2 = doubleAnimation2.CreateClock();
			translateTransform.ApplyAnimationClock(TranslateTransform.XProperty, animationClock);
			translateTransform.ApplyAnimationClock(TranslateTransform.YProperty, animationClock2);
			if (callbackHandler != null)
			{
				animationClock.CurrentStateInvalidated += callbackHandler;
			}
			animationClock.Controller.Begin();
			animationClock2.Controller.Begin();
		}

		internal static bool AreLogicalPixelsSameAsDevicePixels(Visual relativeVisual = null)
		{
			return GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: true, relativeVisual).M22 == 1.0;
		}

		public static bool CanExecuteCommand(ICommandSource commandSource)
		{
			if (commandSource == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("commandSource");
			}
			bool result = false;
			ICommand command = commandSource.Command;
			if (command != null)
			{
				RoutedCommand routedCommand = command as RoutedCommand;
				object commandParameter = commandSource.CommandParameter;
				if (routedCommand != null)
				{
					IInputElement target = commandSource.CommandTarget ?? (commandSource as IInputElement);
					result = routedCommand.CanExecute(commandParameter, target);
				}
				else
				{
					result = command.CanExecute(commandParameter);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static Thickness CalculateTotalMarginAndPadding(DependencyObject ancestor, DependencyObject descendant)
		{
			if (ancestor == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ancestor");
			}
			if (descendant == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("descendant");
			}
			Thickness result = default(Thickness);
			if (ancestor is Visual visual && !visual.IsAncestorOf(descendant))
			{
				return result;
			}
			for (DependencyObject dependencyObject = descendant; dependencyObject != null; dependencyObject = GetParent(dependencyObject))
			{
				DependencyProperty dependencyProperty = null;
				DependencyProperty dependencyProperty2 = null;
				if (dependencyObject is AnchoredBlock)
				{
					dependencyProperty = AnchoredBlock.MarginProperty;
					dependencyProperty2 = AnchoredBlock.PaddingProperty;
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is Block)
				{
					dependencyProperty = Block.MarginProperty;
					dependencyProperty2 = Block.PaddingProperty;
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is FrameworkElement)
				{
					dependencyProperty = FrameworkElement.MarginProperty;
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is ListItem)
				{
					dependencyProperty = ListItem.MarginProperty;
					dependencyProperty2 = ListItem.PaddingProperty;
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is Border)
				{
					dependencyProperty2 = Border.PaddingProperty;
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is System.Windows.Controls.Control)
				{
					dependencyProperty2 = System.Windows.Controls.Control.PaddingProperty;
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is TableCell)
				{
					dependencyProperty2 = TableCell.PaddingProperty;
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is TextBlock)
				{
					dependencyProperty2 = TextBlock.PaddingProperty;
				}
				if (dependencyProperty != null)
				{
					Thickness thickness = (Thickness)dependencyObject.GetValue(dependencyProperty);
					result.Top += thickness.Top;
					result.Left += thickness.Left;
					result.Bottom += thickness.Bottom;
					result.Right += thickness.Right;
				}
				if (dependencyProperty2 != null)
				{
					Thickness thickness2 = (Thickness)dependencyObject.GetValue(dependencyProperty2);
					result.Top += thickness2.Top;
					result.Left += thickness2.Left;
					result.Bottom += thickness2.Bottom;
					result.Right += thickness2.Right;
				}
				if (dependencyObject == ancestor)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static void CopyPropertyValues(FrameworkElementFactory target, DependencyObject source)
		{
			if (target == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("target");
			}
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			LocalValueEnumerator localValueEnumerator = source.GetLocalValueEnumerator();
			while (localValueEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (localValueEnumerator.Current.Value is BindingExpressionBase)
				{
					target.SetBinding(localValueEnumerator.Current.Property, ((BindingExpressionBase)localValueEnumerator.Current.Value).ParentBindingBase);
				}
				else if (localValueEnumerator.Current.Value is BindingBase)
				{
					target.SetBinding(localValueEnumerator.Current.Property, (BindingBase)localValueEnumerator.Current.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					target.SetValue(localValueEnumerator.Current.Property, localValueEnumerator.Current.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void CopyPropertyValues(DependencyObject target, DependencyObject source)
		{
			if (target == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("target");
			}
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			LocalValueEnumerator localValueEnumerator = source.GetLocalValueEnumerator();
			while (localValueEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (localValueEnumerator.Current.Value is BindingExpressionBase)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(target, localValueEnumerator.Current.Property, ((BindingExpressionBase)localValueEnumerator.Current.Value).ParentBindingBase);
				}
				else if (localValueEnumerator.Current.Value is BindingBase)
				{
					if (target is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
					{
						frameworkElement.SetBinding(localValueEnumerator.Current.Property, (BindingBase)localValueEnumerator.Current.Value);
					}
					else if (target is FrameworkContentElement frameworkContentElement)
					{
						frameworkContentElement.SetBinding(localValueEnumerator.Current.Property, (BindingBase)localValueEnumerator.Current.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					target.SetValue(localValueEnumerator.Current.Property, localValueEnumerator.Current.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public static Geometry CreateRoundedRectGeometry(Rect rect, RoundedRectCorners roundedCorners, double radiusX, double radiusY, double edgeThickness)
		{
			return CreateRoundedRectGeometry(rect, roundedCorners, radiusX, radiusY, edgeThickness, RoundedRectSide.Left, RoundedRectSide.Left);
		}

		public static Geometry CreateRoundedRectGeometry(Rect rect, RoundedRectCorners roundedCorners, double radiusX, double radiusY, double edgeThickness, RoundedRectSide startSide, RoundedRectSide endSide)
		{
			double num = edgeThickness / 2.0;
			if (startSide == endSide)
			{
				rect.Inflate(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
				radiusX = Math.Min(radiusX, rect.Width / 2.0);
				radiusY = Math.Min(radiusY, rect.Height / 2.0);
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = (int)endSide;
				if (num2 <= (int)startSide)
				{
					num2 += 4;
				}
				bool flag = RoundedRectSide.Left >= startSide || 4 <= num2;
				bool flag2 = RoundedRectSide.Top >= startSide || 5 <= num2;
				bool flag3 = RoundedRectSide.Right >= startSide || 6 <= num2;
				bool flag4 = RoundedRectSide.Bottom >= startSide || 7 <= num2;
				if (flag)
				{
					rect.X += num;
					rect.Width = Math.Max(rect.Width - num, 0.0);
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					rect.Y += num;
					rect.Height = Math.Max(rect.Height - num, 0.0);
				}
				if (flag3)
				{
					rect.Width = Math.Max(rect.Width - num, 0.0);
				}
				if (flag4)
				{
					rect.Height = Math.Max(rect.Height - num, 0.0);
				}
				radiusX = Math.Min(radiusX, (flag && flag3) ? (rect.Width / 2.0) : rect.Width);
				radiusY = Math.Min(radiusY, (flag2 && flag4) ? (rect.Height / 2.0) : rect.Height);
			}
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			bool flag5 = (roundedCorners & RoundedRectCorners.TopLeft) == RoundedRectCorners.TopLeft;
			bool flag6 = (roundedCorners & RoundedRectCorners.TopRight) == RoundedRectCorners.TopRight;
			bool flag7 = (roundedCorners & RoundedRectCorners.BottomLeft) == RoundedRectCorners.BottomLeft;
			bool flag8 = (roundedCorners & RoundedRectCorners.BottomRight) == RoundedRectCorners.BottomRight;
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(radiusX, radiusY);
			System.Windows.Point[] array = new System.Windows.Point[8]
			{
				flag7 ? new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - radiusY) : rect.BottomLeft,
				flag5 ? new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left, rect.Top + radiusY) : rect.TopLeft,
				flag5 ? new System.Windows.Point(rect.X + radiusX, rect.Top) : rect.TopLeft,
				flag6 ? new System.Windows.Point(rect.Right - radiusX, rect.Top) : rect.TopRight,
				flag6 ? new System.Windows.Point(rect.Right, rect.Top + radiusY) : rect.TopRight,
				flag8 ? new System.Windows.Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom - radiusY) : rect.BottomRight,
				flag8 ? new System.Windows.Point(rect.Right - radiusX, rect.Bottom) : rect.BottomRight,
				flag7 ? new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left + radiusX, rect.Bottom) : rect.BottomLeft
			};
			using StreamGeometryContext streamGeometryContext = streamGeometry.Open();
			int num3 = (int)startSide * 2;
			int num4 = ((endSide == startSide) ? 8 : ((int)endSide * 2 + 1));
			if (num4 < num3)
			{
				num4 += 8;
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = array[num3];
			streamGeometryContext.BeginFigure(point, isFilled: true, isClosed: false);
			for (int i = num3 + 1; i <= num4; i++)
			{
				int num5 = i % 8;
				System.Windows.Point point2 = array[num5];
				if (num5 % 2 == 1)
				{
					streamGeometryContext.LineTo(point2, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: false);
				}
				else if (point2 != point)
				{
					streamGeometryContext.ArcTo(point2, size, 0.0, isLargeArc: false, SweepDirection.Clockwise, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: false);
				}
				point = point2;
			}
			return streamGeometry;
		}

		public static string StringFromNonDefaultProperties(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			Type type = obj.GetType();
			SortedDictionary<string, object> sortedDictionary = null;
			LocalValueEnumerator localValueEnumerator = obj.GetLocalValueEnumerator();
			while (localValueEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				LocalValueEntry current = localValueEnumerator.Current;
				Type ownerType = current.Property.OwnerType;
				if ((type == ownerType || ownerType.IsAssignableFrom(type)) && !object.Equals(current.Property.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue, current.Value))
				{
					if (sortedDictionary == null)
					{
						sortedDictionary = new SortedDictionary<string, object>();
					}
					sortedDictionary.Add(current.Property.Name, current.Value);
				}
			}
			if (sortedDictionary == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = null;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in sortedDictionary)
			{
				if (stringBuilder == null)
				{
					stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(item.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static bool DoesElementContainPoint(FrameworkElement elem, System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			if (p.X >= 0.0 && p.Y >= 0.0 && p.X < elem.ActualWidth)
			{
				return p.Y < elem.ActualHeight;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Point EnsureInElementBounds(System.Windows.Point point, FrameworkElement elem)
		{
			point.X = EnsureInRange(point.X, 0.0, elem.ActualWidth);
			point.Y = EnsureInRange(point.Y, 0.0, elem.ActualHeight);
			return point;
		}

		internal static double EnsureInRange(double val, double min, double max)
		{
			return Math.Min(Math.Max(val, min), max);
		}

		public static bool DoubleIsZero(double value)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(value) < 2.220446049250313E-13)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void ExecuteCommand(ICommandSource commandSource)
		{
			if (commandSource == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("commandSource");
			}
			if (CanExecuteCommand(commandSource))
			{
				ICommand command = commandSource.Command;
				RoutedCommand routedCommand = command as RoutedCommand;
				object commandParameter = commandSource.CommandParameter;
				if (routedCommand != null)
				{
					IInputElement target = commandSource.CommandTarget ?? (commandSource as IInputElement);
					routedCommand.Execute(commandParameter, target);
				}
				else
				{
					command.Execute(commandParameter);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static Transform FindLayoutTransform(FrameworkElement element, Type transformType)
		{
			if (element.LayoutTransform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element.LayoutTransform.GetType() == transformType)
			{
				return element.LayoutTransform;
			}
			if (element.LayoutTransform.GetType() == typeof(TransformGroup))
			{
				TransformGroup transformGroup = element.LayoutTransform as TransformGroup;
				foreach (Transform child in transformGroup.Children)
				{
					if (child.GetType() == transformType)
					{
						return child;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static Transform FindRenderTransform(UIElement element, Type transformType)
		{
			if (element.RenderTransform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element.RenderTransform.GetType() == transformType)
			{
				return element.RenderTransform;
			}
			if (element.RenderTransform.GetType() == typeof(TransformGroup))
			{
				TransformGroup transformGroup = element.RenderTransform as TransformGroup;
				foreach (Transform child in transformGroup.Children)
				{
					if (child.GetType() == transformType)
					{
						return child;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		{

		}

		public static DependencyObject GetAncestorFromType(DependencyObject descendant, Type type, bool allowSubclassOfType, DependencyObject stopAtVisual, Type stopAtType)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = descendant;
			while (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = GetParent(dependencyObject);
				if (parent != null)
				{
					if (parent == stopAtVisual)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (stopAtType != null && stopAtType == parent.GetType())
					{
						return null;
					}
					Type type2 = parent.GetType();
					if (type2 == type)
					{
						return parent;
					}
					if (allowSubclassOfType && type.IsAssignableFrom(type2))
					{
						return parent;
					}
				}
				dependencyObject = parent;
			}
			return null;
		}

			return null;
		}

		internal static XmlLanguage GetNonDefaultLanguage(DependencyObject element)
		{
			XmlLanguage xmlLanguage = element.GetValue(FrameworkElement.LanguageProperty) as XmlLanguage;
			if (xmlLanguage != null && DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(element, FrameworkElement.LanguageProperty).BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Default && xmlLanguage.GetEquivalentCulture().IetfLanguageTag == "en-US")
			{

		public static CultureInfo GetNonNeutralCulture(IFrameworkInputElement element)
		{
			return GetNonNeutralCulture(element, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}

		internal static CultureInfo GetNonNeutralCulture(IFrameworkInputElement element, CultureInfo defaultCulture)
		{
			XmlLanguage xmlLanguage = null;
			if (element is FrameworkElement)
			{
				xmlLanguage = GetNonDefaultLanguage((FrameworkElement)element);
			}
			else if (element is FrameworkContentElement)
			{
				xmlLanguage = GetNonDefaultLanguage((FrameworkContentElement)element);
			}
			else if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_NonNeutralCultureRequiresElement"), "element");
			}
			CultureInfo cultureInfo = null;
			if (xmlLanguage != null)
			{
				try
				{
					cultureInfo = xmlLanguage.GetEquivalentCulture();
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
				}
			}
			if (cultureInfo == null)
			{
				cultureInfo = defaultCulture;
				if (cultureInfo == null)
				{
					cultureInfo = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				}
			}
			return GetNonNeutralCulture(cultureInfo);
		}

		public static CultureInfo GetNonNeutralCulture(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (culture == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("culture", SR.GetString("LE_NonNeutralCultureRequiresCulture"));
			}
			if (culture.IsNeutralCulture)
			{
				CultureInfo cultureInfo = null;
				try
				{
					cultureInfo = CultureInfo.CreateSpecificCulture(culture.Name);
				}
				catch (ArgumentException)
				{
					try
					{
						CultureInfo[] cultures = CultureInfo.GetCultures(CultureTypes.SpecificCultures);
						CultureInfo[] array = cultures;
						foreach (CultureInfo cultureInfo2 in array)
						{
							if (culture.Equals(cultureInfo2.Parent))
							{
								cultureInfo = cultureInfo2;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
					}
				}
				if (cultureInfo == null)
				{
					cultureInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
				}
				if (cultureInfo == null || cultureInfo.IsNeutralCulture)
				{
					cultureInfo = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				}
				culture = cultureInfo;
			}
			return culture;
		}

		public static FrameworkElement GetDescendantFromName(DependencyObject parent, string name)
		{
			int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent);
			if (childrenCount < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, i) is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					if (frameworkElement.Name == name)
					{
						return frameworkElement;
					}
					FrameworkElement descendantFromName = GetDescendantFromName(frameworkElement, name);
					if (descendantFromName != null)
					{
						return descendantFromName;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static T GetDescendantFromType<T>(DependencyObject parent, bool allowSubclassOfType, DependencyObjectSearchCallback<T> callback) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			return GetDescendantFromType(parent, allowSubclassOfType, callback, null);
		}

		public static T GetDescendantFromType<T>(DependencyObject parent, bool allowSubclassOfType, DependencyObjectSearchCallback<T> callback, Type[] typesToIgnore) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			return GetDescendantFromType(parent, typeof(T), allowSubclassOfType, callback, typesToIgnore);
		}

		private static T GetDescendantFromType<T>(DependencyObject parent, Type type, bool allowSubclassOfType, DependencyObjectSearchCallback<T> callback, Type[] typesToIgnore) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent);
			if (childrenCount < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, i) is T val)
				{
					Type type2 = val.GetType();
					if ((type2 == type || (allowSubclassOfType && type.IsAssignableFrom(type2))) && (callback == null || callback(val)))
					{
						return val;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < childrenCount; j++)
			{
				DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, j);
				if (child != null && (typesToIgnore == null || !ContainsType(typesToIgnore, child.GetType())))
				{
					child = GetDescendantFromType(child, type, allowSubclassOfType, callback, typesToIgnore);
					if (child != null)
					{

					}
				}
			}

		}
