		public static char GetFirstMnemonicChar(string text)
		{
			return GetFirstMnemonicChar(text, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture);
		}

		public static char GetFirstMnemonicChar(string text, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (text == null || text.Length < 1)
			{
				return '\0';
			}
			int num = text.IndexOf('_');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return '\0';
			}
			for (int num2 = num; num2 <= text.Length - 2; num2 = num)
			{
				char c = text[num2 + 1];
				if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c))
				{
					if (culture != null)
					{
						return char.ToUpper(c, culture);
					}
					return c;
				}
				num = text.IndexOf('_', num2 + 2);
				if (num <= num2)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return '\0';
		}

		public static object GetPropertyValueFromStyle(Style style, DependencyProperty property, bool walkUpBasedOnChain, bool returnBindingAsBinding)
		{
			object propertyValueFromStyleHelper = GetPropertyValueFromStyleHelper(style, property, walkUpBasedOnChain);
			if (!returnBindingAsBinding)
			{
				if (propertyValueFromStyleHelper is BindingExpressionBase bindingExpressionBase)
				{
					return bindingExpressionBase.ParentBindingBase.ProvideValue(null);
				}
				if (propertyValueFromStyleHelper is BindingBase bindingBase)
				{
					return bindingBase.ProvideValue(null);
				}
			}
			return propertyValueFromStyleHelper;
		}

		private static object GetPropertyValueFromStyleHelper(Style style, DependencyProperty property, bool walkUpBasedOnChain)
		{
			if (style == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("style");
			}
			if (property == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("property");
			}
			foreach (SetterBase setter2 in style.Setters)
			{
				if (setter2 is Setter setter && setter.Property == property)
				{
					return setter.Value;
				}
			}
			object result = null;
			if (walkUpBasedOnChain)
			{
				Style basedOn = style.BasedOn;
				if (basedOn != null)
				{
					result = GetPropertyValueFromStyleHelper(basedOn, property, walkUpBasedOnChain: true);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static string GetPublicKeyToken(Assembly assemblyToCheck)
		{
			if (assemblyToCheck == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("assemblyToCheck");
			}
			return GetPublicKeyToken(assemblyToCheck.FullName);
		}

		internal static string GetPublicKeyToken(string assemblyFullName)
		{
			string[] array = assemblyFullName.Split('=');
			for (int num = array.Length - 1; num > 0; num--)
			{
				if (array[num - 1].Length >= "PublicKeyToken".Length)
				{
					string text = array[num - 1].Substring(array[num - 1].Length - "PublicKeyToken".Length);
					if (text.Equals("PublicKeyToken"))
					{
						if (array[num].Length < 17)
						{
							return array[num];
						}
						return array[num].Substring(0, 16);
					}
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

					{

		}

		private static T GetTemplateChild<T>(FrameworkElement templatedParent, DependencyObject parent, DependencyObjectSearchCallback<T> callback) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			HashSet processedChildren = new HashSet();
			return GetTemplateChild(templatedParent, parent, callback, processedChildren);
		}

		private static T GetTemplateChild<T>(FrameworkElement templatedParent, DependencyObject parent, DependencyObjectSearchCallback<T> callback, HashSet processedChildren) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DependencyObject templatedParent2 = null;
			T targetChild;
			foreach (object child2 in LogicalTreeHelper.GetChildren(parent))
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = child2 as DependencyObject;
				if ((!GetTemplatedParent(dependencyObject, out templatedParent2) || templatedParent2 == templatedParent) && GetTemplateChild(templatedParent, callback, dependencyObject, processedChildren, out targetChild))
				{
					return targetChild;
				}
			}
			if (!IsVisual(parent))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent); i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, i);
				if (GetTemplatedParent(child, out templatedParent2) && templatedParent2 != templatedParent)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (GetTemplateChild(templatedParent, callback, child, processedChildren, out targetChild))
				{
					return targetChild;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool GetTemplateChild<T>(FrameworkElement templatedParent, DependencyObjectSearchCallback<T> callback, DependencyObject child, HashSet processedChildren, out T targetChild) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			if (child != null && !processedChildren.Exists(child))
			{
				targetChild = child as T;
				if (targetChild != null && (callback == null || callback(targetChild)))
				{
					return true;
				}
				processedChildren.Add(child);
				targetChild = GetTemplateChild(templatedParent, child, callback, processedChildren);
				if (targetChild != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			targetChild = null;
			return false;
		}

				return true;
			}
			if (reference is FrameworkContentElement frameworkContentElement)
			{
				templatedParent = frameworkContentElement.TemplatedParent;
				return true;
			}
			templatedParent = null;
			return false;
		}

			}
		}

		public static void RemoveAll(ArrayList list, object itemToRemove)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int count = list.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (itemToRemove == list[i])
				{
					num++;
				}
				else if (num != 0)
				{
					list[i - num] = list[i];
				}
			}
			list.RemoveRange(count - num, num);
		}

		internal static void SetFocusedElement(DependencyObject focusScope, UIElement newFocusedElement)
		{
			KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler handler = delegate(object s, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs se)
			{
				if (se.NewFocus == newFocusedElement)
				{
					se.Handled = true;
				}
			};
			newFocusedElement.AddHandler(Keyboard.PreviewGotKeyboardFocusEvent, handler);
			newFocusedElement.AddHandler(Keyboard.PreviewLostKeyboardFocusEvent, handler);
			FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(focusScope, newFocusedElement);
			newFocusedElement.RemoveHandler(Keyboard.PreviewLostKeyboardFocusEvent, handler);
			newFocusedElement.RemoveHandler(Keyboard.PreviewGotKeyboardFocusEvent, handler);
		}

		public static bool SetPropertyFromStyle(DependencyObject target, DependencyProperty targetProperty, Style source, DependencyProperty sourceProperty, bool walkUpBasedOnChain)
		{
			if (target == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("target");
			}
			if (sourceProperty == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sourceProperty");
			}
			if (targetProperty == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("targetProperty");
			}
			if (!targetProperty.PropertyType.IsAssignableFrom(sourceProperty.PropertyType))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_10"));
			}
			object propertyValueFromStyle = GetPropertyValueFromStyle(source, sourceProperty, walkUpBasedOnChain, returnBindingAsBinding: true);
			if (propertyValueFromStyle is BindingExpressionBase bindingExpressionBase)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(target, targetProperty, bindingExpressionBase.ParentBindingBase);
				return true;
			}
			if (propertyValueFromStyle is BindingBase binding)
			{
				if (target is FrameworkElement)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)target).SetBinding(targetProperty, binding);
					return true;
				}
				if (target is FrameworkContentElement)
				{
					((FrameworkContentElement)target).SetBinding(targetProperty, binding);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (propertyValueFromStyle == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = targetProperty.PropertyType.IsAssignableFrom(propertyValueFromStyle.GetType());
			if (flag)
			{
				target.SetValue(targetProperty, propertyValueFromStyle);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		}

		public static string StripMnemonics(string text, bool escapeRemainingMnemonics)
		{
			if (text == null || text.Length < 2)
			{
				return text;
			}
			int num = text.IndexOf('_');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return text;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (num > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(text.Substring(0, num));
			}
			int num2 = num;
			bool flag = false;
			int i = num;
			for (int num3 = text.Length - 1; i < num3; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c == '_')
				{
					char c2 = text[i + 1];
					if (c2 == '_')
					{
						if (escapeRemainingMnemonics)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append('_');
						}
					}
					else if (flag)
					{
						if (escapeRemainingMnemonics)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append('_');
						}
						stringBuilder.Append('_');
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(c2);
					i++;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
				}
				if (i == num3 - 1)
				{
					char c2 = text[i + 1];
					stringBuilder.Append(c2);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static ResourceDictionary CreateResourceSetDictionary(Assembly assembly, string resourcePath)
		{
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("assembly");
			}
			if (resourcePath == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("resourcePath");
			}
			ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary();
			string[] array = resourcePath.Split(';');
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				Uri source = CoreUtilities.BuildEmbeddedResourceUri(assembly, array[0]);
				resourceDictionary.Source = source;
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array[i].Length != 0)
					{
						ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary2 = new ResourceDictionary();
						Uri source2 = CoreUtilities.BuildEmbeddedResourceUri(assembly, array[i]);
						resourceDictionary2.Source = source2;
						resourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries.Add(resourceDictionary2);
					}
				}
			}
			return resourceDictionary;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point PointFromScreenSafe(Visual element, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return PointFromScreenSafe(element, point, null);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point PointFromScreenSafe(Visual element, System.Windows.Point point, Visual refElement)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("element");
			}
			if (!BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				try
				{
					return element.PointFromScreen(point);
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Point(-1.0, -1.0);
				}
			}
			Visual commonAncestor = GetCommonAncestor(element, refElement);
			if (commonAncestor == null || commonAncestor == element)
			{
				return point;
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = element as FrameworkElement;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = commonAncestor as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement2 != null)
			{
				return frameworkElement2.TranslatePoint(point, frameworkElement);
			}
			element.TransformToAncestor(commonAncestor)?.Transform(point);
			return point;
		}

		internal static Visual GetCommonAncestor(Visual element, Visual refElement)
		{
			Visual visual = null;
			if (refElement != null)
			{
				visual = refElement.FindCommonVisualAncestor(element) as Visual;
			}
			if (visual == null)
			{
				Visual visual2 = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element) as Visual;
				while (visual2 != null)
				{
					visual = visual2;
					Visual visual3 = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(visual2) as Visual;
					if (visual3 == null)
					{
						visual3 = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(visual2) as Visual;
						if (visual3 is Popup && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(visual3) == null)
						{
							ToolWindowHostPopup host = ToolWindowHostPopup.GetHost(visual3 as Popup);
							visual3 = ((host == null || !(host.Child is ToolWindow)) ? null : ((ToolWindow)host.Child).Owner);
						}
					}
					visual2 = visual3;
				}
			}
			return visual;
		}

		public static Rect GetWorkArea(Visual element, Visual refElement)
		{
			return GetWorkArea(element, default(System.Windows.Point), refElement);
		}

		public static Rect GetWorkArea(Visual element, System.Windows.Point point, Visual refElement)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("element");
			}
			if (!BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				return NativeWindowMethods.GetWorkArea(PointToScreenSafe(element, point, refElement));
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = element as FrameworkElement;
			Visual commonAncestor = GetCommonAncestor(element, refElement);
			if (commonAncestor == null || commonAncestor == element)
			{
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					return new Rect(frameworkElement.RenderSize);
				}
				return default(Rect);
			}
			if (commonAncestor is Window reference)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = ((VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(reference) > 0) ? (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(reference, 0) as FrameworkElement) : null);
				if (frameworkElement2 != null)
				{
					return new Rect(frameworkElement2.RenderSize);
				}
			}
			if (commonAncestor is FrameworkElement frameworkElement3)
			{
				return new Rect(frameworkElement3.RenderSize);
			}
			return default(Rect);
		}

		public static Rect RectFromPoints(System.Windows.Point point1, System.Windows.Point point2)
		{
			double x = Math.Min(point1.X, point2.X);
			double y = Math.Min(point1.Y, point2.Y);
			double width = Math.Abs(point2.X - point1.X);
			double height = Math.Abs(point2.Y - point1.Y);
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		}

		public static bool IsNumericType(Type type)
		{
			if (type.IsPrimitive || type == typeof(decimal))
			{
				if (type != typeof(bool) && type != typeof(char))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool GetSnapElementToDevicePixels(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(SnapElementToDevicePixelsProperty);
		}

		public static void SetSnapElementToDevicePixels(DependencyObject d, bool value)
		{
			d.SetValue(SnapElementToDevicePixelsProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnSnapElementToDevicePixelsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.Property == SnapElementToDevicePixelsProperty)
			{
				frameworkElement.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Send, new DispatcherOperationCallback(OnSyncSnapElementActual), d);
				return;
			}
			RoutedEventHandler value = OnSnappedElementLoadChanged;
			if (true.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				if (frameworkElement.IsLoaded)
				{
					frameworkElement.Unloaded += value;
					SnapInfo.Add(frameworkElement);
				}
				else
				{
					frameworkElement.Loaded += value;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				frameworkElement.Loaded -= value;
				frameworkElement.Unloaded -= value;
				SnapInfo.Remove(frameworkElement);
			}
		}

		private static object OnSyncSnapElementActual(object param)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = param as DependencyObject;
			dependencyObject.SetValue(SnapElementToDevicePixelsActualProperty, dependencyObject.GetValue(SnapElementToDevicePixelsProperty));
			return null;
		}

		private static void OnSnappedElementLoadChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = e.RoutedEvent == FrameworkElement.LoadedEvent;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = sender as FrameworkElement;
			RoutedEventHandler value = OnSnappedElementLoadChanged;
			if (flag)
			{
				frameworkElement.Loaded -= value;
				frameworkElement.Unloaded += value;
				SnapInfo.Add(frameworkElement);
			}
			else
			{
				frameworkElement.Unloaded -= value;
				frameworkElement.Loaded += value;
				SnapInfo.Remove(frameworkElement);
			}
		}

		public static int GetLineCount(string text)

			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				string[] array = text.Split(new string[3] { "\r\n", "\r", "\n" }, StringSplitOptions.None);

		}

		internal static bool IsContainedBy(Rect containerRect, Rect rectToTest, bool checkWidth)
		{
			if (checkWidth)
			{
				if (containerRect.Left <= rectToTest.Left)
				{
					return containerRect.Right >= rectToTest.Right;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (containerRect.Top <= rectToTest.Top)
			{
				return containerRect.Bottom >= rectToTest.Bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

			Type targetType2 = style.TargetType;
			if (targetType2 == null || targetType2 == targetType || targetType2.IsAssignableFrom(targetType) || targetType.IsAssignableFrom(targetType2))
			{
				return;

			throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_TargetTypeInvalid", propertyName, targetType.Name, targetType2.Name), propertyName);
		}

		internal static Matrix GetDeviceMatrix(bool toDevice, Visual relativeVisual)
		{
			if (_canGetHwndSource && relativeVisual != null)
			{
				try
				{
					return GetDeviceMatrixImpl(toDevice, relativeVisual);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_canGetHwndSource = false;
				}
			}
			return GetDeviceMatrixImpl(toDevice);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static Matrix GetDeviceMatrixImpl(bool toDevice, Visual relativeElement)
		{
			if (PresentationSource.FromVisual(relativeElement) is HwndSource hwndSource)
			{
				if (toDevice)
				{
					return hwndSource.CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice;
				}
				return hwndSource.CompositionTarget.TransformFromDevice;
			}
			return GetDeviceMatrixImpl(toDevice);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static Matrix GetDeviceMatrixImpl(bool toDevice)
		{
			System.Windows.Size primaryMonitorSize = NativeWindowMethods.PrimaryMonitorSize;
			double primaryScreenWidth = SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenWidth;
			double primaryScreenHeight = SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenHeight;
			if (toDevice)
			{
				return new Matrix(primaryMonitorSize.Width / primaryScreenWidth, 0.0, 0.0, primaryMonitorSize.Height / primaryScreenHeight, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
			return new Matrix(primaryScreenWidth / primaryMonitorSize.Width, 0.0, 0.0, primaryScreenHeight / primaryMonitorSize.Height, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		internal static void RandomizeList<T>(IList<T> list)
		{
			int count = list.Count;
			if (count >= 2)
			{
				Random rnd = Rnd;
				for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					int index = rnd.Next(0, num);
					T value = list[num];
					list[num] = list[index];
					list[index] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static T[] Combine<T>(params IEnumerable<T>[] lists)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			if (lists != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < lists.Length; i++)
				{
					IList<T> list2 = (IList<T>)lists[i];
					if (list2 != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(list2);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static CultureInfo GetLanguageCultureInfo(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			XmlLanguage nonDefaultLanguage = GetNonDefaultLanguage(element);
			if (nonDefaultLanguage != null)
			{
				CultureInfo value = null;
				bool flag = false;
				if (g_LanguageCultureMap == null)
				{
					g_LanguageCultureMap = new Dictionary<XmlLanguage, CultureInfo>();
				}
				else if (g_LanguageCultureMap.TryGetValue(nonDefaultLanguage, out value))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					value = GetNonNeutralCulture(element);
					g_LanguageCultureMap.Add(nonDefaultLanguage, value);
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
			CultureInfo cultureInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			if (cultureInfo == null)
			{
				cultureInfo = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
			}
			return GetNonNeutralCulture(cultureInfo);
		}

		internal static void SetFocusedElement(DependencyObject focusScope, IInputElement focusedElement)
		{
			KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler handler = delegate(object s, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs se)
			{
				if (se.NewFocus == focusedElement)
				{
					se.Handled = true;
				}
			};
			Keyboard.AddPreviewGotKeyboardFocusHandler(focusScope, handler);
			Keyboard.AddPreviewLostKeyboardFocusHandler(focusScope, handler);
			try
			{
				FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(focusScope, focusedElement);
			}
			finally
			{
				Keyboard.RemovePreviewGotKeyboardFocusHandler(focusScope, handler);
				Keyboard.RemovePreviewLostKeyboardFocusHandler(focusScope, handler);
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsUIElementOrUIElement3D(DependencyObject d)
		{
			if (d is UIElement)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (d != null && null != UIElement3DType && UIElement3DType.IsAssignableFrom(d.GetType()))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static Rect Intersect(Rect rect1, Rect rect2)
		{
			Rect result = Rect.Intersect(rect1, rect2);
			if (result.IsEmpty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (result.Y == rect1.Bottom || result.Y == rect2.Bottom)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (result.X == rect1.Right || result.X == rect2.Right)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Point? CalculateOnScreenLocation(Rect logicalScreenRect, Visual relativeElement, bool fullyInView)
		{
			Rect rect = ConvertFromLogicalPixels(logicalScreenRect, relativeElement);
			Rect rect2 = ((!BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted) ? ConvertToLogicalPixels(NativeWindowMethods.GetWorkArea(rect), relativeElement) : GetWorkArea(relativeElement));
			Rect rect3 = Intersect(rect2, logicalScreenRect);
			if (fullyInView && rect3 == logicalScreenRect)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!fullyInView && !rect3.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect rect4;
			if (BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				rect4 = rect2;
			}
			else
			{
				rect4 = NativeWindowMethods.GetWorkArea(logicalScreenRect.TopLeft);
				rect4.Union(NativeWindowMethods.GetWorkArea(logicalScreenRect.TopRight));
				rect4.Union(NativeWindowMethods.GetWorkArea(logicalScreenRect.BottomLeft));
				rect4.Union(NativeWindowMethods.GetWorkArea(logicalScreenRect.BottomRight));
				if (!fullyInView && !Intersect(rect, rect4).IsEmpty)
				{
					return null;
				}
				rect4 = ConvertToLogicalPixels(rect4, relativeElement);
			}
			System.Windows.Point location = logicalScreenRect.Location;
			if (logicalScreenRect.Right < rect2.Left || (fullyInView && logicalScreenRect.Width < rect2.Width && logicalScreenRect.Left < rect2.Left))
			{
				location.X = rect2.Left;
			}
			else if (logicalScreenRect.Left >= rect2.Right || (fullyInView && logicalScreenRect.Width < rect2.Width && logicalScreenRect.Right > rect2.Right))
			{
				location.X = rect2.Right - 1.0 - logicalScreenRect.Width;
			}
			else if (fullyInView && rect3.Width != logicalScreenRect.Width)
			{
				if (logicalScreenRect.Left < rect4.Left)
				{
					location.X = rect4.Left;
				}
				else if (logicalScreenRect.Right > rect4.Right)
				{
					location.X = rect4.Right - 1.0 - logicalScreenRect.Width;
				}
			}
			if (logicalScreenRect.Bottom < rect2.Top || (fullyInView && logicalScreenRect.Height < rect2.Height && logicalScreenRect.Top < rect2.Top))
			{
				location.Y = rect2.Top;
			}
			else if (logicalScreenRect.Top >= rect2.Bottom || (fullyInView && logicalScreenRect.Height < rect2.Height && logicalScreenRect.Bottom > rect2.Bottom))
			{
				location.Y = rect2.Bottom - 1.0 - logicalScreenRect.Height;
			}
			else if (fullyInView && rect3.Height != logicalScreenRect.Height)
			{
				if (logicalScreenRect.Top < rect4.Top)
				{
					location.Y = rect4.Top;
				}
				else if (logicalScreenRect.Bottom > rect4.Bottom)
				{
					location.Y = rect4.Bottom - 1.0 - logicalScreenRect.Height;
				}
			}
			return location;
		}

		public static void EnableModelessKeyboardInterop()
		{
			_modelessKeyboardInteropEnabled = true;
		}

		internal static void EnableModelessKeyboardInteropForWindow(Window window)
		{
			if (!_modelessKeyboardInteropEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				EnableModelessKeyboardInteropForWindowHelper(window);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static void EnableModelessKeyboardInteropForWindowHelper(Window window)
		{
			string fullName = typeof(DependencyObject).Assembly.FullName;
			int startIndex = fullName.IndexOf("Version=");
			string text = "WindowsFormsIntegration, " + fullName.Substring(startIndex);
			Assembly[] assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
			Assembly[] array = assemblies;
			foreach (Assembly assembly in array)
			{
				if (!(assembly.FullName == text))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Type type = assembly.GetType("System.Windows.Forms.Integration.ElementHost");
				if (null != type)
				{
					MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("EnableModelessKeyboardInterop");
					if (null != method)
					{
						method.Invoke(null, new object[1] { window });
					}
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	public class ResizeController
	{
		private IResizeHost _host;

		private bool? _resizeInXAxis;

		private bool _mouseEventsHooked;

		private ResizeConstraints _constraintsInYAxis;

		private FrameworkElement _resizeTarget;

		private System.Windows.Point _lastDragPoint;

		private double _resizerBarWidth = 6.0;

		private System.Windows.Input.Cursor _cachedCursor;

		private double _interItemSpacingY;

		public double InterItemSpacingX
		{

				return _interItemSpacingX;

				CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNan(value);
				CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotInfinity(value);

			}

			}
		}

		public bool IsResizing
		{
			get
			{
				if (_resizeTarget != null)
				{
					if (_constraintsInXAxis == null)
					{
						return _constraintsInYAxis != null;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public FrameworkElement ResizerBar
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsResizing)
				{
					if (_constraintsInXAxis != null && !_constraintsInXAxis.ResizeWhileDragging)
					{
						return _constraintsInXAxis.ResizerBar;
					}
					if (_constraintsInYAxis != null && !_constraintsInYAxis.ResizeWhileDragging)
					{
						return _constraintsInYAxis.ResizerBar;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				return _resizerBarWidth;

			set
			{
				if (value < 1.0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_5"));
				}
				_resizerBarWidth = value;
			}
		}

		public ResizeController(IResizeHost host, bool allowResizingOfElementsThatExtendToTheRight = false)
		{
			if (host == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("host");
			}
			_allowResizingOfElementsThatExtendToTheRight = allowResizingOfElementsThatExtendToTheRight;
			_host = host;
			FrameworkElement rootElement = _host.RootElement;
			rootElement.PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown += OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown;
			rootElement.AddHandler(Mouse.QueryCursorEvent, new QueryCursorEventHandler(OnQueryCursor), handledEventsToo: true);
		}

		public void CancelResize()
		{
			ClearConstraints(resizeInXAxis: true);
			ClearConstraints(resizeInXAxis: false);
		}

		public void PositionResizerBar()
		{
			if (_constraintsInXAxis != null && _constraintsInXAxis.ResizerBar != null)
			{
				double left = Canvas.GetLeft(_constraintsInXAxis.ResizerBar);
				double y = 0.0;
				if (_host is FrameworkElement && _constraintsInXAxis.ResizeArea != null)
				{
					y = _constraintsInXAxis.ResizeArea.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), _host as FrameworkElement).Y;
				}
				_constraintsInXAxis.ResizerBar.Arrange(new Rect(left, y, _constraintsInXAxis.ResizerBar.DesiredSize.Width, _constraintsInXAxis.ResizerBar.DesiredSize.Height));
			}
			if (_constraintsInYAxis != null && _constraintsInYAxis.ResizerBar != null)
			{
				double x = 0.0;
				double top = Canvas.GetTop(_constraintsInYAxis.ResizerBar);
				_constraintsInYAxis.ResizerBar.Arrange(new Rect(x, top, _constraintsInYAxis.ResizerBar.DesiredSize.Width, _constraintsInYAxis.ResizerBar.DesiredSize.Height));
			}
		}

		internal void BeginResize(MouseButtonEventArgs e, FrameworkElement itemToResize, bool? resizeInXAxis)
		{
			if (e.ClickCount == 2 && _host is IAutoResizeHost autoResizeHost)
			{
				if (resizeInXAxis.HasValue)
				{
					if (autoResizeHost.PerformAutoSize(itemToResize, resizeInXAxis.Value))
					{
						e.Handled = true;
						return;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					bool flag = autoResizeHost.PerformAutoSize(itemToResize, resizeInXAxis: true);
					if (autoResizeHost.PerformAutoSize(itemToResize, resizeInXAxis: false))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						e.Handled = true;
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			FrameworkElement resizeAreaForItem = Host.GetResizeAreaForItem(itemToResize);
			if (resizeAreaForItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_resizeTarget = itemToResize;
			_resizeInXAxis = resizeInXAxis;
			_isFlowDirectionFlipped = _resizeTarget.FlowDirection != resizeAreaForItem.FlowDirection;
			_lastDragPoint = (_originalDragPoint = e.MouseDevice.GetPosition(resizeAreaForItem));
			if (resizeInXAxis.HasValue)
			{
				if (InitializeConstraints(e, resizeAreaForItem, resizeInXAxis.Value) == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InitializeConstraints(e, resizeAreaForItem, resizeInXAxis: true);
				_resizeTarget = itemToResize;
				InitializeConstraints(e, resizeAreaForItem, resizeInXAxis: false);
				if (_constraintsInXAxis == null && _constraintsInYAxis == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			_cachedCursor = Host.RootElement.Cursor;
			Host.RootElement.Cursor = GetResizeCursor(itemToResize, resizeInXAxis);
			HookMouseEvents();
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private ResizeConstraints InitializeConstraints(MouseButtonEventArgs e, FrameworkElement resizeArea, bool resizeInXAxis)
		{
			ResizeConstraints resizeConstraints = null;
			FrameworkElement resizerBar = CreateResizerBar(resizeInXAxis, resizeArea);
			System.Windows.Point point = resizeArea.TranslatePoint(_originalDragPoint, _resizeTarget);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = default(System.Windows.Point);
			if (_isFlowDirectionFlipped)
			{
				point2.X = _resizeTarget.ActualWidth;
			}
			_originalTargetOffset = resizeArea.TranslatePoint(point2, _resizeTarget);
			if (_resizeInXAxis == true)
			{
				double actualWidth = _resizeTarget.ActualWidth;
				if (_isFlowDirectionFlipped)
				{
					point.X += actualWidth;
				}
				_originalDragPointOffset.X = actualWidth - (point.X + ResizerBarWidth / 2.0);
				_resizerBarOffset.X = Math.Max(actualWidth - point.X, 0.0) - ResizerBarWidth / 2.0;
			}
			else
			{
				double actualHeight = _resizeTarget.ActualHeight;
				_originalDragPointOffset.Y = actualHeight - (point.Y + ResizerBarWidth / 2.0);
				_resizerBarOffset.Y = Math.Max(actualHeight - point.Y, 0.0) - ResizerBarWidth / 2.0;
			}
			resizeConstraints = new ResizeConstraints(resizerBar, resizeArea, resizeInXAxis);
			if (resizeInXAxis)
			{
				_constraintsInXAxis = resizeConstraints;
			}
			else
			{
				_constraintsInYAxis = resizeConstraints;
			}
			PositionResizerBar(e.MouseDevice, resizeInXAxis);
			Host.InitializeResizeConstraints(resizeArea, _resizeTarget, resizeConstraints);
			if (resizeConstraints.Cancel)
			{
				ClearConstraints(resizeInXAxis);
				return null;
			}
			if (resizeConstraints.ResizeWhileDragging)
			{
				_originalDragPointOffset = default(System.Windows.Point);
				_resizerBarOffset = default(System.Windows.Point);
				resizeConstraints.ResizerBar.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				resizeConstraints.ResizerBar.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				resizeConstraints.ResizerBar.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(resizeArea.ActualWidth, resizeArea.ActualHeight));
			}
			return resizeConstraints;
		}

		private void ClearConstraints(bool resizeInXAxis)
		{
			ResizeConstraints resizeConstraints = ((!resizeInXAxis) ? _constraintsInYAxis : _constraintsInXAxis);
			if (resizeConstraints != null)
			{
				Host.RemoveResizerBar(resizeConstraints.ResizerBar);
				if (resizeInXAxis)
				{
					_constraintsInXAxis = null;
				}
				else
				{
					_constraintsInYAxis = null;
				}
				Host.RootElement.Cursor = _cachedCursor;
			}
			_resizeTarget = null;
			UnhookMouseEvents();
		}

		private FrameworkElement CreateResizerBar(bool vertical, FrameworkElement resizeArea)
		{
			double resizerBarWidth = ResizerBarWidth;
			System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle rectangle = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle();
			rectangle.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			rectangle.SetResourceReference(Shape.FillProperty, PrimitivesBrushKeys.ResizerBarFillKey);
			if (vertical)
			{
				rectangle.Height = resizeArea.ActualHeight;
				rectangle.Width = resizerBarWidth;
				Canvas.SetTop(rectangle, 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				rectangle.Height = resizerBarWidth;
				rectangle.Width = resizeArea.ActualWidth;
				Canvas.SetLeft(rectangle, 0.0);
			}
			Host.AddResizerBar(rectangle);
			return rectangle;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetAncestorResizableItem(IInputElement descendant)
		{
			FrameworkElement rootElement = _host.RootElement;
			for (DependencyObject dependencyObject = (DependencyObject)descendant; dependencyObject != null; dependencyObject = Utilities.GetParent(dependencyObject, includeLogicalParent: false))
			{
				if (dependencyObject == rootElement)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (dependencyObject is IResizableElement)
				{
					return dependencyObject as FrameworkElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal double GetConstrainedPosition(MouseDevice device, bool adjustWithOffset, bool resizeInXAxis)
		{
			System.Windows.Point currentResizeAreaPoint;
			return GetConstrainedPosition(device, adjustWithOffset, resizeInXAxis, out currentResizeAreaPoint);
		}

		internal double GetConstrainedPosition(MouseDevice device, bool adjustWithOffset, bool resizeInXAxis, out System.Windows.Point currentResizeAreaPoint)
		{
			currentResizeAreaPoint = default(System.Windows.Point);
			ResizeConstraints resizeConstraints = ((!resizeInXAxis) ? _constraintsInYAxis : _constraintsInXAxis);
			if (resizeConstraints == null || resizeConstraints.Cancel)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = device.GetPosition(resizeConstraints.ResizeArea);
			System.Windows.Point point = resizeConstraints.ResizeArea.TranslatePoint(position, _resizeTarget);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = default(System.Windows.Point);
			if (_isFlowDirectionFlipped)
			{
				point2.X = _resizeTarget.ActualWidth;
				point.X = 0.0 - point.X;
				point.X += _resizeTarget.ActualWidth;
			}
			System.Windows.Point point3 = resizeConstraints.ResizeArea.TranslatePoint(point2, _resizeTarget);
			double num;
			double num2;
			if (resizeInXAxis)
			{
				point.X += _originalTargetOffset.X - point3.X;
				num = position.X - point.X;
				num2 = position.X;
			}
			else
			{
				point.Y += _originalTargetOffset.Y - point3.Y;
				num = position.Y - point.Y;
				num2 = position.Y;
			}
			if (adjustWithOffset)
			{
				num2 = ((!resizeInXAxis) ? (num2 + _resizerBarOffset.Y) : (num2 + (_resizerBarOffset.X - _additionalWidthAdjustment)));
			}
			double num3 = num + resizeConstraints.MinExtent;
			double num4 = ((!(resizeConstraints.MaxExtent > resizeConstraints.MinExtent)) ? num3 : (num + resizeConstraints.MaxExtent));
			double num5 = num2;
			if (num2 < num3)
			{
				num2 = num3;
			}
			else if (num2 > num4 && num4 != 0.0)
			{
				num2 = num4;
			}
			double num6 = num5 - num2;
			currentResizeAreaPoint = position;
			if (resizeInXAxis)
			{
				currentResizeAreaPoint.X -= num6;
			}
			else
			{
				currentResizeAreaPoint.Y -= num6;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetElementToResize(FrameworkElement element, MouseDevice mouseDevice, out bool? processWidth)
		{
			processWidth = true;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = GetAncestorResizableItem(element);
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				FrameworkElement rootElement = _host.RootElement;
				frameworkElement = GetNeighborUsingInterItemSpacing(rootElement, mouseDevice, processWidth: true);
				if (frameworkElement == null)
				{
					frameworkElement = GetNeighborUsingInterItemSpacing(rootElement, mouseDevice, processWidth: false);
				}
				if (frameworkElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			IResizeHost host = Host;
			if (host == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IResizeHostMulti resizeHostMulti = host as IResizeHostMulti;
			bool flag = false;
			if (resizeHostMulti != null)
			{
				flag = resizeHostMulti.CanResizeInBothDimensions(frameworkElement);
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = GetElementToResizeHelper(frameworkElement, mouseDevice, processWidth.Value);
			if (frameworkElement2 != null && !IsValidResizeElement(frameworkElement2, mouseDevice))
			{
				frameworkElement2 = null;
			}
			if (frameworkElement2 != null && !flag && host.CanResize(frameworkElement2, processWidth.Value))
			{
				return frameworkElement2;
			}
			processWidth = false;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement3 = GetElementToResizeHelper(frameworkElement, mouseDevice, processWidth.Value);
			if (frameworkElement3 != null && !IsValidResizeElement(frameworkElement3, mouseDevice))
			{
				frameworkElement3 = null;
			}
			if (frameworkElement3 != null && !flag && host.CanResize(frameworkElement3, processWidth.Value))
			{
				return frameworkElement3;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (frameworkElement3 != null && frameworkElement2 != null && frameworkElement3 == frameworkElement2)
				{
					processWidth = null;
					return frameworkElement3;
				}
				if (frameworkElement2 != null)
				{
					processWidth = true;
					return frameworkElement2;
				}
				if (frameworkElement3 != null)
				{
					processWidth = false;
					return frameworkElement3;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetElementToResizeHelper(FrameworkElement resizableElement, MouseDevice mouseDevice, bool processWidth)
		{
			FrameworkElement resizeAreaForItem = _host.GetResizeAreaForItem(resizableElement);
			if (resizeAreaForItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = mouseDevice.GetPosition(resizableElement);
			if (processWidth)
			{
				bool flag = resizeAreaForItem.FlowDirection != resizableElement.FlowDirection;
				double num = resizableElement.ActualWidth;
				_additionalWidthAdjustment = 0.0;
				if ((position.X < 3.0 && !flag) || (flag && position.X >= num - 3.0))
				{
					System.Windows.Point point = position;
					point.X = ((!flag) ? (-2.0) : (num + 2.0));
					System.Windows.Point point2 = resizableElement.TranslatePoint(point, resizeAreaForItem);
					if (resizeAreaForItem.InputHitTest(point2) is FrameworkElement descendant)
					{
						FrameworkElement ancestorResizableItem = GetAncestorResizableItem(descendant);
						if (ancestorResizableItem != null && ancestorResizableItem != resizableElement)
						{
							return GetElementToResizeHelper(ancestorResizableItem, mouseDevice, processWidth);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (_allowResizingOfElementsThatExtendToTheRight)
					{
						System.Windows.Point point3 = resizableElement.TranslatePoint(new System.Windows.Point(num, 0.0), resizeAreaForItem);
						double actualWidth = resizeAreaForItem.ActualWidth;
						if (point3.X > actualWidth)
						{
							_additionalWidthAdjustment = Math.Max(0.0, point3.X - (actualWidth - 1.0));
							num -= _additionalWidthAdjustment;
						}
					}
					if ((position.X < 3.0 && flag) || (!flag && position.X >= num - 3.0))
					{
						return resizableElement;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (position.Y < 3.0)
			{
				System.Windows.Point position2 = mouseDevice.GetPosition(resizableElement);
				position2.Y -= 2.0 + position.Y;
				System.Windows.Point point4 = resizableElement.TranslatePoint(position2, resizeAreaForItem);
				if (resizeAreaForItem.InputHitTest(point4) is FrameworkElement descendant2)
				{
					FrameworkElement ancestorResizableItem2 = GetAncestorResizableItem(descendant2);
					if (ancestorResizableItem2 != null && ancestorResizableItem2 != resizableElement)
					{
						return GetElementToResizeHelper(ancestorResizableItem2, mouseDevice, processWidth);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				double actualHeight = resizableElement.ActualHeight;
				if (position.Y >= actualHeight - 3.0)
				{
					return resizableElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetNeighborUsingInterItemSpacing(FrameworkElement root, MouseDevice mouseDevice, bool processWidth)
		{
			double num = Math.Ceiling(_interItemSpacingX);
			double num2 = Math.Ceiling(_interItemSpacingY);
			if (num < 0.1 && num2 < 0.1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = mouseDevice.GetPosition(root);
			if (processWidth)
			{
				return GetNeighborHelper(root, mouseDevice, position, 0.0 - num, 0.0);
			}
			FrameworkElement neighborHelper = GetNeighborHelper(root, mouseDevice, position, 0.0, 0.0 - num2);
			if (neighborHelper != null)
			{
				return neighborHelper;
			}
			if (_host is IResizeHostMulti)
			{
				return GetNeighborHelper(root, mouseDevice, position, 0.0 - num, 0.0 - num2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetNeighborHelper(FrameworkElement root, MouseDevice mouseDevice, System.Windows.Point point, double adjustmentX, double adjustmentY)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(adjustmentX);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(adjustmentY);
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			while (adjustmentX != 0.0 || adjustmentY != 0.0)
			{
				double num5 = Math.Max(adjustmentX, -4.0);
				double num6 = Math.Max(adjustmentY, -4.0);
				point.X += num5;
				point.Y += num6;
				FrameworkElement neighborResizableElementHelper = GetNeighborResizableElementHelper(root, mouseDevice, point);
				if (neighborResizableElementHelper != null)
				{
					return neighborResizableElementHelper;
				}
				num3 += Math.Abs(num5);
				num4 += Math.Abs(num6);
				if (num3 >= num && num4 >= num2)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if ((!(adjustmentX < -4.0) || !(point.X >= 4.0)) && (!(adjustmentY < -4.0) || !(point.Y >= 4.0)))
				{
					break;
				}
				adjustmentX -= num5;
				num6 -= num6;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetNeighborResizableElementHelper(FrameworkElement root, MouseDevice mouseDevice, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = root.InputHitTest(point) as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				frameworkElement = GetAncestorResizableItem(frameworkElement);
			}
			return frameworkElement;
		}

		private System.Windows.Input.Cursor GetResizeCursor(FrameworkElement resizeableItem, bool? resizeInXAxis)
		{
			if (!resizeInXAxis.HasValue)
			{
				if (Host is IResizeHostMulti resizeHostMulti)
				{
					return resizeHostMulti.GetMultiResizeCursor(resizeableItem, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNWSE);
				}
				return System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNWSE;
			}
			if (resizeInXAxis == true)
			{
				return Host.GetResizeCursor(resizeableItem, resizeInXAxis.Value, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeWE);
			}
			return Host.GetResizeCursor(resizeableItem, resizeInXAxis.Value, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNS);
		}

		private void HookMouseEvents()
		{
			FrameworkElement rootElement = Host.RootElement;
			rootElement.PreviewMouseMove += OnPreviewMouseMove;
			rootElement.PreviewMouseLeftButtonUp += OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp;
			rootElement.LostMouseCapture += OnLostMouseCapture;
			rootElement.PreviewKeyDown += OnPreviewKeyDown;
			_mouseEventsHooked = true;
			rootElement.CaptureMouse();
		}

		private bool IsValidResizeElement(FrameworkElement element, MouseDevice mouseDevice)
		{
			if (element != null && !IsResizing && mouseDevice != null)
			{
				IInputElement captured = mouseDevice.Captured;
				if (captured != null)
				{
					if (!(captured is DependencyObject dependencyObject))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (element != dependencyObject && !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(dependencyObject, element, preferLogicalTree: false))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				FrameworkElement resizeAreaForItem = _host.GetResizeAreaForItem(element);
				if (resizeAreaForItem != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Point position = mouseDevice.GetPosition(resizeAreaForItem);
					if (position.X >= 0.0 && position.Y >= 0.0 && position.X < resizeAreaForItem.ActualWidth)
					{
						return position.Y < resizeAreaForItem.ActualHeight;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnLostMouseCapture(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			CancelResize();
			UnhookMouseEvents();
		}

		private void OnPreviewKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_resizeTarget != null && e.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				CancelResize();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.Handled && e.OriginalSource is FrameworkElement element)
			{
				bool? processWidth;
				FrameworkElement elementToResize = GetElementToResize(element, e.MouseDevice, out processWidth);
				if (elementToResize != null)
				{
					BeginResize(e, elementToResize, processWidth);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_resizeTarget != null)
			{
				ResizeToNewMousePosition(e.MouseDevice);
				CancelResize();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewMouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_resizeTarget == null || ((_constraintsInXAxis == null || _constraintsInXAxis.Cancel) && (_constraintsInYAxis == null || _constraintsInYAxis.Cancel)))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_constraintsInXAxis != null)
			{
				if (_constraintsInXAxis.ResizeWhileDragging)
				{
					ResizeToNewMousePosition(e.MouseDevice);
				}
				else
				{
					PositionResizerBar(e.MouseDevice, resizeInXAxis: true);
				}
			}
			if (_constraintsInYAxis != null)
			{
				if (_constraintsInYAxis.ResizeWhileDragging)
				{
					ResizeToNewMousePosition(e.MouseDevice);
				}
				else
				{
					PositionResizerBar(e.MouseDevice, resizeInXAxis: false);
				}
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void OnQueryCursor(object sender, QueryCursorEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.OriginalSource is FrameworkElement element))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool? processWidth;
			FrameworkElement elementToResize = GetElementToResize(element, e.MouseDevice, out processWidth);
			if (elementToResize != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Input.Cursor resizeCursor = GetResizeCursor(elementToResize, processWidth);
				if (resizeCursor != null)
				{
					e.Cursor = resizeCursor;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void PositionResizerBar(MouseDevice device, bool resizeInXAxis)
		{
			ResizeConstraints resizeConstraints = ((!resizeInXAxis) ? _constraintsInYAxis : _constraintsInXAxis);
			if (resizeConstraints != null && !resizeConstraints.Cancel && !resizeConstraints.ResizeWhileDragging && resizeConstraints.ResizerBar.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				double constrainedPosition = GetConstrainedPosition(device, adjustWithOffset: true, resizeInXAxis);
				if (resizeInXAxis)
				{
					Canvas.SetLeft(resizeConstraints.ResizerBar, constrainedPosition);
				}
				else
				{
					Canvas.SetTop(resizeConstraints.ResizerBar, constrainedPosition);
				}
				if (Host is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					frameworkElement.InvalidateArrange();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResizeToNewMousePosition(MouseDevice mouseDevice)
		{
			IResizeHostMulti resizeHostMulti = Host as IResizeHostMulti;
			System.Windows.Point currentPoint = default(System.Windows.Point);
			bool flag = _constraintsInXAxis != null;
			bool flag2 = _constraintsInYAxis != null;
			if (resizeHostMulti != null && flag && flag2)
			{
				System.Windows.Point lastDragPoint = default(System.Windows.Point);
				double num = ResizeToNewMousePositionHelper(mouseDevice, resizeInXAxis: true, callResizeMethod: false, out currentPoint);
				lastDragPoint.X = currentPoint.X;
				double num2 = ResizeToNewMousePositionHelper(mouseDevice, resizeInXAxis: false, callResizeMethod: false, out currentPoint);
				lastDragPoint.Y = currentPoint.Y;
				if (num != 0.0 && num2 != 0.0)
				{
					_lastDragPoint = lastDragPoint;
					_originalDragPointOffset = default(System.Windows.Point);
					_resizerBarOffset = default(System.Windows.Point);
					resizeHostMulti.ResizeBothDimensions(_resizeTarget, num, num2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					ResizeToNewMousePositionHelper(mouseDevice, resizeInXAxis: true, callResizeMethod: true, out currentPoint);
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					ResizeToNewMousePositionHelper(mouseDevice, resizeInXAxis: false, callResizeMethod: true, out currentPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		private double ResizeToNewMousePositionHelper(MouseDevice mouseDevice, bool resizeInXAxis, bool callResizeMethod, out System.Windows.Point currentPoint)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double constrainedPosition = GetConstrainedPosition(mouseDevice, adjustWithOffset: false, resizeInXAxis, out currentPoint);
			bool flag;
			if (resizeInXAxis)
			{
				num = constrainedPosition - (_lastDragPoint.X + _additionalWidthAdjustment);
				flag = currentPoint.X > _lastDragPoint.X;
			}
			else
			{
				num = constrainedPosition - _lastDragPoint.Y;
				flag = currentPoint.Y > _lastDragPoint.Y;
			}
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (callResizeMethod && num != 0.0)
			{
				ResizeConstraints resizeConstraints = (resizeInXAxis ? _constraintsInXAxis : _constraintsInYAxis);
				double num2 = (resizeInXAxis ? _resizeTarget.ActualWidth : _resizeTarget.ActualHeight);
				double num3 = num2 + num;
				if (!double.IsNaN(resizeConstraints.MinExtent) && num3 < resizeConstraints.MinExtent)
				{
					num3 = resizeConstraints.MinExtent;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(resizeConstraints.MaxExtent) && num3 > resizeConstraints.MaxExtent)
				{
					num3 = resizeConstraints.MaxExtent;
				}
				num = num3 - num2;
				_lastDragPoint = currentPoint;
				_originalDragPointOffset = default(System.Windows.Point);
				_resizerBarOffset = default(System.Windows.Point);
				if (!CoreUtilities.AreClose(num, 0.0))
				{
					Host.Resize(_resizeTarget, resizeInXAxis, num);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void UnhookMouseEvents()
		{
			if (_mouseEventsHooked)
			{
				FrameworkElement rootElement = Host.RootElement;
				rootElement.PreviewMouseMove -= OnPreviewMouseMove;
				rootElement.PreviewMouseLeftButtonUp -= OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp;
				rootElement.LostMouseCapture -= OnLostMouseCapture;
				rootElement.PreviewKeyDown -= OnPreviewKeyDown;
				_mouseEventsHooked = false;
				rootElement.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Windows.Selection
{
	public interface ISelectableItem
	{
		bool IsSelected { get; }

		bool IsSelectable { get; }

		bool IsDraggable { get; }

		bool IsTabStop { get; }
	}
	internal sealed class SelectionController
	{
		private class DoubleClickThreshold
		{
			private SelectionController _controller;

			private DateTime _expiration;

			private System.Windows.Point _startPoint;

			private DispatcherTimer _timer;

			private bool _expired;

			private FrameworkElement _rootElement;

			internal DoubleClickThreshold(SelectionController controller, System.Windows.Point startPoint)
			{
				_controller = controller;
				_startPoint = startPoint;
				_rootElement = _controller._host.RootElement;
				_rootElement.Unloaded += OnRootElementUnloaded;
				int systemDoubleClickTime = Utilities.SystemDoubleClickTime;
				_expiration = DateTime.Now.AddMilliseconds(systemDoubleClickTime + 10);
				_timer = new DispatcherTimer();
				_timer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(systemDoubleClickTime);
				_timer.Tick += OnTimerTick;
				_timer.Start();
			}

			internal void Dispose()
			{
				_expired = true;
				if (_rootElement != null)
				{
					_rootElement.Unloaded -= OnRootElementUnloaded;
					_rootElement = null;
				}
				if (_timer != null)
				{
					_timer.Stop();
					_timer = null;
				}
			}

			internal bool HasTimeExpired()
			{
				if (!_expired)
				{
					_expired = DateTime.Now > _expiration;
					if (_expired)
					{
						Dispose();
					}
				}
				return _expired;
			}

			internal bool IsWithinSizeThreshhold(System.Windows.Point pt)
			{
				if (!_expired)
				{
					System.Windows.Size systemDoubleClickSize = Utilities.SystemDoubleClickSize;
					_expired = !(pt.X >= _startPoint.X - systemDoubleClickSize.Width) || !(pt.X <= _startPoint.X + systemDoubleClickSize.Width) || !(pt.Y >= _startPoint.Y - systemDoubleClickSize.Height) || !(pt.Y <= _startPoint.Y + systemDoubleClickSize.Height);
					if (_expired)
					{
						Dispose();
					}
				}
				return !_expired;
			}

			private void OnRootElementUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				Dispose();
			}

			private void OnTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				Dispose();
				if (_controller._dblClickThreshhold == this && _controller._currentStrategy == null)
				{
					_controller._dblClickThreshhold = null;
					_controller._host.ScrollPendingItemIntoView();
				}
			}
		}

		private ISelectionHost _host;

		private SelectionStrategyBase _currentStrategy;

		private ISelectableItem _currentItem;

		private DoubleClickThreshold _dblClickThreshhold;

		private static DependencyObject _hitTestResult;

		internal SelectionStrategyBase ActiveStrategy
		{
			get
			{
				return _currentStrategy;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _currentStrategy)
				{
					if (value == null)
					{
						_currentStrategy.InitializeController(null);
					}
					_currentStrategy = value;
					OnActiveStrategyChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler ActiveStrategyChanged;

		internal SelectionController(ISelectionHost host)
		{
			if (host == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("host");
			}
			_host = host;
		}

		public bool CancelPendingOperations(bool killDblClickTimer)
		{
			if (killDblClickTimer && _dblClickThreshhold != null)
			{
				_dblClickThreshhold.Dispose();
				_dblClickThreshhold = null;
			}
			if (_currentStrategy != null && !_currentStrategy.IsReleasingMouseCapture)
			{
				_currentStrategy.CancelPendingOperations();
				ActiveStrategy = null;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsWithinDblClickThreshold()
		{
			if (_dblClickThreshhold != null && _dblClickThreshhold.HasTimeExpired())
			{
				_dblClickThreshhold = null;
			}
			return _dblClickThreshhold != null;
		}

		public void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			FrameworkElement rootElement = _host.RootElement;
			if (rootElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_currentItem = GetSelectableItem(e, rootElement);
			if (_currentItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ActiveStrategy = _host.GetSelectionStrategyForItem(_currentItem);
			SelectionStrategyBase currentStrategy = _currentStrategy;
			if (currentStrategy == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_dblClickThreshhold == null)
			{
				_dblClickThreshhold = new DoubleClickThreshold(this, e.GetPosition(_host.RootElement));
			}
			bool flag = currentStrategy.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(_currentItem, e);
			if (!flag || Mouse.LeftButton != MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					currentStrategy.CancelPendingOperations();
				}
				if (_dblClickThreshhold != null)
				{
					_dblClickThreshhold.Dispose();
					_dblClickThreshhold = null;
					if (flag)
					{
						_host.ScrollPendingItemIntoView();
					}
				}
				ActiveStrategy = null;
			}
			else
			{
				bool ignoreNextMouseMove = currentStrategy.IgnoreNextMouseMove;
				currentStrategy.IgnoreNextMouseMove = true;
				currentStrategy.InitializeController(this);
				try
				{
					rootElement.CaptureMouse();
				}
				finally
				{
					currentStrategy.IgnoreNextMouseMove = ignoreNextMouseMove;
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		public void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				if (_currentStrategy == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				_currentItem = GetSelectableItem(e, _host.RootElement);
				_currentStrategy.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(_currentItem, e);
				if (_currentStrategy != null)
				{
					_currentStrategy.InitializeController(null);
				}
				_currentItem = null;
				_currentStrategy = null;
			}
			finally
			{
				ReleaseCapture();
			}
			VerifyDblClickThreshhold(e);
			OnActiveStrategyChanged();
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		public void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			VerifyDblClickThreshhold(e);
			if (_currentStrategy != null)
			{
				_currentItem = GetSelectableItem(e, _host.RootElement);
				_currentStrategy.OnMouseMove(_currentItem, e);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnActiveStrategyChanged()
		{
			if (this.ActiveStrategyChanged != null)
			{
				this.ActiveStrategyChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseCapture()
		{
			if (_host.RootElement.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				_host.RootElement.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
		}

		private void VerifyDblClickThreshhold(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_dblClickThreshhold != null && (_dblClickThreshhold.HasTimeExpired() || !_dblClickThreshhold.IsWithinSizeThreshhold(e.GetPosition(_host.RootElement))) && _currentStrategy == null)
			{
				_dblClickThreshhold = null;
				_host.ScrollPendingItemIntoView();
			}
		}

		internal static ISelectableItem GetSelectableItem(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, DependencyObject root)
		{
			if (!(root is IInputElement))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(root is Visual))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(root is UIElement))
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = e.MouseDevice.GetPosition((IInputElement)root);
			_hitTestResult = null;
			if (root is UIElement)
			{
				_hitTestResult = ((UIElement)root).InputHitTest(position) as DependencyObject;
			}
			else
			{
				VisualTreeHelper.HitTest((Visual)root, OnHitTestFilterCallback, OnHitTestResultCallback, new PointHitTestParameters(position));
			}
			if (_hitTestResult == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISelectableElement selectableElement = GetSelectableElement(_hitTestResult, root);
			_hitTestResult = null;
			return selectableElement?.SelectableItem;
		}

		private static HitTestResultBehavior OnHitTestResultCallback(HitTestResult result)
		{
			_hitTestResult = result.VisualHit;
			return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
		}

		private static HitTestFilterBehavior OnHitTestFilterCallback(DependencyObject target)
		{
			HitTestFilterBehavior result = HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
			if (target is UIElement uIElement && (!uIElement.IsVisible || !uIElement.IsHitTestVisible))
			{
				result = HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipSelfAndChildren;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static ISelectableElement GetSelectableElement(DependencyObject element, DependencyObject root)
		{
			if (element is ISelectableElement)
			{
				return (ISelectableElement)element;
			}
			if (element == root)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DependencyObject parent = Utilities.GetParent(element);
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetSelectableElement(parent, root);
		}
	}

	public enum ScrollSpeed

		Slowest,
		Slower,
		Slow,
		Medium,
		Fast,
		Faster,
		Fastest
	}
	public enum ScrollDirection
	{
		Increment,
		Decrement
	}
	public enum ScrollOrientation
	{
		Both,
		Horizontal,
		Vertical,
		BasedOnDistance
	}
	public struct AutoScrollInfo
	{

		private bool _canScrollDown;

		private bool _canScrollLeft;

		private bool _canScrollRight;

		private bool _canScrollUp;

		private ScrollOrientation _scrollOrientation;

		private AdjustScrollInfoCallback _adjustScrollInfoCallback;

		public AdjustScrollInfoCallback AdjustScrollInfoCallback
		{
			get
			{
				return _adjustScrollInfoCallback;
			}
			set
			{
				_adjustScrollInfoCallback = value;
			}
		}

		public bool CanScrollDown => _canScrollDown;

		public bool CanScrollLeft => _canScrollLeft;

		public bool CanScrollRight => _canScrollRight;

		public bool CanScrollUp => _canScrollUp;

		public FrameworkElement ScrollArea => _scrollArea;

		{
			get
			{
				return _scrollOrientation;
			}

			}

		public AutoScrollInfo(FrameworkElement scrollArea, bool canScrollDown, bool canScrollLeft, bool canScrollRight, bool canScrollUp)
		{
			_scrollArea = scrollArea;
			_canScrollDown = canScrollDown;
			_canScrollLeft = canScrollLeft;
			_canScrollRight = canScrollRight;

			_adjustScrollInfoCallback = null;
		}
	}
	public delegate void AdjustScrollInfoCallback(bool isHorizontal, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseArgs, ISelectableItem item, ref ScrollDirection? scrollDirection, ref double timerInterval);
	public abstract class SelectionStrategyBase
	{
		protected enum SelectionState
		{
			SingleSelect,
			PreDrag,
			PreEdit,
			PotentialPreDrag,
			ExtSelect,
			ControlClick
		}

		protected class AutoScrollManager
		{
			private SelectionStrategyBase _selectionStrategy;

			private AutoScrollInfo _autoScrollInfo;

			private System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs _mouseEventArgs;

			private bool _directionIsVertical;

			private bool _isScrollingRequired;

			private ScrollDirection _scrollDirection;

			private ScrollSpeed _scrollSpeed;

			private double _timerInterval;

			private Rect _scrollAreaRect;

			private Rect _scrollAreaInnerRect;

			private System.Windows.Point _mousePosition;

			public bool IsScrollingRequired => _isScrollingRequired;

			private int MaxTimerInterval
			{
				get
				{
					if (!_directionIsVertical)
					{
						return _selectionStrategy.AutoScrollHorizontalIntervalMax;
					}
					return _selectionStrategy.AutoScrollVerticalIntervalMax;
				}
			}

			private int MinTimerInterval
			{
				get
				{
					if (!_directionIsVertical)
					{
						return _selectionStrategy.AutoScrollHorizontalIntervalMin;
					}
					return _selectionStrategy.AutoScrollVerticalIntervalMin;
				}
			}

			public ScrollDirection ScrollDirection => _scrollDirection;

			public ScrollSpeed ScrollSpeed => _scrollSpeed;

			public double TimerInterval => _timerInterval;

			public AutoScrollManager(SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategy, AutoScrollInfo autoScrollInfo, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs, bool directionIsVertical)
			{
				if (selectionStrategy == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("selectionStrategy", SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_3"));
				}
				if (mouseEventArgs == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("mouseEventArgs", SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_4"));
				}
				_selectionStrategy = selectionStrategy;
				_autoScrollInfo = autoScrollInfo;
				_mouseEventArgs = mouseEventArgs;
				_directionIsVertical = directionIsVertical;
				Initialize();
			}

			private double GetAutoScrollTimerInterval(int mouseThresholdAreaPenetration)
			{
				int maxTimerInterval = MaxTimerInterval;
				int minTimerInterval = MinTimerInterval;
				double num = Math.Log(maxTimerInterval / minTimerInterval);
				double num2 = (double)mouseThresholdAreaPenetration / (_directionIsVertical ? (SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenHeight * 0.4) : (SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenWidth * 0.4));
				num2 = Math.Abs(num2 * num);
				double val = (double)maxTimerInterval / Math.Pow(Math.E, num2);
				val = Math.Min(val, maxTimerInterval);
				return Math.Max(val, minTimerInterval);
			}

			private int GetMouseThresholdAreaPenetration()
			{
				int num = GetMouseThresholdAreaPenetration(_directionIsVertical);
				if (num != 0 && _autoScrollInfo.ScrollOrientation != ScrollOrientation.Both)
				{
					int mouseThresholdAreaPenetration = GetMouseThresholdAreaPenetration(!_directionIsVertical);
					if (mouseThresholdAreaPenetration != 0)
					{
						switch (_autoScrollInfo.ScrollOrientation)
						{
						case ScrollOrientation.Horizontal:
							if (_directionIsVertical)
							{
								num = 0;
							}
							break;
						case ScrollOrientation.Vertical:
							if (!_directionIsVertical)
							{
								num = 0;
							}
							break;
						case ScrollOrientation.BasedOnDistance:
						{
							int num2 = Math.Abs(num).CompareTo(Math.Abs(mouseThresholdAreaPenetration));
							if (num2 > 0 || (num2 == 0 && !_directionIsVertical))
							{
								num = 0;
							}
							break;
						}
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

			private int GetMouseThresholdAreaPenetration(bool vertical)
			{
				int result = 0;
				if (vertical)
				{
					if (_mousePosition.Y < _scrollAreaInnerRect.Top)
					{
						if (_autoScrollInfo.CanScrollUp)
						{
							result = (int)(_mousePosition.Y - _scrollAreaInnerRect.Top);
						}
					}
					else if (_mousePosition.Y > _scrollAreaInnerRect.Bottom && _autoScrollInfo.CanScrollDown)
					{
						result = (int)(_mousePosition.Y - _scrollAreaInnerRect.Bottom);
					}
				}
				else if (_mousePosition.X < _scrollAreaInnerRect.Left)
				{
					if (_autoScrollInfo.CanScrollLeft)
					{
						result = (int)(_mousePosition.X - _scrollAreaInnerRect.Left);
					}
				}
				else if (_mousePosition.X > _scrollAreaInnerRect.Right && _autoScrollInfo.CanScrollRight)
				{
					result = (int)(_mousePosition.X - _scrollAreaInnerRect.Right);
				}
				return result;
			}

			private ScrollSpeed GetScrollSpeedFromTimerInterval(double timerInterval)
			{
				double num = MinTimerInterval;
				double num2 = MaxTimerInterval;
				if (timerInterval <= num)
				{
					return ScrollSpeed.Fastest;
				}
				if (timerInterval >= num2)
				{
					return ScrollSpeed.Slowest;
				}
				double num3 = (timerInterval - num) / (num2 - num);
				if (num3 < 0.14)
				{
					return ScrollSpeed.Fastest;
				}
				if (num3 < 0.28)
				{
					return ScrollSpeed.Faster;
				}
				if (num3 < 0.42)
				{
					return ScrollSpeed.Fast;
				}
				if (num3 < 0.56)
				{
					return ScrollSpeed.Medium;
				}
				if (num3 < 0.7)
				{
					return ScrollSpeed.Slow;
				}
				if (num3 < 0.84)
				{
					return ScrollSpeed.Slower;
				}
				return ScrollSpeed.Slowest;
			}

			private void Initialize()
			{
				if (_directionIsVertical)
				{
					if (!_autoScrollInfo.CanScrollUp && !_autoScrollInfo.CanScrollDown)
					{
						_isScrollingRequired = false;
						return;
					}
				}
				else if (!_autoScrollInfo.CanScrollLeft && !_autoScrollInfo.CanScrollRight)
				{
					_isScrollingRequired = false;
					return;
				}
				_scrollAreaRect = new Rect(_autoScrollInfo.ScrollArea.TranslatePoint(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), _selectionStrategy.SelectionHost.RootElement), new System.Windows.Size(_autoScrollInfo.ScrollArea.ActualWidth, _autoScrollInfo.ScrollArea.ActualHeight));
				_scrollAreaInnerRect = _scrollAreaRect;
				_scrollAreaInnerRect.Inflate(-_selectionStrategy.PixelThresholdForHorizontalAutoScroll, -_selectionStrategy.PixelThresholdForVerticalAutoScroll);
				_mousePosition = _selectionStrategy.GetMousePointInRootElementCoordinates(_mouseEventArgs);
				_isScrollingRequired = false;
				if (!_scrollAreaInnerRect.Contains(_mousePosition))
				{
					_timerInterval = -1.0;
					int num = Math.Min(Math.Max(GetMouseThresholdAreaPenetration(), -10000), 10000);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						_timerInterval = GetAutoScrollTimerInterval(Math.Abs(num));
					}
					if (_timerInterval != -1.0)
					{
						_isScrollingRequired = true;
						_scrollDirection = ((num < 0) ? ScrollDirection.Decrement : ScrollDirection.Increment);
					}
				}
				if (_autoScrollInfo.AdjustScrollInfoCallback != null)
				{
					ScrollDirection? scrollDirection = (_isScrollingRequired ? new ScrollDirection?(_scrollDirection) : ((ScrollDirection?)null));
					double timerInterval = (_isScrollingRequired ? _timerInterval : ((double)MaxTimerInterval));
					_autoScrollInfo.AdjustScrollInfoCallback(!_directionIsVertical, _mouseEventArgs, _selectionStrategy.CurrentSelectableItem, ref scrollDirection, ref timerInterval);
					_isScrollingRequired = scrollDirection.HasValue;
					_scrollDirection = scrollDirection ?? ScrollDirection.Decrement;
					_timerInterval = Math.Max(Math.Min(timerInterval, MaxTimerInterval), MinTimerInterval);
				}
				if (_isScrollingRequired)
				{
					_scrollSpeed = GetScrollSpeedFromTimerInterval(_timerInterval);
				}
			}
		}

		private ISelectionHost _selectionHost;

		private DispatcherTimer _verticalAutoScrollTimer;

		private DispatcherTimer _horizontalAutoScrollTimer;

		private bool _inDragMode;

		private bool _ignoreNextMouseMove;

		private bool _isReleasingMouseCapture;

		private double _initialXPos;

		private double _initialYPos;

		private SelectionController _controller;

		private SelectionState _currentSelectionState;

		private WeakReference _currentSelectableItemRef;

		private AutoScrollManager _autoScrollManagerVertical;

		private AutoScrollManager _autoScrollManagerHorizontal;

		private Stopwatch _autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal;

		private Stopwatch _autoScrollStopwatchVertical;

		public virtual bool IsMultiSelect => false;

		public virtual bool IsSingleSelect => false;

		public bool IsReleasingMouseCapture => _isReleasingMouseCapture;

		protected virtual int AutoScrollHorizontalIntervalMax => 300;

		protected virtual int AutoScrollHorizontalIntervalMin => 10;

		protected virtual int AutoScrollVerticalIntervalMax => 300;

		protected virtual int AutoScrollVerticalIntervalMin => 10;

		protected virtual DispatcherPriority AutoScrollTimerDispatcherPriority => DispatcherPriority.Input;

		protected ISelectableItem CurrentSelectableItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (_currentSelectableItemRef == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_currentSelectableItemRef) as ISelectableItem;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					_currentSelectableItemRef = null;
				}
				else
				{
					_currentSelectableItemRef = new WeakReference(value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected SelectionState CurrentSelectionState
		{
			get
			{
				return _currentSelectionState;
			}
			set
			{
				_currentSelectionState = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual int DragThreshold => 3;

		protected internal bool IgnoreNextMouseMove
		{
			get
			{
				return _ignoreNextMouseMove;
			}
			set

				_ignoreNextMouseMove = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool InDragMode
		{

			}
			set
