		}

		protected double InitialXPos
		{
			get
			{
				return _initialXPos;
			}
			set
			{
				_initialXPos = value;
			}
		}

		protected double InitialYPos
		{
			get
			{
				return _initialYPos;
			}
			set
			{
				_initialYPos = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsAnyMouseButtonDown
		{
			get
			{
				if (Mouse.LeftButton != MouseButtonState.Pressed && Mouse.MiddleButton != MouseButtonState.Pressed)
				{
					return Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsCtrlKeyPressed
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.LeftCtrl))
				{
					return Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.RightCtrl);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsLeftMouseButtonDown => Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed;

		protected bool IsShiftKeyPressed
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.LeftShift))
				{
					return Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.RightShift);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual int PixelThresholdForHorizontalAutoScroll => 20;

		protected virtual int PixelThresholdForVerticalAutoScroll => 20;

		protected ISelectionHost SelectionHost => _selectionHost;

		protected SelectionStrategyBase(ISelectionHost selectionHost)
		{
			if (selectionHost == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("selectionHost", SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_2"));
			}
			_selectionHost = selectionHost;
		}

		public virtual void CancelPendingOperations()
		{
			if (InDragMode)
			{
				if (SelectionHost != null)
				{
					SelectionHost.OnDragEnd(canceled: true);
				}
				InDragMode = false;
			}
			StopHorizontalAutoScrollTimer();
			StopVerticalAutoScrollTimer();
		}

		public virtual bool CanItemBeNavigatedTo(ISelectableItem item, bool shiftKeyDown, bool controlKeyDown)
		{
			return item?.IsTabStop ?? false;
		}

		public static SelectionStrategyBase GetSelectionStrategy(SelectionType type, ISelectionHost host, SelectionStrategyBase oldStrategy)
		{
			if (host == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("host");
			}
			SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategyBase = ((oldStrategy != null && oldStrategy._selectionHost == host) ? oldStrategy : null);
			if (selectionStrategyBase != null && GetSelectionType(selectionStrategyBase) == type)
			{
				return selectionStrategyBase;
			}
			return type switch
			{
				SelectionType.Extended => new SelectionStrategyExtended(host), 
				SelectionType.Single => new SelectionStrategySingle(host), 
				SelectionType.Range => new SelectionStrategyContiguous(host), 
				SelectionType.ExtendedAutoDrag => new SelectionStrategyExtendedAutoDrag(host), 
				SelectionType.SingleAutoDrag => new SelectionStrategySingleAutoDrag(host), 
				_ => new SelectionStrategyNone(host), 
			};
		}

		public static bool IsMultiSelectStrategy(SelectionType selectionType)
		{
			switch (selectionType)
			{
			case SelectionType.Extended:
			case SelectionType.Range:
			case SelectionType.ExtendedAutoDrag:
				return true;
			case SelectionType.None:
			case SelectionType.Single:
			case SelectionType.SingleAutoDrag:
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsSingleSelectStrategy(SelectionType selectionType)
		{
			switch (selectionType)
			{
			case SelectionType.Single:
			case SelectionType.SingleAutoDrag:
				return true;
			case SelectionType.None:
			case SelectionType.Extended:
			case SelectionType.Range:
			case SelectionType.ExtendedAutoDrag:
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public abstract bool OnMouseLeftButtonDown(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e);

		public abstract bool OnMouseMove(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e);

		public abstract void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e);

		public abstract bool SelectItemViaKeyboard(ISelectableItem item, bool shiftKeyDown, bool controlKeyDown, bool forceToggle);

		protected void DragMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ManageTimers(e);
			SelectionHost.OnDragMove(e);
		}

		protected void DragStart(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs)
		{
			if (SelectionHost != null && CurrentSelectableItem != null)
			{
				if (SelectionHost.OnDragStart(CurrentSelectableItem, mouseEventArgs) && IsAnyMouseButtonDown)
				{
					InDragMode = true;
				}
				else
				{
					OnDragStartCanceled();
				}
			}
		}

		protected System.Windows.Point GetMousePointInRootElementCoordinates(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs)
		{
			return mouseEventArgs.GetPosition(SelectionHost.RootElement);
		}

		protected internal bool IsWithinDblClickThreshold()
		{
			if (_controller != null)
			{
				if (IsCtrlKeyPressed || IsShiftKeyPressed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return _controller.IsWithinDblClickThreshold();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void ManageTimers(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs)
		{
			AutoScrollInfo autoScrollInfo = SelectionHost.GetAutoScrollInfo(CurrentSelectableItem);
			_autoScrollManagerHorizontal = new AutoScrollManager(this, autoScrollInfo, mouseEventArgs, directionIsVertical: false);
			if (_autoScrollManagerHorizontal.IsScrollingRequired)
			{
				SetupHorizontalAutoScrollTimer(_autoScrollManagerHorizontal.TimerInterval);
			}
			else
			{
				StopHorizontalAutoScrollTimer();
			}
			_autoScrollManagerVertical = new AutoScrollManager(this, autoScrollInfo, mouseEventArgs, directionIsVertical: true);
			if (_autoScrollManagerVertical.IsScrollingRequired)
			{
				SetupVerticalAutoScrollTimer(_autoScrollManagerVertical.TimerInterval);
			}
			else
			{
				StopVerticalAutoScrollTimer();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDragStartCanceled()
		{
			if (SelectionHost.RootElement.IsMouseCaptured && !IsAnyMouseButtonDown && SelectionHost != null)
			{
				SelectionHost.OnDragEnd(canceled: true);
			}
			if (SelectionHost.RootElement.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				SelectionHost.RootElement.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldStartDrag(double x, double y)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(x - InitialXPos) > (double)DragThreshold || Math.Abs(y - InitialYPos) > (double)DragThreshold)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void StopHorizontalAutoScrollTimer()
		{
			if (_autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal != null)
			{
				_autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal.Stop();
				_autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal = null;
			}
			if (_horizontalAutoScrollTimer != null && _horizontalAutoScrollTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				_horizontalAutoScrollTimer.Stop();
			}
		}

		protected void StopVerticalAutoScrollTimer()
		{
			if (_autoScrollStopwatchVertical != null)
			{
				_autoScrollStopwatchVertical.Stop();
				_autoScrollStopwatchVertical = null;
			}
			if (_verticalAutoScrollTimer != null && _verticalAutoScrollTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				_verticalAutoScrollTimer.Stop();
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeController(SelectionController controller)
		{
			_controller = controller;
		}

		private void ForceSynchronousMouseMove()
		{
			IInputElement captured = Mouse.Captured;
			if (captured != null)
			{
				_isReleasingMouseCapture = true;
				try
				{
					Mouse.Capture(null);
					Mouse.Capture(captured, CaptureMode.Element);
				}
				finally
				{
					_isReleasingMouseCapture = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private static SelectionType? GetSelectionType(SelectionStrategyBase strategy)
		{
			if (strategy is SelectionStrategyContiguous)
			{
				return SelectionType.Range;
			}
			if (strategy is SelectionStrategySingleAutoDrag)
			{
				return SelectionType.SingleAutoDrag;
			}
			if (strategy is SelectionStrategySingle)
			{
				return SelectionType.Single;
			}
			if (strategy is SelectionStrategyExtendedAutoDrag)
			{
				return SelectionType.ExtendedAutoDrag;
			}
			if (strategy is SelectionStrategyExtended)
			{
				return SelectionType.Extended;
			}
			if (strategy is SelectionStrategyNone)
			{
				return SelectionType.None;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnHorizontalAutoScrollTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsWithinDblClickThreshold())
			{
				return;
			}
			StopHorizontalAutoScrollTimer();
			if (Mouse.LeftButton != MouseButtonState.Released)
			{
				ISelectableItem currentSelectableItem = CurrentSelectableItem;
				if (currentSelectableItem != null)
				{
					_selectionHost.DoAutoScrollHorizontal(currentSelectableItem, _autoScrollManagerHorizontal.ScrollDirection, _autoScrollManagerHorizontal.ScrollSpeed);
					ForceSynchronousMouseMove();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnVerticalAutoScrollTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsWithinDblClickThreshold())
			{
				return;
			}
			StopVerticalAutoScrollTimer();
			if (Mouse.LeftButton != MouseButtonState.Released)
			{
				ISelectableItem currentSelectableItem = CurrentSelectableItem;
				if (currentSelectableItem != null)
				{
					_selectionHost.DoAutoScrollVertical(currentSelectableItem, _autoScrollManagerVertical.ScrollDirection, _autoScrollManagerVertical.ScrollSpeed);
					ForceSynchronousMouseMove();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetupHorizontalAutoScrollTimer(double interval)
		{
			if (_horizontalAutoScrollTimer == null)
			{
				_horizontalAutoScrollTimer = new DispatcherTimer(AutoScrollTimerDispatcherPriority);
				_horizontalAutoScrollTimer.Tick += OnHorizontalAutoScrollTimerTick;
			}
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(interval);
			if (timeSpan != _horizontalAutoScrollTimer.Interval || !_horizontalAutoScrollTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				Stopwatch autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal = _autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal ?? Stopwatch.StartNew();
				if (_autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal != null)
				{
					timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromTicks(Math.Max(timeSpan.Ticks - _autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal.ElapsedTicks, 0L));
					_autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal = null;
				}
				_horizontalAutoScrollTimer.Interval = timeSpan;
				_autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal = autoScrollStopwatchHorizontal;
				_horizontalAutoScrollTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		private void SetupVerticalAutoScrollTimer(double interval)
		{
			if (_verticalAutoScrollTimer == null)
			{
				_verticalAutoScrollTimer = new DispatcherTimer(AutoScrollTimerDispatcherPriority);
				_verticalAutoScrollTimer.Tick += OnVerticalAutoScrollTimerTick;
			}
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(interval);
			if (timeSpan != _verticalAutoScrollTimer.Interval || !_verticalAutoScrollTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				Stopwatch autoScrollStopwatchVertical = _autoScrollStopwatchVertical ?? Stopwatch.StartNew();
				if (_autoScrollStopwatchVertical != null)
				{
					timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromTicks(Math.Max(timeSpan.Ticks - _autoScrollStopwatchVertical.ElapsedTicks, 0L));
					_autoScrollStopwatchVertical = null;
				}
				_verticalAutoScrollTimer.Interval = timeSpan;
				_autoScrollStopwatchVertical = autoScrollStopwatchVertical;
				_verticalAutoScrollTimer.Start();
			}
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategySingle : SelectionStrategyBase
	{
		private bool _allowToggle = true;

		public override bool IsSingleSelect => true;

		public bool AllowToggle
		{
			get
			{
				return _allowToggle;
			}
			set
			{
				_allowToggle = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldSelectOnDrag => true;

		public SelectionStrategySingle(ISelectionHost selectionHost)
			: base(selectionHost)
		{
		}

		public override bool OnMouseLeftButtonDown(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			return ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(item, e, forceDrag: false);
		}

		public override bool OnMouseMove(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.InDragMode)
			{
				DragMove(e);
				return true;
			}
			System.Windows.Point mousePointInRootElementCoordinates = GetMousePointInRootElementCoordinates(e);
			if (base.CurrentSelectionState == SelectionState.PreDrag && ShouldStartDrag(mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.X, mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.Y))
			{
				DragStart(e);
				return true;
			}
			ManageTimers(e);
			if (ShouldSelectOnDrag)
			{
				if (item != null && !base.IgnoreNextMouseMove && !base.SelectionHost.ActivateItem(item, preventScrollItemIntoView: false))
				{
					return false;
				}
				SelectItemAtPoint(e);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			StopHorizontalAutoScrollTimer();
			StopVerticalAutoScrollTimer();
			bool inDragMode = base.InDragMode;
			if (base.InDragMode)
			{
				base.SelectionHost.OnDragEnd(canceled: false);
				base.InDragMode = false;
			}
			base.SelectionHost.RootElement.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			base.SelectionHost.OnMouseUp(e, !inDragMode && IsWithinDblClickThreshold());
		}

		public override bool SelectItemViaKeyboard(ISelectableItem item, bool shiftKeyDown, bool controlKeyDown, bool forceToggle)
		{
			if (forceToggle && (!_allowToggle || !controlKeyDown))
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.CurrentSelectableItem = item;
			if (!base.SelectionHost.ActivateItem(item, preventScrollItemIntoView: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.SingleSelect;
			if (!base.CurrentSelectableItem.IsSelected)
			{
				base.SelectionHost.SelectItem(item, clearExistingSelection: true);
			}
			else if (forceToggle && _allowToggle)
			{
				base.SelectionHost.DeselectItem(base.CurrentSelectableItem);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, bool forceDrag)
		{
			System.Windows.Point mousePointInRootElementCoordinates = GetMousePointInRootElementCoordinates(e);
			base.InitialXPos = mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.X;
			base.InitialYPos = mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.Y;
			base.CurrentSelectableItem = item;
			if (!base.SelectionHost.ActivateItem(item, preventScrollItemIntoView: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.CurrentSelectableItem.IsSelected)
			{
				if (_allowToggle && base.IsCtrlKeyPressed)
				{
					base.SelectionHost.DeselectItem(base.CurrentSelectableItem);
					return false;
				}
				if (base.CurrentSelectableItem.IsDraggable)
				{
					base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.PreDrag;
				}
				else
				{
					base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.PreEdit;
				}
				return true;
			}
			base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.SingleSelect;
			base.SelectionHost.SelectItem(base.CurrentSelectableItem, clearExistingSelection: true);
			if (forceDrag && base.CurrentSelectableItem.IsDraggable)
			{
				base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.PreDrag;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void SelectItemAtPoint(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs)
		{
			if (base.IgnoreNextMouseMove || !base.IsLeftMouseButtonDown)
			{
				base.IgnoreNextMouseMove = false;
				StopHorizontalAutoScrollTimer();
				StopVerticalAutoScrollTimer();
				return;
			}
			ISelectableItem nearestCompatibleItem = base.SelectionHost.GetNearestCompatibleItem(base.CurrentSelectableItem, mouseEventArgs);
			if (nearestCompatibleItem != null && (nearestCompatibleItem != base.CurrentSelectableItem || !nearestCompatibleItem.IsSelected) && (base.CurrentSelectableItem == null || !(nearestCompatibleItem.GetType() != base.CurrentSelectableItem.GetType())) && base.SelectionHost.SelectItem(nearestCompatibleItem, clearExistingSelection: true))
			{
				base.CurrentSelectableItem = nearestCompatibleItem;
			}
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategyNone : SelectionStrategyBase
	{
		public SelectionStrategyNone(ISelectionHost selectionHost)
			: base(selectionHost)
		{
		}

		public override bool OnMouseLeftButtonDown(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Point mousePointInRootElementCoordinates = GetMousePointInRootElementCoordinates(e);
			base.InitialXPos = mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.X;
			base.InitialYPos = mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.Y;
			if (base.IsLeftMouseButtonDown)
			{
				base.IgnoreNextMouseMove = false;
			}
			if (!base.SelectionHost.ActivateItem(item, preventScrollItemIntoView: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.CurrentSelectableItem = item;
			return true;
		}

		public override bool OnMouseMove(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.InDragMode)
			{
				DragMove(e);
				return true;
			}
			System.Windows.Point mousePointInRootElementCoordinates = GetMousePointInRootElementCoordinates(e);
			if (ShouldStartDrag(mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.X, mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.Y))
			{
				DragStart(e);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			StopHorizontalAutoScrollTimer();
			StopVerticalAutoScrollTimer();
			base.SelectionHost.OnDragEnd(canceled: false);
			base.InDragMode = false;
			base.SelectionHost.RootElement.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			base.SelectionHost.OnMouseUp(e, preventScrollItemIntoView: false);
		}

		public override bool SelectItemViaKeyboard(ISelectableItem item, bool shiftKeyDown, bool controlKeyDown, bool forceToggle)
		{
			if (forceToggle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.SelectionHost.ActivateItem(item, preventScrollItemIntoView: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.CurrentSelectableItem = item;
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategyExtended : SelectionStrategyBase
	{
		private bool _isInManualDragMode;

		private bool _shouldSelect = true;

		private bool _selectionDragCanceled;

		private DispatcherTimer _dragDelayTimer;

		private System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs _initialMouseDownEventArgs;

		public override bool IsMultiSelect => true;

		public virtual bool IsDiscontiguousAllowed => true;

		protected virtual DispatcherPriority DragDelayTimerDispatcherPriority => DispatcherPriority.Normal;

		protected virtual double DragDelayTimerInterval => 750.0;

		protected bool ShouldSelect => _shouldSelect;

		public SelectionStrategyExtended(ISelectionHost selectionHost)
			: base(selectionHost)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanItemBeNavigatedTo(ISelectableItem item, bool shiftKeyDown, bool controlKeyDown)
		{
			if (!base.CanItemBeNavigatedTo(item, shiftKeyDown, controlKeyDown))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (shiftKeyDown || controlKeyDown)
			{
				return base.SelectionHost.IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection(item);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnDragStartCanceled()
		{
		}

		public override bool OnMouseLeftButtonDown(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			return ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(item, e, forceDrag: false);
		}

		public override bool OnMouseMove(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.InDragMode)
			{
				DragMove(e);
				return true;
			}
			if (base.CurrentSelectionState == SelectionState.PotentialPreDrag && _isInManualDragMode)
			{
				base.SelectionHost.RootElement.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.ExtSelect;
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			System.Windows.Point mousePointInRootElementCoordinates = GetMousePointInRootElementCoordinates(e);
			if ((base.CurrentSelectionState == SelectionState.PreDrag || base.CurrentSelectionState == SelectionState.PotentialPreDrag) && ShouldStartDrag(mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.X, mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.Y))
			{
				if (base.CurrentSelectionState == SelectionState.PreDrag)
				{
					DragStart(e);
					base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.ExtSelect;
					return true;
				}
				flag = true;
				StopDragDelayTimer();
			}
			if (!base.IsLeftMouseButtonDown)
			{
				StopHorizontalAutoScrollTimer();
				StopVerticalAutoScrollTimer();
			}
			else
			{
				ManageTimers(e);
			}
			if (base.IgnoreNextMouseMove || !base.IsLeftMouseButtonDown)
			{
				base.IgnoreNextMouseMove = false;
				return true;
			}
			item = base.SelectionHost.GetNearestCompatibleItem(base.CurrentSelectableItem, e);
			if (item == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			item = base.SelectionHost.TranslateItem(item);
			if (item == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (base.CurrentSelectionState == SelectionState.PotentialPreDrag && (_selectionDragCanceled || flag))
			{
				base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.ExtSelect;
			}
			else if (item == base.CurrentSelectableItem)
			{
				return true;
			}
			base.CurrentSelectableItem = item;
			if (!base.SelectionHost.ActivateItem(item, IsWithinDblClickThreshold() && !base.InDragMode))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.IsCtrlKeyPressed && IsDiscontiguousAllowed)
			{
				if (_shouldSelect)
				{
					base.SelectionHost.SelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection: false);
				}
				else
				{
					base.SelectionHost.DeselectRange(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.SelectionHost.SelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection: true);
			}
			base.IgnoreNextMouseMove = true;
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = _isInManualDragMode || base.InDragMode;
			try
			{
				StopDragDelayTimer();
				StopHorizontalAutoScrollTimer();
				StopVerticalAutoScrollTimer();
				if (_isInManualDragMode)
				{
					base.SelectionHost.OnDragEnd(canceled: false);
					_isInManualDragMode = false;
				}
				base.IgnoreNextMouseMove = false;
				if (base.CurrentSelectionState != SelectionState.PreDrag && base.CurrentSelectionState != SelectionState.PotentialPreDrag)
				{
					base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.ExtSelect;
					return;
				}
				item = base.SelectionHost.TranslateItem(item);
				if (item == null || base.CurrentSelectableItem == null || item.GetType() != base.CurrentSelectableItem.GetType() || (base.CurrentSelectionState == SelectionState.PreDrag && base.CurrentSelectionState == SelectionState.PotentialPreDrag && base.IsShiftKeyPressed))
				{
					return;
				}
				base.SelectionHost.SetPivotItem(item, isRangeSelect: false);
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (base.IsCtrlKeyPressed && IsDiscontiguousAllowed)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					if (ShouldSelect)
					{
						base.SelectionHost.SelectItem(item, clearExistingSelection: false);
					}
					else
					{
						base.SelectionHost.DeselectItem(item);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.SelectionHost.SelectItem(item, clearExistingSelection: true);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.SelectionHost.OnMouseUp(e, !flag && IsWithinDblClickThreshold());
			}
		}

		public override bool SelectItemViaKeyboard(ISelectableItem item, bool shiftKeyDown, bool controlKeyDown, bool forceToggle)
		{
			bool flag = shiftKeyDown;
			bool flag2 = (controlKeyDown || forceToggle) && IsDiscontiguousAllowed;
			if (flag && !base.SelectionHost.IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.SelectionHost.ActivateItem(item, preventScrollItemIntoView: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!flag && flag2 && !forceToggle)
			{
				return true;
			}
			base.CurrentSelectableItem = item;
			_shouldSelect = true;
			base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.ExtSelect;
			base.SelectionHost.SetPivotItem(item, flag);
			if (!flag2 && item.IsSelected && item.IsDraggable && forceToggle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.ControlClick;
				if (!flag)
				{
					_shouldSelect = !item.IsSelected;
				}
				else
				{
					_shouldSelect = base.SelectionHost.GetPivotItem(item)?.IsSelected ?? false;
				}
			}
			if (_shouldSelect && flag2 && base.SelectionHost.IsMaxSelectedItemsReached(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				base.SelectionHost.ClearSnapshot();
			}
			if (flag2 && !flag)
			{
				base.SelectionHost.SnapshotSelection(item);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					base.SelectionHost.EnterSnakingMode(item);
					if (_shouldSelect)
					{
						base.SelectionHost.SelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection: false);
					}
					else
					{
						base.SelectionHost.DeselectRange(item);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.SelectionHost.SelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection: true);
				}
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				if (_shouldSelect)
				{
					base.SelectionHost.SelectItem(item, clearExistingSelection: false);
				}
				else
				{
					base.SelectionHost.DeselectItem(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.SelectionHost.SelectItem(item, clearExistingSelection: true);
			}
			if (_shouldSelect && base.SelectionHost.IsMaxSelectedItemsReached(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, bool forceDrag)
		{
			_isInManualDragMode = false;
			bool isShiftKeyPressed = base.IsShiftKeyPressed;
			bool flag = false;
			if (base.IsCtrlKeyPressed && IsDiscontiguousAllowed)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if ((isShiftKeyPressed || flag) && !base.SelectionHost.IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			System.Windows.Point mousePointInRootElementCoordinates = GetMousePointInRootElementCoordinates(e);
			base.InitialXPos = mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.X;
			base.InitialYPos = mousePointInRootElementCoordinates.Y;
			_initialMouseDownEventArgs = e;
			base.CurrentSelectableItem = item;
			_shouldSelect = true;
			if (!base.SelectionHost.ActivateItem(item, preventScrollItemIntoView: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (item.IsSelected || !item.IsSelectable || forceDrag)
			{
				if (item.IsDraggable)
				{
					base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.PreDrag;
				}
				else if (!flag)
				{
					base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.PotentialPreDrag;
					_selectionDragCanceled = false;
					StartDragDelayTimer();
				}
				else
				{
					base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.ExtSelect;
				}
				if (isShiftKeyPressed && (base.CurrentSelectionState == SelectionState.PreDrag || base.CurrentSelectionState == SelectionState.PotentialPreDrag))
				{
					base.SelectionHost.ClearSnapshot();
					if (flag)
					{
						base.SelectionHost.SnapshotSelection(item);
						_shouldSelect = base.SelectionHost.GetPivotItem(item)?.IsSelected ?? false;
						if (_shouldSelect)
						{
							base.SelectionHost.SelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection: false);
						}
						else
						{
							base.SelectionHost.DeselectRange(item);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						base.SelectionHost.SelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection: true);
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.ExtSelect;
			}
			base.SelectionHost.SetPivotItem(item, isShiftKeyPressed);
			if (item.IsSelected && item.IsDraggable)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					_shouldSelect = false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!forceDrag)
				{
					base.CurrentSelectionState = SelectionState.ControlClick;
				}
				if (!isShiftKeyPressed)
				{
					_shouldSelect = !item.IsSelected;
				}
				else
				{
					_shouldSelect = base.SelectionHost.GetPivotItem(item)?.IsSelected ?? false;
				}
			}
			else if (item.IsSelected)
			{
				return true;
			}
			base.SelectionHost.ClearSnapshot();
			if (flag)
			{
				base.SelectionHost.SnapshotSelection(item);
			}
			if (isShiftKeyPressed)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					if (_shouldSelect)
					{
						base.SelectionHost.SelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection: false);
					}
					else
					{
						base.SelectionHost.DeselectRange(item);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.SelectionHost.SelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection: true);
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				if (_shouldSelect)
				{
					base.SelectionHost.SelectItem(item, clearExistingSelection: false);
				}
				else
				{
					base.SelectionHost.DeselectItem(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.SelectionHost.SelectItem(item, clearExistingSelection: true);
			}
			if (_shouldSelect && base.SelectionHost.IsMaxSelectedItemsReached(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void StartDragDelayTimer()
		{
			StopDragDelayTimer();
			_dragDelayTimer = new DispatcherTimer(DragDelayTimerDispatcherPriority);
			_dragDelayTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(DragDelayTimerInterval);
			_dragDelayTimer.Tick += OnDragDelayTimerTick;
			_dragDelayTimer.Start();
		}

		private void OnDragDelayTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.SelectionHost.OnDragStart(base.CurrentSelectableItem, _initialMouseDownEventArgs))
			{
				_selectionDragCanceled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				_isInManualDragMode = true;
			}
			StopDragDelayTimer();
		}

		protected void StopDragDelayTimer()
		{
			if (_dragDelayTimer != null)
			{
				_dragDelayTimer.Stop();
				_dragDelayTimer.Tick -= OnDragDelayTimerTick;
				_dragDelayTimer = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategyContiguous : SelectionStrategyExtended
	{
		public override bool IsDiscontiguousAllowed => false;

		public SelectionStrategyContiguous(ISelectionHost selectionHost)
			: base(selectionHost)
		{
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategyExtendedAutoDrag : SelectionStrategyExtended
	{
		public SelectionStrategyExtendedAutoDrag(ISelectionHost selectionHost)
			: base(selectionHost)
		{
		}

		public override bool OnMouseLeftButtonDown(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			return ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(item, e, forceDrag: true);
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategySingleAutoDrag : SelectionStrategySingle
	{
		protected override bool ShouldSelectOnDrag => false;

		public SelectionStrategySingleAutoDrag(ISelectionHost selectionHost)
			: base(selectionHost)
		{
		}

		public override bool OnMouseLeftButtonDown(ISelectableItem item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			return base.ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(item, e, forceDrag: true);
		}
	}

			internal bool IsDeactivated

					return _isDeactivated;

				set

					_isDeactivated = value;
					if (_isItemItsOwnContainer || !(_container is UIElement uIElement))

						return;

					if (_isDeactivated)

						_cachedVisibilityLocalValue = uIElement.ReadLocalValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
						uIElement.SetValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox);
						if (_cachedVisibilityLocalValue is BindingExpressionBase)

					else if (_cachedVisibilityLocalValue is BindingBase)
					{
						if (uIElement is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)

		private class RecyclingGenerator : IDisposable
		{
			private RecyclingItemContainerGenerator _owner;

			private GeneratorPosition _position;

			private GeneratorDirection _direction;

			private ContainerReference _newlyCreatedContainerNotInVisualTree;

			private int _currentIndex;

			private int _startIndex;

			private List<ContainerReference> _generatedContainers;

			internal int CountOfGeneratedItems
			{
				get
				{
					int num = _generatedContainers.Count;
					if (_newlyCreatedContainerNotInVisualTree != null)
					{
						num--;
					}
					return num;
				}
			}

			private int InsertAtIndexInActiveList
			{
				get
				{
					int count = _owner._activeContainersInUse.Count;
					int i;
					for (i = 0; i < count && _owner._indexMap.IndexOf(_owner._activeContainersInUse[i]) <= _startIndex; i++)
					{
					}
					return i;
				}
			}

			internal RecyclingGenerator(RecyclingItemContainerGenerator owner, GeneratorPosition position, GeneratorDirection direction, bool allowStartAtRealizedItem)
			{
				_owner = owner;
				_position = position;
				_direction = direction;
				_currentIndex = position.Index;
				int index = position.Index;
				int num = position.Offset;
				_generatedContainers = new List<ContainerReference>();
				if (index >= 0)
				{
					int countOfActiveContainers = _owner.CountOfActiveContainers;
					if (index < countOfActiveContainers)
					{
						ContainerReference containerReference = _owner.GetContainerReference(index, isIndexBasedOnZOrder: false);
						if (containerReference != null)
						{
							_currentIndex = _owner._indexMap.IndexOf(containerReference);
						}
					}
				}
				if (num == 0)
				{
					if (_currentIndex == -1)
					{
						if (direction == GeneratorDirection.Backward)
						{
							_currentIndex = _owner.Items.Count - 1;
						}
						else
						{
							_currentIndex = 0;
						}
					}
					if (!allowStartAtRealizedItem && _owner._indexMap[_currentIndex] != null)
					{
						num = ((direction != GeneratorDirection.Backward) ? 1 : (-1));
					}
				}
				else if (num < 0 && _currentIndex < 0)
				{
					if (direction == GeneratorDirection.Backward)
					{
						_currentIndex = _owner.Items.Count;
					}
					else
					{
						_currentIndex = -1;
					}
				}
				_currentIndex += num;
				_startIndex = _currentIndex;
				_owner.SetStatus(GeneratorStatus.GeneratingContainers);
			}

			private void CalculateNextIndex()
			{
				if (_direction == GeneratorDirection.Backward)
				{
					_currentIndex--;
				}
				else
				{
					_currentIndex++;
				}
			}

			internal DependencyObject GenerateNext(bool returnNullIfAlreadyRealized, out bool isNewlyRealized)
			{
				if (_newlyCreatedContainerNotInVisualTree != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_10"));
				}
				isNewlyRealized = false;
				if (_currentIndex < 0 || _currentIndex >= _owner.Items.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (_currentIndex >= _owner._indexMap.Count)
				{
					_owner._indexMap.Expand(_currentIndex + 1);
				}
				ContainerReference containerReference = _owner._indexMap[_currentIndex] as ContainerReference;
				if (containerReference != null && !object.Equals(_owner.Items[_currentIndex], containerReference.Item))
				{
					if (containerReference.Container != null && !containerReference.IsDeactivated)
					{
						_owner.DeactivateContainer(containerReference.Container);
					}
					_owner.RemoveContainerFromCache(containerReference);
					_owner._indexMap[_currentIndex] = null;
					containerReference = null;
				}
				if (containerReference != null)
				{
					_owner.RemoveContainerFromCache(containerReference);
					if (containerReference.IsDeactivated)
					{
						containerReference.IsDeactivated = false;
						_owner._recyclingItemsControl.ReactivateContainer(containerReference.Container, containerReference.Item);
					}
					if (returnNullIfAlreadyRealized)
					{
						_generatedContainers.Add(containerReference);
						CalculateNextIndex();
						return null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = false;
					object obj = _owner.Items[_currentIndex];
					if (obj == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (_owner._recyclableContainers != null)
					{
						if (_owner._recyclableContainers.TryGetValue(obj, out var value))
						{
							containerReference = value;
						}
						else
						{
							if (_owner._recyclableContainersDups != null)
							{
								foreach (ContainerReference recyclableContainersDup in _owner._recyclableContainersDups)
								{
									if (object.Equals(obj, recyclableContainersDup.Item))
									{
										containerReference = recyclableContainersDup;
										break;
									}
								}
							}
							if (containerReference == null)
							{
								int count = _owner._recyclableContainersListFiltered.Count;
								for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
								{
									value = _owner._recyclableContainersListFiltered[i];
									if (_owner.IsContainerCompatibleWithItem(value, obj))
									{
										containerReference = value;
										flag2 = true;
										break;
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (containerReference == null)
					{
						containerReference = _owner.CreateNewContainerReference(obj);
						isNewlyRealized = true;
						_newlyCreatedContainerNotInVisualTree = containerReference;
					}
					else
					{
						_owner.RemoveContainerFromCache(containerReference);
					}
					int num = _owner._indexMap.IndexOf(containerReference);
					if (num >= 0 && num != _currentIndex)
					{
						_owner._indexMap[num] = null;
					}
					_owner._indexMap[_currentIndex] = containerReference;
					if (containerReference.IsDeactivated)
					{
						if (!flag2)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						containerReference.IsDeactivated = false;
					}
					containerReference.Item = obj;
					if (flag)
					{
						_owner._recyclingItemsControl.ReactivateContainer(containerReference.Container, containerReference.Item);
					}
					else if (flag2)
					{
						_owner.ConnectContainerToItem(containerReference);
						_owner._recyclingItemsControl.ReuseContainerForNewItem(containerReference.Container, containerReference.Item);
					}
				}
				_generatedContainers.Add(containerReference);
				CalculateNextIndex();
				return containerReference.Container;
			}

			internal ContainerReference GetActiveContainerReference(int index, bool isIndexBasedOnZOrder)
			{
				int countOfActiveContainers = _owner.CountOfActiveContainers;
				int count = _generatedContainers.Count;
				int insertAtIndexInActiveList = InsertAtIndexInActiveList;
				List<ContainerReference> list = ((!isIndexBasedOnZOrder) ? _owner._activeContainersInUse : _owner.ActiveContainersInUseByZorder);
				if (count == 0 || index < insertAtIndexInActiveList)
				{
					return list[index];
				}
				if (index >= insertAtIndexInActiveList + count)
				{
					return list[index - count];
				}
				index -= insertAtIndexInActiveList;
				if (_direction == GeneratorDirection.Backward && count > 1)
				{
					index = count - (1 + index);
				}
				return _generatedContainers[index];
			}

			internal int GetIndexOfActiveContainerReference(ContainerReference cr, bool isIndexBasedOnZOrder)
			{
				int countOfActiveContainers = _owner.CountOfActiveContainers;
				int count = _generatedContainers.Count;
				int insertAtIndexInActiveList = InsertAtIndexInActiveList;
				List<ContainerReference> list = ((!isIndexBasedOnZOrder) ? _owner._activeContainersInUse : _owner.ActiveContainersInUseByZorder);
				int num = list.IndexOf(cr);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					if (num >= insertAtIndexInActiveList)
					{
						num += count;
					}
					return num;
				}
				num = list.IndexOf(cr);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (_direction == GeneratorDirection.Backward && count > 1)
				{
					num = count - (1 + num);
				}
				return num + insertAtIndexInActiveList;
			}

			internal void OnContainerAddedToVisualTree(ContainerReference cr)
			{
				if (cr.IsInVisualTree)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_11"));
				}
				if (cr != _newlyCreatedContainerNotInVisualTree)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_12"));
				}
				cr.IsInVisualTree = true;
				_newlyCreatedContainerNotInVisualTree = null;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (_newlyCreatedContainerNotInVisualTree != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_10"));
				}
				_owner._currentGenerator = null;
				_owner.SetStatus(GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated);
				int num = _generatedContainers.Count;
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (num == 1)
				{
					if (_owner._activeContainersInUse.Contains(_generatedContainers[0]))
					{
						_generatedContainers.Clear();
						num = 0;
					}
				}
				else if (_owner._activeContainersInUse.Count > 0)
				{
					HashSet hashSet = new HashSet();
					hashSet.AddItems(_owner._activeContainersInUse);
					for (int num2 = num - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						if (hashSet.Exists(_generatedContainers[num2]))
						{
							_generatedContainers.RemoveAt(num2);
							num--;
						}
					}
				}
				if (_direction == GeneratorDirection.Backward && num > 1)
				{
					_generatedContainers.Reverse();
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					_owner._activeContainersInUse.InsertRange(InsertAtIndexInActiveList, _generatedContainers);
				}
			}
		}

		private class ZOrderComparer : IComparer
		{
			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				ContainerReference containerReference = x as ContainerReference;
				ContainerReference containerReference2 = y as ContainerReference;
				if (containerReference == containerReference2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (containerReference == null || containerReference2 == null)
				{
					if (containerReference == null)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				int zIndex = containerReference.ZIndex;
				int zIndex2 = containerReference2.ZIndex;
				if (zIndex < zIndex2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (zIndex > zIndex2)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (containerReference._originalIndex < containerReference2._originalIndex)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		public int CountOfAllContainers

				}
				else
				{
					countOfActiveContainers += _deactivatedContainers.Count;
					if (_referencesBeforeLastReset != null)

					}
				}
				return countOfActiveContainers;
			}

				if (_currentGenerator != null)

					num += _currentGenerator.CountOfGeneratedItems;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public GeneratorStatus Status => _status;

		private List<ContainerReference> ActiveContainersInUseByZorder
		{
			get
			{
				if (_activeContainersInUseByZorder == null)
				{
					_activeContainersInUseByZorder = new List<ContainerReference>();
				}
				else if (_isZOrderDirty || _activeContainersInUse.Count != _activeContainersInUseByZorder.Count)
				{
					_activeContainersInUseByZorder.Clear();
				}
				if (_activeContainersInUseByZorder.Count == 0)
				{
					_isZOrderDirty = false;
					int count = _activeContainersInUse.Count;
					if (count > 0)
					{
						if (count == 1)
						{
							_activeContainersInUseByZorder.Add(_activeContainersInUse[0]);
						}
						else
						{
							for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
							{
								_activeContainersInUse[i]._originalIndex = i;
							}
							ContainerReference[] array = new ContainerReference[count];
							_activeContainersInUse.CopyTo(array);
							CoreUtilities.SortMerge(array, new ZOrderComparer());
							_activeContainersInUseByZorder.AddRange(array);
						}
					}
				}
				return _activeContainersInUseByZorder;
			}
		}

		private ItemCollection Items => _recyclingItemsControl.Items;

		internal bool IsInRemoveAll => _isInRemoveAll;

		public event EventHandler<ContainerDiscardedEventArgs> ContainerDiscarded;

		public event EventHandler StatusChanged;

		internal event EventHandler ZOrderChanged;

		internal RecyclingItemContainerGenerator(RecyclingItemsControl recyclingItemsControl)
		{
			if (recyclingItemsControl == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("recyclingItemsControl", SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_1"));
			}
			_recyclingItemsControl = recyclingItemsControl;
			_deactivatedContainers = new List<ContainerReference>();
			_activeContainersInUse = new List<ContainerReference>();
			InitializeIndexMap();
			((INotifyCollectionChanged)Items).CollectionChanged += OnItemCollectionChanged;
		}

		private void OnItemCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				if (_referencesBeforeLastReset == null)
				{
					_referencesBeforeLastReset = new Dictionary<object, ContainerReference>();
				}
				foreach (ContainerReference nonNullItem in _indexMap.NonNullItems)
				{
					object item = nonNullItem.Item;
					if (item != null)
					{
						_referencesBeforeLastReset[item] = nonNullItem;
					}
				}
				if (_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap != null)
				{
					foreach (ContainerReference item3 in _deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap)
					{
						object item2 = item3.Item;
						if (item2 != null)
						{
							_referencesBeforeLastReset[item2] = item3;
						}
					}
					_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap = null;
				}
				_indexMap.Clear();
				_indexMap.Expand(Items.Count);
				_activeContainersInUse.Clear();
				_deactivatedContainers.Clear();
				if (_activeContainersInUseByZorder != null)
				{
					_activeContainersInUseByZorder.Clear();
				}
				ProcessPendingResetAsync();
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				object[] items = new object[e.NewItems.Count];
				if (e.NewStartingIndex > _indexMap.Count)
				{
					_indexMap.Expand(e.NewStartingIndex);
				}
				_indexMap.InsertRange(e.NewStartingIndex, items);
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				int num3 = e.NewStartingIndex + e.NewItems.Count - 1;
				for (int k = e.NewStartingIndex; k <= num3; k++)
				{
					if (_indexMap[k] is ContainerReference cr2)
					{
						ClearContainerReference(cr2, removeFromMap: false, removeFromCache: true, removeFromRecyclingCache: true);
						_indexMap[k] = null;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				int num;
				IList list2;
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					num = e.NewStartingIndex;
					list2 = e.NewItems;
				}
				else
				{
					num = e.OldStartingIndex;
					list2 = e.OldItems;
				}
				int num2 = num + list2.Count - 1;
				if (num2 >= _indexMap.Count)
				{
					OnItemCollectionChanged(sender, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
					break;
				}
				for (int j = num; j <= num2; j++)
				{
					if (_indexMap[j] is ContainerReference cr)
					{
						ClearContainerReference(cr, removeFromMap: false, removeFromCache: true, removeFromRecyclingCache: true);
					}
				}
				_indexMap.RemoveRange(num, list2.Count);
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
			{
				IList list = ((e.NewItems == null) ? e.OldItems : e.NewItems);
				object[] array = new object[list.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (_indexMap[i + e.OldStartingIndex] is ContainerReference containerReference)
					{
						array[i] = containerReference;
					}
				}
				_indexMap.RemoveRange(e.OldStartingIndex, list.Count);
				_indexMap.InsertRange(e.NewStartingIndex, array);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void OnZorderChanged()
		{
			_isZOrderDirty = true;
			if (this.ZOrderChanged != null)
			{
				this.ZOrderChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private static ContainerReference GetContainerReference(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (ContainerReference)d.GetValue(ContainerReferenceProperty);
		}

		public void BeginGeneration(ScrollDirection scrollDirection)
		{
			BeginGeneration(scrollDirection, null);
		}

		public void BeginGeneration(ScrollDirection scrollDirection, IEnumerable itemsExpectedToBeGenerated)
		{
			if (_isGenerating)
			{
				EndGeneration();
			}
			if (_isGenerating)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_2"));
			}
			if (_resetOperationPending != null)
			{
				_resetOperationPending.Abort();
				_resetOperationPending = null;
			}
			_scrollDirection = scrollDirection;
			PlaceAllActiveContainersInLimbo(itemsExpectedToBeGenerated);
			_isGenerating = true;
		}

		public DependencyObject ContainerFromIndex(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= _indexMap.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(_indexMap[index] is ContainerReference { IsDeactivated: false } containerReference))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return containerReference.Container;
		}

		public DependencyObject ContainerFromItem(object item)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = ContainerFromIndex(_recyclingItemsControl.Items.IndexOf(item));
			if (dependencyObject == null && _referencesBeforeLastReset != null && _referencesBeforeLastReset.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
			{
				dependencyObject = value.Container;
			}
			return dependencyObject;
		}

		public void DeactivateAllContainers()
		{
			DeactivateAllContainersInUse();
			DeactivateAllContainersInLimbo();
		}

		public void DeactivateContainer(DependencyObject container)
		{
			DeactivateContainerHelper(container, removeFromRecyclableCache: true);
		}

		private void DeactivateContainerHelper(DependencyObject container, bool removeFromRecyclableCache)
		{
			ContainerReference containerReference = GetContainerReference(container);
			if (containerReference == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DeactivateContainerHelper(containerReference);
			int num = _activeContainersInUse.IndexOf(containerReference);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				_activeContainersInUse.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			else if (removeFromRecyclableCache)
			{
				RemoveContainerFromRecyclableCache(containerReference);
			}
			if (_activeContainersInUseByZorder != null)
			{
				num = _activeContainersInUseByZorder.IndexOf(containerReference);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					_activeContainersInUseByZorder.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DeactivateContainerHelper(ContainerReference cr)
		{
			cr.IsDeactivated = true;
			_recyclingItemsControl.DeactivateContainer(cr.Container, cr.Item);
			_deactivatedContainers.Add(cr);
		}

		public void EndGeneration()
		{
			_isGenerating = false;
			if (_activeContainersInUseByZorder != null)
			{
				_activeContainersInUseByZorder.Clear();
			}
			DeactivateAllContainersInLimbo();
			_referencesBeforeLastReset = null;
			_referencesBeforeLastResetList = null;
			_recyclableContainers = null;
			_recyclableContainersList = null;
			_recyclableContainersListFiltered = null;
			_recyclableContainersDups = null;
			_indexMap.Compact();
			if (_resetPostponed)
			{
				ProcessPendingResetAsync();
			}
		}

		public int IndexFromContainer(DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			ContainerReference containerReference = GetContainerReference(container);
			if (containerReference == null || containerReference.IsDeactivated)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return _indexMap.IndexOf(containerReference);
		}

		public object ItemFromContainer(DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			ContainerReference containerReference = GetContainerReference(container);
			if (containerReference == null || containerReference.IsDeactivated)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			int num = _indexMap.IndexOf(containerReference);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			return containerReference.Item;
		}

		public void RemoveAllDeactivatedContainers()
		{
			_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap = null;
			for (int num = _deactivatedContainers.Count - 1; num >= 0; num = _deactivatedContainers.Count - 1)
			{
				ContainerReference cr = _deactivatedContainers[num];
				_deactivatedContainers.RemoveAt(num);
				ClearContainerReference(cr, removeFromMap: true, removeFromCache: true, removeFromRecyclingCache: true);
			}
		}

		public void VerifyAllDeactivatedContainers()
		{
			if (_deactivatedContainers.Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<ContainerReference> list = null;
			foreach (ContainerReference deactivatedContainer in _deactivatedContainers)
			{
				bool? flag = _recyclingItemsControl.IsStillValid(deactivatedContainer.Container, deactivatedContainer.Item);
				if (flag.HasValue && !flag.Value)
				{
					if (list == null)
					{
						list = new List<ContainerReference>();
					}
					list.Add(deactivatedContainer);
				}
			}
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (list.Count == _deactivatedContainers.Count)
			{
				_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap = null;
			}
			foreach (ContainerReference item in list)
			{
				_deactivatedContainers.Remove(item);
				if (_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap != null)
				{
					_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap.Remove(item);
				}
				ClearContainerReference(item, removeFromMap: true, removeFromCache: true, removeFromRecyclingCache: true);
			}
		}

		internal DependencyObject GetContainer(int index, bool isIndexBasedOnZOrder)
		{
			return GetContainerReference(index, isIndexBasedOnZOrder)?.Container;
		}

		private ContainerReference GetContainerReference(int index, bool isIndexBasedOnZOrder)
		{
			int countOfActiveContainers = CountOfActiveContainers;
			if (index < countOfActiveContainers)
			{
				if (_currentGenerator != null)
				{
					return _currentGenerator.GetActiveContainerReference(index, isIndexBasedOnZOrder);
				}
				if (isIndexBasedOnZOrder)
				{
					return ActiveContainersInUseByZorder[index];
				}
				return _activeContainersInUse[index];
			}
			index -= countOfActiveContainers;
			countOfActiveContainers = _deactivatedContainers.Count;
			if (index < countOfActiveContainers)
			{
				return _deactivatedContainers[index];
			}
			index -= countOfActiveContainers;
			if (_recyclableContainersList != null)
			{
				countOfActiveContainers = _recyclableContainersList.Count;
				if (index < countOfActiveContainers)
				{
					return _recyclableContainersList[index];
				}
			}
			else if (_referencesBeforeLastReset != null)
			{
				int count = _referencesBeforeLastReset.Count;
				if (index < count)
				{
					if (_referencesBeforeLastResetList == null || _referencesBeforeLastResetList.Count != count)
					{
						_referencesBeforeLastResetList = new List<ContainerReference>(_referencesBeforeLastReset.Values);
					}
					return _referencesBeforeLastResetList[index];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ContainerReference GetContainerReferenceHelper(int index, LinkedList<ContainerReference> llist)
		{
			LinkedListNode<ContainerReference> linkedListNode = llist.First;
			while (index > 0)
			{
				linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next;
				index--;
			}
			return linkedListNode.Value;
		}

		internal int GetIndexOfContainerInActiveList(DependencyObject container, bool isIndexBasedOnZOrder)
		{
			ContainerReference containerReference = GetContainerReference(container);
			if (containerReference != null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_currentGenerator != null)
			{
				return _currentGenerator.GetIndexOfActiveContainerReference(containerReference, isIndexBasedOnZOrder);
			}
			if (isIndexBasedOnZOrder)
			{
				return ActiveContainersInUseByZorder.IndexOf(containerReference);
			}
			return _activeContainersInUse.IndexOf(containerReference);
		}

		internal void OnContainerAddedToVisualTree(DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (_currentGenerator == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_3"));
			}
			ContainerReference containerReference = GetContainerReference(container);
			if (containerReference == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_4"));
			}
			_currentGenerator.OnContainerAddedToVisualTree(containerReference);
		}

		private void ClearContainerReference(ContainerReference cr, bool removeFromMap, bool removeFromCache, bool removeFromRecyclingCache)
		{
			if (removeFromMap)
			{
				int num = _indexMap.IndexOf(cr);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					_indexMap[num] = null;
				}
			}
			if (removeFromCache)
			{
				int num = _activeContainersInUse.IndexOf(cr);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					_activeContainersInUse.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					num = _deactivatedContainers.IndexOf(cr);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						_deactivatedContainers.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					if (_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap != null)
					{
						num = _deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap.IndexOf(cr);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap.RemoveAt(num);
						}
					}
					if (removeFromRecyclingCache)
					{
						RemoveContainerFromRecyclableCache(cr);
					}
				}
				if (_activeContainersInUseByZorder != null)
				{
					num = _activeContainersInUseByZorder.IndexOf(cr);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						_activeContainersInUseByZorder.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
			cr.Generator = null;
			cr.Container.ClearValue(ContainerReferenceProperty);
			if (!cr.IsItemItsOwnContainer)
			{
				cr.Container.SetValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, null);
			}
			_recyclingItemsControl.ClearContainerForItemInternal(cr.Container, cr.Item);
			if (this.ContainerDiscarded != null)
			{
				this.ContainerDiscarded(this, new ContainerDiscardedEventArgs(cr.Container));
			}
		}

		private ContainerReference CreateNewContainerReference(object item)
		{
			bool flag = _recyclingItemsControl.IsItemItsOwnContainerInternal(item);
			DependencyObject container = ((!flag) ? _recyclingItemsControl.GetContainerForItemInternal(item) : (item as DependencyObject));
			ContainerReference containerReference = new ContainerReference(container, flag);
			if (!flag)
			{
				containerReference.Item = item;
			}
			ConnectContainerToItem(containerReference);
			return containerReference;
		}

		private void ConnectContainerToItem(ContainerReference cr)
		{
			DependencyObject container = cr.Container;
			container.SetValue(ContainerReferenceProperty, cr);
			cr.Generator = this;
			if (!cr.IsItemItsOwnContainer)
			{
				container.SetValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, cr.Item);
			}
		}

		private void DeactivateAllContainersInLimbo()
		{
			if (_recyclableContainersList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = _recyclableContainersList.Count;
			if (count >= 1)
			{
				int count2 = _recyclingItemsControl.Items.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					ContainerReference cr = _recyclableContainersList[i];
					DeactivateLimboedContainer(count2, cr);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DeactivateLimboedContainer(int itemCount, ContainerReference cr)
		{
			if (_referencesBeforeLastReset == null)
			{
				if (!cr.IsDeactivated)
				{
					DeactivateContainerHelper(cr);
				}
			}
			else if (itemCount > 0 && !HasContainerBeenCleared(cr) && _recyclingItemsControl.ShouldDeactivateContainer(cr.Container, cr.Item))
			{
				bool flag = _indexMap.Contains(cr);
				if (!flag)
				{
					int num = _recyclingItemsControl.Items.IndexOf(cr.Item);
					if (num >= 0 && num < _indexMap.Count && _indexMap[num] == null)
					{
						_indexMap[num] = cr;
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				bool flag2 = flag;
				if (!flag)
				{
					int maxDeactivatedContainersWithoutIndexes = _recyclingItemsControl.MaxDeactivatedContainersWithoutIndexes;
					if (0 < maxDeactivatedContainersWithoutIndexes)
					{
						if (_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap == null)
						{
							_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap = new List<ContainerReference>();
						}
						if (_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap.Count < maxDeactivatedContainersWithoutIndexes)
						{
							_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap.Add(cr);
							flag2 = true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					DeactivateContainerHelper(cr);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearContainerReference(cr, removeFromMap: true, removeFromCache: true, removeFromRecyclingCache: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ClearContainerReference(cr, removeFromMap: true, removeFromCache: true, removeFromRecyclingCache: false);
			}
		}

		private void DeactivateAllContainersInUse()
		{
			int count = _activeContainersInUse.Count;
			if (count >= 1)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					DeactivateContainerHelper(_activeContainersInUse[i]);
				}
				_activeContainersInUse.Clear();
				if (_activeContainersInUseByZorder != null)
				{
					_activeContainersInUseByZorder.Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		private object GetItem(DependencyObject container)
		{
			return GetContainerReference(container)?.Item;
		}

		private object GetItem(DependencyObject container, out int index)
		{
			ContainerReference containerReference = GetContainerReference(container);
			if (containerReference != null)
			{
				return GetItem(containerReference, out index);
			}
			index = -1;
			return null;
		}

		private object GetItem(ContainerReference cr, out int index)
		{
			index = _indexMap.IndexOf(cr);
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Items[index];
		}

		private bool HasContainerBeenCleared(ContainerReference cr)
		{
			if (cr.Container != null)
			{
				return cr.Container.GetValue(ContainerReferenceProperty) == null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void InitializeIndexMap()
		{
			_indexMap = new SparseArray(20, 1f, useOwnerData: true);
			_indexMap.Expand(Items.Count);
		}

		private bool IsContainerCompatibleWithItem(ContainerReference cr, object item)
		{
			if (cr.IsItemItsOwnContainer)
			{
				return item == cr.Item;
			}
			return _recyclingItemsControl.IsContainerCompatibleWithItem(cr.Container, item);
		}

		private void PlaceAllActiveContainersInLimbo(IEnumerable itemsExpectedToBeGenerated)
		{
			HashSet hashSet = null;
			if (itemsExpectedToBeGenerated != null)
			{
				hashSet = new HashSet();
				foreach (object item2 in itemsExpectedToBeGenerated)
				{
					if (item2 != null)
					{
						hashSet.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				if (hashSet.Count == 0)
				{
					hashSet = null;
				}
			}
			int count = _activeContainersInUse.Count;
			int count2 = _deactivatedContainers.Count;
			int num = ((_referencesBeforeLastReset != null) ? _referencesBeforeLastReset.Count : 0);
			_recyclableContainers = new Dictionary<object, ContainerReference>();
			_recyclableContainersList = new List<ContainerReference>(count + count2 + num);
			_recyclableContainersListFiltered = new List<ContainerReference>(count + count2 + num);
			List<ContainerReference> list = new List<ContainerReference>();
			if (count > 0)
			{
				_recyclableContainersList.AddRange(_activeContainersInUse);
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				_recyclableContainersList.AddRange(_referencesBeforeLastReset.Values);
			}
			if (count2 > 0)
			{
				_recyclableContainersList.AddRange(_deactivatedContainers);
			}
			int count3 = _recyclableContainersList.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count3; i++)
			{
				ContainerReference containerReference = _recyclableContainersList[i];
				object item = containerReference.Item;
				if (item == null || _recyclableContainers.ContainsKey(item))
				{
					if (_recyclableContainersDups == null)
					{
						_recyclableContainersDups = new HashSet();
					}
					_recyclableContainersDups.Add(containerReference);
				}
				else
				{
					_recyclableContainers[item] = containerReference;
				}
				if (containerReference.IsDeactivated)
				{
					list.Add(containerReference);
				}
				else if (hashSet == null || !hashSet.Exists(item))
				{
					_recyclableContainersListFiltered.Add(containerReference);
				}
			}
			if (_recyclableContainersListFiltered.Count > 1)
			{
				if (hashSet == null && _scrollDirection == ScrollDirection.Decrement)
				{
					_recyclableContainersListFiltered.Reverse();
				}
				else
				{
					Utilities.RandomizeList(_recyclableContainersListFiltered);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				if (hashSet == null)
				{
					_recyclableContainersListFiltered.InsertRange(0, list);
				}
				else
				{
					_recyclableContainersListFiltered.AddRange(list);
				}
			}
			_activeContainersInUse.Clear();
			if (_activeContainersInUseByZorder != null)
			{
				_activeContainersInUseByZorder.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessPendingReset()
		{
			if (_resetOperationPending == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_resetOperationPending = null;
			if (_recyclingItemsControl.PostponeContainerClearing)
			{
				_resetPostponed = true;
				return;
			}
			_resetPostponed = false;
			if (_referencesBeforeLastReset == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<ContainerReference> list = new List<ContainerReference>();
			foreach (ContainerReference value in _referencesBeforeLastReset.Values)
			{
				bool? flag = _recyclingItemsControl.IsStillValid(value.Container, value.Item);
				if (flag.HasValue && !flag.Value)
				{
					list.Add(value);
				}
			}
			foreach (ContainerReference item in list)
			{
				if (item.Item != null)
				{
					_referencesBeforeLastReset.Remove(item.Item);
					ClearContainerReference(item, removeFromMap: false, removeFromCache: false, removeFromRecyclingCache: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessPendingResetAsync()
		{
			if (_resetOperationPending == null && _recyclingItemsControl != null)
			{
				_resetOperationPending = _recyclingItemsControl.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, new PropertyValueTracker.MethodInvoker(ProcessPendingReset));
			}
		}

		private bool RemoveContainerFromCache(ContainerReference cr)
		{
			bool flag = RemoveContainerFromRecyclableCache(cr);
			if ((!flag || cr.IsDeactivated) && _deactivatedContainers.Remove(cr))
			{
				if (_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap != null)
				{
					_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap.Remove(cr);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool flag2 = _activeContainersInUse.Remove(cr);
			if (flag2 && _activeContainersInUseByZorder != null)
			{
				_activeContainersInUseByZorder.Remove(cr);
			}
			return flag2;
		}

		private bool RemoveContainerFromRecyclableCache(ContainerReference cr)
		{
			if (_recyclableContainers == null || !_recyclableContainers.Remove(cr.Item))
			{
				if (_recyclableContainersDups == null || !_recyclableContainersDups.Exists(cr))
				{
					return false;
				}
				_recyclableContainersDups.Remove(cr);
				if (_recyclableContainersDups.Count == 0)
				{
					_recyclableContainersDups = null;
				}
			}
			_recyclableContainersListFiltered.Remove(cr);
			_recyclableContainersList.Remove(cr);
			return true;
		}

		private void SetItemContainerStyle(DependencyObject container, object item)
		{
			if (!(container is FrameworkElement) || (!(bool)container.GetValue(IsStyleSetFromItemContainerStyleProperty) && DependencyProperty.UnsetValue != container.ReadLocalValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty)))
			{
				return;
			}
			Style style = _recyclingItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle;
			if (style == null)
			{
				StyleSelector itemContainerStyleSelector = _recyclingItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleSelector;
				if (itemContainerStyleSelector != null)
				{
					style = itemContainerStyleSelector.SelectStyle(item, container);
				}
			}
			if (style != null)
			{
				if (style.TargetType != null && !style.TargetType.IsInstanceOfType(container))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidStyleTargetType", style.TargetType, container.GetType()));
				}
				container.SetValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, style);
			}
			else
			{
				container.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
			}
			container.SetValue(IsStyleSetFromItemContainerStyleProperty, KnownBoxes.FromValue(style != null));
		}

		private void SetStatus(GeneratorStatus status)
		{
			if (_status != status)
			{
				_status = status;
				if (this.StatusChanged != null)
				{
					this.StatusChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		public DependencyObject GenerateNext()
		{
			if (_currentGenerator == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_5"));
			}
			bool isNewlyRealized;
			return _currentGenerator.GenerateNext(returnNullIfAlreadyRealized: true, out isNewlyRealized);
		}

		public DependencyObject GenerateNext(out bool isNewlyRealized)
		{
			if (_currentGenerator == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_5"));
			}
			return _currentGenerator.GenerateNext(returnNullIfAlreadyRealized: false, out isNewlyRealized);
		}

		public GeneratorPosition GeneratorPositionFromIndex(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (itemIndex < 0 || itemIndex >= Items.Count)
			{
				return new GeneratorPosition(-1, Math.Max(0, itemIndex + 1));
			}
			int count = _activeContainersInUse.Count;
			int index = -1;
			int num = itemIndex + 1;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				ContainerReference containerReference = _activeContainersInUse[i];
				if (containerReference != null)
				{
					int num3 = _indexMap.IndexOf(containerReference);
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (num3 == itemIndex)
					{
						return new GeneratorPosition(i, 0);
					}
					if (num3 > itemIndex)
					{
						break;
					}
					num2 = num3;
					index = i;
				}
			}
			return new GeneratorPosition(index, Math.Max(0, itemIndex - num2));
		}

		ItemContainerGenerator IItemContainerGenerator.GetItemContainerGeneratorForPanel(System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public int IndexFromGeneratorPosition(GeneratorPosition position)
		{
			int index = position.Index;
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return index + position.Offset;
			}
			int countOfAllContainers = CountOfAllContainers;
			if (index >= countOfAllContainers)
			{
				return index + position.Offset;
			}
			ContainerReference containerReference = GetContainerReference(index, isIndexBasedOnZOrder: false);
			if (containerReference == null)
			{
				return index + position.Offset;
			}
			int num = _indexMap.IndexOf(containerReference);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return index + position.Offset;
			}
			return num + position.Offset;
		}

		public void PrepareItemContainer(DependencyObject container)
		{
			object item = GetItem(container);
			if (_recyclingItemsControl.ShouldApplyItemContainerStyleInternal(container, item))
			{
				SetItemContainerStyle(container, item);
			}
			_recyclingItemsControl.PrepareContainerForItemInternal(container, item);
		}

		public void Remove(GeneratorPosition position, int count)
		{
			if (position.Offset != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_6"), "position");
			}
			if (count < 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_7"), "count");
			}
			int num = Math.Max(0, position.Index);
			int num2 = num + count - 1;
			int count2 = _indexMap.Count;
			if (num2 >= count2)
			{
				num2 = count2 - 1;
			}
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				if (_indexMap[i] is ContainerReference cr)
				{
					ClearContainerReference(cr, removeFromMap: false, removeFromCache: true, removeFromRecyclingCache: true);
					_indexMap[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAll()
		{
			_isInRemoveAll = true;
			try
			{
				foreach (ContainerReference nonNullItem in _indexMap.NonNullItems)
				{
					ClearContainerReference(nonNullItem, removeFromMap: false, removeFromCache: false, removeFromRecyclingCache: false);
				}
				if (_recyclableContainers != null)
				{
					foreach (ContainerReference recyclableContainers in _recyclableContainersList)
					{
						ClearContainerReference(recyclableContainers, removeFromMap: false, removeFromCache: false, removeFromRecyclingCache: false);
					}
					_recyclableContainers = null;
					_recyclableContainersList = null;
					_recyclableContainersListFiltered = null;
					_recyclableContainersDups = null;
				}
				else if (_referencesBeforeLastReset != null)
				{
					foreach (ContainerReference value in _referencesBeforeLastReset.Values)
					{
						ClearContainerReference(value, removeFromMap: false, removeFromCache: false, removeFromRecyclingCache: false);
					}
				}
				_referencesBeforeLastReset = null;
				_referencesBeforeLastResetList = null;
				_activeContainersInUse.Clear();
				_deactivatedContainers.Clear();
				_deactivatedContainersNotInIndexMap = null;
				if (_activeContainersInUseByZorder != null)
				{
					_activeContainersInUseByZorder.Clear();
				}
				_indexMap.Clear();
				_indexMap.Expand(Items.Count);
			}
			finally
			{
				_isInRemoveAll = false;
			}
		}

		public IDisposable StartAt(GeneratorPosition position, GeneratorDirection direction, bool allowStartAtRealizedItem)
		{
			if (_currentGenerator != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_8"));
			}
			if (!_isGenerating)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_RecyclingGenerator_9"));
			}
			_currentGenerator = new RecyclingGenerator(this, position, direction, allowStartAtRealizedItem);
			return _currentGenerator;
		}

		public IDisposable StartAt(GeneratorPosition position, GeneratorDirection direction)
		{
			if (!_isGenerating)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_BeginGenerationNotCalled"));
			}
			return ((IItemContainerGenerator)this).StartAt(position, direction, allowStartAtRealizedItem: false);
		}
	}

		private class ContainerEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private RecyclingItemsPanel _panel;

			private bool _activeContainersOnly;

			private int _currentPosition;

			private object _currentItem;

			private static object UnsetObjectMarker = new object();

			object IEnumerator.Current
			{
				get
				{
					if (_currentItem == UnsetObjectMarker)
					{
						if (_currentPosition == -1)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_3"));
						}
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_4"));
					}
					return _currentItem;
				}
			}

			internal ContainerEnumerator(RecyclingItemsPanel panel, bool activeContainersOnly)
			{
				_panel = panel;
				_activeContainersOnly = activeContainersOnly;
				_currentPosition = -1;
				_currentItem = UnsetObjectMarker;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				int num = ((!_activeContainersOnly) ? _panel.VisualChildrenCount : _panel.CountOfActiveContainers);
				while (_currentPosition < num - 1)
				{
					_currentPosition++;
					_currentItem = _panel.GetVisualChild(_currentPosition);
					if (_activeContainersOnly || (_currentItem is Visual && LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(_currentItem as Visual) == _panel))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				_currentPosition = num;
				_currentItem = UnsetObjectMarker;
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_currentPosition = -1;
				_currentItem = UnsetObjectMarker;
			}
		}

		{
