			get
			{
				if (!base.IsItemsHost)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return base.InternalChildren.Count;
			}
		}

		private int UnderlyingItemsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (ItemsControl is RecyclingItemsControl recyclingItemsControl)
				{
					return recyclingItemsControl.UnderlyingItemsCount;
				}
				if (_itemsControl != null)
				{
					return _itemsControl.Items.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		protected RecyclingItemsPanel()
			: this(removeDeactivatedContainersOnCleanup: false)
		{
		}

		protected RecyclingItemsPanel(bool removeDeactivatedContainersOnCleanup)
		{
			_removeDeactivatedContainersOnCleanup = removeDeactivatedContainersOnCleanup;
		}

		private void OnContainerDiscarded(object sender, RecyclingItemContainerGenerator.ContainerDiscardedEventArgs e)
		{
			_zOrderDirty = true;
			if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(e.Container) == this)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(e.Container);
			}
			if (e.Container is Visual)
			{
				RemoveVisualChild(e.Container as Visual);
			}
			if (sender is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator { IsInRemoveAll: not false })
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			if (!(e.Container is IInputElement { IsKeyboardFocusWithin: not false }))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (DependencyObject parent = Utilities.GetParent(this, includeLogicalParent: true); parent != null; parent = Utilities.GetParent(parent, includeLogicalParent: true))
			{
				if (parent is IInputElement { Focusable: not false } inputElement2)
				{
					inputElement2.Focus();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnItemContainerGenerationModeChanged(DependencyObject item, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RecyclingItemsPanel recyclingItemsPanel = item as RecyclingItemsPanel;
			recyclingItemsPanel._cachedItemContainerGenerationMode = (ItemContainerGenerationMode)e.NewValue;
			recyclingItemsPanel._hasBeenPreloaded = false;
			recyclingItemsPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
			bool flag = recyclingItemsPanel._cachedItemContainerGenerationMode == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle;
			if (flag != recyclingItemsPanel._wasRecyclingOnLastGeneration)
			{
				recyclingItemsPanel.OnIsRecyclingStateChanged();
			}
		}

		private void OnZOrderChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_zOrderDirty = true;
		}

		protected new void AddInternalChild(UIElement child)
		{
			if (!PerformRecyclingAdd(child))
			{
				base.AddInternalChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (_wasRecyclingOnLastGeneration && ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				if (_zOrderDirty && base.InternalChildren.Count > 0)
				{
					_zOrderDirty = false;
					Visual visualChild = base.GetVisualChild(0);
				}
				return recyclingItemContainerGenerator.GetContainer(index, isIndexBasedOnZOrder: true) as Visual;
			}
			return base.GetVisualChild(index);
		}

		protected new void InsertInternalChild(int index, UIElement child)
		{
			if (!PerformRecyclingAdd(child))
			{
				base.InsertInternalChild(index, child);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsItemsHostChanged(bool oldIsItemsHost, bool newIsItemsHost)
		{
			if (!newIsItemsHost && oldIsItemsHost && _recyclingEventsWired && ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				_recyclingEventsWired = false;
				recyclingItemContainerGenerator.DeactivateAllContainers();
				recyclingItemContainerGenerator.RemoveAllDeactivatedContainers();
				recyclingItemContainerGenerator.ContainerDiscarded -= OnContainerDiscarded;
				recyclingItemContainerGenerator.ZOrderChanged -= OnZOrderChanged;
			}
			base.OnIsItemsHostChanged(oldIsItemsHost, newIsItemsHost);
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(object sender, ItemsChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			NotifyCollectionChangedAction action = args.Action;
			if (action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				_hasBeenPreloaded = false;
				_zOrderDirty = true;
				if (_pendingPostResetVerification == null && ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle)
				{
					if (Utilities.AllowsAsyncOperations(this))
					{
						OnPostResetVerification(null);
					}
					else
					{
						_pendingPostResetVerification = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, new DispatcherOperationCallback(OnPostResetVerification), null);
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnItemsChanged(sender, args);
		}

		protected new void RemoveInternalChildRange(int index, int range)
		{
			if (ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved != ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle)
			{
				base.RemoveInternalChildRange(index, range);
			}
		}

		public DependencyObject ContainerFromIndex(int index)
		{
			if (!base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				return ChildElements[index] as DependencyObject;
			}
			IItemContainerGenerator activeItemContainerGenerator = ActiveItemContainerGenerator;
			if (activeItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				return recyclingItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(index);
			}
			if (activeItemContainerGenerator is ItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator)
			{
				return itemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(index);
			}
			return ChildElements[index] as DependencyObject;
		}

		public DependencyObject ContainerFromItem(object item)
		{
			if (!base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				return item as DependencyObject;
			}
			IItemContainerGenerator activeItemContainerGenerator = ActiveItemContainerGenerator;
			if (activeItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				return recyclingItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item);
			}
			if (activeItemContainerGenerator is ItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator)
			{
				return itemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item);
			}
			return item as DependencyObject;
		}

		public object ItemFromContainer(DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			if (!base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				return container;
			}
			IItemContainerGenerator activeItemContainerGenerator = ActiveItemContainerGenerator;
			if (activeItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				return recyclingItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(container);
			}
			if (activeItemContainerGenerator is ItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator)
			{
				return itemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(container);
			}
			return container;
		}

		public void RemoveAllDeactivatedContainers()
		{
			if (ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle && ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				recyclingItemContainerGenerator.RemoveAllDeactivatedContainers();
			}
		}

		public void VerifyAllDeactivatedContainers()
		{
			if (ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle && ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				recyclingItemContainerGenerator.VerifyAllDeactivatedContainers();
			}
		}

		protected void BeginGeneration(ScrollDirection scrollDirection)
		{
			BeginGeneration(scrollDirection, null);
		}

		protected void BeginGeneration(ScrollDirection scrollDirection, IEnumerable itemsExpectedToBeGenerated)
		{
			_wasRecyclingOnLastGeneration = false;
			_pendingPostResetVerification = null;
			ItemsControl itemsControl = ItemsControl;
			if (itemsControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = base.InternalChildren.Count;
			switch (ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved)
			{
			case ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle:
				_wasRecyclingOnLastGeneration = true;
				if (ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
				{
					if (!_recyclingEventsWired)
					{
						_recyclingEventsWired = true;
						recyclingItemContainerGenerator.ContainerDiscarded += OnContainerDiscarded;
						recyclingItemContainerGenerator.ZOrderChanged += OnZOrderChanged;
					}
					recyclingItemContainerGenerator.BeginGeneration(scrollDirection, itemsExpectedToBeGenerated);
				}
				else
				{
					_wasRecyclingOnLastGeneration = false;
				}
				break;
			case ItemContainerGenerationMode.PreLoad:
			{
				bool flag = base.InternalChildren.Count == 0;
				if (_hasBeenPreloaded && !flag)
				{
					break;
				}
				IItemContainerGenerator activeItemContainerGenerator = ActiveItemContainerGenerator;
				using (activeItemContainerGenerator.StartAt(activeItemContainerGenerator.GeneratorPositionFromIndex(0), GeneratorDirection.Forward, allowStartAtRealizedItem: true))
				{
					int num = 0;
					int underlyingItemsCount = UnderlyingItemsCount;
					bool isNewlyRealized;
					while (activeItemContainerGenerator.GenerateNext(out isNewlyRealized) is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
					{
						if (isNewlyRealized)
						{
							base.InsertInternalChild(num, (UIElement)frameworkElement);
							activeItemContainerGenerator.PrepareItemContainer(frameworkElement);
						}
						num++;
						if (num >= underlyingItemsCount)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				_hasBeenPreloaded = true;
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		protected bool CleanupUnusedGeneratedElements()
		{
			if (_isInCleanup)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.IsItemsHost || ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved != ItemContainerGenerationMode.Virtualize)
			{
				if (_removeDeactivatedContainersOnCleanup)
				{
					RemoveAllDeactivatedContainers();
				}
				return false;
			}
			_isInCleanup = true;
			try
			{
				int tickCount = Environment.TickCount;
				int num = TotalGeneratedChildrenCount;
				int totalVisibleGeneratedItems = TotalVisibleGeneratedItems;
				int num2 = num - totalVisibleGeneratedItems;
				if (num2 > MaximumUnusedGeneratedItemsToKeep)
				{
					UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
					IItemContainerGenerator activeItemContainerGenerator = ActiveItemContainerGenerator;
					for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
					{
						if (ShouldAbortCleanup(tickCount) != AbortAction.NoAbort)
						{
							return num2 > MaximumUnusedGeneratedItemsToKeep;
						}
						if (internalChildren[i].IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
						{
							continue;
						}
						int num3 = -1;
						int itemIndexFromChildIndex = GetItemIndexFromChildIndex(i);
						if (GetCanCleanupItem(itemIndexFromChildIndex))
						{
							num3 = itemIndexFromChildIndex;
							int num4 = 1;
							for (int j = i + 1; j < num && !internalChildren[j].IsKeyboardFocusWithin; j++)
							{
								AbortAction abortAction = ShouldAbortCleanup(tickCount);
								if (abortAction != AbortAction.NoAbort)
								{
									if (abortAction == AbortAction.AbortWithCleanup)
									{
										activeItemContainerGenerator.Remove(new GeneratorPosition(i, 0), num4);
										RemoveInternalChildRange(i, num4);
										num2 -= num4;
										num -= num4;
									}
									return num2 > MaximumUnusedGeneratedItemsToKeep;
								}
								itemIndexFromChildIndex = GetItemIndexFromChildIndex(j);
								if (!GetCanCleanupItem(itemIndexFromChildIndex) || itemIndexFromChildIndex != num3 + 1 || num2 - num4 <= MaximumUnusedGeneratedItemsToKeep)
								{
									break;
								}
								num3 = itemIndexFromChildIndex;
								num4++;
							}
							activeItemContainerGenerator.Remove(new GeneratorPosition(i, 0), num4);
							RemoveInternalChildRange(i, num4);
							num2 -= num4;
							num -= num4;
							i--;
						}
						if (num2 <= MaximumUnusedGeneratedItemsToKeep)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_isInCleanup = false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void DeactivateAllContainers()
		{
			if (ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle && ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				recyclingItemContainerGenerator.DeactivateAllContainers();
			}
		}

		public void DeactivateContainer(DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle && ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				recyclingItemContainerGenerator.DeactivateContainer(container);
			}
		}

		protected void EndGeneration()
		{
			switch (ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved)
			{
			case ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle:
				if (ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
				{
					recyclingItemContainerGenerator.EndGeneration();
					_zOrderDirty = true;
					if (base.InternalChildren.Count == 0 && recyclingItemContainerGenerator.CountOfActiveContainers > 0)
					{
						InvalidateZOrder(force: true);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ItemContainerGenerationMode.Virtualize:
				TriggerCleanupOfUnusedGeneratedItems(useDelay: true);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void InvalidateZOrder()
		{
			InvalidateZOrder(force: false);
		}

		private void InvalidateZOrder(bool force)
		{
			if (ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle && (CountOfActiveContainers >= 2 || force))
			{
				_zOrderDirty = true;
				if (base.InternalChildren.Count == 0)
				{
					base.AddInternalChild((UIElement)new FrameworkElement());
				}
				if (base.InternalChildren.Count > 0)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = base.InternalChildren[0];
					int num = (int)uIElement.GetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty);
					uIElement.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty, num + 1);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void TriggerCleanupOfUnusedGeneratedItems(bool useDelay)
		{
			if (!base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!Utilities.AllowsAsyncOperations(this))
			{
				OnAsyncCleanUp(null);
			}
			else if (useDelay)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				if (_pendingAsyncCleanup != null)
				{
					flag = _pendingAsyncCleanup.Abort();
					if (flag)
					{
						_pendingAsyncCleanup = null;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (_cleanupDelayTimer == null)
					{
						_cleanupDelayTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
						_cleanupDelayTimer.Tick += OnCleanupDelayExpired;
						_cleanupDelayTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500.0);
						_cleanupDelayTimer.Start();
						base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
					}
					else if (_removeDeactivatedContainersOnCleanup && ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle)
					{
						_cleanupDelayTimer.Stop();
						_cleanupDelayTimer.Start();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (_pendingAsyncCleanup == null)
			{
				_pendingAsyncCleanup = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, new DispatcherOperationCallback(OnAsyncCleanUp), null);
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool GetCanCleanupItem(int itemIndex);

		protected int GetChildIndexFromItemIndex(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (!base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				return itemIndex;
			}
			IItemContainerGenerator activeItemContainerGenerator = ActiveItemContainerGenerator;
			if (activeItemContainerGenerator == null)
			{
				return itemIndex;
			}
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			GeneratorPosition generatorPosition = activeItemContainerGenerator.GeneratorPositionFromIndex(itemIndex);
			if (generatorPosition.Offset != 0)
			{
				return generatorPosition.Index + 1;
			}
			return generatorPosition.Index;
		}

		protected int GetItemIndexFromChildIndex(int childIndex)
		{
			if (!base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				return childIndex;
			}
			IItemContainerGenerator activeItemContainerGenerator = ActiveItemContainerGenerator;
			if (activeItemContainerGenerator == null)
			{
				return childIndex;
			}
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			return activeItemContainerGenerator.IndexFromGeneratorPosition(new GeneratorPosition(childIndex, 0));
		}

		protected virtual void OnNewElementRealized(UIElement element, int index)
		{
		}

		private Visual GetChildElement(int index)
		{
			if (ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle && ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				return recyclingItemContainerGenerator.GetContainer(index, isIndexBasedOnZOrder: false) as Visual;
			}
			return base.Children[index];
		}

		private object OnAsyncCleanUp(object args)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				flag = CleanupUnusedGeneratedElements();
			}
			finally
			{
				_pendingAsyncCleanup = null;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				TriggerCleanupOfUnusedGeneratedItems(useDelay: true);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnCleanupDelayExpired(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				flag = CleanupUnusedGeneratedElements();
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					base.Unloaded -= OnUnloaded;
					_cleanupDelayTimer.Stop();
					_cleanupDelayTimer = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnIsRecyclingStateChanged()
		{
			int count = base.InternalChildren.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				base.RemoveInternalChildRange(0, count);
			}
			if (_wasRecyclingOnLastGeneration && ItemsControl is RecyclingItemsControl recyclingItemsControl)
			{
				recyclingItemsControl.RecyclingItemContainerGenerator.RemoveAll();
			}
		}

		private object OnPostResetVerification(object args)
		{
			if (_pendingPostResetVerification != null)
			{
				BeginGeneration(ScrollDirection.Increment);
				EndGeneration();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Unloaded -= OnUnloaded;
			if (_cleanupDelayTimer != null)
			{
				_cleanupDelayTimer.Stop();
				_cleanupDelayTimer = null;
				CleanupUnusedGeneratedElements();
			}
		}

		private bool PerformRecyclingAdd(UIElement child)
		{
			if (ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle && ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator recyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(child) == null)
				{
					AddLogicalChild(child);
				}
				AddVisualChild(child);
				recyclingItemContainerGenerator.OnContainerAddedToVisualTree(child);
				_zOrderDirty = true;
				if (base.InternalChildren.Count == 0)
				{
					InvalidateZOrder(force: true);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private AbortAction ShouldAbortCleanup(int tickAtStartOfCleanup)
		{
			if (Environment.TickCount - tickAtStartOfCleanup > 200)
			{
				return AbortAction.AbortWithCleanup;
			}
			if (!IsOkToCleanupUnusedGeneratedElements)
			{
				return AbortAction.AbortWithNoCleanup;
			}
			return AbortAction.NoAbort;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Windows.Scrolling
{
	public static class DeferredScrollService
	{
		private static readonly DependencyProperty DeferredScrollPanel = DependencyProperty.Register("DeferredScrollPanel", typeof(IDeferredScrollPanel), typeof(IDeferredScrollHost));

		public static void RegisterDeferredScrollHost(Type classType)
		{
			if (null == classType)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("classType");
			}
			if (!typeof(IDeferredScrollHost).IsAssignableFrom(classType))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_5"));
			}
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(classType, Thumb.DragStartedEvent, new DragStartedEventHandler(OnThumbDragStarted), handledEventsToo: true);
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(classType, Thumb.DragCompletedEvent, new DragCompletedEventHandler(OnThumbDragCompleted), handledEventsToo: true);
		}

		private static void OnThumbDragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = sender as DependencyObject;
			if (dependencyObject.GetValue(DeferredScrollPanel) is IDeferredScrollPanel deferredScrollPanel)
			{
				deferredScrollPanel.OnThumbDragComplete(e.Canceled);
			}
		}

		private static void OnThumbDragStarted(object sender, DragStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			IDeferredScrollHost deferredScrollHost = sender as IDeferredScrollHost;
			IDeferredScrollPanel scrollPanel = deferredScrollHost.ScrollPanel;
			if (scrollPanel != null && e.OriginalSource is Thumb { TemplatedParent: System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar { TemplatedParent: ScrollViewer templatedParent2 } templatedParent } thumb && scrollPanel.SupportsDeferredScrolling(templatedParent.Orientation, templatedParent2))
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = deferredScrollHost as DependencyObject;
				dependencyObject.SetValue(DeferredScrollPanel, scrollPanel);
				scrollPanel.OnThumbDragStart(thumb, templatedParent.Orientation);
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IDeferredScrollHost
	{
		IDeferredScrollPanel ScrollPanel { get; }
	}
	public interface IDeferredScrollPanel
	{
		bool SupportsDeferredScrolling(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation scrollBarOrientation, ScrollViewer scrollViewer);

		void OnThumbDragStart(Thumb thumb, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation scrollBarOrientation);

		void OnThumbDragComplete(bool cancelled);
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Windows.Themes
{
	public class ResourceSetLoader : ResourceDictionary, ISupportInitialize
	{
		private bool _initializing;

		private ResourceSetLocator _locator;

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public ResourceSetLocator Locator
		{
			get
			{
				return _locator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _locator)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyCanBeModified(this);
					_locator = value;
					OnCriteriaChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public ResourceSetLoader()
		{
		}

		internal ResourceSetLoader(ResourceSetLocator locator)
		{
			Locator = locator;
		}

		private void OnCriteriaChanged()
		{
			if (!_initializing)
			{
				Clear();
				base.MergedDictionaries.Clear();
				if (_locator != null)
				{
					ResourceDictionary item = Utilities.CreateResourceSetDictionary(_locator.Assembly, _locator.ResourcePath);
					base.MergedDictionaries.Add(item);
					ResourceWasher.ForceAutoWashResources(this);
				}
			}
		}

		public new void BeginInit()
		{
			_initializing = true;
			base.BeginInit();
		}

		public new void EndInit()
		{
			_initializing = false;
			OnCriteriaChanged();
			base.EndInit();
		}
	}
	public enum WashMode
	{
		SoftLightBlend,
		HueSaturationReplacement
	}
	public class ResourceWasher : ResourceDictionary, ISupportInitialize
	{
		private bool _autoWash = true;

		private bool _themeWashInitialized;

		private bool _isInitializing;

		private ResourceDictionary _sourceDictionary;

		private ResourceDictionary _clonedDictionary;

		private System.Windows.Media.Color _washColor = Colors.Transparent;

		private WashMode _washMode;

		private WashGroupCollection _washGroups;

		private float _hue;

		private float _saturation;

		private Dictionary<ResourceDictionary, ResourceDictionary> _originalDictioanries;

		private Dictionary<object, object> _originalToCloneTable;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsExcludedFromWashProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IsExcludedFromWash", typeof(bool), typeof(ResourceWasher), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty WashGroupProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("WashGroup", typeof(string), typeof(ResourceWasher), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		[DefaultValue(true)]
		public bool AutoWash
		{
			get
			{
				return _autoWash;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _autoWash)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					_autoWash = value;
					OnCriteriaChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public ResourceDictionary SourceDictionary
		{
			get
			{
				return _sourceDictionary;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _sourceDictionary)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					_sourceDictionary = value;
					OnCriteriaChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color WashColor
		{
			get
			{
				return _washColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _washColor)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					_washColor = value;
					_hue = GetHue(value);
					_saturation = GetSaturation(value);
					OnCriteriaChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(WashMode.SoftLightBlend)]
		public WashMode WashMode
		{
			get
			{
				return _washMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _washMode)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(WashMode), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("WashMode", (int)value, typeof(WashMode));
					}
					_washMode = value;
					OnCriteriaChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public WashGroupCollection WashGroups
		{
			get
			{
				return _washGroups;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_washGroups != value)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					if (_washGroups != null)
					{
						_washGroups.CollectionChanged -= OnWashGroupsCollectionChanged;
					}
					_washGroups = value;
					if (_washGroups != null)
					{
						_washGroups.CollectionChanged += OnWashGroupsCollectionChanged;
					}
					OnCriteriaChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public ResourceWasher()
		{
			_originalDictioanries = new Dictionary<ResourceDictionary, ResourceDictionary>();
			_originalToCloneTable = new Dictionary<object, object>();
		}

		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush))]
		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(System.Windows.Media.Pen))]
		public static bool GetIsExcludedFromWash(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(IsExcludedFromWashProperty);
		}

		{
			d.SetValue(IsExcludedFromWashProperty, value);
		}

		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush))]
		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(System.Windows.Media.Pen))]
		public static string GetWashGroup(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (string)d.GetValue(WashGroupProperty);
		}

		public static void SetWashGroup(DependencyObject d, string value)
		{
			d.SetValue(WashGroupProperty, value);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeWashColor()
		{
			return _washColor != Colors.Transparent;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetWashColor()
		{
			_washColor = Colors.Transparent;
		}

		private void OnWashGroupsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnCriteriaChanged();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeWashGroups()
		{
			if (_washGroups != null)
			{
				return _washGroups.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetWashGroups()

			if (_washGroups != null)

				_washGroups.Clear();

		public new void BeginInit()

			_isInitializing = true;
			base.BeginInit();
		}

		public new void EndInit()

			_isInitializing = false;
			if (_autoWash)
			{
				WashResources();
			}
			base.EndInit();
		}

		public void WashResources()
		{
			_themeWashInitialized = true;
			if (_clonedDictionary != null)
			{
				if (base.MergedDictionaries.Contains(_clonedDictionary))
				{
					base.MergedDictionaries.Remove(_clonedDictionary);
				}
				_clonedDictionary.Clear();
				_clonedDictionary.MergedDictionaries.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				_clonedDictionary = new ResourceDictionary();
			}
			if (_sourceDictionary != null)
			{
				if (_washColor == Colors.Transparent && _originalDictioanries.Count == 0 && (_washGroups == null || _washGroups.Count == 0))
				{
					_clonedDictionary.MergedDictionaries.Add(ThemeManager.Clone(_sourceDictionary));
				}
				else
				{
					Dictionary<Style, Style> clonedStyles = new Dictionary<Style, Style>();
					WashResourcesHelper(_sourceDictionary, _clonedDictionary, clonedStyles);
				}
				base.MergedDictionaries.Add(_clonedDictionary);
			}
		}

		private void WashResourcesHelper(ResourceDictionary source, ResourceDictionary target, Dictionary<Style, Style> clonedStyles)
		{
			target.MergedDictionaries.Clear();
			foreach (ResourceDictionary mergedDictionary in source.MergedDictionaries)
			{
				ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary();
				WashResourcesHelper(mergedDictionary, resourceDictionary, clonedStyles);
				target.MergedDictionaries.Add(resourceDictionary);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary2 = null;
			if (!_originalDictioanries.ContainsKey(source))
			{
				resourceDictionary2 = new ResourceDictionary();
				_originalDictioanries.Add(source, resourceDictionary2);
				flag = true;
			}
			else
			{
				resourceDictionary2 = _originalDictioanries[source];
			}
			Dictionary<object, System.Windows.Media.Brush> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, System.Windows.Media.Brush>();
			Dictionary<object, System.Windows.Media.Pen> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<object, System.Windows.Media.Pen>();
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item3 in source)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					if (item3.Value is System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush)
					{
						System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = CloneBrush(sourceBrush);
						if (brush.CanFreeze)
						{
							brush.Freeze();
						}
						resourceDictionary2.Add(item3.Key, brush);
						_originalToCloneTable[item3.Value] = brush;
					}
					else if (item3.Value is System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
					{
						string washGroup = GetWashGroup(pen);
						System.Windows.Media.Pen pen2 = pen.Clone();
						SetWashGroup(pen2, washGroup);
						if (pen2.CanFreeze)
						{
							pen2.Freeze();
						}
						resourceDictionary2.Add(item3.Key, pen2);
					}
					else if (item3.Value is IList<System.Windows.Media.Brush> { IsReadOnly: false } list)
					{
						List<System.Windows.Media.Brush> list2 = new List<System.Windows.Media.Brush>();
						foreach (System.Windows.Media.Brush item4 in list)
						{
							System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = CloneBrush(item4);
							if (brush2.CanFreeze)
							{
								brush2.Freeze();
							}
							list2.Add(brush2);
						}
						resourceDictionary2.Add(item3.Key, list2);
					}
					else
					{
						AddToDictionary(resourceDictionary2, item3.Key, item3.Value);
					}
				}
				object obj = item3.Value;
				if (obj is System.Windows.Media.Brush)
				{
					System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush2 = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)resourceDictionary2[item3.Key];
					obj = (sourceBrush2 = WashBrushHelper(sourceBrush2, obj));
					dictionary.Add(item3.Key, sourceBrush2);
				}
				else if (obj is System.Windows.Media.Pen)
				{
					System.Windows.Media.Pen sourcePen = (System.Windows.Media.Pen)resourceDictionary2[item3.Key];
					obj = (sourcePen = WashPenHelper(sourcePen, obj));
					dictionary2.Add(item3.Key, sourcePen);
				}
				else if (obj is Style)
				{
					Style style2 = (Style)resourceDictionary2[item3.Key];
					if (!clonedStyles.TryGetValue(style2, out var value))
					{
						value = new Style(style2.TargetType);
						value.BasedOn = style2;
						clonedStyles[style2] = value;
					}
					Dictionary<DependencyProperty, Setter> dictionary3 = new Dictionary<DependencyProperty, Setter>();
					while (style2 != null)
					{
						for (int num = style2.Setters.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
						{
							if (style2.Setters[num] is Setter { Property: not null } setter && !dictionary3.ContainsKey(setter.Property))
							{
								dictionary3[setter.Property] = setter;
							}
						}
						style2 = style2.BasedOn;
					}
					foreach (KeyValuePair<DependencyProperty, Setter> item5 in dictionary3)
					{
						Setter value2 = item5.Value;
						object value3;
						try
						{
							value3 = value2.Value;
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (value3 is IResourceWasherTarget)
						{
							InitializeResourceTarget(value3 as IResourceWasherTarget, flag);
						}
						System.Windows.Media.Brush brush4 = value3 as System.Windows.Media.Brush;
						if (brush4 != null)
						{
							if (_originalToCloneTable.TryGetValue(brush4, out var value4))
							{
								brush4 = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)value4;
							}
							Setter setter2 = new Setter();
							setter2.Property = value2.Property;
							setter2.Value = WashBrushHelper(brush4, value3);
							value.Setters.Add(setter2);
						}
						else if (value3 is Style)
						{
							Style style3 = value2.Value as Style;
							if (!clonedStyles.TryGetValue(style3, out var value5))
							{
								value5 = new Style(style3.TargetType);
								value5.BasedOn = style3;
								clonedStyles[style3] = value5;
							}
							Setter item = new Setter(value2.Property, value5);
							value.Setters.Add(item);
						}
						else if (value3 is DynamicResourceExtension)
						{
							System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush2 = WashBrushDynamicResource((DynamicResourceExtension)value3);
							if (sourceBrush2 != null)
							{
								Setter item2 = new Setter(value2.Property, sourceBrush2);
								value.Setters.Add(item2);
							}
						}
					}
					obj = value;
				}
				else if (obj is IList<System.Windows.Media.Brush>)
				{
					IList<System.Windows.Media.Brush> list3 = obj as IList<System.Windows.Media.Brush>;
					if (!list3.IsReadOnly)
					{
						IList<System.Windows.Media.Brush> list4 = (IList<System.Windows.Media.Brush>)resourceDictionary2[item3.Key];
						int i = 0;
						for (int num2 = Math.Min(list3.Count, list4.Count); i < num2; i++)
						{
							list3[i] = WashBrushHelper(list4[i], list3[i]);
						}
					}
				}
				AddToDictionary(target, item3.Key, obj);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, System.Windows.Media.Brush> item6 in dictionary)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush5 = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)source[item6.Key];
				if (!brush5.IsFrozen)
				{
					CopyBrush(item6.Value, brush5);
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, System.Windows.Media.Pen> item7 in dictionary2)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Pen pen4 = (System.Windows.Media.Pen)source[item7.Key];
				if (!pen4.IsFrozen)
				{
					pen4.Brush = item7.Value.Brush;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Color PerformColorWash(System.Windows.Media.Color startColor, System.Windows.Media.Color washColor, WashGroup group)
		{
			if (washColor == Colors.Transparent)
			{
				return startColor;
			}
			if (((group == null || !group.WashMode.HasValue) ? _washMode : group.WashMode.Value) == WashMode.SoftLightBlend)
			{
				int num = AdjustColorComponentValue(startColor.R, washColor.R);
				int num2 = AdjustColorComponentValue(startColor.G, washColor.G);
				int num3 = AdjustColorComponentValue(startColor.B, washColor.B);
				return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(startColor.A, (byte)(num & 0xFF), (byte)(num2 & 0xFF), (byte)(num3 & 0xFF));
			}
			float hue;
			float saturation;
			if (group != null)
			{
				hue = group.Hue;
				saturation = group.Saturation;
			}
			else
			{
				hue = _hue;
				saturation = _saturation;
			}
			return ColorFromHLS(startColor.A, hue, GetBrightness(startColor), saturation);
		}

		internal object CreateWashedResource(object value)
		{
			if (value is System.Windows.Media.Brush)
			{
				return WashBrushHelper(value as System.Windows.Media.Brush, null);
			}
			if (value is System.Windows.Media.Pen)
			{
				return WashPenHelper(value as System.Windows.Media.Pen, null);
			}
			if (value is System.Windows.Media.Color)
			{
				return WashColorHelper((System.Windows.Media.Color)value, null);
			}
			if (value is ResourceDictionary)
			{
				ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary();
				WashResourcesHelper(value as ResourceDictionary, resourceDictionary, new Dictionary<Style, Style>());
				resourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries.Insert(0, value as ResourceDictionary);
				value = resourceDictionary;
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal static void ForceAutoWashResources(ResourceDictionary rd)
		{
			if (rd is ResourceWasher resourceWasher)
			{
				if (!resourceWasher.AutoWash)
				{
					resourceWasher.WashResources();
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (ResourceDictionary mergedDictionary in rd.MergedDictionaries)
			{
				ForceAutoWashResources(mergedDictionary);
			}
		}

		internal static float GetBrightness(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			float num = (float)(int)color.R / 255f;
			float num2 = (float)(int)color.G / 255f;
			float num3 = (float)(int)color.B / 255f;
			float num4 = ((num > num2) ? num : num2);
			if (num3 > num4)
			{
				num4 = num3;
			}
			float num5 = ((num < num2) ? num : num2);
			if (num3 < num5)
			{
				num5 = num3;
			}
			float num6 = num4 + num5;
			return num6 / 2f;
		}

		internal static float GetHue(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			float num = (float)(int)color.R / 255f;
			float num2 = (float)(int)color.G / 255f;
			float num3 = (float)(int)color.B / 255f;
			if (num == num2 && num == num3)
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			float num4 = ((num > num2) ? num : num2);
			if (num3 > num4)
			{
				num4 = num3;
			}
			float num5 = ((num < num2) ? num : num2);
			if (num3 < num5)
			{
				num5 = num3;
			}
			float num6 = num4 - num5;
			float num7 = 0f;
			if (num == num4)
			{
				num7 = (num2 - num3) / num6 * 60f;
			}
			else if (num2 == num4)
			{
				num7 = (num3 - num) / num6 * 60f;
				num7 += 120f;
			}
			else if (num3 == num4)
			{
				num7 = (num - num2) / num6 * 60f;
				num7 += 240f;
			}
			if (num7 < 0f)
			{
				num7 += 360f;
			}
			return num7;
		}

		internal static float GetSaturation(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			float num = (float)(int)color.R / 255f;
			float num2 = (float)(int)color.G / 255f;
			float num3 = (float)(int)color.B / 255f;
			float num4 = ((num > num2) ? num : num2);
			if (num3 > num4)
			{
				num4 = num3;
			}
			float num5 = ((num < num2) ? num : num2);
			if (num3 < num5)
			{
				num5 = num3;
			}
			double num6 = num4 - num5;
			if (num6 == 0.0)
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			double num7 = num4 + num5;
			double num8 = num7 / 2.0;
			if (num8 > 0.5)
			{
				return (float)(num6 / (2.0 - num7));
			}
			return (float)(num6 / num7);
		}

		internal void VerifyThemeAccess()
		{
			if (!_themeWashInitialized)
			{
				WashResources();
			}
		}

		private static void AddToDictionary(ResourceDictionary originalDictionary, object key, object value)
		{
			originalDictionary.Add(key, value);
		}

		private static int AdjustColorComponentValue(int startValue, int baseValue)
		{
			int num = startValue * baseValue / 255;
			return num + startValue * (255 - (255 - startValue) * (255 - baseValue) / 255 - num) / 255;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color ColorFromHLS(byte alpha, float hue, float luminance, float saturation)
		{
			int val;
			int val2;
			int val3;
			if ((double)saturation == 0.0)
			{
				val = (val2 = (val3 = (int)((double)luminance * 255.0)));
			}
			else
			{
				float num = ((!(luminance <= 0.5f)) ? (luminance + saturation - luminance * saturation) : (luminance + luminance * saturation));
				float rm = 2f * luminance - num;
				val = (int)ToRGBHelper(rm, num, hue + 120f);
				val2 = (int)ToRGBHelper(rm, num, hue);
				val3 = (int)ToRGBHelper(rm, num, hue - 120f);
			}
			val = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(255, val));
			val2 = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(255, val2));
			val3 = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(255, val3));
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(alpha, (byte)val, (byte)val2, (byte)val3);
		}

		private WashGroup GetGroupFromName(string groupName)
		{
			if (groupName == null || groupName.Length == 0 || _washGroups == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = _washGroups.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				WashGroup washGroup = _washGroups[i];
				if (washGroup.Name == groupName)
				{
					return washGroup;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Color GetWashColor(WashGroup group)
		{
			if (group != null && group.WashColor.HasValue)
			{
				return group.WashColor.Value;
			}
			return WashColor;
		}

		private void InitializeResourceTarget(IResourceWasherTarget target, bool storeValues)
		{
			if (!(target is DependencyObject dependencyObject) || ((!(dependencyObject is Freezable) || !((Freezable)dependencyObject).IsFrozen) && !GetIsExcludedFromWash(dependencyObject)))
			{
				target.ResourceWasher = this;
			}
		}

		private void OnCriteriaChanged()
		{
			if (_isInitializing || !_autoWash)
			{
				_themeWashInitialized = false;
			}
			else
			{
				WashResources();
			}
		}

		private static float ToRGBHelper(float rm1, float rm2, float rh)
		{
			if (rh > 360f)
			{
				rh -= 360f;
			}
			else if (rh < 0f)
			{
				rh += 360f;
			}
			if (rh < 60f)
			{
				rm1 += (rm2 - rm1) * rh / 60f;
			}
			else if (rh < 180f)
			{
				rm1 = rm2;
			}
			else if (rh < 240f)
			{
				rm1 += (rm2 - rm1) * (240f - rh) / 60f;
			}
			return rm1 * 255f;
		}

		private void VerifyCanBeModified()
		{
			Utilities.VerifyCanBeModified(this);
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Color WashColorHelper(System.Windows.Media.Color startColor, WashGroup group)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color washColor = GetWashColor(group);
			return PerformColorWash(startColor, washColor, group);
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush WashBrushHelper(System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush, object sourceObject)
		{
			if (GetIsExcludedFromWash(sourceBrush))
			{
				return sourceBrush;
			}
			string washGroup = GetWashGroup(sourceBrush);
			WashGroup groupFromName = GetGroupFromName(washGroup);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = WashBrushHelper(sourceBrush, groupFromName);
			if (sourceObject is Freezable { IsFrozen: not false })
			{
				brush.Freeze();
			}
			return brush;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush WashBrushHelper(System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush, WashGroup group)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color washColor = GetWashColor(group);
			if (washColor == Colors.Transparent)
			{
				return sourceBrush;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = sourceBrush.Clone();
			if (brush is SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush)
			{
				solidColorBrush.Color = WashColorHelper(solidColorBrush.Color, group);
				return solidColorBrush;
			}
			if (brush is GradientBrush { GradientStops: var gradientStops } gradientBrush)
			{
				int count = gradientStops.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					GradientStop gradientStop = gradientStops[i];
					gradientStop.Color = WashColorHelper(gradientStop.Color, group);
				}
				return gradientBrush;
			}
			return brush;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush WashBrushDynamicResource(DynamicResourceExtension resource)
		{
			if (resource == null || resource.ResourceKey == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (resource.ResourceKey.GetType().FullName != "System.Windows.SystemResourceKey")
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyInfo property = typeof(System.Windows.SystemColors).GetProperty(resource.ResourceKey.ToString(), BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
			if (property == null || property.PropertyType != typeof(SolidColorBrush))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return WashBrushHelper((System.Windows.Media.Brush)property.GetValue(null, null), null);
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen WashPenHelper(System.Windows.Media.Pen sourcePen, object sourceObject)
		{
			if (GetIsExcludedFromWash(sourcePen))
			{
				return sourcePen;
			}
			string washGroup = GetWashGroup(sourcePen);
			WashGroup groupFromName = GetGroupFromName(washGroup);
			System.Windows.Media.Color washColor = GetWashColor(groupFromName);
			if (washColor == Colors.Transparent)
			{
				return sourcePen;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = sourcePen.Clone();
			pen.Brush = WashBrushHelper(sourcePen.Brush, groupFromName);
			if (sourceObject is Freezable { IsFrozen: not false })
			{
				pen.Freeze();
			}
			return pen;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CloneBrush(System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush)
		{
			return CloneBrush(sourceBrush, washColor: false, null);
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CloneBrush(System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush, bool washColor, WashGroup group)
		{
			return sourceBrush.Clone();
		}

		private void CopyBrush(System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush, System.Windows.Media.Brush destinationBrush)
		{
			CopyBrush(sourceBrush, destinationBrush, washColor: false, null);
		}

		private void CopyBrush(System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush, System.Windows.Media.Brush destinationBrush, bool washColor, WashGroup group)
		{
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = sourceBrush as SolidColorBrush;
			SetWashGroup(destinationBrush, GetWashGroup(sourceBrush));
			SetIsExcludedFromWash(destinationBrush, GetIsExcludedFromWash(sourceBrush));
			destinationBrush.Opacity = sourceBrush.Opacity;
			if (solidColorBrush != null)
			{
				SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush2 = destinationBrush as SolidColorBrush;
				if (washColor)
				{
					solidColorBrush2.Color = WashColorHelper(solidColorBrush.Color, group);
				}
				else
				{
					solidColorBrush2.Color = solidColorBrush.Color;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(sourceBrush is GradientBrush gradientBrush) || !(destinationBrush is GradientBrush gradientBrush2))
				{
					return;
				}
				gradientBrush2.GradientStops.Clear();
				GradientStopCollection gradientStops = gradientBrush.GradientStops;
				int count = gradientStops.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					GradientStop gradientStop = gradientStops[i];
					GradientStop gradientStop2 = new GradientStop();
					if (washColor)
					{
						gradientStop2.Color = WashColorHelper(gradientStop.Color, group);
					}
					else
					{
						gradientStop2.Color = gradientStop.Color;
					}
					gradientStop2.Offset = gradientStop.Offset;
					gradientBrush2.GradientStops.Add(gradientStop2);
				}
				if (gradientBrush is LinearGradientBrush && destinationBrush is LinearGradientBrush)
				{
					LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = (LinearGradientBrush)gradientBrush;
					LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush2 = (LinearGradientBrush)destinationBrush;
					linearGradientBrush2.StartPoint = linearGradientBrush.StartPoint;
					linearGradientBrush2.EndPoint = linearGradientBrush.EndPoint;
				}
				else if (gradientBrush is RadialGradientBrush && destinationBrush is RadialGradientBrush)
				{
					RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush = (RadialGradientBrush)gradientBrush;
					RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush2 = (RadialGradientBrush)destinationBrush;
					radialGradientBrush2.Center = radialGradientBrush.Center;
					radialGradientBrush2.RadiusX = radialGradientBrush.RadiusX;
					radialGradientBrush2.RadiusY = radialGradientBrush.RadiusY;
					radialGradientBrush2.GradientOrigin = radialGradientBrush.GradientOrigin;
				}
			}
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			BeginInit();
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			EndInit();
		}
	}
	internal interface IResourceWasherTarget
	{
		ResourceWasher ResourceWasher { get; set; }
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(StaticPropertyResourceKeyConverter))]
	public sealed class StaticPropertyResourceKey : ResourceKey
	{
		private Type _type;

		private string _propertyName;

		public override Assembly Assembly => _type.Assembly;

		public Type Type => _type;

		public string PropertyName => _propertyName;

		public StaticPropertyResourceKey(Type type, string propertyName)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("type");
			}
			if (propertyName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("propertyName");
			}
			_type = type;
			_propertyName = propertyName;
			StaticPropertyResourceKeyConverter.CacheType(type);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(_type.Name);
			stringBuilder.Append(".");
			stringBuilder.Append(_propertyName);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class StaticPropertyResourceKeyConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, Type> s_typesWithResourceKeys = new Dictionary<string, Type>();

		private static object s_Lock = new object();

		internal static void CacheType(Type type)
		{
			lock (s_Lock)
			{
				s_typesWithResourceKeys[type.Name] = type;
			}
		}

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sourceType");
			}
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(MarkupExtension) && context is IValueSerializerContext)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				string[] array = text.Split('.');
				if (array.Length == 2)
				{
					lock (s_Lock)
					{
						if (!s_typesWithResourceKeys.TryGetValue(array[0], out var value2))
						{
							throw new FormatException(SR.GetString("LE_StringFormatException_3", array[0]));
						}
						FieldInfo field = value2.GetField(array[1]);
						if (!(field != null))
						{
							PropertyInfo property = value2.GetProperty(array[1]);
							if (property != null)
							{
								MethodInfo getMethod = property.GetGetMethod();
								if (getMethod != null)
								{
									return getMethod.Invoke(null, null);
								}
							}
							throw new FormatException(SR.GetString("LE_StringFormatException_2", value2.FullName, array[1]));
						}
						return field.GetValue(null);
					}
				}
				throw new FormatException(SR.GetString("LE_StringFormatException_1", text));
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(MarkupExtension) && value is StaticPropertyResourceKey staticPropertyResourceKey && context is IValueSerializerContext valueSerializerContext)
			{
				ValueSerializer valueSerializerFor = valueSerializerContext.GetValueSerializerFor(typeof(Type));
				if (valueSerializerFor != null)
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
					stringBuilder.Append(valueSerializerFor.ConvertToString(staticPropertyResourceKey.Type, valueSerializerContext));
					stringBuilder.Append(".");
					stringBuilder.Append(staticPropertyResourceKey.PropertyName);
					return new StaticExtension(stringBuilder.ToString());
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class WashGroup
	{
		private string _name;

		private System.Windows.Media.Color? _washColor;

		private float _hue;

		private float _saturation;

		private WashMode? _washMode;

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			set
			{
				_name = value;
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(NullableConverter<System.Windows.Media.Color>))]
		public System.Windows.Media.Color? WashColor
		{
			get
			{
				return _washColor;
			}
			set
			{
				_washColor = value;
				System.Windows.Media.Color color = value ?? Colors.Transparent;
				_hue = ResourceWasher.GetHue(color);
				_saturation = ResourceWasher.GetSaturation(color);
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(NullableConverter<WashMode>))]
		public WashMode? WashMode
		{
			get
			{
				return _washMode;
			}
			set
			{
				_washMode = value;
			}
		}

		internal float Hue => _hue;

		internal float Saturation => _saturation;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeWashColor()
		{
			return _washColor.HasValue;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetWashColor()
		{
			_washColor = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeWashMode()
		{
			return _washMode.HasValue;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetWashMode()
		{
			_washMode = null;
		}
	}
	public class WashGroupCollection : ObservableCollection<WashGroup>
	{
	}

	public abstract class ResourceSet : ResourceDictionary
	{
		private bool _resourcesWashed;

		private ResourceDictionary _cachedResourcesReference;

		public abstract string Theme { get; }

		public abstract string Grouping { get; }

		public abstract ResourceDictionary Resources { get; }

		protected ResourceSet()
		{
			ThemeManager.VerifyThemeInformationRegistered(GetType().Assembly);
			_cachedResourcesReference = Resources;
			base.MergedDictionaries.Add(_cachedResourcesReference);
			VerifyResources();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("{0} for {1}", new object[2] { Theme, Grouping });
		}

		public static object GetSealedResource(ResourceDictionary dictionary, object key)
		{
			if (dictionary == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dictionary");
			}
			object obj = dictionary[key];
			if (obj is Style)
			{
				((Style)obj).Seal();
			}
			else if (obj is FrameworkTemplate)
			{
				((FrameworkTemplate)obj).Seal();
			}
			else if (obj is Freezable)
			{
				((Freezable)obj).Freeze();
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected internal void VerifyResources()
		{
			if (!_resourcesWashed && _cachedResourcesReference != null && !AssemblyResourceSetLoader.LoadingResourceSets)
			{
				_resourcesWashed = true;
				ResourceWasher.ForceAutoWashResources(_cachedResourcesReference);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ResourceSetLocator
	{
		public abstract string Theme { get; }

		public abstract string Grouping { get; }

		public abstract Assembly Assembly { get; }

		public abstract string ResourcePath { get; }
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public abstract class AssemblyResourceSetLoader
	{
		private static int g_resourceSetloadingCount;

		internal static bool LoadingResourceSets => g_resourceSetloadingCount > 0;

		public void RegisterResourceSets()
		{
			RegisterResourceSets(null);
		}

		internal void RegisterResourceSets(List<string> groupingNames)
		{
			Interlocked.Increment(ref g_resourceSetloadingCount);
			try
			{
				if (groupingNames != null)
				{
					foreach (string groupingName in groupingNames)
					{
						OnRegisterResourceSets(groupingName);
					}
					return;
				}
				OnRegisterResourceSets(null);
			}
			finally
			{
				Interlocked.Decrement(ref g_resourceSetloadingCount);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void OnRegisterResourceSets(string groupingName);

		protected static void RegisterResourceSet(ResourceSet resourceSet)
		{
			ThemeManager.Register(resourceSet.Theme, resourceSet.Grouping, resourceSet.Resources);
		}

		protected static void RegisterResourceSet(ResourceSetLocator locator)
		{
			ThemeManager.Register(locator);
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Assembly, AllowMultiple = false)]
	public sealed class AssemblyResourceSetLoaderAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private Type resourceSetLoaderType;

		public Type AssemblyResourceSetLoaderType => resourceSetLoaderType;

		public AssemblyResourceSetLoaderAttribute(Type assemblyResourceSetLoaderType)
		{
			if (null == assemblyResourceSetLoaderType)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("assemblyResourceSetLoaderType");
			}
			if (!typeof(AssemblyResourceSetLoader).IsAssignableFrom(assemblyResourceSetLoaderType))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_5"));
			}
			resourceSetLoaderType = assemblyResourceSetLoaderType;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return resourceSetLoaderType.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is AssemblyResourceSetLoaderAttribute assemblyResourceSetLoaderAttribute)
			{
				return assemblyResourceSetLoaderAttribute.AssemblyResourceSetLoaderType == resourceSetLoaderType;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Assembly, AllowMultiple = false)]
	public sealed class AssemblyThemeGroupingNameAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private string _name;

		public string Name => _name;

		public AssemblyThemeGroupingNameAttribute(string name)

			if (name == null)

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _name.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is AssemblyThemeGroupingNameAttribute assemblyThemeGroupingNameAttribute)
			{
				return assemblyThemeGroupingNameAttribute._name == _name;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class ThemeManager
	{
		private class ThemeInfo
		{
			private class RegistrationInfo
			{
				private DispatcherResourceDictionaryList _providedDictionary;

				private ResourceDictionary _registeredDictionary;

				private ResourceSetLocator _registeredLocator;

				private string _grouping;

				internal string Grouping => _grouping;

				internal ResourceSetLocator RegisteredLocator => _registeredLocator;

				internal ResourceDictionary RegisteredDictionary => _registeredDictionary;

				internal RegistrationInfo(string grouping)
				{
					_grouping = grouping;
					_providedDictionary = new DispatcherResourceDictionaryList(prepareProvidedDictionary: true, CreateDictionary);
				}

				private ResourceDictionary CreateDictionary()
				{
					if (_registeredDictionary != null)
					{
						return _registeredDictionary;
					}
					if (_registeredLocator != null)
					{
						return new ResourceSetLoader(_registeredLocator);
					}
					return new ResourceDictionary();
				}

				internal ResourceDictionary GetProvidedDictionary(bool createIfNull)
				{
					return _providedDictionary.GetCurrent(createIfNull);
				}

				internal bool Register(ResourceSetLocator value)
				{
					if (_registeredLocator == value)
					{
						return false;
					}
					_registeredLocator = value;
					_registeredDictionary = null;
					_providedDictionary.Refresh();
					return true;
				}

				internal bool Register(ResourceDictionary value)
				{
					if (value == _registeredDictionary)
					{
						return false;
					}
					_registeredLocator = null;
					_registeredDictionary = value;
					_providedDictionary.Refresh();
					return true;
				}
			}

			private class DispatcherResourceDictionaryList
			{
				private List<DispatcherResourceDictionaryItem> _dictionaries;

				private readonly bool _prepareProvidedDictionary;

				private readonly Func<ResourceDictionary> _createCallback;

				internal DispatcherResourceDictionaryList(bool prepareProvidedDictionary, Func<ResourceDictionary> createCallback)
				{
					_dictionaries = new List<DispatcherResourceDictionaryItem>();
					_prepareProvidedDictionary = prepareProvidedDictionary;
					_createCallback = createCallback;
				}

				private DispatcherResourceDictionaryItem CreateItem(out ResourceDictionary dictionary)
				{
					dictionary = new ResourceDictionary();
					dictionary.MergedDictionaries.Add(_createCallback());
					if (_prepareProvidedDictionary)
					{
						PrepareProvidedDictionary(dictionary);
					}
					return new DispatcherResourceDictionaryItem(Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher, dictionary);
				}

				private ResourceDictionary GetCurrent()
				{
					foreach (DispatcherResourceDictionaryItem dictionary in _dictionaries)
					{
						if (dictionary.Dispatcher == Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher)
						{
							return dictionary.Dictionary;
						}
					}
					return null;
				}

				internal ResourceDictionary GetCurrent(bool createIfNull)
				{
					ResourceDictionary dictionary = GetCurrent();
					if (dictionary == null && createIfNull)
					{
						DispatcherResourceDictionaryItem item = CreateItem(out dictionary);
						_dictionaries.Add(item);
					}
					return dictionary;
				}

				internal void Refresh()
				{
					for (int num = _dictionaries.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						DispatcherResourceDictionaryItem dispatcherResourceDictionaryItem = _dictionaries[num];
						ResourceDictionary rd = dispatcherResourceDictionaryItem.Dictionary;
						if (rd == null)
						{
							_dictionaries.RemoveAt(num);
						}
						else
						{
							Dispatcher dispatcher = dispatcherResourceDictionaryItem.Dispatcher;
							if (dispatcher == Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher)
							{
								if (!rd.IsReadOnly)
								{
									rd.MergedDictionaries[0] = _createCallback();
								}
								else
								{
									DispatcherResourceDictionaryItem value = CreateItem(out rd);
									_dictionaries[num] = value;
								}
							}
							else if (dispatcher == null)
							{
								_dictionaries.RemoveAt(num);
							}
							else
							{
								dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
								{
									if (!rd.IsReadOnly)
									{
										rd.MergedDictionaries[0] = _createCallback();
									}
								});
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private class DispatcherResourceDictionaryItem
			{
				private readonly WeakReference _dispatcher;

				private readonly WeakReference _dictionary;

				internal ResourceDictionary Dictionary => CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_dictionary) as ResourceDictionary;

				internal Dispatcher Dispatcher => CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_dispatcher) as Dispatcher;

				internal DispatcherResourceDictionaryItem(Dispatcher dispatcher, ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary)
				{
					_dispatcher = new WeakReference(dispatcher);
					_dictionary = new WeakReference(resourceDictionary);
				}
			}

			private string _name;

			private DispatcherResourceDictionaryList _allGroupings;

			private bool _areAllGroupingsDirty;

			private Dictionary<string, RegistrationInfo> _registrationInfo;

			[ThreadStatic]
			private static FrameworkElement _sharedOwner;

			[ThreadStatic]
			private static ResourceDictionary _sharedEmptyDictionary;

			public string Name => _name;

			internal ThemeInfo(string name)
			{
				_name = name;
				_registrationInfo = new Dictionary<string, RegistrationInfo>();
				_allGroupings = new DispatcherResourceDictionaryList(prepareProvidedDictionary: false, () => CreateAllGroupings(this));
			}

			private static ResourceDictionary CreateAllGroupings(ThemeInfo info)
			{
				ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = CreateProvidedDictionary();
				KeyValuePair<string, RegistrationInfo>[] array = info._registrationInfo.ToArray();
				KeyValuePair<string, RegistrationInfo>[] array2 = array;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, RegistrationInfo> keyValuePair in array2)
				{
					ResourceDictionary providedDictionary = keyValuePair.Value.GetProvidedDictionary(createIfNull: true);
					resourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries.Add(providedDictionary);
				}
				return resourceDictionary;
			}

			private static ResourceDictionary CreateProvidedDictionary()
			{
				ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary();
				PrepareProvidedDictionary(resourceDictionary);
				return resourceDictionary;
			}

			internal string[] GetGroupingNames()
			{
				string[] array = new string[_registrationInfo.Count];
				_registrationInfo.Keys.CopyTo(array, 0);
				Array.Sort(array, StringComparer.Ordinal);
				return array;
			}

			private RegistrationInfo GetInfo(string grouping)
			{
				if (!_registrationInfo.TryGetValue(grouping, out var value))
				{
					value = new RegistrationInfo(grouping);
					_registrationInfo.Add(grouping, value);
				}
				return value;
			}

			public ResourceDictionary GetResourceSet(string grouping, bool createIfNull)
			{
				if (grouping == "*")
				{
					return VerifyAllGroupings(createIfNull);
				}
				if (!_registrationInfo.TryGetValue(grouping, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value.GetProvidedDictionary(createIfNull);
			}

			internal bool HasGrouping(string grouping)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(grouping) || grouping == "*")
				{
					return _registrationInfo.Count > 0;
				}
				return _registrationInfo.ContainsKey(grouping);
			}

			private static void PrepareProvidedDictionary(ResourceDictionary rd)
			{
				if (_sharedOwner == null)
				{
					_sharedOwner = new FrameworkElement();
				}
				if (_sharedEmptyDictionary == null)
				{
					_sharedEmptyDictionary = new ResourceDictionary();
				}
				_sharedOwner.Resources = rd;
				_sharedOwner.Resources = _sharedEmptyDictionary;
			}

			public bool Register(string grouping, ResourceSetLocator locator)
			{
				RegistrationInfo info = GetInfo(grouping);
				if (info.Register(locator))
				{
					_areAllGroupingsDirty = true;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool Register(string grouping, ResourceDictionary dictionary)
			{
				RegistrationInfo info = GetInfo(grouping);
				if (info.Register(dictionary))
				{
					_areAllGroupingsDirty = true;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal void TransferRegisteredObjects(ThemeInfo destThemeInfo)
			{
				KeyValuePair<string, RegistrationInfo>[] array = _registrationInfo.ToArray();
				KeyValuePair<string, RegistrationInfo>[] array2 = array;
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					KeyValuePair<string, RegistrationInfo> keyValuePair = array2[i];
					if (keyValuePair.Value.RegisteredLocator != null)
					{
						destThemeInfo.Register(keyValuePair.Key, keyValuePair.Value.RegisteredLocator);
					}
					else
					{
						destThemeInfo.Register(keyValuePair.Key, keyValuePair.Value.RegisteredDictionary);
					}
				}
			}

			internal void VerifyAllGroupings()
			{
				VerifyAllGroupings(createIfNull: false);
			}

			private ResourceDictionary VerifyAllGroupings(bool createIfNull)
			{
				if (_areAllGroupingsDirty)
				{
					_areAllGroupingsDirty = false;
					_allGroupings.Refresh();
				}
				return _allGroupings.GetCurrent(createIfNull);
			}
		}

		private class ControlThemeInfo : DependencyObject
		{
			private string _currentTheme;

			private ResourceDictionary _mergedDictionary;

			private FrameworkElement _element;

			private string[] _currentGroupings;

			private string _appliedTheme;

			private string[] _appliedGroupings;

			private bool _isApplyingTheme;

			private static readonly DependencyProperty ControlThemeInfoProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ControlThemeInfo", typeof(ControlThemeInfo), typeof(ControlThemeInfo), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

			private bool IsApplyThemeNeeded
			{
				get
				{
					if (_currentTheme != _appliedTheme)
					{
						return true;
					}
					int count = CoreUtilities.GetCount(_currentGroupings);
					if (count != CoreUtilities.GetCount(_appliedGroupings))
					{
						return true;
					}
					switch (count)
					{
					case 0:
						return true;
					case 1:
						return _currentGroupings[0] == _appliedGroupings[0];
					default:
					{
						string[] currentGroupings = _currentGroupings;
						foreach (string value in currentGroupings)
						{
							if (Array.IndexOf(_appliedGroupings, value) < 0)
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
						return false;
					}
					}
				}
			}

			private ControlThemeInfo(FrameworkElement element)
			{
				_element = element;
				if (!element.IsInitialized)
				{
					element.Initialized += OnElementInitialized;
				}
				else if (element.IsLoaded)
				{
					element.AddHandler(FrameworkElement.UnloadedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnElementUnloaded), handledEventsToo: true);
				}
				else
				{
					element.AddHandler(FrameworkElement.LoadedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnElementLoaded), handledEventsToo: true);
				}
			}

			private void ApplyTheme(string theme, string[] groupings, bool updateMembers)
			{
				if (_isApplyingTheme)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_CannotChangeThemeWhileApplyingTheme", theme, _currentTheme));
				}
				_isApplyingTheme = true;
				try
				{
					ApplyThemeImpl(theme, groupings, updateMembers);
				}
				finally
				{
					_isApplyingTheme = false;
				}
			}

			private void ApplyThemeImpl(string theme, string[] groupings, bool updateMembers)
			{
				if (updateMembers)
				{
					_currentTheme = theme;
					_currentGroupings = groupings;
				}
				_appliedTheme = theme;
				_appliedGroupings = groupings;
				ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(theme))
				{
					foreach (string text in groupings)
					{
						if (text != null)
						{
							ResourceDictionary resourceSet = GetResourceSet(theme, text);
							if (resourceSet != null)
							{
								resourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries.Add(resourceSet);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				Collection<ResourceDictionary> mergedDictionaries = _element.Resources.MergedDictionaries;
				if (_mergedDictionary != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < mergedDictionaries.Count; j++)
					{
						if (mergedDictionaries[j] == _mergedDictionary)
						{
							_mergedDictionary = resourceDictionary;
							mergedDictionaries[j] = _mergedDictionary;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (_mergedDictionary != resourceDictionary)
				{
					_mergedDictionary = resourceDictionary;
					mergedDictionaries.Insert(0, _mergedDictionary);
				}
			}

			internal static ResourceDictionary GetThemeDictionary(FrameworkElement fe)
			{
				if (fe.GetValue(ControlThemeInfoProperty) is ControlThemeInfo controlThemeInfo)
				{
					return controlThemeInfo._mergedDictionary;
				}
				return null;
			}

			private void OnDelayedUnload(object param)
			{
				if (!Utilities.HasLoadedAncestor(_element))
				{
					_element.RemoveHandler(FrameworkElement.UnloadedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnElementUnloaded));
					_element.AddHandler(FrameworkElement.LoadedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnElementLoaded), handledEventsToo: true);
					ApplyTheme(null, null, updateMembers: false);
				}
			}

			private void OnElementInitialized(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				_element.Initialized -= OnElementInitialized;
				if (_element.IsLoaded)
				{
					_element.AddHandler(FrameworkElement.UnloadedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnElementUnloaded), handledEventsToo: true);
				}
				else
				{
					_element.AddHandler(FrameworkElement.LoadedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnElementLoaded), handledEventsToo: true);
				}
				if (IsApplyThemeNeeded)
				{
					ApplyTheme(_currentTheme, _currentGroupings, updateMembers: false);
				}
			}

			private void OnElementLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				_element.RemoveHandler(FrameworkElement.LoadedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnElementLoaded));
				_element.AddHandler(FrameworkElement.UnloadedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnElementUnloaded), handledEventsToo: true);
				if (IsApplyThemeNeeded)
				{
					ApplyTheme(_currentTheme, _currentGroupings, updateMembers: false);
				}
			}

			private void OnElementUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				_element.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle, new SendOrPostCallback(OnDelayedUnload), null);
			}

			internal static void ProcessThemeChanged(FrameworkElement themedControl, string theme, string[] groupings)
			{
				Utilities.ThrowIfNull(themedControl, "themedControl");
				Utilities.ThrowIfNull(groupings, "groupings");
				ControlThemeInfo controlThemeInfo = themedControl.GetValue(ControlThemeInfoProperty) as ControlThemeInfo;
				if (controlThemeInfo == null)
				{
					controlThemeInfo = new ControlThemeInfo(themedControl);
					themedControl.SetValue(ControlThemeInfoProperty, controlThemeInfo);
				}
				if (themedControl.IsLoaded || ReportSection.GetIsInReport(themedControl))
				{
					controlThemeInfo.ApplyTheme(theme, groupings, updateMembers: true);
					return;
				}
				if (!controlThemeInfo.IsApplyThemeNeeded && themedControl.IsInitialized && Utilities.HasLoadedAncestor(themedControl))
				{
					controlThemeInfo.ApplyTheme(theme, groupings, updateMembers: true);
					return;
				}
				controlThemeInfo._currentTheme = theme;
				controlThemeInfo._currentGroupings = groupings;
			}
		}

		private static string g_currentTheme;

		private static SortedList<string, ThemeInfo> g_themes;

		private static ThemeInfo g_currentThemeInfo;

		private static bool g_currentThemeInfoDirty;

		private static object g_EventLock;

		private static EventHandler g_currentThemeChangedDelegate;

		private static EventHandler g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate;

		private static bool g_ignoreRegistrationInfoChanged;

		private static int g_loadedAssemblyVersion;

		private static int g_lastProcessedAssemblyVersion;

		private static List<Assembly> g_assemblyList;

		private static readonly object g_AssemblyLoadSyncObject;

		private static readonly bool g_hookedAssemblyLoad;

		private static readonly Hashtable g_reviewedAssemblies;

		private static List<string> g_loadedGroupingNames;

		private static List<Type> g_processedResourceSetTypes;

		private static readonly object g_RegisteredGroupingsSyncObject;

		private static Dictionary<Type, string[]> g_registeredGroupings;

		public const string AllGroupingsLiteral = "*";
