		public static readonly RoutedEvent ThemeChangedEvent;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ThemeProperty;

		public static string CurrentTheme
		{
			get
			{
				return g_currentTheme;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(g_currentTheme != value))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value == "[default]")
				{
					value = null;
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					ThemeInfo themeInfo = GetThemeInfo(value, allowSpecialLiterals: false);
					if (themeInfo == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_6", value));
					}
				}
				g_currentTheme = value;
				g_currentThemeInfoDirty = true;
				VerifyCurrentThemeInfo();
				if (g_currentThemeChangedDelegate != null)
				{
					g_currentThemeChangedDelegate(null, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		public static event EventHandler CurrentThemeChanged
		{
			add
			{
				lock (g_EventLock)
				{
					if (g_currentThemeChangedDelegate == null)
					{
						g_currentThemeChangedDelegate = value;
					}
					else
					{
						g_currentThemeChangedDelegate = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(g_currentThemeChangedDelegate, value);
					}
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				lock (g_EventLock)
				{
					if (g_currentThemeChangedDelegate != null)
					{
						g_currentThemeChangedDelegate = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(g_currentThemeChangedDelegate, value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static event EventHandler RegistrationInfoChanged
		{
			add
			{
				lock (g_EventLock)
				{
					if (g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate == null)
					{
						g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate = value;
					}
					else
					{
						g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate, value);
					}
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				lock (g_EventLock)
				{
					if (g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate != null)
					{
						g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate, value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		static ThemeManager()
		{
			g_currentTheme = "Generic";
			g_themes = new SortedList<string, ThemeInfo>();
			g_currentThemeInfo = new ThemeInfo("[current]");
			g_currentThemeInfoDirty = true;
			g_EventLock = new object();
			g_assemblyList = new List<Assembly>();
			g_AssemblyLoadSyncObject = new object();
			g_loadedGroupingNames = new List<string>();
			g_processedResourceSetTypes = new List<Type>();
			g_RegisteredGroupingsSyncObject = new object();
			g_registeredGroupings = new Dictionary<Type, string[]>();
			ThemeChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ThemeChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedPropertyChangedEventHandler<string>), typeof(ThemeManager));
			ThemeProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Theme", typeof(string), typeof(ThemeManager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnThemeChanged, CoerceTheme));
			Assembly[] assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
			Assembly[] array = assemblies;
			foreach (Assembly item in array)
			{
				g_assemblyList.Add(item);
			}
			g_loadedAssemblyVersion++;
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.ControlAppDomain);
				try
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
				}
				HookAssemblyLoad();
				g_hookedAssemblyLoad = true;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				g_hookedAssemblyLoad = false;
				g_reviewedAssemblies = new Hashtable();
				for (int j = 0; j < assemblies.Length; j++)
				{
					g_reviewedAssemblies.Add(assemblies[j], null);
				}
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceTheme(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			if (value is string)
			{
				if (string.Compare((string)value, "[default]", ignoreCase: true) == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (((string)value).Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void OnThemeChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is FrameworkElement)
			{
				Type type = target.GetType();
				string[] groupingsForType = GetGroupingsForType(type);
				if (groupingsForType == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_ThemeManagerRegisterGroupings", type.FullName));
				}
				OnThemeChanged(target as FrameworkElement, (string)e.NewValue, groupingsForType);
			}
		}

		public static string GetTheme(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (string)d.GetValue(ThemeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetTheme(DependencyObject d, string value)
		{
			d.SetValue(ThemeProperty, value);
		}

		public static string[] GetGroupingsForType(Type type)
		{
			string[] array = GetGroupingsForTypeImpl(type);
			if (array != null)
			{
				array = (string[])array.Clone();
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static string[] GetGroupingsForTypeImpl(Type type)
		{
			string[] value = null;
			lock (g_RegisteredGroupingsSyncObject)
			{
				while (null != type)
				{
					if (g_registeredGroupings.TryGetValue(type, out value))
					{
						return value;
					}
					type = type.BaseType;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		public static string[] GetGroupingsForTheme(string theme)
		{
			ThemeInfo themeInfo = GetThemeInfo(theme, allowSpecialLiterals: false);
			if (themeInfo == null)
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ThemeManager));
			try
			{
				return themeInfo.GetGroupingNames();
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ThemeManager));
			}
		}

		public static ResourceDictionary GetResourceSet(string theme, string grouping)
		{
			ThemeInfo themeInfo = GetThemeInfo(theme, allowSpecialLiterals: true);
			if (themeInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (grouping == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("grouping");
			}
			if (grouping.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_7"));
			}
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ThemeManager));
			try
			{
				if (themeInfo == g_currentThemeInfo)
				{
					VerifyCurrentThemeInfo();
				}
				string grouping2 = grouping.ToLower();
				return themeInfo.GetResourceSet(grouping2, createIfNull: true);
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ThemeManager));
			}
		}

		public static string[] GetThemes()
		{
			return GetThemes(includeDefault: false);
		}

		public static string[] GetThemes(bool includeDefault)
		{
			return GetThemes(includeDefault, "*");
		}

		public static string[] GetThemes(bool includeDefault, string grouping)
		{
			ProcessLoadedAssemblies();
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ThemeManager));
			try
			{
				int count = g_themes.Count;
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				IList<ThemeInfo> values = g_themes.Values;
				if (includeDefault)
				{
					list.Add("[default]");
				}
				if (grouping != null)
				{
					grouping = grouping.ToLower();
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					ThemeInfo themeInfo = values[i];
					if (themeInfo.HasGrouping(grouping))
					{
						list.Add(themeInfo.Name);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ThemeManager));
			}
		}

		public static bool IsThemeValid(string theme)
		{
			if (theme == null || theme.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ThemeInfo themeInfo = GetThemeInfo(theme, allowSpecialLiterals: true);
			return themeInfo != null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static void OnThemeChanged(FrameworkElement themedControl, string theme, string[] groupings)
		{
			ControlThemeInfo.ProcessThemeChanged(themedControl, theme, groupings);
		}

		public static void Register(string theme, string grouping, ResourceDictionary resources)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(resources, "resources");
			Register(theme, grouping, (object)resources);
		}

		public static void Register(ResourceSetLocator locator)
		{
			if (locator.Assembly == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ThemeManagerLocatorAssembly"));
			}
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(locator, "locator");
			Register(locator.Theme, locator.Grouping, locator);
		}

		private static void Register(string theme, string grouping, object objectToRegister)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(theme, "theme");
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(grouping, "grouping");
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(objectToRegister, "objectToRegister");
			if (theme.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("theme");
			}
			if (grouping.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("grouping");
			}
			if (!(objectToRegister is ResourceDictionary) && !(objectToRegister is ResourceSetLocator))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("objectToRegister");
			}
			string text = theme.ToLower();
			if (text == "[default]" || text == "[current]")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_8"));
			}
			string text2 = grouping.ToLower();
			if (text2 == "*")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_9"));
			}
			bool flag = false;
			ThemeInfo value = null;
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ThemeManager));
			try
			{
				if (!g_themes.TryGetValue(text, out value))
				{
					value = new ThemeInfo(theme);
					g_themes.Add(text, value);
					flag = true;
				}
				flag = ((!(objectToRegister is ResourceSetLocator)) ? value.Register(text2, (ResourceDictionary)objectToRegister) : value.Register(text2, (ResourceSetLocator)objectToRegister));
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ThemeManager));
				if (flag)
				{
					if (value.Name == g_currentTheme)
					{
						g_currentThemeInfoDirty = true;
					}
					if (!g_ignoreRegistrationInfoChanged)
					{
						value.VerifyAllGroupings();
						VerifyCurrentThemeInfo();
						if (g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate != null)
						{
							g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate(null, EventArgs.Empty);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RegisterGroupings(Type type, string[] groupings)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(type, "type");
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(groupings, "groupings");
			lock (g_RegisteredGroupingsSyncObject)
			{
				if (g_registeredGroupings.ContainsKey(type))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_ThemeManagerGroupingsAlreadyRegistered", type.FullName));
				}
				string[] array = (string[])groupings.Clone();
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string value in array2)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ThemeManagerGroupingsCannotBeNull"), "groupings");
					}
				}
				g_registeredGroupings[type] = groupings;
			}
		}

		public static void VerifyThemeInformationRegistered(Assembly assembly)
		{
			ProcessLoadedAssemblies();
			if (null != assembly && !g_hookedAssemblyLoad && !g_ignoreRegistrationInfoChanged && !g_reviewedAssemblies.ContainsKey(assembly))
			{
				g_reviewedAssemblies.Add(assembly, null);
				OnAssemblyLoaded(assembly);
			}
		}

		internal static ResourceDictionary Clone(ResourceDictionary source)
		{
			if (source is ResourceSet resourceSet)
			{
				resourceSet.VerifyResources();
			}
			if (source is ResourceWasher resourceWasher)
			{
				resourceWasher.VerifyThemeAccess();
			}
			ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary();
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item2 in source)
			{
				resourceDictionary.Add(item2.Key, item2.Value);
			}
			foreach (ResourceDictionary mergedDictionary in source.MergedDictionaries)
			{
				ResourceDictionary item = Clone(mergedDictionary);
				resourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries.Add(item);
			}
			return resourceDictionary;
		}

		private static AssemblyResourceSetLoader CreateAssemblyInfo(Type assemblyResourceSetLoaderType)
		{
			try
			{
				return Activator.CreateInstance(assemblyResourceSetLoaderType) as AssemblyResourceSetLoader;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static void CreateAssemblyResourceSetLoaders(List<AssemblyResourceSetLoader> list, List<Type> assemblyStyleResourceSetLoaderTypes)
		{
			if (assemblyStyleResourceSetLoaderTypes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Type assemblyStyleResourceSetLoaderType in assemblyStyleResourceSetLoaderTypes)
			{
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader assemblyResourceSetLoader = CreateAssemblyInfo(assemblyStyleResourceSetLoaderType);
				if (assemblyResourceSetLoader != null)
				{
					list.Add(assemblyResourceSetLoader);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static ResourceDictionary GetAppliedThemeDictionary(FrameworkElement fe)
		{
			return ControlThemeInfo.GetThemeDictionary(fe);
		}

		private static void GetAssemblyResourceSetLoaderTypes(List<Type> list, Assembly assembly)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!(assembly.GetType() == typeof(AssemblyBuilder)) && !assembly.ReflectionOnly)
				{
					object[] customAttributes = assembly.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(AssemblyResourceSetLoaderAttribute), inherit: false);
					if (customAttributes != null && customAttributes.Length != 0)
					{
						list.Add(((AssemblyResourceSetLoaderAttribute)customAttributes[0]).AssemblyResourceSetLoaderType);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private static void GetAssemblyThemeGroupingName(List<string> list, Assembly assembly)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!(assembly.GetType() == typeof(AssemblyBuilder)) && !assembly.ReflectionOnly)
				{
					object[] customAttributes = assembly.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(AssemblyThemeGroupingNameAttribute), inherit: false);
					if (customAttributes != null && customAttributes.Length != 0)
					{
						list.Add(((AssemblyThemeGroupingNameAttribute)customAttributes[0]).Name);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private static ThemeInfo GetThemeInfo(string theme, bool allowSpecialLiterals)
		{
			if (theme == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("theme");
			}
			if (theme.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("theme");
			}
			ProcessLoadedAssemblies();
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ThemeManager));
			try
			{
				string text = theme.ToLower();
				if (allowSpecialLiterals)
				{
					if (text == "[current]")
					{
						return g_currentThemeInfo;
					}
					if (text == "[default]")
					{
						text = "Generic";
						text = theme.ToLower();
					}
				}
				if (!g_themes.TryGetValue(text, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ThemeManager));
			}
		}

		private static void HookAssemblyLoad()
		{
			AppDomain.CurrentDomain.AssemblyLoad += OnAssemblyLoaded;
		}

		private static void OnAssemblyLoaded(object sender, AssemblyLoadEventArgs e)
		{
			OnAssemblyLoaded(e.LoadedAssembly);
		}

		private static void OnAssemblyLoaded(Assembly loadedAssembly)
		{
			try
			{
				Monitor.Enter(g_AssemblyLoadSyncObject);
				g_assemblyList.Add(loadedAssembly);
				g_loadedAssemblyVersion++;
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(g_AssemblyLoadSyncObject);
			}
		}

		private static void ProcessLoadedAssemblies()
		{
			if (g_lastProcessedAssemblyVersion != g_loadedAssemblyVersion)
			{
				ProcessLoadedAssembliesImpl();
			}
		}

		private static void ProcessLoadedAssembliesImpl()
		{
			Assembly[] array;
			try
			{
				Monitor.Enter(g_AssemblyLoadSyncObject);
				array = new Assembly[g_assemblyList.Count];
				g_assemblyList.CopyTo(array);
				g_assemblyList.Clear();
				g_lastProcessedAssemblyVersion = g_loadedAssemblyVersion;
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(g_AssemblyLoadSyncObject);
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				GetAssemblyThemeGroupingName(list, array[i]);
			}
			List<Type> list2 = new List<Type>();
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				GetAssemblyResourceSetLoaderTypes(list2, array[j]);
			}
			List<string> list3 = new List<string>();
			List<Type> list4 = new List<Type>();
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ThemeManager));
			try
			{
				list4.AddRange(g_processedResourceSetTypes);
				if (list2.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (Type item in list2)
					{
						g_processedResourceSetTypes.Add(item);
					}
				}
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (string item2 in list)
					{
						g_loadedGroupingNames.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				list3.AddRange(g_loadedGroupingNames);
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ThemeManager));
			}
			g_ignoreRegistrationInfoChanged = true;
			try
			{
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					List<AssemblyResourceSetLoader> list5 = new List<AssemblyResourceSetLoader>();
					CreateAssemblyResourceSetLoaders(list5, list4);
					foreach (AssemblyResourceSetLoader item3 in list5)
					{
						item3.RegisterResourceSets(list);
					}
				}
				if (list2.Count > 0)
				{
					List<AssemblyResourceSetLoader> list6 = new List<AssemblyResourceSetLoader>();
					CreateAssemblyResourceSetLoaders(list6, list2);
					foreach (AssemblyResourceSetLoader item4 in list6)
					{
						item4.RegisterResourceSets(list3);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				g_ignoreRegistrationInfoChanged = false;
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0 && list2.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (g_themes != null)
			{
				Monitor.Enter(typeof(ThemeManager));
				try
				{
					foreach (ThemeInfo value in g_themes.Values)
					{
						value.VerifyAllGroupings();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					Monitor.Exit(typeof(ThemeManager));
				}
			}
			VerifyCurrentThemeInfo();
			if (g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate != null)
			{
				g_registrationInfoChangedDelegate(null, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyCurrentThemeInfo()
		{
			if (!g_currentThemeInfoDirty || g_ignoreRegistrationInfoChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			g_currentThemeInfoDirty = false;
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ThemeManager));
			try
			{
				string text = ((g_currentTheme == null) ? null : g_currentTheme.ToLower());
				ThemeInfo themeInfo = null;
				if (text != null)
				{
					themeInfo = GetThemeInfo(text, allowSpecialLiterals: false);
				}
				ThemeInfo themeInfo2 = g_currentThemeInfo;
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				list.AddRange(themeInfo2.GetGroupingNames());
				if (themeInfo != null)
				{
					themeInfo.TransferRegisteredObjects(themeInfo2);
					string[] groupingNames = themeInfo.GetGroupingNames();
					foreach (string item in groupingNames)
					{
						list.Remove(item);
					}
				}
				foreach (string item2 in list)
				{
					themeInfo2.Register(item2, new ResourceDictionary());
				}
				themeInfo2.VerifyAllGroupings();
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ThemeManager));
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyResourcesWashed(ResourceDictionary rd)
		{
			if (rd == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = rd.MergedDictionaries.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (rd.MergedDictionaries[i] is ResourceWasher resourceWasher)
				{
					resourceWasher.VerifyThemeAccess();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ResourceHolder : ResourceDictionary
	{
		internal ResourceHolder()
		{
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Windows.Tiles
{
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class TileDragIndicator : ContentControl
	{
		internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ContainerPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContainerProperty;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public FrameworkElement Container => (FrameworkElement)GetValue(ContainerProperty);

		static TileDragIndicator()
		{
			ContainerPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Container", typeof(FrameworkElement), typeof(TileDragIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ContainerProperty = ContainerPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TileDragIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(TileDragIndicator)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TileDragIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
		}
	}
	internal class TileDragManager
	{
		private class DropInfo
		{
			private TileDragManager _dragManager;

			private TileManager.LayoutItem _dropTargetItem;

			private DropLocation _dropLocation;

			private RectInfo _dropTargetRect;

			private bool _isProcessed;

			private bool _isDropValid;

			private bool _isDropNOOP;

			private bool _isDragAreaInvalid;

			internal TileManager.LayoutItem DropTargetItem => _dropTargetItem;

			internal bool IsDragAreaInvalid => _isDragAreaInvalid;

			internal bool IsDropNOOP
			{
				get
				{
					EnsureProcessed();
					return _isDropNOOP;
				}
			}

			internal bool IsDropValid
			{
				get
				{
					EnsureProcessed();
					return _isDropValid;
				}
			}

			internal DropInfo(TileDragManager dragManager, bool isDragAreaInvalid)
			{
				_isDragAreaInvalid = isDragAreaInvalid;
				Initialize(dragManager, DropLocation.None, null, null);
			}

			internal DropInfo(TileDragManager dragManager, TileManager.LayoutItem dropTargetItem, bool isDropNOOP)
				: this(dragManager, new RectInfo(dragManager, dropTargetItem.TargetRect, dragManager.Panel), DropLocation.OverTarget, isDropNOOP)
			{
				_isDragAreaInvalid = false;
				_isDropValid = true;
				_dropTargetItem = dropTargetItem;
			}

			internal DropInfo(TileDragManager dragManager, RectInfo targetRect, DropLocation dropLocation, bool isDropNOOP)
			{
				_dragManager = dragManager;
				_dropTargetRect = targetRect;
				_dropLocation = dropLocation;
				_isDropNOOP = isDropNOOP;
			}

			internal bool ApplyDrop()
			{
				EnsureProcessed();
				if (_dropTargetItem == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (_dragManager._isSwapping && !_dragManager._canSwapTarget)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return _dragManager._tileManager.MoveTileHelper(_dragManager._layoutItem, _dropTargetItem, calledFromDragManager: true);
			}

			private void EnsureProcessed()
			{
				if (!_isProcessed)
				{
					ProcessHelper();
					_isProcessed = true;
				}
			}

			internal static DropIndicator GetDropIndicator(ToolWindow indicatorWindow)
			{
				DropIndicator dropIndicator = (DropIndicator)Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(indicatorWindow, typeof(DropIndicator), allowSubclassOfType: true);
				if (dropIndicator == null)
				{
					dropIndicator = indicatorWindow.Content as DropIndicator;
				}
				return dropIndicator;
			}

			private void Initialize(TileDragManager dragManager, DropLocation dropLocation, TileManager.LayoutItem dropTargetItem, RectInfo dropTargetRect)
			{
				_dragManager = dragManager;
				_dropLocation = dropLocation;
				_dropTargetItem = dropTargetItem;
				_dropTargetRect = dropTargetRect;
			}

			internal bool InitializeDropIndicator(ToolWindow indicatorWindow)
			{
				DropIndicator dropIndicator = GetDropIndicator(indicatorWindow);
				if (_dropTargetRect == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Rect rectInScreen = _dropTargetRect.GetRectInScreen();
				if (dropIndicator != null)
				{
					dropIndicator.DropLocation = _dropLocation;
					dropIndicator.DropTargetWidth = rectInScreen.Width;
					dropIndicator.DropTargetHeight = rectInScreen.Height;
					indicatorWindow.UpdateLayout();
					UIElement descendantFromName = Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(indicatorWindow, "PART_Offset");
					if (descendantFromName != null)
					{
						System.Windows.Point point = descendantFromName.TranslatePoint(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), indicatorWindow);
						rectInScreen.Offset(0.0 - point.X, 0.0 - point.Y);
						System.Windows.FlowDirection flowDirection = _dragManager.Panel.FlowDirection;
						if ((DropLocation.RightOfTarget == _dropLocation && flowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight) || (DropLocation.LeftOfTarget == _dropLocation && flowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft))
						{
							rectInScreen.Offset(rectInScreen.Width, 0.0);
						}
						else if (DropLocation.BelowTarget == _dropLocation)
						{
							rectInScreen.Offset(0.0, rectInScreen.Height);
						}
					}
				}
				_dragManager.PositionToolWindow(indicatorWindow, rectInScreen.Location);
				return true;
			}

			private void ProcessHelper()
			{
			}
		}

		internal class RectInfo
		{
			private TileDragManager _dragManager;

			private Rect _rect;

			private FrameworkElement _relativeTo;

			internal RectInfo(TileDragManager dragManager, Rect rect, FrameworkElement relativeTo)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(dragManager);
				_dragManager = dragManager;
				_rect = rect;
				_relativeTo = relativeTo;
			}

			internal Rect GetRectInScreen()
			{
				return GetRect(null);
			}

			internal Rect GetRect()
			{
				return GetRect(_dragManager.Panel);
			}

			internal Rect GetRect(UIElement relativeTo)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = PointInfo.TranslatePointHelper(_rect.TopLeft, _relativeTo, relativeTo);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = PointInfo.TranslatePointHelper(_rect.BottomRight, _relativeTo, relativeTo);
				return Utilities.RectFromPoints(point, point2);
			}

			internal bool Contains(PointInfo point)
			{
				Rect rect = GetRect();
				System.Windows.Point position = point.GetPosition();
				return rect.Contains(position);
			}
		}

		internal class PointInfo
		{
			private TileDragManager _dragManager;

			private System.Windows.Point _point;

			private FrameworkElement _relativeTo;

			internal PointInfo(TileDragManager dragManager, System.Windows.Point point, FrameworkElement relativeTo)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(dragManager);
				_dragManager = dragManager;
				_point = point;
				_relativeTo = relativeTo;
			}

			internal System.Windows.Point GetPosition()
			{
				return GetPosition(_dragManager.Panel);
			}

			internal System.Windows.Point GetPositionInScreen()
			{
				return GetPosition(null);
			}

			internal System.Windows.Point GetPosition(UIElement relativeTo)
			{
				return TranslatePointHelper(_point, _relativeTo, relativeTo);
			}

			internal static System.Windows.Point TranslatePointHelper(System.Windows.Point p, UIElement currentRelativeTo, UIElement relativeTo)
			{
				if (currentRelativeTo != relativeTo)
				{
					p = ((relativeTo == null) ? Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(currentRelativeTo, p) : (currentRelativeTo?.TranslatePoint(p, relativeTo) ?? Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(relativeTo, p)));
				}
				return p;
			}

			internal bool IsInsideTilesPanel()
			{
				return Utilities.DoesElementContainPoint(_dragManager.Panel, GetPosition());
			}
		}

		private TileManager _tileManager;

		private TileManager.LayoutItem _layoutItem;

		private TilesPanelBase _panel;

		private FrameworkElement _tile;

		private ItemInfoBase _itemInfo;

		private FrameworkElement _dragElement;

		private ToolWindow _dragIndicatorWindow;

		private System.Windows.Point _dragIndicatorWindow_OffsetFromMouse;

		private ToolWindow _dropIndicatorWindow;

		private TileManager.LayoutItem _lastSwapTarget;

		private bool _canSwapTarget;

		private bool _isSwapping;

		private bool _panelWasUnloaded;

		private bool _dragIndicatorShown;

		private AllowTileDragging _allowTileDragging;

		internal TilesPanelBase Panel => _panel;

		internal bool PanelWasUnloaded => _panelWasUnloaded;

		internal TileManager TileManager => _tileManager;

		internal FrameworkElement Tile => _tile;

		internal TileDragManager(TilesPanelBase panel, FrameworkElement tile, ItemInfoBase itemInfo, TileManager.LayoutItem layoutItem, FrameworkElement dragElement, AllowTileDragging allowTileDragging)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(panel);
			_tile = tile;
			_itemInfo = itemInfo;
			_layoutItem = layoutItem;
			_panel = panel;
			_tileManager = panel.GetManager();
			_dragElement = dragElement;
			_allowTileDragging = allowTileDragging;
			panel.Unloaded += OnPanelUnloaded;
		}

		internal RectInfo GetLayoutAreaRect()
		{
			TilesPanelBase panel = Panel;
			Rect rect = new Rect(panel.TileAreaSize);
			Thickness tileAreaPadding = panel.GetTileAreaPadding();
			rect.Offset(new Vector(tileAreaPadding.Left, tileAreaPadding.Top));
			return new RectInfo(this, rect, panel);
		}

		private ScrollSpeed CalcScrollSpeed(double distance)
		{
			double num = 200.0;
			int val = 0;
			int num2 = 6;
			return (ScrollSpeed)Math.Max(val, Math.Min(num2, (int)((double)num2 * (distance / num))));
		}

		private void DragHelper(PointInfo mouseLoc, bool apply)
		{
			System.Windows.Point dragIndicatorLocation;
			DropInfo dropInfo = DragHelper_GetDropInfoHelper(mouseLoc, out dragIndicatorLocation);
			if (!_dragIndicatorShown)
			{
				_dragIndicatorWindow_OffsetFromMouse = ((_dragElement != null) ? Utilities.EnsureInElementBounds(mouseLoc.GetPosition(_dragElement), _dragElement) : new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
				if (_dragElement.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					_dragIndicatorWindow_OffsetFromMouse.X = _dragElement.ActualWidth - _dragIndicatorWindow_OffsetFromMouse.X;
				}
				dropInfo = DragHelper_GetDropInfoHelper(mouseLoc, out dragIndicatorLocation);
				ShowDragIndicator(dragIndicatorLocation);
			}
			if (_dragIndicatorWindow != null)
			{
				PositionToolWindow(_dragIndicatorWindow, dragIndicatorLocation);
			}
			bool flag = dropInfo?.IsDropNOOP ?? false;
			bool flag2 = dropInfo?.IsDropValid ?? false;
			if (dropInfo != null && dropInfo.IsDragAreaInvalid)
			{
				Mouse.OverrideCursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.No;
			}
			else
			{
				Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
			}
			if (!flag && flag2)
			{
				TileManager.LayoutItem dropTargetItem = dropInfo.DropTargetItem;
				_isSwapping = _allowTileDragging == AllowTileDragging.Swap;
				if (!_isSwapping && dropTargetItem != null && dropTargetItem.ItemInfo != null)
				{
					_isSwapping = dropTargetItem.ItemInfo.GetIsMaximized() != _itemInfo.GetIsMaximized();
				}
				if ((apply && _isSwapping) || (!apply && !_isSwapping))
				{
					dropInfo.ApplyDrop();
				}
				else if (!apply && dropTargetItem != null)
				{
					SetSwapTarget(dropTargetItem);
				}
			}
		}

		private DropInfo DragHelper_GetDropInfoHelper(PointInfo mouseLoc, out System.Windows.Point dragIndicatorLocation)
		{
			DropInfo dropInfo = null;
			bool flag = mouseLoc.IsInsideTilesPanel();
			dragIndicatorLocation = mouseLoc.GetPositionInScreen();
			dragIndicatorLocation.Offset(0.0 - _dragIndicatorWindow_OffsetFromMouse.X, 0.0 - _dragIndicatorWindow_OffsetFromMouse.Y);
			Thickness tileAreaPadding = _panel.GetTileAreaPadding();
			if (_panel.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				tileAreaPadding.Left += _layoutItem.TargetRect.Size.Width;
			}
			_layoutItem.SetTargetRect(new Rect(System.Windows.Point.Add(_panel.PointFromScreen(dragIndicatorLocation), new Vector(0.0 - tileAreaPadding.Left, 0.0 - tileAreaPadding.Top)), _layoutItem.TargetRect.Size), measureElement: true);
			_layoutItem.CurrentRect = _layoutItem.TargetRect;
			TileManager.LayoutItem layoutItemFromPoint = _tileManager.GetLayoutItemFromPoint(mouseLoc.GetPosition(_panel), _layoutItem);
			if (layoutItemFromPoint != null)
			{
				dropInfo = new DropInfo(this, layoutItemFromPoint, layoutItemFromPoint.Container == _tile);
			}
			else
			{
				SetSwapTarget(null);
			}
			if (dropInfo == null && !flag)
			{
				dropInfo = new DropInfo(this, isDragAreaInvalid: true);
			}
			return dropInfo;
		}

		internal void HideDragIndicator()
		{
			if (_dragIndicatorWindow != null)
			{
				_dragIndicatorWindow.Close();
				_dragIndicatorShown = false;
			}
		}

		internal void OnDragEnd(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs, bool cancel)
		{
			_panel.Unloaded -= OnPanelUnloaded;
			SetSwapTarget(null);
			OnDragEndHelper(mouseEventArgs, cancel);
			_panel.OnEndDrag(_tile);
			_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void OnDragEndHelper(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs, bool cancel)
		{
			if (!cancel && !_panelWasUnloaded)
			{
				PointInfo mouseLoc = new PointInfo(this, mouseEventArgs.GetPosition(_panel), _panel);
				DragHelper(mouseLoc, apply: true);
			}
			Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
			HideDragIndicator();
			if (_dragIndicatorWindow != null)
			{
				_dragIndicatorWindow.Close();
				_dragIndicatorWindow = null;
			}
			if (_dropIndicatorWindow != null)
			{
				_dropIndicatorWindow.Close();
				_dropIndicatorWindow = null;
			}
		}

		internal void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs)
		{
			if (!_panelWasUnloaded)
			{
				PointInfo mouseLoc = new PointInfo(this, mouseEventArgs.GetPosition(_panel), _panel);
				DragHelper(mouseLoc, apply: false);
			}
		}

		private void OnPanelUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			_panelWasUnloaded = true;
		}

		private void PositionToolWindow(ToolWindow toolWindow, System.Windows.Point screenPoint)
		{
			System.Windows.Point relativePoint = Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(_panel, screenPoint);
			FrameworkElement owner = toolWindow.Owner ?? _panel;
			relativePoint = ToolWindow.GetScreenPoint(owner, relativePoint, _panel);
			toolWindow.Left = relativePoint.X;
			toolWindow.Top = relativePoint.Y;
		}

		private void SetSwapTarget(TileManager.LayoutItem swapTarget)
		{
			if (swapTarget == _lastSwapTarget)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_lastSwapTarget != null && _lastSwapTarget.Container != null)
			{
				_lastSwapTarget.Container.ClearValue(TilesPanelBase.IsSwapTargetPropertyKey);
			}
			_lastSwapTarget = swapTarget;
			if (_lastSwapTarget != null)
			{
				_canSwapTarget = _panel.CanSwapContainers(_layoutItem.Container as FrameworkElement, _layoutItem.ItemInfo, _lastSwapTarget.Container as FrameworkElement, _lastSwapTarget.ItemInfo);
				if (_canSwapTarget)
				{
					_lastSwapTarget.Container.SetValue(TilesPanelBase.IsSwapTargetPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ShowDragIndicator(System.Windows.Point dragIndicatorLocation)
		{
			_dragIndicatorWindow = new ToolWindow();
			_dragIndicatorWindow.ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize;
			_dragIndicatorWindow.UseOSNonClientArea = false;
			_dragIndicatorWindow.FlowDirection = _panel.FlowDirection;
			FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(ContentPresenter));
			frameworkElementFactory.Name = "PART_Content";
			ControlTemplate controlTemplate = new ControlTemplate(typeof(ToolWindow));
			controlTemplate.VisualTree = frameworkElementFactory;
			controlTemplate.Seal();
			_dragIndicatorWindow.Template = controlTemplate;
			TileDragIndicator tileDragIndicator = new TileDragIndicator();
			_dragIndicatorWindow.Content = tileDragIndicator;
			tileDragIndicator.SetValue(TileDragIndicator.ContainerPropertyKey, _tile);
			_tile.SetValue(TilesPanelBase.IsDraggingPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			_tile.UpdateLayout();
			System.Windows.Size renderSize = _tile.RenderSize;
			renderSize.Width += 0.5;
			renderSize.Height += 0.5;
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)renderSize.Width, (int)renderSize.Height, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Default);
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(_tile) > 0)
			{
				renderTargetBitmap.Render((Visual)VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(_tile, 0));
			}
			else
			{
				renderTargetBitmap.Render(_tile);
			}
			renderTargetBitmap.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Controls.Image image = new System.Windows.Controls.Image();
			image.Source = renderTargetBitmap;
			image.Stretch = Stretch.None;
			image.Width = renderSize.Width;
			image.Height = renderSize.Height;
			tileDragIndicator.Content = image;
			PositionToolWindow(_dragIndicatorWindow, dragIndicatorLocation);
			_dragIndicatorWindow.Show(_panel, activate: false);
			_dragIndicatorShown = true;
		}

		internal void StartDrag(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs)
		{
			PointInfo mouseLoc = new PointInfo(this, mouseEventArgs.GetPosition(_panel), _panel);
			DragHelper(mouseLoc, apply: false);
		}
	}

	public class ItemInfoBase : PropertyChangeNotifier, ISparseArrayMultiItem, ISparseArrayItem
	{
		private TileManager _manager;

		private object _item;

		private int _index;

		private object _sparseArrayOwnerData;

		private System.Windows.Size? _preferredSizeOverride;

		[ReadOnly(true)]
		[Bindable(false)]
		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				IList items = _manager.Items;
				if (_index < 0 || _index >= items.Count || !object.Equals(_item, items[_index]))
				{
					_index = items.IndexOf(_item);
				}
				return _index;
			}
		}

		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public object Item => _item;

		[ReadOnly(true)]
		[Bindable(false)]
		public int LogicalIndex => _manager.GetLogicalIndexOfItem(_item, returnScrollPosition: false);

		public bool OccupiesScrollPosition
		{
			get
			{
				if (!GetIsClosed())
				{
					return !GetIsMaximized();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[ReadOnly(true)]
		[Bindable(false)]
		public int ScrollPosition => _manager.GetLogicalIndexOfItem(_item, returnScrollPosition: true);

		internal bool IsInSparseArray => _sparseArrayOwnerData != null;

		protected TileManager Manager => _manager;

		protected internal System.Windows.Size? PreferredSizeOverride
		{
			get
			{
				return _preferredSizeOverride;
			}
			set
			{
				_preferredSizeOverride = value;
			}
		}

		int ISparseArrayMultiItem.ScrollCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!OccupiesScrollPosition)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		protected internal ItemInfoBase(TileManager manager, object item, int index)
		{
			_manager = manager;
			_item = item;
			_index = index;
		}

		public void BringIntoView()
		{
			int index = Index;
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				_manager.BringIndexIntoView(index);
			}
		}

		public void ClearSizeCustomization()
		{
			PreferredSizeOverride = null;
		}

		public int GetCurrentColumn()
		{
			return _manager.GetCurrentColumn(this);
		}

		public ITileConstraints GetCurrentConstraints()
		{
			if (!_manager.IsItemInView(this))
			{
				return null;
			}
			TileManager.LayoutItem layoutItem = _manager.GetLayoutItem(this);
			if (layoutItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return layoutItem;
		}

		public int GetCurrentRow()
		{
			return _manager.GetCurrentRow(this);
		}

		public Rect GetCurrentTargetRect()
		{
			return _manager.Panel?.GetTargetRectOfItem(Item) ?? Rect.Empty;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool GetIsClosed()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool GetIsMaximized()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected void GetResizeRange(out double maxDeltaLeft, out double maxDeltaRight, out double maxDeltaTop, out double maxDeltaBottom)
		{
			_manager.GetResizeRange(this, out maxDeltaLeft, out maxDeltaRight, out maxDeltaTop, out maxDeltaBottom);
		}

		protected void OnResize(double deltaX, double deltaY)
		{
			_manager.OnItemResized(this, deltaX, deltaY);
		}

		protected void InvalidateScrollPosition()
		{
			if (IsInSparseArray)
			{
				_manager.SparseArray.InvalidateItem(this);
			}
		}

		object ISparseArrayMultiItem.GetItemAtScrollIndex(int scrollIndex)
		{
			return this;
		}

		object ISparseArrayItem.GetOwnerData(SparseArray context)
		{
			return _sparseArrayOwnerData;
		}

		void ISparseArrayItem.SetOwnerData(object ownerData, SparseArray context)
		{
			_sparseArrayOwnerData = ownerData;
		}
	}

	public abstract class TilesPanelBase : RecyclingItemsPanel, IScrollInfo, IDeferredScrollPanel
	{
		internal class GenerationCache : IDisposable
		{
			internal TilesPanelBase _panel;

			private TileManager _manager;

			private IList _childElements;

			private int _childElementCount;

			private System.Windows.Size _constraint;

			private System.Windows.Size _measureConstraint = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);

			private IItemContainerGenerator _generator;

			private IDisposable _currentGeneratorStart;

			internal ArrayList _itemsExpectedToBeGenerated;

			private int _currentGeneratorPositionIndex;

			private int _nextChildElementIndex;

			private ItemsControl _itemsControl;

			internal GridBagLayoutManager _previousGridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall;

			internal Dictionary<DependencyObject, TileManager.LayoutItem> _previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache;

			internal HashSet _newItemsToBeArrangedTempCache;

			internal System.Windows.Size _desiredSize;

			internal bool _requiresAnotherLayoutPass;

			internal GenerationCache(TilesPanelBase panel, System.Windows.Size constraint)
			{
				_panel = panel;
				_itemsControl = ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(_panel);
				_manager = panel.GetManager();
				_constraint = constraint;
				_childElements = _panel.ChildElements;
				_childElementCount = _childElements.Count;
				ScrollDirection scrollDirection = _manager.BeginGeneration(this);
				_panel.BeginGeneration(scrollDirection, _itemsExpectedToBeGenerated);
				_itemsExpectedToBeGenerated = null;
				_generator = _panel.GetGenerator();
			}

			internal void GenerateElements()
			{
				_manager.GenerateElements(this);
			}

			internal UIElement GenerateElement(int indexToGen)
			{
				if (_itemsControl == null)
				{
					return _childElements[indexToGen] as UIElement;
				}
				if (_currentGeneratorStart == null || _currentGeneratorPositionIndex != indexToGen)
				{
					StartGenerator(indexToGen);
				}
				bool isNewlyRealized;
				UIElement uIElement = _generator.GenerateNext(out isNewlyRealized) as UIElement;
				_currentGeneratorPositionIndex++;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (isNewlyRealized)
				{
					if (_nextChildElementIndex < 0)
					{
						_nextChildElementIndex = _panel.FindSlotForNewlyRealizedRecordPresenter(indexToGen);
					}
					if (_nextChildElementIndex >= _childElementCount)
					{
						_panel.AddInternalChild(uIElement);
					}
					else
					{
						_panel.InsertInternalChild(_nextChildElementIndex, uIElement);
					}
					_childElementCount++;
					_generator.PrepareItemContainer(uIElement);
				}
				if (_nextChildElementIndex >= 0)
				{
					_nextChildElementIndex++;
				}
				return uIElement;
			}

			private void ReleaseGeneratorStart()
			{
				if (_currentGeneratorStart != null)
				{
					_currentGeneratorStart.Dispose();
					_currentGeneratorStart = null;
				}
			}

			private void StartGenerator(int indexToGen)
			{
				ReleaseGeneratorStart();
				_currentGeneratorPositionIndex = indexToGen;
				GeneratorPosition generatorPositionFromItemIndex = _panel.GetGeneratorPositionFromItemIndex(indexToGen, out _nextChildElementIndex);
				_currentGeneratorStart = _generator.StartAt(generatorPositionFromItemIndex, GeneratorDirection.Forward, allowStartAtRealizedItem: true);
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				ReleaseGeneratorStart();
				if (_generator != null)
				{
					_panel.EndGeneration();
				}
				_desiredSize = _manager.EndGeneration(this);
			}
		}

		internal class ScrollData
		{
			internal ScrollViewer _scrollOwner;

			internal System.Windows.Size _extent;

			internal System.Windows.Size _viewport;

			internal Vector _offset;

			internal Vector _oldOffset;

			internal bool _canHorizontallyScroll;

			internal bool _canVerticallyScroll;

			private bool _isInDeferredDrag;

			private double _deferredDragOffset;

			private TilesPanelBase _panel;

			internal double DeferredDragOffset
			{
				get
				{
					return _deferredDragOffset;
				}
				set
				{
					_deferredDragOffset = value;
				}
			}

			internal bool IsInDeferredDrag
			{
				get
				{
					return _isInDeferredDrag;
				}
				set
				{
					_isInDeferredDrag = value;
				}
			}

			internal ScrollData(TilesPanelBase panel)
			{
				_panel = panel;
			}

			internal void Reset()
			{
				Vector offset = _offset;
				_offset = default(Vector);
				_extent = default(System.Windows.Size);
				_viewport = default(System.Windows.Size);
				_panel.GetManager().OnScrollOffsetChanged(_offset, offset);
			}

			internal void VerifyScrollData(System.Windows.Size viewPort, System.Windows.Size extent)
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(viewPort.Width))
				{
					viewPort.Width = extent.Width;
				}
				if (double.IsInfinity(viewPort.Height))
				{
					viewPort.Height = extent.Height;
				}
				bool flag = (!TileManager.AreClose(_viewport.Width, viewPort.Width) | !TileManager.AreClose(_viewport.Height, viewPort.Height)) || !TileManager.AreClose(_extent.Width, extent.Width) || !TileManager.AreClose(_extent.Height, extent.Height);
				System.Windows.Size viewport = _viewport;
				System.Windows.Size extent2 = _extent;
				_viewport = viewPort;
				_extent = extent;
				Vector offset = _offset;
				flag |= VerifyOffset();
				if (flag)
				{
					_panel.GetManager().OnScrollOffsetChanged(_offset, offset);
				}
				if (_scrollOwner != null && flag)
				{
					_oldOffset = _offset;
					_scrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
				}
			}

			private bool VerifyOffset()
			{
				double x = Math.Max(Math.Min(_offset.X, _panel.MaxHorizontalOffset), 0.0);
				double y = Math.Max(Math.Min(_offset.Y, _panel.MaxVerticalOffset), 0.0);
				Vector oldOffset = _oldOffset;
				_offset = new Vector(x, y);
				if (TileManager.AreClose(_offset.X, oldOffset.X))
				{
					return !TileManager.AreClose(_offset.Y, oldOffset.Y);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsOkToCleanupUnusedGeneratedElements
		{

					return _dragManager == null;
				}
				return false;
			}

		protected override System.Windows.Controls.Orientation LogicalOrientation
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetIsInMaximizedMode())
				{
					MaximizedTileLocation maximizedTileLocation = GetMaximizedTileLocation();
					if (maximizedTileLocation == MaximizedTileLocation.Left || maximizedTileLocation == MaximizedTileLocation.Right)
					{
						return System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical;
					}
					return System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal;
				}
				TileLayoutOrder tileLayoutOrder = GetTileLayoutOrder();
				if (tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.Horizontal || tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable)
				{
					return System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal;
				}
				return System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsItemsHost)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return GetManager().CountOfItemsToBeArranged;
			}
		}

		protected TilesPanelBase()
			: base(removeDeactivatedContainersOnCleanup: true)
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (_bypassArrange)
			{
				_arrangeCount = 0;
				_measureCount = 0;
				_bypassArrange = false;
				return finalSize;
			}
			bool itemLocationsAreaTheSame = false;
			_ignoreChildSizeChanges = true;
			if ((finalSize.Height > _lastMeasureSize.Height && finalSize.Width > _lastMeasureSize.Width) || (finalSize.Height > _lastMeasureSize.Height && finalSize.Width > _lastMeasureSize.Width))
			{
				if (finalSize != _lastMeasureSizeAdjusted)
				{
					_lastMeasureSizeAdjusted = finalSize;
					MeasureHelper(finalSize);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_lastMeasureSizeAdjusted = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			_arrangeCount++;
			try
			{
				TileManager manager = GetManager();
				if (_bypassArrangeVerification)
				{
					_bypassArrangeVerification = false;
				}
				else
				{
					manager.VerifyArrangeSize();
					if (!base.IsMeasureValid)
					{
						_bypassArrangeVerification = true;
						return finalSize;
					}
				}
				manager.OnArrange(out itemLocationsAreaTheSame, out var inViewItemsAreTheSame);
				if (!inViewItemsAreTheSame)
				{
					_inViewItemsHaveChanged = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_ignoreChildSizeChanges = false;
			}
			_lastArrangeSize = finalSize;
			bool bypassAnimations = false;
			if (ArrangeHelper(calledFromArrange: true, animationsEnded: false, bypassAnimations))
			{
				if (!IsAnimationInProgress || _repositionFactor > 0.5)
				{
					if (_asynchAnimationStart == null)
					{
						_asynchAnimationStart = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Render, new Utilities.MethodDelegate(ProcessAnimationRestart));
					}
					else
					{
						ProcessAnimationRestart();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (!IsAnimationInProgress)
			{
				OnArrangeComplete();
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override void BringIndexIntoView(int index)
		{
			GetManager().BringIndexIntoView(index);
		}

		protected override UIElementCollection CreateUIElementCollection(FrameworkElement logicalParent)
		{
			TilesPanelUIElementCollection tilesPanelUIElementCollection = new TilesPanelUIElementCollection(this, this, logicalParent);
			tilesPanelUIElementCollection.CollectionChanged += OnCollectionChanged;
			return tilesPanelUIElementCollection;
		}

		protected override bool GetCanCleanupItem(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (IsAnimationInProgress)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GetCanCleanupItemHelper(itemIndex))
			{
				if (itemIndex != 0)
				{
					return GetCanCleanupItemHelper(itemIndex - 1);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetCanCleanupItemHelper(int itemIndex)
		{
			TileManager manager = GetManager();
			IList items = manager.Items;
			if (items == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (itemIndex < 0 || itemIndex >= items.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object obj = items[itemIndex];
			ItemInfoBase itemInfo = manager.GetItemInfo(obj);
			if (itemInfo == null || itemInfo.GetIsMaximized())
			{
				return false;
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ContainerFromIndex(itemIndex) as FrameworkElement;
			if (obj == frameworkElement)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (frameworkElement != null && (frameworkElement.IsFocused || frameworkElement.IsKeyboardFocusWithin || frameworkElement.IsMouseCaptureWithin))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !manager.IsContainerInArrangeCache(frameworkElement);
		}

		protected override Geometry GetLayoutClip(System.Windows.Size layoutSlotSize)
		{
			Thickness tileAreaPadding = GetTileAreaPadding();
			if (tileAreaPadding.Bottom == 0.0 && tileAreaPadding.Top == 0.0 && tileAreaPadding.Left == 0.0 && tileAreaPadding.Right == 0.0)
			{
				_tileAreaSize = layoutSlotSize;
				return base.GetLayoutClip(layoutSlotSize);
			}
			Rect rect = new Rect(layoutSlotSize);
			rect.X = tileAreaPadding.Left;
			rect.Y = tileAreaPadding.Top;
			rect.Width = Math.Max(rect.Width - (tileAreaPadding.Left + tileAreaPadding.Right), 0.0);
			rect.Height = Math.Max(rect.Height - (tileAreaPadding.Top + tileAreaPadding.Bottom), 0.0);
			_tileAreaSize = rect.Size;
			Geometry geometry = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
			geometry.Freeze();
			return geometry;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			ClearMeasureBypassedMap();
			_isInMeasure = true;
			_lastMeasureSize = availableSize;
			_lastDesiredSize = MeasureHelper(availableSize);
			_isInMeasure = false;
			return _lastDesiredSize;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size MeasureHelper(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			_tileAreaSize = availableSize;
			_measureCount++;
			ItemsControl itemsControl = null;
			if (base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				itemsControl = ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(this);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (itemsControl != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Size renderSize = itemsControl.RenderSize;
				if (renderSize != _itemsControlLastRenderSize)
				{
					flag = true;
					_itemsControlLastRenderSize = renderSize;
				}
			}
			if (!flag && DateTime.Now.Subtract(_lastMeasureTimeStamp).TotalSeconds > 0.1)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				ScrollData scrollDataInfo = ScrollDataInfo;
				if (scrollDataInfo._offset != _lastScrollOffset)
				{
					flag = true;
					_lastScrollOffset = scrollDataInfo._offset;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				_arrangeCount = 0;
				_measureCount = 0;
				_bypassArrange = false;
			}
			else if (_arrangeCount > 20 && _measureCount > 20)
			{
				_bypassArrange = true;
			}
			_lastMeasureTimeStamp = DateTime.Now;
			Thickness tileAreaPadding = GetTileAreaPadding();
			if ((tileAreaPadding.Bottom != 0.0 || tileAreaPadding.Top != 0.0) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(_tileAreaSize.Height))
			{
				_tileAreaSize.Height = Math.Max(1.0, _tileAreaSize.Height - (tileAreaPadding.Bottom + tileAreaPadding.Top));
			}
			if ((tileAreaPadding.Left != 0.0 || tileAreaPadding.Right != 0.0) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(_tileAreaSize.Width))
			{
				_tileAreaSize.Width = Math.Max(1.0, _tileAreaSize.Width - (tileAreaPadding.Left + tileAreaPadding.Right));
			}
			GenerationCache generationCache = null;
			bool flag2 = true;
			while (flag2)
			{
				bool isInMaximizedMode = GetIsInMaximizedMode();
				using (generationCache = new GenerationCache(this, availableSize))
				{
					generationCache.GenerateElements();
				}
				flag2 = generationCache._requiresAnotherLayoutPass || isInMaximizedMode != GetIsInMaximizedMode();
			}
			System.Windows.Size desiredSize = generationCache._desiredSize;
			if ((tileAreaPadding.Bottom != 0.0 || tileAreaPadding.Top != 0.0) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(desiredSize.Height))
			{
				desiredSize.Height = Math.Max(1.0, desiredSize.Height - (tileAreaPadding.Bottom + tileAreaPadding.Top));
			}
			if ((tileAreaPadding.Left != 0.0 || tileAreaPadding.Right != 0.0) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(desiredSize.Width))
			{
				desiredSize.Width = Math.Max(1.0, desiredSize.Width - (tileAreaPadding.Left + tileAreaPadding.Right));
			}
			return desiredSize;
		}

		protected override void OnChildDesiredSizeChanged(UIElement child)
		{
			if (_ignoreChildSizeChanges)
			{
				_childSizeChanged = true;
				return;
			}
			if (!_isInMeasure && _measureBypassedMap != null && _measureBypassedMap.Count > 0 && _measureBypassedMap.TryGetValue(child, out var value) && value.Container == child)
			{
				value.OnAsyncDesiredSizeChange();
			}
			base.OnChildDesiredSizeChanged(child);
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLostMouseCapture(e);
			if (_dragManager != null)
			{
				_dragManager.OnDragEnd(e, cancel: true);
				_dragManager = null;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_dragManager == null)
			{
				base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
				return;
			}
			TileDragManager dragManager = _dragManager;
			_dragManager = null;
			ReleaseMouseCapture();
			dragManager.OnDragEnd(e, cancel: false);
			e.Handled = true;
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		internal void OnEndDrag(FrameworkElement container)
		{
			container.ClearValue(IsDraggingPropertyKey);
			OnTileDragEnd(container);
		}

			{
				base.OnMouseMove(e);
				return;
			}
			_dragManager.OnMouseMove(e);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		}

		internal int FindSlotForNewlyRealizedRecordPresenter(int newItemIndex)
		{
			IList childElements = base.ChildElements;
			int count = childElements.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			IItemContainerGenerator generator = GetGenerator();
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				int num = generator.IndexFromGeneratorPosition(new GeneratorPosition(i, 0));
				if (num >= newItemIndex)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return count;
		}

		internal IItemContainerGenerator GetGenerator()
		{
			return base.ActiveItemContainerGenerator;
		}

		internal GeneratorPosition GetGeneratorPositionFromItemIndex(int itemIndex, out int childIndex)
		{
			GeneratorPosition result = GetGenerator()?.GeneratorPositionFromIndex(itemIndex) ?? new GeneratorPosition(-1, itemIndex + 1);
			childIndex = ((result.Offset == 0) ? result.Index : (result.Index + 1));
			return result;
		}

		internal void OnChildMeasureBypassed(TileManager.LayoutItem item)
		{
			if (_isInMeasure && item.Container is UIElement key)
			{
				if (_measureBypassedMap == null)
				{
					_measureBypassedMap = new Dictionary<UIElement, TileManager.LayoutItem>();
				}
				if (_measureBypassedMap.Count == 0)
				{
					base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
					base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
				}
				_measureBypassedMap[key] = item;
			}
		}

		protected internal Rect GetTargetRectOfItem(object item)
		{
			TileManager manager = GetManager();
			TileManager.LayoutItem layoutItem = manager.GetLayoutItem(item);
			if (layoutItem == null || layoutItem.Container == null || !manager.IsContainerInArrangeCache(layoutItem.Container))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect targetRect = layoutItem.TargetRect;
			Thickness tileAreaPadding = GetTileAreaPadding();
			ItemInfoBase itemInfo = layoutItem.ItemInfo;
			Vector vector = ((itemInfo == null || !itemInfo.GetIsMaximized()) ? manager.ArrangeOffset : manager.ArrangeOffsetForMaxmizedTiles);
			Vector offsetVector = new Vector(tileAreaPadding.Left, tileAreaPadding.Top) + vector;
			return Rect.Offset(targetRect, offsetVector);
		}

		protected Rect GetTargetRectOfContainer(DependencyObject container)
		{
			TileManager manager = GetManager();
			object obj = ItemFromContainer(container);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return GetTargetRectOfItem(obj);
		}

		}

		protected internal bool MoveTile(FrameworkElement container, object item, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			TileManager manager = GetManager();
			TileManager.LayoutItem layoutItem = manager.GetLayoutItem(item, container, createIfNotFound: false, clearDimensions: false);
			if (layoutItem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TileManager.LayoutItem layoutItemFromPoint = manager.GetLayoutItemFromPoint(point, layoutItem);
			if (layoutItemFromPoint == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return manager.MoveTileHelper(layoutItem, layoutItemFromPoint, calledFromDragManager: false);
		}

		protected bool StartTileDrag(FrameworkElement container, object item, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			TileManager manager = GetManager();
			if (manager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ItemInfoBase itemInfo = manager.GetItemInfo(item);
			if (itemInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			AllowTileDragging allowTileDragging = GetAllowTileDragging(container, itemInfo);
			switch (allowTileDragging)
			{
			case AllowTileDragging.No:
				return false;
			case AllowTileDragging.Slide:
				if (!GetIsInMaximizedMode() && GetTileLayoutOrder() == TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile)
				{
					allowTileDragging = AllowTileDragging.Swap;
				}
				break;
			}
			CaptureMouse();
			TileManager.LayoutItem layoutItem = manager.GetLayoutItem(item, container, createIfNotFound: true, clearDimensions: false);
			_dragManager = new TileDragManager(this, container, itemInfo, layoutItem, container, allowTileDragging);
			_dragManager.StartDrag(e);
			if (layoutItem != null)
			{
				if (!container.IsMeasureValid)
				{
					container.Measure(layoutItem.TargetRect.Size);
				}
				container.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(-100000.0, -100000.0), layoutItem.TargetRect.Size));
			}
			else
			{
				container.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(-100000.0, -100000.0), container.DesiredSize));
			}
			container.SetValue(IsDraggingPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			OnTileDragStart(container);
			return true;
		}

		}

		private void AdjustVerticalOffset(double adjustment)
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(((IScrollInfo)this).VerticalOffset + adjustment);
		}

		private bool ArrangeHelper(bool calledFromArrange, bool animationsEnded, bool bypassAnimations)
		{
			if (!calledFromArrange && !base.IsArrangeValid)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Thickness tileAreaPadding = GetTileAreaPadding();
			TileManager manager = GetManager();
			Vector vector = new Vector(tileAreaPadding.Left, tileAreaPadding.Top) + manager.ArrangeOffset;
			Vector vector2 = new Vector(tileAreaPadding.Left, tileAreaPadding.Top) + manager.ArrangeOffsetForMaxmizedTiles;
			Rect rect = new Rect(_lastArrangeSize);
			rect.Offset(vector);
			rect.Width = Math.Max(rect.Width - (tileAreaPadding.Left + tileAreaPadding.Right), 0.0);
			rect.Height = Math.Max(rect.Height - (tileAreaPadding.Top + tileAreaPadding.Bottom), 0.0);
			rect.Width = Math.Max(rect.Width, _tileAreaSize.Width);
			rect.Height = Math.Max(rect.Height, _tileAreaSize.Height);
			Vector vector3 = new Vector(-100000.0, -100000.0);
			double num = RepositionFactor;
			double num2 = ResizeFactor;
			if (CoreUtilities.AreClose(num, 1.0))
			{
				num = 1.0;
			}
			if (CoreUtilities.AreClose(num2, 1.0))
			{
				num2 = 1.0;
			}
			IEnumerator itemsToBeArranged = GetManager().GetItemsToBeArranged();
			Stack<TileManager.LayoutItem> stack = null;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((_dragManager != null) ? _dragManager.Tile : null);
			bool flag = !bypassAnimations && GetShouldAnimate();
			bool flag2 = animationsEnded || !flag;
			if (flag2)
			{
				if (GetIsInMaximizedMode())
				{
					if (GetShowAllMinimizedTiles())
					{
						flag2 = false;
					}
				}
				else if (GetShowAllTiles() || GetTileLayoutOrder() == TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile)
				{
					flag2 = false;
				}
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			List<TileManager.LayoutItem> list = new List<TileManager.LayoutItem>();
			while (itemsToBeArranged.MoveNext())
			{
				if (itemsToBeArranged.Current is TileManager.LayoutItem item)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			bool ignoreChildSizeChanges = _ignoreChildSizeChanges;
			if (!ignoreChildSizeChanges)
			{
				_childSizeChanged = false;
			}
			_ignoreChildSizeChanges = true;
			try
			{
				int count = list.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					TileManager.LayoutItem layoutItem = list[i];
					if (layoutItem == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					UIElement uIElement = layoutItem.Container as UIElement;
					if (uIElement == frameworkElement)
					{
						continue;
					}
					System.Windows.Size size = layoutItem.TargetRect.Size;
					if (uIElement.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed || size.Width < 1.0 || size.Height < 1.0)
					{
						if (uIElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
						{
							layoutItem.CurrentRect = layoutItem.TargetRect;
							if (!uIElement.IsMeasureValid)
							{
								uIElement.Measure(_lastMeasureSize);
							}
							uIElement.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(vector3.X, vector3.Y), uIElement.DesiredSize));
						}
						if (stack == null)
						{
							stack = new Stack<TileManager.LayoutItem>();
						}
						stack.Push(layoutItem);
						continue;
					}
					if (animationsEnded || !flag)
					{
						OnAnimationEnded(uIElement);
					}
					if (flag && uIElement != null)
					{
						bool isCurrentSameAsTarget = layoutItem.IsCurrentSameAsTarget;
						if (!flag4)
						{
							flag4 = !isCurrentSameAsTarget;
						}
						if (!calledFromArrange && !isCurrentSameAsTarget)
						{
							Rect currentRect = layoutItem.CurrentRect;
							Rect originalRect = layoutItem.OriginalRect;
							Rect targetRect = layoutItem.TargetRect;
							currentRect = originalRect;
							currentRect.X = ApplyFactor(originalRect.X, targetRect.X, num);
							currentRect.Y = ApplyFactor(originalRect.Y, targetRect.Y, num);
							if (layoutItem.ShouldAnimateResize)
							{
								if (!flag3)
								{
									flag3 = true;
								}
								currentRect.Width = Math.Max(ApplyFactor(originalRect.Width, targetRect.Width, num2), 1.0);
								currentRect.Height = Math.Max(ApplyFactor(originalRect.Height, targetRect.Height, num2), 1.0);
							}
							else
							{
								currentRect.Size = targetRect.Size;
							}
							layoutItem.CurrentRect = currentRect;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						layoutItem.CurrentRect = layoutItem.TargetRect;
					}
					Rect rect2 = Rect.Offset(layoutItem.CurrentRect, vector);
					bool flag5 = layoutItem.ItemInfo?.GetIsMaximized() ?? false;
					Vector vector4 = (flag5 ? vector2 : vector);
					bool flag6 = false;
					if (flag2 && !flag5)
					{
						flag6 = !rect.IntersectsWith(rect2) && !rect.IntersectsWith(Rect.Offset(layoutItem.TargetRect, vector));
					}
					if (uIElement == null || flag6)
					{
						if (stack == null)
						{
							stack = new Stack<TileManager.LayoutItem>();
						}
						stack.Push(layoutItem);
						vector4 = vector3;
						rect2 = layoutItem.TargetRect;
						rect2 = Rect.Offset(rect2, vector4);
						layoutItem.CurrentRect = layoutItem.TargetRect;
					}
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						if (calledFromArrange || !uIElement.IsArrangeValid)
						{
							uIElement.Arrange(new Rect(layoutItem.TargetRect.Size));
						}
						if (calledFromArrange)
						{
							layoutItem.SetOriginalRect(layoutItem.CurrentRect, calledFromArrange: true);
						}
						UpdateTransform(uIElement, layoutItem.OriginalRect, layoutItem.CurrentRect, layoutItem.TargetRect, vector4, num2, calledFromArrange);
					}
				}
				if (stack != null)
				{
					while (stack.Count > 0)
					{
						manager.RemoveLayoutItem(stack.Pop());
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_ignoreChildSizeChanges = ignoreChildSizeChanges;
				if (!ignoreChildSizeChanges && _childSizeChanged)
				{
					_childSizeChanged = false;
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
			return flag4;
		}

		private AnimationClock AnimateDoubleProperty(DependencyProperty dp, DoubleAnimationBase animation)
		{
			AnimationClock animationClock = animation.CreateClock();
			_activeAnimationCount++;
			animationClock.Completed += OnAnimationCompleted;
			ApplyAnimationClock(dp, animationClock);
			animationClock.Controller.Begin();
			SetValue(dp, 0.0);
			return animationClock;
		}

		private void AnimateRepositionAndResize()
		{
			if (GetShouldAnimate())
			{
				if (_repositionClock != null)
				{
					_repositionClock.Controller.Remove();
					UnhookAnimation(_repositionClock);
				}
				if (_resizeClock != null)
				{
					_resizeClock.Controller.Remove();
					UnhookAnimation(_resizeClock);
				}
				DoubleAnimationBase repositionAnimation = GetRepositionAnimation();
				if (repositionAnimation != null)
				{
					_repositionClock = AnimateDoubleProperty(RepositionFactorProperty, repositionAnimation);
				}
				repositionAnimation = GetResizeAnimation();
				if (repositionAnimation != null)
				{
					_resizeClock = AnimateDoubleProperty(ResizeFactorProperty, repositionAnimation);
				}
			}
		}

		private static double ApplyFactor(double original, double target, double factor)
		{
			if (factor == 1.0)
			{
				return target;
			}
			return original + (target - original) * factor;
		}

		private void ClearMeasureBypassedMap()
		{
			if (_measureBypassedMap != null)
			{
				_measureBypassedMap.Clear();
				base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			}
		}

		private void OnAnimationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UnhookAnimation(sender as AnimationClock);
		}

		private void OnArrangeComplete()
		{
			if (_inViewItemsHaveChanged)
			{
				_inViewItemsHaveChanged = false;
				OnItemsInViewChanged();
			}
			TriggerCleanupOfUnusedGeneratedItems(useDelay: true);
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsItemsHost && base.IsInitialized)
			{
				GetManager().OnItemsChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		private static void OnConstraintPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((d is Visual reference) ? (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(reference) as TilesPanelBase) : null)?.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void OnFactorChanged()
		{
			if (_repositionFactor < 0.1 && _resizeFactor < 0.1)
			{
				ProcessFactorChange();
			}
			else if (_processFactorChangePending == null)
			{
				_processFactorChangePending = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Send, new Utilities.MethodDelegate(ProcessFactorChange));
			}
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, (Action)delegate
			{
				ClearMeasureBypassedMap();
			});
		}

		private void ProcessFactorChange()
		{
			_processFactorChangePending = null;
			bool flag = ArrangeHelper(calledFromArrange: false, animationsEnded: false, bypassAnimations: false);
		}

		private void ProcessAllAnimationsEnded()
		{
			if (!_isRestartingAnimations)
			{
				ArrangeHelper(calledFromArrange: false, animationsEnded: true, bypassAnimations: false);
				OnArrangeComplete();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessAnimationRestart()
		{
			_asynchAnimationStart = null;
			if (IsAnimationInProgress)
			{
				_isRestartingAnimations = true;
			}
			try
			{
				AnimateRepositionAndResize();
			}
			finally
			{
				_isRestartingAnimations = false;
			}
		}

		private void SetHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				TileManager manager = GetManager();
				if (manager.ScrollTilesVertically)
				{
					offset = Math.Round(offset);
				}
				double num = Math.Max(Math.Min(manager.ScrollMaxOffset.X, offset), 0.0);
				if (ScrollDataInfo.IsInDeferredDrag)
				{
					ScrollDataInfo.DeferredDragOffset = num;
					OnDeferredScrollOffsetChanged(num);
				}
				else if (num != ScrollDataInfo._offset.X)
				{
					Vector offset2 = ScrollDataInfo._offset;
					ScrollDataInfo._offset.X = num;
					manager.OnScrollOffsetChanged(ScrollDataInfo._offset, offset2);
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetVerticalOffset(double offset)
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				TileManager manager = GetManager();
				if (manager.ScrollTilesVertically)
				{
					offset = Math.Round(offset);
				}
				double num = Math.Max(Math.Min(manager.ScrollMaxOffset.Y, offset), 0.0);
				if (ScrollDataInfo.IsInDeferredDrag)
				{
					ScrollDataInfo.DeferredDragOffset = num;
					OnDeferredScrollOffsetChanged(num);
				}
				else if (num != ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y)
				{
					Vector offset2 = ScrollDataInfo._offset;
					ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y = num;
					manager.OnScrollOffsetChanged(ScrollDataInfo._offset, offset2);
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnhookAnimation(AnimationClock clock)
		{
			if (clock == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyProperty dependencyProperty = null;
			if (clock == _repositionClock)
			{
				dependencyProperty = RepositionFactorProperty;
				_repositionClock = null;
			}
			else if (clock == _resizeClock)
			{
				dependencyProperty = ResizeFactorProperty;
				_resizeClock = null;
			}
			clock.Completed -= OnAnimationCompleted;
			if (dependencyProperty != null)
			{
				_activeAnimationCount--;
				ClearValue(dependencyProperty);
				if (_activeAnimationCount < 1)
				{
					ProcessAllAnimationsEnded();
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool ValidateColumnRow(object objVal)
		{
			int num = (int)objVal;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return num == -1;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ValidateColumnRowSpan(object objVal)
		{
			int num = (int)objVal;
			if (num < 1)
			{
				return num == 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ValidateColumnRowWeight(object objVal)
		{
			float num = (float)objVal;
			if (float.IsNaN(num) || float.IsInfinity(num))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return num >= 0f;
		}

		internal static bool ValidateMaximizedTileLimit(object objVal)
		{
			int num = (int)objVal;
			return num >= 0;
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(GetManager().ScrollSmallChange.Y);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineLeft()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(0.0 - GetManager().ScrollSmallChange.X);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineRight()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(GetManager().ScrollSmallChange.X);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineUp()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(0.0 - GetManager().ScrollSmallChange.Y);
		}

		Rect IScrollInfo.MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				return GetManager().MakeVisible(visual, rectangle);
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset((double)SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines * GetManager().ScrollSmallChange.Y);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelLeft()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset((double)(-SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines) * GetManager().ScrollSmallChange.X);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelRight()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset((double)SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines * GetManager().ScrollSmallChange.X);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelUp()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset((double)(-SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines) * GetManager().ScrollSmallChange.Y);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(GetManager().ScrollLargeChange.Y);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageLeft()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(0.0 - GetManager().ScrollLargeChange.X);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageRight()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(GetManager().ScrollLargeChange.X);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageUp()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(0.0 - GetManager().ScrollLargeChange.Y);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.SetHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(offset);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.SetVerticalOffset(double offset)
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(offset);
		}

		void IDeferredScrollPanel.OnThumbDragComplete(bool cancelled)
		{
			if (ScrollDataInfo.IsInDeferredDrag)
			{
				ScrollDataInfo.IsInDeferredDrag = false;
				if (ScrollBarOrientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					SetHorizontalOffset(ScrollDataInfo.DeferredDragOffset);
				}
				else
				{
					SetVerticalOffset(ScrollDataInfo.DeferredDragOffset);
				}
				OnDeferredScrollingEnded(cancelled);
			}
		}

		void IDeferredScrollPanel.OnThumbDragStart(Thumb thumb, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation scrollBarOrientation)
		{
			if (GetIsInDeferredScrollingMode())
			{
				ScrollDataInfo.IsInDeferredDrag = true;
				ScrollDataInfo.DeferredDragOffset = ((ScrollBarOrientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal) ? ScrollDataInfo._offset.X : ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y);
				OnDeferredScrollingStarted(thumb, scrollBarOrientation);
			}
		}

		bool IDeferredScrollPanel.SupportsDeferredScrolling(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation scrollBarOrientation, ScrollViewer scrollViewer)
		{
			return GetSupportsDeferredScrolling(scrollBarOrientation, scrollViewer);
		}
	}

		private static System.Windows.Size GetPageSizeFromQueue(PrintQueue queue, PrintTicket ticket, PageMediaSize pageMediaSize, out Vector origin, out System.Windows.Size imageableAreaExtent)
		{
			if (queue == null)
			{
				origin = default(Vector);
				imageableAreaExtent = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
				return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			if (ticket == null)
			{
				ticket = queue.UserPrintTicket;
				if (ticket == null)
				{
					ticket = queue.DefaultPrintTicket;
				}
			}
			if (pageMediaSize != null)
			{
				ticket = ticket.Clone();
				ticket.PageMediaSize = pageMediaSize;
			}
			PageImageableArea pageImageableArea = null;
			try
			{
				PrintCapabilities printCapabilities = ((ticket == null) ? queue.GetPrintCapabilities() : queue.GetPrintCapabilities(ticket));
				pageImageableArea = printCapabilities.PageImageableArea;
			}
			catch (PrintQueueException)
			{
			}
			if (pageImageableArea != null)
			{
				origin = new Vector(pageImageableArea.OriginWidth, pageImageableArea.OriginHeight);
				imageableAreaExtent = new System.Windows.Size(pageImageableArea.ExtentWidth, pageImageableArea.ExtentHeight);
			}
			else
			{
				origin = default(Vector);
				imageableAreaExtent = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			if (ticket != null)
			{
				pageMediaSize = ticket.PageMediaSize;
				if (pageMediaSize != null && pageMediaSize.Height.HasValue && pageMediaSize.Width.HasValue)
				{
					if (imageableAreaExtent.IsEmpty)
					{
						return new System.Windows.Size(pageMediaSize.Width.Value, pageMediaSize.Height.Value);
					}
					System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(pageMediaSize.Width.Value, pageMediaSize.Height.Value);
					System.Windows.Size size2 = new System.Windows.Size(pageImageableArea.ExtentWidth, pageImageableArea.ExtentHeight);
					if (size.Width > size.Height != size2.Width > size2.Height)
					{
						double width = size.Width;
						size.Width = size.Height;
						size.Height = width;
					}
					return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Min(size2.Width, size.Width), Math.Min(size2.Height, size.Height));
				}
			}
			if (pageImageableArea != null)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Size(pageImageableArea.ExtentWidth, pageImageableArea.ExtentHeight);
			}
			return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetPageSizeInternal()
		{
			ReportSettings reportSettings = ReportSettings;
			ReportSettings reportSettings2 = CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_lastSettings) as ReportSettings;
			if (reportSettings != reportSettings2 || (reportSettings != null && reportSettings.PageMetricsVersion != _pageMetricsVersion))
			{
				_previousPageSize = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
				_imageableAreaExtent = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			if (!_previousPageSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				return _previousPageSize;
			}
			_lastSettings = ((reportSettings != null) ? new WeakReference(reportSettings) : null);
			_pageMetricsVersion = reportSettings?.PageMetricsVersion ?? 0;
			_origin = default(Vector);
			_imageableAreaExtent = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			System.Windows.Size size = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			if (!_accessFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					PrintQueue printQueue = reportSettings?.PrintQueue;
					PageMediaSize pageMediaSize = reportSettings?.PageMediaSize;
					if (printQueue != null)
					{
						size = GetPageSizeFromQueue(printQueue, ActivePrintTicket, pageMediaSize, out _origin, out _imageableAreaExtent);
					}
					if (printQueue == null || size.IsEmpty)
					{
						size = GetPageSizeFromQueue(LocalPrintServer.GetDefaultPrintQueue(), ActivePrintTicket, pageMediaSize, out _origin, out _imageableAreaExtent);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					_accessFailed = true;
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Size empty = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			if (reportSettings != null)
			{
				empty = reportSettings.PageSize;
				PageMediaSize pageMediaSize2 = reportSettings.PageMediaSize;
				if (pageMediaSize2 != null)
				{
					if (pageMediaSize2.Width.HasValue && pageMediaSize2.Width > 0.0)
					{
						empty.Width = pageMediaSize2.Width.Value;
					}
					if (pageMediaSize2.Height.HasValue && pageMediaSize2.Height > 0.0)
					{
						empty.Height = pageMediaSize2.Height.Value;
					}
				}
				if (empty.IsEmpty || empty.Width < 1.0 || empty.Height < 1.0)
				{
					empty = size;
				}
				else if (!size.IsEmpty && size.Width > 0.0 && size.Height > 0.0)
				{
					empty.Width = Math.Min(empty.Width, size.Width);
					empty.Height = Math.Min(empty.Height, size.Height);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				empty = size;
			}
			if (empty.IsEmpty || empty.Width < 1.0 || empty.Height < 1.0)
			{
				empty = new System.Windows.Size(816.0, 1056.0);
			}
			_previousPageSize = empty;
			return empty;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Windows.Commands
