	public class CommandWrapper
	{
		private RoutedCommand _command;

		private long _stateDisallowed;

		private long _stateRequired;

		private bool _isEnabled = true;

		private InputGestureCollection _inputGestures;

		private ModifierKeys _modifierKeysDisallowed;

		public RoutedCommand Command => _command;

		public bool HasInputGestures
		{
			get
			{
				if (_inputGestures != null)
				{
					return _inputGestures.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public InputGestureCollection InputGestures
		{
			get
			{
				if (_inputGestures == null)
				{
					_inputGestures = new InputGestureCollection();
				}
				return _inputGestures;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _isEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				_isEnabled = value;
			}
		}

		public ModifierKeys ModifierKeysDisallowed => _modifierKeysDisallowed;

		public long StateDisallowed => _stateDisallowed;

		public long StateRequired => _stateRequired;

		public CommandWrapper(RoutedCommand command)
			: this(command, 0L, 0L)
		{
		}

		public CommandWrapper(RoutedCommand command, long stateDisallowed, long stateRequired)
			: this(command, stateDisallowed, stateRequired, (InputGestureCollection)null)
		{
		}

		public CommandWrapper(RoutedCommand command, long stateDisallowed, long stateRequired, InputGestureCollection inputGestures)
			: this(command, stateDisallowed, stateRequired, inputGestures, ModifierKeys.None)
		{
		}

		public CommandWrapper(RoutedCommand command, long stateDisallowed, long stateRequired, InputGesture inputGesture)
			: this(command, stateDisallowed, stateRequired, inputGesture, ModifierKeys.None)
		{
		}

		public CommandWrapper(RoutedCommand command, long stateDisallowed, long stateRequired, InputGesture inputGesture, ModifierKeys modifierKeysDisallowed)
			: this(command, stateDisallowed, stateRequired, (inputGesture == null) ? null : new InputGesture[1] { inputGesture }, modifierKeysDisallowed)
		{
		}

		public CommandWrapper(RoutedCommand command, long stateDisallowed, long stateRequired, InputGesture[] inputGestures, ModifierKeys modifierKeysDisallowed)
			: this(command, stateDisallowed, stateRequired, (inputGestures == null) ? null : new InputGestureCollection(inputGestures), modifierKeysDisallowed)
		{
		}

		public CommandWrapper(RoutedCommand command, long stateDisallowed, long stateRequired, InputGestureCollection inputGestures, ModifierKeys modifierKeysDisallowed)
		{
			_command = command;
			_stateDisallowed = stateDisallowed;
			_stateRequired = stateRequired;
			_inputGestures = inputGestures;
			_modifierKeysDisallowed = modifierKeysDisallowed;
			if (command is ICommandEx commandEx)
			{
				_stateDisallowed |= commandEx.MinimumStateDisallowed;
				_stateRequired |= commandEx.MinimumStateRequired;
			}
		}

		public CommandWrapper(IGRoutedCommand command, InputGestureCollection inputGestures)
			: this(command, command.MinimumStateDisallowed, command.MinimumStateRequired, inputGestures)
		{
		}

		public CommandWrapper(IGRoutedUICommand command, InputGestureCollection inputGestures)
			: this(command, command.MinimumStateDisallowed, command.MinimumStateRequired, inputGestures)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsAllowed(long state)
		{
			if (!_isEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((state & StateRequired) != StateRequired)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((state & StateDisallowed) != 0L)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsMinimumStatePresent(long state)
		{
			if (!_isEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CommandUtilities.IsMinimumStatePresent(state, Command);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public interface ICommandHost
	{
		bool Execute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo);

		long GetCurrentState(long statesToQuery);

		bool CanExecute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo);
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public abstract class CommandsBase
	{
		public abstract bool ProcessKeyboardInput(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e, ICommandHost commandHost);
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public abstract class Commands<T> : CommandsBase where T : ICommandHost
	{
		private static CommandWrapper[] CommandWrappersInternal;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static bool _lastCommandExecuted;

		public static CommandWrapper[] FindCommandWrappers(RoutedCommand commandToFind)
		{
			List<CommandWrapper> list = new List<CommandWrapper>(3);
			CommandWrapper[] commandWrappersInternal = CommandWrappersInternal;
			foreach (CommandWrapper commandWrapper in commandWrappersInternal)
			{
				if (commandWrapper.Command == commandToFind)
				{
					list.Add(commandWrapper);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			return null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void Initialize(CommandWrapper[] commandWrappers)
		{
			CommandWrappersInternal = commandWrappers;
			foreach (CommandWrapper commandWrapper in commandWrappers)
			{
				CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(T), new CommandBinding(commandWrapper.Command, OnCommand, OnQueryCommand));
			}
		}

		public static bool IsCommandAllowed(ICommandHost commandHost, RoutedCommand command)
		{
			return IsCommandAllowed(commandHost, command, null);
		}

		public static bool IsCommandAllowed(ICommandHost commandHost, RoutedCommand command, object commandParameter)
		{
			return IsCommandAllowed(commandHost, command, commandParameter, null);
		}

		public static bool IsCommandAllowed(ICommandHost commandHost, RoutedCommand command, object commandParameter, object originalSource)
		{
			bool continueRouting;
			return IsCommandAllowed(commandHost, command, commandParameter, originalSource, out continueRouting);
		}

		public static bool IsCommandAllowed(ICommandHost commandHost, RoutedCommand command, object commandParameter, object originalSource, out bool continueRouting)
		{
			bool forceHandled;
			return IsCommandAllowed(commandHost, command, commandParameter, originalSource, out continueRouting, out forceHandled);
		}

		internal static bool IsCommandAllowed(ICommandHost commandHost, RoutedCommand command, object commandParameter, object originalSource, out bool continueRouting, out bool forceHandled)
		{
			continueRouting = false;
			forceHandled = false;
			if (command == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("command");
			}
			if (commandHost == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("commandHost");
			}
			if (command is ICommandEx && !CommandUtilities.IsMinimumStatePresent(commandHost, command, out forceHandled))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(command, commandParameter, originalSource, continueRouting);
			bool result = commandHost.CanExecute(executeCommandInfo);
			continueRouting = executeCommandInfo.ContinueRouting;
			forceHandled = executeCommandInfo.ForceHandled;
			return result;
		}

		public static bool IsMinimumStatePresentForCommand(ICommandHost commandHost, RoutedCommand command)
		{
			if (command == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("command");
			}
			if (commandHost == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("commandHost");
			}
			return CommandUtilities.IsMinimumStatePresent(commandHost, command);
		}

		public override bool ProcessKeyboardInput(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e, ICommandHost commandHost)
		{
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.LWin:
			case Key.RWin:
			case Key.LeftShift:
			case Key.RightShift:
			case Key.LeftCtrl:
			case Key.RightCtrl:
			case Key.LeftAlt:
			case Key.RightAlt:
				return false;
			default:
			{
				ModifierKeys modifiers = Keyboard.Modifiers;
				bool result = false;
				List<CommandWrapper> list = new List<CommandWrapper>();
				CommandWrapper[] commandWrappersInternal = CommandWrappersInternal;
				if (commandWrappersInternal != null)
				{
					foreach (CommandWrapper commandWrapper in commandWrappersInternal)
					{
						if (commandWrapper == null || !commandWrapper.HasInputGestures)
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (InputGesture inputGesture in commandWrapper.InputGestures)
						{
							if (inputGesture.Matches(commandHost, e))
							{
								if ((commandWrapper.ModifierKeysDisallowed & modifiers) == 0)
								{
									list.Add(commandWrapper);
								}
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				int num = list?.Count ?? 0;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					long num2 = 0L;
					for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
					{
						CommandWrapper commandWrapper2 = list[j];
						num2 |= commandWrapper2.StateRequired;
						num2 |= commandWrapper2.StateDisallowed;
					}
					long currentState = commandHost.GetCurrentState(num2);
					for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
					{
						CommandWrapper commandWrapper3 = list[k];
						if (!commandWrapper3.IsAllowed(currentState))
						{
							continue;
						}
						RoutedCommand command = commandWrapper3.Command;
						object keyboardParameter = GetKeyboardParameter(commandHost, command, e);
						bool lastCommandExecuted = _lastCommandExecuted;
						_lastCommandExecuted = false;
						try
						{
							command.Execute(keyboardParameter, commandHost as IInputElement);
							if (_lastCommandExecuted)
							{
								result = true;
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							_lastCommandExecuted = lastCommandExecuted;
						}
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			}
		}

		private static void OnCommand(object target, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (target is ICommandHost commandHost)
			{
				ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(args.Command, args.Parameter, args.OriginalSource);
				args.Handled = commandHost.Execute(executeCommandInfo) || executeCommandInfo.ForceHandled;
			}
			_lastCommandExecuted = args.Handled;
		}

		private static void OnQueryCommand(object target, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			ICommandHost commandHost = target as ICommandHost;
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = args.Command as RoutedCommand;
			if (commandHost != null && routedCommand != null)
			{
				if (IsCommandAllowed(commandHost, routedCommand, args.Parameter, args.OriginalSource, out var continueRouting, out var forceHandled))
				{
					args.CanExecute = true;
					args.Handled = true;
					args.ContinueRouting = continueRouting;
					return;
				}
				args.ContinueRouting = continueRouting;
				if (forceHandled)
				{
					args.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				args.CanExecute = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual object GetKeyboardParameter(ICommandHost commandHost, RoutedCommand command, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs keyArgs)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ExecuteCommandInfo
	{
		private ICommand _command;

		private object _parameter;

		private object _originalSource;

		private bool _continueRouting;

		private bool _forceHandled;

		public ICommand Command => _command;

		public RoutedCommand RoutedCommand => _command as RoutedCommand;

		public object Parameter => _parameter;

		public object OriginalSource => _originalSource;

		public bool ContinueRouting
		{

		private static bool IsMinimumStatePresent(ICommandHost host, long? hostState, RoutedCommand command, out bool forceHandled)
		{
			long num = -1L;
			long num2 = -1L;
			if (!(command is ICommandEx { MinimumStateRequired: var minimumStateRequired, MinimumStateDisallowed: var minimumStateDisallowed } commandEx))
			{
				forceHandled = false;
				return true;
			}
			forceHandled = commandEx.ForceHandled;
			long num3 = (hostState.HasValue ? hostState.Value : (host?.GetCurrentState(minimumStateRequired | minimumStateDisallowed) ?? 0));
			if ((num3 & minimumStateRequired) != minimumStateRequired)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((num3 & minimumStateDisallowed) != 0L)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

	[Obsolete("This class is obsolete. The System.Windows.Controls.BooleanToVisibilityConverter should be used instead.", true)]
	public class BoolToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is bool)
			{
				return BoolToVisibility((bool)value);
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is Visibility)
			{
				return VisibilityToBool((Visibility)value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool VisibilityToBool(Visibility v)
		{
			if (v == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Visibility BoolToVisibility(bool b)
		{
			if (b)
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}
	}
	[Obsolete("This class is obsolete. The Infragistics.Windows.Controls.NotBoolToVisibilityConverter should be used instead.", true)]
	public class NotBoolToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is bool)
			{
				return BoolToVisibility(!(bool)value);
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is Visibility)
			{
				return !VisibilityToBool((Visibility)value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool VisibilityToBool(Visibility v)
		{
			if (v == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Visibility BoolToVisibility(bool b)
		{
			if (b)
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}
	}

	public abstract class RecyclingItemsControlAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer, IListAutomationPeer
	{
		private Dictionary<object, RecycleableItemAutomationPeer> _itemPeers = new Dictionary<object, RecycleableItemAutomationPeer>();

		private System.Windows.Controls.Panel _itemsControlPanel;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Panel ItemsControlPanel
		{
			get
			{
				if (_itemsControlPanel == null)
				{
					_itemsControlPanel = FindPanel();
				}
				return _itemsControlPanel;
			}
		}

		UIElement IListAutomationPeer.Owner => base.Owner;

		System.Windows.Controls.Panel IListAutomationPeer.ItemsControlPanel => ItemsControlPanel;

		protected RecyclingItemsControlAutomationPeer(RecyclingItemsControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.List;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "RecyclingItemsControl";
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			ItemsControl itemsControl = (ItemsControl)base.Owner;
			List<AutomationPeer> childrenCoreBase = GetChildrenCoreBase(excludeItemElements: true);
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			Dictionary<object, RecycleableItemAutomationPeer> itemPeers = _itemPeers;
			_itemPeers = new Dictionary<object, RecycleableItemAutomationPeer>();
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)itemsControl.Items)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!itemPeers.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
				{
					value = CreateAutomationPeer(item);
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					AutomationPeer wrapperPeer = value.GetWrapperPeer();
					if (wrapperPeer != null)
					{
						wrapperPeer.EventsSource = value;
					}
				}
				list.Add(value);
				_itemPeers[item] = value;
			}
			if (childrenCoreBase != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(childrenCoreBase);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal DependencyObject ContainerFromItem(object item)
		{
			RecyclingItemsControl recyclingItemsControl = (RecyclingItemsControl)base.Owner;
			if (ItemsControlPanel is RecyclingItemsPanel { ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved: ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle })
			{
				return recyclingItemsControl.RecyclingItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item);
			}
			return recyclingItemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item);
		}

		protected abstract RecycleableItemAutomationPeer CreateAutomationPeer(object item);

		protected List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCoreBase(bool excludeItemElements)
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> childrenCore = base.GetChildrenCore();
			if (childrenCore != null && excludeItemElements)
			{
				for (int num = childrenCore.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					FrameworkElementAutomationPeer frameworkElementAutomationPeer = childrenCore[num] as FrameworkElementAutomationPeer;
					if (frameworkElementAutomationPeer != null && frameworkElementAutomationPeer.Owner is ScrollViewer)
					{
						List<AutomationPeer> children = childrenCore[num].GetChildren();
						if (children != null)
						{
							for (int num2 = children.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
							{
								if (children[num2] is FrameworkElementAutomationPeer frameworkElementAutomationPeer2)
								{
									if (frameworkElementAutomationPeer2.Owner is System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar)
									{
										children.RemoveAt(num2);
									}
									else if (ItemFromContainer(frameworkElementAutomationPeer2.Owner) != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
									{
										children.RemoveAt(num2);
									}
								}
							}
						}
						childrenCore.RemoveAt(num);
						if (children != null)
						{
							childrenCore.AddRange(children);
						}
					}
					else if (ItemFromContainer(frameworkElementAutomationPeer.Owner) != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
					{
						childrenCore.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
			return childrenCore;
		}

		protected internal object GetItemOrContainerFromContainer(DependencyObject container)
		{
			object obj = ItemFromContainer(container);
			if (obj == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue && ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(container) == base.Owner && ((RecyclingItemsControl)base.Owner).IsItemItsOwnContainerInternal(container))
			{
				obj = container;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected internal virtual RecycleableItemAutomationPeer GetItemPeer(object item)
		{
			RecycleableItemAutomationPeer value = null;
			if (_itemPeers != null)
			{
				_itemPeers.TryGetValue(item, out value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal object ItemFromContainer(DependencyObject container)
		{
			RecyclingItemsControl recyclingItemsControl = (RecyclingItemsControl)base.Owner;
			if (ItemsControlPanel is RecyclingItemsPanel { ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved: ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle })
			{
				return recyclingItemsControl.RecyclingItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(container);
			}
			return recyclingItemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(container);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnItemsSourceChanged(IEnumerable oldValue, IEnumerable newValue)
		{
		}

		private System.Windows.Controls.Panel FindPanel()
		{
			Utilities.DependencyObjectSearchCallback<System.Windows.Controls.Panel> callback = (System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel) => ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(panel) == base.Owner;
			return Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(base.Owner, allowSubclassOfType: true, callback, new Type[1] { typeof(ItemsControl) });
		}

		internal void OnItemsPanelChanged()
		{
			_itemsControlPanel = null;
		}

		AutomationPeer IListAutomationPeer.GetUnderlyingPeer(object item)
		{
			if (!(ContainerFromItem(item) is UIElement element))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(element);
		}

		DependencyObject IListAutomationPeer.ContainerFromItem(object item)
		{
			return ContainerFromItem(item);
		}

		object IListAutomationPeer.GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			return GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}
	}

		{
			XamTabControl xamTabControl = ((XamTabControlAutomationPeer)base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer).Owner as XamTabControl;
			xamTabControl?.ApplyTemplate();
			List<AutomationPeer> list = base.GetChildrenCore();
			if (xamTabControl != null && xamTabControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(base.Item) is TabItem { IsSelected: not false } && xamTabControl.IsMinimized)
			{
				ContentPresenter minimizedContentPresenter = xamTabControl.MinimizedContentPresenter;
				if (minimizedContentPresenter != null)

					List<AutomationPeer> children = new FrameworkElementAutomationPeer(minimizedContentPresenter).GetChildren();

					{
						if (list == null)
						{
							list = children;
						}
						else
						{
							list.AddRange(children);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

	public class ToolWindowAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer, ITransformProvider
	{
		bool ITransformProvider.CanMove => true;

		bool ITransformProvider.CanResize
		{
			get
			{
				ResizeMode resizeMode = ((ToolWindow)base.Owner).ResizeMode;
				if (resizeMode == ResizeMode.CanResize || resizeMode == ResizeMode.CanResizeWithGrip)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		bool ITransformProvider.CanRotate => false;

		public ToolWindowAutomationPeer(ToolWindow owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Custom;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "ToolWindow";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Transform)
			{
				if (!BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
				{
					return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
				}
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		void ITransformProvider.Move(double x, double y)
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			if (!((ITransformProvider)this).CanMove)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_CannotPerformAutomationOperation"));
			}
			ToolWindow toolWindow = base.Owner as ToolWindow;
			if (double.IsInfinity(x))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("x");
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(y))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("y");
			}
			toolWindow.Left = x;
			toolWindow.Top = y;
		}

		void ITransformProvider.Resize(double width, double height)
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			if (!((ITransformProvider)this).CanResize)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_CannotPerformAutomationOperation"));
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(width))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("width");
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(height))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("height");
			}
			ToolWindow toolWindow = base.Owner as ToolWindow;
			toolWindow.Width = width;
			toolWindow.Height = height;
		}

		void ITransformProvider.Rotate(double degrees)
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_CannotPerformAutomationOperation"));
		}
	}
	public class XamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer : RecyclingItemsControlAutomationPeer, ISelectionProvider
	{
		bool ISelectionProvider.CanSelectMultiple => false;

		bool ISelectionProvider.IsSelectionRequired => false;

		public XamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer(XamCarouselListBox listBox)
			: base(listBox)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "XamCarouselListBox";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			switch (patternInterface)
			{
			case PatternInterface.Scroll:
			{
				XamCarouselListBox xamCarouselListBox = (XamCarouselListBox)base.Owner;
				if (xamCarouselListBox != null && xamCarouselListBox.ScrollInfo != null && xamCarouselListBox.ScrollInfo.ScrollOwner != null)
				{
					AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(xamCarouselListBox.ScrollInfo.ScrollOwner);
					if (automationPeer != null && automationPeer is IScrollProvider)
					{
						automationPeer.EventsSource = this;
						return automationPeer;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			case PatternInterface.Selection:
				return this;
			default:
				return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
			}
		}

		protected override RecycleableItemAutomationPeer CreateAutomationPeer(object item)
		{
			return new CarouselListBoxItemAutomationPeer(item, this);
		}

		private void RaiseAutomationEvent(object item, AutomationEvents eventId)
		{
			GetItemPeer(item)?.RaiseAutomationEvent(eventId);
		}

		internal void RaiseIsSelectedChanged(DependencyObject container, bool isSelected)
		{
			object itemOrContainerFromContainer = GetItemOrContainerFromContainer(container);
			if (itemOrContainerFromContainer != null && GetItemPeer(itemOrContainerFromContainer) is CarouselListBoxItemAutomationPeer carouselListBoxItemAutomationPeer)
			{
				carouselListBoxItemAutomationPeer.RaisePropertyChangedEvent(SelectionItemPatternIdentifiers.IsSelectedProperty, !isSelected, isSelected);
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.SelectionPatternOnInvalidated) && !AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.SelectionItemPatternOnElementAddedToSelection) && !AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.SelectionItemPatternOnElementRemovedFromSelection) && !AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.SelectionItemPatternOnElementSelected))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (args.AddedItems.Count == 1)
			{
				RaiseAutomationEvent(args.AddedItems[0], AutomationEvents.SelectionItemPatternOnElementSelected);
				return;
			}
			if (args.AddedItems.Count + args.RemovedItems.Count > 20)
			{
				RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.SelectionPatternOnInvalidated);
				return;
			}
			foreach (object removedItem in args.RemovedItems)
			{
				RaiseAutomationEvent(removedItem, AutomationEvents.SelectionItemPatternOnElementRemovedFromSelection);
			}
			foreach (object addedItem in args.AddedItems)
			{
				RaiseAutomationEvent(addedItem, AutomationEvents.SelectionItemPatternOnElementAddedToSelection);
			}
		}

		IRawElementProviderSimple[] ISelectionProvider.GetSelection()
		{
			XamCarouselListBox xamCarouselListBox = (XamCarouselListBox)base.Owner;
			if (xamCarouselListBox.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				RecycleableItemAutomationPeer itemPeer = GetItemPeer(xamCarouselListBox.SelectedItem);
				if (itemPeer != null)
				{
					return new IRawElementProviderSimple[1] { ProviderFromPeer(itemPeer) };
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class CarouselListBoxItemAutomationPeer : RecycleableItemAutomationPeer, IScrollItemProvider, ISelectionItemProvider
	{
		private XamCarouselListBox List => (XamCarouselListBox)base.ListAutomationPeer.Owner;

		bool ISelectionItemProvider.IsSelected => base.Item == List.SelectedItem;

		IRawElementProviderSimple ISelectionItemProvider.SelectionContainer => ProviderFromPeer(base.ListAutomationPeer as AutomationPeer);

		public CarouselListBoxItemAutomationPeer(object item, XamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer listAutomationPeer)
			: base(item, listAutomationPeer)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "CarouselListBoxItem";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			return patternInterface switch
			{
				PatternInterface.SelectionItem => this, 
				PatternInterface.ScrollItem => this, 
				_ => base.GetPattern(patternInterface), 
			};
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.AddToSelection()
		{
			ThrowIfNotEnabled();
			if (base.ListAutomationPeer.GetPattern(PatternInterface.Selection) is ISelectionProvider { CanSelectMultiple: false } selectionProvider && selectionProvider.GetSelection() != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			List.SelectedItem = base.Item;
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.RemoveFromSelection()
		{
			ThrowIfNotEnabled();
			if (((ISelectionItemProvider)this).IsSelected)
			{
				List.SelectedItem = null;
			}
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.Select()
		{
			ThrowIfNotEnabled();
			List.SelectedItem = base.Item;
		}

		void IScrollItemProvider.ScrollIntoView()
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Panel itemsControlPanel = base.ListAutomationPeer.ItemsControlPanel;
			if (itemsControlPanel is XamCarouselPanel)
			{
				int itemIndex = List.Items.IndexOf(base.Item);
				((XamCarouselPanel)itemsControlPanel).EnsureItemIsVisible(itemIndex);
			}
		}
	}
	public class XamTabControlAutomationPeer : TabControlAutomationPeer, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		private ExpandCollapseState? _lastReturnedExpandState;

		ExpandCollapseState IExpandCollapseProvider.ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if (((XamTabControl)base.Owner).AllowMinimize)
				{
					if (((XamTabControl)base.Owner).IsMinimized)
					{
						_lastReturnedExpandState = ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
					}
					else
					{
						_lastReturnedExpandState = ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_lastReturnedExpandState = ExpandCollapseState.LeafNode;
				}
				return _lastReturnedExpandState.Value;
			}
		}

		public XamTabControlAutomationPeer(XamTabControl tabControl)
			: base(tabControl)
		{
		}

		protected override ItemAutomationPeer CreateItemAutomationPeer(object item)
		{
			return new TabItemExAutomationPeer(item, this);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = base.GetChildrenCore();
			XamTabControl tc = (XamTabControl)base.Owner;
			tc.ApplyTemplate();
			FrameworkElement headerArea = tc.HeaderArea;
			if (headerArea != null)
			{
				List<AutomationPeer> children = new FrameworkElementAutomationPeer(headerArea).GetChildren();
				if (children != null)
				{
					Predicate<AutomationPeer> match = delegate(AutomationPeer peer)
					{
						if (!(peer is UIElementAutomationPeer { Owner: var owner }))
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(owner) == tc)
						{
							return false;
						}
						return (!(owner is ScrollViewer scrollViewer) || scrollViewer.TemplatedParent != tc) ? true : false;
					};
					List<AutomationPeer> list2 = children.FindAll(match);
					if (list == null)
					{
						list = list2;
					}
					else
					{
						list.AddRange(list2);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "XamTabControl";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		internal void RaiseExpandCollapseStateChanged()
		{
			if (_lastReturnedExpandState.HasValue && AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.PropertyChanged))
			{
				ExpandCollapseState expandCollapseState = ((IExpandCollapseProvider)this).ExpandCollapseState;
				if (expandCollapseState != _lastReturnedExpandState.Value)
				{
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, _lastReturnedExpandState.Value, expandCollapseState);
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyEnabled()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			if (!((XamTabControl)base.Owner).AllowMinimize)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Collapse()
		{
			VerifyEnabled();
			((XamTabControl)base.Owner).IsMinimized = true;
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Expand()
		{
			VerifyEnabled();
			((XamTabControl)base.Owner).IsMinimized = false;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Windows.Controls

	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class AutoDisabledImage : System.Windows.Controls.Image
	{
		private delegate void MethodInvoker();

		private ImageSource _lastImageSource;

		private bool _lastImageSourceHadNullBaseUri;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DisabledSourceProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		public ImageSource DisabledSource
		{
			get
			{
				return (ImageSource)GetValue(DisabledSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DisabledSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static AutoDisabledImage()
		{
			DisabledSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DisabledSource", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(AutoDisabledImage), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnDisabledSourceChanged));
			System.Windows.Controls.Image.SourceProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(AutoDisabledImage), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnSourceChanged, CoerceSource));
			UIElement.IsEnabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(AutoDisabledImage), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnIsEnabledChanged));
			UIElement.OpacityMaskProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(AutoDisabledImage), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceOpacityMask));
			UIElement.OpacityProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(AutoDisabledImage), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceOpacity));
		}

		private static void OnDisabledSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (false.Equals(d.GetValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty)))
			{
				((AutoDisabledImage)d).VerifySource();
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceOpacity(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			AutoDisabledImage autoDisabledImage = d as AutoDisabledImage;
			if (autoDisabledImage.IsInitialized && !autoDisabledImage.IsEnabled && autoDisabledImage.DisabledSource == null)
			{
				return 0.5;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static object CoerceOpacityMask(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			AutoDisabledImage autoDisabledImage = d as AutoDisabledImage;
			if (autoDisabledImage.IsInitialized && newValue == null && autoDisabledImage._lastImageSource != null && autoDisabledImage.DisabledSource == null && !autoDisabledImage.IsEnabled)
			{
				return new ImageBrush(autoDisabledImage._lastImageSource);
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static object CoerceSource(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			AutoDisabledImage autoDisabledImage = d as AutoDisabledImage;
			autoDisabledImage._lastImageSource = newValue as ImageSource;
			autoDisabledImage._lastImageSourceHadNullBaseUri = newValue is IUriContext && ((IUriContext)newValue).BaseUri == null;
			if (autoDisabledImage.IsInitialized && !autoDisabledImage.IsEnabled)
			{
				object disabledSource = autoDisabledImage.DisabledSource;
				if (disabledSource != null)
				{
					return disabledSource;
				}
				if (newValue is BitmapSource bitmapSource)
				{
					try
					{
						FormatConvertedBitmap formatConvertedBitmap = new FormatConvertedBitmap(bitmapSource, PixelFormats.Gray32Float, null, 1.0);
						if (bitmapSource.IsFrozen && formatConvertedBitmap.CanFreeze)
						{
							formatConvertedBitmap.Freeze();
						}
						return formatConvertedBitmap;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static void OnIsEnabledChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			AutoDisabledImage autoDisabledImage = d as AutoDisabledImage;
			if (autoDisabledImage.IsInitialized)
			{
				autoDisabledImage.VerifySource();
			}
		}

		private static void OnSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			AutoDisabledImage autoDisabledImage = d as AutoDisabledImage;
			bool flag = e.NewValue is IUriContext && ((IUriContext)e.NewValue).BaseUri == null;
			if (autoDisabledImage._lastImageSource == e.NewValue && flag != autoDisabledImage._lastImageSourceHadNullBaseUri && !autoDisabledImage.IsEnabled)
			{
				autoDisabledImage.CoerceValue(System.Windows.Controls.Image.SourceProperty);
			}
			autoDisabledImage.CoerceValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
			autoDisabledImage.CoerceValue(UIElement.OpacityMaskProperty);
		}

		private void VerifySource()
		{
			CoerceValue(System.Windows.Controls.Image.SourceProperty);
			CoerceValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			if (ReportSection.GetIsInReport(this))
			{
				VerifySource();
			}
			else
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Render, new MethodInvoker(VerifySource));
			}
		}
	}

	public class BoolConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		protected object trueValue = KnownBoxes.TrueBox;

		protected object falseValue = KnownBoxes.FalseBox;

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is bool && (bool)value)
			{
				return trueValue;
			}
			return falseValue;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (object.Equals(trueValue, value))
			{
				return KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
			}
			return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
		}
	}
	public class BoolToValueConverter : BoolConverter
	{
		public object FalseConvertValue
		{
			get
			{
				return falseValue;
			}
			set
			{
				falseValue = value;
			}
		}

		public object TrueConvertValue
		{
			get
			{
				return trueValue;
			}
			set
			{
				trueValue = value;
			}
		}
	}
	public class BoolToHiddenConverter : BoolConverter
	{
		public BoolToHiddenConverter()
		{
			trueValue = KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox;
			falseValue = KnownBoxes.VisibilityHiddenBox;
		}
	}
	public class NotBoolToVisibilityConverter : BoolConverter
	{
		public NotBoolToVisibilityConverter()
		{
			trueValue = KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox;
			falseValue = KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox;
		}
	}
	public class NullToFalseConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || (value is string && ((string)value).Length <= 0))
			{
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}
			return KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
		}
	}
	public class NullToParameterConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private static bool IsNullOrEmptyString(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (value is string)
				{
					return ((string)value).Length == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!IsNullOrEmptyString(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return parameter;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
		}
	}
	public class TypeCheckConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private bool _allowDerivedTypes = true;

		public bool AllowDerivedTypes
		{
			get
			{
				return _allowDerivedTypes;
			}
			set
			{
				_allowDerivedTypes = value;
			}
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Type type = parameter as Type;
			if (value == null || !(null != type) || !(_allowDerivedTypes ? type.IsInstanceOfType(value) : (type == value.GetType())))
			{
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}
			return KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
		}
	}
	public class VisibilityToBooleanConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Visibility? visibility = (Visibility)value;
			if (visibility.HasValue && visibility.Value == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				return KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
			}
			return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			bool? flag = (bool)value;
			if (flag.HasValue && flag.Value)
			{
				return KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox;
			}
			return KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox;
		}
	}

	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class CardPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			UIElementCollection children = base.Children;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = children.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = children[i];
				uIElement.Measure(availableSize);
				System.Windows.Size desiredSize = uIElement.DesiredSize;
				if (desiredSize.Width > num)
				{
					num = desiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (desiredSize.Height > num2)
				{
					num2 = desiredSize.Height;
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			UIElementCollection children = base.Children;
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(finalSize);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = children.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				children[i].Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

		{
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property != VersionProperty && !DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				SetValue(VersionPropertyKey, Version + 1);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void Reset()
		{
			ResetAutoScaleItemContentsToFit();
			ResetCarouselPanelNavigatorStyle();
			ResetHeightInInfiniteContainers();
			ResetIsListContinuous();
			ResetIsNavigatorVisible();
			ResetItemHorizontalScrollBarVisibility();
			ResetItemPath();
			ResetItemPathAutoPad();
			ResetItemPathHorizontalAlignment();
			ResetItemPathPadding();
			ResetItemPathPrefixPercent();
			ResetItemPathRenderBrush();
			ResetItemPathRenderPen();
			ResetItemPathStretch();
			ResetItemPathSuffixPercent();
			ResetItemPathVerticalAlignment();
			ResetItemSize();
			ResetItemsPerPage();
			ResetItemTransitionStyle();
			ResetItemVerticalScrollBarVisibility();
			ResetOpacityEffectStopDirection();
			ResetOpacityEffectStops();
			ResetReserveSpaceForReflections();
			ResetRotateItemsWithPathTangent();
			ResetScalingEffectStops();
			ResetScalingEffectStopDirection();
			ResetShouldAnimateItemsOnListChange();
			ResetShouldScrollItemsIntoInitialPosition();
			ResetSkewAngleXEffectStops();
			ResetSkewAngleXEffectStopDirection();
			ResetSkewAngleYEffectStops();
			ResetSkewAngleYEffectStopDirection();
			ResetUseOpacity();
			ResetUseScaling();
			ResetUseSkewing();
			ResetUseZOrder();
			ResetWidthInInfiniteContainers();
			ResetZOrderEffectStopDirection();
			ResetZOrderEffectStops();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAutoScaleItemContentsToFit() && !ShouldSerializeCarouselPanelNavigatorStyle() && !ShouldSerializeHeightInInfiniteContainers() && !ShouldSerializeIsListContinuous() && !ShouldSerializeIsNavigatorVisible() && !ShouldSerializeItemHorizontalScrollBarVisibility() && !ShouldSerializeItemPath() && !ShouldSerializeItemPathAutoPad() && !ShouldSerializeItemPathHorizontalAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeItemPathPadding() && !ShouldSerializeItemPathPrefixPercent() && !ShouldSerializeItemPathRenderBrush() && !ShouldSerializeItemPathRenderPen() && !ShouldSerializeItemPathStretch() && !ShouldSerializeItemPathSuffixPercent() && !ShouldSerializeItemPathVerticalAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeItemSize() && !ShouldSerializeItemsPerPage() && !ShouldSerializeItemTransitionStyle() && !ShouldSerializeItemVerticalScrollBarVisibility() && !ShouldSerializeOpacityEffectStopDirection() && !ShouldSerializeOpacityEffectStops() && !ShouldSerializeReserveSpaceForReflections() && !ShouldSerializeRotateItemsWithPathTangent() && !ShouldSerializeScalingEffectStopDirection() && !ShouldSerializeScalingEffectStops() && !ShouldSerializeShouldAnimateItemsOnListChange() && !ShouldSerializeShouldScrollItemsIntoInitialPosition() && !ShouldSerializeSkewAngleXEffectStopDirection() && !ShouldSerializeSkewAngleXEffectStops() && !ShouldSerializeSkewAngleYEffectStopDirection() && !ShouldSerializeSkewAngleYEffectStops() && !ShouldSerializeUseOpacity() && !ShouldSerializeUseScaling() && !ShouldSerializeUseSkewing() && !ShouldSerializeUseZOrder() && !ShouldSerializeWidthInInfiniteContainers() && !ShouldSerializeZOrderEffectStopDirection())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeZOrderEffectStops();
			}

		internal void EnumeratePropertiesWithNonDefaultValues(PropertyChangedEventHandler callback)
		{
			LocalValueEnumerator localValueEnumerator = GetLocalValueEnumerator();
			while (localValueEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				LocalValueEntry current = localValueEnumerator.Current;
				if (!object.Equals(current.Property.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue, current.Value))
				{
					callback(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(current.Property.Name));
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool ValidatePositiveDouble(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is double))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN((double)value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !((double)value <= 0.0);
		}
	}
	public interface IFilterEvaluator
	{
		bool? Evaluate(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, ref object lhs, ref object rhs, ConditionEvaluationContext context);
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class GrowOnlyDecorator : Decorator
	{
		private System.Windows.Size _lastDesiredSize;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GrowHeightProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GrowHeight", typeof(bool), typeof(GrowOnlyDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GrowWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GrowWidth", typeof(bool), typeof(GrowOnlyDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ResetSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ResetSize", typeof(bool), typeof(GrowOnlyDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None));

		[Bindable(true)]
		public bool GrowHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(GrowHeightProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GrowHeightProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public bool GrowWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(GrowWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GrowWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(false)]
		public bool ResetSize
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ResetSizeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ResetSizeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			if (ResetSize)
			{
				ResetSize = false;
				_lastDesiredSize = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			if (GrowWidth)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(_lastDesiredSize.Width) && (double.IsNaN(result.Width) || result.Width < _lastDesiredSize.Width))
				{
					result.Width = _lastDesiredSize.Width;
				}
				_lastDesiredSize.Width = result.Width;
			}
			if (GrowHeight)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(_lastDesiredSize.Height) && (double.IsNaN(result.Height) || result.Height < _lastDesiredSize.Height))
				{
					result.Height = _lastDesiredSize.Height;
				}
				_lastDesiredSize.Height = result.Height;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public static class ClippedTextToolTipService
	{
		private class FEClass : FrameworkElement
		{
			internal static DependencyProperty DefaultStyleKeyPropertyInternal = FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty;
		}

		private class ObjectToTextFilterConverter : IValueConverter
		{
			internal static readonly IValueConverter Instance = new ObjectToTextFilterConverter();

			private ObjectToTextFilterConverter()
			{
			}

			object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (value is ContentElement || value is Visual || value is Visual3D)
				{
					return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
				}
				if (value is DependencyObject && LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)value) != null)
				{
					return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
				}
				return value;
			}

			object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
			}
		}

		private static object ServiceToolTipId;

		private static bool UsingFindToolTipEvent;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowToolTipWhenClippedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AncestorTypeForToolTipProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ToolTipStyleKeyProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty ToolTipSourceProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty ToolTipTargetProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty CurrentToolTipOfTargetProperty;

		static ClippedTextToolTipService()
		{
			ServiceToolTipId = new object();
			ShowToolTipWhenClippedProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ShowToolTipWhenClipped", typeof(bool), typeof(ClippedTextToolTipService), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnShowToolTipWhenClippedChanged, CoerceCanApplyPropertyToDependencyObject));
			AncestorTypeForToolTipProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("AncestorTypeForToolTip", typeof(Type), typeof(ClippedTextToolTipService), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnAncestorTypeForToolTipChanged, CoerceCanApplyPropertyToDependencyObject));
			ToolTipStyleKeyProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ToolTipStyleKey", typeof(ResourceKey), typeof(ClippedTextToolTipService), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnToolTipStyleKeyChanged, CoerceCanApplyPropertyToDependencyObject));
			ToolTipSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ToolTipSource", typeof(UIElement), typeof(ClippedTextToolTipService), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ToolTipTargetProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ToolTipTarget", typeof(UIElement), typeof(ClippedTextToolTipService), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			CurrentToolTipOfTargetProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("CurrentToolTipOfTarget", typeof(object), typeof(ClippedTextToolTipService), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnCurrentToolTipOfTargetChanged));
			RoutedEvent[] routedEventsForOwner = EventManager.GetRoutedEventsForOwner(typeof(ToolTipService));
			if (routedEventsForOwner != null)
			{
				RoutedEvent[] array = routedEventsForOwner;
				foreach (RoutedEvent routedEvent in array)
				{
					if (routedEvent.Name == "FindToolTip")
					{
						EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(FrameworkElement), routedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnFindToolTip));
						UsingFindToolTipEvent = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!UsingFindToolTipEvent)
			{
				EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(FrameworkElement), ToolTipService.ToolTipOpeningEvent, new ToolTipEventHandler(OnToolTipOpening));
			}
		}

		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(TextBlock))]
		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(ContentPresenter))]
		public static bool GetShowToolTipWhenClipped(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(ShowToolTipWhenClippedProperty);
		}

		public static void SetShowToolTipWhenClipped(DependencyObject d, bool value)
		{
			d.SetValue(ShowToolTipWhenClippedProperty, value);
		}

		public static Type GetAncestorTypeForToolTip(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (Type)d.GetValue(AncestorTypeForToolTipProperty);
		}

		public static void SetAncestorTypeForToolTip(DependencyObject d, Type value)
		{
			d.SetValue(AncestorTypeForToolTipProperty, value);
		}

		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(TextBlock))]
		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(ContentPresenter))]
		public static ResourceKey GetToolTipStyleKey(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (ResourceKey)d.GetValue(ToolTipStyleKeyProperty);
		}

		public static void SetToolTipStyleKey(DependencyObject d, ResourceKey value)
		{
			d.SetValue(ToolTipStyleKeyProperty, value);
		}

		private static UIElement GetToolTipSource(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (UIElement)d.GetValue(ToolTipSourceProperty);
		}

		private static void SetToolTipSource(DependencyObject d, UIElement value)
		{
			d.SetValue(ToolTipSourceProperty, value);
		}

		private static UIElement GetToolTipTarget(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (UIElement)d.GetValue(ToolTipTargetProperty);
		}

		private static void SetToolTipTarget(DependencyObject d, UIElement value)
		{
			d.SetValue(ToolTipTargetProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnCurrentToolTipOfTargetChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsServiceToolTip(e.NewValue))
			{
				d.SetValue(ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			else if (IsServiceToolTip(e.OldValue))
			{
				d.ClearValue(ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty);
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceCanApplyPropertyToDependencyObject(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			if (!(d is TextBlock) && !(d is ContentPresenter))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_CannotSetClippedTextToolTipService"));
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static bool HasServiceToolTip(DependencyObject toolTipTarget)
		{
			if (toolTipTarget != null)
			{
				return IsServiceToolTip(toolTipTarget.GetValue(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty));
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsServiceToolTip(object tooltip)
		{
			if (tooltip is System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip toolTip)
			{
				return toolTip.Tag == ServiceToolTipId;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsToolTipNeeded(FrameworkElement toolTipSource)
		{
			TextBlock textBlock = toolTipSource as TextBlock;
			if (textBlock == null && toolTipSource is ContentPresenter reference && VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(reference) == 1)
			{
				DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(reference, 0);
				textBlock = ((!(child is AccessText) || VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(child) != 1) ? (child as TextBlock) : (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(child, 0) as TextBlock));
			}
			return IsToolTipNeeded(textBlock);
		}

		private static bool IsToolTipNeeded(TextBlock tb)
		{
			if (tb == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			Rect rect;
			Rect rect2;
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(tb) == 0 || tb.ContentStart == null || tb.ContentEnd == null)
			{
				rect = (rect2 = Rect.Empty);
			}
			else
			{
				rect = tb.ContentStart.DocumentStart.GetCharacterRect(tb.ContentStart.LogicalDirection);
				rect2 = tb.ContentEnd.DocumentEnd.GetCharacterRect(tb.ContentEnd.LogicalDirection);
			}
			if (!rect.IsEmpty && !rect2.IsEmpty)
			{
				Rect rect3 = Rect.Union(rect, rect2);
				System.Windows.Size size = LayoutInformation.GetLayoutSlot(tb).Size;
				Thickness margin = tb.Margin;
				rect3.Width = Math.Max(0.0, rect3.Width + margin.Left + margin.Right);
				rect3.Height = Math.Max(0.0, rect3.Height + margin.Top + margin.Bottom);
				if ((!CoreUtilities.AreClose(rect3.Width, size.Width) && rect3.Width > size.Width) || (!CoreUtilities.AreClose(rect3.Height, size.Height) && rect3.Height > size.Height))
				{
					result = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				tb.UpdateLayout();
				if (LayoutInformation.GetLayoutClip(tb) != null)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				else
				{
					try
					{
						AccessText accessText = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(tb) as AccessText;
						FrameworkElement element = (FrameworkElement)(((object)accessText) ?? ((object)tb));
						string textToFormat = ((accessText != null) ? accessText.Text : tb.Text);
						CultureInfo nonNeutralCulture = Utilities.GetNonNeutralCulture(element);
						Typeface typeface = new Typeface(tb.FontFamily, tb.FontStyle, tb.FontWeight, tb.FontStretch);
						FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(textToFormat, nonNeutralCulture, tb.FlowDirection, typeface, tb.FontSize, tb.Foreground);
						formattedText.MaxTextWidth = tb.ActualWidth;
						formattedText.Trimming = TextTrimming.None;
						if (formattedText.Height > tb.ActualHeight)
						{
							result = true;
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void InitializeToolTip(DependencyObject toolTipSource)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip toolTip = new System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip();
			DependencyProperty dp = ((toolTipSource is TextBlock) ? TextBlock.TextProperty : ContentPresenter.ContentProperty);
			toolTip.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(dp, BindingMode.OneWay, toolTipSource, ObjectToTextFilterConverter.Instance));
			toolTip.Tag = ServiceToolTipId;
			if (toolTipSource.GetValue(ToolTipStyleKeyProperty) is ResourceKey resourceKey)
			{
				toolTip.SetResourceReference(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, resourceKey);
				toolTip.SetValue(FEClass.DefaultStyleKeyPropertyInternal, resourceKey);
			}
			Type type = toolTipSource.GetValue(AncestorTypeForToolTipProperty) as Type;
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = null;
			if (type != null)
			{
				dependencyObject = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(toolTipSource, type, allowSubclassOfType: true);
			}
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				dependencyObject = toolTipSource;
			}
			dependencyObject.SetValue(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty, toolTip);
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(dependencyObject, CurrentToolTipOfTargetProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{
				Source = dependencyObject,
				Path = new PropertyPath(ToolTipService.ToolTipProperty)
			});
			if (dependencyObject != toolTipSource)
			{
				GetToolTipSource(dependencyObject)?.ClearValue(ToolTipTargetProperty);
				dependencyObject.SetValue(ToolTipSourceProperty, toolTipSource);
				toolTipSource.SetValue(ToolTipTargetProperty, dependencyObject);
			}
		}

		private static void OnShowToolTipWhenClippedChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = d as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement is TextBlock || frameworkElement is ContentPresenter)
			{
				if (!(bool)e.NewValue)
				{
					RemoveToolTip(frameworkElement);
				}
				else if (!UsingFindToolTipEvent || GetAncestorTypeForToolTip(d) != null)
				{
					InitializeToolTip(frameworkElement);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnAncestorTypeForToolTipChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = GetToolTipTarget(d);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = d as FrameworkElement;
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				dependencyObject = frameworkElement;
			}
			if (dependencyObject.GetValue(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty) is System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip toolTip)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = null;
				if (e.NewValue != null)
				{
					dependencyObject2 = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(frameworkElement, (Type)e.NewValue, allowSubclassOfType: true);
				}
				if (dependencyObject2 == null)
				{
					dependencyObject2 = frameworkElement;
				}
				bool flag = toolTip.Tag == ServiceToolTipId;
				if (dependencyObject2 != dependencyObject)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						dependencyObject.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty);
					}
					dependencyObject.ClearValue(CurrentToolTipOfTargetProperty);
					dependencyObject.ClearValue(ToolTipSourceProperty);
					if (dependencyObject2 != frameworkElement)
					{
						dependencyObject2.SetValue(ToolTipSourceProperty, frameworkElement);
						frameworkElement.SetValue(ToolTipTargetProperty, dependencyObject2);
					}
					else
					{
						frameworkElement.ClearValue(ToolTipTargetProperty);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						dependencyObject2.SetValue(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty, toolTip);
						BindingOperations.SetBinding(dependencyObject2, CurrentToolTipOfTargetProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding
						{
							Source = dependencyObject2,
							Path = new PropertyPath(ToolTipService.ToolTipProperty)
						});
					}
				}
			}
			else if (GetShowToolTipWhenClipped(frameworkElement) && e.NewValue != null)
			{
				InitializeToolTip(frameworkElement);
			}
		}

		private static void OnFindToolTip(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is DependencyObject dependencyObject))
			{
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (dependencyObject.GetValue(ToolTipSourceProperty) ?? dependencyObject) as FrameworkElement;
			if ((!(frameworkElement is TextBlock) && !(frameworkElement is ContentPresenter)) || !GetShowToolTipWhenClipped(frameworkElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = frameworkElement.GetValue(ToolTipTargetProperty) as FrameworkElement;
			if (!SkipTarget(frameworkElement2 ?? dependencyObject) && IsToolTipNeeded(frameworkElement))
			{
				if (HasServiceToolTip(dependencyObject))
				{
					dependencyObject.SetValue(ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
				else
				{
					InitializeToolTip(frameworkElement);
				}
			}
			else if (HasServiceToolTip(dependencyObject))
			{
				dependencyObject.SetValue(ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			}
		}

		private static void OnToolTipOpening(object sender, ToolTipEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is DependencyObject dependencyObject && (dependencyObject.GetValue(ToolTipSourceProperty) ?? dependencyObject) is FrameworkElement frameworkElement && (bool)frameworkElement.GetValue(ShowToolTipWhenClippedProperty) && !IsToolTipNeeded(frameworkElement))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static void OnToolTipStyleKeyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = GetToolTipTarget(d);
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				dependencyObject = d;
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject.GetValue(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty) is System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip toolTip && toolTip.Tag == ServiceToolTipId)
			{
				if (e.NewValue == null)
				{
					toolTip.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
					toolTip.ClearValue(FEClass.DefaultStyleKeyPropertyInternal);
				}
				else if (e.NewValue is Style)
				{
					toolTip.SetValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, e.NewValue);
					toolTip.ClearValue(FEClass.DefaultStyleKeyPropertyInternal);
				}
				else
				{
					toolTip.SetResourceReference(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, e.NewValue);
					toolTip.SetValue(FEClass.DefaultStyleKeyPropertyInternal, e.NewValue);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RemoveToolTip(DependencyObject toolTipSource)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = GetToolTipTarget(toolTipSource);
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				dependencyObject.ClearValue(ToolTipSourceProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				dependencyObject = toolTipSource;
			}
			if (dependencyObject.GetValue(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty) is System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip toolTip && toolTip.Tag == ServiceToolTipId)
			{
				dependencyObject.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty);
			}
			dependencyObject.ClearValue(CurrentToolTipOfTargetProperty);
			toolTipSource.ClearValue(ToolTipTargetProperty);
		}

		private static bool SkipTarget(DependencyObject d)
		{
			object obj = d.ReadLocalValue(ToolTipService.ToolTipProperty);
			if (obj != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				return !IsServiceToolTip(obj);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class DesiredSizeDecorator : Decorator
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ChildDesiredHeightPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ChildDesiredHeight", typeof(double), typeof(DesiredSizeDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChildDesiredHeightProperty = ChildDesiredHeightPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ChildDesiredWidthPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ChildDesiredWidth", typeof(double), typeof(DesiredSizeDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChildDesiredWidthProperty = ChildDesiredWidthPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public double ChildDesiredHeight => (double)GetValue(ChildDesiredHeightProperty);

		[Bindable(true)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public double ChildDesiredWidth => (double)GetValue(ChildDesiredWidthProperty);

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			SetValue(ChildDesiredHeightPropertyKey, result.Height);
			SetValue(ChildDesiredWidthPropertyKey, result.Width);
			return result;
		}
	}
	public enum DropLocation
	{
		None,
		AboveTarget,
		BelowTarget,
		LeftOfTarget,
		RightOfTarget,
		OverTarget
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class DropIndicator : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		private bool _wasInitializeEventRaised;

		public static readonly RoutedEvent DropTargetInitializeEvent;

		public static readonly RoutedEvent DropTargetEnterEvent;

		public static readonly RoutedEvent DropTargetLeaveEvent;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DropLocationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DropTargetHeightProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DropTargetWidthProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey OrientationPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public DropLocation? DropLocation
		{
			get
			{
				return (DropLocation?)GetValue(DropLocationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DropLocationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public double DropTargetHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(DropTargetHeightProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DropTargetHeightProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public double DropTargetWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(DropTargetWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DropTargetWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public System.Windows.Controls.Orientation? Orientation => (System.Windows.Controls.Orientation?)GetValue(OrientationProperty);

		public event EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs> DropTargetInitialize
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(DropTargetInitializeEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(DropTargetInitializeEvent, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs> DropTargetEnter
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(DropTargetEnterEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(DropTargetEnterEvent, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs> DropTargetLeave
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(DropTargetLeaveEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(DropTargetLeaveEvent, value);
			}
		}

		static DropIndicator()
		{
			DropTargetInitializeEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("DropTargetInitialize", RoutingStrategy.Direct, typeof(EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs>), typeof(DropIndicator));
			DropTargetEnterEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("DropTargetEnter", RoutingStrategy.Direct, typeof(EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs>), typeof(DropIndicator));
			DropTargetLeaveEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("DropTargetLeave", RoutingStrategy.Direct, typeof(EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs>), typeof(DropIndicator));
			DropLocationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DropLocation", typeof(DropLocation?), typeof(DropIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnDropLocationChanged));
			DropTargetHeightProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DropTargetHeight", typeof(double), typeof(DropIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN));
			DropTargetWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DropTargetWidth", typeof(double), typeof(DropIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN));
			OrientationPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Orientation", typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation?), typeof(DropIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			OrientationProperty = OrientationPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(DropIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(DropIndicator)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(DropIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
		}

		protected virtual void OnDropTargetInitialize(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseDropTargetInitialize(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = DropTargetInitializeEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnDropTargetInitialize(args);
			_wasInitializeEventRaised = true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnDropTargetEnter(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseDropTargetEnter(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = DropTargetEnterEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnDropTargetEnter(args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDropTargetLeave(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseDropTargetLeave(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = DropTargetLeaveEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnDropTargetLeave(args);
		}

		private static void OnDropLocationChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DropLocation? dropLocation = (DropLocation?)e.NewValue;
			System.Windows.Controls.Orientation? orientation = null;
			if (dropLocation.HasValue)
			{
				DropLocation value = dropLocation.Value;
				if (Infragistics.Windows.Controls.DropLocation.AboveTarget == value || Infragistics.Windows.Controls.DropLocation.BelowTarget == value)
				{
					orientation = System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal;
				}
				else if (Infragistics.Windows.Controls.DropLocation.LeftOfTarget == value || Infragistics.Windows.Controls.DropLocation.RightOfTarget == value)
				{
					orientation = System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical;
				}
			}
			dependencyObject.SetValue(OrientationPropertyKey, orientation);
			if (!(dependencyObject is DropIndicator { IsLoaded: not false } dropIndicator))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!dropIndicator._wasInitializeEventRaised)
			{
				dropIndicator.RaiseDropTargetInitialize(new RoutedEventArgs());
				if (!dropLocation.HasValue)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!dropLocation.HasValue || dropLocation.Value == Infragistics.Windows.Controls.DropLocation.None)
			{
				dropIndicator.RaiseDropTargetLeave(new RoutedEventArgs());
			}
			else
			{
				dropIndicator.RaiseDropTargetEnter(new RoutedEventArgs());
			}
		}
	}
