	public class ComparisonCondition : ICondition, ICloneable
	{
		internal class SerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
		{
			private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

			public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
			{
				get
				{
					if (_props == null)
					{
						_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[2]
						{
							new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(ComparisonOperator), "Operator"),
							new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(object), "Value")
						};
					}
					return _props;
				}
			}

			public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
			{
				ComparisonCondition comparisonCondition = (ComparisonCondition)obj;
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
				dictionary["Operator"] = comparisonCondition.Operator;
				object obj2 = comparisonCondition.Value;
				if (obj2 is SpecialFilterOperandBase)
				{
					obj2 = SpecialFilterOperands.GetSerializationValue((SpecialFilterOperandBase)obj2);
				}
				dictionary["Value"] = obj2;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(comparisonCondition._displayText))
				{
					dictionary["DisplayText"] = comparisonCondition._displayText;
				}
				return dictionary;
			}

			public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
			{
				if (values.TryGetValue("Operator", out var value) && values.TryGetValue("Value", out var value2))
				{
					values.TryGetValue("DisplayText", out var value3);
					return new ComparisonCondition((ComparisonOperator)value, value2, value3 as string);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private class InOperatorCache
		{
			internal object _lastValue;

			internal SpecialFilterOperandFactory.InOperand _cachedInOperand;
		}

		private ComparisonOperator _comparisonOperator;

		private object _value;

		private string _displayText;

		private Regex _cachedRegex;

		private string _cachedRegex_Pattern;

		private bool _cachedRegex_IgnoreCase;

		private SpecialFilterOperandBase _topValuesOperand;

		private ComparisonOperator _topValuesOperand_Operator;

		private double _topValuesOperand_Number;

		private Type _lastConversionType;

		private object _lastConversionSourceValue;

		private object _lastConvertedValue;

		private object _lastConversionToStringSourceValue;

		private object _lastConvertedToStringValue;

		private InOperatorCache _inOperatorCache;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<ComparisonOperatorFlags, ComparisonOperator[]> _operatorTable;

		public string DisplayText
		{
			get
			{
				return _displayText;
			}
			set
			{
				_displayText = value;
			}
		}

		public ComparisonOperator Operator
		{
			get
			{
				return _comparisonOperator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_comparisonOperator != value)
				{
					Utilities.ThrowIfInvalidEnum(value, "Operator");
					_comparisonOperator = value;
					ClearCache();
				}
			}
		}

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_value != value)
				{
					ValidateValueHelper(_comparisonOperator, value);
					_value = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ComparisonCondition()
		{
		}

		public ComparisonCondition(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value)
			: this(comparisonOperator, value, null)
		{
		}

		public ComparisonCondition(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, string displayText)
		{
			ValidateValueHelper(comparisonOperator, value);
			Operator = comparisonOperator;
			_value = value;
			_displayText = displayText;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ComparisonCondition comparisonCondition && comparisonCondition._comparisonOperator == _comparisonOperator)
			{
				return object.Equals(comparisonCondition._value, _value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = _comparisonOperator.GetHashCode();
			if (_value != null)
			{
				num |= _value.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_displayText))
			{
				return _displayText;
			}
			object value = Value;
			return SR.GetString("ComparisonCondition_" + Operator, value);
		}

		public static ComparisonCondition Create(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object operand, bool validateOperand, out Exception error)
		{
			return Create(comparisonOperator, operand, null, validateOperand, out error);
		}

		public static ComparisonCondition Create(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object operand, string displayText, bool validateOperand, out Exception error)
		{
			error = null;
			if (validateOperand && !ValidateValueHelper(comparisonOperator, operand, null, null, out error))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ComparisonCondition comparisonCondition = new ComparisonCondition();
			comparisonCondition._comparisonOperator = comparisonOperator;
			comparisonCondition._value = operand;
			comparisonCondition._displayText = displayText;
			return comparisonCondition;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return new ComparisonCondition(_comparisonOperator, _value, _displayText);
		}

		public static ComparisonOperatorFlags GetComparisonOperatorFlag(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator)
		{
			return (ComparisonOperatorFlags)(1 << (int)comparisonOperator);
		}

		public static ComparisonOperator[] GetComparisonOperators(ComparisonOperatorFlags flags)
		{
			if (_operatorTable == null)
			{
				_operatorTable = new Dictionary<ComparisonOperatorFlags, ComparisonOperator[]>();
			}
			if (!_operatorTable.TryGetValue(flags, out var value))
			{
				value = (_operatorTable[flags] = GetComparisonOperatorsImpl(flags));
			}
			return (ComparisonOperator[])value.Clone();
		}

		private static ComparisonOperator[] GetComparisonOperatorsImpl(ComparisonOperatorFlags flags)
		{
			List<ComparisonOperator> list = new List<ComparisonOperator>();
			for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
			{
				int num = 1 << i;
				if (((uint)num & (uint)flags) != 0 && Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ComparisonOperator), i))
				{
					list.Add((ComparisonOperator)i);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static ComparisonOperatorFlags GetCompatibleComparisonOperators(Type dataType, out ComparisonOperator defaultUIOperator)
		{
			ComparisonOperator[] prioritizedDefaultUIOperators;
			return GetCompatibleComparisonOperators(dataType, out defaultUIOperator, out prioritizedDefaultUIOperators);
		}

		private static ComparisonOperatorFlags GetCompatibleComparisonOperators(Type dataType, out ComparisonOperator defaultUIOperator, out ComparisonOperator[] prioritizedDefaultUIOperators)
		{
			Type underlyingType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(dataType);
			bool flag = Utilities.IsNumericType(underlyingType);
			ComparisonOperatorFlags comparisonOperatorFlags = ComparisonOperatorFlags.None;
			if (flag || typeof(DateTime) == underlyingType)
			{
				defaultUIOperator = ComparisonOperator.Equals;
				comparisonOperatorFlags |= ComparisonOperatorFlags.Equals | ComparisonOperatorFlags.NotEquals | ComparisonOperatorFlags.LessThan | ComparisonOperatorFlags.LessThanOrEqualsTo | ComparisonOperatorFlags.GreaterThan | ComparisonOperatorFlags.GreaterThanOrEqualsTo | ComparisonOperatorFlags.Top | ComparisonOperatorFlags.Bottom | ComparisonOperatorFlags.In | ComparisonOperatorFlags.NotIn;
				if (flag)
				{
					comparisonOperatorFlags |= ComparisonOperatorFlags.TopPercentile | ComparisonOperatorFlags.BottomPercentile;
					prioritizedDefaultUIOperators = new ComparisonOperator[10]
					{
						ComparisonOperator.Equals,
						ComparisonOperator.Top,
						ComparisonOperator.TopPercentile,
						ComparisonOperator.Bottom,
						ComparisonOperator.BottomPercentile,
						ComparisonOperator.StartsWith,
						ComparisonOperator.Contains,
						ComparisonOperator.Like,
						ComparisonOperator.Match,
						ComparisonOperator.In
					};
				}
				else
				{
					prioritizedDefaultUIOperators = new ComparisonOperator[11]
					{
						ComparisonOperator.Equals,
						ComparisonOperator.StartsWith,
						ComparisonOperator.EndsWith,
						ComparisonOperator.Contains,
						ComparisonOperator.Like,
						ComparisonOperator.Match,
						ComparisonOperator.Top,
						ComparisonOperator.TopPercentile,
						ComparisonOperator.Bottom,
						ComparisonOperator.BottomPercentile,
						ComparisonOperator.In
					};
				}
			}
			else if (typeof(bool) == underlyingType)
			{
				defaultUIOperator = ComparisonOperator.Equals;
				comparisonOperatorFlags = ComparisonOperatorFlags.Equals | ComparisonOperatorFlags.NotEquals;
				prioritizedDefaultUIOperators = new ComparisonOperator[1];
			}
			else
			{
				defaultUIOperator = ComparisonOperator.StartsWith;
				comparisonOperatorFlags = ComparisonOperatorFlags.Equals | ComparisonOperatorFlags.NotEquals | ComparisonOperatorFlags.LessThan | ComparisonOperatorFlags.LessThanOrEqualsTo | ComparisonOperatorFlags.GreaterThan | ComparisonOperatorFlags.GreaterThanOrEqualsTo | ComparisonOperatorFlags.Contains | ComparisonOperatorFlags.DoesNotContain | ComparisonOperatorFlags.Like | ComparisonOperatorFlags.NotLike | ComparisonOperatorFlags.Match | ComparisonOperatorFlags.DoesNotMatch | ComparisonOperatorFlags.StartsWith | ComparisonOperatorFlags.DoesNotStartWith | ComparisonOperatorFlags.EndsWith | ComparisonOperatorFlags.DoesNotEndWith | ComparisonOperatorFlags.In | ComparisonOperatorFlags.NotIn;
				prioritizedDefaultUIOperators = new ComparisonOperator[6]
				{
					ComparisonOperator.StartsWith,
					ComparisonOperator.Contains,
					ComparisonOperator.Like,
					ComparisonOperator.Match,
					ComparisonOperator.Equals,
					ComparisonOperator.In
				};
			}
			return comparisonOperatorFlags;
		}

		public static ComparisonOperator GetCompatibleComparisonOperator(Type dataType, ComparisonOperatorFlags availableOperators)
		{
			ComparisonOperator defaultUIOperator;
			ComparisonOperator[] prioritizedDefaultUIOperators;
			ComparisonOperatorFlags compatibleComparisonOperators = GetCompatibleComparisonOperators(dataType, out defaultUIOperator, out prioritizedDefaultUIOperators);
			if ((GetComparisonOperatorFlag(defaultUIOperator) & availableOperators) != ComparisonOperatorFlags.None)
			{
				return defaultUIOperator;
			}
			if (prioritizedDefaultUIOperators != null)
			{
				foreach (ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator in prioritizedDefaultUIOperators)
				{
					if ((GetComparisonOperatorFlag(comparisonOperator) & availableOperators) != ComparisonOperatorFlags.None)
					{
						return comparisonOperator;
					}
				}
			}
			ComparisonOperator[] comparisonOperators = GetComparisonOperators(availableOperators);
			if (comparisonOperators.Length == 0)
			{
				return defaultUIOperator;
			}
			return comparisonOperators[0];
		}

		public static bool IsCompareValueValid(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object compareValue, CultureInfo convertCulture, string convertFormat, out Exception error)
		{
			return ValidateValueHelper(comparisonOperator, compareValue, convertCulture, convertFormat, out error);
		}

		public static bool IsCountingOperator(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator)
		{
			switch (comparisonOperator)
			{
			case ComparisonOperator.Top:
			case ComparisonOperator.Bottom:
			case ComparisonOperator.TopPercentile:
			case ComparisonOperator.BottomPercentile:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsMatch(object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			object lhs = value;
			object rhs = _value;
			IFilterEvaluator filterEvaluator = context?.FilterEvaluator;
			if (filterEvaluator != null)
			{
				bool? flag = filterEvaluator.Evaluate(_comparisonOperator, ref lhs, ref rhs, context);
				if (flag.HasValue)
				{
					return flag.Value;
				}
			}
			if (rhs is SpecialFilterOperandBase specialFilterOperandBase)
			{
				if (specialFilterOperandBase.SupportsOperator(_comparisonOperator))
				{
					return specialFilterOperandBase.IsMatch(_comparisonOperator, lhs, context);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (ComparisonOperator.In == _comparisonOperator || ComparisonOperator.NotIn == _comparisonOperator)
			{
				if (_inOperatorCache == null || _inOperatorCache._lastValue != _value)
				{
					_inOperatorCache = new InOperatorCache
					{
						_lastValue = _value
					};
					IEnumerable items = null;
					if (_value is string)
					{
						char[] array = "\"'".ToCharArray();
						ListParser listParser = new ListParser(array, array, '\\', ',');
						items = listParser.ParseList(_value.ToString(), skipEmptyItems: false);
					}
					else if (_value != null)
					{
						items = new object[1] { _value };
					}
					_inOperatorCache._cachedInOperand = new SpecialFilterOperandFactory.InOperand(items);
				}
				return _inOperatorCache._cachedInOperand.IsMatch((ComparisonOperator.In != _comparisonOperator) ? ComparisonOperator.NotEquals : ComparisonOperator.Equals, value, context);
			}
			GetConvertType(_comparisonOperator, context, lhs, rhs, out var lhsConvertType, out var rhsConvertType, out var fallbackConvertType);
			object val = lhs;
			object val2 = rhs;
			if (!ConvertHelper(ref val, lhsConvertType, context) || !ConvertHelper(ref val2, rhsConvertType, context))
			{
				if (!(null != fallbackConvertType))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ConvertHelper(ref val, fallbackConvertType, context) || !ConvertHelper(ref val2, fallbackConvertType, context))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return Evaluate(_comparisonOperator, val, val2, context);
		}

		public static bool IsQuantitativeComparison(ComparisonOperator op)
		{
			switch (op)
			{
			case ComparisonOperator.Equals:
			case ComparisonOperator.NotEquals:
			case ComparisonOperator.LessThan:
			case ComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo:
			case ComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
			case ComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsStringComparison(ComparisonOperator op)
		{
			switch (op)
			{
			case ComparisonOperator.Contains:
			case ComparisonOperator.DoesNotContain:
			case ComparisonOperator.Like:
			case ComparisonOperator.NotLike:
			case ComparisonOperator.Match:
			case ComparisonOperator.DoesNotMatch:
			case ComparisonOperator.StartsWith:
			case ComparisonOperator.DoesNotStartWith:
			case ComparisonOperator.EndsWith:
			case ComparisonOperator.DoesNotEndWith:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void ClearCache()
		{
			_cachedRegex = null;
			_cachedRegex_Pattern = null;
			_topValuesOperand = null;
			_topValuesOperand_Number = double.NaN;
		}

		private static int CompareHelper(object x, object y, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			IComparer comparer = context?.Comparer;
			if (comparer != null)
			{
				return comparer.Compare(x, y);
			}
			if (x is string && y is string)
			{
				return string.Compare((string)x, (string)y, context.IgnoreCase, GetCulture(context));
			}
			if (x == null || x is DBNull)
			{
				if (y == null || y is DBNull)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (y == null || y is DBNull)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (x is IComparable)
			{
				int num = Comparer.Default.Compare(x, y);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			return -2;
		}

		internal static string ConstructInOperand(List<string> values)
		{
			ListParser inOperandListParser = GetInOperandListParser();
			return inOperandListParser.ConstructList(values, separateEachItemBySpace: true);
		}

		private object ConvertDataType(object x, Type targetType, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			if (targetType == typeof(string))
			{
				if (_lastConversionToStringSourceValue == x && x != null)
				{
					return _lastConvertedToStringValue;
				}
			}
			else if (_lastConversionSourceValue == x && _lastConversionType == targetType && x != null)
			{
				return _lastConvertedValue;
			}
			object obj = ConvertDataTypeHelper(x, targetType, context);
			if (x == _value)
			{
				if (targetType == typeof(string))
				{
					_lastConversionToStringSourceValue = x;
					_lastConvertedToStringValue = obj;
				}
				else
				{
					_lastConversionSourceValue = x;
					_lastConversionType = targetType;
					_lastConvertedValue = obj;
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		internal static object ConvertDataTypeHelper(object x, Type targetType, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			return context.ConvertValue(x, targetType);
		}

		private bool ConvertHelper(ref object val, Type targetType, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			if (null != targetType)
			{
				object obj = ConvertDataType(val, targetType, context);
				if (obj == null && val != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				val = obj;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string ConvertToString(object x, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			string text = x as string;
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = ConvertDataType(x, typeof(string), context) as string;
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static SpecialFilterOperandBase CreateTopValuesOperandHelper(ComparisonOperator op, double topNValue, out Exception error)
		{
			switch (op)
			{
			case ComparisonOperator.Top:
				return SpecialFilterOperandFactory.TopValuesOperand.CreateHelper("Top", topNValue, percentage: false, ascendingOrder: true, out error);
			case ComparisonOperator.Bottom:
				return SpecialFilterOperandFactory.TopValuesOperand.CreateHelper("Bottom", topNValue, percentage: false, ascendingOrder: false, out error);
			case ComparisonOperator.TopPercentile:
				return SpecialFilterOperandFactory.TopValuesOperand.CreateHelper("TopPercentile", topNValue, percentage: true, ascendingOrder: true, out error);
			case ComparisonOperator.BottomPercentile:
				return SpecialFilterOperandFactory.TopValuesOperand.CreateHelper("BottomPercentile", topNValue, percentage: true, ascendingOrder: false, out error);
			default:
				error = new InvalidOperationException();
				return null;
			}
		}

		private bool Evaluate(ComparisonOperator op, object lhs, object rhs, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			switch (op)
			{
			case ComparisonOperator.Equals:
			{
				int num2 = CompareHelper(lhs, rhs, context);
				if (-2 != num2)
				{
					return num2 == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case ComparisonOperator.NotEquals:
				return !Evaluate(ComparisonOperator.Equals, lhs, rhs, context);
			case ComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
			{
				int num2 = CompareHelper(lhs, rhs, context);
				if (-2 != num2)
				{
					return num2 > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case ComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo:
			{
				int num2 = CompareHelper(lhs, rhs, context);
				if (-2 != num2)
				{
					return num2 >= 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case ComparisonOperator.LessThan:
			{
				int num2 = CompareHelper(lhs, rhs, context);
				if (-2 != num2)
				{
					return num2 < 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case ComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo:
			{
				int num2 = CompareHelper(lhs, rhs, context);
				if (-2 != num2)
				{
					return num2 <= 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case ComparisonOperator.Top:
			case ComparisonOperator.Bottom:
			case ComparisonOperator.TopPercentile:
			case ComparisonOperator.BottomPercentile:
			{
				SpecialFilterOperandBase specialFilterOperandBase = null;
				if (rhs is double num)
				{
					if (op == _topValuesOperand_Operator && num == _topValuesOperand_Number)
					{
						specialFilterOperandBase = _topValuesOperand;
					}
					else
					{
						SpecialFilterOperandFactory.TopValuesOperand.ClearUserCacheHelper(_topValuesOperand, context);
						specialFilterOperandBase = (_topValuesOperand = CreateTopValuesOperandHelper(op, num, out var _));
						_topValuesOperand_Number = num;
						_topValuesOperand_Operator = op;
					}
				}
				return specialFilterOperandBase?.IsMatch(ComparisonOperator.Equals, lhs, context) ?? false;
			}
			case ComparisonOperator.NotIn:
				return !Evaluate(ComparisonOperator.In, lhs, rhs, context);
			default:
			{
				string text = ConvertToString(lhs, context);
				string text2 = ConvertToString(rhs, context);
				bool ignoreCase = context.IgnoreCase;
				switch (op)
				{
				case ComparisonOperator.Contains:
					if (ignoreCase)
					{
						string text3 = ToLower(text, context);
						string value = ToLower(text2, context);
						return text3.Contains(value);
					}
					return text.Contains(text2);
				case ComparisonOperator.DoesNotContain:
					return !Evaluate(ComparisonOperator.Contains, text, text2, context);
				case ComparisonOperator.StartsWith:
					return text.StartsWith(text2, ignoreCase, GetCulture(context));
				case ComparisonOperator.DoesNotStartWith:
					return !Evaluate(ComparisonOperator.StartsWith, text, text2, context);
				case ComparisonOperator.EndsWith:
					return text.EndsWith(text2, ignoreCase, GetCulture(context));
				case ComparisonOperator.DoesNotEndWith:
					return !Evaluate(ComparisonOperator.EndsWith, text, text2, context);
				case ComparisonOperator.Like:
				{
					string pattern2 = text2;
					return GetCachedRegex(pattern2, isPatternWildcard: true, ignoreCase)?.IsMatch(text) ?? false;
				}
				case ComparisonOperator.NotLike:
					return !Evaluate(ComparisonOperator.Like, text, text2, context);
				case ComparisonOperator.Match:
				{
					Regex regex = rhs as Regex;
					if (regex == null)
					{
						string pattern = text2;
						regex = GetCachedRegex(pattern, isPatternWildcard: false, ignoreCase);
					}
					return regex?.IsMatch(text) ?? false;
				}
				case ComparisonOperator.DoesNotMatch:
					return !Evaluate(ComparisonOperator.Match, text, text2, context);
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
			}
		}

		private Regex GetCachedRegex(string pattern, bool isPatternWildcard, bool ignoreCase)
		{
			Regex regex = null;
			if (_cachedRegex_Pattern == pattern && _cachedRegex_IgnoreCase == ignoreCase)
			{
				regex = _cachedRegex;
			}
			else
			{
				_cachedRegex_Pattern = pattern;
				_cachedRegex_IgnoreCase = ignoreCase;
				try
				{
					if (isPatternWildcard)
					{
						regex = CoreUtilities.WildcardToRegexConverter.Convert(pattern, ignoreCase);
					}
					else
					{
						RegexOptions regexOptions = RegexOptions.ExplicitCapture;
						if (ignoreCase)
						{
							regexOptions |= RegexOptions.IgnoreCase;
						}
						regex = new Regex(pattern, regexOptions);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				_cachedRegex = regex;
			}
			return regex;
		}

		internal static void GetConvertType(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, ConditionEvaluationContext context, object lhs, object rhs, out Type lhsConvertType, out Type rhsConvertType, out Type fallbackConvertType)
		{
			lhsConvertType = null;
			rhsConvertType = null;
			fallbackConvertType = null;
			if (IsStringComparison(comparisonOperator))
			{
				lhsConvertType = (rhsConvertType = typeof(string));
			}
			else if (IsCountingOperator(comparisonOperator))
			{
				lhsConvertType = null;
				rhsConvertType = typeof(double);
			}
			else if (IsQuantitativeComparison(comparisonOperator) && lhs != null && DBNull.Value != lhs && rhs != null && DBNull.Value != rhs)
			{
				lhsConvertType = (rhsConvertType = GetPreferredComparisonTypeHelper(context, lhs, rhs));
				if (rhsConvertType != typeof(bool))
				{
					fallbackConvertType = typeof(string);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static CultureInfo GetCulture(ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			CultureInfo cultureInfo = null;
			if (context != null)
			{
				ValueEntry currentValue = context.CurrentValue;
				if (currentValue != null)
				{
					cultureInfo = currentValue.Culture;
				}
			}
			if (cultureInfo == null)
			{
				cultureInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			}
			return cultureInfo;
		}

		private static ListParser GetInOperandListParser()
		{
			char[] array = "\"'".ToCharArray();
			return new ListParser(array, array, '\\', ',');
		}

		private static Type GetPreferredComparisonTypeHelper(ConditionEvaluationContext context, object lhs, object rhs)
		{
			Type type = context.PreferredComparisonDataType;
			if (null == type || typeof(object) == type)
			{
				Type underlyingType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(lhs.GetType());
				Type underlyingType2 = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(rhs.GetType());
				type = ((underlyingType == underlyingType2) ? underlyingType : ((!Utilities.IsNumericType(underlyingType) && !Utilities.IsNumericType(underlyingType2)) ? typeof(string) : typeof(decimal)));
			}
			return type;
		}

		private static bool IsValidRegex(string regex, out Exception error)
		{
			Exception innerException = null;
			try
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(regex))
				{
					new Regex(regex);
					error = null;
					return true;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				innerException = ex;
			}
			error = new ArgumentException("value", SR.GetString("Filter_Regex_InvalidPattern"), innerException);
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsValidWildcard(string wildcard, out Exception error)
		{
			CoreUtilities.WildcardToRegexConverter.Convert(wildcard, out var _, out var _, out error);
			return error == null;
		}

		private string ToLower(string str, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			return str.ToLower(GetCulture(context));
		}

		private static void ValidateValueHelper(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value)
		{
			if (!ValidateValueHelper(comparisonOperator, value, null, null, out var error))
			{
				throw error;
			}
		}

		private static bool ValidateValueHelper(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, CultureInfo convertCulture, string convertFormat, out Exception error)
		{
			error = null;
			if (value is SpecialFilterOperandBase specialFilterOperandBase)
			{
				if (!specialFilterOperandBase.SupportsOperator(comparisonOperator))
				{
					error = new ArgumentException("value", SR.GetString("Filter_IncompatibleOperand"));
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (convertCulture == null)
			{
				convertCulture = GetCulture(null);
			}
			switch (comparisonOperator)
			{
			case ComparisonOperator.Match:
			case ComparisonOperator.DoesNotMatch:
			{
				string regex = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(string), convertCulture, convertFormat) as string;
				if (!IsValidRegex(regex, out error))
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			}
			case ComparisonOperator.Like:
			case ComparisonOperator.NotLike:
			{
				string wildcard = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(string), convertCulture, convertFormat) as string;
				if (!IsValidWildcard(wildcard, out error))
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			if (IsCountingOperator(comparisonOperator))
			{
				object obj = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(double), convertCulture, convertFormat);
				if (!(obj is double) || CreateTopValuesOperandHelper(comparisonOperator, (double)obj, out error) == null)
				{
					if (error == null)
					{
						error = new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_26"));
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

			UpdateDisplayText();
		}

			: this(ComparisonOperator.Equals)

		}

		{

		}

		{
			SetValue(DescriptionPropertyKey, _dynamicString.Value);
		}
	}

		public ComparisonOperatorSelector()
		{
			Array values = Enum.GetValues(typeof(ComparisonOperator));
			_allOperatorList = new List<ComparisonOperatorListItem>(values.Length);
			foreach (ComparisonOperator item2 in values)
			{
				ComparisonOperatorListItem item = CreateOperatorListItem(item2);
				_allOperatorList.Add(item);
			}
			_filteredList = new ObservableCollection<ComparisonOperatorListItem>(_allOperatorList);
			_items = new ComparisonOperatorListItemCollection(_filteredList);
			SetValue(SelectorPropertyKey, this);
		}

		{
			AllowableOperatorsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowableOperators", typeof(ComparisonOperatorFlags), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ComparisonOperatorFlags.All, OnAllowableOperatorsChanged));

			DropDownButtonStyleKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), "DropDownButtonStyleKey");
			IsDropDownOpenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsDropDownOpen", typeof(bool), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, OnVisualStatePropertyChanged));

			SelectedOperatorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedOperator", typeof(ComparisonOperator?), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnSelectedOperatorChanged));
			SelectedOperatorChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("SelectedOperatorChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<SelectedOperatorChangedEventArgs>), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector));
			SelectedOperatorInfoPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("SelectedOperatorInfo", typeof(ComparisonOperatorListItem), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			SelectedOperatorInfoProperty = SelectedOperatorInfoPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			SelectorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("Selector", typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.OverridesInheritanceBehavior));
			SelectorProperty = SelectorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			OperatorEqualsImageProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OperatorEqualsImage", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			OperatorEqualsImageKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), "OperatorEqualsImageKey");
			OperatorNotEqualsImageProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OperatorNotEqualsImage", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			OperatorNotEqualsImageKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), "OperatorNotEqualsImageKey");
			OperatorLessThanImageProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OperatorLessThanImage", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			OperatorLessThanImageKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), "OperatorLessThanImageKey");
			OperatorLessThanOrEqualToImageProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OperatorLessThanOrEqualToImage", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			OperatorLessThanOrEqualToImageKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), "OperatorLessThanOrEqualToImageKey");
			OperatorGreaterThanImageProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OperatorGreaterThanImage", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			OperatorGreaterThanImageKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), "OperatorGreaterThanImageKey");
			OperatorGreaterThanOrEqualToImageProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OperatorGreaterThanOrEqualToImage", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(ComparisonOperatorSelector), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		private static void OnAllowableOperatorsChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(target is ComparisonOperatorSelector comparisonOperatorSelector))
			{
				return;
			}
			ComparisonOperatorFlags flags = (ComparisonOperatorFlags)e.NewValue;
			ComparisonOperator[] comparisonOperators = ComparisonCondition.GetComparisonOperators(flags);
			int num = comparisonOperators.Length;
			int count = comparisonOperatorSelector._filteredList.Count;
			if (num < comparisonOperatorSelector._allOperatorList.Count)
			{
				int num2 = num - 1;
				for (int num3 = count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator = comparisonOperatorSelector._filteredList[num3].Operator;
					bool flag = false;
					while (num2 >= 0)
					{
						ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator2 = comparisonOperators[num2];
						if (comparisonOperator2 == comparisonOperator)
						{
							flag = true;
							num2--;
							break;
						}
						if (comparisonOperator2 < comparisonOperator)
						{
							break;
						}
						num2--;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						comparisonOperatorSelector._filteredList.RemoveAt(num3);
					}
				}
			}
			count = comparisonOperatorSelector._filteredList.Count;
			if (num <= count)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num4 = count - 1;
			for (int num5 = num - 1; num5 >= 0; num5--)
			{
				ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator3 = comparisonOperators[num5];
				bool flag2 = false;
				while (num4 >= 0)
				{
					ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator4 = comparisonOperatorSelector._filteredList[num4].Operator;
					if (comparisonOperator3 == comparisonOperator4)
					{
						flag2 = true;
						break;
					}
					if (comparisonOperator3 > comparisonOperator4)
					{
						break;
					}
					num4--;
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					comparisonOperatorSelector._filteredList.Insert(num4 + 1, comparisonOperatorSelector._allOperatorList[(int)comparisonOperator3]);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnSelectedIndexChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is ComparisonOperatorSelector comparisonOperatorSelector)
			{
				comparisonOperatorSelector._cachedSelectedIndex = (int)e.NewValue;
				if (comparisonOperatorSelector._cachedSelectedIndex >= 0)

				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnSelectedOperatorChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(target is ComparisonOperatorSelector comparisonOperatorSelector))
			{
				return;
			}
			comparisonOperatorSelector._cachedSelectedOperator = (ComparisonOperator?)e.NewValue;
			if (!comparisonOperatorSelector._cachedSelectedOperator.HasValue)
			{
				comparisonOperatorSelector.ClearValue(SelectedOperatorInfoPropertyKey);
				comparisonOperatorSelector.SetValue(SelectedIndexProperty, -1);
			}
			else
			{
				int num = comparisonOperatorSelector._items.IndexOfOperator(comparisonOperatorSelector._cachedSelectedOperator.Value);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					comparisonOperatorSelector.SetValue(SelectedOperatorInfoPropertyKey, comparisonOperatorSelector._items[num]);
				}
				else
				{
					ComparisonOperator value = comparisonOperatorSelector._cachedSelectedOperator.Value;
					int num2 = -1;
					int count = comparisonOperatorSelector._allOperatorList.Count;
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						if (comparisonOperatorSelector._allOperatorList[i].Operator == value)
						{
							num2 = i;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (num2 >= 0)
					{
						comparisonOperatorSelector.SetValue(SelectedOperatorInfoPropertyKey, comparisonOperatorSelector._allOperatorList[num2]);
					}
					else
					{
						comparisonOperatorSelector.SetValue(SelectedOperatorInfoPropertyKey, comparisonOperatorSelector.CreateOperatorListItem(comparisonOperatorSelector._cachedSelectedOperator.Value));
					}
				}
				comparisonOperatorSelector.SetValue(SelectedIndexProperty, num);
			}
			comparisonOperatorSelector.OnSelectedOperatorChanged((ComparisonOperator?)e.OldValue, (ComparisonOperator?)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedOperatorChanged(ComparisonOperator? previousValue, ComparisonOperator? currentValue)
		{
			SelectedOperatorChangedEventArgs e = new SelectedOperatorChangedEventArgs(previousValue, currentValue);
			e.RoutedEvent = SelectedOperatorChangedEvent;
			e.Source = this;
			RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (base.IsEnabled)
			{
				if (base.IsMouseOver)
				{
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "MouseOver", "Normal");
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "Disabled", "Normal");
			}
			if (IsDropDownOpen)
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "FocusedDropDown", "Focused");
			}
			else if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Focused", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unfocused", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		private static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ComparisonOperatorSelector comparisonOperatorSelector = target as ComparisonOperatorSelector;
			comparisonOperatorSelector.UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

	public class ConditionGroup : ObservableCollection<ICondition>, ICondition, ICloneable
	{
		internal class SerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
		{
			private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

			public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
			{
				get
				{
					if (_props == null)
					{
						_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[2]
						{
							new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(LogicalOperator), "LogicalOperator"),
							new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(ICondition), "[]")
						};
					}
					return _props;
				}
			}

			public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
			{
				ConditionGroup conditionGroup = (ConditionGroup)obj;
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
				dictionary["LogicalOperator"] = conditionGroup.LogicalOperator;
				dictionary["[]"] = conditionGroup;
				return dictionary;
			}

			public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
			{
				ConditionGroup conditionGroup = new ConditionGroup();
				if (values.TryGetValue("LogicalOperator", out var value))

					conditionGroup.LogicalOperator = (LogicalOperator)value;
				}
				if (values.TryGetValue("[]", out value))
				{
					foreach (ICondition item in (IEnumerable)value)
					{
						conditionGroup.Add(item);
					}
				}
				return conditionGroup;
			}
		}

			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string) && value is ConditionGroup)
				{
					return value.ToString();
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private LogicalOperator _logicalOperator;

		private object _tooltip;

		public object ToolTip
		{
			get

				if (_tooltip != null)

					return _tooltip;
				}
				return FormatToolTipText();

				_tooltip = value;

		public LogicalOperator LogicalOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return _logicalOperator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_logicalOperator != value)
				{
					Utilities.ThrowIfInvalidEnum(value, "LogicalOperator");
					_logicalOperator = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("LogicalOperator");
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ConditionGroup conditionGroup) || conditionGroup._logicalOperator != _logicalOperator || conditionGroup.Count != base.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = base.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(base[i], conditionGroup[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = _logicalOperator.GetHashCode();
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = base.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ICondition condition = base[i];
				if (condition != null)
				{
					num |= condition.GetHashCode();
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return SR.GetString("ConditionGroup_Description");
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			ConditionGroup conditionGroup = new ConditionGroup();
			conditionGroup._logicalOperator = _logicalOperator;
			using IEnumerator<ICondition> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				ICondition current = enumerator.Current;
				conditionGroup.Add((ICondition)current.Clone());
			}
			return conditionGroup;
		}

		public bool IsMatch(object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			LogicalOperator logicalOperator = LogicalOperator;
			int count = base.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				ICondition condition = base[i];
				if (condition.IsMatch(value, context))
				{
					if (LogicalOperator.Or == logicalOperator)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (logicalOperator == LogicalOperator.And)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (count != 0)
			{
				return logicalOperator == LogicalOperator.And;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string FormatToolTipText()
		{
			int count = base.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (count == 1)
			{
				return base[0].ToString();
			}
			if (count > 2 && _logicalOperator == LogicalOperator.Or && base[0] is ComparisonCondition comparisonCondition)
			{
				ComparisonOperator? comparisonOperator = comparisonCondition.Operator;
				if (comparisonOperator == ComparisonOperator.Equals)
				{
					for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
					{
						if (!(base[i] is ComparisonCondition comparisonCondition2) || comparisonCondition2.Operator != comparisonOperator)
						{
							comparisonOperator = null;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (comparisonOperator.HasValue)
					{
						StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
						string text = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.TextInfo.ListSeparator;
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							text = " ";
						}
						else if (text.Length == 1 && !char.IsWhiteSpace(text[0]))
						{
							text += " ";
						}
						for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
						{
							if (j > 0)
							{
								stringBuilder.Append(text);
							}
							stringBuilder.Append(((ComparisonCondition)base[j]).Value);
						}
						return SR.GetString("ConditionGroup_Equals", stringBuilder.ToString());
					}
				}
			}
			string text2 = null;
			string format = ((LogicalOperator != LogicalOperator.And) ? SR.GetString("ConditionGroup_Logical_OR") : SR.GetString("ConditionGroup_Logical_AND"));
			for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
			{
				string text3;
				if (base[k] is ConditionGroup conditionGroup)
				{
					text3 = conditionGroup.FormatToolTipText();
					text3 = SR.GetString("ConditionGroup_Group", text3);
				}
				else
				{
					text3 = base[k].ToString();
				}
				if (text2 == null)
				{
					text2 = text3;
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					text2 = string.Format(format, new object[2] { text2, text3 });
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return text2;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propName)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("LogicalOperator"));
		}

	[ContentProperty("SourceCondition")]
	[DefaultProperty("SourceCondition")]
	public class ComplementCondition : ICondition, ICloneable
	{
		internal class SerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
		{
			private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

			public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
			{
				get
				{
					if (_props == null)
					{
						_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[1]
						{
							new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(ICondition), "[]")
						};
					}
					return _props;
				}
			}

			public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
			{
				ComplementCondition complementCondition = (ComplementCondition)obj;
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
				if (complementCondition.SourceCondition != null)
				{
					dictionary["[]"] = new ICondition[1] { complementCondition.SourceCondition };
				}
				return dictionary;
			}

			public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
			{
				if (values.TryGetValue("[]", out var value))
				{
					{
						IEnumerator enumerator = ((IEnumerable)value).GetEnumerator();
						try
						{
							if (enumerator.MoveNext())
							{
								ICondition sourceCondition = (ICondition)enumerator.Current;
								return new ComplementCondition(sourceCondition);
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
							if (disposable != null)
							{
								disposable.Dispose();
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private ICondition _sourceCondition;

		public ICondition SourceCondition
		{
			get
			{
				return _sourceCondition;
			}
			set
			{
				_sourceCondition = value;
			}
		}

		public ComplementCondition()
		{
		}

		public ComplementCondition(ICondition sourceCondition)
		{
			_sourceCondition = sourceCondition;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ComplementCondition complementCondition)
			{
				return object.Equals(complementCondition._sourceCondition, _sourceCondition);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (_sourceCondition == null)
			{
				return 100;
			}
			return _sourceCondition.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return SR.GetString("ComplementCondition", SourceCondition);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return new ComplementCondition((ICondition)_sourceCondition.Clone());
		}

		public bool IsMatch(object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			if (_sourceCondition != null)
			{
				return !_sourceCondition.IsMatch(value, context);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ConditionEvaluationContext
	{
		private object _userCache;

		private Dictionary<object, object> _userCacheTable;

		public abstract IEnumerable<ValueEntry> AllValues { get; }

		public abstract ValueEntry CurrentValue { get; }

		public virtual IComparer Comparer => null;

		public abstract bool IgnoreCase { get; }

		public abstract Type PreferredComparisonDataType { get; }

		public virtual IEnumerable ThreadSynchronizationCollection => null;

		[Obsolete("UserCache is replaced by GetUserCache and SetUserCache methods.", false)]
		public object UserCache
		{
			get
			{
				return _userCache;
			}
			set
			{
				_userCache = value;
			}
		}

		internal virtual IFilterEvaluator FilterEvaluator => null;

		public ConditionEvaluationContext()
		{
		}

		public virtual object ConvertValue(object x, Type targetType)
		{
			if (x == null || DBNull.Value == x)
			{
				return x;
			}
			Type type = x.GetType();
			if (type == targetType)
			{
				return x;
			}
			if (Utilities.IsNumericType(targetType) && Utilities.IsNumericType(type))
			{
				try
				{
					return Convert.ChangeType(x, targetType);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			ValueEntry currentValue = CurrentValue;
			return CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(x, targetType, currentValue.Culture, currentValue.Format);
		}

		public object GetUserCache(object cacheIdentifier)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(cacheIdentifier);
			if (_userCacheTable != null && _userCacheTable.TryGetValue(cacheIdentifier, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void SetUserCache(object cacheIdentifier, object cacheValue)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(cacheIdentifier);
			if (cacheValue == null)
			{
				if (_userCacheTable != null)
				{
					_userCacheTable.Remove(cacheIdentifier);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (_userCacheTable == null)
			{
				_userCacheTable = new Dictionary<object, object>();
			}
			_userCacheTable[cacheIdentifier] = cacheValue;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ValueEntry
	{
		private double? _cachedValueAsDouble;

		public abstract object Context { get; }

		public abstract CultureInfo Culture { get; }

		public abstract string Format { get; }

		public abstract object Value { get; }

		public double ValueAsDouble => GetValueAsDouble(null);

		public ValueEntry()
		{
		}

		internal double GetValueAsDouble(ConditionEvaluationContext context)
		{
			if (_cachedValueAsDouble.HasValue)
			{
				return _cachedValueAsDouble.Value;
			}
			object value = Value;
			if (((context == null) ? CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(double), Culture, Format) : context.ConvertValue(value, typeof(double))) is double num)
			{
				_cachedValueAsDouble = num;
				return num;
			}
			_cachedValueAsDouble = double.NaN;
			return _cachedValueAsDouble.Value;
		}
	}
	internal class SpecialFilterOperandFactory
	{
		internal abstract class IGOperand : SpecialFilterOperandBase
		{
			internal class FormattedSRValue : IFormattable
			{
				private string _sr;

				private object[] _args;

				private CultureInfo _defaultCultureInfo;

				internal FormattedSRValue(string sr, object[] args, CultureInfo defaultCultureInfo)
				{
					Utilities.ThrowIfNull(sr, "sr");
					_sr = sr;
					_args = args;
					_defaultCultureInfo = defaultCultureInfo;
				}

				public override string ToString()
				{
					return ToString(null, null);
				}

				public string ToString(string format, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
				{
					CultureInfo culture = _defaultCultureInfo;
					if (formatProvider is CultureInfo)
					{
						culture = formatProvider as CultureInfo;
					}
					DynamicResourceString dynamicResourceString = SR.GetDynamicResourceString(_sr, _args, culture);
					if (dynamicResourceString == null)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					return dynamicResourceString.Value;
				}
			}

			private string _name;

			private string _sr_displayContent;

			private string _sr_description;

			private DynamicResourceString _drsDescription;

			private FormattedSRValue _fsrDisplayContent;

			public override object Description
			{
				get
				{
					if (_drsDescription == null)
					{
						_drsDescription = SR.GetDynamicResourceString(_sr_description, ValueArgumentsForStrings, null);
					}
					return _drsDescription.Value;
				}
			}

			public override object DisplayContent
			{
				get
				{
					if (_fsrDisplayContent == null)
					{
						_fsrDisplayContent = new FormattedSRValue(_sr_displayContent, ValueArgumentsForStrings, null);
					}
					return _fsrDisplayContent;
				}
			}

			public override string Name => _name;

			public override bool UsesAllValues => false;

			protected virtual object[] ValueArgumentsForStrings => null;

			public IGOperand(string name, string resourceName)
			{
				_name = name;
				_sr_displayContent = "SpecialFilterOperand_" + resourceName + "_DisplayContent";
				_sr_description = "SpecialFilterOperand_" + resourceName + "_Description";
			}

			public IGOperand(string name)
				: this(name, name)
			{
			}

			protected override bool EqualsOverride(SpecialFilterOperandBase operand)
			{
				if (operand is IGOperand iGOperand && _name == iGOperand.Name && _sr_displayContent == iGOperand._sr_displayContent)
				{
					return _sr_description == iGOperand._sr_description;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				if (_name == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _name.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (!SupportsOperator(comparisonOperator) || (value != null && DBNull.Value != value && !SupportsDataType(value.GetType())))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			internal static object ConvertValue(object value, Type targetType, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				return ComparisonCondition.ConvertDataTypeHelper(value, targetType, context);
			}

			internal static double GetCurrentValueAsDouble(object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				object obj = ComparisonCondition.ConvertDataTypeHelper(value, typeof(double), context);
				if (!(obj is double))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return (double)obj;
			}
		}

		internal class BlanksOperand : IGOperand
		{
			internal class SerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
			{
				private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

				private const string NonBlanksProp = "MatchNonBlanks";

				public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
				{
					get
					{
						if (_props == null)
						{
							_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[1]
							{
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(bool), "MatchNonBlanks")
							};
						}
						return _props;
					}
				}

				public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
				{
					BlanksOperand blanksOperand = (BlanksOperand)obj;
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					dictionary["MatchNonBlanks"] = blanksOperand._nonBlanks;
					return dictionary;
				}

				public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
				{
					bool nonBlanks = false;
					if (values.TryGetValue("MatchNonBlanks", out var value))
					{
						nonBlanks = (bool)value;
					}
					return new BlanksOperand(nonBlanks);
				}
			}

			internal const string NAME_Blanks = "Blanks";

			internal const string NAME_NonBlanks = "NonBlanks";

			private bool _nonBlanks;

			public BlanksOperand(bool nonBlanks)
				: base((!nonBlanks) ? "Blanks" : "NonBlanks")
			{
				_nonBlanks = nonBlanks;
			}

			protected override bool EqualsOverride(SpecialFilterOperandBase operand)
			{
				if (operand is BlanksOperand blanksOperand && base.EqualsOverride((SpecialFilterOperandBase)blanksOperand))
				{
					return _nonBlanks == blanksOperand._nonBlanks;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return base.GetHashCode() ^ _nonBlanks.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool SupportsDataType(Type type)
			{
				return true;
			}

			public override bool SupportsOperator(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator)
			{
				if (comparisonOperator != ComparisonOperator.Equals)
				{
					return ComparisonOperator.NotEquals == comparisonOperator;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (comparisonOperator == ComparisonOperator.Equals)
				{
					return _nonBlanks != IsBlank(value, context);
				}
				if (ComparisonOperator.NotEquals == comparisonOperator)
				{
					return !IsMatch(ComparisonOperator.Equals, value, context);
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static bool IsBlank(object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (value == null || value is DBNull)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (value is string)
				{
					if (((string)value).Length != 0)
					{
						return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value.ToString());
					}
					return true;
				}
				Type type = value.GetType();
				if (type.IsPrimitive || value is DateTime || value is decimal || type.IsEnum || value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString());
			}
		}

		internal class AverageOperand : IGOperand
		{
			internal class SerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
			{
				private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

				private const string AboveAverageProp = "AboveAverage";

				public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
				{
					get
					{
						if (_props == null)
						{
							_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[1]
							{
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(bool), "AboveAverage")
							};
						}
						return _props;
					}
				}

				public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
				{
					AverageOperand averageOperand = (AverageOperand)obj;
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					dictionary["AboveAverage"] = averageOperand._aboveAverage;
					return dictionary;
				}

				public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
				{
					bool aboveAverage = false;
					if (values.TryGetValue("AboveAverage", out var value))
					{
						aboveAverage = (bool)value;
					}
					return new AverageOperand(aboveAverage);
				}
			}

			internal const string NAME_AboveAverage = "AboveAverage";

			internal const string NAME_BelowAverage = "BelowAverage";

			private bool _aboveAverage;

			public override bool UsesAllValues => true;

			public AverageOperand(bool aboveAverage)
				: base(aboveAverage ? "AboveAverage" : "BelowAverage")
			{
				_aboveAverage = aboveAverage;
			}

			public override bool SupportsDataType(Type type)
			{
				return Utilities.IsNumericType(CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(type));
			}

			public override bool SupportsOperator(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator)
			{
				if (comparisonOperator != ComparisonOperator.Equals)
				{
					return ComparisonOperator.NotEquals == comparisonOperator;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object valueObj, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (comparisonOperator == ComparisonOperator.Equals)
				{
					double currentValueAsDouble = IGOperand.GetCurrentValueAsDouble(valueObj, context);
					if (!double.IsNaN(currentValueAsDouble))
					{
						double average = GetAverage(context);
						if (double.IsNaN(average))
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (!_aboveAverage)
						{
							return currentValueAsDouble < average;
						}
						return currentValueAsDouble > average;
					}
				}
				else if (ComparisonOperator.NotEquals == comparisonOperator)
				{
					return !IsMatch(ComparisonOperator.Equals, valueObj, context);
				}
				return false;
			}

			private double GetAverage(ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				object type = GetType();
				object userCache = context.GetUserCache(type);
				if (userCache != null)
				{
					return (double)userCache;
				}
				int count = 0;
				double sum = 0.0;
				Utilities.AccessCollectionSafe(context.ThreadSynchronizationCollection, delegate
				{
					foreach (ValueEntry allValue in context.AllValues)
					{
						double valueAsDouble = allValue.ValueAsDouble;
						if (!double.IsNaN(valueAsDouble) && !double.IsInfinity(valueAsDouble))
						{
							sum += valueAsDouble;
							count++;
						}
					}
				}, writeAccess: false);
				double num = ((count > 0) ? (sum / (double)count) : double.NaN);
				context.SetUserCache(type, num);
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal class TopValuesOperand : IGOperand
		{
			internal class SerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
			{
				private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

				public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
				{
					get
					{
						if (_props == null)
						{
							_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[4]
							{
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(string), "Name"),
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(double), "TopNumber"),
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(bool), "Percentage"),
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(bool), "AscendingOrder")
							};
						}
						return _props;
					}
				}

				public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
				{
					TopValuesOperand topValuesOperand = (TopValuesOperand)obj;
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					dictionary["Name"] = topValuesOperand.Name;
					dictionary["TopNumber"] = topValuesOperand._topNumber;
					dictionary["Percentage"] = topValuesOperand._percentage;
					dictionary["AscendingOrder"] = topValuesOperand._ascendingOrder;
					return dictionary;
				}

				public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
				{
					if (values.TryGetValue("Name", out var value) && values.TryGetValue("TopNumber", out var value2) && values.TryGetValue("Percentage", out var value3) && values.TryGetValue("AscendingOrder", out var value4))
					{
						return new TopValuesOperand((string)value, (double)value2, (bool)value3, (bool)value4);
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			private double _topNumber;

			private bool _percentage;

			private bool _ascendingOrder;

			public override bool UsesAllValues => true;

			protected override object[] ValueArgumentsForStrings => new object[1] { _topNumber };

			public TopValuesOperand(string name, double topNumber, bool percentage, bool ascendingOrder)
				: base(name, (!percentage) ? (ascendingOrder ? "Top" : "Bottom") : (ascendingOrder ? "TopPercentile" : "BottomPercentile"))
			{
				if (!ValidateParams(topNumber, percentage, ascendingOrder, out var error))
				{
					throw error;
				}
				_topNumber = topNumber;
				_percentage = percentage;
				_ascendingOrder = ascendingOrder;
			}

			protected override bool EqualsOverride(SpecialFilterOperandBase operand)
			{
				if (operand is TopValuesOperand topValuesOperand && base.EqualsOverride((SpecialFilterOperandBase)topValuesOperand) && _ascendingOrder == topValuesOperand._ascendingOrder && _percentage == topValuesOperand._percentage)
				{
					return _topNumber == topValuesOperand._topNumber;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return base.GetHashCode() ^ _ascendingOrder.GetHashCode() ^ _percentage.GetHashCode() ^ _topNumber.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool SupportsDataType(Type type)
			{
				type = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(type);
				if (!Utilities.IsNumericType(type))
				{
					return typeof(DateTime) == type;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool SupportsOperator(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator)
			{
				if (comparisonOperator != ComparisonOperator.Equals)
				{
					return ComparisonOperator.NotEquals == comparisonOperator;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (comparisonOperator == ComparisonOperator.Equals)
				{
					object maxValidValue = GetMaxValidValue(context);
					if (maxValidValue is double num)
					{
						double doubleHelper = GetDoubleHelper(value, context);
						if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(doubleHelper))
						{
							if (!_ascendingOrder)
							{
								return doubleHelper <= num;
							}
							return doubleHelper >= num;
						}
						return false;
					}
					IComparer comparer = context.Comparer ?? Comparer<object>.Default;
					if (maxValidValue != null && value != null)
					{
						int num2 = comparer.Compare(value, maxValidValue);
						if (!_ascendingOrder)
						{
							return num2 <= 0;
						}
						return num2 >= 0;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (ComparisonOperator.NotEquals == comparisonOperator)
				{
					return !IsMatch(ComparisonOperator.Equals, value, context);
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal static void ClearUserCacheHelper(SpecialFilterOperandBase topValuesOperand, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (topValuesOperand is TopValuesOperand cacheIdentifier)
				{
					context.SetUserCache(cacheIdentifier, null);
				}
			}

			internal static TopValuesOperand CreateHelper(string name, double topNumber, bool percentage, bool ascendingOrder, out Exception error)
			{
				if (!ValidateParams(topNumber, percentage, ascendingOrder, out error))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new TopValuesOperand(name, topNumber, percentage, ascendingOrder);
			}

			private static double DateTimeToDouble(DateTime value)
			{
				return value.Ticks;
			}

			private IList GetAllValues(ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				List<double> listDouble = new List<double>();
				List<object> listObj = null;
				Utilities.AccessCollectionSafe(context.ThreadSynchronizationCollection, delegate
				{
					Type preferredComparisonDataType = context.PreferredComparisonDataType;
					bool flag = IsNumericOrDateTime(preferredComparisonDataType);
					foreach (ValueEntry allValue in context.AllValues)
					{
						double doubleHelper = GetDoubleHelper(allValue, context);
						if (!double.IsNaN(doubleHelper) && !double.IsInfinity(doubleHelper))
						{
							listDouble.Add(doubleHelper);
						}
						else if (!flag && !CoreUtilities.IsValueEmpty(allValue.Value) && (null == preferredComparisonDataType || !IsNumericOrDateTime(allValue.Value.GetType())))
						{
							listDouble = null;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (listDouble == null)
					{
						listObj = new List<object>();
						foreach (ValueEntry allValue2 in context.AllValues)
						{
							listObj.Add(allValue2.Value);
						}
					}
				}, writeAccess: false);
				IList list = listDouble;
				return list ?? listObj;
			}

			private static double GetDoubleHelper(object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (value is DateTime)
				{
					return DateTimeToDouble((DateTime)value);
				}
				return IGOperand.GetCurrentValueAsDouble(value, context);
			}

			private static double GetDoubleHelper(ValueEntry ii, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				object value = ii.Value;
				if (value is DateTime)
				{
					return DateTimeToDouble((DateTime)value);
				}
				return ii.GetValueAsDouble(context);
			}

			private object GetMaxValidValue(ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				object obj = context.GetUserCache(this);
				if (obj == null)
				{
					IList allValues = GetAllValues(context);
					obj = double.NaN;
					if (allValues.Count > 0 && _topNumber > 0.0)
					{
						if (allValues is List<double>)
						{
							CoreUtilities.SortMergeGeneric((List<double>)allValues, Comparer<double>.Default);
						}
						else
						{
							CoreUtilities.SortMergeGeneric((List<object>)allValues, CoreUtilities.CreateComparer<object>(context.Comparer ?? Comparer<object>.Default));
						}
						int num = ((!_percentage) ? ((int)_topNumber - 1) : (Math.Max(1, (int)(_topNumber / 100.0 * (double)allValues.Count)) - 1));
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							num = Math.Min(num, allValues.Count - 1);
							obj = ((!_ascendingOrder) ? allValues[num] : allValues[allValues.Count - 1 - num]);
						}
					}
					context.SetUserCache(this, obj);
				}
				return obj;
			}

			private static bool IsNumericOrDateTime(Type type)
			{
				if (null != type)
				{
					if (!Utilities.IsNumericType(type))
					{
						return typeof(DateTime) == type;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal static bool ValidateParams(double topNumber, bool percentage, bool ascendingOrder, out Exception error)
			{
				error = null;
				if (double.IsNaN(topNumber))
				{
					error = new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("topNumber", SR.GetString("Filter_TopOperand_InvalidValue_NaN"));
				}
				else if (topNumber < 0.0)
				{
					error = new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("topNumber", SR.GetString("Filter_TopOperand_InvalidValue_LessThanZero"));
				}
				else if (percentage && topNumber > 100.0)
				{
					error = new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("topNumber", SR.GetString("Filter_TopOperand_InvalidValue_GreaterThan100Percent"));
				}
				return error == null;
			}
		}

		internal class DateOperand : IGOperand
		{
			public DateOperand(string name, string resourceName)
				: base(name, resourceName)
			{
			}

			public override bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (!base.IsMatch(comparisonOperator, value, context))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (value == null || value == DBNull.Value || CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(value.GetType()) != typeof(DateTime))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool SupportsDataType(Type dataType)
			{
				return CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(dataType) == typeof(DateTime);
			}

			public override bool SupportsOperator(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator)
			{
				switch (comparisonOperator)
				{
				case ComparisonOperator.Equals:
				case ComparisonOperator.NotEquals:
				case ComparisonOperator.LessThan:
				case ComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo:
				case ComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
				case ComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

			private bool useCustomCurrentDate;

			private DateTime customCurrentDate;

			private RelativeDate relativeDate;

			private DateTime cachedCurrentDate;

			private DateTime cachedStart;

			private DateTime cachedEnd;

			private CultureInfo cachedCurrentCulture;

			public RelativeDateOperand(string name, RelativeDate relativeDate)
				: base(name, name)
			{
				this.relativeDate = relativeDate;
			}

			private static void CalculateQuarterRange(DateTime dateInQuarter, ref DateTime cachedStart, ref DateTime cachedEnd)
			{
				if (dateInQuarter.Month < 4)
				{
					cachedStart = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 1, 1);
					cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 3, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateInQuarter.Year, 3));
				}
				else if (dateInQuarter.Month < 7)
				{
					cachedStart = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 4, 1);
					cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 6, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateInQuarter.Year, 6));
				}
				else if (dateInQuarter.Month < 10)
				{
					cachedStart = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 7, 1);
					cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 9, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateInQuarter.Year, 9));
				}
				else
				{
					cachedStart = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 10, 1);
					cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 12, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateInQuarter.Year, 12));
				}
			}

			internal Tuple<DateTime, DateTime> GetCachedStartAndEndDates()
			{
				VerifyCache(null);
				return new Tuple<DateTime, DateTime>(cachedStart, cachedEnd);
			}

			internal RelativeDate GetRelativeDate()
			{
				return relativeDate;
			}

			private static bool MatchHelper(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, DateTime rangeStart, DateTime rangeEnd, DateTime comparisonValue)
			{
				switch (comparisonOperator)
				{
				case ComparisonOperator.Equals:
					if (rangeStart <= comparisonValue)
					{
						return rangeEnd >= comparisonValue;
					}
					return false;
				case ComparisonOperator.NotEquals:
					return !MatchHelper(ComparisonOperator.Equals, rangeStart, rangeEnd, comparisonValue);
				case ComparisonOperator.LessThan:
					return comparisonValue < rangeStart;
				case ComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo:
					if (!(comparisonValue < rangeStart))
					{
						return MatchHelper(ComparisonOperator.Equals, rangeStart, rangeEnd, comparisonValue);
					}
					return true;
				case ComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
					return comparisonValue > rangeEnd;
				case ComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo:
					if (!(comparisonValue > rangeEnd))
					{
						return MatchHelper(ComparisonOperator.Equals, rangeStart, rangeEnd, comparisonValue);
					}
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}

			private void ResetCurrentDate()
			{
				useCustomCurrentDate = false;
				cachedCurrentDate = DateTime.MinValue;
			}

			private void SetCurrentDate(DateTime currentDate)
			{
				useCustomCurrentDate = true;
				customCurrentDate = currentDate;
			}

			private void VerifyCache(ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				CultureInfo cultureInfo = ((context != null && context.CurrentValue != null) ? context.CurrentValue.Culture : null) ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
				if (cachedCurrentDate == (useCustomCurrentDate ? customCurrentDate : DateTime.Today) && cultureInfo == cachedCurrentCulture)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (useCustomCurrentDate)
				{
					cachedCurrentDate = customCurrentDate;
				}
				else
				{
					cachedCurrentDate = DateTime.Today;
				}
				cachedCurrentCulture = cultureInfo;
				switch (relativeDate)
				{
				case RelativeDate.NextWeek:
				case RelativeDate.ThisWeek:
				case RelativeDate.LastWeek:
				{
					DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek = cultureInfo.DateTimeFormat.FirstDayOfWeek;
					int num = (cachedCurrentDate.DayOfWeek - firstDayOfWeek + 7) % 7;
					DateTime dateTime6 = cachedCurrentDate.AddDays(-num);
					if (relativeDate == RelativeDate.LastWeek)
					{
						cachedStart = dateTime6.AddDays(-7.0);
					}
					else if (relativeDate == RelativeDate.NextWeek)
					{
						cachedStart = dateTime6.AddDays(7.0);
					}
					else
					{
						cachedStart = dateTime6;
					}
					cachedEnd = cachedStart.AddDays(6.0);
					break;
				}
				case RelativeDate.LastMonth:
				{
					DateTime dateTime5 = cachedCurrentDate.AddMonths(-1);
					cachedStart = new DateTime(dateTime5.Year, dateTime5.Month, 1);
					cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateTime5.Year, dateTime5.Month, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime5.Year, dateTime5.Month));
					break;
				}
				case RelativeDate.ThisMonth:
				{
					DateTime dateTime4 = cachedCurrentDate;
					cachedStart = new DateTime(dateTime4.Year, dateTime4.Month, 1);
					cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateTime4.Year, dateTime4.Month, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime4.Year, dateTime4.Month));
					break;
				}
				case RelativeDate.NextMonth:
				{
					DateTime dateTime3 = cachedCurrentDate.AddMonths(1);
					cachedStart = new DateTime(dateTime3.Year, dateTime3.Month, 1);
					cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateTime3.Year, dateTime3.Month, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime3.Year, dateTime3.Month));
					break;
				}
				case RelativeDate.LastQuarter:
				{
					DateTime dateInQuarter2 = cachedCurrentDate.AddMonths(-3);
					CalculateQuarterRange(dateInQuarter2, ref cachedStart, ref cachedEnd);
					break;
				}
				case RelativeDate.ThisQuarter:
					CalculateQuarterRange(cachedCurrentDate, ref cachedStart, ref cachedEnd);
					break;
				case RelativeDate.NextQuarter:
				{
					DateTime dateInQuarter = cachedCurrentDate.AddMonths(3);
					CalculateQuarterRange(dateInQuarter, ref cachedStart, ref cachedEnd);
					break;
				}
				case RelativeDate.LastYear:
				{
					DateTime dateTime2 = cachedCurrentDate.AddYears(-1);
					cachedStart = new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, 1, 1);
					cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, 12, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime2.Year, 12));
					break;
				}
				case RelativeDate.ThisYear:
					cachedStart = new DateTime(cachedCurrentDate.Year, 1, 1);
					cachedEnd = new DateTime(cachedCurrentDate.Year, 12, DateTime.DaysInMonth(cachedCurrentDate.Year, 12));
					break;
				case RelativeDate.NextYear:
				{
					DateTime dateTime = cachedCurrentDate.AddYears(1);
					cachedStart = new DateTime(dateTime.Year, 1, 1);
					cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateTime.Year, 12, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime.Year, 12));
					break;
				}
				case RelativeDate.YearToDate:
					cachedStart = new DateTime(cachedCurrentDate.Year, 1, 1);
					cachedEnd = cachedCurrentDate;
					break;
				case RelativeDate.Tomorrow:
					cachedStart = (cachedEnd = cachedCurrentDate.AddDays(1.0));
					break;
				case RelativeDate.Today:
					cachedStart = (cachedEnd = cachedCurrentDate);
					break;
				case RelativeDate.Yesterday:
					cachedStart = (cachedEnd = cachedCurrentDate.AddDays(-1.0));
					break;
				default:
					cachedStart = DateTime.MaxValue;
					cachedEnd = DateTime.MinValue;
					break;
				}
			}

			protected override bool EqualsOverride(SpecialFilterOperandBase operand)
			{
				if (operand is RelativeDateOperand relativeDateOperand && base.EqualsOverride((SpecialFilterOperandBase)relativeDateOperand))
				{
					return relativeDate == relativeDateOperand.relativeDate;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return base.GetHashCode() ^ relativeDate.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (!base.IsMatch(comparisonOperator, value, context))
				{
					return false;
				}
				VerifyCache(context);
				DateTime date = ((DateTime)value).Date;
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedStart, cachedEnd, date);
			}
		}

		internal class MonthOperand : DateOperand
		{
			private class FormattedMonthName : IFormattable
			{
				private MonthOperand _operand;

				internal FormattedMonthName(MonthOperand operand)
				{
					_operand = operand;
				}

				public string ToString(string format, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
				{
					try
					{
						DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = DateTimeFormatInfo.GetInstance(formatProvider);
						if (dateTimeFormatInfo == null)
						{
							dateTimeFormatInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.DateTimeFormat;
						}
						return dateTimeFormatInfo.GetMonthName(_operand.month);
					}
					catch
					{
						return _operand.month.ToString();
					}
				}
			}

			internal class SerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
			{
				private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

				public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
				{
					get
					{
						if (_props == null)
						{
							_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[2]
							{
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(string), "Name"),
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(short), "Month")
							};
						}
						return _props;
					}
				}

				public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
				{
					MonthOperand monthOperand = (MonthOperand)obj;
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					dictionary["Name"] = monthOperand.Name;
					dictionary["Month"] = monthOperand.month;
					return dictionary;
				}

				public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
				{
					if (values.TryGetValue("Name", out var value) && values.TryGetValue("Month", out var value2))
					{
						return new MonthOperand((string)value, (short)value2);
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			private short month;

			protected override object[] ValueArgumentsForStrings => new object[1]
			{
				new FormattedMonthName(this)
			};

			public MonthOperand(string name, short month)
				: base(name, "Month")
			{
				if (month < 1 || month > 12)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				this.month = month;
			}

			protected override bool EqualsOverride(SpecialFilterOperandBase operand)
			{
				if (operand is MonthOperand monthOperand && base.EqualsOverride((SpecialFilterOperandBase)monthOperand))
				{
					return month == monthOperand.month;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return base.GetHashCode() ^ month.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (!base.IsMatch(comparisonOperator, value, context))
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = ((DateTime)value).Month;
				return comparisonOperator switch
				{
					ComparisonOperator.Equals => month == num, 
					ComparisonOperator.NotEquals => month != num, 
					ComparisonOperator.LessThan => num < month, 
					ComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo => num <= month, 
					ComparisonOperator.GreaterThan => num > month, 
					ComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo => num >= month, 
					_ => false, 
				};
			}

			internal short GetMonth()
			{
				return month;
			}
		}
