		internal class DateRangeOperand : DateOperand
		{
			internal class SerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
			{
				private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

				public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
				{
					get
					{
						if (_props == null)
						{
							_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[2]
							{
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(DateRangeScope), "Scope"),
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(DateTime), "RelativeDate")
							};
						}
						return _props;
					}
				}

				public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
				{
					DateRangeOperand dateRangeOperand = (DateRangeOperand)obj;
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					dictionary["Scope"] = dateRangeOperand._scope;
					dictionary["RelativeDate"] = dateRangeOperand._relativeDate;
					return dictionary;
				}

				public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
				{
					if (values.TryGetValue("Scope", out var value) && values.TryGetValue("RelativeDate", out var value2))
					{
						return new DateRangeOperand((DateTime)value2, (DateRangeScope)value);
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			private DateTime _relativeDate;

			private DateRangeScope _scope;

			private DateRange _cachedDateRange;

			private static System.Globalization.Calendar Calendar => CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.Calendar;

			protected override object[] ValueArgumentsForStrings => new object[1] { _relativeDate };

			public DateRangeOperand(DateTime relativeDate, DateRangeScope scope)
				: base(GetName(relativeDate, scope), GetResourceName(scope))
			{
				_relativeDate = relativeDate;
				_scope = scope;
				_cachedDateRange = CalculateRange(relativeDate, scope);
			}

			private static DateRange CalculateRange(DateTime relativeDate, DateRangeScope scope)
			{
				int year = relativeDate.Year;
				int month = relativeDate.Month;
				int day = relativeDate.Day;
				int hour = relativeDate.Hour;
				int minute = relativeDate.Minute;
				int second = relativeDate.Second;
				switch (scope)
				{
				case DateRangeScope.Year:
					month = (day = 1);
					hour = (minute = (second = 0));
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Month:
					day = 1;
					hour = (minute = (second = 0));
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Day:
					hour = (minute = (second = 0));
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Hour:
					minute = (second = 0);
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Minute:
					second = 0;
					break;
				}
				DateTime date = GetDate(year, month, day, hour, minute, second, isStart: true);
				DateTime endDate = GetEndDate(scope, year, month, day, hour, minute, second);
				return new DateRange(date, endDate);
			}

			private static DateTime GetDate(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute, int second, bool isStart)
			{
				System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = Calendar;
				try
				{
					return calendar.ToDateTime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second, 0);
				}
				catch (ArgumentOutOfRangeException)
				{
					return isStart ? calendar.MinSupportedDateTime : calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime;
				}
			}

			private static DateTime GetEndDate(DateRangeScope scope, int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute, int second)
			{
				switch (scope)
				{
				case DateRangeScope.Year:
					year++;
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Month:
					if (month == 12)
					{
						return GetEndDate(DateRangeScope.Year, year, 1, day, hour, minute, second);
					}
					month++;
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Day:
					if (day == Calendar.GetDaysInMonth(year, month))
					{
						return GetEndDate(DateRangeScope.Month, year, month, 1, hour, minute, second);
					}
					day++;
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Hour:
					if (hour == 23)
					{
						return GetEndDate(DateRangeScope.Day, year, month, day, 0, minute, second);
					}
					hour++;
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Minute:
					if (minute == 59)
					{
						return GetEndDate(DateRangeScope.Hour, year, month, day, hour, 0, second);
					}
					minute++;
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Second:
					if (second == 59)
					{
						return GetEndDate(DateRangeScope.Minute, year, month, day, hour, minute, 0);
					}
					second++;
					break;
				}
				return GetDate(year, month, day, hour, minute, second, isStart: false);
			}

			private static string GetName(DateTime relativeDate, DateRangeScope scope)
			{
				CultureInfo invariantCulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				string format;
				switch (scope)
				{
				case DateRangeScope.Year:
					format = "DateRange {0:yyyy}";
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Month:
					format = "DateRange {0:yyyy}-{0:MM}";
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Day:
					format = "DateRange {0:yyyy}-{0:MM}-{0:dd}";
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Hour:
					format = "DateRange {0:yyyy}-{0:MM}-{0:dd} {0:HH}";
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Minute:
					format = "DateRange {0:yyyy}-{0:MM}-{0:dd} {0:HH}:{0:mm}";
					break;
				case DateRangeScope.Second:
					format = "DateRange {0:yyyy}-{0:MM}-{0:dd} {0:HH}:{0:mm}:{0:ss}";
					break;
				default:
					return "DateRange";
				}
				return string.Format(invariantCulture, format, new object[1] { relativeDate });
			}

			private static string GetResourceName(DateRangeScope scope)
			{
				return scope switch
				{
					DateRangeScope.Year => "DateRange_Year", 
					DateRangeScope.Month => "DateRange_Month", 
					DateRangeScope.Day => "DateRange_Day", 
					DateRangeScope.Hour => "DateRange_Hour", 
					DateRangeScope.Minute => "DateRange_Minute", 
					DateRangeScope.Second => "DateRange_Second", 
					_ => "DateRange", 
				};
			}

			protected override bool EqualsOverride(SpecialFilterOperandBase operand)
			{
				if (operand is DateRangeOperand dateRangeOperand && _scope == dateRangeOperand._scope)
				{
					return base.EqualsOverride((SpecialFilterOperandBase)dateRangeOperand);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return base.GetHashCode() ^ _scope.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (!base.IsMatch(comparisonOperator, value, context))
				{
					return false;
				}
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				return comparisonOperator switch
				{
					ComparisonOperator.Equals => _cachedDateRange.ContainsExclusive(dateTime), 
					ComparisonOperator.NotEquals => !_cachedDateRange.ContainsExclusive(dateTime), 
					ComparisonOperator.LessThan => dateTime < _cachedDateRange.Start, 
					ComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo => dateTime < _cachedDateRange.End, 
					ComparisonOperator.GreaterThan => dateTime >= _cachedDateRange.End, 
					ComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo => dateTime >= _cachedDateRange.Start, 
					_ => false, 
				};
			}
		}

		internal class InOperand : IGOperand
		{
			internal class SerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
			{
				private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

				public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
				{
					get
					{
						if (_props == null)
						{
							_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[1]
							{
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(object), "[]")
							};
						}
						return _props;
					}
				}

				public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
				{
					InOperand inOperand = (InOperand)obj;
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					List<ObjectWrapper> list = new List<ObjectWrapper>();
					foreach (object item in inOperand._items)
					{
						list.Add(new ObjectWrapper(item));
					}
					dictionary["[]"] = list;
					return dictionary;
				}

				public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
				{
					if (values.TryGetValue("[]", out var value))
					{
						ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
						foreach (ObjectWrapper item in (IEnumerable)value)
						{
							arrayList.Add(item.Value);
						}
						return new InOperand(arrayList);
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			private class CacheKey
			{
				internal InOperand Operand;

				internal Type PreferredComparisonDataType;

				internal Type ConvertToType;

				internal CultureInfo Culture;

				internal bool IgnoreCase;

				public override int GetHashCode()
				{
					int num = Operand.GetHashCode() ^ Culture.GetHashCode() ^ IgnoreCase.GetHashCode();
					if (ConvertToType != null)
					{
						num ^= ConvertToType.GetHashCode();
					}
					if (PreferredComparisonDataType != null)
					{
						num ^= PreferredComparisonDataType.GetHashCode();
					}
					return num;
				}

				public override bool Equals(object obj)
				{
					if (!(obj is CacheKey))
					{
						return false;
					}
					CacheKey cacheKey = (CacheKey)obj;
					if (cacheKey.Operand == Operand && cacheKey.PreferredComparisonDataType == PreferredComparisonDataType && cacheKey.ConvertToType == ConvertToType && cacheKey.Culture == Culture)
					{
						return cacheKey.IgnoreCase == IgnoreCase;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			private class CacheInfo
			{
				internal readonly HashSet Items;

				internal readonly SpecialFilterOperandBase BlanksOperand;

				internal CacheInfo(HashSet items, SpecialFilterOperandBase blanksOperand)
				{
					CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(items);
					Items = items;
					BlanksOperand = blanksOperand;
				}
			}

			private IEnumerable _items;

			protected override object[] ValueArgumentsForStrings
			{
				get
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
					foreach (object item in _items)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(item);
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Remove(stringBuilder.Length - 2, 2);
					}
					return new object[1] { stringBuilder.ToString() };
				}
			}

			public InOperand(IEnumerable items)
				: base("In")
			{
				_items = items ?? new object[0];
			}

			protected override bool EqualsOverride(SpecialFilterOperandBase operand)
			{
				if (operand is InOperand inOperand && base.EqualsOverride((SpecialFilterOperandBase)inOperand))
				{
					return inOperand._items == _items;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return base.GetHashCode() ^ _items.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				if (!base.IsMatch(comparisonOperator, value, context))
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (comparisonOperator)
				{
				case ComparisonOperator.In:
					comparisonOperator = ComparisonOperator.Equals;
					break;
				case ComparisonOperator.NotIn:
					comparisonOperator = ComparisonOperator.NotEquals;
					break;
				}
				ComparisonCondition.GetConvertType(comparisonOperator, context, value, value, out var lhsConvertType, out var rhsConvertType, out var _);
				CultureInfo culture = ComparisonCondition.GetCulture(context);
				CacheKey cacheIdentifier = new CacheKey
				{
					Operand = this,
					PreferredComparisonDataType = context.PreferredComparisonDataType,
					ConvertToType = lhsConvertType,
					Culture = culture,
					IgnoreCase = context.IgnoreCase
				};
				CacheInfo cacheInfo = context.GetUserCache(cacheIdentifier) as CacheInfo;
				if (cacheInfo == null)
				{
					IEqualityComparer equalityComparer = ((rhsConvertType == typeof(string)) ? StringComparer.Create(culture, context.IgnoreCase) : null);
					HashSet hashSet = new HashSet(10, 0.5f, equalityComparer);
					SpecialFilterOperandBase blanksOperand = null;
					foreach (object item in _items)
					{
						if (item is SpecialFilterOperandBase && ((SpecialFilterOperandBase)item).Name == "Blanks")
						{
							blanksOperand = item as SpecialFilterOperandBase;
						}
						else if (rhsConvertType != null)
						{
							object obj = ComparisonCondition.ConvertDataTypeHelper(item, rhsConvertType, context);
							if (obj != null)
							{
								hashSet.Add(obj);
							}
						}
					}
					cacheInfo = new CacheInfo(hashSet, blanksOperand);
					context.SetUserCache(cacheIdentifier, cacheInfo);
				}
				object obj2 = ((lhsConvertType != null) ? ComparisonCondition.ConvertDataTypeHelper(value, lhsConvertType, context) : value);
				if (cacheInfo.BlanksOperand != null && cacheInfo.BlanksOperand.IsMatch(comparisonOperator, obj2, context))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (obj2 == null || obj2 == DBNull.Value)
				{
					return comparisonOperator == ComparisonOperator.NotEquals;
				}
				return cacheInfo.Items.Contains(obj2) == (comparisonOperator == ComparisonOperator.Equals);
			}

			public override bool SupportsDataType(Type type)
			{
				return true;
			}

			public override bool SupportsOperator(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator)
			{
				if (comparisonOperator != ComparisonOperator.Equals && comparisonOperator != ComparisonOperator.NotEquals && comparisonOperator != ComparisonOperator.In)
				{
					return comparisonOperator == ComparisonOperator.NotIn;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal static List<IGOperand> GetBuiltInOperands()
		{
			List<IGOperand> list = new List<IGOperand>(50);
			list.Add(new BlanksOperand(nonBlanks: false));
			list.Add(new BlanksOperand(nonBlanks: true));

	public class SpecialFilterOperands
	{
		internal class OperandWrapper : SpecialFilterOperandBase
		{
			internal class OperandWrapperSerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
			{
				private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

				private const string NameProp = "Name";

				public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
				{
					get
					{
						if (_props == null)
						{
							_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[1]
							{
								new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(string), "Name")
							};
						}
						return _props;
					}
				}

				public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
				{
					OperandWrapper operandWrapper = (OperandWrapper)obj;
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					dictionary["Name"] = operandWrapper.Name;
					return dictionary;
				}

				public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
				{
					if (values.TryGetValue("Name", out var value))
					{
						return new OperandWrapper((string)value);
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			private string _operandName;

			private int _verifiedRegisteredOperandsVersion;

			private SpecialFilterOperandBase _cachedOperand;

			private static Dictionary<string, OperandWrapper> g_wrappers;

			private SpecialFilterOperandBase Source
			{
				get
				{
					if (_verifiedRegisteredOperandsVersion != g_registeredOperandsVersion)
					{
						_verifiedRegisteredOperandsVersion = g_registeredOperandsVersion;
						SpecialFilterOperandBase specialFilterOperandBase = GetRegisteredOperand(_operandName);
						if (specialFilterOperandBase == null)
						{
							specialFilterOperandBase = GetBuiltInOperand(_operandName);
						}
						if (specialFilterOperandBase != null)
						{
							_cachedOperand = specialFilterOperandBase;
						}
					}
					return _cachedOperand;
				}
			}

			public override object Description
			{
				get
				{
					SpecialFilterOperandBase source = Source;
					if (source == null)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					return source.Description;
				}
			}

			public override object DisplayContent => Source?.DisplayContent;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					SpecialFilterOperandBase source = Source;
					if (source == null)
					{
						return _operandName;
					}
					return source.Name;
				}
			}

			public override bool UsesAllValues => Source?.UsesAllValues ?? false;

			static OperandWrapper()
			{
				g_wrappers = new Dictionary<string, OperandWrapper>();
			}

			private OperandWrapper(string operandName)
			{
				_operandName = operandName;
			}

			protected override bool EqualsOverride(SpecialFilterOperandBase obj)
			{
				SpecialFilterOperandBase source = Source;
				SpecialFilterOperandBase specialFilterOperandBase;
				if (obj is OperandWrapper operandWrapper)
				{
					specialFilterOperandBase = operandWrapper.Source;
					if (source == null && specialFilterOperandBase == null)
					{
						return Name == operandWrapper.Name;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					specialFilterOperandBase = obj;
				}
				if (source != null && specialFilterOperandBase != null)
				{
					return source.Equals(specialFilterOperandBase);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return Source?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				SpecialFilterOperandBase source = Source;
				if (source == null)
				{
					return Name;
				}
				return source.ToString();
			}

			internal static OperandWrapper GetWrapper(string operandName)
			{
				lock (g_wrappers)
				{
					if (g_wrappers.TryGetValue(operandName, out var value))
					{
						return value;
					}
					value = new OperandWrapper(operandName);
					if (value.Source != null)
					{
						g_wrappers[operandName] = value;
						return value;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context)
			{
				return Source?.IsMatch(comparisonOperator, value, context) ?? false;
			}

			public override bool SupportsOperator(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator)
			{
				return Source?.SupportsOperator(comparisonOperator) ?? false;
			}

			public override bool SupportsDataType(Type type)
			{
				return Source?.SupportsDataType(type) ?? false;
			}
		}

		private static int g_registeredOperandsVersion;

		private static Dictionary<string, SpecialFilterOperandBase> g_builtInOperands;

		private static Dictionary<string, SpecialFilterOperandBase> g_operands;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public static int Version => g_registeredOperandsVersion;

		static SpecialFilterOperands()
		{
			g_registeredOperandsVersion = 1;
			g_builtInOperands = new Dictionary<string, SpecialFilterOperandBase>();
			g_operands = new Dictionary<string, SpecialFilterOperandBase>();
			foreach (SpecialFilterOperandFactory.IGOperand builtInOperand in SpecialFilterOperandFactory.GetBuiltInOperands())
			{
				string name = builtInOperand.Name;
				g_builtInOperands.Add(name, builtInOperand);
				g_operands.Add(name, builtInOperand);
			}
		}

		private SpecialFilterOperands()
		{
		}

		internal static SpecialFilterOperandBase CreateInOperand(IEnumerable items)
		{
			return new SpecialFilterOperandFactory.InOperand(items);
		}

		internal static object GetSerializationValue(SpecialFilterOperandBase source)
		{
			if (source is SpecialFilterOperandFactory.IGOperand || source is OperandWrapper)
			{
				return source;
			}
			SpecialFilterOperandBase registeredOperand = GetRegisteredOperand(source.Name);
			if (registeredOperand == source)
			{
				return OperandWrapper.GetWrapper(source.Name);
			}
			return source;
		}

		internal static void RegisterSerializationInfos(ObjectSerializerBase serializer)
		{
			serializer.RegisterInfo(typeof(OperandWrapper), new OperandWrapper.OperandWrapperSerializationInfo());
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperandBase CreateDateRangeOperand(DateTime relativeDate, DateRangeScope scope)
		{
			return new SpecialFilterOperandFactory.DateRangeOperand(relativeDate, scope);
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperandBase GetBuiltInOperand(string name)
		{
			if (g_builtInOperands.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperandBase GetRegisteredOperand(string name)
		{
			lock (g_operands)
			{
				g_operands.TryGetValue(name, out var value);
				return value;
			}
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperandBase[] GetRegisteredOperands()
		{
			return GetRegisteredOperands(null);
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperandBase[] GetRegisteredOperands(Type dataType)
		{
			List<SpecialFilterOperandBase> list = new List<SpecialFilterOperandBase>();
			lock (g_operands)
			{
				foreach (SpecialFilterOperandBase value in g_operands.Values)
				{
					if (null == dataType || value.SupportsDataType(dataType))
					{
						list.Add(value);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static void Register(SpecialFilterOperandBase operand)
		{
			lock (g_operands)
			{
				g_operands[operand.Name] = operand;
				g_registeredOperandsVersion++;
			}
		}

		public static void Unregister(SpecialFilterOperandBase operand)
		{
			lock (g_operands)
			{
				g_operands.Remove(operand.Name);
				g_registeredOperandsVersion++;
			}
		}
	}
	public class SpecialFilterOperandTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			return sourceType == typeof(string);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is string))
			{
				throw GetConvertFromException(value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			SpecialFilterOperandBase[] registeredOperands = SpecialFilterOperands.GetRegisteredOperands();
			string[] array = new string[registeredOperands.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < registeredOperands.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = registeredOperands[i].Name;
			}
			return new StandardValuesCollection(array);
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SpecialFilterOperandBase
	{
		public abstract object Description { get; }

		public abstract object DisplayContent { get; }

		public abstract string Name { get; }

		public abstract bool UsesAllValues { get; }

		public SpecialFilterOperandBase()
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is SpecialFilterOperandBase specialFilterOperandBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (specialFilterOperandBase is SpecialFilterOperands.OperandWrapper && !(this is SpecialFilterOperands.OperandWrapper))
			{
				return specialFilterOperandBase.EqualsOverride(this);
			}
			return EqualsOverride(specialFilterOperandBase);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			object displayContent = DisplayContent;
			string text = GetString(displayContent);
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = Description as string;
				if (text == null && displayContent != null)
				{
					text = displayContent.ToString();
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				return base.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected virtual bool EqualsOverride(SpecialFilterOperandBase operand)
		{
			return this == operand;
		}

		public abstract bool IsMatch(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context);

		public abstract bool SupportsOperator(ComparisonOperator comparisonOperator);

		public abstract bool SupportsDataType(Type type);

		private static string GetString(object value)
		{
			if (value is SpecialFilterOperandFactory.IGOperand.FormattedSRValue formattedSRValue)
			{
				return formattedSRValue.ToString();
			}
			return value as string;
		}
	}
	public interface ICondition : ICloneable
	{
		bool IsMatch(object value, ConditionEvaluationContext context);
	}

	}

	public sealed class FormattableToStringConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is IFormattable formattable))
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			if (!(parameter is string) && parameter != null)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			string text = parameter as string;
			return formattable.ToString(text, culture);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
		}
	}
	public abstract class IGControlBase : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		private SelectionController _selectionController;

		private ResizeController _resizeController;

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = base.VisualChildrenCount;
				if (this is IResizeHost resizeHost && resizeHost.Controller.ResizerBar != null)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract CommandsBase Commands { get; }

		protected IGControlBase()
		{
			Infragistics.Windows.Themes.ThemeManager.VerifyThemeInformationRegistered(GetType().Assembly);
			if (this is ISelectionHost)
			{
				_selectionController = new SelectionController((ISelectionHost)this);
				_selectionController.ActiveStrategyChanged += OnActiveSelectionStrategyChanged;
			}
			if (this is IResizeHost)
			{
				_resizeController = ((IResizeHost)this).Controller;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (this is IResizeHost resizeHost && resizeHost.Controller.ResizerBar != null)
			{
				resizeHost.Controller.PositionResizerBar();
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (this is IResizeHost resizeHost && resizeHost.Controller.ResizerBar != null && index == base.VisualChildrenCount)
			{
				return resizeHost.Controller.ResizerBar;
			}
			return base.GetVisualChild(index);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				e.Handled = CancelPendingMouseOperations(killDblClickTimer: true);
			}
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled && !e.Handled && Commands != null && Commands.ProcessKeyboardInput(e, this as ICommandHost))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource == this || !base.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				CancelPendingMouseOperations(killDblClickTimer: false);
			}
			base.OnLostMouseCapture(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (_selectionController != null && !e.Handled)
			{
				_selectionController.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
				_ = e.Handled;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			if ((_resizeController == null || !_resizeController.IsResizing) && _selectionController != null && !e.Handled)
			{
				_selectionController.OnMouseMove(e);
				_ = e.Handled;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if ((_resizeController == null || !_resizeController.IsResizing) && _selectionController != null && !e.Handled)
			{
				_selectionController.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
				_ = e.Handled;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled && !base.IsKeyboardFocused && !base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && base.Focusable && base.IsEnabled && !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(this, Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject, preferLogicalTree: true))
			{
				PerformFocusOnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnActiveSelectionStrategyChanged(SelectionStrategyBase strategy)
		{
		}

		internal virtual void PerformFocusOnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs args)
		{
			Focus();
		}

		private bool CancelPendingMouseOperations(bool killDblClickTimer)
		{
			IResizeHost resizeHost = this as IResizeHost;
			bool flag = false;
			if (resizeHost != null && resizeHost.Controller.IsResizing)
			{
				resizeHost.Controller.CancelResize();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (_selectionController != null)
			{
				flag = flag || _selectionController.CancelPendingOperations(killDblClickTimer);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void OnActiveSelectionStrategyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnActiveSelectionStrategyChanged(_selectionController.ActiveStrategy);
		}
	}

	{
	}
	public static class PopupHelper
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static bool? _popupAllowsTransparency;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DropDownButtonProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty HandleMouseDownOnCloseProperty;

		internal static bool IsPopupInChildWindow => !PopupAllowsTransparency;

		internal static bool PopupAllowsTransparency
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_popupAllowsTransparency.HasValue)
				{
					Popup popup = new Popup();
					popup.AllowsTransparency = true;
					popup.CoerceValue(Popup.AllowsTransparencyProperty);
					_popupAllowsTransparency = popup.AllowsTransparency;
				}
				return _popupAllowsTransparency.Value;
			}
		}

		static PopupHelper()
		{
			DropDownButtonProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("DropDownButton", typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase), typeof(PopupHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnDropDownButtonChanged));
			HandleMouseDownOnCloseProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("HandleMouseDownOnClose", typeof(bool), typeof(PopupHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnHandleMouseDownOnCloseChanged));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(Popup), Mouse.PreviewMouseUpEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPopupPreviewMouseUp));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(Popup), Mouse.PreviewMouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPopupPreviewMouseDown));
		}

		private static void OnDropDownButtonChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Popup popup)
			{
				if (e.NewValue == null)
				{
					popup.Opened -= OnPopupOpened;
				}
				else
				{
					popup.Opened += OnPopupOpened;
				}
			}
		}

		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(Popup))]
		public static System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase GetDropDownButton(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase)d.GetValue(DropDownButtonProperty);
		}

		public static void SetDropDownButton(DependencyObject d, System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase value)
		{
			d.SetValue(DropDownButtonProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnHandleMouseDownOnCloseChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Popup popup)
			{
				if (true.Equals(e.NewValue))
				{
					popup.PreviewMouseDown += OnPopupPreviewMouseDownInstance;
				}
				else
				{
					popup.PreviewMouseDown -= OnPopupPreviewMouseDownInstance;
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool GetHandleMouseDownOnClose(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(HandleMouseDownOnCloseProperty);
		}

		public static void SetHandleMouseDownOnClose(DependencyObject d, bool value)
		{
			d.SetValue(HandleMouseDownOnCloseProperty, value);
		}

		public static void BringToFront(Popup popup)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(popup, "popup");
			if (!popup.IsOpen)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				PopupController.BringToFront(popup);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private static void OnPopupOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Popup popup = (Popup)sender;
			System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase dropDownButton = GetDropDownButton(popup);
			if (dropDownButton != null && dropDownButton.IsMouseCaptureWithin && !popup.StaysOpen)
			{
				dropDownButton.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				popup.StaysOpen = true;
				popup.StaysOpen = false;
			}
		}

		private static void OnPopupPreviewMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Popup popup = sender as Popup;
			System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase dropDownButton = GetDropDownButton(popup);
			if (dropDownButton != null && popup.IsOpen && !popup.StaysOpen && dropDownButton.ClickMode == ClickMode.Press)
			{
				HitTestResult hitTestResult = VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(dropDownButton, e.GetPosition(dropDownButton));
				if (hitTestResult != null && hitTestResult.VisualHit != null && dropDownButton.IsAncestorOf(hitTestResult.VisualHit))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnPopupPreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Popup popup = sender as Popup;
			System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase dropDownButton = GetDropDownButton(popup);
			if (dropDownButton == null || !popup.IsOpen || popup.StaysOpen || dropDownButton.ClickMode == ClickMode.Hover)
			{
				return;
			}
			HitTestResult hitTestResult = VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(dropDownButton, e.GetPosition(dropDownButton));
			if (hitTestResult != null && hitTestResult.VisualHit != null && dropDownButton.IsAncestorOf(hitTestResult.VisualHit))
			{
				if (dropDownButton.ClickMode == ClickMode.Press)
				{
					popup.IsOpen = false;
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static void OnPopupPreviewMouseDownInstance(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Popup popup = sender as Popup;
			if (!popup.IsOpen && GetHandleMouseDownOnClose(popup))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}
	}

		public Rect MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty || visual == null || !IsAncestorOf(visual))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			GeneralTransform generalTransform = visual.TransformToAncestor(this);
			if (generalTransform == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect rect = generalTransform.TransformBounds(rectangle);
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				Rect rect2 = new Rect(base.RenderSize);
				Rect rect3 = Rect.Intersect(rect, rect2);
				if (rect3.Width != rect.Width)
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					if (rect.Right > rect2.Right)
					{
						num = rect.Right - rect2.Right;
					}
					if (rect.Left - num - rect2.Left < 0.0)
					{
						num += rect.Left - num - rect2.Left;
					}
					rect.X -= num;
					num += HorizontalOffset;
					SetHorizontalOffset(num);
				}
				if (rect3.Height != rect.Height)
				{
					double num2 = 0.0;
					if (rect.Bottom > rect2.Bottom)
					{
						num2 = rect.Bottom - rect2.Bottom;
					}
					if (rect.Top - num2 - rect2.Top < 0.0)
					{
						num2 += rect.Top - num2 - rect2.Top;
					}
					rect.Y -= num2;
					num2 += VerticalOffset;
					SetVerticalOffset(num2);
				}
			}
			return rect;
		}

		public void SetHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{

			{
				return;

				if (ScrollDataInfo._scrollOwner != null)

					ScrollDataInfo._scrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
				}
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

	internal class GlyphRunFormattedText
	{
		private struct LineInfo
		{
			internal readonly double _width;

			internal readonly double _widthWithoutEllipsis;

			internal readonly int _firstCharIndex;

			internal readonly ushort[] _glyphIndices;

			internal readonly double[] _advanceWidths;

			internal readonly int[] _spaceIndices;

			private LineInfo(double width, double widthWithoutEllipsis, int firstCharIndex, ushort[] glyphIndices, double[] advanceWidths, int[] spaceIndices)
			{
				_width = width;
				_widthWithoutEllipsis = widthWithoutEllipsis;
				_firstCharIndex = firstCharIndex;
				_glyphIndices = glyphIndices;
				_advanceWidths = advanceWidths;
				_spaceIndices = spaceIndices;
			}

			public static LineInfo CreateLine(GlyphRunFormattedText fText, double availableWidth)
			{
				EnsureKerningAdjustments(fText, availableWidth, 0);
				return new LineInfo(fText.Width, fText.Width, 0, fText._glyphIndices, fText._advanceWidths, null);
			}

			public static LineInfo CreateLine(GlyphRunFormattedText fText, List<int> spaceIndices, double availableWidth, int firstCharIndex, int lastCharIndex, bool isLastLine, bool appendEllipsisIfNecessary, bool forceNewLine)
			{
				EnsureKerningAdjustments(fText, availableWidth, firstCharIndex);
				int capacity = lastCharIndex + 1 - firstCharIndex;
				List<ushort> list = new List<ushort>(capacity);
				List<double> list2 = new List<double>(capacity);
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (int i = firstCharIndex; i <= lastCharIndex; i++)
				{
					double num3 = fText._advanceWidths[i];
					ushort num4 = fText._glyphIndices[i];
					if (num3 <= 0.0 && num4 == fText._blankGlythIndex)
					{
						double tabExtent = fText.TabExtent;
						if (tabExtent > 0.0)
						{
							double num5 = num % tabExtent;
							num3 = tabExtent - num5;
						}
					}
					num += num3;
					list2.Add(num3);
					list.Add(num4);
				}
				num2 = num;
				if (fText._trimming != TextTrimming.None && list.Count > spaceIndices.Count)
				{
					Typeface typeface = fText._runProperties.Typeface;
					GlyphTypeface glyphTypeface = fText._glyphTypeface;
					if (glyphTypeface != null)
					{
						IDictionary<int, ushort> characterToGlyphMap = glyphTypeface.CharacterToGlyphMap;
						if (characterToGlyphMap.TryGetValue(46, out var value))
						{
							double fontRenderingEmSize = fText._runProperties.FontRenderingEmSize;
							double num6 = glyphTypeface.AdvanceWidths[value] * fontRenderingEmSize * 1.2;
							double num7 = ((fText._ellipsisKey > 0) ? (fText._ellipsisWidth * fontRenderingEmSize) : (num6 * 3.5));
							bool flag = false;
							double num8 = 0.0;
							if (appendEllipsisIfNecessary && !isLastLine)
							{
								num8 = num7;
							}
							if (num + num8 > availableWidth && (appendEllipsisIfNecessary || (fText._paraProperties.TextWrapping == TextWrapping.WrapWithOverflow && spaceIndices.Count == 0)))
							{
								double num9 = availableWidth - num7;
								double num10 = Math.Max(0.0, num - num9);
								if (fText._trimming == TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis || spaceIndices.Count == 0)
								{
									num2 -= RemoveCharacterByCharacter(list, list2, num10);
								}

			private static void EnsureKerningAdjustments(GlyphRunFormattedText fText, double availableWidth, int lineStartIndex)
			{
				int num = fText._charsWithGlyphs.Length;
				int num2 = num - 2;
				if (fText._pendingKerningAdjustmentIndex > num2)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num3 = 0.0;
				for (int i = Math.Min(lineStartIndex, fText._pendingKerningAdjustmentIndex); i <= num2; i++)
				{
					if (fText._advanceWidths[i] == 0.0 || fText._advanceWidths[i + 1] == 0.0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (i >= fText._pendingKerningAdjustmentIndex)
					{
						double kerningAdjustment = TextMetricsProvider.GetKerningAdjustment(fText._charsWithGlyphs[i], fText._runProperties, fText._charsWithGlyphs[i + 1]);
						if (kerningAdjustment < 0.0)
						{
							fText._advanceWidths[i] += kerningAdjustment;
						}
						fText._pendingKerningAdjustmentIndex = i + 1;
					}
					if (i >= lineStartIndex)
					{
						num3 += fText._advanceWidths[i];
						if (num3 >= availableWidth)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private static double RemoveCharacterByCharacter(List<ushort> glyphIndices, List<double> advanceWidths, double widthRemainingToRecover)
			{
				if (widthRemainingToRecover <= 0.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				double num = 0.0;
				for (int num2 = advanceWidths.Count - 1; num2 >= 1; num2--)
				{
					double num3 = advanceWidths[num2];
					widthRemainingToRecover -= num3;
					num += num3;
					advanceWidths.RemoveAt(num2);
					glyphIndices.RemoveAt(num2);
					if (widthRemainingToRecover <= 0.0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public void Draw(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Brush foreground, Rect bounds, VerticalAlignment verticalAlignment, out double bottom)
		{
			if (_lines == null)
			{
				_lines = new LineInfo[1] { LineInfo.CreateLine(this, bounds.Width) };
			}
			if (_paraProperties.TextAlignment == TextAlignment.Justify && _lastJustifyWidth != bounds.Width)
			{
				JustifyLines(bounds.Width);
			}
			Typeface typeface = _runProperties.Typeface;
			System.Windows.Point baselineOrigin = default(System.Windows.Point);
			double fontRenderingEmSize = _runProperties.FontRenderingEmSize;
			TextDecorationCollection textDecorations = _runProperties.TextDecorations;
			double num = LineHeight * (double)_lines.Length;
			double num2 = _glyphTypeface.Baseline * fontRenderingEmSize;
			if (typeface.Weight == FontWeights.Black || typeface.Weight == FontWeights.ExtraBold || typeface.Weight == FontWeights.ExtraBlack || typeface.Weight == FontWeights.UltraBlack)
			{
				XmlLanguage eN_US_Language = EN_US_Language;
				if (eN_US_Language != null && typeface.FontFamily.FamilyNames.TryGetValue(eN_US_Language, out var value) && value == "Arial")
				{
					num2 += _glyphTypeface.UnderlinePosition * fontRenderingEmSize;
				}
			}
			num = ((_lines.Length != 1) ? (num - (LineHeight - num2)) : num2);
			switch (verticalAlignment)
			{
			case VerticalAlignment.Center:
				baselineOrigin.Y = bounds.Top + (bounds.Height + num) / 2.0;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Top:
			case VerticalAlignment.Stretch:
				baselineOrigin.Y = num2;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
				baselineOrigin.Y = bounds.Bottom - (num - num2);
				break;
			}
			bottom = 0.0;
			LineInfo[] lines = _lines;
			for (int i = 0; i < lines.Length; i++)
			{
				LineInfo lineInfo = lines[i];
				switch (_paraProperties.TextAlignment)
				{
				case TextAlignment.Center:
					baselineOrigin.X = bounds.Left + bounds.Width / 2.0 - lineInfo._width / 2.0;
					break;
				case TextAlignment.Left:
				case TextAlignment.Justify:
					baselineOrigin.X = 0.0;
					break;
				case TextAlignment.Right:
					baselineOrigin.X = bounds.Right - lineInfo._width;
					break;
				}
				if (lineInfo._glyphIndices.Length != 0)
				{
					GlyphRun glyphRun = new GlyphRun(_glyphTypeface, 0, isSideways: false, fontRenderingEmSize, lineInfo._glyphIndices, baselineOrigin, lineInfo._advanceWidths, null, null, null, null, null, null);
					GuidelineSet guidelineSet = new GuidelineSet();
					guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(baselineOrigin.X);
					guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(baselineOrigin.Y);
					dc.PushGuidelineSet(guidelineSet);
					System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = foreground ?? _runProperties.ForegroundBrush;
					dc.DrawGlyphRun(brush, glyphRun);
					dc.Pop();
					if (textDecorations != null && textDecorations.Count > 0)
					{
						foreach (TextDecoration item in textDecorations)
						{
							System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = item.Pen;
							if (pen == null)
							{
								double num3 = ((item.Location == TextDecorationLocation.Strikethrough) ? _glyphTypeface.StrikethroughThickness : _glyphTypeface.UnderlineThickness);
								pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, num3 * fontRenderingEmSize);
							}
							double num4 = 0.0;
							num4 = item.Location switch
							{
								TextDecorationLocation.OverLine => baselineOrigin.Y + pen.Thickness / 2.0 - _glyphTypeface.Baseline * fontRenderingEmSize, 
								TextDecorationLocation.Strikethrough => baselineOrigin.Y - _glyphTypeface.StrikethroughPosition * fontRenderingEmSize, 
								TextDecorationLocation.Underline => baselineOrigin.Y + 1.0 - _glyphTypeface.UnderlinePosition * fontRenderingEmSize, 
								_ => baselineOrigin.Y, 
							};
							guidelineSet = new GuidelineSet();
							guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(baselineOrigin.X);
							guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(num4 + 0.5);
							dc.PushGuidelineSet(guidelineSet);
							dc.DrawLine(pen, new System.Windows.Point(baselineOrigin.X, num4), new System.Windows.Point(baselineOrigin.X + lineInfo._widthWithoutEllipsis, num4));
							dc.Pop();
						}
					}
				}
				bottom = baselineOrigin.Y + (_glyphTypeface.Height - _glyphTypeface.Baseline) * fontRenderingEmSize;
				baselineOrigin.Y += LineHeight;
			}
		}

		private void JustifyLines(double renderWidth)
		{
			_lastJustifyWidth = renderWidth;
			int num = _lines.Length - 2;
			for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
			{
				_lines[i].Justify(renderWidth);
			}
		}

	public interface IGlyphRunTextEvaluator
	{
		bool UseOptimizedGlyphRun(string text, FrameworkElement element, TextRunProperties runProperties, TextParagraphProperties paragraphProperties);
	}
	internal class AnsiOnlyTextEvaluator : IGlyphRunTextEvaluator
	{
		internal static readonly AnsiOnlyTextEvaluator Instance = new AnsiOnlyTextEvaluator();

		private AnsiOnlyTextEvaluator()
		{
		}

		public bool UseOptimizedGlyphRun(string text, FrameworkElement element, TextRunProperties runProperties, TextParagraphProperties paragraphProperties)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int length = text.Length;
			if (length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c > 'ÿ')
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class AnsiNonAlphaOnlyTextEvaluator : IGlyphRunTextEvaluator
	{
		internal static readonly AnsiNonAlphaOnlyTextEvaluator Instance = new AnsiNonAlphaOnlyTextEvaluator();

		private AnsiNonAlphaOnlyTextEvaluator()
		{
		}

		public bool UseOptimizedGlyphRun(string text, FrameworkElement element, TextRunProperties runProperties, TextParagraphProperties paragraphProperties)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int length = text.Length;
			if (length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c > 'ÿ')
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (c > '@' && c < '[')
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (c > '`' && c < '{')
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	internal struct InternalTextRunPropertiesKey : IEquatable<InternalTextRunPropertiesKey>
	{
		internal readonly double Height;

		internal readonly System.Windows.Media.FontFamily Family;

		internal readonly System.Windows.FontStyle Style;

		internal readonly FontWeight Weight;

		internal readonly FontStretch Stretch;

		internal readonly System.Windows.Media.Brush Foreground;

		internal readonly TextDecorationCollection TextDecorations;

		private readonly int _hashCode;

		internal InternalTextRunPropertiesKey(double fontHeight, System.Windows.Media.FontFamily family, System.Windows.Media.Brush foreground, System.Windows.FontStyle style, FontWeight weight, FontStretch stretch, TextDecorationCollection textDecorations)
		{
			Family = family;
			Foreground = foreground;
			Style = style;
			Weight = weight;
			Stretch = stretch;
			Height = fontHeight;
			TextDecorations = textDecorations;
			_hashCode = Height.GetHashCode();
			if (Foreground != null)
			{
				_hashCode ^= Foreground.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (Family != null)
			{
				_hashCode ^= Family.GetHashCode();
			}
			_hashCode ^= Style.GetHashCode();
			_hashCode ^= Weight.GetHashCode();
			_hashCode ^= Stretch.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is InternalTextRunPropertiesKey)
			{
				return Equals((InternalTextRunPropertiesKey)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _hashCode;
		}

		public bool Equals(InternalTextRunPropertiesKey other)
		{
			if (Height == other.Height && Family == other.Family && Foreground == other.Foreground && Style == other.Style && Stretch == other.Stretch && Weight == other.Weight)
			{
				bool flag = TextDecorations != null && TextDecorations.Count > 0;
				bool flag2 = other.TextDecorations != null && other.TextDecorations.Count > 0;
				if (flag != flag2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (TextDecorations.Count != other.TextDecorations.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int num = TextDecorations.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					TextDecoration textDecoration = TextDecorations[num];
					TextDecoration textDecoration2 = other.TextDecorations[num];
					if (textDecoration2 != textDecoration && (textDecoration2.Location != textDecoration.Location || textDecoration2.Pen != textDecoration.Pen || textDecoration2.PenOffset != textDecoration.PenOffset || textDecoration2.PenOffsetUnit != textDecoration.PenOffsetUnit || textDecoration2.PenThicknessUnit != textDecoration.PenThicknessUnit))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		private FormattedText[] FormattedTexts
		{
			get
			{
				if (_formattedTexts == null)
				{
					string text = Text ?? string.Empty;
					CultureInfo languageCultureInfo = Utilities.GetLanguageCultureInfo(this);
					if (TextWrapping == TextWrapping.NoWrap && (text.Length > 9600 || TextTrimming != TextTrimming.None || TextAlignment != TextAlignment.Left))
					{
						List<TextRangeDefinition> textLines = GetTextLines(text);
						_formattedTexts = new FormattedText[textLines.Count];
						for (int i = 0; i < textLines.Count; i++)
						{
							TextRangeDefinition textRangeDefinition = textLines[i];
							FormattedText formattedText = CreatedFormattedText(text.Substring(textRangeDefinition.StartIndex, Math.Min(textRangeDefinition.Length, 9600)), languageCultureInfo);
							formattedText.MaxLineCount = 1;
							_formattedTexts[i] = formattedText;
							if (textRangeDefinition.Length >= 9600)
							{
								if (i < textLines.Count - 1)
								{
									FormattedText[] array = new FormattedText[i + 1];
									Array.Copy(_formattedTexts, array, array.Length);
									_formattedTexts = array;
								}
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (text.EndsWith("\n") || text.EndsWith("\r"))
						{
							text += "\n";
						}
						_formattedTexts = new FormattedText[1] { CreatedFormattedText(text, languageCultureInfo) };
					}
				}
				return _formattedTexts;
			}
		}

		private GlyphRunFormattedText GlyphRunFormattedText
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string text = Text;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return null;
				}
				InternalTextRunProperties internalTextRunProperties = null;
				InternalTextParagraphProperties internalTextParagraphProperties = null;
				if (_glyphRunFT == null)
				{
					if (!_useGlyphRun.HasValue)
					{
						IGlyphRunTextEvaluator glyphRunTextEvaluator = null;
						SimpleTextGlyphRunMode? glyphRunMode = GetGlyphRunMode(this);
						if (!glyphRunMode.HasValue)
						{
							glyphRunTextEvaluator = GlyphRunTextEvaluator;
						}
						else
						{
							switch (glyphRunMode.Value)
							{
							case SimpleTextGlyphRunMode.Always:
								_useGlyphRun = true;
								break;
							case SimpleTextGlyphRunMode.AnsiNonAlphaOnly:
								glyphRunTextEvaluator = AnsiNonAlphaOnlyTextEvaluator.Instance;
								break;
							case SimpleTextGlyphRunMode.AnsiOnly:
								glyphRunTextEvaluator = AnsiOnlyTextEvaluator.Instance;
								break;
							case SimpleTextGlyphRunMode.Never:
								_useGlyphRun = false;
								break;
							case SimpleTextGlyphRunMode.UseGlyphRunTextEvaluator:
								glyphRunTextEvaluator = GetGlyphRunTextEvaluator(this);
								break;
							}
						}
						if (glyphRunTextEvaluator != null)
						{
							internalTextRunProperties = RunProperties;
							internalTextParagraphProperties = CreateParagraphProperties(internalTextRunProperties);
							_useGlyphRun = glyphRunTextEvaluator.UseOptimizedGlyphRun(text, this, internalTextRunProperties, internalTextParagraphProperties);
						}
					}
					if (!_useGlyphRun.HasValue)
					{
						_useGlyphRun = OptimizeWidthMeasurement;
					}
					if (_useGlyphRun == false)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (internalTextRunProperties == null)
					{
						internalTextRunProperties = RunProperties;
					}
					if (internalTextParagraphProperties == null)
					{
						internalTextParagraphProperties = CreateParagraphProperties(internalTextRunProperties);
					}
					_glyphRunFT = GlyphRunFormattedText.Create(this, text, internalTextRunProperties, internalTextParagraphProperties, TextTrimming);
				}
				return _glyphRunFT;
			}
		}

		private InternalTextRunProperties RunProperties
		{
			get
			{
				if (_runProperties == null)
				{
					double fontSize = FontSize;
					InternalTextRunPropertiesKey key = new InternalTextRunPropertiesKey(fontSize, FontFamily, Foreground, FontStyle, FontWeight, FontStretch, TextDecorations);
					if (_RunPropertiesMap == null)
					{
						_RunPropertiesMap = new Dictionary<InternalTextRunPropertiesKey, InternalTextRunProperties>();
					}
					else if (_RunPropertiesMap.TryGetValue(key, out _runProperties))
					{
						return _runProperties;
					}
					Typeface typeface = new Typeface(FontFamily, FontStyle, FontWeight, FontStretch);
					BaselineAlignment alignment = BaselineAlignment.Baseline;
					TextEffectCollection textEffects = null;
					_runProperties = new InternalTextRunProperties(typeface, fontSize, Foreground, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, null, alignment, TextDecorations, textEffects);
					_RunPropertiesMap[key] = _runProperties;
				}
				return _runProperties;
			}
		}

				return _typeface;
			}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			_lastMeasureConstraint = constraint;
			GlyphRunFormattedText glyphRunFormattedText = GlyphRunFormattedText;
			if (glyphRunFormattedText != null)
			{
				return glyphRunFormattedText.Measure(constraint);
			}
			SetConstraintsForMeasure(constraint);
			FormattedText[] formattedTexts = FormattedTexts;
			if (formattedTexts.Length == 0)
			{
				FormattedText formattedText = CreatedFormattedText("Wj", Utilities.GetLanguageCultureInfo(this));
				double width = ((double.IsPositiveInfinity(constraint.Width) || OptimizeWidthMeasurement) ? 0.0 : constraint.Width);
				return OnMeasureOverrideComplete(new System.Windows.Size(width, Math.Min(constraint.Height, formattedText.Height)));
			}
			bool flag = TextWrapping != TextWrapping.NoWrap;
			double? num = null;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			foreach (FormattedText formattedText2 in formattedTexts)
			{
				TextAlignment textAlignment = formattedText2.TextAlignment;
				try
				{
					if (textAlignment != TextAlignment.Left)
					{
						formattedText2.TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Left;
					}
					double extent = formattedText2.Extent;
					double val = ((!flag && !double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width) && OptimizeWidthMeasurement) ? constraint.Width : Math.Min(constraint.Width, formattedText2.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace + 1E-10));
					double num4 = formattedText2.Height;
					if (num4 == 0.0 && formattedText2.Text.Length == 0)
					{
						if (!num.HasValue)
						{
							FormattedText formattedText3 = CreatedFormattedText("Wj", Utilities.GetLanguageCultureInfo(this));
							num = formattedText3.Height;
						}
						num4 = num.Value;
					}
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, val);
					num3 += num4;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (textAlignment != TextAlignment.Left)
					{
						formattedText2.TextAlignment = textAlignment;
					}
				}
			}
			if (base.UseLayoutRounding)
			{
				num2 = Math.Ceiling(num2);
				num3 = Math.Ceiling(num3);
			}
			num3 += 1E-10;
			return OnMeasureOverrideComplete(new System.Windows.Size(num2, num3));
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new SimpleTextBlockAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			GlyphRunFormattedText glyphRunFormattedText = GlyphRunFormattedText;
			if (glyphRunFormattedText != null)
			{
				drawingContext.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(base.RenderSize)));
				glyphRunFormattedText.Draw(drawingContext, Foreground, new Rect(base.RenderSize), base.VerticalAlignment, out var _);
				drawingContext.Pop();
				return;
			}
			SetConstraintsForRender();
			FormattedText[] formattedTexts = FormattedTexts;
			System.Windows.Size renderSize = base.RenderSize;
			bool flag = base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (FormattedText formattedText in formattedTexts)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, formattedText.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace);
				num2 = (flag ? formattedText.OverhangLeading : formattedText.OverhangTrailing);
				num2 = Math.Abs(num2);
			}
			double num3;
			double num4;
			switch (base.HorizontalAlignment)
			{
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left:
				num3 = num;
				num4 = 0.0;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center:
				num3 = num;
				num4 = (renderSize.Width - num) / 2.0;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right:
				num3 = num;
				num4 = renderSize.Width - num;
				break;
			default:
				num3 = renderSize.Width;
				num4 = 0.0;
				if (num > num3)
				{
					switch (TextAlignment)
					{
					case TextAlignment.Center:
						num4 += (num - num3) / 2.0;
						break;
					case TextAlignment.Right:
						num4 += num - num3;
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				drawingContext.PushTransform(new MatrixTransform(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, renderSize.Width, 0.0));
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = renderSize;
			size.Width += num2;
			drawingContext.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(size)));
			double? num5 = null;
			System.Windows.Point origin = default(System.Windows.Point);
			foreach (FormattedText formattedText2 in formattedTexts)
			{
				if (TextWrapping == TextWrapping.NoWrap)
				{
					switch (TextAlignment)
					{
					case TextAlignment.Left:
					case TextAlignment.Justify:
						origin.X = num4;
						break;
					case TextAlignment.Center:
						origin.X = num4 + (num3 - formattedText2.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace) / 2.0;
						break;
					case TextAlignment.Right:
						origin.X = num4 + (num3 - formattedText2.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace);
						break;
					}
					if (flag && TextTrimming == TextTrimming.None)
					{
						bool? useGlyphRun = _useGlyphRun;
						bool flag2 = true;
						if (useGlyphRun == true != flag2 || !useGlyphRun.HasValue || renderSize.Width > formattedText2.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace)
						{
							origin.X = renderSize.Width - origin.X;
						}
					}
				}
				drawingContext.DrawText(formattedText2, origin);
				double num6 = formattedText2.Height;
				if (num6 == 0.0 && formattedText2.Text.Length == 0)
				{
					if (!num5.HasValue)
					{
						FormattedText formattedText3 = CreatedFormattedText("Wj", Utilities.GetLanguageCultureInfo(this));
						num5 = formattedText3.Height;
					}
					num6 = num5.Value;
				}
				origin.Y += num6;
			}
			drawingContext.Pop();
			if (flag)
			{
				drawingContext.Pop();
			}
		}

		private FormattedText CreatedFormattedText(string text, CultureInfo cultureInfo)
		{
			FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(text, cultureInfo, base.FlowDirection, Typeface, FontSize, Foreground, GetNumberSubstitution(), TextOptions.GetTextFormattingMode(this));
			formattedText.Trimming = TextTrimming;
			formattedText.TextAlignment = GetResolvedTextAlignment(TextWrapping, TextAlignment);
			formattedText.SetTextDecorations(TextDecorations);
			return formattedText;
		}

		private static List<TextRangeDefinition> GetTextLines(string text)
		{
			List<TextRangeDefinition> list = new List<TextRangeDefinition>();
			char[] anyOf = new char[2] { '\r', '\n' };
			int num = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				int num2 = text.IndexOfAny(anyOf, num);
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(new TextRangeDefinition
				{
					StartIndex = num,
					Length = num2 - num
				});
				num = num2 + 1;
				if (num < text.Length && text[num2] == '\r' && text[num] == '\n')
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (num <= text.Length)
			{
				list.Add(new TextRangeDefinition
				{
					StartIndex = num,
					Length = text.Length - num
				});
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static TextAlignment GetResolvedTextAlignment(TextWrapping textWrapping, TextAlignment textAlignment)
		{
			if (textWrapping == TextWrapping.NoWrap)
			{
				if (textAlignment != TextAlignment.Justify)
				{
					return TextAlignment.Left;
				}
				return TextAlignment.Justify;
			}
			return textAlignment;
		}

		private static void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SimpleTextBlock simpleTextBlock = (SimpleTextBlock)dependencyObject;
			simpleTextBlock.OnTextPropertyDirtied(out var isMeasureInvalidated);
			if (isMeasureInvalidated)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Property.Name)
			{
			case "Text":
			case "TextFormattingMode":
				if (double.IsInfinity(simpleTextBlock._lastMeasureConstraint.Width) || double.IsInfinity(simpleTextBlock._lastMeasureConstraint.Height) || simpleTextBlock._useGlyphRun == true || !simpleTextBlock.OptimizeWidthMeasurement)
				{
					simpleTextBlock.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				if (e.Property == TextOptions.TextFormattingModeProperty && (TextFormattingMode)e.NewValue == TextFormattingMode.Display && simpleTextBlock.GlyphRunFormattedText == null)
				{
					simpleTextBlock.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.ClipToBoundsProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
				break;
			case "TextWrapping":
				simpleTextBlock.InvalidateMeasure();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetConstraintsForMeasure(System.Windows.Size measureConstraint)
		{
			if (GlyphRunFormattedText != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FormattedText[] formattedTexts = FormattedTexts;
			System.Windows.Size renderSize = base.RenderSize;
			bool flag = TextWrapping != TextWrapping.NoWrap;
			bool flag2 = TextTrimming != TextTrimming.None;
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				double num = (double.IsInfinity(measureConstraint.Width) ? 0.0 : measureConstraint.Width);
				if (formattedTexts[0].MaxTextWidth != num)
				{
					formattedTexts[0].MaxTextWidth = num;
				}
			}
			foreach (FormattedText formattedText in formattedTexts)
			{
				if (formattedText.MaxTextHeight != double.MaxValue)
				{
					formattedText.MaxTextHeight = double.MaxValue;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetConstraintsForRender()
		{
			if (GlyphRunFormattedText != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FormattedText[] formattedTexts = FormattedTexts;
			System.Windows.Size renderSize = base.RenderSize;
			bool flag = TextWrapping != TextWrapping.NoWrap;
			if (flag && formattedTexts[0].MaxTextWidth != renderSize.Width)
			{
				formattedTexts[0].MaxTextWidth = renderSize.Width;
			}
			if (TextTrimming == TextTrimming.None)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (FormattedText formattedText in formattedTexts)
				{
					if (formattedText.MaxTextWidth != 0.0)
					{
						formattedText.MaxTextWidth = 0.0;
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (FormattedText formattedText2 in formattedTexts)
			{
				if (formattedText2.MaxTextWidth != renderSize.Width)
				{
					formattedText2.MaxTextWidth = renderSize.Width;
				}
			}
			if (flag && formattedTexts[0].MaxTextHeight != renderSize.Height)
			{
				formattedTexts[0].MaxTextHeight = renderSize.Height;
			}
		}

		double ISupportTextMeasurement.GetTextWidth(string text)
		{
			FormattedText formattedText = CreatedFormattedText(text, Utilities.GetLanguageCultureInfo(this));
			return formattedText.Width;
		}

	internal static class TextMetricsProvider
	{
		internal class MetricsInfo
		{
			private struct CharPairKey : IEquatable<CharPairKey>
			{
				private readonly char Char1;

				private readonly char Char2;

				internal CharPairKey(char char1, char char2)
				{
					Char1 = char1;
					Char2 = char2;
				}

				public override bool Equals(object obj)
				{
					if (obj is CharPairKey)
					{
						return Equals((CharPairKey)obj);
					}
					return false;
				}

				public override int GetHashCode()
				{
					return Char1 + Char2 * 10000;
				}

				public static bool operator ==(CharPairKey pair1, CharPairKey pair2)
				{
					if (pair1.Char1 == pair2.Char1)
					{
						return pair1.Char2 == pair2.Char2;
					}
					return false;
				}

				public static bool operator !=(CharPairKey pair1, CharPairKey pair2)
				{
					return !(pair1 == pair2);
				}

				bool IEquatable<CharPairKey>.Equals(CharPairKey other)
				{
					return this == other;
				}
			}

			private InternalTextRunProperties _runProperties;

			private double _baseline;

			private double _height;

			private bool _isFontFixedSize;

			private System.Windows.Size _fixedCharacterSize;

			private double[] _cachedWidths;

			private double _cachedHeight;

			private double _fontSize;

			private Dictionary<CharPairKey, float> _characterPairKerningAdjustments;

			private HashSet<CharPairKey> _characterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments;

			[ThreadStatic]
			private static SolidColorBrush s_dummyBrush;

			private const char LOWCHAR = ' ';

			private const char HIGHCHAR = '\u007f';

			private const int CACHE_SIZE = 96;

			private const double MINIMUM_KERNING_ADJUSTMENT = 0.001;

			internal double Baseline
			{
				get
				{
					if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(_baseline))
					{
						return GetFormattedTextHelper("Wo").Baseline;
					}
					return _baseline;
				}
			}

			internal System.Windows.Size FixedCharacterSize => _fixedCharacterSize;

			internal double Height
			{
				get
				{
					if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(_height))
					{
						_height = GetStringSize("Wy").Height;
					}
					return _height;
				}
			}

			internal bool IsFontFixedSize => _isFontFixedSize;

			internal Typeface Typeface => _runProperties.Typeface;

			private double[] CachedWidths
			{
				get
				{
					if (_cachedWidths == null)
					{
						_cachedWidths = new double[96];
						System.Windows.Size empty = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
						int num = 0;
						string text = null;
						for (int i = 32; i <= 127; i++)
						{
							text = string.Empty;
							text = text.PadRight(30, (char)i);
							empty = MeasureText(text);
							_cachedWidths[num] = empty.Width / 30.0;
							_cachedHeight = empty.Height;
							num++;
						}
					}
					return _cachedWidths;
				}
			}

			private Dictionary<CharPairKey, float> CharacterPairKerningAdjustments => _characterPairKerningAdjustments;

			private HashSet<CharPairKey> CharacterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments => _characterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments;

			private static SolidColorBrush DummyBrush
			{
				get
				{
					if (s_dummyBrush == null)
					{
						s_dummyBrush = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black;
					}
					return s_dummyBrush;
				}
			}

			internal MetricsInfo(InternalTextRunProperties runProperties)
			{
				_runProperties = runProperties;
				_baseline = double.PositiveInfinity;
				_height = double.PositiveInfinity;
				_fontSize = runProperties.FontRenderingEmSize;
				_characterPairKerningAdjustments = new Dictionary<CharPairKey, float>(100);
				_characterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments = new HashSet<CharPairKey>();
				UpdateFixedWidthInfo();
			}

			internal double GetCharacterPairKerningAdjustment(char char1, char char2)
			{
				if (IsFontFixedSize)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				CharPairKey charPairKey = new CharPairKey(char1, char2);
				if (CharacterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments.Count > CharacterPairKerningAdjustments.Count)
				{
					if (CharacterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments.Contains(charPairKey))
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
					if (CharacterPairKerningAdjustments.Keys.Contains(charPairKey))
					{
						return Convert.ToDouble(CharacterPairKerningAdjustments[charPairKey]);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (CharacterPairKerningAdjustments.Keys.Contains(charPairKey))
					{
						return Convert.ToDouble(CharacterPairKerningAdjustments[charPairKey]);
					}
					if (CharacterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments.Contains(charPairKey))
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
				}
				double width = GetStringSize(new string(new char[2] { char1, char2 })).Width;
				double width2 = GetStringSize(new string(char1, 1)).Width;
				double width3 = GetStringSize(new string(char2, 1)).Width;
				double num = width2 + width3 - width;
				if (num > 0.001)
				{
					CharacterPairKerningAdjustments.Add(charPairKey, (float)num);
					return num;
				}
				CharacterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments.Add(charPairKey);
				return 0.0;
			}

			internal System.Windows.Size GetStringSize(string text)
			{
				return GetStringSize(text, useCachedFixedCharacterSizeIfFontIsFixed: true);
			}

			internal System.Windows.Size GetStringSize(string text, bool useCachedFixedCharacterSizeIfFontIsFixed)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
				}
				bool flag = IsFontFixedSize;
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = !ContainsUnicodeCharacters(text);
				}
				if (flag && useCachedFixedCharacterSizeIfFontIsFixed)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size((double)text.Length * FixedCharacterSize.Width, FixedCharacterSize.Height);
				}
				if (!flag && text.Length == 1)
				{
					char c = text[0];
					if (c >= ' ' && c <= '\u007f')
					{
						return new System.Windows.Size(CachedWidths[CacheIndexFromChar(c)], _cachedHeight);
					}
				}
				return MeasureText(text);
			}

			private int CacheIndexFromChar(char c)
			{
				return c - 32;
			}

			private static bool ContainsUnicodeCharacters(string text)
			{
				string text2 = text.Trim();
				for (int i = 0; i < text2.Length; i++)
				{
					if (text[i] > 'ÿ')
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			private FormattedText GetFormattedTextHelper(string text)
			{
				return new FormattedText(text, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight, Typeface, _fontSize, DummyBrush);
			}

			private System.Windows.Size MeasureText(string text)
			{
				FormattedText formattedTextHelper = GetFormattedTextHelper(text);
				double extent = formattedTextHelper.Extent;
				return new System.Windows.Size(formattedTextHelper.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace, Math.Max(extent, formattedTextHelper.Height));
			}

			private void UpdateFixedWidthInfo()
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = MeasureText("W");
				System.Windows.Size size2 = MeasureText(".");
				_isFontFixedSize = size.Width == size2.Width;
				_fixedCharacterSize = (_isFontFixedSize ? size : new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
			}
		}

		internal static MetricsInfo GetMetricsInfo(InternalTextRunProperties runProperties)
		{
			MetricsInfo metricsInfo = runProperties.MetricsInfo;
			if (metricsInfo != null)
			{
				return metricsInfo;
			}
			return runProperties.MetricsInfo = new MetricsInfo(runProperties);
		}

		public static double GetBaseline(InternalTextRunProperties fontSpec)
		{
			return GetMetricsInfo(fontSpec).Baseline;
		}

		public static double GetHeight(InternalTextRunProperties fontSpec)
		{
			return GetMetricsInfo(fontSpec).Height;
		}

		public static double GetKerningAdjustment(char leading, InternalTextRunProperties runProps, char trailing)
		{
			if (runProps == null || leading < '!' || trailing < '!')
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			MetricsInfo metricsInfo = GetMetricsInfo(runProps);
			double characterPairKerningAdjustment = metricsInfo.GetCharacterPairKerningAdjustment(leading, trailing);
			if (characterPairKerningAdjustment != 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0 - characterPairKerningAdjustment;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public static double GetTextWidth(string text, InternalTextRunProperties fontSpec)
		{
			return GetMetricsInfo(fontSpec).GetStringSize(text, useCachedFixedCharacterSizeIfFontIsFixed: true).Width;
		}

		public static int GetCharacterIndexFromOffset(string text, InternalTextRunProperties fontSpec, double offsetX)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			int length = text.Length;
			MetricsInfo metricsInfo = GetMetricsInfo(fontSpec);
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				num3 = metricsInfo.GetStringSize(text.Substring(i, 1), useCachedFixedCharacterSizeIfFontIsFixed: true).Width;
				if (num + num3 / 2.0 > offsetX)
				{
					return num2;
				}
				num2++;
				num += num3;
				if (!metricsInfo.IsFontFixedSize && i > 0)
				{
					num -= metricsInfo.GetCharacterPairKerningAdjustment(text[i - 1], text[i]);
				}
			}
			return num2;
		}

		public static double GetOffsetFromCharacterIndex(string text, InternalTextRunProperties fontSpec, int characterIndex)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || characterIndex == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			int length = text.Length;
			MetricsInfo metricsInfo = GetMetricsInfo(fontSpec);
			double width = metricsInfo.GetStringSize(text.Substring(0, characterIndex)).Width;
			return width - metricsInfo.GetCharacterPairKerningAdjustment(text[characterIndex - 1], text[characterIndex]);
		}
	}
	internal static class TextUtilities
	{
		internal const double ToIdeal = 300.0;

		private const double RealFactor = 1.0 / 300.0;

		internal static int RealToIdeal(double d)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Round(d * 300.0);
			if (num < 1 && d > 0.0)
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static double GetHeight(double height, double baseline)
		{
			double num = height - baseline;
			double d = ((num + baseline != height) ? ((double)(RealToIdeal(baseline) + RealToIdeal(num))) : ((double)RealToIdeal(height)));
			return IdealToReal(d);
		}

		internal static double IdealToReal(double d)
		{
			double num = d * (1.0 / 300.0);
			if (num < 1.0 / 300.0 && d > 0.0)
			{
				num = 1.0 / 300.0;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class SynchronizedSizeDecorator : Decorator
	{
		private bool _isMeasuringTarget;

		private System.Windows.Size _lastActualDesired;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SynchronizeHeightProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SynchronizeHeight", typeof(bool), typeof(SynchronizedSizeDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SynchronizeWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SynchronizeWidth", typeof(bool), typeof(SynchronizedSizeDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TargetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Target", typeof(SynchronizedSizeDecorator), typeof(SynchronizedSizeDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, null, CoerceTarget));

		[Bindable(true)]
		public bool SynchronizeHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(SynchronizeHeightProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SynchronizeHeightProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public bool SynchronizeWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(SynchronizeWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SynchronizeWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public SynchronizedSizeDecorator Target
		{
			get
			{
				return (SynchronizedSizeDecorator)GetValue(TargetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TargetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = (_lastActualDesired = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize));
			SynchronizedSizeDecorator target = Target;
			if (target != null && target != this)
			{
				if (!target.IsMeasureValid && !target._isMeasuringTarget)
				{
					try
					{
						_isMeasuringTarget = true;
						target.Measure(availableSize);
					}
					finally
					{
						_isMeasuringTarget = false;
					}
				}
				System.Windows.Size size = (target._isMeasuringTarget ? target._lastActualDesired : target.DesiredSize);
				bool flag = false;
				if (SynchronizeWidth && !CoreUtilities.AreClose(result.Width, size.Width))
				{
					if (result.Width < size.Width)
					{
						result.Width = size.Width;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (SynchronizeHeight && !CoreUtilities.AreClose(result.Height, size.Height))
				{
					if (result.Height < size.Height)
					{
						result.Height = size.Height;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					target.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnChildDesiredSizeChanged(UIElement child)
		{
			Target?.InvalidateMeasure();
			base.OnChildDesiredSizeChanged(child);
		}

		private static object CoerceTarget(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			SynchronizedSizeDecorator synchronizedSizeDecorator = (SynchronizedSizeDecorator)d;
			SynchronizedSizeDecorator synchronizedSizeDecorator2 = (SynchronizedSizeDecorator)newValue;
			if (newValue != null && (synchronizedSizeDecorator2.IsAncestorOf(synchronizedSizeDecorator) || synchronizedSizeDecorator2.IsDescendantOf(synchronizedSizeDecorator)))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return newValue;
		}
	}
