	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Bottom", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Top", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	public sealed class PopupResizerBar : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		private bool _hasVisualStateGroups;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ResizeModeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LocationProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		public PopupResizeMode ResizeMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (PopupResizeMode)GetValue(PopupResizerDecorator.ResizeModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PopupResizerDecorator.ResizeModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public PopupResizerBarLocation Location
		{
			get
			{
				return (PopupResizerBarLocation)GetValue(LocationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LocationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static PopupResizerBar()
		{
			ResizeModeProperty = PopupResizerDecorator.ResizeModeProperty.AddOwner(typeof(PopupResizerBar), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(PopupResizeMode.VerticalOnly));
			LocationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Location", typeof(PopupResizerBarLocation), typeof(PopupResizerBar), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(PopupResizerBarLocation.Bottom, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure, OnVisualStatePropertyChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(PopupResizerBar), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(PopupResizerBar)));
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new PopupResizerBarAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDown(e);
			if (base.IsMouseCaptureWithin)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseUp(e);
			if (base.IsMouseCaptureWithin)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		internal Thumb GetThumb()
		{
			return GetTemplateChild("PART_Thumb") as Thumb;
		}

		internal void PerformMove(double x, double y)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(this, new System.Windows.Point(x, y));
			if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), allowSubclassOfType: true) is PopupResizerDecorator popupResizerDecorator)
			{
				popupResizerDecorator.PerformMove(point.X, point.Y);
			}
		}

		private void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			PopupResizerBarLocation location = Location;
			if (location != PopupResizerBarLocation.Bottom && location == PopupResizerBarLocation.Top)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Top", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Bottom", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		private static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PopupResizerBar popupResizerBar = target as PopupResizerBar;
			popupResizerBar.UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Thumb", Type = typeof(Thumb))]
	[StyleTypedProperty(Property = "ResizerBarStyle", StyleTargetType = typeof(PopupResizerBar))]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public sealed class PopupResizerDecorator : Decorator
	{
		private delegate void MethodDelegate();

		public class Constraints : PropertyChangeNotifier
		{
			private WeakReference _elementReference;

			private PopupResizerDecorator _resizeDecorator;

			private double _minimumHeight = double.NaN;

			private double _minimumWidth = double.NaN;

			private double _maximumHeight = double.NaN;

			private double _maximumWidth = double.NaN;

			public double MaximumHeight
			{
				get
				{
					return _maximumHeight;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != _maximumHeight)
					{
						if (value < 0.0)
						{
							throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("MaximumHeight", value, SR.GetString("LE_ValueCannotBeNegative"));
						}
						_maximumHeight = value;
						RaisePropertyChangedEvent("MaximumHeight");
					}
				}
			}

			public double MaximumWidth
			{
				get
				{
					return _maximumWidth;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != _maximumWidth)
					{
						if (value < 0.0)
						{
							throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("MaximumWidth", value, SR.GetString("LE_ValueCannotBeNegative"));
						}
						_maximumWidth = value;
						RaisePropertyChangedEvent("MaximumWidth");
					}
				}
			}

			public double MinimumHeight
			{
				get
				{
					return _minimumHeight;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != _minimumHeight)
					{
						if (value < 0.0)
						{
							throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("MinimumHeight", value, SR.GetString("LE_ValueCannotBeNegative"));
						}
						_minimumHeight = value;
						RaisePropertyChangedEvent("MinimumHeight");

				}
			}

				get
				{
					return _minimumWidth;
				}

						_minimumWidth = value;
						RaisePropertyChangedEvent("MinimumWidth");
					}
				}
			}

			internal FrameworkElement Element
			{
				get
				{
					if (_elementReference == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_elementReference) as FrameworkElement;
				}
			}

			internal void Aggregate(ref double maxHorizontalDeltaNegative, ref double maxHorizontalDeltaPositive, ref double maxVerticalDeltaNegative, ref double maxVerticalDeltaPositive)
			{
				FrameworkElement element = Element;
				if (element != null)
				{
					Thickness margin = element.Margin;
					double actual = element.ActualWidth - (margin.Left + margin.Right);
					double actual2 = element.ActualHeight - (margin.Top + margin.Bottom);
					AggregateHelper(ref maxHorizontalDeltaNegative, ref maxHorizontalDeltaPositive, actual, _minimumWidth, _maximumWidth, isStackedDimension: false);
					AggregateHelper(ref maxVerticalDeltaNegative, ref maxVerticalDeltaPositive, actual2, _minimumHeight, _maximumHeight, isStackedDimension: true);
				}
			}

			private static void AggregateHelper(ref double maxDeltaNegative, ref double maxDeltaPositive, double actual, double minimum, double maximum, bool isStackedDimension)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(minimum) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(minimum))
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					num = actual - minimum;
					if (double.IsNaN(maxDeltaNegative))
					{
						if (isStackedDimension)
						{
							maxDeltaNegative = 0.0;
						}
						else
						{
							maxDeltaNegative = actual;
						}
					}
					if (num >= 0.0)
					{
						if (isStackedDimension)
						{
							maxDeltaNegative += num;
						}
						else
						{
							maxDeltaNegative = Math.Min(maxDeltaNegative, num);
						}
					}
					else if (!isStackedDimension)
					{
						maxDeltaNegative = 0.0;
					}
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(maximum) || double.IsPositiveInfinity(maximum) || !(maximum > actual))
				{
					return;
				}
				double num2 = maximum - actual;
				if (double.IsNaN(maxDeltaPositive))
				{
					if (isStackedDimension)
					{
						maxDeltaPositive = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						maxDeltaPositive = double.MaxValue;
					}
				}
				if (num2 > 0.0)
				{
					if (isStackedDimension)
					{
						maxDeltaPositive += num2;
					}
					else
					{
						maxDeltaPositive = Math.Min(maxDeltaPositive, num2);
					}
				}
				else if (!isStackedDimension)
				{
					maxDeltaPositive = 0.0;
				}
			}

			internal void Initialize(FrameworkElement element)
			{
				FrameworkElement element2 = Element;
				if (element2 != null)
				{
					if (_resizeDecorator != null)
					{
						_resizeDecorator.UnregisterDescendantResizeConstraints(element2);
						_resizeDecorator = null;
					}
					else if (!element2.IsLoaded)
					{
						element2.Loaded -= OnElementLoaded;
					}
					_elementReference = null;
				}
				if (element != null)
				{
					_elementReference = new WeakReference(element);
					_resizeDecorator = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(element, typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), allowSubclassOfType: false, null, typeof(Popup)) as PopupResizerDecorator;
					if (_resizeDecorator != null)
					{
						_resizeDecorator.RegisterDescendantResizeConstraints(element, this);
					}
					else if (!element.IsLoaded)
					{
						element.Loaded += OnElementLoaded;
					}
				}
				OnElementChanged(element2, element);
			}

			internal virtual void OnElementChanged(FrameworkElement oldElement, FrameworkElement newElement)
			{
			}

			private void OnElementLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = sender as FrameworkElement;
				FrameworkElement element = Element;
				frameworkElement.Loaded -= OnElementLoaded;
				if (element == frameworkElement)
				{
					_resizeDecorator = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(element, typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), allowSubclassOfType: false) as PopupResizerDecorator;
					if (_resizeDecorator != null)
					{
						_resizeDecorator.RegisterDescendantResizeConstraints(element, this);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private PopupResizerBar _resizerBar;

		private System.Windows.Point _customPlacmentPoint;

		private double _minDraggingWidth;

		private double _minDraggingHeight;

		private double _preferredHeight = double.PositiveInfinity;

				InvalidateMeasure();
			}

		private System.Windows.FlowDirection ResizerBarFlowDirection => (System.Windows.FlowDirection)GetValue(ResizerBarFlowDirectionProperty);

		static PopupResizerDecorator()
		{
			ResizeConstraintsProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ResizeConstraints", typeof(Constraints), typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnResizeConstraintsChanged));
			ResizeModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ResizeMode", typeof(PopupResizeMode), typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(PopupResizeMode.None, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			ResizerBarLocationPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ResizerBarLocation", typeof(PopupResizerBarLocation), typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(PopupResizerBarLocation.Bottom, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange));
			ResizerBarLocationProperty = ResizerBarLocationPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ResizerBarStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ResizerBarStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnResizerBarStyleChanged));
			ResizerBarFlowDirectionPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ResizerBarFlowDirection", typeof(System.Windows.FlowDirection), typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight));
			ResizerBarFlowDirectionProperty = ResizerBarFlowDirectionPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkElement.FlowDirectionProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnFlowDirectionChanged));
			FrameworkElement.HeightProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceHeight));
			FrameworkElement.WidthProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(PopupResizerDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceWidth));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(arrangeSize);
			if (_resizerBar != null)
			{
				Rect finalRect2 = new Rect(arrangeSize);
				finalRect2.Height = Math.Min(arrangeSize.Height, _resizerBar.DesiredSize.Height);
				finalRect.Height = Math.Max(finalRect.Height - finalRect2.Height, 0.0);
				if (_resizerBar.Location == PopupResizerBarLocation.Top)
				{
					finalRect.Y = finalRect2.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					finalRect2.Y = finalRect.Height;
				}
				_resizerBar.Arrange(finalRect2);
			}
			Child?.Arrange(finalRect);
			return arrangeSize;
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			int visualChildrenCount = base.VisualChildrenCount;
			if (index == visualChildrenCount && _resizerBar != null)
			{
				return _resizerBar;
			}
			return base.GetVisualChild(index);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (constraint.Width > _preferredWidth)
			{
				constraint.Width = _preferredWidth;
			}
			if (constraint.Height > _preferredHeight)
			{
				constraint.Height = _preferredHeight;
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = default(System.Windows.Size);
			if (ResizeMode == PopupResizeMode.None)
			{
				if (_resizerBar != null)
				{
					RemoveLogicalChild(_resizerBar);
					RemoveVisualChild(_resizerBar);
					_resizerBar = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (_resizerBar == null)
				{
					_resizerBar = new PopupResizerBar();
					AddLogicalChild(_resizerBar);
					AddVisualChild(_resizerBar);
					_resizerBar.SetBinding(PopupResizerBar.ResizeModeProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ResizeModeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
					_resizerBar.SetBinding(PopupResizerBar.LocationProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ResizerBarLocationProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
					SynchronizeResizerBarStyle();
					VerifyResizerBarFlowDirection();
					_resizerBar.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.FlowDirectionProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ResizerBarFlowDirectionProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
				}
				_resizerBar.Measure(constraint);
				size = _resizerBar.DesiredSize;
				if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(constraint.Height))
				{
					constraint.Height = Math.Max(constraint.Height - _resizerBar.DesiredSize.Height, 1.0);
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			if (_resizerBar != null && _resizerBar.Location == PopupResizerBarLocation.Bottom)
			{
				result.Height += size.Height;
			}
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(_preferredHeight) && result.Height < constraint.Height)
			{
				result.Height = constraint.Height;
			}
			if (_resizerBar != null && _resizerBar.Location == PopupResizerBarLocation.Top)
			{
				result.Height += size.Height;
			}
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(_preferredWidth) && result.Width < constraint.Width)
			{
				result.Width = constraint.Width;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			InitializeLocation();
		}

		private static void OnResizeConstraintsChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(target is FrameworkElement element))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_6"));
			}
			if (e.OldValue is Constraints constraints)
			{
				constraints.Initialize(null);
			}
			if (e.NewValue is Constraints constraints2)
			{
				constraints2.Initialize(element);
			}
		}

		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForChildren(IncludeDescendants = true)]
		public static Constraints GetResizeConstraints(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return (Constraints)element.GetValue(ResizeConstraintsProperty);
		}

		public static void SetResizeConstraints(FrameworkElement element, Constraints value)
		{
			element.SetValue(ResizeConstraintsProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnResizerBarStyleChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is PopupResizerDecorator popupResizerDecorator)
			{
				popupResizerDecorator.SynchronizeResizerBarStyle();
			}
		}

		internal void PerformMove(double deltaX, double deltaY)
		{
			ProcessOnDragStarted();
			ProcessOnDragDelta(deltaX, deltaY);
			ProcessOnDragCompleted();
		}

		internal void RegisterDescendantResizeConstraints(FrameworkElement element, Constraints constraints)
		{
			if (constraints == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("constraints");
			}
			if (element == null || !element.IsDescendantOf(this))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_5"));
			}
			if (_constraintDictionary == null)
			{
				_constraintDictionary = new Dictionary<FrameworkElement, Constraints>();
			}
			_constraintDictionary.Add(element, constraints);
		}

		internal void UnregisterDescendantResizeConstraints(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (_constraintDictionary != null && _constraintDictionary.ContainsKey(element))
			{
				_constraintDictionary.Remove(element);
			}
		}

		private static void ApplyExplicitElementConstraints(double explicitExtent, double explicitMinExtent, double explicitMaxExtent, ref double minDraggingExtent, ref double maxDraggingExtent)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(explicitExtent))
			{
				minDraggingExtent = explicitExtent;
				maxDraggingExtent = explicitExtent;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(explicitMaxExtent))
			{
				maxDraggingExtent = Math.Min(explicitMaxExtent, maxDraggingExtent);
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(explicitMinExtent))
			{
				minDraggingExtent = Math.Max(explicitMinExtent, minDraggingExtent);
				maxDraggingExtent = Math.Max(explicitMinExtent, maxDraggingExtent);
			}
		}

		private static double CalculateConstrainedDelta(double currentValue, double delta, double minimum, double maximum)
		{
			double val = currentValue + delta;
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(maximum))
			{
				val = Math.Min(val, maximum);
			}
			val = Math.Max(val, minimum);
			return val - currentValue;
		}

		private static object CoerceHeight(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			PopupResizerDecorator popupResizerDecorator = target as PopupResizerDecorator;
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(popupResizerDecorator._preferredHeight))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static object CoerceWidth(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			PopupResizerDecorator popupResizerDecorator = target as PopupResizerDecorator;
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(popupResizerDecorator._preferredWidth))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private CustomPopupPlacement[] CustomPopupPlacementCallback(System.Windows.Size popupSize, System.Windows.Size targetSize, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			System.Windows.Point customPlacmentPoint = _customPlacmentPoint;
			if (ResizerBarFlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				customPlacmentPoint.X -= popupSize.Width;
			}
			return new CustomPopupPlacement[1]
			{
				new CustomPopupPlacement(customPlacmentPoint, PopupPrimaryAxis.None)
			};
		}

		private PopupResizerBarLocation DetermineLocation()
		{
			PopupResizerBarLocation result = PopupResizerBarLocation.Bottom;
			if (ResizeMode == PopupResizeMode.None)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (_popup == null)
			{
				_popup = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(Popup), allowSubclassOfType: true) as Popup;
				if (_popup != null)
				{
					_popup.Closed += OnPopupClosed;
					_popupOriginalPlacement = _popup.Placement;
					_popupOriginalVerticalOffset = _popup.VerticalOffset;
					_popupOriginalHorizontalOffset = _popup.HorizontalOffset;
					_popupRoot = _popup.Child as FrameworkElement;
					_popupOriginalCustomPopupCallback = _popup.CustomPopupPlacementCallback;
					VerifyResizerBarFlowDirection();
				}
			}
			if (_popup == null)
			{
				Trace.TraceError("Popup element not found");
				return result;
			}
			switch (_popupOriginalPlacement)
			{
			case PlacementMode.Bottom:
			case PlacementMode.Center:
			case PlacementMode.AbsolutePoint:
			case PlacementMode.RelativePoint:
			case PlacementMode.Top:
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, new MethodDelegate(VerifyLocation));
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void GetExplicitElementConstraint(FrameworkElement element, DependencyProperty property, double adjustment, ref double constraint)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(constraint))
			{
				double num = (double)element.GetValue(property);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(num) && num != (double)property.GetMetadata(element.GetType()).DefaultValue)
				{
					constraint = num - adjustment;
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeLocation()
		{
			if (_resizerBar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Thumb thumb = _resizerBar.GetThumb();
			if (thumb == null)
			{
				Trace.TraceError("A Thumb with the name PART_Thumb not found in PopupResizerBar");
			}
			if (thumb != _thumb)
			{
				if (_thumb != null)
				{
					_thumb.DragStarted -= OnDragStarted;
				}
				_thumb = thumb;
				if (_thumb != null)
				{
					_thumb.DragStarted += OnDragStarted;
				}
			}
			if (_popup == null)
			{
				PopupResizerBarLocation popupResizerBarLocation = DetermineLocation();
				if (popupResizerBarLocation == PopupResizerBarLocation.Bottom)
				{
					ClearValue(ResizerBarLocationPropertyKey);
				}
				else
				{
					SetValue(ResizerBarLocationPropertyKey, popupResizerBarLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void InvalidateMeasure(UIElement descendant, UIElement ancestor)
		{
			while (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(descendant) is UIElement uIElement && uIElement != ancestor)
			{
				uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
				descendant = uIElement;
			}
		}

		private void OnConstraintPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			_draggingConstraintsDirty = true;
		}

		private static void OnFlowDirectionChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is PopupResizerDecorator popupResizerDecorator)
			{
				popupResizerDecorator.VerifyResizerBarFlowDirection();
			}
		}

		private void OnDragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			_thumb.DragDelta -= OnDragDelta;
			_thumb.DragCompleted -= OnDragCompleted;
			e.Handled = true;
			ProcessOnDragCompleted();

		private void OnDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)

		private void ProcessOnDragDelta(double horizontalChange, double verticalChange)
		{
			if (_popup == null || _processingDragDelta)
			{
				return;
			}
			_processingDragDelta = true;
			try
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				switch (ResizeMode)
				{
				case PopupResizeMode.Both:
					flag = true;
					flag2 = true;
					break;
				case PopupResizeMode.VerticalOnly:
					flag2 = true;
					break;
				}
				Thickness margin = base.Margin;
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _popupRoot ?? this;
				System.Windows.Point point = PointToTopLevelElement(frameworkElement, default(System.Windows.Point));
				if (!Utilities.AreLogicalPixelsSameAsDevicePixels() && !BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
				{
					point.X = Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)point.X);
					point.Y = Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)point.Y);
				}
				if (flag2 && verticalChange != 0.0)
				{
					double actualHeight = base.ActualHeight;
					double num = actualHeight - (margin.Top + margin.Bottom);
					double num2 = verticalChange;
					if (_resizerBar.Location == PopupResizerBarLocation.Top)
					{
						num2 = 0.0 - num2;
						if (num2 > 0.0)
						{
							num2 = Math.Max(Math.Min(point.Y - (2.0 + _resizeWorkArea.Y), num2), 0.0);
						}
					}
					else if (num2 > 0.0)
					{
						num2 = Math.Max(Math.Min(_resizeWorkArea.Bottom - (point.Y + frameworkElement.ActualHeight + 2.0), num2), 0.0);
					}
					if (num2 != 0.0)
					{
						num2 = CalculateConstrainedDelta(num, num2, _minDraggingHeight, _maxDraggingHeight);
						if (num2 != 0.0)
						{
							_draggingConstraintsDirty = true;
						}
					}
					if (num2 != 0.0)
					{
						if (_resizerBar.Location == PopupResizerBarLocation.Top)
						{
							_popup.VerticalOffset -= num2;
							PreferredHeight = num + num2;
						}
						else
						{
							PreferredHeight = num + num2;
						}
						InvalidateMeasure(this, null);
					}
				}
				if (!flag || horizontalChange == 0.0)
				{
					return;
				}
				double actualWidth = base.ActualWidth;
				double num3 = actualWidth - (margin.Left + margin.Right);
				double num4 = CalculateConstrainedDelta(num3, horizontalChange, _minDraggingWidth, _maxDraggingWidth);
				if (num4 > 0.0)
				{
					if (ResizerBarFlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
					{
						if (point.X - num4 <= _resizeWorkArea.X)
						{
							num4 = Math.Max(point.X - _resizeWorkArea.X, 0.0);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						System.Windows.Point point2 = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(frameworkElement, new System.Windows.Point(frameworkElement.ActualWidth + num4, frameworkElement.ActualHeight));
						if (!Utilities.AreLogicalPixelsSameAsDevicePixels() && !BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
						{
							point2.X = Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)point2.X);
							point2.Y = Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)point2.Y);
						}
						Rect rect = Utilities.RectFromPoints(point, point2);
						Rect rect2 = Rect.Intersect(_resizeWorkArea, rect);
						if (rect2.Width < rect.Width)
						{
							num4 = Math.Max(rect2.Width - frameworkElement.ActualWidth, 0.0);
						}
					}
				}
				if (num4 != 0.0)
				{
					PreferredWidth = num3 + num4;
					InvalidateMeasure(this, null);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_processingDragDelta = false;
			}
		}

			_thumb.DragDelta += OnDragDelta;
			_thumb.DragCompleted += OnDragCompleted;

		private void ProcessOnDragStarted()
		{

			VerifyDraggingConstraints(dragStarting: true);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) as FrameworkElement;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = frameworkElement;

					_resizeWorkArea = new Rect(Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)_resizeWorkArea.X), Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)_resizeWorkArea.Y), Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)_resizeWorkArea.Width), Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)_resizeWorkArea.Height));
				}
				_resizeWorkArea.Height -= margin.Bottom;
				_resizeWorkArea.Width -= margin.Right;
				if (ResizerBarFlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					_resizeWorkArea.X += margin.Right;
				}
				if (_popup.Placement != PlacementMode.Absolute && (_popup.Placement != PlacementMode.Custom || _popup.CustomPopupPlacementCallback != _popupPlacementCallback))
				{
					Thickness margin2 = base.Margin;
					PreferredWidth = base.ActualWidth - (margin2.Left + margin2.Right);
					PreferredHeight = base.ActualHeight - (margin2.Top + margin2.Bottom);

					if (uIElement3 == null)

							_customPlacmentPoint.X = Math.Ceiling(_customPlacmentPoint.X);
							_customPlacmentPoint.Y = Math.Ceiling(_customPlacmentPoint.Y);

						{
							_customPlacmentPoint.X = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(_customPlacmentPoint.X);
							_customPlacmentPoint.Y = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(_customPlacmentPoint.Y);

						_popup.VerticalOffset = point.Y;
						_popup.HorizontalOffset = point.X;

		private void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			double preferredHeight = (PreferredWidth = double.PositiveInfinity);
			PreferredHeight = preferredHeight;
			if (_constraintDictionary != null && _constraintDictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				int count = _constraintDictionary.Count;
				List<FrameworkElement> list = new List<FrameworkElement>(count);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<FrameworkElement, Constraints> item in _constraintDictionary)
				{
					list.Add(item.Key);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					list[i].ClearValue(ResizeConstraintsProperty);
				}
			}
			if (_popup != null)
			{
				_popup.ClearValue(Popup.PlacementProperty);
				_popup.ClearValue(Popup.VerticalOffsetProperty);
				_popup.ClearValue(Popup.HorizontalOffsetProperty);
				if (_popupOriginalCustomPopupCallback != null)
				{
					_popup.CustomPopupPlacementCallback = _popupOriginalCustomPopupCallback;
				}
				else
				{
					_popup.ClearValue(Popup.CustomPopupPlacementCallbackProperty);
				}
				_popup.Closed -= OnPopupClosed;
				_popup = null;
			}
			_popupRoot = null;
			InvalidateVisual();
			if (_popupWasResized)
			{
				_popupWasResized = false;
				InvalidateMeasure(this, null);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Point PointFromTopLevelElement(UIElement referenceElement, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (!BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				return referenceElement.PointFromScreen(point);
			}
			return CommonAncestor?.TranslatePoint(point, referenceElement) ?? point;
		}

		private System.Windows.Point PointToTopLevelElement(UIElement referenceElement, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (!BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				return referenceElement.PointToScreen(point);
			}
			UIElement commonAncestor = CommonAncestor;
			if (commonAncestor == null)
			{
				return point;
			}
			return referenceElement.TranslatePoint(point, commonAncestor);
		}

		}

		private void VerifyDraggingConstraints(bool dragStarting)
		{
			if (!_draggingConstraintsDirty || _popup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement child = Child;
			if (child == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<FrameworkElement> list = null;
			double maxHorizontalDeltaNegative = double.NaN;
			double maxHorizontalDeltaPositive = double.NaN;
			double maxVerticalDeltaNegative = double.NaN;
			double maxVerticalDeltaPositive = double.NaN;
			if (_constraintDictionary != null && _constraintDictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				PropertyChangedEventHandler value = OnConstraintPropertyChanged;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<FrameworkElement, Constraints> item in _constraintDictionary)
				{
					Constraints value2 = item.Value;
					FrameworkElement element = value2.Element;
					bool flag = element == null;
					if (dragStarting && !flag && !element.IsDescendantOf(this))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						if (list == null)
						{
							list = new List<FrameworkElement>();
						}
						list.Add(item.Key);
					}
					else
					{
						value2.Aggregate(ref maxHorizontalDeltaNegative, ref maxHorizontalDeltaPositive, ref maxVerticalDeltaNegative, ref maxVerticalDeltaPositive);
						if (dragStarting)
						{
							value2.PropertyChanged += value;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (list != null)
			{
				foreach (FrameworkElement item2 in list)
				{
					_constraintDictionary.Remove(item2);
				}
			}
			Thickness margin = base.Margin;
			double num = base.ActualWidth - (margin.Left + margin.Right);
			double num2 = base.ActualHeight - (margin.Top + margin.Bottom);
			System.Windows.Size desiredSize = child.DesiredSize;
			System.Windows.Size renderSize = child.RenderSize;
			double val = Math.Max(renderSize.Height - desiredSize.Height, 0.0);
			double val2 = Math.Max(renderSize.Width - desiredSize.Width, 0.0);
			if (!double.IsNaN(maxHorizontalDeltaNegative))
			{
				_minDraggingWidth = Math.Max(num - Math.Max(maxHorizontalDeltaNegative, val2), 2.0);
			}
			else
			{
				_minDraggingWidth = 2.0;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(maxVerticalDeltaNegative))
			{
				_minDraggingHeight = Math.Max(num2 - Math.Max(maxVerticalDeltaNegative, val), 2.0);
			}
			else
			{
				_minDraggingHeight = 2.0;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(maxHorizontalDeltaPositive))
			{
				_maxDraggingWidth = num + maxHorizontalDeltaPositive;
			}
			else
			{
				_maxDraggingWidth = double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(maxVerticalDeltaPositive))
			{
				_maxDraggingHeight = num2 + maxVerticalDeltaPositive;
			}
			else
			{
				_maxDraggingHeight = double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			double num3 = _popup.Width;
			double num4 = _popup.Height;
			double num5 = _popup.MinWidth;
			double num6 = _popup.MinHeight;
			double num7 = _popup.MaxWidth;
			double num8 = _popup.MaxHeight;
			if (_resizerBar != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = default(System.Windows.Size);
				if (_popupRoot != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Size renderSize2 = _popupRoot.RenderSize;
					System.Windows.Size renderSize3 = base.RenderSize;
					size.Width = Math.Max(renderSize2.Width - renderSize3.Width, 0.0);
					size.Height = Math.Max(renderSize2.Height - renderSize3.Height, 0.0);
					Thickness margin2 = _popupRoot.Margin;
					size.Width += margin2.Left + margin2.Right;
					size.Height += margin2.Top + margin2.Bottom;
					num6 = Math.Max(num6 -= size.Height, 0.0);
					num5 = Math.Max(num5 -= size.Width, 0.0);
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(num7) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(num7))
				{
					num7 -= size.Width;
					num7 = Math.Max(base.ActualWidth, num7);
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(num8) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(num8))
				{
					num8 -= _resizerBar.ActualHeight + size.Height;
					num8 = Math.Max(base.ActualHeight, num8);
				}
				num6 = Math.Max(num6, _resizerBar.ActualHeight * 2.0);
				num3 -= size.Width;
				num4 -= size.Height;
			}
			ApplyExplicitElementConstraints(num3, num5, num7, ref _minDraggingWidth, ref _maxDraggingWidth);
			ApplyExplicitElementConstraints(num4, num6, num8, ref _minDraggingHeight, ref _maxDraggingHeight);
			_draggingConstraintsDirty = false;
		}

		private void VerifyLocation()
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = null;
			for (DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = this; dependencyObject2 != null; dependencyObject2 = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject))
			{
				dependencyObject = dependencyObject2;
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				frameworkElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(dependencyObject, 0) as FrameworkElement;
			}
			frameworkElement = frameworkElement ?? this;
			System.Windows.Point point = default(System.Windows.Point);
			UIElement uIElement = _popup.PlacementTarget;
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				uIElement = _popup.TemplatedParent as UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			switch (_popup.Placement)
			{
			case PlacementMode.AbsolutePoint:
				point = new System.Windows.Point(_popup.HorizontalOffset, _popup.VerticalOffset);
				point = PointFromTopLevelElement(uIElement, point);
				break;
			case PlacementMode.Center:
				point = new System.Windows.Point(uIElement.RenderSize.Width / 2.0, uIElement.RenderSize.Height / 2.0);
				break;
			case PlacementMode.Bottom:
				point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, uIElement.RenderSize.Height);
				break;
			case PlacementMode.RelativePoint:
				point = new System.Windows.Point(_popup.HorizontalOffset, _popup.VerticalOffset);
				break;
			}
			System.Windows.Point point2 = frameworkElement.TranslatePoint(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, Math.Max(frameworkElement.RenderSize.Height - 10.0, 10.0)), uIElement);
			PopupResizerBarLocation popupResizerBarLocation = PopupResizerBarLocation.Bottom;
			if (point2.Y < point.Y)
			{
				popupResizerBarLocation = PopupResizerBarLocation.Top;
			}
			SetValue(ResizerBarLocationPropertyKey, popupResizerBarLocation);
		}

		private void VerifyResizerBarFlowDirection()
		{
			Popup popup = ((_popup == null) ? (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(Popup), allowSubclassOfType: true) as Popup) : _popup);
			PlacementMode placementMode;
			System.Windows.FlowDirection flowDirection;
			if (popup != null)
			{
				placementMode = popup.Placement;
				flowDirection = popup.FlowDirection;
			}
			else
			{
				placementMode = PlacementMode.Absolute;
				flowDirection = base.FlowDirection;
			}
			if (placementMode == PlacementMode.Left && flowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight)
			{
				flowDirection = System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft;
			}
			SetValue(ResizerBarFlowDirectionPropertyKey, flowDirection);
		}
	}
	public sealed class StringFormatConverter : IMultiValueConverter, IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			if (!(parameter is string))
			{
				if (values.Length == 1 || !(values[0] is string))
				{
					return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
				}
				parameter = values[0];
				object[] array = new object[values.Length - 1];
				Array.Copy(values, 1, array, 0, values.Length - 1);
				values = array;
			}
			string format = (string)parameter;
			return string.Format(culture, format, values);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return new object[1] { System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing };
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return Convert(new object[1] { value }, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return ConvertBack(value, new Type[1] { targetType }, parameter, culture);
		}
	}
	public sealed class StringWithoutMnemonicsConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Utilities.StripMnemonics(text, escapeRemainingMnemonics: false);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
		}
	}

					return allowClosing.Value;

				TabItemCloseButtonVisibility? closeButtonVisibility = CloseButtonVisibility;
				if (closeButtonVisibility.HasValue)

					return closeButtonVisibility.Value != TabItemCloseButtonVisibility.Hidden;

				XamTabControl tabControl = TabControl;
				if (tabControl == null)

					return false;
				}
				allowClosing = tabControl.AllowTabClosing;
				if (allowClosing.HasValue)

					return allowClosing.Value;

				if (tabControl.TabItemCloseButtonVisibility != TabItemCloseButtonVisibility.Hidden)

			add
			{
				AddHandler(ExecutingCommandEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(ExecutingCommandEvent, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<ExecutedCommandEventArgs> ExecutedCommand
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(ExecutedCommandEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(ExecutedCommandEvent, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<TabClosingEventArgs> Closing
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(ClosingEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(ClosingEvent, value);
			}
		}

		public event RoutedEventHandler Closed
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(ClosedEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(ClosedEvent, value);
			}
		}

		static TabItemEx()
		{
			ExecutingCommandEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ExecutingCommand", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ExecutingCommandEventArgs>), typeof(TabItemEx));
			ExecutedCommandEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ExecutedCommand", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ExecutedCommandEventArgs>), typeof(TabItemEx));
			ClosingEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Closing", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<TabClosingEventArgs>), typeof(TabItemEx));
			ClosedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Closed", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(TabItemEx));
			TabControlVersionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TabControlVersion", typeof(int), typeof(TabItemEx), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0, OnTabControlVersionChanged));
			AllowClosingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowClosing", typeof(bool?), typeof(TabItemEx), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnAllowClosingChanged));
			CloseButtonVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CloseButtonVisibility", typeof(TabItemCloseButtonVisibility?), typeof(TabItemEx), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnCloseButtonVisibilityChanged));
			ComputedCloseButtonVisibilityPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ComputedCloseButtonVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(TabItemEx), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox));
			ComputedCloseButtonVisibilityProperty = ComputedCloseButtonVisibilityPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsMouseOverTab", typeof(bool), typeof(TabItemEx), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnIsMouseOverTabChanged));
			IsMouseOverTabProperty = IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TabItemEx), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(TabItemEx)));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(TabItemEx), Mouse.GotMouseCaptureEvent, new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(OnGotMouseCaptureWithin), handledEventsToo: true);
		}

		protected virtual void OnExecutingCommand(ExecutingCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal bool RaiseExecutingCommand(ExecutingCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ExecutingCommandEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnExecutingCommand(args);
			return !args.Cancel;
		}

		protected virtual void OnExecutedCommand(ExecutedCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseExecutedCommand(ExecutedCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ExecutedCommandEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnExecutedCommand(args);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			ValidateTabControlBindings();
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnAccessKey(AccessKeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.Focusable && !base.IsSelected)
			{
				DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				if (base.IsSelected)
				{
					BringIntoView();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnAccessKey(e);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled && TabItemExCommands.Instance.ProcessKeyboardInput(e, this))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			VerifyIsMouseOverTab(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			VerifyIsMouseOverTab(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.Focusable && !base.IsSelected)
			{
				DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				if (base.IsSelected)
				{
					BringIntoView();
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDown(e);
			if (e.MiddleButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && AllowClosingResolved && IsMouseOverTab)
			{
				XamTabControl tabControl = TabControl;
				if (tabControl != null && tabControl.CloseTab(this))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			VerifyIsMouseOverTab(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewGotKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamTabControl tabControl = TabControl;
			if (tabControl == null || !tabControl.IsMinimized || tabControl.IsDropDownOpen)
			{
				base.OnPreviewGotKeyboardFocus(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == TabItem.TabStripPlacementProperty)
			{
				UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelected(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnSelected(e);
			ComputeCloseButtonVisibility();
		}

		protected override void OnUnselected(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnUnselected(e);
			ComputeCloseButtonVisibility();
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
			ValidateTabControlBindings();
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosing(TabClosingEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseClosing(TabClosingEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ClosingEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnClosing(args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosed(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseClosed()
		{
			RoutedEventArgs e = new RoutedEventArgs();
			e.RoutedEvent = ClosedEvent;
			e.Source = this;
			OnClosed(e);
		}

		private static void OnTabControlVersionChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is TabItemEx tabItemEx)
			{
				tabItemEx.ComputeCloseButtonVisibility();
			}
		}

		private static void OnAllowClosingChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is TabItemEx tabItemEx)
			{
				tabItemEx.ComputeCloseButtonVisibility();
			}
		}

		private static void OnCloseButtonVisibilityChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is TabItemEx tabItemEx)
			{
				tabItemEx.ComputeCloseButtonVisibility();
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsMouseOverTabChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is TabItemEx tabItemEx)
			{
				tabItemEx.ComputeCloseButtonVisibility();
				tabItemEx.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		public bool ExecuteCommand(RoutedCommand command)
		{
			return ExecuteCommandImpl(new ExecuteCommandInfo(command));
		}

		private void ComputeCloseButtonVisibility()
		{
			Visibility visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			if (AllowClosingResolved)
			{
				TabItemCloseButtonVisibility? tabItemCloseButtonVisibility = CloseButtonVisibility;
				if (!tabItemCloseButtonVisibility.HasValue)
				{
					XamTabControl tabControl = TabControl;
					if (tabControl != null)
					{
						tabItemCloseButtonVisibility = TabControl.TabItemCloseButtonVisibility;
					}
				}
				if (tabItemCloseButtonVisibility.HasValue)
				{
					switch (tabItemCloseButtonVisibility.Value)
					{
					case TabItemCloseButtonVisibility.Visible:
						visibility = Visibility.Visible;
						break;
					case TabItemCloseButtonVisibility.WhenSelected:
						visibility = ((!base.IsSelected) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
						break;
					case TabItemCloseButtonVisibility.WhenSelectedOrHotTracked:
						visibility = ((!base.IsSelected && !IsMouseOverTab) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			SetValue(ComputedCloseButtonVisibilityPropertyKey, visibility);
		}

		private bool ExecuteCommandImpl(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(routedCommand, "command");
			if (!Commands<TabItemEx>.IsMinimumStatePresentForCommand(this, routedCommand))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((ICommandHost)this).CanExecute(commandInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExecutingCommandEventArgs e = new ExecutingCommandEventArgs(routedCommand);
			if (!RaiseExecutingCommand(e))
			{
				return !e.ContinueKeyRouting;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			XamTabControl tabControl = TabControl;
			if (tabControl != null)
			{
				if (routedCommand == TabItemExCommands.Close)
				{
					flag = tabControl.CloseTab(this);
				}
				if (routedCommand == TabItemExCommands.CloseAllButThis)
				{
					flag = tabControl.CloseAllTabs(this);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				RaiseExecutedCommand(new ExecutedCommandEventArgs(routedCommand));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private static void OnGotMouseCaptureWithin(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((TabItemEx)sender).VerifyIsMouseOverTab(e);
		}

		private void ValidateTabControlBindings()
		{
			XamTabControl tabControl = TabControl;
			if (tabControl != null)
			{
				if (_bindingsSetWithTabControl != tabControl)
				{
					_bindingsSetWithTabControl = tabControl;
					SetBinding(TabControlVersionProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamTabControl.InternalVersionProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tabControl));
				}
			}
			else if (_bindingsSetWithTabControl != null)
			{
				_bindingsSetWithTabControl = null;
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, TabControlVersionProperty);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyIsMouseOverTab(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Mouse.Captured != null && !base.IsMouseCaptureWithin)
			{
				ClearValue(IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey);
				return;
			}
			if (!base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				ClearValue(IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey);
				return;
			}
			HitTestResult hitTestResult = VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(this, e.GetPosition(this));
			if (hitTestResult != null && hitTestResult.VisualHit != null)
			{
				SetValue(IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (IsMouseOverTab)
			{
				switch (base.TabStripPlacement)
				{
				case Dock.Bottom:
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "Bottom_MouseOverTab", "Bottom");
					break;
				case Dock.Left:
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "Left_MouseOverTab", "Left");
					break;
				case Dock.Right:
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "Right_MouseOverTab", "Right");
					break;
				case Dock.Top:
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "Top_MouseOverTab", "Top");
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (base.TabStripPlacement)
				{
				case Dock.Bottom:
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Bottom", useTransitions);
					break;
				case Dock.Left:
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Left", useTransitions);
					break;
				case Dock.Right:
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Right", useTransitions);
					break;
				case Dock.Top:
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Top", useTransitions);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TabItemEx tabItemEx = target as TabItemEx;
			tabItemEx.UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

		internal bool Close()
		{
			if (base.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!AllowClosingResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TabClosingEventArgs e = new TabClosingEventArgs();
			RaiseClosing(e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			RaiseClosed();
			return base.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		bool ICommandHost.Execute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			if (routedCommand != null)
			{
				return ExecuteCommandImpl(commandInfo);
			}
			return false;
		}

		long ICommandHost.GetCurrentState(long statesToQuery)
		{
			TabItemExStates tabItemExStates = (TabItemExStates)0L;
			if (AllowClosingResolved)
			{
				tabItemExStates |= TabItemExStates.AllowsClosing;
			}
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				tabItemExStates |= TabItemExStates.SelectedTab;
			}
			return (long)tabItemExStates & statesToQuery;
		}

		bool ICommandHost.CanExecute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			if (routedCommand == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (routedCommand == TabItemExCommands.Close)
			{
				return AllowClosingResolved;
			}
			if (routedCommand == TabItemExCommands.CloseAllButThis)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class TabItemExCommands : Commands<TabItemEx>
	{
		private const ModifierKeys AllCtrlShiftModifiers = ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand Close;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand CloseAllButThis;

		private static TabItemExCommands g_instance;

		internal static TabItemExCommands Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (g_instance == null)
				{
					g_instance = new TabItemExCommands();
				}
				return g_instance;
			}
		}

		internal static CommandWrapper[] GetCommandWrappers()
		{
			return new CommandWrapper[2]
			{
				new CommandWrapper(Close, 0L, 3L, new InputGestureCollection(new KeyGesture[1]
				{
					new KeyGesture(Key.W, ModifierKeys.Control)
				}), ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Shift | ModifierKeys.Windows),
				new CommandWrapper(CloseAllButThis)
			};
		}

		static TabItemExCommands()
		{
			Close = new IGRoutedCommand("Close", typeof(TabItemExCommands), 0L, 2L);
			CloseAllButThis = new IGRoutedCommand("CloseAllButThis", typeof(TabItemExCommands), 0L, 0L);
			Commands<TabItemEx>.Initialize(GetCommandWrappers());
		}

		public static void LoadCommands()
		{
		}

		private static InputGestureCollection CreateGestureCombinations(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			InputGestureCollection inputGestureCollection = new InputGestureCollection();
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Control);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.None);
			return inputGestureCollection;
		}

		private static void AddGesture(InputGestureCollection gestures, Key key, ModifierKeys gestureModifiers, ModifierKeys modifierToCheck)
		{
			if ((gestureModifiers & modifierToCheck) == modifierToCheck)
			{
				gestures.Add(new KeyGesture(key, modifierToCheck));
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class TabItemPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel, IScrollInfo
	{
		private delegate void MethodInvoker();

		private class TabItemInfo
		{
			internal int ChildIndex;

			internal double Extent;

			internal double AdjustmentMade;

			internal double MinExtent;

			internal readonly UIElement Element;

			internal int Priority;

			internal TabRowInfo Row;

			private WeakReference _group;

			internal ITabItemGroup Group
			{
				get
				{
					return CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_group) as ITabItemGroup;
				}
				set
				{
					ITabItemGroup tabItemGroup = Group;
					if (value != tabItemGroup)
					{
						if (tabItemGroup != null)
						{
							tabItemGroup.PropertyChanged -= OnGroupPropertyChanged;
						}
						_group = ((value != null) ? new WeakReference(value) : null);
						if (value != null)
						{
							value.PropertyChanged += OnGroupPropertyChanged;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			internal TabItemInfo(UIElement element, int childIndex, TabRowInfo row)
			{
				ChildIndex = childIndex;
				Element = element;
				Row = row;
			}

			private void OnGroupPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.PropertyName) || e.PropertyName == "PreferredExtent") && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(Element) is TabItemPanel tabItemPanel)
				{
					tabItemPanel.InvalidateArrange();
					tabItemPanel._lastExtent = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private class TabRowInfo
		{
			internal double CurrentExtent;

			internal double PreferredExtent;

			internal bool HasMultiplePriorities;

			internal bool SkipExpandUngrouped;

			internal List<TabItemInfo> Tabs = new List<TabItemInfo>();
		}

		private class TabGroupInfo
		{
			internal readonly ITabItemGroup Group;

			internal double PreferredExtent;

			internal double SpaceNeeded;

			internal List<TabItemInfo> Tabs = new List<TabItemInfo>();

			internal TabGroupInfo(ITabItemGroup group)
			{
				Group = group;
			}
		}

		private class TabPriorityComparer : IComparer<TabItemInfo>
		{
			private static TabPriorityComparer instance;

			public static IComparer<TabItemInfo> Instance => instance;

			static TabPriorityComparer()
			{
				instance = new TabPriorityComparer();
			}

			private TabPriorityComparer()
			{
			}

			public int Compare(TabItemInfo x, TabItemInfo y)
			{
				int num = x.Priority.CompareTo(y.Priority);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (x.Extent != y.Extent)
				{
					return y.Extent.CompareTo(x.Extent);
				}
				return y.ChildIndex.CompareTo(x.ChildIndex);
			}
		}

		internal class ScrollData
		{
			internal ScrollViewer _scrollOwner;

			internal System.Windows.Size _extent;

			internal System.Windows.Size _viewport;

			internal Vector _offset;

			internal bool _canHorizontallyScroll;

			internal bool _canVerticallyScroll;

			private TabItemPanel _panel;

			internal ScrollData(TabItemPanel panel)
			{
				_panel = panel;
			}

			internal void Reset()
			{
				_offset = default(Vector);
				_extent = default(System.Windows.Size);
				_viewport = default(System.Windows.Size);
			}

			internal void VerifyScrollData(System.Windows.Size viewPort, System.Windows.Size extent)
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(viewPort.Width))
				{
					viewPort.Width = extent.Width;
				}
				if (double.IsInfinity(viewPort.Height))
				{
					viewPort.Height = extent.Height;
				}
				bool flag = !PagerContentPresenter.AreClose(_viewport.Width, viewPort.Width) || !PagerContentPresenter.AreClose(_viewport.Height, viewPort.Height) || !PagerContentPresenter.AreClose(_extent.Width, extent.Width) || !PagerContentPresenter.AreClose(_extent.Height, extent.Height);
				_viewport = viewPort;
				_extent = extent;
				flag |= VerifyOffset();
				if (_scrollOwner != null && flag)
				{
					_scrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
				}
			}

			private bool VerifyOffset()
			{
				double x = Math.Max(Math.Min(_offset.X, _panel.MaxHorizontalOffset), 0.0);
				double y = Math.Max(Math.Min(_offset.Y, _panel.MaxVerticalOffset), 0.0);
				Vector offset = _offset;
				_offset = new Vector(x, y);
				if (PagerContentPresenter.AreClose(_offset.X, offset.X))
				{
					return !PagerContentPresenter.AreClose(_offset.Y, offset.Y);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private List<TabRowInfo> _rows = new List<TabRowInfo>();

		private double? _lastExtent;

		private double _lastPreferredExtent;

		private bool _isMeasuringInArrange;

		private double _tabRowHeight;

		private Selector _hookedSelector;

		private int _maximumTabRows;

		private bool _alignTabRowToSelectedTab;

		private int _lastNumberOfRowsArranged;

		private double? _oldHorizontalOffset;

		private double? _oldVerticalOffset;

		private const double LineOffset = 16.0;

		private const double ElementOffset = 10000.0;

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty GroupProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InterRowSpacingProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InterTabSpacingProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsFirstTabInRowPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsFirstTabInRowProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaximumSizeToFitAdjustmentProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey TabSeparatorOpacityPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TabSeparatorOpacityProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MinimumTabExtentProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaximumTabRowsProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty TabInfoProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TabLayoutStyleProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TabStripPlacementProperty;

		private ScrollData _scrollDataInfo;

		private int FirstTabItemRowIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (_rows != null && _rows.Count <= MaximumTabRows)
				{
					if (SelectedTabRowIndex >= 0)
					{
						return SelectedTabRowIndex;
					}
					return 0;
				}
				return (int)Math.Round(IsVertical ? ((IScrollInfo)this).HorizontalOffset : ((IScrollInfo)this).VerticalOffset, MidpointRounding.ToEven);
			}
		}

		internal double HorizontalOffsetInternal => ScrollDataInfo._offset.X;

		[Bindable(true)]
		public double InterRowSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(InterRowSpacingProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InterRowSpacingProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public double InterTabSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(InterTabSpacingProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InterTabSpacingProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private bool InvertsHorizontalOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsMultiRow)
				{
					return TabStripPlacement == Dock.Left;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool InvertsVerticalOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsMultiRow)
				{
					return TabStripPlacement == Dock.Top;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsMultiRow => IsMultiRowStyle(TabLayoutStyle);

		private bool IsScrollClient
		{
			get
			{
				if (_scrollDataInfo != null)
				{
					return _scrollDataInfo._scrollOwner != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsVertical
		{
			get
			{
				Dock tabStripPlacement = TabStripPlacement;
				if (tabStripPlacement != Dock.Left)
				{
					return tabStripPlacement == Dock.Right;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public double MaximumSizeToFitAdjustment
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MaximumSizeToFitAdjustmentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaximumSizeToFitAdjustmentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal double MaxHorizontalOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsMultiRow && IsVertical)
				{
					return Math.Max(ScrollDataInfo._extent.Width, 0.0);
				}
				return Math.Max(ScrollDataInfo._extent.Width - ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Width, 0.0);
			}
		}

		internal double MaxVerticalOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsMultiRow && !IsVertical)
				{
					return Math.Max(ScrollDataInfo._extent.Height, 0.0);
				}
				return Math.Max(ScrollDataInfo._extent.Height - ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Height, 0.0);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public double MinimumTabExtent
		{
			get

				return (double)GetValue(MinimumTabExtentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MinimumTabExtentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public int MaximumTabRows
		{
			get

				return _maximumTabRows;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaximumTabRowsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private int SelectedTabRowIndex
		{
			get
			{
				int result = 0;
				if (ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(this) is Selector selector && _rows.Count > 1)
				{
					object selectedItem = selector.SelectedItem;
					result = GetTabItemRowNumber(selectedItem);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal double VerticalOffsetInternal => ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y;
