		static TabItemPanel()
		{
			GroupProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Group", typeof(ITabItemGroup), typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnGroupChanged));
			InterRowSpacingProperty = XamTabControl.InterRowSpacingProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			InterTabSpacingProperty = XamTabControl.InterTabSpacingProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			IsFirstTabInRowPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("IsFirstTabInRow", typeof(bool), typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsFirstTabInRowProperty = IsFirstTabInRowPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MaximumSizeToFitAdjustmentProperty = XamTabControl.MaximumSizeToFitAdjustmentProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange, OnMaximumSizeToFitAdjustment));
			TabSeparatorOpacityPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("TabSeparatorOpacity", typeof(double), typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1.0));
			TabSeparatorOpacityProperty = TabSeparatorOpacityPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MinimumTabExtentProperty = XamTabControl.MinimumTabExtentProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(18.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			MaximumTabRowsProperty = XamTabControl.MaximumTabRowsProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(XamTabControl.MaximumTabRowsProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnMaximumTabRowsChanged));
			TabInfoProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("TabInfo", typeof(TabItemInfo), typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			TabLayoutStyleProperty = XamTabControl.TabLayoutStyleProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowAutoSize, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnTabLayoutStyleChanged));
			TabStripPlacementProperty = System.Windows.Controls.TabControl.TabStripPlacementProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.DockTopBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnTabStripPlacementChanged));
			KeyboardNavigation.TabNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Once));
			KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TabItemPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle));
		}

		public TabItemPanel()
		{
			_maximumTabRows = (int)MaximumTabRowsProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			_oldHorizontalOffset = null;
			_oldVerticalOffset = null;
			bool isVertical = IsVertical;
			double num = 0.0;
			double interTabSpacing = InterTabSpacing;
			double interRowSpacing = InterRowSpacing;
			Dock tabStripPlacement = TabStripPlacement;
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = (isVertical ? finalSize.Height : finalSize.Width);
			if (num3 != _lastExtent)
			{
				UpdateExtents(num3);
			}
			TabLayoutStyle tabLayoutStyle = TabLayoutStyle;
			double tabRowHeight = _tabRowHeight;
			List<TabRowInfo> rows = _rows;
			int num4 = FirstTabItemRowIndex;
			int num5 = num4;
			Rect rect = default(Rect);
			switch (tabStripPlacement)
			{
			case Dock.Top:
				rect.Y = finalSize.Height;
				break;
			case Dock.Left:
				rect.X = finalSize.Width;
				break;
			}
			if (rows.Count > MaximumTabRows)
			{
				switch (tabStripPlacement)
				{
				case Dock.Top:
					rect.Y += tabRowHeight * (double)num4;
					break;
				case Dock.Left:
					rect.X += tabRowHeight * (double)num4;
					break;
				case Dock.Bottom:
					rect.Y -= tabRowHeight * (double)num4;
					break;
				case Dock.Right:
					rect.X -= tabRowHeight * (double)num4;
					break;
				}
				num4 = 0;
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = default(System.Windows.Point);
			if (!IsMultiRow && IsScrollClient)
			{
				switch (tabStripPlacement)
				{
				case Dock.Top:
				case Dock.Bottom:
					point.X = rect.X - _scrollDataInfo._offset.X;
					break;
				case Dock.Left:
				case Dock.Right:
					point.Y = rect.Y - _scrollDataInfo._offset.Y;
					break;
				}
			}
			int num6 = num5 + (MaximumTabRows - 1);
			int count = rows.Count;
			int i = num4;
			for (int num7 = num4 + count; i < num7; i++)
			{
				TabRowInfo tabRowInfo = rows[i % count];
				List<TabItemInfo> tabs = tabRowInfo.Tabs;
				double num8 = num;
				num = tabRowHeight;
				num2++;
				switch (tabStripPlacement)
				{
				case Dock.Top:
					rect.Y -= num;
					if (num2 > 1)
					{
						rect.Y -= interRowSpacing;
					}
					break;
				case Dock.Bottom:
					rect.Y += num8;
					if (num2 > 1)
					{
						rect.Y += interRowSpacing;
					}
					break;
				case Dock.Left:
					rect.X -= num;
					if (num2 > 1)
					{
						rect.X -= interRowSpacing;
					}
					break;
				case Dock.Right:
					rect.X += num8;
					if (num2 > 1)
					{
						rect.X += interRowSpacing;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (isVertical)
				{
					rect.Y = point.Y;
					rect.Width = num;
				}
				else
				{
					rect.Height = num;
					rect.X = point.X;
				}
				int j = 0;
				for (int count2 = tabs.Count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					TabItemInfo tabItemInfo = tabs[j];
					UIElement element = tabItemInfo.Element;
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = element.DesiredSize;
					double extent = tabItemInfo.Extent;
					if (isVertical)
					{
						rect.Height = extent;
					}
					else
					{
						rect.Width = extent;
					}
					if (rect.Width < element.DesiredSize.Width || rect.Height < element.DesiredSize.Height)
					{
						_isMeasuringInArrange = true;
						element.Measure(rect.Size);
						_isMeasuringInArrange = false;
					}
					if (i < num5 || i > num6)
					{
						Vector offsetVector = default(Vector);
						if (isVertical)
						{
							if (rect.X < 0.0)
							{
								offsetVector.X = -10000.0;
							}
							else
							{
								offsetVector.X = 10000.0;
							}
						}
						else if (rect.Y < 0.0)
						{
							offsetVector.Y = -10000.0;
						}
						else
						{
							offsetVector.Y = 10000.0;
						}
						element.Arrange(Rect.Offset(rect, offsetVector));
					}
					else
					{
						element.Arrange(rect);
					}
					if (!isVertical)
					{
						rect.X += extent + interTabSpacing;
					}
					else
					{
						rect.Y += extent + interTabSpacing;
					}
				}
			}
			if (_alignTabRowToSelectedTab || _lastNumberOfRowsArranged != count)
			{
				_alignTabRowToSelectedTab = false;
				_lastNumberOfRowsArranged = count;
				EventHandler value = OnLayoutUpdated;
				base.LayoutUpdated -= value;
				base.LayoutUpdated += value;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			_rows.Clear();
			_lastExtent = null;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			int num5 = 0;
			int num6 = 0;
			double interTabSpacing = InterTabSpacing;
			double interRowSpacing = InterRowSpacing;
			bool isVertical = IsVertical;
			bool isMultiRow = IsMultiRow;
			double num7 = (isVertical ? availableSize.Height : availableSize.Width);
			UIElementCollection children = base.Children;
			TabRowInfo tabRowInfo = null;
			bool flag = !isMultiRow && TabLayoutStyle != TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowAutoSize;
			if (flag && double.IsPositiveInfinity(num7) && IsScrollClient)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			_lastPreferredExtent = 0.0;
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = children.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = children[i];
				if (uIElement.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (num5 == 0)
				{
					uIElement.SetValue(IsFirstTabInRowPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
				else
				{
					uIElement.ClearValue(IsFirstTabInRowPropertyKey);
				}
				uIElement.Measure(availableSize2);
				System.Windows.Size desiredSize = uIElement.DesiredSize;
				double minExtent = GetMinExtent(uIElement, isVertical);
				double num8 = Math.Max(minExtent, isVertical ? desiredSize.Height : desiredSize.Width);
				double num9 = (flag ? minExtent : num8);
				double num10 = (isVertical ? desiredSize.Width : desiredSize.Height);
				if (isMultiRow && num5 > 0 && num9 + num2 > num7 - interTabSpacing)
				{
					uIElement.SetValue(IsFirstTabInRowPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					if (!uIElement.IsMeasureValid)
					{
						uIElement.Measure(availableSize2);
						desiredSize = uIElement.DesiredSize;
						minExtent = GetMinExtent(uIElement, isVertical);
						num8 = Math.Max(minExtent, isVertical ? desiredSize.Height : desiredSize.Width);
						num9 = (flag ? minExtent : num8);
						num10 = (isVertical ? desiredSize.Width : desiredSize.Height);
					}
					if (num > num4)
					{
						num4 = num;
					}
					if (tabRowInfo.PreferredExtent > _lastPreferredExtent)
					{
						_lastPreferredExtent = tabRowInfo.PreferredExtent;
					}
					if (num2 > num3)
					{
						num3 = num2;
					}
					num5 = 0;
				}
				if (num5 == 0)
				{
					tabRowInfo = new TabRowInfo();
					_rows.Add(tabRowInfo);
					num6++;
					num = num10;
					num2 = num9;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 += num9 + interTabSpacing;
					if (num10 > num)
					{
						num = num10;
					}
					tabRowInfo.PreferredExtent += interTabSpacing;
				}
				num5++;
				tabRowInfo.PreferredExtent += num8;
				TabItemInfo tabItemInfo = new TabItemInfo(uIElement, i, tabRowInfo);
				tabRowInfo.Tabs.Add(tabItemInfo);
				uIElement.SetValue(TabInfoProperty, tabItemInfo);
			}
			if (num6 > 0)
			{
				if (num > num4)
				{
					num4 = num;
				}
				if (tabRowInfo.PreferredExtent > _lastPreferredExtent)
				{
					_lastPreferredExtent = tabRowInfo.PreferredExtent;
				}
				if (num2 > num3)
				{
					num3 = num2;
				}
			}
			if (_lastPreferredExtent > num3 && num3 < num7)
			{
				num3 = Math.Min(_lastPreferredExtent, num7);
			}
			_tabRowHeight = num4;
			System.Windows.Size viewPort;
			System.Windows.Size extent;
			if (isMultiRow)
			{
				int num11 = Math.Max(0, _rows.Count - 1);
				if (isVertical)
				{
					viewPort = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Min(num11, MaximumTabRows - 1), availableSize.Height);
					extent = new System.Windows.Size(num11, num3);
				}
				else
				{
					viewPort = new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, Math.Min(num11, MaximumTabRows - 1));
					extent = new System.Windows.Size(num3, num11);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				viewPort = new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, availableSize.Height);
				extent = ((!isVertical) ? new System.Windows.Size(num3, num4) : new System.Windows.Size(num4, num3));
			}
			Vector offset = ScrollDataInfo._offset;
			if (_oldHorizontalOffset.HasValue && _oldVerticalOffset.HasValue)
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._offset.X = _oldHorizontalOffset.Value;
				ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y = _oldVerticalOffset.Value;
			}
			_oldHorizontalOffset = ScrollDataInfo._offset.X;
			_oldVerticalOffset = ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y;
			ScrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(viewPort, extent);
			if (isMultiRow && base.IsInitialized && (!PagerContentPresenter.AreClose(ScrollDataInfo._offset.X, offset.X) || !PagerContentPresenter.AreClose(ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y, offset.Y)))
			{
				_alignTabRowToSelectedTab = true;
			}
			double num12 = (num4 + interRowSpacing) * (double)Math.Min(_rows.Count, MaximumTabRows);
			if (num12 > 0.0)
			{
				num12 -= interRowSpacing;
			}
			System.Windows.Size result = (isVertical ? new System.Windows.Size(num12, num3) : new System.Windows.Size(num3, num12));
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				if (ScrollDataInfo._canHorizontallyScroll && availableSize.Width < result.Width)
				{
					result.Width = availableSize.Width;
				}
				if (ScrollDataInfo._canVerticallyScroll && availableSize.Height < result.Height)
				{
					result.Height = availableSize.Height;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnChildDesiredSizeChanged(UIElement child)
		{
			if (!_isMeasuringInArrange)
			{
				base.OnChildDesiredSizeChanged(child);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsItemsHostChanged(bool oldIsItemsHost, bool newIsItemsHost)
		{
			ItemsControl itemsOwner = ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(this);
			HookSelector(itemsOwner as Selector);
			base.OnIsItemsHostChanged(oldIsItemsHost, newIsItemsHost);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == FrameworkElement.ActualWidthProperty)
			{
				if (e.OldValue is double && (double)e.OldValue < _lastPreferredExtent && !IsVertical && !IsMultiRow && TabLayoutStyle != TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowAutoSize)
				{
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
			else if (e.Property == FrameworkElement.ActualHeightProperty && e.OldValue is double && (double)e.OldValue < _lastPreferredExtent && IsVertical && !IsMultiRow && TabLayoutStyle != TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowAutoSize)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisualChildrenChanged(DependencyObject visualAdded, DependencyObject visualRemoved)
		{
			base.OnVisualChildrenChanged(visualAdded, visualRemoved);
			if (visualRemoved != null)
			{
				TabItemInfo tabItemInfo = (TabItemInfo)visualRemoved.GetValue(TabInfoProperty);
				if (tabItemInfo != null)
				{
					tabItemInfo.Group = null;
					tabItemInfo.Row.Tabs.Remove(tabItemInfo);
				}
				visualRemoved.ClearValue(TabInfoProperty);
			}
		}

		private static void OnGroupChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Utilities.IsUIElementOrUIElement3D(d))
			{
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(d) is TabItemPanel tabItemPanel)
				{
					tabItemPanel.InvalidateArrange();
				}
				if (d.GetValue(TabInfoProperty) is TabItemInfo tabItemInfo)
				{
					tabItemInfo.Group = e.NewValue as ITabItemGroup;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static ITabItemGroup GetGroup(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (ITabItemGroup)d.GetValue(GroupProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetGroup(DependencyObject d, ITabItemGroup value)
		{
			d.SetValue(GroupProperty, value);
		}

		public static bool GetIsFirstTabInRow(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(IsFirstTabInRowProperty);
		}

		private static void OnMaximumSizeToFitAdjustment(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is TabItemPanel { TabLayoutStyle: TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowSizeToFit } tabItemPanel)
			{
				tabItemPanel._lastExtent = null;
			}
		}

		public static double GetTabSeparatorOpacity(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (double)d.GetValue(TabSeparatorOpacityProperty);
		}

		private static void OnMaximumTabRowsChanged(object target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is TabItemPanel tabItemPanel)
			{
				tabItemPanel._maximumTabRows = (int)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		private static void OnTabLayoutStyleChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is TabItemPanel { IsInitialized: not false } tabItemPanel)
			{
				tabItemPanel._alignTabRowToSelectedTab = true;
			}
		}

		private static void OnTabStripPlacementChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is TabItemPanel { IsInitialized: not false } tabItemPanel)
			{
				tabItemPanel._alignTabRowToSelectedTab = true;
			}
		}

		private void AdjustHorizontalOffset(double adjustment, bool adjustForOrientation)
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(((IScrollInfo)this).HorizontalOffset + adjustment, adjustForOrientation: true);
		}

		private double AdjustTabsProportionally(List<TabItemInfo> tabs, bool hasMultiplePriorities, bool isVertical, double adjustment, double maxPerTabAdjustment, bool skipUngroupedTabs)
		{
			bool flag = adjustment > 0.0;
			List<TabItemInfo> list = new List<TabItemInfo>();
			foreach (TabItemInfo tab in tabs)
			{
				if (!skipUngroupedTabs || tab.Group != null)
				{
					list.Add(tab);
				}
			}
			list.Sort(TabPriorityComparer.Instance);
			if (flag)
			{
				list.Reverse();
			}
			double result = AdjustTabsProportionallyImpl(list, hasMultiplePriorities, isVertical, adjustment, maxPerTabAdjustment);
			if (maxPerTabAdjustment > 0.0)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = tabs.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					TabItemInfo tabItemInfo = tabs[i];
					if (tabItemInfo.AdjustmentMade > 0.0)
					{
						double num = tabItemInfo.AdjustmentMade / maxPerTabAdjustment;
						object value = ((num > 0.3) ? KnownBoxes.DoubleZeroBox : ((object)(1.0 - num / 0.3)));
						tabItemInfo.Element.SetValue(TabSeparatorOpacityPropertyKey, value);
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double AdjustTabsProportionallyImpl(List<TabItemInfo> sortedTabs, bool hasMultiplePriorities, bool isVertical, double adjustment, double maxPerTabAdjustment)
		{
			bool flag = adjustment > 0.0;
			int count = sortedTabs.Count;
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = -1;
			int num4 = 0;
			while (!CoreUtilities.AreClose(adjustment, 0.0) && num2 < count)
			{
				int? num5 = null;
				int num6 = 0;
				int i = num2;
				double num7 = 0.0;
				double? num8 = null;
				for (; i < count; i++)
				{
					TabItemInfo tabItemInfo = sortedTabs[i];
					if (double.IsNaN(tabItemInfo.Extent))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (!num5.HasValue)
					{
						num5 = tabItemInfo.Priority;
						num6++;
						num7 = tabItemInfo.Extent;
						continue;
					}
					if (num5 != tabItemInfo.Priority)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!flag && !CoreUtilities.AreClose(tabItemInfo.Extent, num7))
					{
						if (num3 == num2 && num4 >= num6)
						{
							num7 = tabItemInfo.Extent;
							num6++;
						}
						else
						{
							num8 = tabItemInfo.Extent;
						}
						break;
					}
					num6++;
				}
				num3 = num2;
				num4 = num6;
				if (num6 > 0)
				{
					double num9 = ((adjustment < 0.0) ? (-1.0) : 1.0);
					double adjustment2 = ((!flag && num8.HasValue) ? (num9 * Math.Min(Math.Abs(adjustment), Math.Abs(num7 - num8.Value) * (double)num6)) : adjustment);
					double num10 = AdjustTabsProportionallyImpl(sortedTabs, isVertical, num2, num6, adjustment2, flag, maxPerTabAdjustment);
					adjustment -= num10;
					num += num10;
					if (!flag && num8.HasValue && !CoreUtilities.AreClose(num10, 0.0))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				num2 = i;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double AdjustTabsProportionallyImpl(List<TabItemInfo> tabs, bool isVertical, int startIndex, int tabsToAdjust, double adjustment, bool expanding, double maxPerTabAdjustment)
		{
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			int count = tabs.Count;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			int count2 = tabs.Count;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < count; i++)
			{
				TabItemInfo tabItemInfo = tabs[i];
				if (double.IsNaN(tabItemInfo.Extent))
				{
					continue;
				}
				double extent = tabItemInfo.Extent;
				double minExtent = tabItemInfo.MinExtent;
				num2 = adjustment / (double)(tabsToAdjust - num);
				if (expanding && maxPerTabAdjustment > 0.0 && num2 + tabItemInfo.AdjustmentMade > maxPerTabAdjustment)
				{
					num2 = Math.Max(maxPerTabAdjustment - tabItemInfo.AdjustmentMade, 0.0);
				}
				else if (!expanding && maxPerTabAdjustment < 0.0 && num2 < maxPerTabAdjustment)
				{
					num2 = maxPerTabAdjustment;
				}
				extent += num2;
				if (extent < minExtent)
				{
					num2 += minExtent - extent;
					extent += minExtent - extent;
				}
				tabItemInfo.Extent = extent;
				tabItemInfo.AdjustmentMade += num2;
				num3 += num2;
				adjustment -= num2;
				num++;
				if (num == tabsToAdjust || adjustment == 0.0)
				{
					return num3;
				}
				if (expanding)
				{
					if (adjustment < 0.0)
					{
						return num3;
					}
				}
				else if (adjustment > 0.0)
				{
					return num3;
				}
			}
			return num3;
		}

		private void AdjustVerticalOffset(double adjustment, bool adjustForOrientation)
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(((IScrollInfo)this).VerticalOffset + adjustment, adjustForOrientation: true);
		}

		private void BringSelectedTabIntoView()
		{
			if (ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(this) is Selector selector && selector.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				int num = selector.SelectedIndex;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				if (selector.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(num) is Visual visual)
				{
					((IScrollInfo)this).MakeVisible(visual, new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), new System.Windows.Size(base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight)));
				}
			}
		}

		private double GetScrollAdjustment(double adjustment)
		{
			if (!IsMultiRow)
			{
				adjustment *= 16.0;
			}
			if (InvertsHorizontalOffset || InvertsVerticalOffset)
			{
				return 0.0 - adjustment;
			}
			return adjustment;
		}

		private double GetMinExtent(UIElement tabElement, bool isVertical)
		{
			double num = ((!(tabElement is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)) ? double.NaN : (isVertical ? frameworkElement.MinHeight : frameworkElement.MinWidth));
			double minimumTabExtent = MinimumTabExtent;
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num = minimumTabExtent;
			}
			else if (num < minimumTabExtent)
			{
				num = minimumTabExtent;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal int GetTabItemRowNumber(object item)
		{
			int result = 0;
			if (ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(this) is Selector selector && _rows.Count > 1 && selector.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				TabItemInfo tabItemInfo = (TabItemInfo)uIElement.GetValue(TabInfoProperty);
				if (tabItemInfo != null)
				{
					return _rows.IndexOf(tabItemInfo.Row);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void HookSelector(Selector selector)
		{
			UnhookSelector();
			_hookedSelector = selector;
			if (selector != null)
			{
				selector.SelectionChanged += OnSelectorSelectionChanged;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsMultiRowStyle(TabLayoutStyle style)
		{
			switch (style)
			{
			case TabLayoutStyle.MultiRowAutoSize:
			case TabLayoutStyle.MultiRowSizeToFit:
				return true;
			case TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowAutoSize:
			case TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowJustified:
			case TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowSizeToFit:
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			BringSelectedTabIntoView();
		}

		private void OnSelectorSelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void ProcessGroupExtents(List<TabRowInfo> rows, double extent)
		{
			double interTabSpacing = InterTabSpacing;
			TabLayoutStyle tabLayoutStyle = TabLayoutStyle;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = rows.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				TabRowInfo tabRowInfo = rows[i];
				double num = extent - tabRowInfo.CurrentExtent;
				if (CoreUtilities.LessThanOrClose(num, 0.0))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Dictionary<ITabItemGroup, TabGroupInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<ITabItemGroup, TabGroupInfo>();
				int j = 0;
				for (int count2 = tabRowInfo.Tabs.Count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					TabItemInfo tabItemInfo = tabRowInfo.Tabs[j];
					ITabItemGroup tabItemGroup = tabItemInfo.Group;
					if (tabItemGroup == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(tabItemGroup, out var value))
					{
						double preferredExtent = tabItemGroup.PreferredExtent;
						if (double.IsNaN(preferredExtent) || CoreUtilities.LessThanOrClose(preferredExtent, 0.0))
						{
							continue;
						}
						value = (dictionary[tabItemGroup] = new TabGroupInfo(tabItemGroup));
						value.PreferredExtent = preferredExtent;
					}
					value.Tabs.Add(tabItemInfo);
				}
				if (dictionary.Count == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<ITabItemGroup, TabGroupInfo> item in dictionary)
				{
					double num2 = 0.0;
					TabGroupInfo value2 = item.Value;
					foreach (TabItemInfo tab in value2.Tabs)
					{
						num2 += tab.Extent;
					}
					double num3 = num2 + (double)(value2.Tabs.Count - 1) * interTabSpacing;
					value2.SpaceNeeded = Math.Max(value2.PreferredExtent - num3, 0.0);
					num -= value2.SpaceNeeded;
				}
				if (CoreUtilities.LessThan(num, 0.0))
				{
					tabRowInfo.SkipExpandUngrouped = true;
					break;
				}
				foreach (TabGroupInfo value3 in dictionary.Values)
				{
					AdjustTabsProportionally(value3.Tabs, hasMultiplePriorities: false, IsVertical, value3.SpaceNeeded, 0.0, skipUngroupedTabs: false);
					tabRowInfo.CurrentExtent += value3.SpaceNeeded;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetHorizontalOffset(double offset, bool adjustForOrientation)
		{
			if (!IsScrollClient)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num;
			if (ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Width >= ScrollDataInfo._extent.Width)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				double maxHorizontalOffset = MaxHorizontalOffset;
				if (IsMultiRow && IsVertical)
				{
					offset = Math.Round(offset, 0);
				}
				if (adjustForOrientation && InvertsHorizontalOffset)
				{
					offset = maxHorizontalOffset - offset;
				}
				num = Math.Max(Math.Min(offset, maxHorizontalOffset), 0.0);
			}
			if (num != ScrollDataInfo._offset.X)
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._offset.X = num;
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		private void SetVerticalOffset(double offset, bool adjustForOrientation)
		{
			if (!IsScrollClient)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num;
			if (ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Height >= ScrollDataInfo._extent.Height)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				double maxVerticalOffset = MaxVerticalOffset;
				if (IsMultiRow && !IsVertical)
				{
					offset = Math.Round(offset, 0);
				}
				if (adjustForOrientation && InvertsVerticalOffset)
				{
					offset = maxVerticalOffset - offset;
				}
				num = Math.Max(Math.Min(offset, maxVerticalOffset), 0.0);
			}
			if (num != ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y)
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y = num;
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		private void UnhookSelector()
		{
			if (_hookedSelector != null)
			{
				_hookedSelector.SelectionChanged -= OnSelectorSelectionChanged;
				_hookedSelector = null;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateExtents(double extent)
		{
			_lastExtent = extent;
			bool isVertical = IsVertical;
			List<TabRowInfo> rows = _rows;
			TabRowInfo tabRowInfo = null;
			List<TabItemInfo> list = null;
			TabItemInfo tabItemInfo = null;
			TabLayoutStyle tabLayoutStyle = TabLayoutStyle;
			double interTabSpacing = InterTabSpacing;
			bool flag = false;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = rows.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				tabRowInfo = rows[i];
				list = tabRowInfo.Tabs;
				double num = 0.0;
				int num2 = ((list.Count > 0) ? XamTabControl.GetTabPriority(list[0].Element) : 0);
				bool flag2 = true;
				int j = 0;
				for (int count2 = list.Count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					tabItemInfo = list[j];
					tabItemInfo.AdjustmentMade = 0.0;
					tabItemInfo.Element.ClearValue(TabSeparatorOpacityPropertyKey);
					if (tabItemInfo.Element.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
					{
						tabItemInfo.Extent = double.NaN;
					}
					else
					{
						double val = (isVertical ? tabItemInfo.Element.DesiredSize.Height : tabItemInfo.Element.DesiredSize.Width);
						tabItemInfo.Extent = Math.Max(val, GetMinExtent(tabItemInfo.Element, isVertical));
					}
					tabItemInfo.Priority = XamTabControl.GetTabPriority(tabItemInfo.Element);
					tabItemInfo.MinExtent = GetMinExtent(tabItemInfo.Element, isVertical);
					tabItemInfo.Group = GetGroup(tabItemInfo.Element);
					num += tabItemInfo.Extent + interTabSpacing;
					if (tabItemInfo.Group != null)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (flag2 && num2 != tabItemInfo.Priority)
					{
						flag2 = false;
					}
				}
				tabRowInfo.CurrentExtent = num - interTabSpacing;
				tabRowInfo.HasMultiplePriorities = !flag2;
				tabRowInfo.SkipExpandUngrouped = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ProcessGroupExtents(rows, extent);
			}
			if (tabLayoutStyle == TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowAutoSize || tabLayoutStyle == TabLayoutStyle.MultiRowAutoSize)
			{
				return;
			}
			int k = 0;
			for (int count3 = rows.Count; k < count3; k++)
			{
				tabRowInfo = rows[k];
				list = tabRowInfo.Tabs;
				switch (tabLayoutStyle)
				{
				case TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowJustified:
					if (tabRowInfo.CurrentExtent > extent)
					{
						AdjustTabsProportionally(list, tabRowInfo.HasMultiplePriorities, isVertical, extent - tabRowInfo.CurrentExtent, 0.0, tabRowInfo.SkipExpandUngrouped);
					}
					break;
				case TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowSizeToFit:
				case TabLayoutStyle.MultiRowSizeToFit:
					if (tabRowInfo.CurrentExtent < extent)
					{
						AdjustTabsProportionally(list, tabRowInfo.HasMultiplePriorities, isVertical, extent - tabRowInfo.CurrentExtent, MaximumSizeToFitAdjustment, tabRowInfo.SkipExpandUngrouped);
					}
					else if (tabRowInfo.CurrentExtent > extent)
					{
						AdjustTabsProportionally(list, tabRowInfo.HasMultiplePriorities, isVertical, extent - tabRowInfo.CurrentExtent, 0.0, tabRowInfo.SkipExpandUngrouped);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(GetScrollAdjustment(1.0), adjustForOrientation: true);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineLeft()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(GetScrollAdjustment(-1.0), adjustForOrientation: true);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineRight()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(GetScrollAdjustment(1.0), adjustForOrientation: true);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineUp()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(GetScrollAdjustment(-1.0), adjustForOrientation: true);
		}

		Rect IScrollInfo.MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				if (!IsMultiRow)
				{
					if (rectangle.IsEmpty || visual == null || !IsAncestorOf(visual))
					{
						return Rect.Empty;
					}
					GeneralTransform generalTransform = visual.TransformToAncestor(this);
					if (generalTransform == null)
					{
						return Rect.Empty;
					}
					Rect rect = generalTransform.TransformBounds(rectangle);
					Rect rect2 = new Rect(base.RenderSize);
					Rect rect3 = Rect.Intersect(rect, rect2);
					if (rect3.Width != rect.Width)
					{
						double num = 0.0;
						if (rect.Right > rect2.Right)
						{
							num = rect.Right - rect2.Right;
						}
						if (rect.Left - num - rect2.Left < 0.0)
						{
							num += rect.Left - num - rect2.Left;
						}
						rect.X -= num;
						num += ((IScrollInfo)this).HorizontalOffset;
						((IScrollInfo)this).SetHorizontalOffset(num);
					}
					if (rect3.Height != rect.Height)
					{
						double num2 = 0.0;
						if (rect.Bottom > rect2.Bottom)
						{
							num2 = rect.Bottom - rect2.Bottom;
						}
						if (rect.Top - num2 - rect2.Top < 0.0)
						{
							num2 += rect.Top - num2 - rect2.Top;
						}
						rect.Y -= num2;
						num2 += ((IScrollInfo)this).VerticalOffset;
						((IScrollInfo)this).SetVerticalOffset(num2);
					}
					return rect;
				}
				TabItem tabItem = visual as TabItem;
				if (tabItem == null)
				{
					tabItem = (TabItem)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(visual, typeof(TabItem), allowSubclassOfType: true, this);
				}
				if (tabItem != null)
				{
					TabItemInfo tabItemInfo = (TabItemInfo)tabItem.GetValue(TabInfoProperty);
					if (tabItemInfo != null)
					{
						int num3 = _rows.IndexOf(tabItemInfo.Row);
						if (num3 >= 0)
						{
							if (IsVertical)
							{
								((IScrollInfo)this).SetHorizontalOffset((double)num3);
							}
							else
							{
								((IScrollInfo)this).SetVerticalOffset((double)num3);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(GetScrollAdjustment(-SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines), adjustForOrientation: true);
		}

		}

		}

	internal interface ITabItemGroup : INotifyPropertyChanged

	internal class MousePanningAdorner : Adorner
	{
		private enum ScrollCursor
		{
			None = 0,
			ScrollUp = 1,
			ScrollDown = 2,
			ScrollLeft = 4,
			ScrollRight = 8,
			ScrollUpDown = 3,
			ScrollLeftRight = 12,
			ScrollUpLeft = 5,
			ScrollUpRight = 9,
			ScrollDownRight = 10,
			ScrollDownLeft = 6,
			ScrollAll = 15
		}

		private ScrollViewer _scrollViewer;

		private double _offsetX;

		private double _offsetY;

		private const double Radius = 12.5;

		private DispatcherTimer _timerHorz;

		private DispatcherTimer _timerVert;

		private DispatcherTimer _mouseUpTimer;

		private bool _canScrollVert = true;

		private bool _canScrollHorz = true;

		private ScrollCursor _currentScrollDir;

		private bool _hasScrolled;

		private System.Windows.Point _lastMouseMovePt = new System.Windows.Point(-10000.0, -10000.0);

		private ImageSource _panImage;

		private IInputElement _focusedElement;

		internal MousePanningAdorner(ScrollViewer scrollViewer, double offsetX, double offsetY)
			: base(scrollViewer)
		{
			if (scrollViewer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("scrollViewer");
			}
			_scrollViewer = scrollViewer;
			_offsetX = offsetX;
			_offsetY = offsetY;
			_canScrollHorz = scrollViewer.ViewportWidth < scrollViewer.ExtentWidth;
			_canScrollVert = scrollViewer.ViewportHeight < scrollViewer.ExtentHeight;
			_panImage = scrollViewer.TryFindResource((_canScrollHorz && _canScrollVert) ? MousePanningDecorator.ScrollAllImageKey : ((!_canScrollHorz) ? MousePanningDecorator.ScrollNSImageKey : MousePanningDecorator.ScrollEWImageKey)) as ImageSource;
		}

		public override GeneralTransform GetDesiredTransform(GeneralTransform transform)
		{
			GeneralTransformGroup generalTransformGroup = new GeneralTransformGroup();
			generalTransformGroup.Children.Add(transform);
			generalTransformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform(_offsetX - 12.5, _offsetY - 12.5));
			return generalTransformGroup;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size(25.0, 25.0);
		}

		protected override void OnGotMouseCapture(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotMouseCapture(e);
			InitializeCursor(0.0, 0.0);
			base.ForceCursor = true;
			InitializeFocusedElement(Keyboard.FocusedElement);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLostMouseCapture(e);
			DisposeTimer(ref _timerHorz);
			DisposeTimer(ref _timerVert);
			DisposeTimer(ref _mouseUpTimer);
			InitializeFocusedElement(null);
			if (base.Parent is AdornerLayer adornerLayer)
			{
				adornerLayer.Remove(this);
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(base.AdornedElement);
			ProcessMouseMove(position);
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDown(e);
			e.Handled = true;
			ReleaseMouseCapture();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_hasScrolled)
			{
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
			else if (!BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				_mouseUpTimer = new DispatcherTimer(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(250.0), DispatcherPriority.Input, OnMouseUpTimerTick, base.Dispatcher);
			}
			base.OnMouseUp(e);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			if (_panImage != null)
			{
				drawingContext.DrawImage(_panImage, new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 25.0, 25.0));
			}
		}

		private double CalculateTimerInterval(double offset)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(offset) <= 12.5)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			offset = Math.Min(298.0, Math.Abs(offset));
			return Math.Pow((300.0 - offset) / 300.0, 3.0) * 500.0;
		}

		internal static bool CanScroll(ScrollViewer scrollViewer)
		{
			if (scrollViewer != null)
			{
				if (!(scrollViewer.ViewportWidth < scrollViewer.ExtentWidth))
				{
					return scrollViewer.ViewportHeight < scrollViewer.ExtentHeight;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void DisposeTimer(ref DispatcherTimer timer)
		{
			if (timer != null)
			{
				timer.Stop();
				timer = null;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeCursor(double offsetX, double offsetY)
		{
			ScrollCursor scrollCursor = ScrollCursor.None;
			if (_canScrollVert)
			{
				if (offsetY < -12.5)
				{
					scrollCursor |= ScrollCursor.ScrollUp;
				}
				if (offsetY > 12.5)
				{
					scrollCursor |= ScrollCursor.ScrollDown;
				}
			}
			if (_canScrollVert)
			{
				if (offsetX < -12.5)
				{
					scrollCursor |= ScrollCursor.ScrollLeft;
				}
				if (offsetX > 12.5)
				{
					scrollCursor |= ScrollCursor.ScrollRight;
				}
			}
			if (scrollCursor == ScrollCursor.None)
			{
				if (_canScrollVert)
				{
					scrollCursor |= ScrollCursor.ScrollUpDown;
				}
				if (_canScrollHorz)
				{
					scrollCursor |= ScrollCursor.ScrollLeftRight;
				}
			}
			_currentScrollDir = scrollCursor;
			System.Windows.Input.Cursor cursor = null;
			switch (scrollCursor)
			{
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollDown:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollS;
				break;
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollUp:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollN;
				break;
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollUpDown:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollNS;
				break;
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollLeft:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollW;
				break;
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollRight:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollE;
				break;
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollLeftRight:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollWE;
				break;
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollUpLeft:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollNW;
				break;
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollUpRight:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollNE;
				break;
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollDownLeft:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollSW;
				break;
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollDownRight:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollSE;
				break;
			case ScrollCursor.ScrollAll:
				cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollAll;
				break;
			}
			base.Cursor = cursor;
		}

		private void InitializeFocusedElement(IInputElement focusedElement)
		{
			if (_focusedElement != focusedElement)
			{
				if (_focusedElement != null)
				{
					_focusedElement.PreviewKeyDown -= OnFocusedElementPreviewKeyDown;
					_focusedElement.LostKeyboardFocus -= OnFocusedElementLostFocus;
				}
				_focusedElement = focusedElement;
				if (focusedElement != null)
				{
					focusedElement.PreviewKeyDown += OnFocusedElementPreviewKeyDown;
					focusedElement.LostKeyboardFocus += OnFocusedElementLostFocus;
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeTimer(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation orientation, double offset, ref DispatcherTimer timer)
		{
			double num = CalculateTimerInterval(offset);
			if (num <= 0.0)
			{
				if (timer != null)
				{
					timer.Stop();
				}
				return;
			}
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num);
			if (timer != null)
			{
				if (timeSpan != timer.Interval)
				{
					timer.Interval = timeSpan;
				}
				if (!timer.IsEnabled)
				{
					timer.Start();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				timer = new DispatcherTimer(timeSpan, DispatcherPriority.Input, OnTimerTick, base.Dispatcher);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessMouseMove(System.Windows.Point mousePosition)
		{
			_lastMouseMovePt = mousePosition;
			double num = (_canScrollHorz ? (mousePosition.X - _offsetX) : 0.0);
			double num2 = (_canScrollVert ? (mousePosition.Y - _offsetY) : 0.0);
			InitializeTimer(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal, num, ref _timerHorz);
			InitializeTimer(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical, num2, ref _timerVert);
			if (!_hasScrolled)
			{
				_hasScrolled = _timerHorz != null || _timerVert != null;
			}
			InitializeCursor(num, num2);
		}

		private void OnFocusedElementLostFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IInputElement focusedElement = (base.IsMouseCaptured ? Keyboard.FocusedElement : null);
			InitializeFocusedElement(focusedElement);
		}

		private void OnFocusedElementPreviewKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			ReleaseMouseCapture();
		}

		private void OnMouseUpTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Point cursorPosApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetCursorPosApi();
			cursorPosApi = base.AdornedElement.PointFromScreen(cursorPosApi);
			if (cursorPosApi != _lastMouseMovePt)
			{
				ProcessMouseMove(cursorPosApi);
			}
		}

		private void OnTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Orientation orientation = ((sender != _timerHorz) ? System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical : System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal);
			if (orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				if ((_currentScrollDir & ScrollCursor.ScrollUpDown) == ScrollCursor.ScrollUp)
				{
					_scrollViewer.LineUp();
				}
				else if ((_currentScrollDir & ScrollCursor.ScrollUpDown) == ScrollCursor.ScrollDown)
				{
					_scrollViewer.LineDown();
				}
			}
			else if ((_currentScrollDir & ScrollCursor.ScrollLeftRight) == ScrollCursor.ScrollLeft)
			{
				_scrollViewer.LineLeft();
			}
			else if ((_currentScrollDir & ScrollCursor.ScrollLeftRight) == ScrollCursor.ScrollRight)
			{
				_scrollViewer.LineRight();
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class MousePanningDecorator : AdornerDecorator
	{
		public static readonly ResourceKey ScrollAllImageKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(MousePanningDecorator), "ScrollAllImageKey");

		public static readonly ResourceKey ScrollNSImageKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(MousePanningDecorator), "ScrollNSImageKey");

		public static readonly ResourceKey ScrollEWImageKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(MousePanningDecorator), "ScrollEWImageKey");

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.Handled && e.ChangedButton == MouseButton.Middle)
			{
				ScrollViewer scrollViewer = null;
				do
				{
					DependencyObject source = scrollViewer ?? (e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject);
					scrollViewer = (ScrollViewer)GetAncestor(source, typeof(ScrollViewer), this);
				}
				while (scrollViewer != null && !MousePanningAdorner.CanScroll(scrollViewer));
				if (scrollViewer != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(scrollViewer);
					AdornerLayer adornerLayer = AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(scrollViewer);
					if (adornerLayer != null)
					{
						MousePanningAdorner mousePanningAdorner = new MousePanningAdorner(scrollViewer, position.X, position.Y);
						adornerLayer.Add(mousePanningAdorner);
						if (mousePanningAdorner.CaptureMouse())
						{
							e.Handled = true;
							return;
						}
						adornerLayer.Remove(mousePanningAdorner);
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnMouseDown(e);
		}

		private static DependencyObject GetAncestor(DependencyObject source, Type ancestorType, DependencyObject stopAtElement)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = ((source != null) ? Utilities.GetParent(source) : null);
			while (dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject != stopAtElement)
			{
				if (ancestorType.IsAssignableFrom(dependencyObject.GetType()))
				{
					return dependencyObject;
				}
				dependencyObject = Utilities.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class PagerContentPresenter : ContentPresenter, IScrollInfo
	{
		internal class ScrollData
		{
			internal ScrollViewer _scrollOwner;

			internal System.Windows.Size _extent;

			internal System.Windows.Size _viewport;

			internal Vector _offset;

			internal bool _canHorizontallyScroll;

			internal bool _canVerticallyScroll;

			internal void Reset()
			{
				_offset = default(Vector);
				_extent = default(System.Windows.Size);
				_viewport = default(System.Windows.Size);
			}

			internal void VerifyScrollData(System.Windows.Size viewPort, System.Windows.Size extent)
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(viewPort.Width))
				{
					viewPort.Width = extent.Width;
				}
				if (double.IsInfinity(viewPort.Height))
				{
					viewPort.Height = extent.Height;
				}
				bool flag = !AreClose(_viewport.Width, viewPort.Width) || !AreClose(_viewport.Height, viewPort.Height) || !AreClose(_extent.Width, extent.Width) || !AreClose(_extent.Width, extent.Width);
				_viewport = viewPort;
				_extent = extent;
				flag |= VerifyOffset();
				if (_scrollOwner != null && flag)
				{
					_scrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
				}
			}

			private bool VerifyOffset()
			{
				double x = Math.Max(Math.Min(_offset.X, _extent.Width - _viewport.Width), 0.0);
				double y = Math.Max(Math.Min(_offset.Y, _extent.Height - _viewport.Height), 0.0);
				Vector offset = _offset;
				_offset = new Vector(x, y);
				if (AreClose(_offset.X, offset.X))
				{
					return !AreClose(_offset.Y, offset.Y);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private ScrollData _scrollDataInfo;

		private IScrollInfo _scrollInfo;

		internal const double LineOffset = 16.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CanContentScrollProperty = ScrollViewer.CanContentScrollProperty.AddOwner(typeof(PagerContentPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnCanContentScrollChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ClipContentHorizontallyProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ClipContentHorizontally", typeof(bool?), typeof(PagerContentPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ClipContentVerticallyProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ClipContentVertically", typeof(bool?), typeof(PagerContentPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ReserveSpaceForScrollButtonsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ReserveSpaceForScrollButtons", typeof(bool), typeof(PagerContentPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, OnReserveSpaceForScrollButtonsChanged));

		private bool _cachedReserveSpaceForScrollButtons = true;

		public bool CanContentScroll
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(CanContentScrollProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CanContentScrollProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool? ClipContentHorizontally
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool?)GetValue(ClipContentHorizontallyProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ClipContentHorizontallyProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool? ClipContentVertically
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool?)GetValue(ClipContentVerticallyProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ClipContentVerticallyProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ReserveSpaceForScrollButtons
		{
			get
			{
				return _cachedReserveSpaceForScrollButtons;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ReserveSpaceForScrollButtonsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private bool IsScrollClient => _scrollInfo == this;

		private ScrollData ScrollDataInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (_scrollDataInfo == null)
				{
					_scrollDataInfo = new ScrollData();
				}
				return _scrollDataInfo;
			}
		}

		public bool CanHorizontallyScroll
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsScrollClient)
				{
					return ScrollDataInfo._canHorizontallyScroll;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsScrollClient && ScrollDataInfo._canHorizontallyScroll != value)
				{
					ScrollDataInfo._canHorizontallyScroll = value;
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool CanVerticallyScroll
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsScrollClient)
				{
					return ScrollDataInfo._canVerticallyScroll;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsScrollClient && ScrollDataInfo._canVerticallyScroll != value)
				{
					ScrollDataInfo._canVerticallyScroll = value;
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		public double ExtentHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsScrollClient)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return ScrollDataInfo._extent.Height;
			}
		}

		public double ExtentWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsScrollClient)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return ScrollDataInfo._extent.Width;
			}
		}

		public double HorizontalOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsScrollClient)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return ScrollDataInfo._offset.X;
			}
		}

		public ScrollViewer ScrollOwner
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsScrollClient)
				{
					return ScrollDataInfo._scrollOwner;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsScrollClient)
				{
					ScrollDataInfo._scrollOwner = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public double VerticalOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsScrollClient)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y;
			}
		}

		{
			get

			}
		}

		public double ViewportWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsScrollClient)
				{

			}
		}

		private static void OnReserveSpaceForScrollButtonsChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is PagerContentPresenter pagerContentPresenter)
			{
				pagerContentPresenter._cachedReserveSpaceForScrollButtons = (bool)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		internal void AdjustRect(ref Rect renderRect, PagerScrollDirection direction)
		{
			if (!_cachedReserveSpaceForScrollButtons || !(base.TemplatedParent is XamPager xamPager))
			{
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement scrollElement = xamPager.GetScrollElement(direction);
			if (scrollElement == null || scrollElement.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			GeneralTransform generalTransform = scrollElement.TransformToVisual(this);
			Rect rect = generalTransform.TransformBounds(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, scrollElement.ActualWidth, scrollElement.ActualHeight));
			Rect rect2 = Rect.Intersect(rect, renderRect);
			if (rect2.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (direction)
			{
			case PagerScrollDirection.Left:
				if (rect2.Width > 0.0)
				{
					renderRect.Width -= rect2.Width;
					renderRect.X = rect2.Right;
				}
				break;
			case PagerScrollDirection.Right:
				if (rect2.Width > 0.0)
				{
					renderRect.Width -= rect2.Width;
				}
				break;
			case PagerScrollDirection.Up:
				if (rect2.Height > 0.0)
				{
					renderRect.Height -= rect2.Height;
					renderRect.Y = rect2.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case PagerScrollDirection.Down:
				if (rect2.Height > 0.0)
				{
					renderRect.Height -= rect2.Height;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal static void EnsureIsANumber(double number)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(number))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset", number, SR.GetString("LE_ValueCannotBeNan"));
			}
		}

		private static void OnCanContentScrollChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is PagerContentPresenter { _scrollDataInfo: not null } pagerContentPresenter)
			{
				pagerContentPresenter.VerifyScrollInfo();
				pagerContentPresenter.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private void VerifyScrollInfo()
		{
			if (base.TemplatedParent is XamPager xamPager)
			{
				IScrollInfo scrollInfo = null;
				if (CanContentScroll)
				{
					scrollInfo = base.Content as IScrollInfo;
					if (scrollInfo == null && base.Content is ItemsPresenter itemsPresenter)
					{
						itemsPresenter.ApplyTemplate();
						if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(itemsPresenter) > 0)
						{
							scrollInfo = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(itemsPresenter, 0) as IScrollInfo;
						}
					}
				}
				if (scrollInfo == null)
				{
					scrollInfo = this;
				}
				if (scrollInfo != _scrollInfo)
				{
					if (IsScrollClient)
					{
						_scrollInfo = null;
					}
					else if (_scrollInfo != null && _scrollInfo.ScrollOwner == xamPager)
					{
						_scrollInfo.ScrollOwner = null;
					}
				}
				if (scrollInfo != null)
				{
					_scrollInfo = scrollInfo;
					scrollInfo.ScrollOwner = xamPager;
					xamPager.ScrollInfoInternal = scrollInfo;
				}
			}
			else if (_scrollInfo != null)
			{
				if (_scrollInfo.ScrollOwner is XamPager xamPager2 && xamPager2.ScrollInfoInternal == _scrollInfo)
				{
					xamPager2.ScrollInfoInternal = null;
				}
				_scrollInfo.ScrollOwner = null;
				_scrollInfo = null;
				_scrollDataInfo = null;
			}
		}

		internal static bool AreClose(double value1, double value2)
		{
			if (value1 == value2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Math.Abs(value1 - value2) < 1E-10;
		}

		internal bool IsDescendantInView(DependencyObject d)
		{
			bool result = false;
			UIElement uIElement = d as UIElement;
			if (uIElement == null && d is ContentElement)
			{
				uIElement = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(d, typeof(UIElement), allowSubclassOfType: true) as UIElement;
			}
			if (uIElement != null && uIElement.IsDescendantOf(this))
			{
				GeneralTransform generalTransform = uIElement.TransformToAncestor(this);
				Rect rect = generalTransform.TransformBounds(new Rect(uIElement.RenderSize));
				Rect renderRect = new Rect(base.RenderSize);
				AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Left);
				AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Right);
				AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Up);
				AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Down);
				result = !Rect.Intersect(rect, renderRect).Size.IsEmpty;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				ScrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(finalSize, ScrollDataInfo._extent);
			}
			UIElement uIElement = ((VisualChildrenCount > 0) ? (GetVisualChild(0) as UIElement) : null);
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				Rect finalRect = new Rect(uIElement.DesiredSize);
				if (IsScrollClient)
				{
					finalRect.Location = new System.Windows.Point(0.0 - ScrollDataInfo._offset.X, 0.0 - ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y);
				}
				if (finalSize.Width > finalRect.Width)
				{
					finalRect.Width = finalSize.Width;
				}
				if (finalSize.Height > finalRect.Height)
				{
					finalRect.Height = finalSize.Height;
				}
				uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Geometry GetLayoutClip(System.Windows.Size layoutSlotSize)
		{
			IScrollInfo scrollInfo = _scrollInfo;
			bool flag = scrollInfo?.CanHorizontallyScroll ?? false;
			bool flag2 = scrollInfo?.CanVerticallyScroll ?? false;
			Geometry geometry;
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				Rect renderRect = new Rect(base.RenderSize);
				bool? clipContentVertically = ClipContentVertically;
				if (!((!clipContentVertically.HasValue) ? (flag2 && !(scrollInfo.ViewportHeight >= scrollInfo.ExtentHeight) && !AreClose(scrollInfo.ViewportHeight, scrollInfo.ExtentHeight)) : clipContentVertically.Value))
				{
					renderRect.Y -= 100.0;
					renderRect.Height += 200.0;
				}
				else
				{
					AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Up);
					AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Down);
				}
				bool? clipContentHorizontally = ClipContentHorizontally;
				if (!((!clipContentHorizontally.HasValue) ? (flag && !(scrollInfo.ViewportWidth >= scrollInfo.ExtentWidth) && !AreClose(scrollInfo.ViewportWidth, scrollInfo.ExtentWidth)) : clipContentHorizontally.Value))
				{
					renderRect.X -= 100.0;
					renderRect.Width += 200.0;
				}
				else
				{
					AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Left);
					AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Right);
				}
				geometry = new RectangleGeometry(renderRect);
				geometry.Freeze();
			}
			else
			{
				geometry = null;
			}
			return geometry;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			if (VisualChildrenCount > 0)
			{
				System.Windows.Size constraint = availableSize;
				if (IsScrollClient)
				{
					if (ScrollDataInfo._canHorizontallyScroll)
					{
						constraint.Width = double.PositiveInfinity;
					}
					if (ScrollDataInfo._canVerticallyScroll)
					{
						constraint.Height = double.PositiveInfinity;
					}
				}
				size = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			}
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				ScrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(availableSize, size);
			}
			if (availableSize.Width < size.Width)
			{
				size.Width = availableSize.Width;
			}
			if (availableSize.Height < size.Height)
			{
				size.Height = availableSize.Height;
			}
			return size;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			VerifyScrollInfo();
		}

		public void LineDown()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetVerticalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y + 16.0);
			}
		}

		public void LineLeft()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetHorizontalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.X - 16.0);
			}
		}

		public void LineRight()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetHorizontalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.X + 16.0);
			}
		}

		public void LineUp()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetVerticalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y - 16.0);
			}
		}

		public Rect MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty || visual == null || !IsAncestorOf(visual))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			GeneralTransform generalTransform = visual.TransformToAncestor(this);
			if (generalTransform == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect rect = generalTransform.TransformBounds(rectangle);
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				Rect renderRect = new Rect(base.RenderSize);
				AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Left);
				AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Right);
				AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Up);
				AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Down);
				Rect rect2 = Rect.Intersect(rect, renderRect);
				if (rect2.Width != rect.Width)
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					if (rect.Right > renderRect.Right)
					{
						num = rect.Right - renderRect.Right;
					}
					if (rect.Left - num - renderRect.Left < 0.0)
					{
						num += rect.Left - num - renderRect.Left;
					}
					rect.X -= num;
					num += HorizontalOffset;
					SetHorizontalOffset(num);
				}
				if (rect2.Height != rect.Height)
				{
					double num2 = 0.0;
					if (rect.Bottom > renderRect.Bottom)
					{
						num2 = rect.Bottom - renderRect.Bottom;
					}
					if (rect.Top - num2 - renderRect.Top < 0.0)
					{
						num2 += rect.Top - num2 - renderRect.Top;
					}
					rect.Y -= num2;
					num2 += VerticalOffset;
					SetVerticalOffset(num2);
				}
			}
			return rect;
		}

		public void MouseWheelDown()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetVerticalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y + (double)SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines * 16.0);
			}
		}

		public void MouseWheelLeft()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetHorizontalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.X - (double)SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines * 16.0);
			}
		}

		public void MouseWheelRight()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetHorizontalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.X + (double)SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines * 16.0);
			}
		}

		public void MouseWheelUp()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetVerticalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y - (double)SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines * 16.0);
			}
		}

		public void PageDown()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetVerticalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y + ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Height);
			}
		}

		public void PageLeft()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetVerticalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.X - ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Width);
			}
		}

		public void PageRight()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetVerticalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.X + ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Width);
			}
		}

		public void PageUp()
		{
			if (IsScrollClient)
			{
				SetVerticalOffset(ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y - ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Height);
			}
		}

		public void SetHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			if (!IsScrollClient)
			{
				return;
			}
			EnsureIsANumber(offset);
			offset = Math.Max(offset, 0.0);
			if (!AreClose(offset, ScrollDataInfo._offset.X))
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._offset.X = offset;
				if (ScrollDataInfo._scrollOwner != null)
				{
					ScrollDataInfo._scrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
				}
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		public void SetVerticalOffset(double offset)
		{
			if (!IsScrollClient)
			{
				return;
			}
			EnsureIsANumber(offset);
			offset = Math.Max(offset, 0.0);
			if (!AreClose(offset, ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y))
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y = offset;
				if (ScrollDataInfo._scrollOwner != null)
				{
					ScrollDataInfo._scrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
				}
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}
	}

		internal delegate void MethodInvoker();

		public delegate void ShowDialogCallback(ToolWindow window, bool? dialogResult);

		private class DeferredShowInfo : IDisposable
		{
			private bool _activate;

			private bool? _result;

			private ToolWindow _toolWindow;

			private IDeferShow _deferShow;

			internal bool IsCancelled
			{
				get
				{
					if (_result.HasValue)
					{
						return !_result.Value;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			internal DeferredShowInfo(ToolWindow toolWindow, bool activate, IDeferShow deferShow)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(toolWindow, "toolWindow");
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(deferShow, "deferShow");
				_toolWindow = toolWindow;
				_activate = activate;
				_deferShow = deferShow;
			}

			internal void Cancel()
			{
				ProcessShow(cancel: true);
			}

			internal void Show()
			{
				ProcessShow(cancel: false);
			}

			private void ProcessShow(bool cancel)
			{
				if (!_result.HasValue)
				{
					_result = cancel;
					if (cancel)
					{
						_deferShow.Cancel();
					}
					else
					{
						_deferShow.Show(_activate);
					}
					_toolWindow._deferredShowInfo = null;
				}
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
				ProcessShow(cancel: false);
			}
		}

		internal interface IDeferShow
		{
			void Show(bool activate);

			void Cancel();
		}

		private static bool HasUnmanagedCodeRights
		{
			get
			{
				if (_hasUnmanagedCodeFailed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				try
				{
					_unmanagedCodePermission.Demand();
					return true;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_hasUnmanagedCodeFailed = true;
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		static ToolWindow()
		{
			AllowCloseProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowClose", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, OnAllowCloseChanged));
			AllowMaximizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowMaximize", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnAllowMinMaxChanged, CoerceAllowMaximize));
			AllowMinimizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowMinimize", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnAllowMinMaxChanged, CoerceAllowMinimize));
			AllowsTransparencyProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowsTransparency", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, OnAllowsTransparencyChanged));
			CaptionVisibilityPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CaptionVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(ToolWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox));
			CaptionVisibilityProperty = CaptionVisibilityPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			HorizontalAlignmentModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalAlignmentMode", typeof(ToolWindowAlignmentMode), typeof(ToolWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ToolWindowAlignmentMode.Manual, OnRelativePositionSettingChanged));
			HorizontalAlignmentOffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalAlignmentOffset", typeof(double), typeof(ToolWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, OnRelativePositionSettingChanged));

		public ToolWindow()
		{
			_cachedWindowState = (WindowState)GetValue(WindowStateProperty);
			SetValue(ToolWindowPropertyKey, this);
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (_parts == null)
			{
				_parts = new FrameworkElement[PartCount];
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < PartCount; i++)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _parts[i];
					if (frameworkElement != null)
					{
						frameworkElement.ClearValue(HitTestCodePropertyKey);
						frameworkElement.ClearValue(ToolWindowPartProperty);
						frameworkElement.MouseLeftButtonDown -= OnPartMouseLeftButtonDown;
						frameworkElement.QueryCursor -= OnPartQueryCursor;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < PartCount; j++)
			{
				ToolWindowPart toolWindowPart = (ToolWindowPart)j;
				string partName = GetPartName(toolWindowPart);
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = GetTemplateChild(partName) as FrameworkElement;
				if (frameworkElement2 != null && toolWindowPart != ToolWindowPart.Content)
				{
					frameworkElement2.SetValue(HitTestCodePropertyKey, NativeWindowMethods.GetHitTestResult(toolWindowPart));
					frameworkElement2.SetValue(ToolWindowPartProperty, BoxedParts[j]);
					frameworkElement2.MouseLeftButtonDown += OnPartMouseLeftButtonDown;
					frameworkElement2.QueryCursor += OnPartQueryCursor;
				}
				_parts[j] = frameworkElement2;
			}
			if (!_isInCalculatingSizeWithoutContent)
			{
				CalculateMinMaxExtents(async: true);
			}
			VerifyResizeGripHitTestResult();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			base.OnContentChanged(oldContent, newContent);
			CalculateMinMaxExtents(async: true);
			if (_minMaxWatcher != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(_minMaxWatcher);
			}
			_minMaxWatcher = ((newContent is FrameworkElement) ? new MinMaxWatcher(this, (FrameworkElement)newContent) : null);
		}

		protected sealed override void OnContextMenuOpening(ContextMenuEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnContextMenuOpening(e);
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
			while (dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject != this)
			{
				if (ContextMenuService.GetContextMenu(dependencyObject) != null && ContextMenuService.GetIsEnabled(dependencyObject) && ((bool)dependencyObject.GetValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty) || ContextMenuService.GetShowOnDisabled(dependencyObject)))
				{
					return;
				}
				dependencyObject = ((!Utilities.IsVisual(dependencyObject)) ? LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject) : (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject) ?? LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject)));
			}
			if (ShowContextMenu(e.OriginalSource, new System.Windows.Point(e.CursorLeft, e.CursorTop), showDefaultOnly: true))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new ToolWindowAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			InitializeBorderThicknessBindings();
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Host != null)
			{
				Host.Activate();
			}
			base.OnPreviewMouseDown(e);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{GetType().Name} Content: {base.Content}";
		}

			CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();

		private static object CoerceAllowMaximize(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = d as ToolWindow;
			if (toolWindow.ResizeMode == ResizeMode.NoResize)
			{
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}
			return baseValue;
		}

		private static object CoerceAllowMinimize(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = d as ToolWindow;
			return toolWindow.ResizeMode switch
			{
				ResizeMode.NoResize => KnownBoxes.FalseBox, 
				ResizeMode.CanMinimize => KnownBoxes.TrueBox, 
				_ => baseValue, 
			};
		}

		}

		private static void OnIsActiveChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			if (true.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				toolWindow.OnActivated(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			else
			{
				toolWindow.OnDeactivated(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			toolWindow.UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		private static void OnIsOwnedWindowChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = d as ToolWindow;
			if (toolWindow.Host != null && toolWindow.Host.IsWindow && toolWindow.IsVisible)
			{
				try
				{
					toolWindow.VerifyIsOwnedState();
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private void VerifyIsOwnedState()
		{
			if (Host != null && Host.IsWindow)
			{
				if (IsOwnedWindow)
				{
					SetWindowOwner(Host as Window, GetOwningWindow(Owner));
				}
				else
				{
					ClearWindowOwner(Host as Window);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsUsingOSNonClientAreaChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = d as ToolWindow;
			toolWindow.InitializeBorderThicknessBindings();
			if (toolWindow.Host != null && !toolWindow.IsModal && toolWindow.Host.IsWindow && toolWindow.IsVisible)
			{
				toolWindow.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Loaded, new MethodInvoker(toolWindow.ReshowIfVisible));
			}
		}

		private static void OnOwnerChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = e.OldValue as FrameworkElement;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = e.NewValue as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				frameworkElement.Loaded -= toolWindow.OnOwnerLoaded;
				frameworkElement.Unloaded -= toolWindow.OnOwnerUnloaded;
			}
			if (frameworkElement2 != null)
			{
				frameworkElement2.Unloaded += toolWindow.OnOwnerUnloaded;
			}
		}

		private static void OnResizeModeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ToolWindow)d).InitializeBorderThicknessBindings();
		}

		private static object CoerceResizeMode(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			if (toolWindow._isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent && (ResizeMode)newValue == ResizeMode.CanResizeWithGrip)
			{
				return ResizeMode.CanResize;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static void OnThemeChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = target as ToolWindow;
			if (toolWindow.IsLoaded)
			{
				toolWindow.InvalidateMeasure();
				toolWindow.UpdateLayout();
			}
			toolWindow.OnThemeChanged((string)e.OldValue, (string)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnThemeChanged(string previousValue, string currentValue)
		{
			RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<string> e = new RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<string>(previousValue, currentValue);
			e.RoutedEvent = ThemeChangedEvent;
			e.Source = this;
			RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		private static object CoerceTitle(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			if (toolWindow.IsUsingOSNonClientArea)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			if (!toolWindow._isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			return "W";
		}

			d.CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
			d.CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
			toolWindow.OnWindowStateChanged();
		}

		internal void AdjustRelativeRect(Rect ownerRect, ref Rect rect)
		{
			if (UsesRelativePosition)
			{
				AdjustRelativeRect(ownerRect, ref rect, Owner, HorizontalAlignmentMode, base.HorizontalAlignment, HorizontalAlignmentOffset, VerticalAlignmentMode, base.VerticalAlignment, VerticalAlignmentOffset);
			}
		}

		internal static void AdjustRelativeRect(Rect ownerRect, ref Rect rect, FrameworkElement owner, ToolWindowAlignmentMode horizontalAlignmentMode, System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment, double horizontalAlignmentOffset, ToolWindowAlignmentMode verticalAlignmentMode, VerticalAlignment verticalAlignment, double verticalAlignmentOffset)
		{
			if (verticalAlignmentMode == ToolWindowAlignmentMode.UseAlignment)
			{
				switch (verticalAlignment)
				{
				case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
					rect.Y = ownerRect.Bottom - rect.Height;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Top:
					rect.Y = ownerRect.Top;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Center:
					rect.Y = ownerRect.Top + (ownerRect.Height - rect.Height) / 2.0;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Stretch:
					rect.Y = ownerRect.Top;
					rect.Height = ownerRect.Height;
					break;
				}
				rect.Y += verticalAlignmentOffset;
			}
			if (horizontalAlignmentMode != ToolWindowAlignmentMode.UseAlignment)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment2 = horizontalAlignment;
			bool flag = owner != null && owner.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight;
			if (!flag)
			{
				switch (horizontalAlignment2)
				{
				case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left:
					horizontalAlignment2 = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right;
					break;
				case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right:
					horizontalAlignment2 = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left;
					break;
				}
			}
			switch (horizontalAlignment2)
			{
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right:
				rect.X = ownerRect.Right - rect.Width;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left:
				rect.X = ownerRect.Left;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center:
				rect.X = ownerRect.Left + (ownerRect.Width - rect.Width) / 2.0;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch:
				rect.X = ownerRect.Left;
				rect.Width = ownerRect.Width;
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				rect.X += horizontalAlignmentOffset;
			}
			else
			{
				rect.X -= horizontalAlignmentOffset;
			}
		}

		internal void CalculateMinMaxExtents(bool async)
		{
			_sizeWithoutCaption = (_sizeWithoutContent = System.Windows.Size.Empty);
			if (async && !ReportSection.GetIsInReport(this))
			{
				_isDelayedMinMaxPending = true;
				if (Host != null && !Host.HandlesDelayedMinMaxRequests)
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.DataBind, new MethodInvoker(CalculateMinMaxExtentsImpl));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CalculateMinMaxExtentsImpl();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void CloseOverride()
		{
			if (Host != null)
			{
				Host.Close();
			}
			else if (Owner != null)
			{
				ClearValue(OwnerPropertyKey);
			}
		}

		internal static IntPtr GetOwnerHwnd(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			if (_getOwnerHwndFailed)
			{
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			if (BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			if (!HasUnmanagedCodeRights)
			{
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			try
			{
				return GetOwnerHwndImpl(owner);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				_getOwnerHwndFailed = true;
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static IntPtr GetOwnerHwndImpl(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			if (!(PresentationSource.FromVisual(owner) is HwndSource hwndSource))
			{
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			return hwndSource.Handle;
		}

		internal Rect GetRestoreBounds(bool queryHost)
		{
			if (queryHost && Host != null)
			{
				return Host.GetRestoreBounds();
			}
			return _restoreBounds;
		}

		internal FrameworkElement GetTemplatePart(ToolWindowPart part)
		{
			if (_parts != null)
			{
				return _parts[(int)part];
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool IsMouseOverRoot(FrameworkElement relativeElement, System.Windows.Point relativePoint)
		{
			IntPtr ownerHwnd = GetOwnerHwnd(relativeElement);
			if (ownerHwnd != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return IsMouseOverRootUnsafe(ownerHwnd, relativeElement, relativePoint);
			}
			Visual commonAncestor = Utilities.GetCommonAncestor(relativeElement, null);
			System.Windows.Point point = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(commonAncestor, default(System.Windows.Point));
			System.Windows.Point point2 = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(commonAncestor, VisualTreeHelper.GetDescendantBounds(commonAncestor).BottomRight);
			Rect rect = Utilities.RectFromPoints(point, point2);
			System.Windows.Point point3 = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(relativeElement, relativePoint);
			return rect.Contains(point3);
		}

		private static bool IsMouseOverRootUnsafe(IntPtr hwnd, FrameworkElement relativeElement, System.Windows.Point relativePoint)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(relativeElement, relativePoint);
			return NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowInfo(hwnd).rcWindow.ToRect().Contains(point);
		}

		internal void OnClosedInternal(bool clearDeferredShow = false)
		{
			DeferredShowInfo deferredShowInfo = _deferredShowInfo;
			if (_showingAsDialog && !_dialogResult.HasValue)
			{
				_dialogResult = false;
			}
			_isLoadedAfterShow = false;
			if (_deferredShowInfo == null || !_deferredShowInfo.IsCancelled)
			{
				OnClosed(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			ClearValue(OwnerPropertyKey);
			if (_showingAsDialog)
			{
				OnEndShowDialog();
			}
			if (clearDeferredShow && _deferredShowInfo == deferredShowInfo)
			{
				_deferredShowInfo = null;
			}
		}

		internal bool OnClosingInternal(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_deferredShowInfo != null && _deferredShowInfo.IsCancelled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			OnClosing(e);
			if (_isReshowing)
			{
				e.Cancel = false;
			}
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				_dialogResult = null;
			}
			return e.Cancel;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool OnDoubleClickCaption(System.Windows.Point pt, MouseDevice mouse)
		{
			if (Host != null)
			{
				WindowState windowState = WindowState;
				switch (WindowState)
				{
				case WindowState.Minimized:
					if (AllowMinimize)
					{
						windowState = ((RestoreToMaximized && AllowMaximize) ? WindowState.Maximized : WindowState.Normal);
					}
					break;
				case WindowState.Maximized:
					if (AllowMaximize)
					{
						windowState = WindowState.Normal;
					}
					break;
				case WindowState.Normal:
					if (AllowMaximize)
					{
						windowState = WindowState.Maximized;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (windowState != WindowState)
				{
					WindowState = windowState;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool OnDragCaption(System.Windows.Point pt, MouseDevice mouse)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void OnMoveCancelled()
		{
		}

		internal virtual bool OnEnterMove()
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual bool OnExitMove()

		}

		internal virtual void OnWindowMoving(System.Windows.Point pt, MouseDevice mouse, Rect logicalScreenRect)
		{
		}

			{
				Host.SetRestoreBounds(restoreBounds);
			}
			else
			{
				_restoreBounds = restoreBounds;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowSystemContextMenu(System.Windows.Point location)
