			return ShowContextMenu(this, location, showDefaultOnly: false);
		}

		internal static bool WillHostInWindow(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			if (GetOwningWindow(owner) == null)
			{
				return GetOwnerHwnd(owner) != IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void VerifyIsUsingOSNonClientArea()
		{
			SetValue(IsUsingOSNonClientAreaPropertyKey, (Window.GetWindow(this) == Host && UseOSNonClientArea) ? KnownBoxes.TrueBox : DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
		}

		private object AdjustMinExtent(object extent, bool isWidth)
		{
			if (extent is double num)
			{
				IToolWindowHost host = Host;
				if (host != null && host.IsUsingOsNonClientArea)
				{
					System.Windows.Size size = CalculateNonClientSize(default(System.Windows.Size));
					double num2 = (isWidth ? size.Width : size.Height);
					extent = ((!CoreUtilities.LessThanOrClose(num, num2)) ? ((object)(num - num2)) : KnownBoxes.DoubleZeroBox);
				}
			}
			return extent;
		}

		private void CalculateMinMaxExtentsImpl()
		{
			if (_parts == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_isDelayedMinMaxPending = false;
			CalculateSizeWithoutContent();
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _parts[10];
			frameworkElement = ((frameworkElement != null && VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(frameworkElement) == 1) ? (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(frameworkElement, 0) as FrameworkElement) : null);
			_calculatedMinWidth = _sizeWithoutContent.Width;
			_calculatedMinHeight = _sizeWithoutContent.Height;
			_calculatedMaxWidth = double.PositiveInfinity;
			_calculatedMaxHeight = double.PositiveInfinity;
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				if (true)
				{
					_calculatedMinWidth = Math.Max(_sizeWithoutContent.Width, _sizeWithoutCaption.Width + frameworkElement.MinWidth);
					_calculatedMinHeight = _sizeWithoutContent.Height + frameworkElement.MinHeight;
					if (!double.IsInfinity(frameworkElement.MaxWidth))
					{
						_calculatedMaxWidth = _sizeWithoutCaption.Width + frameworkElement.MaxWidth;
					}
					if (!double.IsInfinity(frameworkElement.MaxHeight))
					{
						_calculatedMaxHeight = _sizeWithoutContent.Height + frameworkElement.MaxHeight;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_calculatedMinHeight = Math.Max(_sizeWithoutContent.Height, _sizeWithoutCaption.Height + frameworkElement.MinHeight);
					_calculatedMinWidth = _sizeWithoutContent.Width + frameworkElement.MinWidth;
					if (!double.IsInfinity(frameworkElement.MaxHeight))
					{
						_calculatedMaxHeight = _sizeWithoutCaption.Height + frameworkElement.MaxHeight;
					}
					if (!double.IsInfinity(frameworkElement.MaxWidth))
					{
						_calculatedMaxWidth = _sizeWithoutContent.Width + frameworkElement.MaxWidth;
					}
				}
			}
			CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
			CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty);
			CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty);
			CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty);
		}

		private void CalculateSizeWithoutContent()
		{
			if (_parts == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent = _isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent;
			_isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent = true;
			bool isInCalculatingSizeWithoutContent = _isInCalculatingSizeWithoutContent;
			_isInCalculatingSizeWithoutContent = true;
			try
			{
				_calculatedMaxHeight = (_calculatedMaxWidth = (_calculatedMinHeight = (_calculatedMinWidth = null)));
				CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
				CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty);
				CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty);
				CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty);
				CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
				CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
				CoerceValue(TitleProperty);
				CoerceValue(ResizeModeProperty);
				CalculateSizeWithoutContentImpl();
			}
			finally
			{
				_isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent = isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent;
				CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
				CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
				CoerceValue(TitleProperty);
				CoerceValue(ResizeModeProperty);
				_isInCalculatingSizeWithoutContent = isInCalculatingSizeWithoutContent;
			}
		}

		private void CalculateSizeWithoutContentImpl()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _parts[10];
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = _parts[0];
			System.Windows.Size sizeWithoutContent = _sizeWithoutContent;
			using (new TempValueReplacement(frameworkElement, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox))
			{
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					Utilities.InvalidateMeasure(frameworkElement, this);
				}
				InvalidateMeasure();
				Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				if (base.IsMeasureValid)
				{
					_sizeWithoutContent = base.DesiredSize;
					using (new TempValueReplacement(frameworkElement2, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox))
					{
						if (frameworkElement2 != null)
						{
							Utilities.InvalidateMeasure(frameworkElement2, this);
						}
						InvalidateMeasure();
						Measure(_sizeWithoutContent);
						_sizeWithoutCaption = base.DesiredSize;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_sizeWithoutContent = (_sizeWithoutCaption = default(System.Windows.Size));
				}
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private bool? CanExecute(ICommand command)
		{
			if (command == CloseCommand)
			{
				return AllowClose;
			}
			if (command == MinimizeCommand)
			{
				return AllowMinimize;
			}
			if (command == MaximizeCommand)
			{
				return AllowMaximize;
			}
			if (command == RestoreCommand)
			{
				switch (WindowState)
				{
				case WindowState.Normal:
					return false;
				case WindowState.Minimized:
					return AllowMinimize;
				case WindowState.Maximized:
					return AllowMaximize;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void CanExecuteDialogCommand(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = e.Command as RoutedCommand;
			if (routedCommand.OwnerType == typeof(Window) && routedCommand.Name == "DialogCancel" && Host != null && !Host.IsWindow)
			{
				e.CanExecute = true;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void ClearWindowOwner(Window toolWindow)
		{
			if (toolWindow.Owner != null)
			{
				toolWindow.Owner = null;
				return;
			}
			IntPtr ownerHwnd = GetOwnerHwnd(Owner);
			if (IntPtr.Zero != ownerHwnd)
			{
				WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(toolWindow);
				if (windowInteropHelper.Owner == ownerHwnd)
				{
					windowInteropHelper.Owner = IntPtr.Zero;
				}
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceMinMaxButtonVisibility(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = d as ToolWindow;
			if (!toolWindow.AllowMinimize && !toolWindow.AllowMaximize)
			{
				return KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static object CoerceMinWidth(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			if (toolWindow._isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (toolWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			newValue = toolWindow.AdjustMinExtent(newValue, isWidth: true);
			return CoerceMinMaxValue(newValue, 0.0, toolWindow._calculatedMinWidth);
		}

		private static object CoerceMinHeight(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			if (toolWindow._isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (toolWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			newValue = toolWindow.AdjustMinExtent(newValue, isWidth: false);
			return CoerceMinMaxValue(newValue, 0.0, toolWindow._calculatedMinHeight);
		}

		private static object CoerceMaxWidth(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			if (toolWindow._isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent)
			{
				return double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			if (toolWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				return double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			return CoerceMinMaxValue(newValue, double.PositiveInfinity, toolWindow._calculatedMaxWidth);
		}

		private static object CoerceMaxHeight(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			if (toolWindow._isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent)
			{
				return double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			if (toolWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				return double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			return CoerceMinMaxValue(newValue, double.PositiveInfinity, toolWindow._calculatedMaxHeight);
		}

		private static object CoerceWidth(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			if (toolWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double num = (double)newValue;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && toolWindow.Host != null && toolWindow.Host.IsWindow)
			{
				double m = Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: false, toolWindow).M11;
				double num2 = m / 2.0;
				int num3 = (int)Math.Floor((num + num2) / m);
				double num4 = (double)num3 * m;
				if (!CoreUtilities.AreClose(num4, num))
				{
					num = num4;
				}
			}
			if (!toolWindow._isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		private static object CoerceHeight(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			if (toolWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double num = (double)newValue;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && toolWindow.Host != null && toolWindow.Host.IsWindow)
			{
				double m = Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: false, toolWindow).M22;
				double num2 = m / 2.0;
				int num3 = (int)Math.Floor((num + num2) / m);
				double num4 = (double)num3 * m;
				if (!CoreUtilities.AreClose(num4, num))
				{
					num = num4;
				}
			}
			if (!toolWindow._isCalculatingSizeWithoutContent)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		private static object CoerceMinMaxValue(object newValue, double requiredValue, object calculatedValue)
		{
			if ((newValue == null || (double)newValue == requiredValue) && calculatedValue != null)
			{
				return calculatedValue;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private bool ExecuteCommand(ICommand command)
		{
			if (CanExecute(command) != true)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (command == CloseCommand)
			{
				Close();
			}
			else
			{
				WindowState? windowState = null;
				if (command == MaximizeCommand)
				{
					windowState = WindowState.Maximized;
				}
				else if (command == MinimizeCommand)
				{
					windowState = WindowState.Minimized;
				}
				else if (command == RestoreCommand)
				{
					windowState = ((WindowState != WindowState.Minimized || !RestoreToMaximized) ? new WindowState?(WindowState.Normal) : new WindowState?(WindowState.Maximized));
				}
				if (windowState.HasValue)
				{
					if (Host != null)
					{
						Host.SetWindowState(windowState.Value);
					}
					else
					{
						WindowState = windowState.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ExecuteDialogCommand(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = e.Command as RoutedCommand;
			if (routedCommand.OwnerType == typeof(Window) && routedCommand.Name == "DialogCancel")
			{
				DialogResult = false;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static ToolWindowAdorner GetAdorner(FrameworkElement owner, bool createIfNull)
		{
			UIElement elementToAdorn;
			AdornerLayer rootAdornerLayer = Utilities.GetRootAdornerLayer(owner, out elementToAdorn);
			if (rootAdornerLayer != null)
			{
				ToolWindowAdorner toolWindowAdorner = null;
				int i = 0;
				for (int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(rootAdornerLayer); i < childrenCount; i++)
				{
					toolWindowAdorner = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(rootAdornerLayer, i) as ToolWindowAdorner;
					if (toolWindowAdorner != null)
					{
						if (toolWindowAdorner.AdornedElement == elementToAdorn)
						{
							break;
						}
						toolWindowAdorner = null;
					}
				}
				if (createIfNull && toolWindowAdorner == null)
				{
					toolWindowAdorner = new ToolWindowAdorner(elementToAdorn);
					rootAdornerLayer.Add(toolWindowAdorner);
				}
				return toolWindowAdorner;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Window GetOwningWindow(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			if (BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Window window = Window.GetWindow(owner);
			if (window == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!HasUnmanagedCodeRights)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return window;
		}

		private static string GetPartName(ToolWindowPart part)
		{
			return part switch
			{
				ToolWindowPart.BorderBottom => "PART_BorderBottom", 
				ToolWindowPart.BorderBottomLeft => "PART_BorderBottomLeft", 
				ToolWindowPart.BorderBottomRight => "PART_BorderBottomRight", 
				ToolWindowPart.BorderLeft => "PART_BorderLeft", 
				ToolWindowPart.BorderRight => "PART_BorderRight", 
				ToolWindowPart.BorderTop => "PART_BorderTop", 
				ToolWindowPart.BorderTopLeft => "PART_BorderTopLeft", 
				ToolWindowPart.BorderTopRight => "PART_BorderTopRight", 
				ToolWindowPart.Caption => "PART_Caption", 
				ToolWindowPart.Content => "PART_Content", 
				ToolWindowPart.ResizeGrip => "PART_ResizeGrip", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		private void InitializeBorderThicknessBindings()
		{
			if (IsUsingOSNonClientArea)
			{
				ClearValue(PreferredBorderWidthProperty);
				ClearValue(PreferredBorderHeightProperty);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = ResizeMode == ResizeMode.CanResize || ResizeMode == ResizeMode.CanResizeWithGrip;
			ResourceKey name = (flag ? SystemParameters.ResizeFrameVerticalBorderWidthKey : SystemParameters.FixedFrameVerticalBorderWidthKey);
			ResourceKey name2 = (flag ? SystemParameters.ResizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeightKey : SystemParameters.FixedFrameHorizontalBorderHeightKey);
			SetResourceReference(PreferredBorderWidthProperty, name);
			SetResourceReference(PreferredBorderHeightProperty, name2);
		}

			d.CoerceValue(MaximizeButtonVisibilityProperty);
		}

				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

			}
		}

			}
		}

		private void OnPartMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Host == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = sender as DependencyObject;
			ToolWindowPart? toolWindowPart = ((dependencyObject != null) ? GetToolWindowPart(dependencyObject) : ((ToolWindowPart?)null));
			if (!toolWindowPart.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (toolWindowPart.Value == ToolWindowPart.Caption)
			{
				if (e.ClickCount == 2)
				{
					e.Handled = OnDoubleClickCaption(e.GetPosition(this), e.MouseDevice);
				}
				else
				{
					if (e.ClickCount != 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					e.Handled = OnDragCaption(e.GetPosition(this), e.MouseDevice);
				}
				if (!e.Handled && Host != null)
				{
					Host.DragMove(e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			else if (e.ClickCount == 1)
			{
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation location = ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Top;
				switch (toolWindowPart.Value)
				{
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderTop:
					location = ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Top;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderLeft:
					location = ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Left;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderRight:
					location = ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Right;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderBottom:
					location = ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Bottom;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderTopLeft:
					location = ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderTopRight:
					location = ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderBottomLeft:
					location = ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderBottomRight:
					location = ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.ResizeGrip:
					location = ((base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight) ? ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight : ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft);
					break;
				}
				if (Host != null)
				{
					Host.DragResize(location, (System.Windows.Input.Cursor)dependencyObject.GetValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty), e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnPartQueryCursor(object sender, QueryCursorEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Host == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolWindowPart? toolWindowPart = ((sender is DependencyObject d) ? GetToolWindowPart(d) : ((ToolWindowPart?)null));
			if (toolWindowPart.HasValue && toolWindowPart.Value != ToolWindowPart.Caption)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				switch (toolWindowPart.Value)
				{
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderTop:
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderBottom:
					e.Cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNS;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderLeft:
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderRight:
					e.Cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeWE;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderTopLeft:
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderBottomRight:
					e.Cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNWSE;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderTopRight:
				case ToolWindowPart.BorderBottomLeft:
					e.Cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNESW;
					break;
				case ToolWindowPart.ResizeGrip:
					e.Cursor = ((base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight) ? System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNWSE : System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNESW);
					break;
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static void OnRelativePositionSettingChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (ToolWindow)d;
			if (toolWindow.Host != null)
			{
				toolWindow.CalculateMinMaxExtents(async: true);
				toolWindow.Host.RelativePositionStateChanged();
			}
		}

		private void OnStartShowDialog()
		{
			_showingAsDialog = true;
			CommandManager.AddCanExecuteHandler(this, CanExecuteDialogCommand);
			CommandManager.AddExecutedHandler(this, ExecuteDialogCommand);
		}

		private static void OnVisibilityChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = d as ToolWindow;
			if (toolWindow.Host != null && !toolWindow.IsModal && toolWindow.Host.IsWindow && !Visibility.Collapsed.Equals(e.NewValue) && toolWindow.IsUsingOSNonClientArea != toolWindow.Host.IsUsingOsNonClientArea)
			{
				toolWindow.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Loaded, new MethodInvoker(toolWindow.ReshowIfVisible));
			}
		}

		private void PrepareForShow(FrameworkElement owner, bool modal)
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_ElementHasVisualParent", owner));
			}
			if (owner == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("owner");
			}
			if (_showingAsDialog)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_CannotShowOnDialog"));
			}
			if (modal)
			{
				if (!owner.IsLoaded)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_DialogOwnerNotLoaded"));
				}
				if (!SupportsShowDialog)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString("LE_ShowDialogNotSupported"));
				}
			}
			_dialogResult = null;
			if (!modal)
			{
				FrameworkElement owner2 = Owner;
				if (owner2 != null)
				{
					if (owner2 != owner)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_ToolWindowHasOwner"));
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			SetValue(OwnerPropertyKey, owner);
			_isLoadedAfterShow = false;
		}

		private ToolWindowHostWindow PrepareShowInHostWindow(Window owningWindow)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = new ToolWindowHostWindow();
			toolWindowHostWindow.Content = this;
			if (IsOwnedWindow)
			{
				SetWindowOwner(toolWindowHostWindow, owningWindow);
			}
			switch (WindowStartupLocation)
			{
			case ToolWindowStartupLocation.Manual:
				toolWindowHostWindow.WindowStartupLocation = System.Windows.WindowStartupLocation.Manual;
				break;
			case ToolWindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen:
				toolWindowHostWindow.WindowStartupLocation = System.Windows.WindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen;
				break;
			case ToolWindowStartupLocation.CenterOwnerWindow:
				toolWindowHostWindow.WindowStartupLocation = System.Windows.WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner;
				break;
			}
			if (!base.IsMeasureValid)
			{
				CalculateMinMaxExtents(async: true);
			}
			Utilities.EnableModelessKeyboardInteropForWindow(toolWindowHostWindow);
			OnWindowShowing(EventArgs.Empty);
			return toolWindowHostWindow;
		}

		private void Reshow()
		{
			if (Host == null || _deferredShowInfo != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsModal)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_CannotChangeModalToolWindowTransparency"));
			}
			if (_isReshowing)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_ToolWindowIsReshowing"));
			}
			bool isActive = IsActive;
			FrameworkElement owner = Owner;
			ToolWindowHostType preferredHost = _preferredHost;
			_isReshowing = true;
			try
			{
				Close();
				Show(owner, isActive, preferredHost);
			}
			finally
			{
				_isReshowing = false;
			}
		}

		private void ReshowIfVisible()
		{
			if (Host != null && base.IsVisible && IsUsingOSNonClientArea != Host.IsUsingOsNonClientArea)
			{
				Reshow();
			}
		}

		private void SetWindowOwner(Window toolWindow, Window owningWindow)
		{
			toolWindow.Owner = owningWindow;
			if (owningWindow == null)
			{
				IntPtr ownerHwnd = GetOwnerHwnd(Owner);
				if (IntPtr.Zero != ownerHwnd)
				{
					new WindowInteropHelper(toolWindow).Owner = ownerHwnd;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShowContextMenu(object originalSource, System.Windows.Point location, bool showDefaultOnly)
		{
			if (WindowState == WindowState.Minimized && Host != null && Host.IsWindow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ReadLocalValue(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty) == null)
			{
				if (!showDefaultOnly)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu contextMenu = base.ContextMenu;
			if (contextMenu != null && showDefaultOnly)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (contextMenu == null)
			{
				contextMenu = CreateDefaultContextMenu(originalSource);
				if (contextMenu == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (contextMenu.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			contextMenu.PlacementTarget = this;
			if (location.X == -1.0 && location.Y == -1.0)
			{
				contextMenu.Placement = PlacementMode.Center;
			}
			else
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = default(System.Windows.Point);
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = originalSource as DependencyObject;
				while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
				{
					dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				}
				if (dependencyObject is UIElement)
				{
					point = TranslatePoint(point, (UIElement)dependencyObject);
				}
				contextMenu.Placement = PlacementMode.RelativePoint;
				contextMenu.HorizontalOffset = location.X - point.X;
				contextMenu.VerticalOffset = location.Y - point.Y;
			}
			contextMenu.Unloaded += delegate(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu)sender).PlacementTarget = null;
			};
			contextMenu.IsOpen = true;
			return true;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private void ShowModalToolWindowHostWindow(Window owningWindow, ShowDialogCallback callback)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = PrepareShowInHostWindow(owningWindow);
			bool? dialogResult = toolWindowHostWindow.ShowDialog();
			callback?.Invoke(this, dialogResult);
		}

		private IDeferShow ShowImpl(FrameworkElement owner, ToolWindowPositionInfo positionInfo = null)
		{
			if (owner != Owner || !owner.IsLoaded)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_deferredShowInfo != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("A deferred show is already in progress.");
			}
			CoerceValue(MinimizeButtonVisibilityProperty);
			CoerceValue(MaximizeButtonVisibilityProperty);
			if (_preferredHost == ToolWindowHostType.Popup)
			{
				return ToolWindowHostPopup.Show(this);
			}
			Window owningWindow = GetOwningWindow(owner);
			bool flag = owningWindow != null || GetOwnerHwnd(owner) != IntPtr.Zero;
			if (_preferredHost == ToolWindowHostType.Window && flag)
			{
				return ShowInToolWindowHostWindow(owningWindow, positionInfo);
			}
			ToolWindow toolWindow = GetToolWindow(owner);
			if (toolWindow != null && toolWindow.Host is ToolWindowHostPopup)
			{
				_preferredHost = ToolWindowHostType.Popup;
				return ToolWindowHostPopup.Show(this);
			}
			ToolWindowAdorner adorner = GetAdorner(owner, createIfNull: true);
			if (adorner != null)
			{
				return adorner.AddWindow(this, owner);
			}
			if (_preferredHost == ToolWindowHostType.Adorner && flag)
			{
				_preferredHost = ToolWindowHostType.Window;
				return ShowImpl(owner);
			}
			return null;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private IDeferShow ShowInToolWindowHostWindow(Window owningWindow, ToolWindowPositionInfo positionInfo)
		{
			if (positionInfo != null && Utilities.IsProcessPerMonitorDpiAware)
			{
				return PerMonitorDpiToolWindowHost.CreateDeferShow(this, owningWindow, positionInfo);
			}
			ToolWindowHostWindow window = PrepareShowInHostWindow(owningWindow);
			return new ToolWindowHostWindow.DeferShowHelper(window);
		}

		private void UpdatePreferredBorderThickness()
		{
			Thickness thickness = default(Thickness);
			if (!IsUsingOSNonClientArea)
			{
				double left = (thickness.Right = PreferredBorderWidth);
				thickness.Left = left;
				left = (thickness.Bottom = PreferredBorderHeight);
				thickness.Top = left;
			}
			SetValue(PreferredBorderThicknessPropertyKey, thickness);
		}

		private void VerifyResizeGripHitTestResult()
		{
			if (_parts != null)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _parts[9];
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					ToolWindowPart part = ((base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight) ? ToolWindowPart.BorderBottomRight : ToolWindowPart.BorderBottomLeft);
					frameworkElement.SetValue(HitTestCodePropertyKey, NativeWindowMethods.GetHitTestResult(part));
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected System.Windows.Size CalculateNonClientSize(System.Windows.Size clientSize)
		{
			if (IsUsingOSNonClientArea)
			{
				clientSize = AddToolWindowHostNonClient(clientSize);
			}
			else if (!_sizeWithoutCaption.IsEmpty)
			{
				clientSize.Width += _sizeWithoutCaption.Width;
				clientSize.Height += _sizeWithoutContent.Height;
			}
			return clientSize;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private System.Windows.Size AddToolWindowHostNonClient(System.Windows.Size clientSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = clientSize;
			if (Host is ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow)
			{
				result = toolWindowHostWindow.AddNonClientSize(clientSize);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu CreateDefaultContextMenu(object originalSource)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected void OnSupportsAllowsTransparencyChanged()
		{
			if (Host != null && AllowsTransparencyResolved != Host.AllowsTransparency && Host.SupportsAllowTransparency(AllowsTransparencyResolved))
			{
				Reshow();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (IsActive)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Active", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Inactive", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		private static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = target as ToolWindow;
			toolWindow.UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

		{
			if (Host != null)
			{
				Host.Activate();
			}
		}

			}
		}

		{
			if (_deferredShowInfo != null)
			{
				_deferredShowInfo.Cancel();
			}
			CloseOverride();
		}

		{

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static System.Windows.Point GetScreenPoint(FrameworkElement owner, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(owner, "owner");
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(e, "e");
			return GetScreenPoint(owner, e.GetPosition(owner), owner);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static System.Windows.Point GetScreenPoint(FrameworkElement owner, System.Windows.Point relativePoint, FrameworkElement relativeElement)
		{
			return GetScreenPoint(owner, relativePoint, relativeElement, ToolWindowHostType.Window);
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Point GetScreenPoint(FrameworkElement owner, System.Windows.Point relativePoint, FrameworkElement relativeElement, ToolWindowHostType preferredHost)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(owner, "owner");
			Window owningWindow = GetOwningWindow(owner);
			System.Windows.Point point = relativePoint;
			if (relativeElement != owner)
			{
				if (relativeElement != null)
				{
					point = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(relativeElement, point);
				}
				point = Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(owner, point);
			}
			bool flag = owningWindow != null || GetOwnerHwnd(owner) != IntPtr.Zero;
			if (flag && preferredHost != ToolWindowHostType.Adorner)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point2 = owner.PointToScreen(point);
				return Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)point2.X, (int)point2.Y, owner);
			}
			UIElement elementToAdorn;
			AdornerLayer rootAdornerLayer = Utilities.GetRootAdornerLayer(owner, out elementToAdorn);
			if (elementToAdorn != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point3 = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(owner, point);
				return Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(elementToAdorn, point3);
			}
			if (flag && preferredHost == ToolWindowHostType.Adorner)
			{
				return GetScreenPoint(owner, relativePoint, relativeElement, ToolWindowHostType.Window);
			}
			return point;
		}

		public static ToolWindow[] GetToolWindows(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			int ownerWindowIndex;
			return GetToolWindows(owner, out ownerWindowIndex);
		}

		internal static ToolWindow[] GetToolWindows(FrameworkElement owner, out int ownerWindowIndex)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(owner, "owner");
			List<ToolWindow> list = new List<ToolWindow>();
			Window owningWindow = GetOwningWindow(owner);
			if (owningWindow != null || GetOwnerHwnd(owner) != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				GetToolWindowHostWindows(owner, list, owningWindow, out ownerWindowIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				ToolWindowHostPopup.AddToolWindows(owner, list);
				ownerWindowIndex = list.Count;
			}
			GetAdorner(owner, createIfNull: false)?.GetToolWindows(owner, list, ref ownerWindowIndex);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static void GetToolWindowHostWindows(FrameworkElement owner, List<ToolWindow> windows, Window owningWindow, out int ownerWindowIndex)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow.GetToolWindows(owningWindow, owner, windows, out ownerWindowIndex);
		}

		public void SetRestoreBounds(Rect restoreBounds)
		{
			if (restoreBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			SetRestoreBounds(restoreBounds, updateHost: true);
		}

		public void Show(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			Show(owner, activate: true);
		}

		public void Show(FrameworkElement owner, bool activate)
		{
			Show(owner, activate, preferPopup: false);
		}

		public void Show(FrameworkElement owner, bool activate, bool preferPopup)
		{
			Show(owner, activate, preferPopup ? ToolWindowHostType.Popup : ToolWindowHostType.Window);
		}

		internal void Show(FrameworkElement owner, bool activate, ToolWindowHostType preferredHost, ToolWindowPositionInfo positionInfo = null)
		{
			ShowAsync(owner, activate, preferredHost, positionInfo)?.Dispose();
		}

		internal IDisposable ShowAsync(FrameworkElement owner, bool activate, bool preferPopup)
		{
			return ShowAsync(owner, activate, preferPopup ? ToolWindowHostType.Popup : ToolWindowHostType.Window);
		}

		internal IDisposable ShowAsync(FrameworkElement owner, bool activate, ToolWindowHostType preferredHost, ToolWindowPositionInfo positionInfo = null)
		{
			PrepareForShow(owner, modal: false);
			_activateOnShow = activate;
			_preferredHost = preferredHost;
			owner.Loaded -= OnOwnerLoaded;
			if (!owner.IsLoaded)
			{
				owner.Loaded += OnOwnerLoaded;
				return null;
			}
			IDeferShow deferShow = ShowImpl(owner, positionInfo);
			if (deferShow == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			_deferredShowInfo = new DeferredShowInfo(this, activate, deferShow);
			return _deferredShowInfo;
		}

		public void ShowDialog(FrameworkElement owner, ShowDialogCallback callback)
		{
			PrepareForShow(owner, modal: true);
			_preferredHost = ToolWindowHostType.Window;
			Window owningWindow = GetOwningWindow(owner);
			OnStartShowDialog();
			CoerceValue(MinimizeButtonVisibilityProperty);
			CoerceValue(MaximizeButtonVisibilityProperty);
			if (owningWindow != null || GetOwnerHwnd(owner) != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				ShowModalToolWindowHostWindow(owningWindow, callback);
			}
			else
			{
				ToolWindowHostPopup.ShowDialog(this, callback);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnActivated(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			((EventHandler)Events[EventActivated])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosed(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			((EventHandler)Events[EventClosed])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnClosing(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			((CancelEventHandler)Events[EventClosing])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeactivated(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			((EventHandler)Events[EventDeactivated])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		internal void OnWindowShowing(EventArgs e)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(e, "e");
			((EventHandler)Events[EventWindowShowing])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		void IMinMaxWatcherOwner.OnMinMaxChanged(MinMaxWatcher watcher)
		{
			CalculateMinMaxExtents(async: true);
		}

	{
		Window,
		Popup,
		Adorner,
		HwndSource
	}
	internal class ToolWindowPositionInfo
	{
		private double _width = double.NaN;

		private double _height = double.NaN;

		private double _horizontalAlignmentOffset;

		private double _verticalAlignmentOffset;

		private System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment _horizontalAlignment;

		private VerticalAlignment _verticalAlignment;

		private ToolWindowAlignmentMode _horizontalAlignmentMode;

		private ToolWindowAlignmentMode _verticalAlignmentMode;

		private bool _hasChanged;

		public double Width
		{
			get
			{
				return _width;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _width, value);
			}
		}

		public double Height
		{
			get
			{
				return _height;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _height, value);
			}
		}

		public double HorizontalAlignmentOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return _horizontalAlignmentOffset;
			}
			set
			{

		}

		public double VerticalAlignmentOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return _verticalAlignmentOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _verticalAlignmentOffset, value);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment HorizontalAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return _horizontalAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _horizontalAlignment, value);
			}
		}

		public VerticalAlignment VerticalAlignment

		{
			get
			{
				return _verticalAlignmentMode;
			}

		public bool HasChanged => _hasChanged;

		internal void ClearHasChanged()
		{
			_hasChanged = false;
		}

		private void SetField<T>(ref T member, T value)
		{
			if (!object.Equals(member, value))
			{
				member = value;
				_hasChanged = true;
			}
		}

	internal class ToolWindowAdorner : Adorner
	{
		private class ToolWindowAdornerPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
		{
			private int _topZIndex;

			private Dictionary<FrameworkElement, ToolWindowOwnerInfo> _owners;

			internal ToolWindowAdornerPanel()
			{
				_owners = new Dictionary<FrameworkElement, ToolWindowOwnerInfo>();
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
			{
				Rect rect = new Rect(finalSize);
				rect.Inflate(-10.0, -10.0);
				foreach (ToolWindowAdornerItem child in base.Children)
				{
					ToolWindow toolWindow = child.Child as ToolWindow;
					double num = child.Left;
					double num2 = child.Top;
					double width = child.Width;
					double height = child.Height;
					if (double.IsNaN(num))
					{
						num = 0.0;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(num2))
					{
						num2 = 0.0;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(width))
					{
						width = child.DesiredSize.Width;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(height))
					{
						height = child.DesiredSize.Height;
					}
					Rect thisRect = new Rect(num, num2, width, height);
					if (toolWindow != null && toolWindow.Owner != null)
					{
						FrameworkElement owner = toolWindow.Owner;
						if (owner.FindCommonVisualAncestor(this) != null)
						{
							Rect ownerRect = owner.TransformToVisual(this).TransformBounds(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, owner.ActualWidth, owner.ActualHeight));
							child.PerformInitialPositioning(ref thisRect);
							toolWindow.AdjustRelativeRect(ownerRect, ref thisRect);
						}
					}
					if (!thisRect.IntersectsWith(rect) && (toolWindow == null || toolWindow.KeepOnScreen))
					{
						thisRect.Offset(CalculateAdjustment(rect, thisRect));
					}
					child.Arrange(thisRect);
					if (toolWindow == null || !toolWindow.KeepOnScreen)
					{
						continue;
					}
					FrameworkElement captionElement = toolWindow.CaptionElement;
					if (captionElement == null || !captionElement.IsVisible)
					{
						continue;
					}
					GeneralTransform generalTransform = captionElement.TransformToAncestor(child);
					if (generalTransform != null)
					{
						Rect rect2 = generalTransform.TransformBounds(new Rect(captionElement.RenderSize));
						rect2.Offset(thisRect.X, thisRect.Y);
						if (!rect2.IntersectsWith(rect))
						{
							thisRect.Offset(CalculateAdjustment(rect, rect2));
							child.Arrange(thisRect);
						}
					}
				}
				return finalSize;
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
			{
				foreach (ToolWindowAdornerItem child in base.Children)
				{
					System.Windows.Size availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
					child.Measure(availableSize);
				}
				return constraint;
			}

			protected override void OnVisualChildrenChanged(DependencyObject visualAdded, DependencyObject visualRemoved)
			{
				ToolWindowAdornerItem toolWindowAdornerItem = visualRemoved as ToolWindowAdornerItem;
				ToolWindowAdornerItem toolWindowAdornerItem2 = visualAdded as ToolWindowAdornerItem;
				if (toolWindowAdornerItem != null)
				{
					OnItemRemoved(toolWindowAdornerItem);
				}
				if (toolWindowAdornerItem2 != null)
				{
					OnItemAdded(toolWindowAdornerItem2);
				}
				base.OnVisualChildrenChanged(visualAdded, visualRemoved);
			}

			internal void BringToFront(UIElement child)
			{
				Visual visualChild = GetVisualChild(VisualChildrenCount - 1);
				if (child != visualChild)
				{
					child.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty, ++_topZIndex);
				}
			}

			private static Vector CalculateAdjustment(Rect screenRect, Rect rect)
			{
				Vector result = default(Vector);
				if (rect.Left >= screenRect.Right)
				{
					result.X = screenRect.Right - 1.0 - rect.Left;
				}
				else if (rect.Right < screenRect.Left)
				{
					result.X = screenRect.Left + 1.0 - rect.Right;
				}
				if (rect.Top >= screenRect.Bottom)
				{
					result.Y = screenRect.Bottom - 1.0 - rect.Top;
				}
				else if (rect.Bottom < screenRect.Top)
				{
					result.Y = screenRect.Top + 1.0 - rect.Bottom;
				}
				return result;
			}

			internal void GetToolWindows(FrameworkElement owner, List<ToolWindow> windows, ref int insertAtIndex)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(this); i < childrenCount; i++)
				{
					ToolWindow toolWindow = ((VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(this, i) is ToolWindowAdornerItem toolWindowAdornerItem) ? (toolWindowAdornerItem.Child as ToolWindow) : null);
					if (toolWindow != null && toolWindow.Owner == owner)
					{
						windows.Insert(insertAtIndex++, toolWindow);
					}
				}
			}

			private void OnItemAdded(ToolWindowAdornerItem item)
			{
				if (item.Child is ToolWindow { Owner: var owner })
				{
					if (!_owners.TryGetValue(owner, out var value))
					{
						value = new ToolWindowOwnerInfo(owner, this);
						_owners.Add(owner, value);
					}
					value.AddWindow(item);
				}
			}

			private void OnItemRemoved(ToolWindowAdornerItem item)
			{
				if (item.Child is ToolWindow { Owner: { } owner })
				{
					ToolWindowOwnerInfo toolWindowOwnerInfo = _owners[owner];
					toolWindowOwnerInfo.RemoveWindow(item);
				}
			}

			internal void OnRelativeStateChanged(ToolWindowAdornerItem item)
			{
				if (item.Child is ToolWindow { Owner: var owner })
				{
					ToolWindowOwnerInfo toolWindowOwnerInfo = _owners[owner];
					toolWindowOwnerInfo.VerifyRelationPositionCount();
				}
			}

			internal void OnTopmostStateChanged(ToolWindowAdornerItem child)
			{
				int num = base.Children.IndexOf(child);
				if (num >= 0 && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) is ToolWindowAdorner toolWindowAdorner)
				{
					toolWindowAdorner.TransferToOtherPanel(child, this);
				}
			}
		}

		private class ToolWindowOwnerInfo
		{
			private ToolWindowAdornerPanel _panel;

			private FrameworkElement _owner;

			private List<ToolWindowAdornerItem> _windows;

			private Rect _lastRelativeBounds = Rect.Empty;

			private int _relativeItemCount;

			internal ToolWindowOwnerInfo(FrameworkElement owner, ToolWindowAdornerPanel panel)
			{
				_owner = owner;
				_panel = panel;
				_windows = new List<ToolWindowAdornerItem>();
			}

			internal void AddWindow(ToolWindowAdornerItem item)
			{
				_windows.Add(item);
				if (item.UsesRelativePosition)
				{
					_relativeItemCount++;
					if (_relativeItemCount == 1)
					{
						_panel.LayoutUpdated += OnPanelLayoutUpdated;
						_lastRelativeBounds = _owner.TransformToVisual(_panel).TransformBounds(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, _owner.ActualWidth, _owner.ActualHeight));
					}
				}
			}

			private void OnPanelLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				if (_owner.FindCommonVisualAncestor(_panel) != null)
				{
					Rect rect = _owner.TransformToVisual(_panel).TransformBounds(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, _owner.ActualWidth, _owner.ActualHeight));
					if (rect != _lastRelativeBounds)
					{
						_lastRelativeBounds = rect;
						_panel.InvalidateArrange();
					}
				}
			}

			internal void RemoveWindow(ToolWindowAdornerItem item)
			{
				_windows.Remove(item);
				if (item.UsesRelativePosition)
				{
					_relativeItemCount--;
					if (_relativeItemCount == 0)
					{
						_panel.LayoutUpdated -= OnPanelLayoutUpdated;
						_lastRelativeBounds = Rect.Empty;
					}
				}
			}

			internal void VerifyRelationPositionCount()
			{
				int num = 0;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _windows.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (_windows[i].UsesRelativePosition)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				if (num != _relativeItemCount)
				{
					if (_relativeItemCount == 0)
					{
						_panel.LayoutUpdated += OnPanelLayoutUpdated;
						_panel.InvalidateArrange();
					}
					else if (num == 0)
					{
						_panel.LayoutUpdated -= OnPanelLayoutUpdated;
						_lastRelativeBounds = Rect.Empty;
						_panel.InvalidateArrange();
					}
					_relativeItemCount = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private class ToolWindowAdornerItem : ToolWindowContainer, IToolWindowHost
		{
			public override bool AllowsTransparency => true;

			public override ToolWindowHostType HostType => ToolWindowHostType.Adorner;

			static ToolWindowAdornerItem()
			{
				ToolWindowContainer.TopmostProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowAdornerItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnTopmostChanged));
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Point GetRelativeScreenPoint(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(AdornerLayer), allowSubclassOfType: true) as FrameworkElement;
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(frameworkElement);
				if (position.X > frameworkElement.RenderSize.Width)
				{
					position.X = frameworkElement.RenderSize.Width;
				}
				else if (position.X < 0.0)
				{
					position.X = 0.0;
				}
				if (position.Y > frameworkElement.RenderSize.Height)
				{
					position.Y = frameworkElement.RenderSize.Height;
				}
				else if (position.Y < 0.0)
				{
					position.Y = 0.0;
				}
				GeneralTransform generalTransform = frameworkElement.TransformToDescendant(this);
				if (generalTransform == null)
				{
					return position;
				}
				System.Windows.Point point = generalTransform.Transform(position);
				return Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(this, point);
			}

			public override void Close()
			{
				ToolWindowAdornerPanel toolWindowAdornerPanel = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) as ToolWindowAdornerPanel;
				ToolWindow toolWindow = base.Child as ToolWindow;
				if (toolWindowAdornerPanel != null && (toolWindow == null || !toolWindow.OnClosingInternal(new CancelEventArgs())))
				{
					toolWindowAdornerPanel.Children.Remove(this);
					base.Child = null;
					toolWindow?.OnClosedInternal();
				}
			}

			public override void RelativePositionStateChanged()
			{
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) is ToolWindowAdornerPanel toolWindowAdornerPanel)
				{
					toolWindowAdornerPanel.OnRelativeStateChanged(this);
				}
			}

			public override void BringToFront()
			{
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) is ToolWindowAdornerPanel toolWindowAdornerPanel)
				{
					toolWindowAdornerPanel.BringToFront(this);
				}
			}

			public override bool SupportsAllowTransparency(bool allowsTransparency)
			{
				return allowsTransparency;
			}

			private static void OnTopmostChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				ToolWindowAdornerItem toolWindowAdornerItem = d as ToolWindowAdornerItem;
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(toolWindowAdornerItem) is ToolWindowAdornerPanel toolWindowAdornerPanel && toolWindowAdornerItem != null)
				{
					toolWindowAdornerPanel.OnTopmostStateChanged(toolWindowAdornerItem);
				}
			}
		}

		private class DeferShowHelper : ToolWindow.IDeferShow
		{
			private ToolWindowAdornerItem _window;

			internal DeferShowHelper(ToolWindowAdornerItem window)
			{
				_window = window;
			}

			public void Show(bool activate)
			{
				if (activate)
				{
					_window.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
				}
			}

			public void Cancel()
			{
				_window.Close();
			}
		}

		private ToolWindowAdornerPanel _panel;

		private ToolWindowAdornerPanel _topMostPanel;

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 1;
				if (_topMostPanel != null)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private ToolWindowAdornerPanel TopMostPanel
		{
			get
			{
				if (_topMostPanel == null)
				{
					_topMostPanel = new ToolWindowAdornerPanel();
					AddVisualChild(_topMostPanel);
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				return _topMostPanel;
			}
		}

		internal ToolWindowAdorner(UIElement adornedElement)
			: base(adornedElement)
		{
			_panel = new ToolWindowAdornerPanel();
			AddVisualChild(_panel);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(finalSize);
			_panel.Arrange(finalRect);
			if (_topMostPanel != null)
			{
				_topMostPanel.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			switch (index)
			{
			case 0:
				return _panel;
			case 1:
				if (_topMostPanel != null)
				{
					return _topMostPanel;
				}
				break;
			}
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
		}

		internal ToolWindow.IDeferShow AddWindow(ToolWindow window, FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			ToolWindowAdornerItem toolWindowAdornerItem = new ToolWindowAdornerItem();
			toolWindowAdornerItem.Child = window;
			if (!toolWindowAdornerItem.Topmost)
			{
				_panel.Children.Add(toolWindowAdornerItem);
			}
			else
			{
				TopMostPanel.Children.Add(toolWindowAdornerItem);
			}
			window.Activated += OnToolWindowActivated;
			return new DeferShowHelper(toolWindowAdornerItem);
		}

		internal void BringToFront(ToolWindow toolWindow)
		{
			ToolWindowAdornerItem toolWindowAdornerItem = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(toolWindow) as ToolWindowAdornerItem;
			((toolWindowAdornerItem != null) ? GetPanel(toolWindowAdornerItem) : null)?.BringToFront(toolWindowAdornerItem);
		}

		internal void GetToolWindows(FrameworkElement owner, List<ToolWindow> windows, ref int insertAtIndex)
		{
			if (_topMostPanel != null)
			{
				_topMostPanel.GetToolWindows(owner, windows, ref insertAtIndex);
			}
			_panel.GetToolWindows(owner, windows, ref insertAtIndex);
		}

		internal void RemoveWindow(ToolWindow window)
		{
			ToolWindowAdornerPanel panel = GetPanel(window);
			if (panel != null)
			{
				RemoveWindow(window, panel);
			}
		}

		private bool RemoveWindow(ToolWindow window, ToolWindowAdornerPanel panel)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int num = panel.Children.Count - 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (panel.Children[i] is ToolWindowAdornerItem toolWindowAdornerItem && toolWindowAdornerItem.Child == window)
				{
					window.Activated -= OnToolWindowActivated;
					toolWindowAdornerItem.Child = null;
					panel.Children.RemoveAt(i);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private ToolWindowAdornerPanel GetPanel(ToolWindow window)
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(window) is ToolWindowAdornerItem item)
			{
				return GetPanel(item);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ToolWindowAdornerPanel GetPanel(ToolWindowAdornerItem item)
		{
			return VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(item) as ToolWindowAdornerPanel;
		}

		private void OnToolWindowActivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)sender) is ToolWindowAdornerItem toolWindowAdornerItem)
			{
				GetPanel(toolWindowAdornerItem)?.BringToFront(toolWindowAdornerItem);
			}
		}

		private void TransferToOtherPanel(ToolWindowAdornerItem child, ToolWindowAdornerPanel currentPanel)
		{
			ToolWindowAdornerPanel toolWindowAdornerPanel = ((currentPanel == _panel) ? TopMostPanel : _panel);
			currentPanel.Children.Remove(child);
			toolWindowAdornerPanel.Children.Add(child);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ToolWindowContainer : FrameworkElement, IToolWindowHost
	{
		private enum CaptureAction
		{
			None,
			Drag,
			Resize
		}

		[Flags]
		internal enum ResizeFlags
		{
			Top = 1,
			Left = 2,
			Right = 4,
			Bottom = 8,
			TopLeft = 3,
			TopRight = 5,
			BottomLeft = 0xA,
			BottomRight = 0xC
		}

		private CaptureAction _captureAction;

		private ResizeFlags _resizeFlags;

		private System.Windows.Point _lastMousePoint;

		private UIElement _child;

		private bool _isInitialPositionPending;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LeftProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TopProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TopmostProperty;

		public UIElement Child
		{
			get
			{
				return _child;
			}
			set
			{
				UIElement child = Child;
				child?.ClearValue(ToolWindow.HostProperty);
				_child = value;
				if (child != null)
				{
					RemoveVisualChild(child);
					if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(child) == this)
					{
						RemoveLogicalChild(child);
					}
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					AddVisualChild(value);
					if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(value) == null)
					{
						AddLogicalChild(value);
					}
				}
				if (Child != null)
				{
					ToolWindow toolWindow = value as ToolWindow;
					_isInitialPositionPending = toolWindow != null && toolWindow.WindowStartupLocation != ToolWindowStartupLocation.Manual;
					Child.SetValue(ToolWindow.HostProperty, this);
					SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, value));
					SetBinding(LeftProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.LeftProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, value));
					SetBinding(TopProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.TopProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, value));
					SetBinding(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, value));
					SetBinding(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, value));
					SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, value));
					SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, value));
					SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, value));
					SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, value));
					SetBinding(TopmostProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.TopmostProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, value));
				}
				else
				{
					BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(this);
				}
				OnChildChanged(child, Child);
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren
		{
			get
			{
				if (_child != null && LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(_child) == this)
				{
					return new SingleItemEnumerator(_child);
				}
				return EmptyEnumerator.Instance;
			}
		}

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_child != null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInitialPositionPending => _isInitialPositionPending;

		protected bool IsResizing => _captureAction == CaptureAction.Resize;

		public double Left
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(LeftProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LeftProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double Top
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(TopProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TopProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool Topmost
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(TopmostProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TopmostProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal bool UsesRelativePosition
		{
			get
			{
				if (Child is ToolWindow toolWindow)
				{
					return toolWindow.UsesRelativePosition;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		bool IToolWindowHost.HandlesDelayedMinMaxRequests => false;

		bool IToolWindowHost.IsWindow => false;

		public abstract bool AllowsTransparency { get; }

		bool IToolWindowHost.IsUsingOsNonClientArea => false;

		public abstract ToolWindowHostType HostType { get; }

		bool IToolWindowHost.HasPendingCloseRequest => false;

		internal ToolWindowContainer()
		{
		}

		static ToolWindowContainer()
		{
			LeftProperty = ToolWindow.LeftProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentArrange));
			TopProperty = ToolWindow.TopProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentArrange));
			TopmostProperty = ToolWindow.TopmostProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.HorizontalAlignmentStretchBox));
			FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VerticalAlignmentStretchBox));
			FocusManager.IsFocusScopeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), Keyboard.PreviewLostKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnPreviousLostKeyboardFocus));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), Keyboard.GotKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnGotKeyboardFocusWithin), handledEventsToo: true);
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), Keyboard.LostKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnLostKeyboardFocusWithin), handledEventsToo: true);
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), Mouse.MouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnWindowMouseDown), handledEventsToo: true);
			KeyboardNavigation.TabNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle));
			KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowContainer), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (_child != null)
			{
				_child.Arrange(new Rect(finalSize));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index == 0 && _child != null)
			{
				return _child;
			}
			return base.GetVisualChild(index);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = default(System.Windows.Size);
			if (_child != null)
			{
				_child.Measure(availableSize);
				return _child.DesiredSize;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.IsMouseCaptured && _captureAction != CaptureAction.None)
			{
				ProcessCaptureAction(e);
			}
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				_captureAction = CaptureAction.None;
				e.Handled = true;
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ClearValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty);
			_ = _captureAction;
			base.OnLostMouseCapture(e);
		}

		protected abstract System.Windows.Point GetRelativeScreenPoint(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e);

		protected virtual void OnChildChanged(UIElement oldChild, UIElement newChild)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnEnteringMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnEnteringDrag(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, ToolWindowResizeElementLocation location)
		{
		}

		private static void OnGotKeyboardFocusWithin(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = ((e.NewFocus is DependencyObject) ? ToolWindow.GetToolWindow((DependencyObject)e.NewFocus) : null);
			if (toolWindow != null && !toolWindow.IsActive)
			{
				toolWindow.SetValue(ToolWindow.IsActivePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
		}

		private static void OnLostKeyboardFocusWithin(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = ((e.OldFocus is DependencyObject) ? ToolWindow.GetToolWindow((DependencyObject)e.OldFocus) : null);
			ToolWindow toolWindow2 = ((e.NewFocus is DependencyObject) ? ToolWindow.GetToolWindow((DependencyObject)e.NewFocus) : null);
			if (toolWindow != toolWindow2)
			{
				toolWindow?.ClearValue(ToolWindow.IsActivePropertyKey);
			}
		}

		private static void OnPreviousLostKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowContainer toolWindowContainer = sender as ToolWindowContainer;
			if (!(e.NewFocus is Window) || VisualTreeHelper.GetParent((Window)e.NewFocus) != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.OldFocus as DependencyObject;
			while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
			{
				dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null && toolWindowContainer.IsAncestorOf(dependencyObject))
			{
				UIElement uIElement = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(dependencyObject) as UIElement;
				if (uIElement != toolWindowContainer && uIElement.IsVisible)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			e.Handled = true;
			IInputElement focusedElement = FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(toolWindowContainer);
			if (focusedElement != null)
			{
				focusedElement.Focus();
			}
			else
			{
				toolWindowContainer.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
			}
		}

		private static void OnWindowMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowContainer toolWindowContainer = (ToolWindowContainer)sender;
			((IToolWindowHost)toolWindowContainer).Activate();
		}

		internal void PerformInitialPositioning(ref Rect thisRect)
		{
			if (!(Child is ToolWindow toolWindow) || !IsInitialPositionPending)
			{
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement owner = toolWindow.Owner;
			if (owner == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_isInitialPositionPending = false;
			Rect? rect = null;
			switch (toolWindow.WindowStartupLocation)
			{
			case ToolWindowStartupLocation.CenterOwnerWindow:
			{
				UIElement uIElement = (owner as ToolWindow) ?? ToolWindow.GetToolWindow(owner) ?? (Utilities.GetCommonAncestor(owner, null) as UIElement) ?? Window.GetWindow(this);
				if (uIElement is Window && VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(uIElement) > 0)
				{
					uIElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(uIElement, 0) as UIElement;
				}
				rect = ((uIElement != null) ? new Rect?(new Rect(Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(uIElement, default(System.Windows.Point)), uIElement.RenderSize)) : new Rect?(Utilities.GetWorkArea(this)));
				break;
			}
			case ToolWindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen:
				rect = Utilities.GetWorkArea(this);
				break;
			}
			if (rect.HasValue)
			{
				Rect value = rect.Value;
				thisRect.Y = value.Top + (value.Height - thisRect.Height) / 2.0;
				thisRect.X = value.Left + (value.Width - thisRect.Width) / 2.0;
				Left = thisRect.X;
				Top = thisRect.Y;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessCaptureAction(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Point relativeScreenPoint = GetRelativeScreenPoint(e);
			if (!(relativeScreenPoint != _lastMousePoint))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = relativeScreenPoint.X - _lastMousePoint.X;
			double num2 = relativeScreenPoint.Y - _lastMousePoint.Y;
			_lastMousePoint = relativeScreenPoint;
			double num3 = Left;
			double num4 = Top;
			if (double.IsNaN(num3))
			{
				num3 = 0.0;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num4))
			{
				num4 = 0.0;
			}
			double num5 = base.Width;
			double num6 = base.Height;
			double num7 = num5;
			double num8 = num6;
			if (_captureAction == CaptureAction.Drag)
			{
				num3 += num;
				num4 += num2;
			}
			else if (_captureAction == CaptureAction.Resize)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(num5))
				{
					num5 = base.ActualWidth;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(num6))
				{
					num6 = base.ActualHeight;
				}
				double maxWidth = base.MaxWidth;
				double maxHeight = base.MaxHeight;
				double minWidth = base.MinWidth;
				double minHeight = base.MinHeight;
				if ((_resizeFlags & ResizeFlags.Left) == ResizeFlags.Left)
				{
					num7 = num5 - num;
					num3 += num;
					if (!double.IsNaN(maxWidth) && num7 > maxWidth)
					{
						double num9 = num7 - maxWidth;
						num3 += num9;
						_lastMousePoint.X += num9;
						num7 = maxWidth;
					}
					if (num7 < base.MinWidth)
					{
						double num10 = base.MinWidth - num7;
						num3 -= num10;
						_lastMousePoint.X -= num10;
						num7 = base.MinWidth;
					}
				}
				else if ((_resizeFlags & ResizeFlags.Right) == ResizeFlags.Right)
				{
					num7 = num5 + num;
					if (!double.IsNaN(maxWidth) && num7 > maxWidth)
					{
						double num11 = num7 - maxWidth;
						_lastMousePoint.X -= num11;
						num7 = maxWidth;
					}
					if (num7 < minWidth)
					{
						double num12 = minWidth - num7;
						_lastMousePoint.X += num12;
						num7 = minWidth;
					}
				}
				if ((_resizeFlags & ResizeFlags.Top) == ResizeFlags.Top)
				{
					num8 = num6 - num2;
					num4 += num2;
					if (!double.IsNaN(maxHeight) && num8 > maxHeight)
					{
						double num13 = num8 - maxHeight;
						num4 += num13;
						_lastMousePoint.Y += num13;
						num8 = maxHeight;
					}
					if (num8 < minHeight)
					{
						double num14 = minHeight - num8;
						num4 -= num14;
						_lastMousePoint.Y -= num14;
						num8 = minHeight;
					}
				}
				else if ((_resizeFlags & ResizeFlags.Bottom) == ResizeFlags.Bottom)
				{
					num8 = num6 + num2;
					if (!double.IsNaN(maxHeight) && num8 > maxHeight)
					{
						double num15 = num8 - maxHeight;
						_lastMousePoint.Y -= num15;
						num8 = maxHeight;
					}
					if (num8 < minHeight)
					{
						double num16 = minHeight - num8;
						_lastMousePoint.Y += num16;
						num8 = minHeight;
					}
				}
			}
			ProcessMoveSize(num3, num4, num7, num8);
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessMoveSize(double left, double top, double width, double height)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = Child as ToolWindow;
			bool flag = !toolWindow.UsesRelativePosition || toolWindow.HorizontalAlignmentMode == ToolWindowAlignmentMode.Manual;
			bool flag2 = !toolWindow.UsesRelativePosition || toolWindow.VerticalAlignmentMode == ToolWindowAlignmentMode.Manual;
			if (flag)
			{
				Left = left;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				Top = top;
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (flag && width != base.Width)
			{
				base.Width = width;
				flag3 = true;
			}
			if (flag2 && height != base.Height)
			{
				base.Height = height;
				flag3 = true;
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				((UIElement)base.Parent).InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.DragMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Mouse.LeftButton != MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_ToolWindowLeftMouseButtonNotDown"));
			}
			OnEnteringMove(e);
			_lastMousePoint = GetRelativeScreenPoint(e);
			CaptureMouse();
			if (base.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				_captureAction = CaptureAction.Drag;
			}
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.DragResize(ToolWindowResizeElementLocation location, System.Windows.Input.Cursor cursor, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Mouse.LeftButton != MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_ToolWindowLeftMouseButtonNotDown"));
			}
			OnEnteringDrag(e, location);
			_lastMousePoint = GetRelativeScreenPoint(e);
			CaptureMouse();
			if (base.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				base.Cursor = cursor;
				_resizeFlags = location switch
				{
					ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Top => ResizeFlags.Top, 
					ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Right => ResizeFlags.Right, 
					ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Bottom => ResizeFlags.Bottom, 
					ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft => ResizeFlags.TopLeft, 
					ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight => ResizeFlags.TopRight, 
					ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft => ResizeFlags.BottomLeft, 
					ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight => ResizeFlags.BottomRight, 
					_ => ResizeFlags.Left, 
				};
				_captureAction = CaptureAction.Resize;
			}
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.Activate()
		{
			bool flag = base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
			if (!flag && Keyboard.FocusedElement is DependencyObject)
			{
				flag = Utilities.IsDescendantOf(this, Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			IInputElement focusedElement = FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(this);
			if (focusedElement != null)
			{
				if (focusedElement.Focus())
				{
					((IToolWindowHost)this).BringToFront();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
			}
		}

	internal class ToolWindowHostPopup : ToolWindowContainer, IToolWindowHost

		private class PopupChildWrapper : FrameworkElement
		{
			private ToolWindowHostPopup _host;

			private bool _isMeasuringMaxHeight;

			protected override int VisualChildrenCount => 1;

			protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => new SingleItemEnumerator(_host);

			public ToolWindowHostPopup Host => _host;

			internal PopupChildWrapper(ToolWindowHostPopup host)
			{
				_host = host;
				AddLogicalChild(host);
				AddVisualChild(host);
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
			{
				if (_isMeasuringMaxHeight)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(2147483647.0, 2147483647.0);
				}
				_host.Measure(availableSize);
				return _host.DesiredSize;
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
			{
				_host.Arrange(new Rect(finalSize));
				return finalSize;
			}

			protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
			{
				if (index != 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				return _host;
			}

			internal System.Windows.Size CalculateMaxPopupSize(Rect workRect)
			{
				bool isMeasuringMaxHeight = _isMeasuringMaxHeight;
				_isMeasuringMaxHeight = true;
				try
				{
					UIElement uIElement = this;
					while (uIElement != null && Utilities.GetParent(uIElement, includeLogicalParent: false) is UIElement uIElement2)
					{
						uIElement = uIElement2;
					}
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
					}
					Utilities.InvalidateMeasure(this, uIElement);
					InvalidateMeasure();
					uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
					uIElement.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = uIElement.DesiredSize;
					InvalidateMeasure();
					uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
					Utilities.InvalidateMeasure(this, uIElement);
					return desiredSize;
				}
				finally
				{
					_isMeasuringMaxHeight = isMeasuringMaxHeight;
				}
			}
		}

		private class DeferShowHelper : ToolWindow.IDeferShow
		{
			private ToolWindowHostPopup _window;

			internal DeferShowHelper(ToolWindowHostPopup window)
			{
				_window = window;
			}

			public void Show(bool activate)
			{
				Popup popup = _window._popup;
				if (_window.Child is ToolWindow toolWindow)
				{
					popup.AllowsTransparency = toolWindow.AllowsTransparencyResolved;
				}
				popup.IsOpen = true;
				ToolWindow toolWindow2 = _window.Child as ToolWindow;
				if (activate && toolWindow2 != null)
				{
					toolWindow2.Activate();
					toolWindow2.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, new ContextCallback(_window.VerifyActivation), null);
				}
				_window.VerifyIsInView(force: false, async: true, ensureFullyInView: false);
			}

			public void Cancel()
			{
				if (_window.Child is ToolWindow { IsModal: false } toolWindow)
				{
					_window.Child = null;
					CurrentPopups.Remove(_window);
					toolWindow?.OnClosedInternal();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = base.Child as ToolWindow;
			if (_popup.IsOpen && (toolWindow == null || !toolWindow.OnClosingInternal(new CancelEventArgs())))
			{
				_popup.IsOpen = false;
			}
		}
