			VerifyIsInView(force: true, async: true, fullyInView);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Point GetRelativeScreenPoint(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(this);
			position.X += base.Left;
			position.Y += base.Top;
			if (ConstrainToWorkArea || base.IsResizing)
			{
				if (position.X < _screenRect.X)
				{
					position.X = _screenRect.X;
				}
				else if (position.X > _screenRect.Right)
				{
					position.X = _screenRect.Right;
				}
				if (position.Y < _screenRect.Y)
				{
					position.Y = _screenRect.Y;
				}
				else if (position.Y > _screenRect.Bottom)
				{
					position.Y = _screenRect.Bottom;
				}
			}
			return position;
		}

		protected override void OnChildChanged(UIElement oldChild, UIElement newChild)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = oldChild as ToolWindow;
			ToolWindow toolWindow2 = newChild as ToolWindow;
			if (toolWindow != null)
			{
				FrameworkElement owner = toolWindow.Owner;
				if (owner != null)
				{
					GetToolWindows(owner)?.Remove(toolWindow);
				}
			}
			if (toolWindow2 != null)
			{
				FrameworkElement owner2 = toolWindow2.Owner;
				if (owner2 != null)
				{
					IList<ToolWindow> list = GetToolWindows(owner2);
					if (list == null)
					{
						list = new List<ToolWindow>();
						owner2.SetValue(ToolWindowsPropertyKey, list);
					}
					list.Add(toolWindow2);
				}
			}
			base.OnChildChanged(oldChild, newChild);
		}

		protected override void OnEnteringDrag(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, ToolWindowResizeElementLocation location)
		{
			Rect workArea = GetWorkArea(e);
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(this);
			if (_popup.Child is PopupChildWrapper popupChildWrapper)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = popupChildWrapper.CalculateMaxPopupSize(workArea);
				if (!size.IsEmpty)
				{
					Rect rect = new Rect(base.Left, base.Top, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight);
					Rect rect2 = new Rect(base.Left, base.Top, Math.Min(workArea.Width, size.Width), Math.Min(workArea.Height, size.Height));
					switch (location)
					{
					case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Top:
					case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft:
					case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight:
						rect2.Y = rect.Bottom - rect2.Height;
						break;
					}
					if (location == ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Left || location == ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft || location == ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft)
					{
						rect2.X = rect.Right - rect2.Width;
					}
					workArea.Intersect(rect2);
				}
			}
			switch (location)
			{
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Bottom:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight:
				workArea.Height -= base.ActualHeight - position.Y;
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Top:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight:
				workArea.Y += position.Y;
				workArea.Height -= position.Y;
				break;
			}
			switch (location)
			{
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Left:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft:
				workArea.X += position.X;
				workArea.Width -= position.X;
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Right:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight:
				workArea.Width -= base.ActualWidth - position.X;
				break;
			}
			_screenRect = workArea;
			if (workArea.Width < base.Width || workArea.Height < base.Height)
			{
				ProcessMoveSize(Math.Max(workArea.Left, base.Left), Math.Max(workArea.Top, base.Top), Math.Min(workArea.Width, base.Width), Math.Min(workArea.Height, base.Height));
			}
			base.OnEnteringDrag(e, location);
		}

		protected override void OnEnteringMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ConstrainToWorkArea)
			{
				Rect workArea = GetWorkArea(e);
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(this);
				Rect rect = new Rect(base.Left, base.Top, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight);
				workArea = Rect.Union(rect, workArea);
				double num = Math.Min(base.Top, 0.0);
				double num2 = Math.Min(base.Left, 0.0);
				workArea.Y = position.Y + num;
				workArea.X = position.X + num2;
				workArea.Width = Math.Max(workArea.Width - base.ActualWidth, 0.0);
				workArea.Height = Math.Max(workArea.Height - base.ActualHeight, 0.0);
				_screenRect = workArea;
			}
			base.OnEnteringMove(e);
		}

		public override void RelativePositionStateChanged()
		{
			RelativePositionStateChanged(RelativePositionStateChangedId);
		}

		private object RelativePositionStateChanged(object param)
		{
			ToolWindow toolWindow = base.Child as ToolWindow;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = toolWindow != null && _popup != null && _popup.IsOpen;
			if (!flag2 && toolWindow != null && param == InitialRelativePositionId)
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				try
				{
					FrameworkElement owner = toolWindow.Owner;
					System.Windows.Point location;
					if (owner is Window window)
					{
						location = new System.Windows.Point(window.Left, window.Top);
					}
					else
					{
						location = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(owner, default(System.Windows.Point));
						if (!BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
						{
							Matrix deviceMatrix = Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: false, this);
							location.X *= deviceMatrix.M11;
							location.Y *= deviceMatrix.M22;
						}
					}
					System.Windows.Size renderSize = owner.RenderSize;
					if (owner != null && !BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
					{
						Matrix deviceMatrix2 = Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: false, owner);
						Matrix deviceMatrix3 = Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: false, this);
						renderSize.Width *= deviceMatrix3.M11 / deviceMatrix2.M11;
						renderSize.Height *= deviceMatrix3.M22 / deviceMatrix2.M22;
					}
					Rect ownerRect = new Rect(location, renderSize);
					if (owner.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
					{
						ownerRect.X -= owner.ActualWidth;
					}
					Rect thisRect = new Rect(base.Left, base.Top, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight);
					if (base.IsLoaded)
					{
						PerformInitialPositioning(ref thisRect);
					}
					toolWindow.AdjustRelativeRect(ownerRect, ref thisRect);
					if (toolWindow.VerticalAlignmentMode != ToolWindowAlignmentMode.Manual)
					{
						flag = true;
						base.Top = thisRect.Y;
						if (thisRect.Height != base.ActualHeight)
						{
							base.Height = thisRect.Height;
						}
					}
					if (toolWindow.HorizontalAlignmentMode != ToolWindowAlignmentMode.Manual)
					{
						flag = true;
						base.Left = thisRect.X;
						if (thisRect.Width != base.ActualWidth)
						{
							base.Width = thisRect.Width;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			if (flag && base.IsLoaded)
			{
				if (param != SynchronousRelativePositionId && _controller != null)
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, new DispatcherOperationCallback(RelativePositionStateChanged), SynchronousRelativePositionId);
				}
				base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
			}
			else
			{
				base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool SupportsAllowTransparency(bool allowsTransparency)
		{
			return allowsTransparency == PopupHelper.PopupAllowsTransparency;
		}

		private static void OnIsOpenChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (false.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				ToolWindowHostPopup toolWindowHostPopup = (ToolWindowHostPopup)d;
				if (toolWindowHostPopup.Child is ToolWindow { IsModal: false } toolWindow)
				{
					toolWindowHostPopup.Child = null;
					toolWindow?.OnClosedInternal();
				}
			}
		}

		private static Stack<ToolWindowHostPopup> GetModalToolWindows(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (Stack<ToolWindowHostPopup>)d.GetValue(ModalToolWindowsProperty);
		}

		private static IList<ToolWindow> GetToolWindows(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (IList<ToolWindow>)d.GetValue(ToolWindowsProperty);
		}

		internal static void AddToolWindows(FrameworkElement owner, List<ToolWindow> windows)
		{
			IList<ToolWindow> toolWindows = GetToolWindows(owner);
			if (toolWindows != null)
			{
				for (int num = toolWindows.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					windows.Add(toolWindows[num]);
				}
			}
		}

		private static ToolWindowHostPopup GetCurrentDialog(FrameworkElement page)
		{
			if (page != null)
			{
				Stack<ToolWindowHostPopup> modalToolWindows = GetModalToolWindows(page);
				if (modalToolWindows != null && modalToolWindows.Count > 0)
				{
					return modalToolWindows.Peek();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static ToolWindowHostPopup GetHost(Popup popup)
		{
			if (popup == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (popup.Child is PopupChildWrapper popupChildWrapper)
			{
				return popupChildWrapper.Host;
			}
			return popup.Child as ToolWindowHostPopup;
		}

		private static FrameworkElement GetRootVisual(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = owner;
			while (dependencyObject != null && !(dependencyObject is Page))
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				if (dependencyObject2 == null && (dependencyObject is Visual || dependencyObject is Visual3D))
				{
					dependencyObject2 = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				}
				if (dependencyObject2 == null && dependencyObject is Popup)
				{
					ToolWindowHostPopup host = GetHost(dependencyObject as Popup);
					if (host != null && host.Child is ToolWindow)
					{
						dependencyObject2 = ((ToolWindow)host.Child).Owner;
					}
				}
				if (dependencyObject2 == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				dependencyObject = dependencyObject2;
			}
			if (dependencyObject is Window)
			{
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(dependencyObject, 0);
			}
			return dependencyObject as FrameworkElement;
		}

		private Rect GetWorkArea(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!ConstrainToWorkArea)
			{
				return NativeWindowMethods.VirtualScreenArea;
			}
			return new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), _rootVisual.RenderSize);
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RelativePositionStateChanged(LayoutUpdatedId);
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Unloaded -= OnUnloaded;
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Loaded -= OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
			RelativePositionStateChanged();
		}

		private void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool isKeyboardFocusWithin = base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
			ToolWindow toolWindow = base.Child as ToolWindow;
			base.Child = null;
			if (toolWindow != null)
			{
				if (_modalDisabledStates != null)
				{
					_modalDisabledStates.Dispose();
				}
				CurrentPopups.Remove(this);
				PopModalDialog(this);
				if (isKeyboardFocusWithin && CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_previousFocusedElement) is IInputElement inputElement)
				{
					inputElement.Focus();
				}
				bool value = toolWindow.DialogResult ?? false;
				toolWindow.OnClosedInternal();
				if (_callback != null)
				{
					_callback(toolWindow, value);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnPopupClosedModeless(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CurrentPopups.Remove(this);
		}

		private static void PopModalDialog(ToolWindowHostPopup popup)
		{
			Stack<ToolWindowHostPopup> modalToolWindows = GetModalToolWindows(popup._rootVisual);
			if (modalToolWindows != null && modalToolWindows.Contains(popup))
			{
				while (modalToolWindows.Pop() != popup)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void PrepareModalDisabledState()
		{
			_modalDisabledStates = new GroupTempValueReplacement();
			List<ToolWindowHostPopup> list = new List<ToolWindowHostPopup>();
			for (int num = CurrentPopups.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				ToolWindowHostPopup toolWindowHostPopup = _currentPopups[num];
				if (toolWindowHostPopup != null)
				{
					if (toolWindowHostPopup != _elementToDisable)
					{
						_modalDisabledStates.Add(new TempValueReplacement(toolWindowHostPopup, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
					}
					if (toolWindowHostPopup._isModal)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (_elementToDisable != null)
			{
				_modalDisabledStates.Add(new TempValueReplacement(_elementToDisable, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			}
		}

		private static void PushModalDialog(ToolWindowHostPopup popup)
		{
			if (popup._rootVisual != null)
			{
				Stack<ToolWindowHostPopup> stack = GetModalToolWindows(popup._rootVisual);
				if (stack == null)
				{
					stack = new Stack<ToolWindowHostPopup>();
					popup._rootVisual.SetValue(ModalToolWindowsPropertyKey, stack);
				}
				stack.Push(popup);
			}
		}

		internal static ToolWindow.IDeferShow Show(ToolWindow toolWindow)
		{
			return ShowImpl(toolWindow, isModal: false, null);
		}

		internal static void ShowDialog(ToolWindow toolWindow, ToolWindow.ShowDialogCallback callback)
		{
			ShowImpl(toolWindow, isModal: true, callback)?.Show(activate: true);
		}

		private static ToolWindow.IDeferShow ShowImpl(ToolWindow toolWindow, bool isModal, ToolWindow.ShowDialogCallback callback)
		{
			Popup popup = new Popup();
			ToolWindowHostPopup toolWindowHostPopup = new ToolWindowHostPopup();
			if (isModal)
			{
				toolWindowHostPopup._callback = callback;
			}
			popup.AllowsTransparency = toolWindow.AllowsTransparencyResolved;
			toolWindowHostPopup._popup = popup;
			if (isModal)
			{
				toolWindowHostPopup._previousFocusedElement = new WeakReference(Keyboard.FocusedElement);
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (toolWindowHostPopup._rootVisual = GetRootVisual(toolWindow.Owner));
			if (isModal)
			{
				toolWindowHostPopup._elementToDisable = GetCurrentDialog(frameworkElement) ?? frameworkElement;
			}
			PopupChildWrapper popupChildWrapper = (PopupChildWrapper)(popup.Child = new PopupChildWrapper(toolWindowHostPopup));
			popup.StaysOpen = true;
			toolWindowHostPopup.Child = toolWindow;
			popupChildWrapper.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.FlowDirectionProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.FlowDirectionProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow.Owner));
			popup.PopupAnimation = PopupAnimation.None;
			if (isModal)
			{
				popup.PlacementTarget = frameworkElement ?? toolWindow.Owner;
			}
			else
			{
				popup.PlacementTarget = toolWindow.Owner;
			}
			popup.Placement = PlacementMode.Absolute;
			popup.SetBinding(Popup.HorizontalOffsetProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.LeftProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, toolWindowHostPopup));
			popup.SetBinding(Popup.VerticalOffsetProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.TopProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, toolWindowHostPopup));
			if (isModal)
			{
				popup.Closed += toolWindowHostPopup.OnPopupClosed;
			}
			else
			{
				popup.Closed += toolWindowHostPopup.OnPopupClosedModeless;
			}
			toolWindowHostPopup.SetBinding(IsOpenProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(Popup.IsOpenProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, popup));
			if (double.IsNaN(popup.HorizontalOffset))
			{
				popup.HorizontalOffset = 0.0;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(popup.VerticalOffset))
			{
				popup.VerticalOffset = 0.0;
			}
			popup.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.RequiredPopupWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
			popup.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.RequiredPopupHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
			toolWindowHostPopup._controller = PopupController.Create(popup, toolWindow.Owner);
			if (toolWindowHostPopup._controller != null)
			{
				toolWindowHostPopup._controller.BindPopupRootExtents = true;
			}
			if (isModal)
			{
				PushModalDialog(toolWindowHostPopup);
			}
			toolWindowHostPopup._isModal = isModal;
			if (isModal)
			{
				toolWindowHostPopup.PrepareModalDisabledState();
			}
			CurrentPopups.Add(toolWindowHostPopup);
			toolWindowHostPopup.RelativePositionStateChanged(InitialRelativePositionId);
			return new DeferShowHelper(toolWindowHostPopup);
		}

		private void VerifyActivation(object param)
		{
			if (base.Child is ToolWindow { IsVisible: not false } toolWindow)
			{
				if (true.Equals(param))
				{
					toolWindow.BringToFront();
				}
				else
				{
					toolWindow.Activate();
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyIsInView(bool force, bool async, bool ensureFullyInView)
		{
			if (base.Child is ToolWindow toolWindow && (toolWindow.KeepOnScreen || force) && toolWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Minimized)
			{
				if (async)
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, new SendOrPostCallback(VerifyIsInViewImpl), ensureFullyInView);
				}
				else
				{
					VerifyIsInViewImpl(ensureFullyInView);
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyIsInViewImpl(object param)
		{
			if (!(base.Child is ToolWindow toolWindow))
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect logicalScreenRect = new Rect(base.Left, base.Top, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight);
			System.Windows.Point? point = Utilities.CalculateOnScreenLocation(logicalScreenRect, this, true.Equals(param));
			if (point.HasValue)
			{
				if (toolWindow != null && toolWindow.HorizontalAlignmentMode == ToolWindowAlignmentMode.Manual)
				{
					base.Left = point.Value.X;
				}
				if (toolWindow != null && toolWindow.VerticalAlignmentMode == ToolWindowAlignmentMode.Manual)
				{
					base.Top = point.Value.Y;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class PopupController : DependencyObject
	{
		private FrameworkElement _owner;

		private PresentationSource _ownerSource;

		private PresentationSource _childSource;

		private Popup _popup;

		private UIElement _popupChild;

		private bool? _topMost;

		private bool _isDeactivated;

		private WeakReference _boundPopupRoot;

		private static bool _controllerCreateFailed;

		private bool _isOpen;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty HorizontalOffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalOffset", typeof(double), typeof(PopupController), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, OnOffsetChanged));

		private static readonly DependencyProperty VerticalOffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalOffset", typeof(double), typeof(PopupController), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, OnOffsetChanged));

		public bool BindPopupRootExtents { get; set; }

		public bool? TopMost
		{
			get
			{
				return _topMost;
			}
			set
			{
				_topMost = value;
			}
		}

		private bool IsTopMost
		{
			get
			{
				bool? flag = TopMost;
				if (!flag.HasValue)
				{
					flag = false;
					if (_ownerSource != null)
					{
						if (_ownerSource.RootVisual is Window window && !Utilities.IsBrowserWindow(window))
						{
							flag = window.Topmost;
						}
						else if (_ownerSource is HwndSource { IsDisposed: false } hwndSource)
						{
							flag = NativeWindowMethods.IsTopMostApi(hwndSource.Handle);
						}
					}
				}
				return flag.Value;
			}
		}

		private PopupController(Popup popup, FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			_owner = owner;
			_popup = popup;
			_popup.Opened += OnPopupOpened;
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, HorizontalOffsetProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(Popup.HorizontalOffsetProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, popup));
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, VerticalOffsetProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(Popup.VerticalOffsetProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, popup));
		}

		public static PopupController Create(Popup popup, FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			if (!_controllerCreateFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
					uIPermission.Demand();
					PermissionSet permissionSet = new PermissionSet(PermissionState.Unrestricted);
					permissionSet.Demand();
					return new PopupController(popup, owner);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_controllerCreateFailed = true;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		internal static void BringToFront(Popup popup)
		{
			if (!popup.IsOpen)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement child = popup.Child;
			if (child != null)
			{
				HwndSource hwndSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual(child) as HwndSource;
				if (!hwndSource.IsDisposed && hwndSource.Handle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(hwndSource.Handle, NativeWindowMethods.HWND_TOP, 0, 0, 0, 0, 19);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Deactivate()
		{
			_isDeactivated = true;
			_popup.Opened -= OnPopupOpened;
			if (_isOpen)
			{
				OnPopupClosed(_popup, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void AddChildHook(PresentationSource newSource)
		{
			RemoveChildHook(newSource);
			if (newSource is HwndSource hwndSource)
			{
				hwndSource.AddHook(ChildHookProc);
			}
		}

		private void AddOwnerHook(PresentationSource newSource)
		{
			RemoveOwnerHook(newSource);
			if (newSource is HwndSource hwndSource)
			{
				hwndSource.AddHook(OwnerHookProc);
			}
		}

		private object BringToFront(object state)
		{
			if (_isDeactivated)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (state is HwndSource { IsDisposed: false } hwndSource && hwndSource.Handle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				Window window = Window.GetWindow(_popup);
				if (window != null && !Utilities.IsBrowserWindow(window))
				{
					IntPtr intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.GetFocus();
					IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(window).Handle;
					bool flag = false;
					while (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
					{
						if (intPtr == handle || intPtr == hwndSource.Handle)
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.GetParent(intPtr);
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						window.Activate();
					}
				}
				IntPtr hWND_TOP = NativeWindowMethods.HWND_TOP;
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(hwndSource.Handle, hWND_TOP, 0, 0, 0, 0, 19);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IntPtr ChildHookProc(IntPtr hwnd, int msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			switch (msg)
			{
			case 70:
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWPOS wINDOWPOS = (NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWPOS)Marshal.PtrToStructure(lParam, typeof(NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWPOS));
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(_popup.HorizontalOffset, _popup.VerticalOffset);
				if (_popup.Placement == PlacementMode.Relative && _popup.PlacementTarget != null)
				{
					point = _popup.PlacementTarget.PointToScreen(point);
				}
				else
				{
					HwndSource hwndSource = _childSource as HwndSource;
					CompositionTarget compositionTarget = hwndSource?.CompositionTarget;
					point = ((compositionTarget != null) ? hwndSource.CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice : Matrix.Identity).Transform(point);
				}
				NativeWindowMethods.POINT pOINT = new NativeWindowMethods.POINT((int)point.X, (int)point.Y);
				wINDOWPOS.x = pOINT.X;
				wINDOWPOS.y = pOINT.Y;
				Marshal.StructureToPtr((object)wINDOWPOS, lParam, fDeleteOld: true);
				break;
			}
			case 33:
				BringToFront(_childSource);
				break;
			}
			return IntPtr.Zero;
		}

		private void InitializeChildSource(PresentationSource source)
		{
			if (!(source is HwndSource hwndSource))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isTopMost = IsTopMost;
			IntPtr handle = hwndSource.Handle;
			if (handle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				IntPtr windowLong = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(handle, -20);
				IntPtr ptr = windowLong;
				ptr = ((!isTopMost) ? NativeWindowMethods.RemoveBits(ptr, 8) : NativeWindowMethods.AddBits(ptr, 8));
				if (windowLong != ptr)
				{
					IntPtr hWndInsertAfter = (isTopMost ? NativeWindowMethods.HWND_TOPMOST : NativeWindowMethods.HWND_NOTOPMOST);
					NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(handle, hWndInsertAfter, 0, 0, 0, 0, 19);
				}
			}
			AddChildHook(source);
		}

		private void OnChildSourceChanged(object sender, SourceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RemoveChildHook(e.OldSource);
			_childSource = e.NewSource;
			InitializeChildSource(e.NewSource);
		}

		private static void OnOffsetChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((PopupController)d).RefreshPopupLocation();
		}

		private void OnOwnerSourceChanged(object sender, SourceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RemoveOwnerHook(e.OldSource);
			_ownerSource = e.NewSource;
			AddOwnerHook(_ownerSource);
		}

		private void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_isOpen = false;
			_popup.Closed -= OnPopupClosed;
			if (!_isDeactivated)
			{
				_popup.Opened += OnPopupOpened;
			}
			RemoveChildHook(_childSource);
			RemoveOwnerHook(_ownerSource);
			_ownerSource = null;
			_childSource = null;
			PresentationSource.RemoveSourceChangedHandler(_popup, OnOwnerSourceChanged);
			PresentationSource.RemoveSourceChangedHandler(_popupChild, OnChildSourceChanged);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_boundPopupRoot) as FrameworkElement;
			_boundPopupRoot = null;
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				frameworkElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
				frameworkElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
				frameworkElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty);
				frameworkElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
				frameworkElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty);
				frameworkElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty);
			}
		}

		private void OnPopupOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_popup.Opened -= OnPopupOpened;
			if (_popup.Child == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_isOpen = true;
			_popup.Closed += OnPopupClosed;
			_ownerSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual(_owner ?? _popup);
			_childSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual(_popup.Child) as HwndSource;
			InitializeChildSource(_childSource);
			AddOwnerHook(_ownerSource);
			PresentationSource.AddSourceChangedHandler(_popup, OnOwnerSourceChanged);
			_popupChild = _popup.Child;
			PresentationSource.AddSourceChangedHandler(_popupChild, OnChildSourceChanged);
			if (_childSource != null && BindPopupRootExtents)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _childSource.RootVisual as FrameworkElement;
				_boundPopupRoot = ((frameworkElement != null) ? new WeakReference(frameworkElement) : null);
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					frameworkElement.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _popup));
					frameworkElement.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _popup));
					frameworkElement.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _popup));
					frameworkElement.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _popup));
					frameworkElement.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _popup));
					frameworkElement.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _popup));
				}
			}
			RefreshPopupLocation();
			BringToFront(_childSource);
		}

		private IntPtr OwnerHookProc(IntPtr hwnd, int msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			switch (msg)
			{
			case 71:
			{
				IToolWindowHost host = ToolWindowHostPopup.GetHost(_popup);
				if (host != null && (((NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWPOS)Marshal.PtrToStructure(lParam, typeof(NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWPOS))).flags & 3) != 3)
				{
					host.RelativePositionStateChanged();
				}
				break;
			}
			case 126:
				((IToolWindowHost)ToolWindowHostPopup.GetHost(_popup))?.EnsureOnScreen(fullyInView: true);
				break;
			}
			return IntPtr.Zero;
		}

		private void RefreshPopupLocation()
		{
			if (!_isDeactivated && _childSource is HwndSource { IsDisposed: false, CompositionTarget: not null } hwndSource && hwndSource.Handle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				Matrix transformToDevice = hwndSource.CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice;
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(_popup.HorizontalOffset, _popup.VerticalOffset);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = transformToDevice.Transform(point);
				int flags = 533;
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(hwndSource.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, (int)point2.X, (int)point2.Y, 0, 0, flags);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveChildHook(PresentationSource oldSource)
		{
			if (oldSource is HwndSource hwndSource)
			{
				hwndSource.RemoveHook(ChildHookProc);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveOwnerHook(PresentationSource oldSource)
		{
			if (oldSource is HwndSource hwndSource)
			{
				hwndSource.RemoveHook(OwnerHookProc);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ToolWindowHostWindow : Window, IToolWindowHost
	{
		private class WindowPositionToRectConverter : IMultiValueConverter
		{
			private static readonly IMultiValueConverter instance;

			public static IMultiValueConverter Instance => instance;

			private WindowPositionToRectConverter()
			{
			}

			static WindowPositionToRectConverter()
			{
				instance = new WindowPositionToRectConverter();
			}

			object IMultiValueConverter.Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				double num = (double)values[0];
				double num2 = (double)values[1];
				double num3 = (double)values[2];
				double num4 = (double)values[3];
				if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num2) || double.IsNaN(num3) || double.IsNaN(num4))
				{
					return Rect.Empty;
				}
				return new Rect(num, num2, num3, num4);
			}

			object[] IMultiValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return new object[1] { System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing };
			}
		}

		internal class DeferShowHelper : ToolWindow.IDeferShow
		{
			private ToolWindowHostWindow _window;

			internal DeferShowHelper(ToolWindowHostWindow window)
			{
				_window = window;
			}

			public void Show(bool activate)
			{
				using (new TempValueReplacement(_window, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox))
				{
					_window.Show(activate);
				}
			}

			public void Cancel()
			{
				_window.Close();
			}
		}

		private class CoerceProxy
		{
			private CoerceValueCallback _baseCallback;

			internal CoerceProxy(CoerceValueCallback baseCallback)
			{
				_baseCallback = baseCallback;
			}

			public virtual object CoerceValue(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
			{
				if (_baseCallback != null)
				{
					return _baseCallback(d, baseValue);
				}
				return baseValue;
			}
		}

		private class TopLeftCoerceProxy : CoerceProxy
		{
			private DependencyProperty _property;

			internal TopLeftCoerceProxy(DependencyProperty property, CoerceValueCallback baseCallback)
				: base(baseCallback)
			{
				_property = property;
			}

			public override object CoerceValue(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
			{
				if (!CoreUtilities.Antirecursion.Enter(d, _property, disallowMultipleEntries: true))
				{
					return baseValue;
				}
				try
				{
					if (d is ToolWindowHostWindow { WindowState: not WindowState.Normal } toolWindowHostWindow)
					{
						if (NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(toolWindowHostWindow) == WindowState.Normal)
						{
							return baseValue;
						}
						WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(toolWindowHostWindow);
						IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
						if (handle != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWPLACEMENT lpwndpl = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowPlacement(handle);
							object result = base.CoerceValue(d, baseValue);
							if (!lpwndpl.Equals(NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowPlacement(handle)))
							{
								NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPlacement(handle, ref lpwndpl);
							}
							return result;
						}
					}
					return base.CoerceValue(d, baseValue);
				}
				finally
				{
					CoreUtilities.Antirecursion.Exit(d, _property);
				}
			}
		}

			TrackWmMoving = 0x40,
			IsMovingWindow = 0x80,
			IsInMoveSize = 0x100,
			IsChangingWindowState = 0x200,
			IsUpdatingClientWidthFromNonClient = 0x400,
			IsUpdatingClientHeightFromNonClient = 0x800,
			IsClosing = 0x1000,
			HasSourceBeenInitialized = 0x2000,
			IsChangingVisibility = 0x4000,
			HasPendingLocationChanged = 0x8000
		}

		private class HookTrace
		{
			private static readonly TraceSource _HookTraceSource;

			private static bool _isHookTraceSourceEnabled;

			static HookTrace()
			{
				_HookTraceSource = new TraceSource("Infragistics.ToolWindowHook");
				_isHookTraceSourceEnabled = _HookTraceSource.Switch.ShouldTrace(TraceEventType.Information);
			}

			[Conditional("TRACE_HOOKPROC")]
			internal static void Log(bool shouldLog, ToolWindowHostWindow window, string message, bool includeStackTrace)
			{
			}

			[Conditional("TRACE_HOOKPROC")]
			internal static void Log(ToolWindowHostWindow window, string message, params object[] messageParams)
			{
			}

			[Conditional("TRACE_HOOKPROC")]
			internal static void Log(ToolWindowHostWindow window, string message, bool includeStackTrace, params object[] messageParams)
			{
				if (_isHookTraceSourceEnabled)
				{
					ToolWindow content = window._content;
					object obj = content?.Content;
					string text = ((obj != null) ? $"Type={obj.GetType().Name}, Hash={obj.GetHashCode()}, ToString='{obj}'" : "{None}");
					if (messageParams != null)
					{
						message = string.Format(message, messageParams);
					}
					_HookTraceSource.TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, 0, "[{0}] {1} ToolWindow={2}, TW.Hash={3}, TW.Content='{4}', Hook={5}, Stack={6}", window.GetHashCode(), message, content, (content != null) ? content.GetHashCode().ToString() : "", text, window._hook, includeStackTrace ? Environment.StackTrace : "");
				}
			}
		}

		private class NonClientSizeConverter : IValueConverter
		{
			private ToolWindowHostWindow _window;

			private bool _isWidth;

			private bool _addOnConvert;

			internal NonClientSizeConverter(ToolWindowHostWindow window, bool isWidth, bool addOnConvert)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(window);
				_window = window;
				_isWidth = isWidth;
				_addOnConvert = addOnConvert;
			}

			private object ConvertHelper(object value, bool addClientSize)
			{
				if (value is double && _window.UseSystemNonClientArea)
				{
					double num = (double)value;
					if (!double.IsInfinity(num))
					{
						double width = 0.0;
						double height = 0.0;
						_window.UpdateForClientSize(addNonClient: true, ref width, ref height);
						double num2 = (_isWidth ? width : height);
						value = (addClientSize ? ((object)(num + num2)) : ((!CoreUtilities.LessThanOrClose(num, num2)) ? ((object)(num - num2)) : KnownBoxes.DoubleZeroBox));
					}
				}
				return value;
			}

			public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return ConvertHelper(value, _addOnConvert);
			}

			public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return ConvertHelper(value, !_addOnConvert);
			}
		}

		static ToolWindowHostWindow()
		{
			VisibilityInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VisibilityInternal", typeof(Visibility), typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Visibility.Collapsed, OnVisibilityInternalChanged));
			WindowStateInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("WindowStateInternal", typeof(WindowState), typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(WindowState.Normal, OnWindowStateInternalChanged));
			AllowCloseProperty = ToolWindow.AllowCloseProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnAllowCloseChanged));
			ClientHeightProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ClientHeight", typeof(double), typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, OnClientHeightChanged));
			ClientWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ClientWidth", typeof(double), typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, OnClientWidthChanged));
			InternalLeftProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("InternalLeft", typeof(double), typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, OnInternalLeftTopChanged));
			InternalTopProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("InternalTop", typeof(double), typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, OnInternalLeftTopChanged));
			OwnerRectProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OwnerRect", typeof(Rect), typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Rect), OnOwnerRectChanged));
			UseSystemNonClientAreaProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UseSystemNonClientArea", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, OnUseSystemNonClientAreaChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow)));
			Window.WindowStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(WindowStyle.None));
			Window.ShowInTaskbarProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceMaxWidth));
			FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceMaxHeight));
			FrameworkElement.WidthProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnWidthChanged));
			FrameworkElement.HeightProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnHeightChanged));
			ToolWindow.AllowMinimizeProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnAllowMinMaxChanged));
			ToolWindow.AllowMaximizeProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnAllowMinMaxChanged));
			if (Environment.Version.Major <= 3)
			{
				Window.TopProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, new TopLeftCoerceProxy(Window.TopProperty, Window.TopProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow)).CoerceValueCallback).CoerceValue));
				Window.LeftProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, new TopLeftCoerceProxy(Window.LeftProperty, Window.LeftProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow)).CoerceValueCallback).CoerceValue));
			}
			Window.SizeToContentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnSizeToContentChanged, CoerceSizeToContent));
			Window.WindowStateProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnWindowStateChanged));
			UIElement.VisibilityProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisibilityChanged));
			FrameworkElementFactory visualTree = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(ContentPresenter));
			ControlTemplate controlTemplate = new ControlTemplate(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow));
			controlTemplate.VisualTree = visualTree;
			controlTemplate.Seal();
			System.Windows.Controls.Control.TemplateProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowHostWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(controlTemplate));
		}

		internal ToolWindowHostWindow()
		{
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.UseSystemNonClientArea, (bool)GetValue(UseSystemNonClientAreaProperty));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			if (UseSystemNonClientArea)
			{
				UpdateClientSizeFromNonClientSize(!double.IsNaN(ClientWidth), !double.IsNaN(ClientHeight), arrangeBounds.Width, arrangeBounds.Height);
				return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			}
			if (!UseSystemNonClientArea && VisualChildrenCount > 0)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = GetVisualChild(0) as FrameworkElement;
				frameworkElement.Arrange(new Rect(arrangeBounds));
				if (base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					frameworkElement.LayoutTransform = new MatrixTransform(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, arrangeBounds.Width, 0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					frameworkElement.LayoutTransform = null;
				}
			}
			return arrangeBounds;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (UseSystemNonClientArea)
			{
				UpdateClientSizeFromNonClientSize(!double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) && !double.IsNaN(ClientWidth), !double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) && !double.IsNaN(ClientHeight), availableSize.Width, availableSize.Height);
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			if (VisualChildrenCount > 0 && GetVisualChild(0) is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				uIElement.Measure(availableSize);
				return uIElement.DesiredSize;
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		protected override void OnActivated(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_content != null)
			{
				_content.SetValue(ToolWindow.IsActivePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			base.OnActivated(e);
		}

		protected override void OnClosing(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnClosing(e);
			if (_content != null)
			{
				CacheRestoreBounds();
				_content.OnClosingInternal(e);
			}
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
				if (windowInteropHelper.Handle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowLong(windowInteropHelper.Handle, -8, IntPtr.Zero);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClosed(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnClosed(e);
			OnClosedImpl(clearDeferredShow: false);
		}

		private void OnClosedImpl(bool clearDeferredShow)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			if (_content != null)
			{
				ToolWindow content = _content;
				base.Content = null;
				content.OnClosedInternal(clearDeferredShow);
			}
			ReleaseActivationHook();
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			base.OnContentChanged(oldContent, newContent);
			bool flag = GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsInOnContentChanged);
			try
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsInOnContentChanged, set: true);
				OnContentChangedImpl(oldContent, newContent);
			}
			finally
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsInOnContentChanged, flag);
			}
			if (_content != null && _content.WindowState == WindowState.Normal)
			{
				SynchronizeLocation(updateFromTopLeft: false);
				UpdateNonClientSizeFromClientSize(updateWidth: true, updateHeight: true);
			}
		}

		private void OnContentChangedImpl(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			if (_content != null)
			{
				_content.ClearValue(ToolWindow.HostProperty);
				_content.ClearValue(ToolWindow.IsActivePropertyKey);
				_content.ClearValue(ToolWindow.IsInSizeMoveProperty);
			}
			ToolWindow toolWindow = (_content = newContent as ToolWindow);
			if (toolWindow != null)
			{
				toolWindow.SetValue(ToolWindow.HostProperty, this);
				toolWindow.SetValue(ToolWindow.IsActivePropertyKey, base.IsActive ? KnownBoxes.TrueBox : DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
				SetBinding(InternalLeftProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.LeftProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(InternalTopProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.TopProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(UseSystemNonClientAreaProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.IsUsingOSNonClientAreaProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow, new NonClientSizeConverter(this, isWidth: true, addOnConvert: true)));
				SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow, new NonClientSizeConverter(this, isWidth: false, addOnConvert: true)));
				SetBinding(FrameworkElement.FlowDirectionProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.FlowDirectionProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(VisibilityInternalProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(Window.TopmostProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.TopmostProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(Window.ResizeModeProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.ResizeModeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(AllowCloseProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.AllowCloseProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(Window.ShowInTaskbarProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.ShowInTaskbarProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(ToolWindow.AllowMaximizeProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.AllowMaximizeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(ToolWindow.AllowMinimizeProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.AllowMinimizeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolWindow));
				if (new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					SetBinding(WindowStateInternalProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.WindowStateProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, toolWindow));
				}
				FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(this, toolWindow);
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, InternalLeftProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, InternalTopProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, ClientWidthProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, ClientHeightProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.FlowDirectionProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, UseSystemNonClientAreaProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, Window.TopmostProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, Window.ResizeModeProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, AllowCloseProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, Window.ShowInTaskbarProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, ToolWindow.AllowMaximizeProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, ToolWindow.AllowMinimizeProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, WindowStateInternalProperty);
				FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(this, null);
			}
			VerifyTitleBinding();
			VerifyWindowStyle();
			if (toolWindow != null)
			{
				SetBinding(ClientWidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, toolWindow));
				SetBinding(ClientHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, toolWindow));
			}
			VerifyRelativePositionBinding();
			if (toolWindow == null)
			{
				ReleaseActivationHook();
			}
			if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.TrackWmMoving))
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.ReleaseCapture();
			}
			if (toolWindow != null && _content == toolWindow)
			{
				_content.IsInSizeMove = GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsInMoveSize);
			}
		}

		private static void OnVisibilityInternalChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = d as ToolWindowHostWindow;
			if (toolWindowHostWindow._content != null)
			{
				Visibility visibility = (Visibility)e.NewValue;
				if (visibility == toolWindowHostWindow.Visibility)
				{
					toolWindowHostWindow._content.Visibility = visibility;
				}
				else
				{
					toolWindowHostWindow.Visibility = visibility;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnWindowStateInternalChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = d as ToolWindowHostWindow;
			if (toolWindowHostWindow._content != null)
			{
				WindowState windowState = (WindowState)e.NewValue;
				if (windowState == toolWindowHostWindow.WindowState)
				{
					toolWindowHostWindow._content.WindowState = windowState;
				}
				else
				{
					((IToolWindowHost)toolWindowHostWindow).SetWindowState(windowState);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDeactivated(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_content != null)
			{
				_content.ClearValue(ToolWindow.IsActivePropertyKey);
			}
			base.OnDeactivated(e);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.System && e.SystemKey == Key.F4 && ModifierKeys.Alt == (e.KeyboardDevice.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Alt) && !AllowClose)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnLocationChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLocationChanged(e);
			OnLocationChangedImpl();
		}

		private void OnLocationChangedImpl()
		{
			if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.UpdatingRelativePosition))
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.HasPendingLocationChanged, set: true);
				return;
			}
			SynchronizeLocation(updateFromTopLeft: true);
			RequestDeferredUpdateRelativePos();
		}

		private void RequestDeferredUpdateRelativePos()
		{
			if (_pendingUpdateRelativePos == null || _pendingUpdateRelativePos.Status == DispatcherOperationStatus.Aborted)
			{
				_pendingUpdateRelativePos = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, (ToolWindow.MethodInvoker)delegate
				{
					UpdateRelativePosition();
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == Window.ResizeModeProperty)
			{
				VerifyWindowStyle();
			}
			else if (e.Property == Window.ShowInTaskbarProperty || e.Property == Window.IconProperty)
			{
				UpdateIsIconSuppressed(!_isUpdatingIcon);
			}
			else if (e.Property != Window.TopProperty)
			{
				_ = e.Property;
				_ = Window.LeftProperty;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnStateChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			CacheRestoreBounds();
			CoerceValue(Window.SizeToContentProperty);
			base.OnStateChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnSourceInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.HasSourceBeenInitialized, set: true);
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
			IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
			UpdateIsIconSuppressed(_isIconSuppressed);
			HwndSource hwndSource = HwndSource.FromHwnd(handle);
			hwndSource.AddHook(WndProc);
			PresentationSource.AddSourceChangedHandler(this, OnPresentationSourceChanged);
			if (_content != null)
			{
				SetBinding(WindowStateInternalProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolWindow.WindowStateProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, _content));
				if (_content != null && base.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
				{
					Rect restoreBounds = _content.GetRestoreBounds(queryHost: false);
					if (NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(this) == WindowState.Normal && base.WindowState == WindowState.Minimized && !restoreBounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, new SendOrPostCallback(AsyncInitializeRestoreBounds), restoreBounds);
					}
					else
					{
						SetRestoreBounds(handle, restoreBounds);
					}
				}
				UseSystemNonClientArea = UseSystemNonClientArea;
			}
			VerifyWindowStyleBits(handle);
			UpdateAllowClose(this, AllowClose);
			VerifyRelativePositionBinding();
			SynchronizeLocation(updateFromTopLeft: true);
			base.OnSourceInitialized(e);
			VerifyIsInView(force: false, async: true, ensureFullyInView: false);
			UpdateRelativePosition(force: true);
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			if (sizeInfo.PreviousSize != sizeInfo.NewSize)
			{
				UpdateRelativePosition();
			}
		}

		private static void OnAllowCloseChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow window = (ToolWindowHostWindow)d;
			UpdateAllowClose(window, true.Equals(e.NewValue));
		}

		private static void OnClientHeightChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((ToolWindowHostWindow)d).UpdateNonClientSizeFromClientSize(updateWidth: false, updateHeight: true))
			{
				d.InvalidateProperty(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
			}
		}

		private static void OnClientWidthChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((ToolWindowHostWindow)d).UpdateNonClientSizeFromClientSize(updateWidth: true, updateHeight: false))
			{
				d.InvalidateProperty(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
			}
		}

		private static void OnOwnerRectChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = (ToolWindowHostWindow)d;
			toolWindowHostWindow.UpdateRelativePosition();
		}

		private static void OnUseSystemNonClientAreaChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = (ToolWindowHostWindow)d;
			toolWindowHostWindow.SetFlag(InternalFlags.UseSystemNonClientArea, (bool)e.NewValue);
			if (toolWindowHostWindow._content == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(toolWindowHostWindow);
			IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
			if (handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				toolWindowHostWindow.VerifyWindowStyle();
				return;
			}
			toolWindowHostWindow.CoerceValue(Window.SizeToContentProperty);
			toolWindowHostWindow.VerifyWindowStyle();
			if (toolWindowHostWindow._content != null && toolWindowHostWindow._content.Host == toolWindowHostWindow)
			{
				toolWindowHostWindow._content.CalculateMinMaxExtents(async: false);
			}
			toolWindowHostWindow.UpdateNonClientSizeFromClientSize(updateWidth: true, updateHeight: true);
			if (handle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(handle, IntPtr.Zero, 0, 0, 0, 0, 567);
			}
		}

		internal System.Windows.Size AddNonClientSize(System.Windows.Size clientSize)
		{
			double width = clientSize.Width;
			double height = clientSize.Height;
			UpdateForClientSize(addNonClient: true, ref width, ref height);
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
		}

		internal static bool AreClose(double value1, double value2, double threshold = 1E-10)
		{
			if (value1 == value2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(value1) && double.IsNaN(value2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Math.Abs(value1 - value2) < threshold;
		}

		internal void BringToFront()
		{
			IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
			if (IntPtr.Zero != handle)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(handle, IntPtr.Zero, 0, 0, 0, 0, 19);
			}
		}

		internal static ToolWindow FromRootVisual(Visual rootVisual)
		{
			ToolWindow result = null;
			if (rootVisual != null)
			{
				if (rootVisual is ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow)
				{
					result = toolWindowHostWindow.Content as ToolWindow;
				}
				else
				{
					Popup popup = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(rootVisual) as Popup;
					ToolWindowHostPopup host = ToolWindowHostPopup.GetHost(popup);
					if (host != null)
					{
						result = host.Child as ToolWindow;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static void GetToolWindows(Window window, FrameworkElement owner, List<ToolWindow> list, out int ownerWindowIndex)
		{
			IntPtr parent = IntPtr.Zero;
			if (window != null)
			{
				parent = new WindowInteropHelper(window).Handle;
			}
			else
			{
				IntPtr ownerHwnd = ToolWindow.GetOwnerHwnd(owner);
				if (ownerHwnd != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					parent = NativeWindowMethods.GetAncestorApi(ownerHwnd, 2);
				}
			}
			int windowIndex = list.Count;
			if (IntPtr.Zero != parent)
			{
				Dictionary<IntPtr, HwndSource> sources = new Dictionary<IntPtr, HwndSource>();
				foreach (PresentationSource currentSource in PresentationSource.CurrentSources)
				{
					if (currentSource is HwndSource { IsDisposed: false, Handle: var handle } hwndSource && !(handle == IntPtr.Zero))
					{
						sources[handle] = hwndSource;
					}
				}
				NativeWindowMethods.EnumWindowsProc childCallback = delegate(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr lParam)
				{
					GetToolWindows(owner, list, sources, hwnd);
					return true;
				};
				NativeWindowMethods.EnumWindowsProc lpfn = delegate(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr lParam)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, childCallback, IntPtr.Zero);
					GetToolWindows(owner, list, sources, hwnd);
					if (hwnd == parent)
					{
						windowIndex = list.Count;
					}
					return true;
				};
				NativeWindowMethods.EnumThreadWindows(NativeWindowMethods.GetCurrentThreadIdApi(), lpfn, IntPtr.Zero);
			}
			ownerWindowIndex = windowIndex;
		}

		private static void GetToolWindows(FrameworkElement owner, List<ToolWindow> list, Dictionary<IntPtr, HwndSource> sources, IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			if (sources.TryGetValue(hwnd, out var value) && !value.IsDisposed)
			{
				ToolWindow toolWindow = FromRootVisual(value.RootVisual);
				if (toolWindow != null && toolWindow.Owner == owner)
				{
					list.Add(toolWindow);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Show(bool activate)
		{
			VerifyWindowStyle();
			if (!activate)
			{
				InstallActivationHook();
			}
			try
			{
				Show();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				ReleaseActivationHook();
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void AsyncInitializeRestoreBounds(object restoreBounds)
		{
			Rect restoreBounds2 = (Rect)restoreBounds;
			IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
			if (NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(handle) != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				base.SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Manual;
				SetRestoreBounds(handle, restoreBounds2);
			}
		}

		private void CacheRestoreBounds()
		{
			if (_content == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				Rect restoreBounds = base.RestoreBounds;
				if (!restoreBounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					_content.SetRestoreBounds(restoreBounds, updateHost: false);
					WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
					if (windowInteropHelper.Handle != IntPtr.Zero)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWPLACEMENT windowPlacement = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowPlacement(windowInteropHelper.Handle);
						_content.RestoreToMaximized = (windowPlacement.flags & 2) == 2;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(this) == WindowState.Normal)
			{
				_content.RestoreToMaximized = false;
			}
		}

		private void CloseHelper()
		{
			bool flag = GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsClosing);
			if (flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsClosing, set: true);
			try
			{
				CloseHelperImpl();
			}
			finally
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsClosing, flag);
			}
		}

		private void CancelPendingCloseRequest()
		{
			if (_pendingCloseRequest != null)
			{
				DispatcherOperation pendingCloseRequest = _pendingCloseRequest;
				_pendingCloseRequest = null;
				if (pendingCloseRequest.Status == DispatcherOperationStatus.Pending)
				{
					pendingCloseRequest.Abort();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CloseHelperImpl()
		{
			if (IsInWndProc)
			{
				if (!HasPendingCloseRequest)
				{
					_pendingCloseRequest = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
					{
						_pendingCloseRequest = null;
						CloseHelper();
					});
				}
				return;
			}
			CancelPendingCloseRequest();
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
			IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
			HwndSource hwndSource = ((IntPtr.Zero != handle) ? HwndSource.FromHwnd(handle) : null);
			if (hwndSource == null || hwndSource.RootVisual != null)
			{
				Close();
			}
			ReleaseActivationHook();
		}

		private static object CoerceMaxWidth(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = (ToolWindowHostWindow)d;
			double width = (double)newValue;
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(width) || !toolWindowHostWindow.UseSystemNonClientArea)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			double height = double.NaN;
			toolWindowHostWindow.UpdateForClientSize(addNonClient: true, ref width, ref height);
			return width;
		}

		private static object CoerceMaxHeight(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = (ToolWindowHostWindow)d;
			double height = (double)newValue;
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(height) || !toolWindowHostWindow.UseSystemNonClientArea)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			double width = double.NaN;
			toolWindowHostWindow.UpdateForClientSize(addNonClient: true, ref width, ref height);
			return height;
		}

		private static object CoerceSizeToContent(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow window = d as ToolWindowHostWindow;
			if (NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(window) != WindowState.Normal && !SizeToContent.Manual.Equals(baseValue))
			{
				return SizeToContent.Manual;
			}
			return baseValue;
		}

		private NativeWindowMethods.POINT ConvertFromLogicalPixels(double x, double y)
		{
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
			IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
			System.Windows.Point point = ((IntPtr.Zero != handle) ? HwndSource.FromHwnd(handle) : null)?.CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice.Transform(new System.Windows.Point(x, y)) ?? new System.Windows.Point(Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(x), Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(y));
			return new NativeWindowMethods.POINT((int)Math.Round(point.X, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero), (int)Math.Round(point.Y, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero));
		}

		private System.Windows.Point ConvertToLogicalPixels(int x, int y)
		{
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
			IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
			return ((IntPtr.Zero != handle) ? HwndSource.FromHwnd(handle) : null)?.CompositionTarget.TransformFromDevice.Transform(new System.Windows.Point(x, y)) ?? new System.Windows.Point(Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(x), Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(y));
		}

		private bool GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return (_flags & flag) != 0;
		}

		private IntPtr HookProc(int nCode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam)
		{
			if (nCode == 5)
			{
				Window window = Window.GetWindow(this);
				WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = ((window != null) ? new WindowInteropHelper(window) : null);
				if (windowInteropHelper != null && windowInteropHelper.Handle == wParam)
				{
					ReleaseActivationHook();
					return new IntPtr(1);
				}
			}
			return NativeWindowMethods.CallNextHookEx(_hook, nCode, wParam, lParam);
		}

		private void InstallActivationHook()
		{
			if (_hook != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				ReleaseActivationHook();
			}
			if (_hookCallback == null)
			{
				_hookCallback = HookProc;
			}
			_hook = NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowsHookEx(5, _hookCallback, IntPtr.Zero, NativeWindowMethods.GetCurrentThreadIdApi());
		}

		}

			((ToolWindowHostWindow)d).UpdateClientSizeFromNonClientSize(updateWidth: false, updateHeight: true);
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RequestDeferredUpdateRelativePos();
		}

		private void OnAfterWindowStateChanged(WindowState newState)
		{
			if (!GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingWindowState) && newState == base.WindowState && newState == WindowState.Normal && _content != null && _content.WindowState == newState)
			{
				UpdateClientSizeFromNonClientSize(!double.IsNaN(_content.Width), !double.IsNaN(_content.Height));
			}
		}

		private static void OnAllowMinMaxChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = d as ToolWindowHostWindow;
			System.Windows.Size size = toolWindowHostWindow.AddNonClientSize(new System.Windows.Size(100.0, 100.0));
			toolWindowHostWindow.VerifyWindowStyle();
			toolWindowHostWindow.UpdateNonClientSizeFromClientSize(updateWidth: true, updateHeight: true);
			if (toolWindowHostWindow.SizeToContent == SizeToContent.Manual || !toolWindowHostWindow.UseSystemNonClientArea)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Size size2 = toolWindowHostWindow.AddNonClientSize(new System.Windows.Size(100.0, 100.0));
			if (size2 != size)
			{
				bool flag = toolWindowHostWindow.GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsForcingSizeToContent);
				toolWindowHostWindow.SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsForcingSizeToContent, set: true);
				try
				{
					SizeToContent sizeToContent = toolWindowHostWindow.SizeToContent;
					toolWindowHostWindow.SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Manual;
					toolWindowHostWindow.SizeToContent = sizeToContent;
				}
				finally
				{
					toolWindowHostWindow.SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsForcingSizeToContent, flag);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnPresentationSourceChanged(object sender, SourceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PresentationSource newSource = e.NewSource;
			if (newSource == null)
			{
				PresentationSource.RemoveSourceChangedHandler(this, OnPresentationSourceChanged);
				if (!GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsClosing))
				{
					OnClosedImpl(clearDeferredShow: true);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		}

		private static void OnVisibilityChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = d as ToolWindowHostWindow;
			bool flag = toolWindowHostWindow.GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingVisibility);
			if (!flag)
			{
				toolWindowHostWindow.SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingVisibility, set: true);
				try
				{
					ToolWindow content = toolWindowHostWindow._content;
					if (content != null)
					{
						content.Visibility = (Visibility)e.NewValue;
					}
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					toolWindowHostWindow.SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingVisibility, flag);
				}
			}
			if (Visibility.Collapsed.Equals(e.NewValue) && toolWindowHostWindow.GetFlag(InternalFlags.HasSourceBeenInitialized) && PresentationSource.FromVisual(toolWindowHostWindow) == null)
			{
				toolWindowHostWindow.OnClosedImpl(clearDeferredShow: true);
			}
		}

		private static void OnWindowStateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowHostWindow toolWindowHostWindow = d as ToolWindowHostWindow;
			bool flag = toolWindowHostWindow.GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingWindowState);
			toolWindowHostWindow.SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingWindowState, set: true);
			if (!flag)
			{
				toolWindowHostWindow._previousWindowState = (WindowState)e.OldValue;
			}
			try
			{
				toolWindowHostWindow.SetValue(WindowStateInternalProperty, e.NewValue);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					toolWindowHostWindow._previousWindowState = null;
				}
				toolWindowHostWindow.SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingWindowState, flag);
			}
			toolWindowHostWindow.OnAfterWindowStateChanged((WindowState)e.NewValue);
			if (WindowState.Normal.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				toolWindowHostWindow.VerifyIsInView(force: false, async: true, ensureFullyInView: false);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG_DPI")]
		private void OutputDpiInfo(object value, string category = null)
		{
			if (_content != null && "DropPreview".Equals(_content.Tag))
			{
				IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
				Matrix deviceMatrix = Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: true, this);
				string text = string.Format("[{0}-{1}:{2}] DPI:{3}", handle, GetHashCode(), DateTime.Now.ToString("hh:mm:ss:ffffff"), deviceMatrix);
				if (handle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWINFO windowInfo = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowInfo(handle);
					text += $" HwndRect: {windowInfo.rcWindow.left},{windowInfo.rcWindow.top} {windowInfo.rcWindow.Width},{windowInfo.rcWindow.Height}";
				}
				text += $" Dpi: {deviceMatrix.M11}x{deviceMatrix.M22}";
				text += $" Props: {base.Left},{base.Top} {base.ActualWidth},{base.ActualHeight}";
				text += $" PropsFromDevice: {base.Left / deviceMatrix.M11},{base.Top / deviceMatrix.M11} {base.ActualWidth / deviceMatrix.M11},{base.ActualHeight / deviceMatrix.M11}";
				value = string.Concat(value, " ", Environment.StackTrace.Replace("\r\n", "\\r\\n"));
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseActivationHook()
		{
			if (IntPtr.Zero != _hook)
			{
				IntPtr hook = _hook;
				_hook = IntPtr.Zero;
				NativeWindowMethods.UnhookWindowsHookEx(hook);
			}
		}

		private void SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool set)
		{
			if (set)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= ~flag;
			}
		}

		private void SetRestoreBounds(IntPtr hwnd, Rect restoreBounds)
		{
			if (hwnd != IntPtr.Zero && !restoreBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWPLACEMENT lpwndpl = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowPlacement(hwnd);
				NativeWindowMethods.POINT pOINT = ConvertFromLogicalPixels(restoreBounds.Left, restoreBounds.Top);
				NativeWindowMethods.POINT pOINT2 = ConvertFromLogicalPixels(restoreBounds.Right, restoreBounds.Bottom);
				lpwndpl.rcNormalPosition = new NativeWindowMethods.RECT(pOINT.X, pOINT.Y, pOINT2.X, pOINT2.Y);
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPlacement(hwnd, ref lpwndpl);
			}
		}

		private void SetRestoreToMaximize(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			if (!(hwnd != IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				return;
			}
			NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWPLACEMENT lpwndpl = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowPlacement(hwnd);
			if (_content != null && lpwndpl.showCmd == 2 && base.WindowState == WindowState.Minimized)
			{
				int flags = lpwndpl.flags;
				if (_content.RestoreToMaximized)
				{
					lpwndpl.flags |= 2;
				}
				else
				{
					lpwndpl.flags &= -3;
				}
				if (lpwndpl.flags != flags)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPlacement(hwnd, ref lpwndpl);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShowContentContextMenu(IntPtr hwnd, System.Windows.Point? location)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (_content != null && location.HasValue)
			{
				GeneralTransform generalTransform = TransformToDescendant(_content);
				if (generalTransform != null)
				{
					location = generalTransform.Transform(location.Value);
					flag = _content.ShowSystemContextMenu(location.Value);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				IntPtr systemMenuApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetSystemMenuApi(hwnd, revert: false);
				if (_content == null || !_content.AllowMaximize)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.EnableMenuItem(systemMenuApi, 61488, 1);
				}
				else
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.EnableMenuItem(systemMenuApi, 61488, 0);
				}
				if (_content == null || !_content.AllowMinimize)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.EnableMenuItem(systemMenuApi, 61472, 1);
				}
				else
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.EnableMenuItem(systemMenuApi, 61472, 0);
				}
				if (_content == null || NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(hwnd) == WindowState.Normal)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.EnableMenuItem(systemMenuApi, 61728, 1);
				}
				else
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.EnableMenuItem(systemMenuApi, 61728, 0);
				}
				if (_content != null && _content.IsModal)
				{
					if (_content == null || _content.ResizeMode == ResizeMode.NoResize || _content.ResizeMode == ResizeMode.CanMinimize)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.EnableMenuItem(systemMenuApi, 61440, 1);
					}
					else
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.EnableMenuItem(systemMenuApi, 61440, 0);
					}
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void SynchronizeLocation(bool updateFromTopLeft)
		{
			if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsSynchronizingLocation) || GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsInOnContentChanged) || NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(this) != WindowState.Normal || _content == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsSynchronizingLocation, set: true);
			try
			{
				IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
				double num = base.Top;
				double num2 = base.Left;
				if (IntPtr.Zero != handle)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWINFO windowInfo = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowInfo(handle);
					System.Windows.Point point = ConvertToLogicalPixels(windowInfo.rcWindow.left, windowInfo.rcWindow.top);
					num = point.Y;
					num2 = point.X;
				}
				if (updateFromTopLeft)
				{
					InternalLeft = num2;
					InternalTop = num;
					return;
				}
				if (!InternalTop.Equals(num))
				{
					base.Top = InternalTop;
				}
				if (!InternalLeft.Equals(num2))
				{
					base.Left = InternalLeft;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsSynchronizingLocation, set: false);
			}
		}

		private bool TryGetMonitorFromRestoreBounds(IntPtr hwnd, out IntPtr hMonitor)
		{
			hMonitor = IntPtr.Zero;
			if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingWindowState) && !UseSystemNonClientArea)
			{
				WindowState? previousWindowState = _previousWindowState;
				WindowState windowState = WindowState.Minimized;
				if (previousWindowState.GetValueOrDefault() == windowState && previousWindowState.HasValue && !base.ShowInTaskbar && base.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized && NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(hwnd) == WindowState.Maximized && !_content.GetRestoreBounds().IsEmpty)
				{
					Rect restoreBounds = _content.GetRestoreBounds();
					NativeWindowMethods.POINT pOINT = ConvertFromLogicalPixels(restoreBounds.Left, restoreBounds.Top);
					NativeWindowMethods.POINT pOINT2 = ConvertFromLogicalPixels(restoreBounds.Right, restoreBounds.Bottom);
					NativeWindowMethods.RECT rECT = new NativeWindowMethods.RECT(pOINT.X, pOINT.Y, pOINT2.X, pOINT2.Y);
					hMonitor = NativeWindowMethods.MonitorFromPoint(new NativeWindowMethods.POINT(rECT.left + rECT.Width / 2, rECT.top + rECT.Height / 2), 2);
				}
			}
			return hMonitor != IntPtr.Zero;
		}

		private static void UpdateAllowClose(Window window, bool allowClose)
		{
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(window);
			IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
			if (IntPtr.Zero != handle)
			{
				IntPtr systemMenuApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetSystemMenuApi(handle, revert: false);
				if (IntPtr.Zero != systemMenuApi)
				{
					int num = 0;
					num = ((!allowClose) ? (num | 1) : (num & -2));
					NativeWindowMethods.EnableMenuItem(systemMenuApi, 61536, num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateClientSizeFromNonClientSize(bool updateWidth, bool updateHeight)
		{
			bool flag = GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingClientWidthFromNonClient);
			bool flag2 = GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingClientHeightFromNonClient);
			try
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingClientWidthFromNonClient, flag || updateWidth);
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingClientHeightFromNonClient, flag2 || updateHeight);
				UpdateClientSizeFromNonClientSizeImpl(updateWidth, updateHeight);
			}
			finally
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingClientWidthFromNonClient, flag);
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingClientHeightFromNonClient, flag2);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateClientSizeFromNonClientSizeImpl(bool updateWidth, bool updateHeight)
		{
			if (!GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsInOnContentChanged) && !GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsClosing))
			{
				double width = base.Width;
				double height = base.Height;
				if (updateWidth && (base.SizeToContent & SizeToContent.Width) == SizeToContent.Width)
				{
					width = double.NaN;
				}
				if (updateHeight && (base.SizeToContent & SizeToContent.Height) == SizeToContent.Height)
				{
					height = double.NaN;
				}
				if (base.WindowState == WindowState.Normal && NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(this) == base.WindowState)
				{
					UpdateClientSizeFromNonClientSize(updateWidth, updateHeight, width, height);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateClientSizeFromNonClientSize(bool updateWidth, bool updateHeight, double width, double height)
		{
			if ((_content == null || !_content.IsCalculatingSizeWithoutContent) && !GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingWindowState))
			{
				UpdateForClientSize(addNonClient: false, ref width, ref height);
				if (updateHeight && !AreClose(height, ClientHeight))
				{
					ClientHeight = (double.IsNaN(height) ? height : Math.Max(height, 0.0));
				}
				if (updateWidth && !AreClose(width, ClientWidth))
				{
					ClientWidth = (double.IsNaN(width) ? width : Math.Max(width, 0.0));
				}
			}
		}

		private bool UpdateForClientSize(bool addNonClient, ref double width, ref double height)
		{
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
			IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (handle == IntPtr.Zero)

		private void VerifyIsInView(bool force, bool async, bool ensureFullyInView)

				}
			}
		}

				}

				{

					multiBinding.Bindings.Add(Utilities.CreateBindingObject(Window.LeftProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, owner));
					multiBinding.Bindings.Add(Utilities.CreateBindingObject(Window.TopProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, owner));
					multiBinding.Bindings.Add(Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ActualWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, owner));
					multiBinding.Bindings.Add(Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ActualHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, owner));
					multiBinding.Converter = WindowPositionToRectConverter.Instance;
					SetBinding(OwnerRectProperty, multiBinding);
				}
				base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (toolWindow != null)
			{
				flag = (toolWindow.HorizontalAlignmentMode != ToolWindowAlignmentMode.UseAlignment || toolWindow.HorizontalAlignment != System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch) && double.IsNaN(toolWindow.Width);
				flag2 = (toolWindow.VerticalAlignmentMode != ToolWindowAlignmentMode.UseAlignment || toolWindow.VerticalAlignment != VerticalAlignment.Stretch) && double.IsNaN(toolWindow.Height);

				{

				}

			if (flag && flag2)
			{

			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				base.SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Width;

			}
			else

			}
		}

		private void VerifyWindowStyle()
		{
			bool allowsTransparency;
			if (_content != null && UseSystemNonClientArea)
			{
				allowsTransparency = false;
				if (_content.AllowMinimize || _content.AllowMaximize || _content.IsModal)
				{
					base.WindowStyle = WindowStyle.SingleBorderWindow;
				}
				else
				{
					base.WindowStyle = WindowStyle.ToolWindow;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None;
				allowsTransparency = _content != null && _content.AllowsTransparencyResolved;
			}
			try
			{
				if (_content != null && new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle == IntPtr.Zero)

				}
			}
			catch (InvalidOperationException)

			}

			}
			UpdateIsIconSuppressed();
		}
