		private void VerifyWindowStyleBits(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			if (hwnd != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				IntPtr windowLong = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(hwnd, -16);
				ToolWindow toolWindow = base.Content as ToolWindow;
				IntPtr ptr = windowLong;
				ptr = ((toolWindow != null && toolWindow.AllowMaximize) ? NativeWindowMethods.AddBits(ptr, 65536) : NativeWindowMethods.RemoveBits(ptr, 65536));
				ptr = ((toolWindow != null && toolWindow.AllowMinimize) ? NativeWindowMethods.AddBits(ptr, 131072) : NativeWindowMethods.RemoveBits(ptr, 131072));
				if (windowLong != ptr)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowLong(hwnd, -16, ptr);
				}
				windowLong = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(hwnd, -20);
				ptr = windowLong;
				ptr = ((base.WindowStyle != WindowStyle.SingleBorderWindow) ? NativeWindowMethods.RemoveBits(ptr, 1) : NativeWindowMethods.AddBits(ptr, 1));
				if (base.WindowStyle == WindowStyle.None && Environment.Version.Major <= 3)
				{
					ptr = NativeWindowMethods.AddBits(ptr, 128);
				}
				else if (base.WindowStyle != WindowStyle.ToolWindow)
				{
					ptr = NativeWindowMethods.RemoveBits(ptr, 128);
				}
				if (windowLong != ptr)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowLong(hwnd, -20, ptr);
				}
			}
		}

		private IntPtr WmContextMenu(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			NativeWindowMethods.POINT lpPoint = NativeWindowMethods.PointFromLParam(lParam);
			System.Windows.Point? location = null;
			if (base.WindowState == WindowState.Minimized)
			{
				if (UseSystemNonClientArea)
				{
					return IntPtr.Zero;
				}
				if (lpPoint.X == -1 && lpPoint.Y == -1)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.GetCursorPos(ref lpPoint);
				}
				ShowContentContextMenu(hwnd, null);
				IntPtr systemMenuApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetSystemMenuApi(hwnd, revert: false);
				if (systemMenuApi != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					handled = true;
					uint fuFlags = 258u;
					int num = NativeWindowMethods.TrackPopupMenuEx(systemMenuApi, fuFlags, lpPoint.X, lpPoint.Y, hwnd, IntPtr.Zero);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.PostMessage(hwnd, 274, new IntPtr(num), IntPtr.Zero);
					}
					return IntPtr.Zero;
				}
			}
			if (lpPoint.X != -1 || lpPoint.Y != -1)
			{
				switch ((NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults)NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(hwnd, 132, IntPtr.Zero, lParam).ToInt64())
				{
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTCLIENT:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTGROWBOX:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTHSCROLL:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTVSCROLL:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTLEFT:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTRIGHT:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTTOP:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTTOPLEFT:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTTOPRIGHT:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTBOTTOM:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTBOTTOMLEFT:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTBOTTOMRIGHT:
				case NativeWindowMethods.HitTestResults.HTBORDER:
					return IntPtr.Zero;
				}
				location = PointFromScreen(new System.Windows.Point(lpPoint.X, lpPoint.Y));
			}
			if (ShowContentContextMenu(hwnd, location))
			{
				handled = true;
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			return IntPtr.Zero;
		}

		private IntPtr WmGetMinMaxInfo(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr lParam)
		{

			if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsInMoveSize))

				hMonitor = NativeWindowMethods.MonitorFromPoint(new NativeWindowMethods.POINT(x, y), 2);
			}

		private IntPtr WndProc(IntPtr hwnd, int message, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			try
			{
				_wndProcCount++;
				return WndProcImpl(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			}
			finally
			{
				_wndProcCount--;
			}
		}

		private IntPtr WndProcImpl(IntPtr hwnd, int message, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			switch (message)
			{
			case 70:
				return WmWindowPosChanging(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			case 123:
				return WmContextMenu(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			case 126:
				VerifyIsInView(force: false, async: true, ensureFullyInView: true);
				break;
			case 534:
				return WmMoving(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			case 134:
				if (!UseSystemNonClientArea)
				{
					handled = true;
					return NativeWindowMethods.DefWindowProc(hwnd, message, wParam, new IntPtr(-1));
				}
				break;
			case 131:
				return WmNcCalcSize(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			case 132:
				return WmNcHitTest(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			case 163:
				return WmNclButtonDblClk(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			case 24:
				return WmShowWindow(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			case 133:
				if (!UseSystemNonClientArea && !NativeWindowMethods.IsDWMCompositionEnabled)
				{
					handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case 174:
			case 175:
				if (!UseSystemNonClientArea)
				{
					handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case 5:
				return WmSize(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			case 124:
				return WmStyleChanging(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			case 274:
				return WmSysCommand(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			case 561:
				return WmEnterSizeMove(hwnd);
			case 562:
				return WmExitSizeMove(hwnd, ref handled);
			case 533:
				return WmExitSizeMove(hwnd, ref handled);
			case 36:
				return WmGetMinMaxInfo(hwnd, lParam);
			case 736:
				return WmDpiChanged(hwnd, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
			}
			return IntPtr.Zero;
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.DragMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				VerifyAccess();
				if (Mouse.LeftButton != MouseButtonState.Pressed)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
				if (windowInteropHelper.Handle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(windowInteropHelper.Handle, 274, new IntPtr(61458), IntPtr.Zero);
					NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(windowInteropHelper.Handle, 514, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DragMove();
			}
		}

		bool IToolWindowHost.SupportsAllowTransparency(bool allowsTransparency)
		{
			if (_content == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_content.UseOSNonClientArea)
			{
				return !allowsTransparency;
			}
			return true;
		}

		Rect IToolWindowHost.GetRestoreBounds()
		{
			Rect restoreBounds = base.RestoreBounds;
			if (restoreBounds.IsEmpty && _content != null)
			{
				restoreBounds = _content.GetRestoreBounds(queryHost: false);
			}
			return restoreBounds;
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.SetRestoreBounds(Rect restoreBounds)
		{
			if (!restoreBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
				IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
				if (handle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					SetRestoreBounds(handle, restoreBounds);
				}
				else if (_content != null)
				{
					_content.SetRestoreBounds(restoreBounds, updateHost: false);
				}
			}
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.SetWindowState(WindowState state)
		{
			bool flag = GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingWindowState);
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingWindowState, set: true);
			if (!flag)
			{
				_previousWindowState = base.WindowState;
			}
			try
			{
				base.WindowState = state;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					_previousWindowState = null;
				}
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsChangingWindowState, flag);
			}
			OnAfterWindowStateChanged(state);
		}

		Rect IToolWindowHost.GetWindowBounds()
		{
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
			if (windowInteropHelper.Handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWINFO windowInfo = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowInfo(windowInteropHelper.Handle);
			System.Windows.Point point = ConvertToLogicalPixels(windowInfo.rcWindow.left, windowInfo.rcWindow.top);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = ConvertToLogicalPixels(windowInfo.rcWindow.right, windowInfo.rcWindow.bottom);
			return Utilities.RectFromPoints(point, point2);
		}

		{
			CancelPendingCloseRequest();
		}

		{
			protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
			{
				return new PerMonitorDeferHostRootAutomationPeer(this);
			}
		}

		private class PerMonitorDeferHostRootAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer
		{
			internal PerMonitorDeferHostRootAutomationPeer(ContentPresenter owner)
				: base(owner)
			{
			}

			protected override string GetClassNameCore()
			{
				return "ToolWindow";
			}

			protected override string GetNameCore()
			{
				return "";
			}

			protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
			{
				return AutomationControlType.Window;
			}
		}

		private HwndSource _hs;

		private ToolWindow _window;

		private Window _owningWindow;

		private ContentPresenter _root;

		private bool _isShowingWindow;

		private ToolWindowPositionInfo _positionInfo;

		bool IToolWindowHost.HandlesDelayedMinMaxRequests => false;

		bool IToolWindowHost.IsWindow => false;

		bool IToolWindowHost.AllowsTransparency => true;

		bool IToolWindowHost.IsUsingOsNonClientArea => false;

		ToolWindowHostType IToolWindowHost.HostType => ToolWindowHostType.HwndSource;

		bool IToolWindowHost.HasPendingCloseRequest => false;

		private PerMonitorDpiToolWindowHost(ToolWindow toolWindow, Window owningWindow, ToolWindowPositionInfo positionInfo)
		{
			_window = toolWindow;
			_owningWindow = owningWindow;
			_positionInfo = positionInfo;
		}

		public void Show(bool activate)
		{
			if (_window == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolWindow window = _window;
			FrameworkElement owner = window.Owner;
			Rect ownerRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, owner.ActualWidth, owner.ActualHeight);
			SizeToContent sizeToContent = SizeToContent.Manual;
			Rect rect = default(Rect);
			if (!double.IsNaN(_positionInfo.Width) && !double.IsInfinity(_positionInfo.Width))
			{
				rect.Width = _positionInfo.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				rect.Width = 0.0;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(_positionInfo.Height) && !double.IsInfinity(_positionInfo.Height))
			{
				rect.Height = _positionInfo.Height;
			}
			else
			{
				rect.Height = 0.0;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			flag = (_positionInfo.HorizontalAlignmentMode != ToolWindowAlignmentMode.UseAlignment || _positionInfo.HorizontalAlignment != System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch) && double.IsNaN(_positionInfo.Width);
			flag2 = (_positionInfo.VerticalAlignmentMode != ToolWindowAlignmentMode.UseAlignment || _positionInfo.VerticalAlignment != VerticalAlignment.Stretch) && double.IsNaN(_positionInfo.Height);
			if (flag)
			{
				sizeToContent |= SizeToContent.Width;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				sizeToContent |= SizeToContent.Height;
			}
			ToolWindow.AdjustRelativeRect(ownerRect, ref rect, window.Owner, _positionInfo.HorizontalAlignmentMode, _positionInfo.HorizontalAlignment, _positionInfo.HorizontalAlignmentOffset, _positionInfo.VerticalAlignmentMode, _positionInfo.VerticalAlignment, _positionInfo.VerticalAlignmentOffset);
			System.Windows.Point point = owner.PointToScreen(rect.Location);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = owner.PointToScreen(rect.BottomRight);
			HwndSourceParameters parameters = new HwndSourceParameters("IGToolWindow");
			parameters.PositionX = (int)Math.Round(point.X, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
			parameters.PositionY = (int)Math.Round(point.Y, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
			parameters.Width = (int)Math.Round(point2.X - point.X, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
			parameters.Height = (int)Math.Round(point2.Y - point.Y, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
			parameters.WindowStyle = int.MinValue;
			parameters.ExtendedWindowStyle = 128;
			parameters.UsesPerPixelOpacity = true;
			if (window.Topmost)
			{
				parameters.ExtendedWindowStyle |= 8;
			}
			if (_owningWindow != null && window.IsOwnedWindow)
			{
				parameters.ParentWindow = new WindowInteropHelper(_owningWindow).Handle;
			}
			try
			{
				_isShowingWindow = true;
				_root = new PerMonitorDeferHostRoot();
				_root.Content = window;
				_hs = new HwndSource(parameters);
				_hs.SizeToContent = sizeToContent;
				_hs.RootVisual = _root;
				_hs.Disposed += OnDisposed;
				int x = parameters.PositionX;
				int y = parameters.PositionY;
				int cx = parameters.Width;
				int cy = parameters.Height;
				if (sizeToContent != SizeToContent.Manual)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						rect.Width = window.ActualWidth * Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: true, window).M11 * Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: false, owner).M11;
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						rect.Height = window.ActualHeight * Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: true, window).M22 * Utilities.GetDeviceMatrix(toDevice: false, owner).M22;
					}
					ToolWindow.AdjustRelativeRect(ownerRect, ref rect, window.Owner, _positionInfo.HorizontalAlignmentMode, _positionInfo.HorizontalAlignment, _positionInfo.HorizontalAlignmentOffset, _positionInfo.VerticalAlignmentMode, _positionInfo.VerticalAlignment, _positionInfo.VerticalAlignmentOffset);
					point = owner.PointToScreen(rect.Location);
					point2 = owner.PointToScreen(rect.BottomRight);
					x = (int)Math.Round(point.X, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
					y = (int)Math.Round(point.Y, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
					cx = (int)Math.Round(point2.X - point.X, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
					cy = (int)Math.Round(point2.Y - point.Y, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
				}
				int num = 64;
				if (!activate)
				{
					num |= 0x10;
				}
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(_hs.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, x, y, cx, cy, num);
			}
			finally
			{
				_isShowingWindow = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_hs = null;
			Close();
		}

		internal static ToolWindow.IDeferShow CreateDeferShow(ToolWindow toolWindow, Window owningWindow, ToolWindowPositionInfo positionInfo)
		{
			PerMonitorDpiToolWindowHost perMonitorDpiToolWindowHost = new PerMonitorDpiToolWindowHost(toolWindow, owningWindow, positionInfo);
			toolWindow.SetValue(ToolWindow.HostProperty, perMonitorDpiToolWindowHost);
			return new PerMonitorDeferHost(perMonitorDpiToolWindowHost);
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.Activate()
		{
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.BringToFront()
		{
			if (_hs != null)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(_hs.Handle, NativeWindowMethods.HWND_TOP, 0, 0, 0, 0, 19);
			}
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			ToolWindow window = _window;
			if (window != null)
			{
				HwndSource hs = _hs;
				_hs = null;
				_window = null;
				if (window.Host == this)
				{
					window.ClearValue(ToolWindow.HostProperty);
				}
				_root.Content = null;
				if (hs != null)
				{
					hs.Disposed -= OnDisposed;
					hs.Dispose();
				}
				window.OnClosedInternal();
			}
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.DragMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.DragResize(ToolWindowResizeElementLocation location, System.Windows.Input.Cursor cursor, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.EnsureOnScreen(bool fullyInView)
		{
		}

		Rect IToolWindowHost.GetRestoreBounds()
		{
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		Rect IToolWindowHost.GetWindowBounds()
		{
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.RelativePositionStateChanged()
		{
			if (!_isShowingWindow)
			{
				Close();
			}
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.SetRestoreBounds(Rect rect)
		{
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.SetWindowState(WindowState newState)
		{
		}

		bool IToolWindowHost.SupportsAllowTransparency(bool allowsTransparency)
		{
			return true;
		}

		void IToolWindowHost.CancelPendingCloseRequest()
		{
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class ToolWindowResizeElement : Border
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty BorderLocationProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty WindowBorderThicknessProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty WindowCornerRadiusProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		public ToolWindowResizeElementLocation BorderLocation
		{
			get
			{
				return (ToolWindowResizeElementLocation)GetValue(BorderLocationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BorderLocationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private Thickness WindowBorderThickness => (Thickness)GetValue(WindowBorderThicknessProperty);

		private CornerRadius WindowCornerRadius => (CornerRadius)GetValue(WindowCornerRadiusProperty);

		static ToolWindowResizeElement()
		{
			BorderLocationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BorderLocation", typeof(ToolWindowResizeElementLocation), typeof(ToolWindowResizeElement), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Top, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnBorderLocationChanged));
			WindowBorderThicknessProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("WindowBorderThickness", typeof(Thickness), typeof(ToolWindowResizeElement), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness), OnWindowBorderThicknessChanged));
			WindowCornerRadiusProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("WindowCornerRadius", typeof(CornerRadius), typeof(ToolWindowResizeElement), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(CornerRadius), OnWindowCornerRadiusChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowResizeElement), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowResizeElement)));
			Border.BorderBrushProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolWindowResizeElement), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent));
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			if ((base.TemplatedParent ?? Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(ToolWindow), allowSubclassOfType: true)) is ToolWindow source)
			{
				SetBinding(WindowBorderThicknessProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(System.Windows.Controls.Control.BorderThicknessProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, source));
				SetBinding(WindowCornerRadiusProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(Border.CornerRadiusProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, source));
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, WindowBorderThicknessProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, WindowCornerRadiusProperty);
			}
			InitializeAlignments();
			InitializeBorderThickness();
			InitializeCornerRadius();
			InitializeCursor();
			InitializeMargins();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			switch (BorderLocation)
			{
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft:
				result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, Math.Max(base.BorderThickness.Left, base.CornerRadius.BottomLeft));
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, Math.Max(base.BorderThickness.Bottom, base.CornerRadius.BottomLeft));
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight:
				result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, Math.Max(base.BorderThickness.Right, base.CornerRadius.BottomRight));
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, Math.Max(base.BorderThickness.Bottom, base.CornerRadius.BottomRight));
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft:
				result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, Math.Max(base.BorderThickness.Left, base.CornerRadius.TopLeft));
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, Math.Max(base.BorderThickness.Top, base.CornerRadius.TopLeft));
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight:
				result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, Math.Max(base.BorderThickness.Right, base.CornerRadius.TopRight));
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, Math.Max(base.BorderThickness.Top, base.CornerRadius.TopRight));
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void OnBorderLocationChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowResizeElement toolWindowResizeElement = (ToolWindowResizeElement)d;
			toolWindowResizeElement.InitializeBorderThickness();
			toolWindowResizeElement.InitializeCornerRadius();
			toolWindowResizeElement.InitializeAlignments();
			toolWindowResizeElement.InitializeMargins();
			toolWindowResizeElement.InitializeCursor();
		}

		private static void OnWindowBorderThicknessChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowResizeElement toolWindowResizeElement = (ToolWindowResizeElement)d;
			toolWindowResizeElement.InitializeBorderThickness();
			toolWindowResizeElement.InitializeMargins();
		}

		private static void OnWindowCornerRadiusChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolWindowResizeElement toolWindowResizeElement = (ToolWindowResizeElement)d;
			toolWindowResizeElement.InitializeCornerRadius();
			toolWindowResizeElement.InitializeMargins();
		}

		private void InitializeAlignments()
		{
			InitializeHorizontalAlignment();
			InitializeVerticalAlignment();
		}

		private void InitializeCursor()
		{
			System.Windows.Input.Cursor value = null;
			switch (BorderLocation)
			{
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Left:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Right:
				value = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeWE;
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Top:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Bottom:
				value = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNS;
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight:
				value = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNWSE;
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft:
				value = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNESW;
				break;
			}
			SetValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty, value);
			SetValue(FrameworkElement.ForceCursorProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
		}

		private void InitializeHorizontalAlignment()
		{
			object value;
			switch (BorderLocation)
			{
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Left:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft:
				value = KnownBoxes.HorizontalAlignmentLeftBox;
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Right:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight:
				value = KnownBoxes.HorizontalAlignmentRightBox;
				break;
			default:
				value = KnownBoxes.HorizontalAlignmentStretchBox;
				break;
			}
			SetValue(FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty, value);
		}

		private void InitializeVerticalAlignment()
		{
			object value;
			switch (BorderLocation)
			{
			default:
				value = KnownBoxes.VerticalAlignmentStretchBox;
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Top:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight:
				value = KnownBoxes.VerticalAlignmentTopBox;
				break;
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Bottom:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft:
			case ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight:
				value = KnownBoxes.VerticalAlignmentBottomBox;
				break;
			}
			SetValue(FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty, value);
		}

		private void InitializeMargins()
		{
			Thickness windowBorderThickness = WindowBorderThickness;
			CornerRadius windowCornerRadius = WindowCornerRadius;
			base.Margin = BorderLocation switch
			{
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Left => new Thickness(0.0, Math.Max(windowBorderThickness.Top, windowCornerRadius.TopLeft), 0.0, Math.Max(windowBorderThickness.Bottom, windowCornerRadius.BottomLeft)), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Right => new Thickness(0.0, Math.Max(windowBorderThickness.Top, windowCornerRadius.TopRight), 0.0, Math.Max(windowBorderThickness.Bottom, windowCornerRadius.BottomRight)), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Bottom => new Thickness(Math.Max(windowBorderThickness.Left, windowCornerRadius.BottomLeft), 0.0, Math.Max(windowBorderThickness.Right, windowCornerRadius.BottomRight), 0.0), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Top => new Thickness(Math.Max(windowBorderThickness.Left, windowCornerRadius.TopLeft), 0.0, Math.Max(windowBorderThickness.Right, windowCornerRadius.TopRight), 0.0), 
				_ => default(Thickness), 
			};
		}

		private void InitializeBorderThickness()
		{
			Thickness windowBorderThickness = WindowBorderThickness;
			base.BorderThickness = BorderLocation switch
			{
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Right => new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, windowBorderThickness.Right, 0.0), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Bottom => new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, windowBorderThickness.Bottom), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.Top => new Thickness(0.0, windowBorderThickness.Top, 0.0, 0.0), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft => new Thickness(windowBorderThickness.Left, windowBorderThickness.Top, 0.0, 0.0), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight => new Thickness(0.0, windowBorderThickness.Top, windowBorderThickness.Right, 0.0), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft => new Thickness(windowBorderThickness.Left, 0.0, 0.0, windowBorderThickness.Bottom), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight => new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, windowBorderThickness.Right, windowBorderThickness.Bottom), 
				_ => new Thickness(windowBorderThickness.Left, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), 
			};
		}

		private void InitializeCornerRadius()
		{
			CornerRadius windowCornerRadius = WindowCornerRadius;
			base.CornerRadius = BorderLocation switch
			{
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopLeft => new CornerRadius(windowCornerRadius.TopLeft, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.TopRight => new CornerRadius(0.0, windowCornerRadius.TopRight, 0.0, 0.0), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomLeft => new CornerRadius(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, windowCornerRadius.BottomLeft), 
				ToolWindowResizeElementLocation.BottomRight => new CornerRadius(0.0, 0.0, windowCornerRadius.BottomRight, 0.0), 
				_ => default(CornerRadius), 
			};
		}
	}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (element is CarouselListBoxItem carouselListBoxItem)
			{
				carouselListBoxItem.ClearContainerForItem(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void DeactivateContainer(DependencyObject container, object item)
		{
			base.DeactivateContainer(container, item);
			container.SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new CarouselListBoxItem(_carouselPanel);
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is CarouselListBoxItem;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			if (_carouselPanel == null)
			{
				_carouselPanel = Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(XamCarouselPanel), allowSubclassOfType: true) as XamCarouselPanel;
				if (_carouselPanel != null)
				{
					_carouselPanel.SelectionHost = this;
					BindCarouselPanelViewSettings(_carouselPanel);
					_carouselPanel.CarouselPanelAdorner.SetBinding(UIElement.OpacityProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.OpacityProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new XamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			if (_viewSettings == null && !DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				SetValue(XamCarouselPanel.ViewSettingsProperty, ViewSettings);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			bool flag = false;
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if ((bool)GetValue(IsSelectionActiveProperty) != flag)
			{
				SetValue(IsSelectionActivePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(flag));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			if (base.Items != null && base.Items.CurrentItem != null && _isSynchronizedWithCurrentItemPrivate)
			{
				SetSelectedToCurrent();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemsPanelChanged(ItemsPanelTemplate oldItemsPanel, ItemsPanelTemplate newItemsPanel)
		{
			if (_carouselPanel != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(_carouselPanel);
				_carouselPanel = null;
			}
			base.OnItemsPanelChanged(oldItemsPanel, newItemsPanel);
		}

		protected override void OnItemsSourceChanged(IEnumerable oldValue, IEnumerable newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null && (base.ItemTemplate != null || base.ItemTemplateSelector != null))
			{
				base.RecyclingItemContainerGenerator.RemoveAll();
			}
			SetSynchronizationWithCurrentItem();
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Property == ViewSettingsProperty)
			{
				if (_viewSettings != null)
				{
					DependencyObject parent = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(_viewSettings);
					if (parent is XamCarouselPanel)
					{
						((XamCarouselPanel)parent).RemoveLogicalChildProxy(_viewSettings);
					}
					else if (parent == this)
					{
						RemoveLogicalChild(_viewSettings);
					}
				}
				_viewSettings = e.NewValue as CarouselViewSettings;
				if (_carouselPanel != null)
				{
					BindCarouselPanelViewSettings(_carouselPanel);
				}
				if (_viewSettings != null)
				{
					DependencyObject parent2 = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(_viewSettings);
					if (parent2 != null && parent2 is XamCarouselPanel)
					{
						((XamCarouselPanel)parent2).RemoveLogicalChildProxy(_viewSettings);
						parent2 = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(_viewSettings);
					}
					if (parent2 == null)
					{
						AddLogicalChild(_viewSettings);
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (element is CarouselListBoxItem carouselListBoxItem)
			{
				carouselListBoxItem.PrepareContainerForItem(item);
			}
			if (item == SelectedItem)
			{
				element.SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ReactivateContainer(DependencyObject container, object item)
		{
			base.ReactivateContainer(container, item);
			if (item == SelectedItem)
			{
				container.SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ReuseContainerForNewItem(DependencyObject container, object item)
		{
			base.ReuseContainerForNewItem(container, item);
			if (item == SelectedItem)
			{
				container.SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			else
			{
				container.SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			}
		}

		public static bool GetIsSelected(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("element");
			}
			return (bool)element.GetValue(IsSelectedProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIsSelected(DependencyObject element, bool isSelected)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("element");
			}
			element.SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.FromValue(isSelected));
		}

		public static bool GetIsSelectionActive(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(IsSelectionActiveProperty);
		}

		private static void OnIsSynchronizedWithCurrentItemChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamCarouselListBox)d).SetSynchronizationWithCurrentItem();
		}

		private static void OnSelectedIndexChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is XamCarouselListBox xamCarouselListBox))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			xamCarouselListBox._updateSelectedIndex = false;
			try
			{
				IItemContainerGenerator activeItemContainerGenerator = xamCarouselListBox.ActiveItemContainerGenerator;
				if ((int)e.OldValue != -1 && (int)e.OldValue < xamCarouselListBox.Items.Count)
				{
					list.Add(xamCarouselListBox.Items[(int)e.OldValue]);
					if (xamCarouselListBox.ContainerFromIndex((int)e.OldValue) is CarouselPanelItem carouselPanelItem)
					{
						carouselPanelItem.SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
					}
					if (xamCarouselListBox._updateSelectedItem)
					{
						xamCarouselListBox.SetValue(SelectedItemProperty, null);
					}
				}
				if ((int)e.NewValue != -1 && (int)e.NewValue < xamCarouselListBox.Items.Count)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					list2.Add(xamCarouselListBox.Items[(int)e.NewValue]);
					if (xamCarouselListBox.ContainerFromIndex((int)e.NewValue) is CarouselPanelItem carouselPanelItem2)
					{
						if (!GetIsSelected(carouselPanelItem2))
						{
							carouselPanelItem2.SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (xamCarouselListBox._updateSelectedItem)
					{
						xamCarouselListBox.SetValue(SelectedItemProperty, xamCarouselListBox.Items[(int)e.NewValue]);
					}
					xamCarouselListBox.UpdateSelectedValueBinding();
					if (flag && xamCarouselListBox._carouselPanel != null)
					{
						((IScrollInfo)xamCarouselListBox._carouselPanel).SetVerticalOffset((double)(int)e.NewValue);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				xamCarouselListBox._updateSelectedIndex = true;
			}
			xamCarouselListBox.SetCurrentToSelected();
			SelectionChangedEventArgs args = new SelectionChangedEventArgs(SelectionChangedEvent, list, list2);
			xamCarouselListBox.RaiseSelectionChanged(args);
			if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(xamCarouselListBox) is XamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer xamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer)
			{
				xamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer.RaiseSelectionChanged(args);
			}
		}

		private static object OnCoerceSelectedIndex(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			if (d is XamCarouselListBox xamCarouselListBox && value is int && (int)value >= xamCarouselListBox.Items.Count)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static bool OnValidateSelectedIndex(object value)
		{
			return (int)value >= -1;
		}

		private static void OnSelectedItemChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XamCarouselListBox { _updateSelectedIndex: not false } xamCarouselListBox)
			{
				xamCarouselListBox._updateSelectedItem = false;
				try
				{
					xamCarouselListBox.SetValue(SelectedIndexProperty, xamCarouselListBox.Items.IndexOf(e.NewValue));
				}
				finally
				{
					xamCarouselListBox._updateSelectedItem = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnSelectedValuePathChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XamCarouselListBox xamCarouselListBox)
			{
				xamCarouselListBox.UpdateSelectedValueBinding();
			}
		}

		private static object OnCoerceViewSettings(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			if (value == null && !DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(d))
			{
				return new CarouselViewSettings();
			}
			return value;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeViewSettings()
		{
			return ViewSettings != (CarouselViewSettings)ViewSettingsProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetViewSettings()
		{
			ViewSettings = (CarouselViewSettings)ViewSettingsProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		private static void OnSelectedValueInternalChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XamCarouselListBox xamCarouselListBox)
			{
				xamCarouselListBox.SetValue(SelectedValuePropertyKey, e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private void BindCarouselPanelViewSettings(XamCarouselPanel carouselPanel)
		{
			if (carouselPanel != null)
			{
				if (_viewSettings == null)
				{
					BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(carouselPanel);
					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
				binding.Source = this;
				binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath("ViewSettings");
				carouselPanel.SetBinding(XamCarouselPanel.ViewSettingsProperty, binding);
			}
		}

		private DependencyObject ContainerFromIndex(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (ActiveItemContainerGenerator is RecyclingItemContainerGenerator)
			{
				return base.RecyclingItemContainerGenerator.GetContainer(GetChildIndexFromItemIndex(itemIndex), isIndexBasedOnZOrder: false);
			}
			return base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(itemIndex);
		}

		private int GetChildIndexFromItemIndex(int itemIndex)
		{
			GeneratorPosition generatorPositionFromItemIndex = GetGeneratorPositionFromItemIndex(itemIndex);
			if (generatorPositionFromItemIndex.Offset != 0)
			{
				return generatorPositionFromItemIndex.Index + 1;
			}
			return generatorPositionFromItemIndex.Index;
		}

		private GeneratorPosition GetGeneratorPositionFromItemIndex(int itemIndex)
		{
			return ActiveItemContainerGenerator.GeneratorPositionFromIndex(itemIndex);
		}

		private bool IsXmlNode(object item)
		{
			if (item != null && item.GetType().FullName.StartsWith("System.Xml", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return item is XmlNode;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void OnIsSelectedChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(d) is XamCarouselListBox element)
			{
				XamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer xamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(element) as XamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer;
				xamCarouselListBoxAutomationPeer.RaiseIsSelectedChanged(d, (bool)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private void OnItemsCurrentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_isSynchronizedWithCurrentItemPrivate)
			{
				SetSelectedToCurrent();
			}
		}

		private void SetCurrentToSelected()
		{
			if (SelectedItem == null)
			{
				base.Items.MoveCurrentToPosition(-1);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Items.MoveCurrentTo(SelectedItem);
			}
		}

		private void SetSelectedToCurrent()
		{
			object currentItem = base.Items.CurrentItem;
			if (currentItem != null)
			{
				SelectedItem = currentItem;
			}
		}

		private void SetSynchronizationWithCurrentItem()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool? isSynchronizedWithCurrentItem = IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItem;
			bool isSynchronizedWithCurrentItemPrivate = _isSynchronizedWithCurrentItemPrivate;
			if (isSynchronizedWithCurrentItem.HasValue)
			{
				flag = isSynchronizedWithCurrentItem.Value;
			}
			_isSynchronizedWithCurrentItemPrivate = flag;
			if (!isSynchronizedWithCurrentItemPrivate && flag)
			{
				SetSelectedToCurrent();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedValueBinding()
		{
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, SelectedValueInternalProperty);
			if (SelectedItem != null && SelectedValuePath != null && !(SelectedValuePath == string.Empty))
			{
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
				binding.Source = SelectedItem;
				if (IsXmlNode(SelectedItem))
				{
					binding.XPath = SelectedValuePath;
					binding.Path = new PropertyPath("/InnerText");
				}
				else
				{
					binding.Path = new PropertyPath(SelectedValuePath);
				}
				SetBinding(SelectedValueInternalProperty, binding);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = SelectionChangedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnSelectionChanged(args);
		}
	}
	public class XamCarouselPanel : RecyclingItemsPanel, IScrollInfo, IWeakEventListener, ICommandHost
	{
		private delegate void MethodDelegate();

		private class RenderingEventProxy
		{
			private WeakReference _panelRef;

			private bool _isWired;

			internal RenderingEventProxy(XamCarouselPanel panel)
			{
				_panelRef = new WeakReference(panel);
				_isWired = false;
			}

			private void OnCompositionTarget_Rendering(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				if (CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_panelRef) is XamCarouselPanel xamCarouselPanel)
				{
					xamCarouselPanel.CompositionTarget_Rendering(sender, e);
				}
				else
				{
					UnwireRenderingEvent();
				}
			}

			internal void UnwireRenderingEvent()
			{
				if (_isWired)
				{
					CompositionTarget.Rendering -= OnCompositionTarget_Rendering;
				}
				_isWired = false;
			}

			internal void WireRenderingEvent()
			{
				if (!_isWired)
				{
					_isWired = true;
					CompositionTarget.Rendering += OnCompositionTarget_Rendering;
				}
			}
		}

		internal class ScrollData
		{
			internal ScrollViewer _scrollOwner;

			internal System.Windows.Size _extent;

			internal System.Windows.Size _viewport;

			internal Vector _offset;

			internal bool _canHorizontallyScroll;

			internal bool _canVerticallyScroll;

			internal void Reset()
			{
				_offset = default(Vector);
				_extent = default(System.Windows.Size);
				_viewport = default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
		}

		internal struct PathFractionPoint
		{
			internal System.Windows.Point Point;

			internal System.Windows.Point TangentPoint;

			internal PathFractionPoint(System.Windows.Point point, System.Windows.Point tangentPoint)
			{
				Point = point;
				TangentPoint = tangentPoint;
			}
		}

		internal struct ScrollActionInfo
		{
			internal double OffsetBeforeScroll;

			internal double OffsetAfterScroll;

			internal static ScrollActionInfo Empty = new ScrollActionInfo(double.NegativeInfinity, double.NegativeInfinity, scrollingHigher: false, null);

			internal bool ScrollingHigher;

			internal XamCarouselPanel CarouselPanel;

			internal bool IsEmpty
			{
				get
				{
					if (OffsetBeforeScroll == double.NegativeInfinity)
					{
						return OffsetAfterScroll == double.NegativeInfinity;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			internal int ScrollAmount
			{
				get
				{
					if (CarouselPanel.ViewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous)
					{
						if (ScrollingHigher)
						{
							if (OffsetBeforeScroll > OffsetAfterScroll)
							{
								return CarouselPanel.TotalItemCount - (int)OffsetBeforeScroll + ((int)OffsetAfterScroll + 1);
							}
						}
						else if (OffsetBeforeScroll < OffsetAfterScroll)
						{
							return -((int)OffsetBeforeScroll + (CarouselPanel.TotalItemCount - (int)OffsetAfterScroll));
						}
					}
					return (int)(OffsetAfterScroll - OffsetBeforeScroll);
				}
			}

			internal int ScrollAmountAbsolute => Math.Abs(ScrollAmount);

			internal ScrollActionInfo(double offsetBeforeScroll, double offsetAfterScroll, bool scrollingHigher, XamCarouselPanel carouselPanel)
			{
				OffsetAfterScroll = offsetAfterScroll;
				OffsetBeforeScroll = offsetBeforeScroll;
				ScrollingHigher = scrollingHigher;
				CarouselPanel = carouselPanel;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsItemsHost)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return Math.Min(TotalItemCount - FirstVisibleItemIndex, ((int)ScrollingData._offset.Y >= 0) ? ItemsPerPageResolved : (ItemsPerPageResolved + (int)ScrollingData._offset.Y));
			}
		}

			}

				{
					ScrollingData.Reset();
					ScrollingData._scrollOwner = value;
				}
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (ViewSettingsInternal != null)
				{
					return Math.Max(1, Math.Min(TotalItemCount, ViewSettingsInternal.ItemsPerPage));

				return Math.Max(1, Math.Min(TotalItemCount, 5));
			}

		protected virtual long CurrentState
		{
			get
			{
				long num = 0L;
				if (CanNavigateToNextItem)
				{
					num |= 1;
				}
				if (CanNavigateToPreviousItem)
				{
					num |= 2;
				}
				if (CanNavigateToNextPage)
				{
					num |= 4;
				}
				if (CanNavigateToPreviousPage)
				{
					num |= 8;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private static PathGeometry ArcPath
		{
			get
			{
				PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
				Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure.StartPoint = rect.Location;
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment(rect.TopRight, new System.Windows.Size(rect.Width / 2.0, rect.Height), 180.0, isLargeArc: false, SweepDirection.Counterclockwise, isStroked: false));
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				return pathGeometry;
			}
		}

		private CarouselPanelNavigator CarouselPanelNavigator
		{
			get
			{
				if (_carouselPanelNavigator == null)
				{
					_carouselPanelNavigator = new CarouselPanelNavigator(this);
					if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(_carouselPanelNavigator) == null)
					{
						AddLogicalChild(_carouselPanelNavigator);
					}
					BindNavigatorVisibility();
				}
				return _carouselPanelNavigator;
			}
		}

		private static PathGeometry DiagonalPath
		{
			get
			{
				PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
				Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
				System.Windows.Point startPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 1.0);
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure.StartPoint = startPoint;
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment(point, isStroked: false));
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				return pathGeometry;
			}
		}

		private static PathGeometry EllipsePath
		{
			get
			{
				PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
				Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.0);
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(new ArcSegment(new System.Windows.Point(0.50001, 0.0), new System.Windows.Size(rect.Width / 2.0, rect.Height / 2.0), 360.0, isLargeArc: true, SweepDirection.Counterclockwise, isStroked: true));
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				return pathGeometry;
			}
		}

		private double HighestPossibleScrollOffset => ScrollingData._extent.Height - 1.0;

		private bool IsEntireListVisible => TotalItemCount <= ItemsPerPageResolved;

		private PathGeometry ItemPathGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				if (_itemPathGeometry == null)
				{
					Shape itemPath = ViewSettingsInternal.ItemPath;
					if (itemPath is System.Windows.Shapes.Path)
					{
						System.Windows.Shapes.Path path = itemPath as System.Windows.Shapes.Path;
						if (path.Data != null && !path.Data.IsEmpty())
						{
							_itemPathGeometry = PathGeometry.CreateFromGeometry(path.Data);
						}
					}
					if (_itemPathGeometry == null && itemPath != null && itemPath.RenderedGeometry != null && !itemPath.RenderedGeometry.IsEmpty())
					{
						_itemPathGeometry = PathGeometry.CreateFromGeometry(itemPath.RenderedGeometry);
					}
					if (_itemPathGeometry == null)
					{
						_itemPathGeometry = EllipsePath.Clone();
					}
				}
				return _itemPathGeometry;
			}
		}

		private int LastVisibleItemIndex => GetLastVisibleItemIndex(FirstVisibleItemIndex);

		private double LowestPossibleScrollOffset => 0.0 - (ScrollingData._viewport.Height - 1.0);

		private Dictionary<double, PathFractionPoint> PathFractionPointsCache
		{

			}
		}

		{

					CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
					_wrapperSize = new System.Windows.Size(viewSettingsInternal.ItemSize.Width, viewSettingsInternal.ReserveSpaceForReflections ? (viewSettingsInternal.ItemSize.Height * 2.0) : viewSettingsInternal.ItemSize.Height);
					_wrapperSizeDirty = false;
				}
				return _wrapperSize;
			}

		public XamCarouselPanel()
		{
			base.ClipToBounds = true;
			base.Focusable = true;
			try
			{
				_license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(XamCarouselPanel), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
		}

		static XamCarouselPanel()
		{
			CanNavigateToPreviousItemPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CanNavigateToPreviousItem", typeof(bool), typeof(XamCarouselPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			CanNavigateToPreviousItemProperty = CanNavigateToPreviousItemPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CanNavigateToPreviousPagePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CanNavigateToPreviousPage", typeof(bool), typeof(XamCarouselPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			CanNavigateToPreviousPageProperty = CanNavigateToPreviousPagePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CanNavigateToNextItemPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CanNavigateToNextItem", typeof(bool), typeof(XamCarouselPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			CanNavigateToNextItemProperty = CanNavigateToNextItemPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CanNavigateToNextPagePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CanNavigateToNextPage", typeof(bool), typeof(XamCarouselPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			CanNavigateToNextPageProperty = CanNavigateToNextPagePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FirstVisibleItemIndexPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("FirstVisibleItemIndex", typeof(int), typeof(XamCarouselPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0));
			FirstVisibleItemIndexProperty = FirstVisibleItemIndexPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ReflectionVisibilityPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ReflectionVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(XamCarouselPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox));
			ReflectionVisibilityProperty = ReflectionVisibilityPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ViewSettingsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ViewSettings", typeof(CarouselViewSettings), typeof(XamCarouselPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnCoerceViewSettings));
			IsInCarouselListBoxProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsInCarouselListBox", typeof(bool), typeof(XamCarouselPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			ViewSettingsVersionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ViewSettingsVersion", typeof(int), typeof(XamCarouselPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0));
			ExecutingCommandEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ExecutingCommand", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ExecutingCommandEventArgs>), typeof(XamCarouselPanel));
			ExecutedCommandEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ExecutedCommand", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ExecutedCommandEventArgs>), typeof(XamCarouselPanel));
			Infragistics.Themes.ThemeManager.RegisterControl(typeof(XamCarouselPanel));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			DoArrangeProcessing(finalSize, forceArrangeOfAllItems: true);
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override UIElementCollection CreateUIElementCollection(FrameworkElement logicalParent)
		{
			CarouselPanelUIElementCollection carouselPanelUIElementCollection = new CarouselPanelUIElementCollection(this, this, logicalParent);
			carouselPanelUIElementCollection.CollectionChanged += OnChildrenCollectionChanged;
			return carouselPanelUIElementCollection;
		}

		protected override bool GetCanCleanupItem(int itemIndex)
		{
			return !GetIsItemIndexVisible(itemIndex, FirstVisibleItemIndex);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			PathFractionPointsCache.Clear();
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			if (availableSize.Width == double.PositiveInfinity || availableSize.Height == double.PositiveInfinity)
			{
				double width = ((availableSize.Width == double.PositiveInfinity) ? viewSettingsInternal.WidthInInfiniteContainers : availableSize.Width);
				double height = ((availableSize.Height == double.PositiveInfinity) ? viewSettingsInternal.HeightInInfiniteContainers : availableSize.Height);
				availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
			}
			if (_carouselPanelAdorner == null)
			{
				InitializeAdorner();
			}
			if (_visiblePositionPercentValuesDirty)
			{
				RecalculateVisiblePositionPercentValues();
			}
			int itemsPerPageResolved = ItemsPerPageResolved;
			UpdateScrollData(new System.Windows.Size(TotalItemCount, TotalItemCount), new System.Windows.Size(itemsPerPageResolved, itemsPerPageResolved), ScrollingData._offset);
			_previousMeasureSize = availableSize;
			ScaleItemPath(availableSize);
			return availableSize;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Delta > 0)
			{
				MouseWheelLeft();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else if (e.Delta < 0)
			{
				MouseWheelRight();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			base.OnMouseWheel(e);
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			if (_viewSettings == null && IsInCarouselListBox && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(XamCarouselListBox), allowSubclassOfType: true) is XamCarouselListBox source)
			{
				SetBinding(ViewSettingsProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamCarouselListBox.ViewSettingsProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, source));
			}
			if (_viewSettings == null && !DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				SetValue(ViewSettingsProperty, ViewSettings);
			}
			ViewSettingsInternal.OnControlInitialized();
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(object sender, ItemsChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(sender, args);
			switch (args.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				RemoveRangeOfChldren(args.Position, args.ItemUICount);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				RemoveRangeOfChldren(args.Position, args.ItemUICount);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				RemoveRangeOfChldren(args.OldPosition, args.ItemUICount);
				break;
			}
			switch (args.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
			{
				int itemsPerPageResolved = ItemsPerPageResolved;
				if (args.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
				{
					UpdateScrollData(new System.Windows.Size(TotalItemCount, TotalItemCount), new System.Windows.Size(itemsPerPageResolved, itemsPerPageResolved), new Vector(ScrollOffsetForInitialArrangeAnimation, ScrollOffsetForInitialArrangeAnimation));
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateScrollData(new System.Windows.Size(TotalItemCount, TotalItemCount), new System.Windows.Size(itemsPerPageResolved, itemsPerPageResolved), new Vector(VerticalOffset, VerticalOffset));
				}
				ShouldGenerateElements = true;
				if (args.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
				{
					_initialArrangeAnimationDone = false;
				}
				else if (ViewSettingsInternal.ShouldAnimateItemsOnListChange)
				{
					_initialArrangeAnimationDone = false;
				}
				InvalidateArrange();
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			Key key = e.Key;
			bool itemsHostSupportsSelection = ItemsHostSupportsSelection;
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.Left:
			case Key.Up:
				if (base.IsItemsHost && itemsHostSupportsSelection)
				{
					if (SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex < 0)
					{
						SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex = Math.Max(0, SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex - 1);
					}
					EnsureItemIsVisible(SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					LineUp();
				}
				flag = true;
				break;
			case Key.Right:
			case Key.Down:
				if (base.IsItemsHost && itemsHostSupportsSelection)
				{
					if (SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex < 0)
					{
						SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex = Math.Min(TotalItemCount - 1, SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex + 1);
					}
					EnsureItemIsVisible(SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					LineDown();
				}
				flag = true;
				break;
			case Key.Prior:
				if (base.IsItemsHost && itemsHostSupportsSelection)
				{
					if (GetIsItemIndexVisible(SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex, FirstVisibleItemIndex) && SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex != FirstVisibleItemIndex)
					{
						SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex = FirstVisibleItemIndex;
					}
					else
					{
						SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex = Math.Max(0, SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex - ItemsPerPageResolved + 1);
						EnsureItemIsVisible(SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					PageUp();
				}
				flag = true;
				break;
			case Key.Next:
				if (base.IsItemsHost && itemsHostSupportsSelection)
				{
					if (GetIsItemIndexVisible(SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex, FirstVisibleItemIndex) && SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex != LastVisibleItemIndex)
					{
						SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex = LastVisibleItemIndex;
					}
					else
					{
						SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex = Math.Min(TotalItemCount - 1, SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex + ItemsPerPageResolved - 1);
						SetVerticalOffset(FirstVisibleItemIndexFromLastVisibleItemIndex(SelectionHost.SelectedItemIndex));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					PageDown();
				}
				flag = true;
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnKeyDown(e);
			}
		}

			base.OnMouseDown(e);
			if (!base.IsFocused)
			{
				Focus();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property != ViewSettingsProperty)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_viewSettings != null)
			{
				PropertyChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(_viewSettings, this, string.Empty);
				DependencyObject parent = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(_viewSettings);
				if (parent == this)
				{
					RemoveLogicalChild(_viewSettings);
				}
			}
			_viewSettings = e.NewValue as CarouselViewSettings;
			if (base.IsInitialized && _viewSettings != null)
			{
				_viewSettings.OnControlInitialized();
			}
			BindNavigatorVisibility();
			if (_viewSettings != null)
			{
				BumpCarouselViewSettingsVersion();
				PropertyChangedEventManager.AddListener(_viewSettings, this, string.Empty);
				DependencyObject parent2 = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(_viewSettings);
				if (parent2 == null)
				{
					AddLogicalChild(_viewSettings);
				}
				_viewSettings.EnumeratePropertiesWithNonDefaultValues(OnViewSettingsPropertyChanged);
			}
			if (e.OldValue is CarouselViewSettings carouselViewSettings)
			{
				carouselViewSettings.EnumeratePropertiesWithNonDefaultValues(OnViewSettingsPropertyChanged);
			}
		}

			else

			}
		}

		internal void SetVerticalOffset(double offset, bool? scrollingHigherHint)
		{
			bool scrollingHigher = (scrollingHigherHint.HasValue ? scrollingHigherHint.Value : (offset > ScrollingData._offset.Y));
			double num = 0.0;
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			int itemsPerPageResolved = ItemsPerPageResolved;
			if (!viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous || (viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous && TotalItemCount < itemsPerPageResolved))
			{
				num = Math.Min(Math.Max(LowestPossibleScrollOffset, offset), HighestPossibleScrollOffset);
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = TotalItemCount - 1;
				num = ((offset > (double)num2) ? (offset - (double)num2 - 1.0) : ((!(offset < 0.0)) ? offset : ((double)num2 - Math.Abs(offset) + 1.0)));
			}
			int visiblePosition;
			bool isItemIndexVisible = GetIsItemIndexVisible((int)num, (int)ScrollingData._offset.Y, out visiblePosition);
			if (!scrollingHigherHint.HasValue && isItemIndexVisible && viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous && TotalItemCount > itemsPerPageResolved)
			{
				scrollingHigher = true;
			}
			double num3 = num - ScrollingData._offset.Y;
			if (num3 == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList childElements = base.ChildElements;
			int count = childElements.Count;
			if (ScrollInProgress)
			{
				StopAnimatedScrollProcessing();
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (childElements[i] is CarouselPanelItem carouselPanelItem)
					{
						carouselPanelItem.PathTargetPercent = carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent;
					}
				}
			}
			StartAnimatedScrollProcessing(new ScrollActionInfo(ScrollingData._offset.Y, num, scrollingHigher, this));
			double y = ScrollingData._offset.Y;
			UpdateScrollData(ScrollingData._extent, ScrollingData._viewport, new Vector(num, num));
			if (base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				GenerateElementsHelper((int)num, itemsPerPageResolved, (int)y, itemsPerPageResolved);
			}
			count = childElements.Count;
			bool isListContinuous = viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				CarouselPanelItem carouselPanelItem2 = childElements[j] as CarouselPanelItem;
				int itemIndexFromChildIndex = GetItemIndexFromChildIndex(j);
				int visiblePosition2;
				bool isItemIndexVisible2 = GetIsItemIndexVisible(itemIndexFromChildIndex, (int)y, out visiblePosition2);
				int visiblePosition3;
				bool isItemIndexVisible3 = GetIsItemIndexVisible(itemIndexFromChildIndex, (int)num, out visiblePosition3);
				if (carouselPanelItem2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				carouselPanelItem2.Velocity = 0.0;
				carouselPanelItem2.PathTargetPercent = CalculateChildTargetPct(j, itemIndexFromChildIndex, (int)num, isItemIndexVisible2, isItemIndexVisible3);
				if (isItemIndexVisible2)
				{
					carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent = CalculateChildTargetPct(j, itemIndexFromChildIndex, (int)y, itemVisibleBeforeScroll: true, itemVisibleAfterScroll: true);
				}
				if (_scrollActionInfo.ScrollingHigher)
				{
					if (isItemIndexVisible3 && !isItemIndexVisible2)
					{
						if (carouselPanelItem2.IsPathLocationUnset || !isListContinuous)
						{
							carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent = 1.0;
						}
						else if (isListContinuous && carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent != 1.0)
						{
							carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent = 1.0;
						}
					}
					else if (isItemIndexVisible3 && isItemIndexVisible2 && visiblePosition3 > visiblePosition2 && isListContinuous && carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent != 1.0)
					{
						carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent = 1.0;
					}
				}
				else if (isItemIndexVisible3 && !isItemIndexVisible2)
				{
					if (carouselPanelItem2.IsPathLocationUnset)
					{
						carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent = 0.0;
					}
					else if (carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent != 0.0)
					{
						carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent = 0.0;
					}
				}
				else if (isItemIndexVisible3 && isItemIndexVisible2 && visiblePosition3 < visiblePosition2 && isListContinuous && carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent != 0.0)
				{
					carouselPanelItem2.PathLocationPercent = 0.0;
				}
			}
		}
