		public Rect MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (visual is CarouselPanelItem carouselPanelItem)
			{
				int visualChildrenCount = VisualChildrenCount;
				for (int i = 0; i < visualChildrenCount; i++)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = GetVisualChild(i) as UIElement;
					if (uIElement == carouselPanelItem)
					{
						EnsureItemIsVisible(GetItemIndexFromChildIndex(i));
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		private static object OnCoerceViewSettings(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			if (value == null && !DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(d))
			{
				return new CarouselViewSettings();
			}
			return value;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeViewSettings()
		{
			return ViewSettings != (CarouselViewSettings)ViewSettingsProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetViewSettings()
		{
			ViewSettings = (CarouselViewSettings)ViewSettingsProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		public bool EnsureItemIsVisible(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (itemIndex < 0 || itemIndex > TotalItemCount - 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_10"));
			}
			if (GetIsItemIndexVisible(itemIndex, FirstVisibleItemIndex))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (itemIndex < FirstVisibleItemIndex)
			{
				SetVerticalOffset(itemIndex);
				return true;
			}
			SetVerticalOffset(FirstVisibleItemIndexFromLastVisibleItemIndex(itemIndex));
			return true;
		}

		public bool ExecuteCommand(CommandWrapper commandWrapper)
		{
			if (commandWrapper == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("commandWrapper");
			}
			return ExecuteCommand(commandWrapper.Command);
		}

		public bool ExecuteCommand(RoutedCommand command)
		{
			if (!Commands<XamCarouselPanel>.IsMinimumStatePresentForCommand(this, command))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExecutingCommandEventArgs e = new ExecutingCommandEventArgs(command);
			if (!RaiseExecutingCommand(e))
			{
				return !e.ContinueKeyRouting;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (command == XamCarouselPanelCommands.NavigateToNextItem)
			{
				LineRight();
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (command == XamCarouselPanelCommands.NavigateToPreviousItem)
			{
				LineLeft();
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (command == XamCarouselPanelCommands.NavigateToNextPage)
			{
				PageDown();
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (command == XamCarouselPanelCommands.NavigateToPreviousPage)
			{
				PageUp();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				RaiseExecutedCommand(new ExecutedCommandEventArgs(command));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void ApplyEffectsToItem(CarouselPanelItem item, double currentPct, System.Windows.Point itemTangentPoint)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Matrix identity = Matrix.Identity;
			double num = 1.0;
			Rect rect = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), _previousArrangeSize);
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			System.Windows.Point currentLocation = item.CurrentLocation;
			if (viewSettingsInternal.UseScaling)
			{
				num = ScalingEffectStopDirectionResolved switch
				{
					EffectStopDirection.Vertical => ScalingEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromRange(rect.Top, rect.Bottom, currentLocation.Y), 
					EffectStopDirection.Horizontal => ScalingEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromRange(rect.Left, rect.Right, currentLocation.X), 
					_ => ScalingEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromOffset(currentPct), 
				};
				double m = (identity.M22 = num);
				identity.M11 = m;
			}
			double num3 = 1.0;
			if (viewSettingsInternal.UseOpacity)
			{
				num3 = OpacityEffectStopDirectionResolved switch
				{
					EffectStopDirection.Vertical => OpacityEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromRange(rect.Top, rect.Bottom, currentLocation.Y), 
					EffectStopDirection.Horizontal => OpacityEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromRange(rect.Left, rect.Right, currentLocation.X), 
					_ => OpacityEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromOffset(currentPct), 
				};
			}
			double num4 = 1.0;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (flag = InPathPrefixArea(currentPct, viewSettingsInternal))
			{
				num4 = GetPrefixAreaPenetrationPercent(currentPct, viewSettingsInternal);
			}
			else if (flag2 = InPathSuffixArea(currentPct, viewSettingsInternal))
			{
				num4 = GetSuffixAreaPenetrationPercent(currentPct, viewSettingsInternal);
			}
			if (num4 == 0.0)
			{
				identity.OffsetX = -10000.0;
				identity.OffsetY = -10000.0;
			}
			else
			{
				identity.OffsetX = currentLocation.X;
				identity.OffsetY = currentLocation.Y;
			}
			System.Windows.Size itemSize = viewSettingsInternal.ItemSize;
			identity.OffsetX -= itemSize.Width * num / 2.0;
			identity.OffsetY -= itemSize.Height * num / 2.0;
			if (viewSettingsInternal.RotateItemsWithPathTangent)
			{
				identity.RotateAt(CalculateRotationFromTangentPoint(itemTangentPoint), currentLocation.X, currentLocation.Y);
			}
			if ((viewSettingsInternal.ItemTransitionStyle & PathItemTransitionStyle.AdjustOpacity) != 0 && (flag || flag2))
			{
				if (item.Opacity != num3 * num4)
				{
					item.Opacity = num3 * num4;
				}
			}
			else if (item.Opacity != num3)
			{
				item.Opacity = num3;
			}
			if ((viewSettingsInternal.ItemTransitionStyle & PathItemTransitionStyle.AdjustSize) != 0 && (flag || flag2))
			{
				double m = (identity.M22 = identity.M11 * num4);
				identity.M11 = m;
			}
			double newSkewAngleX = 0.0;
			double newSkewAngleY = 0.0;
			if (viewSettingsInternal.UseSkewing)
			{
				newSkewAngleX = ((SkewAngleXEffectStopDirectionResolved == EffectStopDirection.Vertical) ? SkewAngleXEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromRange(rect.Top, rect.Bottom, currentLocation.Y) : ((SkewAngleXEffectStopDirectionResolved != EffectStopDirection.Horizontal) ? SkewAngleXEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromOffset(currentPct) : SkewAngleXEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromRange(rect.Left, rect.Right, currentLocation.X)));
				newSkewAngleY = ((SkewAngleYEffectStopDirectionResolved == EffectStopDirection.Vertical) ? SkewAngleYEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromRange(rect.Top, rect.Bottom, currentLocation.Y) : ((SkewAngleYEffectStopDirectionResolved != EffectStopDirection.Horizontal) ? SkewAngleYEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromOffset(currentPct) : SkewAngleYEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromRange(rect.Left, rect.Right, currentLocation.X)));
			}
			item.UpdateTransforms(identity, newSkewAngleX, newSkewAngleY, itemSize.Width / 2.0, itemSize.Height / 2.0);
		}

		private void BindNavigatorVisibility()
		{
			if (_carouselPanelNavigator != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
				binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
				binding.Source = ViewSettingsInternal;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath(CarouselViewSettings.IsNavigatorVisibleProperty);
				binding.Converter = new BooleanToVisibilityConverter();
				_carouselPanelNavigator.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, binding);
			}
		}

		private void BumpCarouselViewSettingsVersion()
		{
			SetValue(ViewSettingsVersionProperty, (int)GetValue(ViewSettingsVersionProperty) + 1);
		}

		private double CalculateChildTargetPct(int childIndex, int childsItemIndex, int scrollOffset, bool itemVisibleBeforeScroll, bool itemVisibleAfterScroll)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			if (GetShouldPositionItemAtBeginningOfPath(childsItemIndex, scrollOffset, itemVisibleBeforeScroll, itemVisibleAfterScroll))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (GetShouldPositionItemAtEndOfPath(childsItemIndex, scrollOffset, itemVisibleBeforeScroll, itemVisibleAfterScroll))
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			int visiblePositionFromItemIndex = GetVisiblePositionFromItemIndex(childsItemIndex, scrollOffset);
			if (visiblePositionFromItemIndex < 0)
			{
				if (!(base.ChildElements[childIndex] is CarouselPanelItem carouselPanelItem))
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				if (carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent == 0.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				if (carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent == 1.0)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				if (carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent < 1.0 - carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (visiblePositionFromItemIndex == 0)
			{
				return viewSettingsInternal.ItemPathPrefixPercent;
			}
			if (visiblePositionFromItemIndex == ItemsPerPageResolved - 1)
			{
				return 1.0 - viewSettingsInternal.ItemPathSuffixPercent;
			}
			return VisiblePositionPercentLocations[visiblePositionFromItemIndex];
		}

		private static double CalculateRotationFromTangentPoint(System.Windows.Point tangentPoint)
		{
			double num = Math.Acos(tangentPoint.X) * (180.0 / Math.PI);
			if (tangentPoint.Y < 0.0)
			{
				num = 360.0 - num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void CompositionTarget_Rendering(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsInitialized || _previousMeasureSize == System.Windows.Size.Empty || (_previousMeasureSize.Width == 0.0 && _previousMeasureSize.Height == 0.0))
			{
				return;
			}
			long ticks = DateTime.Now.Ticks;
			long val = ticks - _previousTick;
			double num = SecondsFromTicks(Math.Min(400000L, val));
			_previousTick = ticks;
			double num2 = 1.0 / num;
			if (num2 > _smoothedFrameRate)
			{
				if ((num2 - _smoothedFrameRate) / _smoothedFrameRate > 0.05)
				{
					_smoothedFrameRate *= 1.05;
				}
				else
				{
					_smoothedFrameRate = num2;
				}
			}
			else if ((_smoothedFrameRate - num2) / _smoothedFrameRate > 0.05)
			{
				_smoothedFrameRate *= 0.95;
			}
			else
			{
				_smoothedFrameRate = num2;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool scrollInProgress = ScrollInProgress;
			bool scrollingHigher = _scrollActionInfo.ScrollingHigher;
			IList childElements = base.ChildElements;
			int count = childElements.Count;
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			double attractionFactor = 7.0 * (30.0 / _smoothedFrameRate);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (childElements[i] is CarouselPanelItem && UpdateElementPosition(childElements[i] as CarouselPanelItem, num, 0.0, attractionFactor, scrollInProgress, scrollingHigher))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag && ScrollInProgress)
			{
				StopAnimatedScrollProcessing();
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				DoArrangeProcessing(_previousArrangeSize, forceArrangeOfAllItems: false);
			}
		}

		private void DoArrangeProcessing(System.Windows.Size finalSize, bool forceArrangeOfAllItems)
		{
			_previousArrangeSize = finalSize;
			System.Windows.Size wrapperSize = WrapperSize;
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			int num = 0;
			int totalItemCount = TotalItemCount;
			int itemsPerPageResolved = ItemsPerPageResolved;
			if (base.IsItemsHost && ShouldGenerateElements)
			{
				num = GenerateElementsHelper((int)ScrollingData._offset.Y, itemsPerPageResolved, null, 0);
				if (num > 0 && totalItemCount > 0)
				{
					ShouldGenerateElements = false;
				}
			}
			if (!ScrollInProgress)
			{
				RecalculateCurrentItemLocations();
			}
			bool flag = viewSettingsInternal.ShouldScrollItemsIntoInitialPosition && ((base.IsItemsHost && num > 0) || !base.IsItemsHost);
			IList childElements = base.ChildElements;
			int count = childElements.Count;
			if (count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num2 = GetItemIndexFromChildIndex(0);
			if (base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(this);
				for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
				{
					if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(this, i) is UIElement uIElement && !childElements.Contains(uIElement))
					{
						uIElement.Opacity = 0.0;
					}
				}
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num3 < count)
			{
				if (!(childElements[num3] is CarouselPanelItem carouselPanelItem))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_12"));
				}
				if (flag && !_initialArrangeAnimationDone)
				{
					carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent = 0.0;
				}
				else if (carouselPanelItem.IsPathLocationUnset)
				{
					int num4 = num3 - FirstVisibleChildIndex;
					if (num4 >= 0 && num4 < itemsPerPageResolved)
					{
						carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent = VisiblePositionPercentLocations[num4];
					}
					else
					{
						carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent = 0.0;
					}
				}
				double pathLocationPercent = carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent;
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point tangent = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				try
				{
					double num5 = Math.Round(pathLocationPercent, 4);
					if (PathFractionPointsCache.ContainsKey(num5))
					{
						PathFractionPoint pathFractionPoint = PathFractionPointsCache[num5];
						point = pathFractionPoint.Point;
						tangent = pathFractionPoint.TangentPoint;
					}
					else
					{
						ItemPathGeometry.GetPointAtFractionLength(num5, out point, out tangent);
						PathFractionPoint pathFractionPoint = new PathFractionPoint(point, tangent);
						PathFractionPointsCache.Add(num5, pathFractionPoint);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					point = carouselPanelItem.CurrentLocation;
				}
				carouselPanelItem.Width = wrapperSize.Width;
				carouselPanelItem.Height = wrapperSize.Height;
				if (!carouselPanelItem.IsMeasureValid)
				{
					carouselPanelItem.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				}
				if (carouselPanelItem.NeedsArrange || !carouselPanelItem.IsArrangeValid)
				{
					carouselPanelItem.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), wrapperSize));
					carouselPanelItem.NeedsArrange = false;
				}
				UpdateFirstAndLastItemPropertiesOnChild(carouselPanelItem, num2, totalItemCount);
				carouselPanelItem.CurrentLocation = point;
				ApplyEffectsToItem(carouselPanelItem, pathLocationPercent, tangent);
				num3++;
				num2++;
			}
			if (flag && !_initialArrangeAnimationDone && count > 0)
			{
				double num6 = ScrollOffsetForInitialArrangeAnimation + Math.Max(Math.Min((double)count - 1.0, itemsPerPageResolved - 1), 1.0);
				ScrollingData._offset = new Vector(num6, num6);
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle, new MethodDelegate(PerformInitialArrangeAnimation));
			}
			SetZOrder();
		}

		private int FirstVisibleItemIndexFromLastVisibleItemIndex(int lastVisibleItemIndex)
		{
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			int num = lastVisibleItemIndex - ItemsPerPageResolved + 1;
			if (viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous)
			{
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				int num2 = Math.Abs(num);
				return TotalItemCount - num2;
			}
			return Math.Max(0, num);
		}

		private int GenerateElements(int firstItemIndexToGenerate, int totalElementsToGenerate)
		{
			if (!base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			int childIndex = 0;
			int i = firstItemIndexToGenerate;
			int num = 0;
			GeneratorPosition generatorPositionFromItemIndex = GetGeneratorPositionFromItemIndex(firstItemIndexToGenerate, out childIndex);
			IItemContainerGenerator activeItemContainerGenerator = base.ActiveItemContainerGenerator;
			using (activeItemContainerGenerator.StartAt(generatorPositionFromItemIndex, GeneratorDirection.Forward, allowStartAtRealizedItem: true))
			{
				for (int totalItemCount = TotalItemCount; i < totalItemCount; i++)
				{
					if (num >= totalElementsToGenerate)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (i >= 0)
					{
						if (!(activeItemContainerGenerator.GenerateNext(out var isNewlyRealized) is UIElement uIElement))
						{
							break;
						}
						num++;
						if (isNewlyRealized)
						{
							int index = childIndex;
							if (childIndex >= base.InternalChildren.Count)
							{
								AddInternalChild(uIElement);
								index = VisualChildrenCount - 1;
							}
							else
							{
								InsertInternalChild(childIndex, uIElement);
							}
							activeItemContainerGenerator.PrepareItemContainer(uIElement);
							OnNewElementRealized(uIElement, index);
						}
						if (uIElement is CarouselListBoxItem)
						{
							((CarouselListBoxItem)uIElement).IndexOfItem = i;
						}
					}
					childIndex++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GenerateElementsHelper(int firstItemIndex1, int totalElements1, int? firstItemIndex2, int totalElements2)
		{
			ScrollDirection scrollDirection = ScrollDirection.Increment;
			if (ScrollInProgress)
			{
				scrollDirection = ((!_scrollActionInfo.ScrollingHigher) ? ScrollDirection.Decrement : ScrollDirection.Increment);
			}
			BeginGeneration(scrollDirection);
			int num = GenerateElementsHelperPrivate(firstItemIndex1, totalElements1);
			if (firstItemIndex2.HasValue)
			{
				num += GenerateElementsHelperPrivate(firstItemIndex2.Value, totalElements2);
			}
			EndGeneration();
			return num;
		}

		private int GenerateElementsHelperPrivate(int firstItemIndexToGenerate, int totalElementsToGenerate)
		{
			if (!GetIsListWrapping(firstItemIndexToGenerate))
			{
				return GenerateElements(firstItemIndexToGenerate, totalElementsToGenerate);
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = TotalItemCount - firstItemIndexToGenerate;
			num = GenerateElements(firstItemIndexToGenerate, num2);
			if (num < totalElementsToGenerate)
			{
				num += GenerateElements(0, ItemsPerPageResolved - num2);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private GeneratorPosition GetGeneratorPositionFromItemIndex(int itemIndex, out int childIndex)
		{
			if (!base.IsItemsHost)
			{
				childIndex = 0;
				return new GeneratorPosition(-1, itemIndex + 1);
			}
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			GeneratorPosition result = base.ActiveItemContainerGenerator?.GeneratorPositionFromIndex(itemIndex) ?? new GeneratorPosition(-1, itemIndex + 1);
			childIndex = ((result.Offset == 0) ? result.Index : (result.Index + 1));
			return result;
		}

		private bool GetIsItemIndexInLastVisiblePosition(int itemIndex, double scrollOffset)
		{
			int num = (((int)scrollOffset < 0) ? (itemIndex + Math.Abs((int)scrollOffset)) : (itemIndex - (int)scrollOffset));
			return num == ItemsPerPageResolved - 1;
		}

		private bool GetIsListWrapping(int scrollOffset)
		{
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			if (!viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int itemsPerPageResolved = ItemsPerPageResolved;
			if (TotalItemCount == itemsPerPageResolved)
			{
				if (scrollOffset != 0 && scrollOffset % itemsPerPageResolved != 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (TotalItemCount < itemsPerPageResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return TotalItemCount - scrollOffset < itemsPerPageResolved;
		}

		private int GetLastVisibleItemIndex(int scrollOffset)
		{
			return LastVisibleItemIndexFromFirstVisibleItemIndex(scrollOffset);
		}

		private double GetPrefixAreaPenetrationPercent(double pathPositionPercentage, CarouselViewSettings viewSettings)
		{
			if (viewSettings.ItemPathPrefixPercent == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return pathPositionPercentage / viewSettings.ItemPathPrefixPercent;
		}

		private bool GetShouldPositionItemAtEndOfPath(int itemIndex, int scrollOffset, bool itemVisibleBeforeScroll, bool itemVisibleAfterScroll)
		{
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			if (!viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous)
			{
				return itemIndex >= scrollOffset + ItemsPerPageResolved;
			}
			if (GetIsItemIndexVisible(itemIndex, scrollOffset))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ScrollInProgress)
			{
				if (!_scrollActionInfo.ScrollingHigher && itemVisibleBeforeScroll)
				{
					return !itemVisibleAfterScroll;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return itemIndex > GetLastVisibleItemIndex(scrollOffset);
		}

		private bool GetShouldPositionItemAtBeginningOfPath(int itemIndex, int scrollOffset, bool itemVisibleBeforeScroll, bool itemVisibleAfterScroll)
		{
			if (!ViewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous)
			{
				return itemIndex < scrollOffset;
			}
			if (GetIsItemIndexVisible(itemIndex, scrollOffset))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ScrollInProgress)
			{
				if (_scrollActionInfo.ScrollingHigher && itemVisibleBeforeScroll)
				{
					return !itemVisibleAfterScroll;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return itemIndex < scrollOffset;
		}

		private double GetSuffixAreaPenetrationPercent(double pathPositionPercentage, CarouselViewSettings viewSettings)
		{
			if (viewSettings.ItemPathSuffixPercent == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return (1.0 - pathPositionPercentage) / viewSettings.ItemPathSuffixPercent;
		}

		private int GetVisiblePositionFromItemIndex(int itemIndex, int scrollOffset)
		{
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			int itemsPerPageResolved = ItemsPerPageResolved;
			if (!GetIsListWrapping(scrollOffset))
			{
				int num = itemIndex - scrollOffset;
				if (num < 0 || num >= itemsPerPageResolved)
				{
					return -1;
				}
			}
			int num2 = TotalItemCount - scrollOffset;
			if (itemIndex >= scrollOffset && itemIndex < scrollOffset + num2)
			{
				return itemIndex - scrollOffset;
			}
			int num3 = num2 + GetChildIndexFromItemIndex(itemIndex);
			if (num3 >= itemsPerPageResolved)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return num3;
		}

		private void InitializeAdorner()
		{
			if (_carouselPanelAdorner == null)
			{
				_carouselPanelAdorner = new CarouselPanelAdorner(this);
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
				binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
				binding.Source = this;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath("IsVisible");
				binding.Converter = new BooleanToVisibilityConverter();
				_carouselPanelAdorner.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, binding);
				binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
				binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
				binding.Source = this;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath("IsEnabled");
				_carouselPanelAdorner.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, binding);
				binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
				binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
				binding.Source = this;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath("Opacity");
				_carouselPanelAdorner.SetBinding(UIElement.OpacityProperty, binding);
				AddAdornerChildElement(CarouselPanelNavigator);
				AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(this)?.Add(_carouselPanelAdorner);
			}
		}

		private bool InPathPrefixArea(double pathPositionPercentage, CarouselViewSettings viewSettings)
		{
			return pathPositionPercentage < viewSettings.ItemPathPrefixPercent;
		}

		private bool InPathSuffixArea(double pathPositionPercentage, CarouselViewSettings viewSettings)
		{
			return pathPositionPercentage > 1.0 - viewSettings.ItemPathSuffixPercent;
		}

		private int LastVisibleItemIndexFromFirstVisibleItemIndex(int scrollOffset)
		{
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			int num = scrollOffset + ItemsPerPageResolved - 1;
			if (viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous)
			{
				if (num < TotalItemCount)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return num - TotalItemCount - 1;
			}
			return Math.Min(TotalItemCount, num);
		}

		private void OnChildrenCollectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ScrollInProgress)
			{
				StopAnimatedScrollProcessing();
			}
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Unloaded -= OnUnloaded;
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			_wasLoaded = true;
			RemoveAdornerChildElement(CarouselPanelNavigator);
			AdornerLayer adornerLayer = AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(this);
			if (adornerLayer != null && _carouselPanelAdorner != null)
			{
				adornerLayer.Remove(_carouselPanelAdorner);
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Loaded -= OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
			ShouldGenerateElements = true;
			InvalidateMeasure();
			UpdateLayout();
			if (!_wasLoaded)
			{
				return;
			}
			_wasLoaded = false;
			AdornerLayer adornerLayer = AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(this);
			if (adornerLayer != null)
			{
				Adorner[] adorners = adornerLayer.GetAdorners(this);
				if (adorners == null || (adorners.GetLength(0) > 0 && adorners[0] != _carouselPanelAdorner))
				{
					adornerLayer.Add(_carouselPanelAdorner);
				}
			}
			AddAdornerChildElement(CarouselPanelNavigator);
		}

		private void OnViewSettingsPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BumpCarouselViewSettingsVersion();
			switch (e.PropertyName)
			{
			case "ShouldScrollItemsIntoInitialPosition":
				_scrollOffsetForInitialArrangeAnimation = 0.0;
				break;
			case "IsListContinuous":
				UpdateCanNavigateStatus();
				InvalidateArrange();
				break;
			case "ItemSize":
				_wrapperSizeDirty = true;
				InvalidateArrange();
				break;
			case "ItemPathPrefixPercent":
			case "ItemPathSuffixPercent":
				RecalculateCurrentItemLocations();
				InvalidateArrange();
				break;
			case "AutoScaleItemContentsToFit":
			case "ItemHorizontalScrollBarVisibility":
			case "ItemVerticalScrollBarVisibility":
				InvalidateArrange();
				break;
			case "UseZOrder":
			case "ZOrderEffectStopDirection":
			case "ZOrderEffectStops":
			case "OpacityEffectStops":
			case "OpacityEffectStopDirection":
			case "ScalingEffectStops":
			case "ScalingEffectStopDirection":
			case "SkewAngleXEffectStops":
			case "SkewAngleXEffectStopDirection":
			case "SkewAngleYEffectStops":
			case "SkewAngleYEffectStopDirection":
			case "UseOpacity":
			case "UseScaling":
			case "UseSkewing":
				InvalidateArrange();
				break;
			case "ItemPath":
				_itemPathGeometry = null;
				InvalidateVisual();
				InvalidateMeasure();
				UpdateLayout();
				break;
			case "ItemPathRenderBrush":
				_cachedItemPathRenderBrush = ViewSettingsInternal.ItemPathRenderBrush;
				InvalidateVisual();
				break;
			case "ItemPathRenderPen":
				_cachedItemPathRenderPen = ViewSettingsInternal.ItemPathRenderPen;
				InvalidateVisual();
				break;
			case "ItemPathAutoPad":
			case "ItemPathHorizontalAlignment":
			case "ItemPathPadding":
			case "ItemPathStretch":
			case "ItemPathVerticalAlignment":
			case "RotateItemsWithPathTangent":
				InvalidateMeasure();
				break;
			case "ReserveSpaceForReflections":
				_wrapperSizeDirty = true;
				_visiblePositionPercentValuesDirty = true;
				SetValue(ReflectionVisibilityPropertyKey, (!ViewSettingsInternal.ReserveSpaceForReflections) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				InvalidateMeasure();
				break;
			case "ItemsPerPage":
			{
				if (ScrollInProgress)
				{
					StopAnimatedScrollProcessing();
				}
				ShouldGenerateElements = true;
				int itemsPerPageResolved = ItemsPerPageResolved;
				UpdateScrollData(ScrollingData._extent, new System.Windows.Size(itemsPerPageResolved, itemsPerPageResolved), ScrollingData._offset);
				RecalculateCurrentItemLocations();
				InvalidateMeasure();
				break;
			}
			case "CarouselPanelNavigatorStyle":
				CarouselPanelNavigator.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				if (ViewSettingsInternal.CarouselPanelNavigatorStyle != null)
				{
					CarouselPanelNavigator.Style = ViewSettingsInternal.CarouselPanelNavigatorStyle;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

			SetZOrder();
		}

		private void PerformInitialArrangeAnimation()
		{
			if (!_initialArrangeAnimationDone)
			{
				_initialArrangeAnimationDone = true;
				SetVerticalOffset(ScrollOffsetForInitialArrangeAnimation);
				_scrollOffsetForInitialArrangeAnimation = 0.0;
			}
		}

		private void RecalculateCurrentItemLocations()
		{
			_visiblePositionPercentValuesDirty = true;
			RecalculateVisiblePositionPercentValues();
			IList childElements = base.ChildElements;
			int count = childElements.Count;
			int scrollOffset = (int)ScrollingData._offset.Y;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (childElements[i] is CarouselPanelItem carouselPanelItem)
				{
					int itemIndexFromChildIndex = GetItemIndexFromChildIndex(i);
					carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent = CalculateChildTargetPct(i, itemIndexFromChildIndex, scrollOffset, itemVisibleBeforeScroll: true, itemVisibleAfterScroll: true);
					carouselPanelItem.NeedsArrange = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RecalculateVisiblePositionPercentValues()
		{
			if (_visiblePositionPercentValuesDirty)
			{
				CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
				int itemsPerPageResolved = ItemsPerPageResolved;
				_visiblePositionPercentValues = new double[itemsPerPageResolved];
				double itemPathPrefixPercent = viewSettingsInternal.ItemPathPrefixPercent;
				double num = 1.0 - viewSettingsInternal.ItemPathSuffixPercent;
				double num2 = num - itemPathPrefixPercent;
				if (itemsPerPageResolved - 1 < 0)
				{
					_distanceBetweenVisiblePositions = num2;
				}
				else
				{
					_distanceBetweenVisiblePositions = num2 / (double)(itemsPerPageResolved - 1);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < itemsPerPageResolved; i++)
				{
					_visiblePositionPercentValues[i] = itemPathPrefixPercent + (double)i * _distanceBetweenVisiblePositions;
				}
				_firstVisiblePositionPercentLocation = _visiblePositionPercentValues[0];
				_lastVisiblePositionPercentLocation = _visiblePositionPercentValues[itemsPerPageResolved - 1];
				_visiblePositionPercentValuesDirty = false;
			}
		}

		private void RemoveRangeOfChldren(GeneratorPosition position, int count)
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved == ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle || base.Children == null || count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = position.Index;
			if (position.Offset > 0)
			{
				num += position.Offset;
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				int count2 = base.ChildElements.Count;
				if (num < count2)
				{
					RemoveInternalChildRange(num, Math.Min(count, count2 - num));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ScaleItemPath(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			ItemPathGeometry.Transform = null;
			Rect rect = new Rect(ItemPathGeometry.Bounds.Left, ItemPathGeometry.Bounds.Top, (ItemPathGeometry.Bounds.Width == 0.0) ? 1.0 : ItemPathGeometry.Bounds.Width, (ItemPathGeometry.Bounds.Height == 0.0) ? 1.0 : ItemPathGeometry.Bounds.Height);
			Thickness thickness = viewSettingsInternal.ItemPathPadding;
			if (viewSettingsInternal.ItemPathAutoPad)
			{
				System.Windows.Size itemSize = viewSettingsInternal.ItemSize;
				thickness = new Thickness(thickness.Left + itemSize.Width / 2.0, thickness.Top + itemSize.Height / 2.0, thickness.Right + itemSize.Width / 2.0, thickness.Bottom + itemSize.Height / 2.0);
			}
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(0.0 + thickness.Left, 0.0 + thickness.Top, Math.Max(availableSize.Width - (thickness.Left + thickness.Right), 0.0), Math.Max(availableSize.Height - (thickness.Top + thickness.Bottom), 0.0));
			double num = rect2.Width / rect.Width;
			double num2 = rect2.Height / rect.Height;
			switch (viewSettingsInternal.ItemPathStretch)
			{
			case Stretch.None:
				num = (num2 = 1.0);
				break;
			case Stretch.Uniform:
				num = (num2 = Math.Min(num, num2));
				break;
			case Stretch.UniformToFill:
				num = (num2 = Math.Max(num, num2));
				break;
			}
			double num3 = 0.0 - num * rect.Left;
			double num4 = 0.0 - num2 * rect.Top;
			double num5 = ((ItemPathGeometry.Bounds.Width == 0.0) ? 1.0 : (rect.Width * num));
			double num6 = ((ItemPathGeometry.Bounds.Height == 0.0) ? 1.0 : (rect.Height * num2));
			switch (viewSettingsInternal.ItemPathHorizontalAlignment)
			{
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center:
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch:
				num3 += thickness.Left + (rect2.Width - num5) / 2.0;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left:
				num3 += thickness.Left;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right:
				num3 += thickness.Left + (rect2.Width - num5);
				break;
			}
			switch (viewSettingsInternal.ItemPathVerticalAlignment)
			{
			case VerticalAlignment.Center:
			case VerticalAlignment.Stretch:
				num4 += thickness.Top + (rect2.Height - num6) / 2.0;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Top:
				num4 += thickness.Top;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
				num4 += thickness.Top + (rect2.Height - num6);
				break;
			}
			ItemPathGeometry.Transform = new MatrixTransform(new Matrix(num, 0.0, 0.0, num2, num3, num4));
		}

		private static double SecondsFromTicks(long ticks)
		{
			return (double)ticks / 10000000.0;
		}

		private void SetZOrder()
		{
			IList childElements = base.ChildElements;
			int count = childElements.Count;
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			if (!viewSettingsInternal.UseZOrder)
			{
				int num = Math.Max(0, GetChildIndexFromItemIndex((int)ScrollingData._offset.Y));
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = -1;
				int num4 = num;
				while (num2 < count && num4 < count)
				{
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = childElements[num4] as DependencyObject;
					int num5 = (int)dependencyObject.GetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty);
					if (num5 <= num3)
					{
						num5 = num3 + 1;
						dependencyObject.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty, num5);
					}
					num3 = num5;
					num2++;
					if (num2 < count && viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous && num4 == count - 1)
					{
						num4 = -1;
					}
					num4++;
				}
				return;
			}
			List<int> list = new List<int>(count);
			System.Windows.Size size;
			if (_previousArrangeSize != System.Windows.Size.Empty)
			{
				size = _previousArrangeSize;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(_previousMeasureSize != System.Windows.Size.Empty))
				{
					return;
				}
				size = _previousMeasureSize;
			}
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height);
			EffectStopDirection zOrderEffectStopDirectionResolved = ZOrderEffectStopDirectionResolved;
			ZOrderEffectStopCollection zOrderEffectStopsResolved = ZOrderEffectStopsResolved;
			int count2;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (!(childElements[i] is CarouselPanelItem { Opacity: 0 } carouselPanelItem))
				{
					continue;
				}
				double num6 = (carouselPanelItem.CurrentZindexEffectStopValue = zOrderEffectStopDirectionResolved switch
				{
					EffectStopDirection.Vertical => zOrderEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromRange(rect.Top, rect.Bottom, (int)carouselPanelItem.CurrentLocation.Y), 
					EffectStopDirection.Horizontal => zOrderEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromRange(rect.Left, rect.Right, (int)carouselPanelItem.CurrentLocation.X), 
					_ => zOrderEffectStopsResolved.GetStopValueFromOffset(carouselPanelItem.PathLocationPercent), 
				});
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					list.Add(i);
					continue;
				}
				count2 = list.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
				{
					if (num6 <= ((CarouselPanelItem)childElements[list[j]]).CurrentZindexEffectStopValue)
					{
						list.Insert(j, i);
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					list.Add(i);
				}
			}
			count2 = list.Count;
			for (int k = 0; k < count2; k++)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = childElements[list[k]] as DependencyObject;
				if ((int)dependencyObject2.GetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty) != k)
				{
					dependencyObject2.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty, k);
				}
			}
		}

		private void StartAnimatedScrollProcessing(ScrollActionInfo scrollActionInfo)
		{
			_scrollActionInfo = scrollActionInfo;
			if (_renderingEventProxy == null)
			{
				_renderingEventProxy = new RenderingEventProxy(this);
			}
			_renderingEventProxy.WireRenderingEvent();
		}

		private void StopAnimatedScrollProcessing()
		{
			_scrollActionInfo = ScrollActionInfo.Empty;
			if (_renderingEventProxy != null)
			{
				_renderingEventProxy.UnwireRenderingEvent();
			}
			OnAnimatedScrollComplete((int)ScrollingData._offset.Y);
			TriggerCleanupOfUnusedGeneratedItems(useDelay: false);
		}

		private static bool UpdateElementPosition(CarouselPanelItem element, double secondsSinceLastFrameRender, double dampening, double attractionFactor, bool scrollInProgress, bool scrollingHigher)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double pathTargetPercent = element.PathTargetPercent;
			double pathLocationPercent = element.PathLocationPercent;
			if (pathLocationPercent == pathTargetPercent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double velocity = element.Velocity;
			double num = 0.0;
			num = ((!scrollInProgress) ? (pathTargetPercent - pathLocationPercent) : (scrollingHigher ? ((!(pathLocationPercent > pathTargetPercent)) ? 0.0 : (pathTargetPercent - pathLocationPercent)) : ((!(pathTargetPercent > pathLocationPercent)) ? 0.0 : (pathTargetPercent - pathLocationPercent))));
			if (Math.Abs(num) > 0.0004)
			{
				velocity *= dampening;
				velocity += num;
				double num2 = velocity * secondsSinceLastFrameRender * attractionFactor;
				num2 *= ((num2 > 0.09) ? (0.09 / num2) : 1.0);
				pathLocationPercent += num2;
				pathLocationPercent = Math.Max(Math.Min(pathLocationPercent, 1.0), 0.0);
				element.PathLocationPercent = pathLocationPercent;
				element.Velocity = velocity;
				return true;
			}
			if (pathLocationPercent != pathTargetPercent)
			{
				pathLocationPercent = pathTargetPercent;
				element.PathLocationPercent = pathLocationPercent;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void UpdateFirstAndLastItemPropertiesOnChild(CarouselPanelItem child, int childsItemIndex, int totalItemCount)
		{
			if (child != null)
			{
				child.SetValue(CarouselPanelItem.IsFirstItemPropertyKey, childsItemIndex == 0);
				child.SetValue(CarouselPanelItem.IsLastItemPropertyKey, childsItemIndex == totalItemCount - 1);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateScrollData(System.Windows.Size newExtent, System.Windows.Size newViewport, Vector newOffset)
		{
			if (ScrollingData._extent != newExtent || ScrollingData._viewport != newViewport || ScrollingData._offset != newOffset)
			{
				ScrollingData._extent = newExtent;
				ScrollingData._viewport = newViewport;
				ScrollingData._offset = newOffset;
				SetValue(FirstVisibleItemIndexPropertyKey, (int)Math.Max(newOffset.Y, 0.0));
				UpdateCanNavigateStatus();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCanNavigateStatus()
		{
			CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = ViewSettingsInternal;
			bool flag = ScrollingData._offset.Y > LowestPossibleScrollOffset || viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous;
			bool flag2 = ScrollingData._offset.Y < HighestPossibleScrollOffset || viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous;
			if (viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous)
			{
				if (TotalItemCount > 1)
				{
					SetValue(CanNavigateToPreviousItemPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					SetValue(CanNavigateToNextItemPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					int itemsPerPageResolved = ItemsPerPageResolved;
					int totalItemCount = TotalItemCount;
					SetValue(CanNavigateToPreviousPagePropertyKey, itemsPerPageResolved != totalItemCount);
					SetValue(CanNavigateToNextPagePropertyKey, itemsPerPageResolved != totalItemCount);
				}
				else
				{
					SetValue(CanNavigateToPreviousItemPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
					SetValue(CanNavigateToNextItemPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
					SetValue(CanNavigateToPreviousPagePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
					SetValue(CanNavigateToNextPagePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (flag && !CanNavigateToPreviousItem)
			{
				SetValue(CanNavigateToPreviousItemPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			else if (!flag && CanNavigateToPreviousItem)
			{
				SetValue(CanNavigateToPreviousItemPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			}
			if (flag2 && !CanNavigateToNextItem)
			{
				SetValue(CanNavigateToNextItemPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			else if (!flag2 && CanNavigateToNextItem)
			{
				SetValue(CanNavigateToNextItemPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			}
			if (flag && !CanNavigateToPreviousPage)
			{
				SetValue(CanNavigateToPreviousPagePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			else if (!flag && CanNavigateToPreviousPage)
			{
				SetValue(CanNavigateToPreviousPagePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			}
			if (flag2 && !CanNavigateToNextPage)
			{
				SetValue(CanNavigateToNextPagePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			else if (!flag2 && CanNavigateToNextPage)
			{
				SetValue(CanNavigateToNextPagePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			}
		}

		internal static Transform FindTransform(Transform renderTransform, Type transformTypeToFind)
		{
			if (renderTransform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = renderTransform.GetType();
			if (type == transformTypeToFind)
			{
				return renderTransform;
			}
			if (type == typeof(TransformGroup))
			{
				TransformGroup transformGroup = renderTransform as TransformGroup;
				TransformCollection children = transformGroup.Children;
				int count = children.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					Transform transform = children[i];
					if (transform.GetType() == transformTypeToFind)
					{
						return transform;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool ReplaceTransform(UIElement element, Transform newTransform)
		{
			if (element.RenderTransform == null)
			{
				element.RenderTransform = newTransform;
				return true;
			}
			Type type = element.RenderTransform.GetType();
			Type type2 = newTransform.GetType();
			if (type == type2)
			{
				element.RenderTransform = newTransform;
				return true;
			}
			if (type == typeof(TransformGroup))
			{
				TransformGroup transformGroup = element.RenderTransform as TransformGroup;
				TransformCollection children = transformGroup.Children;
				int count = children.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (children[i].GetType() == type2)
					{
						children[i] = newTransform;
						return true;
					}
				}
				children.Add(newTransform);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

	public abstract class EffectStopCollection<T> : INotifyPropertyChanged, INotifyCollectionChanged, IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, IList, ICollection where T : EffectStop
	{
		private List<T> _list = new List<T>(3);

		private int _listVersion;

		private int _listSortVersion = -1;

		private List<T> _sortedList;

		private double _stopValueForBottomOfRange;

		private int _stopValueForBottomOfRangeVersion = -1;

		private double _stopValueForTopOfRange = 1.0;

		private int _stopValueForTopOfRangeVersion = -1;

		private bool _changeNotificationsSuspended;

		private bool _changesMadeWhileNotificationsSuspended;

		private PropertyChangedEventHandler _propertyChangedHandler;

		private NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler _collectionChangedHandler;

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _list[index];
			}
			set
			{
				_list[index] = value;
				BumpListVersion(fullReset: false);
			}
		}

		public int Count => _list.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => false;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _list[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (index < _list.Count)
				{
					_list[index].PropertyChanged -= OnEffectStopPropertyChanged;
					_list[index] = value as T;
					_list[index].PropertyChanged += OnEffectStopPropertyChanged;
					BumpListVersion(fullReset: false);
				}
			}
		}

		int ICollection.Count => _list.Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => this;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged
		{
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.Synchronized)]
			add
			{
				_collectionChangedHandler = Delegate.Combine(_collectionChangedHandler, value) as NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler;
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.Synchronized)]
			remove
			{
				_collectionChangedHandler = Delegate.Remove(_collectionChangedHandler, value) as NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler;
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged
		{
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.Synchronized)]
			add
			{
				_propertyChangedHandler = Delegate.Combine(_propertyChangedHandler, value) as PropertyChangedEventHandler;
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.Synchronized)]
			remove
			{
				_propertyChangedHandler = Delegate.Remove(_propertyChangedHandler, value) as PropertyChangedEventHandler;
			}
		}

		public void ReplaceAll(EffectStopCollection<T> newEffectStopCollection)
		{
			_list.Clear();
			_list.AddRange(newEffectStopCollection);
			BumpListVersion(fullReset: true);
		}

		public void ResumeChangeNotifications(bool fullReset)
		{
			if (_changeNotificationsSuspended)
			{
				_changeNotificationsSuspended = false;
				if (_changesMadeWhileNotificationsSuspended)
				{
					_listVersion++;
					RaiseChangeEvents(fullReset);
					_changesMadeWhileNotificationsSuspended = false;
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return _list.Count > 0;
		}

		public void SuspendChangeNotifications()
		{
			_changeNotificationsSuspended = true;
			_changesMadeWhileNotificationsSuspended = true;
		}

		private void BumpListVersion(bool fullReset)
		{
			if (_changeNotificationsSuspended)
			{
				_changesMadeWhileNotificationsSuspended = true;
				return;
			}
			RaiseChangeEvents(fullReset);
			_listVersion++;
		}

		private double GetStopValueForTopOfRange()
		{
			VerifyIsSorted();
			if (_stopValueForTopOfRangeVersion != _listVersion)
			{
				if (_sortedList.Count == 0)
				{
					_stopValueForTopOfRange = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					_stopValueForTopOfRange = _sortedList[_sortedList.Count - 1].Value;
				}
				_stopValueForTopOfRangeVersion = _listVersion;
			}
			return _stopValueForTopOfRange;
		}

		private double GetStopValueForBottomOfRange()
		{
			VerifyIsSorted();
			if (_stopValueForBottomOfRangeVersion != _listVersion)
			{
				if (_sortedList.Count == 0)
				{
					_stopValueForBottomOfRange = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					_stopValueForBottomOfRange = _sortedList[0].Value;
				}
				_stopValueForBottomOfRangeVersion = _listVersion;
			}
			return _stopValueForBottomOfRange;
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, object item, int index)
		{
			if (_collectionChangedHandler != null)
			{
				if (item is IList)
				{
					_collectionChangedHandler(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(action, (IList)item, index));
				}
				else
				{
					_collectionChangedHandler(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(action, item, index));
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnEffectStopPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (_propertyChangedHandler != null)
			{
				_propertyChangedHandler(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseChangeEvents(bool fullReset)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("Count");
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			if (fullReset)
			{
				OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset, null, -1);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyIsSorted()
		{
			if (_listSortVersion != _listVersion)
			{
				int count = _list.Count;
				_sortedList = new List<T>(count);
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					_sortedList.Add(_list[i]);
				}
				_sortedList.Sort();
				_listSortVersion = _listVersion;
			}
		}

		internal double GetStopValueFromOffset(double offset)
		{
			VerifyIsSorted();
			List<T> sortedList = _sortedList;
			int count = sortedList.Count;
			EffectStop effectStop = sortedList[0];
			EffectStop effectStop2 = sortedList[count - 1];
			if (offset <= effectStop.Offset)
			{
				return effectStop.Value;
			}
			if (offset >= effectStop2.Offset)
			{
				return effectStop2.Value;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				EffectStop effectStop3 = sortedList[i];
				if (offset <= effectStop3.Offset)
				{
					EffectStop effectStop4 = sortedList[i - 1];
					double offset2 = effectStop4.Offset;
					double offset3 = effectStop3.Offset;
					double num = (offset - offset2) / (offset3 - offset2);
					double value = effectStop4.Value;
					double value2 = effectStop3.Value;
					return value + num * (value2 - value);
				}
			}
			return effectStop2.Value;
		}

		internal double GetStopValueFromRange(double rangeLowValue, double rangeHighValue, double valueToEvaluate)
		{
			if (rangeHighValue <= rangeLowValue)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (valueToEvaluate < rangeLowValue)
			{
				valueToEvaluate = rangeLowValue;
			}
			else if (valueToEvaluate > rangeHighValue)
			{
				valueToEvaluate = rangeHighValue;
			}
			if (valueToEvaluate == rangeLowValue)
			{
				return GetStopValueForBottomOfRange();
			}
			if (valueToEvaluate == rangeHighValue)
			{
				return GetStopValueForTopOfRange();
			}
			List<T> list = _list;
			int count = list.Count;
			if (count < 1)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (count == 1)
			{
				return list[0].Value;
			}
			return GetStopValueFromOffset((valueToEvaluate - rangeLowValue) / (rangeHighValue - rangeLowValue));
		}

		public int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			return _list.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			_list.Insert(index, item);
			BumpListVersion(fullReset: false);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			_list.RemoveAt(index);
			BumpListVersion(fullReset: false);
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			_list.Add(item);
			BumpListVersion(fullReset: false);
			item.PropertyChanged += OnEffectStopPropertyChanged;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			foreach (T item in _list)
			{
				item.PropertyChanged -= OnEffectStopPropertyChanged;
			}
			_list.Clear();
			BumpListVersion(fullReset: true);
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return _list.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_list.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			BumpListVersion(fullReset: false);
			item.PropertyChanged -= OnEffectStopPropertyChanged;
			return _list.Remove(item);
		}

		IEnumerator<T> IEnumerable<T>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _list.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _list.GetEnumerator();
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			T item = value as T;
			Add(item);
			return _list.IndexOf(item);
		}

		void IList.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value as T);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return _list.IndexOf(value as T);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			T val = value as T;
			Insert(index, val);
			BumpListVersion(fullReset: false);
			val.PropertyChanged += OnEffectStopPropertyChanged;
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			Remove(value as T);
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < _list.Count)
			{
				_list[index].PropertyChanged -= OnEffectStopPropertyChanged;
			}
			_list.RemoveAt(index);
			BumpListVersion(fullReset: false);
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			((ICollection)_list).CopyTo(array, index);
		}
	}

	public abstract class EffectStop : DependencyObjectNotifier, IComparable
	{
		private double _cachedOffset;

		private double _cachedValue;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Offset", typeof(double), typeof(EffectStop), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, OnOffsetChanged), OnValidateOffset);

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(double), typeof(EffectStop), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, OnValueChanged, OnCoerceValue));

		[Bindable(true)]
		public double Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return _cachedOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OffsetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public double Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _cachedValue;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected EffectStop()
		{
		}

		protected EffectStop(double offset, double value)
		{
			SetValue(OffsetProperty, Math.Max(Math.Min(offset, 1.0), 0.0));
			SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			RaisePropertyChangedEvent(e.Property.Name);
		}

		private static void OnOffsetChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is EffectStop effectStop)
			{
				effectStop._cachedOffset = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		private static bool OnValidateOffset(object value)
		{
			if ((double)value < 0.0 || (double)value > 1.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void OnValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is EffectStop effectStop)
			{
				effectStop._cachedValue = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		private static object OnCoerceValue(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			if (d is ScalingEffectStop)
			{
				if ((double)value < 0.0 || (double)value > 10.0)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				return value;
			}
			if (d is ZOrderEffectStop)
			{
				if ((double)value < 0.0 || (double)value > 1.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return value;
			}
			if (d is SkewAngleXEffectStop)
			{
				if ((double)value < -360.0 || (double)value > 360.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return value;
			}
			if (d is SkewAngleYEffectStop)
			{
				if ((double)value < -360.0 || (double)value > 360.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return value;
			}
			if (d is OpacityEffectStop)
			{
				if ((double)value < 0.0 || (double)value > 1.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return value;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			EffectStop effectStop = (EffectStop)obj;
			if (Offset == effectStop.Offset)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (Offset < effectStop.Offset)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 1;
		}
	}

			_carouselPanel = carouselPanel;
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = null;
			binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay,
				Source = carouselPanel,
				Path = new PropertyPath("ViewSettingsVersion")
			};
			SetBinding(ViewSettingsVersionProperty, binding);
		}

		private static void OnViewSettingsVersionChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{

			{
				CarouselViewSettings viewSettingsInternal = carouselPanelItem.CarouselPanel.ViewSettingsInternal;
				if (viewSettingsInternal != null)
				{
					carouselPanelItem.SetValue(AutoScaleItemContentsToFitPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(viewSettingsInternal.AutoScaleItemContentsToFit));
					carouselPanelItem.SetValue(IsListContinuousPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(viewSettingsInternal.IsListContinuous));
					carouselPanelItem.SetValue(ItemHorizontalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(viewSettingsInternal.ItemHorizontalScrollBarVisibility));
					carouselPanelItem.SetValue(ItemVerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(viewSettingsInternal.ItemVerticalScrollBarVisibility));
				}
			}

		internal bool UpdateTransforms(Matrix newMatrix, double newSkewAngleX, double newSkewAngleY, double newSkewCenterX, double newSkewCenterY)
		{
			EnsureTransforms();
			bool result = false;
			if (_matrixTransform.Matrix != newMatrix)
			{
				_matrixTransform.Matrix = newMatrix;
				result = true;
			}
			if (_skewTransform.AngleX != newSkewAngleX)
			{
				_skewTransform.AngleX = newSkewAngleX;
				result = true;
			}
			if (_skewTransform.AngleY != newSkewAngleY)
			{
				_skewTransform.AngleY = newSkewAngleY;
				result = true;
			}
			if (!double.IsNegativeInfinity(newSkewCenterX) && _skewTransform.CenterX != newSkewCenterX)
			{
				_skewTransform.CenterX = newSkewCenterX;
				result = true;
			}
			if (!double.IsNegativeInfinity(newSkewCenterY) && _skewTransform.CenterY != newSkewCenterY)
			{
				_skewTransform.CenterY = newSkewCenterY;
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void EnsureTransforms()
		{
			if (!(base.RenderTransform is TransformGroup { Children: var children }) || children.Count <= 2 || !(children[0].GetType() == typeof(SkewTransform)) || !(children[1].GetType() == typeof(ScaleTransform)) || !(children[2].GetType() == typeof(MatrixTransform)) || _skewTransform != children[0] || _scaleTransform != children[1] || _matrixTransform != children[2])
			{
				TransformGroup transformGroup2 = new TransformGroup();
				_skewTransform = new SkewTransform();
				transformGroup2.Children.Add(_skewTransform);
				_scaleTransform = new ScaleTransform();
				transformGroup2.Children.Add(_scaleTransform);
				_matrixTransform = new MatrixTransform();
				transformGroup2.Children.Add(_matrixTransform);
				base.RenderTransform = transformGroup2;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class CarouselPanelUIElementCollection : UIElementCollection
	{
		private XamCarouselPanel _carouselPanel;

		internal XamCarouselPanel CarouselPanel => _carouselPanel;

		internal event EventHandler<EventArgs> CollectionChanged;

		public CarouselPanelUIElementCollection(XamCarouselPanel carouselPanel, UIElement visualParent, FrameworkElement logicalParent)
			: base(visualParent, logicalParent)
		{
			_carouselPanel = carouselPanel;
		}

		public override int Add(UIElement element)
		{
			if (CarouselPanel.IsInCarouselListBox)
			{
				CarouselListBoxItem carouselListBoxItem = new CarouselListBoxItem(CarouselPanel);
				carouselListBoxItem.Content = element;
				return base.Add(carouselListBoxItem);
			}
			CarouselPanelItem carouselPanelItem = new CarouselPanelItem(CarouselPanel);
			carouselPanelItem.Content = element;
			int result = base.Add(carouselPanelItem);
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
			return result;
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			base.Clear();
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
		}

		public override IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return base.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public override void Insert(int index, UIElement element)
		{
			base.Insert(index, element);
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
		}

		public override void Remove(UIElement element)
		{
			base.Remove(element);
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
		}

		public override void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			base.RemoveAt(index);
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
		}

		public override void RemoveRange(int index, int count)
		{
			base.RemoveRange(index, count);
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
		}

		private void RaiseCollectionChanged()
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "SortAscending", GroupName = "SortStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "SortDescending", GroupName = "SortStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Unsorted", GroupName = "SortStates")]
	public class SortIndicator : System.Windows.Controls.Button
	{
		private bool _hasVisualStateGroups;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SortStatusProperty;

		public static readonly RoutedEvent SortStatusChangedEvent;

		public SortStatus SortStatus
		{
			get
			{
				return (SortStatus)GetValue(SortStatusProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SortStatusProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<SortStatusChangedEventArgs> SortStatusChanged
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(SortStatusChangedEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(SortStatusChangedEvent, value);
			}
		}

		static SortIndicator()
		{
			SortStatusProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SortStatus", typeof(SortStatus), typeof(SortIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(SortStatus.NotSorted, OnSortStatusChanged));
			SortStatusChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("SortStatusChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<SortStatusChangedEventArgs>), typeof(SortIndicator));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(SortIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(SortIndicator)));
			UIElement.IsHitTestVisibleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(SortIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		private static void OnSortStatusChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is SortIndicator sortIndicator)
			{
				sortIndicator.OnSortStatusChanged((SortStatus)e.OldValue, (SortStatus)e.NewValue);
				sortIndicator.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSortStatusChanged(SortStatus previousValue, SortStatus currentValue)
		{
			SortStatusChangedEventArgs e = new SortStatusChangedEventArgs(previousValue, currentValue);
			e.RoutedEvent = SortStatusChangedEvent;
			e.Source = this;
			RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			switch (SortStatus)
			{
			case SortStatus.Ascending:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "SortAscending", useTransitions);
				break;
			case SortStatus.Descending:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "SortDescending", useTransitions);
				break;
			default:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unsorted", useTransitions);
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SortIndicator sortIndicator = target as SortIndicator;
			sortIndicator.UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}
	}

		private bool DoesParentHandleScrolling
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.TemplatedParent is System.Windows.Controls.Control obj)
				{
					try
					{
						PropertyInfo property = typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Control).GetProperty("HandlesScrolling", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
						if (null != property && KnownBoxes.TrueBox.Equals(property.GetValue(obj, null)))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					catch (MethodAccessException)
					{
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

			ScrollUpVisibilityPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ScrollUpVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(XamPager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox, OnScrollVisibilityChanged));
			ScrollUpVisibilityProperty = ScrollUpVisibilityPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ScrollDownVisibilityPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ScrollDownVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(XamPager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox, OnScrollVisibilityChanged));
			ScrollDownVisibilityProperty = ScrollDownVisibilityPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ScrollLeftButtonStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollLeftButtonStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamPager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ScrollRightButtonStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollRightButtonStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamPager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ScrollUpButtonStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollUpButtonStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamPager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ScrollDownButtonStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollDownButtonStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamPager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamPager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(XamPager)));
			CanExecuteRoutedEventHandler canExecute = OnCanExecuteScrollCommand;
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(XamPager), new CommandBinding(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar.LineLeftCommand, null, canExecute));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(XamPager), new CommandBinding(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar.LineRightCommand, null, canExecute));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(XamPager), new CommandBinding(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar.LineUpCommand, null, canExecute));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(XamPager), new CommandBinding(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar.LineDownCommand, null, canExecute));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(XamPager), FrameworkElement.RequestBringIntoViewEvent, new RequestBringIntoViewEventHandler(OnRequestBringIntoView));
		}

		{

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_scrollDownElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollDown") as FrameworkElement;
			_scrollUpElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollUp") as FrameworkElement;
			_scrollLeftElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollLeft") as FrameworkElement;
			_scrollRightElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollRight") as FrameworkElement;
			_contentPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_PagerContentPresenter") as PagerContentPresenter;
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.Handled && e.OriginalSource != this)
			{
				switch (e.Key)
				{
				case Key.Left:
				case Key.Up:
				case Key.Right:
				case Key.Down:
					if (!DoesParentHandleScrolling)
					{
						ProcessArrowKey(e);
						return;
					}
					break;
				case Key.End:
				case Key.Home:
					if (e.KeyboardDevice.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Control)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Property == ScrollViewer.ComputedHorizontalScrollBarVisibilityProperty)
			{
				VerifyScrollHorizontalVisibility();
			}
			else if (e.Property == ScrollViewer.ComputedVerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty)
			{
				VerifyScrollVerticalVisibility();
			}
			if (_contentPresenter != null && (e.Property == ScrollLeftVisibilityProperty || e.Property == ScrollRightVisibilityProperty || e.Property == ScrollUpVisibilityProperty || e.Property == ScrollDownVisibilityProperty))
			{
				_contentPresenter.InvalidateVisual();
			}
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnScrollChanged(ScrollChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			VerifyScrollHorizontalVisibility();
			VerifyScrollVerticalVisibility();
			if (e.HorizontalChange != 0.0 || e.VerticalChange != 0.0)
			{
				CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag = e.ExtentWidth - e.ExtentWidthChange - (e.ViewportWidth - e.ViewportWidthChange) > 0.0;
				bool flag2 = e.ExtentWidth - e.ViewportWidth > 0.0;
				if (flag != flag2)
				{
					CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
				}
			}
			base.OnScrollChanged(e);
		}

		internal FrameworkElement GetScrollElement(PagerScrollDirection direction)
		{
			return direction switch
			{
				PagerScrollDirection.Up => _scrollUpElement, 
				PagerScrollDirection.Left => _scrollLeftElement, 
				PagerScrollDirection.Right => _scrollRightElement, 
				PagerScrollDirection.Down => _scrollDownElement, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static void OnCanExecuteScrollCommand(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is XamPager { ScrollInfo: not null } xamPager)
			{
				_ = xamPager.ScrollInfo;
				_ = xamPager._contentPresenter;
			}
		}

		private static void OnRequestBringIntoView(object sender, RequestBringIntoViewEventArgs e)
		{
			XamPager xamPager = sender as XamPager;
			xamPager.OnRequestBringIntoView(e);
		}

		private void OnRequestBringIntoView(RequestBringIntoViewEventArgs e)
		{
			PagerContentPresenter contentPresenter = _contentPresenter;
			if (_ignoreBringIntoView || contentPresenter == null || base.ScrollInfo == contentPresenter || !(e.TargetObject is FrameworkElement frameworkElement) || !contentPresenter.IsAncestorOf(frameworkElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect rect = e.TargetRect;
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				rect = new Rect(frameworkElement.RenderSize);
			}
			Rect renderRect = new Rect(contentPresenter.RenderSize);
			Rect rect2 = renderRect;
			contentPresenter.AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Left);
			contentPresenter.AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Right);
			contentPresenter.AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Up);
			contentPresenter.AdjustRect(ref renderRect, PagerScrollDirection.Down);
			GeneralTransform generalTransform = contentPresenter.TransformToDescendant(frameworkElement);
			if (generalTransform == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			renderRect = generalTransform.TransformBounds(renderRect);
			rect2 = generalTransform.TransformBounds(rect2);
			Rect rect3 = Rect.Intersect(rect, rect2);
			Rect rect4 = Rect.Intersect(rect3, renderRect);
			if (rect4 == rect3)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (rect4.Width != rect3.Width)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				if (rect3.Right > renderRect.Right)
				{
					rect.Width += rect3.Right - renderRect.Right;
				}
				if (rect3.Left - num - renderRect.Left < 0.0)
				{
					rect.X += rect3.Left - num - renderRect.Left;
				}
			}
			if (rect4.Height != rect3.Height)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				if (rect3.Bottom > renderRect.Bottom)
				{
					rect.Height += rect3.Bottom - renderRect.Bottom;
				}
				if (rect3.Top - num2 - renderRect.Top < 0.0)
				{
					rect.Y += rect3.Top - num2 - renderRect.Top;
				}
			}
			e.Handled = true;
			_ignoreBringIntoView = true;
			try
			{
				((FrameworkElement)e.TargetObject).BringIntoView(rect);
			}
			finally
			{
				_ignoreBringIntoView = false;
			}
		}

		private static void OnScrollVisibilityChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
		}

		private void ProcessArrowKey(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_contentPresenter == null || !(e.OriginalSource is DependencyObject) || !_contentPresenter.IsAncestorOf(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject))
			{
				return;
			}
			FocusNavigationDirection direction;
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case Key.Left:
				direction = FocusNavigationDirection.Left;
				break;
			case Key.Right:
				direction = FocusNavigationDirection.Right;
				break;
			case Key.Up:
				direction = FocusNavigationDirection.Up;
				break;
			case Key.Down:
				direction = FocusNavigationDirection.Down;
				break;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject;
			DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = null;
			if (_contentPresenter.IsDescendantInView(dependencyObject))
			{
				if (dependencyObject is UIElement)
				{
					dependencyObject2 = ((UIElement)dependencyObject).PredictFocus(direction);
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
				{
					dependencyObject2 = ((ContentElement)dependencyObject).PredictFocus(direction);
				}
			}
			else if (_contentPresenter != null)
			{
				dependencyObject2 = _contentPresenter.PredictFocus(direction);
			}
			if (!(dependencyObject2 is IInputElement) || !_contentPresenter.IsAncestorOf(dependencyObject2))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = _contentPresenter.IsDescendantInView(dependencyObject2);
			if (!flag && e.KeyboardDevice.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.None)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				switch (e.Key)
				{
				case Key.Left:
					if (base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
					{
						LineRight();
					}
					else
					{
						LineLeft();
					}
					break;
				case Key.Right:
					if (base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
					{
						LineLeft();
					}
					else
					{
						LineRight();
					}
					break;
				case Key.Down:
					LineDown();
					break;
				case Key.Up:
					LineUp();
					break;
				}
				UpdateLayout();
				flag = _contentPresenter.IsDescendantInView(dependencyObject2);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				((IInputElement)dependencyObject2).Focus();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void VerifyScrollHorizontalVisibility()
		{
			object value;
			object value2;
			if (base.ComputedHorizontalScrollBarVisibility == Visibility.Visible && base.ScrollInfo != null)
			{
				double num = base.ScrollInfo.ExtentWidth - base.ScrollInfo.ViewportWidth;
				bool flag = base.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility == ScrollBarVisibility.Auto;
				value = ((flag && base.ScrollInfo.HorizontalOffset == 0.0) ? KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox : KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox);
				value2 = ((flag && base.ScrollInfo.HorizontalOffset >= num) ? KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox : KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox);
			}
			else
			{
				value = (value2 = KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox);
			}
			SetValue(ScrollLeftVisibilityPropertyKey, value);
			SetValue(ScrollRightVisibilityPropertyKey, value2);
		}

		private void VerifyScrollVerticalVisibility()
		{
			object value;
			object value2;
			if (base.ComputedVerticalScrollBarVisibility == Visibility.Visible && base.ScrollInfo != null)
			{
				double num = base.ScrollInfo.ExtentHeight - base.ScrollInfo.ViewportHeight;
				bool flag = base.VerticalScrollBarVisibility == ScrollBarVisibility.Auto;
				value = ((flag && base.ScrollInfo.VerticalOffset == 0.0) ? KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox : KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox);
				value2 = ((flag && base.ScrollInfo.VerticalOffset >= num) ? KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox : KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox);
			}
			else
			{
				value = (value2 = KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox);
			}
			SetValue(ScrollUpVisibilityPropertyKey, value);
			SetValue(ScrollDownVisibilityPropertyKey, value2);
		}
	}
