	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TabItemScrollViewer", Type = typeof(ScrollViewer))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Popup", Type = typeof(Popup))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_SelectedContentHost", Type = typeof(ContentPresenter))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_SelectedContentHostMinimized", Type = typeof(ContentPresenter))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HeaderArea", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	public class XamTabControl : System.Windows.Controls.TabControl, ICommandHost
	{
		private class PopupPlacementAdorner : AdornerEx
		{
			private Rect _rect;

			internal Rect Rect
			{
				get
				{
					return _rect;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != _rect)
					{
						if (value.IsEmpty)
						{
							value = default(Rect);
						}
						_rect = value;
						InvalidateMeasure();
					}
				}
			}

			internal PopupPlacementAdorner(XamTabControl tabControl)
				: base(tabControl)
			{
				base.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
			{
				return _rect.Size;
			}

			public override GeneralTransform GetDesiredTransform(GeneralTransform transform)
			{
				GeneralTransformGroup generalTransformGroup = new GeneralTransformGroup();
				generalTransformGroup.Children.Add(transform);
				generalTransformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform(_rect.X, _rect.Y));
				return generalTransformGroup;
			}
		}

		private class TabDragHelper
		{
			private enum MoveDirection
			{
				Left,
				Right,
				Up,
				Down
			}

			internal const double _IMMEDIATE_MODE_TAB_OFFSET = 5.0;

			internal System.Windows.Point MouseTabLocation;

			internal System.Windows.Point MouseStartLocation;

			internal System.Windows.Point CachedMousePosition;

			internal ToolWindow TabDragIndicator;

			internal ToolWindow TabDropIndicator;

			internal DropLocation DropLocation;

			internal TabItem DraggedTab;

			internal TabItem DragOverTab;

			internal TabItem CachedDragOverTab;

			internal DispatcherTimer ScrollDispatcher = new DispatcherTimer();

			internal object Item;

			internal KeyEventTracker KeyTracker;

			internal bool WasImmediateModeSuspend;

			internal readonly XamTabControl XamTabControlRef;

			private const int _SCROLL_TIMER_NTERVAL = 5;

			private const double _SCROLL_OFFSET = 0.5;

			private const int _SCROLL_PADDING = 10;

			private const int _TAB_OFFSET = 4;

			private List<TranslateTransform> _tabsWithTransform = new List<TranslateTransform>();

			private List<TabItem> _tabsMovedLeft = new List<TabItem>();

			private List<TabItem> _tabsMovedRight = new List<TabItem>();

			private List<TabItem> _tabsMovedUp = new List<TabItem>();

			private List<TabItem> _tabsMovedDown = new List<TabItem>();

			private int _cachedDragOverIndex = -1;

			private double _scrollLength;

			private TabDragMode _cachedTabDragMode;

			private ScrollViewer _tabItemScrollViewer;

			private ContentPresenter _preTabItemContentPresenter;

			private ContentPresenter _postTabItemContentPresenter;

			private FrameworkElement _headerArea;

			internal TabDragHelper(XamTabControl xamTabControl, TabDragMode tabDragMode)
			{
				XamTabControlRef = xamTabControl;
				_cachedTabDragMode = tabDragMode;
				_tabItemScrollViewer = XamTabControlRef.GetTemplateChild("PART_TabItemScrollViewer") as ScrollViewer;
				_preTabItemContentPresenter = Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(XamTabControlRef, "PreTabItemContent") as ContentPresenter;
				_postTabItemContentPresenter = Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(XamTabControlRef, "PostTabItemContent") as ContentPresenter;
				_headerArea = XamTabControlRef.HeaderArea;
				XamTabControlRef.PreviewMouseLeftButtonUp += XamTabControlRef_MouseLeftButtonUp;
				XamTabControlRef.MouseMove += XamTabControlRef_MouseMove;
				XamTabControlRef.LostMouseCapture += XamTabControlRef_LostMouseCapture;
			}

			internal void EndTabDrag()
			{
				XamTabControlRef.DisposeTabDragHelper();
				ScrollDispatcher.Tick -= ScrollDispatcher_Tick;
				ScrollDispatcher.Stop();
				XamTabControlRef.PreviewMouseLeftButtonUp -= XamTabControlRef_MouseLeftButtonUp;
				XamTabControlRef.MouseMove -= XamTabControlRef_MouseMove;
				XamTabControlRef.LostMouseCapture -= XamTabControlRef_LostMouseCapture;
				XamTabControlRef.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				if (_cachedTabDragMode == TabDragMode.Immediate)
				{
					ClearTabTransforms();
				}
				if (DraggedTab != null)
				{
					DraggedTab.SetValue(IsDraggingPropertyKey, false);
				}
				if (KeyTracker != null)
				{
					KeyTracker.KeyEvent -= OnKeyTrackerKeyEvent;
					KeyTracker.Deactivate();
				}
				if (_cachedTabDragMode == TabDragMode.Deferred && TabDragIndicator != null)
				{
					TabDragIndicator.Close();
					TabDropIndicator.Close();
					TabDragIndicator = null;
					TabDropIndicator = null;
				}
			}

			internal void StartDrag(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef);
				VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(XamTabControlRef, null, DraggedTabHitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(position));
				if (DraggedTab != null)
				{
					_cachedDragOverIndex = GetTabIndex(DraggedTab);
					CachedMousePosition = e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef);
					MouseStartLocation = e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef);
					Item = DraggedTab.DataContext;
					MouseTabLocation = e.GetPosition(DraggedTab);
					KeyEventTracker keyEventTracker = new KeyEventTracker();
					keyEventTracker.KeyEvent += OnKeyTrackerKeyEvent;
					keyEventTracker.Activate();
					KeyTracker = keyEventTracker;
					ScrollDispatcher.Interval = new TimeSpan(5L);
					ScrollDispatcher.Tick += ScrollDispatcher_Tick;
					ScrollDispatcher.Start();
				}
			}

			private void ApplyTransform(TabItem tab, MoveDirection moveDirection)
			{
				Transform renderTransform = tab.RenderTransform;
				if (renderTransform is TransformGroup)
				{
					if ((renderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[0] is TranslateTransform translateTransform)
					{
						switch (moveDirection)
						{
						case MoveDirection.Down:
							translateTransform.Y -= DraggedTab.ActualHeight - 5.0;
							break;
						case MoveDirection.Up:
							translateTransform.Y += DraggedTab.ActualHeight - 5.0;
							break;
						case MoveDirection.Left:
							translateTransform.X += DraggedTab.ActualWidth - 5.0;
							break;
						case MoveDirection.Right:
							translateTransform.X -= DraggedTab.ActualWidth - 5.0;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				TranslateTransform translateTransform2 = new TranslateTransform();
				switch (moveDirection)
				{
				case MoveDirection.Down:
					translateTransform2.Y = 0.0 - DraggedTab.ActualHeight + 5.0;
					break;
				case MoveDirection.Up:
					translateTransform2.Y = DraggedTab.ActualHeight - 5.0;
					break;
				case MoveDirection.Left:
					translateTransform2.X = DraggedTab.ActualWidth - 5.0;
					break;
				case MoveDirection.Right:
					translateTransform2.X = 0.0 - DraggedTab.ActualWidth + 5.0;
					break;
				}
				TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				transformGroup.Children.Add(translateTransform2);
				transformGroup.Children.Add(tab.RenderTransform);
				tab.ClearValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty);
				tab.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, transformGroup);
				_tabsWithTransform.Add(translateTransform2);
			}

			private void CaptureMouse()
			{
				if (Mouse.Captured != XamTabControlRef && (bool)DraggedTab.GetValue(IsDraggingProperty) && !XamTabControlRef.IsMinimized)
				{
					XamTabControlRef.CaptureMouse();
				}
			}

			private void ClearTabTransforms()
			{
				foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)XamTabControlRef.Items)
				{
					if (XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is TabItem { RenderTransform: var renderTransform } tabItem && renderTransform is TransformGroup && _tabsWithTransform.Contains((renderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[0] as TranslateTransform))
					{
						Transform value = (tabItem.RenderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[1];
						tabItem.CoerceValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty);
						tabItem.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, value);
					}
				}
			}

			private ToolWindow CreateIndicator()
			{
				FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(ContentPresenter));
				frameworkElementFactory.Name = "PART_Content";
				ControlTemplate controlTemplate = new ControlTemplate(typeof(ToolWindow));
				controlTemplate.VisualTree = frameworkElementFactory;
				controlTemplate.Seal();
				return new ToolWindow
				{
					WindowStartupLocation = ToolWindowStartupLocation.Manual,
					ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize,
					UseOSNonClientArea = false,
					Topmost = true,
					VerticalAlignmentMode = ToolWindowAlignmentMode.Manual,
					HorizontalAlignmentMode = ToolWindowAlignmentMode.Manual,
					Focusable = false,
					IsHitTestVisible = false,
					Template = controlTemplate
				};
			}

			private void DeferredDrag(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				XamTabControl xamTabControlRef = XamTabControlRef;
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(xamTabControlRef);
				if (VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(xamTabControlRef, position) is PointHitTestResult { VisualHit: not null } pointHitTestResult)
				{
					DragOverTab = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(pointHitTestResult.VisualHit, typeof(TabItem), allowSubclassOfType: true) as TabItem;
				}
				System.Windows.Point point = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(xamTabControlRef, default(System.Windows.Point));
				point.X = new DeviceUnitLength(point.X, DeviceUnitType.Pixel).ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit);
				point.Y = new DeviceUnitLength(point.Y, DeviceUnitType.Pixel).ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit);
				if (TabDragIndicator == null && DraggedTab != null)
				{
					TabDragIndicator = CreateIndicator();
					System.Windows.Controls.Image image = new System.Windows.Controls.Image();
					Rect descendantBounds = VisualTreeHelper.GetDescendantBounds(DraggedTab);
					RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)Math.Ceiling(descendantBounds.Width), (int)Math.Ceiling(descendantBounds.Height), 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
					DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
					using (DrawingContext drawingContext = drawingVisual.RenderOpen())
					{
						VisualBrush brush = new VisualBrush(DraggedTab);
						drawingContext.DrawRectangle(brush, null, new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), descendantBounds.Size));
					}
					renderTargetBitmap.Render(drawingVisual);
					image.Source = renderTargetBitmap;
					image.IsHitTestVisible = false;
					TabDragIndicator.Content = image;
					TabDragIndicator.Left = position.X + point.X - MouseTabLocation.X;
					TabDragIndicator.Top = position.Y + point.Y - MouseTabLocation.Y;
					TabDragIndicator.Show(xamTabControlRef);
					DraggedTab.SetValue(IsDraggingPropertyKey, true);
					TabDropIndicator = CreateIndicator();
					TabDropIndicator.Content = new DropIndicator();
					TabDropIndicator.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(XamTabControlRef.Resources);
					if (xamTabControlRef.HasVerticalTabs)
					{
						(TabDropIndicator.Content as DropIndicator).DropLocation = DropLocation.BelowTarget;
					}
					TabDropIndicator.Show(DraggedTab);
					TabDropIndicator.Opacity = 0.0;
					XamTabControlRef.RaiseTabDragStarted(new TabDragStartedEventArgs(DraggedTab, Item));
				}
				TabDragIndicator.Left = position.X + point.X - MouseTabLocation.X;
				TabDragIndicator.Top = position.Y + point.Y - MouseTabLocation.Y;
				if (_headerArea != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Point position2 = e.GetPosition(_headerArea);
					if (position2.Y < 0.0 || position2.Y > _headerArea.ActualHeight || position2.X < 0.0 || position2.X > _headerArea.ActualWidth)
					{
						TabDragIndicator.Opacity = 0.5;
						TabDropIndicator.Opacity = 0.0;
						DragOverTab = null;
						CachedDragOverTab = null;
						return;
					}
					TabDragIndicator.Opacity = 1.0;
					TabDropIndicator.Opacity = 1.0;
				}
				if (!XamTabControlRef.HasVerticalTabs)
				{
					int num = (int)position.X;
					int num2 = (int)position.X;
					for (int i = 0; (double)i < XamTabControlRef.ActualWidth; i++)
					{
						num--;
						num2++;
						VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(xamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(new System.Windows.Point(num, position.Y)));
						if (DragOverTab != null)
						{
							SetHorizontalDropIndicatorLocation(e, DragOverTab);
							break;
						}
						VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(xamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(new System.Windows.Point(num2, position.Y)));
						if (DragOverTab != null)
						{
							SetHorizontalDropIndicatorLocation(e, DragOverTab);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int num3 = (int)position.Y;
					int num4 = (int)position.Y;
					for (int j = 0; (double)j < XamTabControlRef.ActualHeight; j++)
					{
						num3--;
						num4++;
						VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(xamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(new System.Windows.Point(position.X, num3)));
						if (DragOverTab != null)
						{
							SetVerticalDropIndicatorLocation(e, DragOverTab);
							break;
						}
						VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(xamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(new System.Windows.Point(position.X, num4)));
						if (DragOverTab != null)
						{
							SetVerticalDropIndicatorLocation(e, DragOverTab);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				TabDropIndicator.Opacity = 1.0;
				if (DragOverTab != null)
				{
					(TabDropIndicator.Content as DropIndicator).DropTargetHeight = DragOverTab.ActualHeight;
					(TabDropIndicator.Content as DropIndicator).DropTargetWidth = DragOverTab.ActualWidth;
				}
				else
				{
					TabDropIndicator.Opacity = 0.0;
				}
				CachedDragOverTab = DragOverTab;
				xamTabControlRef.RaiseTabDragging(new TabDraggingEventArgs(DraggedTab, Item, DragOverTab, DropLocation));
			}

			private void DoDragDrop(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				bool flag = Math.Abs(e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).X - MouseStartLocation.X) >= SystemParameters.MinimumHorizontalDragDistance || Math.Abs(e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).Y - MouseStartLocation.Y) >= SystemParameters.MinimumVerticalDragDistance;
				if (_cachedTabDragMode == TabDragMode.Immediate && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && flag)
				{
					ImmediateDrag(e);
					CaptureMouse();
				}
				if (_cachedTabDragMode == TabDragMode.Deferred && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && flag)
				{
					DeferredDrag(e);
					CaptureMouse();
				}
			}

			private HitTestResultBehavior DraggedTabHitTestResult(HitTestResult result)
			{
				if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(result.VisualHit, typeof(TabItem), allowSubclassOfType: true) is TabItem tabItem && XamTabControlRef.Equals(ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(tabItem)))
				{
					DraggedTab = tabItem;
					return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
				}
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
			}

			private int GetTabIndex(TabItem tab)
			{
				int num = XamTabControlRef.Items.IndexOf(tab);
				if (num != -1)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return XamTabControlRef.Items.IndexOf(tab.DataContext);
			}

			private void ImmediateDrag(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				if (_headerArea == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(_headerArea);
				if (position.Y <= 1.0 || position.Y > _headerArea.ActualHeight || position.X <= 1.0 || position.X > _headerArea.ActualWidth)
				{
					if (!WasImmediateModeSuspend)
					{
						ClearTabTransforms();
						_tabsWithTransform.Clear();
						if (XamTabControlRef.HasVerticalTabs)
						{
							_tabsMovedUp.Clear();
							_tabsMovedDown.Clear();
						}
						else
						{
							_tabsMovedLeft.Clear();
							_tabsMovedRight.Clear();
						}
						WasImmediateModeSuspend = true;
						CachedDragOverTab = null;
						_cachedDragOverIndex = -1;
						DragOverTab = null;
					}
				}
				else if (DraggedTab != null)
				{
					if (!(bool)DraggedTab.GetValue(IsDraggingProperty))
					{
						XamTabControlRef.RaiseTabDragStarted(new TabDragStartedEventArgs(DraggedTab, Item));
						DraggedTab.SetValue(IsDraggingPropertyKey, true);
					}
					if (_cachedDragOverIndex == -1)
					{
						_cachedDragOverIndex = GetTabIndex(DraggedTab);
					}
					if (WasImmediateModeSuspend)
					{
						VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(XamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(Mouse.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef)));
						if (XamTabControlRef.HasVerticalTabs)
						{
							MoveDraggedTabAfterSuspension(e, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical);
						}
						else
						{
							MoveDraggedTabAfterSuspension(e, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal);
						}
						WasImmediateModeSuspend = false;
					}
					else
					{
						MoveDraggedTab(e, 0.0);
						if (!XamTabControlRef.HasVerticalTabs)
						{
							System.Windows.Point point = DraggedTab.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), XamTabControlRef);
							if (CachedMousePosition.X > e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).X)
							{
								point.Y += DraggedTab.ActualHeight / 2.0;
								VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(XamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(point));
								System.Windows.Point point2 = default(System.Windows.Point);
								if (DragOverTab != null && DraggedTab != DragOverTab)
								{
									point2 = DragOverTab.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), XamTabControlRef);
									point2.Y += DragOverTab.ActualHeight / 2.0;
									point2.X += DragOverTab.ActualWidth / 2.0;
									if (point2.X >= point.X)
									{
										MoveTabsHorizontally(e);
									}
								}
							}
							if (CachedMousePosition.X < e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).X)
							{
								point.Y += DraggedTab.ActualHeight / 2.0;
								point.X += DraggedTab.ActualWidth;
								VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(XamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(point));
								System.Windows.Point point3 = default(System.Windows.Point);
								if (DragOverTab != null && DraggedTab != DragOverTab)
								{
									point3 = DragOverTab.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), XamTabControlRef);
									point3.Y += DragOverTab.ActualHeight / 2.0;
									point3.X += DragOverTab.ActualWidth / 2.0;
									if (point3.X <= point.X)
									{
										MoveTabsHorizontally(e);
									}
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							System.Windows.Point point4 = DraggedTab.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), XamTabControlRef);
							if (CachedMousePosition.Y > e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).Y)
							{
								point4.X += DraggedTab.ActualWidth / 2.0;
								VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(XamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(point4));
								System.Windows.Point point5 = default(System.Windows.Point);
								if (DragOverTab != null && DraggedTab != DragOverTab)
								{
									point5 = DragOverTab.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), XamTabControlRef);
									point5.Y += DragOverTab.ActualHeight / 2.0;
									point5.X += DragOverTab.ActualWidth / 2.0;
									if (point5.Y >= point4.Y)
									{
										MoveTabsVertically(e);
									}
								}
							}
							if (CachedMousePosition.Y < e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).Y)
							{
								point4.Y += DraggedTab.ActualHeight;
								point4.X += DraggedTab.ActualWidth / 2.0;
								VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(XamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(point4));
								System.Windows.Point point6 = default(System.Windows.Point);
								if (DragOverTab != null && DraggedTab != DragOverTab)
								{
									point6 = DragOverTab.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), XamTabControlRef);
									point6.Y += DragOverTab.ActualHeight / 2.0;
									point6.X += DragOverTab.ActualWidth / 2.0;
									if (point6.Y <= point4.Y)
									{
										MoveTabsVertically(e);
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				CachedMousePosition = e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef);
				XamTabControlRef.RaiseTabDragging(new TabDraggingEventArgs(DraggedTab, Item, DragOverTab, DropLocation));
			}

			private void MoveDraggedTabAfterSuspension(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation tabsOrientation)
			{
				if (_headerArea == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num;
				double num2;
				if (tabsOrientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					num = e.GetPosition(_headerArea).X;
					num2 = _headerArea.ActualWidth;
				}
				else
				{
					num = e.GetPosition(_headerArea).Y;
					num2 = _headerArea.ActualHeight;
				}
				if (XamTabControlRef.IsTabItemPanelScrolling)
				{
					if (DragOverTab == null)
					{
						VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(XamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResultIncludeDraggedTab, new PointHitTestParameters(e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef)));
						if (DragOverTab == null)
						{
							if (num > num2)
							{
								DragOverTab = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[XamTabControlRef.Items.Count - 1]) as TabItem;
							}
							else
							{
								DragOverTab = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[0]) as TabItem;
							}
						}
					}
					MoveDraggedTab(e, _scrollLength);
				}
				else if (DragOverTab != null)
				{
					MoveDraggedTab(e, 0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(XamTabControlRef, null, TabHitTestResultIncludeDraggedTab, new PointHitTestParameters(e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef)));
					if (DragOverTab == null)
					{
						double num3 = 0.0;
						for (int i = 0; i < XamTabControlRef.Items.Count; i++)
						{
							num3 = ((tabsOrientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal) ? (num3 + (XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[i]) as TabItem).ActualHeight) : (num3 + (XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[i]) as TabItem).ActualWidth));
						}
						if (num > num3)
						{
							DragOverTab = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[XamTabControlRef.Items.Count - 1]) as TabItem;
						}
						else
						{
							DragOverTab = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[0]) as TabItem;
						}
						MoveDraggedTab(e, 0.0);
					}
				}
				if (tabsOrientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					MoveTabsHorizontally(e);
				}
				else
				{
					MoveTabsVertically(e);
				}
			}

			private void MoveTabsHorizontally(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				int tabIndex = GetTabIndex(DragOverTab);
				if (_cachedDragOverIndex < tabIndex)
				{
					for (int i = _cachedDragOverIndex; i <= tabIndex; i++)
					{
						TabItem tabItem = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[i]) as TabItem;
						if ((tabItem == null || !tabItem.Equals(DraggedTab)) && (_tabsMovedRight.Contains(tabItem) || !_tabsMovedLeft.Contains(tabItem)))
						{
							MoveTab(tabItem, MoveDirection.Left);
						}
					}
				}
				if (_cachedDragOverIndex > tabIndex)
				{
					for (int num = _cachedDragOverIndex; num >= tabIndex; num--)
					{
						TabItem tabItem2 = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[num]) as TabItem;
						if ((tabItem2 == null || !tabItem2.Equals(DraggedTab)) && (_tabsMovedLeft.Contains(tabItem2) || !_tabsMovedRight.Contains(tabItem2)))
						{
							MoveTab(tabItem2, MoveDirection.Right);
						}
					}
				}
				if (_cachedDragOverIndex == tabIndex)
				{
					double num2 = 0.0;
					for (int j = 0; j < XamTabControlRef.Items.Count; j++)
					{
						num2 += (XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[j]) as TabItem).ActualWidth;
					}
					if (e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).X < num2)
					{
						ContentPresenter contentPresenter = Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(XamTabControlRef, "PreTabItemContent") as ContentPresenter;
						if ((_tabsMovedLeft.Contains(DragOverTab) || !_tabsMovedRight.Contains(DragOverTab)) && e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).X < CachedMousePosition.X)
						{
							PagerContentPresenter pagerContentPresenter = Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(XamTabControlRef, typeof(PagerContentPresenter), allowSubclassOfType: true) as PagerContentPresenter;
							if (XamTabControlRef.IsTabItemPanelScrolling)
							{
								if (e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).X < pagerContentPresenter.ActualWidth)
								{
									MoveTab(DragOverTab, MoveDirection.Right);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								MoveTab(DragOverTab, MoveDirection.Right);
							}
						}
						else if ((_tabsMovedRight.Contains(DragOverTab) || !_tabsMovedLeft.Contains(DragOverTab)) && e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).X > CachedMousePosition.X && CachedMousePosition.X > contentPresenter.ActualWidth && DraggedTab != DragOverTab)
						{
							MoveTab(DragOverTab, MoveDirection.Left);
						}
					}
				}
				_cachedDragOverIndex = GetTabIndex(DragOverTab);
			}

			private void MoveTabsVertically(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				int tabIndex = GetTabIndex(DragOverTab);
				if (_cachedDragOverIndex < tabIndex)
				{
					for (int i = _cachedDragOverIndex; i <= tabIndex; i++)
					{
						TabItem tabItem = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[i]) as TabItem;
						if ((tabItem == null || !tabItem.Equals(DraggedTab)) && (_tabsMovedDown.Contains(tabItem) || !_tabsMovedUp.Contains(tabItem)))
						{
							MoveTab(tabItem, MoveDirection.Up);
						}
					}
				}
				if (_cachedDragOverIndex > tabIndex)
				{
					for (int num = _cachedDragOverIndex; num >= tabIndex; num--)
					{
						TabItem tabItem2 = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[num]) as TabItem;
						if ((tabItem2 == null || !tabItem2.Equals(DraggedTab)) && (_tabsMovedUp.Contains(tabItem2) || !_tabsMovedDown.Contains(tabItem2)))
						{
							MoveTab(tabItem2, MoveDirection.Down);
						}
					}
				}
				if (_cachedDragOverIndex == tabIndex)
				{
					double num2 = 0.0;
					for (int j = 0; j < XamTabControlRef.Items.Count; j++)
					{
						num2 += (XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[j]) as TabItem).ActualHeight;
					}
					if (e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).Y < num2)
					{
						ContentPresenter contentPresenter = Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(XamTabControlRef, "PreTabItemContent") as ContentPresenter;
						if ((_tabsMovedUp.Contains(DragOverTab) || !_tabsMovedDown.Contains(DragOverTab)) && e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).Y < CachedMousePosition.Y)
						{
							PagerContentPresenter pagerContentPresenter = Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(XamTabControlRef, typeof(PagerContentPresenter), allowSubclassOfType: true) as PagerContentPresenter;
							if (XamTabControlRef.IsTabItemPanelScrolling)
							{
								if (e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).Y < pagerContentPresenter.ActualHeight)
								{
									MoveTab(DragOverTab, MoveDirection.Down);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								MoveTab(DragOverTab, MoveDirection.Down);
							}
						}
						else if ((_tabsMovedDown.Contains(DragOverTab) || !_tabsMovedUp.Contains(DragOverTab)) && e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).Y > CachedMousePosition.Y && CachedMousePosition.Y > contentPresenter.ActualHeight)
						{
							MoveTab(DragOverTab, MoveDirection.Up);
						}
					}
				}
				_cachedDragOverIndex = GetTabIndex(DragOverTab);
			}

			private void ModifyTabs()
			{
				if (DraggedTab != null && CachedDragOverTab != null)
				{
					ScrollDispatcher.Stop();
					int tabIndex = GetTabIndex(DraggedTab);
					object obj = XamTabControlRef.Items[tabIndex];
					TabItem tabItem = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(obj) as TabItem;
					if (XamTabControlRef.ItemsSource != null)
					{
						(XamTabControlRef.ItemsSource as IList).RemoveAt(tabIndex);
						if (CachedDragOverTab == obj)
						{
							if (DropLocation == DropLocation.RightOfTarget)
							{
								(XamTabControlRef.ItemsSource as IList).Add(obj);
							}
							else
							{
								(XamTabControlRef.ItemsSource as IList).Insert(0, obj);
							}
						}
						else if (DropLocation == DropLocation.LeftOfTarget || DropLocation == DropLocation.BelowTarget)
						{
							(XamTabControlRef.ItemsSource as IList).Insert(GetTabIndex(CachedDragOverTab), obj);
						}
						else
						{
							(XamTabControlRef.ItemsSource as IList).Insert(GetTabIndex(CachedDragOverTab) + 1, obj);
						}
						if (!XamTabControlRef.IsMinimized)
						{
							if (obj != tabItem)
							{
								DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(XamTabControlRef, Selector.SelectedItemProperty, obj);
							}
							else
							{
								DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(tabItem, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
							}
						}
						XamTabControlRef.Items.Refresh();
					}
					else
					{
						XamTabControlRef.Items.RemoveAt(tabIndex);
						if (CachedDragOverTab == obj)
						{
							if (DropLocation == DropLocation.RightOfTarget)
							{
								XamTabControlRef.Items.Add(obj);
							}
							else
							{
								XamTabControlRef.Items.Insert(0, obj);
							}
						}
						else if (DropLocation == DropLocation.LeftOfTarget || DropLocation == DropLocation.BelowTarget)
						{
							XamTabControlRef.Items.Insert(GetTabIndex(CachedDragOverTab), obj);
						}
						else
						{
							XamTabControlRef.Items.Insert(GetTabIndex(CachedDragOverTab) + 1, obj);
						}
						if (!XamTabControlRef.IsMinimized)
						{
							DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(tabItem, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
						}
					}
					XamTabControlRef.RaiseTabDragCompleted(new TabDragCompletedEventArgs(tabItem, Item));
				}
				EndTabDrag();
			}

			private void MoveDraggedTab(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, double distance)
			{
				if (XamTabControlRef.HasVerticalTabs)
				{
					Transform renderTransform = DraggedTab.RenderTransform;
					if (renderTransform is TransformGroup && _tabsWithTransform.Contains((renderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[0] as TranslateTransform))
					{
						((renderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[0] as TranslateTransform).Y += e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).Y - CachedMousePosition.Y;
						return;
					}
					TranslateTransform translateTransform = new TranslateTransform();
					translateTransform.Y = e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).Y - MouseStartLocation.Y + distance;
					TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
					transformGroup.Children.Add(translateTransform);
					transformGroup.Children.Add(DraggedTab.RenderTransform);
					DraggedTab.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, transformGroup);
					_tabsWithTransform.Add(translateTransform);
				}
				else
				{
					Transform renderTransform2 = DraggedTab.RenderTransform;
					if (renderTransform2 is TransformGroup && _tabsWithTransform.Contains((renderTransform2 as TransformGroup).Children[0] as TranslateTransform))
					{
						((renderTransform2 as TransformGroup).Children[0] as TranslateTransform).X += e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).X - CachedMousePosition.X;
						return;
					}
					TranslateTransform translateTransform2 = new TranslateTransform();
					translateTransform2.X = e.GetPosition(XamTabControlRef).X - MouseStartLocation.X + distance;
					TransformGroup transformGroup2 = new TransformGroup();
					transformGroup2.Children.Add(translateTransform2);
					transformGroup2.Children.Add(DraggedTab.RenderTransform);
					DraggedTab.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, transformGroup2);
					_tabsWithTransform.Add(translateTransform2);
				}
			}

			private void MoveTab(TabItem tab, MoveDirection moveDirection)
			{
				Transform renderTransform = tab.RenderTransform;
				if (renderTransform is TransformGroup && _tabsWithTransform.Contains((renderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[0] as TranslateTransform))
				{
					if ((renderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[0] is TranslateTransform translateTransform)
					{
						switch (moveDirection)
						{
						case MoveDirection.Down:
							translateTransform.Y += DraggedTab.ActualHeight - 5.0;
							break;
						case MoveDirection.Up:
							translateTransform.Y -= DraggedTab.ActualHeight - 5.0;
							break;
						case MoveDirection.Left:
							translateTransform.X -= DraggedTab.ActualWidth - 5.0;
							break;
						case MoveDirection.Right:
							translateTransform.X += DraggedTab.ActualWidth - 5.0;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					TranslateTransform translateTransform2 = new TranslateTransform();
					switch (moveDirection)
					{
					case MoveDirection.Down:
						translateTransform2.Y = DraggedTab.ActualHeight - 5.0;
						break;
					case MoveDirection.Up:
						translateTransform2.Y = 0.0 - DraggedTab.ActualHeight + 5.0;
						break;
					case MoveDirection.Left:
						translateTransform2.X = 0.0 - DraggedTab.ActualWidth + 5.0;
						break;
					case MoveDirection.Right:
						translateTransform2.X = DraggedTab.ActualWidth - 5.0;
						break;
					}
					TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
					transformGroup.Children.Add(translateTransform2);
					transformGroup.Children.Add(tab.RenderTransform);
					tab.CoerceValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty);
					tab.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, transformGroup);
					_tabsWithTransform.Add(translateTransform2);
				}
				CachedDragOverTab = DragOverTab;
				switch (moveDirection)
				{
				case MoveDirection.Down:
					DropLocation = DropLocation.BelowTarget;
					_tabsMovedUp.Remove(tab);
					_tabsMovedDown.Add(tab);
					break;
				case MoveDirection.Up:
					DropLocation = DropLocation.AboveTarget;
					_tabsMovedDown.Remove(tab);
					_tabsMovedUp.Add(tab);
					break;
				case MoveDirection.Left:
					DropLocation = DropLocation.RightOfTarget;
					_tabsMovedRight.Remove(tab);
					_tabsMovedLeft.Add(tab);
					break;
				case MoveDirection.Right:
					DropLocation = DropLocation.LeftOfTarget;
					_tabsMovedLeft.Remove(tab);
					_tabsMovedRight.Add(tab);
					break;
				}
			}

			private void OnKeyTrackerKeyEvent(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
				{
					EndTabDrag();
				}
			}

			private void ScrollDispatcher_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				if (_tabItemScrollViewer == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num = 10.0 + _preTabItemContentPresenter.ActualWidth;
				double num2 = 10.0 + _postTabItemContentPresenter.ActualWidth;
				double num3 = 10.0 + _preTabItemContentPresenter.ActualHeight;
				double num4 = 10.0 + _postTabItemContentPresenter.ActualHeight;
				System.Windows.Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(_headerArea);
				if ((position.Y < num3 || position.Y > _headerArea.ActualHeight - num4) && XamTabControlRef.HasVerticalTabs && position.X >= 0.0 && position.X <= _headerArea.ActualWidth)
				{
					if (position.Y < num3 && _tabItemScrollViewer.ContentVerticalOffset > 0.0)
					{
						if (TabDropIndicator != null && TabDropIndicator.Opacity != 0.0)
						{
							TabDropIndicator.Opacity = 0.0;
						}
						if (_cachedTabDragMode == TabDragMode.Deferred)
						{
							_tabItemScrollViewer.ScrollToVerticalOffset(_tabItemScrollViewer.VerticalOffset - 0.5);
						}
						if (_cachedTabDragMode != TabDragMode.Immediate || DraggedTab == null || WasImmediateModeSuspend)
						{
							return;
						}
						_tabItemScrollViewer.ScrollToVerticalOffset(_tabItemScrollViewer.VerticalOffset - 0.5);
						_scrollLength -= 0.5;
						if (DraggedTab.RenderTransform is TransformGroup)
						{
							((DraggedTab.RenderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[0] as TranslateTransform).Y -= 0.5;
						}
						if (CachedDragOverTab != null)
						{
							int num5 = GetTabIndex(CachedDragOverTab) - 1;
							if (_tabsMovedRight.Contains(CachedDragOverTab))
							{
								ScrollTab(CachedDragOverTab, MoveDirection.Up);
							}
							if (num5 >= 0)
							{
								TabItem tab = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[num5]) as TabItem;
								ScrollTab(tab, MoveDirection.Up);
							}
						}
						return;
					}
					if (position.Y > _headerArea.ActualHeight - num4 && _tabItemScrollViewer.ContentVerticalOffset < _tabItemScrollViewer.ScrollableHeight)
					{
						if (TabDropIndicator != null && TabDropIndicator.Opacity != 0.0)
						{
							TabDropIndicator.Opacity = 0.0;
						}
						if (_cachedTabDragMode == TabDragMode.Deferred)
						{
							_tabItemScrollViewer.ScrollToVerticalOffset(_tabItemScrollViewer.VerticalOffset + 0.5);
						}
						if (_cachedTabDragMode != TabDragMode.Immediate || DraggedTab == null || WasImmediateModeSuspend)
						{
							return;
						}
						_tabItemScrollViewer.ScrollToVerticalOffset(_tabItemScrollViewer.VerticalOffset + 0.5);
						_scrollLength += 0.5;
						if (DraggedTab.RenderTransform is TransformGroup)
						{
							((DraggedTab.RenderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[0] as TranslateTransform).Y += 0.5;
						}
						if (CachedDragOverTab != null)
						{
							int num6 = GetTabIndex(CachedDragOverTab) + 1;
							if (_tabsMovedRight.Contains(CachedDragOverTab))
							{
								ScrollTab(CachedDragOverTab, MoveDirection.Down);
							}
							if (num6 != XamTabControlRef.Items.Count)
							{
								TabItem tab2 = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[num6]) as TabItem;
								ScrollTab(tab2, MoveDirection.Down);
							}
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				if ((!(position.X < num) && !(position.X > _headerArea.ActualWidth - num2)) || XamTabControlRef.HasVerticalTabs || !(position.Y >= 0.0) || !(position.Y <= _headerArea.ActualHeight))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (position.X < num && _tabItemScrollViewer.ContentHorizontalOffset > 0.0)
				{
					if (TabDropIndicator != null && TabDropIndicator.Opacity != 0.0)
					{
						TabDropIndicator.Opacity = 0.0;
					}
					if (_cachedTabDragMode == TabDragMode.Deferred)
					{
						_tabItemScrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(_tabItemScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset - 0.5);
					}
					if (_cachedTabDragMode != TabDragMode.Immediate || DraggedTab == null || WasImmediateModeSuspend)
					{
						return;
					}
					_tabItemScrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(_tabItemScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset - 0.5);
					_scrollLength -= 0.5;
					if (DraggedTab.RenderTransform is TransformGroup)
					{
						((DraggedTab.RenderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[0] as TranslateTransform).X -= 0.5;
					}
					if (CachedDragOverTab != null)
					{
						int num7 = GetTabIndex(CachedDragOverTab) - 1;
						if (_tabsMovedRight.Contains(CachedDragOverTab))
						{
							ScrollTab(CachedDragOverTab, MoveDirection.Left);
						}
						if (num7 >= 0)
						{
							TabItem tab3 = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[num7]) as TabItem;
							ScrollTab(tab3, MoveDirection.Left);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(position.X > _headerArea.ActualWidth - num2) || !(_tabItemScrollViewer.ContentHorizontalOffset < _tabItemScrollViewer.ScrollableWidth))
					{
						return;
					}
					if (TabDropIndicator != null && TabDropIndicator.Opacity != 0.0)
					{
						TabDropIndicator.Opacity = 0.0;
					}
					if (_cachedTabDragMode == TabDragMode.Deferred)
					{
						_tabItemScrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(_tabItemScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset + 0.5);
					}
					if (_cachedTabDragMode != TabDragMode.Immediate || DraggedTab == null || WasImmediateModeSuspend)
					{
						return;
					}
					_tabItemScrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(_tabItemScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset + 0.5);
					_scrollLength += 0.5;
					if (DraggedTab.RenderTransform is TransformGroup)
					{
						((DraggedTab.RenderTransform as TransformGroup).Children[0] as TranslateTransform).X += 0.5;
					}
					if (CachedDragOverTab != null)
					{
						int num8 = GetTabIndex(CachedDragOverTab) + 1;
						if (_tabsMovedRight.Contains(CachedDragOverTab))
						{
							ScrollTab(CachedDragOverTab, MoveDirection.Right);
						}
						if (num8 != XamTabControlRef.Items.Count)
						{
							TabItem tab4 = XamTabControlRef.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(XamTabControlRef.Items[num8]) as TabItem;
							ScrollTab(tab4, MoveDirection.Right);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private void SetCachedDragOverTabWhileScrolling(TabItem tab, MoveDirection moveDirection)
			{
				if (tab == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (moveDirection == MoveDirection.Down || moveDirection == MoveDirection.Right)
				{
					if (GetTabIndex(CachedDragOverTab) + 1 != XamTabControlRef.Items.Count)
					{
						CachedDragOverTab = tab;
					}
				}
				else if (GetTabIndex(CachedDragOverTab) - 1 >= 0)
				{
					CachedDragOverTab = tab;
				}
			}

			private void ScrollTab(TabItem tab, MoveDirection moveDirection)
			{
				if (tab == DraggedTab)
				{
					CachedDragOverTab = tab;
					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Point point = XamTabControlRef.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), tab);
				bool flag = false;
				if (moveDirection == MoveDirection.Down && point.Y * -1.0 <= XamTabControlRef.ActualHeight)
				{
					ApplyTransform(tab, moveDirection);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (moveDirection == MoveDirection.Up && point.Y <= tab.ActualHeight)
				{
					ApplyTransform(tab, moveDirection);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (moveDirection == MoveDirection.Left && point.X <= tab.ActualWidth)
				{
					ApplyTransform(tab, moveDirection);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (moveDirection == MoveDirection.Right && point.X * -1.0 <= XamTabControlRef.ActualWidth)
				{
					ApplyTransform(tab, moveDirection);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					SetCachedDragOverTabWhileScrolling(tab, moveDirection);
					switch (moveDirection)
					{
					case MoveDirection.Down:
						_tabsMovedDown.Remove(tab);
						_tabsMovedUp.Add(tab);
						break;
					case MoveDirection.Up:
						_tabsMovedUp.Remove(tab);
						_tabsMovedDown.Add(tab);
						break;
					case MoveDirection.Left:
						_tabsMovedLeft.Remove(tab);
						_tabsMovedRight.Add(tab);
						break;
					case MoveDirection.Right:
						_tabsMovedRight.Remove(tab);
						_tabsMovedLeft.Add(tab);
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			private void SetHorizontalDropIndicatorLocation(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, TabItem dragOverTab)
			{
				if (e.GetPosition(dragOverTab).X < dragOverTab.ActualWidth / 2.0)
				{
					double x = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(dragOverTab, default(System.Windows.Point)).X;
					TabDropIndicator.Left = new DeviceUnitLength(x, DeviceUnitType.Pixel).ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit) - dragOverTab.ActualWidth / 2.0;
					DropLocation = DropLocation.LeftOfTarget;
				}
				else
				{
					double x2 = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(dragOverTab, default(System.Windows.Point)).X;
					TabDropIndicator.Left = new DeviceUnitLength(x2, DeviceUnitType.Pixel).ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit) + dragOverTab.ActualWidth / 2.0;
					DropLocation = DropLocation.RightOfTarget;
				}
				double y = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(dragOverTab, default(System.Windows.Point)).Y;
				if (Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(TabDropIndicator.Content as DropIndicator, "ArrowTL") is Grid grid)
				{
					TabDropIndicator.Top = new DeviceUnitLength(y, DeviceUnitType.Pixel).ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit) - grid.ActualHeight;
				}
			}

			private void SetVerticalDropIndicatorLocation(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, TabItem dragOverTab)
			{
				if (e.GetPosition(dragOverTab).Y < dragOverTab.ActualHeight / 2.0)
				{
					double y = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(dragOverTab, default(System.Windows.Point)).Y;
					TabDropIndicator.Top = new DeviceUnitLength(y, DeviceUnitType.Pixel).ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit) - 4.0;
					DropLocation = DropLocation.BelowTarget;
				}
				else
				{
					double y2 = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(dragOverTab, default(System.Windows.Point)).Y;
					TabDropIndicator.Top = new DeviceUnitLength(y2, DeviceUnitType.Pixel).ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit) + dragOverTab.ActualHeight - 4.0;
					DropLocation = DropLocation.AboveTarget;
				}
				double x = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(dragOverTab, default(System.Windows.Point)).X;
				if (Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(TabDropIndicator.Content as DropIndicator, "ArrowTL") is Grid grid)
				{
					TabDropIndicator.Left = new DeviceUnitLength(x, DeviceUnitType.Pixel).ConvertToUnitType(DeviceUnitType.DeviceIndependentUnit) - grid.ActualHeight;
				}
			}

			private HitTestResultBehavior TabHitTestResult(HitTestResult result)
			{
				DragOverTab = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(result.VisualHit, typeof(TabItem), allowSubclassOfType: true) as TabItem;
				if (DragOverTab != null && !DragOverTab.Equals(DraggedTab) && XamTabControlRef.Equals(ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(DragOverTab)))
				{
					return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
				}
				DragOverTab = null;
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
			}

			private HitTestResultBehavior TabHitTestResultIncludeDraggedTab(HitTestResult result)
			{
				DragOverTab = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(result.VisualHit, typeof(TabItem), allowSubclassOfType: true) as TabItem;
				if (DragOverTab != null && XamTabControlRef.Equals(ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(DragOverTab)))
				{
					return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
				}
				DragOverTab = null;
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
			}

			private void XamTabControlRef_LostMouseCapture(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.OriginalSource == XamTabControlRef && (bool)DraggedTab.GetValue(IsDraggingProperty))
				{
					EndTabDrag();
				}
			}

			private void XamTabControlRef_MouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				if (XamTabControlRef == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ModifyTabs();
				if (!XamTabControlRef.IsMinimized || CachedDragOverTab == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				XamTabControlRef.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					if (!DraggedTab.IsSelected)
					{
						DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(XamTabControlRef, Selector.SelectedItemProperty, DraggedTab);
					}
				}, DispatcherPriority.Background, null);
			}

			private void XamTabControlRef_MouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				if (DraggedTab != null)
				{
					DoDragDrop(e);
				}
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (base.TabStripPlacement != Dock.Left)

					return base.TabStripPlacement == Dock.Right;

				return true;
			}

		internal TabDragMode TabDragModeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				TabDragMode tabDragMode = TabDragMode;
				if (tabDragMode == TabDragMode.None)
				{
					return tabDragMode;
				}
				if (base.ItemsSource != null && (!(base.ItemsSource is IList) || (base.ItemsSource as IList).IsReadOnly))
				{
					return TabDragMode.None;
				}
				TabItem firstTabItem = GetFirstTabItem(excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true);
				TabItem lastTabItem = GetLastTabItem(excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true);
				if (firstTabItem != null && firstTabItem.Equals(lastTabItem))
				{
					return TabDragMode.None;
				}
				if (tabDragMode == TabDragMode.Deferred)
				{
					return tabDragMode;
				}
				Utilities.DependencyObjectSearchCallback<TabItemPanel> callback = (TabItemPanel panel) => ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(panel) == this;
				TabItemPanel descendantFromType = Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, allowSubclassOfType: true, callback, new Type[1] { typeof(TabItemPanel) });
				if (descendantFromType == null)
				{
					return TabDragMode.Deferred;
				}
				if (descendantFromType != null)
				{
					int tabItemRowNumber = descendantFromType.GetTabItemRowNumber(GetFirstTabItem(excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true));
					int tabItemRowNumber2 = descendantFromType.GetTabItemRowNumber(GetLastTabItem(excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true));
					if (TabDragMode != TabDragMode.None && (tabItemRowNumber != 0 || tabItemRowNumber2 != 0))
					{
						return TabDragMode.Deferred;
					}
				}
				return tabDragMode;
			}
		}

		public XamTabControl()
		{
			try
			{
				_license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(XamTabControl), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
			VerifyScrollBarVisibility();
			SetValue(PreferredDropDownPlacementCallbackPropertyKey, new CustomPopupPlacementCallback(GetPreferredPopupPlacement));
			Infragistics.Themes.ThemeManager.RegisterControl(typeof(XamTabControl));
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (_cpMinimized != null)
			{
				_cpMinimized.ClearValue(ContentPresenter.ContentProperty);
			}
			if (_cpMaximized != null)
			{
				_cpMaximized.ClearValue(ContentPresenter.ContentProperty);
			}
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_cpMinimized = GetTemplateChild("PART_SelectedContentHostMinimized") as ContentPresenter;
			_cpMaximized = GetTemplateChild("PART_SelectedContentHost") as ContentPresenter;
			_tabItemScrollViewer = GetTemplateChild("PART_TabItemScrollViewer") as ScrollViewer;
			if (_popup != null)
			{
				_popup.Closed -= OnPopupClosed;
			}
			_popup = GetTemplateChild("PART_Popup") as Popup;
			if (_popup != null)
			{
				_popup.Closed += OnPopupClosed;
			}
			if (_tabItemScrollViewer != null)
			{
				SetBinding(ComputedTabItemHorizontalScrollBarVisibilityProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ScrollViewer.ComputedHorizontalScrollBarVisibilityProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _tabItemScrollViewer));
				SetBinding(ComputedTabItemVerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ScrollViewer.ComputedVerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _tabItemScrollViewer));
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, ComputedTabItemHorizontalScrollBarVisibilityProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, ComputedTabItemVerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty);
			}
			if (GetTemplateChild("PART_HeaderArea") is FrameworkElement source)
			{
				SetBinding(TabHeaderHeightProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ActualHeight")
				{
					Source = source
				});
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, TabHeaderHeightProperty);
			}
			if (IsMinimized)
			{
				VerifyMinimizedContentBinding();
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new XamTabControlAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator != null)
			{
				base.ItemContainerGenerator.StatusChanged += OnGeneratorStatusChanged;
			}
			base.OnInitialized(e);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled && TabControlCommands.Instance.ProcessKeyboardInput(e, this))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDoubleClick(e);
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new TabItemEx();
		}

		private TabItem GetTabItem(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs mouseArgs)
		{
			System.Windows.Point position = mouseArgs.GetPosition(this);
			if (!(InputHitTest(position) is DependencyObject descendant))
			{
				return null;
			}
			TabItem tabItem = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(descendant, typeof(TabItem), allowSubclassOfType: true, this) as TabItem;
			if (tabItem != null)
			{
				int num = base.ItemContainerGenerator.IndexFromContainer(tabItem);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					tabItem = null;
				}
			}
			if (tabItem != null)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = mouseArgs.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
				while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
				{
					dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				}
				if (dependencyObject is UIElement uIElement && uIElement.InputHitTest(mouseArgs.GetPosition(uIElement)) != null && !tabItem.IsAncestorOf(uIElement))
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return tabItem;
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(this);
			TabItem tabItem = GetTabItem(e);
			_eatNextMouseLeftButtonUp = false;
			bool flag = tabItem?.Focusable ?? false;
			if (tabItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (InputHitTest(position) is DependencyObject dependencyObject)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase buttonBase = dependencyObject as System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase;
				if (buttonBase == null)
				{
					buttonBase = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase), allowSubclassOfType: true, tabItem) as System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase;
				}
				if (buttonBase != null && buttonBase.IsEnabled)
				{
					base.OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
					return;
				}
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = tabItem?.IsSelected ?? false;
			int doubleClickTime = NativeWindowMethods.DoubleClickTime;
			System.Windows.Size doubleClickSize = NativeWindowMethods.DoubleClickSize;
			double num = Math.Abs(position.X - _lastSingleLeftMouseDownPoint.X);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(position.Y - _lastSingleLeftMouseDownPoint.Y);
			if (e.Timestamp - _lastSingleLeftMouseDownTime < doubleClickTime && num <= doubleClickSize.Width && num2 <= doubleClickSize.Height)
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			else
			{
				if (flag3 || IsMinimized)
				{
					_lastSingleLeftMouseDownTime = e.Timestamp;
					_lastSingleLeftMouseDownPoint = position;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				if (IsDropDownOpen && (flag3 || tabItem == null))
				{
					IsDropDownOpen = false;
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!flag3)
			{
				if (IsMinimized)
				{
					flag = false;
					_eatNextMouseLeftButtonUp = true;
				}
				if (tabItem.Focusable)
				{
					if (!tabItem.Focus())
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (tabItem.IsKeyboardFocused && !tabItem.IsSelected && IsMinimized)
					{
						DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(tabItem, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(tabItem, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
			}
			tabItem.BringIntoView();
			if (!flag)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			if (flag2 && AllowMinimize)
			{
				IsMinimized = !IsMinimized;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			TabDragMode tabDragModeResolved = TabDragModeResolved;
			if (tabDragModeResolved != TabDragMode.None)
			{
				if (_tabDragHelper != null)
				{
					_tabDragHelper.EndTabDrag();
				}
				_tabDragHelper = new TabDragHelper(this, tabDragModeResolved);
				_tabDragHelper.StartDrag(e);
			}
			if (!e.Handled && flag)
			{
				base.OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_eatNextMouseLeftButtonUp)
			{
				_eatNextMouseLeftButtonUp = false;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Property == System.Windows.Controls.Control.TemplateProperty)
			{
				if (_cpMinimized != null)
				{
					_cpMinimized.ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
				}
				if (_cpMaximized != null)
				{
					_cpMaximized.ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
				}
			}
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property != System.Windows.Controls.TabControl.SelectedContentProperty || _cpMaximized == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
			{
				if (_cpMaximized != null && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(_cpMaximized) is FrameworkElement { IsMeasureValid: not false } frameworkElement)
				{
					frameworkElement.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			});
		}

		protected override void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_initializingSelection)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.AddedItems.Count == 1 && IsMinimized)
			{
				if (_suppressSelectionChangeCount > 0)
				{
					_initializingSelection = true;
					try
					{
						base.SelectedIndex = -1;
						return;
					}
					finally
					{
						_initializingSelection = false;
					}
				}
				bool isDropDownOpen = IsDropDownOpen;
				IsDropDownOpen = true;
				if (isDropDownOpen)
				{
					InitializeDropdownLocationInfo();
				}
			}
			if (base.IsInitialized && e.AddedItems.Count == 1)
			{
				TabItem selectedTabItem = GetSelectedTabItem();
				if (selectedTabItem != null)
				{
					DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(this);
					if (FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(focusScope) is TabItem tabItem && tabItem != selectedTabItem && ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(tabItem) == this)
					{
						if (!base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
						{
							Utilities.SetFocusedElement(focusScope, selectedTabItem);
						}
						else if (selectedTabItem.Focusable)
						{
							selectedTabItem.Focus();
						}
						else
						{
							Focus();
						}
					}
					selectedTabItem.BringIntoView();
				}
			}
			base.OnSelectionChanged(e);
			RefreshSelectedTabPeerChildren();
		}

		private static void OnAllowNullSelectedItemChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamTabControl xamTabControl = d as XamTabControl;
			if (false.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				xamTabControl.ResetSelectedItem();
			}
		}

				xamTabControl.VerifyScrollBarVisibility();
			}
		}

		{
			if (target is XamTabControl xamTabControl)
			{
				xamTabControl.RaiseAutomationExpandCollapseStateChanged();
			}
		}

		private static void OnAllowTabClosingChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is XamTabControl xamTabControl)
			{
				xamTabControl.BumpInternalVersion();
			}
		}

		public static bool GetIsDragging(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(IsDraggingProperty);
		}

		private static void OnIsDropDownOpenChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is XamTabControl xamTabControl))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = (bool)e.NewValue;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!xamTabControl.IsMinimized)
				{
					xamTabControl.IsMinimized = true;
				}
				else
				{
					xamTabControl.ResetSelectedItem();
				}
			}
			else if (xamTabControl.IsMinimized)
			{
				xamTabControl.ResetSelectedItem();
			}
			xamTabControl.VerifySelectedContent();
			if (flag)
			{
				xamTabControl.InitializeDropdownLocationInfo();
			}
			xamTabControl.RefreshSelectedTabPeerChildren();
			if (flag)
			{
				xamTabControl.RaiseDropDownOpened(new RoutedEventArgs());
			}
			else
			{
				xamTabControl.RaiseDropDownClosed(new RoutedEventArgs());
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceIsDropDownOpen(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			XamTabControl xamTabControl = d as XamTabControl;
			if (xamTabControl != null && KnownBoxes.TrueBox.Equals(value) && !xamTabControl.IsMinimized)
			{
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}
			if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(xamTabControl))
			{
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}
			if ((bool)value)
			{
				TabControlDropDownOpeningEventArgs args = new TabControlDropDownOpeningEventArgs();
				xamTabControl.RaiseDropDownOpening(args);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void OnIsMinimizedChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XamTabControl xamTabControl)
			{
				if (!(bool)e.NewValue && xamTabControl.IsDropDownOpen)
				{
					xamTabControl.IsDropDownOpen = false;
				}
				xamTabControl.VerifyMinimizedContentBinding();
				xamTabControl.ResetSelectedItem();
				xamTabControl.RaiseAutomationExpandCollapseStateChanged();
			}
		}

		private static bool OnValidateAtLeastZero(object newValue)
		{
			if (newValue is double)
			{
				return (double)newValue >= 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			if (!(value is int) || (int)value < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
