		{
			RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<string> e = new RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<string>(previousValue, currentValue);
			e.RoutedEvent = ThemeChangedEvent;
			e.Source = this;
			RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		public bool ExecuteCommand(RoutedCommand command)
		{
			return ExecuteCommandImpl(new ExecuteCommandInfo(command));
		}

		internal void DisposeTabDragHelper()
		{
			_tabDragHelper = null;
		}

		private void BumpInternalVersion()
		{
			SetValue(InternalVersionPropertyKey, InternalVersion + 1);
		}

		internal bool CloseTab(TabItemEx tab)
		{
			if (!tab.Close())
			{
				return false;
			}
			EnsureSelectedTabIsVisible();
			return true;
		}

		internal bool CloseAllTabs(TabItem excludeTab)
		{
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = base.Items.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (GetTabItemAtIndex(i, nullIfDisabled: false, nullIfCollapsed: true) is TabItemEx tabItemEx && tabItemEx != excludeTab)
					{
						tabItemEx.Close();
					}
				}
			}
			EnsureSelectedTabIsVisible();
			return true;
		}

		private void EnsureSelectedTabIsVisible()
		{
			TabItem selectedTabItem = GetSelectedTabItem();
			if (selectedTabItem != null && selectedTabItem.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				TabItem tabItem = GetNextTabItem(selectedTabItem, excludeDisabled: true, excludeCollapsed: true);
				if (tabItem == null)
				{
					tabItem = GetPreviousTabItem(selectedTabItem, excludeDisabled: true, excludeCollapsed: true);
				}
				if (tabItem == null)
				{
					tabItem = GetNextTabItem(selectedTabItem, excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true);
				}
				if (tabItem == null)
				{
					tabItem = GetPreviousTabItem(selectedTabItem, excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true);
				}
				if (tabItem == null)
				{
					base.SelectedIndex = -1;
				}
				else
				{
					base.SelectedIndex = base.ItemContainerGenerator.IndexFromContainer(tabItem);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ExecuteCommandImpl(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(routedCommand, "command");
			if (!Commands<XamTabControl>.IsMinimumStatePresentForCommand(this, routedCommand))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((ICommandHost)this).CanExecute(commandInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExecutingCommandEventArgs e = new ExecutingCommandEventArgs(routedCommand);
			if (!RaiseExecutingCommand(e))
			{
				return !e.ContinueKeyRouting;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (routedCommand == TabItemExCommands.Close || routedCommand == TabControlCommands.CloseSelected)
			{
				if (GetSelectedTabItem() is TabItemEx tab)
				{
					flag = CloseTab(tab);
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == TabItemExCommands.CloseAllButThis)
			{
				TabItem selectedTabItem = GetSelectedTabItem();
				if (selectedTabItem != null)
				{
					flag = CloseAllTabs(selectedTabItem);
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.CloseAll)
			{
				flag = CloseAllTabs(null);
			}
			else if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.SelectFirstTab)
			{
				TabItem firstTabItemToSelect = GetFirstTabItemToSelect();
				if (firstTabItemToSelect != null)
				{
					DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(firstTabItemToSelect, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					firstTabItemToSelect.BringIntoView();
				}
				flag = firstTabItemToSelect?.IsSelected ?? false;
			}
			else if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.SelectLastTab)
			{
				TabItem lastTabItem = GetLastTabItem(excludeDisabled: true, excludeCollapsed: true);
				if (lastTabItem == null)
				{
					lastTabItem = GetLastTabItem(excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true);
				}
				if (lastTabItem != null)
				{
					DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(lastTabItem, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					lastTabItem.BringIntoView();
				}
				flag = lastTabItem?.IsSelected ?? false;
			}
			if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.SelectNextTab)
			{
				TabItem selectedTabItem2 = GetSelectedTabItem();
				if (selectedTabItem2 != null)
				{
					TabItem nextTabItem = GetNextTabItem(selectedTabItem2, excludeDisabled: true, excludeCollapsed: true);
					if (nextTabItem == null)
					{
						nextTabItem = GetNextTabItem(selectedTabItem2, excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true);
					}
					if (nextTabItem != null)
					{
						DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(nextTabItem, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
						nextTabItem.BringIntoView();
					}
					flag = nextTabItem?.IsSelected ?? false;
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.SelectPreviousTab)
			{
				TabItem selectedTabItem3 = GetSelectedTabItem();
				if (selectedTabItem3 != null)
				{
					TabItem previousTabItem = GetPreviousTabItem(selectedTabItem3, excludeDisabled: true, excludeCollapsed: true);
					if (previousTabItem == null)
					{
						previousTabItem = GetPreviousTabItem(selectedTabItem3, excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true);
					}
					if (previousTabItem != null)
					{
						DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(previousTabItem, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
						previousTabItem.BringIntoView();
					}
					flag = previousTabItem?.IsSelected ?? false;
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.Expand)
			{
				IsMinimized = false;
				flag = !IsMinimized;
			}
			else if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.Minimize)
			{
				if (AllowMinimize)
				{
					IsMinimized = true;
					flag = IsMinimized;
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.ToggleMinimized)
			{
				if (IsMinimized)
				{
					IsMinimized = false;
					flag = !IsMinimized;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!AllowMinimize)
					{
						return false;
					}
					IsMinimized = true;
					flag = IsMinimized;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				RaiseExecutedCommand(new ExecutedCommandEventArgs(routedCommand));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private TabItem GetFirstTabItem(bool excludeDisabled, bool excludeCollapsed)
		{
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = base.Items.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					TabItem tabItemAtIndex = GetTabItemAtIndex(i, excludeDisabled, excludeCollapsed);
					if (tabItemAtIndex != null)
					{
						return tabItemAtIndex;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private TabItem GetFirstTabItemToSelect()
		{
			TabItem firstTabItem = GetFirstTabItem(excludeDisabled: true, excludeCollapsed: true);
			if (firstTabItem != null)
			{
				return firstTabItem;
			}
			return GetFirstTabItem(excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true);
		}

		private TabItem GetLastTabItem(bool excludeDisabled, bool excludeCollapsed)
		{
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				for (int num = base.Items.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					TabItem tabItemAtIndex = GetTabItemAtIndex(num, excludeDisabled, excludeCollapsed);
					if (tabItemAtIndex != null)
					{
						return tabItemAtIndex;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private TabItem GetNextTabItem(TabItem startTab, bool excludeDisabled, bool excludeCollapsed)
		{
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				int num = base.ItemContainerGenerator.IndexFromContainer(startTab);
				int i = num + 1;
				for (int count = base.Items.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					TabItem tabItemAtIndex = GetTabItemAtIndex(i, excludeDisabled, excludeCollapsed);
					if (tabItemAtIndex != null)
					{
						return tabItemAtIndex;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private TabItem GetPreviousTabItem(TabItem startTab, bool excludeDisabled, bool excludeCollapsed)
		{
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				int num = base.ItemContainerGenerator.IndexFromContainer(startTab);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = base.Items.Count;
				}
				for (int num2 = num - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					TabItem tabItemAtIndex = GetTabItemAtIndex(num2, excludeDisabled, excludeCollapsed);
					if (tabItemAtIndex != null)
					{
						return tabItemAtIndex;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private object GetFirstVisibleTabItem()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) is FrameworkElement { Visibility: Visibility.Visible, IsEnabled: not false } frameworkElement)
				{
					return frameworkElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private CustomPopupPlacement[] GetPreferredPopupPlacement(System.Windows.Size popupSize, System.Windows.Size targetSize, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			CustomPopupPlacement[] array = new CustomPopupPlacement[2];
			double x = ((base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight) ? 0.0 : (0.0 - popupSize.Width));
			System.Windows.Point point2;
			System.Windows.Point point;
			PopupPrimaryAxis primaryAxis;
			switch (base.TabStripPlacement)
			{
			case Dock.Left:
				point2 = new System.Windows.Point(targetSize.Width, 0.0);
				point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0 - popupSize.Width, 0.0);
				primaryAxis = PopupPrimaryAxis.Horizontal;
				break;
			case Dock.Right:
				point = new System.Windows.Point(targetSize.Width, 0.0);
				point2 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0 - popupSize.Width, 0.0);
				primaryAxis = PopupPrimaryAxis.Horizontal;
				break;
			default:
				point2 = new System.Windows.Point(x, targetSize.Height);
				point = new System.Windows.Point(x, 0.0 - popupSize.Height);
				primaryAxis = PopupPrimaryAxis.Vertical;
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				point = new System.Windows.Point(x, targetSize.Height);
				point2 = new System.Windows.Point(x, 0.0 - popupSize.Height);
				primaryAxis = PopupPrimaryAxis.Vertical;
				break;
			}
			array[0] = new CustomPopupPlacement(point2, primaryAxis);
			array[1] = new CustomPopupPlacement(point, primaryAxis);
			return array;
		}

		private TabItem GetSelectedTabItem()
		{
			int selectedIndex = base.SelectedIndex;
			if (selectedIndex >= 0)
			{
				return base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(selectedIndex) as TabItem;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private TabItem GetTabItemAtIndex(int index, bool nullIfDisabled, bool nullIfCollapsed)
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(index) is TabItem tabItem && (!nullIfCollapsed || tabItem.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed) && (!nullIfDisabled || tabItem.IsEnabled))
			{
				return tabItem;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void InitializeDropdownLocationInfo()
		{
			object selectedItem = base.SelectedItem;
			TabItem tabItem = ((selectedItem == null) ? null : (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(selectedItem) as TabItem));
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (GetTemplateChild("PART_HeaderArea") as FrameworkElement) ?? this;
			bool flag = Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && base.IsMouseOver;
			if (flag && tabItem is TabItemEx)
			{
				HitTestResult hitTestResult = VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(tabItem, Mouse.GetPosition(tabItem));
				if (hitTestResult == null || hitTestResult.VisualHit == null)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(frameworkElement.ActualWidth, frameworkElement.ActualHeight);
			System.Windows.Point point = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(frameworkElement, default(System.Windows.Point));
			System.Windows.Point point2 = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(frameworkElement, new System.Windows.Point(size.Width, size.Height));
			Rect rect = Utilities.RectFromPoints(point, point2);
			System.Windows.Point point3;
			if (flag)
			{
				point3 = Mouse.GetPosition(frameworkElement);
			}
			else
			{
				Rect workArea = Utilities.GetWorkArea(frameworkElement, default(System.Windows.Point), null);
				Rect workArea2 = Utilities.GetWorkArea(frameworkElement, new System.Windows.Point(frameworkElement.ActualWidth, frameworkElement.ActualHeight), null);
				workArea.Intersect(rect);
				workArea2.Intersect(rect);
				double num = workArea.Width * workArea.Height;
				double num2 = workArea2.Width * workArea2.Height;
				point3 = ((num >= num2) ? workArea.Location : workArea2.Location);
				point3 = Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(frameworkElement, point3);
			}
			Rect workArea3 = Utilities.GetWorkArea(frameworkElement, point3, null);
			Rect rect2 = Rect.Intersect(rect, workArea3);
			bool flag2 = DropDownPlacement == TabAreaDropDownPlacement.AllowMonitorSpanning;
			if (flag2 && _popup.Tag == null)
			{
				PopupController popupController = PopupController.Create(_popup, this);
				if (popupController != null)
				{
					_popup.Tag = popupController;
					popupController.BindPopupRootExtents = true;
					_popup.Placement = PlacementMode.Absolute;
				}
				else
				{
					flag2 = false;
				}
			}
			else if (!flag2 && _popup.Tag is PopupController)
			{
				PopupController popupController2 = _popup.Tag as PopupController;
				_popup.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.TagProperty);
				_popup.ClearValue(Popup.PlacementProperty);
				_popup.ClearValue(Popup.HorizontalOffsetProperty);
				_popup.ClearValue(Popup.VerticalOffsetProperty);
				popupController2.Deactivate();
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				rect2 = rect;
			}
			System.Windows.Point point4 = Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(frameworkElement, rect2.Location);
			System.Windows.Point point5 = Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(frameworkElement, new System.Windows.Point(rect2.Right, rect2.Bottom));
			Rect rect3 = Utilities.RectFromPoints(point4, point5);
			double num3 = ((base.TabStripPlacement == Dock.Left || base.TabStripPlacement == Dock.Right) ? rect3.Height : rect3.Width);
			SetValue(PreferredDropDownExtentPropertyKey, num3);
			if (_popup != null && _popup.CustomPopupPlacementCallback == PreferredDropDownPlacementCallback && _popup.Placement == PlacementMode.Custom)
			{
				if (_popupPlacementAdorner == null)
				{
					_popupPlacementAdorner = new PopupPlacementAdorner(this);
				}
				if (!(_popupPlacementAdorner.Parent is AdornerLayer))
				{
					AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(this)?.Add(_popupPlacementAdorner);
				}
				else
				{
					((AdornerLayer)_popupPlacementAdorner.Parent).InvalidateArrange();
				}
				_popupPlacementAdorner.Rect = frameworkElement.TransformToVisual(this).TransformBounds(rect3);
				if (!(_popup.PlacementTarget is PopupPlacementAdorner))
				{
					_oldPlacementTarget = _popup.ReadLocalValue(Popup.PlacementTargetProperty);
					_popup.PlacementTarget = _popupPlacementAdorner;
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				Rect rect4 = frameworkElement.TransformToVisual(this).TransformBounds(rect3);
				System.Windows.Point point6 = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(this, (base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight) ? rect4.BottomLeft : rect4.BottomRight);
				point6.X = Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)point6.X, this);
				point6.Y = Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels((int)point6.Y, this);
				_popup.HorizontalOffset = point6.X;
				_popup.VerticalOffset = point6.Y;
			}
		}

		private void OnAfterContainersGenerated(object context)
		{
			_suppressSelectionChangeCount--;
		}

		private static void OnComputedScrollBarVisibilityChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XamTabControl xamTabControl)
			{
				Visibility visibility = (Visibility)xamTabControl.GetValue(ComputedTabItemHorizontalScrollBarVisibilityProperty);
				Visibility visibility2 = (Visibility)xamTabControl.GetValue(ComputedTabItemVerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty);
				bool value = visibility == Visibility.Visible || visibility2 == Visibility.Visible;
				xamTabControl.SetValue(IsTabItemPanelScrollingPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(value));
			}
		}

		private void OnGeneratorStatusChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status != GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsMinimized)
			{
				_suppressSelectionChangeCount++;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Send, new ContextCallback(OnAfterContainersGenerated), null);
			}
			else if (base.HasItems && base.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				TabItem firstTabItemToSelect = GetFirstTabItemToSelect();
				if (firstTabItemToSelect != null)
				{
					DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(firstTabItemToSelect, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			if (!_isRefreshSelectedTabPeerPending)
			{
				return;
			}
			_isRefreshSelectedTabPeerPending = false;
			TabItem selectedTabItem = GetSelectedTabItem();
			if (selectedTabItem != null)
			{
				AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(selectedTabItem);
				if (automationPeer != null && automationPeer.EventsSource != null)
				{
					automationPeer.EventsSource.ResetChildrenCache();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Popup popup = sender as Popup;
			if (_oldPlacementTarget != NotInitialized)
			{
				if (_oldPlacementTarget == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
				{
					popup.ClearValue(Popup.PlacementTargetProperty);
				}
				else if (_oldPlacementTarget is BindingBase)
				{
					popup.SetBinding(Popup.PlacementTargetProperty, (BindingBase)_oldPlacementTarget);
				}
				else
				{
					popup.SetValue(Popup.PlacementTargetProperty, _oldPlacementTarget);
				}
			}
			_oldPlacementTarget = NotInitialized;
		}

		private static void OnPopupPreviewMouseUp_ClassHandler(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangedButton != MouseButton.Left || !(sender is Popup { TemplatedParent: XamTabControl { IsMinimized: not false, IsDropDownOpen: not false } templatedParent }))
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(templatedParent);
			if (templatedParent.InputHitTest(position) is DependencyObject descendant && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(descendant, typeof(TabItem), allowSubclassOfType: true, templatedParent) is TabItem container)
			{
				int num = templatedParent.ItemContainerGenerator.IndexFromContainer(container);
				if (num >= 0 && num == templatedParent.SelectedIndex)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnTabStripPlacementChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XamTabControl xamTabControl)
			{
				xamTabControl.VerifyScrollBarVisibility();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseAutomationExpandCollapseStateChanged()
		{
			if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this) is XamTabControlAutomationPeer xamTabControlAutomationPeer)
			{
				xamTabControlAutomationPeer.RaiseExpandCollapseStateChanged();
			}
		}

		private void RefreshSelectedTabPeerChildren()
		{
			if (!_isRefreshSelectedTabPeerPending)
			{
				_isRefreshSelectedTabPeerPending = true;
				base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
				base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
			}
		}

		private void ResetSelectedItem()
		{
			if (IsMinimized && !IsDropDownOpen && base.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				_previouslySelectedItem = base.SelectedItem;
				TabItem tabItem = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(_previouslySelectedItem) as TabItem;
				SetValue(Selector.SelectedItemProperty, null);
				if (tabItem == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (tabItem.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					if (tabItem.Focusable)
					{
						tabItem.Focus();
					}
					else
					{
						Focus();
					}
					return;
				}
				DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(tabItem);
				if (focusScope != null && focusScope == FocusManager.GetFocusScope(this))
				{
					Utilities.SetFocusedElement(focusScope, this);
				}
			}
			else if (base.SelectedItem == null && (!IsMinimized || IsDropDownOpen) && !AllowNullSelectedItem)
			{
				if (_previouslySelectedItem == null && base.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					_previouslySelectedItem = GetFirstVisibleTabItem();
				}
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(_previouslySelectedItem) != null)
				{
					base.SelectedItem = _previouslySelectedItem;
				}
				_previouslySelectedItem = null;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateThemeResources()
		{
			string[] groupings = new string[1] { PrimitivesResourceSet<PrimitivesGeneric.Locator>.Location.Grouping };
			Infragistics.Windows.Themes.ThemeManager.OnThemeChanged(this, Theme, groupings);
			if (base.IsInitialized)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
				UpdateLayout();
			}
		}

		private void VerifyScrollBarVisibility()
		{
			object value;
			object value2;
			if (IsMultiRow != HasVerticalTabs)
			{
				value = KnownBoxes.ScrollBarVisibilityAutoBox;
				value2 = KnownBoxes.ScrollBarVisibilityDisabledBox;
			}
			else
			{
				value = KnownBoxes.ScrollBarVisibilityDisabledBox;
				value2 = KnownBoxes.ScrollBarVisibilityAutoBox;
			}
			SetValue(TabItemHorizontalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey, value2);
			SetValue(TabItemVerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey, value);
		}

		private void VerifyMinimizedContentBinding()
		{
			bool isMinimized = IsMinimized;
			ContentPresenter cpMinimized = _cpMinimized;
			ContentPresenter cpMaximized = _cpMaximized;
			if (cpMinimized != null && cpMaximized != null)
			{
				ContentPresenter contentPresenter = (isMinimized ? cpMaximized : cpMinimized);
				ContentPresenter contentPresenter2 = (isMinimized ? cpMinimized : cpMaximized);
				contentPresenter.Content = null;
				contentPresenter2.SetBinding(ContentPresenter.ContentProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(System.Windows.Controls.TabControl.SelectedContentProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
				contentPresenter.ApplyTemplate();
			}
		}

		private void VerifySelectedContent()
		{
			object selectedItem = base.SelectedItem;
			TabItem tabItem = selectedItem as TabItem;
			if (tabItem == null && selectedItem != null)
			{
				tabItem = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(selectedItem) as TabItem;
			}
			if (tabItem != null && base.SelectedContent != tabItem.Content)
			{
				base.OnApplyTemplate();
			}
		}

		bool ICommandHost.Execute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			if (routedCommand != null)
			{
				return ExecuteCommandImpl(commandInfo);
			}
			return false;
		}

		long ICommandHost.GetCurrentState(long statesToQuery)
		{
			TabControlStates tabControlStates = (TabControlStates)0L;
			if (AllowMinimize)
			{
				tabControlStates |= TabControlStates.AllowMinimized;
			}
			if (IsMinimized)
			{
				tabControlStates |= TabControlStates.Minimized;
			}
			TabItem selectedTabItem = GetSelectedTabItem();
			if (selectedTabItem != null)
			{
				tabControlStates |= TabControlStates.HasSelectedTab;
				if (selectedTabItem is TabItemEx && ((TabItemEx)selectedTabItem).AllowClosingResolved)
				{
					tabControlStates |= TabControlStates.SelectedTabAllowsClosing;
				}
			}
			TabItem firstTabItem = GetFirstTabItem(excludeDisabled: true, excludeCollapsed: true);
			if (firstTabItem != null)
			{
				tabControlStates |= TabControlStates.HasSelectableTab;
				if (selectedTabItem == firstTabItem)
				{
					tabControlStates |= TabControlStates.FirstTabSelected;
				}
				TabItem lastTabItem = GetLastTabItem(excludeDisabled: true, excludeCollapsed: true);
				if (selectedTabItem == lastTabItem)
				{
					tabControlStates |= TabControlStates.LastTabSelected;
				}
			}
			return (long)tabControlStates;
		}

		bool ICommandHost.CanExecute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			if (routedCommand == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.ToggleMinimized)
			{
				return AllowMinimize;
			}
			if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.Expand)
			{
				return IsMinimized;
			}
			if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.Minimize)
			{
				if (AllowMinimize)
				{
					return !IsMinimized;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (routedCommand == TabItemExCommands.Close || routedCommand == TabControlCommands.CloseSelected)
			{
				if (GetSelectedTabItem() is TabItemEx tabItemEx)
				{
					return tabItemEx.AllowClosingResolved;
				}
				return false;
			}
			TabItem firstTabItem = GetFirstTabItem(excludeDisabled: false, excludeCollapsed: true);
			if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.CloseAll)
			{
				return firstTabItem != null;
			}
			if (firstTabItem != null)
			{
				TabItem firstTabItem2 = GetFirstTabItem(excludeDisabled: true, excludeCollapsed: true);
				if (firstTabItem2 != null)
				{
					TabItem selectedTabItem = GetSelectedTabItem();
					if (routedCommand == TabItemExCommands.CloseAllButThis)
					{
						return selectedTabItem != null;
					}
					if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.SelectFirstTab)
					{
						return firstTabItem2 != selectedTabItem;
					}
					TabItem lastTabItem = GetLastTabItem(excludeDisabled: true, excludeCollapsed: true);
					if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.SelectLastTab)
					{
						return lastTabItem != selectedTabItem;
					}
					if (selectedTabItem != null)
					{
						if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.SelectNextTab)
						{
							return lastTabItem != selectedTabItem;
						}
						if (routedCommand == TabControlCommands.SelectPreviousTab)
						{
							return firstTabItem2 != selectedTabItem;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class TabControlCommands : Commands<XamTabControl>
	{
		private const ModifierKeys AllCtrlShiftModifiers = ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand CloseAll;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand CloseSelected;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand Expand;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand Minimize;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand SelectFirstTab;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand SelectLastTab;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand SelectNextTab;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand SelectPreviousTab;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand ToggleMinimized;

		private static TabControlCommands g_instance;

		internal static TabControlCommands Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (g_instance == null)
				{
					g_instance = new TabControlCommands();
				}
				return g_instance;
			}
		}

		internal static CommandWrapper[] GetCommandWrappers()
		{
			return new CommandWrapper[9]
			{
				new CommandWrapper(CloseAll),
				new CommandWrapper(CloseSelected),
				new CommandWrapper(Expand),
				new CommandWrapper(Minimize),
				new CommandWrapper(SelectFirstTab),
				new CommandWrapper(SelectLastTab),
				new CommandWrapper(SelectNextTab),
				new CommandWrapper(SelectPreviousTab),
				new CommandWrapper(ToggleMinimized, 0L, 1L, new InputGestureCollection(new KeyGesture[1]
				{
					new KeyGesture(Key.M, ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift)
				}), ModifierKeys.None)
			};
		}

		static TabControlCommands()
		{
			CloseAll = new IGRoutedCommand("CloseAll", typeof(TabControlCommands), 0L, 0L);
			CloseSelected = new IGRoutedCommand("CloseSelected", typeof(TabControlCommands), 0L, 68L);
			Expand = new IGRoutedCommand("Expand", typeof(TabControlCommands), 0L, 32L);
			Minimize = new IGRoutedCommand("Minimize", typeof(TabControlCommands), 32L, 1L);
			SelectFirstTab = new IGRoutedCommand("SelectFirstTab", typeof(TabControlCommands), 8L, 4L);
			SelectLastTab = new IGRoutedCommand("SelectLastTab", typeof(TabControlCommands), 16L, 4L);
			SelectNextTab = new IGRoutedCommand("SelectNextTab", typeof(TabControlCommands), 16L, 4L);
			SelectPreviousTab = new IGRoutedCommand("SelectPreviousTab", typeof(TabControlCommands), 8L, 4L);
			ToggleMinimized = new IGRoutedCommand("ToggleMinimized", typeof(TabControlCommands), 0L, 1L);
			Commands<XamTabControl>.Initialize(GetCommandWrappers());
		}

		public static void LoadCommands()
		{
		}

		private static InputGestureCollection CreateGestureCombinations(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			InputGestureCollection inputGestureCollection = new InputGestureCollection();
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Control);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.None);
			return inputGestureCollection;
		}

		private static void AddGesture(InputGestureCollection gestures, Key key, ModifierKeys gestureModifiers, ModifierKeys modifierToCheck)
		{
			if ((gestureModifiers & modifierToCheck) == modifierToCheck)
			{
				gestures.Add(new KeyGesture(key, modifierToCheck));
			}
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Windows.Controls.Markup
{
	[MarkupExtensionReturnType(typeof(System.Windows.Input.Cursor))]
	public class CursorExtension : MarkupExtension
	{
		private string _path;

		private Type _typeInAssembly;

		private System.Windows.Input.Cursor _fallBack;

		private static bool _failedToLoad;

		[ConstructorArgument("path")]
		public string Path
		{
			get
			{
				return _path;
			}
			set
			{
				_path = value;
			}
		}

		[ConstructorArgument("typeInAssembly")]
		public Type TypeInAssembly
		{
			get
			{
				return _typeInAssembly;
			}
			set
			{
				_typeInAssembly = value;
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Input.Cursor FallbackValue
		{
			get
			{
				return _fallBack;
			}
			set
			{
				_fallBack = value;
			}
		}

		public CursorExtension()
		{
		}

		public CursorExtension(string path)
			: this()
		{
			_path = path;
		}

		public CursorExtension(string path, Type typeInAssembly)
			: this(path)
		{
			_typeInAssembly = typeInAssembly;
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			if (_path == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_MissingCursorExtensionPath"));
			}
			Uri uri;
			if (_typeInAssembly == null)
			{
				if (!(serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IUriContext)) is IUriContext uriContext))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_MarkupExtensionServiceRequired", GetType(), typeof(IUriContext)));
				}
				uri = new Uri(uriContext.BaseUri, _path);
			}
			else
			{
				uri = CoreUtilities.BuildEmbeddedResourceUri(_typeInAssembly.Assembly, _path);
			}
			if (_failedToLoad)
			{
				return _fallBack;
			}
			try
			{
				return Utilities.LoadCursor(uri);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				_failedToLoad = true;
				return _fallBack;
			}
		}
	}
	public class SafeDropShadowEffectExtension : MarkupExtension
	{
		public double BlurRadius { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Color Color { get; set; }

		public double Direction { get; set; }

		public double Opacity { get; set; }

		public double ShadowDepth { get; set; }

		public RenderingBias RenderingBias { get; set; }

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			if (BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				DropShadowEffect dropShadowEffect = new DropShadowEffect();
				dropShadowEffect.BlurRadius = BlurRadius;
				dropShadowEffect.Color = Color;
				dropShadowEffect.Direction = Direction;
				dropShadowEffect.Opacity = Opacity;
				dropShadowEffect.RenderingBias = RenderingBias;
				dropShadowEffect.ShadowDepth = ShadowDepth;
				return dropShadowEffect;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	[MarkupExtensionReturnType(typeof(OuterGlowBitmapEffect))]
	public class SafeOuterGlowExtension : MarkupExtension
	{
		private System.Windows.Media.Color _glowColor = Colors.Gold;

		private double _noise;

		public double Opacity
		{
			get
			{
				return _opacity;
			}
			set
			{
				_opacity = value;
			}
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			if (BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				OuterGlowBitmapEffect outerGlowBitmapEffect = new OuterGlowBitmapEffect();
				outerGlowBitmapEffect.GlowColor = _glowColor;
				outerGlowBitmapEffect.GlowSize = _glowSize;
				outerGlowBitmapEffect.Noise = _noise;
				outerGlowBitmapEffect.Opacity = _opacity;
				return outerGlowBitmapEffect;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public class UltraLicense : License
	{
		private UltraLicenseInfo licenseInfo;

		public UltraProductInfoBase ProductInfo => licenseInfo.ProductInfo;

		public string ComponentName => licenseInfo.ComponentName;

		public override string LicenseKey
		{
			get
			{
				string key = LicenseKeyForDisplay;
				if (licenseInfo.Key == null)
				{
					AddLicenseOptionsTokensToKey(ref key, licenseInfo.LicenseOptions);
				}
				return key;
			}
		}

		public string LicenseKeyForDisplay => licenseInfo.Key ?? licenseInfo.ProductInfo.Key;

		public LicenseOptions LicenseOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (licenseInfo.LicenseOptions == LicenseOptions.All)
				{
					return LicenseOptions.All;
				}
				UltraProductInfoBase productInfo = ProductInfo;
				if (productInfo is BetaProductInfo && productInfo.Status == LicenseStatus.BetaValid)
				{
					return LicenseOptions.All;
				}
				return licenseInfo.LicenseOptions;
			}
		}

		internal UltraLicenseInfo LicenseInfo => licenseInfo;

		internal UltraLicense(string componentName, UltraProductInfoBase productInfo, LicenseOptions licenseOptions)
			: this(new UltraLicenseInfo(componentName, productInfo, licenseOptions))
		{
		}

		internal UltraLicense(string componentName, UltraProductInfoBase productInfo, string key, LicenseOptions licenseOptions)
			: this(new UltraLicenseInfo(componentName, productInfo, key, licenseOptions))
		{
		}

		internal UltraLicense(UltraLicenseInfo licenseInfo)
		{
			this.licenseInfo = licenseInfo;
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
		}

		internal static void AddLicenseOptionsTokensToKey(ref string key, LicenseOptions licenseOptions)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(key);
			Array values = Enum.GetValues(typeof(LicenseOptions));
			string[] names = Enum.GetNames(typeof(LicenseOptions));
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				LicenseOptions licenseOptions2 = (LicenseOptions)values.GetValue(i);
				if (licenseOptions2 != LicenseOptions.None && licenseOptions2 != LicenseOptions.All && (licenseOptions & licenseOptions2) == licenseOptions2)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("_");
					stringBuilder.Append(names[i]);
				}
			}
			key = stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static LicenseOptions ParseLicenseOptionsTokensFromKey(ref string key)
		{
			LicenseOptions licenseOptions = LicenseOptions.All;
			if (key != null)
			{
				licenseOptions = LicenseOptions.None;
				Array values = Enum.GetValues(typeof(LicenseOptions));
				string[] names = Enum.GetNames(typeof(LicenseOptions));
				for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
				{
					LicenseOptions licenseOptions2 = (LicenseOptions)values.GetValue(i);
					if (licenseOptions2 != LicenseOptions.None && licenseOptions2 != LicenseOptions.All)
					{
						string text = $"_{names[i]}";
						if (key.IndexOf(text) >= 0)
						{
							licenseOptions |= licenseOptions2;
							key = key.Replace(text, string.Empty);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return licenseOptions;
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum LicenseOptions
	{
		None = 0,
		Office2007UI = 1,
		All = int.MaxValue
	}
	internal struct UltraLicenseInfo
	{
		public UltraProductInfoBase ProductInfo;

		public string Key;

		public string ComponentName;

		public LicenseOptions LicenseOptions;

		internal UltraLicenseInfo(string componentName, UltraProductInfoBase productInfo, LicenseOptions licenseOptions)
			: this(componentName, productInfo, null, licenseOptions)
		{
		}

		internal UltraLicenseInfo(string componentName, UltraProductInfoBase productInfo, string key, LicenseOptions licenseOptions)
		{
			ProductInfo = productInfo;
			ComponentName = componentName;
			Key = key;
			LicenseOptions = licenseOptions;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class)]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public abstract class UltraLicenseBaseAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private string componentName;

		private ArrayList products;

		public string ComponentName => componentName;

		internal UltraProductInfoBase[] AllProducts
		{
			get
			{
				if (products == null)
				{
					products = new ArrayList(3);
					LoadProductArray();
				}
				return (UltraProductInfoBase[])products.ToArray(typeof(UltraProductInfoBase));
			}
		}

		protected UltraLicenseBaseAttribute(string componentName)
		{
			if (!Utilities.HasSamePublicKey(GetType()))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_17"));
			}
			this.componentName = componentName;
		}

		public abstract UltraProductInfoBase[] GetLicensedWithProducts();

		private void LoadProductArray()
		{
			UltraProductInfoBase[] licensedWithProducts = GetLicensedWithProducts();
			if (licensedWithProducts == null || licensedWithProducts.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraProductInfoBase[] array = licensedWithProducts;
			foreach (UltraProductInfoBase ultraProductInfoBase in array)
			{
				if (!(ultraProductInfoBase is UltraProductInfo ultraProductInfo))
				{
					products.Add(ultraProductInfoBase);
					continue;
				}
				products.Add(ultraProductInfo);
				UltraProductInfoBase[] allNewerProducts = ultraProductInfo.AllNewerProducts;
				if (allNewerProducts != null && allNewerProducts.Length != 0)
				{
					products.AddRange(allNewerProducts);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public sealed class UltraLicenseProvider : LicenseProvider

		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public enum LicenseStatus
	{
		Unchecked,
		UnableToLocateLicenseAssembly,
		InsufficientSecurityPermissions,
		RegKeyNotFound,
		CDKeyInvalid,
		BetaExpired,
		BetaValid,
		TrialExpired,
		ActivationGracePeriodExpired,
		CDKeyValid,
		TrialValid,
		ActivationGracePeriodValid,
		Licensed
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public enum ProductType
	{
		WinFormsComponent,
		WebFormsComponent,
		WpfComponent
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public abstract class UltraProductInfoBase
	{
		private string productName;

		private ProductType productType;

		public abstract string Expiration { get; }

		public abstract bool RequiresActivation { get; }

		public string ProductName => productName;

		public abstract bool Expired { get; }

		public abstract LicenseStatus Status { get; }

		public abstract string Key { get; }

		public abstract string CompanyName { get; }

		public abstract string UserName { get; }

		public ProductType Type => productType;

		internal UltraProductInfoBase(string productName)
		{
			this.productName = productName;
		}

		internal UltraProductInfoBase(string productName, ProductType productType)
		{
			this.productName = productName;
			this.productType = productType;
		}

		protected internal abstract bool IsKeyValid(string key);

		public string GetStatusText()
		{
			switch (Status)
			{
			case LicenseStatus.ActivationGracePeriodExpired:
				return SR.GetUncustomizedString("LDR_About_GraceExpired");
			case LicenseStatus.ActivationGracePeriodValid:
				return SR.GetUncustomizedString("LDR_About_InGrace");
			case LicenseStatus.BetaExpired:
				return SR.GetUncustomizedString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionBetaExpired");
			case LicenseStatus.BetaValid:
				return SR.GetUncustomizedString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionBeta");
			case LicenseStatus.TrialExpired:
				return SR.GetUncustomizedString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionTrialExpired");
			case LicenseStatus.TrialValid:
				return SR.GetUncustomizedString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionTrial");
			case LicenseStatus.CDKeyValid:
			case LicenseStatus.Licensed:
				return SR.GetUncustomizedString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionLicensed");
			case LicenseStatus.Unchecked:
			case LicenseStatus.RegKeyNotFound:
			case LicenseStatus.CDKeyInvalid:
				return SR.GetUncustomizedString("AboutDialogLicenseDescriptionUnknown");
			default:
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public string GetKeyText()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Key))
			{
				if (Key.Length != 18)
				{
					text = Key;
					if (text == "{Trial}")
					{
						text = SR.GetString("TrialKey_AboutDialogLabel");
					}
				}
				else
				{
					text = Key.Substring(0, 4) + "-" + Key.Substring(4, 7) + "-" + Key.Substring(11, 7);
				}
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public sealed class BetaProductInfo : UltraProductInfoBase
	{
		internal static readonly char[] BETAKEY = new char[4] { 'B', 'e', 't', 'a' };

		private DateTime expirationDate;

		private string key = new string(BETAKEY);

		public override string Expiration => expirationDate.ToLongDateString();

		public override bool RequiresActivation => false;

		public override LicenseStatus Status
		{
			get
			{
				if (Expired)
				{
					return LicenseStatus.BetaExpired;
				}
				return LicenseStatus.BetaValid;
			}
		}

		public override string Key => key;

		public override string CompanyName => string.Empty;

		public override string UserName => string.Empty;

		public override bool Expired => DateTime.Today > expirationDate;

		public BetaProductInfo(string productName, DateTime expirationDate)
			: base(productName)
		{
			this.expirationDate = expirationDate;
		}

		public BetaProductInfo(string productName, DateTime expirationDate, ProductType productType)
			: base(productName, productType)
		{
			this.expirationDate = expirationDate;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsKeyValid(string key)
		{
			if (key != null)
			{
				return key == this.key;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		public UltraProductInfo(string productName, string regKeyProductName, string codePrefix, Guid id, bool requiresActivation, byte majorVersion, byte minorVersion)

		private void CheckLicenseStatus()
		{
			if (status != LicenseStatus.Unchecked)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (CheckProductStatus(this, updateProductInfoIfFound: false) != LicenseStatus.Unchecked)
			{
				CheckProductStatus(this, updateProductInfoIfFound: true);
				return;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			string licenseAssemblyInfo = GetLicenseAssemblyInfo();
			try
			{
				ObjectHandle objectHandle = Activator.CreateInstance(licenseAssemblyInfo, "Infragistics.License.LicenseValidator");
				object obj = objectHandle.Unwrap();
				Type type = obj.GetType();
				object[] array = new object[6] { regKeyProductName, majorVersion, minorVersion, empty, userName, companyName };
				MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("GetRegistryInfo");
				object obj2 = method.Invoke(obj, array);
				if (obj2 == null || !(bool)obj2 || (string)array[3] == "{Error}")
				{
					UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.RegKeyNotFound, DateTime.MinValue);
					return;
				}
				cdkey = array[3] as string;
				userName = array[4] as string;
				companyName = array[5] as string;
				if (cdkey == "{Trial}")
				{
					IsDemoValid(updateProductInfo: true);
				}
				else
				{
					IsLicenseValid(cdkey, updateProductInfo: true);
				}
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
				if (status == LicenseStatus.Unchecked)
				{
					UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.UnableToLocateLicenseAssembly, DateTime.MinValue);
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				if (status == LicenseStatus.Unchecked)
				{
					UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.InsufficientSecurityPermissions, DateTime.MinValue);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				if (status == LicenseStatus.Unchecked)
				{
					UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.RegKeyNotFound, DateTime.MinValue);
				}
			}
		}

		private static string GetLicenseAssemblyInfo()
		{
			string format = "Infragistics.License, Culture=\"\", Version={0}, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb";
			RegistryKey registryKey2;
			RegistryKey registryKey = (registryKey2 = null);
			try
			{
				registryKey2 = Registry.ClassesRoot.OpenSubKey("Infragistics.License");
				registryKey = registryKey2.OpenSubKey("Version2");
				string arg = registryKey.GetValue(null) as string;
				return string.Format(format, arg);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return "Infragistics.License, Culture=\"\", PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb";
			}
			finally
			{
				registryKey?.Close();
				registryKey2?.Close();
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsKeyValid(string key)
		{
			if (key == "{Trial}")
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (key == null || key.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsLicenseValid(key, updateProductInfo: false);
		}

		private bool IsDemoValid(bool updateProductInfo)
		{
			string licenseAssemblyInfo = GetLicenseAssemblyInfo();
			object obj = null;
			try
			{
				ObjectHandle objectHandle = Activator.CreateInstance(licenseAssemblyInfo, "Infragistics.License.LicenseValidator");
				obj = objectHandle.Unwrap();
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
				if (updateProductInfo)
				{
					UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.UnableToLocateLicenseAssembly, DateTime.MinValue);
				}
				return false;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				if (updateProductInfo)
				{
					UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.InsufficientSecurityPermissions, DateTime.MinValue);
				}
				return false;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				if (updateProductInfo)
				{
					UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.RegKeyNotFound, DateTime.MinValue);
				}
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				Type type = obj.GetType();
				MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("DaysRemainingBeforeTimeOut");
				object[] parameters = new object[5] { 30, regKeyProductName, majorVersion, minorVersion, id };
				try
				{
					object obj2 = method.Invoke(obj, parameters);
					int num = (daysRemaining = (int)obj2);
					if (updateProductInfo)
					{
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.TrialValid, GetExpirationDate(num));
						}
						else
						{
							UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.TrialExpired, GetExpirationDate(num));
						}
					}
					return num >= 0;
				}
				catch (Exception ex4)
				{
					if (updateProductInfo)
					{
						Exception innerException = ex4.InnerException;
						SecurityException ex5 = innerException as SecurityException;
						if (ex5 == null && innerException != null)
						{
							ex5 = innerException.InnerException as SecurityException;
						}
						if (ex5 != null)
						{
							if (ex5.PermissionType == null || typeof(RegistryPermission).IsAssignableFrom(ex5.PermissionType))
							{
								daysRemaining = 30;
								UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.TrialValid, GetExpirationDate(daysRemaining));
								return true;
							}
							UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.InsufficientSecurityPermissions, DateTime.MinValue);
						}
						else
						{
							UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.RegKeyNotFound, DateTime.MinValue);
						}
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus newStatus, DateTime expirationDate)
		{
			status = newStatus;
			this.expirationDate = expirationDate;
			if (newStatus > LicenseStatus.RegKeyNotFound && CheckProductStatus(this, updateProductInfoIfFound: false) == LicenseStatus.Unchecked)
			{
				ProductVerified(this);
			}
		}

		private bool IsLicenseValid(string key, bool updateProductInfo)
		{
			if (!VerifyCheckSum(key, isInternal: false))
			{
				if (updateProductInfo)
				{
					UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.CDKeyInvalid, DateTime.MinValue);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (!updateProductInfo)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (updateProductInfo)
			{
				cdkey = key;
				UpdateProductStatus(LicenseStatus.Licensed, DateTime.MaxValue);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void ProductVerified(UltraProductInfo product)
		{
			if (product != null)
			{
				if (verifiedProducts == null)
				{
					verifiedProducts = new ArrayList();
				}
				verifiedProducts.Add(product);
			}
		}

		private static bool HasPromptBeenDisplayed(UltraProductInfo product)
		{
			if (_canCheckEnvironmentVariable && product != null)
			{
				try
				{
					string promptVariableName = product.GetPromptVariableName();
					string environmentVariable = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(promptVariableName);
					if (bool.TrueString.Equals(environmentVariable))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_canCheckEnvironmentVariable = false;
				}
			}
			if (verifiedProducts == null || product == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (UltraProductInfo verifiedProduct in verifiedProducts)
			{
				if (verifiedProduct.Equals(product))
				{
					return verifiedProduct.promptDisplayed;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private string GetPromptVariableName()
		{
			return $"IG_{codePrefix}_{majorVersion}_{minorVersion}_{regKeyProductName}_{id}";
		}

		private static void UpdatePromptStatus(UltraProductInfo product, bool hasBeenDisplayed)
		{
			if (verifiedProducts == null || product == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraProductInfo verifiedProduct in verifiedProducts)
			{
				if (verifiedProduct.Equals(product))
				{
					verifiedProduct.promptDisplayed = hasBeenDisplayed;
				}
			}
		}

		private static LicenseStatus CheckProductStatus(UltraProductInfo product, bool updateProductInfoIfFound)
		{
			if (verifiedProducts == null || product == null)
			{
				return LicenseStatus.Unchecked;
			}
			foreach (UltraProductInfo verifiedProduct in verifiedProducts)
			{
				if (!verifiedProduct.Equals(product))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (updateProductInfoIfFound)
				{
					if (verifiedProduct.cdkey != null && verifiedProduct.cdkey.Length > 0)
					{
						product.cdkey = verifiedProduct.cdkey;
					}
					product.companyName = verifiedProduct.companyName;
					product.expirationDate = verifiedProduct.expirationDate;
					product.status = verifiedProduct.status;
					product.userName = verifiedProduct.userName;
					product.promptDisplayed = verifiedProduct.promptDisplayed;
					product.daysRemaining = verifiedProduct.daysRemaining;
				}
				return verifiedProduct.Status;
			}
			return LicenseStatus.Unchecked;
		}

		private bool VerifyCheckSum(string str, bool isInternal)
		{
			if (!isInternal && badCount > 6)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (str == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (str.Length != 18)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < str.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = str[i];
				if (c < '0' || (c > 'Z' && i > 0))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (!IsCDKeyPrefixValid(str))
			{
				if (!isInternal)
				{
					badCount++;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (codePrefix.Substring(0, 2) != str.Substring(0, 2))
			{
				if (!isInternal)
				{
					badCount++;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (codePrefix.Length >= 4 && str.Length >= 4 && char.IsNumber(codePrefix[2]) && char.IsNumber(codePrefix[3]) && char.IsNumber(str[2]) && char.IsNumber(str[3]))
			{
				int num = int.Parse(str.Substring(2, 2));
				int num2 = int.Parse(codePrefix.Substring(2, 2));
				if (num < num2)
				{
					if (!isInternal)
					{
						badCount++;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 8; j < 18; j++)
			{
				if (!char.IsDigit(str[j]))
				{
					if (!isInternal)
					{
						badCount++;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			int serialNumber = 0;
			bool flag = VerifyCDKey(str, ref serialNumber) != 0;
			if (!isInternal && !flag)
			{
				Thread.Sleep(1000);
				badCount++;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private static bool IsCDKeyPrefixValid(string licKey)
		{
			if (licKey == null || licKey.Length < 7)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
			{
				char c = licKey[i];
				if (!char.IsDigit(c) && (i >= 2 || !char.IsLetter(c)))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (licKey[4] == '0' && licKey[5] == '0')
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (licKey[6] != '0' && !char.IsLetter(licKey[6]))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (licKey[7] != '0' && licKey[7] != '1')
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static long LicenseCalcCheckSum(string str)
		{
			long num = 27L;
			long num2 = 31L;
			long value = 12765L;
			long value2 = 376L;
			for (int i = 0; i < str.Length; i++)
			{
				long num3 = str[i];
				num3 = num3 * 3 + num2;
				value2 += num * (num3 * num3);
				num2 = str[i];
				num2 *= 3;
				value += value2;
				num++;
				ReduceValue(ref value2, 999999, 697543);
				ReduceValue(ref value, 99999, 58567);
				ReduceValue(ref value, 9999, 9997);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void ReduceValue(ref long value, int maximum, int factor)
		{
			if (value > maximum)
			{
				long num = value - maximum;
				long num2 = num / factor;
				if (num % factor != 0L)
				{
					num2++;
				}
				value -= num2 * factor;
			}
		}

		private static long VerifyCDKey(string licKey, ref int serialNumber)
		{
			char[] array = new char[7];
			CDMsk checkDigitMask = GetCheckDigitMask(licKey);
			int i = 0;
			bool flag = true;
			for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
			{
				int num;
				for (num = checkDigitMask.rgCP[j]; i + j + 8 < num; i++)
				{
					array[5 - i] = licKey[8 + j + i];
				}
				string str = new string(licKey.ToCharArray(0, num));
				long checkSum = LicenseCalcCheckSum(str);
				char c = licKey[num];
				if (c != GetCheckDigitFromSum(checkSum, checkDigitMask))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				long num2 = long.Parse(new string(array));
				num2 = ((num2 >= checkDigitMask.nF1) ? (num2 - checkDigitMask.nF1) : (num2 + (1000000 - checkDigitMask.nF1)));
				serialNumber = (int)num2;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return 3L;
			}
			Thread.Sleep(500);
			return 0L;
		}

		private static CDMsk GetCheckDigitMask(string licKey)
		{
			if (licKey == null || licKey.Length < 18)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_19"));
			}
			string str = licKey.Substring(0, 8);
			long num = LicenseCalcCheckSum(str);
			return s_CDM[num % s_CDM.Length];
		}

		private static char GetCheckDigitFromSum(long checkSum, CDMsk mask)
		{
			return (char)(48 + (checkSum + mask.nF3) % mask.nF2 % 10);
		}

		private int GetCalendarWeeksLeft()
		{
			return (daysRemaining + 2 - 1) / 2;
		}

		private static DateTime GetExpirationDate(int usageDaysRemaining)
		{
			int num = (usageDaysRemaining + 2 - 1) / 2;
			return DateTime.Today.AddDays(7.0 * (double)num);
		}

		private void LoadAllNewerProductInfo()
		{
			if (allNewerProducts != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string licenseAssemblyInfo = GetLicenseAssemblyInfo();
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(3);
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList(3);
			try
			{
				ObjectHandle objectHandle = Activator.CreateInstance(licenseAssemblyInfo, "Infragistics.License.LicenseValidator");
				object obj = objectHandle.Unwrap();
				Type type = obj.GetType();
				MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("GetNewerVersions");
				object[] parameters = new object[5] { regKeyProductName, majorVersion, minorVersion, arrayList, arrayList2 };
				method.Invoke(obj, parameters);
				byte[] array = arrayList.ToArray(typeof(byte)) as byte[];
				byte[] array2 = arrayList2.ToArray(typeof(byte)) as byte[];
				if (array != null && array2 != null && array.Length == array2.Length)
				{
					allNewerProducts = new UltraProductInfo[array.Length];
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						byte b = array[i];
						byte b2 = array2[i];
						UltraProductInfo ultraProductInfo = new UltraProductInfo(base.ProductName, regKeyProductName, codePrefix, id, requiresActivation, base.Type, b, b2);
						allNewerProducts[i] = ultraProductInfo;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					allNewerProducts = new UltraProductInfo[0];
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal void DisplayPrompt()
		{
			if (promptDisplayed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (HasPromptBeenDisplayed(this))
			{
				promptDisplayed = true;
				return;
			}
			string text = null;
			switch (status)
			{
			case LicenseStatus.ActivationGracePeriodValid:
				text = string.Format(SR.GetString("LicensedProductActivationGracePrompt"), daysRemaining, GetCalendarWeeksLeft(), base.ProductName);
				break;
			case LicenseStatus.TrialValid:
				text = string.Format(SR.GetString("LicensedProductTrialPeriodPrompt"), daysRemaining, GetCalendarWeeksLeft(), base.ProductName);
				break;
			default:
				return;
			}
			promptDisplayed = true;
			UpdatePromptStatus(this, hasBeenDisplayed: true);
			if (text != null && _canCheckEnvironmentVariable)
			{
				try
				{
					string promptVariableName = GetPromptVariableName();
					Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(promptVariableName, bool.TrueString);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_canCheckEnvironmentVariable = false;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				string caption = SR.GetString("LicensedProductPromptDialogTitle", base.ProductName);
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(text, caption, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return codePrefix.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is UltraProductInfo ultraProductInfo && codePrefix == ultraProductInfo.codePrefix && majorVersion == ultraProductInfo.majorVersion && minorVersion == ultraProductInfo.minorVersion && regKeyProductName == ultraProductInfo.regKeyProductName)
			{
				return id == ultraProductInfo.id;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public sealed class UnlicensedProductInfo : UltraProductInfoBase
	{
		private string key = string.Empty;

		public override string Expiration => "N/A";

		public override bool RequiresActivation => false;

		public override LicenseStatus Status => LicenseStatus.Licensed;

		public override string Key => string.Empty;

		public override string CompanyName => string.Empty;

		public override string UserName => string.Empty;

		public override bool Expired => false;

		public UnlicensedProductInfo(string productName)
			: base(productName)
		{
		}

		public UnlicensedProductInfo(string productName, ProductType productType)
			: base(productName, productType)
		{
		}

		protected internal override bool IsKeyValid(string key)
		{
			if (key != null)
			{
				return key == this.key;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Windows.Internal
{
	internal class ThrottleTimer : DependencyObject
	{
		internal interface IAction
		{
			void Perform();
		}

		private class RegisteredCallback
		{
			private WeakReference _action;

			internal int _numberOfTimes;

			internal long _lastCallTime = -1L;

			internal IAction Action
			{
				get
				{
					if (_action == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return (IAction)CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_action);
				}
			}

			internal RegisteredCallback(IAction action)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(action, "action");
				_action = new WeakReference(action);
			}
		}

		private System.Threading.Timer _timer;

		private WeakList<RegisteredCallback> _callbacksList = new WeakList<RegisteredCallback>();

		private WeakDictionary<IAction, RegisteredCallback> _callbacks = new WeakDictionary<IAction, RegisteredCallback>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: false);

		private int _indecesCounter;

		private long _timerInterval;

		private const int IN_TICK = 1;

		private const int NOT_IN_TICK = 0;

		private int _inOnTimerTick;

		private bool _isTimerActive;

		private int _lastCompactCount;

		private long _throttleInterval;

		private long _maxTickProcessDuration;

		private int _lastTickCount;

		private long _wrapCounter;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<long, ThrottleTimer> g_instances;

		private long CurrentTime
		{
			get
			{
				int tickCount = Environment.TickCount;
				if (tickCount < _lastTickCount)
				{
					_wrapCounter += 2147483647L;
				}
				_lastTickCount = tickCount;
				return _wrapCounter + tickCount;
			}
		}

		public ThrottleTimer(long throttleInterval)
		{
			_throttleInterval = throttleInterval;
			_timerInterval = throttleInterval / 10;
			_maxTickProcessDuration = _timerInterval / 4;
		}

		public void DoThrottledInvoke(IAction action, bool throttleFirstInvoke)
		{
			if (!_callbacks.TryGetValue(action, out var value))
			{
				value = RegisterCallback(action, 0, dontAddToCallbackList: true);
			}
			long currentTime = CurrentTime;
			if (throttleFirstInvoke && -1 == value._lastCallTime)
			{
				value._lastCallTime = currentTime;
			}
			if (currentTime - value._lastCallTime > _timerInterval)
			{
				value._lastCallTime = currentTime;
				IAction action2 = value.Action;
				if (action2 != null)
				{
					if (value._numberOfTimes > 0)
					{
						value._numberOfTimes--;
					}
					action2.Perform();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (value._numberOfTimes <= 0)
				{
					_callbacksList.Add(value);
				}
				value._numberOfTimes = 1;
				EnsureTimerActive();
			}
		}

		public static ThrottleTimer GetInstance(long interval)
		{
			if (g_instances == null)
			{
				g_instances = new Dictionary<long, ThrottleTimer>();
			}
			Dictionary<long, ThrottleTimer> dictionary = g_instances;
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(interval, out var value))
			{
				value = (dictionary[interval] = new ThrottleTimer(interval));
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void CompactStructures()
		{
			if (_callbacksList.Count > 2 * _lastCompactCount)
			{
				_callbacksList.Compact();
				_callbacks.Compact(removeEntriesWithNullValues: true);
				_lastCompactCount = _callbacksList.Count;
			}
		}

		private void DeactivateTimer()
		{
			if (_isTimerActive)
			{
				_isTimerActive = false;
				_timer.Change(-1, -1);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureTimerActive()
		{
			if (!_isTimerActive)
			{
				if (_timer == null)
				{
					_timer = new System.Threading.Timer(OnTimerTick, null, _timerInterval, _timerInterval);
				}
				else
				{
					_timer.Change(_timerInterval, _timerInterval);
				}
				_isTimerActive = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnTimerTick(object parameter)
		{
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _inOnTimerTick, 1, 0) == 0)
			{
				try
				{
					base.Dispatcher.Invoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, new PropertyValueTracker.MethodInvoker(OnTimerTick_Sync));
				}
				finally
				{
					Interlocked.Exchange(ref _inOnTimerTick, 0);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnTimerTick_Sync()
		{
			WeakList<RegisteredCallback> callbacksList = _callbacksList;
			if (callbacksList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			CompactStructures();
			long currentTime = CurrentTime;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < callbacksList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_indecesCounter == int.MaxValue)
				{
					_indecesCounter = 0;
				}
				int index = _indecesCounter++ % callbacksList.Count;
				RegisteredCallback registeredCallback = null;
				try
				{
					registeredCallback = callbacksList[index];
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (registeredCallback != null && registeredCallback._numberOfTimes > 0)
				{
					num++;
					long currentTime2 = CurrentTime;
					if (currentTime2 - registeredCallback._lastCallTime < _throttleInterval)
					{
						continue;
					}
					registeredCallback._numberOfTimes--;
					registeredCallback._lastCallTime = currentTime2;
					IAction action = registeredCallback.Action;
					if (action == null || registeredCallback._numberOfTimes == 0)
					{
						try
						{
							callbacksList[index] = null;
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
					if (action != null)
					{
						action.Perform();
						if (currentTime2 - currentTime > _maxTickProcessDuration)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					try
					{
						callbacksList[index] = null;
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			if (num < callbacksList.Count / 2)
			{
				callbacksList.Compact();
				_callbacks.Compact(removeEntriesWithNullValues: true);
				_lastCompactCount = callbacksList.Count;
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				DeactivateTimer();
			}
		}

		private RegisteredCallback RegisterCallback(IAction action, int numberOfTimes, bool dontAddToCallbackList)
		{
			if (numberOfTimes < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (!_callbacks.TryGetValue(action, out var value))
			{
				value = new RegisteredCallback(action);
				flag = true;
			}
			value._numberOfTimes = numberOfTimes;
			if (flag)
			{
				_callbacks[action] = value;
				if (!dontAddToCallbackList)
				{
					_callbacksList.Add(value);
				}
				if (value._numberOfTimes > 0)
				{
					EnsureTimerActive();
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal void Unregister(IAction action)
		{
			if (_callbacks.TryGetValue(action, out var value))
			{
				_callbacks.Remove(action);
				int num = _callbacksList.IndexOf(value);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					_callbacksList[num] = null;
				}
				if (_callbacks.Count == 0)
				{
					DeactivateTimer();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class PropertyValueTracker : DependencyObject, ThrottleTimer.IAction
	{
		public delegate void PropertyValueChangedHandler();

		internal delegate void MethodInvoker();

		private PropertyValueChangedHandler _handler;

		private bool _callAsynchronously;

		private bool _hasPendingAsynchronousCallback;

		private object _tag;

		private DispatcherPriority _asynchronousDispatcherPriority = DispatcherPriority.Render;

		private int _throttleTime;

		private ThrottleTimer _cachedThrottleTimer;

		private bool _throttleFirstInvoke;

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty TargetProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("Target", typeof(object), typeof(PropertyValueTracker), null, OnTargetChanged);

		public DispatcherPriority AsynchronousDispatcherPriority
		{
			get
			{
				return _asynchronousDispatcherPriority;
			}
			set
			{
				_asynchronousDispatcherPriority = value;
			}
		}

		public bool CallAsynchronously
		{
			get
			{
				return _callAsynchronously;
			}
			set
			{
				_callAsynchronously = value;
			}
		}

		public object Tag
		{
			get
			{
				return _tag;
			}
			set
			{
				_tag = value;
			}
		}

		public int ThrottleTime
		{
			get
			{
				return _throttleTime;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_throttleTime != value)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Throttle time can't be less than 0.");
					}
					_throttleTime = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ThrottleFirstInvoke
		{
			get
			{
				return _throttleFirstInvoke;
			}
			set
			{
				_throttleFirstInvoke = value;
			}
		}

		internal object Target => GetValue(TargetProperty);

		public PropertyValueTracker(object source, string propertyPath, PropertyValueChangedHandler handler)
			: this(source, propertyPath, handler, callAsynchronously: false)
		{
		}

		public PropertyValueTracker(object source, string propertyPath, PropertyValueChangedHandler handler, bool callAsynchronously)
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = Utilities.CreateBindingObject(propertyPath, BindingMode.OneWay, source);
			Initialize(binding, handler, callAsynchronously);
		}

		public PropertyValueTracker(object source, DependencyProperty dependencyProperty, PropertyValueChangedHandler handler)
			: this(source, dependencyProperty, handler, callAsynchronously: false)
		{
		}

		public PropertyValueTracker(object source, DependencyProperty dependencyProperty, PropertyValueChangedHandler handler, bool callAsynchronously)
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = Utilities.CreateBindingObject(dependencyProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, source);
			Initialize(binding, handler, callAsynchronously);
		}

		private static void OnTargetChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PropertyValueTracker propertyValueTracker = (PropertyValueTracker)dependencyObject;
			propertyValueTracker.ProcessTargetChanged();
		}

		private void Initialize(System.Windows.Data.Binding binding, PropertyValueChangedHandler handler, bool callAsynchronously)
		{
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, TargetProperty, binding);
			_handler = handler;
			_callAsynchronously = callAsynchronously;
		}

		private void DelayedInvokeHanlder()
		{
			_hasPendingAsynchronousCallback = false;
			InvokeHandler();
		}

		private void InvokeHandler()
		{
			if (_handler != null)
			{
				_handler();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessTargetChanged()
		{
			if (_handler == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_throttleTime > 0)
			{
				if (!_hasPendingAsynchronousCallback)
				{
					if (_cachedThrottleTimer == null)
					{
						_cachedThrottleTimer = ThrottleTimer.GetInstance(_throttleTime);
					}
					_hasPendingAsynchronousCallback = true;
					_cachedThrottleTimer.DoThrottledInvoke(this, ThrottleFirstInvoke);
				}
			}
			else if (_callAsynchronously)
			{
				if (!_hasPendingAsynchronousCallback)
				{
					Dispatcher dispatcher = base.Dispatcher;
					if (dispatcher != null)
					{
						dispatcher.BeginInvoke(AsynchronousDispatcherPriority, new MethodInvoker(DelayedInvokeHanlder));
						_hasPendingAsynchronousCallback = true;
					}
					else
					{
						InvokeHandler();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InvokeHandler();
			}
		}

		public void Deactivate()
		{
			_handler = null;
			ClearValue(TargetProperty);
			if (_cachedThrottleTimer != null)
			{
				_cachedThrottleTimer.Unregister(this);
			}
		}

		void ThrottleTimer.IAction.Perform()
		{
			_hasPendingAsynchronousCallback = false;
			InvokeHandler();
		}
	}
