	public class PropertySerializationInfo
	{
		private Type _type;

		private string _name;

		public Type Type => _type;

		public string Name => _name;

		public PropertySerializationInfo(Type type, string name)
		{
			_type = type;
			_name = name;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _type.GetHashCode() ^ _name.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is PropertySerializationInfo propertySerializationInfo && _type == propertySerializationInfo._type)
			{
				return _name == propertySerializationInfo._name;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static PropertySerializationInfo Create(DependencyProperty dpProperty)
		{
			return new PropertySerializationInfo(dpProperty.PropertyType, dpProperty.Name);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ObjectSerializationInfo
	{
		public const string COLLECTION_ELEMENT_DESIGNATOR_KEY = "[]";

		public abstract IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties { get; }

		public abstract Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj);

		public abstract object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> obj);
	}
	internal class XmlSerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
	{
		private List<PropertySerializationInfo> _props;

		internal const string ELEMENT_NAME = "XmlSerializerData";

		private Dictionary<Type, XmlSerializer> _serializerCache;

		public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
		{
			get
			{
				if (_props == null)
				{
					_props = GetSerializedProperties();
				}
				return _props;
			}
		}

		private List<PropertySerializationInfo> GetSerializedProperties()
		{
			List<PropertySerializationInfo> list = new List<PropertySerializationInfo>();
			list.Add(new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(string), "Type"));
			list.Add(new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(string), "Data"));
			return list;
		}

		private XmlSerializer GetSerializer(Type type)
		{
			if (_serializerCache == null)
			{
				_serializerCache = new Dictionary<Type, XmlSerializer>();
			}
			if (!_serializerCache.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				try
				{
					value = new XmlSerializer(type);
				}
				catch
				{
					value = null;
				}
				_serializerCache[type] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static Type GetTypeHelper(string name)
		{
			try
			{
				Assembly[] assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
				foreach (Assembly assembly in assemblies)
				{
					Type type = assembly.GetType(name);
					if (null != type)
					{
						return type;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = obj.GetType();
			XmlSerializer serializer = GetSerializer(type);
			if (null == type)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			serializer.Serialize(memoryStream, obj);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			byte[] buffer = memoryStream.GetBuffer();
			Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			dictionary["Type"] = type.FullName;
			dictionary["Data"] = Convert.ToBase64String(buffer);
			memoryStream.Close();
			memoryStream.Dispose();
			return dictionary;
		}

		public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
		{
			Type type = null;
			if (values.TryGetValue("Type", out var value))
			{
				type = GetTypeHelper((string)value);
			}
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = ((null != type) ? GetSerializer(type) : null);
			if (xmlSerializer != null && values.TryGetValue("Data", out value))
			{
				byte[] buffer = Convert.FromBase64String((string)value);
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(buffer);
				object result = xmlSerializer.Deserialize(memoryStream);
				memoryStream.Close();
				memoryStream.Dispose();
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool IsTypeSupported(Type type)
		{
			return GetSerializer(type) != null;
		}
	}
	public class ObjectSerializerBase
	{
		internal class AttributeValueParser
		{
			private class TypeInfo
			{
				internal Type _type;

				internal TypeConverter _converter;

				internal string _name;

				internal TypeInfo(Type type)
				{
					_type = type;
					_name = type.Name;
					_converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(type);
				}

				internal TypeInfo(Type type, string name, TypeConverter converter)
				{
					_type = type;
					_name = name;
					_converter = converter;
				}
			}

			private const char TYPE_NAME_SEPARATOR = ':';

			private List<TypeInfo> _knownTypesInfo;

			private Regex _typeValuePairRegex;

			private CultureInfo _cultureInfo;

			private static AttributeValueParser g_instance = new AttributeValueParser();

			internal AttributeValueParser()
			{
				_cultureInfo = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				object[] array = new object[63]
				{
					typeof(string),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(sbyte),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(byte),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(short),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(ushort),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(int),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(uint),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(long),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(ulong),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(float),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(double),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(char),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(bool),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(decimal),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(DateTime),
					null,
					new DateTimeConverterWithMilliseconds(),
					typeof(string),
					null,
					null,
					typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color),
					null,
					new System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter(),
					typeof(Thickness),
					null,
					new ThicknessConverter(),
					typeof(Rect),
					null,
					new RectConverter(),
					typeof(System.Windows.Size),
					null,
					new System.Windows.SizeConverter(),
					typeof(System.Windows.Point),
					null,
					new System.Windows.PointConverter()
				};
				List<TypeInfo> list = new List<TypeInfo>();
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i += 3)
				{
					TypeInfo typeInfo = new TypeInfo((Type)array[i]);
					if (array[2 + i] != null)
					{
						typeInfo._converter = (TypeConverter)array[2 + i];
					}
					list.Add(typeInfo);
				}
				_knownTypesInfo = list;
				_typeValuePairRegex = new Regex("^ *([^ \\:]+) *\\: *(.*) *$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			}

			private bool ConvertFromStringHelper(string valueAsString, TypeInfo typeInfo, out object convertedValue)
			{
				if (typeInfo != null)
				{
					if (typeInfo._converter != null)
					{
						try
						{
							convertedValue = typeInfo._converter.ConvertFromString(null, _cultureInfo, valueAsString);
							return true;
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
					else
					{
						convertedValue = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(valueAsString, typeInfo._type, _cultureInfo, null);
						if (convertedValue != null)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				convertedValue = null;
				return false;
			}

			private bool ConvertToStringHelper(object value, out string convertedString)
			{
				convertedString = null;
				if (value == null)
				{
					convertedString = string.Empty;
				}
				else
				{
					TypeInfo typeInfo = GetTypeInfo(value.GetType());
					if (typeInfo != null)
					{
						if (typeInfo._converter != null)
						{
							convertedString = typeInfo._converter.ConvertToString(null, _cultureInfo, value);
						}
						else
						{
							convertedString = (string)CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(string), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, null);
						}
					}
				}
				return convertedString != null;
			}

			private TypeInfo GetTypeInfo(string name, Type propertyType)
			{
				List<TypeInfo> knownTypesInfo = _knownTypesInfo;
				for (int i = 0; i < knownTypesInfo.Count; i++)
				{
					TypeInfo typeInfo = knownTypesInfo[i];
					if (string.Compare(typeInfo._name, name, ignoreCase: true, _cultureInfo) == 0)
					{
						return typeInfo;
					}
				}
				if (null != propertyType)
				{
					propertyType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(propertyType);
				}
				if (null != propertyType && propertyType.IsEnum)
				{
					return new TypeInfo(propertyType);
				}
				return null;
			}

			private TypeInfo GetTypeInfo(Type type)
			{
				List<TypeInfo> knownTypesInfo = _knownTypesInfo;
				for (int i = 0; i < knownTypesInfo.Count; i++)
				{
					TypeInfo typeInfo = knownTypesInfo[i];
					if (type == typeInfo._type)
					{
						return typeInfo;
					}
				}
				if (null != type)
				{
					Type underlyingType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(type);
					if (underlyingType != type)
					{
						return GetTypeInfo(underlyingType);
					}
				}
				if (null != type && type.IsEnum)
				{
					return new TypeInfo(type);
				}
				return null;
			}

			private bool ParseAttrubuteValueHelper(string attributeValue, Type propertyType, out object parsedValue)
			{
				if (!ParseTypeValuePair(attributeValue, propertyType, out parsedValue))
				{
					TypeInfo typeInfo = GetTypeInfo(propertyType);
					if (typeInfo == null || !ConvertFromStringHelper(attributeValue, typeInfo, out parsedValue))
					{
						if (typeInfo != null || !(typeof(object) == propertyType))
						{
							return false;
						}
						parsedValue = attributeValue;
					}
				}
				parsedValue = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(parsedValue, propertyType, _cultureInfo, null);
				return parsedValue != null;
			}

			private bool ParseTypeValuePair(string attributeValue, Type propertyType, out object parsedValue)
			{
				if (attributeValue.IndexOf(':') > 0)
				{
					Match match = _typeValuePairRegex.Match(attributeValue);
					if (match != null && match.Success)
					{
						string value = match.Groups[1].Value;
						string value2 = match.Groups[2].Value;
						TypeInfo typeInfo = GetTypeInfo(value, propertyType);
						if (typeInfo != null && ConvertFromStringHelper(value2, typeInfo, out parsedValue))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				parsedValue = null;
				return false;
			}

			private bool ToAttributeValueHelper(object value, Type propertyType, out string attributeValue)
			{
				if (ConvertToStringHelper(value, out attributeValue))
				{
					Type type = ((value != null) ? CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(value.GetType()) : null);
					Type underlyingType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(propertyType);
					if (null != type && type != underlyingType && !(value is string))
					{
						TypeInfo typeInfo = GetTypeInfo(value.GetType());
						if (typeInfo != null)
						{
							attributeValue = typeInfo._name + ":" + attributeValue;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public static bool ParseAttrubuteValue(string attributeValue, Type propertyType, out object parsedValue)
			{
				return g_instance.ParseAttrubuteValueHelper(attributeValue, propertyType, out parsedValue);
			}

			internal static void RegisterType(Type type)
			{
				TypeInfo typeInfo = g_instance.GetTypeInfo(type);
				if (typeInfo != null && g_instance._knownTypesInfo.IndexOf(typeInfo) < 0)
				{
					g_instance._knownTypesInfo.Add(typeInfo);
				}
			}

			public static bool ToAttributeValue(object value, Type propertyType, out string attributeValue)
			{
				return g_instance.ToAttributeValueHelper(value, propertyType, out attributeValue);
			}
		}

		private class DateTimeConverterWithMilliseconds : DateTimeConverter
		{
			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (value is DateTime && destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
					if (dateTime.Millisecond != 0)
					{
						return dateTime.ToString("o", culture);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private XmlDocument _document;

		private Dictionary<Type, ObjectSerializationInfo> _registeredInfos;

		private XmlSerializationInfo _xmlSerializationInfo = new XmlSerializationInfo();

		public ObjectSerializerBase()
		{
			_document = new XmlDocument();
			_registeredInfos = new Dictionary<Type, ObjectSerializationInfo>();
			RegisterInfo(typeof(ConditionGroup), new ConditionGroup.SerializationInfo());
			RegisterInfo(typeof(ComparisonCondition), new ComparisonCondition.SerializationInfo());
			RegisterInfo(typeof(ComplementCondition), new ComplementCondition.SerializationInfo());
			RegisterInfo(typeof(ObjectWrapper), new ObjectWrapper.SerializationInfo());
			SpecialFilterOperandFactory.RegisterSerializationInfos(this);
			SpecialFilterOperands.RegisterSerializationInfos(this);
		}

		protected bool AppendValueHelper(XmlElement parentElem, string attributeName, string elementName, object value, Type propertyType)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeName) && SaveAsAttribute(value, propertyType, out var attributeValue))
			{
				parentElem.SetAttribute(attributeName, attributeValue);
				return true;
			}
			if (InternalSaveAsElement(value, propertyType, out var element))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(elementName))
				{
					XmlElement xmlElement = CreateNewElement(elementName);
					parentElem.AppendChild(xmlElement);
					parentElem = xmlElement;
				}
				parentElem.AppendChild(element);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected XmlElement CreateNewElement(string name)
		{
			return _document.CreateElement(name);
		}

		protected virtual bool ParseAttributeOverride(string attributeValue, Type propertyType, out object parsedValue)
		{
			parsedValue = null;
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool ParseElementOverride(XmlElement element, Type propertyType, out object parsedValue)
		{
			parsedValue = null;
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool SaveAsAttributeOverride(object obj, Type propertyType, out string attributeValue)
		{
			attributeValue = null;
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool SaveAsElementOverride(object obj, Type propertyType, out XmlElement element)
		{
			element = null;
			return false;
		}

		public bool ParseAttribute(XmlElement elem, string attributeName, Type propertyType, out object parsedValue)
		{
			parsedValue = null;
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = elem.Attributes[attributeName];
			if (xmlAttribute != null)
			{
				return ParseAttribute(xmlAttribute.Value, propertyType, out parsedValue);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ParseAttribute(string attributeValue, Type propertyType, out object parsedValue)
		{
			if (ParseAttributeOverride(attributeValue, propertyType, out parsedValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (AttributeValueParser.ParseAttrubuteValue(attributeValue, propertyType, out parsedValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ParseElement(XmlElement element, Type propertyType, out object parsedValue)
		{
			if (ParseElementOverride(element, propertyType, out parsedValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (InternalParseElement(element, propertyType, out parsedValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			parsedValue = null;
			return false;
		}

		public bool SaveAsAttribute(object obj, Type propertyType, out string attributeValue)
		{
			if (SaveAsAttributeOverride(obj, propertyType, out attributeValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (AttributeValueParser.ToAttributeValue(obj, propertyType, out attributeValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool SaveAsElement(object obj, Type propertyType, out XmlElement element)
		{
			if (SaveAsElementOverride(obj, propertyType, out element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (InternalSaveAsElement(obj, propertyType, out element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			element = null;
			return false;
		}

		private XmlElement GetFirstChildElement(XmlElement parentElem)
		{
			foreach (XmlNode childNode in parentElem.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (childNode is XmlElement)
				{
					return childNode as XmlElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal ObjectSerializationInfo GetRegisteredInfo(Type type)
		{
			if (_registeredInfos.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			ConstructorInfo constructor = type.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes);
			if (constructor != null && constructor.IsPublic)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<Type, ObjectSerializationInfo> registeredInfo in _registeredInfos)
				{
					if (type.IsSubclassOf(registeredInfo.Key) && registeredInfo.Value.GetType() == typeof(ReflectionSerializationInfo))
					{
						return _registeredInfos[type] = new ReflectionSerializationInfo(type, () => Activator.CreateInstance(type), ((ReflectionSerializationInfo)registeredInfo.Value).SerializeDefaultValues);
					}
				}
			}
			if (_xmlSerializationInfo.IsTypeSupported(type))
			{
				return _registeredInfos[type] = _xmlSerializationInfo;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ObjectSerializationInfo GetObjectSerializationInfo(XmlElement element, Type propertyType)
		{
			if ("XmlSerializerData" == element.Name)
			{
				return _xmlSerializationInfo;
			}
			foreach (Type key in _registeredInfos.Keys)
			{
				if (propertyType.IsAssignableFrom(key) && key.Name == element.Name)
				{
					return GetRegisteredInfo(key);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool InternalParseElement(XmlElement element, Type propertyType, out object parsedValue)
		{
			if (element != null && null != propertyType)
			{
				ObjectSerializationInfo objectSerializationInfo = GetObjectSerializationInfo(element, propertyType);
				if (objectSerializationInfo != null)
				{
					IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> serializedProperties = objectSerializationInfo.SerializedProperties;
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					int num = 0;
					foreach (PropertySerializationInfo item in serializedProperties)
					{
						string name = item.Name;
						Type type = item.Type;
						object parsedValue2;
						if ("[]" == name)
						{
							ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
							foreach (XmlNode childNode in element.ChildNodes)
							{
								if (childNode is XmlElement element2 && InternalParseElement(element2, type, out parsedValue2))
								{
									arrayList.Add(parsedValue2);
								}
							}
							dictionary[name] = arrayList.ToArray(type);
							continue;
						}
						XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = element.Attributes[name];
						if (xmlAttribute != null)
						{
							if (ParseAttribute(xmlAttribute.Value, type, out parsedValue2))
							{
								dictionary[name] = parsedValue2;
							}
							else
							{
								num++;
							}
						}
						else if (element.SelectSingleNode(name) is XmlElement parentElem)
						{
							XmlElement firstChildElement = GetFirstChildElement(parentElem);
							if (firstChildElement != null && InternalParseElement(firstChildElement, type, out parsedValue2))
							{
								dictionary[name] = parsedValue2;
							}
							else
							{
								num++;
							}
						}
					}
					parsedValue = objectSerializationInfo.Deserialize(dictionary);
					if (parsedValue != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			parsedValue = null;
			return false;
		}

		public bool InternalSaveAsElement(object obj, Type propertyType, out XmlElement element)
		{
			Type type = obj?.GetType();
			if (null != type)
			{
				ObjectSerializationInfo registeredInfo = GetRegisteredInfo(type);
				if (registeredInfo != null)
				{
					string name = type.Name;
					if (registeredInfo is XmlSerializationInfo)
					{
						name = "XmlSerializerData";
					}
					element = CreateNewElement(name);
					IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> serializedProperties = registeredInfo.SerializedProperties;
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = registeredInfo.Serialize(obj);
					int num = 0;
					foreach (PropertySerializationInfo item in serializedProperties)
					{
						string name2 = item.Name;
						Type type2 = item.Type;
						if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(name2, out var value))
						{
							continue;
						}
						if ("[]" == name2)
						{
							if (value is IEnumerable enumerable)
							{
								foreach (object item2 in enumerable)
								{
									if (!AppendValueHelper(element, null, null, item2, type2))
									{
										num++;
									}
								}
							}
							else
							{
								num++;
							}
						}
						else if (!AppendValueHelper(element, name2, name2, value, type2))
						{
							num++;
						}
					}
					if (num == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			element = null;
			return false;
		}

		public void RegisterInfo(Type type, ObjectSerializationInfo info)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(info, "info");
			_registeredInfos[type] = info;
		}
	}
	internal class ObjectWrapper
	{
		internal class SerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
		{
			private PropertySerializationInfo[] _props;

			private const string ValueProperty = "Value";

			public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties => _props;

			public SerializationInfo()
			{
				_props = new PropertySerializationInfo[1]
				{
					new PropertySerializationInfo(typeof(object), "Value")
				};
			}

			public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
			{
				ObjectWrapper objectWrapper = (ObjectWrapper)obj;
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
				dictionary["Value"] = objectWrapper.Value;
				return dictionary;
			}

			public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> obj)
			{
				if (obj.TryGetValue("Value", out var value))
				{
					return new ObjectWrapper(value);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal readonly object Value;

		public ObjectWrapper(object value)
		{
			Value = value;
		}
	}
	internal class ReflectionSerializationInfo : ObjectSerializationInfo
	{
		internal class ReflectionPropertySerializationInfo : PropertySerializationInfo
		{
			internal PropertyInfo _prop;

			internal ReflectionPropertySerializationInfo(PropertyInfo prop)
				: base(prop.PropertyType, prop.Name)
			{
				_prop = prop;
			}
		}

		private Type _type;

		private Func<object> _objectCreator;

		private bool _serializeDefaultValues;

		public override IEnumerable<PropertySerializationInfo> SerializedProperties
		{
			get
			{
				PropertyInfo[] properties = _type.GetProperties();
				return properties.Where((PropertyInfo ii) => ii.CanRead && ii.CanWrite && !CoreUtilities.HasItems(ii.GetIndexParameters())).Select((Func<PropertyInfo, PropertySerializationInfo>)((PropertyInfo ii) => new ReflectionPropertySerializationInfo(ii)));
			}
		}

		internal bool SerializeDefaultValues => _serializeDefaultValues;

		public ReflectionSerializationInfo(Type type, Func<object> objectCreator, bool serializeDefaultValues = false)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(type);
			_type = type;
			_objectCreator = objectCreator;
			_serializeDefaultValues = serializeDefaultValues;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerialize(ReflectionPropertySerializationInfo property, object value)
		{
			if (!_serializeDefaultValues && value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override Dictionary<string, object> Serialize(object obj)
		{
			Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = null;
			foreach (ReflectionPropertySerializationInfo serializedProperty in SerializedProperties)
			{
				object value = serializedProperty._prop.GetValue(obj, null);
				if (ShouldSerialize(serializedProperty, value))
				{
					dictionary = Utilities.AddEntryHelper(dictionary, serializedProperty.Name, value);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public override object Deserialize(Dictionary<string, object> values)
		{
			object obj = _objectCreator();
			foreach (ReflectionPropertySerializationInfo serializedProperty in SerializedProperties)
			{
				if (values.TryGetValue(serializedProperty.Name, out var value))
				{
					serializedProperty._prop.SetValue(obj, value, null);
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public class TileManager : ILayoutContainer
	{
		private class ItemRowColumnSizeInfo
		{
			private ItemInfoBase _info;

			private int _row;

			private int _column;

			private Rect _targetRect;

			private System.Windows.Size _preferredSize;

			private bool _wasMaximized;

			internal int Column => _column;

			internal ItemInfoBase Info => _info;

			internal int Row => _row;

			internal System.Windows.Size PreferredSize => _preferredSize;

			internal Rect TargetRect => _targetRect;

			internal bool WasMaximized => _wasMaximized;

			internal ItemRowColumnSizeInfo(ItemInfoBase info, int row, int column, Rect targetRect, System.Windows.Size preferredSize)
			{
				_info = info;
				_row = row;
				_column = column;
				_targetRect = targetRect;
				_preferredSize = preferredSize;
				_wasMaximized = info.GetIsMaximized();
			}

			internal Vector VerifyMaximizeState(Vector offset, Vector offsetForMaxmizedTiles)
			{
				bool isMaximized = _info.GetIsMaximized();
				if (_wasMaximized != isMaximized)
				{
					Vector vector = ((!_wasMaximized) ? (offset - offsetForMaxmizedTiles) : (offsetForMaxmizedTiles - offset));
					_targetRect.Offset(vector);
					_wasMaximized = isMaximized;
					return vector;
				}
				return default(Vector);
			}
		}

		private class LayoutItemGeneratorEnumerator : IEnumerator<ILayoutItem>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private TileManager _manager;

			private TilesPanelBase _panel;

			private TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache _genCache;

			private int _countMaxmized;

			private int _scrollCount;

			private int _currentLogicalIndex = -2;

			private int _startIndex;

			private bool _isEndReached;

			private bool _enumerateMaximizedTiles;

			private IList _items;

			private IList _maximizedItems;

			private ILayoutItem _currentItem;

			private System.Windows.Controls.Orientation _orientation;

			private ScrollDirection _direction;

			public ILayoutItem Current
			{
				get
				{
					EnsureNotEndReached();
					if (_currentItem == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_2"));
					}
					return _currentItem;
				}
			}

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			internal LayoutItemGeneratorEnumerator(TileManager manager, TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache, bool enumerateMaximizedTiles, int startIndex, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation orientation, ScrollDirection direction)
			{
				_manager = manager;
				_panel = manager._panel;
				_genCache = genCache;
				_enumerateMaximizedTiles = enumerateMaximizedTiles;
				_items = _manager.Items;
				_scrollCount = _manager.SparseArray.ScrollCount;
				_maximizedItems = _panel.GetMaximizedItems();
				_countMaxmized = _maximizedItems.Count;
				_startIndex = startIndex;
				_orientation = orientation;
				_direction = direction;
				Reset();
			}

			private void EnsureNotEndReached()
			{
				if (_isEndReached)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_1"));
				}
			}

			private int GetNextIndexToGen()
			{
				ItemInfoBase itemInfo;
				if (_enumerateMaximizedTiles)
				{
					if (_countMaxmized > 0)
					{
						if (_currentLogicalIndex < -1)
						{
							_currentLogicalIndex = 0;
						}
						while (_currentLogicalIndex < _countMaxmized)
						{
							object item = _maximizedItems[_currentLogicalIndex];
							_currentLogicalIndex++;
							itemInfo = _manager.GetItemInfo(item);
							if (!itemInfo.GetIsClosed())
							{
								return itemInfo.Index;
							}
						}
					}
					return -1;
				}
				if (_currentLogicalIndex < -1)
				{
					_currentLogicalIndex = _startIndex;
				}
				if (_currentLogicalIndex < 0 || _currentLogicalIndex >= _scrollCount)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (_currentLogicalIndex >= _scrollCount)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				itemInfo = _manager.GetItemAtScrollIndex(_currentLogicalIndex);
				if (_direction == ScrollDirection.Increment)
				{
					_currentLogicalIndex++;
				}
				else
				{
					_currentLogicalIndex--;
				}
				return itemInfo?.Index ?? (-1);
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				EnsureNotEndReached();
				int nextIndexToGen = GetNextIndexToGen();
				while (nextIndexToGen >= 0)
				{
					object item = _items[nextIndexToGen];
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = _genCache.GenerateElement(nextIndexToGen);
					UIElement uIElement = dependencyObject as UIElement;
					if (dependencyObject == null || (uIElement != null && uIElement.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed))
					{
						nextIndexToGen = GetNextIndexToGen();
						continue;
					}
					Dock enterFromSide = ((nextIndexToGen >= _manager._lastScrollPosition) ? ((_orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical) ? Dock.Right : Dock.Bottom) : ((_orientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical) ? Dock.Top : Dock.Left));
					_currentItem = _manager.InitializeLayoutItem(dependencyObject, item, enterFromSide);
					return true;
				}
				_isEndReached = true;
				_currentItem = null;
				if (!_enumerateMaximizedTiles)
				{
					_manager._wasLastScrollableItemGened = true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_isEndReached = false;
				_currentLogicalIndex = -2;
				_currentItem = null;
			}
		}

		internal enum TileArea
		{
			MaximizedTiles,
			MinimizedTiles
		}

		internal class LayoutItem : ILayoutItem, IGridBagConstraint, ITileConstraints
		{
			private DependencyObject _container;

			private UIElement _element;

			private object _item;

			private TileManager _manager;

			private Rect? _currentRect;

			private Rect _targetRect;

			private Rect _originalRect;

			private Dock _enterFromSide;

			private TileState _lastAtRestTileState;

			private GridBagLayoutItemDimensions _dimensions;

			private bool _fillAvailableRows;

			private bool _fillAvailableColumns;

			private int _asyncDesiredSizeChangeCount;

			private System.Windows.Size _preferredSizeCache;

			private System.Windows.Size _desiredSizeCache;

			private System.Windows.Size _lastMeasureSize;

			internal bool AlwaysMeasureContainer => _asyncDesiredSizeChangeCount > 3;

			internal DependencyObject Container => _container;

			internal Rect? CurrentRectInternal => _currentRect;

			internal Rect CurrentRect
			{
				get
				{
					if (_currentRect.HasValue)
					{
						return _currentRect.Value;
					}
					Rect targetRect = _targetRect;
					switch (_enterFromSide)
					{
					case Dock.Top:
						targetRect.Y = 0.0 - targetRect.Height;
						break;
					case Dock.Bottom:
						targetRect.Y = _manager._panel.ActualHeight;
						break;
					case Dock.Left:
						targetRect.X = 0.0 - targetRect.Width;
						break;
					case Dock.Right:
						targetRect.X = _manager._panel.ActualWidth;
						break;
					}
					return targetRect;
				}
				set
				{
					if (_currentRect != value)
					{
						_currentRect = value;
						if (IsCurrentSameAsTarget)
						{
							_originalRect = _targetRect;
							_lastAtRestTileState = _manager._panel.GetContainerState(_element);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			internal Dock EnterFromSide
			{
				get
				{
					return _enterFromSide;
				}
				set
				{
					_enterFromSide = value;
				}
			}

			internal bool IsCurrentSameAsTarget
			{
				get
				{
					if (!_currentRect.HasValue)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return _currentRect.Value == _targetRect;
				}
			}

			internal object Item => _item;

			internal ItemInfoBase ItemInfo => _manager.GetItemInfo(_item, createIfNotFound: false, -1);

			internal Rect OriginalRect => _originalRect;

			internal System.Windows.Size PreferredSizeCache => _preferredSizeCache;

			internal bool ShouldAnimateResize
			{
				get
				{
					TileState containerState = _manager._panel.GetContainerState(_container);
					return _lastAtRestTileState != containerState;
				}
			}

			internal Rect TargetRect => _targetRect;

			System.Windows.Size ILayoutItem.MaximumSize
			{
				get
				{
					double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
					double num2 = double.PositiveInfinity;
					ITileConstraints itemConstraints = _manager.GetItemConstraints(_container);
					if (itemConstraints != null)
					{
						num = itemConstraints.MaxWidth;

			{
				if (_element == null)

					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Size preferredSizeHelper = GetPreferredSizeHelper(calledFromEnsureMeasure: true);
				bool flag = !_element.IsMeasureValid;

				if (!flag)

					flag = (preferredSizeHelper != _lastMeasureSize && size != _lastMeasureSize) || _desiredSizeCache.IsEmpty;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (_manager._panel != null)
					{
						System.Windows.Size availableSize = size;
						if (size == _lastMeasureSize)
						{
							availableSize.Width += (double)(DateTime.Now.Millisecond + 1) / 1000.0;
						}
						_lastMeasureSize = size;
						_element.Measure(availableSize);
						_desiredSizeCache = _element.DesiredSize;
					}
				}
				else if (size == _lastMeasureSize)
				{
					_desiredSizeCache = _element.DesiredSize;
				}
			}

		private class ExplicitLayoutItemComparer : Comparer<IGridBagConstraint>
		{
			private ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior _behavior;

			internal ExplicitLayoutItemComparer(ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior behavior)
			{
				_behavior = behavior;
			}

			public override int Compare(IGridBagConstraint x, IGridBagConstraint y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (x == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (y == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				int num;
				int num2;
				if (_behavior == ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior.SynchronizeTileHeightsAcrossColumns)
				{
					num = x.RowSpan;
					num2 = y.RowSpan;
				}
				else
				{
					num = x.ColumnSpan;
					num2 = y.ColumnSpan;
				}
				if (num != num2)
				{
					if (num >= num2)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				int num3;
				int num4;
				if (_behavior == ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior.SynchronizeTileHeightsAcrossColumns)
				{
					num3 = x.Row;
					num4 = y.Row;
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = x.Column;
					num4 = y.Column;
				}
				if (num3 < num4)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (num3 > num4)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal class ExplicitRowColumnLayoutItem : ILayoutItem, IGridBagConstraint, ITileConstraints
		{
			private TileManager _manager;

			private Rect _rect;

			private System.Windows.Size _preferredSize;

			private System.Windows.Size _minSize;

			private System.Windows.Size _maxSize = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);

			internal int ColumnOffset => _columnOffset;

			{

			double ITileConstraints.PreferredWidth => ((ILayoutItem)this).PreferredSize.Width;

			internal ExplicitRowColumnLayoutItem(TileManager manager, ExplicitRowColumnSection section)
			{
				_manager = manager;
				if (_manager._explicitTileSizeBehavior == ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior.SynchronizeTileHeightsAcrossColumns)
				{
					_column = 0;
					_columnSpan = 1;
					_row = section._startRowCol;
					_rowSpan = section._span;
					_rowOffset = -_row;
				}
				else
				{
					_column = section._startRowCol;
					_columnSpan = section._span;
					_columnOffset = -_column;
					_row = 0;
					_rowSpan = 1;
				}
				LayoutItemsCollection layoutItems = _gridBagManager.LayoutItems;
				foreach (IGridBagConstraint item in section._items)
				{
					layoutItems.Add((ILayoutItem)item, new ExplicitItemConstraintWrapper(this, item));
				}
			}

			internal void CalculateminMaxPreffered()
			{
				_minSize = _gridBagManager.CalculateMinimumSize(_manager, _gridBagManager);
				_maxSize = _gridBagManager.CalculateMaximumSize(_manager, _gridBagManager);
				_preferredSize = _gridBagManager.CalculatePreferredSize(_manager, _gridBagManager);
				if (_manager._explicitTileSizeBehavior == ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior.SynchronizeTileHeightsAcrossColumns)
				{
					_columnWeight = 0f;
					_rowWeight = SumWeights(_gridBagManager.RowWeights, _row + _rowOffset, _rowSpan);
				}
				else
				{
					_columnWeight = SumWeights(_gridBagManager.ColumnWeights, _column + _columnOffset, _columnSpan);
					_rowWeight = 0f;
				}
			}

			internal bool isEquivalent(ExplicitRowColumnSection section)
			{
				if (_manager._explicitTileSizeBehavior == ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior.SynchronizeTileHeightsAcrossColumns)
				{
					if (_row != section._startRowCol || _rowSpan != section._span)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (_column != section._startRowCol || _columnSpan != section._span)
				{
					return false;
				}
				LayoutItemsCollection layoutItems = _gridBagManager.LayoutItems;
				int count = section._items.Count;
				if (count != layoutItems.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (section._items[i] != layoutItems[i])
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			private static float SumWeights(float[] weights, int index, int span)
			{
				int num = index + span - 1;
				int num2 = weights.Length;
				if (num >= num2)
				{
					num = num2 - 1;
				}
				float num3 = 0f;
				for (int i = index; i < num; i++)
				{
					num3 += weights[i];
				}
				return num3;
			}
		}

		internal class ExplicitRowColumnSection
		{
			internal int _endRowCol;

			internal int _startRowCol;

			internal int _span = 1;

			internal List<IGridBagConstraint> _items = new List<IGridBagConstraint>();

			internal bool Intersects(int start, int end)
			{
				if (end < _startRowCol)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (start > _endRowCol)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			internal void Add(IGridBagConstraint item, int start, int end)
			{
				_startRowCol = Math.Min(start, _startRowCol);
				_endRowCol = Math.Max(end, _endRowCol);
				_span = _endRowCol + 1 - _startRowCol;
				_items.Add(item);
			}
		}

		internal class TileAreaLayoutItem : ILayoutItem, IGridBagConstraint, ITileConstraints
		{

					}

			internal Rect Rect
			{
				get
				{
					return _rect;
				}
				set
				{
					_rect = value;
					GridBagLayoutManager gridBagManager = GridBagManager;
					gridBagManager.LayoutContainer(_manager, gridBagManager);
					bool isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight = _manager.IsMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight;
					System.Windows.Size tileAreaSize = _manager._panel.TileAreaSize;
					double value2;
					double value3;
					if (isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight)
					{
						value2 = _rect.Height;
						_rect.Height = Math.Max(Math.Min(tileAreaSize.Height, _rect.Height), _minSizeContents.Height);
						if (_area == TileArea.MaximizedTiles)
						{
							if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Height))
							{
								_rect.Height += Math.Max(_rect.Y, 0.0);
								_rect.Y = 0.0;
							}
							else
							{
								_rect.Y = 0.0;
								_rect.Height = tileAreaSize.Height;
							}
						}
						value3 = _rect.Height;
						if (_area == TileArea.MinimizedTiles)
						{
							_manager._minimizedAreaActualExtent = _rect.Width;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						value2 = _rect.Width;
						_rect.Width = Math.Max(Math.Min(tileAreaSize.Width, _rect.Width), _minSizeContents.Width);
						if (_area == TileArea.MaximizedTiles)
						{
							if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Width))
							{
								_rect.Width += Math.Max(_rect.X, 0.0);
								_rect.X = 0.0;
							}
							else
							{
								_rect.X = 0.0;
								_rect.Width = tileAreaSize.Width;
							}
						}
						value3 = _rect.Width;
						if (_area == TileArea.MinimizedTiles)
						{
							_manager._minimizedAreaActualExtent = _rect.Height;
						}
					}
					if (!CoreUtilities.AreClose(value2, value3))
					{
						gridBagManager.LayoutContainer(_manager, gridBagManager);
					}
				}
			}

			System.Windows.Size ILayoutItem.MaximumSize => _maxSizeArea;

			System.Windows.Size ILayoutItem.MinimumSize => _minSizeArea;

			System.Windows.Size ILayoutItem.PreferredSize => _preferredSize;

			Visibility ILayoutItem.Visibility => Visibility.Visible;

			int IGridBagConstraint.Column
			{
				get
				{
					if (_area == TileArea.MaximizedTiles)
					{
						if (_manager._maximizedTileLocation == MaximizedTileLocation.Right)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						return 0;
					}
					if (_manager._maximizedTileLocation == MaximizedTileLocation.Left)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return 0;
				}
			}

			int IGridBagConstraint.ColumnSpan => 1;

			float IGridBagConstraint.ColumnWeight
			{
				get
				{
					if (_area == TileArea.MaximizedTiles)
					{
						return 1f;
					}
					return 0f;
				}
			}

			System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment IGridBagConstraint.HorizontalAlignment
			{
				get
				{
					if (_area == TileArea.MinimizedTiles && _manager._panel != null && !_manager.IsMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight)
					{
						return _manager._panel.GetHorizontalTileAreaAlignment();
					}
					return System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;
				}
			}

			Thickness IGridBagConstraint.Margin => default(Thickness);

			int IGridBagConstraint.Row
			{
				get
				{
					if (_area == TileArea.MaximizedTiles)
					{
						if (_manager._maximizedTileLocation == MaximizedTileLocation.Bottom)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						return 0;
					}
					if (_manager._maximizedTileLocation == MaximizedTileLocation.Top)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return 0;
				}
			}

			int IGridBagConstraint.RowSpan => 1;

			float IGridBagConstraint.RowWeight
			{
				get
				{
					if (_area == TileArea.MaximizedTiles)
					{
						return 1f;
					}
					return 0f;
				}
			}

			VerticalAlignment IGridBagConstraint.VerticalAlignment
			{
				get
				{
					if (_area == TileArea.MinimizedTiles && _manager._panel != null && _manager.IsMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight)
					{
						return _manager._panel.GetVerticalTileAreaAlignment();
					}
					return VerticalAlignment.Stretch;
				}
			}

			System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment? ITileConstraints.HorizontalAlignment => ((IGridBagConstraint)this).HorizontalAlignment;

			Thickness? ITileConstraints.Margin => ((IGridBagConstraint)this).Margin;

			double ITileConstraints.MaxHeight => _maxSizeContents.Height;

			double ITileConstraints.MaxWidth => _maxSizeContents.Width;

			double ITileConstraints.MinHeight => _minSizeContents.Height;

			double ITileConstraints.MinWidth => _minSizeContents.Width;

			double ITileConstraints.PreferredHeight => _preferredSize.Height;

			double ITileConstraints.PreferredWidth => _preferredSize.Width;

			VerticalAlignment? ITileConstraints.VerticalAlignment => ((IGridBagConstraint)this).VerticalAlignment;

			internal TileAreaLayoutItem(TileManager manager, TileArea area)
			{
				_manager = manager;
				_area = area;
			}

			internal void InitializeCachedSizes(GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection dims)
			{
				_minSizeContents = dims.MinimumSize;
				_maxSizeContents = dims.MaximumSize;
				_minSizeArea = _minSizeContents;
				if (_area == TileArea.MaximizedTiles)
				{
					_maxSizeArea = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
				}
				else
				{
					_maxSizeArea = _maxSizeContents;
				}
				_preferredSize = dims.PreferredSize;
				bool isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight = _manager.IsMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight;
				if (_area == TileArea.MinimizedTiles && _manager._explicitMinimizedAreaExtent > 0.0 && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(_manager._explicitMinimizedAreaExtent))
				{
					if (isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight)
					{
						_minSizeArea.Width = Math.Max(_minSizeArea.Width, _manager._explicitMinimizedAreaExtent);
						_maxSizeArea.Width = _minSizeArea.Width;
					}
					else
					{
						_minSizeArea.Height = Math.Max(_minSizeArea.Height, _manager._explicitMinimizedAreaExtent);
						_maxSizeArea.Height = _minSizeArea.Height;
					}
				}
				System.Windows.Size tileAreaSize = _manager._panel.TileAreaSize;
				if (isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight)
				{
					if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Height))
					{
						_preferredSize.Height = tileAreaSize.Height;
					}
				}
				else if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Width))
				{
					_preferredSize.Width = tileAreaSize.Width;
				}
			}
		}

		internal class TileRowColumnLayoutItem : ILayoutItem, IGridBagConstraint, ITileConstraints
		{
			private TileManager _manager;

			private int _rowColumnIndex;

			private int _scrollOffset;

			private int _lastScrollPositionGenerated;

			private bool _isTileRow;

			private GridBagLayoutManager _gridBagManager = new GridBagLayoutManager();

			private GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection _childDimensionsCollection;

			private Rect _rect;

			private System.Windows.Size _preferredSize;

			private System.Windows.Size _minSize;

			private System.Windows.Size _maxSize = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);

			internal LayoutItem FirstChildLayoutItem
			{
				get
				{
					if (_gridBagManager.LayoutItems.Count < 1)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return (LayoutItem)_gridBagManager.LayoutItems[0];
				}
			}

			internal GridBagLayoutManager GridBagManager => _gridBagManager;

			internal LayoutItem LastChildLayoutItem
			{
				get
				{
					if (_gridBagManager.LayoutItems.Count < 1)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return (LayoutItem)_gridBagManager.LayoutItems[_gridBagManager.LayoutItems.Count - 1];
				}
			}

			internal int LastScrollPositionGenerated => _lastScrollPositionGenerated;

			internal Rect Rect
			{
				get
				{
					return _rect;
				}
				set
				{
					_rect = value;
					System.Windows.Size tileAreaSize = _manager._panel.TileAreaSize;
					if (_isTileRow)
					{
						if (_manager._panel.GetHorizontalTileAreaAlignment() == System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch)
						{
							_rect.Width = Math.Max(tileAreaSize.Width, _rect.Width);
						}
					}
					else if (_manager._panel.GetVerticalTileAreaAlignment() == VerticalAlignment.Stretch)
					{
						_rect.Height = Math.Max(tileAreaSize.Height, _rect.Height);
					}
					_gridBagManager.LayoutContainer(_manager, this);
				}
			}

			internal int ScrollOffset => _scrollOffset;

			System.Windows.Size ILayoutItem.MaximumSize => _maxSize;

			System.Windows.Size ILayoutItem.MinimumSize => _minSize;

			System.Windows.Size ILayoutItem.PreferredSize => _preferredSize;

			Visibility ILayoutItem.Visibility => Visibility.Visible;

			int IGridBagConstraint.Column
			{
				get
				{
					if (!_isTileRow)
					{
						return _rowColumnIndex;
					}
					return 0;
				}
			}

			int IGridBagConstraint.ColumnSpan => 1;

			float IGridBagConstraint.ColumnWeight => 0f;

			System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment IGridBagConstraint.HorizontalAlignment => System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;

			Thickness IGridBagConstraint.Margin => default(Thickness);

			int IGridBagConstraint.Row
			{
				get
				{
					if (!_isTileRow)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return _rowColumnIndex;
				}
			}

			int IGridBagConstraint.RowSpan => 1;

			float IGridBagConstraint.RowWeight => 0f;

			VerticalAlignment IGridBagConstraint.VerticalAlignment => VerticalAlignment.Stretch;

			System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment? ITileConstraints.HorizontalAlignment => ((IGridBagConstraint)this).HorizontalAlignment;

			Thickness? ITileConstraints.Margin => ((IGridBagConstraint)this).Margin;

			double ITileConstraints.MaxHeight => ((ILayoutItem)this).MaximumSize.Height;

			double ITileConstraints.MaxWidth => ((ILayoutItem)this).MaximumSize.Width;

			double ITileConstraints.MinHeight => ((ILayoutItem)this).MinimumSize.Height;

			double ITileConstraints.MinWidth => ((ILayoutItem)this).MinimumSize.Width;

			double ITileConstraints.PreferredHeight => ((ILayoutItem)this).PreferredSize.Height;

			double ITileConstraints.PreferredWidth => ((ILayoutItem)this).PreferredSize.Width;

			VerticalAlignment? ITileConstraints.VerticalAlignment => ((IGridBagConstraint)this).VerticalAlignment;

			internal TileRowColumnLayoutItem(TileManager manager, bool isTileRow, int rowColumnIndex, int scrollOffset)
			{
				_manager = manager;
				_isTileRow = isTileRow;
				_rowColumnIndex = rowColumnIndex;
				_scrollOffset = scrollOffset;
			}

			internal int CalculateAutoLayoutHelper(TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache, IEnumerator<ILayoutItem> enumerator, bool autoFitAllItems, System.Windows.Size constraint, int minRows, int minCols, int maxRows, int maxCols, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation orientation, ScrollDirection direction, out System.Windows.Size preferredSize)
			{
				_childDimensionsCollection = GridBagManager.CalculateAutoLayout(enumerator, orientation, autoFitAllItems: false, constraint, minRows, minCols, maxRows, maxCols, null);
				if (orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					_manager._totalRowsDisplayed = Math.Max(_childDimensionsCollection.RowDims.Length - 1, _manager._totalRowsDisplayed);
				}
				else
				{
					_manager._totalColumnsDisplayed = Math.Max(_childDimensionsCollection.ColumnDims.Length - 1, _manager._totalColumnsDisplayed);
				}
				LayoutItem layoutItem = null;
				foreach (ILayoutItem item in (IEnumerable)_childDimensionsCollection)
				{
					layoutItem = item as LayoutItem;
				}
				if (layoutItem != null)
				{
					ItemInfoBase itemInfo = _manager.GetItemInfo(layoutItem.Item);
					if (itemInfo != null)
					{
						_lastScrollPositionGenerated = itemInfo.ScrollPosition;
					}
				}
				preferredSize = _childDimensionsCollection.PreferredSize;
				_preferredSize = preferredSize;
				return _lastScrollPositionGenerated;
			}

			internal int GetFirstScrollPosition()
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _gridBagManager.LayoutItems.Count; i++)
				{
					ItemInfoBase itemInfo = ((LayoutItem)_gridBagManager.LayoutItems[i]).ItemInfo;
					if (itemInfo != null)
					{
						int scrollPosition = itemInfo.ScrollPosition;
						if (scrollPosition >= 0)
						{
							return scrollPosition;
						}
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}

			internal int GetLastScrollPosition()
			{
				for (int num = _gridBagManager.LayoutItems.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					int scrollPosition = ((LayoutItem)_gridBagManager.LayoutItems[num]).ItemInfo.ScrollPosition;
					if (scrollPosition >= 0)
					{
						return scrollPosition;
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}

			internal void ProcessGeneratedElements(TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache)
			{
				if (_childDimensionsCollection != null)
				{
					_manager.ProcessDimensionsCollection(_gridBagManager, genCache, _childDimensionsCollection);
					_preferredSize = _childDimensionsCollection.PreferredSize;
					_minSize = _childDimensionsCollection.MinimumSize;
					_maxSize = _childDimensionsCollection.MaximumSize;
					_childDimensionsCollection = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private class TileRowColumnGeneratorEnumerator : IEnumerator<ILayoutItem>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private TileManager _manager;

			private TilesPanelBase _panel;

			private TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache _genCache;

			private int _scrollCount;

			private int _currentScrollPosition = -2;

			private int _currentScrollOffset;

			private int _currentRowColumnIndex = -1;

			private int _startIndex;

			private double _extentRemaining;

			private bool _isEndReached;

			private bool _enumerateRows;

			private ScrollDirection _direction;

			private TileRowColumnLayoutItem _currentTileRowColumn;

			private List<TileRowColumnLayoutItem> _tileRowColumns = new List<TileRowColumnLayoutItem>();

			private int _maxElementsToGenerate;

			public ILayoutItem Current
			{
				get
				{
					EnsureNotEndReached();
					if (_currentTileRowColumn == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_2"));
					}
					return _currentTileRowColumn;
				}
			}

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			internal TileRowColumnGeneratorEnumerator(TileManager manager, TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache, bool enumerateRows, int startIndex, int scrollOffset, ScrollDirection direction)
			{
				_manager = manager;
				_panel = manager._panel;
				_genCache = genCache;
				_enumerateRows = enumerateRows;
				_scrollCount = _manager.SparseArray.ScrollCount;
				_startIndex = startIndex;
				_currentScrollOffset = scrollOffset;
				_direction = direction;
				if (enumerateRows)
				{
					_maxElementsToGenerate = _panel.GetMaxColumns();
				}
				else
				{
					_maxElementsToGenerate = _panel.GetMaxRows();
				}
				Reset();
			}

			private void EnsureNotEndReached()
			{
				if (_isEndReached)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_1"));
				}
			}

			private int GetNextIndexToGen()
			{
				if (_extentRemaining <= 0.0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (_currentScrollPosition < -1)
				{
					_currentScrollPosition = _startIndex;
				}
				if (_currentScrollPosition < 0 || _currentScrollPosition >= _scrollCount)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return _manager.GetItemAtScrollIndex(_currentScrollPosition)?.Index ?? (-1);
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				EnsureNotEndReached();
				int nextIndexToGen = GetNextIndexToGen();
				if (nextIndexToGen >= 0)
				{
					_currentRowColumnIndex++;
					if (_currentRowColumnIndex >= _tileRowColumns.Count)
					{
						_currentTileRowColumn = new TileRowColumnLayoutItem(_manager, _enumerateRows, _currentRowColumnIndex, _currentScrollOffset);
						if (_direction == ScrollDirection.Increment)
						{
							_currentScrollOffset++;
						}
						else
						{
							_currentScrollOffset = Math.Max(_currentScrollOffset - 1, 0);
						}
						GridBagLayoutManager gridBagManager = _currentTileRowColumn.GridBagManager;
						gridBagManager.InterItemSpacingHorizontal = _panel.GetInterTileSpacing(vertical: false, TileState.Normal);
						gridBagManager.InterItemSpacingVertical = _panel.GetInterTileSpacing(vertical: true, TileState.Normal);
						gridBagManager.HorizontalContentAlignment = _panel.GetHorizontalTileAreaAlignment();
						gridBagManager.VerticalContentAlignment = _panel.GetVerticalTileAreaAlignment();
						gridBagManager.ExpandToFitHeight = gridBagManager.VerticalContentAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch;
						gridBagManager.ExpandToFitWidth = gridBagManager.HorizontalContentAlignment == System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;
						gridBagManager.ShrinkToFitHeight = true;
						gridBagManager.ShrinkToFitWidth = true;
						System.Windows.Controls.Orientation orientation = ((!_enumerateRows) ? System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical : System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal);
						_currentScrollPosition = _currentTileRowColumn.CalculateAutoLayoutHelper(_genCache, new LayoutItemGeneratorEnumerator(_manager, _genCache, enumerateMaximizedTiles: false, _currentScrollPosition, orientation, _direction), autoFitAllItems: false, _panel.TileAreaSize, 0, 0, _enumerateRows ? 1 : _maxElementsToGenerate, (!_enumerateRows) ? 1 : _maxElementsToGenerate, orientation, _direction, out var preferredSize);
						if (_enumerateRows)
						{
							_extentRemaining -= preferredSize.Height;
						}
						else
						{
							_extentRemaining -= preferredSize.Width;
						}
						if (_currentScrollPosition >= 0)
						{
							_tileRowColumns.Add(_currentTileRowColumn);
						}
						else
						{
							_currentTileRowColumn = null;
						}
						if (_direction == ScrollDirection.Increment)
						{
							_currentScrollPosition++;
						}
						else
						{
							_currentScrollPosition--;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						_currentTileRowColumn = _tileRowColumns[_currentRowColumnIndex];
					}
					if (_currentTileRowColumn != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				_isEndReached = true;
				_currentTileRowColumn = null;
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_isEndReached = false;
				_currentScrollPosition = -2;
				_currentRowColumnIndex = -1;
				_currentTileRowColumn = null;
				if (_enumerateRows)
				{
					_extentRemaining = _panel.TileAreaSize.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					_extentRemaining = _panel.TileAreaSize.Width;
				}
			}
		}

		private class ContainerToItemMapWrapper
		{
			private static object ItemIsContainerMarker = new object();

			private WeakDictionary<DependencyObject, object> _map = new WeakDictionary<DependencyObject, object>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: false);

			internal object this[DependencyObject container]
			{
				get
				{
					object obj = _map[container];
					if (obj == ItemIsContainerMarker)
					{
						return container;
					}
					return obj;
				}
				set
				{
					_map[container] = ((container == value) ? ItemIsContainerMarker : value);
				}
			}

			internal void Add(DependencyObject container, object item)
			{
				_map.Add(container, (container == item) ? ItemIsContainerMarker : item);
			}

			internal void Clear()
			{
				_map.Clear();
			}

			internal bool ContainsKey(DependencyObject container)
			{
				return _map.ContainsKey(container);
			}

			internal bool Remove(DependencyObject container)
			{
				return _map.Remove(container);
			}

			internal bool TryGetValue(DependencyObject container, out object item)
			{
				if (!_map.TryGetValue(container, out item))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (item == ItemIsContainerMarker)
				{
					item = container;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

				}
				return _panel.Children;

		internal double MinimizedAreaActualExtent => _minimizedAreaActualExtent;

		internal Vector ScrollMaxOffset => _scrollMaxOffset;

		internal int ScrollPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return _scrollPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _scrollPosition)
				{
					double offsetFromScrollPosition = GetOffsetFromScrollPosition(value);
					TilesPanelBase.ScrollData scrollDataInfo = Panel.ScrollDataInfo;
					if (_scrollTilesHorizontally)
					{
						scrollDataInfo._offset = new Vector(offsetFromScrollPosition, scrollDataInfo._offset.Y);
					}
					else
					{
						scrollDataInfo._offset = new Vector(scrollDataInfo._offset.X, offsetFromScrollPosition);
					}
					scrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(scrollDataInfo._viewport, scrollDataInfo._extent);
					Panel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		public ItemInfoBase GetItemInfo(object item)

		public ItemInfoBase GetItemInfo(object item, bool createIfNotFound, int originalItemIndex)
		{
			if (!_itemInfoMap.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
			{
				if (!createIfNotFound)
				{
					return null;
				}
				VerifyItemSlot(item, ref originalItemIndex);
				value = CreateItemInfo(item, originalItemIndex);
				_itemInfoMap.Add(item, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void SortItems(IComparer<ItemInfoBase> comparer)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(comparer, "comparer");
			EnsureItemArrayIsAllocated();
			int count = Items.Count;
			if (count >= 2)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					object item = GetItem(i, useRearrangedOrder: false);
				}
				SparseArray.SortGeneric(comparer);
			}
		}

		internal static bool AreClose(double value1, double value2)
		{
			if (value1 == value2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Math.Abs(value1 - value2) < 1E-10;
		}

		internal ScrollDirection BeginGeneration(TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache)
		{
			_genCache = genCache;
			_itemsInView.Clear();
			_wasLastScrollableItemGened = false;
			_defaultMinimunItemSize = _panel.GetDefaultMinimumItemSize();
			bool isInMaximizedMode = _isInMaximizedMode;
			_isInMaximizedMode = _panel.GetIsInMaximizedMode();
			Vector arrangeOffset = _arrangeOffset;
			Vector arrangeOffsetForMaxmizedTiles = _arrangeOffsetForMaxmizedTiles;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode != isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				_arrangeOffset = default(Vector);
				_arrangeOffsetForMaxmizedTiles = default(Vector);
			}
			if (_lastItemLocations != null)
			{
				int count = _lastItemLocations.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					ItemRowColumnSizeInfo itemRowColumnSizeInfo = _lastItemLocations[i];
					bool wasMaximized = itemRowColumnSizeInfo.WasMaximized;
					Vector offset = itemRowColumnSizeInfo.VerifyMaximizeState(arrangeOffset, arrangeOffsetForMaxmizedTiles);
					bool wasMaximized2 = itemRowColumnSizeInfo.WasMaximized;
					if (offset.X == 0.0 && offset.Y == 0.0 && wasMaximized == wasMaximized2)
					{
						continue;
					}
					LayoutItem layoutItem = GetLayoutItem(itemRowColumnSizeInfo.Info.Item);
					if (layoutItem != null)
					{
						layoutItem.OffsetAllRects(offset);
						if (wasMaximized && !wasMaximized2 && layoutItem.Container != null)
						{
							layoutItem.Container.ClearValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				_maximizedTileLocation = _panel.GetMaximizedTileLocation();
				_maximizedTileLayoutOrder = _panel.GetMaximizedTileLayoutOrder();
				_explicitMinimizedAreaExtent = _panel.GetExplicitMinimizedAreaExtent();
			}
			else
			{
				_tileLayoutOrder = _panel.GetTileLayoutOrder();
				_explicitTileSizeBehavior = _panel.GetExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior();
				_synchronizedSize = _panel.GetSynchronizedSize();
				if (_synchronizedSize.HasValue)
				{
					System.Windows.Size value = _synchronizedSize.Value;
					if (double.IsNaN(value.Width) || double.IsInfinity(value.Width))
					{
						value.Width = 0.0;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(value.Height) || double.IsInfinity(value.Height))
					{
						value.Height = 0.0;
					}
					_synchronizedSize = value;
				}
			}
			EnsureItemArrayIsAllocated();
			CreateExpectedItemsList(genCache);
			genCache._previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache = new Dictionary<DependencyObject, LayoutItem>();
			foreach (LayoutItem item in _itemsToBeArranged)
			{
				DependencyObject container = item.Container;
				if (container != null)
				{
					genCache._previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache.Add(container, item);
				}
			}
			genCache._newItemsToBeArrangedTempCache = new HashSet();
			if (_gridBagLayoutNormal != null)
			{
				_gridBagLayoutNormal.LayoutItems.Clear();
			}
			if (_gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall != null)
			{
				genCache._previousGridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall = _gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall;
				_gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall = null;
			}
			if (_gridBagLayoutMaximized != null)
			{
				_gridBagLayoutMaximized.LayoutItems.Clear();
			}
			if (_gridBagLayoutMinimized != null)
			{
				_gridBagLayoutMinimized.LayoutItems.Clear();
			}
			if (_scrollPosition < _lastScrollPosition)
			{
				return ScrollDirection.Decrement;
			}
			return ScrollDirection.Increment;
		}

		internal void BringIndexIntoView(int index)
		{
			IList items = Items;
			if (index < 0 || index >= items.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			object obj = items[index];
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ItemInfoBase itemInfo = GetItemInfo(obj, createIfNotFound: true, index);
			if (itemInfo == null || itemInfo.GetIsClosed())
			{
				return;
			}
			LayoutItem layoutItem = GetLayoutItem(obj, null, createIfNotFound: false, clearDimensions: false);
			if (layoutItem != null)
			{
				Rect rect = new Rect(_panel.TileAreaSize);
				if (_itemsInView.Contains(itemInfo) && layoutItem.Container is FrameworkElement visual)
				{
					MakeVisible(visual, Rect.Empty);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (itemInfo.OccupiesScrollPosition && (_scrollTilesVertically || _scrollTilesHorizontally))
			{
				double offsetFromScrollPosition = GetOffsetFromScrollPosition(itemInfo.ScrollPosition);
				if (_scrollTilesHorizontally)
				{
					((IScrollInfo)_panel).SetHorizontalOffset(offsetFromScrollPosition);
				}
				else if (_scrollTilesVertically)
				{
					((IScrollInfo)_panel).SetVerticalOffset(offsetFromScrollPosition);
				}
				_panel.Measure(_panel.LastMeasureSize);
			}
		}

		internal System.Windows.Size EndGeneration(TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache)
		{
			if (_synchLastScrollPosOperation == null && (_lastScrollPosition != _scrollPosition || _lastScrollLogicalOffset != _scrollLogicalOffset))
			{
				_synchLastScrollPosOperation = _panel.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Send, new Utilities.MethodDelegate(SynchLastScrollPosition));
			}
			bool isScrollingVertically;
			GridBagLayoutManager overallGridBagLayout = GetOverallGridBagLayout(out isScrollingVertically);
			_minimizedAreaActualExtent = 0.0;
			overallGridBagLayout.LayoutContainer(this, overallGridBagLayout, out var layoutRect);
			System.Windows.Size lastMeasureSize = _panel.LastMeasureSize;
			if (double.IsInfinity(lastMeasureSize.Height))
			{
				double height = _panel.DesiredSize.Height;
				if (height > 0.0)
				{
					lastMeasureSize.Height = height;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(lastMeasureSize.Width))
			{
				double width = _panel.DesiredSize.Width;
				if (width > 0.0)
				{
					lastMeasureSize.Width = width;
				}
			}
			Rect rect = new Rect(lastMeasureSize);
			double? num = null;
			if (_lastScrollPosition != _scrollPosition && _lastItemLocations != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				int count = _lastItemLocations.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					ItemRowColumnSizeInfo itemRowColumnSizeInfo = _lastItemLocations[i];
					ItemInfoBase info = itemRowColumnSizeInfo.Info;
					if (info == null || info.GetIsMaximized())
					{
						continue;
					}
					LayoutItem layoutItem = GetLayoutItem(info.Item);
					if (layoutItem == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (_itemsToBeArranged.Exists(layoutItem))
					{
						int num2 = _itemsInView.IndexOf(info);
						if (num2 >= 0)
						{
							if (!flag)
							{
								Rect targetRect = itemRowColumnSizeInfo.TargetRect;
								Rect targetRect2 = layoutItem.TargetRect;
								num = ((!isScrollingVertically) ? new double?(targetRect.Left - targetRect2.Left) : new double?(targetRect.Top - targetRect2.Top));
								if (CoreUtilities.AreClose(num.Value, 0.0))
								{
									num = null;
								}
								flag = true;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							layoutItem.SetTargetRect(itemRowColumnSizeInfo.TargetRect, measureElement: false);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						layoutItem.SetTargetRect(itemRowColumnSizeInfo.TargetRect, measureElement: false);
					}
					if (layoutItem.CurrentRectInternal.HasValue)
					{
						layoutItem.SetOriginalRect(layoutItem.CurrentRectInternal.Value, calledFromArrange: false);
					}
					else
					{
						layoutItem.SetOriginalRect(itemRowColumnSizeInfo.TargetRect, calledFromArrange: false);
					}
				}
				if (!num.HasValue && !flag)
				{
					if (isScrollingVertically)
					{
						if (!double.IsInfinity(lastMeasureSize.Height))
						{
							num = ((_lastScrollPosition >= _scrollPosition) ? new double?(0.0 - lastMeasureSize.Height) : new double?(lastMeasureSize.Height));
						}
					}
					else if (!double.IsInfinity(lastMeasureSize.Width))
					{
						num = ((_lastScrollPosition >= _scrollPosition) ? new double?(0.0 - lastMeasureSize.Width) : new double?(lastMeasureSize.Width));
					}
				}
			}
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				foreach (LayoutItem item in genCache._newItemsToBeArrangedTempCache)
				{
					Rect rect2 = item.TargetRect;
					if (rect2.Width == 0.0 && rect2.Height == 0.0)
					{
						rect2 = new Rect(-10000.0, -10000.0, 100.0, 100.0);
						item.SetTargetRect(rect2, measureElement: false);
					}
					if (isScrollingVertically)
					{
						rect2.Offset(0.0, num.Value);
					}
					else
					{
						rect2.Offset(num.Value, 0.0);
					}
					item.SetOriginalRect(rect2, calledFromArrange: false);
				}
			}
			foreach (LayoutItem value in genCache._previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache.Values)
			{
				ItemInfoBase itemInfo = GetItemInfo(value.Item);
				Rect targetRect3 = value.TargetRect;
				if (targetRect3.Width == 0.0)
				{
					if (_itemsToBeArranged.Exists(value))
					{
						_itemsToBeArranged.Remove(value);
					}
					int num3 = _itemsInView.IndexOf(itemInfo);
					if (num3 >= 0)
					{
						_itemsInView.RemoveAt(num3);
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					if (isScrollingVertically)
					{
						targetRect3.Offset(0.0, 0.0 - num.Value);
					}
					else
					{
						targetRect3.Offset(0.0 - num.Value, 0.0);
					}
					value.SetTargetRect(targetRect3, measureElement: true);
					double num4 = ((num.Value > 0.0) ? 1 : (-1));
					while (targetRect3.IntersectsWith(rect))
					{
						if (isScrollingVertically)
						{
							targetRect3.Offset(0.0, 0.0 - num4);
						}
						else
						{
							targetRect3.Offset(0.0 - num4, 0.0);
						}
						value.SetTargetRect(targetRect3, measureElement: true);
					}
				}
				if (!targetRect3.IntersectsWith(rect))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (itemInfo != null && itemInfo.ScrollPosition < _scrollPosition)
				{
					if (isScrollingVertically)
					{
						if (!double.IsInfinity(lastMeasureSize.Height))
						{
							targetRect3.Y = 0.0 - Math.Min(Math.Abs(targetRect3.Bottom), lastMeasureSize.Height) - 1.0;
						}
					}
					else if (!double.IsInfinity(lastMeasureSize.Width))
					{
						targetRect3.X = 0.0 - Math.Min(Math.Abs(targetRect3.Right), lastMeasureSize.Width) - 1.0;
					}
				}
				else if (isScrollingVertically)
				{
					if (!double.IsInfinity(lastMeasureSize.Height))
					{
						targetRect3.Y = Math.Max(Math.Abs(targetRect3.Y), 0.0) + lastMeasureSize.Height + 1.0;
					}
				}
				else if (!double.IsInfinity(lastMeasureSize.Width))
				{
					targetRect3.X = Math.Max(Math.Abs(targetRect3.X), 0.0) + lastMeasureSize.Width + 1.0;
				}
				if (targetRect3.IntersectsWith(rect))
				{
					if (isScrollingVertically)
					{
						if (!double.IsInfinity(lastMeasureSize.Width))
						{
							if (targetRect3.X > rect.Width / 2.0)
							{
								targetRect3.X = rect.Right + 1.0;
							}
							else
							{
								targetRect3.X = 0.0 - (targetRect3.Width + 1.0);
							}
						}
					}
					else if (!double.IsInfinity(lastMeasureSize.Height))
					{
						if (targetRect3.Y > rect.Height / 2.0)
						{
							targetRect3.Y = rect.Bottom + 1.0;
						}
						else
						{
							targetRect3.Y = 0.0 - (targetRect3.Height + 1.0);
						}
					}
				}
				value.SetTargetRect(targetRect3, measureElement: true);
			}
			IList childElements = _panel.ChildElements;
			int num5 = childElements.Count;
			if (num5 > _itemsToBeArranged.Count)
			{
				for (int num6 = num5 - 1; num6 >= 0; num6--)
				{
					if (childElements[num6] is UIElement { Visibility: not Visibility.Collapsed } uIElement)
					{
						LayoutItem layoutItem3 = GetLayoutItem(null, uIElement, createIfNotFound: false, clearDimensions: false);
						if (layoutItem3 != null && !_itemsToBeArranged.Exists(layoutItem3))
						{
							AddItemToBeArranged(layoutItem3);
							if (num5 <= _itemsToBeArranged.Count)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num5--;
					}
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = layoutRect.Size;
			System.Windows.Size tileAreaSize = _panel.TileAreaSize;
			if (overallGridBagLayout.ExpandToFitHeight && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Height))
			{
				size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, tileAreaSize.Height);
			}
			if (overallGridBagLayout.ExpandToFitWidth && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Width))
			{
				size.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, tileAreaSize.Width);
			}
			System.Windows.Size size2 = size;
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Height))
			{
				size2.Height = Math.Max(size2.Height, tileAreaSize.Height);
			}
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Width))
			{
				size2.Width = Math.Max(size2.Width, tileAreaSize.Width);
			}
			_lastMeasureDesiredSize = size2;
			if (UpdateScrollingInfo(overallGridBagLayout, size2, isScrollingVertically, checkIfScrolledTooFar: false))
			{
				genCache._requiresAnotherLayoutPass = true;
			}
			_lastElement = null;
			_lastElementConstraints = null;
			_lastElementDefaultConstraints = null;
			_lastElementState = null;
			_genCache = null;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode && _lastShowAllTiles)
			{
				switch (_maximizedTileLocation)
				{
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Left:
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Right:
					size.Height = Math.Min(size.Height, _panel.LastMeasureSize.Height);
					break;
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Top:
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Bottom:
					size.Width = Math.Min(size.Width, _panel.LastMeasureSize.Width);
					break;
				}
			}
			return size;
		}

		private GridBagLayoutManager GetOverallGridBagLayout(out bool isScrollingVertically)
		{
			GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutManager;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				gridBagLayoutManager = GridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall;
				gridBagLayoutManager.InvalidateLayout();
				isScrollingVertically = IsMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight;
			}
			else
			{
				switch (_tileLayoutOrder)
				{
				default:
					gridBagLayoutManager = GridBagLayoutNormal;
					break;
				case TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile:
					gridBagLayoutManager = ((_explicitTileSizeBehavior != ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior.SynchronizeTileWidthsAndHeights) ? GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall : GridBagLayoutNormal);
					break;
				case TileLayoutOrder.VerticalVariable:
				case TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable:
					gridBagLayoutManager = GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall;
					break;
				}
				TileLayoutOrder tileLayoutOrder = _tileLayoutOrder;
				if (tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.Horizontal || tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable)
				{
					isScrollingVertically = true;
				}
				else
				{
					isScrollingVertically = false;
				}
			}
			return gridBagLayoutManager;
		}

		internal void GenerateElements(TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(_panel.TileAreaSize);
			foreach (LayoutItem value in genCache._previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache.Values)
			{
				ItemInfoBase itemInfo = GetItemInfo(value.Item);
				if (itemInfo != null && value.Container is UIElement { Visibility: not Visibility.Collapsed } && itemInfo.Index >= 0)
				{
					Rect rect2;
					if (value.CurrentRectInternal.HasValue)
					{
						rect2 = value.CurrentRectInternal.Value;
						value.SetOriginalRect(rect2, calledFromArrange: false);
					}
					else
					{
						rect2 = value.TargetRect;
					}
					if (rect.IntersectsWith(rect2) || rect.IntersectsWith(value.TargetRect))
					{
						UIElement uIElement2 = genCache.GenerateElement(itemInfo.Index);
					}
				}
			}
			_totalColumnsDisplayed = 0;
			_totalRowsDisplayed = 0;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall = GridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall;
				switch (_maximizedTileLocation)
				{
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Top:
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Bottom:
					gridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall.InterItemSpacingHorizontal = 0.0;
					gridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall.InterItemSpacingVertical = _panel.GetInterTileAreaSpacing();
					break;
				default:
					gridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall.InterItemSpacingHorizontal = _panel.GetInterTileAreaSpacing();
					gridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall.InterItemSpacingVertical = 0.0;
					break;
				}
				GenerateMaximizedElements(genCache);
				_wasLastScrollableItemGened = false;
				GenerateMinimizedElements(genCache);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateNormalElements(genCache);
			}
		}

		internal int GetCurrentColumn(ItemInfoBase info)
		{
			return GetCurrenRowColumnHelper(info, isColumn: true);
		}

		internal int GetCurrentRow(ItemInfoBase info)
		{
			return GetCurrenRowColumnHelper(info, isColumn: false);
		}

		internal Rect GetInViewRect(DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (_panel == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (!_containerToItemMap.TryGetValue(container, out var item))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (!_layoutItemMap.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			ItemInfoBase itemInfo = value.ItemInfo;
			if (itemInfo == null || !_itemsInView.Contains(itemInfo))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect targetRect = value.TargetRect;
			Rect rect = new Rect(_panel.TileAreaSize);
			Vector offsetVector = ((!itemInfo.GetIsMaximized()) ? ArrangeOffset : ArrangeOffsetForMaxmizedTiles);
			targetRect.Offset(offsetVector);
			Rect result = Rect.Intersect(rect, targetRect);
			if (result.IsEmpty)
			{
				return result;
			}
			result.Offset(0.0 - targetRect.Left, 0.0 - targetRect.Top);
			return result;
		}

		internal object GetItem(int index, bool useRearrangedOrder)
		{

			}
			ItemInfoBase itemInfoBase2 = (ItemInfoBase)_sparseArray[index];
			if (itemInfoBase2 == null)

				_sparseArray[index] = itemInfoBase2;
			}
			if (useRearrangedOrder && itemInfoBase2 != null)

			}
			return obj;
		}

		internal LayoutItem GetLayoutItem(object item, DependencyObject container, bool createIfNotFound, bool clearDimensions)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				container = _panel.ContainerFromItem(item);
				if (container == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (container != null)
			{
				if (_containerToItemMap.TryGetValue(container, out var item2))
				{
					if (!object.Equals(item2, item))
					{
						if (item != null)
						{
							_containerToItemMap[container] = item;
							if (_layoutItemMap.TryGetValue(item2, out var value))
							{
								_itemsToBeArranged.Remove(value);
								if (_genCache != null && _genCache._previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache.ContainsKey(container))
								{
									_genCache._previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache.Remove(container);
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							item = item2;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (item != null)
				{
					_containerToItemMap.Add(container, item);
				}
			}
			if (!_layoutItemMap.TryGetValue(item, out var value2))
			{
				if (!createIfNotFound)
				{
					return null;
				}
				value2 = new LayoutItem(container, item, this);
				_layoutItemMap.Add(item, value2);
				RemoveDuplicateContainerRefs(value2);
			}
			else if (container != null)
			{
				DependencyObject container2 = value2.Container;
				value2.InitializeContainer(container, clearDimensions);
				if (container != container2)
				{
					RemoveDuplicateContainerRefs(value2);
				}
			}
			return value2;
		}
