		internal double GetOffsetFromScrollPosition(int scrollPosition)
		{
			if (scrollPosition == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (_panel == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			int scrollCount = _sparseArray.ScrollCount;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				return Math.Min(scrollPosition, Math.Max(scrollCount - 1, 0));
			}
			if (_panel.GetShowAllTiles())
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			switch (_tileLayoutOrder)
			{
			case TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile:
				return 0.0;
			case TileLayoutOrder.VerticalVariable:
			case TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable:
			{
				GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall = GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall;
				int count = gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.LayoutItems.Count;
				if (count > 0)
				{
					if (scrollPosition >= _scrollPosition && scrollPosition <= _scrollPositionOfLastArrangedItem)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
						{
							TileRowColumnLayoutItem tileRowColumnLayoutItem = gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.LayoutItems[i] as TileRowColumnLayoutItem;
							if (scrollPosition >= tileRowColumnLayoutItem.GetFirstScrollPosition() && scrollPosition <= tileRowColumnLayoutItem.GetLastScrollPosition())
							{
								return tileRowColumnLayoutItem.ScrollOffset;
							}
						}
					}
					double num2 = Math.Max(_variableAvgItemsPerRowColumn, 1.0);
					if (scrollPosition > _scrollPositionOfLastArrangedItem)
					{
						return (int)Math.Min((double)_scrollLogicalOffsetOfLastArrangedItem + (double)(scrollPosition - _scrollPositionOfLastArrangedItem) / num2, _variableTotalRowColmuns);
					}
					return (int)Math.Max((double)_scrollLogicalOffset - (double)(_scrollPosition - scrollPosition) / num2, 0.0);
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
			case TileLayoutOrder.Vertical:
			case TileLayoutOrder.Horizontal:
			{
				int num = Math.Max(NormalModeItemsPerRowColumn, 1);
				return Math.Floor((double)Math.Min(SparseArray.ScrollCount - 1, scrollPosition) / (double)num);
			}
			default:
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		internal void GetResizeRange(ItemInfoBase itemInfo, out double maxDeltaLeft, out double maxDeltaRight, out double maxDeltaTop, out double maxDeltaBottom)
		{
			LayoutItem layoutItem = GetLayoutItem(itemInfo.Item);
			if (layoutItem != null)
			{
				ILayoutItem sectionContainer;
				GridBagLayoutManager containingGridBagLayoutManager = GetContainingGridBagLayoutManager(layoutItem, out sectionContainer);
				if (containingGridBagLayoutManager != null)
				{
					object containerContext = ((sectionContainer != null) ? ((object)sectionContainer) : ((object)containingGridBagLayoutManager));
					containingGridBagLayoutManager.GetResizeRange(this, containerContext, layoutItem, out maxDeltaLeft, out maxDeltaRight, out maxDeltaTop, out maxDeltaBottom);
					return;
				}
			}
			maxDeltaLeft = 0.0;
			maxDeltaRight = 0.0;
			maxDeltaTop = 0.0;
			maxDeltaBottom = 0.0;
		}

		internal int GetScrollPositionFromOffset(double offset)
		{
			if ((int)offset == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (_panel == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int scrollCount = _sparseArray.ScrollCount;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				return Math.Min((int)offset, Math.Max(scrollCount - 1, 0));
			}
			if (_panel.GetShowAllTiles())
			{
				return 0;
			}
			offset = Math.Floor(offset);
			switch (_tileLayoutOrder)
			{
			case TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile:
				return 0;
			case TileLayoutOrder.VerticalVariable:
			case TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable:
			{
				GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall = GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall;
				int count = gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.LayoutItems.Count;
				if (count > 0)
				{
					if ((int)offset >= _scrollLogicalOffset && (int)offset < _scrollLogicalOffset + count)
					{
						TileRowColumnLayoutItem tileRowColumnLayoutItem = gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.LayoutItems[(int)offset - _scrollLogicalOffset] as TileRowColumnLayoutItem;
						return tileRowColumnLayoutItem.GetFirstScrollPosition();
					}
					double num2 = Math.Max(_variableAvgItemsPerRowColumn, 1.0);
					if (_scrollLogicalOffsetOfLastArrangedItem < (int)offset)
					{
						return (int)Math.Min(SparseArray.ScrollCount - 1, (double)_scrollPosition + (offset - (double)_scrollLogicalOffset) * num2);
					}
					return (int)Math.Max((double)_scrollPosition - ((double)_scrollLogicalOffset - offset) * num2, 0.0);
				}
				return 0;
			}
			case TileLayoutOrder.Vertical:
			case TileLayoutOrder.Horizontal:
			{
				int num = Math.Max(NormalModeItemsPerRowColumn, 1);
				return Math.Min(Math.Max(SparseArray.ScrollCount - 1, 0), num * (int)offset);
			}
			default:
				return 0;
			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal Rect MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (_panel == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = visual as UIElement;
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty && uIElement != null)
			{
				rectangle = new Rect(uIElement.RenderSize);
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = visual;
			DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = visual;
			while (dependencyObject2 != null && dependencyObject2 != _panel)
			{
				dependencyObject = dependencyObject2;
				dependencyObject2 = Utilities.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = dependencyObject as FrameworkElement;
			if (dependencyObject2 == null || frameworkElement == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			ItemInfoBase itemInfoBase = null;
			LayoutItem layoutItem = GetLayoutItem(null, dependencyObject, createIfNotFound: false, clearDimensions: false);
			if (layoutItem == null && frameworkElement is ContentControl contentControl)
			{
				layoutItem = GetLayoutItem(contentControl.Content, null, createIfNotFound: true, clearDimensions: false);
			}
			if (layoutItem == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			itemInfoBase = layoutItem.ItemInfo;
			if (itemInfoBase == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Vector offset = _panel.ScrollDataInfo._offset;
			System.Windows.Point point = uIElement.TranslatePoint(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), _panel);
			Rect rect = Rect.Offset(rectangle, point.X, point.Y);
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(_panel.TileAreaSize);
			Rect targetRect;
			if (frameworkElement.IsVisible && _itemsInView.Contains(itemInfoBase))
			{
				targetRect = layoutItem.TargetRect;
				if (rect2.Contains(targetRect))
				{
					return rectangle;
				}
				if (rect2.Contains(rect))
				{
					return rectangle;
				}
				if (_panel.IsAnimationInProgress)
				{
					Rect? currentRectInternal = layoutItem.CurrentRectInternal;
					if (currentRectInternal.HasValue)
					{
						rect.X += layoutItem.TargetRect.X - currentRectInternal.Value.X;
						rect.Y += layoutItem.TargetRect.Y - currentRectInternal.Value.Y;
					}
				}
			}
			targetRect = layoutItem.TargetRect;
			bool flag = MakeVisiblePixelScrollingHelper(rect, rect2, targetRect, offset);
			if ((_scrollTilesVertically || _scrollTilesHorizontally) && itemInfoBase.OccupiesScrollPosition)
			{
				int scrollPosition = itemInfoBase.ScrollPosition;
				double offsetFromScrollPosition = GetOffsetFromScrollPosition(scrollPosition);
				int num = 0;
				foreach (ItemInfoBase item in _itemsInView)
				{
					if (item.OccupiesScrollPosition)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				int num2 = 0;
				ScrollDirection scrollDirection;
				if (scrollPosition < _scrollPosition)
				{
					scrollDirection = ScrollDirection.Decrement;
					num2 = scrollPosition;
				}
				else
				{
					scrollDirection = ScrollDirection.Increment;
					num2 = Math.Max(_scrollPosition + 1, scrollPosition - num);
				}
				double offsetFromScrollPosition2 = GetOffsetFromScrollPosition(num2);
				TilesPanelBase.ScrollData scrollDataInfo = _panel.ScrollDataInfo;
				if (_scrollTilesVertically)
				{
					scrollDataInfo._offset.Y = offsetFromScrollPosition2;
				}
				else
				{
					scrollDataInfo._offset.X = offsetFromScrollPosition2;
				}
				flag = true;
				scrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(scrollDataInfo._viewport, scrollDataInfo._extent);
				if (scrollDirection == ScrollDirection.Increment)
				{
					_panel.Measure(_panel.LastMeasureSize);
					targetRect = layoutItem.TargetRect;
					double num3 = -1.0;
					while ((double)_scrollLogicalOffset != offsetFromScrollPosition && (double)_scrollLogicalOffset != num3 && (targetRect.Width == 0.0 || !Utilities.IsContainedBy(rect2, targetRect, _scrollTilesHorizontally)))
					{
						num3 = _scrollLogicalOffset;
						if (_scrollTilesVertically)
						{
							((IScrollInfo)Panel).LineDown();
						}
						else
						{
							((IScrollInfo)Panel).LineRight();
						}
						_panel.Measure(_panel.LastMeasureSize);
						targetRect = layoutItem.TargetRect;
					}
				}
			}
			targetRect = layoutItem.TargetRect;
			if (MakeVisiblePixelScrollingHelper(rect, rect2, targetRect, offset) || flag)
			{
				_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
				_panel.InvalidateArrange();
				return rectangle;
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		private bool MakeVisiblePixelScrollingHelper(Rect rectangle, Rect panelRect, Rect liRect, Vector originalScrollOffset)
		{
			if (liRect.Width == 0.0 || liRect.Height == 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TilesPanelBase.ScrollData scrollDataInfo = _panel.ScrollDataInfo;
			bool result = false;
			if (!_scrollTilesHorizontally && !Utilities.IsContainedBy(panelRect, rectangle, checkWidth: true))
			{
				if (panelRect.Left > rectangle.Left)
				{
					scrollDataInfo._offset.X = Math.Max(originalScrollOffset.X + rectangle.Left, 0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					scrollDataInfo._offset.X = Math.Max(originalScrollOffset.X + rectangle.Right - scrollDataInfo._viewport.Width, 0.0);
				}
				_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
				result = true;
			}
			if (!_scrollTilesVertically && !Utilities.IsContainedBy(panelRect, rectangle, checkWidth: false))
			{
				if (panelRect.Top > rectangle.Top)
				{
					scrollDataInfo._offset.Y = Math.Max(originalScrollOffset.Y + rectangle.Top, 0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					scrollDataInfo._offset.Y = Math.Max(originalScrollOffset.Y + rectangle.Bottom - scrollDataInfo._viewport.Height, 0.0);
				}
				_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
				result = true;
			}
			scrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(scrollDataInfo._viewport, scrollDataInfo._extent);
			return result;
		}

		internal bool MoveTileHelper(LayoutItem sourceItem, LayoutItem targetItem, bool calledFromDragManager)
		{
			if (_panel == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sourceItem == null || targetItem == null || sourceItem == targetItem || !(sourceItem.Container is FrameworkElement) || !(targetItem.Container is FrameworkElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ItemInfoBase itemInfo = sourceItem.ItemInfo;
			ItemInfoBase itemInfo2 = targetItem.ItemInfo;
			if (itemInfo == null || itemInfo2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = sourceItem.Container as FrameworkElement;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = targetItem.Container as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement == null || frameworkElement2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			AllowTileDragging allowTileDragging = _panel.GetAllowTileDragging(frameworkElement, itemInfo);
			if (allowTileDragging == AllowTileDragging.No)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = allowTileDragging == AllowTileDragging.Swap;
			if (!flag)
			{
				flag = itemInfo.GetIsMaximized() != itemInfo2.GetIsMaximized();
			}
			if (flag && !calledFromDragManager && !_panel.CanSwapContainers(frameworkElement, itemInfo, frameworkElement2, itemInfo2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (itemInfo.GetIsMaximized() && itemInfo2.GetIsMaximized())
			{
				ObservableCollectionExtended<object> maximizedItems = _panel.GetMaximizedItems();
				int num = maximizedItems.IndexOf(itemInfo.Item);
				int num2 = maximizedItems.IndexOf(itemInfo2.Item);
				if (num == num2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				maximizedItems.BeginUpdate();
				try
				{
					if (allowTileDragging == AllowTileDragging.Swap)
					{
						if (num < num2)
						{
							maximizedItems.RemoveAt(num);
							maximizedItems.RemoveAt(num2 - 1);
							maximizedItems.Insert(num, itemInfo2.Item);
							maximizedItems.Insert(num2, itemInfo.Item);
						}
						else
						{
							maximizedItems.RemoveAt(num2);
							maximizedItems.RemoveAt(num - 1);
							maximizedItems.Insert(num2, itemInfo.Item);
							maximizedItems.Insert(num, itemInfo2.Item);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						maximizedItems.RemoveAt(num);
						maximizedItems.Insert(num2, itemInfo.Item);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					maximizedItems.EndUpdate();
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					_panel.OnContainersSwapped(frameworkElement, itemInfo, frameworkElement2, itemInfo2);
				}
				_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
				return true;
			}
			if (itemInfo.GetIsMaximized() || itemInfo2.GetIsMaximized())
			{
				_panel.OnContainersSwapped(frameworkElement, itemInfo, frameworkElement2, itemInfo2);
				_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
				return true;
			}
			if (!_isInMaximizedMode && _tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile)
			{
				int column = TilesPanelBase.GetColumn(targetItem.Container);
				int columnSpan = TilesPanelBase.GetColumnSpan(targetItem.Container);
				int row = TilesPanelBase.GetRow(targetItem.Container);
				int rowSpan = TilesPanelBase.GetRowSpan(targetItem.Container);
				int column2 = TilesPanelBase.GetColumn(sourceItem.Container);
				int columnSpan2 = TilesPanelBase.GetColumnSpan(sourceItem.Container);
				int row2 = TilesPanelBase.GetRow(sourceItem.Container);
				int rowSpan2 = TilesPanelBase.GetRowSpan(sourceItem.Container);
				TilesPanelBase.SetColumn(targetItem.Container, column2);
				TilesPanelBase.SetColumnSpan(targetItem.Container, columnSpan2);
				TilesPanelBase.SetRow(targetItem.Container, row2);
				TilesPanelBase.SetRowSpan(targetItem.Container, rowSpan2);
				TilesPanelBase.SetColumn(sourceItem.Container, column);
				TilesPanelBase.SetColumnSpan(sourceItem.Container, columnSpan);
				TilesPanelBase.SetRow(sourceItem.Container, row);
				TilesPanelBase.SetRowSpan(sourceItem.Container, rowSpan);
				_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
				_panel.OnContainersSwapped(frameworkElement, itemInfo, frameworkElement2, itemInfo2);
				return true;
			}
			int logicalIndex = itemInfo.LogicalIndex;
			if (logicalIndex < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int logicalIndex2 = itemInfo2.LogicalIndex;
			if (logicalIndex2 < 0 || logicalIndex2 == logicalIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ScrollManagerSparseArray sparseArray = SparseArray;
			if (allowTileDragging == AllowTileDragging.Swap)
			{
				if (logicalIndex < logicalIndex2)
				{
					sparseArray.RemoveAt(logicalIndex);
					sparseArray.RemoveAt(logicalIndex2 - 1);
					sparseArray.Insert(logicalIndex, itemInfo2);
					sparseArray.Insert(logicalIndex2, itemInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					sparseArray.RemoveAt(logicalIndex2);
					sparseArray.RemoveAt(logicalIndex - 1);
					sparseArray.Insert(logicalIndex2, itemInfo);
					sparseArray.Insert(logicalIndex, itemInfo2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				sparseArray.RemoveAt(logicalIndex);
				sparseArray.Insert(logicalIndex2, itemInfo);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				_panel.OnContainersSwapped(frameworkElement, itemInfo, frameworkElement2, itemInfo2);
			}
			_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
			return true;
		}

		internal void OnArrange(out bool itemLocationsAreaTheSame, out bool inViewItemsAreTheSame)
		{
			List<ItemRowColumnSizeInfo> itemRowColumnSnapshot = GetItemRowColumnSnapshot();
			itemLocationsAreaTheSame = true;
			int count = itemRowColumnSnapshot.Count;
			if (_lastItemLocations == null)
			{
				itemLocationsAreaTheSame = true;
				inViewItemsAreTheSame = itemRowColumnSnapshot.Count == 0;
			}
			else if (_lastItemLocations.Count != count)
			{
				itemLocationsAreaTheSame = false;
				inViewItemsAreTheSame = false;
			}
			else
			{
				inViewItemsAreTheSame = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					ItemRowColumnSizeInfo itemRowColumnSizeInfo = itemRowColumnSnapshot[i];
					ItemRowColumnSizeInfo itemRowColumnSizeInfo2 = _lastItemLocations[i];
					if (itemRowColumnSizeInfo.Info != itemRowColumnSizeInfo2.Info)
					{
						inViewItemsAreTheSame = false;
						itemLocationsAreaTheSame = false;
						break;
					}
					if (itemRowColumnSizeInfo.Row != itemRowColumnSizeInfo2.Row || itemRowColumnSizeInfo.Column != itemRowColumnSizeInfo2.Column || itemRowColumnSizeInfo.PreferredSize != itemRowColumnSizeInfo2.PreferredSize)
					{
						itemLocationsAreaTheSame = false;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (_lastItemLocations == null || !itemLocationsAreaTheSame)
			{
				_lastItemLocations = itemRowColumnSnapshot;
			}
			System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment horizontalTileAreaAlignment = _panel.GetHorizontalTileAreaAlignment();
			VerticalAlignment verticalTileAreaAlignment = _panel.GetVerticalTileAreaAlignment();
			if (horizontalTileAreaAlignment != _lastHorizontalTileAreaAlignment || verticalTileAreaAlignment != _lastVerticalTileAreaAlignment)
			{
				itemLocationsAreaTheSame = false;
				_lastHorizontalTileAreaAlignment = horizontalTileAreaAlignment;
				_lastVerticalTileAreaAlignment = verticalTileAreaAlignment;
			}
		}

		internal void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_itemsInOriginalOrder == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				int newStartingIndex = e.NewStartingIndex;
				int count2 = e.NewItems.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count2; i++)
				{
					object obj = e.NewItems[i];
					int index = newStartingIndex + i;
					_itemsInOriginalOrder.Insert(index, obj);
					ItemInfoBase itemInfo = GetItemInfo(obj);
					_sparseArray.Insert(index, itemInfo);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
			{
				IList list2 = ((e.NewItems == null) ? e.OldItems : e.NewItems);
				int count4 = list2.Count;
				if (e.NewStartingIndex + count4 >= _itemsInOriginalOrder.Count || e.OldStartingIndex + count4 >= _itemsInOriginalOrder.Count)
				{
					ProcessResetNotification();
					break;
				}
				object[] array = new object[count4];
				for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
				{
					array[k] = _itemsInOriginalOrder[k + e.OldStartingIndex];
				}
				_itemsInOriginalOrder.RemoveRange(e.OldStartingIndex, list2.Count);
				_itemsInOriginalOrder.InsertRange(e.NewStartingIndex, array);
				if (_sparseArray[Math.Min(e.NewStartingIndex, e.OldStartingIndex)] != null)
				{
					_sparseArray.Clear();
					_sparseArray.Expand(_itemsInOriginalOrder.Count);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				_panel.VerifyMaximizedItems();
				int count3 = e.NewItems.Count;
				int num3 = e.NewStartingIndex + count3 - 1;
				for (int j = 0; j <= count3; j++)
				{
					object item = e.NewItems[j];
					object item2 = e.OldItems[j];
					ItemInfoBase itemInfo2 = GetItemInfo(item2);
					if (itemInfo2 != null)
					{
						int num4 = _sparseArray.IndexOf(itemInfo2);
						if (num4 >= 0)
						{
							_sparseArray[num4] = GetItemInfo(item);
						}
					}
				}
				RemoveRangeHelper(e.NewStartingIndex, e.OldItems);
				_itemsInOriginalOrder.InsertRange(e.NewStartingIndex, e.NewItems);
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				_panel.VerifyMaximizedItems();
				int num;
				IList list;
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					num = e.NewStartingIndex;
					list = e.NewItems;
				}
				else
				{
					num = e.OldStartingIndex;
					list = e.OldItems;
				}
				int count = list.Count;
				int num2 = num + count - 1;
				if (num2 >= _itemsInOriginalOrder.Count)
				{
					ProcessResetNotification();
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveRangeHelper(num, list);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				ProcessResetNotification();
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void OnScrollOffsetChanged(Vector newOffset, Vector oldOffset)
		{
			int scrollPosition = _scrollPosition;
			if (!_scrollTilesHorizontally && !_scrollTilesVertically)
			{
				_scrollLogicalOffset = 0;
				_arrangeOffset.X = 0.0 - newOffset.X;
				_arrangeOffset.Y = 0.0 - newOffset.Y;
			}
			else
			{
				if (_scrollTilesHorizontally)
				{
					_scrollPosition = GetScrollPositionFromOffset((int)newOffset.X);
					_scrollLogicalOffset = (int)newOffset.X;
					_arrangeOffset.X = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					_arrangeOffset.X = 0.0 - newOffset.X;
				}
				if (_scrollTilesVertically)
				{
					_scrollPosition = GetScrollPositionFromOffset((int)newOffset.Y);
					_scrollLogicalOffset = (int)newOffset.Y;
					_arrangeOffset.Y = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					_arrangeOffset.Y = 0.0 - newOffset.Y;
				}
			}
			_arrangeOffsetForMaxmizedTiles = _arrangeOffset;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				MaximizedTileLocation maximizedTileLocation = _maximizedTileLocation;
				if (maximizedTileLocation == MaximizedTileLocation.Left || maximizedTileLocation == MaximizedTileLocation.Right)
				{
					_arrangeOffsetForMaxmizedTiles.Y = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					_arrangeOffsetForMaxmizedTiles.X = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (scrollPosition != _scrollPosition)
			{
				_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		internal void OnItemResized(ItemInfoBase itemInfo, double deltaX, double deltaY)
		{
			if (CoreUtilities.AreClose(deltaX, 0.0))
			{
				deltaX = 0.0;
			}
			if (CoreUtilities.AreClose(deltaY, 0.0))
			{
				deltaY = 0.0;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				MaximizedTileLayoutOrder maximizedTileLayoutOrder = _maximizedTileLayoutOrder;
				if (maximizedTileLayoutOrder == MaximizedTileLayoutOrder.HorizontalWithLastTileFill || maximizedTileLayoutOrder == MaximizedTileLayoutOrder.Horizontal)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (_tileLayoutOrder)
				{
				case TileLayoutOrder.Horizontal:
				case TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable:
				case TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile:
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (deltaX != 0.0 && flag)
			{
				if (ItemResizeHelper(itemInfo, deltaX, 0.0))
				{
					_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
					if (deltaY != 0.0)
					{
						_panel.UpdateLayout();
					}
				}
				deltaX = 0.0;
			}
			if (deltaY != 0.0 && ItemResizeHelper(itemInfo, 0.0, deltaY))
			{
				_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
				if (deltaX != 0.0)
				{
					_panel.UpdateLayout();
				}
			}
			if (deltaX != 0.0 && ItemResizeHelper(itemInfo, deltaX, 0.0))
			{
				_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveContainer(DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (container != null && _containerToItemMap.ContainsKey(container))
			{
				object key = _containerToItemMap[container];
				_containerToItemMap.Remove(container);
				if (_layoutItemMap.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					LayoutItem li = _layoutItemMap[key];
					RemoveLayoutItem(li);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveLayoutItem(LayoutItem li)
		{
			DependencyObject container = li.Container;
			object item = li.Item;
			if (container != null && _containerToItemMap.ContainsKey(container))
			{
				_containerToItemMap.Remove(container);
			}
			if (_itemsToBeArranged.Exists(li))
			{
				_itemsToBeArranged.Remove(li);
			}
			else if (container != null)
			{
				foreach (LayoutItem item2 in _itemsToBeArranged)
				{
					if (item2.Container == container)
					{
						_itemsToBeArranged.Remove(item2);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (item != null && _layoutItemMap.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				_layoutItemMap.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		internal void SnapshotItemRects()
		{
			foreach (LayoutItem item in _itemsToBeArranged)
			{
				item.SnapshotCurrentRect();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyArrangeSize()

			if (UpdateScrollingInfo(overallGridBagLayout, _lastMeasureDesiredSize, isScrollingVertically, checkIfScrolledTooFar: true))

				_panel.InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

			_itemsToBeArranged.Add(li);
		}

				else
				{
					LayoutItem layoutItem = (LayoutItem)gridBagManager.LayoutItems[gridBagManager.LayoutItems.Count - 1];

						flag = AdjustMaxOffset(ref maxOffset, ref extentValue, ref viewportValue, panelExtent, gridBagManager, liFirst, layoutItem, !checkIfScrolledTooFar);
					}

						case MaximizedTileLocation.Top:
						case MaximizedTileLocation.Bottom:
							flag2 = layoutItem.TargetRect.Right <= _panel.TileAreaSize.Width + 1.0;
							break;

							viewportValue++;

			else

				case TileLayoutOrder.Vertical:

					int count = gridBagLayoutNormal.LayoutItems.Count;
					if (count == 0)
					{

					}
					else

						LayoutItem layoutItem2 = (LayoutItem)gridBagLayoutNormal.LayoutItems[count - 1];
						_scrollPositionOfLastArrangedItem = layoutItem2.ItemInfo.ScrollPosition;
					}
					_scrollLogicalOffsetOfLastArrangedItem = _scrollPositionOfLastArrangedItem;
					if (_normalModeRowColumnsInView < 1)
					{
						maxOffset = 0;
						break;
					}
					maxOffset = Math.Max(extentValue - viewportValue, 0);
					if (extentValue <= 0 || count <= 1)
					{

					}
					int num4 = _scrollLogicalOffset * _normalModeItemsPerRowColumn;
					if (num4 != _scrollPosition && _normalModeItemsPerRowColumn > 0)

						}
						LayoutItem liFirst2 = gridBagLayoutNormal.LayoutItems[0] as LayoutItem;
						LayoutItem liLast = gridBagLayoutNormal.LayoutItems[count - 1] as LayoutItem;

					}

				}
				case TileLayoutOrder.VerticalVariable:

					maxOffset = 0;

					if (gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.LayoutItems.Count == 0)

		private bool AdjustMaxOffset(ref int maxOffset, ref int extentValue, ref int viewportValue, double panelExtent, GridBagLayoutManager gbm, LayoutItem liFirst, LayoutItem liLast, bool bypassScrolledTooFarCheck)
		{
			double num = (_scrollTilesVertically ? liFirst.TargetRect.Top : liFirst.TargetRect.Left);
			double num2 = (_scrollTilesVertically ? liLast.TargetRect.Bottom : liLast.TargetRect.Right);
			double num3 = (_scrollTilesVertically ? liLast.TargetRect.Height : liLast.TargetRect.Width);
			double num4 = num + panelExtent - num2;
			if (_scrollTilesHorizontally)
			{
				double interItemSpacingHorizontal = gbm.InterItemSpacingHorizontal;
			}
			else
			{
				double interItemSpacingHorizontal = gbm.InterItemSpacingHorizontal;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool result = false;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (_scrollLogicalOffset == 0)
				{
					extentValue = 0;
					viewportValue = 1;
					maxOffset = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					maxOffset = _scrollLogicalOffset - 1;
					result = true;
				}
			}
			else if (num4 < 0.0 && !bypassScrolledTooFarCheck && _scrollLogicalOffset >= maxOffset)
			{
				int num5 = maxOffset;
				maxOffset = Math.Min(SparseArray.ScrollCount - 1, _scrollLogicalOffset + 1);
				int num6 = maxOffset - num5;
				viewportValue -= num6;
				if (viewportValue < 1)
				{
					extentValue += 1 - viewportValue;
					viewportValue = 1;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				maxOffset = Math.Max(_scrollLogicalOffset, maxOffset);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection CalculateAutoLayoutHelper(GridBagLayoutManager gbl, TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache, IEnumerator<ILayoutItem> enumerator, bool autoFitAllItems, System.Windows.Size constraint, int minRows, int minCols, int maxRows, int maxCols, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation orientation)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Orientation? constraintedOrientation = null;
			if (_gridBagLayoutMaximized == gbl)
			{
				switch (_maximizedTileLocation)
				{
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Left:
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Right:
					constraintedOrientation = System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal;
					break;
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Top:
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Bottom:
					constraintedOrientation = System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical;
					break;
				}
			}
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection gridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection = gbl.CalculateAutoLayout(enumerator, orientation, autoFitAllItems, constraint, minRows, minCols, maxRows, maxCols, constraintedOrientation);
			ProcessDimensionsCollection(gbl, genCache, gridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection);
			return gridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection;
		}

		private void CreateExpectedItemsList(TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache)
		{
			if (_itemsToBeArranged == null || _itemsToBeArranged.Count < 1 || _panel.ItemContainerGenerationModeResolved != ItemContainerGenerationMode.Recycle)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if ((!_isInMaximizedMode) ? (_tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile || _panel.GetShowAllTiles()) : _panel.GetShowAllMinimizedTiles())
			{
				genCache._itemsExpectedToBeGenerated = new ArrayList(Items);
				return;
			}
			IList list = null;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				list = _panel.GetMaximizedItems();
			}
			if (_panel.GetShouldAnimate())
			{
				genCache._itemsExpectedToBeGenerated = new ArrayList(_itemsToBeArranged.Count);
				if (list != null)
				{
					genCache._itemsExpectedToBeGenerated.AddRange(list);
				}
				{
					foreach (LayoutItem item2 in _itemsToBeArranged)
					{
						DependencyObject container = item2.Container;
						if (container != null)
						{
							object item = item2.Item;
							if (item != null)
							{
								genCache._itemsExpectedToBeGenerated.Add(item);
							}
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			int num = (IsMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight ? ((int)_panel.ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Height) : ((int)_panel.ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Width));
			int num2;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				num2 = Math.Max(1, num);
			}
			else
			{
				TileLayoutOrder tileLayoutOrder = _tileLayoutOrder;
				int num3 = ((tileLayoutOrder != TileLayoutOrder.VerticalVariable && tileLayoutOrder != TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable) ? _normalModeItemsPerRowColumn : ((int)Math.Ceiling(_variableAvgItemsPerRowColumn)));
				num2 = 1 + num * num3;
			}
			genCache._itemsExpectedToBeGenerated = new ArrayList(num2 + (list?.Count ?? 0));
			if (list != null)
			{
				genCache._itemsExpectedToBeGenerated.AddRange(list);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				int num4 = _scrollPosition + i;
				if (num4 < _sparseArray.ScrollCount)
				{
					object itemAtScrollIndex = GetItemAtScrollIndex(num4);
					if (itemAtScrollIndex != null)
					{
						genCache._itemsExpectedToBeGenerated.Add(itemAtScrollIndex);
					}
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureItemArrayIsAllocated()
		{
			if (_itemsInOriginalOrder == null)

				int count = Items.Count;
				_itemsInOriginalOrder = new ArrayList(count + 10);
				ExpandCachedItemArrays(count);

		}

		private void ExpandCachedItemArrays(int newCount)
		{
			if (_itemsInOriginalOrder != null)
			{
				for (int i = _itemsInOriginalOrder.Count; i < newCount; i++)
				{

					_totalColumnsDisplayed = Math.Max(gridBagConstraint.Column + gridBagConstraint.ColumnSpan, _totalColumnsDisplayed);
					_totalRowsDisplayed = Math.Max(gridBagConstraint.Row + gridBagConstraint.RowSpan, _totalRowsDisplayed);

			if (!flag || list.Count == 0)

		private void GenerateNormalVariableElements(TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache, bool createRows)
		{
			GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall = GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall;

			gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.VerticalContentAlignment = _panel.GetVerticalTileAreaAlignment();

			gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.ExpandToFitHeight = gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.VerticalContentAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch;

			bool showAllTiles = _panel.GetShowAllTiles();
			if (showAllTiles)
			{
				gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.ShrinkToFitHeight = true;
				gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.ShrinkToFitWidth = true;
			}
			else
			{
				gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.ShrinkToFitHeight = false;
				gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.ShrinkToFitWidth = false;
				if (_scrollLogicalOffset > 0)
				{
					LayoutItemsCollection layoutItemsCollection = ((genCache._previousGridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall != null) ? genCache._previousGridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.LayoutItems : null);
					int num = layoutItemsCollection?.Count ?? 0;
					if (layoutItemsCollection != null && layoutItemsCollection.Count > 0)
					{

						TileRowColumnLayoutItem tileRowColumnLayoutItem2 = (TileRowColumnLayoutItem)layoutItemsCollection[layoutItemsCollection.Count - 1];

							_scrollPosition = tileRowColumnLayoutItem3.GetFirstScrollPosition();

							int num2 = ((_scrollLogicalOffset >= tileRowColumnLayoutItem.ScrollOffset) ? (_scrollLogicalOffset - tileRowColumnLayoutItem2.ScrollOffset) : (tileRowColumnLayoutItem.ScrollOffset - _scrollLogicalOffset));
							double num3 = (double)num2 * _variableAvgItemsPerRowColumn;

										break;

									}
									if (num6 == num7)

		private GridBagLayoutManager GetContainingGridBagLayoutManager(ILayoutItem layoutItem, out ILayoutItem sectionContainer)
		{
			sectionContainer = null;
			GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutManager = null;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				gridBagLayoutManager = GridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall;
				if (gridBagLayoutManager != null && layoutItem is LayoutItem)
				{
					foreach (TileAreaLayoutItem item in (IEnumerable<ILayoutItem>)gridBagLayoutManager.LayoutItems)
					{
						if (item != null && item.GridBagManager.LayoutItems.Contains(layoutItem))
						{
							return item.GridBagManager;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (_tileLayoutOrder)
				{
				default:
					gridBagLayoutManager = GridBagLayoutNormal;
					break;
				case TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile:
					if (_explicitTileSizeBehavior == ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior.SynchronizeTileWidthsAndHeights)
					{
						gridBagLayoutManager = GridBagLayoutNormal;
						break;
					}
					gridBagLayoutManager = GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall;
					if (gridBagLayoutManager == null || !(layoutItem is LayoutItem))
					{
						break;
					}
					foreach (ExplicitRowColumnLayoutItem item2 in (IEnumerable<ILayoutItem>)gridBagLayoutManager.LayoutItems)
					{
						if (item2 != null && item2.GridBagManager.LayoutItems.Contains(layoutItem))
						{
							sectionContainer = item2;
							return item2.GridBagManager;
						}
					}
					break;
				case TileLayoutOrder.VerticalVariable:
				case TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable:
					gridBagLayoutManager = GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall;
					if (gridBagLayoutManager == null || !(layoutItem is LayoutItem))
					{
						break;
					}
					foreach (TileRowColumnLayoutItem item3 in (IEnumerable<ILayoutItem>)gridBagLayoutManager.LayoutItems)
					{
						if (item3 != null && item3.GridBagManager.LayoutItems.Contains(layoutItem))
						{
							sectionContainer = item3;
							return item3.GridBagManager;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (gridBagLayoutManager != null && gridBagLayoutManager.LayoutItems.Contains(layoutItem))
			{
				return gridBagLayoutManager;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private int GetCurrenRowColumnHelper(ItemInfoBase info, bool isColumn)
		{
			LayoutItem layoutItem = GetLayoutItem(info.Item);
			if (layoutItem == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				if (info.GetIsMaximized())
				{
					GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutMaximized = GridBagLayoutMaximized;
					int rowColumnSlot = GetRowColumnSlot(isColumn, layoutItem, gridBagLayoutMaximized);
					if (rowColumnSlot < 1)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					switch (_maximizedTileLocation)
					{
					case MaximizedTileLocation.Right:
						if (isColumn)
						{
							return rowColumnSlot + 1;
						}
						break;
					case MaximizedTileLocation.Bottom:
						if (!isColumn)
						{
							return rowColumnSlot + 1;
						}
						break;
					}
					return rowColumnSlot;
				}
				GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutMinimized = GridBagLayoutMinimized;
				int num = gridBagLayoutMinimized.LayoutItems.IndexOf(layoutItem);
				if (num < 1)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				switch (_maximizedTileLocation)
				{
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Left:
					if (isColumn)
					{
						num += _totalMaximizedColumns;
					}
					break;
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Right:
					if (isColumn)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					break;
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Top:
					if (!isColumn)
					{
						num += _totalMaximizedRows;
					}
					break;
				case MaximizedTileLocation.Bottom:
					if (!isColumn)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					break;
				}
				return num;
			}
			if (_tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile)
			{
				if (!isColumn)
				{
					return info.GetCurrentRow();
				}
				return info.GetCurrentColumn();
			}
			ILayoutItem sectionContainer;
			GridBagLayoutManager containingGridBagLayoutManager = GetContainingGridBagLayoutManager(layoutItem, out sectionContainer);
			if (containingGridBagLayoutManager == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection layoutItemDimensions = containingGridBagLayoutManager.GetLayoutItemDimensions(this, containingGridBagLayoutManager);
			if (sectionContainer is TileRowColumnLayoutItem li)
			{
				switch (_tileLayoutOrder)
				{
				case TileLayoutOrder.VerticalVariable:
					if (isColumn)
					{
						return GetRowColumnSlot(isColumn, li, GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall);
					}
					break;
				case TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable:
					if (!isColumn)
					{
						return GetRowColumnSlot(isColumn, li, GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return GetRowColumnSlot(isColumn, layoutItem, containingGridBagLayoutManager);
		}

		private ITileConstraints GetItemConstraints(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (_lastElement != element)
			{
				_lastElement = element;
				TileState containerState = _panel.GetContainerState(element);
				if (!_lastElementState.HasValue || containerState != _lastElementState.Value)
				{
					_lastElementState = containerState;
					_lastElementDefaultConstraints = _panel.GetDefaultConstraints(containerState);
				}
				_lastElementConstraints = _panel.GetContainerConstraints(element, containerState);
			}
			return _lastElementConstraints;
		}

		private List<ItemRowColumnSizeInfo> GetItemRowColumnSnapshot()
		{
			List<ItemRowColumnSizeInfo> list = new List<ItemRowColumnSizeInfo>();
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				GetItemRowColumnSnapshotHelper(list, GridBagLayoutMaximized.LayoutItems, null, null);
				GetItemRowColumnSnapshotHelper(list, GridBagLayoutMinimized.LayoutItems, null, null);
			}
			else
			{
				switch (_tileLayoutOrder)
				{
				default:
					GetItemRowColumnSnapshotHelper(list, GridBagLayoutNormal.LayoutItems, null, null);
					break;
				case TileLayoutOrder.VerticalVariable:
				case TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable:
				{
					LayoutItemsCollection layoutItems = GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.LayoutItems;
					int count = layoutItems.Count;
					int? explicitRow = null;
					int? explicitColumn = null;
					bool flag = _tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.VerticalVariable;
					for (int i = 0; i < count && layoutItems[i] is TileRowColumnLayoutItem tileRowColumnLayoutItem; i++)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							explicitColumn = i;
						}
						else
						{
							explicitRow = i;
						}
						GetItemRowColumnSnapshotHelper(list, tileRowColumnLayoutItem.GridBagManager.LayoutItems, explicitRow, explicitColumn);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void GetItemRowColumnSnapshotHelper(List<ItemRowColumnSizeInfo> list, LayoutItemsCollection layoutItems, int? explicitRow, int? explicitColumn)
		{
			int count = layoutItems.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				LayoutItem layoutItem = (LayoutItem)layoutItems[i];
				if (layoutItem == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				IGridBagConstraint gridBagConstraint = layoutItem;
				list.Add(new ItemRowColumnSizeInfo(layoutItem.ItemInfo, explicitRow.HasValue ? explicitRow.Value : gridBagConstraint.Row, explicitColumn.HasValue ? explicitColumn.Value : gridBagConstraint.Column, layoutItem.TargetRect, layoutItem.PreferredSizeCache));
			}
		}

		private object GetRowColumnProperty(DependencyObject element, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			ITileConstraints itemConstraints = GetItemConstraints(element);
			TileState tileState = (_lastElementState.HasValue ? _lastElementState.Value : TileState.Normal);
			bool flag = false;
			switch (tileState)
			{
			case TileState.Normal:
				return element.GetValue(property);
			case TileState.Maximized:
				flag = true;
				break;
			}
			bool isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight = IsMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight;
			switch (property.Name)
			{
			case "Column":
				if (flag)
				{
					return (_maximizedTileLayoutOrder != MaximizedTileLayoutOrder.SingleColumn) ? (-1) : 0;
				}
				return (!isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight) ? (-1) : 0;
			case "ColumnSpan":
				if (flag)
				{
					return (_maximizedTileLayoutOrder == MaximizedTileLayoutOrder.SingleColumn) ? 1 : 0;
				}
				return isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight ? 1 : 0;
			case "ColumnWeight":
				return 0f;
			case "Row":
				if (flag)
				{
					return (_maximizedTileLayoutOrder != MaximizedTileLayoutOrder.SingleRow) ? (-1) : 0;
				}
				return isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight ? (-1) : 0;
			case "RowSpan":
				if (flag)
				{
					return (_maximizedTileLayoutOrder == MaximizedTileLayoutOrder.SingleRow) ? 1 : 0;
				}
				return (!isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight) ? 1 : 0;
			case "RowWeight":
				if (isMaximizedAreaLeftOrRight && tileState == TileState.MinimizedExpanded)
				{
					return 1f;
				}
				return 0f;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private int GetRowColumnSlot(bool isColumn, ILayoutItem li, GridBagLayoutManager gbm)
		{
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection layoutItemDimensions = gbm.GetLayoutItemDimensions(this, gbm);
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensions gridBagLayoutItemDimensions = layoutItemDimensions[li];
			if (gridBagLayoutItemDimensions != null)
			{
				if (isColumn)
				{
					return gridBagLayoutItemDimensions.Column;
				}
				return gridBagLayoutItemDimensions.Row;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private TileAreaLayoutItem GetTileAreaLayoutItem(TileArea area)
		{
			GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall = GridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall;
			int count = gridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall.LayoutItems.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (gridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall.LayoutItems[i] is TileAreaLayoutItem tileAreaLayoutItem && tileAreaLayoutItem.Area == area)
				{
					return tileAreaLayoutItem;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void InvalidatePanelMeasure()
		{
			if (_panel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_panel._isInMeasure)
			{
				_panel.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					if (_panel != null)
					{
						_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
					}
				}, DispatcherPriority.Send);
			}
			else
			{
				_panel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private bool ItemResizeHelper(ItemInfoBase itemInfo, double deltaX, double deltaY)
		{
			LayoutItem layoutItem = GetLayoutItem(itemInfo.Item);
			if (layoutItem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!_isInMaximizedMode && (_tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.Horizontal || _tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.Vertical))
			{
				ItemInfoBase itemInfo2 = layoutItem.ItemInfo;
				if (itemInfo2 != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Size size = layoutItem.TargetRect.Size;
					size.Width = Math.Max(1.0, size.Width + deltaX);
					size.Height = Math.Max(1.0, size.Height + deltaY);
					UpdatePreferredSizeOverride(size, deltaX, deltaY, layoutItem, itemInfo2);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			ILayoutItem sectionContainer;
			GridBagLayoutManager containingGridBagLayoutManager = GetContainingGridBagLayoutManager(layoutItem, out sectionContainer);
			if (containingGridBagLayoutManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object containerContext = ((sectionContainer != null) ? ((object)sectionContainer) : ((object)containingGridBagLayoutManager));
			bool expandToFitWidth = containingGridBagLayoutManager.ExpandToFitWidth;
			bool expandToFitHeight = containingGridBagLayoutManager.ExpandToFitHeight;
			bool? shrinkToFitWidth = containingGridBagLayoutManager.ShrinkToFitWidth;
			bool? shrinkToFitHeight = containingGridBagLayoutManager.ShrinkToFitHeight;
			bool autoFitWidth = containingGridBagLayoutManager.HorizontalContentAlignment == System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;
			bool autoFitHeight = containingGridBagLayoutManager.VerticalContentAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch;
			ExplicitRowColumnLayoutItem explicitRowColumnLayoutItem = sectionContainer as ExplicitRowColumnLayoutItem;
			if (explicitRowColumnLayoutItem != null)
			{
				double deltaX2 = 0.0;
				double deltaY2 = 0.0;
				if (_explicitTileSizeBehavior == ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior.SynchronizeTileWidthsAcrossRows)
				{
					autoFitWidth = false;
					containingGridBagLayoutManager.ExpandToFitWidth = false;
					containingGridBagLayoutManager.ShrinkToFitWidth = false;
					deltaX2 = deltaX;
				}
				else
				{
					autoFitHeight = false;
					containingGridBagLayoutManager.ExpandToFitHeight = false;
					containingGridBagLayoutManager.ShrinkToFitHeight = false;
					deltaY2 = deltaY;
				}
				SetPreferredSizeOverrideToTargetSize(deltaX2, deltaY2, explicitRowColumnLayoutItem);
			}
			Dictionary<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> dictionary = containingGridBagLayoutManager.ResizeItem(this, containerContext, layoutItem, deltaX, deltaY, autoFitWidth, autoFitHeight);
			containingGridBagLayoutManager.ExpandToFitWidth = expandToFitWidth;
			containingGridBagLayoutManager.ExpandToFitHeight = expandToFitHeight;
			containingGridBagLayoutManager.ShrinkToFitWidth = shrinkToFitWidth;
			containingGridBagLayoutManager.ShrinkToFitHeight = shrinkToFitHeight;
			int count = dictionary.Count;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> item in dictionary)
			{
				if (!(item.Key is LayoutItem { ItemInfo: { } itemInfo3 } layoutItem2))
				{
					continue;
				}
				double deltaX3 = deltaX;
				double deltaY3 = deltaY;
				if (layoutItem2 != layoutItem)
				{
					if (_tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.HorizontalVariable)
					{
						deltaY3 = 0.0;
					}
					else if (_tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.VerticalVariable)
					{
						deltaX3 = 0.0;
					}
				}
				UpdatePreferredSizeOverride(item.Value, deltaX3, deltaY3, layoutItem2, itemInfo3);
			}
			if (explicitRowColumnLayoutItem != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if ((_explicitTileSizeBehavior != ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior.SynchronizeTileWidthsAcrossRows) ? (deltaY != 0.0 && explicitRowColumnLayoutItem.GridBagManager.VerticalContentAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch) : (deltaX != 0.0 && explicitRowColumnLayoutItem.GridBagManager.HorizontalContentAlignment == System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch))
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					double num2 = 0.0;
					if (_explicitTileSizeBehavior == ExplicitLayoutTileSizeBehavior.SynchronizeTileWidthsAcrossRows)
					{
						num = deltaX;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = deltaY;
					}
					GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall = GridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall;
					Dictionary<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> dictionary2 = gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall.ResizeItem(this, gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall, explicitRowColumnLayoutItem, num, num2, containingGridBagLayoutManager.HorizontalContentAlignment == System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, containingGridBagLayoutManager.VerticalContentAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch);
					int count2 = dictionary2.Count;
					foreach (KeyValuePair<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> item2 in dictionary2)
					{
						if (item2.Key is ExplicitRowColumnLayoutItem explicitRowColumnLayoutItem2 && explicitRowColumnLayoutItem2 != explicitRowColumnLayoutItem)
						{
							explicitRowColumnLayoutItem2.Rect = new Rect(explicitRowColumnLayoutItem2.Rect.Location, item2.Value);
							SetPreferredSizeOverrideToTargetSize(num, num2, explicitRowColumnLayoutItem2);
							explicitRowColumnLayoutItem2.GridBagManager.InvalidateLayout();
							explicitRowColumnLayoutItem2.CalculateminMaxPreffered();
						}
					}
					foreach (ILayoutItem item3 in (IEnumerable<ILayoutItem>)explicitRowColumnLayoutItem.GridBagManager.LayoutItems)
					{
						if (item3 is LayoutItem layoutItem3)
						{
							layoutItem3.DirtyPreferredSizeCache();
						}
					}
					explicitRowColumnLayoutItem.GridBagManager.InvalidateLayout();
					explicitRowColumnLayoutItem.CalculateminMaxPreffered();
				}
			}
			return count > 0;
		}

		private void OnItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_itemsControl != null)
			{
				if (this != _panel.GetManager())
				{
					((INotifyCollectionChanged)_itemsControl.Items).CollectionChanged -= OnItemsCollectionChanged;
					_itemsControl = null;
				}
				else
				{
					OnItemsChanged(e);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessDimensionsCollection(GridBagLayoutManager gbl, TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache, GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection dimsCollection)
		{
			foreach (ILayoutItem item in (IEnumerable)dimsCollection)
			{
				if (item is LayoutItem layoutItem2)
				{
					layoutItem2.SetDimensions(dimsCollection[layoutItem2]);
					AddItemToBeArranged(layoutItem2);
					_itemsInView.Add(layoutItem2.ItemInfo);
					UpdateGenCacheOnItemAdded(genCache, layoutItem2);
					if (layoutItem2.ItemInfo.GetIsMaximized() && layoutItem2.Container != null)
					{
						layoutItem2.Container.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty, 1000);
					}
				}
				else if (item is TileRowColumnLayoutItem tileRowColumnLayoutItem)
				{
					tileRowColumnLayoutItem.ProcessGeneratedElements(genCache);
				}
				gbl.LayoutItems.Add(item, item);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessResetNotification()
		{
			_panel.VerifyMaximizedItems();
			try
			{
				if (_itemsInOriginalOrder == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(_itemsInOriginalOrder.Count);
				IList items = Items;
				int count = items.Count;
				int count2 = _itemsInOriginalOrder.Count;
				if (_sparseArray.Count != count2)
				{
					_sparseArray.Clear();
					_sparseArray.Expand(count);
					_itemsInOriginalOrder = null;
					InvalidatePanelMeasure();
					return;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				int num = 0;
				for (int num2 = count2 - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					object obj = _itemsInOriginalOrder[num2];
					if (obj != null)
					{
						num++;
						if (num2 >= count || obj != items[num2])
						{
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num == 0 || !flag)
				{
					_itemsInOriginalOrder = null;
					_sparseArray.Clear();
					InvalidatePanelMeasure();
				}
				else if (count < count2)
				{
					for (int i = count; i < count2; i++)
					{
						object obj2 = _itemsInOriginalOrder[i];
						if (obj2 != null)
						{
							ItemInfoBase itemInfo = GetItemInfo(obj2, createIfNotFound: false, -1);
							if (itemInfo != null)
							{
								_sparseArray.Remove(itemInfo);
							}
						}
					}
					_itemsInOriginalOrder.RemoveRange(count, count2 - count);
					int count3 = _sparseArray.Count;
					if (count3 > count)
					{
						_sparseArray.RemoveRange(count, count3 - count);
					}
				}
				else if (count > count2)
				{
					ExpandCachedItemArrays(count);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<object, ItemInfoBase> item in (IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<object, ItemInfoBase>>)_itemInfoMap)
				{
					if (item.Value.Index < 0)
					{
						arrayList2.Add(item.Key);
					}
				}
				int count4 = arrayList2.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < count4; j++)
				{
					RemoveItemFromMaps(arrayList2[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveDuplicateContainerRefs(LayoutItem layoutItem)
		{
			DependencyObject container = layoutItem.Container;
			if (container == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_genCache != null)
			{
				if (_genCache._previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache.TryGetValue(container, out var value) && value != layoutItem)
				{
					if (_itemsToBeArranged.Exists(value))
					{
						_itemsToBeArranged.Remove(value);
					}
					_genCache._previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache.Remove(container);
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (LayoutItem item in _itemsToBeArranged)
			{
				if (item != layoutItem && item.Container == container)
				{
					_itemsToBeArranged.Remove(item);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveItemFromMaps(object item)
		{
			if (_itemInfoMap.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
			{
				_itemInfoMap.Remove(item);
				_sparseArray.Remove(value);
			}
			else if (_sparseArray.Count > 0)
			{
				_sparseArray.RemoveAt(_sparseArray.Count - 1);
			}
			if (_layoutItemMap.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				LayoutItem li = _layoutItemMap[item];
				RemoveLayoutItem(li);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveRangeHelper(int startIndex, IList list)
		{
			int count = list.Count;
			_itemsInOriginalOrder.RemoveRange(startIndex, count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				object item = list[i];
				RemoveItemFromMaps(item);
			}
		}

		private static void SetPreferredSizeOverrideToTargetSize(double deltaX, double deltaY, ExplicitRowColumnLayoutItem siblingSection)
		{
			if (deltaX == 0.0 && deltaY == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ILayoutItem item in (IEnumerable<ILayoutItem>)siblingSection.GridBagManager.LayoutItems)
			{
				if (item is LayoutItem { ItemInfo: { } itemInfo, TargetRect: var targetRect } layoutItem)
				{
					UpdatePreferredSizeOverride(targetRect.Size, deltaX, deltaY, layoutItem, itemInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SynchLastScrollPosition()
		{
			_synchLastScrollPosOperation = null;
			_lastScrollPosition = _scrollPosition;
			_lastScrollLogicalOffset = _scrollLogicalOffset;
		}

		private static void UpdateGenCacheOnItemAdded(TilesPanelBase.GenerationCache genCache, LayoutItem li)
		{
			if (genCache._previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache.ContainsKey(li.Container))
			{
				genCache._previousItemsToBeArrangedTempCache.Remove(li.Container);
			}
			else
			{
				genCache._newItemsToBeArrangedTempCache.Add(li);
			}
		}

		private static void UpdatePreferredSizeOverride(System.Windows.Size targetSize, double deltaX, double deltaY, LayoutItem li, ItemInfoBase liInfo)
		{
			System.Windows.Size? preferredSizeOverride = liInfo.PreferredSizeOverride;
			System.Windows.Size value = default(System.Windows.Size);
			if (deltaX != 0.0)
			{
				value.Width = Math.Max(targetSize.Width - 0.5, 0.0);
			}
			else if (preferredSizeOverride.HasValue)
			{
				value.Width = preferredSizeOverride.Value.Width;
			}
			if (deltaY != 0.0)
			{
				value.Height = Math.Max(targetSize.Height - 0.5, 0.0);
			}
			else if (preferredSizeOverride.HasValue)
			{
				value.Height = preferredSizeOverride.Value.Height;
			}
			liInfo.PreferredSizeOverride = value;
			li.DirtyPreferredSizeCache();
		}

		private bool UpdateScrollingInfo(GridBagLayoutManager gbl, System.Windows.Size preferredSize, bool isScrollingTilesVertically, bool checkIfScrolledTooFar)
		{
			_scrollTilesVertically = false;
			_scrollTilesHorizontally = false;
			bool flag;
			bool flag2;
			if (_isInMaximizedMode)
			{
				flag = true;
				flag2 = _panel.GetShowAllMinimizedTiles();
			}
			else
			{
				flag = _panel.GetShowAllTiles();
				flag2 = flag || _tileLayoutOrder == TileLayoutOrder.UseExplicitRowColumnOnTile;
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				_scrollTilesHorizontally = !isScrollingTilesVertically;
				_scrollTilesVertically = isScrollingTilesVertically;
			}
			else
			{
				_scrollPositionOfLastArrangedItem = _sparseArray.ScrollCount - 1;
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = ((!flag) ? preferredSize : gbl.CalculateMinimumSize(this, gbl));
			System.Windows.Size extent = default(System.Windows.Size);
			System.Windows.Size viewport = new System.Windows.Size(1.0, 1.0);
			System.Windows.Size tileAreaSize = _panel.TileAreaSize;
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (_scrollTilesHorizontally)
			{
				flag3 = CalculateTileScrollExtents(checkIfScrolledTooFar, ref extent, ref viewport);
			}
			else
			{
				_scrollSmallChange.X = 10.0;
				_scrollLargeChange.X = Math.Max(tileAreaSize.Width - 10.0, 10.0);
				extent.Width = size.Width;
				viewport.Width = tileAreaSize.Width;
				_scrollMaxOffset.X = Math.Max(extent.Width - viewport.Width, 0.0);
			}
			if (_scrollTilesVertically)
			{
				flag3 = CalculateTileScrollExtents(checkIfScrolledTooFar, ref extent, ref viewport);
			}
			else
			{
				_scrollSmallChange.Y = 10.0;
				_scrollLargeChange.Y = Math.Max(tileAreaSize.Height - 10.0, 10.0);
				extent.Height = size.Height;
				viewport.Height = tileAreaSize.Height;
				_scrollMaxOffset.Y = Math.Max(extent.Height - viewport.Height, 0.0);
			}
			if (flag3 || !checkIfScrolledTooFar)
			{
				TilesPanelBase.ScrollData scrollDataInfo = _panel.ScrollDataInfo;
				if (_scrollMaxOffset.X == 0.0)
				{
					viewport.Width = 1.0;
					extent.Width = 1.0;
				}
				if (_scrollMaxOffset.Y == 0.0)
				{
					viewport.Height = 1.0;
					extent.Height = 1.0;
				}
				if (_scrollTilesVertically)
				{
					scrollDataInfo._offset.Y = _scrollLogicalOffset;
				}
				else if (_scrollTilesHorizontally)
				{
					scrollDataInfo._offset.X = _scrollLogicalOffset;
				}
				scrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(viewport, extent);
			}
			return flag3;
		}

		private bool VerifyItemSlot(object item, ref int originalItemIndex)
		{
			if (originalItemIndex < 0)
			{
				originalItemIndex = Items.IndexOf(item);
				if (originalItemIndex < 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		Rect ILayoutContainer.GetBounds(object containerContext)
		{
			if (containerContext == _gridBagLayoutMaximized)
			{
				return MaximizedTileArea.Rect;
			}
			if (containerContext == _gridBagLayoutMinimized)
			{
				return MinimizedTileArea.Rect;
			}
			if (containerContext is TileRowColumnLayoutItem tileRowColumnLayoutItem)
			{
				return tileRowColumnLayoutItem.Rect;
			}
			if (containerContext is ExplicitRowColumnLayoutItem explicitRowColumnLayoutItem)
			{
				return explicitRowColumnLayoutItem.Rect;
			}
			GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutManager = containerContext as GridBagLayoutManager;
			System.Windows.Size tileAreaSize = _panel.TileAreaSize;
			if (gridBagLayoutManager != null)
			{
				if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Width) || double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Height))
				{
					System.Windows.Size size = gridBagLayoutManager.CalculatePreferredSize(this, gridBagLayoutManager);
					if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Width))
					{
						tileAreaSize.Width = size.Width;
					}
					if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(tileAreaSize.Height))
					{
						tileAreaSize.Height = size.Height;
					}
				}
				System.Windows.Size size2 = gridBagLayoutManager.CalculateMinimumSize(this, gridBagLayoutManager);
				tileAreaSize.Width = Math.Max(tileAreaSize.Width, size2.Width);
				tileAreaSize.Height = Math.Max(tileAreaSize.Height, size2.Height);
			}
			return new Rect(tileAreaSize);
		}

		void ILayoutContainer.PositionItem(ILayoutItem item, Rect rect, object containerContext)
		{
			if (containerContext == _gridBagLayoutMaximizedModeOverall)
			{
				if (item is TileAreaLayoutItem tileAreaLayoutItem)
				{
					tileAreaLayoutItem.Rect = rect;
				}
			}
			else if (containerContext == _gridBagLayoutNormalModeOverall)
			{
				if (item is ExplicitRowColumnLayoutItem explicitRowColumnLayoutItem)
				{
					explicitRowColumnLayoutItem.Rect = rect;
				}
				else if (item is TileRowColumnLayoutItem tileRowColumnLayoutItem)
				{
					tileRowColumnLayoutItem.Rect = rect;
				}
			}
			else if (item is LayoutItem layoutItem)
			{
				layoutItem.SetTargetRect(rect, measureElement: true);
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public abstract class AdornerEx : Adorner
	{
		protected AdornerEx(FrameworkElement adornedElement)
			: base(adornedElement)
		{
			WireLoadedUnloaded(addToLayer: false);
		}

		private void OnAdornedElementLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)base.AdornedElement).Loaded -= OnAdornedElementLoaded;
			VerifyAdornerLayer(calledFromLoaded: true);
		}

		private void OnAdornerLayerUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)base.AdornedElement).Unloaded -= OnAdornerLayerUnloaded;
			VerifyAdornerLayer(calledFromLoaded: false);
		}

		private void VerifyAdornerLayer(bool calledFromLoaded)
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) is AdornerLayer adornerLayer)
			{
				if (adornerLayer == AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(base.AdornedElement))
				{
					if (calledFromLoaded)
					{
						((FrameworkElement)base.AdornedElement).Unloaded += OnAdornerLayerUnloaded;
					}
					else
					{
						((FrameworkElement)base.AdornedElement).Loaded += OnAdornedElementLoaded;
					}
					return;
				}
				((FrameworkElement)base.AdornedElement).Unloaded -= OnAdornerLayerUnloaded;
				adornerLayer.Remove(this);
			}
			WireLoadedUnloaded(calledFromLoaded);
		}

		private void WireLoadedUnloaded(bool addToLayer)
		{
			AdornerLayer adornerLayer = AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(base.AdornedElement);
			if (adornerLayer != null)
			{
				if (!addToLayer && !((FrameworkElement)base.AdornedElement).IsLoaded)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)base.AdornedElement).Loaded += OnAdornedElementLoaded;
				}
				else
				{
					((FrameworkElement)base.AdornedElement).Unloaded += OnAdornerLayerUnloaded;
				}
				if (addToLayer && adornerLayer != VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this))
				{
					adornerLayer.Add(this);
				}
			}
			else if (addToLayer)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)base.AdornedElement).Loaded += OnAdornedElementLoaded;
			}
		}
	}

		public static PropertyDescriptorCollection GetXmlNodeProperties(XmlNode node)
		{
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			if (node.Attributes != null)
			{
				foreach (XmlAttribute attribute in node.Attributes)
				{
					list.Add(new XmlNodePropertyDescriptor(attribute));
				}
			}
			if (node.ChildNodes != null)
			{
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (XmlNode childNode in node.ChildNodes)
				{
					if (childNode.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element)
					{
						num++;
					}
					else if (childNode.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Text)
					{
						num++;
						num2++;
					}
				}
				if (num2 > 0 && num > 1)
				{
					list.Add(new XmlNodePropertyDescriptor("Text"));
				}
				else
				{
					Dictionary<string, XmlNode> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, XmlNode>();
					Dictionary<string, XmlNodePropertyDescriptor> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, XmlNodePropertyDescriptor>();
					foreach (XmlNode childNode2 in node.ChildNodes)
					{
						switch (childNode2.NodeType)
						{
						case XmlNodeType.Element:
						{
							string name = childNode2.Name;
							if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
							{
								if (!dictionary2.ContainsKey(name))
								{
									if (dictionary.ContainsKey(name))
									{
										XmlNode xmlNode3 = dictionary[name];
										dictionary.Remove(name);
										dictionary2.Add(name, new XmlNodePropertyDescriptor(name, xmlNode3.LocalName, treatAsList: true));
									}
									else
									{
										dictionary.Add(name, childNode2);
									}
								}
							}
							else
							{
								list.Add(new XmlNodePropertyDescriptor(childNode2));
							}
							break;
						}
						case XmlNodeType.Text:
							list.Add(new XmlNodePropertyDescriptor(childNode2));
							break;
						}
					}
					if (dictionary.Count > 0)
					{
						foreach (XmlNode value in dictionary.Values)
						{
							XmlAttributeCollection attributes = value.Attributes;
							string name2 = value.Name;
							if (attributes != null && attributes.Count > 0 && name2 != null && name2.Length > 0)
							{
								dictionary2.Add(name2, new XmlNodePropertyDescriptor(name2, value.LocalName, treatAsList: true));
							}
							else
							{
								list.Add(new XmlNodePropertyDescriptor(value));
							}
						}
					}
					if (dictionary2.Count > 0)
					{
						foreach (XmlNodePropertyDescriptor value2 in dictionary2.Values)
						{
							list.Add(value2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[list.Count];
			if (list.Count > 0)

		public static bool GetDataSourceNullValue(PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor, out object nullValue)
		{
			Type componentType = propertyDescriptor.ComponentType;
			if (propertyDescriptor is DataColumnPropertyDescriptor || typeof(DataRowView).IsAssignableFrom(componentType) || typeof(DataRow).IsAssignableFrom(componentType))
			{
				nullValue = DBNull.Value;
				return true;
			}
			Type propertyType = propertyDescriptor.PropertyType;
			Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(propertyType);
			if (null != underlyingType && underlyingType != propertyType)
			{
				nullValue = null;
				return true;
			}
			AttributeCollection attributes = propertyDescriptor.Attributes;
			DefaultValueAttribute defaultValueAttribute = ((attributes != null) ? ((DefaultValueAttribute)attributes[typeof(DefaultValueAttribute)]) : null);
			if (defaultValueAttribute != null)
			{
				object value = defaultValueAttribute.Value;
				if (value == null || DBNull.Value == value)
				{
					nullValue = value;
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (!propertyType.IsValueType)
			{
				if (propertyDescriptor is DependencyPropertyDescriptor || propertyDescriptor is ValuePropertyDescriptor)
				{
					nullValue = null;
					return true;
				}
				Type type = propertyDescriptor.GetType();
				if ("ReflectPropertyDescriptor" == type.Name)
				{
					nullValue = null;
					return true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (propertyDescriptor is DependencyPropertyDescriptor)
				{
					nullValue = DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
					return true;
				}
				if (defaultValueAttribute != null)
				{
					nullValue = defaultValueAttribute.Value;
					return true;
				}
			}
			nullValue = null;
			return false;
		}

		public static object DataBindConvert(object source, Type destinationType, CultureInfo culture, string format, IFormatProvider formatInfo, out bool validConversion)
		{
			validConversion = true;
			if (source == null || source is DBNull)
			{
				return source;
			}
			Type type = source.GetType();
			if (destinationType.IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				return source;
			}
			TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(type);
			if (converter != null && converter.CanConvertTo(destinationType))
			{
				try
				{
					return converter.ConvertTo(null, culture, source, destinationType);
				}
				catch (NotSupportedException)
				{
				}
			}
			TypeConverter converter2 = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(destinationType);
			if (converter2 != null && converter2.CanConvertFrom(type))
			{
				try
				{
					return converter2.ConvertFrom(null, culture, source);
				}
				catch (NotSupportedException)
				{
				}
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				string text = CoreUtilities.ToString(source, format, formatInfo, ignoreFormatIfEmpty: false);
				return text ?? source.ToString();
			}
			if (source is IConvertible)
			{
				try
				{
					if (formatInfo != null)
					{
						return Convert.ChangeType(source, destinationType, formatInfo);
					}
					if (culture != null)
					{
						return Convert.ChangeType(source, destinationType, culture);
					}
					return Convert.ChangeType(source, destinationType);
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException)
				{
				}
			}
			validConversion = false;
			return null;
		}

		public static IEnumerable GetSampleData()
		{
			if (g_sampleDataProvider == null)
			{
				byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(SR.GetString("SampleData_XML"));
				Stream stream = new MemoryStream(bytes);
				if (stream != null)
				{
					g_sampleDataProvider = new XmlDataProvider();
					XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
					xmlDocument.Load(stream);
					using (g_sampleDataProvider.DeferRefresh())
					{
						g_sampleDataProvider.Document = xmlDocument;
						g_sampleDataProvider.XPath = "/SampleData/users/user";
						g_sampleDataProvider.IsAsynchronous = false;
					}
					g_sampleDataProvider.Refresh();
					g_sampleDataProvider.InitialLoad();
					stream.Close();
				}
			}
			return g_sampleDataProvider.Data as IEnumerable;
		}

	public class XmlNodePropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
	{
		private Type _type;

		private IXmlSchemaInfo _schema;

		private bool _isReadOnly;

		private bool _isAttribute;

		private bool _useInnerText;

		private string _displayName;

		public IXmlSchemaInfo SchemaInfo => _schema;

		public override Type ComponentType => typeof(XmlNode);

		public override string DisplayName => _displayName;

		public override Type PropertyType => _type;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => _isReadOnly;

		internal XmlNodePropertyDescriptor(string name)
			: this(name, name, treatAsList: false)
		{
		}

		internal XmlNodePropertyDescriptor(string name, string localName, bool treatAsList)
			: base(name, null)
		{
			_isReadOnly = true;
			if (treatAsList)
			{
				_useInnerText = false;
				_type = typeof(IList);
			}
			else
			{
				_useInnerText = true;
				_type = typeof(string);
			}
			_displayName = localName;
		}

		public XmlNodePropertyDescriptor(XmlNode node)
			: base(node.Name, null)
		{
			_isAttribute = node is XmlAttribute;
			_isReadOnly = node.IsReadOnly;
			_schema = node.SchemaInfo;
			_displayName = node.LocalName;
			if (node.HasChildNodes && (node.ChildNodes.Count > 1 || (node.ChildNodes.Count == 1 && node.FirstChild is XmlElement)))
			{
				_type = typeof(IEnumerable);
				return;
			}
			if (_schema != null)
			{
				if (_schema.MemberType != null && _schema.MemberType.Datatype != null)
				{
					_type = _schema.MemberType.Datatype.ValueType;
				}
				if (_type == null && _schema.SchemaType != null && _schema.SchemaType.Datatype != null)
				{
					_type = _schema.SchemaType.Datatype.ValueType;
				}
			}
			if (_type == null)
			{
				_type = typeof(string);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override object GetValue(object component)
		{
			if (!(component is XmlNode node))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_2"));
			}
			object valueInternal = GetValueInternal(node, useDefaultSource: true);
			string text = valueInternal as string;
			if (valueInternal != null && text == null)
			{
				return valueInternal;
			}
			if (_type == typeof(string))
			{
				return text;
			}
			if (_type == typeof(bool))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToBoolean(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(byte))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToByte(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(char))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToChar(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToDateTime(text, XmlDateTimeSerializationMode.RoundtripKind);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(decimal))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToDecimal(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(double))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToDouble(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(Guid))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToGuid(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(short))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToInt16(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(int))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToInt32(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(long))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToInt64(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(sbyte))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToSByte(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(float))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToSingle(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(TimeSpan))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToTimeSpan(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(ushort))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToUInt16(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(uint))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToUInt32(text);
			}
			if (_type == typeof(ulong))
			{
				return XmlConvert.ToUInt64(text);
			}
			if (typeof(IConvertible).IsAssignableFrom(_type))
			{
				return ((IConvertible)text).ToType(_type, (IFormatProvider)null);
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override void ResetValue(object component)
		{
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
		{
			if (!(component is XmlNode node))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_2"));
			}
			if (_useInnerText)
			{
				throw new ReadOnlyException();
			}
			string text = value as string;
			if (value != null && text == null)
			{
				text = ((value is bool) ? XmlConvert.ToString((bool)value) : ((value is byte) ? XmlConvert.ToString((byte)value) : ((value is char) ? XmlConvert.ToString((char)value) : ((value is DateTime) ? XmlConvert.ToString((DateTime)value, XmlDateTimeSerializationMode.RoundtripKind) : ((value is decimal) ? XmlConvert.ToString((decimal)value) : ((value is double) ? XmlConvert.ToString((double)value) : ((value is Guid) ? XmlConvert.ToString((Guid)value) : ((value is short) ? XmlConvert.ToString((short)value) : ((value is int) ? XmlConvert.ToString((int)value) : ((value is long) ? XmlConvert.ToString((long)value) : ((value is sbyte) ? XmlConvert.ToString((sbyte)value) : ((value is float) ? XmlConvert.ToString((float)value) : ((value is TimeSpan) ? XmlConvert.ToString((TimeSpan)value) : ((value is ushort) ? XmlConvert.ToString((ushort)value) : ((value is uint) ? XmlConvert.ToString((uint)value) : ((!(value is ulong)) ? value.ToString() : XmlConvert.ToString((ulong)value)))))))))))))))));
			}
			SetValueInternal(node, text, useDefaultSource: true);
		}

		private object GetValueInternal(XmlNode node, bool useDefaultSource)
		{
			if (_useInnerText)
			{
				return node.InnerText;
			}
			if ((!useDefaultSource) ? (!_isAttribute) : _isAttribute)
			{
				XmlNode namedItem = node.Attributes.GetNamedItem(Name);
				if (namedItem == null)
				{
					if (useDefaultSource)
					{
						return GetValueInternal(node, useDefaultSource: false);
					}
					return null;
				}
				return namedItem.InnerText;
			}
			List<XmlNode> list = ((_type == typeof(IList)) ? new List<XmlNode>() : null);
			for (XmlNode xmlNode = node.FirstChild; xmlNode != null; xmlNode = xmlNode.NextSibling)
			{
				if (xmlNode.Name == Name)
				{
					if (list == null)
					{
						if (_type == typeof(IEnumerable))
						{
							return xmlNode.ChildNodes;
						}
						return xmlNode.InnerText;
					}
					list.Add(xmlNode);
				}
			}
			if (list != null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (useDefaultSource)
			{
				return GetValueInternal(node, useDefaultSource: false);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SetValueInternal(XmlNode node, string text, bool useDefaultSource)
		{
			bool flag = ((!useDefaultSource) ? (!_isAttribute) : _isAttribute);
			XmlNode xmlNode = null;
			string innerText = null;
			if (flag)
			{
				xmlNode = node.Attributes.GetNamedItem(Name);
			}
			else
			{
				for (XmlNode xmlNode2 = node.FirstChild; xmlNode2 != null; xmlNode2 = xmlNode2.NextSibling)
				{
					if (xmlNode2.Name == Name)
					{
						xmlNode = xmlNode2;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (xmlNode == null && useDefaultSource)
			{
				SetValueInternal(node, text, useDefaultSource: false);
			}
			else
			{
				if (xmlNode == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					innerText = xmlNode.InnerText;
					xmlNode.InnerText = text;
					if (xmlNode.OwnerDocument != null && xmlNode.OwnerDocument.Schemas.Count > 0)
					{
						xmlNode.OwnerDocument.Validate(OnValidateChild, xmlNode);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					xmlNode.InnerText = innerText;
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnValidateChild(object sender, ValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			throw e.Exception;
		}
	}

		internal class PropertyDescriptorComparer : IEqualityComparer
		{
			internal static PropertyDescriptorComparer Instance = new PropertyDescriptorComparer();

			bool IEqualityComparer.Equals(object x, object y)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = x as PropertyDescriptor;
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = y as PropertyDescriptor;
				if (propertyDescriptor == propertyDescriptor2)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (propertyDescriptor == null || propertyDescriptor2 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (propertyDescriptor.ComponentType == propertyDescriptor2.ComponentType)
				{
					return propertyDescriptor.Name == propertyDescriptor2.Name;
				}
				return false;
			}

			int IEqualityComparer.GetHashCode(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor))
				{
					return obj?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
				}
				return propertyDescriptor.Name.GetHashCode() ^ propertyDescriptor.ComponentType.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected void OnPropertiesChangedHelper(PropertyDescriptorCollection oldProperties, PropertyDescriptorCollection newProperties)
		{
			if (this.PropertyDescriptorsChanged == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HashSet hashSet = new HashSet(oldProperties?.Count ?? 0, 0.5f, PropertyDescriptorComparer.Instance);
			HashSet hashSet2 = new HashSet(newProperties?.Count ?? 0, 0.5f, PropertyDescriptorComparer.Instance);
			if (oldProperties != null)
			{
				hashSet.AddItems(oldProperties);
			}
			if (newProperties != null)
			{
				hashSet2.AddItems(newProperties);
			}
			if (HashSet.AreEqual(hashSet, hashSet2))
			{
				return;
			}
			HashSet intersection = HashSet.GetIntersection(hashSet, hashSet2);
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[hashSet2.Count - intersection.Count];
			PropertyDescriptor[] array2 = new PropertyDescriptor[hashSet.Count - intersection.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item2 in hashSet2)
			{
				if (!intersection.Exists(item2))
				{
					array[num] = item2;
					num++;
				}
			}
			num = 0;
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item3 in hashSet)
			{
				if (!intersection.Exists(item3))
				{
					array2[num] = item3;
					num++;
				}
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item4 in intersection)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor3 = hashSet.GetEquivalentItem(item4) as PropertyDescriptor;
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor4 = hashSet2.GetEquivalentItem(item4) as PropertyDescriptor;
				if (!(propertyDescriptor3.PropertyType == propertyDescriptor4.PropertyType) || !(propertyDescriptor3.DisplayName == propertyDescriptor4.DisplayName) || propertyDescriptor3.IsReadOnly != propertyDescriptor4.IsReadOnly || propertyDescriptor3.IsBrowsable != propertyDescriptor4.IsBrowsable)
				{
					list.Add(propertyDescriptor4);
				}
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] array3 = new PropertyDescriptor[list.Count];
			list.CopyTo(array3);
			RaisePropertyDescriptorsChangedEvent(new PropertyDescriptorsChangedEventArgs(this, array, array3, array2));
		}

		public static PropertyDescriptorProvider CreateProvider(object item, IEnumerable containingList)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				if (item is DataRowView dataRowView)
				{
					return new DataViewPropertyDescriptorProvider(dataRowView.DataView);

				}

				}
			}

					return new DataViewPropertyDescriptorProvider(view);

					return null;
				}
				return new TypePropertyDescriptorProvider(itemType);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public virtual bool IsCompatibleItem(object item, IEnumerable containingList)
		{
			if (item == null)

				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");

			if (item is DataRowView dataRowView)

			}
			if (DataBindingUtilities.GetUnderlyingItemSource(containingList) is ITypedList typedList)
			{
				return typedList == _source as ITypedList;
			}

		public virtual bool IsCompatibleList(IEnumerable list)
		{
			if (list == null)

				return false;
			}
			if (_source is Type)

				Type itemType;
				ITypedList typedListFromContainingList = GetTypedListFromContainingList(list, out itemType);

				}

			}
			Type itemType2;

			ITypedList typedListFromContainingList3 = GetTypedListFromContainingList(_source as IEnumerable, out itemType2);
			if (typedListFromContainingList2 != null)

			}
			return false;
		}
