		public static ITypedList GetTypedListFromContainingList(IEnumerable sourceList, out Type itemType)
		{
			sourceList = DataBindingUtilities.GetUnderlyingItemSource(sourceList);
			if (sourceList == null)
			{
				itemType = null;
				return null;
			}
			Type type = sourceList.GetType();
			lock (g_ListTypeItemTypeMap)
			{
				if (g_ListTypeItemTypeMap.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
				{
					itemType = value.ItemType;
					if (value.IsKnownType)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return sourceList as ITypedList;
				}
				value.ListType = type;
				if (type.FullName == "System.Windows.Forms.BindingSource")
				{
					type = GetListTypeFromBindingSource(sourceList);
				}
				Type[] interfaces = type.GetInterfaces();
				int num = interfaces.Length;
				Type type2 = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					Type type3 = interfaces[i];
					if (type3 != typeof(IEnumerable) && type3 != typeof(ICollection) && type3 != typeof(IList) && type3 != typeof(IBindingList) && type3 != typeof(IBindingListView) && type3 != typeof(ITypedList) && type3.IsGenericType)
					{
						Type genericTypeDefinition = type3.GetGenericTypeDefinition();
						if (genericTypeDefinition == typeof(IEnumerable<>))
						{
							type2 = type3;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (type2 == null)
				{
					string name = type.Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 10 && name.StartsWith("ObjectView") && type.IsGenericType)
					{
						type2 = type;
					}
				}
				if (type2 != null)
				{
					Type[] genericArguments = type2.GetGenericArguments();
					if (genericArguments != null && genericArguments.Length == 1 && genericArguments[0] != typeof(object))
					{
						value.ItemType = genericArguments[0];
						value.IsKnownType = DataBindingUtilities.IsKnownType(value.ItemType);
					}
				}
				itemType = value.ItemType;
				g_ListTypeItemTypeMap.Add(value.ListType, value);
				if (value.IsKnownType)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return sourceList as ITypedList;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static Type GetListTypeFromBindingSource(IEnumerable containingList)
		{
			if (containingList is BindingSource { List: not null } bindingSource)
			{
				return bindingSource.List.GetType();
			}
			return containingList.GetType();
		}

					try
					{
						PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[(listAccessors == null) ? 1 : (listAccessors.Length + 1)];
						listAccessors?.CopyTo(array, 0);
						array[array.Length - 1] = item;
						ProviderTreeNodePropertyDescriptorProvider providerTreeNodePropertyDescriptorProvider = new ProviderTreeNodePropertyDescriptorProvider(ancestorList, array, item.Name);
						PropertyDescriptorCollection properties2 = providerTreeNodePropertyDescriptorProvider.GetProperties();

					}

	public class TypePropertyDescriptorProvider : PropertyDescriptorProvider
	{
		private static WeakList<TypePropertyDescriptorProvider> s_ActiveTypeProviders = new WeakList<TypePropertyDescriptorProvider>();

		private static RefreshEventHandler s_RefreshHandler = null;

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection _properties;

		public Type Type => base.Source as Type;

		public override object Key => base.Source;

		public override string Name => Type.Name;

		public override bool RaisesPropertyDescriptorsChangedEvent => true;

		public TypePropertyDescriptorProvider(Type type)
			: base(type)
		{
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties()
		{
			if (_properties != null)
			{
				return _properties;
			}
			Type type = Type;
			if (type == typeof(object) || DataBindingUtilities.IsKnownType(type))
			{
				_properties = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[1]
				{
					new ValuePropertyDescriptor(type, "Value")
				}, readOnly: true);
				return _properties;
			}
			AddToNotifyList(this);
			return _properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(type));
		}

		private static void AddToNotifyList(TypePropertyDescriptorProvider provider)
		{
			try
			{
				Monitor.Enter(typeof(TypePropertyDescriptorProvider));
				if (!s_ActiveTypeProviders.Contains(provider))
				{
					s_ActiveTypeProviders.Add(provider);
					if (s_RefreshHandler == null)
					{
						s_RefreshHandler = OnTypeDescriptorRefreshed;
						TypeDescriptor.Refreshed += s_RefreshHandler;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(TypePropertyDescriptorProvider));
			}
		}

		private void OnPropertiesChanged()
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = _properties;
			_properties = null;
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties2 = GetProperties();
			OnPropertiesChangedHelper(properties, properties2);
		}

		private static void OnTypeDescriptorRefreshed(RefreshEventArgs e)
		{
			List<TypePropertyDescriptorProvider> list = new List<TypePropertyDescriptorProvider>();
			try
			{
				Monitor.Enter(typeof(TypePropertyDescriptorProvider));
				int num = 0;
				foreach (TypePropertyDescriptorProvider s_ActiveTypeProvider in s_ActiveTypeProviders)
				{
					if (s_ActiveTypeProvider != null)
					{
						num++;
						if (s_ActiveTypeProvider.Type == e.TypeChanged)
						{
							list.Add(s_ActiveTypeProvider);
						}
					}
				}
				if (num == 0)
				{
					if (s_RefreshHandler != null)
					{
						TypeDescriptor.Refreshed -= s_RefreshHandler;
						s_RefreshHandler = null;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(TypePropertyDescriptorProvider));
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (TypePropertyDescriptorProvider item in list)
			{
				item.OnPropertiesChanged();
			}
		}
	}
	public class XmlNodePropertyDescriptorProvider : PropertyDescriptorProvider
	{
		private HashSet _propertyDescriptorHash;

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection _properties;

		public XmlNode Node => base.Source as XmlNode;

		public override object Key => Node.Name;

		public override string Name => Node.LocalName;

		public override bool RaisesPropertyDescriptorsChangedEvent => true;

		public XmlNodePropertyDescriptorProvider(XmlNode node)
			: base(node)
		{
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties()
		{
			if (_properties == null)
			{
				_properties = DataBindingUtilities.GetXmlNodeProperties(Node);
			}
			return _properties;
		}

		public override bool IsCompatibleProvider(PropertyDescriptorProvider provider)
		{
			if (!(provider is XmlNodePropertyDescriptorProvider xmlNodePropertyDescriptorProvider))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Node.GetType() != xmlNodePropertyDescriptorProvider.Node.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Node.SchemaInfo != null || xmlNodePropertyDescriptorProvider.Node.SchemaInfo != null)
			{
				return Node.SchemaInfo == xmlNodePropertyDescriptorProvider.Node.SchemaInfo;
			}
			return Node.Name == xmlNodePropertyDescriptorProvider.Node.Name;
		}

		public void MergePropertiesFromNode(XmlNode node)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(node, "node");
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = GetProperties();
			PropertyDescriptorCollection xmlNodeProperties = DataBindingUtilities.GetXmlNodeProperties(node);
			HashSet hashSet = _propertyDescriptorHash;
			if (hashSet == null)
			{
				hashSet = new HashSet(properties.Count, 0.5f, PropertyDescriptorComparer.Instance);
				hashSet.AddItems(properties);
				_propertyDescriptorHash = hashSet;
			}
			HashSet hashSet2 = new HashSet(xmlNodeProperties.Count, 0.5f, PropertyDescriptorComparer.Instance);
			hashSet2.AddItems(xmlNodeProperties);
			if (hashSet2.IsSubsetOf(hashSet))
			{
				return;
			}
			_propertyDescriptorHash = hashSet2;
			HashSet union = HashSet.GetUnion(hashSet, hashSet2);
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[union.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in union)
			{
				array[num] = item;
				num++;
			}
			_properties = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array, readOnly: true);
			OnPropertiesChangedHelper(properties, _properties);
		}
	}
	internal class PropertyDescriptorCollectionComparer : IEqualityComparer<PropertyDescriptorCollection>
	{
		internal static readonly PropertyDescriptorCollectionComparer Instance = new PropertyDescriptorCollectionComparer();

		public bool Equals(PropertyDescriptorCollection x, PropertyDescriptorCollection y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = x.Count;
			if (count != y.Count || count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (x[i] != y[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(PropertyDescriptorCollection obj)
		{
			return obj.Count + 1;
		}
	}
	public class PropertyDescriptorsChangedEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private PropertyDescriptorProvider _provider;

		private PropertyDescriptor[] _propertiesAdded;

		private PropertyDescriptor[] _propertiesChanged;

		private PropertyDescriptor[] _propertiesRemoved;

		public PropertyDescriptorProvider Provider => _provider;

		public PropertyDescriptor[] PropertiesAdded => _propertiesAdded;

		public PropertyDescriptor[] PropertiesChanged => _propertiesChanged;

		public PropertyDescriptor[] PropertiesRemoved => _propertiesRemoved;

		internal PropertyDescriptorsChangedEventArgs(PropertyDescriptorProvider provider, PropertyDescriptor[] propertiesAdded, PropertyDescriptor[] propertiesChanged, PropertyDescriptor[] propertiesRemoved)
		{
			_provider = provider;
			_propertiesAdded = propertiesAdded;
			_propertiesChanged = propertiesChanged;
			_propertiesRemoved = propertiesRemoved;
		}
	}

	public class NullableConverter<T> : NullableConverter where T : struct
	{

		}

	internal class TempValueReplacement : IDisposable
	{
		private object _originalValue;

		private DependencyProperty _property;

		private DependencyObject _object;

		private BindingExpressionBase _originalExpression;

		internal TempValueReplacement(DependencyObject d, DependencyProperty property)
			: this(d, property, d?.GetValue(property))
		{
		}

		internal TempValueReplacement(DependencyObject d, DependencyProperty property, object newValue)
		{
			_object = d;
			_property = property;
			if (d != null)
			{
				_originalValue = d.ReadLocalValue(property);
				_originalExpression = BindingOperations.GetBindingExpressionBase(d, property);
				d.SetValue(property, newValue);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (_object != null)
			{
				RestoreValue(_object, _property, _originalValue, _originalExpression);
			}
		}

		private static void RestoreValue(DependencyObject d, DependencyProperty property, object value, BindingExpressionBase originalExpression)
		{
			if (originalExpression != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(d, property, originalExpression.ParentBindingBase);
			}
			else if (value == null || property.PropertyType.IsAssignableFrom(value.GetType()))
			{
				d.SetValue(property, value);
			}
			else if (value is BindingBase)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(d, property, (BindingBase)value);
			}
			else
			{
				d.ClearValue(property);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class GroupTempValueReplacement : IDisposable
	{
		private List<TempValueReplacement> _replacements;

		internal GroupTempValueReplacement()
		{
			_replacements = new List<TempValueReplacement>();
		}

		internal void Add(TempValueReplacement replacement)
		{
			if (replacement == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("replacement");
			}
			_replacements.Add(replacement);
		}

		internal void Add(FrameworkElement element, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			_replacements.Add(new TempValueReplacement(element, property));
		}

		internal void Add(FrameworkElement element, DependencyProperty property, object newValue)
		{
			_replacements.Add(new TempValueReplacement(element, property, newValue));
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _replacements.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				_replacements[i].Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	internal class PopupTextBoxHelper
	{
		private bool FocusPopupForImeFailed;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.TextBoxBase _textBox;

		private InputMethodState? _currentState;

		private Popup _popup;

		private bool? originalStaysOpen;

		private bool updatingIMEState;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.TextBoxBase TextBox
		{
			get
			{
				return _textBox;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == _textBox)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (_textBox != null)
				{
					_textBox.RemoveHandler(Keyboard.PreviewGotKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnTextBoxPreviewGotKeyboardFocus));
					_textBox.RemoveHandler(Keyboard.LostKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnTextBoxLostKeyboardFocus));
					_textBox.RemoveHandler(Keyboard.KeyUpEvent, new System.Windows.Input.KeyEventHandler(OnTextBoxKeyUp));
					TextCompositionManager.RemovePreviewTextInputUpdateHandler(_textBox, PreiviewTextInputUpdate);
					TextCompositionManager.RemovePreviewTextInputHandler(_textBox, PreiviewTextInput);
					if (_popup != null)
					{
						SetPopupStayOpenState(reset: true);
						_popup = null;
					}
				}
				_textBox = value;
				if (_textBox != null)
				{
					_textBox.AddHandler(Keyboard.PreviewGotKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnTextBoxPreviewGotKeyboardFocus), handledEventsToo: true);
					_textBox.AddHandler(Keyboard.LostKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnTextBoxLostKeyboardFocus), handledEventsToo: true);
					_textBox.AddHandler(Keyboard.KeyUpEvent, new System.Windows.Input.KeyEventHandler(OnTextBoxKeyUp), handledEventsToo: true);
					TextCompositionManager.AddPreviewTextInputUpdateHandler(_textBox, PreiviewTextInputUpdate);
					TextCompositionManager.AddPreviewTextInputHandler(_textBox, PreiviewTextInput);
				}
				UpdateImeState(assumeHasFocus: false);
			}
		}

		internal PopupTextBoxHelper()
		{
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private void FocusPopupForIme()
		{
			if (PresentationSource.FromVisual(_textBox) is HwndSource { IsDisposed: false } hwndSource)
			{
				IntPtr intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.SetActiveWindow(hwndSource.Handle);
				if (Keyboard.DefaultRestoreFocusMode == RestoreFocusMode.None)
				{
					Keyboard.ClearFocus();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnTextBoxKeyUp(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateImeState(assumeHasFocus: false);
			if (_textBox != null && _currentState == InputMethodState.Off)
			{
				_textBox.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, (Action)delegate
				{
					UpdateImeState(assumeHasFocus: false);
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnTextBoxLostKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateImeState(assumeHasFocus: false);
			if (_popup != null)
			{
				SetPopupStayOpenState(reset: true);
			}
		}

		private void OnTextBoxPreviewGotKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateImeState(assumeHasFocus: true);
		}

		private void UpdateImeState(bool assumeHasFocus)
		{
			if (updatingIMEState)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				updatingIMEState = true;
				if (_textBox == null || (!assumeHasFocus && Keyboard.FocusedElement != _textBox) || FocusPopupForImeFailed)
				{
					_currentState = null;
					return;
				}
				InputMethodState? currentState = _currentState;
				_currentState = InputMethod.Current.ImeState;
				InputMethodState? currentState2 = _currentState;
				InputMethodState inputMethodState = InputMethodState.On;
				if (currentState2.GetValueOrDefault() != inputMethodState || !currentState2.HasValue || currentState == _currentState)
				{
					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.TextBoxBase textBox = _textBox;
				Dictionary<IFocusManager, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<IFocusManager, bool>();
				try
				{
					IFocusManager focusManager = null;
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = _textBox;
					do
					{
						focusManager = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(IFocusManager), allowSubclassOfType: true) as IFocusManager;
						dependencyObject = focusManager as DependencyObject;
						if (focusManager != null)
						{
							dictionary.Add(focusManager, focusManager.AllowFocusChange);
							focusManager.AllowFocusChange = true;
						}
					}
					while (focusManager != null && dependencyObject != null);
					FocusPopupForIme();
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = Keyboard.FocusedElement as FrameworkElement;
					if (!assumeHasFocus && textBox == _textBox && ((frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.IsAncestorOf(textBox)) || Keyboard.DefaultRestoreFocusMode == RestoreFocusMode.None))
					{
						textBox.Focus();
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					FocusPopupForImeFailed = true;
				}
				finally
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<IFocusManager, bool> item in dictionary)
					{
						item.Key.AllowFocusChange = item.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				updatingIMEState = false;
			}
		}

		private void PreiviewTextInputUpdate(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			SetPopupStayOpenState(reset: false);
		}

		private void PreiviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			SetPopupStayOpenState(reset: true);
		}

		private void SetPopupStayOpenState(bool reset)
		{
			Popup popup = GetPopup();
			if (popup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (reset)
			{
				if (originalStaysOpen.HasValue)
				{
					popup.StaysOpen = originalStaysOpen.Value;
					originalStaysOpen = null;
				}
			}
			else if (!originalStaysOpen.HasValue)
			{
				originalStaysOpen = popup.StaysOpen;
				popup.StaysOpen = true;
			}
		}

		private Popup GetPopup()
		{
			if (_textBox == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_popup != null)
			{
				return _popup;
			}
			_popup = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(_textBox, typeof(Popup), allowSubclassOfType: true) as Popup;
			return _popup;
		}
	}

		private static bool _wpfClipboardFailed;

		private static bool _winFormClipboardFailed;

		private static readonly bool _isClr4;

		private const int DefaultRetryCount = 10;

		private const int DefaultRetryDelay = 100;

		static ClipboardHelper()
		{
			_isClr4 = Environment.Version.Major >= 4;
		}

		public static void Clear()
		{
			if (!_wpfClipboardFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					System.Windows.Clipboard.Clear();
					return;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_wpfClipboardFailed = true;
				}
			}
			ClearWinFormClipboard();
		}

		public static System.Windows.IDataObject CreateDataObject()
		{
			if (!_wpfClipboardFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					return new System.Windows.DataObject();
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_wpfClipboardFailed = true;
				}
			}
			return CreateWinFormDataObject();
		}

		public static System.Windows.IDataObject GetDataObject()
		{
			if (!GetDataObject(10, 100, out var dataObject))
			{
				return GetWinFormDataObject();
			}
			return dataObject;
		}

		private static bool GetDataObject(int retryTimes, int retryDelay, out System.Windows.IDataObject dataObject)
		{
			dataObject = null;
			if (retryTimes < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("retryTimes");
			}
			if (retryDelay < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("retryDelay");
			}
			if (_isClr4)
			{
				retryTimes = 0;
			}
			if (!_wpfClipboardFailed)
			{
				for (int num = retryTimes; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					try
					{
						dataObject = System.Windows.Clipboard.GetDataObject();
						return true;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						_wpfClipboardFailed = true;
					}
					catch (ExternalException)
					{
						if (num == 0)
						{
							throw;
						}
						Thread.Sleep(retryDelay);
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static string GetText()
		{
			return GetText(System.Windows.TextDataFormat.UnicodeText);
		}

		public static string GetText(System.Windows.TextDataFormat format)
		{
			if (!_wpfClipboardFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					return System.Windows.Clipboard.GetText(format);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_wpfClipboardFailed = true;
				}
			}
			return GetWinFormText(format);
		}

		public static bool SetDataObject(object data)
		{
			return SetDataObject(data, copy: false);
		}

		public static bool SetDataObject(object data, bool copy)
		{
			return SetDataObject(data, copy, 10, 100);
		}

		public static bool SetDataObject(object data, bool copy, int retryTimes, int retryDelay)
		{
			Utilities.ThrowIfNull(data, "data");
			if (retryTimes < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("retryTimes");
			}
			if (retryDelay < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("retryDelay");
			}
			if (!_wpfClipboardFailed)
			{
				int num = retryTimes;
				if (_isClr4)
				{
					num = Math.Max((retryTimes - 1) / 10, 0);
				}
				for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					try
					{
						System.Windows.Clipboard.SetDataObject(data, copy);
						return true;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						_wpfClipboardFailed = true;
					}
					catch (ExternalException)
					{
						if (num2 == 0)
						{
							throw;
						}
						Thread.Sleep(retryDelay);
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return SetWinFormDataObject(data, copy, retryTimes, retryDelay);
		}

		public static bool SetText(string text)
		{
			return SetText(text, System.Windows.TextDataFormat.UnicodeText);
		}

		public static bool SetText(string text, System.Windows.TextDataFormat format)
		{
			VerifyNotNull(text, "text");
			if (!_wpfClipboardFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					System.Windows.Clipboard.SetText(text, format);
					return true;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_wpfClipboardFailed = true;
				}
			}
			return SetWinFormText(text, format);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static void ClearWinFormClipboard()
		{
			if (!_winFormClipboardFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard.Clear();
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_winFormClipboardFailed = true;
				}
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static System.Windows.IDataObject CreateWinFormDataObject()
		{
			System.Windows.IDataObject result = null;
			if (!_winFormClipboardFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					result = new WinToWpfDataObject(new System.Windows.Forms.DataObject());
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_winFormClipboardFailed = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static string GetDataFormat(System.Windows.TextDataFormat format)
		{
			return format switch
			{
				System.Windows.TextDataFormat.UnicodeText => System.Windows.DataFormats.UnicodeText, 
				System.Windows.TextDataFormat.CommaSeparatedValue => System.Windows.DataFormats.CommaSeparatedValue, 
				System.Windows.TextDataFormat.Html => System.Windows.DataFormats.Html, 
				System.Windows.TextDataFormat.Rtf => System.Windows.DataFormats.Rtf, 
				System.Windows.TextDataFormat.Text => System.Windows.DataFormats.Text, 
				System.Windows.TextDataFormat.Xaml => System.Windows.DataFormats.Xaml, 
				_ => System.Windows.DataFormats.UnicodeText, 
			};
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static System.Windows.IDataObject GetWinFormDataObject()
		{
			System.Windows.IDataObject result = null;
			if (!_winFormClipboardFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					System.Windows.Forms.IDataObject dataObject = System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard.GetDataObject();
					if (dataObject != null)
					{
						result = new WinToWpfDataObject(dataObject);
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_winFormClipboardFailed = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static object GetWinFormData(string format)
		{
			object result = null;
			if (!_winFormClipboardFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					System.Windows.Forms.IDataObject dataObject = System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard.GetDataObject();
					if (dataObject != null)
					{
						bool autoConvert = ShouldAutoConvert(format);
						result = dataObject.GetData(format, autoConvert);
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_winFormClipboardFailed = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static string GetWinFormText(System.Windows.TextDataFormat format)
		{
			string dataFormat = GetDataFormat(format);
			return ((string)GetWinFormData(dataFormat)) ?? string.Empty;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static bool SetWinFormText(string text, System.Windows.TextDataFormat format)
		{
			string dataFormat = GetDataFormat(format);
			return SetWinFormData(dataFormat, text);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static bool SetWinFormData(string format, object data)
		{
			if (!_winFormClipboardFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					System.Windows.Forms.DataObject dataObject = new System.Windows.Forms.DataObject();
					bool autoConvert = ShouldAutoConvert(format);
					dataObject.SetData(format, autoConvert, data);
					System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard.SetDataObject(dataObject, copy: true);
					return true;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_winFormClipboardFailed = true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static bool SetWinFormDataObject(object data, bool copy, int retryTimes, int retryDelay)
		{
			if (!_winFormClipboardFailed)
			{
				try
				{
					if (data is System.Windows.IDataObject wpfDataObject)
					{
						data = new WpfToWinDataObject(wpfDataObject);
					}
					System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard.SetDataObject(data, copy, retryTimes, retryDelay);
					return true;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_winFormClipboardFailed = true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ShouldAutoConvert(string format)
		{
			if (!(format == System.Windows.DataFormats.FileDrop))
			{
				return format == System.Windows.DataFormats.Bitmap;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void VerifyNotNull(object value, string name)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(name);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ActionHistory
	{
		public abstract class ActionBase
		{
			protected internal abstract bool CanPerform(object context);

			protected internal abstract ActionBase Perform(object context);
		}

		internal class NoOpAction : ActionBase
		{
			internal static readonly ActionBase Instance = new NoOpAction();

			private NoOpAction()
			{
			}

			protected internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
			{
				return false;
			}

			protected internal override ActionBase Perform(object context)
			{
				return this;
			}
		}

		private class ActionsCollection : IEnumerable<ActionBase>, IEnumerable
		{
			private class Enumerator : IEnumerator<ActionBase>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
			{
				private ActionsCollection _actions;

				private int _version;

				private int _index;

				private ActionBase _current;

				public ActionBase Current
				{
					get
					{
						if (_index == -2)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_3"));
						}
						if (_index == -1)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_4"));
						}
						return _current;
					}
				}

				object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

				internal Enumerator(ActionsCollection actions)
				{
					_actions = actions;
					Reset();
				}

				public bool MoveNext()
				{
					if (_version != _actions._version)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					if (_index == -1)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (_index == -2)
					{
						_index = _actions.Count;
					}
					_index--;
					if (_index >= 0)
					{
						_current = _actions.stack[_index];
						return true;
					}
					_current = null;
					return false;
				}

				public void Reset()
				{
					_version = _actions._version;
					_index = -2;
					_current = null;
				}

				void IDisposable.Dispose()
				{
				}
			}

			private int _maxItems;

			private List<ActionBase> stack;

			private int _version;

			internal int Count => stack.Count;

			internal ActionsCollection(int maxItems)
			{
				SetMaxItems(maxItems);
				stack = new List<ActionBase>();
			}

			internal void Clear()
			{
				stack.Clear();
				_version++;
			}

			public IEnumerator<ActionBase> GetEnumerator()
			{
				return new Enumerator(this);
			}

			internal ActionBase Peek()
			{
				return stack[Count - 1];
			}

			internal ActionBase Pop()
			{
				ActionBase result = Peek();
				stack.RemoveAt(Count - 1);
				_version++;
				return result;
			}

			internal void Push(ActionBase action)
			{
				stack.Add(action);
				if (Count > _maxItems)
				{
					stack.RemoveAt(0);
				}
				_version++;
			}

			internal void SetMaxItems(int maxItems)
			{
				if (maxItems < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				_maxItems = ((maxItems > 0) ? maxItems : int.MaxValue);
				if (stack != null && stack.Count > _maxItems)
				{
					stack.RemoveRange(0, stack.Count - _maxItems);
					_version++;
				}
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private ActionsCollection undoActions;

		private ActionsCollection redoActions;

		private bool isPerformingAction;

		public static readonly ActionBase NoUndoAction = NoOpAction.Instance;

		public bool IsPerformingAction => isPerformingAction;

		private bool HasRedoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (redoActions != null)
				{
					return redoActions.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool HasUndoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (undoActions != null)
				{
					return undoActions.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private ActionBase RedoActionOnQueue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasRedoActions)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return RedoActions.Peek();
			}
		}

		private ActionsCollection RedoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (redoActions == null)
				{
					redoActions = new ActionsCollection(MaxUndoDepth);
				}
				return redoActions;
			}
		}

		private ActionsCollection UndoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (undoActions == null)
				{
					undoActions = new ActionsCollection(MaxUndoDepth);
				}
				return undoActions;
			}
		}

		private ActionBase UndoActionOnQueue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasUndoActions)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return UndoActions.Peek();
			}
		}

		protected virtual object UndoContext => null;

		protected virtual object RedoContext => null;

		protected virtual int MaxUndoDepth => 100;

		public bool CanRedo()
		{
			return CanPerform(redoActions, RedoContext);
		}

		public bool CanUndo()
		{
			return CanPerform(undoActions, UndoContext);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			ClearUndo();
			ClearRedo();
		}

		public void ClearRedo()
		{
			if (HasRedoActions)
			{
				RedoActions.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal void ClearUndo()
		{
			if (HasUndoActions)
			{
				UndoActions.Clear();
			}
		}

		public bool PerformAction(ActionBase action, object actionContext)
		{
			return PerformActionHelper(actionContext, action, UndoActions);
		}

		public bool Redo()
		{
			if (HasRedoActions)
			{
				return UndoRedoHelper(RedoContext, RedoActions, UndoActions);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Undo()
		{
			if (HasUndoActions)
			{
				return UndoRedoHelper(UndoContext, UndoActions, RedoActions);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void AddUndoAction(ActionBase action)
		{
			if (!(action is NoOpAction))
			{
				UndoActions.Push(action);
			}
		}

		protected void AddRedoAction(ActionBase action)
		{
			if (!(action is NoOpAction))
			{
				RedoActions.Push(action);
			}
		}

		protected IEnumerator<ActionBase> GetRedoEnumerator()
		{
			return RedoActions.GetEnumerator();
		}

		protected IEnumerator<ActionBase> GetUndoEnumerator()
		{
			return UndoActions.GetEnumerator();
		}

		protected void OnMaxUndoDepthChanged()
		{
			if (undoActions != null)
			{
				undoActions.SetMaxItems(MaxUndoDepth);
			}
			if (redoActions != null)
			{
				redoActions.SetMaxItems(MaxUndoDepth);
			}
		}

		protected ActionBase PeekRedo()
		{
			return RedoActionOnQueue;
		}

		protected ActionBase PeekUndo()
		{
			return UndoActionOnQueue;
		}

		private bool CanPerform(ActionsCollection stack, object context)
		{
			if (stack == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (ActionBase item in stack)
			{
				if (item.CanPerform(context))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG_HISTORY")]
		private static void Output(string message, string category)
		{
		}

		private bool PerformActionHelper(object actionContext, ActionBase action, ActionsCollection undoList)
		{
			bool flag = isPerformingAction;
			isPerformingAction = true;
			try
			{
				ActionBase actionBase = action.Perform(actionContext);
				bool flag2 = actionBase != null;
				if (flag2)
				{
					if (actionBase is NoOpAction)
					{
						Clear();
					}
					else
					{
						if (!object.Equals(actionContext, UndoContext) && !object.Equals(actionContext, RedoContext) && undoList == undoActions)
						{
							ClearRedo();
						}
						undoList.Push(actionBase);
					}
				}
				return flag2;
			}
			finally
			{
				isPerformingAction = flag;
			}
		}

		private bool UndoRedoHelper(object actionContext, ActionsCollection xxStack, ActionsCollection yyStack)
		{
			ActionBase actionBase = xxStack.Pop();
			while (!actionBase.CanPerform(actionContext) && xxStack.Count > 0)
			{
				actionBase = xxStack.Pop();
			}
			return PerformActionHelper(actionContext, actionBase, yyStack);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ClassComparer<T> : IComparer<T> where T : class
	{
		protected abstract int CompareOverride(T x, T y);

		public int Compare(T x, T y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (x == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (y == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return CompareOverride(x, y);
		}
	}
	public class EnumerableObjectWrapper : PropertyChangeNotifier
	{
		private string _name;

		private IEnumerable _items;

		public IEnumerable Items => _items;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _name)
				{
					_name = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Name");
				}
			}
		}

		public EnumerableObjectWrapper(IEnumerable items)
			: this(items, null)
		{
		}

		public EnumerableObjectWrapper(IEnumerable items, string name)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("items");
			}
			if (items is string)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_22"));
			}
			_items = items;
			if (name != null)
			{
				_name = name;
			}
			else if (_items is ITypedList typedList)
			{
				_name = typedList.GetListName(null);
			}
			else
			{
				_name = items.ToString();
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is EnumerableObjectWrapper enumerableObjectWrapper)
			{
				return enumerableObjectWrapper._items == _items;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _items.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class FocusWithinManager : DependencyObject
	{
		private class DictionaryValueComparer<TKey, TValue> : IComparer<TKey>
		{
			private IDictionary<TKey, TValue> _table;

			private bool _reverseOrder;

			public DictionaryValueComparer(IDictionary<TKey, TValue> table, bool reverseOrder)
			{
				_table = table;
				_reverseOrder = reverseOrder;
			}

			public int Compare(TKey xxObj, TKey yyObj)
			{
				TValue val = _table[xxObj];
				TValue val2 = _table[yyObj];
				int num = ((IComparable)(object)val).CompareTo(val2);
				if (_reverseOrder)
				{
					num *= -1;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static long time_stamp;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static WeakDictionary<DependencyObject, long> _focusedElems;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static WeakDictionary<DependencyObject, object> _hookedInElems;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsFocusWithinPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsFocusWithinProperty;

		private static WeakDictionary<DependencyObject, long> FocusedElems
		{
			get
			{
				if (_focusedElems == null)
				{
					_focusedElems = new WeakDictionary<DependencyObject, long>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: false);
				}
				return _focusedElems;
			}
		}

		private static WeakDictionary<DependencyObject, object> HookedInElems
		{
			get
			{
				if (_hookedInElems == null)
				{
					_hookedInElems = new WeakDictionary<DependencyObject, object>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: false);
				}
				return _hookedInElems;
			}
		}

		static FocusWithinManager()
		{
			IsFocusWithinPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsFocusWithin", typeof(bool), typeof(FocusWithinManager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsFocusWithinProperty = IsFocusWithinPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		private FocusWithinManager()
		{
		}

		public static bool CheckFocusWithinHelper(DependencyObject elem)
		{
			if (elem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			GetFocusedElem(elem, out var focusedElem, out var _);
			if (focusedElem != null)
			{
				return IsAncestorOf(elem, focusedElem);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsAncestorOf(DependencyObject ancestor, DependencyObject elem)
		{
			return IsAncestorOfHelper(ancestor, elem);
		}

		public static void RegisterType(Type classType)
		{
			RegisterType(classType, null);
		}

		public static void RegisterType(Type classType, PropertyChangedCallback callback)
		{
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(classType, UIElement.GotFocusEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnGotFocusClassHandler), handledEventsToo: true);
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(classType, UIElement.LostFocusEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnLostFocusClassHandler), handledEventsToo: true);
			if (callback != null)
			{
				IsFocusWithinPropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(classType, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(callback));
			}
		}

		private static void GetFocusedElem(DependencyObject elem, out DependencyObject focusedElem, out DependencyObject focusScope)
		{
			focusScope = ((elem != null) ? FocusManager.GetFocusScope(elem) : null);
			focusedElem = ((focusScope != null) ? (focusScope.GetValue(FocusManager.FocusedElementProperty) as DependencyObject) : null);
		}

		private static void HookOrUnhookLostFocus(DependencyObject obj, bool hook)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (hook)
			{
				if (!HookedInElems.ContainsKey(obj))
				{
					bool flag = true;
					if (obj is UIElement)
					{
						((UIElement)obj).LostFocus += OnLostFocusHandler;
					}
					else if (obj is ContentElement)
					{
						((ContentElement)obj).LostFocus += OnLostFocusHandler;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						HookedInElems.Add(obj, null);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (obj is UIElement)
				{
					((UIElement)obj).LostFocus -= OnLostFocusHandler;
				}
				else if (obj is ContentElement)
				{
					((ContentElement)obj).LostFocus -= OnLostFocusHandler;
				}
				HookedInElems.Remove(obj);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsAncestorOfHelper(DependencyObject ancestor, DependencyObject elem)
		{
			if (ancestor == elem)
			{
				return true;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = null;
			if (elem is Visual || elem is Visual3D)
			{
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(elem);
			}
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(elem);
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				return IsAncestorOfHelper(ancestor, dependencyObject);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void OnGotFocusClassHandler(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnGotLostFocusHelper(gotFocus: true, sender, e);
		}

		private static void OnGotLostFocusHelper(bool gotFocus, object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is DependencyObject elem)
			{
				VerifyFocusWithin(elem, gotFocus);
			}
		}

		private static void OnLostFocusClassHandler(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnGotLostFocusHelper(gotFocus: false, sender, e);
		}

		private static void OnLostFocusHandler(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is DependencyObject dependencyObject)
			{
				HookOrUnhookLostFocus(dependencyObject, hook: false);
				GetFocusedElem(dependencyObject, out var focusedElem, out var focusScope);
				VerifyFocusWithin(focusedElem, focusScope);
			}
		}

		private static void SetFocusWithin(DependencyObject elem, bool value, DependencyObject focusedElem)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				elem.SetValue(IsFocusWithinPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				HookOrUnhookLostFocus(focusedElem, hook: true);
				if (!FocusedElems.ContainsKey(elem))
				{
					FocusedElems[elem] = time_stamp++;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				elem.ClearValue(IsFocusWithinPropertyKey);
				FocusedElems.Remove(elem);
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyFocusWithin(DependencyObject elem, bool fromGotFocusHandler)
		{
			if (elem != null)
			{
				GetFocusedElem(elem, out var focusedElem, out var focusScope);
				if (fromGotFocusHandler)
				{
					VerifyFocusWithin(focusedElem, focusScope);
				}
				bool flag = fromGotFocusHandler;
				if (!flag && focusedElem != null && IsAncestorOf(elem, focusedElem))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				SetFocusWithin(elem, flag, focusedElem);
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyFocusWithin(DependencyObject focusedElem, DependencyObject focusScope)
		{
			List<DependencyObject> list = new List<DependencyObject>();
			foreach (DependencyObject key in FocusedElems.Keys)
			{
				DependencyObject focusScope2 = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(key);
				if (focusScope == focusScope2 && (focusedElem == null || !IsAncestorOf(key, focusedElem)))
				{
					list.Add(key);
				}
			}
			list.Sort(new DictionaryValueComparer<DependencyObject, long>(FocusedElems, reverseOrder: true));
			foreach (DependencyObject item in list)
			{
				FocusedElems.Remove(item);
			}
			foreach (DependencyObject item2 in list)
			{
				SetFocusWithin(item2, value: false, focusedElem);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class FrameworkContentElementNotifier : FrameworkContentElement, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			RaisePropertyChangedEvent(e.Property.Name);
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChangedEvent(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			List<DependencyProperty> list = new List<DependencyProperty>();
			LocalValueEnumerator localValueEnumerator = GetLocalValueEnumerator();
			while (localValueEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				DependencyProperty property = localValueEnumerator.Current.Property;
				if (!property.ReadOnly)
				{
					list.Add(property);
				}
			}
			foreach (DependencyProperty item in list)
			{
				ClearValue(item);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			LocalValueEnumerator localValueEnumerator = GetLocalValueEnumerator();
			while (localValueEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				LocalValueEntry current = localValueEnumerator.Current;
				if (!object.Equals(current.Property.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue, current.Value))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class HashSet : ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private Hashtable _table;

		public int Count => _table.Count;

		public bool IsEmpty => Count == 0;

		public bool IsSynchronized => _table.IsSynchronized;

		public object SyncRoot => _table.SyncRoot;

		public HashSet()
		{
			_table = new Hashtable();
		}

		public HashSet(int initialCapacity)
		{
			_table = new Hashtable(initialCapacity);
		}

		public HashSet(int initialCapacity, float loadFactor)
		{
			_table = new Hashtable(initialCapacity, loadFactor);
		}

		public HashSet(int initialCapacity, float loadFactor, IEqualityComparer equalityComparer)
		{
			_table = new Hashtable(initialCapacity, loadFactor, equalityComparer);
		}

		public void Add(object item)
		{
			_table[item] = item;
		}

		public void AddItems(IEnumerable items)
		{
			foreach (object item in items)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void AddItems(HashSet source)
		{
			foreach (object item in source)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public static bool AreEqual(HashSet x, HashSet y)
		{
			if (x.Count != y.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return x.IsSubsetOf(y);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_table.Clear();
		}

		internal bool Contains(object item)
		{
			return Exists(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_table.Keys.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool DoesIntersect(HashSet s)
		{
			if (Count > s.Count)
			{
				return s.DoesIntersect(this);
			}
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					object current = enumerator.Current;
					if (s.Exists(current))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Exists(object item)
		{
			return _table.ContainsKey(item);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _table.Keys.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public object GetEquivalentItem(object item)
		{
			return _table[item];
		}

		public static HashSet GetIntersection(HashSet set1, HashSet set2)
		{
			HashSet hashSet = new HashSet();
			if (set1.Count > set2.Count)
			{
				return GetIntersection(set2, set1);
			}
			foreach (object item in set1)
			{
				if (set2.Exists(item))
				{
					hashSet.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return hashSet;
		}

		public static HashSet GetUnion(HashSet set1, HashSet set2)
		{
			HashSet hashSet = new HashSet();
			hashSet.AddItems(set1);
			hashSet.AddItems(set2);
			return hashSet;
		}

		public bool IsSubsetOf(HashSet s)
		{
			if (Count > s.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					object current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!s.Exists(current))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Remove(object item)
		{
			_table.Remove(item);
		}

		public T[] ToArray<T>()
		{
			T[] array = new T[Count];
			int num = 0;
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					T val = (T)enumerator.Current;
					array[num++] = val;
				}
				return array;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	{
		void OnMinMaxChanged(MinMaxWatcher watcher);
	}
	internal class MinMaxWatcher : DependencyObject
	{
		private IMinMaxWatcherOwner _owner;

		private FrameworkElement _element;

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty MinWidthProperty = FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MinMaxWatcher));

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty MaxWidthProperty = FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MinMaxWatcher));

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty MinHeightProperty = FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MinMaxWatcher));

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty MaxHeightProperty = FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MinMaxWatcher));

		public FrameworkElement Element => _element;

		internal double MinWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MinWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MinWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal double MaxWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MaxWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaxWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal double MinHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MinHeightProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MinHeightProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal double MaxHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MaxHeightProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaxHeightProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal MinMaxWatcher(IMinMaxWatcherOwner owner, FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (owner == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("owner");
			}
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("element");
			}
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, MinWidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(MinWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, element));
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, MaxWidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(MaxWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, element));
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, MinHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(MinHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, element));
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, MaxHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(MaxHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, element));
			_owner = owner;
			_element = element;
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_owner != null)
			{
				_owner.OnMinMaxChanged(this);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class NameScopeProxy : INameScope
	{
		protected abstract DependencyObject StartingElement { get; }

		private INameScope GetNameScope()
		{
			for (DependencyObject dependencyObject = StartingElement; dependencyObject != null; dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject) ?? VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject))
			{
				INameScope nameScope = NameScope.GetNameScope(dependencyObject);
				if (nameScope != null)
				{
					return nameScope;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		object INameScope.FindName(string name)
		{
			return GetNameScope()?.FindName(name);
		}

		void INameScope.RegisterName(string name, object scopedElement)
		{
			GetNameScope()?.RegisterName(name, scopedElement);
		}

		void INameScope.UnregisterName(string name)
		{
			GetNameScope()?.UnregisterName(name);
		}
	}

		internal struct POINT : IEquatable<POINT>
		{
			internal int X;

			internal int Y;

			internal System.Windows.Point Point => new System.Windows.Point(X, Y);

			internal POINT(int x, int y)
			{
				X = x;
				Y = y;
			}

			public bool Equals(POINT other)
			{
				if (X == other.X)
				{
					return Y == other.Y;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal struct RECT
		{
			internal int left;

			internal int top;

			internal int right;

			internal int bottom;

			internal System.Drawing.Rectangle Rect => System.Drawing.Rectangle.FromLTRB(left, top, right, bottom);

			public int Height => bottom - top;

			public int Width => right - left;

			internal RECT(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
			{
				this.left = left;
				this.top = top;
				this.right = right;
				this.bottom = bottom;
			}

			internal static RECT Intersect(RECT rect1, RECT rect2)
			{
				System.Drawing.Rectangle rectangle = System.Drawing.Rectangle.Intersect(rect1.Rect, rect2.Rect);
				return new RECT(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom);
			}

			public static RECT FromLTRB(POINT leftTop, POINT rightBottom)
			{
				return new RECT(leftTop.X, leftTop.Y, rightBottom.X, rightBottom.Y);
			}

			public Rect ToRect()
			{
				return new Rect(left, top, Math.Abs(right - left), Math.Abs(bottom - top));
			}
		}

		private class ScreenHelper
		{
			private object _screenObject;

			private Rect _bounds;

			private Rect _workingArea;

			internal Rect Bounds => _bounds;

			internal Rect WorkingArea => _workingArea;

			private ScreenHelper(object screenObject)
			{
				_screenObject = screenObject;
				if (screenObject == null)
				{
					_bounds = new Rect(Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(SystemParameters.VirtualScreenLeft), Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(SystemParameters.VirtualScreenTop), Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(SystemParameters.VirtualScreenWidth), Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(SystemParameters.VirtualScreenHeight));
					_workingArea = _bounds;
					return;
				}
				if (!(screenObject is IntPtr))
				{
					_bounds = GetBoundsFallback(out _workingArea);
					return;
				}
				MONITIORINFOEX mONITIORINFOEX = new MONITIORINFOEX();
				GetMonitorInfo(new HandleRef(null, (IntPtr)screenObject), mONITIORINFOEX);
				double virtualScreenWidth = VirtualScreenWidth;
				int systemMetrics = GetSystemMetrics(78);
				double num = 1.0;
				RECT rcMonitor = mONITIORINFOEX._rcMonitor;
				_bounds = new Rect((double)rcMonitor.left * num, (double)rcMonitor.top * num, (double)rcMonitor.Width * num, (double)rcMonitor.Height * num);
				RECT rcWork = mONITIORINFOEX._rcWork;
				_workingArea = new Rect((double)rcWork.left * num, (double)rcWork.top * num, (double)rcWork.Width * num, (double)rcWork.Height * num);
			}

			internal static ScreenHelper FromPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
				if (hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown)
				{
					return FromPointFallback(point);
				}
				try
				{
					if (GetSystemMetrics(80) == 0)
					{
						return new ScreenHelper(null);
					}
					POINT pt = new POINT((int)point.X, (int)point.Y);
					return new ScreenHelper(MonitorFromPoint(pt, 2));
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown = true;
					return FromPointFallback(point);
				}
			}

			internal static ScreenHelper FromRect(Rect rect)
			{
				rect = Utilities.RectFromPoints(rect.TopLeft, rect.BottomRight);
				if (!hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown)
				{
					try
					{
						if (GetSystemMetrics(80) == 0)
						{
							return new ScreenHelper(null);
						}
						RECT rect2 = new RECT((int)rect.Left, (int)rect.Top, (int)rect.Right, (int)rect.Bottom);
						return new ScreenHelper(MonitorFromRect(ref rect2, 2));
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown = true;
					}
				}
				return FromRectFallback(rect);
			}

			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			private static ScreenHelper FromPointFallback(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
				return new ScreenHelper(Screen.FromPoint(new System.Drawing.Point((int)point.X, (int)point.Y)));
			}

			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			private static ScreenHelper FromRectFallback(Rect rect)
			{
				System.Drawing.Rectangle rect2 = System.Drawing.Rectangle.FromLTRB((int)rect.Left, (int)rect.Top, (int)rect.Right, (int)rect.Bottom);
				return new ScreenHelper(Screen.FromRectangle(rect2));
			}

			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			private Rect GetBoundsFallback(out Rect workingRect)
			{
				Screen screen = _screenObject as Screen;
				System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds = screen.Bounds;
				System.Drawing.Rectangle workingArea = screen.WorkingArea;
				workingRect = new Rect(workingArea.Left, workingArea.Top, workingArea.Width, workingArea.Height);
				return new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			}
		}

		internal static int CaretBlinkTime
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_unsafeCaretBlinkTimeDoesntWork)
				{
					try
					{
						return UnsafeCaretBlinkTime();
					}
					catch
					{
						_unsafeCaretBlinkTimeDoesntWork = true;
					}
				}
				if (!_systemInformationCaretBlinkTimeDoesntWork)
				{
					try
					{
						return GetSystemInformationCaretBlinkTime();
					}
					catch
					{
						_systemInformationCaretBlinkTimeDoesntWork = true;
					}
				}
				return 500;
			}
		}

		internal static int DoubleClickTime

				return 500;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsClassicTheme
		{
			get
			{
				if (!AreThemesSupported)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !IsThemeActiveInternal();
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsNonClientAreaThemed
		{
			get
			{
				if (AreThemesSupported && IsThemeActiveInternal())
				{
					try
					{
						return UnsafeIsNonClientAreaThemed();
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsWindows8orAbove
		{
			get
			{
				Version version = Environment.OSVersion.Version;
				if (version.Major > 6)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (version.Major < 6)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return version.Minor >= 2;
			}
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Size PrimaryMonitorSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_securityException)
				{
					try
					{
						return PrimaryMonitorSizeUnsafe;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						_securityException = true;
					}
				}
				return PrimaryMonitorSizeFallback;
			}
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size PrimaryMonitorSizeUnsafe
		{
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			get
			{
				return new System.Windows.Size(GetSystemMetrics(0), GetSystemMetrics(1));
			}
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size PrimaryMonitorSizeFallback
		{
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			get
			{
				System.Drawing.Size primaryMonitorSize = SystemInformation.PrimaryMonitorSize;
				return new System.Windows.Size(primaryMonitorSize.Width, primaryMonitorSize.Height);
			}
		}

		internal static PROCESS_DPI_AWARENESS ProcessDpiAwareness
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_processDpiAwareness.HasValue)
				{
					try
					{
						_processDpiAwareness = GetProcessDpiAwareness();
					}
					catch
					{
						_processDpiAwareness = PROCESS_DPI_AWARENESS.PROCESS_DPI_UNAWARE;
					}
				}
				return _processDpiAwareness.Value;
			}
		}

		internal static Rect VirtualScreenArea
		{
			get
			{
				if (hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown)
				{
					return VirtualScreenAreaFallback;
				}
				try
				{
					return new Rect(SystemParameters.VirtualScreenLeft, SystemParameters.VirtualScreenTop, SystemParameters.VirtualScreenWidth, SystemParameters.VirtualScreenHeight);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown = true;
					return VirtualScreenAreaFallback;
				}
			}
		}

		private static Rect VirtualScreenAreaFallback
		{
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			get
			{
				System.Drawing.Rectangle virtualScreen = SystemInformation.VirtualScreen;
				return new Rect
				{
					X = ConvertToLogicalPixels(virtualScreen.X),
					Y = ConvertToLogicalPixels(virtualScreen.Y),
					Width = ConvertToLogicalPixels(virtualScreen.Width),
					Height = ConvertToLogicalPixels(virtualScreen.Height)
				};
			}
		}

		internal static double VirtualScreenLeft

		{

			AreThemesSupported = false;

			HWND_BOTTOM = new IntPtr(1);
			HWND_TOPMOST = new IntPtr(-1);
			HWND_NOTOPMOST = new IntPtr(-2);
			AreThemesSupported = CanOSSupportThemes();
		}

		internal static IntPtr AddBits(IntPtr ptr, int bitsToAdd)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt32() | bitsToAdd);
			}
			return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt64() | (uint)bitsToAdd);
		}

		internal static void AdjustMaximizedRect(ref RECT rect)
		{
			RECT monitorRect = GetMonitorRect(rect);
			if (RECT.Intersect(monitorRect, rect).Height == monitorRect.Height)
			{
				rect.bottom = monitorRect.bottom - 1;
			}
		}

		internal static bool AreBitsPresent(IntPtr ptr, int bits)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				return (ptr.ToInt32() & bits) != 0;
			}
			return (ptr.ToInt64() & bits) != 0;
		}

		private static bool CanOSSupportThemes()
		{
			OperatingSystem oSVersion = Environment.OSVersion;
			if (oSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT)
			{
				if (oSVersion.Version.Major <= 5)
				{
					if (oSVersion.Version.Major == 5)
					{
						return oSVersion.Version.Minor >= 1;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Point GetCursorPosApi()

			if (!_securityException)

				try
				{
					return GetCursorPosUnsafe();

					_securityException = true;

		internal static HitTestResults GetHitTestResult(ToolWindowPart part)
		{
			switch (part)
			{
			case ToolWindowPart.BorderBottom:
				return HitTestResults.HTBOTTOM;
			case ToolWindowPart.BorderBottomLeft:
				return HitTestResults.HTBOTTOMLEFT;
			case ToolWindowPart.BorderBottomRight:
				return HitTestResults.HTBOTTOMRIGHT;
			case ToolWindowPart.BorderLeft:
				return HitTestResults.HTLEFT;
			case ToolWindowPart.BorderRight:
				return HitTestResults.HTRIGHT;
			case ToolWindowPart.BorderTop:
				return HitTestResults.HTTOP;
			case ToolWindowPart.BorderTopLeft:
				return HitTestResults.HTTOPLEFT;
			case ToolWindowPart.BorderTopRight:
				return HitTestResults.HTTOPRIGHT;
			case ToolWindowPart.Caption:
			case ToolWindowPart.Content:
				return HitTestResults.HTCLIENT;
			case ToolWindowPart.ResizeGrip:
				return HitTestResults.HTBOTTOMRIGHT;
			default:
				return HitTestResults.HTCLIENT;
			}
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Size GetHwndBorderSize(Window window)
		{
			if (!hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown)
			{
				try
				{
					if (GetHwndBorderSizeUnsafe(window, out var borderSize))
					{
						return borderSize;
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown = true;
				}
			}
			return window.ResizeMode switch
			{
				ResizeMode.NoResize => new System.Windows.Size(SystemParameters.FixedFrameVerticalBorderWidth, SystemParameters.FixedFrameHorizontalBorderHeight), 
				_ => new System.Windows.Size(SystemParameters.ResizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth, SystemParameters.ResizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight), 
			};
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static bool GetHwndBorderSizeUnsafe(Window window, out System.Windows.Size borderSize)
		{
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(window);
			if (windowInteropHelper.Handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				borderSize = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
				return false;
			}
			int dwStyle = IntPtrToInt32(GetWindowLong(windowInteropHelper.Handle, -16));
			int dwExStyle = IntPtrToInt32(GetWindowLong(windowInteropHelper.Handle, -20));
			RECT lpRect = default(RECT);
			AdjustWindowRectExApi(ref lpRect, dwStyle, bMenu: false, dwExStyle);
			double width = Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(lpRect.right, window);
			double height = Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(lpRect.bottom, window);
			borderSize = new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
			return true;
		}

		private static RECT GetMonitorRect(RECT rect)
		{
			if (GetSystemMetrics(80) == 0)
			{
				return new RECT(0, 0, GetSystemMetrics(0), GetSystemMetrics(1));
			}
			IntPtr handle = MonitorFromRect(ref rect, 2);
			MONITIORINFOEX mONITIORINFOEX = new MONITIORINFOEX();
			GetMonitorInfo(new HandleRef(null, handle), mONITIORINFOEX);
			return mONITIORINFOEX._rcMonitor;
		}

		internal static SIZE GetNonClientSize(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			int dwStyle = IntPtrToInt32(GetWindowLong(hwnd, -16));
			int dwExStyle = IntPtrToInt32(GetWindowLong(hwnd, -20));
			RECT lpRect = default(RECT);
			AdjustWindowRectExApi(ref lpRect, dwStyle, bMenu: false, dwExStyle);
			return new SIZE(lpRect.right - lpRect.left, lpRect.bottom - lpRect.top);
		}

		internal static string GetRegisteredMessageName(int message)
		{
			if (message >= 49152 && message <= 65535)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(256);
				int clipboardFormatName = GetClipboardFormatName(message, stringBuilder, stringBuilder.Capacity);
				if (clipboardFormatName > 0)
				{
					return stringBuilder.ToString(0, clipboardFormatName);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static int GetScreenHeight(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, 0u);
			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				intPtr = MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, 2u);
			}
			if (IntPtr.Zero != intPtr)
			{
				MONITORINFO lpmi = new MONITORINFO
				{
					cbSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(MONITORINFO))
				};
				if (GetMonitorInfo(intPtr, out lpmi))
				{
					return lpmi.rcMonitor.bottom - lpmi.rcMonitor.top;
				}
			}
			return Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(SystemParameters.PrimaryScreenHeight);
		}

		internal static double GetWindowDpi(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			if (!_skipGetDpiForWindow)
			{
				try
				{
					return (double)GetDpiForWindow(hwnd) / 96.0;
				}
				catch
				{
					_skipGetDpiForWindow = true;
				}
			}
			IntPtr hmonitor = MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, 2u);
			GetDpiForMonitor(hmonitor, 0u, out var dpiX, out var _);
			return (double)dpiX / 96.0;
		}

		internal static double GetWindowDpi(Window window)

			if (!(handle == IntPtr.Zero))

				return GetWindowDpi(handle);
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		internal static WindowState GetWindowState(Window window)
		{
			if (window == null)
			{
				return WindowState.Normal;
			}
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(window);
			if (windowInteropHelper.Handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return window.WindowState;
			}
			return GetWindowState(windowInteropHelper.Handle);
		}

		internal static WindowState GetWindowState(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			WindowState result = WindowState.Normal;
			if (IntPtr.Zero != hwnd)
			{
				WINDOWPLACEMENT windowPlacement = GetWindowPlacement(hwnd);
				result = ((windowPlacement.showCmd == 2) ? WindowState.Minimized : ((windowPlacement.showCmd == 3) ? WindowState.Maximized : WindowState.Normal));
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static bool IsTopMostApi(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (hwnd != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				IntPtr ancestorApi = GetAncestorApi(hwnd, 2);
				if (ancestorApi != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					IntPtr windowLong = GetWindowLong(ancestorApi, -20);
					result = AreBitsPresent(windowLong, 8);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static bool IsWindowStyleRemoved(Window window, int styleBit)
		{
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(window);
			if (windowInteropHelper.Handle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				IntPtr windowLong = GetWindowLong(windowInteropHelper.Handle, -16);
				if (!AreBitsPresent(windowLong, styleBit))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static IntPtr MakeLParam(int width, int height)
		{
			return (IntPtr)(((short)height << 16) | (width & 0xFFFF));
		}

		internal static void NotifyFrameChange(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			if (hwnd != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				SetWindowPosApi(hwnd, IntPtr.Zero, 0, 0, 0, 0, 567);
			}
		}

		internal static POINT PointFromLParam(IntPtr lParam)
		{
			int value = IntPtrToInt32(lParam);
			return new POINT(SignedLoWord(value), SignedHiWord(value));
		}

		internal static bool PreventClose(Window window)
		{
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(window);
			IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
			if (handle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				IntPtr systemMenu = GetSystemMenu(handle, revert: false);
				if (IntPtr.Zero != systemMenu)
				{
					int menuState = GetMenuState(systemMenu, 61536, 0);
					if ((menuState & 3) != 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static IntPtr RemoveBits(IntPtr ptr, int bitsToRemove)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt32() & ~bitsToRemove);
			}
			return new IntPtr(ptr.ToInt64() & ~bitsToRemove);
		}

		internal static IntPtr RemoveBits(IntPtr ptr, int bitsToRemove, out int bitsRemoved)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 4)
			{
				int num = ptr.ToInt32();
				bitsRemoved = num & bitsToRemove;
				return new IntPtr(num & ~bitsToRemove);
			}
			long num2 = ptr.ToInt64();
			bitsRemoved = (int)(num2 & bitsToRemove);
			return new IntPtr(num2 & ~bitsToRemove);
		}

		internal static void SetZorder(Window window, Window windowAfter)
		{
			HwndSource hwndSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual(window) as HwndSource;
			HwndSource hwndSource2 = PresentationSource.FromVisual(windowAfter) as HwndSource;
			IntPtr handle = hwndSource.Handle;
			IntPtr handle2 = hwndSource2.Handle;
			if (handle != IntPtr.Zero && handle2 != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				SetWindowPosApi(handle, handle2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 531);
			}
		}

		internal static void SetZorder(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr hwndAfter)
		{
			SetWindowPosApi(hwnd, hwndAfter, 0, 0, 0, 0, 531);
		}

		internal static int SignedLoWord(int value)
		{
			return (short)(value & 0xFFFF);
		}

		internal static int SignedHiWord(int value)
		{
			return (short)((value >> 16) & 0xFFFF);
		}
	}
	public abstract class StyleSelectorHelperBase
	{
		private DependencyObject _target;

		public abstract Style Style { get; }

		protected StyleSelectorHelperBase(DependencyObject target)
		{
			_target = target;
			if (!(target is FrameworkContentElement) && !(target is FrameworkElement))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_3"));
			}
		}

		public void InvalidateStyle()
		{
			Style style = Style;
			FrameworkContentElement frameworkContentElement = _target as FrameworkContentElement;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _target as FrameworkElement;
			if (style == null)
			{
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					frameworkElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					frameworkContentElement.ClearValue(FrameworkContentElement.StyleProperty);
				}
			}
			else if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				frameworkElement.Style = style;
			}
			else
			{
				frameworkContentElement.Style = style;
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.AutomationPeers
{
	public abstract class AutomationPeerProxy : AutomationPeer
	{
		private static readonly MethodInfo _updateSubTreeMethod;

		private static bool _updateSubTreeFailed;

		static AutomationPeerProxy()
		{
			try
			{
				_updateSubTreeMethod = typeof(AutomationPeer).GetMethod("UpdateSubtree", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			}
			catch
			{
				_updateSubTreeMethod = null;
			}
			_updateSubTreeFailed = _updateSubTreeMethod == null;
		}

		protected override string GetAcceleratorKeyCore()
		{
			AutomationPeer underlyingPeer = GetUnderlyingPeer();
			if (underlyingPeer == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return underlyingPeer.GetAcceleratorKey();
		}

		protected override string GetAccessKeyCore()
		{
			AutomationPeer underlyingPeer = GetUnderlyingPeer();
			if (underlyingPeer == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return underlyingPeer.GetAccessKey();
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdCore()
		{
			AutomationPeer underlyingPeer = GetUnderlyingPeer();
			if (underlyingPeer == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return underlyingPeer.GetAutomationId();
		}

		protected override Rect GetBoundingRectangleCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.GetBoundingRectangle() ?? default(Rect);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			AutomationPeer underlyingPeer = GetUnderlyingPeer();
			if (underlyingPeer != null)
			{
				if (!_updateSubTreeFailed)
				{
					try
					{
						_updateSubTreeMethod.Invoke(underlyingPeer, Type.EmptyTypes);
					}
					catch (MemberAccessException)
					{
						_updateSubTreeFailed = true;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						_updateSubTreeFailed = true;
					}
				}
				List<AutomationPeer> children = underlyingPeer.GetChildren();
				if (children != null)
				{
					return new List<AutomationPeer>(children);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Point GetClickablePointCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.GetClickablePoint() ?? new System.Windows.Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}

		protected override string GetHelpTextCore()
		{
			AutomationPeer underlyingPeer = GetUnderlyingPeer();
			if (underlyingPeer == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return underlyingPeer.GetHelpText();
		}

		protected override string GetItemStatusCore()
		{
			AutomationPeer underlyingPeer = GetUnderlyingPeer();
			if (underlyingPeer == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return underlyingPeer.GetItemStatus();
		}

		protected override string GetItemTypeCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.GetItemType();
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer GetLabeledByCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.GetLabeledBy();
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			AutomationPeer underlyingPeer = GetUnderlyingPeer();
			if (underlyingPeer == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return underlyingPeer.GetName();
		}

		protected override AutomationOrientation GetOrientationCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.GetOrientation() ?? AutomationOrientation.None;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override bool HasKeyboardFocusCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.HasKeyboardFocus() ?? false;
		}

		protected override bool IsContentElementCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.IsContentElement() ?? true;
		}

		protected override bool IsControlElementCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.IsControlElement() ?? true;
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabledCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.IsEnabled() ?? false;
		}

		protected override bool IsKeyboardFocusableCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.IsKeyboardFocusable() ?? false;
		}

		protected override bool IsOffscreenCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.IsOffscreen() ?? true;
		}

		protected override bool IsPasswordCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.IsPassword() ?? false;
		}

		protected override bool IsRequiredForFormCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.IsRequiredForForm() ?? false;
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			GetUnderlyingPeer()?.SetFocus();
		}

		protected abstract AutomationPeer GetUnderlyingPeer();

		protected void ThrowIfNotEnabled()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
		}
	}

	public class ExpansionIndicatorAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer, IToggleProvider
	{
		public ToggleState ToggleState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Owner is Infragistics.Controls.Primitives.ExpansionIndicator expansionIndicator))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				if (expansionIndicator.IsExpanded)
				{
					return ToggleState.On;
				}
				return ToggleState.Off;
			}
		}

		public ExpansionIndicatorAutomationPeer(Infragistics.Controls.Primitives.ExpansionIndicator owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.CheckBox;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "ExpansionIndicator";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Toggle)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		public void Toggle()
		{
			if (!(base.Owner is Infragistics.Controls.Primitives.ExpansionIndicator expansionIndicator))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (!expansionIndicator.IsEnabled)
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			expansionIndicator.IsExpanded = !expansionIndicator.IsExpanded;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Core
{
	internal struct LongValue
	{
		public int Low;

		public int High;

		public LongValue(int low, int high)
		{
			Low = low;
			High = high;
		}

		public static LongValue All()
		{
			return new LongValue(-1, -1);
		}

		public bool HasAll(LongValue other)
		{
			if ((other.Low & Low) == other.Low)
			{
				return (other.High & High) == other.High;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool HasAny(LongValue other)
		{
			if ((other.Low & Low) == 0)
			{
				return (other.High & High) != 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsMatch(LongValue disallowed, LongValue required)
		{
			if (!HasAny(disallowed))
			{
				return HasAll(required);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static LongValue Or(LongValue v1, LongValue v2)
		{
			return new LongValue(v1.Low | v2.Low, v1.High | v2.High);
		}

		internal LongValue OrHigh(int high)
		{
			return new LongValue(Low, High | high);
		}

		internal LongValue OrLow(int low)
		{
			return new LongValue(Low | low, High);
		}

		internal static LongValue FromLong(long l)
		{
			return new LongValue((int)(l & 0xFFFFFFFFu), (int)(l >> 32));
		}

		internal long ToLong()
		{
			return ((long)High << 32) | (uint)Low;
		}
	}
}

	public class ObservableCollectionWrapper<T> : Collection<T>, ICollectionWrapper, INotifyPropertyChanged, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		private NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler _collectionChanged;

		private PropertyChangedEventHandler _propertyChanged;

		object ICollectionWrapper.InnerItems => base.Items;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged
		{
			add
			{
				NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler collectionChanged = _collectionChanged;
				_collectionChanged = (NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(_collectionChanged, value);
				if (collectionChanged == null && _collectionChanged != null && base.Items is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += OnItemsCollectionChanged;
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler collectionChanged = _collectionChanged;
				_collectionChanged = (NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(_collectionChanged, value);
				if (collectionChanged != null && _collectionChanged == null && base.Items is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= OnItemsCollectionChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChanged = _propertyChanged;
				_propertyChanged = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(_propertyChanged, value);
				if (propertyChanged == null && _propertyChanged != null && base.Items is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged += OnItemsPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChanged = _propertyChanged;
				_propertyChanged = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(_propertyChanged, value);
				if (propertyChanged != null && _propertyChanged == null && base.Items is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged -= OnItemsPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollectionWrapper(IList<T> list)
			: base(list)
		{
		}

		private void OnItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			_collectionChanged(this, e);
		}

		private void OnItemsPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			_propertyChanged(this, e);
		}
	}
