	internal class AdapterNotifyCollection<TWrapper, TItem> : IList<TWrapper>, ICollection<TWrapper>, IEnumerable<TWrapper>, IEnumerable, IList, ICollection, INotifyCollectionChanged, INotifyPropertyChanged, IDeferUpdate
	{
		private class Enumerator : IEnumerator<TWrapper>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private Func<TItem, TWrapper> _toWrapperCallback;

			private IEnumerator<TItem> _sourceEnumerator;

			public TWrapper Current => _toWrapperCallback(_sourceEnumerator.Current);

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			internal Enumerator(AdapterNotifyCollection<TWrapper, TItem> source)
			{
				_toWrapperCallback = source._toWrapperCallback;
				IList<TItem> list = source._source ?? new TItem[0];
				_sourceEnumerator = list.GetEnumerator();
				Reset();
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				_sourceEnumerator.Dispose();
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				return _sourceEnumerator.MoveNext();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_sourceEnumerator.Reset();
			}
		}

		private IList<TItem> _source;

		private Func<TItem, TWrapper> _toWrapperCallback;

		private Func<TWrapper, TItem> _toItemCallback;

		private static readonly NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs ResetArgs = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);

		protected PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected IList<TItem> Source => _source;

		public int Count => _source.Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => ((ICollection)_source).IsSynchronized;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => ((ICollection)_source).SyncRoot;

		public bool IsReadOnly => _source.IsReadOnly;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (_source is IList)
				{
					return ((IList)_source).IsFixedSize;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				this[index] = (TWrapper)value;
			}
		}

		public TWrapper this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _toWrapperCallback(_source[index]);
			}
			set
			{
				_source[index] = _toItemCallback(value);
			}
		}

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChanged = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(PropertyChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChanged = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(PropertyChanged, value);
			}
		}

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public AdapterNotifyCollection(IList<TItem> source, Func<TItem, TWrapper> toWrapperCallback, Func<TWrapper, TItem> toItemCallback)
		{
			if (toWrapperCallback == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("toWrapperCallback");
			}
			if (toItemCallback == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("toItemCallback");
			}
			_toWrapperCallback = toWrapperCallback;
			_toItemCallback = toItemCallback;
			Initialize(source);
		}

		public virtual void Initialize(IList<TItem> source)
		{
			if (source == _source)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_source != null)
			{
				if (_source is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= OnSourceCollectionChanged;
				}
				if (_source is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged -= OnSourceCollectionPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			_source = source;
			if (_source != null)
			{
				if (_source is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged2)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged2.CollectionChanged += OnSourceCollectionChanged;
				}
				if (_source is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged2)
				{
					notifyPropertyChanged2.PropertyChanged += OnSourceCollectionPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			if (_source == null)
			{
				_source = new TItem[0];
			}
			OnCollectionReset();
		}

		protected TWrapper GetWrapper(TItem item)
		{
			return _toWrapperCallback(item);
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			this.CollectionChanged?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		private void OnCollectionReset()
		{
			OnCollectionChanged(ResetArgs);
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			OnPropertyChanged("Count");
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		private void OnSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler notifyCollectionChangedEventHandler = this.CollectionChanged;
			if (notifyCollectionChangedEventHandler != null)
			{
				switch (e.Action)
				{
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
					e = ((e.NewItems.Count <= 1) ? new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move, new TWrapper[1] { _toWrapperCallback((TItem)e.OldItems[0]) }, e.NewStartingIndex, e.OldStartingIndex) : new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
					e = ((e.NewItems.Count <= 1) ? new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, new TWrapper[1] { _toWrapperCallback((TItem)e.NewItems[0]) }, e.NewStartingIndex) : ResetArgs);
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
					e = ((e.NewItems.Count <= 1) ? new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, new TWrapper[1] { _toWrapperCallback((TItem)e.NewItems[0]) }, new TWrapper[1] { _toWrapperCallback((TItem)e.OldItems[0]) }, e.NewStartingIndex) : ResetArgs);
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
					e = ((e.OldItems.Count <= 1) ? new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, new TWrapper[1] { _toWrapperCallback((TItem)e.OldItems[0]) }, e.OldStartingIndex) : ResetArgs);
					break;
				}
				notifyCollectionChangedEventHandler(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void OnSourceCollectionPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		void IDeferUpdate.BeginUpdate()
		{
			if (_source is IDeferUpdate deferUpdate)
			{
				deferUpdate.BeginUpdate();
			}
		}

		void IDeferUpdate.EndUpdate()
		{
			if (_source is IDeferUpdate deferUpdate)
			{
				deferUpdate.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new Enumerator(this);
		}

		IEnumerator<TWrapper> IEnumerable<TWrapper>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new Enumerator(this);
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _source.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				array.SetValue(_toWrapperCallback(_source[i]), index++);
			}
		}

		public void Add(TWrapper item)
		{
			_source.Add(_toItemCallback(item));
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_source.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(TWrapper item)
		{
			return _source.Contains(_toItemCallback(item));
		}

		void ICollection<TWrapper>.CopyTo(TWrapper[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _source.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[arrayIndex++] = _toWrapperCallback(_source[i]);
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(TWrapper item)
		{
			return _source.Remove(_toItemCallback(item));
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			Add((TWrapper)value);
			return _source.Count - 1;
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains((TWrapper)value);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf((TWrapper)value);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Insert(index, (TWrapper)value);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			_source.Remove(_toItemCallback((TWrapper)value));
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			_source.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public int IndexOf(TWrapper item)
		{
			return _source.IndexOf(_toItemCallback(item));
		}

		public void Insert(int index, TWrapper item)
		{
			_source.Insert(index, _toItemCallback(item));
		}
	}
	internal class AggregateCollection<T> : IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, IList, ICollection, INotifyCollectionChanged, ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications, ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>
	{
		private class AggregateSparseArray : SparseArray
		{
			internal class MultiItem : ISparseArrayMultiItem, ISparseArrayItem
			{
				internal IEnumerable _originalList;

				internal IEnumerable<T> _list;

				private object _ownerData;

				public int ScrollCount => CoreUtilities.GetCount(_list);

				internal MultiItem(IEnumerable originalList, IEnumerable<T> list)
				{
					_originalList = originalList;
					_list = list;
				}

				internal NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs ProcessHelper(AggregateSparseArray sparseArr, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
				{
					NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e = null;
					int aggregateIndex = sparseArr.GetAggregateIndex(this);
					if (aggregateIndex >= 0)
					{
						switch (args.Action)
						{
						case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
							e = CoreUtilities.CreateAddRemoveNCCArgs(add: true, args.NewItems, aggregateIndex + args.NewStartingIndex);
							break;
						case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
							e = CoreUtilities.CreateAddRemoveNCCArgs(add: false, args.OldItems, aggregateIndex + args.OldStartingIndex);
							break;
						case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
							e = CoreUtilities.CreateReplaceNCCArgs(args.OldItems, args.NewItems, aggregateIndex + args.NewStartingIndex);
							break;
						}
					}
					if (e != null)
					{
						sparseArr.DirtyItemScrollCount(this);
					}
					else
					{
						sparseArr.DirtyScrollCountInfo();
					}
					return e;
				}

				public object GetItemAtScrollIndex(int scrollIndex)
				{
					if (CoreUtilities.GetItemAt(_list, scrollIndex, out var item))
					{
						return item;
					}
					return null;
				}

				public object GetOwnerData(SparseArray context)
				{
					return _ownerData;
				}

				public void SetOwnerData(object ownerData, SparseArray context)
				{
					_ownerData = ownerData;
				}
			}

			internal AggregateSparseArray()
				: base(manageScrollCounts: true, 2, 1f)
			{
			}

			internal void DirtyItemScrollCount(MultiItem item)
			{
				NotifyItemScrollCountChanged(item);
			}

			internal int GetAggregateCount()
			{
				return GetScrollCount();
			}

			internal int GetAggregateIndex(MultiItem multiItem)
			{
				return GetScrollIndexOf(multiItem, ignoreItemHiddenState: true);
			}

			internal int GetAggregateIndex(T item)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = base.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					MultiItem multiItem = (MultiItem)base[i];
					int indexOf = CoreUtilities.GetIndexOf(multiItem._list, item);
					if (indexOf >= 0)
					{
						int aggregateIndex = GetAggregateIndex(multiItem);
						if (aggregateIndex >= 0)
						{
							return aggregateIndex + indexOf;
						}
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}

			internal MultiItem GetCorrespondingMultiItem(IEnumerable list)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = base.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					MultiItem multiItem = (MultiItem)base[i];
					if (multiItem._originalList == list || multiItem._list == list)
					{
						return multiItem;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal bool GetItemAtAggregateIndex(int index, out T item)
			{
				object itemAtScrollIndex = GetItemAtScrollIndex(index, null);
				if (itemAtScrollIndex is T)
				{
					item = (T)itemAtScrollIndex;
					return true;
				}
				item = default(T);
				return false;
			}
		}

		private IList<IEnumerable> _lists;

		private NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler _collectionChanged;

		private AggregateSparseArray _sparseArr;

		private PropertyChangeListenerList _propChangeListeners;

		private NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler _nccHandler;

		private PropertyChangeListener<AggregateCollection<T>> _listener;

		public IList<IEnumerable> Collections
		{
			get
			{
				return _lists;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_lists != value)
				{
					SetCollections(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public int Count => _sparseArr.GetAggregateCount();

		public bool IsReadOnly => true;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => true;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
			}
		}

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => this;

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (_sparseArr.GetItemAtAggregateIndex(index, out var item))
				{
					return item;
				}
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
			set
			{
				CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
			}
		}

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged
		{
			add
			{
				_collectionChanged = Delegate.Combine(_collectionChanged, value) as NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler;
			}
			remove
			{
				_collectionChanged = Delegate.Remove(_collectionChanged, value) as NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler;
			}
		}

		internal AggregateCollection()
			: this((IList<IEnumerable>)null)
		{
		}

		internal AggregateCollection(IList<IEnumerable> lists)
		{
			_listener = new PropertyChangeListener<AggregateCollection<T>>(this, OnContainedCollectionNotification);
			_nccHandler = OnContainedCollectionChanged;
			SetCollections(lists);
		}

		private void HookUnhook(IList<IEnumerable> lists, bool hook, bool hookUnhookFromSubLists)
		{
			if (lists == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (lists is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler value = OnCollectionListChanged;
				if (hook)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += value;
				}
				else
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= value;
				}
			}
			if (hookUnhookFromSubLists)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = lists.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					HookUnhookSubList(lists[i], hook);
				}
			}
		}

		private void HookUnhookSubList(IEnumerable ii, bool hook)
		{
			if (ii is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				if (hook)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += _nccHandler;
				}
				else
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= _nccHandler;
				}
			}
			if (ii is ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications supportPropertyChangeNotifications)
			{
				if (hook)
				{
					supportPropertyChangeNotifications.AddListener(_listener, useWeakReference: false);
				}
				else
				{
					supportPropertyChangeNotifications.RemoveListener(_listener);
				}
			}
		}

		private void InsertMultiItemHelper(int i, bool raiseReset)
		{

			}
		}

		private void OnCollectionListChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				if (e.NewItems != null)

					int j = 0;

			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				if (e.OldItems != null)

					int i = 0;
					for (int count = e.OldItems.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						RemoveMultiItemHelper(e.OldStartingIndex + i, e.OldItems[i] as IEnumerable, raiseReset: true);
					}
					return;
				}
				break;
			}
			SetCollections(_lists);
		}

		private void OnContainedCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e2 = null;

			AggregateSparseArray.MultiItem correspondingMultiItem = _sparseArr.GetCorrespondingMultiItem(list);

	public class DateCollection : ObservableCollection<DateTime>, ICollection<DateTime>, IEnumerable<DateTime>, IEnumerable
	{
		private bool _isSortDirty;

		private DateTime[] _sortedDates;

		private DateRange _allowedRange = DateRange.Infinite;

		protected internal DateRange AllowedRange
		{
			get
			{
				return _allowedRange;
			}
			set
			{
				value.Normalize();
				value.RemoveTime();
				if (value != _allowedRange)
				{
					_allowedRange = value;
					EnsureWithinMinMax();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			DateTime[] array = new DateTime[base.Count];
			CopyTo(array, 0);
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			base.ClearItems();
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				OnDatesChanged(new DateTime[0], array);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, DateTime item)
		{
			item = item.Date;
			VerifyCanAdd(item);
			int newItemCount = base.Count + 1;
			VerifyNewDateCount(ref newItemCount, validate: true);
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			OnDatesChanged(new DateTime[1] { item }, new DateTime[0]);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = base[index];
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			OnDatesChanged(new DateTime[0], new DateTime[1] { dateTime });
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, DateTime item)
		{
			item = item.Date;
			if (!(base[index] == item))
			{
				VerifyCanAdd(item);
				InvalidateSortedDates();
				DateTime dateTime = base[index];
				base.SetItem(index, item);
				OnDatesChanged(new DateTime[1] { item }, new DateTime[1] { dateTime });
			}
		}

		internal int BinarySearch(DateTime date)
		{
			VerifySortedDates();
			return Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, date.Date);
		}

		internal bool ContainsDate(DateTime date)
		{
			return BinarySearch(date) >= 0;
		}

		internal void Reinitialize(IList<DateTime> newSelection)
		{
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>();
			List<DateTime> list2 = new List<DateTime>();
			if (newSelection != _sortedDates)
			{
				CalculateDelta(newSelection, list, list2);
				InvalidateSortedDates();
			}
			base.Items.Clear();
			foreach (DateTime item in newSelection)
			{
				base.Items.Add(item);
			}
			if (list.Count > 0 || list2.Count > 0)
			{
				OnDatesChanged(list, list2);
			}
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Count"));
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Item[]"));
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		private void CalculateDelta(IList<DateTime> newSelection, List<DateTime> datesSelected, List<DateTime> datesUnselected)
		{
			if (newSelection.Count == 0)
			{
				datesUnselected.AddRange(this);
				return;
			}
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				datesSelected.AddRange(newSelection);
				return;
			}
			datesUnselected.AddRange(this);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = newSelection.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				DateTime date = newSelection[i].Date;
				if (ContainsDate(date))
				{
					datesUnselected.Remove(date);
				}
				else
				{
					datesSelected.Add(date);
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureWithinMinMax()
		{
			if (base.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			VerifySortedDates();
			DateRange allowedRange = AllowedRange;
			allowedRange.Normalize();
			allowedRange.RemoveTime();
			DateTime start = allowedRange.Start;
			DateTime end = allowedRange.End;
			int num = Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, start);
			int num2 = Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, end);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = ~num2;
				num2--;
			}
			int num3 = num2 - num + 1;
			if (num3 >= base.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>(Math.Max(num3, 0));
			if (num3 > 0)
			{
				DateRange dateRange = new DateRange(start, end);
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = base.Items.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					DateTime dateTime = base.Items[i];
					if (dateRange.Contains(dateTime))
					{
						list.Add(dateTime);
					}
				}
			}
			Reinitialize(list.ToArray());
		}

		private void InvalidateSortedDates()
		{
			_isSortDirty = true;
			_sortedDates = null;
		}

		private void SyncSortedDates()
		{
			DateTime[] array = new DateTime[base.Count];
			CopyTo(array, 0);
			Array.Sort(array, Comparer<DateTime>.Default);
			_sortedDates = array;
		}

		private void VerifyCanAdd(DateTime date)
		{
			VerifySortedDates();
			if (Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, date) >= 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_DateAlreadySelected", date));
			}
			if (!_allowedRange.Contains(date))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(string.Format(SR.GetString("LE_DateOutOfRange"), date, _allowedRange.Start, _allowedRange.End));
			}
		}

		private void VerifySortedDates()
		{
			if (_sortedDates == null)
			{
				SyncSortedDates();
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(DateTime start, DateTime end, bool allowPartialSelection)
		{
			AddRange(new DateRange(start, end), allowPartialSelection);
		}

		public void AddRange(DateRange range, bool allowPartialSelection)
		{
			range.RemoveTime();
			range.Normalize();
			if (!allowPartialSelection && !_allowedRange.Contains(range))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			DateTime[] array = GetAllowedDates(range);
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = array.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				VerifyCanAdd(array[i]);
			}
			int num2 = base.Count + num;
			int newItemCount = num2;
			VerifyNewDateCount(ref newItemCount, !allowPartialSelection);
			if (newItemCount < num2)
			{
				num = newItemCount - base.Count;
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				DateTime[] array2 = new DateTime[num];
				Array.Copy(array, array2, num);
				array = array2;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				base.Items.Add(array[j]);
			}
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Count"));
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Item[]"));
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			OnDatesChanged(array, new DateTime[0]);
		}

		public new bool Contains(DateTime date)
		{
			return ContainsDate(date);
		}

		public bool IntersectsWith(DateRange range)
		{
			range.RemoveTime();
			range.Normalize();
			DateTime start = range.Start;
			DateTime end = range.End;
			if (start == end)
			{
				return ContainsDate(start);
			}
			VerifySortedDates();
			int num = Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, start);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			num = ~num;
			int num2 = Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, end);
			if (num2 >= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			num2 = ~num2;
			int i = num;
			for (int num3 = Math.Min(num2, _sortedDates.Length - 1); i <= num3; i++)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = _sortedDates[i];
				if (dateTime >= start && dateTime <= end)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			if (base.Count > 0 && _isSortDirty)
			{
				VerifySortedDates();
				_isSortDirty = false;
				Reinitialize(_sortedDates);
			}
		}

		protected virtual DateTime[] GetAllowedDates(DateRange dateRange)
		{
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>();
			dateRange.Normalize();
			dateRange.RemoveTime();
			if (!dateRange.Intersect(_allowedRange))
			{
				return new DateTime[0];
			}
			DateTime dateTime = dateRange.Start.Date;
			DateTime date = dateRange.End.Date;
			while (dateTime <= date)
			{
				list.Add(dateTime);
				dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDatesChanged(IList<DateTime> added, IList<DateTime> removed)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void VerifyNewDateCount(ref int newItemCount, bool validate)
		{
		}

		bool ICollection<DateTime>.Contains(DateTime date)
		{
			return ContainsDate(date);
		}
	}
	public class MultiSourceEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private IEnumerator[] _sourceEnumerators;

		private int _currentEnumeratorIndex;

		private object _currentItem;

		private static object UnsetObjectMarker = new object();

		public object Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (_currentItem == UnsetObjectMarker)
				{
					if (_currentEnumeratorIndex == -1)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_3"));
					}
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_4"));
				}
				return _currentItem;
			}
		}

		public MultiSourceEnumerator(params IEnumerator[] sourceEnumerators)
		{
			if (sourceEnumerators == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sourceEnumerators");
			}
			if (sourceEnumerators.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("sourceEnumerators", SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_20"));
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sourceEnumerators.Length; i++)
			{
				if (sourceEnumerators[i] == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("sourceEnumerators", SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_20"));
				}
			}
			_sourceEnumerators = sourceEnumerators;
			_currentEnumeratorIndex = -1;
			_currentItem = UnsetObjectMarker;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (_currentEnumeratorIndex < 0)
			{
				_currentEnumeratorIndex = 0;
			}
			if (!_sourceEnumerators[_currentEnumeratorIndex].MoveNext())
			{
				if (_currentEnumeratorIndex < _sourceEnumerators.Length - 1)
				{
					_currentEnumeratorIndex++;
					return ((IEnumerator)this).MoveNext();
				}
				_currentItem = UnsetObjectMarker;
				return false;
			}
			_currentItem = _sourceEnumerators[_currentEnumeratorIndex].Current;
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_currentEnumeratorIndex = -1;
			_currentItem = UnsetObjectMarker;
			for (int i = 0; i < _sourceEnumerators.Length; i++)
			{
				_sourceEnumerators[i].Reset();
			}
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public class ObservableCollectionExtended<T> : ObservableCollection<T>, ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications, ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>, IDeferUpdate
	{
		private int _suspendCount;

		private bool _hasChanged;

		private bool _hookSubObjects;

		private PropertyChangedEventHandler _propChangeHandler;

		private PropertyChangeListenerList _propChangeListeners;

		private bool _hookSubObjectsListeners;

		private static readonly NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs ResetArgs = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);

		public bool IsUpdating => _suspendCount != 0;

		protected virtual bool NotifyItemsChanged => false;

		internal PropertyChangeListenerList PropChangeListeners
		{
			get
			{
				if (_propChangeListeners == null)
				{
					_propChangeListeners = new PropertyChangeListenerList();
				}
				return _propChangeListeners;
			}
		}

		private IList<T> ItemsToEnumerate => base.Items;

		public event EventHandler<ItemPropertyChangedEventArgs> ItemPropertyChanged;

		public ObservableCollectionExtended()
			: this(hookItemPropertyChanged: true, hookItemListeners: false)
		{
		}

		public ObservableCollectionExtended(List<T> list)
			: base(list)
		{
			Initialize(hookItemPropertyChanged: true, hookItemListeners: false);
		}

		internal ObservableCollectionExtended(bool hookItemPropertyChanged, bool hookItemListeners)
		{
			Initialize(hookItemPropertyChanged, hookItemListeners);
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<T> collection)
		{
			InsertRange(base.Count, collection);
		}

		public void BeginUpdate()
		{
			int num = Interlocked.Increment(ref _suspendCount);
			if (num == 1)
			{
				OnBeginUpdate();
			}
		}

		public int BinarySearch(T item)
		{
			return BinarySearch(item, null);
		}

		public int BinarySearch(T item, IComparer<T> comparer)
		{
			if (!(base.Items is List<T> list))
			{
				T[] array = new T[base.Count];
				CopyTo(array, 0);
				return Array.BinarySearch(array, item, comparer);
			}
			return list.BinarySearch(item, comparer);
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref _suspendCount) == 0)
			{
				if (_hasChanged)
				{
					_hasChanged = false;
					OnPropertyChanged("Count");
					OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
					OnResetCollection();
				}
				OnEndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public virtual void InsertRange(int index, IEnumerable<T> collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collection");
			}
			CheckReentrancy();
			bool notifyItemsChanged = NotifyItemsChanged;
			if (notifyItemsChanged)
			{
				foreach (T item in collection)
				{
					OnItemAdding(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (T item2 in collection)
			{
				HookSubObject(item2);
				base.Items.Insert(index++, item2);
				if (notifyItemsChanged)
				{
					OnItemAdded(item2);
				}
			}
			if (!IsUpdating)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged("Count");
				OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
				OnResetCollection();
			}
			else
			{
				_hasChanged = true;
			}
		}

		public void ReInitialize(IEnumerable<T> collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collection");
			}
			BeginUpdate();
			Clear();
			AddRange(collection);
			EndUpdate();
		}

		public virtual void RemoveRange(int index, int count)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (count < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count");
			}
			CheckReentrancy();
			bool notifyItemsChanged = NotifyItemsChanged;
			for (int num = index + count - 1; num >= index; num--)
			{
				T val = base[num];
				if (notifyItemsChanged)
				{
					OnItemRemoving(val);
				}
				UnhookSubObject(val);
				base.Items.RemoveAt(num);
				if (notifyItemsChanged)
				{
					OnItemRemoved(val);
				}
			}
			if (!IsUpdating)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged("Count");
				OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
				OnResetCollection();
			}
			else
			{
				_hasChanged = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnBeginUpdate()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnEndUpdate()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAdded(T itemAdded)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAdding(T itemAdded)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemoved(T itemRemoved)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemoving(T item)
		{
		}

		private void HookSubObject(T item)
		{
			if (_hookSubObjectsListeners && item is ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications supportPropertyChangeNotifications)
			{
				supportPropertyChangeNotifications.AddListener(PropChangeListeners, useWeakReference: false);
			}
			if (_hookSubObjects && item is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged)
			{
				notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged += _propChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		private void Initialize(bool hookItemPropertyChanged, bool hookItemListeners)
		{
			_hookSubObjects = hookItemPropertyChanged && typeof(INotifyPropertyChanged).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T));
			_hookSubObjectsListeners = hookItemListeners && typeof(ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T));
			if (!_hookSubObjects && !_hookSubObjectsListeners)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_hookSubObjects)
			{
				_propChangeHandler = OnSubObjectChanged;
			}
			foreach (T item in ItemsToEnumerate)
			{
				HookSubObject(item);
			}
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		private void OnResetCollection()
		{
			OnCollectionChanged(ResetArgs);
		}

		private void OnSubObjectChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnItemPropertyChanged(new ItemPropertyChangedEventArgs(sender, e.PropertyName));
		}

		private void UnhookSubObject(T item)
		{
			if (_hookSubObjectsListeners && item is ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications supportPropertyChangeNotifications)
			{
				supportPropertyChangeNotifications.RemoveListener(PropChangeListeners);
			}
			if (_hookSubObjects && item is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged)
			{
				notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged -= _propChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemPropertyChanged(ItemPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ItemPropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.ItemPropertyChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			CheckReentrancy();
			bool notifyItemsChanged = NotifyItemsChanged;
			IList<T> itemsToEnumerate = ItemsToEnumerate;
			T[] array = (notifyItemsChanged ? new T[itemsToEnumerate.Count] : null);
			if (array != null)
			{
				itemsToEnumerate.CopyTo(array, 0);
			}
			if (notifyItemsChanged)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					OnItemRemoving(array[i]);
				}
			}
			if (_hookSubObjects || _hookSubObjectsListeners)
			{
				IList<T> list = itemsToEnumerate;
				int j = 0;
				for (int count = list.Count; j < count; j++)
				{
					UnhookSubObject(list[j]);
				}
			}
			base.Items.Clear();
			if (array != null)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
				{
					OnItemRemoved(array[k]);
				}
			}
			if (IsUpdating)
			{
				_hasChanged = true;
				return;
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("Count");
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			OnResetCollection();
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, T item)
		{
			CheckReentrancy();
			bool notifyItemsChanged = NotifyItemsChanged;
			if (notifyItemsChanged)
			{
				OnItemAdding(item);
			}
			base.Items.Insert(index, item);
			HookSubObject(item);
			if (notifyItemsChanged)
			{
				OnItemAdded(item);
			}
			if (IsUpdating)
			{
				_hasChanged = true;
				return;
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("Count");
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, item, index));
		}

		protected override void MoveItem(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			CheckReentrancy();
			T val = base.Items[oldIndex];
			base.Items.RemoveAt(oldIndex);
			base.Items.Insert(newIndex, val);
			if (IsUpdating)
			{
				_hasChanged = true;
				return;
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move, val, newIndex, oldIndex));
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (_propChangeListeners != null)
			{
				_propChangeListeners.OnCollectionChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (_propChangeListeners != null)
			{
				_propChangeListeners.OnPropertyValueChanged(this, e.PropertyName, null);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			CheckReentrancy();
			T val = base[index];
			bool notifyItemsChanged = NotifyItemsChanged;
			if (notifyItemsChanged)
			{
				OnItemRemoving(val);
			}
			UnhookSubObject(val);
			base.Items.RemoveAt(index);
			if (notifyItemsChanged)
			{
				OnItemRemoved(val);
			}
			if (IsUpdating)
			{
				_hasChanged = true;
				return;
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("Count");
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, val, index));
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, T item)
		{
			CheckReentrancy();
			bool notifyItemsChanged = NotifyItemsChanged;
			if (notifyItemsChanged)
			{
				OnItemRemoving(base[index]);
				OnItemAdding(item);
			}
			T val = base[index];
			UnhookSubObject(val);
			HookSubObject(item);
			base.Items[index] = item;
			if (notifyItemsChanged)
			{
				OnItemRemoved(val);
				OnItemAdded(item);
			}
			if (IsUpdating)
			{
				_hasChanged = true;
				return;
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, item, val, index));
		}

		void ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>.AddListener(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> listener, bool useWeakReference)
		{
			PropChangeListeners.Add(listener, useWeakReference);
		}

		void ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>.RemoveListener(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> listener)
		{
			PropChangeListeners.Remove(listener);
		}
	}
	public class ItemPropertyChangedEventArgs : PropertyChangedEventArgs
	{
		private object _item;

		public object Item => _item;

		public ItemPropertyChangedEventArgs(object item, string propertyName)
			: base(propertyName)
		{
			_item = item;
		}
	}
	public class ReadOnlyNotifyCollection<T> : IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, IList, ICollection, INotifyCollectionChanged, ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications, ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private IList<T> _source;

		private PropertyChangeListenerList _propChangeListeners;

		private NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler _collectionChanged;

		private PropertyChangedEventHandler _propertyChanged;

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _source[index];
			}
			set
			{
				CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
			}
		}

		public int Count => _source.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => true;

		protected IList<T> Source => _source;

		private PropertyChangeListenerList PropChangeListeners
		{
			get
			{
				if (_propChangeListeners == null)
				{
					_propChangeListeners = new PropertyChangeListenerList();
					_propChangeListeners.Add(new PropertyChangeListener<ReadOnlyNotifyCollection<T>>(this, OnListenersSubObjectPropertyChanged), useWeakReference: false);
				}
				return _propChangeListeners;
			}
		}

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => true;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _source[index];
			}
			set
			{
				CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
			}
		}

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized
		{
			get
			{
				if (_source is ICollection collection)
				{
					return collection.IsSynchronized;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		object ICollection.SyncRoot
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(_source is ICollection collection))
				{
					return _source;
				}
				return collection.SyncRoot;
			}
		}

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged
		{
			add
			{
				_collectionChanged = Delegate.Combine(_collectionChanged, value) as NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler;
			}
			remove
			{
				_collectionChanged = Delegate.Remove(_collectionChanged, value) as NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler;
			}
		}

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				_propertyChanged = Delegate.Combine(_propertyChanged, value) as PropertyChangedEventHandler;
			}
			remove
			{
				_propertyChanged = Delegate.Remove(_propertyChanged, value) as PropertyChangedEventHandler;
			}
		}

		public ReadOnlyNotifyCollection(IList<T> source)
		{
			SetSourceCollection(source);
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return _source.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			CoreUtilities.CopyTo(_source, array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _source.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			return _source.IndexOf(item);
		}

		private void OnSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseCollectionChanged(e, notifyListeners: true);
		}

		private void OnSourcePropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged(e, notifyListeners: true);
		}

		internal void RaiseCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs eventArgs, bool notifyListeners)
		{
			if (_collectionChanged != null)
			{
				_collectionChanged(this, eventArgs);
			}
			if (notifyListeners && _propChangeListeners != null)
			{
				_propChangeListeners.OnCollectionChanged(this, eventArgs);
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseCollectionReset()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Count"), notifyListeners: true);
			RaisePropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Item[]"), notifyListeners: true);
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset), notifyListeners: true);
		}

		internal void RaisePropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs eventArgs, bool notifyListeners)
		{
			if (_propertyChanged != null)
			{
				_propertyChanged(this, eventArgs);
			}
			if (notifyListeners && _propChangeListeners != null)
			{
				_propChangeListeners.OnPropertyValueChanged(this, eventArgs.PropertyName, eventArgs);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void SetSourceCollection(IList<T> source)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(source);
			if (_source != source)
			{
				HookUnhook(_source, hook: false);
				_source = source;
				HookUnhook(_source, hook: true);
				RaiseCollectionReset();
			}
		}

		private void HookUnhook(object source, bool hook)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (source is ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications supportPropertyChangeNotifications)
			{
				if (hook)
				{
					supportPropertyChangeNotifications.AddListener(PropChangeListeners, useWeakReference: false);
				}
				else
				{
					supportPropertyChangeNotifications.RemoveListener(PropChangeListeners);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (_source is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				if (hook)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += OnSourceCollectionChanged;
				}
				else
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= OnSourceCollectionChanged;
				}
			}
			if (_source is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged)
			{
				if (hook)
				{
					notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged += OnSourcePropertyChanged;
				}
				else
				{
					notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged -= OnSourcePropertyChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Compact()
		{
			if (_propChangeListeners != null)
			{
				_propChangeListeners.Compact();
			}
		}

		private void OnListenersSubObjectPropertyChanged(ReadOnlyNotifyCollection<T> owner, object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (sender == _source)
			{
				if (extraInfo is NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs eventArgs)
				{
					RaiseCollectionChanged(eventArgs, notifyListeners: true);
				}
				else if (extraInfo is PropertyChangedEventArgs eventArgs2)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged(eventArgs2, notifyListeners: true);
				}
			}
		}

		void IList<T>.Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
		}

		void IList<T>.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
		}

		void ICollection<T>.Add(T item)
		{
			CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
		}

		void ICollection<T>.Clear()
		{
			CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
		}

		bool ICollection<T>.Remove(T item)
		{
			CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
			return false;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
			return -1;
		}

		void IList.Clear()
		{
			CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			if (value == null || value is T)
			{
				return Contains((T)value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			if (value != null && !(value is T))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return IndexOf((T)value);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			CoreUtilities.RaiseReadOnlyCollectionException();
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			CoreUtilities.CopyTo(_source, array, index);
		}

		void ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>.AddListener(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> listener, bool useWeakReference)
		{
			PropChangeListeners.Add(listener, useWeakReference);
		}

		void ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>.RemoveListener(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> listener)
		{
			PropChangeListeners.Remove(listener);
		}
	}
	public class SingleItemEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private object _currentItem;

		private object _item;

		private bool _endReached;

		private static object UnsetObjectMarker = new object();

		public object Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (_currentItem == UnsetObjectMarker)
				{
					if (_endReached)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_4"));
					}
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_3"));
				}
				return _currentItem;
			}
		}

		public SingleItemEnumerator(object item)
		{
			_item = item;
			_currentItem = UnsetObjectMarker;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (_endReached)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_4"));
			}
			if (_item == null || _currentItem == _item)
			{
				_endReached = true;
				return false;
			}
			_currentItem = _item;
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_currentItem = UnsetObjectMarker;
			_endReached = false;
		}
	}
	public sealed class EmptyEnumerator : IEnumerator

				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_4"));
			}
		}

		private EmptyEnumerator()
		{
		}

		bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
		{
			return false;
		}

		void IEnumerator.Reset()
		{
		}
	}

	public class SparseArray : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private class Node
		{
			internal Node parent;

			internal Node left;

			internal Node right;

			internal int leftCount;

			internal int rightCount;

			internal int count;

			internal object[] arr;

			internal int TotalCount => leftCount + rightCount + count;

			internal object[] ItemsArray
			{
				get
				{
					if (arr == null)
					{
						return arr = new object[count];
					}
					return arr;
				}
			}

			internal Node()
			{
			}

			internal Node(Node parent)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				stringBuilder.Append(GetType().Name).Append(" ").Append(GetHashCode());
				stringBuilder.Append(" ").Append((parent == null) ? "no parent" : ((this == parent.left) ? "lc" : ((this == parent.right) ? "rc" : "invalid")));
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		private class NodeExtended : Node
		{
			internal int visibleCount;

			internal int leftVisibleCount;

			internal int rightVisibleCount;

			internal int scrollCount;

			internal int leftScrollCount;

			internal int rightScrollCount;

			internal bool isNodeDirty;

			internal bool isLeftDirty;

			internal bool isRightDirty;

			internal int TotalVisibleCount => leftVisibleCount + visibleCount + rightVisibleCount;

			internal int TotalScrollCount => leftScrollCount + scrollCount + rightScrollCount;

			internal virtual int[] ScrollCounts
			{
				get
				{
					return null;
				}
				set
				{
				}
			}

			internal NodeExtended()
			{
			}

			internal NodeExtended(NodeExtended parent)
				: base(parent)
			{
			}
		}

		private class NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache : NodeExtended
		{
			internal static int[] g_dirtyFlag = new int[0];

			private int[] _scrollCounts = g_dirtyFlag;

			internal override int[] ScrollCounts
			{
				get
				{
					return _scrollCounts;
				}
				set
				{
					_scrollCounts = value;
				}
			}

			internal NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache()
			{
			}

			internal NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache(NodeExtended parent)
				: base(parent)
			{
			}
		}

		private class Enumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private SparseArray sarr;

			private int nodeIndex = -1;

			private Node currNode;

			object IEnumerator.Current
			{
				get
				{
					EnsureNotExhausted();
					if (nodeIndex < 0 || nodeIndex >= currNode.count || currNode.arr == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return currNode.arr[nodeIndex];
				}
			}

			internal Enumerator(SparseArray sarr)
			{
				this.sarr = sarr;
				((IEnumerator)this).Reset();
			}

			private void EnsureNotExhausted()
			{
				if (currNode == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_1"));
				}
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				currNode = GetMinimum(sarr.tree);
				nodeIndex = -currNode.leftCount - 1;
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				EnsureNotExhausted();
				nodeIndex++;
				if (nodeIndex < currNode.count)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (nodeIndex < currNode.count + currNode.rightCount && currNode.right == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				currNode = GetSuccessor(currNode);
				if (currNode != null)
				{
					nodeIndex = ((currNode.left == null) ? (-currNode.leftCount) : 0);
				}
				return currNode != null;
			}
		}

		private class CreateItemEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private SparseArray sarr;

			private int index = -1;

			private ICreateItemCallback createItemCallback;

			object IEnumerator.Current
			{
				get
				{
					EnsureNotExhausted();
					return sarr.GetItem(index, createItemCallback);
				}
			}

			internal CreateItemEnumerator(SparseArray sarr, ICreateItemCallback createItemCallback)
			{
				this.sarr = sarr;
				this.createItemCallback = createItemCallback;
				((IEnumerator)this).Reset();
			}

			private void EnsureNotExhausted()
			{
				if (index >= sarr.Count)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_1"));
				}
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				index = -1;
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				EnsureNotExhausted();
				index++;
				return index < sarr.Count;
			}
		}

		private class NonNullEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private SparseArray sarr;

			private int nodeIndex = -1;

			private Node currNode;

			object IEnumerator.Current
			{
				get
				{
					EnsureNotExhausted();
					if (currNode.arr == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return currNode.arr[nodeIndex];
				}
			}

			internal NonNullEnumerator(SparseArray sarr)
			{
				this.sarr = sarr;
				((IEnumerator)this).Reset();
			}

			private void EnsureNotExhausted()
			{
				if (currNode == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_1"));
				}
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				currNode = GetMinimum(sarr.tree);
				nodeIndex = -1;
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				EnsureNotExhausted();
				nodeIndex++;
				while (currNode != null && (nodeIndex >= currNode.count || currNode.arr == null || currNode.arr[nodeIndex] == null))
				{
					nodeIndex++;
					if (nodeIndex >= currNode.count)
					{
						currNode = GetSuccessor(currNode);
						nodeIndex = 0;
					}
				}
				return currNode != null;
			}
		}

		private class NonNullEnumerable : IEnumerable
		{

		private class VisibleItemsEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			internal class Enumerable : IEnumerable
			{
				private SparseArray _sarr;

				private ICreateItemCallback _createItemCallback;

				internal Enumerable(SparseArray sarr, ICreateItemCallback createItemCallback)
				{
					_sarr = sarr;
					_createItemCallback = createItemCallback;
				}

				public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
				{
					return new VisibleItemsEnumerator(_sarr, _createItemCallback);
				}
			}

			private SparseArray _sarr;

			private object _current;

			private int _visibleIndex;

			private ICreateItemCallback _createItemCallback;

			public object Current => _current;

			internal VisibleItemsEnumerator(SparseArray sarr, ICreateItemCallback createItemCallback)
			{
				if (!sarr.manageScrollCounts)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Sparse array doesn't manage visible counts!");
				}
				_sarr = sarr;
				_createItemCallback = createItemCallback;
				Reset();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_current = null;
				_visibleIndex = -1;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				while (++_visibleIndex < _sarr.GetVisibleCount())
				{
					_current = _sarr.GetItemAtVisibleIndex(_visibleIndex, _createItemCallback);
					if (_current != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected SparseArray(int factor, float growthFactor, bool useOwnerData, bool manageScrollCounts)
		{
			if (factor < 2)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("factor", GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_1"));
			}
			if (growthFactor <= 0f || growthFactor > 1f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("growthFactor", GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_2"));
			}
			this.factor = factor;
			growBy = Math.Max(1, (int)((float)factor * growthFactor));
			this.useOwnerData = useOwnerData || manageScrollCounts;
			this.manageScrollCounts = manageScrollCounts;
			_cacheScrollCounts = this.manageScrollCounts;
			tree = CreateNode();
		}

		public void Expand(int newCount)
		{
			if (newCount < Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("newCount", GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_3"));
			}
			int num = newCount - Count;
			Node right = tree;
			while (right.right != null)
			{
				right.rightCount += num;
				right = right.right;
			}
			bool setIsNodeDirtyFlag = false;
			if (right.count < factor)
			{
				int num2 = Math.Min(num, factor - right.count);
				Lend(null, right, num2, toLeft: false);
				num -= num2;
				setIsNodeDirtyFlag = true;
			}
			right.rightCount += num;
			DirtyScrollCount(right, setIsNodeDirtyFlag, overallScrollCountChanged: true);
			MaintainAncestors(right);
		}

		public int Add(object item)
		{
			Node right = tree;
			while (right.right != null)
			{
				right.rightCount++;
				right = right.right;
			}
			if (right.rightCount <= 0)
			{
				Array_Insert(right, right.count, item);
				DirtyScrollCount_OverallScrollCountChanged(right);
				FixupNode(right);
			}
			else
			{
				right.rightCount++;
				if (item != null)
				{
					SetItemHelper(Count - 1, item, performingAdd: true);
				}
				else
				{
					DirtyScrollCount(right, setIsNodeDirtyFlag: false, overallScrollCountChanged: true);
				}
			}
			return Count - 1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, object item)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index < Count)
			{
				int index2 = index;
				Node nodeContainingIndex = GetNodeContainingIndex(ref index, item != null);
				if (nodeContainingIndex != null)
				{
					Array_Insert(nodeContainingIndex, index, item);
					ApplyDeltaToAncestors(nodeContainingIndex, 1);
					FixupNode(nodeContainingIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					ApplyDeltaToDescendantPath(index2, 1);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (Count != index)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
				}
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(ICollection items)

			InsertRange(Count, items);

		public void InsertRange(int index, ICollection items)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				ValidateIndex(index);
			}
			if (index > Count)
			{
				ValidateIndex(index);
			}
			int count = items.Count;
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Expand(Count + count);
			for (int num = Count - 1 - count; num >= index; num--)
			{
				this[num + count] = this[num];
			}
			IEnumerator enumerator = items.GetEnumerator();
			enumerator.Reset();
			bool flag = true;
			while (flag && enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				object current = enumerator.Current;
				int indexVal = index;
				Node nodeContainingIndex = GetNodeContainingIndex(ref indexVal, current != null);
				index++;
				if (nodeContainingIndex != null)
				{
					object[] itemsArray = nodeContainingIndex.ItemsArray;
					itemsArray[indexVal++] = current;
					SetOwnerDataHelper(current, nodeContainingIndex);
					while (indexVal < nodeContainingIndex.count && (flag = enumerator.MoveNext()))
					{
						current = enumerator.Current;
						SetOwnerDataHelper(current, nodeContainingIndex);
						itemsArray[indexVal++] = current;
						index++;
					}
					DirtyScrollCount_OverallScrollCountChanged(nodeContainingIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			ValidateIndex(index);
			int index2 = index;
			Node nodeContainingIndex = GetNodeContainingIndex(ref index, forceCreation: false);
			if (nodeContainingIndex != null)
			{
				Array_Remove(nodeContainingIndex, index);
				ApplyDeltaToAncestors(nodeContainingIndex, -1);
				FixupNode(nodeContainingIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				ApplyDeltaToDescendantPath(index2, -1);
			}
		}

		public void Move(object item, int newIndex)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			MoveHelper(num, newIndex, item, itemIsSpecified: true);
		}

		public void Move(int itemIndex, int newIndex)

		}

		private void MoveHelper(int itemIndex, int newIndex, object item, bool itemIsSpecified)
		{
			ValidateIndex(itemIndex);
			ValidateIndex(newIndex);
			if (!itemIsSpecified)
			{
				item = GetItem(itemIndex);
			}
			bool flag = onScrollCountChangedCalledBefore;
			onScrollCountChangedCalledBefore = true;
			try
			{
				RemoveAt(itemIndex);
				Insert(newIndex, item);
			}
			finally
			{
				onScrollCountChangedCalledBefore = flag;
			}
		}

		public int IndexOf(object item)
		{
			if (useOwnerData)
			{
				if (GetOwnerDataHelper(item) is Node node)
				{
					int nodeStartIndex = GetNodeStartIndex(node);
					if (nodeStartIndex >= 0 && node.arr != null)
					{
						int num = Array.IndexOf(node.arr, item, 0, node.count);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							return nodeStartIndex + num;
						}
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
			return IndexOf(tree, item);
		}

		public void RemoveRange(int index, int count)
		{
			if (count <= 0)

				if (count != 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count", GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_4"));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int num = index + count - 1;
				ValidateIndex(index);
				ValidateIndex(num);
				RemoveRangeHelper(index, num);
			}
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index, ICreateItemCallback callback)
		{
			if (array.Length - index < Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(GetString("LE_ArgumentException_3"), "array");
			}
			if (callback == null)
			{
				CopyToHelper(tree, array, ref index);
				return;
			}
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator(callback);
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				array.SetValue(enumerator.Current, index++);
			}
		}

		public object GetItem(int index, ICreateItemCallback createItemCallback)
		{
			ValidateIndex(index);
			int indexVal = index;
			Node nodeContainingIndex = GetNodeContainingIndex(ref indexVal, createItemCallback != null);
			if (nodeContainingIndex != null)
			{
				if (createItemCallback != null && (nodeContainingIndex.arr == null || nodeContainingIndex.arr[indexVal] == null))
				{
					return CreateItemHelper(createItemCallback, nodeContainingIndex, indexVal, index);
				}
				if (nodeContainingIndex.arr == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return nodeContainingIndex.arr[indexVal];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Reverse(int index, int count)
		{
			if (count >= 1)
			{
				int num = index;
				int num2 = index + count - 1;
				ValidateIndex(num);
				ValidateIndex(num2);
				while (num < num2)
				{
					object value = this[num];
					this[num] = this[num2];
					this[num2] = value;
					num++;
					num2--;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Sort(IComparer comparer)

			if (comparer == null)

				IComparer comparer2 = Comparer<object>.Default;
				comparer3 = comparer2;
			}
			else
			{
				comparer3 = comparer;

			CoreUtilities.SortMerge(array, comparer3);
			ReplaceAllItems(array);

		public void Compact()
		{
			if (CompactHelper(tree) && manageScrollCounts)
			{
				scrollCountInfoDirtyOnAllNodes = true;
				EnsureScrollCountCalculated();
			}
		}

		private bool CompactHelper(Node n)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (n == null)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag = CompactHelper(n.left) || flag;
			flag = CompactHelper(n.right) || flag;
			if (Array_AreAllItemsNull(n))
			{
				flag = RemoveEmptyNode(n) || flag;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool RemoveEmptyNode(Node n)
		{
			bool flag = n == tree;
			bool flag2;
			if (n.left != null && n.right != null)
			{
				flag2 = n.leftCount < n.rightCount;
			}
			else if (n.left != null)
			{
				flag2 = false;
			}
			else
			{
				if (n.right == null)
				{
					if (n.parent != null)
					{
						if (n == n.parent.left)
						{
							n.parent.left = null;
						}
						else if (n == n.parent.right)
						{
							n.parent.right = null;
						}
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				flag2 = true;
			}
			Node node = (flag2 ? RotateLeft(n) : RotateRight(n));
			if (flag)
			{
				tree = node;
			}
			RemoveEmptyNode(n);
			return true;
		}

		private static int CountDescretePoints(int[] arr, int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
			{
				int num3 = arr[i];
				if (num2 != num3)
				{
					num++;
				}
				num2 = num3;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public int GetVisibleIndexOf(ISparseArrayMultiItem item, bool ignoreItemHiddenState)
		{
			if (!manageScrollCounts)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			EnsureScrollCountCalculated();
			if (!ignoreItemHiddenState && item.ScrollCount <= 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (GetOwnerDataHelper(item) is NodeExtended nodeExtended)
			{
				int nodeStartVisibleIndex = GetNodeStartVisibleIndex(nodeExtended);
				if (nodeStartVisibleIndex >= 0)
				{
					int num = 0;
					if (nodeExtended.arr != null)
					{
						bool flag = false;
						int[] scrollCounts;
						if (_cacheScrollCounts && NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache.g_dirtyFlag != (scrollCounts = nodeExtended.ScrollCounts))
						{
							int num2 = Array.IndexOf(nodeExtended.arr, item);
							flag = num2 >= 0;
							if (flag)
							{
								num = ((scrollCounts != null) ? CountDescretePoints(scrollCounts, 0, num2 - 1) : num2);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							int num3 = 0;
							while (!flag && num3 < nodeExtended.count)
							{
								ISparseArrayMultiItem sparseArrayMultiItem = (ISparseArrayMultiItem)nodeExtended.arr[num3];
								if (sparseArrayMultiItem != item)
								{
									num += GetItemVisibleCount(sparseArrayMultiItem);
								}
								else
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								num3++;
							}
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							return nodeStartVisibleIndex + num;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public int GetVisibleIndexOf(int itemIndex, bool ignoreItemHiddenState)
		{
			if (!manageScrollCounts)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			EnsureScrollCountCalculated();
			int indexVal = itemIndex;
			if (GetNodeContainingIndex(ref indexVal, forceCreation: true) is NodeExtended nodeExtended && indexVal >= 0)
			{
				int num = GetNodeStartVisibleIndex(nodeExtended);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					if (nodeExtended.arr == null)
					{
						return num + indexVal;
					}
					int[] scrollCounts;
					if (_cacheScrollCounts && NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache.g_dirtyFlag != (scrollCounts = nodeExtended.ScrollCounts))
					{
						int num2 = ((scrollCounts != null) ? CountDescretePoints(scrollCounts, 0, indexVal - 1) : indexVal);
						int num3 = ((scrollCounts == null) ? 1 : (scrollCounts[indexVal] - ((indexVal > 0) ? scrollCounts[indexVal - 1] : 0)));
						if (!ignoreItemHiddenState && num3 <= 0)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						return num + num2;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < nodeExtended.count; i++)
					{
						ISparseArrayMultiItem item = (ISparseArrayMultiItem)nodeExtended.arr[i];
						int itemVisibleCount = GetItemVisibleCount(item);
						if (indexVal == i)
						{
							if (!ignoreItemHiddenState && itemVisibleCount <= 0)
							{
								return -1;
							}
							return num;
						}
						num += itemVisibleCount;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public int GetScrollIndexOf(ISparseArrayMultiItem item, bool ignoreItemHiddenState)
		{
			if (!manageScrollCounts)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			EnsureScrollCountCalculated();
			if (!ignoreItemHiddenState && item.ScrollCount <= 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (GetOwnerDataHelper(item) is NodeExtended nodeExtended)
			{
				int nodeStartScrollIndex = GetNodeStartScrollIndex(nodeExtended);
				if (nodeStartScrollIndex >= 0)
				{
					int num = 0;
					if (nodeExtended.arr != null)
					{
						bool flag = false;
						int[] scrollCounts;
						if (_cacheScrollCounts && NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache.g_dirtyFlag != (scrollCounts = nodeExtended.ScrollCounts))
						{
							int num2 = Array.IndexOf(nodeExtended.arr, item);
							flag = num2 >= 0;
							num = ((num2 > 0) ? ((scrollCounts != null) ? scrollCounts[num2 - 1] : num2) : 0);
						}
						else
						{
							int num3 = 0;
							while (!flag && num3 < nodeExtended.count)
							{
								ISparseArrayMultiItem sparseArrayMultiItem = (ISparseArrayMultiItem)nodeExtended.arr[num3];
								if (sparseArrayMultiItem != item)
								{
									num += GetItemScrollCount(sparseArrayMultiItem);
								}
								else
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								num3++;
							}
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							return nodeStartScrollIndex + num;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected object GetItemAtVisibleIndexOffset(ISparseArrayMultiItem startItem, int offset, ICreateItemCallback createItemCallback)
		{
			int visibleIndexOf = GetVisibleIndexOf(startItem, ignoreItemHiddenState: true);
			if (visibleIndexOf < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetItemAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndexOf + offset, createItemCallback);
		}

		protected object GetItemAtVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex, ICreateItemCallback createItemCallback)
		{
			if (!manageScrollCounts)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (visibleIndex < 0 || visibleIndex >= GetVisibleCount())
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = visibleIndex;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num < GetVisibleCount())
			{
				num2++;
				visibleIndex = num;
				NodeExtended nodeExtended = (NodeExtended)tree;
				bool flag = false;
				NodeExtended nodeExtended2 = null;
				while (nodeExtended != null)
				{
					nodeExtended2 = nodeExtended;
					if (visibleIndex < nodeExtended.leftVisibleCount)
					{
						flag = true;
						nodeExtended = (NodeExtended)nodeExtended.left;
						continue;
					}
					visibleIndex -= nodeExtended.leftVisibleCount;
					if (visibleIndex < nodeExtended.visibleCount)
					{
						break;
					}
					visibleIndex -= nodeExtended.visibleCount;
					nodeExtended = (NodeExtended)nodeExtended.right;
					flag = false;
				}
				if (nodeExtended == null)
				{
					if (createItemCallback != null)
					{
						int nodeStartIndex = GetNodeStartIndex(nodeExtended2);
						if (flag)
						{
							nodeStartIndex -= (nodeExtended2.leftVisibleCount - visibleIndex) / 1;
							nodeStartIndex = Math.Max(0, nodeStartIndex);
						}
						else
						{
							nodeStartIndex += nodeExtended2.count;
							nodeStartIndex += visibleIndex / 1;
							nodeStartIndex = Math.Min(Count - 1, nodeStartIndex);
						}

		private object GetItemAtScrollIndexHelper(int scrollIndex, ICreateItemCallback createItemCallback, bool traverseHierarchy, out int offsetIntoItem)
		{
			offsetIntoItem = -1;
			if (!manageScrollCounts)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (scrollIndex < 0 || scrollIndex >= GetScrollCount())
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = scrollIndex;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num < GetScrollCount())
			{
				num2++;
				scrollIndex = num;
				NodeExtended nodeExtended = (NodeExtended)tree;
				bool flag = false;
				NodeExtended nodeExtended2 = null;
				while (nodeExtended != null)
				{
					nodeExtended2 = nodeExtended;
					if (scrollIndex < nodeExtended.leftScrollCount)
					{
						flag = true;
						nodeExtended = (NodeExtended)nodeExtended.left;
						continue;
					}
					scrollIndex -= nodeExtended.leftScrollCount;
					if (scrollIndex < nodeExtended.scrollCount)
					{
						break;
					}
					scrollIndex -= nodeExtended.scrollCount;
					nodeExtended = (NodeExtended)nodeExtended.right;
					flag = false;
				}
				if (nodeExtended == null)
				{
					if (createItemCallback != null)
					{
						int nodeStartIndex = GetNodeStartIndex(nodeExtended2);
						if (flag)
						{
							nodeStartIndex -= (nodeExtended2.leftScrollCount - scrollIndex) / 1;
							nodeStartIndex = Math.Max(0, nodeStartIndex);
						}
						else
						{
							nodeStartIndex += nodeExtended2.count;
							nodeStartIndex += scrollIndex / 1;
							nodeStartIndex = Math.Min(Count - 1, nodeStartIndex);
						}
						GetNodeContainingIndex(ref nodeStartIndex, forceCreation: true);
						if (num2 > Count)
						{
							return null;
						}
						continue;
					}
					return null;
				}
				if (nodeExtended.arr == null && createItemCallback == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int num3 = 0;
				bool flag2 = false;
				int[] array = null;
				if (_cacheScrollCounts)
				{
					array = nodeExtended.ScrollCounts;
					flag2 = NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache.g_dirtyFlag != array;
				}
				bool flag3 = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < nodeExtended.count; i++)
				{
					ISparseArrayMultiItem sparseArrayMultiItem = (ISparseArrayMultiItem)nodeExtended.ItemsArray[i];
					int num5;

						}
