		private void SetItemHelper(int index, object item, bool performingAdd)
		{
			ValidateIndex(index);
			Node nodeContainingIndex = GetNodeContainingIndex(ref index, item != null);
			if (nodeContainingIndex == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object[] itemsArray = nodeContainingIndex.ItemsArray;
			bool flag = false;
			if (manageScrollCounts)
			{
				flag = true;
				object obj = itemsArray[index];
				if (obj == null)
				{
					int itemScrollCount = GetItemScrollCount((ISparseArrayMultiItem)item);
					if (itemScrollCount == ((!performingAdd) ? 1 : 0))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
			}
			itemsArray[index] = item;
			SetOwnerDataHelper(item, nodeContainingIndex);
			if (flag)
			{
				DirtyScrollCount_OverallScrollCountChanged(nodeContainingIndex);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyDeltaToAncestors(Node n, int delta)
		{
			Node node = n;
			while (n.parent != null)
			{
				if (n == n.parent.left)
				{
					n.parent.leftCount += delta;
				}
				else
				{
					n.parent.rightCount += delta;
				}
				n = n.parent;
			}
			DirtyScrollCount_OverallScrollCountChanged(node);
		}

		private void ApplyDeltaToDescendantPath(int index, int delta)
		{
			Node node = tree;
			Node node2 = null;
			while (node != null)
			{
				node2 = node;
				if (index < node.leftCount)
				{
					node.leftCount += delta;
					node = node.left;
					continue;
				}
				index -= node.leftCount;
				if (index < node.count)
				{
					break;
				}
				index -= node.count;
				node.rightCount += delta;
				node = node.right;
			}
			DirtyScrollCount(node2, setIsNodeDirtyFlag: false, overallScrollCountChanged: true);
		}

		private void GetNodeContainingIndeces(ref int xIndex, ref int yIndex, out Node xNode, out Node yNode)
		{
			int num = xIndex;
			int num2 = xIndex;
			xNode = GetNodeContainingIndex(ref xIndex, forceCreation: true);
			yNode = GetNodeContainingIndex(ref yIndex, forceCreation: false);
			if (yNode == null)
			{
				xIndex = num;
				yIndex = num2;
				yNode = GetNodeContainingIndex(ref yIndex, forceCreation: true);
				xNode = GetNodeContainingIndex(ref xIndex, forceCreation: true);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveRangeHelper(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			while (startIndex <= endIndex)
			{
				int xIndex = startIndex;
				int yIndex = endIndex;
				GetNodeContainingIndeces(ref xIndex, ref yIndex, out var xNode, out var yNode);
				if (xNode == yNode)
				{
					int num = 1 + yIndex - xIndex;
					Array_RemoveRange(xNode, xIndex, num, clearOwnerData: true);
					ApplyDeltaToAncestors(xNode, -num);
					FixupNode(xNode);
					endIndex -= num;
				}
				else if (xIndex == 0 || yNode.count - 1 == yIndex)
				{
					Node node = ((xIndex == 0) ? xNode : yNode);
					int count = node.count;
					Array_RemoveRange(node, 0, count, clearOwnerData: true);
					ApplyDeltaToAncestors(node, -count);
					FixupNode(node);
					endIndex -= count;
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveRangeHelper(startIndex, endIndex - (yIndex + 1));
					endIndex = startIndex + yIndex;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanBorrow(Node n, int itemCount)
		{
			return n.count - itemCount >= factor;
		}

		private object[] Expand_Collapse(Node n, int capacity)
		{
			object[] arr = n.arr;
			int num = ((arr != null) ? arr.Length : 0);
			if (capacity <= num && num - capacity < growBy)
			{
				return arr;
			}
			int num2 = capacity / growBy * growBy;
			if (num2 < capacity)
			{
				num2 += growBy;
			}
			if (num2 > MaxFactor + 1)
			{
				num2 = Math.Max(capacity, MaxFactor + 1);
			}
			object[] result = arr;
			n.arr = new object[num2];
			return result;
		}

		private object GetOwnerDataHelper(object item)
		{
			if (!useOwnerData || item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetOwnerData(item);
		}

		private void SetOwnerDataHelper(Node n, int startIndex, int count)
		{
			SetOwnerDataHelper(n.arr, n, startIndex, count);
		}

		private void SetOwnerDataHelper(object[] arr, object ownerData, int startIndex, int count)
		{
			if (useOwnerData && arr != null)
			{
				count += startIndex;
				for (int i = startIndex; i < count; i++)
				{
					SetOwnerDataHelper(arr[i], ownerData);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetOwnerDataHelper(object item, object ownerData)
		{
			if (useOwnerData && item != null)
			{
				SetOwnerData(item, ownerData);
			}
		}

		private void ClearOwnerData(Node n, int startIndex, int count)
		{
			if (n != null)
			{
				ClearOwnerData(n.arr, startIndex, count);
			}
		}

		private void ClearOwnerData(object[] arr, int startIndex, int count)
		{
			SetOwnerDataHelper(arr, null, startIndex, count);
		}

		private void Array_Insert(Node n, int index, object item)
		{
			if (n.arr != null || item != null)
			{
				object[] array = Expand_Collapse(n, 1 + n.count);
				if (array != null)
				{
					if (array != n.arr && index > 0)
					{
						Array.Copy(array, 0, n.arr, 0, index);
					}
					if (index < n.count)
					{
						Array.Copy(array, index, n.arr, index + 1, n.count - index);
					}
				}
				n.arr[index] = item;
				SetOwnerDataHelper(item, n);
			}
			n.count++;
		}

		private void Array_Remove(Node n, int index)
		{
			Array_RemoveRange(n, index, 1, clearOwnerData: true);
		}

		private void Array_RemoveRange(Node n, int index, int count, bool clearOwnerData)
		{
			if (n.arr != null)
			{
				if (count < n.count)
				{
					object[] array = Expand_Collapse(n, n.count - count);
					if (array != n.arr && index > 0)
					{
						Array.Copy(array, 0, n.arr, 0, index);
					}
					if (clearOwnerData)
					{
						ClearOwnerData(array, index, count);
					}
					if (index + count < n.count)
					{
						Array.Copy(array, index + count, n.arr, index, n.count - (index + count));
					}
					if (array == n.arr)
					{
						Array.Clear(array, n.count - count, count);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (clearOwnerData)
					{
						ClearOwnerData(n, 0, n.count);
					}
					n.arr = null;
				}
			}
			n.count -= count;
		}

		private void Array_InsertRange(Node dest, int destIndex, Node src, int srcIndex, int count)
		{
			if (dest.arr != null || (src != null && src.arr != null))
			{
				object[] array = Expand_Collapse(dest, count + dest.count);
				if (array != dest.arr && destIndex > 0 && array != null)
				{
					Array.Copy(array, 0, dest.arr, 0, destIndex);
				}
				if (destIndex < dest.count && array != null)
				{
					Array.Copy(array, destIndex, dest.arr, destIndex + count, dest.count - destIndex);
				}
				if (src != null && src.arr != null)
				{
					Array.Copy(src.arr, srcIndex, dest.arr, destIndex, count);
					SetOwnerDataHelper(dest, destIndex, count);
				}
				else if (array == dest.arr)
				{
					Array.Clear(array, destIndex, count);
				}
			}
			dest.count += count;
		}

		private bool Array_AreAllItemsNull(Node n)
		{
			object[] arr = n.arr;
			if (arr != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length; i++)
				{
					if (arr[i] != null)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void Lend(Node nodeFrom, Node nodeTo, int itemsToLend, bool toLeft)
		{
			if (nodeTo.count == 0 && nodeFrom != null && itemsToLend == nodeFrom.count)
			{
				nodeTo.arr = nodeFrom.arr;
				nodeFrom.arr = null;
				nodeTo.count = nodeFrom.count;
				nodeFrom.count = 0;
				SetOwnerDataHelper(nodeTo, 0, nodeTo.count);
			}
			else if (toLeft)
			{
				Array_InsertRange(nodeTo, 0, nodeFrom, (nodeFrom != null) ? (nodeFrom.count - itemsToLend) : 0, itemsToLend);
				if (nodeFrom != null)
				{
					Array_RemoveRange(nodeFrom, nodeFrom.count - itemsToLend, itemsToLend, clearOwnerData: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Array_InsertRange(nodeTo, nodeTo.count, nodeFrom, 0, itemsToLend);
				if (nodeFrom != null)
				{
					Array_RemoveRange(nodeFrom, 0, itemsToLend, clearOwnerData: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Node GetMaximum(Node n)
		{
			if (n != null)
			{
				while (n.right != null)
				{
					n = n.right;
				}
			}
			return n;
		}

		private static Node GetMinimum(Node n)
		{
			if (n != null)
			{
				while (n.left != null)
				{
					n = n.left;
				}
			}
			return n;
		}

		private static Node GetPredecessor(Node n)
		{
			if (n.left != null)
			{
				return GetMaximum(n.left);
			}
			while (n.parent != null)
			{
				if (n == n.parent.right)
				{
					return n.parent;
				}
				n = n.parent;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Node GetSuccessor(Node n)
		{
			if (n.right != null)
			{
				return GetMinimum(n.right);
			}
			while (n.parent != null)
			{
				if (n == n.parent.left)
				{
					return n.parent;
				}
				n = n.parent;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void FixupNode(Node n)
		{
			while (n != null && n.count < factor)
			{
				Node node = null;
				int num = factor - n.count;
				int num2 = num;
				if (n.parent == null && n.leftCount == 0 && n.rightCount == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (n.parent != null && ((n == n.parent.left && n.rightCount == 0) || (n == n.parent.right && n.leftCount == 0)))
				{
					if (CanBorrow(n.parent, num))
					{
						Lend(n.parent, n, num, n != n.parent.left);
						if (n == n.parent.left)
						{
							n.parent.leftCount += num;
						}
						else
						{
							n.parent.rightCount += num;
						}
						DirtyScrollCount(n);
					}
					else
					{
						int count = n.count;
						if (count > 0)
						{
							Lend(n, n.parent, count, n.parent.left == n);
						}
						if (n == n.parent.left)
						{
							n.parent.leftCount -= count;
							n.parent.left = n.left;
							if (n.left != null)
							{
								n.left.parent = n.parent;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							n.parent.rightCount -= count;
							n.parent.right = n.right;
							if (n.right != null)
							{
								n.right.parent = n.parent;
							}
						}
					}
					node = n.parent;
					n = null;
				}
				else if (n.leftCount > n.rightCount)
				{
					if (n.left == null)
					{
						int count = Math.Min(n.leftCount, num);
						Lend(null, n, count, toLeft: true);
						num -= count;
						n.leftCount -= count;
						node = n;
					}
					else
					{
						Node node2 = GetMaximum(n.left);
						int count;
						if (node2.rightCount > 0)
						{
							count = Math.Min(node2.rightCount, num);
							Lend(null, n, count, toLeft: true);
							node2.rightCount -= count;
							num -= count;
						}
						if (num > 0)
						{
							count = (CanBorrow(node2, num) ? num : node2.count);
							Lend(node2, n, count, toLeft: true);
							num -= count;
						}
						node = node2;
						if (node2.count == 0)
						{
							if (node2 == node2.parent.left)
							{
								node2.parent.left = node2.left;
							}
							else
							{
								node2.parent.right = node2.left;
							}
							if (node2.left != null)
							{
								node2.left.parent = node2.parent;
							}
							node = node2.parent;
						}
						count = num2 - num;
						n.leftCount -= count;
						while (node2.parent != n)
						{
							node2 = node2.parent;
							node2.rightCount -= count;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (n.right == null)
				{
					int count = Math.Min(n.rightCount, num);
					Lend(null, n, count, toLeft: false);
					num -= count;
					n.rightCount -= count;
					node = n;
				}
				else
				{
					Node node3 = GetMinimum(n.right);
					int count;
					if (node3.leftCount > 0)
					{
						count = Math.Min(node3.leftCount, num);
						Lend(null, n, count, toLeft: false);
						node3.leftCount -= count;
						num -= count;
					}
					if (num > 0)
					{
						count = (CanBorrow(node3, num) ? num : node3.count);
						Lend(node3, n, count, toLeft: false);
						num -= count;
					}
					node = node3;
					if (node3.count == 0)
					{
						if (node3 == node3.parent.left)
						{
							node3.parent.left = node3.right;
						}
						else
						{
							node3.parent.right = node3.right;
						}
						if (node3.right != null)
						{
							node3.right.parent = node3.parent;
						}
						node = node3.parent;
					}
					count = num2 - num;
					n.rightCount -= count;
					while (node3.parent != n)
					{
						node3 = node3.parent;
						node3.leftCount -= count;
					}
				}
				if (node != null)
				{
					DirtyScrollCount(node);
					if (n != null && node != n)
					{
						DirtyScrollCount(n);
					}
					MaintainAncestors(node);
				}
			}
			while (n != null && n.count > MaxFactor)
			{
				Node node4 = CreateNode();
				bool flag = n.leftCount < n.rightCount;
				Lend(n, node4, factor, !flag);
				if (flag)
				{
					n.leftCount += node4.count;
					if (n.left == null)
					{
						n.left = node4;
						node4.parent = n;
					}
					else
					{
						Node node5 = n.left;
						node5.rightCount += node4.count;
						while (node5.right != null)
						{
							node5 = node5.right;
							node5.rightCount += node4.count;
						}
						node5.right = node4;
						node4.parent = node5;
					}
					if (node4 == node4.parent.left)
					{
						node4.leftCount = node4.parent.leftCount - node4.count;
					}
					else
					{
						node4.leftCount = node4.parent.rightCount - node4.count;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					n.rightCount += node4.count;
					if (n.right == null)
					{
						n.right = node4;
						node4.parent = n;
					}
					else
					{
						Node node6 = n.right;
						node6.leftCount += node4.count;
						while (node6.left != null)
						{
							node6 = node6.left;
							node6.leftCount += node4.count;
						}
						node6.left = node4;
						node4.parent = node6;
					}
					if (node4 == node4.parent.right)
					{
						node4.rightCount = node4.parent.rightCount - node4.count;
					}
					else
					{
						node4.rightCount = node4.parent.leftCount - node4.count;
					}
				}
				DirtyScrollCount(n);
				DirtyScrollCount(node4);
				if (node4.parent != null)
				{
					MaintainAncestors(node4.parent);
				}
			}
		}

		private Node RotateLeft(Node p)
		{
			Node right = p.right;
			if (right != null)
			{
				if (p == tree)
				{
					tree = right;
				}
				else if (p == p.parent.left)
				{
					p.parent.left = right;
				}
				else if (p == p.parent.right)
				{
					p.parent.right = right;
				}
				right.parent = p.parent;
				p.parent = right;
				p.right = right.left;
				right.left = p;
				if (p.right != null)
				{
					p.right.parent = p;
				}
				p.rightCount = right.leftCount;
				right.leftCount = p.TotalCount;
			}
			return right;
		}

		private Node RotateRight(Node p)
		{
			Node left = p.left;
			if (left != null)
			{
				if (p == tree)
				{
					tree = left;
				}
				else if (p == p.parent.left)
				{
					p.parent.left = left;
				}
				else if (p == p.parent.right)
				{
					p.parent.right = left;
				}
				left.parent = p.parent;
				p.parent = left;
				p.left = left.right;
				left.right = p;
				if (p.left != null)
				{
					p.left.parent = p;
				}
				p.leftCount = left.rightCount;
				left.rightCount = p.TotalCount;
			}
			return left;
		}

		private void Maintain(Node p)
		{
			while (p != null)
			{
				Node node = null;
				if (p.rightCount > p.leftCount && p.right != null)
				{
					int num = p.leftCount + p.count + p.right.leftCount;
					int rightCount = p.right.rightCount;
					if (Math.Abs(rightCount - num) < p.rightCount - p.leftCount)
					{
						node = RotateLeft(p);
					}
					else if (factor + p.rightCount >= (factor + p.leftCount) * 4)
					{
						Node right = p.right;
						if (RotateRight(right) != null)
						{
							DirtyScrollCount(right, setIsNodeDirtyFlag: false, overallScrollCountChanged: false);
							node = RotateLeft(p);
						}
					}
				}
				if (p.leftCount > p.rightCount && node == null && p.left != null)
				{
					int num = p.left.leftCount;
					int rightCount = p.count + p.rightCount + p.left.rightCount;
					if (Math.Abs(num - rightCount) < p.leftCount - p.rightCount)
					{
						node = RotateRight(p);
					}
					else if (factor + p.leftCount >= (factor + p.rightCount) * 4)
					{
						Node left = p.left;
						if (RotateLeft(left) != null)
						{
							DirtyScrollCount(left, setIsNodeDirtyFlag: false, overallScrollCountChanged: false);
							node = RotateRight(p);
						}
					}
				}
				if (node != null)
				{
					DirtyScrollCount(p, setIsNodeDirtyFlag: false, overallScrollCountChanged: false);
					Maintain(p);
				}
				p = node;
			}
		}

		private void MaintainAncestors(Node n)
		{
			while (n != null)
			{
				Maintain(n);
				n = n.parent;
			}
		}

		private Node GetNodeContainingIndex(ref int indexVal, bool forceCreation)
		{
			Node node = null;
			Node node2 = tree;
			int num = indexVal;
			bool flag = false;
			while (node2 != null)
			{
				node = node2;
				if (num < node2.leftCount)
				{
					node2 = node2.left;
					flag = true;
					continue;
				}
				num -= node2.leftCount;
				if (num < node2.count)
				{
					break;
				}
				num -= node2.count;
				node2 = node2.right;
				flag = false;
			}
			if (node2 == null && forceCreation)
			{
				bool flag2 = true;
				if (flag)
				{
					if (node.leftCount < factor)
					{
						if (CanBorrow(node, factor - node.leftCount))
						{
							node2 = (node.left = CreateNode(node));
							node2.count = node.leftCount;
							Lend(node, node2, factor - node.leftCount, toLeft: false);
							node.leftCount = node2.count;
						}
						else
						{
							Lend(null, node, node.leftCount, toLeft: true);
							node.leftCount = 0;
							node2 = node;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						node2 = (node.left = CreateNode(node));
						node2.leftCount = factor * (num / factor);
						node2.count = factor;
						if (node2.leftCount + node2.count > node.leftCount)
						{
							node2.leftCount = node.leftCount - factor;
						}
						node2.rightCount = node.leftCount - (node2.leftCount + node2.count);
						num -= node2.leftCount;
						flag2 = false;
					}
				}
				else if (node.rightCount < factor)
				{
					int num2 = factor - node.rightCount;
					if (CanBorrow(node, num2))
					{
						node2 = (node.right = CreateNode(node));
						node2.count = node.rightCount;
						Lend(node, node2, num2, toLeft: true);
						node.rightCount = node2.count;
						num += num2;
					}
					else
					{
						num += node.count;
						Lend(null, node, node.rightCount, toLeft: false);
						node.rightCount = 0;
						node2 = node;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					node2 = (node.right = CreateNode(node));
					node2.leftCount = factor * (num / factor);
					node2.count = factor;
					if (node2.leftCount + node2.count > node.rightCount)
					{
						node2.leftCount = node.rightCount - factor;
					}
					node2.rightCount = node.rightCount - (node2.leftCount + node2.count);
					num -= node2.leftCount;
					flag2 = false;
				}
				if (manageScrollCounts)
				{
					NodeExtended nodeExtended = (NodeExtended)node2;
					if (!flag2)
					{
						nodeExtended.leftScrollCount = (nodeExtended.leftVisibleCount = node2.leftCount);
						nodeExtended.scrollCount = (nodeExtended.visibleCount = node2.count);
						nodeExtended.rightScrollCount = (nodeExtended.rightVisibleCount = node2.rightCount);
						nodeExtended.ScrollCounts = null;
					}
					else
					{
						DirtyScrollCount(node2);
					}
				}
				if (node2 != node)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						DirtyScrollCount(node);
					}
					Maintain(node);
				}
			}
			indexVal = num;
			return node2;
		}

		private int GetNodeStartIndex(Node n)
		{
			int num = n.leftCount;
			while (n.parent != null)
			{
				if (n == n.parent.right)
				{
					num += n.parent.leftCount + n.parent.count;
				}
				else if (n != n.parent.left)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				n = n.parent;
			}
			if (n != tree)
			{
				num = -1;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int IndexOf(Node n, object item)
		{
			if (n.left != null)
			{
				int num = IndexOf(n.left, item);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			else if (item == null && n.leftCount > 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (n.arr != null)
			{
				int num = Array.IndexOf(n.arr, item, 0, n.count);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return num + n.leftCount;
				}
			}
			else if (item == null && n.count > 0)
			{
				return n.leftCount;
			}
			if (n.right != null)
			{
				int num = IndexOf(n.right, item);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return num + n.leftCount + n.count;
				}
			}
			else if (item == null && n.rightCount > 0)
			{
				return n.leftCount + n.count;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void ClearOwnerDataTreeWide(Node n)
		{
			if (n.left != null)
			{
				ClearOwnerDataTreeWide(n.left);
			}
			ClearOwnerData(n, 0, n.count);
			if (n.right != null)
			{
				ClearOwnerDataTreeWide(n.right);
			}
		}

		private void SetOwnerDataTreeWide(Node n)
		{
			if (n.left != null)
			{
				SetOwnerDataTreeWide(n.left);
			}
			SetOwnerDataHelper(n, 0, n.count);
			if (n.right != null)
			{
				SetOwnerDataTreeWide(n.right);
			}
		}

		private void CopyToHelper(Node n, Array array, ref int index)
		{
			if (n.left != null)
			{
				CopyToHelper(n.left, array, ref index);
			}
			else if (n.leftCount > 0)
			{
				Array.Clear(array, index, n.leftCount);
				index += n.leftCount;
			}
			if (n.arr != null)
			{
				Array.Copy(n.arr, 0, array, index, n.count);
			}
			else
			{
				Array.Clear(array, index, n.count);
			}
			index += n.count;
			if (n.right != null)
			{
				CopyToHelper(n.right, array, ref index);
			}
			else if (n.rightCount > 0)
			{
				Array.Clear(array, index, n.rightCount);
				index += n.rightCount;
			}
		}

		private Node CreateNode()
		{

		}

		private Node CreateNode(Node parent)
		{
			if (!manageScrollCounts)

				return new Node(parent);
			}
			if (_cacheScrollCounts)
			{
				return new NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache((NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache)parent);
			}
			return new NodeExtended((NodeExtended)parent);
		}

		private int GetNodeStartVisibleIndex(NodeExtended n)
		{

				{
					return -1;
				}
				n = nodeExtended;
			}

		}

				NodeExtended nodeExtended = (NodeExtended)n.parent;
				if (n == nodeExtended.right)
				{
					num += nodeExtended.leftScrollCount + nodeExtended.scrollCount;
				}
				else if (n != nodeExtended.left)
				{
					return -1;
				}

		private object CreateItemHelper(ICreateItemCallback createItemCallback, Node node, int nodeIndex, int overallIndex)
		{
			object obj = node.ItemsArray[nodeIndex];
			object obj2 = createItemCallback.CreateItem(this, overallIndex);
			node.ItemsArray[nodeIndex] = obj2;
			SetOwnerDataHelper(obj2, node);
			if (obj2 != null)
			{
				if (manageScrollCounts)
				{
					ISparseArrayMultiItem item = (ISparseArrayMultiItem)obj2;
					ISparseArrayMultiItem item2 = (ISparseArrayMultiItem)obj;
					int visibleDelta = GetItemVisibleCount(item) - GetItemVisibleCount(item2);
					int scrollDelta = GetItemScrollCount(item) - GetItemScrollCount(item2);
					ApplyScrollDelta((NodeExtended)node, visibleDelta, scrollDelta);
				}
				OnItemCreated(obj2, overallIndex);
			}
			return obj2;
		}

		private void ApplyScrollDelta(NodeExtended node, int visibleDelta, int scrollDelta)
		{
			if (visibleDelta == 0 && scrollDelta == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			NodeExtended nodeExtended = node;
			nodeExtended.visibleCount += visibleDelta;
			nodeExtended.scrollCount += scrollDelta;
			nodeExtended.ScrollCounts = NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache.g_dirtyFlag;
			while (nodeExtended.parent != null)
			{
				NodeExtended nodeExtended2 = (NodeExtended)nodeExtended.parent;
				if (nodeExtended == nodeExtended2.left)
				{
					nodeExtended2.leftVisibleCount += visibleDelta;
					nodeExtended2.leftScrollCount += scrollDelta;
				}
				else
				{
					nodeExtended2.rightVisibleCount += visibleDelta;
					nodeExtended2.rightScrollCount += scrollDelta;
				}
				nodeExtended = nodeExtended2;
			}
			OnScrollCountChanged();
		}

		private static int GetItemVisibleCount(ISparseArrayMultiItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (item.ScrollCount <= 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		private static int GetItemScrollCount(ISparseArrayMultiItem item)
		{
			return item?.ScrollCount ?? 1;
		}

		private void EnsureScrollCountCalculated()
		{
			bool inEnsureScrollCountCalculated = _inEnsureScrollCountCalculated;
			_inEnsureScrollCountCalculated = true;
			try
			{
				EnsureScrollCountCalculatedHelper((NodeExtended)tree);
				scrollCountInfoDirtyOnAllNodes = false;
				onScrollCountChangedCalledBefore = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				_inEnsureScrollCountCalculated = inEnsureScrollCountCalculated;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureScrollCountCalculatedHelper(NodeExtended n)
		{
			if (n.isLeftDirty || scrollCountInfoDirtyOnAllNodes)
			{
				NodeExtended nodeExtended = (NodeExtended)n.left;
				if (nodeExtended != null)
				{
					EnsureScrollCountCalculatedHelper(nodeExtended);
					n.leftVisibleCount = nodeExtended.TotalVisibleCount;
					n.leftScrollCount = nodeExtended.TotalScrollCount;
				}
				else
				{
					n.leftVisibleCount = n.leftCount;
					n.leftScrollCount = n.leftCount;
				}
			}
			if (n.isNodeDirty || scrollCountInfoDirtyOnAllNodes)
			{
				if (n.arr == null)
				{
					n.visibleCount = n.count;
					n.scrollCount = n.count;
					n.ScrollCounts = null;
				}
				else
				{
					int num = 0;
					int num2 = 0;
					int[] array = null;
					if (_cacheScrollCounts)
					{
						array = n.ScrollCounts;
						if (array == null || array.Length != n.count)
						{
							array = new int[n.count];
						}
						n.ScrollCounts = NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache.g_dirtyFlag;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < n.count; i++)
					{
						ISparseArrayMultiItem sparseArrayMultiItem = (ISparseArrayMultiItem)n.arr[i];
						if (sparseArrayMultiItem != null)
						{
							int scrollCount = sparseArrayMultiItem.ScrollCount;
							if (scrollCount < 0)
							{
								throw new InvalidOperationException(GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_2"));
							}
							num += ((scrollCount > 0) ? 1 : 0);
							num2 += scrollCount;
						}
						else
						{
							num++;
							num2++;
						}
						if (array != null)
						{
							array[i] = num2;
						}
					}
					n.visibleCount = num;
					n.scrollCount = num2;
					n.ScrollCounts = array;
				}
			}
			if (n.isRightDirty || scrollCountInfoDirtyOnAllNodes)
			{
				NodeExtended nodeExtended2 = (NodeExtended)n.right;
				if (nodeExtended2 != null)
				{
					EnsureScrollCountCalculatedHelper(nodeExtended2);
					n.rightVisibleCount = nodeExtended2.TotalVisibleCount;
					n.rightScrollCount = nodeExtended2.TotalScrollCount;
				}
				else
				{
					n.rightVisibleCount = n.rightCount;
					n.rightScrollCount = n.rightCount;
				}
			}
			n.isLeftDirty = (n.isNodeDirty = (n.isRightDirty = false));
		}

		private void DirtyScrollCount(Node node)
		{
			DirtyScrollCount(node, setIsNodeDirtyFlag: true, overallScrollCountChanged: false);
		}

		private void DirtyScrollCount_OverallScrollCountChanged(Node node)
		{
			DirtyScrollCount(node, setIsNodeDirtyFlag: true, overallScrollCountChanged: true);
		}

		private void DirtyScrollCount(Node node, bool setIsNodeDirtyFlag, bool overallScrollCountChanged)
		{
			if (!manageScrollCounts || scrollCountInfoDirtyOnAllNodes || node == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			NodeExtended nodeExtended = (NodeExtended)node;
			nodeExtended.isLeftDirty = (nodeExtended.isRightDirty = true);
			if (setIsNodeDirtyFlag)
			{
				nodeExtended.isNodeDirty = true;
				nodeExtended.ScrollCounts = NodeExtendedWithScrollCountCache.g_dirtyFlag;
			}
			while (nodeExtended.parent != null)
			{
				NodeExtended nodeExtended2 = (NodeExtended)nodeExtended.parent;
				if (nodeExtended == nodeExtended2.left)
				{
					if (nodeExtended2.isLeftDirty)
					{
						break;
					}
					nodeExtended2.isLeftDirty = true;
				}
				else
				{
					if (nodeExtended2.isRightDirty)
					{
						break;
					}
					nodeExtended2.isRightDirty = true;
				}
				nodeExtended = nodeExtended2;
			}
			if (overallScrollCountChanged && !onScrollCountChangedCalledBefore)
			{
				onScrollCountChangedCalledBefore = true;
				OnScrollCountChanged();
			}
		}

		private void ReplaceAllItems(ICollection newItems)
		{
			bool flag = onScrollCountChangedCalledBefore;
			onScrollCountChangedCalledBefore = true;
			try
			{
				Clear(raiseOnScrollCountChanged: false, clearOwnerData: true);
				AddRange(newItems);
			}
			finally
			{
				onScrollCountChangedCalledBefore = flag;
			}
			DirtyScrollCountInfo();
		}

	public class WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue> : IDictionary<TKey, TValue>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>, IEnumerable
	{
		private class Entry
		{
			private object _key;

			private object _value;

			internal int _hash;

			internal Entry _next;

			public Entry(int hash, object key, object value)
			{
				_hash = hash;
				_key = key;
				_value = value;
			}

			internal TKey GetKey(WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue> wd)
			{
				object obj = _key;
				if (wd._keysAsWeakReferences)
				{
					obj = WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue>.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe((WeakReference)obj);
				}
				return (TKey)obj;
			}

			internal TValue GetValue(WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue> wd)
			{
				object obj = _value;
				if (wd._valuesAsWeakReferences)
				{
					obj = WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue>.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe((WeakReference)obj);
				}
				return (TValue)obj;
			}

			internal void SetValue(WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue> wd, TValue value)
			{
				_value = (wd._valuesAsWeakReferences ? wd.CreateValueWeakReference(value) : ((object)value));
			}

			internal bool HasKey(WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue> wd)
			{
				return GetKey(wd) != null;
			}

			internal bool HasValue(WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue> wd)
			{
				return GetValue(wd) != null;
			}

			internal bool IsSameKey(WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue> wd, TKey key)
			{
				TKey key2 = GetKey(wd);
				return wd._keyComparer.Equals(key, key2);
			}

			internal bool IsSameValue(WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue> wd, TValue value)
			{
				TValue value2 = GetValue(wd);
				return object.Equals(value, value2);
			}
		}

		private class EntryEnumerable : IEnumerable<Entry>, IEnumerable
		{
			internal abstract class CollectionBase
			{
				protected WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue> _wd;

				public int Count => _wd.Count;

				public bool IsSynchronized => false;

				public object SyncRoot => _wd;

				internal CollectionBase(WeakDictionary<TKey, TValue> wd)
				{
					_wd = wd;
				}

				protected void NotSupported()
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();

			IEqualityComparer<TKey> keyComparer2;

		private void AddHelper(TKey key, TValue value, bool replace)
		{

				if (entry2 != null)

					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_7"));
					}
					entry2.SetValue(this, value);
					_version++;
					return;
				}
			}
			Entry entry3 = new Entry(hashCode, _keysAsWeakReferences ? CreateKeyWeakReference(key) : ((object)key), _valuesAsWeakReferences ? CreateValueWeakReference(value) : ((object)value));
			entry3._next = entry;
			_arr[index] = entry3;
			_count++;
			_version++;

		}

		{

		{

		}

					_current = _list[_index];

				_index = -1;

		{
			WeakReference weakReference = _list[index];

			if (weakReference != null)

				val = (T)CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(weakReference);

			if (item is T)
			{
				return Contains((T)item);
			}
			return false;
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _list.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				array.SetValue(GetItemHelper(i), index++);
			}
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object item)
		{
			if (!(item is T))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return IndexOf((T)item);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object item)
		{
			Insert(index, (T)item);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object item)
		{
			if (item is T)
			{
				Remove((T)item);
			}
		}
	}
	public class WeakList : WeakList<object>
	{
	}
	internal class WeakSet<T> : ISet<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable where T : class
	{
		private static object Value = new object();

		private WeakDictionary<T, object> _items;

		public int Count => _items.Count;

		bool ICollection<T>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public WeakSet()
		{
			_items = new WeakDictionary<T, object>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: false);
		}

		public bool Add(T item)
		{
			if (!_items.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				_items.Add(item, Value);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_items.Clear();
		}

		public void Compact()
		{
			_items.Compact(removeEntriesWithNullValues: true);
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return _items.ContainsKey(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			using IEnumerator<T> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				T current = enumerator.Current;
				array[arrayIndex++] = current;
			}
		}

		public void ExceptWith(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (T item in other)
			{
				_items.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public void IntersectWith(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			foreach (T item in other)
			{
				if (Contains(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			Clear();
			UnionWith(list);
		}

		public bool IsProperSubsetOf(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			return IsSubsetSupersetOfHelper(this, ToSet(other), proper: true, checkSuperset: false);
		}

		public bool IsProperSupersetOf(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			return IsSubsetSupersetOfHelper(this, ToSet(other), proper: true, checkSuperset: true);
		}

		public bool IsSubsetOf(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			return IsSubsetSupersetOfHelper(this, ToSet(other), proper: false, checkSuperset: false);
		}

		public bool IsSupersetOf(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			return IsSubsetSupersetOfHelper(this, ToSet(other), proper: false, checkSuperset: true);
		}

		public bool Overlaps(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			if (other != null)
			{
				foreach (T item in other)
				{
					if (Contains(item))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			return _items.Remove(item);
		}

		public bool SetEquals(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			if (other != null)
			{
				ISet<T> set = ToSet(other);
				using (IEnumerator<T> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						T current = enumerator.Current;
						if (!set.Contains(current))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (T item in set)
				{
					if (!Contains(item))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void SymmetricExceptWith(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			List<T> list2 = new List<T>();
			foreach (T item in other)
			{
				if (Contains(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					list2.Add(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (T item2 in list)
			{
				Remove(item2);
			}
			foreach (T item3 in list2)
			{
				Add(item3);
			}
		}

		public List<T> ToList()
		{
			return this.Select((T x) => x).ToList();
		}

		public void UnionWith(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (T item in other)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsSubsetSupersetOfHelper(ISet<T> s1, ISet<T> s2, bool proper, bool checkSuperset)
		{
			if (s1 == null || s2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (proper)
			{
				bool flag = CoreUtilities.GetFirstItem(s1) != null;
				bool result = CoreUtilities.GetFirstItem(s2) != null;
				if (checkSuperset)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!flag)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			if (checkSuperset)
			{
				foreach (T item in s2)
				{
					if (!s1.Contains(item))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (T item2 in s1)
				{
					if (!s2.Contains(item2))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static ISet<T> ToSet(IEnumerable<T> other)
		{
			ISet<T> set = other as ISet<T>;
			if (set == null && other != null)
			{
				set = new HashSet<T>(other);
			}
			return set;
		}

		void ICollection<T>.Add(T item)
		{
			Add(item);
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			IEnumerable<T> keys = _items.Keys;
			return keys.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class CollectionBase<T> : ICollectionBase<T>, ICollectionBase, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged, IDisposable, IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private Collection<T> _items;

		private object _syncRoot;

		private Dictionary<int, T> _unIndexedItems;

		private Dictionary<T, int> _unIndexedItemsReverse;

		protected virtual Collection<T> Items => _items;

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return GetItem(index);
			}
			set
			{
				ReplaceItem(index, value);
			}
		}

		public int Count => GetCount();

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => ((IList)_items)?.IsFixedSize ?? false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				this[index] = (T)value;
			}
		}

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot
		{
			get
			{
				if (_syncRoot == null)
				{
					ICollection items = _items;
					if (items != null)
					{
						_syncRoot = items.SyncRoot;
					}
					else
					{
						Interlocked.CompareExchange<object>(ref _syncRoot, new object(), (object)null);
					}
				}
				return _syncRoot;
			}
		}

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		private event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		public CollectionBase()
		{
			_items = new Collection<T>();
			_unIndexedItems = new Dictionary<int, T>();
			_unIndexedItemsReverse = new Dictionary<T, int>();
		}

		protected virtual void OnNotifyCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			switch (args.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				OnPropertyChanged("Count");
				break;
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected virtual T GetItem(int index)
		{
			return ResolveItem(index);
		}

		protected virtual void AddItem(int index, T item)
		{
			AddItemSilently(index, item);
			OnItemAdded(index, item);
		}

		protected virtual void InsertItem(int index, T item)
		{
			AddItemSilently(index, item);
			OnItemAdded(index, item);
		}

		protected virtual void AddItemSilently(int index, T item)
		{
			if (index > _items.Count)
			{
				_unIndexedItems.Add(index, item);
				_unIndexedItemsReverse.Add(item, index);
			}
			else
			{
				_items.Insert(index, item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAdded(int index, T item)
		{
			OnNotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, item, index));
		}

		protected virtual bool RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			T item = this[index];
			bool flag = RemoveItemSilently(index);
			if (flag)
			{
				OnItemRemoved(index, item);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected virtual bool RemoveItemSilently(int index)
		{
			bool result = false;
			T value = default(T);
			if (_unIndexedItems.TryGetValue(index, out value))
			{
				result = true;
				_unIndexedItems.Remove(index);
				_unIndexedItemsReverse.Remove(value);
			}
			else if (index >= 0 && index < _items.Count)
			{
				value = _items[index];
				result = _items.Remove(value);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemoved(int index, T item)
		{
			OnNotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, item, index));
		}

		protected virtual void ResetItems()
		{
			ResetItemsSilently();
			OnResetItems();
		}

		protected virtual void ResetItemsSilently()
		{
			_items.Clear();
			_unIndexedItems.Clear();
			_unIndexedItemsReverse.Clear();
		}

		protected virtual void OnResetItems()
		{
			OnNotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		protected virtual void ReplaceItem(int index, T newItem)
		{
			T val = ResolveItem(index);
			if (_unIndexedItems.ContainsKey(index))
			{
				_unIndexedItems[index] = newItem;
				_unIndexedItemsReverse.Remove(val);
				_unIndexedItemsReverse.Add(newItem, index);
			}
			else if (index < _items.Count)
			{
				_items[index] = newItem;
			}
			else
			{
				AddItemSilently(index, newItem);
			}
			OnNotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, newItem, val, index));
		}

		protected virtual int GetCount()
		{
			return _items.Count;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		private T ResolveItem(int index)
		{
			if (index > -1 && index < _items.Count)
			{
				return _items[index];
			}
			if (_unIndexedItems.TryGetValue(index, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		public virtual int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int value = -1;
			if (_unIndexedItemsReverse.TryGetValue(item, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return _items.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public virtual void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			InsertItem(index, item);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveItem(index);
		}

		public virtual void Add(T item)
		{
			AddItem(Count, item);
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			ResetItems();
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			if (item == null || !_unIndexedItemsReverse.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				return _items.Contains(item);
			}
			return true;
		}

		void ICollection<T>.CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			for (int i = arrayIndex; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = GetItem(i);
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			return RemoveItem(IndexOf(item));
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new CollectionBaseEnumerator<T>(this);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (value is T)
			{
				Add((T)value);
				return Count;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			if (value is T)
			{
				return Contains((T)value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			if (value is T)
			{
				return IndexOf((T)value);
			}
			return -1;
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value is T)
			{
				Insert(index, (T)value);
			}
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			if (value is T)
			{
				Remove((T)value);
			}
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			int count = GetCount();
			for (int i = index; i < count; i++)
			{
				array.SetValue(GetItem(i), i);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		void ICollectionBase<T>.AddItemSilently(int index, T item)
		{
			AddItemSilently(index, item);
		}

		void ICollectionBase.AddItemSilently(int index, object item)
		{
			AddItemSilently(index, (T)item);
		}

		bool ICollectionBase.RemoveItemSilently(int index)
		{
			return RemoveItemSilently(index);
		}

		void ICollectionBase.ResetItemsSilently()
		{
			ResetItemsSilently();
		}
	}
	public class CollectionBaseEnumerator<T> : IEnumerator<T>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
	{
		private int _index;

		private T _current;

		private CollectionBase<T> _collection;

		object IEnumerator.Current => _current;

		T IEnumerator<T>.Current => _current;

		public CollectionBaseEnumerator(CollectionBase<T> collection)
		{
			_index = 0;
			_collection = collection;
			_current = default(T);
		}

		bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
		{
			if (_index < _collection.Count)
			{
				_current = _collection[_index];
				_index++;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IEnumerator.Reset()
		{
			_index = 0;
			_current = default(T);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Controls

	[Flags]
	public enum DayOfWeekFlags
	{
		None = 0,
		Sunday = 1,
		Monday = 2,
		Tuesday = 4,
		Wednesday = 8,
		Thursday = 0x10,
		Friday = 0x20,
		Saturday = 0x40
	}
	internal class CalendarHelper
	{
		internal enum DateTimeOffsetType : byte
		{
			Days,
			Weeks,
			Months,
			Years,
			Hours,
			Minutes,
			Seconds
		}

		private System.Globalization.Calendar _calendar;

		private DateTimeFormatInfo _dateTimeFormat;

		internal const DayOfWeekFlags AllDays = DayOfWeekFlags.Sunday | DayOfWeekFlags.Monday | DayOfWeekFlags.Tuesday | DayOfWeekFlags.Wednesday | DayOfWeekFlags.Thursday | DayOfWeekFlags.Friday | DayOfWeekFlags.Saturday;

		public System.Globalization.Calendar Calendar => _calendar;

		public DateTimeFormatInfo DateTimeFormat => _dateTimeFormat;

		public virtual DateTime MaxSupportedDateTime => GetMaxSupportedDateTime(_calendar);

		public virtual DateTime MinSupportedDateTime => GetMinSupportedDateTime(_calendar);

		public CalendarHelper(CultureInfo culture)
			: this(culture.Calendar, culture.DateTimeFormat)
		{
		}

		public CalendarHelper(System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo)
		{
			Initialize(calendar, formatInfo);
		}

		protected virtual void VerifyCanChange()
		{
		}

		protected void Initialize(System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo)
		{
			if (_calendar != null)
			{
				VerifyCanChange();
			}
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(calendar, "calendar");
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(formatInfo, "formatInfo");
			_calendar = calendar;
			_dateTimeFormat = formatInfo;
		}

		internal DateTime CoerceMinMaxDate(DateTime date)
		{
			date = date.Date;
			if (date < MinSupportedDateTime)
			{
				date = MinSupportedDateTime;
			}
			else if (date > MaxSupportedDateTime)
			{
				date = MaxSupportedDateTime;
			}
			return date;
		}

		internal DateTime GetMinMaxDate(bool min)
		{
			if (!min)
			{
				return MaxSupportedDateTime;
			}
			return MinSupportedDateTime;
		}

		internal static DateTime GetMinMax(System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, bool min)
		{
			if (!min)
			{
				return GetMaxSupportedDateTime(calendar);
			}
			return GetMinSupportedDateTime(calendar);
		}

		internal static DateTime GetMaxSupportedDateTime(System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			return calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime;
		}

		internal static DateTime GetMinSupportedDateTime(System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			return calendar.MinSupportedDateTime;
		}

		internal static DateTime GetNonInclusiveEnd(DateTime date)
		{
			if (date.Ticks <= 10000000)
			{
				return DateTime.MinValue;
			}
			return date.AddSeconds(-1.0);
		}

		internal static int GetVisibleDayCount(DayOfWeekFlags hiddenDays, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek, DayOfWeek dayOfWeek)
		{
			int num = (int)dayOfWeek;
			int num2 = 0;
			if ((int)firstDayOfWeek > num)
			{
				num += 7;
			}
			while (num >= (int)firstDayOfWeek)
			{
				if (!IsSet(hiddenDays, (DayOfWeek)num))
				{
					num2++;
				}
				num--;
			}
			return num2 - 1;
		}

		internal bool IsSameMonth(DateTime date1, DateTime date2)
		{
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = _calendar;
			if (calendar.GetEra(date1) != calendar.GetEra(date2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (calendar.GetYear(date1) != calendar.GetYear(date2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (calendar.GetMonth(date1) != calendar.GetMonth(date2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsSet(DayOfWeekFlags days, DayOfWeek day)
		{
			return ((uint)(1 << (int)day) & (uint)days) != 0;
		}

		public DateTime AddDays(DateTime date, int days)
		{
			return ConstrainDate(AddDays(date, days, _calendar));
		}

		internal static DateTime AddDays(DateTime date, int days, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			try
			{
				return calendar.AddDays(date, days);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return GetMinMax(calendar, days < 0);
			}
		}

		internal DateTime AddHours(DateTime date, int hours)
		{
			return ConstrainDate(AddHours(date, hours, _calendar));
		}

		internal static DateTime AddHours(DateTime date, int hours, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			try
			{
				return calendar.AddHours(date, hours);
			}
			catch (ArgumentOutOfRangeException)
			{
				return GetMinMax(calendar, hours < 0);
			}
		}

		public DateTime AddMinutes(DateTime date, int minutes)
		{
			return ConstrainDate(AddMinutes(date, minutes, _calendar));
		}

		internal static DateTime AddMinutes(DateTime date, int minutes, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)

			try

				return calendar.AddMinutes(date, minutes);

				return calendar.AddMonths(date, months);

		public DateTime AddYears(DateTime date, int years)
		{
			return ConstrainDate(AddYears(date, years, _calendar));
		}

		internal static DateTime AddYears(DateTime date, int years, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			try
			{
				return calendar.AddYears(date, years);
			}
			catch (ArgumentOutOfRangeException)
			{
				return GetMinMax(calendar, years < 0);
			}
		}

		public DateTime ConstrainDate(DateTime date)
		{
			DateTime minSupportedDateTime = MinSupportedDateTime;
			if (date < minSupportedDateTime)
			{
				return minSupportedDateTime;
			}
			DateTime maxSupportedDateTime = MaxSupportedDateTime;
			if (!(date < maxSupportedDateTime))
			{
				return maxSupportedDateTime;
			}
			return date;
		}

		internal static DayOfWeek GetFirstDayOfWeek(DayOfWeek? dow, DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormat)
		{
			if (dow.HasValue)
			{
				return dow.Value;
			}
			return dateTimeFormat.FirstDayOfWeek;
		}

		public DateTime GetFirstDayOfWeekForDate(DateTime date, DayOfWeek? firstDayOfWeek, out int additionalOffset)
		{
			return GetFirstDayOfWeekForDate(date, GetFirstDayOfWeek(firstDayOfWeek, _dateTimeFormat), _calendar, out additionalOffset);
		}

		internal static DateTime GetFirstDayOfWeekForDate(DateTime date, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, out int additionalOffset)
		{
			int dayOfWeekNumber = GetDayOfWeekNumber(date, DayOfWeekFlags.None, firstDayOfWeek, calendar);
			try
			{
				date = calendar.AddDays(date, -dayOfWeekNumber);
				additionalOffset = 0;
			}
			catch
			{
				additionalOffset = dayOfWeekNumber - (date - GetMinSupportedDateTime(calendar)).Days;
				date = GetMinSupportedDateTime(calendar);
			}
			return date;
		}

		public int GetDaysInMonth(DateTime date)
		{
			return GetDaysInMonth(date, _calendar);
		}

		internal static int GetDaysInMonth(DateTime date, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			int month = calendar.GetMonth(date);
			int year = calendar.GetYear(date);
			int era = calendar.GetEra(date);
			return calendar.GetDaysInMonth(year, month, era);
		}

		public int GetDaysInYear(DateTime date)
		{
			return GetDaysInYear(date, _calendar);
		}

		internal static int GetDaysInYear(DateTime date, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			int year = calendar.GetYear(date);
			int era = calendar.GetEra(date);
			return calendar.GetDaysInYear(year, era);
		}

		public int GetDayOfMonth(DateTime date)
		{
			return _calendar.GetDayOfMonth(date);
		}

		public DayOfWeek GetDayOfWeek(DateTime date)
		{
			return _calendar.GetDayOfWeek(date);
		}

		public int GetDayOfWeekNumber(DateTime date, DayOfWeekFlags hiddenDays, DayOfWeek? firstDayOfWeek)
		{
			return GetDayOfWeekNumber(date, hiddenDays, GetFirstDayOfWeek(firstDayOfWeek, _dateTimeFormat), _calendar);
		}

		internal static int GetDayOfWeekNumber(DateTime date, DayOfWeekFlags hiddenDays, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			if (hiddenDays != DayOfWeekFlags.None)
			{
				return GetVisibleDayCount(hiddenDays, firstDayOfWeek, calendar.GetDayOfWeek(date));
			}
			DayOfWeek dayOfWeek = calendar.GetDayOfWeek(date);
			return (dayOfWeek - firstDayOfWeek + 7) % 7;
		}

		internal int GetDayOfYear(DateTime date)
		{
			return _calendar.GetDayOfYear(date);
		}

		internal static DateTime GetFirstWeekOfYearDate(int year, int? era, CalendarWeekRule weekRule, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, out int additionalOffset)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = ((!era.HasValue) ? calendar.ToDateTime(year, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0) : calendar.ToDateTime(year, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, era.Value));
			DayOfWeek dayOfWeek = calendar.GetDayOfWeek(dateTime);
			int num = dayOfWeek - firstDayOfWeek;
			int num2 = 0;
			switch (weekRule)
			{
			case CalendarWeekRule.FirstFourDayWeek:
				num2 = ((num <= 3) ? ((num >= -3) ? (-num) : (-(7 + num))) : (7 - num));
				break;
			case CalendarWeekRule.FirstFullWeek:
				if (num > 0)
				{
					num2 = 7 - num;
				}
				else if (num < 0)
				{
					num2 = -num;
				}
				break;
			default:
				num2 = ((num >= 0) ? (-num) : (-(7 + num)));
				break;
			}
			try
			{
				dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(num2);
				additionalOffset = 0;
			}
			catch
			{
				additionalOffset = num2 - (GetMinSupportedDateTime(calendar) - dateTime).Days;
				dateTime = GetMinSupportedDateTime(calendar);
			}
			return dateTime;
		}

		public int GetMonthNumber(DateTime date)
		{
			return _calendar.GetMonth(date);
		}

		public int GetWeekNumberForDate(DateTime date, CalendarWeekRule? weekRule, DayOfWeek? firstDayOfWeek, out int yearContainingWeek)
		{
			return GetWeekNumberForDate(date, GetWeekRule(weekRule, _dateTimeFormat), GetFirstDayOfWeek(firstDayOfWeek, _dateTimeFormat), _calendar, out yearContainingWeek);
		}

		internal static int GetWeekNumberForDate(DateTime date, CalendarWeekRule weekRule, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, out int yearContainingWeek)
		{
			int num = calendar.GetYear(date);
			if (num < calendar.GetYear(GetMaxSupportedDateTime(calendar)))
			{
				num++;
			}
			int era = calendar.GetEra(date);
			int additionalOffset;
			DateTime firstWeekOfYearDate = GetFirstWeekOfYearDate(num, era, weekRule, firstDayOfWeek, calendar, out additionalOffset);
			while (firstWeekOfYearDate > date)
			{
				if (num == 1)
				{
					yearContainingWeek = 0;
					return 0;
				}
				firstWeekOfYearDate = GetFirstWeekOfYearDate(--num, era, weekRule, firstDayOfWeek, calendar, out additionalOffset);
			}
			yearContainingWeek = num;
			return ((date - firstWeekOfYearDate).Days - additionalOffset) / 7 + 1;
		}

		internal static CalendarWeekRule GetWeekRule(CalendarWeekRule? rule, DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormat)
		{
			if (rule.HasValue)
			{
				return rule.Value;
			}
			return dateTimeFormat.CalendarWeekRule;
		}

		public int GetYear(DateTime date)
		{
			return _calendar.GetYear(date);
		}

		public bool TryAddOffset(DateTime date, int offset, DateTimeOffsetType offsetType, out DateTime adjustedDate)
		{
			try
			{
				switch (offsetType)
				{
				case DateTimeOffsetType.Days:
					adjustedDate = _calendar.AddDays(date, offset);
					break;
				case DateTimeOffsetType.Weeks:
					adjustedDate = _calendar.AddWeeks(date, offset);
					break;
				case DateTimeOffsetType.Months:
					adjustedDate = _calendar.AddMonths(date, offset);
					break;
				case DateTimeOffsetType.Years:
					adjustedDate = _calendar.AddYears(date, offset);
					break;
				case DateTimeOffsetType.Hours:
					adjustedDate = _calendar.AddHours(date, offset);
					break;
				case DateTimeOffsetType.Minutes:
					adjustedDate = _calendar.AddMinutes(date, offset);
					break;
				case DateTimeOffsetType.Seconds:
					adjustedDate = _calendar.AddSeconds(date, offset);
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				adjustedDate = ConstrainDate(adjustedDate);
				return true;
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				adjustedDate = ConstrainDate(GetMinMax(_calendar, offset < 0));
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class DialogManager
	{
		internal class CloseDialogHelper<T>
		{
			private T _context;

			private Action<bool?, T> _closeAction;

			internal CloseDialogHelper(Action<bool?, T> closeAction, T closeContext)
			{
				_context = closeContext;
				_closeAction = closeAction;
			}

			public void OnClosed(bool? dialogResult)
			{
				_closeAction(dialogResult, _context);
			}
		}

		private static bool _getOwnerHwndFailed;

		internal static void ActivateDialog(FrameworkElement dialog)
		{
			if (dialog is Window)
			{
				((Window)dialog).Activate();
			}
			else if (dialog is ToolWindow)
			{
				((ToolWindow)dialog).Activate();
			}
		}

		internal static void CloseDialog(FrameworkElement dialogElement)
		{
			if (dialogElement is Window window)
			{
				window.Close();
			}
			else if (dialogElement is ToolWindow toolWindow)
			{
				toolWindow.Close();
			}
		}

		internal static FrameworkElement DisplayDialog(FrameworkElement container, FrameworkElement dialogContents, System.Windows.Size dialogSize, bool resizable, object header, bool showModally, ResourceDictionary resources, Func<bool> closingCallback, Action<bool?> closedCallback)
		{
			return DisplayDialog(container, dialogContents, dialogSize, resizable, header, showModally, resources, closingCallback, closedCallback, resizeSilverlightWindowToFitInBrowser: false);
		}

		internal static FrameworkElement DisplayDialog(FrameworkElement container, FrameworkElement dialogContents, System.Windows.Size dialogSize, bool resizable, object header, bool showModally, ResourceDictionary resources, Func<bool> closingCallback, Action<bool?> closedCallback, bool resizeSilverlightWindowToFitInBrowser)
		{
			Window window = container as Window;
			if (window == null && !BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				window = PresentationUtilities.GetVisualAncestor<Window>(container, null);
			}
			if (dialogContents is Window)
			{
				Window window2 = dialogContents as Window;
				window2.Title = ((header == null) ? string.Empty : header.ToString());
				window2.ResizeMode = (resizable ? ResizeMode.CanResizeWithGrip : ResizeMode.NoResize);
				window2.Owner = window;
				if (window == null)
				{
					IntPtr ownerHwnd = GetOwnerHwnd(container);
					if (IntPtr.Zero != ownerHwnd)
					{
						SetWindowOwner(dialogContents as Window, ownerHwnd);
					}
				}
				if (!resizable)
				{
					window2.WindowStyle = WindowStyle.ToolWindow;
				}
				Utilities.EnableModelessKeyboardInteropForWindow(window2);
				if (showModally)
				{
					window2.WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner;
				}
				if (dialogSize != System.Windows.Size.Empty)
				{
					dialogContents.Width = dialogSize.Width;
					dialogContents.Height = dialogSize.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					window2.SizeToContent = SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight;
				}
				if (resources != null)
				{
					dialogContents.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(resources);
				}
				window2.Loaded += delegate(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
				{
					DispatcherOperationCallback method = delegate(object param)
					{
						((Window)param).MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
						return (object)null;
					};
					((Window)sender).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Loaded, method, sender);
				};
				window2.Closing += delegate(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
				{
					Window window3 = sender as Window;
					if (closingCallback != null && closingCallback())
					{
						e.Cancel = true;
					}
					if (!showModally && !e.Cancel)
					{
						window3.Owner = null;
					}
				};
				if (closedCallback != null)
				{
					window2.Closed += delegate
					{
						closedCallback(window2.DialogResult);
					};
				}
				if (showModally)
				{
					((Window)dialogContents).ShowDialog();
				}
				else
				{
					((Window)dialogContents).Show();
				}
				return dialogContents;
			}
			ToolWindow toolWindow = new ToolWindow();
			toolWindow.Content = dialogContents;
			toolWindow.ResizeMode = (resizable ? ResizeMode.CanResizeWithGrip : ResizeMode.NoResize);
			toolWindow.Title = ((header == null) ? string.Empty : header.ToString());
			if (dialogSize != System.Windows.Size.Empty)
			{
				toolWindow.Width = dialogSize.Width;
				toolWindow.Height = dialogSize.Height;
			}
			if (!resizable)
			{
				ToolWindow toolWindow2 = toolWindow;
				bool allowMaximize = (toolWindow.AllowMinimize = false);
				toolWindow2.AllowMaximize = allowMaximize;
			}
			if (showModally)
			{
				toolWindow.WindowStartupLocation = ToolWindowStartupLocation.CenterOwnerWindow;
			}
			if (resources != null)
			{
				toolWindow.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(resources);
			}
			toolWindow.Loaded += delegate(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				DispatcherOperationCallback method = delegate(object param)
				{
					((ToolWindow)param).MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
					return (object)null;
				};
				((ToolWindow)sender).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Loaded, method, sender);
			};
			if (closingCallback != null)
			{
				toolWindow.Closing += delegate(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
				{
					if (closingCallback())
					{
						e.Cancel = true;
					}
				};
			}
			if (closedCallback != null)
			{
				toolWindow.Closed += delegate
				{
					closedCallback(toolWindow.DialogResult);
				};
			}
			FrameworkElement owner = container ?? window;
			if (showModally)
			{
				toolWindow.ShowDialog(owner, null);
			}
			else
			{
				toolWindow.Show(owner);
			}
			return toolWindow;
		}

		internal static IntPtr GetOwnerHwnd(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			if (_getOwnerHwndFailed)
			{
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			if (BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			try
			{
				return GetOwnerHwndImpl(owner);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				_getOwnerHwndFailed = true;
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static IntPtr GetOwnerHwndImpl(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			if (!(PresentationSource.FromVisual(owner) is HwndSource hwndSource))
			{
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			return hwndSource.Handle;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static void SetWindowOwner(Window window, IntPtr ownerHwnd)
		{
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(window);
			windowInteropHelper.Owner = ownerHwnd;
		}
	}
	internal class DialogElementProxy : IDisposable
	{
		private bool _isInitialized;

		private FrameworkElement _childElement;

		private FrameworkElement _dialogElement;

		internal FrameworkElement DialogElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (_dialogElement == null)
				{
					_dialogElement = ToolWindow.GetToolWindow(_childElement);
					if (_dialogElement == null)
					{
						_dialogElement = PresentationUtilities.GetVisualAncestor<Window>(_childElement, null);
					}
				}
				return _dialogElement;
			}
		}

		internal DialogElementProxy(FrameworkElement childElement)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(childElement, "childElement");
			if (!(childElement is IDialogElementProxyHost))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_DoesNotImplementInterface", "IDialogElementProxyHost"), "childElement");
			}
			_childElement = childElement;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (_childElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_dialogElement != null)
			{
				if (BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
				{
					((ToolWindow)_dialogElement).Closing -= OnWindowClosing;
				}
				else if (_dialogElement is Window)
				{
					((Window)_dialogElement).Closing -= OnWindowClosing;
				}
				else if (_dialogElement is ToolWindow)
				{
					((ToolWindow)_dialogElement).Closing -= OnWindowClosing;
				}
				_dialogElement = null;
			}
			_isInitialized = false;
			_childElement = null;
		}

		internal void Close()
		{
			DialogManager.CloseDialog(DialogElement);
		}

		internal void Initialize()
		{
			if (_isInitialized || DialogElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				if (DialogElement is ToolWindow)
				{
					((ToolWindow)DialogElement).Closing += OnWindowClosing;
				}
			}
			else if (DialogElement is Window)
			{
				((Window)DialogElement).Closing += OnWindowClosing;
			}
			else if (DialogElement is ToolWindow)
			{
				((ToolWindow)DialogElement).Closing += OnWindowClosing;
			}
			_isInitialized = true;
		}

		internal void SetDialogResult(bool result)
		{
			FrameworkElement dialogElement = DialogElement;
			if (dialogElement is Window)
			{
				((Window)dialogElement).DialogResult = result;
			}
			else if (dialogElement is ToolWindow toolWindow)
			{
				if (toolWindow.IsModal)
				{
					toolWindow.DialogResult = result;
				}
				else
				{
					toolWindow.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnWindowClosing(object sender, CancelEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!args.Cancel)
			{
				args.Cancel = ((IDialogElementProxyHost)_childElement).OnClosing();
			}
		}
	}
	internal interface IDialogElementProxyHost
	{
		bool OnClosing();
	}
	internal class KeyEventTracker
	{
		private DependencyObject _focusedElement;

		internal DependencyObject FocusedElement => _focusedElement;

		internal event EventHandler FocusedElementChanged;

		internal event System.Windows.Input.KeyEventHandler KeyEvent;

		internal KeyEventTracker()
		{
		}

		internal void Activate()
		{
			if (_focusedElement == null)
			{
				Hook(PresentationUtilities.GetElementWithKeyboardFocus());
			}
		}

		internal void Deactivate()
		{
			if (_focusedElement != null)
			{
				Unhook(_focusedElement, raiseEvents: true);
			}
		}

		private void Hook(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element != _focusedElement)
			{
				if (_focusedElement != null)
				{
					Unhook(_focusedElement, raiseEvents: false);
				}
				if (element is IInputElement inputElement)
				{
					_focusedElement = element;
					inputElement.LostKeyboardFocus += OnElementLostKeyboardFocus;
					inputElement.KeyDown += OnElementKey;
					inputElement.KeyUp += OnElementKey;
					inputElement.PreviewKeyDown += OnElementKey;
					inputElement.PreviewKeyUp += OnElementKey;
				}
				RaiseFocusedElementChange();
			}
		}

		private void OnElementKey(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			this.KeyEvent?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		private void OnElementLostKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource == _focusedElement && e.OldFocus == _focusedElement)
			{
				Hook(e.NewFocus as DependencyObject);
			}
		}

		private void RaiseFocusedElementChange()
		{
			this.FocusedElementChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void Unhook(DependencyObject element, bool raiseEvents)
		{
			if (element == _focusedElement && element != null)
			{
				_focusedElement = null;
				if (element is IInputElement inputElement)
				{
					inputElement.LostKeyboardFocus -= OnElementLostKeyboardFocus;
					inputElement.KeyDown -= OnElementKey;
					inputElement.KeyUp += OnElementKey;
					inputElement.PreviewKeyDown -= OnElementKey;
					inputElement.PreviewKeyUp -= OnElementKey;
				}
				if (raiseEvents)
				{
					RaiseFocusedElementChange();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class LostFocusTracker
	{
		private Action _callback;

		private UIElement _element;

		private IInputElement _elementWithFocus;

		internal DependencyObject ElementWithFocus => _elementWithFocus as DependencyObject;

		internal bool IsActive => _elementWithFocus != null;

		internal LostFocusTracker(UIElement element, Action callback)
		{
			_element = element;
			_callback = callback;
			VerfiyIsFocusWithin();
		}

		internal void Deactivate(bool forceLostFocusBindingUpdates)
		{
			if (_elementWithFocus != null)
			{
				if (forceLostFocusBindingUpdates)
				{
					PresentationUtilities.ForceLostFocusBindingUpdate(_element, _elementWithFocus as DependencyObject);
				}
				_elementWithFocus.LostKeyboardFocus -= OnElementWithFocus_LostFocus;
				_elementWithFocus = null;
			}
			_element = null;
			_callback = null;
		}

		private void OnElementWithFocus_LostFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_elementWithFocus != null)
			{
				_elementWithFocus.LostKeyboardFocus -= OnElementWithFocus_LostFocus;
				VerfiyIsFocusWithin();
			}
		}

		private void VerfiyIsFocusWithin()
		{
			DependencyObject elementWithKeyboardFocus = PresentationUtilities.GetElementWithKeyboardFocus();
			bool flag = elementWithKeyboardFocus != null && PresentationUtilities.IsAncestorOf(_element, elementWithKeyboardFocus);
			if (flag)
			{
				_elementWithFocus = elementWithKeyboardFocus as IInputElement;
				if (_elementWithFocus != null)
				{
					_elementWithFocus.LostKeyboardFocus += OnElementWithFocus_LostFocus;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (_callback != null)
				{
					Action callback = _callback;
					_callback = null;
					callback();
				}
				_element = null;
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class PresentationUtilities
	{
		internal static RelativeSource RelativeSourceSelf = RelativeSource.Self;

		internal static RelativeSource RelativeSourceTemplatedParent = RelativeSource.TemplatedParent;

		internal const ModifierKeys AllModifiers = ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift | ModifierKeys.Windows;

		internal const ModifierKeys AltModifier = ModifierKeys.Alt;

		internal static System.Windows.Data.Binding CreateBinding(params BindingPart[] parts)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			for (int i = 0; i < parts.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append('.');
				}
				BindingPart bindingPart = parts[i];
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("({0})", i);
				stringBuilder.Append(bindingPart.Path);
				list.Add(bindingPart.PathParameter);
			}
			PropertyPath path = new PropertyPath(stringBuilder.ToString(), list.ToArray());
			return new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{
				Path = path
			};
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Data.Binding CreateBinding(string pathWithoutAttachedProperties)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Data.Binding(pathWithoutAttachedProperties);
		}

		internal static string CreateXmlNamespace(string prefix, string clrNamespace, Assembly assembly)
		{
			string fullName = assembly.FullName;
			return $"xmlns:{prefix}=\"clr-namespace:{clrNamespace};assembly={fullName}\"";
		}

		internal static bool Focus(UIElement element)
		{
			return FocusImpl(element) ?? false;
		}

		private static bool? FocusImpl(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || element.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element.Visibility == Visibility.Hidden)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!element.IsEnabled)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element.Focusable)
			{
				return element.Focus();
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(element); i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				UIElement element2 = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(element, i) as UIElement;
				bool? flag = FocusImpl(element2);
				if (flag.HasValue)
				{
					return flag.Value;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static void ForceLostFocusBindingUpdate(DependencyObject ancestorScope, DependencyObject element)
		{
			ForceLostFocusBindingUpdateImpl(ancestorScope, element);
		}

		private static void ForceLostFocusBindingUpdateImpl(DependencyObject ancestorScope, DependencyObject descendant)
		{
			while (descendant != null)
			{
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor property in TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(descendant))
				{
					DependencyPropertyDescriptor dependencyPropertyDescriptor = DependencyPropertyDescriptor.FromProperty(property);
					if (dependencyPropertyDescriptor != null)
					{
						BindingExpressionBase bindingExpressionBase = BindingOperations.GetBindingExpressionBase(descendant, dependencyPropertyDescriptor.DependencyProperty);
						if (bindingExpressionBase != null && IsLostFocusBinding(bindingExpressionBase, dependencyPropertyDescriptor.Metadata))
						{
							bindingExpressionBase.UpdateSource();
						}
					}
				}
				if (descendant is Visual || descendant is Visual3D)
				{
					descendant = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(descendant);
					if (descendant == ancestorScope)
					{
						break;
					}
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsLostFocusBinding(BindingExpressionBase expression, PropertyMetadata metadata)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UpdateSourceTrigger updateSourceTrigger;
			BindingMode mode;
			if (expression.ParentBindingBase is System.Windows.Data.Binding binding)
			{
				updateSourceTrigger = binding.UpdateSourceTrigger;
				mode = binding.Mode;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(expression.ParentBindingBase is MultiBinding multiBinding))
				{
					return false;
				}
				updateSourceTrigger = multiBinding.UpdateSourceTrigger;
				mode = multiBinding.Mode;
			}
			if (updateSourceTrigger == UpdateSourceTrigger.Default && metadata is FrameworkPropertyMetadata frameworkPropertyMetadata)
			{
				updateSourceTrigger = frameworkPropertyMetadata.DefaultUpdateSourceTrigger;
			}
			if (updateSourceTrigger != UpdateSourceTrigger.LostFocus)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (mode != BindingMode.OneWayToSource)
			{
				return mode == BindingMode.TwoWay;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static Dispatcher GetDispatcher(this DependencyObject element)
		{
			return element?.Dispatcher;
		}

		internal static DependencyObject GetElementWithKeyboardFocus()
		{
			return Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject;
		}

		internal static DependencyObject GetElementWithFocus(UIElement referenceElement)
		{
			DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(referenceElement);
			if (focusScope == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(focusScope) as DependencyObject;
		}

		internal static Key GetKey(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.System)
			{
				return e.SystemKey;
			}
			return e.Key;
		}

		internal static ModifierKeys GetCurrentModifierKeys(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			return Keyboard.Modifiers;
		}

		internal static ModifierKeys GetCurrentModifierKeys()
