			return Keyboard.Modifiers;
		}

		internal static DependencyObject GetRootVisual(DependencyObject element)
		{
			while (element is ContentElement)
			{
				element = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(element);
			}
			while (element != null)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element);
				if (parent == null)
				{
					return element;
				}
				element = parent;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static Thumb GetScrollThumb(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar scrollBar)
		{
			return scrollBar.Track?.Thumb;
		}

		internal static DependencyObject GetTemplatedParent(FrameworkElement fe)
		{
			return fe.TemplatedParent;
		}

		internal static T GetVisualAncestor<T>(DependencyObject element, Predicate<T> match, DependencyObject ceiling = null) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(element, "element");
			while (element is ContentElement)
			{
				element = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(element);
			}
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = element;
			do
			{
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				if (dependencyObject is T val && (match == null || match(val)))
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			while (dependencyObject != null && (ceiling == null || dependencyObject != ceiling));
			return null;
		}

		internal static T GetVisualDescendant<T>(DependencyObject element, Predicate<T> match, Predicate<DependencyObject> skipDescend = null) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(element, "element");
			int i = 0;
			for (int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(element); i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(element, i);
				if (child != null)
				{
					T val = child as T;
					if ((val == null || (match != null && !match(val))) && (skipDescend == null || !skipDescend(child)))
					{
						val = GetVisualDescendant(child, match, skipDescend);
					}
					if (val != null)
					{
						return val;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static T GetVisualDescendantFromPoint<T>(UIElement subTree, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e, Predicate<T> match) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			if (subTree == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(subTree);
			return GetVisualDescendantFromPoint(subTree, position, match);
		}

		internal static T GetVisualDescendantFromRelativePoint<T>(UIElement subTree, System.Windows.Point subTreeRelativePoint, Predicate<T> match) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			if (subTree == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetVisualDescendantFromPoint(subTree, subTreeRelativePoint, match);
		}

		internal static T GetVisualDescendantFromPoint<T>(UIElement subTree, System.Windows.Point pt, Predicate<T> match) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(subTree, "subTree");
			return GetVisualDescendantFromPointHelper(subTree, pt, match);
		}

		private static T GetVisualDescendantFromPointHelper<T>(UIElement subTree, System.Windows.Point pt, Predicate<T> match) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(subTree, "subTree");
			DependencyObject htResult = null;
			HitTestResultCallback resultCallback = delegate(HitTestResult result)
			{
				htResult = result.VisualHit;
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
			};
			HitTestFilterCallback filterCallback = delegate(DependencyObject target)
			{
				HitTestFilterBehavior result = HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
				if (target is UIElement uIElement2 && (!uIElement2.IsVisible || !uIElement2.IsHitTestVisible))
				{
					result = HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipSelfAndChildren;
				}
				return result;
			};
			VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(subTree, filterCallback, resultCallback, new PointHitTestParameters(pt));
			if (htResult == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = htResult as UIElement;
			if (uIElement == null && htResult != null)
			{
				uIElement = GetVisualAncestor<UIElement>(htResult, null);
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = uIElement;
			do
			{
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				if (dependencyObject is T val && (match == null || match(val)))
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			while (dependencyObject != null);
			return null;
		}

		internal static DependencyObject GetImmediateDescendant(DependencyObject descendant, DependencyObject ancestor)
		{
			while (descendant is ContentElement)
			{
				descendant = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(descendant);
			}
			while (descendant != null)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(descendant);
				if (parent == ancestor)
				{
					return descendant;
				}
				descendant = parent;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool HasFocus(UIElement element)
		{
			DependencyObject elementWithFocus = GetElementWithFocus(element);
			if (elementWithFocus != null && IsAncestorOf(element, elementWithFocus))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool HasNoOtherModifiers(ModifierKeys modifiersToIgnore = ModifierKeys.Shift)
		{
			return IsModifierPressed(ModifierKeys.None, modifiersToIgnore);
		}

		internal static bool IsAltKey(Key key)
		{
			if (key != Key.LeftAlt)
			{
				return key == Key.RightAlt;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsAncestorOf(Visual ancestor, DependencyObject descendant)
		{
			if (ancestor == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (descendant is ContentElement)
			{
				descendant = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(descendant);
			}
			if (descendant == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ancestor.IsAncestorOf(descendant);
		}

		internal static bool IsModifierPressed(ModifierKeys modifier, ModifierKeys modifiersToIgnore = ModifierKeys.None)
		{
			ModifierKeys modifierKeys = GetCurrentModifierKeys() & ~modifiersToIgnore;
			return modifierKeys == modifier;
		}

		internal static object LoadXaml(string xaml)
		{
			return XamlReader.Parse(xaml);
		}

		internal static bool MayBeVisible(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || element.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!element.IsVisible || !element.IsLoaded)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void ReparentElement(System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel, FrameworkElement child, bool add)
		{
			if (child == null || panel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (add)
			{
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(child) == null)
				{
					panel.Children.Add(child);
				}
			}
			else if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(child) == panel)
			{
				panel.Children.Remove(child);
			}
		}

		internal static MessageBoxResult ShowMessageBox(DependencyObject element, string messageBoxText, string caption, MessageBoxButton button = MessageBoxButton.OK)
		{
			Window window = null;
			if (element != null)
			{
				window = Window.GetWindow(element);
			}
			if (window != null)
			{
				return System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(window, messageBoxText, caption, button);
			}
			return System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(messageBoxText, caption, button);
		}

		internal static bool TryTransformToRoot(FrameworkElement source, FrameworkElement wpfTarget, out GeneralTransform transform)
		{
			try
			{
				if (source.FindCommonVisualAncestor(wpfTarget) == null)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point = source.PointToScreen(default(System.Windows.Point));
					point = wpfTarget.PointFromScreen(point);
					transform = new TranslateTransform(point.X, point.Y);
					transform.Freeze();
				}
				else
				{
					transform = source.TransformToVisual(wpfTarget);
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				transform = null;
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsTouchDeviceEvent(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs args)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal static void AddHandler(UIElement eventSource, DependencyObject owner, RoutedEvent routedEvent, Delegate handler, bool handledEventsToo)
		{
			eventSource.AddHandler(routedEvent, handler, handledEventsToo);
		}

		internal static void RemoveHandler(UIElement eventSource, DependencyObject owner, RoutedEvent routedEvent, Delegate handler)
		{
			eventSource.RemoveHandler(routedEvent, handler);
		}
	}

	public static class Commanding
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommandProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Command", typeof(CommandSource), typeof(Commanding), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnCommandChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommandsProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Commands", typeof(CommandSourceCollection), typeof(Commanding), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnCommandsChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommandTargetProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("CommandTarget", typeof(FrameworkElement), typeof(Commanding), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnCommandTargetChanged));

		public static CommandSource GetCommand(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return (CommandSource)element.GetValue(CommandProperty);
		}

		public static void SetCommand(FrameworkElement element, CommandSource command)
		{
			element.SetValue(CommandProperty, command);
		}

		private static void OnCommandChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			FrameworkElement elem = obj as FrameworkElement;
			if (e.OldValue is CommandSource source)
			{
				CommandSourceManager.UnregisterCommandSource(source);
			}
			if (e.NewValue is CommandSource source2)
			{
				CommandSourceManager.RegisterCommandSource(source2, elem);
			}
		}

		public static CommandSourceCollection GetCommands(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			CommandSourceCollection commandSourceCollection = (CommandSourceCollection)element.GetValue(CommandsProperty);
			if (commandSourceCollection == null)
			{
				commandSourceCollection = new CommandSourceCollection();
				element.SetValue(CommandsProperty, commandSourceCollection);
			}
			if (commandSourceCollection.Element == null)
			{
				commandSourceCollection.Element = element;
			}
			return commandSourceCollection;
		}

		public static void SetCommands(FrameworkElement elem, CommandSourceCollection commands)
		{
			elem.SetValue(CommandsProperty, commands);
		}

		private static void OnCommandsChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CommandSourceCollection commandSourceCollection = (CommandSourceCollection)e.NewValue;
			if (commandSourceCollection != null)
			{
				commandSourceCollection.Element = obj as FrameworkElement;
			}
		}

		public static FrameworkElement GetCommandTarget(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return (FrameworkElement)element.GetValue(CommandTargetProperty);
		}

		public static void SetCommandTarget(FrameworkElement element, FrameworkElement commandTarget)
		{
			element.SetValue(CommandTargetProperty, commandTarget);
		}

		private static void OnCommandTargetChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class CommandSource : DependencyObjectNotifier
	{
		private class CommandSourceBindingContext : FrameworkElement
		{
			public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(object), typeof(CommandSourceBindingContext), new PropertyMetadata(ValueChanged));

			public object Value
			{
				get
				{
					return GetValue(ValueProperty);
				}
				set
				{
					SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
				}
			}

			private static void ValueChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
			}
		}

		private bool _allowEventHandling = true;

		private FrameworkElement _se;

		private List<FrameworkElement> _seList;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ParameterProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Parameter", typeof(object), typeof(CommandSource), new PropertyMetadata(ParameterChanged));

		public string EventName { get; set; }

		public FrameworkElement SourceElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _se;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				if (_se != value)
				{
					_se = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("SourceElement");
				}
			}
		}

		internal List<FrameworkElement> SourceElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (_seList == null)
				{
					_seList = new List<FrameworkElement>();
				}
				return _seList;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_seList != value)
				{
					_seList = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("SourceElements");
				}
			}
		}

		public object Target { get; set; }

		public string TargetName { get; set; }

		public object Parameter
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ParameterProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ParameterProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Data.Binding ParameterBinding { get; set; }

		public ParameterBindingDataContext ParameterBindingDataContext { get; set; }

		public object ParameterResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (ParameterBinding == null)
				{
					return Parameter;
				}
				CommandSourceBindingContext commandSourceBindingContext = new CommandSourceBindingContext();
				if (ParameterBindingDataContext == ParameterBindingDataContext.SourceElementDataContext && SourceElement.DataContext != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
					binding.Path = new PropertyPath("DataContext");
					binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
					binding.Source = SourceElement;
					commandSourceBindingContext.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, binding);
				}
				else
				{
					commandSourceBindingContext.DataContext = SourceElement;
				}
				commandSourceBindingContext.SetBinding(CommandSourceBindingContext.ValueProperty, ParameterBinding);
				return commandSourceBindingContext.Value;
			}
		}

		public ICommand Command => ResolveCommand();

		public bool Handled { get; set; }

		public bool AllowEventHandling
		{
			get
			{
				return _allowEventHandling;
			}
			set
			{
				_allowEventHandling = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal Delegate EventHandler { get; set; }

		public EventArgs OriginEventArgs { get; protected set; }

		private static void ParameterChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CommandSource commandSource = (CommandSource)obj;
			commandSource.OnPropertyChanged("Parameter");
		}

		protected abstract ICommand ResolveCommand();

		protected object ResolveParameter(ICommandTarget target)
		{
			object obj = ParameterResolved;
			if (obj == null && target != null)
			{
				obj = target.GetParameter(this);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected void Execute(ICommandTarget target, bool canExecute)
		{
			ICommand command = Command;
			ICommandTarget currentTarget = null;
			CommandBase commandBase = command as CommandBase;
			if (commandBase != null)
			{
				commandBase.CommandSource = this;
				currentTarget = commandBase.CurrentTarget;
				commandBase.CurrentTarget = target;
			}
			try
			{
				object parameter = ResolveParameter(target);
				if (canExecute)
				{
					if (command.CanExecute(parameter))
					{
						command.Execute(parameter);
					}
					return;
				}
				foreach (FrameworkElement sourceElement in SourceElements)
				{
					if (sourceElement is System.Windows.Controls.Control control)
					{
						control.IsEnabled = command.CanExecute(parameter);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (commandBase != null)
				{
					commandBase.CurrentTarget = currentTarget;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal void InvokeCommand(bool execute)
		{
			FrameworkElement sourceElement = SourceElement;
			ICommand command = Command;
			if (command is CommandBase commandBase)
			{
				commandBase.CommandSource = this;
			}
			if (Target == null)
			{
				bool flag = string.IsNullOrEmpty(TargetName);
				if (flag && LookForCommandTarget(sourceElement, execute, command))
				{
					return;
				}
				Collection<ICommandTarget> targets = CommandSourceManager.GetTargets(command);
				{
					foreach (ICommandTarget item in targets)
					{
						FrameworkElement frameworkElement = item as FrameworkElement;
						if (flag || (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.Name == TargetName))
						{
							Execute(item, execute);
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			Execute(Target as ICommandTarget, execute);
		}

		private bool LookForCommandTarget(FrameworkElement parent, bool execute, ICommand command)
		{
			ItemsControl itemsControl = null;
			while (parent != null)
			{
				if (Commanding.GetCommandTarget(parent) is ICommandTarget commandTarget && commandTarget.SupportsCommand(command))
				{
					Execute(commandTarget, execute);
					return true;
				}
				if (parent is ItemsControl itemsControl2)
				{
					itemsControl = itemsControl2;
				}
				if (parent is ICommandTarget commandTarget2 && commandTarget2.SupportsCommand(command))
				{
					Execute(commandTarget2, execute);
					return true;
				}
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = parent;
				parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(parent) as FrameworkElement;
				if (parent == null && frameworkElement != null)
				{
					parent = frameworkElement.Parent as FrameworkElement;
					if (parent == null && frameworkElement is IProvideParent)
					{
						parent = ((IProvideParent)frameworkElement).Parent as FrameworkElement;
					}
				}
			}
			if (itemsControl != null)
			{
				return LookForCommandTarget(itemsControl.Parent as FrameworkElement, execute, command);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void EventFired(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			MouseButtonEventArgs e2 = e as MouseButtonEventArgs;
			if (e2 != null && e2.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e3 = e as System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs;
			if (e3 != null && e3.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			OriginEventArgs = e;
			InvokeCommand(execute: true);
			if (Handled && AllowEventHandling)
			{
				if (e2 != null)
				{
					e2.Handled = true;
				}
				if (e3 != null)
				{
					e3.Handled = true;
				}
				Handled = false;
			}
			OriginEventArgs = null;
		}
	}
	public enum ParameterBindingDataContext
	{
		SourceElementDataContext,
		SourceElement
	}

			CopyCommon((HierarchicalDataTemplate)sourceFreezable);
		}

		protected override void GetCurrentValueAsFrozenCore(Freezable sourceFreezable)
		{
			base.GetCurrentValueAsFrozenCore(sourceFreezable);
			CopyCommon((HierarchicalDataTemplate)sourceFreezable);
		}

		private void CopyCommon(HierarchicalDataTemplate source)
		{
			_itemsSource = source._itemsSource;
		}
	}
	internal interface ISupportScrollHelper
	{
		double HorizontalMax { get; }

		ScrollType HorizontalScrollType { get; }

		double HorizontalValue { get; set; }

		double VerticalMax { get; }

		ScrollType VerticalScrollType { get; }

		double VerticalValue { get; set; }

		double GetFirstItemHeight();

		double GetFirstItemWidth();

		TouchScrollMode GetScrollModeFromPoint(System.Windows.Point point, UIElement elementDirectlyOver);

		void InvalidateScrollLayout();

		void OnPanComplete();

		void OnStateChanged(TouchState newState, TouchState oldState);
	}
	internal enum ScrollType
	{
		Pixel,
		Item
	}
	internal class TouchScrollHelper : IProvideTouchInfo
	{
		private class DoubleValueAnimator : DependencyObject
		{
			private Action<DoubleValueAnimator> _onChangedAction;

			private Action<DoubleValueAnimator> _onAnimatedCompleteAction;

			private Timeline _animation;

			private Storyboard _storyboard;

			public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("Value", typeof(double), typeof(DoubleValueAnimator), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(double.NaN, OnValueChanged));

			public double Value
			{
				get
				{
					return (double)GetValue(ValueProperty);
				}
				set
				{
					SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
				}
			}

			private DoubleValueAnimator(Timeline animation)
			{
				_animation = animation;
			}

			internal static DoubleValueAnimator Create(Action<DoubleValueAnimator> onChangedAction, Action<DoubleValueAnimator> onAnimationCompleteAction, Timeline animation)
			{
				DoubleValueAnimator doubleValueAnimator = new DoubleValueAnimator(animation);
				doubleValueAnimator.Initialize(onChangedAction, onAnimationCompleteAction);
				return doubleValueAnimator;
			}

			private static void OnValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				DoubleValueAnimator doubleValueAnimator = (DoubleValueAnimator)d;
				if (doubleValueAnimator._onChangedAction != null && !double.IsNaN((double)e.NewValue))
				{
					doubleValueAnimator._onChangedAction(doubleValueAnimator);
				}
			}

			private void Initialize(Action<DoubleValueAnimator> onChangedAction, Action<DoubleValueAnimator> onAnimationCompleteAction)
			{
				_onAnimatedCompleteAction = onAnimationCompleteAction;
				if (_animation != null)
				{
					if (!(_animation is DoubleAnimation) && !(_animation is DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException("animation must be DoubleAnimation or DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames");
					}
					_storyboard = new Storyboard();
					_storyboard.Completed += OnStoryboardCompleted;
					_storyboard.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
					Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(_animation, new PropertyPath(ValueProperty));
					_storyboard.Children.Add(_animation);
					Storyboard.SetTarget(_animation, this);
					_storyboard.Begin();
				}
				_onChangedAction = onChangedAction;
			}

			private void OnStoryboardCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				_onChangedAction = null;
				if (_onAnimatedCompleteAction != null)
				{
					_onAnimatedCompleteAction(this);
					_onAnimatedCompleteAction = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private ISupportScrollHelper _owner;

		private FrameworkElement _element;

		private bool _animateToIntegralItemOnEndPan;

		private DoubleValueAnimator _panningEndAnimatorX;

		private DoubleValueAnimator _panningEndAnimatorY;

		private bool _isEnabled = true;

		private TouchHelper _touchHandler;

		private const double VELOCITY_EXTENT_FACTOR = 2.0;

		public bool AnimateToIntegralItemOnEndPan
		{
			get
			{
				return _animateToIntegralItemOnEndPan;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _animateToIntegralItemOnEndPan)
				{
					_animateToIntegralItemOnEndPan = value;
					if (!_animateToIntegralItemOnEndPan)
					{
						StopPanningEndAnimation();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public TouchState CurrentState => _touchHandler.CurrentState;

		public bool IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _isEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _isEnabled)
				{
					_isEnabled = value;
					if (_isEnabled)
					{
						ReconnectEvents();
					}
					else
					{
						DisconnectEvents();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<EventArgs> TouchStarted;

		public event EventHandler<EventArgs> TouchCompleted;

		public TouchScrollHelper(FrameworkElement element, ISupportScrollHelper owner)
		{
			_owner = owner;
			_element = element;
			_touchHandler = new TouchHelper(this);
			ReconnectEvents();
		}

		public void CancelTouchInteraction()
		{
			if (_touchHandler != null)
			{
				_touchHandler.CancelTouchInteraction();
			}
		}

		private Timeline CreateAnimation(int durationInMilliseconds, double fromValue, double toValue, IEasingFunction easing)
		{
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
			doubleAnimation.Duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(durationInMilliseconds);
			doubleAnimation.AutoReverse = false;
			doubleAnimation.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
			doubleAnimation.From = fromValue;
			doubleAnimation.To = toValue;
			doubleAnimation.EasingFunction = easing;
			return doubleAnimation;
		}

		private DoubleValueAnimator CreatePanningEndAnimator(double fromValue, double toValue, double elementExtent)
		{
			int durationInMilliseconds = Math.Max(Math.Min((int)(Math.Abs(toValue - fromValue) * elementExtent * 4.0), 750), 200);
			return DoubleValueAnimator.Create(OnPanningEndAnimationValueChanged, OnPanningEndAnimationComplete, CreateAnimation(durationInMilliseconds, fromValue, toValue, new QuadraticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			}));
		}

		private void DisconnectEvents()
		{
			_element.ClearValue(TouchHelperBase.TouchHelperPropertyKey);
			if (_touchHandler != null)
			{
				_touchHandler.TouchStarted -= TouchHandler_TouchStarted;
				_touchHandler.Pan -= TouchHandler_Pan;
				_touchHandler.TouchCompleted -= TouchHandler_TouchCompleted;
				_touchHandler.PanComplete -= TouchHandler_PanComplete;
				_touchHandler.StateChanged -= TouchHandler_StateChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnPanningEndAnimationValueChanged(DoubleValueAnimator animator)
		{
			if (animator == _panningEndAnimatorX)
			{
				_owner.HorizontalValue = animator.Value;
				_owner.InvalidateScrollLayout();
			}
			else if (animator == _panningEndAnimatorY)
			{
				_owner.VerticalValue = animator.Value;
				_owner.InvalidateScrollLayout();
			}
		}

		private void OnPanningEndAnimationComplete(DoubleValueAnimator animator)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (animator == _panningEndAnimatorX)
			{
				_owner.HorizontalValue = CoreUtilities.RoundToIntegralValue(_owner.HorizontalValue);
				_panningEndAnimatorX = null;
				flag = _panningEndAnimatorY == null;
			}
			else if (animator == _panningEndAnimatorY)
			{
				_owner.VerticalValue = CoreUtilities.RoundToIntegralValue(_owner.VerticalValue);
				_panningEndAnimatorY = null;
				flag = _panningEndAnimatorX == null;
			}
			if (flag && _owner != null)
			{
				_owner.OnPanComplete();
			}
		}

		private void ReconnectEvents()
		{
			DisconnectEvents();
			TouchHelperBase.SetTouchHelper(_element, _touchHandler);
			if (_touchHandler != null)
			{
				_touchHandler.TouchStarted += TouchHandler_TouchStarted;
				_touchHandler.Pan += TouchHandler_Pan;
				_touchHandler.TouchCompleted += TouchHandler_TouchCompleted;
				_touchHandler.PanComplete += TouchHandler_PanComplete;
				_touchHandler.StateChanged += TouchHandler_StateChanged;
			}
		}

		private void StopPanningEndAnimation()
		{
			_panningEndAnimatorY = null;
			_panningEndAnimatorY = null;
		}

		private void TouchHandler_TouchStarted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnTouchStarted();
		}

		private void TouchHandler_Pan(object sender, PanEventArgs e)
		{
			StopPanningEndAnimation();
			bool flag = false;
			System.Windows.Point deltaPoint = e.DeltaPoint;
			double verticalMax = _owner.VerticalMax;
			if (verticalMax > 0.0)
			{
				double num = deltaPoint.Y;
				if (_owner.VerticalScrollType == ScrollType.Item)
				{
					double firstItemHeight = _owner.GetFirstItemHeight();
					num /= firstItemHeight;
				}
				if (num != 0.0)
				{
					flag = true;
					if (num < 0.0)
					{
						_owner.VerticalValue = Math.Min(verticalMax, _owner.VerticalValue - num);
					}
					else
					{
						_owner.VerticalValue = Math.Max(0.0, _owner.VerticalValue - num);
					}
				}
			}
			double horizontalMax = _owner.HorizontalMax;
			if (horizontalMax > 0.0)
			{
				double num2 = deltaPoint.X;
				if (_owner.HorizontalScrollType == ScrollType.Item)
				{
					double firstItemWidth = _owner.GetFirstItemWidth();
					num2 /= firstItemWidth;
				}
				if (num2 != 0.0)
				{
					flag = true;
					if (num2 < 0.0)
					{
						_owner.HorizontalValue = Math.Min(horizontalMax, _owner.HorizontalValue - num2);
					}
					else
					{
						_owner.HorizontalValue = Math.Max(0.0, _owner.HorizontalValue - num2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				_owner.InvalidateScrollLayout();
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void TouchHandler_StateChanged(object sender, StateChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_owner != null)
			{
				_owner.OnStateChanged(e.NewState, e.OldState);
			}
		}

		private void TouchHandler_TouchCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnTouchCompleted();
		}

		private void TouchHandler_PanComplete(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessPanComplete();
		}

		private void ProcessPanComplete()
		{
			StopPanningEndAnimation();
			if (_owner == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!AnimateToIntegralItemOnEndPan)
			{
				_owner.OnPanComplete();
				return;
			}
			if (_owner.VerticalScrollType == ScrollType.Item)
			{
				double firstItemHeight = _owner.GetFirstItemHeight();
				double verticalValue = _owner.VerticalValue;
				double num = CoreUtilities.RoundToIntegralValue(verticalValue);
				double value = firstItemHeight * (verticalValue - num);
				if (Math.Abs(value) > 5.0)
				{
					_panningEndAnimatorY = CreatePanningEndAnimator(verticalValue, num, firstItemHeight);
				}
				else
				{
					_owner.VerticalValue = num;
				}
			}
			if (_owner.HorizontalScrollType == ScrollType.Item)
			{
				double firstItemWidth = _owner.GetFirstItemWidth();
				double horizontalValue = _owner.HorizontalValue;
				double num2 = CoreUtilities.RoundToIntegralValue(horizontalValue);
				double value2 = firstItemWidth * (horizontalValue - num2);
				if (Math.Abs(value2) > 5.0)
				{
					_panningEndAnimatorX = CreatePanningEndAnimator(horizontalValue, num2, firstItemWidth);
				}
				else
				{
					_owner.HorizontalValue = num2;
				}
			}
			if (_panningEndAnimatorX == null && _panningEndAnimatorY == null)
			{
				_owner.OnPanComplete();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnTouchStarted()
		{
			if (this.TouchStarted != null)
			{
				this.TouchStarted(_element, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnTouchCompleted()
		{
			if (this.TouchCompleted != null)
			{
				this.TouchCompleted(_element, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		TouchScrollMode IProvideTouchInfo.GetScrollModeFromPoint(System.Windows.Point point, UIElement elementDirectlyOver)
		{
			if (_owner != null)
			{
				return _owner.GetScrollModeFromPoint(point, elementDirectlyOver);
			}
			return TouchScrollMode.None;
		}
	}
	internal interface IProvideTouchInfo
	{
		TouchScrollMode GetScrollModeFromPoint(System.Windows.Point point, UIElement elementDirectlyOver);
	}
	internal enum TouchState
	{
		NotDown,
		Pending,
		Scrolling,
		Holding
	}
	internal enum TouchScrollMode
	{
		None,
		Horizontal,
		Vertical,
		Both
	}

		public PanEventArgs(System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			DeltaPoint = p;
		}
	}

	internal class TapEventArgs : TouchHandleableEventArgs

		{
			Point = p;
			Element = element;
		}
	}
	internal class TouchHelper : TouchHelperBase
	{
		private bool _tapValid;

		private TimeSpan _touchAndHoldThreshold = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2.0);

		private TimeSpan _tapThreshold = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2.0);

		private DispatcherTimer _touchAndHoldTimer;

		private DispatcherTimer _tapTimer;

		private int _startedTimeStamp;

		private UIElement _initalTouchElement;

		private System.Windows.Point _initialTouchPoint;

		private int _lastManipulationStarting;

		private bool _pannedData;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static HwndSourceHelper _hwndSourceHelper;

		private static bool _canCreateHwndSource = true;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static int? _TickCountOfLastQuerySystemGestureStatus;

		public TimeSpan TouchAndHoldThreshold
		{
			get
			{
				return _touchAndHoldThreshold;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _touchAndHoldThreshold)
				{
					_touchAndHoldThreshold = value;
					_touchAndHoldTimer.Interval = _touchAndHoldThreshold;
				}
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan TapThreshold
		{
			get
			{
				return _tapThreshold;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _tapThreshold)
				{
					_tapThreshold = value;
					_tapTimer.Interval = _tapThreshold;
				}
			}
		}

		public TouchHelper()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public TouchHelper(IProvideTouchInfo touchInfoProvider)
			: base(touchInfoProvider)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			UIElement element = base.Element;
			if (element != null)
			{
				ManageHwndSource(element, isAdding: true);
				element.ManipulationCompleted += _element_ManipulationCompleted;
				element.ManipulationInertiaStarting += _element_ManipulationInertiaStarting;
				element.ManipulationStarted += _element_ManipulationStarted;
				element.ManipulationStarting += _element_ManipulationStarting;
				element.ManipulationDelta += _element_ManipulationDelta;
			}
			_touchAndHoldTimer = new DispatcherTimer
			{
				Interval = TouchAndHoldThreshold
			};
			_touchAndHoldTimer.Tick += TouchAndHoldTimer_Tick;
			_tapTimer = new DispatcherTimer
			{
				Interval = TapThreshold
			};
			_tapTimer.Tick += TapTimer_Tick;
		}

		protected override void OnDetached()
		{
			UIElement element = base.Element;
			if (element != null)
			{
				ManageHwndSource(element, isAdding: true);
				element.ManipulationBoundaryFeedback -= _element_ManipulationBoundaryFeedback;
				element.ManipulationCompleted -= _element_ManipulationCompleted;
				element.ManipulationInertiaStarting -= _element_ManipulationInertiaStarting;
				element.ManipulationStarted -= _element_ManipulationStarted;
				element.ManipulationStarting -= _element_ManipulationStarting;
				element.ManipulationDelta -= _element_ManipulationDelta;
			}
			if (_touchAndHoldTimer != null)
			{
				_touchAndHoldTimer.Stop();
				_touchAndHoldTimer.Tick -= TouchAndHoldTimer_Tick;
				_touchAndHoldTimer = null;
			}
			if (_tapTimer != null)
			{
				_tapTimer.Stop();
				_tapTimer.Tick -= TouchAndHoldTimer_Tick;
				_tapTimer = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnStateChanged(TouchState newState, TouchState oldState)
		{
			if (newState != TouchState.Pending)
			{
				_touchAndHoldTimer.Stop();
				_tapTimer.Stop();
			}
			base.OnStateChanged(newState, oldState);
		}

		private bool HasLastQueryTimeExpired()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (_TickCountOfLastQuerySystemGestureStatus.HasValue)
			{
				result = Math.Abs(Environment.TickCount - _TickCountOfLastQuerySystemGestureStatus.Value) > 400;
				_TickCountOfLastQuerySystemGestureStatus = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void ManageHwndSource(UIElement element, bool isAdding)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(element);
			if (_hwndSourceHelper == null)
			{
				if (!isAdding || !_canCreateHwndSource)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (_canCreateHwndSource)
				{
					try
					{
						_hwndSourceHelper = new HwndSourceHelper(WndProc);
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						_canCreateHwndSource = false;
					}
				}
				if (_hwndSourceHelper == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (isAdding)
			{
				_hwndSourceHelper.AddElement(element);
			}
			else
			{
				_hwndSourceHelper.RemoveElement(element);
			}
		}

		private static IntPtr WndProc(IntPtr hwnd, int message, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			if (message == 716)
			{
				_TickCountOfLastQuerySystemGestureStatus = Environment.TickCount;
			}
			return IntPtr.Zero;
		}

		private void _element_ManipulationDelta(object sender, ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			_touchAndHoldTimer.Stop();
			if (e.ManipulationContainer != base.Element)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.CurrentState == TouchState.Scrolling && _TickCountOfLastQuerySystemGestureStatus.HasValue)
			{
				e.Complete();
				e.Handled = true;
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.NotDown;
				return;
			}
			if (HasLastQueryTimeExpired())
			{
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.Holding;
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.NotDown;
				e.Cancel();
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			if (base.CurrentState == TouchState.Pending)
			{
				int tickCount = Environment.TickCount;
				if (Math.Abs(tickCount - _startedTimeStamp) <= 400)
				{
					Vector translation = e.CumulativeManipulation.Translation;
					if (Math.Abs(translation.X) <= 8.0 && Math.Abs(translation.Y) <= 8.0)
					{
						e.Handled = true;
						return;
					}
					base.CurrentState = TouchState.Scrolling;
				}
				else
				{
					base.CurrentState = TouchState.Holding;
				}
			}
			_tapValid = false;
			if (base.CurrentState != TouchState.Scrolling)
			{
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.NotDown;
				e.Cancel();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				OnPan(e);
				_pannedData = true;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void _element_ManipulationStarting(object sender, ManipulationStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ManipulationContainer != base.Element)
			{
				return;
			}
			int lastManipulationStarting = _lastManipulationStarting;
			_lastManipulationStarting = Environment.TickCount;
			int num = Math.Abs(_lastManipulationStarting - lastManipulationStarting);
			if (num < Utilities.SystemDoubleClickTime)
			{
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.NotDown;
				e.Cancel();
				e.Handled = true;
				_lastManipulationStarting = 0;
				return;
			}
			if (HasLastQueryTimeExpired())
			{
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.NotDown;
				e.Cancel();
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(-1000.0, -1000.0);
			UIElement elementDirectlyOver = null;
			using (IEnumerator<IManipulator> enumerator = e.Manipulators.GetEnumerator())
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					IManipulator current = enumerator.Current;
					TouchDevice touchDevice = current as TouchDevice;
					point = current.GetPosition(base.Element);
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = base.Element.InputHitTest(point) as DependencyObject;
					while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
					{
						dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
					}
					elementDirectlyOver = dependencyObject as UIElement;
				}
			}
			SetScrollModeFromPoint(point, elementDirectlyOver);
			switch (base.ScrollMode)
			{
			case TouchScrollMode.None:
				return;
			case TouchScrollMode.Horizontal:
				e.Mode = ManipulationModes.TranslateX;
				break;
			case TouchScrollMode.Vertical:
				e.Mode = ManipulationModes.TranslateY;
				break;
			default:
				e.Mode = ManipulationModes.Translate;
				break;
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void _element_ManipulationStarted(object sender, ManipulationStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ManipulationContainer != base.Element)
			{
				return;
			}
			_initalTouchElement = e.ManipulationContainer as UIElement;
			_initialTouchPoint = e.ManipulationOrigin;
			if (base.ScrollMode == TouchScrollMode.None)
			{
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.NotDown;
				e.Cancel();
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			base.CurrentState = TouchState.Pending;
			_tapValid = true;
			_tapTimer.Start();
			_touchAndHoldTimer.Start();
			int tickCount = Environment.TickCount;
			if (Math.Abs((long)tickCount - (long)_startedTimeStamp) <= 500)
			{
				OnDoubleTap(_initialTouchPoint, _initalTouchElement);
			}
			_startedTimeStamp = Environment.TickCount;
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void _element_ManipulationInertiaStarting(object sender, ManipulationInertiaStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ManipulationContainer != base.Element)
			{
				return;
			}
			ManipulationVelocities initialVelocities = e.InitialVelocities;
			double num = Math.Abs(initialVelocities.LinearVelocity.X);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(initialVelocities.LinearVelocity.Y);
			if (base.CurrentState == TouchState.Pending)
			{
				if (num < 0.001 && num2 < 0.001)
				{
					e.Cancel();
					e.Handled = true;
					base.CurrentState = TouchState.NotDown;
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (base.CurrentState != TouchState.Scrolling)
			{
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.NotDown;
				e.Cancel();
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			InertiaTranslationBehavior translationBehavior = e.TranslationBehavior;
			if (translationBehavior != null)
			{
				if (num * 4.0 > num2)
				{
					translationBehavior.InitialVelocity = new Vector(initialVelocities.LinearVelocity.X, 0.0);
				}
				else if (num2 * 4.0 > num)
				{
					translationBehavior.InitialVelocity = new Vector(0.0, initialVelocities.LinearVelocity.Y);
				}
			}
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				e.TranslationBehavior.DesiredDeceleration = 0.001;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void _element_ManipulationCompleted(object sender, ManipulationCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			_touchAndHoldTimer.Stop();
			if (e.ManipulationContainer == base.Element)
			{
				if (_tapValid)
				{
					OnTap(e.ManipulationOrigin, e.ManipulationContainer as UIElement);
				}
				_initalTouchElement = null;
				if (_pannedData)
				{
					_pannedData = false;
					OnPanComplete();
				}
				OnTouchCompleted(e.ManipulationOrigin, e.ManipulationContainer as UIElement);
				TouchState currentState = base.CurrentState;
				if (currentState == TouchState.Pending || currentState == TouchState.Holding)
				{
					e.Cancel();
				}
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.NotDown;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void _element_ManipulationBoundaryFeedback(object sender, ManipulationBoundaryFeedbackEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void TapTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_tapValid = false;
			_tapTimer.Stop();
		}

		private void TouchAndHoldTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_touchAndHoldTimer.Stop();
			if (base.CurrentState == TouchState.Pending)
			{
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.Holding;
				OnTapAndHold(_initialTouchPoint, _initalTouchElement);
				base.CurrentState = TouchState.NotDown;
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class TouchHelperBase : DependencyObject
	{
		private IProvideTouchInfo _touchInfoProvider;

		private TouchScrollMode _scrollMode;

		private TouchState _currentState;

		private UIElement _element;

		protected const int TOUCH_MOVE_THRESHHOLD = 8;

		protected const int DOUBLE_CLICK_TIME = 500;

		protected const int TOUCH_HOLD_TIME = 400;

		protected const double FLICK_DIRECTION_RATIO_THRESHHOLD = 4.0;

		internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey TouchHelperPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("TouchHelper", typeof(TouchHelper), typeof(TouchHelperBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnTouchHelperChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TouchHelperProperty = TouchHelperPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public TouchState CurrentState
		{
			get
			{
				return _currentState;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (value != _currentState)
				{
					TouchState currentState = _currentState;
					_currentState = value;
					OnStateChanged(_currentState, currentState);
				}
			}
		}

		public UIElement Element => _element;

		internal TouchScrollMode ScrollMode => _scrollMode;

		internal IProvideTouchInfo TouchInfoProvider => _touchInfoProvider;

		public event EventHandler<TapEventArgs> TouchStarted;

		public event EventHandler<TapEventArgs> TouchCompleted;

		public event EventHandler<TapEventArgs> Tap;

		public event EventHandler<TapEventArgs> DoubleTap;

		public event EventHandler<TapEventArgs> TapAndHold;

		public event EventHandler<PanEventArgs> Pan;

		public event EventHandler<EventArgs> PanComplete;

		public event EventHandler<StateChangedEventArgs> StateChanged;

		protected TouchHelperBase(IProvideTouchInfo touchInfoProvider)
		{
			_touchInfoProvider = touchInfoProvider;
		}

		public static TouchHelper GetTouchHelper(UIElement element)
		{
			return (TouchHelper)element.GetValue(TouchHelperProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetTouchHelper(UIElement element, TouchHelper helper)
		{
			element.SetValue(TouchHelperPropertyKey, helper);
		}

		private static void OnTouchHelperChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UIElement element = target as UIElement;
			if (e.OldValue is TouchHelperBase touchHelperBase)
			{
				touchHelperBase.OnDetached();
				touchHelperBase._element = null;
			}
			if (e.NewValue is TouchHelperBase touchHelperBase2)
			{
				touchHelperBase2._element = element;
				touchHelperBase2.OnAttached();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void CancelTouchInteraction()
		{
		}

		protected abstract void OnAttached();

		protected abstract void OnDetached();

		internal void SetScrollModeFromPoint(System.Windows.Point point, UIElement elementDirectlyOver)
		{
			if (_touchInfoProvider == null)
			{
				_scrollMode = TouchScrollMode.Both;
			}
			else
			{
				_scrollMode = _touchInfoProvider.GetScrollModeFromPoint(point, elementDirectlyOver);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnTouchStarted(System.Windows.Point p, UIElement element)
		{
			if (this.TouchStarted != null)
			{
				this.TouchStarted(Element, new TapEventArgs(p, element));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnTouchCompleted(System.Windows.Point p, UIElement element)
		{
			if (this.TouchCompleted != null)
			{
				this.TouchCompleted(Element, new TapEventArgs(p, element));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnTap(System.Windows.Point p, UIElement element)
		{
			if (this.Tap != null)
			{
				this.Tap(Element, new TapEventArgs(p, element));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDoubleTap(System.Windows.Point p, UIElement element)
		{
			if (this.DoubleTap != null)
			{
				this.DoubleTap(Element, new TapEventArgs(p, element));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnTapAndHold(System.Windows.Point p, UIElement element)
		{
			if (this.TapAndHold != null)
			{
				this.TapAndHold(Element, new TapEventArgs(p, element));
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool OnPan(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.Pan != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.X, e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.Y);
				PanEventArgs e2 = new PanEventArgs(p);
				this.Pan(Element, e2);
				return e2.Handled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool OnPan(System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			if (this.Pan != null)
			{
				PanEventArgs e = new PanEventArgs(p);
				this.Pan(Element, e);
				return e.Handled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPanComplete()
		{
			if (this.PanComplete != null)
			{
				this.PanComplete(Element, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnStateChanged(TouchState newState, TouchState oldState)
		{
			if (this.StateChanged != null)
			{
				this.StateChanged(Element, new StateChangedEventArgs(newState, oldState));
			}
		}
	}
}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(BusyAnimationTypeConverter))]
	public abstract class BusyAnimation
	{
		private class BusyAnimationTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private static readonly BusyAnimation[] standardAnimations = GetStandardAnimations();

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (value is string)
				{
					string text = (string)value;
					BusyAnimation[] array = standardAnimations;
					foreach (BusyAnimation busyAnimation in array)
					{
						if (string.Equals(busyAnimation.Name, text, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
						{
							return busyAnimation;
						}
					}
					CoreUtilities.DebuggerLog(40, "Global", $"There is no built in BusyAnimation on the BusyAnimations class with a Name of '{text}'.");
					return null;
				}
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (value is BusyAnimation && destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return ((BusyAnimation)value).Name;
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}

			public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return new StandardValuesCollection(standardAnimations);
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}

			private static BusyAnimation[] GetStandardAnimations()
			{
				List<BusyAnimation> list = new List<BusyAnimation>();
				try
				{
					FieldInfo[] fields = typeof(BusyAnimations).GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
					foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in fields)
					{
						if (typeof(BusyAnimation).IsAssignableFrom(fieldInfo.FieldType))
						{
							list.Add((BusyAnimation)fieldInfo.GetValue(null));
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		private Duration? _animationTotalDuration;

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public Duration? AnimationTotalDuration
		{
			get
			{
				return _animationTotalDuration;
			}
			set
			{
				_animationTotalDuration = value;
			}
		}

		public abstract string Name { get; }

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Name;
		}

		public abstract BusyAnimationPresenter CreatePresenter();
	}
	public abstract class BusyAnimation<T> : BusyAnimation where T : BusyAnimationPresenter, new()
	{
		public override BusyAnimationPresenter CreatePresenter()
		{
			T val = new T
			{
				DataContext = this
			};
			if (base.AnimationTotalDuration.HasValue)
			{
				val.AnimationTotalDuration = base.AnimationTotalDuration.Value;
			}
			return val;
		}
	}

			isTabStopDictionary = null;
			AnimationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Animation", typeof(BusyAnimation), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(BusyAnimations.SpinnerBars, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				XamBusyIndicator xamBusyIndicator = (XamBusyIndicator)d;
				xamBusyIndicator.CreateAnimationPresenter();
			}));
			AnimationPresenterPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("AnimationPresenter", typeof(BusyAnimationPresenter), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			AnimationPresenterProperty = AnimationPresenterPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			BusyContentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BusyContent", typeof(object), typeof(XamBusyIndicator));
			BusyContentStringFormatProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BusyContentStringFormat", typeof(string), typeof(XamBusyIndicator));
			BusyContentTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BusyContentTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			BusyContentTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BusyContentTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			BusyIndicatorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("BusyIndicator", typeof(XamBusyIndicator), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
			BusyIndicatorProperty = BusyIndicatorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DisplayAfterProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DisplayAfter", typeof(TimeSpan), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1.0), OnDisplayAfterChanged));
			FocusTargetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FocusTarget", typeof(UIElement), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			IsBusyProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsBusy", typeof(bool), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsBusyChanged));
			IsIndeterminateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsIndeterminate", typeof(bool), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(true, OnIsIndeterminateChanged));
			IsIndicatorVisibleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsIndicatorVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsIndicatorVisibleChanged));
			OverlayStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OverlayStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamBusyIndicator));
			ProgressValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ProgressValue", typeof(double), typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, OnProgressValueChanged, CoerceProgressValue));
			IsBusyChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("IsBusyChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(XamBusyIndicator));
			IsIndicatorVisibleChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("IsIndicatorVisible", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(XamBusyIndicator));
			ProgressCompletedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ProgressCompleted", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(XamBusyIndicator));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamBusyIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(XamBusyIndicator)));
			Infragistics.Themes.ThemeManager.RegisterControl(typeof(XamBusyIndicator));
		}

		public XamBusyIndicator()
		{
			_displayAfterTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
			SetBusyIndicator(this, this);
			base.Loaded += XamBusyIndicatorLoaded;
		}

		private void XamBusyIndicatorLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsBusy)
			{
				FocusBusyIndicator();
			}
		}

		public static XamBusyIndicator GetBusyIndicator(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (XamBusyIndicator)obj.GetValue(BusyIndicatorProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetBusyIndicator(DependencyObject obj, XamBusyIndicator value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(BusyIndicatorPropertyKey, value);
		}

		private static void OnDisplayAfterChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamBusyIndicator)d).OnDisplayAfterChanged(e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDisplayAfterChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue != e.OldValue)
			{
				_displayAfterTimer.Interval = (TimeSpan)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsBusyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamBusyIndicator)d).OnIsBusyChanged(e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsBusyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsBusy)
			{
				base.PreviewKeyDown += OnPreviewKeyDown;
				defaultMode = KeyboardNavigation.GetTabNavigation(this);
				KeyboardNavigation.SetTabNavigation(this, KeyboardNavigationMode.None);
				if (DisplayAfter.Equals(TimeSpan.Zero))
				{
					IsIndicatorVisible = true;
				}
				else
				{
					_displayAfterTimer.Tick += OnDisplayAfterTimerTick;
					_displayAfterTimer.Interval = DisplayAfter;
					_displayAfterTimer.Start();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				KeyboardNavigation.SetTabNavigation(this, defaultMode);
				base.PreviewKeyDown -= OnPreviewKeyDown;
				if (FocusTarget != null)
				{
					FocusTargetUIElement(FocusTarget);
				}
				IsIndicatorVisible = false;
			}
			RaiseIsBusyChangedEvent();
		}

		private static void OnIsIndeterminateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamBusyIndicator)d).OnIsIndeterminateChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsIndeterminateChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
		}

		private static void OnIsIndicatorVisibleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamBusyIndicator)d).OnIsIndicatorVisibleChanged(e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsIndicatorVisibleChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseIsIndicatorVisibleChangedEvent();
			if ((bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				FocusBusyIndicator();
			}
			if (AnimationPresenter != null)
			{
				AnimationPresenter.EnsureCurrentState();
				if (!IsIndicatorVisible)
				{
					DoubleAnimation animation = new DoubleAnimation(ProgressValue, TimeSpan.Zero);
					_animationPresenter.BeginAnimation(BusyAnimationPresenter.AnimatedProgressValueProperty, animation, HandoffBehavior.SnapshotAndReplace);
				}
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceProgressValue(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			if (value != null && value is double)
			{
				double num = Math.Round((double)value, 4);
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				if (num > 1.0)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				return num;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void OnProgressValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamBusyIndicator)d).OnProgressValueChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnProgressValueChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			UpdateAnimatedProgressValue(oldValue, newValue);
			if (newValue == 1.0)
			{
				RaiseProgressCompletedEvent();
			}
		}

		private void CreateAnimationPresenter()
		{
			if (_animationPresenter != null)
			{
				_animationPresenter = null;
			}
			BusyAnimation animation = Animation;
			if (animation != null)
			{
				_animationPresenter = animation.CreatePresenter();
			}
			SetValue(AnimationPresenterPropertyKey, _animationPresenter);
			_previousTimeSpan = TimeSpan.Zero;
			UpdateAnimatedProgressValue(0.0, ProgressValue);
		}

		private void FocusBusyIndicator()
		{
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				Focus();
			}
		}

		private void FocusTargetUIElement(UIElement focusTarget)
		{
			focusTarget.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, (Action)delegate
			{
				focusTarget.Focus();
			});
		}

		private void OnDisplayAfterTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_displayAfterTimer.Stop();
			if (IsBusy)
			{
				IsIndicatorVisible = true;
			}
			_displayAfterTimer.Tick -= OnDisplayAfterTimerTick;
		}

		private void OnPreviewKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsIndicatorVisible)
			{
				switch (e.Key)
				{
				case Key.Tab:
				case Key.Left:
				case Key.Up:
				case Key.Right:
				case Key.Down:
					e.Handled = true;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAnimatedProgressValue(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (_animationPresenter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsIndicatorVisible)
			{
				double num = Math.Abs(newValue - oldValue);
				DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
				TimeSpan timeSpan = now - _previousStamp;
				TimeSpan timeSpan2;
				DoubleAnimation animation;
				if (_previousTimeSpan != TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					timeSpan = ((!(timeSpan >= _previousTimeSpan)) ? TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(_previousTimeSpan.TotalMilliseconds - timeSpan.TotalMilliseconds) : TimeSpan.Zero);
					timeSpan2 = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num * _animationPresenter.AnimationTotalDuration.TimeSpan.TotalMilliseconds + timeSpan.TotalMilliseconds);
					animation = new DoubleAnimation(newValue, timeSpan2);
				}
				else
				{
					timeSpan2 = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num * _animationPresenter.AnimationTotalDuration.TimeSpan.TotalMilliseconds);
					animation = new DoubleAnimation(newValue, timeSpan2);
				}
				_previousStamp = now;
				_previousTimeSpan = timeSpan2;
				_animationPresenter.BeginAnimation(BusyAnimationPresenter.AnimatedProgressValueProperty, animation);
			}
			else
			{
				_previousTimeSpan = TimeSpan.Zero;
				_animationPresenter.BeginAnimation(BusyAnimationPresenter.AnimatedProgressValueProperty, new DoubleAnimation(newValue, TimeSpan.Zero));
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			CreateAnimationPresenter();
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
		}

		private void RaiseIsBusyChangedEvent()
		{
			RoutedEventArgs e = new RoutedEventArgs(IsBusyChangedEvent);
			RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		private void RaiseIsIndicatorVisibleChangedEvent()
		{
			RoutedEventArgs e = new RoutedEventArgs(IsIndicatorVisibleChangedEvent);
			RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		private void RaiseProgressCompletedEvent()
		{
			RoutedEventArgs e = new RoutedEventArgs(ProgressCompletedEvent);
			RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		public BusyIndicatorVisualData ExportVisualData(BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType animation)
		{
			BusyIndicatorVisualData busyIndicatorVisualData = new BusyIndicatorVisualData();
			ExportViewShapes(busyIndicatorVisualData, animation);
			return busyIndicatorVisualData;
		}

		private void ExportViewShapes(BusyIndicatorVisualData busyIndicator, BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType animation)
		{
			busyIndicator.Width = base.ActualWidth;
			busyIndicator.Height = base.ActualHeight;
			busyIndicator.Overlay = ExportOverlayRectangleVisualData();
			busyIndicator.Content = ExportContentBorderVisualData();
			busyIndicator.BusyContent = ExportBusyContentVisualData();
			busyIndicator.BusyAnimation = ExportAnimationVisualData();
			switch (animation)
			{
			case BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType.Azure:
				busyIndicator.AzureBusyAnimation = ExportAzureBusyAnimationVisualData(busyIndicator.BusyAnimation);
				break;
			case BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType.Gears:
				busyIndicator.GearsBusyAnimation = ExportGearsBusyAnimationVisualData(busyIndicator.BusyAnimation);
				break;
			case BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType.ProgressBar:
				busyIndicator.ProgressBarBusyAnimation = ExportProgressBarBusyAnimationVisualData(busyIndicator.BusyAnimation);
				break;
			case BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType.ProgressRing:
				busyIndicator.ProgressRingBusyAnimation = ExportProgressRingBusyAnimationVisualData(busyIndicator.BusyAnimation);
				break;
			case BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType.SpinnerBalls:
				busyIndicator.SpinnerBallsBusyAnimation = ExportSpinnerBallsBusyAnimationVisualData(busyIndicator.BusyAnimation);
				break;
			case BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType.SpinnerBars:
				busyIndicator.SpinnerBarsBusyAnimation = ExportSpinnerBarsBusyAnimationVisualData(busyIndicator.BusyAnimation);
				break;
			case BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType.SpinnerBarsWave:
				busyIndicator.SpinnerBarsWaveBusyAnimation = ExportSpinnerBarsWaveBusyAnimationVisualData(busyIndicator.BusyAnimation);
				break;
			case BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType.SpinnerSegment:
				busyIndicator.SpinnerSegmentedBusyAnimation = ExportSpinnerSegmentedBusyAnimationVisualData(busyIndicator.BusyAnimation);
				break;
			case BusyIndicatorVisualData.AnimationType.Custom:
				busyIndicator.CustomBusyAnimation = ExportCustomBusyAnimationVisualData(busyIndicator.BusyAnimation);
				break;
			default:
				busyIndicator.SpinnerBarsBusyAnimation = ExportSpinnerBarsBusyAnimationVisualData(busyIndicator.BusyAnimation);
				break;
			}
		}

namespace Infragistics.Controls.Interactions.Primitives
{
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "IsAnimating", GroupName = "AnimationStates")]
	public abstract class BusyAnimationPresenter : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		private const string AnimatedProgressValuePropertyName = "AnimatedProgressValue";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnimatedProgressValueProperty;

		private const string AnimationPresenterPropertyName = "AnimationPresenter";

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey AnimationPresenterPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnimationPresenterProperty;

		private const string AnimationTotalDurationPropertyName = "AnimationTotalDuration";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnimationTotalDurationProperty;

		public double AnimatedProgressValue => (double)GetValue(AnimatedProgressValueProperty);

		public Duration AnimationTotalDuration
		{
			get
			{
				return (Duration)GetValue(AnimationTotalDurationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AnimationTotalDurationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static BusyAnimationPresenter()
		{
			AnimatedProgressValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AnimatedProgressValue", typeof(double), typeof(BusyAnimationPresenter), new PropertyMetadata(0.0));
			AnimationPresenterPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("AnimationPresenter", typeof(BusyAnimationPresenter), typeof(BusyAnimationPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
			AnimationPresenterProperty = AnimationPresenterPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AnimationTotalDurationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AnimationTotalDuration", typeof(Duration), typeof(BusyAnimationPresenter), new PropertyMetadata(new Duration(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3.0))));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(BusyAnimationPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(BusyAnimationPresenter)));
		}

		public BusyAnimationPresenter()
		{
			SetAnimationPresenter(this, this);
		}

		public static BusyAnimationPresenter GetAnimationPresenter(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (BusyAnimationPresenter)obj.GetValue(AnimationPresenterProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetAnimationPresenter(DependencyObject obj, BusyAnimationPresenter value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(AnimationPresenterPropertyKey, value);
		}

		internal void EnsureCurrentState()
		{
			XamBusyIndicator busyIndicator = XamBusyIndicator.GetBusyIndicator(this);
			if (busyIndicator != null && busyIndicator.IsIndicatorVisible)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "IsAnimating", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "IsNotAnimating", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			EnsureCurrentState();
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_arcSegment", Type = typeof(ArcSegment))]
	public class ProgressRingBusyAnimationPresenter : BusyAnimationPresenter
	{
		private const string PartArcSegment = "PART_arcSegment";

		private ArcSegment _arcSegment;

		private const string RingBackgroundPropertyName = "RingBackground";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RingBackgroundProperty;

		private const string RingFillPropertyName = "RingFill";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RingFillProperty;

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush RingBackground
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(RingBackgroundProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RingBackgroundProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush RingFill
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(RingFillProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RingFillProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static ProgressRingBusyAnimationPresenter()
		{
			RingBackgroundProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RingBackground", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(ProgressRingBusyAnimationPresenter));
			RingFillProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RingFill", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(ProgressRingBusyAnimationPresenter));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ProgressRingBusyAnimationPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ProgressRingBusyAnimationPresenter)));
			BusyAnimationPresenter.AnimatedProgressValueProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ProgressRingBusyAnimationPresenter), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, OnAnimatedProgressValueChanged));
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_arcSegment = GetTemplateChild("PART_arcSegment") as ArcSegment;
			OnAnimatedProgressValueChanged(0.0, base.AnimatedProgressValue);
		}

		private static void OnAnimatedProgressValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ProgressRingBusyAnimationPresenter)d).OnAnimatedProgressValueChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		private void RenderArc(double angle)
		{
			double num = 50.0;
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(num, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = ComputeCartesianCoordinate(angle, num);
			point2.X += num;
			point2.Y += num;
			bool isLargeArc = angle > 180.0;
			if (point.X == Math.Round(point2.X) && point.Y == Math.Round(point2.Y))
			{
				point2.X -= 0.01;
			}
			_arcSegment.Point = point2;
			_arcSegment.IsLargeArc = isLargeArc;
		}

		private System.Windows.Point ComputeCartesianCoordinate(double angle, double radius)
		{
			double num = Math.PI / 180.0 * (angle - 90.0);
			double x = radius * Math.Cos(num);
			double y = radius * Math.Sin(num);
			return new System.Windows.Point(x, y);
		}

		protected virtual void OnAnimatedProgressValueChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (_arcSegment != null)
			{
				RenderArc(360.0 * newValue);
			}
		}
	}

	public class NullableToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
		}
	}
