namespace Infragistics.Controls.Layouts.Primitives
{
	public interface IGridBagConstraint
	{
		int Column { get; }

		int ColumnSpan { get; }

		float ColumnWeight { get; }

		System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment HorizontalAlignment { get; }

		Thickness Margin { get; }

		int Row { get; }

		int RowSpan { get; }

		float RowWeight { get; }

		VerticalAlignment VerticalAlignment { get; }
	}
	public sealed class GridBagConstraintConstants
	{
		public const int Relative = -1;

		public const int Remainder = 0;

		private GridBagConstraintConstants()
		{
		}
	}
	public class GridBagConstraint : PropertyChangeNotifier, IGridBagConstraint, ICloneable
	{
		private System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment _horizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;

		private VerticalAlignment _verticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;

		private int _column;

		private int _row;

		private int _columnSpan;

		private int _rowSpan;

		private float _columnWeight;

		private float _rowWeight;

		private Thickness _margin;

		public System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment HorizontalAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return _horizontalAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _horizontalAlignment)
				{
					_horizontalAlignment = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("HorizontalAlignment");
				}
			}
		}

		public int Column
		{
			get
			{
				return _column;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _column)
				{
					if (value < 0 && -1 != value)
					{
						ThrowArgumentOutOfRange("Column", value, "LE_GridBag_InvalidRowColumn");
					}
					_column = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Column");
				}
			}
		}

		public int ColumnSpan
		{
			get
			{
				return _columnSpan;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _columnSpan)
				{
					if (value < 1 && value != 0 && -1 != value)
					{
						ThrowArgumentOutOfRange("ColumnSpan", value, "LE_GridBag_InvalidSpan");
					}
					_columnSpan = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("ColumnSpan");
				}
			}
		}

		public float ColumnWeight
		{
			get
			{
				return _columnWeight;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != ColumnWeight)
				{
					if (value < 0f)
					{
						ThrowArgumentOutOfRange("ColumnWeight", value, "LE_GridBag_InvalidWeight");
					}
					_columnWeight = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("ColumnWeight");
				}
			}
		}

		public Thickness Margin
		{
			get
			{
				return _margin;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(_margin == value))
				{
					_margin = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Insets");
				}
			}
		}

		public int Row
		{
			get
			{
				return _row;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _row)
				{
					if (value < 0 && -1 != value)
					{
						ThrowArgumentOutOfRange("Row", value, "LE_GridBag_InvalidRowColumn");
					}
					_row = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Row");
				}
			}
		}

		public int RowSpan
		{
			get
			{
				return _rowSpan;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _rowSpan)
				{
					if (value < 1 && value != 0 && -1 != value)
					{
						ThrowArgumentOutOfRange("RowSpan", value, "LE_GridBag_InvalidSpan");
					}
					_rowSpan = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("RowSpan");
				}
			}
		}

		public float RowWeight
		{
			get
			{
				return _rowWeight;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _rowWeight)
				{
					if (value < 0f)
					{
						ThrowArgumentOutOfRange("RowWeight", value, "LE_GridBag_InvalidWeight");
					}
					_rowWeight = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("RowWeight");
				}
			}
		}

		public VerticalAlignment VerticalAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return _verticalAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _verticalAlignment)
				{
					_verticalAlignment = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("VerticalAlignment");
				}
			}
		}

		public GridBagConstraint()
			: this(-1, -1, 1, 1)
		{
		}

		public GridBagConstraint(int column, int row, int columnSpan, int rowSpan)
		{
			_column = column;
			_row = row;
			_columnSpan = columnSpan;
			_rowSpan = rowSpan;
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			return (GridBagConstraint)MemberwiseClone();
		}

		public void ResetColumn()
		{
			Column = -1;
		}

		public void ResetColumnSpan()
		{
			ColumnSpan = 1;
		}

		public void ResetColumnWeight()
		{
			ColumnWeight = 0f;
		}

		public void ResetHorizontalAlignment()
		{
			HorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
		}

		public void ResetMargin()
		{
			_margin = default(Thickness);
		}

		public void ResetRow()
		{
			Row = -1;
		}

		public void ResetRowSpan()
		{
			RowSpan = 1;
		}

		public void ResetRowWeight()
		{
			RowWeight = 0f;
		}

		public void ResetVerticalAlignment()
		{
			VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetHorizontalAlignment();
			ResetVerticalAlignment();
			ResetMargin();
			ResetColumn();
			ResetRow();
			ResetColumnSpan();
			ResetRowSpan();
			ResetColumnWeight();
			ResetRowWeight();
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeHorizontalAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeVerticalAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeMargin() && !ShouldSerializeColumn() && !ShouldSerializeRow() && !ShouldSerializeColumnSpan() && !ShouldSerializeRowSpan() && !ShouldSerializeColumnWeight())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeRowWeight();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (ShouldSerializeColumn() || ShouldSerializeRow())
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("Origin={0}, {1}", Column, Row);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeColumnSpan() || ShouldSerializeRowSpan())
			{
				if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("; ");
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("Span={0}, {1}", ColumnSpan, RowSpan);
			}
			if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("; ");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat("; Horiz Align={0}", HorizontalAlignment);
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat("; Vert Align={0}", VerticalAlignment);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeColumn()
		{
			return -1 != _column;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeColumnSpan()
		{
			return 1 != _columnSpan;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeColumnWeight()
		{
			return 0f != _columnWeight;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeHorizontalAlignment()
		{
			return System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center != _horizontalAlignment;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeMargin()
		{
			if (0.0 == _margin.Left && 0.0 == _margin.Top && 0.0 == _margin.Right)
			{
				return 0.0 != _margin.Bottom;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeRow()
		{
			return -1 != _row;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeRowSpan()
		{
			return 1 != _rowSpan;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeRowWeight()
		{
			return 0f != _rowWeight;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeVerticalAlignment()
		{
			return VerticalAlignment.Center != _verticalAlignment;
		}

		private static void ThrowArgumentOutOfRange(string property, object value, string errorResource)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(property, value, GridBagLayoutManager.GetString(errorResource));
		}
	}
	public class GridBagLayoutItemDimensions
	{
		private int _column;

		private int _row;

		private int _columnSpan;

		private int _rowSpan;

		private Rect _bounds = Rect.Empty;

		public Rect Bounds => _bounds;

		public int Column => _column;

		internal int ColumnRight => _column + _columnSpan;

		public int ColumnSpan => _columnSpan;

		public int Row => _row;

		internal int RowBottom => _row + _rowSpan;

		public int RowSpan => _rowSpan;

		internal System.Windows.Size Size => _bounds.Size;

		internal GridBagLayoutItemDimensions(int column, int row, int columnSpan, int rowSpan, Rect bounds)
		{
			_column = column;
			_row = row;
			_columnSpan = columnSpan;
			_rowSpan = rowSpan;
			_bounds = bounds;
		}
	}
	public class GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection : ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private double[] _columnDims;

		private double[] _rowDims;

		private Dictionary<ILayoutItem, GridBagLayoutItemDimensions> _mappings;

		private System.Windows.Size _preferredSize;

		private System.Windows.Size _minimumSize;

		private System.Windows.Size _maximumSize;

		public double[] ColumnDims => _columnDims;

		public System.Windows.Size MaximumSize => _maximumSize;

		public System.Windows.Size MinimumSize => _minimumSize;

		public System.Windows.Size PreferredSize => _preferredSize;

		public double[] RowDims => _rowDims;

		public GridBagLayoutItemDimensions this[ILayoutItem key]
		{
			get
			{
				if (_mappings.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => ((ICollection)_mappings).IsSynchronized;

		int ICollection.Count => _mappings.Count;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => ((ICollection)_mappings).SyncRoot;

		internal GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection(double[] columnDims, double[] rowDims)
		{
			if (columnDims == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("columnDims");
			}
			if (rowDims == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rowDims ");
			}
			_columnDims = columnDims;
			_rowDims = rowDims;
			_mappings = new Dictionary<ILayoutItem, GridBagLayoutItemDimensions>();
		}

		internal void Add(ILayoutItem key, GridBagLayoutItemDimensions itemDimensions)
		{
			_mappings[key] = itemDimensions;
		}

		internal void InitializeLayoutSizes(System.Windows.Size preferredSize, System.Windows.Size minimumSize, System.Windows.Size maximumSize)
		{
			_preferredSize = preferredSize;
			_minimumSize = minimumSize;
			_maximumSize = maximumSize;
		}

		public bool Exists(ILayoutItem key)
		{
			return _mappings.ContainsKey(key);
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _mappings.Keys.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class GridBagLayoutManager : LayoutManagerBase
	{
		internal class AutoLayoutCalc
		{
			private class CalcSizeLayoutContainer : ILayoutContainer
			{
				public Rect GetBounds(object containerContext)
				{
					return (Rect)containerContext;
				}

				public void PositionItem(ILayoutItem item, Rect rect, object containerContext)
				{
				}
			}

			private class EnumeratorWrapper<T> : IEnumerator<T>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
			{
				private IEnumerator<T> _enumerator;

				private List<T> _list;

				private int _currentIndex;

				private bool _enumeratorExhausted;

				public T Current => _list[_currentIndex];

				object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

				internal EnumeratorWrapper(IEnumerator<T> enumerator)
				{
					_enumerator = enumerator;
					_list = new List<T>();
					Reset();
				}

				public bool MoveNext()
				{
					_currentIndex++;
					if (_currentIndex < _list.Count)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (!_enumeratorExhausted)
					{
						if (_enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							_list.Add(_enumerator.Current);
							return true;
						}
						_enumeratorExhausted = true;
					}
					return false;
				}

				public void Reset()
				{
					_currentIndex = -1;
				}

				public void Dispose()
				{
				}
			}

			private class Line
			{
				private AutoLayoutCalc _layout;

				internal double _extent;

				internal int _startIndexInFittedItemsList;

				internal int _endIndexInFittedItemsList;

				internal int ItemCount => 1 + _endIndexInFittedItemsList - _startIndexInFittedItemsList;

				internal Line(AutoLayoutCalc layout)
				{
					_layout = layout;
					_startIndexInFittedItemsList = layout._fittedItems.Count;
					_endIndexInFittedItemsList = _startIndexInFittedItemsList - 1;
				}

				internal double CalcExtentY(bool isFirstLine, out double minExtentY)
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					minExtentY = 0.0;
					AutoLayoutCalc layout = _layout;
					List<GridBagConstraintCache> fittedItems = layout._fittedItems;
					for (int i = _startIndexInFittedItemsList; i <= _endIndexInFittedItemsList; i++)
					{
						GridBagConstraintCache gcc = fittedItems[i];
						double itemPreferredExtent = layout.GetItemPreferredExtent(gcc, oppositeOrientation: true, !isFirstLine);
						double itemMinExtent = layout.GetItemMinExtent(gcc, oppositeOrientation: true, !isFirstLine);
						num = Math.Max(num, itemPreferredExtent);
						minExtentY = Math.Max(minExtentY, itemMinExtent);
					}
					return num;
				}

				internal bool FitItem(GridBagConstraintCache gcc)
				{
					int itemCount = ItemCount;
					bool num;
					if (_layout._forceCellsX <= 0)
					{
						if (_layout._maxCellsX <= 0)
						{
							goto IL_0050;
						}
						num = itemCount >= _layout._maxCellsX;
					}
					else
					{
						num = itemCount >= _layout._forceCellsX;
					}
					if (num)
					{
						return false;
					}
					goto IL_0050;
					IL_0050:
					bool includeSpacing = itemCount > 0;
					double itemPreferredExtent = _layout.GetItemPreferredExtent(gcc, oppositeOrientation: false, includeSpacing);
					double itemMinExtent = _layout.GetItemMinExtent(gcc, oppositeOrientation: false, includeSpacing);
					double cellExtentX = _layout.GetCellExtentX(itemCount, itemPreferredExtent);
					if (_layout._forceCellsX <= 0 && !_layout._autoFitAllItems && _extent + cellExtentX > _layout._layoutExtentX && itemCount > 0 && itemCount + 1 > _layout._minCellsX)
					{
						return false;
					}
					_layout._fittedItems.Add(gcc);
					_endIndexInFittedItemsList++;
					_layout.UpdateCellExtentX(itemCount, itemPreferredExtent, itemMinExtent);
					_extent += cellExtentX;
					return true;
				}
			}

			private GridBagLayoutManager _lm;

			private System.Windows.Controls.Orientation _layoutOrientation;

			private bool _autoFitAllItems;

			private double _layoutExtentX;

			private double _layoutExtentY;

			private int _minCellsX;

			private int _minCellsY;

			private int _maxCellsX;

			private int _maxCellsY;

			private int _forceCellsX;

			private List<Line> _lines = new List<Line>();

			private List<GridBagConstraintCache> _fittedItems = new List<GridBagConstraintCache>();

			private List<double> _cellExtentsX = new List<double>();

			private List<double> _cellMinExtentsX = new List<double>();

			private Dictionary<ILayoutItem, GridBagConstraintCache> _gccCache = new Dictionary<ILayoutItem, GridBagConstraintCache>();

			private System.Windows.Controls.Orientation? _constraintedOrientation;

			private GridBagConstraint g_emptyGCC = new GridBagConstraint();

			internal AutoLayoutCalc(GridBagLayoutManager lm, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation layoutOrientation, bool autoFitAllItems, System.Windows.Size layoutExtent, int minRows, int minColumns, int maxRows, int maxColumns, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation? constraintedOrientation)
			{
				_lm = lm;
				_layoutOrientation = layoutOrientation;
				_autoFitAllItems = autoFitAllItems;
				_constraintedOrientation = constraintedOrientation;
				if (layoutOrientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					_layoutExtentX = layoutExtent.Width;
					_layoutExtentY = layoutExtent.Height;
					_minCellsX = minColumns;
					_minCellsY = minRows;
					_maxCellsX = maxColumns;
					_maxCellsY = maxRows;
				}
				else
				{
					_layoutExtentX = layoutExtent.Height;
					_layoutExtentY = layoutExtent.Width;
					_minCellsX = minRows;
					_minCellsY = minColumns;
					_maxCellsX = maxRows;
					_maxCellsY = maxColumns;
				}
			}

			private static int GetNumberOfItems(IEnumerator enumerator)
			{
				int num = 0;
				enumerator.Reset();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}

			internal GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection AutoCalculateLayout(IEnumerator<ILayoutItem> enumerator)
			{
				enumerator = new EnumeratorWrapper<ILayoutItem>(enumerator);
				int num = Math.Max(1, _minCellsX);
				int num2 = _maxCellsX;
				int num3 = 0;
				double num4 = -1.0;
				int num5 = 0;
				System.Windows.Size actualLayoutExtent;
				System.Windows.Size actualMinLayoutExtent;
				while (true)
				{
					AutoCalculateLayoutHelper(enumerator, out actualLayoutExtent, out actualMinLayoutExtent);
					if (_autoFitAllItems)
					{
						double num6 = Math.Max(_layoutExtentX, actualMinLayoutExtent.Width) / actualLayoutExtent.Width;
						double num7 = Math.Max(_layoutExtentY, actualMinLayoutExtent.Height) / actualLayoutExtent.Height;
						double num8 = (CoreUtilities.AreClose(num6, num7) ? 0.0 : Math.Abs((num6 - num7) / Math.Max(num6, num7)));
						double num9 = (double)_cellExtentsX.Count * Math.Ceiling((double)_fittedItems.Count / (double)_cellExtentsX.Count) / (double)_fittedItems.Count;
						double num10 = num8 + num9;
						if (num3 == 0 || -1.0 == num4 || num4 > num10)
						{
							num3 = _cellExtentsX.Count;
							num4 = num10;
						}
						if (num2 == 0)
						{
							num2 = _fittedItems.Count;
						}
						if (_constraintedOrientation.HasValue && _constraintedOrientation.Value != _layoutOrientation && actualMinLayoutExtent.Width > _layoutExtentX && _cellExtentsX.Count > Math.Max(1, _minCellsX))
						{
							num2 = _cellExtentsX.Count - 1;
							num = Math.Min(num, num2);
							if (num3 > num2)
							{
								num4 = -1.0;
							}
						}
						else if (_constraintedOrientation.HasValue && _constraintedOrientation.Value == _layoutOrientation && actualMinLayoutExtent.Height > _layoutExtentY && (_maxCellsX <= 0 || _cellExtentsX.Count < _maxCellsX))
						{
							num = _cellExtentsX.Count + 1;
							num2 = Math.Max(num, num2);
							if (num3 < num)
							{
								num4 = -1.0;
							}
						}
						else if (num6 > num7)
						{
							num = _cellExtentsX.Count + 1;
						}
						else
						{
							if (!(num6 < num7))
							{
								break;
							}
							num2 = _cellExtentsX.Count - 1;
						}
						if (num > num2)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (_autoFitAllItems && _maxCellsY > 0)
						{
							int numberOfItems = GetNumberOfItems(enumerator);
							int val = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)numberOfItems / (double)_maxCellsY);
							num = Math.Max(num, val);
							num2 = Math.Max(num2, val);
						}
						int num11 = (num + num2) / 2;
						if (num11 == _forceCellsX)
						{
							break;
						}
						_forceCellsX = num11;
					}
					else
					{
						if (actualLayoutExtent.Width > _layoutExtentX)
						{
							num2 = _cellExtentsX.Count - 1;
						}
						else
						{
							if (!(actualLayoutExtent.Width < _layoutExtentX) || num5 <= 0)
							{
								break;
							}
							num = _cellExtentsX.Count + 1;
							num3 = _cellExtentsX.Count;
						}
						if (num > num2)
						{
							break;
						}
						int num12 = (int)((double)_cellExtentsX.Count * (_layoutExtentX / actualLayoutExtent.Width));
						if (num12 < num || num12 > num2)
						{
							num12 = (num + num2) / 2;
						}
						_forceCellsX = num12;
					}
					num5++;
				}
				if (num3 > 0 && num3 != _cellExtentsX.Count)
				{
					_forceCellsX = num3;
					AutoCalculateLayoutHelper(enumerator, out actualLayoutExtent, out actualMinLayoutExtent);
				}
				return GetLayoutItemDimensionsHelper();
			}

			private void AutoCalculateLayoutHelper(IEnumerator<ILayoutItem> enumerator, out System.Windows.Size actualLayoutExtent, out System.Windows.Size actualMinLayoutExtent)
			{
				_lines.Clear();
				_fittedItems.Clear();
				_cellExtentsX.Clear();
				_cellMinExtentsX.Clear();
				List<double> dest = null;
				List<double> dest2 = null;
				bool flag = ((_layoutOrientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal) ? (!_lm.ExpandToFitHeight) : (!_lm.ExpandToFitWidth));
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				enumerator.Reset();
				ILayoutItem layoutItem = (enumerator.MoveNext() ? enumerator.Current : null);
				GridBagConstraintCache gridBagConstraintCache = ((layoutItem != null) ? GetGCC(layoutItem) : null);
				while (gridBagConstraintCache != null)
				{
					Line line = new Line(this);
					_lines.Add(line);
					while (gridBagConstraintCache != null && line.FitItem(gridBagConstraintCache))
					{
						layoutItem = (enumerator.MoveNext() ? enumerator.Current : null);
						gridBagConstraintCache = ((layoutItem != null) ? GetGCC(layoutItem) : null);
					}
					double minExtentY;
					double num3 = line.CalcExtentY(1 == _lines.Count, out minExtentY);
					num += num3;
					num2 += minExtentY;
					if (_maxCellsY > 0 && _lines.Count >= _maxCellsY)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!_autoFitAllItems && num >= _layoutExtentY && _lines.Count >= _minCellsY)
					{
						if (!flag && dest != null)
						{
							_lines.RemoveAt(_lines.Count - 1);
							_fittedItems.RemoveRange(line._startIndexInFittedItemsList, _fittedItems.Count - line._startIndexInFittedItemsList);
							_cellExtentsX = dest;
							_cellMinExtentsX = dest2;
						}
						break;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						CloneValuesHelper(_cellExtentsX, ref dest);
						CloneValuesHelper(_cellMinExtentsX, ref dest2);
					}
				}
				actualLayoutExtent = new System.Windows.Size(Sum(_cellExtentsX), num);
				actualMinLayoutExtent = new System.Windows.Size(Sum(_cellMinExtentsX), num2);
			}

			private static void CloneValuesHelper<T>(List<T> source, ref List<T> dest)
			{
				if (dest == null)
				{
					dest = new List<T>(source.Count);
				}
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = source.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (i == dest.Count)
					{
						dest.Add(source[i]);
					}
					else
					{
						dest[i] = source[i];
					}
				}
			}

			private GridBagConstraintCache GetGCC(ILayoutItem item)
			{
				if (_gccCache.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				value = new GridBagConstraintCache(item, g_emptyGCC);
				_gccCache[item] = value;
				return value;
			}

			private GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection GetLayoutItemDimensionsHelper()
			{
				List<GridBagConstraintCache> fittedItems = _fittedItems;
				GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutManager = _lm.Clone(copyLayoutItems: false);
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _lines.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					Line line = _lines[i];
					int startIndexInFittedItemsList = line._startIndexInFittedItemsList;
					int endIndexInFittedItemsList = line._endIndexInFittedItemsList;
					for (int j = startIndexInFittedItemsList; j <= endIndexInFittedItemsList; j++)
					{
						GridBagConstraintCache gridBagConstraintCache = fittedItems[j];
						GridBagConstraint gridBagConstraint = new GridBagConstraint();
						if (_layoutOrientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
						{
							gridBagConstraint.Row = i;
							gridBagConstraint.Column = j - startIndexInFittedItemsList;
						}
						else
						{
							gridBagConstraint.Row = j - startIndexInFittedItemsList;
							gridBagConstraint.Column = i;
						}
						gridBagLayoutManager.LayoutItems.Add(gridBagConstraintCache._item, gridBagConstraint);
					}
				}
				System.Windows.Size size = ((_layoutOrientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal) ? new System.Windows.Size(_layoutExtentY, _layoutExtentX) : new System.Windows.Size(_layoutExtentX, _layoutExtentY));
				return gridBagLayoutManager.GetLayoutItemDimensions(new CalcSizeLayoutContainer(), new Rect(0.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height));
			}

			private double GetItemMinExtent(GridBagConstraintCache gcc, bool oppositeOrientation, bool includeSpacing)
			{
				bool flag = (_layoutOrientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal) ^ oppositeOrientation;
				double num = (flag ? gcc._minWidth : gcc._minHeight);
				Thickness margin = gcc._margin;
				num += (flag ? (margin.Left + margin.Right) : (margin.Top + margin.Bottom));
				if (includeSpacing)
				{
					num += (flag ? _lm._interItemSpacingHorizontal : _lm._interItemSpacingVertical);
				}
				return num;
			}

			private double GetItemPreferredExtent(GridBagConstraintCache gcc, bool oppositeOrientation, bool includeSpacing)
			{
				bool flag = (_layoutOrientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal) ^ oppositeOrientation;
				double num = (flag ? gcc._prefWidth : gcc._prefHeight);
				if (!_lm._preferredSizeIncludesMargin)
				{
					Thickness margin = gcc._margin;
					num += (flag ? (margin.Left + margin.Right) : (margin.Top + margin.Bottom));
				}
				if (includeSpacing)
				{
					num += (flag ? _lm._interItemSpacingHorizontal : _lm._interItemSpacingVertical);
				}
				return num;
			}

			private static double Sum(List<double> list)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = list.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					num += list[i];
				}
				return num;
			}

			private void UpdateCellExtentX(int cellX, double itemExtentX, double itemMinExtentX)
			{
				if (cellX == _cellExtentsX.Count)
				{
					_cellExtentsX.Add(0.0);
					_cellMinExtentsX.Add(0.0);
				}
				_cellExtentsX[cellX] = Math.Max(_cellExtentsX[cellX], itemExtentX);
				_cellMinExtentsX[cellX] = Math.Max(_cellMinExtentsX[cellX], itemMinExtentX);
			}

			private double GetCellExtentX(int cellX, double itemExtentX)
			{
				if (cellX < _cellExtentsX.Count)
				{
					return Math.Max(itemExtentX, _cellExtentsX[cellX]);
				}
				return itemExtentX;
			}
		}

		private class GridBagConstraintCache
		{
			internal IGridBagConstraint _gc;

			internal ILayoutItem _item;

			internal int _column;

			internal int _row;

			internal int _columnSpan;

			internal int _rowSpan;

			internal Thickness _margin;

			internal double _minWidth;

			internal double _minHeight;

			internal double _maxWidth;

			internal double _maxHeight;

			internal double _prefWidth;

			internal double _prefHeight;

			internal int _gcColumn;

			internal int _gcRow;

			internal int _gcColumnSpan;

			internal int _gcRowSpan;

			internal float _columnWeight;

			internal float _rowWeight;

			internal bool _isAutoWidth;

			internal bool _isAutoHeight;

			internal Side _hasSpacing;

			internal GridBagConstraintCache(ILayoutItem item, IGridBagConstraint gc)
			{
				_item = item;
				_gc = gc;
				_gcColumn = (_column = gc.Column);
				_gcRow = (_row = gc.Row);
				_gcColumnSpan = (_columnSpan = gc.ColumnSpan);
				_gcRowSpan = (_rowSpan = gc.RowSpan);
				_columnWeight = gc.ColumnWeight;
				_rowWeight = gc.RowWeight;
				_margin = gc.Margin;
				System.Windows.Size minimumSize = item.MinimumSize;
				System.Windows.Size preferredSize = item.PreferredSize;
				System.Windows.Size maximumSize = item.MaximumSize;
				_minWidth = minimumSize.Width;
				_minHeight = minimumSize.Height;
				_maxWidth = Math.Max(maximumSize.Width, _minWidth);
				_maxHeight = Math.Max(maximumSize.Height, _minHeight);
				_prefWidth = Math.Max(Math.Min(preferredSize.Width, _maxWidth), _minWidth);
				_prefHeight = Math.Max(Math.Min(preferredSize.Height, _maxHeight), _minHeight);
				IAutoSizeLayoutItem autoSizeLayoutItem = item as IAutoSizeLayoutItem;
				_isAutoWidth = autoSizeLayoutItem?.IsWidthAutoSized ?? false;
				_isAutoHeight = autoSizeLayoutItem?.IsHeightAutoSized ?? false;
			}

			internal Thickness GetMarginWithSpacing(GridBagLayoutManager lm)
			{
				Thickness margin = _margin;
				if (_hasSpacing != Side.None)
				{
					Thickness spacing = GetSpacing(lm);
					margin.Left += spacing.Left;
					margin.Top += spacing.Top;
					margin.Right += spacing.Right;
					margin.Bottom += spacing.Bottom;
				}
				return margin;
			}

			internal Thickness GetSpacing(GridBagLayoutManager lm)
			{
				Side hasSpacing = _hasSpacing;
				Thickness result = new Thickness(((Side.Left & hasSpacing) != Side.None) ? (lm._interItemSpacingHorizontal / 2.0) : 0.0, ((Side.Top & hasSpacing) != Side.None) ? (lm._interItemSpacingVertical / 2.0) : 0.0, ((Side.Right & hasSpacing) != Side.None) ? (lm._interItemSpacingHorizontal / 2.0) : 0.0, ((Side.Bottom & hasSpacing) != Side.None) ? (lm._interItemSpacingVertical / 2.0) : 0.0);
				return result;
			}
		}

		{
			internal GridBagConstraintCache[] _gccArr;

			internal float[] _colWeights;

			internal float[] _rowWeights;

			internal double[] _colWidthsPref;

			internal double[] _rowHeightsPref;

			internal double[] _colWidthsMin;

			internal double[] _rowHeightsMin;

			internal double[] _colWidthsMax;

			internal double[] _rowHeightsMax;

			internal double _lastContainerWidth;

			internal double _lastContainerHeight;

			internal double[] _colCoordinates;

			internal double[] _rowCoordinates;

			internal double[] _colCoordinateExtents;

			internal double[] _rowCoordinateExtents;

			internal bool[] _colIsAuto;

			internal bool[] _rowIsAuto;

			internal GridBagLayoutCache(GridBagConstraintCache[] gccArr, float[] colWeights, float[] rowWeights, double[] colWidthsPref, double[] rowHeightsPref, double[] colWidthsMin, double[] rowHeightsMin, double[] colWidthsMax, double[] rowHeightsMax, bool[] colIsAuto, bool[] rowIsAuto)
			{
				_gccArr = gccArr;
				_colWeights = colWeights;
				_rowWeights = rowWeights;
				_colWidthsPref = colWidthsPref;
				_rowHeightsPref = rowHeightsPref;
				_colWidthsMin = colWidthsMin;
				_rowHeightsMin = rowHeightsMin;
				_colWidthsMax = colWidthsMax;
				_rowHeightsMax = rowHeightsMax;
				_colIsAuto = colIsAuto;
				_rowIsAuto = rowIsAuto;
			}
		}

		private class IntExpandableArray
		{
			private const int ELEMS_PER_ARR = 64;

			private List<int[]> _list;

			private int _length;

			internal int Length => _length;

			internal int this[int index]
			{
				get
				{
					_length = Math.Max(1 + index, _length);
					int[] arr = GetArr(index);
					return arr[index % 64];
				}
				set
				{
					_length = Math.Max(1 + index, _length);
					int[] arr = GetArr(index);
					arr[index % 64] = value;
				}
			}

			internal IntExpandableArray(int initialCapacity)
			{
				_list = new List<int[]>((initialCapacity - 1) / 64 + 1);
			}

			private int[] GetArr(int index)
			{
				int num = index / 64;
				while (_list.Count <= num)
				{
					_list.Add(new int[64]);
				}
				return _list[num];
			}

			internal void Reset()
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _list.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					_list[i].Initialize();
				}
			}
		}

		private class IntPoint
		{
			private int _x;

			private int _y;

			internal int X => _x;

			internal int Y => _y;

			public IntPoint()
				: this(0, 0)
			{
			}

			public IntPoint(int x, int y)
			{
				_x = x;
				_y = y;
			}

			internal void SetXY(int x, int y)
			{
				_x = x;
				_y = y;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return _x ^ _y;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is IntPoint)
				{
					IntPoint intPoint = (IntPoint)obj;
					if (_x == intPoint._x)
					{
						return _y == intPoint._y;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class LayoutItemComparer : IComparer<GridBagConstraintCache>
		{
			private bool _yWise;

			private GridBagLayoutManager _gblm;

			internal LayoutItemComparer(GridBagLayoutManager gblm, bool yWise)
			{
				_yWise = yWise;
				_gblm = gblm;
			}

			internal static int Compare(GridBagConstraintCache gcc1, GridBagConstraintCache gcc2, GridBagLayoutManager gblm, bool yWise, bool flag)
			{
				if (GridBagLayoutMode.Uniform == gblm.LayoutMode)
				{
					if (yWise)
					{
						if (gcc1._rowSpan < gcc2._rowSpan)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						if (gcc1._rowSpan > gcc2._rowSpan)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						if (gcc1._row < gcc2._row)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						if (gcc1._row > gcc2._row)
						{
							return 1;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (gcc1._columnSpan < gcc2._columnSpan)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						if (gcc1._columnSpan > gcc2._columnSpan)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						if (gcc1._column < gcc2._column)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						if (gcc1._column > gcc2._column)
						{
							return 1;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (GridBagLayoutMode.LeftToRight == gblm.LayoutMode)
				{
					if (yWise)
					{
						if (gcc1._row + gcc1._rowSpan < gcc2._row + gcc2._rowSpan)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						if (gcc1._row + gcc1._rowSpan > gcc2._row + gcc2._rowSpan)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						if (gcc1._row < gcc2._row)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						if (gcc1._row > gcc2._row)
						{
							return 1;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (gcc1._column + gcc1._columnSpan < gcc2._column + gcc2._columnSpan)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						if (gcc1._column + gcc1._columnSpan > gcc2._column + gcc2._columnSpan)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						if (gcc1._column < gcc2._column)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						if (gcc1._column > gcc2._column)
						{
							return 1;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (yWise)
				{
					if (gcc1._rowSpan < gcc2._rowSpan)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (gcc1._rowSpan > gcc2._rowSpan)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					if (gcc1._row < gcc2._row)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (gcc1._row > gcc2._row)
					{
						return 1;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (gcc1._columnSpan < gcc2._columnSpan)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (gcc1._columnSpan > gcc2._columnSpan)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					if (gcc1._column < gcc2._column)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (gcc1._column > gcc2._column)
					{
						return 1;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return Compare(gcc1, gcc2, gblm, !yWise, flag: false);
				}
				return 0;
			}

			public int Compare(GridBagConstraintCache o1, GridBagConstraintCache o2)
			{
				return Compare(o1, o2, _gblm, _yWise, flag: true);
			}
		}

		private class ResizeManager
		{
			private class LayoutItemInfo : IAutoSizeLayoutItem, ILayoutItem
			{
				internal ILayoutItem _i;

				internal System.Windows.Size _preferredSize;

				internal GridBagConstraintCache _gcc;

				internal GridBagLayoutItemDimensions _dim;

				internal bool _isAutoWidth;

				internal bool _isAutoHeight;

				public Visibility Visibility => _i.Visibility;

				public System.Windows.Size MaximumSize => _i.MaximumSize;

				public System.Windows.Size MinimumSize => _i.MinimumSize;

				public System.Windows.Size PreferredSize => _preferredSize;

				public bool IsWidthAutoSized => _isAutoWidth;

				public bool IsHeightAutoSized => _isAutoHeight;

				internal LayoutItemInfo(ILayoutItem i)
				{
					_i = i;
					_preferredSize = i.PreferredSize;
					IAutoSizeLayoutItem autoSizeLayoutItem = i as IAutoSizeLayoutItem;
					_isAutoWidth = autoSizeLayoutItem?.IsWidthAutoSized ?? false;
					_isAutoHeight = autoSizeLayoutItem?.IsHeightAutoSized ?? false;
				}
			}

				_containerContext = containerContext;

			public void GetResizeRange(ILayoutItem resizeItem, out double maxDeltaLeft, out double maxDeltaRight, out double maxDeltaTop, out double maxDeltaBottom, IList<ILayoutItem> synchronizedItems)
			{

				GetResizeRangeHelper(itemInfos, out maxDeltaLeft, out maxDeltaRight, out maxDeltaTop, out maxDeltaBottom);

			public void ResizeItems(Dictionary<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> newSizes)
			{
				List<LayoutItemInfo> list = new List<LayoutItemInfo>();
				List<System.Windows.Size> list2 = new List<System.Windows.Size>();
				List<LayoutItemInfo> list3 = new List<LayoutItemInfo>();
				List<System.Windows.Size> list4 = new List<System.Windows.Size>();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> newSize in newSizes)
				{
					LayoutItemInfo mappedItem = GetMappedItem(newSize.Key);
					System.Windows.Size value = newSize.Value;
					if (mappedItem != null)
					{
						if (value.Width > 0.0)
						{
							list.Add(mappedItem);
							list2.Add(value);
						}
						if (value.Height > 0.0)
						{
							list3.Add(mappedItem);
							list4.Add(value);
						}
					}
				}
				ResizeItemsHelper(list.ToArray(), list2.ToArray(), resizeWidth: true, resizeHeight: false);
				ResizeItemsHelper(list3.ToArray(), list4.ToArray(), resizeWidth: false, resizeHeight: true);
			}

			public void ResizeItem(ILayoutItem item, double deltaX, double deltaY, IList<ILayoutItem> synchronizedItems)
			{
				ResizeItemHelper(item, deltaX, deltaY, synchronizedItems);
			}

			private void AddMargin(ref System.Windows.Size sz, LayoutItemInfo ii)
			{
				Thickness marginWithSpacing = ii._gcc.GetMarginWithSpacing(_layoutManager);
				sz.Width += marginWithSpacing.Left + marginWithSpacing.Right;
				sz.Height += marginWithSpacing.Top + marginWithSpacing.Bottom;
			}

			private static bool AreClose(System.Windows.Size x, System.Windows.Size y, double threshold)
			{
				if (Math.Abs(x.Width - y.Width) <= threshold)
				{
					return Math.Abs(x.Height - y.Height) <= threshold;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static bool AreClose(double x, double y, double threshold)
			{
				return Math.Abs(x - y) <= threshold;
			}

			private static bool AreSame(Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> xx, Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> yy)
			{
				if (xx.Count != yy.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> item in xx)
				{
					if (!yy.TryGetValue(item.Key, out var value) || !CoreUtilities.AreClose(item.Value, value))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			private static void ArrayMove<X, Y>(X[] xxArr, Y[] yyArr, int[] indeces)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < indeces.Length; i++)
				{
					int x = indeces[i];
					CoreUtilities.Swap(xxArr, x, i);
					CoreUtilities.Swap(yyArr, x, i);
					CoreUtilities.Swap(indeces, x, i);
				}
			}

			private static double CalcAbsoluteDelta(LayoutItemInfo item, System.Windows.Size size, bool yDimension)
			{
				double value = ((!yDimension) ? (item._dim.Size.Width - size.Width) : (item._dim.Size.Height - size.Height));
				return Math.Abs(value);
			}

			private double CalcDeltaHelper(LayoutItemInfo[] resizeItems, System.Windows.Size[] newSizes, ref int startIndex, bool yDelta)
			{
				double num = double.NaN;
				LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo = resizeItems[startIndex];
				int num2 = ((!yDelta) ? layoutItemInfo._dim.ColumnRight : layoutItemInfo._dim.RowBottom);
				while (startIndex < resizeItems.Length)
				{
					layoutItemInfo = resizeItems[startIndex];
					int num3 = ((!yDelta) ? layoutItemInfo._dim.ColumnRight : layoutItemInfo._dim.RowBottom);
					if (num3 != num2)
					{
						break;
					}
					System.Windows.Size size = newSizes[startIndex];
					double num4 = ((!yDelta) ? (size.Width - layoutItemInfo._dim.Bounds.Width) : (size.Height - layoutItemInfo._dim.Bounds.Height));
					if (double.IsNaN(num))
					{
						num = num4;
					}
					else if (num < num4)
					{
						num = num4;
					}
					startIndex++;
				}
				return CloseToZeroHelper(num);
			}

			private System.Windows.Size CalcNewSizeHelper(LayoutItemInfo item, double deltaX, double deltaY)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = item._dim.Size;
				size.Width = Math.Max(size.Width + deltaX, 0.0);
				size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height + deltaY, 0.0);
				return size;
			}

			private bool ClearIsAutoState(LayoutItemInfo[] items, bool clearAutoWidthState, bool clearAutoHeightState, bool alsoClearAlignedItems, bool recalcLayout)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (!alsoClearAlignedItems)
				{
					foreach (LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo in items)
					{
						if (clearAutoWidthState && layoutItemInfo._isAutoWidth)
						{
							layoutItemInfo._isAutoWidth = false;
							flag = true;
						}
						if (clearAutoHeightState && layoutItemInfo._isAutoHeight)
						{
							layoutItemInfo._isAutoHeight = false;
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					HashSet<LayoutItemInfo> hashSet = new HashSet<LayoutItemInfo>();
					HashSet<LayoutItemInfo> hashSet2 = new HashSet<LayoutItemInfo>();
					foreach (LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo2 in items)
					{
						if (clearAutoWidthState && !hashSet.Contains(layoutItemInfo2))
						{
							LayoutItemInfo[] itemsEndingAt = GetItemsEndingAt(layoutItemInfo2._dim.ColumnRight, yDimension: false);
							flag = ClearIsAutoState(itemsEndingAt, clearAutoWidthState: true, clearAutoHeightState: false, alsoClearAlignedItems: false, recalcLayout: false) || flag;
							for (int k = 0; k < itemsEndingAt.Length; k++)
							{
								hashSet.Add(itemsEndingAt[k]);
							}
						}
						if (clearAutoHeightState && !hashSet2.Contains(layoutItemInfo2))
						{
							LayoutItemInfo[] itemsEndingAt2 = GetItemsEndingAt(layoutItemInfo2._dim.RowBottom, yDimension: true);
							flag = ClearIsAutoState(itemsEndingAt2, clearAutoWidthState: false, clearAutoHeightState: true, alsoClearAlignedItems: false, recalcLayout: false) || flag;
							for (int l = 0; l < itemsEndingAt2.Length; l++)
							{
								hashSet2.Add(itemsEndingAt2[l]);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (recalcLayout && flag)
				{
					ReCalculateLayout();
				}
				return flag;
			}

			private GridBagLayoutManager CloneLayoutManagerHelper(GridBagLayoutManager source)
			{
				GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutManager = source.Clone(copyLayoutItems: false);
				gridBagLayoutManager.IncludeMarginInPositionRect = false;
				LayoutItemsCollection layoutItems = source.LayoutItems;
				LayoutItemsCollection layoutItems2 = gridBagLayoutManager.LayoutItems;
				foreach (ILayoutItem item in (IEnumerable<ILayoutItem>)layoutItems)
				{
					layoutItems2.Add(new LayoutItemInfo(item), layoutItems.GetConstraint(item));
				}
				return gridBagLayoutManager;
			}

			private static double CloseToZeroHelper(double d)
			{
				if (CoreUtilities.AreClose(d, 0.0))
				{
					d = 0.0;
				}
				return d;
			}

			private double[] CreateCoordinates(double[] extents)
			{
				double[] array = new double[1 + extents.Length];
				Array.Copy(extents, array, extents.Length);
				ConvertToCoordinates(array);
				return array;
			}

			private System.Windows.Size[] CreateSizeArr(System.Windows.Size size, int len)
			{
				System.Windows.Size[] array = new System.Windows.Size[len];
				for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
				{
					array[i] = size;
				}
				return array;
			}

			private double GetCellExtent(double[] coordinates, int origin, int span)
			{
				return coordinates[origin + span] - coordinates[origin];
			}

			private Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> GetCurrentItemSizes()
			{
				Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> dictionary = new Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size>();
				LayoutItemInfo[] infos = _infos;
				foreach (LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo in infos)
				{
					dictionary[layoutItemInfo] = layoutItemInfo._dim.Size;
				}
				return dictionary;
			}

			private LayoutItemInfo[] GetItemsEndingAt(int edge, bool yDimension)
			{
				int key = ((!yDimension) ? edge : (-edge - 1));
				if (_itemsEndingAtCache.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				LayoutItemInfo[] infos = _infos;
				List<LayoutItemInfo> list = new List<LayoutItemInfo>();
				foreach (LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo in infos)
				{
					GridBagLayoutItemDimensions dim = layoutItemInfo._dim;
					int num = ((!yDimension) ? layoutItemInfo._dim.ColumnRight : layoutItemInfo._dim.RowBottom);
					if (num == edge)
					{
						list.Add(layoutItemInfo);
					}
				}
				value = list.ToArray();
				_itemsEndingAtCache[key] = value;
				return value;
			}

			private LayoutItemInfo GetMappedItem(ILayoutItem item)
			{
				if (!_mappings.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_GridBag_ItemNotInLayoutItems", item));
				}
				if (value._dim == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_GridBag_ItemNotVisible", item));
				}
				return value;
			}

			internal Dictionary<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> GetNewPreferredSizes(out Dictionary<ILayoutItem, bool> newIsWidthAutoState, out Dictionary<ILayoutItem, bool> newIsHeightAutoState, bool xDimension, bool yDimension)
			{
				Dictionary<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> dictionary = new Dictionary<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size>();
				newIsWidthAutoState = new Dictionary<ILayoutItem, bool>();
				newIsHeightAutoState = new Dictionary<ILayoutItem, bool>();
				foreach (LayoutItemInfo item in (IEnumerable<ILayoutItem>)_layoutManager.LayoutItems)
				{
					if (item._gcc == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					IAutoSizeLayoutItem autoSizeLayoutItem = item._i as IAutoSizeLayoutItem;
					bool flag = autoSizeLayoutItem?.IsWidthAutoSized ?? false;
					bool flag2 = autoSizeLayoutItem?.IsHeightAutoSized ?? false;
					System.Windows.Size preferredSize = item._i.PreferredSize;
					System.Windows.Size size = preferredSize;
					if (xDimension)
					{
						if (preferredSize.Width != item._preferredSize.Width)
						{
							size.Width = item._preferredSize.Width;
						}
						if (flag != item._isAutoWidth)
						{
							newIsWidthAutoState[item._i] = item._isAutoWidth;
						}
					}
					if (yDimension)
					{
						if (preferredSize.Height != item._preferredSize.Height)
						{
							size.Height = item._preferredSize.Height;
						}
						if (flag2 != item._isAutoHeight)
						{
							newIsHeightAutoState[item._i] = item._isAutoHeight;
						}
					}
					if (size != preferredSize)
					{
						dictionary[item._i] = size;
					}
				}
				return dictionary;
			}

			private Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> GetPreferredSizes(LayoutItemInfo[] items)
			{
				Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> dictionary = new Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size>();
				foreach (LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo in items)
				{
					dictionary[layoutItemInfo] = layoutItemInfo._preferredSize;
				}
				return dictionary;
			}

			private LayoutItemInfo GetResizeItemInfosHelper(ILayoutItem resizeItem, IList<ILayoutItem> synchronizedItems, out LayoutItemInfo[] itemInfos)
			{
				LayoutItemInfo mappedItem = GetMappedItem(resizeItem);
				List<LayoutItemInfo> list = new List<LayoutItemInfo>();
				list.Add(mappedItem);
				if (synchronizedItems != null)
				{
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = synchronizedItems.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						ILayoutItem layoutItem = synchronizedItems[i];
						if (layoutItem != resizeItem)
						{
							list.Add(GetMappedItem(layoutItem));
						}
					}
				}
				itemInfos = list.ToArray();
				return mappedItem;
			}

			private void GetResizeRangeHelper(LayoutItemInfo[] resizeItems, out double maxDeltaLeft, out double maxDeltaRight, out double maxDeltaTop, out double maxDeltaBottom)
			{
				maxDeltaLeft = (maxDeltaRight = (maxDeltaTop = (maxDeltaBottom = double.MaxValue)));
				ClearIsAutoState(resizeItems, clearAutoWidthState: true, clearAutoHeightState: true, alsoClearAlignedItems: true, recalcLayout: true);
				HashSet<int> hashSet = new HashSet<int>();
				HashSet<int> hashSet2 = new HashSet<int>();
				foreach (LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo in resizeItems)
				{
					if (!hashSet.Contains(layoutItemInfo._dim.ColumnRight) || !hashSet2.Contains(layoutItemInfo._dim.RowBottom))
					{
						hashSet.Add(layoutItemInfo._dim.ColumnRight);
						hashSet2.Add(layoutItemInfo._dim.RowBottom);
						GetResizeRangeHelperHelper(layoutItemInfo, out var maxDeltaLeft2, out var maxDeltaRight2, out var maxDeltaTop2, out var maxDeltaBottom2);
						maxDeltaLeft = Math.Min(maxDeltaLeft, maxDeltaLeft2);
						maxDeltaRight = Math.Min(maxDeltaRight, maxDeltaRight2);
						maxDeltaTop = Math.Min(maxDeltaTop, maxDeltaTop2);
						maxDeltaBottom = Math.Min(maxDeltaBottom, maxDeltaBottom2);
					}
				}
				if (_autoFitWidth)
				{
					maxDeltaLeft = 0.0 - GetResizeRangeHelper_AdjustDeltaHelper(resizeItems, 0.0 - maxDeltaLeft, yDimension: false);
					maxDeltaRight = GetResizeRangeHelper_AdjustDeltaHelper(resizeItems, maxDeltaRight, yDimension: false);
				}
				if (_autoFitHeight)
				{
					maxDeltaTop = 0.0 - GetResizeRangeHelper_AdjustDeltaHelper(resizeItems, 0.0 - maxDeltaTop, yDimension: true);
					maxDeltaBottom = GetResizeRangeHelper_AdjustDeltaHelper(resizeItems, maxDeltaBottom, yDimension: true);
				}
			}

			private void GetResizeRangeHelperHelper(LayoutItemInfo resizeItem, out double maxDeltaLeft, out double maxDeltaRight, out double maxDeltaTop, out double maxDeltaBottom)
			{
				GridBagLayoutCache glc = _glc;
				LayoutItemInfo[] infos = _infos;
				GridBagLayoutItemDimensions dim = resizeItem._dim;
				int num = dim.Column;
				int num2 = dim.Row;
				double num3 = double.MaxValue;
				double num4 = double.MaxValue;
				foreach (LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo in infos)
				{
					GridBagLayoutItemDimensions dim2 = layoutItemInfo._dim;
					if (dim2.ColumnRight < dim.ColumnRight && dim2.ColumnRight > dim.Column)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, dim2.ColumnRight);
					}
					if (dim2.RowBottom < dim.RowBottom && dim2.RowBottom > dim.Row)
					{
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, dim2.RowBottom);
					}
					Thickness marginWithSpacing = layoutItemInfo._gcc.GetMarginWithSpacing(_layoutManager);
					if (dim2.ColumnRight == dim.ColumnRight && System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch == layoutItemInfo._gcc._gc.HorizontalAlignment)
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, dim2.Bounds.Left + layoutItemInfo._gcc._maxWidth + marginWithSpacing.Right);
					}
					if (dim2.RowBottom == dim.RowBottom && VerticalAlignment.Stretch == layoutItemInfo._gcc._gc.VerticalAlignment)
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, dim2.Bounds.Top + layoutItemInfo._gcc._maxHeight + marginWithSpacing.Bottom);
					}
				}
				double num5 = ArrSum(glc._colWidthsMin, num, dim.ColumnRight - num);
				double num6 = ArrSum(glc._rowHeightsMin, num2, dim.RowBottom - num2);
				double val = glc._colCoordinates[num] + num5;
				double val2 = glc._rowCoordinates[num2] + num6;
				val = Math.Max(val, dim.Bounds.Left + resizeItem._gcc._minWidth);
				val2 = Math.Max(val2, dim.Bounds.Top + resizeItem._gcc._minHeight);
				maxDeltaLeft = dim.Bounds.Right - val;
				maxDeltaTop = dim.Bounds.Bottom - val2;
				maxDeltaRight = num3 - dim.Bounds.Right;
				maxDeltaBottom = num4 - dim.Bounds.Bottom;
				Rect containerBoundsHelper = LayoutManagerBase.GetContainerBoundsHelper(_layoutContainer, _containerContext, _layoutManager);
				if (_autoFitWidth && containerBoundsHelper.Width > 0.0)
				{
					maxDeltaRight = Math.Min(maxDeltaRight, containerBoundsHelper.Width);
				}
				if (_autoFitHeight && containerBoundsHelper.Height > 0.0)
				{
					maxDeltaBottom = Math.Min(maxDeltaBottom, containerBoundsHelper.Height);
				}
			}

			private double GetResizeRangeHelper_AdjustDeltaHelper(LayoutItemInfo[] resizeItems, double delta, bool yDimension)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = delta;
				int num3 = 0;
				int num4 = 20;
				Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> preferredSizes = GetPreferredSizes(_infos);
				while (!AreClose(num, num2, 0.05) && num3++ < num4)
				{
					double num5 = num + 0.33 * (num2 - num);
					double delta2 = num + 0.66 * (num2 - num);
					Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> resizeResultsHelper = GetResizeResultsHelper(resizeItems, num5, yDimension, preferredSizes);
					Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> resizeResultsHelper2 = GetResizeResultsHelper(resizeItems, delta2, yDimension, preferredSizes);
					if (AreSame(resizeResultsHelper, resizeResultsHelper2))
					{
						num2 = num5;
					}
					else
					{
						num = num5;
					}
				}
				return Math.Round(num2, 1);
			}

			private Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> GetResizeResultsHelper(LayoutItemInfo[] resizeItems, double delta, bool yDimension, Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> restorePreferredSizes)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = CalcNewSizeHelper(resizeItems[0], (!yDimension) ? delta : 0.0, yDimension ? delta : 0.0);
				ResizeItemsHelper(resizeItems, CreateSizeArr(size, resizeItems.Length), yDimension);
				Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size> dictionary = new Dictionary<LayoutItemInfo, System.Windows.Size>();
				foreach (LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo in resizeItems)
				{
					dictionary[layoutItemInfo] = layoutItemInfo._dim.Size;
				}
				if (restorePreferredSizes != null)
				{
					SetPreferredSizes(restorePreferredSizes);
				}
				ReCalculateLayout();
				return dictionary;
			}

			private bool IsExtentDifferent(LayoutItemInfo[] resizeItems, System.Windows.Size[] newSizes, bool yDimension)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < resizeItems.Length; i++)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						break;
					}
					System.Windows.Size size = resizeItems[i]._dim.Size;
					System.Windows.Size size2 = newSizes[i];
					flag = ((!yDimension) ? (!CoreUtilities.AreClose(size.Width, size2.Width)) : (!CoreUtilities.AreClose(size.Height, size2.Height)));
				}
				return flag;
			}

			private void ReCalculateLayout()
			{
				ReCalculateLayout(invalidateLayout: true);
			}

			private void ReCalculateLayout(bool invalidateLayout)
			{
				if (invalidateLayout)
				{
					_layoutManager.InvalidateLayout();
				}
				_glc = _layoutManager.GetGridBagLayoutCache();
				if (!invalidateLayout)
				{
					_glc._lastContainerWidth = (_glc._lastContainerHeight = 0.0);
				}
				GridBagConstraintCache[] gccArr = _glc._gccArr;
				GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection layoutItemDimensions = _layoutManager.GetLayoutItemDimensions(_layoutContainer, _containerContext);
				if (_mappings == null || _infos == null)
				{
					_mappings = new Dictionary<ILayoutItem, LayoutItemInfo>();
					List<LayoutItemInfo> list = new List<LayoutItemInfo>();
					foreach (GridBagConstraintCache gridBagConstraintCache in gccArr)
					{
						LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo = (LayoutItemInfo)gridBagConstraintCache._item;
						_mappings[layoutItemInfo._i] = layoutItemInfo;
						list.Add(layoutItemInfo);
					}
					_infos = list.ToArray();
				}
				foreach (GridBagConstraintCache gridBagConstraintCache2 in gccArr)
				{
					LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo2 = (LayoutItemInfo)gridBagConstraintCache2._item;
					if (layoutItemDimensions.Exists(layoutItemInfo2))
					{
						layoutItemInfo2._gcc = gridBagConstraintCache2;
						layoutItemInfo2._dim = layoutItemDimensions[layoutItemInfo2];
					}
				}
			}

			private void RemoveMargin(ref System.Windows.Size sz, LayoutItemInfo ii)
			{
				Thickness marginWithSpacing = ii._gcc.GetMarginWithSpacing(_layoutManager);
				sz.Width -= marginWithSpacing.Left + marginWithSpacing.Right;
				sz.Height -= marginWithSpacing.Top + marginWithSpacing.Bottom;
			}

			private void ResizeLogicalDims(LayoutItemInfo item, double targetExtent, bool yDimension)
			{
				double[] array = ((!yDimension) ? _layoutManager.ColumnWidths : _layoutManager.RowHeights);
				int num = ((!yDimension) ? item._dim.Column : item._dim.Row);
				int num2 = ((!yDimension) ? item._dim.ColumnSpan : item._dim.RowSpan);
				Rect bounds = item._dim.Bounds;
				double num3 = ((!yDimension) ? bounds.Width : bounds.Height);
				double num4 = targetExtent - num3;
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					array[num + i] = Math.Max(array[num + i] + num4 / (double)num2, (!yDimension) ? item._gcc._minWidth : item._gcc._minHeight);
				}
			}

			private void ResizeItemHelper(ILayoutItem item, double deltaX, double deltaY, IList<ILayoutItem> synchronizedItems)
			{
				LayoutItemInfo[] itemInfos;
				LayoutItemInfo resizeItemInfosHelper = GetResizeItemInfosHelper(item, synchronizedItems, out itemInfos);
				System.Windows.Size size = CalcNewSizeHelper(resizeItemInfosHelper, deltaX, deltaY);
				ResizeItemsHelper(itemInfos, CreateSizeArr(size, itemInfos.Length), !IsCloseToZero(deltaX), !IsCloseToZero(deltaY));
			}

			private void ResizeItemsHelper(LayoutItemInfo[] resizeItems, System.Windows.Size[] newSizes, bool yDimension)
			{
				Rect containerBoundsHelper = LayoutManagerBase.GetContainerBoundsHelper(_layoutContainer, _containerContext, _layoutManager);
				System.Windows.Size size = _layoutManager.CalculatePreferredSize(_layoutContainer, _containerContext);
				bool flag = (yDimension ? (_autoFitHeight || (_layoutManager.ExpandToFitHeight && !AreClose(containerBoundsHelper.Height, size.Height, 1.0))) : (_autoFitWidth || (_layoutManager.ExpandToFitWidth && !AreClose(containerBoundsHelper.Width, size.Width, 1.0))));

				int num = ((!flag) ? 1 : 20);

				foreach (LayoutItemInfo layoutItemInfo in infos)

					}
				}
			}

			private void SortResizeItemsHelper(LayoutItemInfo[] resizeItems, System.Windows.Size[] newSizes, bool yWise)
			{
				int[] array = new int[resizeItems.Length];
				ArrInitIndeces(array);
				CoreUtilities.SortMergeGeneric(array, CoreUtilities.CreateComparer(delegate(int x, int y)
				{
					GridBagLayoutItemDimensions dim = resizeItems[x]._dim;
					GridBagLayoutItemDimensions dim2 = resizeItems[y]._dim;
					int num;
					if (!yWise)
					{
						num = dim.ColumnRight.CompareTo(dim2.ColumnRight);
						if (num == 0)
						{
							num = dim.Column.CompareTo(dim2.Column);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num = dim.RowBottom.CompareTo(dim2.RowBottom);
						if (num == 0)
						{
							num = dim.Row.CompareTo(dim2.Row);
						}
					}
					return num;
				}));
				ArrayMove(resizeItems, newSizes, array);
			}
		}

		private GridBagLayoutManager Clone(bool copyLayoutItems)
		{
			GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLayoutManager = new GridBagLayoutManager();
			gridBagLayoutManager._expandToFitHeight = _expandToFitHeight;
			gridBagLayoutManager._expandToFitWidth = _expandToFitWidth;
			gridBagLayoutManager._gridBagMode = _gridBagMode;
			gridBagLayoutManager._includeMarginInPositionRect = _includeMarginInPositionRect;
			gridBagLayoutManager._preferredSizeIncludesMargin = _preferredSizeIncludesMargin;
			gridBagLayoutManager._interItemSpacingHorizontal = _interItemSpacingHorizontal;
			gridBagLayoutManager._interItemSpacingVertical = _interItemSpacingVertical;
			gridBagLayoutManager._horizontalContentAlignment = _horizontalContentAlignment;
			gridBagLayoutManager._verticalContentAlignment = _verticalContentAlignment;
			gridBagLayoutManager._shrinkToFitHeight = _shrinkToFitHeight;
			gridBagLayoutManager._shrinkToFitWidth = _shrinkToFitWidth;
			if (copyLayoutItems)
			{
				LayoutItemsCollection layoutItems = base.LayoutItems;
				foreach (ILayoutItem item in (IEnumerable<ILayoutItem>)layoutItems)
				{
					gridBagLayoutManager.LayoutItems.Add(item, layoutItems.GetConstraint(item));
				}
			}
			return gridBagLayoutManager;
		}

		internal Dictionary<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> PerformAutoSize(ILayoutContainer layoutContainer, object containerContext, Dictionary<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> preferredSizes, bool autoFitWidth, bool autoFitHeight, out Dictionary<ILayoutItem, bool> newIsWidthAutoState, out Dictionary<ILayoutItem, bool> newIsHeightAutoState, bool xDimension, bool yDimension)
		{
			newIsWidthAutoState = (newIsHeightAutoState = null);
			if (preferredSizes == null || preferredSizes.Count == 0)

				return new Dictionary<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size>();
			}
			ResizeManager resizeManager = new ResizeManager(this, layoutContainer, containerContext, autoFitWidth, autoFitHeight);
			resizeManager._isAutoSizing = true;
			resizeManager.ResizeItems(preferredSizes);
			return resizeManager.GetNewPreferredSizes(out newIsWidthAutoState, out newIsHeightAutoState, xDimension, yDimension);
		}

		private Rect ApplyAlignments(double x, double y, double width, double height, GridBagConstraintCache gcc)
		{
			double num = gcc._prefWidth;
			double num2 = gcc._prefHeight;
			double num3 = gcc._maxWidth;
			double num4 = gcc._maxHeight;
			Thickness margin = gcc._margin;
			double num5 = margin.Left + margin.Right;
			double num6 = margin.Top + margin.Bottom;
			if (_includeMarginInPositionRect)
			{
				if (!_preferredSizeIncludesMargin)
				{
					num += num5;
					num2 += num6;
				}
				num3 += num5;
				num4 += num6;
			}
			else
			{
				if (_preferredSizeIncludesMargin)
				{
					num -= num5;
					num2 -= num6;
				}
				x += margin.Left;
				width -= num5;
				y += margin.Top;
				height -= num6;
			}
			if (gcc._hasSpacing != Side.None)
			{
				Thickness spacing = gcc.GetSpacing(this);
				x += spacing.Left;
				width -= spacing.Left + spacing.Right;
				y += spacing.Top;
				height -= spacing.Top + spacing.Bottom;
			}
			if (num > width)
			{
				num = width;
			}
			if (num2 > height)
			{
				num2 = height;
			}
			System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment = gcc._gc.HorizontalAlignment;
			VerticalAlignment verticalAlignment = gcc._gc.VerticalAlignment;
			switch (horizontalAlignment)
			{
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right:
				x += width - num;
				break;
			default:
				if (System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch == horizontalAlignment)
				{
					num = Math.Min(width, num3);
				}
				x += (width - num) / 2.0;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left:
				break;
			}
			switch (verticalAlignment)
			{
			case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
				y += height - num2;
				break;
			default:
				if (VerticalAlignment.Stretch == verticalAlignment)
				{
					num2 = Math.Min(height, num4);
				}
				y += (height - num2) / 2.0;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Top:
				break;
			}
			return new Rect(x, y, Math.Max(num, 0.0), Math.Max(num2, 0.0));
		}

		private static void ArrInit(IntExpandableArray arr, int val)
		{
			ArrInit(arr, val, 0, arr.Length);
		}

		private static void ArrInit(IntExpandableArray arr, int val, int startIndex, int len)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
			{
				arr[startIndex + i] = val;
			}
		}

		private static void ArrInitIndeces(int[] arr)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length; i++)
			{
				arr[i] = i;
			}
		}

		private static int ArrMax(IntExpandableArray arr, int startIndex, int len)
		{
			int num = arr[startIndex];
			for (int i = 1; i < len; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, arr[startIndex + i]);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static void ArrSet<T>(T[] arr, T value, int startIndex, int count)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				arr[startIndex + i] = value;
			}
		}

		private static float ArrSum(float[] arr, int startIndex, int len)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
			{
				num += arr[startIndex + i];
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double ArrSum(double[] arr)
		{
			return ArrSum(arr, 0, arr.Length);
		}

		private static double ArrSum_SkipItems(double[] arr, bool[] skipItems)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int i = 0;
			for (int num2 = arr.Length; i < num2; i++)
			{
				if (!skipItems[i])
				{
					num += arr[i];
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double ArrSum(double[] arr, int startIndex, int len)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
			{
				num += arr[startIndex + i];
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double[] CalculateCoordinatesHelper(double[] extents, double[] minExtents, double[] maxExtents, float[] weightsFloat, bool[] isAuto, double containerExtent, bool expandToFit, bool? shrinkToFit, out double[] calculatedExtents)
		{
			double[] array = new double[extents.Length];
			extents.CopyTo(array, 0);
			double[] array2 = null;
			double num = containerExtent - ArrSum(array);
			int num2 = ((isAuto != null) ? 3 : 2);
			for (int i = 0; i < num2 && !IsCloseToZero(num); i++)
			{
				if (i == 0)
				{
					float num3 = ArrSum(weightsFloat, 0, weightsFloat.Length);
					if (0f == num3)
					{
						continue;
					}
					array2 = new double[extents.Length];
					for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
					{
						array2[j] = weightsFloat[j];
					}
				}
				if (i > 0)
				{
					if (!((!(num < 0.0)) ? expandToFit : (shrinkToFit.HasValue ? shrinkToFit.Value : expandToFit)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (array2 == null)
					{
						array2 = new double[extents.Length];
					}
					for (int k = 0; k < array2.Length; k++)
					{
						array2[k] = (((isAuto != null && isAuto[k]) ^ (1 == i)) ? extents[k] : 0.0);
					}
				}
				while (!IsCloseToZero(num) && array2 != null && NormalizeRatios(array2))
				{
					int num4 = 0;
					for (int l = 0; l < array2.Length; l++)
					{
						double num5 = array2[l] * num;
						if (0.0 != num5)
						{
							double num6 = array[l] + num5;
							double num7 = Math.Max(num6, minExtents[l]);
							double num8 = maxExtents[l];
							if (0.0 != num8)
							{
								num7 = Math.Min(num7, num8);
							}
							array[l] = num7;
							if (num7 != num6)
							{
								array2[l] = 0.0;
								num4++;
							}
						}
					}
					num = containerExtent - ArrSum(array);
					if (num4 == 0 || num4 == array2.Length)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			calculatedExtents = array;
			double[] array3 = new double[array.Length + 1];
			array.CopyTo(array3, 0);
			ConvertToCoordinates(array3);
			return array3;
		}

		private void CalculateInterItemSpacing(GridBagConstraintCache[] gccArr, double[] colWidthsPref, double[] rowHeightsPref)
		{
			if (!HasInterItemSpacingHorizontal && !HasInterItemSpacingVertical)
			{
				return;
			}
			double interItemSpacingHorizontal = InterItemSpacingHorizontal;
			double interItemSpacingVertical = InterItemSpacingVertical;
			foreach (GridBagConstraintCache gridBagConstraintCache in gccArr)
			{
				if (gridBagConstraintCache._column > 0)
				{
					gridBagConstraintCache._hasSpacing |= Side.Left;
				}
				if (gridBagConstraintCache._column + gridBagConstraintCache._columnSpan < colWidthsPref.Length)
				{
					gridBagConstraintCache._hasSpacing |= Side.Right;
				}
				if (gridBagConstraintCache._row > 0)
				{
					gridBagConstraintCache._hasSpacing |= Side.Top;
				}
				if (gridBagConstraintCache._row + gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan < rowHeightsPref.Length)
				{
					gridBagConstraintCache._hasSpacing |= Side.Bottom;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ConvertToCoordinates(double[] arr)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length; i++)
			{
				double num2 = num + arr[i];
				arr[i] = num;
				num = num2;
			}
		}

		private void GetContentOffset(Rect containerRect, out double offsetX, out double offsetY, double[] colCoordinates, double[] rowCoordinates)
		{
			offsetX = containerRect.X;
			offsetY = containerRect.Y;
			double num = containerRect.Width - (colCoordinates[colCoordinates.Length - 1] - colCoordinates[0]);
			double num2 = containerRect.Height - (rowCoordinates[rowCoordinates.Length - 1] - rowCoordinates[0]);
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				switch (_horizontalContentAlignment)
				{
				case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right:
					offsetX += num;
					break;
				case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center:
					offsetX += num / 2.0;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num2 > 0.0)
			{
				switch (_verticalContentAlignment)
				{
				case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
					offsetY += num2;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Center:
					offsetY += num2 / 2.0;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

					{

					}
				}
			}
			tmpGccArr = new GridBagConstraintCache[num];
			if (num != array.Length)
			{
				Array.Copy(array, tmpGccArr, num);
				GridBagConstraintCache[] array2 = array;
				array = tmpGccArr;
				tmpGccArr = array2;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size GetTotalSize(double[] widths, double[] heights)

		}

		private GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection GridBagHelper(ILayoutContainer container, object containerContext, bool layoutContainer, bool returnItemDimensions, ref object layoutRect)
		{
			GridBagLayoutCache gridBagLayoutCache = GetGridBagLayoutCache();

			bool flag = array != null && array2 != null && array.Length == 1 + gridBagLayoutCache._colWidthsPref.Length && array2.Length == 1 + gridBagLayoutCache._rowHeightsPref.Length;
			if (!flag || containerBoundsHelper.Width != gridBagLayoutCache._lastContainerWidth)
			{
				array = CalculateCoordinatesHelper(gridBagLayoutCache._colWidthsPref, gridBagLayoutCache._colWidthsMin, gridBagLayoutCache._colWidthsMax, gridBagLayoutCache._colWeights, gridBagLayoutCache._colIsAuto, containerBoundsHelper.Width, ExpandToFitWidth, ShrinkToFitWidth, out calculatedExtents);
				gridBagLayoutCache._colCoordinateExtents = calculatedExtents;
				gridBagLayoutCache._lastContainerWidth = containerBoundsHelper.Width;
				gridBagLayoutCache._colCoordinates = array;
			}
			if (!flag || containerBoundsHelper.Height != gridBagLayoutCache._lastContainerHeight)
			{
				array2 = CalculateCoordinatesHelper(gridBagLayoutCache._rowHeightsPref, gridBagLayoutCache._rowHeightsMin, gridBagLayoutCache._rowHeightsMax, gridBagLayoutCache._rowWeights, gridBagLayoutCache._rowIsAuto, containerBoundsHelper.Height, ExpandToFitHeight, ShrinkToFitHeight, out calculatedExtents2);
				gridBagLayoutCache._rowCoordinateExtents = calculatedExtents2;

				gridBagLayoutCache._rowCoordinates = array2;
			}
			GetContentOffset(containerBoundsHelper, out var offsetX, out var offsetY, array, array2);
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection gridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection = null;
			if (returnItemDimensions)
			{
				gridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection = new GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection((double[])array.Clone(), (double[])array2.Clone());
				gridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection.InitializeLayoutSizes(GetTotalSize(gridBagLayoutCache._colWidthsPref, gridBagLayoutCache._rowHeightsPref), GetTotalSize(gridBagLayoutCache._colWidthsMin, gridBagLayoutCache._rowHeightsMin), GetTotalSize(gridBagLayoutCache._colWidthsMax, gridBagLayoutCache._rowHeightsMax));
				OffsetEachElem(gridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection.ColumnDims, offsetX - containerBoundsHelper.X);
				OffsetEachElem(gridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection.RowDims, offsetY - containerBoundsHelper.Y);
			}
			if (layoutRect != null)
			{
				layoutRect = new Rect(array[0] + offsetX, array2[0] + offsetY, array[array.Length - 1] - array[0], array2[array2.Length - 1] - array2[0]);

				double num2 = array2[gridBagConstraintCache._row];

				double height = ArrSum(calculatedExtents2, gridBagConstraintCache._row, gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan);
				num += offsetX;
				num2 += offsetY;
				Rect rect = ApplyAlignments(num, num2, width, height, gridBagConstraintCache);
				gridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection?.Add(gridBagConstraintCache._item, new GridBagLayoutItemDimensions(gridBagConstraintCache._column, gridBagConstraintCache._row, gridBagConstraintCache._columnSpan, gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan, rect));

		private static bool IsCloseToZero(double d)
		{
			return CoreUtilities.AreClose(d, 0.0);
		}

		private static bool NormalizeRatios(double[] ratios)
		{
			double num = ArrSum(ratios);
			if (!IsCloseToZero(num))
			{
				if (num != 1.0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < ratios.Length; i++)
					{
						ratios[i] /= num;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OffsetEachElem(double[] arr, double offset)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length; i++)
			{
				arr[i] += offset;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<ILayoutItem, System.Windows.Size> ResizeItemHelper(ResizeManager manager, ILayoutItem resizeItem, double deltaWidth, double deltaHeight, IList<ILayoutItem> synchronizedItems, out Dictionary<ILayoutItem, bool> newIsWidthAutoState, out Dictionary<ILayoutItem, bool> newIsHeightAutoState)
		{
			manager.ResizeItem(resizeItem, deltaWidth, deltaHeight, synchronizedItems);
			return manager.GetNewPreferredSizes(out newIsWidthAutoState, out newIsHeightAutoState, 0.0 != deltaWidth, 0.0 != deltaHeight);
		}

		private void ResolveExtentsHelper(double[] extents, float[] weights, int origin, int span, double layoutItemExtent)
		{
			double num = ArrSum(extents, origin, span);
			if (!(num < layoutItemExtent))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num2 = layoutItemExtent - num;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			float num4 = ArrSum(weights, origin, span);
			if (num4 > 0f)
			{
				for (int i = origin; i < origin + span; i++)
				{
					extents[i] += (int)(num2 * (double)weights[i] / (double)num4);
					num3 += extents[i];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = num;
			}
			if (!(num3 < layoutItemExtent))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (GridBagLayoutMode.Uniform == _gridBagMode)
			{
				num2 = layoutItemExtent - num3;
				for (int j = 0; j < span; j++)
				{
					extents[origin + j] += num2 / (double)span;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				extents[origin + span - 1] += layoutItemExtent - num3;
			}
		}

		private void ResolveOrigins(GridBagConstraintCache[] gccArr, out int rowCount, out int columnCount)
		{
			IntExpandableArray intExpandableArray = new IntExpandableArray(64);
			IntExpandableArray intExpandableArray2 = new IntExpandableArray(64);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				intExpandableArray.Reset();
				intExpandableArray2.Reset();
				int num3 = num2;
				int num4 = num;
				int num5 = 0;
				int num6 = 0;
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (GridBagConstraintCache gridBagConstraintCache in gccArr)
				{
					if (gridBagConstraintCache._gcColumn < 0 || gridBagConstraintCache._gcRow < 0 || gridBagConstraintCache._gcColumnSpan <= 0 || gridBagConstraintCache._gcRowSpan <= 0)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					gridBagConstraintCache._column = gridBagConstraintCache._gcColumn;
					gridBagConstraintCache._row = gridBagConstraintCache._gcRow;
					gridBagConstraintCache._columnSpan = gridBagConstraintCache._gcColumnSpan;
					gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan = gridBagConstraintCache._gcRowSpan;
					if (gridBagConstraintCache._column < 0 && gridBagConstraintCache._row < 0)
					{
						if (num5 >= 0)
						{
							gridBagConstraintCache._row = num5;
						}
						else if (num6 >= 0)
						{
							gridBagConstraintCache._column = num6;
						}
					}
					if (gridBagConstraintCache._column < 0)
					{
						if (gridBagConstraintCache._gcRowSpan <= 0)
						{
							gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan = Math.Max(1, num - gridBagConstraintCache._row - ((-1 == gridBagConstraintCache._gcRowSpan) ? 1 : 0));
						}
						gridBagConstraintCache._column = ArrMax(intExpandableArray, gridBagConstraintCache._row, gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan);
					}
					else if (gridBagConstraintCache._row < 0)
					{
						if (gridBagConstraintCache._gcColumnSpan <= 0)
						{
							gridBagConstraintCache._columnSpan = Math.Max(1, num2 - gridBagConstraintCache._column - ((-1 == gridBagConstraintCache._gcColumnSpan) ? 1 : 0));
						}
						gridBagConstraintCache._row = ArrMax(intExpandableArray2, gridBagConstraintCache._column, gridBagConstraintCache._columnSpan);
					}
					if (gridBagConstraintCache._gcColumnSpan <= 0)
					{
						gridBagConstraintCache._columnSpan = Math.Max(1, num2 - gridBagConstraintCache._column - ((-1 == gridBagConstraintCache._gcColumnSpan) ? 1 : 0));
					}
					if (gridBagConstraintCache._gcRowSpan <= 0)
					{
						gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan = Math.Max(1, num - gridBagConstraintCache._row - ((-1 == gridBagConstraintCache._gcRowSpan) ? 1 : 0));
					}
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, gridBagConstraintCache._column + gridBagConstraintCache._columnSpan);
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, gridBagConstraintCache._row + gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan);
					if (i < 3)
					{
						num2 = num3;
						num = num4;
					}
					ArrInit(intExpandableArray, gridBagConstraintCache._column + gridBagConstraintCache._columnSpan, gridBagConstraintCache._row, gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan);
					ArrInit(intExpandableArray2, gridBagConstraintCache._row + gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan, gridBagConstraintCache._column, gridBagConstraintCache._columnSpan);
					if (gridBagConstraintCache._gcColumnSpan == 0 && gridBagConstraintCache._gcRowSpan == 0)
					{
						num5 = gridBagConstraintCache._row;
					}
					else if (gridBagConstraintCache._gcColumnSpan == 0)
					{
						num5 = gridBagConstraintCache._row + gridBagConstraintCache._rowSpan;
					}
					else if (gridBagConstraintCache._gcRowSpan == 0)
					{
						num6 = gridBagConstraintCache._column + gridBagConstraintCache._columnSpan;
						num5 = -1;
					}
				}
				num = num4;
				num2 = num3;
				if (!flag)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			rowCount = num;
			columnCount = num2;
		}

		private void ResolveWeightsHelper(float[] weights, int origin, int span, float layoutItemWeight)
		{
			float num = ArrSum(weights, origin, span);
			if (!(num < layoutItemWeight))
			{
				return;
			}
			float num2 = layoutItemWeight - num;
			float num3 = 0f;
			if (num > 0f)
			{
				for (int i = origin; i < origin + span; i++)
				{
					weights[i] += weights[i] * num2 / num;
					num3 += weights[i];
				}
			}
			if (num3 < layoutItemWeight)
			{
				weights[origin + span - 1] += layoutItemWeight - num3;
			}
		}

	{

		System.Windows.Size PreferredSize { get; }
	}

	{
		bool IsWidthAutoSized { get; }

		bool IsHeightAutoSized { get; }
	}

	{
		Rect GetBounds(object containerContext);
