	}
	public class LayoutItemsCollection : ICollection<ILayoutItem>, IEnumerable<ILayoutItem>, IEnumerable
	{
		private Dictionary<ILayoutItem, object> _layoutItemsConstraints;

		private List<ILayoutItem> _layoutItems;

		private LayoutManagerBase _layoutManager;

		private Dictionary<ILayoutItem, object> LayoutItemsConstraints
		{
			get
			{
				if (_layoutItemsConstraints == null)
				{
					_layoutItemsConstraints = new Dictionary<ILayoutItem, object>();
				}
				return _layoutItemsConstraints;
			}
		}

		private LayoutManagerBase LayoutManager => _layoutManager;

		protected List<ILayoutItem> LayoutItems => _layoutItems;

		public int Count => LayoutItems.Count;

		public ILayoutItem this[int index] => GetItem(index);

		bool ICollection<ILayoutItem>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public LayoutItemsCollection(LayoutManagerBase layoutManager)
		{
			if (layoutManager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("layoutManager");
			}
			_layoutManager = layoutManager;
			_layoutItems = new List<ILayoutItem>();
		}

		private void InternalSetConstraint(ILayoutItem item, object constraint, int index)
		{
			ValidateConstraintObject(constraint);
			if (!LayoutItemsConstraints.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				if (index < 0)
				{
					LayoutItems.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					LayoutItems.Insert(index, item);
				}
			}
			LayoutItemsConstraints[item] = constraint;
			OnLayoutChanged();
		}

		private void OnLayoutChanged()
		{
			LayoutManager.InternalOnLayoutChanged();
		}

		private void ValidateConstraintObject(object constraint)
		{
			LayoutManager.InternalValidateConstraints(constraint);
		}

		public void Add(ILayoutItem item)
		{
			Add(item, null);
		}

		public void Add(ILayoutItem item, object constraint)
		{
			InternalSetConstraint(item, constraint, -1);
		}

		public bool Contains(ILayoutItem item)
		{
			return LayoutItemsConstraints.ContainsKey(item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			LayoutItems.Clear();
			LayoutItemsConstraints.Clear();
			OnLayoutChanged();
		}

		public void CopyTo(ILayoutItem[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_layoutItems.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public object GetConstraint(ILayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!LayoutItemsConstraints.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString("LE_GridBag_ItemNotInLayoutItems", item), "item");
			}
			return value;
		}

		public ILayoutItem GetItem(int index)
		{
			return LayoutItems[index];
		}

		public int IndexOf(ILayoutItem item)
		{
			return LayoutItems.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, ILayoutItem item)
		{
			Insert(index, item, null);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, ILayoutItem item, object constraint)
		{
			InternalSetConstraint(item, constraint, index);
		}

		public bool Remove(ILayoutItem item)
		{
			if (LayoutItemsConstraints.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				LayoutItems.Remove(item);
				LayoutItemsConstraints.Remove(item);
				OnLayoutChanged();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			LayoutItems.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void SetConstraint(ILayoutItem item, object constraint)
		{
			InternalSetConstraint(item, constraint, -1);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _layoutItems.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<ILayoutItem> IEnumerable<ILayoutItem>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _layoutItems.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public abstract class LayoutManagerBase
	{
		private LayoutItemsCollection _layoutItems;

		public LayoutItemsCollection LayoutItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (_layoutItems == null)
				{
					_layoutItems = new LayoutItemsCollection(this);
				}
				return _layoutItems;
			}
		}

		public LayoutManagerBase()
		{
		}

		internal static Rect GetContainerBoundsHelper(ILayoutContainer container, object containerContext, LayoutManagerBase lm)
		{
			Rect bounds = container.GetBounds(containerContext);
			bool flag = double.IsInfinity(bounds.Width) || double.IsNaN(bounds.Width);
			bool flag2 = double.IsInfinity(bounds.Height) || double.IsNaN(bounds.Height);
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = lm.CalculatePreferredSize(container, containerContext);
				if (flag)
				{
					bounds.Width = size.Width;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					bounds.Height = size.Height;
				}
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		internal void InternalOnLayoutChanged()
		{
			OnLayoutChanged();
		}

		internal void InternalValidateConstraints(object constraint)
		{
			ValidateConstraintObject(constraint);
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutChanged()
		{
			InvalidateLayout();
		}

		protected abstract void ValidateConstraintObject(object constraint);

		public abstract System.Windows.Size CalculateMaximumSize(ILayoutContainer container, object containerContext);

		public abstract System.Windows.Size CalculateMinimumSize(ILayoutContainer container, object containerContext);

		public abstract System.Windows.Size CalculatePreferredSize(ILayoutContainer container, object containerContext);

		public virtual void InvalidateLayout()
		{
		}

		public abstract void LayoutContainer(ILayoutContainer container, object containerContext);
	}

	public class FixedValueConverter : ValueConverterBase
	{
		private static readonly object UnsetValue = new object();

		public object SourceValue { get; set; }

		public object DestinationValue { get; set; }

		public FixedValueConverter()
		{
			SourceValue = UnsetValue;
		}

		private static object ConvertHelper(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture, object source, object destination)
		{
			if (destination == UnsetValue)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			if (source == UnsetValue || object.Equals(source, value))
			{
				return destination;
			}
			return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
		}

		public override object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return ConvertHelper(value, targetType, parameter, culture, SourceValue, DestinationValue);
		}

		public override object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return ConvertHelper(value, targetType, parameter, culture, DestinationValue, SourceValue);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ResourceProvider : PropertyChangeNotifierExtended
	{
		internal delegate void MethodInvoker();

		private static readonly bool _UserPreferenceEventWired;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static DependencyObject _DistpatherOwer;

		private bool _isHighContrast;

		private int _resourceVersion;

		private static bool _CachedIsHighContrastDirty;

		private static bool _CachedIsHighContrast;

		private static WeakSet<ResourceProvider> _Providers;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ResourceProviderProperty;

		public abstract object this[object key] { get; }

		public virtual object this[string key] => this[(object)key];

		[Browsable(false)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool IsHighContrast
		{
			get
			{
				return _isHighContrast;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (_isHighContrast != value)
				{
					_isHighContrast = value;
					InvalidateResources();
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("IsHighContrast");
				}
			}
		}

		public int ResourceVersion
		{
			get
			{
				return _resourceVersion;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (_resourceVersion != value)
				{
					_resourceVersion = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("ResourceVersion");
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool IsHighContrastStatic
		{
			get
			{
				if (_CachedIsHighContrastDirty)
				{
					_CachedIsHighContrastDirty = false;
					_CachedIsHighContrast = SystemParameters.HighContrast || (System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlColor == Colors.Black && System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlTextColor == Colors.White) || (System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlColor == Colors.White && System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlTextColor == Colors.Black);
				}
				return _CachedIsHighContrast;
			}
		}

		static ResourceProvider()
		{
			ResourceProviderProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.RegisterAttached("ResourceProvider", typeof(ResourceProvider), typeof(ResourceProvider), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(null, OnResourceProviderChanged));
			_CachedIsHighContrastDirty = true;
			_Providers = new WeakSet<ResourceProvider>();
			try
			{
				InitUserPreferenceChanged();
				_UserPreferenceEventWired = true;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal ResourceProvider()
		{
			if (_DistpatherOwer == null)
			{
				_DistpatherOwer = new DependencyObject();
			}
			if (!_UserPreferenceEventWired)
			{
				VeriftyCachedIsHighContrast();
			}
			lock (_Providers)
			{
				_Providers.Add(this);
			}
		}

		private void SetIsHighContrastInternal(bool isHighContrast)
		{
			IsHighContrast = isHighContrast;
		}

		private static void OnResourceProviderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is IResourceProviderClient resourceProviderClient)
			{
				resourceProviderClient.OnResourcesChanged();
			}
		}

		public static ResourceProvider GetResourceProvider(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (ResourceProvider)target.GetValue(ResourceProviderProperty);
		}

		public static void SetResourceProvider(DependencyObject target, ResourceProvider value)
		{
			target.SetValue(ResourceProviderProperty, value);
		}

		public virtual void InvalidateResources()
		{
			BumpResourceVersion();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSystemColorsChanged()
		{
			InvalidateResources();
		}

		internal void BumpResourceVersion()
		{
			ResourceVersion++;
		}

		internal void OnSystemColorsChangedInternal()
		{
			if (!_DistpatherOwer.CheckAccess())
			{
				_DistpatherOwer.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(OnSystemColorsChangedInternal));
				return;
			}
			SetIsHighContrastInternal(IsHighContrastStatic);
			OnSystemColorsChanged();
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static void InitUserPreferenceChanged()
		{
			SystemEvents.UserPreferenceChanged += OnUserPreferenceChanged;
		}

		private static void OnUserPreferenceChanged(object sender, UserPreferenceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Category == UserPreferenceCategory.Color)
			{
				VeriftyCachedIsHighContrast();
			}
		}

		private static void VeriftyCachedIsHighContrast()
		{
			bool isHighContrastStatic = IsHighContrastStatic;
			_CachedIsHighContrastDirty = true;
			if (isHighContrastStatic == IsHighContrastStatic)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<ResourceProvider> list = null;
			lock (_Providers)
			{
				list = _Providers.ToList();
			}
			foreach (ResourceProvider item in list)
			{
				item.OnSystemColorsChangedInternal();
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ResourceProvider<T> : ResourceProvider where T : struct
	{
		private static string _TypeExceptionMessage;

		internal static readonly int _Count;

		internal static readonly T[] _Ids;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override object this[object key]
		{
			get
			{
				if (!TryGetEnumValueFromObject(key, out var id))
				{
					throw new KeyNotFoundException(SR.GetString("Provider_KeyNotFound", typeof(T), key));
				}
				return GetResource(id);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override object this[string key] => this[(object)key];

		public object this[T key] => this[(object)key];

		static ResourceProvider()
		{
			if (!typeof(T).IsEnum)
			{
				_TypeExceptionMessage = SR.GetString("Provider_TypeNotEnum", typeof(T));
				return;
			}
			List<T> list = new List<T>(from f in typeof(T).GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public)
				where f.IsLiteral
				select (T)f.GetValue(null));
			list.Sort();
			_Count = list.Count;
			if (_Count < 1)
			{
				_TypeExceptionMessage = SR.GetString("Provider_EnumEmpty", typeof(T));
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (T item in list)
			{
				int num2 = KeyToInt32(item);
				if (num2 != num)
				{
					_TypeExceptionMessage = SR.GetString("Provider_SparseEnumValues", typeof(T));
					return;
				}
				num++;
			}
			_Ids = list.ToArray();
		}

		protected ResourceProvider()
		{
			if (_TypeExceptionMessage != null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(_TypeExceptionMessage);
			}
		}

		protected abstract object GetResource(T id);

		internal static bool TryGetEnumValueFromObject(object key, out T id)
		{
			if (key is T)
			{
				id = (T)key;
			}
			else
			{
				id = _Ids[0];
				if (!(key is string value) || !Enum.TryParse<T>(value, out id))
				{
					if (!(key is IConvertible convertible))
					{
						return false;
					}
					int num;
					try
					{
						num = convertible.ToInt32(null);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (num < 0 || num >= _Count)
					{
						return false;
					}
					id = _Ids[num];
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static int KeyToInt32(T id)
		{
			return ((IConvertible)(object)id).ToInt32(null);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ResourceProviderWithOverrides<T> : ResourceProvider<T>, ISupportInitialize, IResourceWasherTarget where T : struct
	{
		private object[] _values;

		private bool _isLoading;

		private bool _isHighContrastSupported = true;

		private ResourceDictionary _defaultResources;

		private ResourceDictionary _defaultResourcesHighContrast;

		private ResourceDictionary _resourceOverrides;

		private ResourceDictionary _resourceOverridesHighContrast;

		private ResourceWasher _resourceWasher;

		private ResourceDictionary _washedDefaultResources;

		private ResourceDictionary _washedOverrideResources;

		private static object NullEntry = new object();

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool IsHighContrastSupported
		{
			get
			{
				return _isHighContrastSupported;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_isHighContrastSupported != value)
				{
					_isHighContrastSupported = value;
					InvalidateResources();
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("IsHighContrastSupported");
				}
			}
		}

		public ResourceDictionary ResourceOverrides
		{
			get
			{
				return _resourceOverrides;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_resourceOverrides != value)
				{
					_resourceOverrides = value;
					InvalidateResources();
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("ResourceOverrides");
				}
			}
		}

		public ResourceDictionary ResourceOverridesHighContrast
		{
			get
			{
				return _resourceOverridesHighContrast;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_resourceOverridesHighContrast != value)
				{
					_resourceOverridesHighContrast = value;
					InvalidateResources();
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("ResourceOverridesHighContrast");
				}
			}
		}

		protected ResourceDictionary DefaultResources
		{
			get
			{
				return _defaultResources;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _defaultResources)
				{
					_defaultResources = value;
					InvalidateResources();
				}
			}
		}

		protected ResourceDictionary DefaultResourcesHighContrast
		{
			get
			{
				return _defaultResourcesHighContrast;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _defaultResourcesHighContrast)
				{
					_defaultResourcesHighContrast = value;
					InvalidateResources();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsLoading => _isLoading;

		ResourceWasher IResourceWasherTarget.ResourceWasher
		{
			get
			{
				return _resourceWasher;
			}
			set
			{
				_resourceWasher = value;
				InvalidateResources();
			}
		}

		protected override object GetResource(T id)
		{
			int num = ResourceProvider<T>.KeyToInt32(id);
			if (num >= 0 && num < ResourceProvider<T>._Ids.Length)
			{
				object obj;
				if (_values != null)
				{
					obj = _values[num];
					if (obj != null)
					{
						if (obj == NullEntry)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return obj;
					}
				}
				if (_values == null)
				{
					_values = new object[ResourceProvider<T>._Count];
				}
				ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = null;
				ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary2 = null;
				if (base.IsHighContrast && IsHighContrastSupported)
				{
					resourceDictionary = _defaultResourcesHighContrast;
					resourceDictionary2 = ResourceOverridesHighContrast;
				}
				else
				{
					resourceDictionary2 = ResourceOverrides;
				}
				if (resourceDictionary == null)
				{
					resourceDictionary = _washedDefaultResources ?? _defaultResources;
					if (resourceDictionary != null && _resourceWasher != null && _washedDefaultResources == null)
					{
						resourceDictionary = (_washedDefaultResources = (ResourceDictionary)_resourceWasher.CreateWashedResource(resourceDictionary));
					}
					resourceDictionary2 = _washedOverrideResources ?? resourceDictionary2;
					if (resourceDictionary2 != null && _resourceWasher != null && _washedOverrideResources == null)
					{
						resourceDictionary2 = (_washedOverrideResources = (ResourceDictionary)_resourceWasher.CreateWashedResource(resourceDictionary2));
					}
				}
				string text = id.ToString();
				obj = GetResourceHelper(resourceDictionary2, id, num, text, isDefault: false);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					return obj;
				}
				obj = GetResourceHelper(resourceDictionary, id, num, text, isDefault: true);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					return obj;
				}
				if (resourceDictionary != null && !IsResourceValid(id, null))
				{
					LogDebuggerWarning(SR.GetString("Provider_MissingResource", text, this));
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public sealed override void InvalidateResources()
		{
			_values = null;
			_washedDefaultResources = null;
			_washedOverrideResources = null;
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			base.InvalidateResources();
		}

		public virtual void BeginInit()
		{
			_isLoading = true;
		}

		public virtual void EndInit()
		{
			_isLoading = false;
		}

		protected abstract bool IsResourceValid(T id, object resource);

		private object GetResourceHelper(ResourceDictionary rd, T id, int index, string idName, bool isDefault)
		{
			if (rd == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = null;
			if (rd.Contains(idName))
			{
				obj = rd[idName];
			}
			else if (rd.Contains(id))
			{
				obj = rd[id];
			}
			else if (!isDefault)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (IsResourceValid(id, obj))
			{
				if (obj == null)
				{
					_values[index] = NullEntry;
				}
				else
				{
					_values[index] = obj;
				}
				return obj;
			}
			LogDebuggerWarning(SR.GetString("Provider_InvalidResource", id, this, (obj != null) ? obj.GetType().ToString() : "[null]"));
			return null;
		}

		internal static void LogDebuggerWarning(string warning)
		{
			if (CoreUtilities.IsDebuggerLogging())
			{
				CoreUtilities.DebuggerLog(40, "Global", warning + Environment.NewLine);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ResourceStringBase : PropertyChangeNotifier
	{
		private static class ResourceCache
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static Dictionary<string, object> s_resourceMap;

			internal static void ClearCache()
			{
				if (s_resourceMap != null)
				{
					s_resourceMap.Clear();
				}
			}

			internal static object GetResource(ResourceStringBase rs)
			{
				object value = null;
				if (s_resourceMap == null)
				{
					s_resourceMap = new Dictionary<string, object>();
				}
				else
				{
					s_resourceMap.TryGetValue(rs.ResourceName, out value);
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = rs.LoadResourceString();
					if (value == null)
					{
						value = "";
					}
					s_resourceMap[rs.ResourceName] = value;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		private bool _isLoaded;

		private string _resourceName;

		private string _resourceString;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static WeakList<ResourceStringBase> _ResourceStrings;

		public string ResourceName
		{
			get
			{
				return _resourceName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _resourceName)
				{
					_resourceName = value;
					_isLoaded = false;
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Value");
				}
			}
		}

		public string Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_isLoaded)
				{
					_isLoaded = true;
					_resourceString = ResourceCache.GetResource(this) as string;
				}
				return _resourceString;
			}
		}

		protected ResourceStringBase()
		{
			if (_ResourceStrings == null)
			{
				_ResourceStrings = new WeakList<ResourceStringBase>();
			}
			_ResourceStrings.Add(this);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Value;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void InvalidateCachedResources()
		{
			ResourceCache.ClearCache();
			if (_ResourceStrings == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ResourceStringBase resourceString in _ResourceStrings)
			{
				resourceString.InvalidateResource();
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateResource()
		{
			_isLoaded = false;
			_resourceString = null;
			RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Value");
		}

		internal abstract string LoadResourceString();
	}
	public class ScaledDoubleConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private double _scaleFactor = 1.0;

		public double ScaleFactor
		{
			get
			{
				return _scaleFactor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _scaleFactor)
				{
					CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNan(value);
					CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(value);
					CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotInfinity(value);
					_scaleFactor = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is double)
			{
				return (double)value * _scaleFactor;
			}
			if (value is double? num)
			{
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					return num.Value * _scaleFactor;
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (value is decimal || (value != null && value.GetType().IsPrimitive))
			{
				value = System.Convert.ToDouble(value, culture);
				return Convert(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is double)
			{
				if (_scaleFactor == 0.0)
				{
					return value;
				}
				return (double)value / _scaleFactor;
			}
			if (value is double? num)
			{
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					if (_scaleFactor == 0.0)
					{
						return num.Value;
					}
					return num.Value / _scaleFactor;
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (value != null && value.GetType().IsPrimitive)
			{
				value = System.Convert.ToDouble(value, culture);
				return ConvertBack(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	public class SystemResourceProvider : ResourceProvider<SystemResourceId>
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<SystemResourceId, object> _Map;

		private static readonly WeakSet<SystemResourceProvider> _SystemProviders = new WeakSet<SystemResourceProvider>();

		public SystemResourceProvider()
		{
			lock (_SystemProviders)
			{
				_SystemProviders.Add(this);
			}
		}

		protected override object GetResource(SystemResourceId id)
		{
			object value = null;
			if (_Map == null)
			{
				_Map = new Dictionary<SystemResourceId, object>();
			}
			else
			{
				_Map.TryGetValue(id, out value);
			}
			Type type;
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = ColorFromId(id, out type);
			bool flag = value != null;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (type == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush))
				{
					SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = value as SolidColorBrush;
					if (solidColorBrush != null || solidColorBrush.Color == color)
					{
						return value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(type == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color)))
					{
						return value;
					}
					if (value is System.Windows.Media.Color && color == (System.Windows.Media.Color)value)
					{
						return value;
					}
				}
			}
			if (type == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush))
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
				brush.Freeze();
				value = brush;
			}
			else if (type == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color))
			{
				value = color;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				_Map[id] = value;
				VerifyHelper(notify: false);
				NotifyAllProviders();
			}
			else
			{
				_Map.Add(id, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override void InvalidateResources()
		{
			VerifyCachedResources();
		}

		protected override void OnSystemColorsChanged()
		{
			BumpResourceVersion();
			RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Item[]");
		}

		public static bool VerifyCachedResources()
		{
			return VerifyHelper(notify: true);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color ColorFromId(SystemResourceId id, out Type type)
		{
			type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush);
			switch (id)
			{
			case SystemResourceId.ActiveBorderBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ActiveBorderColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ActiveBorderColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ActiveBorderColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ActiveCaptionBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ActiveCaptionColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ActiveCaptionColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ActiveCaptionColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ActiveCaptionTextBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ActiveCaptionTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ActiveCaptionTextColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ActiveCaptionTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.AppWorkspaceBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.AppWorkspaceColor;
			case SystemResourceId.AppWorkspaceColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.AppWorkspaceColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlDarkBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlDarkColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlDarkColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlDarkColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlDarkDarkBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlDarkDarkColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlDarkDarkColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlDarkDarkColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlLightBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlLightColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlLightColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlLightColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlLightLightBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlLightLightColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlLightLightColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlLightLightColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlTextBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ControlTextColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.DesktopBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.DesktopColor;
			case SystemResourceId.DesktopColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.DesktopColor;
			case SystemResourceId.GrayTextBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.GrayTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.GrayTextColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.GrayTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.HighlightBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.HighlightColor;
			case SystemResourceId.HighlightColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.HighlightColor;
			case SystemResourceId.HighlightTextBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.HighlightTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.HighlightTextColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.HighlightTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.InactiveBorderBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.InactiveBorderColor;
			case SystemResourceId.InactiveBorderColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.InactiveBorderColor;
			case SystemResourceId.InactiveCaptionBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.InactiveCaptionColor;
			case SystemResourceId.InactiveCaptionColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.InactiveCaptionColor;
			case SystemResourceId.InactiveCaptionTextBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.InactiveCaptionTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.InactiveCaptionTextColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.InactiveCaptionTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.InfoBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.InfoColor;
			case SystemResourceId.InfoColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.InfoColor;
			case SystemResourceId.InfoTextBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.InfoTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.InfoTextColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.InfoTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.MenuBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.MenuColor;
			case SystemResourceId.MenuColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.MenuColor;
			case SystemResourceId.MenuTextBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.MenuTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.MenuTextColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.MenuTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ScrollBarBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ScrollBarColor;
			case SystemResourceId.ScrollBarColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.ScrollBarColor;
			case SystemResourceId.WindowBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowColor;
			case SystemResourceId.WindowColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowColor;
			case SystemResourceId.WindowFrameBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowFrameColor;
			case SystemResourceId.WindowFrameColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowFrameColor;
			case SystemResourceId.WindowTextBrush:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowTextColor;
			case SystemResourceId.WindowTextColor:
				type = typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowTextColor;
			default:
				return System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowColor;
			}
		}

		private static void NotifyAllProviders()
		{
			List<SystemResourceProvider> list = null;
			lock (_SystemProviders)
			{
				list = _SystemProviders.ToList();
			}
			foreach (SystemResourceProvider item in list)
			{
				item.OnSystemColorsChangedInternal();
			}
		}

		private static bool VerifyHelper(bool notify)
		{
			if (_Map == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			List<SystemResourceId> list = null;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<SystemResourceId, object> item in _Map)
			{
				Type type;
				System.Windows.Media.Color color = ColorFromId(item.Key, out type);
				bool flag = false;
				if (type == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush))
				{
					if (item.Value is SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush)
					{
						if (solidColorBrush.Color != color)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				else if (type == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color))
				{
					if (item.Value is System.Windows.Media.Color)
					{
						if ((System.Windows.Media.Color)item.Value != color)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (list == null)
					{
						list = new List<SystemResourceId>();
					}
					list.Add(item.Key);
				}
			}
			if (list == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int count = list.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				_Map.Remove(list[i]);
			}
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyAllProviders();
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class UniformGrid : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		private int _columns;

		private int _rows;

		private int _firstCol;

		private int _firstRow;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColumnsProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("Columns", typeof(int), typeof(UniformGrid), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(0, OnColumnRowPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FirstColumnProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("FirstColumn", typeof(int), typeof(UniformGrid), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(0, OnColumnRowPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FirstRowProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("FirstRow", typeof(int), typeof(UniformGrid), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(0, OnColumnRowPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RowsProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("Rows", typeof(int), typeof(UniformGrid), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(0, OnColumnRowPropertyChanged));

		[Bindable(true)]
		public int Columns
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(ColumnsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ColumnsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public int FirstColumn
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(FirstColumnProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FirstColumnProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public int FirstRow
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(FirstRowProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FirstRowProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public int Rows
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(RowsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RowsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static double CalculateLayoutRoundingOffset(int firstElementIndex, ref double extraAvailableExtent)
		{
			if (firstElementIndex == 0 || extraAvailableExtent == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = Math.Min(firstElementIndex, extraAvailableExtent);
			extraAvailableExtent = Math.Max(extraAvailableExtent - num, 0.0);
			return num;
		}

		private void CalculateMetrics(bool preferColumns)
		{
			_columns = Columns;
			_rows = Rows;
			_firstCol = FirstColumn;
			_firstRow = FirstRow;
			if (_columns > 0 && _firstCol > _columns)
			{
				_firstCol = _columns;
			}
			if (_rows > 0 && _firstRow > _rows)
			{
				_firstRow = _rows;
			}
			if (_rows != 0 && _columns != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = base.Children.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (base.Children[i].Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			if (_rows == 0)
			{
				if (_columns == 0)
				{
					_rows = (int)Math.Sqrt(num);
					if (_rows * _rows < num)
					{
						_columns = _rows;
						if (preferColumns)
						{
							_columns++;
							if (_columns * _rows < num)
							{
								_rows++;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							_rows++;
							if (_rows * _columns < num)
							{
								_columns++;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						_columns = _rows;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_rows = (num + _firstCol + (_columns - 1)) / _columns;
					_rows += _firstRow;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_columns = (num + _firstRow + (_rows - 1)) / _rows;
				_columns += _firstCol;
			}
		}

		private static void OnColumnRowPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UniformGrid uniformGrid = (UniformGrid)d;
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative((int)e.NewValue, DependencyPropertyUtilities.GetName(e.Property));
			uniformGrid.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			CalculateMetrics(flag);
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width / (double)_columns, availableSize.Height / (double)_rows);
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (base.UseLayoutRounding)
			{
				availableSize2.Width = Math.Floor(availableSize2.Width);
				availableSize2.Height = Math.Floor(availableSize2.Height);
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = base.Children.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = base.Children[i];
				uIElement.Measure(availableSize2);
				System.Windows.Size desiredSize = uIElement.DesiredSize;
				if (desiredSize.Width > num)
				{
					num = desiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (desiredSize.Height > num2)
				{
					num2 = desiredSize.Height;
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Size result = new System.Windows.Size((double)_columns * num, (double)_rows * num2);
			if (flag && result.Width > availableSize.Width)
			{
				CalculateMetrics(preferColumns: false);
				result = new System.Windows.Size((double)_columns * num, (double)_rows * num2);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			double num = finalSize.Width / (double)_columns;
			double num2 = finalSize.Height / (double)_rows;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (base.UseLayoutRounding)
			{
				num = Math.Floor(num);
				num2 = Math.Floor(num2);
				num3 = Math.Floor(finalSize.Width - num * (double)_columns);
				num4 = Math.Floor(finalSize.Height - num2 * (double)_rows);
			}
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(num * (double)_firstCol, num2 * (double)_firstRow, num, num2);
			int num5 = _firstCol;
			double extraAvailableExtent = num3;
			double extraAvailableExtent2 = num4;
			finalRect.X += CalculateLayoutRoundingOffset(_firstCol, ref extraAvailableExtent);
			finalRect.Y += CalculateLayoutRoundingOffset(_firstRow, ref extraAvailableExtent2);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = base.Children.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = base.Children[i];
				if (uIElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					num5++;
					finalRect.Width = num;
					finalRect.Height = num2;
					if (extraAvailableExtent2 > 0.0)
					{
						finalRect.Height += Math.Min(1.0, extraAvailableExtent2);
					}
					if (extraAvailableExtent > 0.0)
					{
						finalRect.Width += Math.Min(1.0, extraAvailableExtent);
						extraAvailableExtent = Math.Max(extraAvailableExtent - 1.0, 0.0);
					}
					uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
					if (num5 < _columns)
					{
						finalRect.X += finalRect.Width;
						continue;
					}
					num5 = 0;
					finalRect.X = 0.0;
					finalRect.Y += finalRect.Height;
					extraAvailableExtent2 = Math.Max(extraAvailableExtent2 - 1.0, 0.0);
					extraAvailableExtent = num3;
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Error", GroupName = "ErrorStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "NoError", GroupName = "ErrorStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Open", GroupName = "OpenStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Closed", GroupName = "OpenStates")]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class ValidationDecorator : ContentControl
	{
		private FrameworkElement _templatedParent;

		private WeakEventHandler<ValidationDecorator, FrameworkElement, ValidationErrorEventArgs> _errorEventHandler;

		private PropertyValueTracker _focusTracker;

		private PropertyValueTracker _hasValidationErrorTracker;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ErrorContentPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ErrorContentProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ErrorForegroundProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey HasErrorPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty HasErrorProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsToolTipOpenProperty;

		public object ErrorContent
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ErrorContentProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(ErrorContentPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush ErrorForeground
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(ErrorForegroundProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ErrorForegroundProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasError
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(HasErrorProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(HasErrorPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsToolTipOpen
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsToolTipOpenProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsToolTipOpenProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static ValidationDecorator()
		{
			ErrorContentPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyUtilities.RegisterReadOnly("ErrorContent", typeof(object), typeof(ValidationDecorator), null, null);
			ErrorContentProperty = ErrorContentPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ErrorForegroundProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("ErrorForeground", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(ValidationDecorator), null, null);
			HasErrorPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyUtilities.RegisterReadOnly("HasError", typeof(bool), typeof(ValidationDecorator), KnownBoxes.FalseBox, null);
			HasErrorProperty = HasErrorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsToolTipOpenProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("IsToolTipOpen", typeof(bool), typeof(ValidationDecorator), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsToolTipOpenChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ValidationDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ValidationDecorator)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ValidationDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = PresentationUtilities.GetTemplatedParent(this) as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement != _templatedParent)
			{
				if (_errorEventHandler != null)
				{
					_errorEventHandler.Detach();
					_errorEventHandler = null;
				}
				ClearErrorState();
				_hasValidationErrorTracker = null;
				_focusTracker = null;
				_templatedParent = frameworkElement;
				if (_templatedParent != null)
				{
					_focusTracker = new PropertyValueTracker(_templatedParent, UIElement.IsKeyboardFocusWithinProperty, OnFocusChanged);
					_hasValidationErrorTracker = new PropertyValueTracker(_templatedParent, Validation.HasErrorProperty, OnHasValidationErrorChanged);
					_errorEventHandler = new WeakEventHandler<ValidationDecorator, FrameworkElement, ValidationErrorEventArgs>(this, _templatedParent, delegate(ValidationDecorator instance, object s, ValidationErrorEventArgs e)
					{
						instance.OnBindingValidationError(s, e);
					}, delegate(WeakEventHandler<ValidationDecorator, FrameworkElement, ValidationErrorEventArgs> weakHandler, FrameworkElement eventSource)
					{
						Validation.RemoveErrorHandler(eventSource, weakHandler.OnEvent);
					});
					Validation.AddErrorHandler(_templatedParent, _errorEventHandler.OnEvent);
				}
				ReadOnlyObservableCollection<ValidationError> errors = Validation.GetErrors(_templatedParent);
				if (errors != null && errors.Count != 0)
				{
					UpdateForValidationError(errors[errors.Count - 1]);
				}
			}
			UpdateVisualStates(transition: false);
		}

		private static void OnIsToolTipOpenChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is ValidationDecorator validationDecorator)
			{
				validationDecorator.VerifyIsTooltipOpen(updateVisualStates: true, calledFronIsOpneChanged: true);
			}
		}

		private void ClearErrorState()
		{
			ClearValue(ErrorContentPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(HasErrorPropertyKey);
			SetValue(IsToolTipOpenProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			UpdateVisualStates(transition: false);
		}

		private void OnBindingValidationError(object sender, ValidationErrorEventArgs e)
		{
			ValidationError error = null;
			if (e.Action == ValidationErrorEventAction.Added)
			{
				error = e.Error;
			}
			else
			{
				ReadOnlyObservableCollection<ValidationError> errors = Validation.GetErrors(_templatedParent);
				if (errors != null && errors.Count != 0)
				{
					error = errors[errors.Count - 1];
				}
			}
			UpdateForValidationError(error);
			UpdateVisualStates(transition: true);
		}

		private void OnFocusChanged()
		{
			VerifyIsTooltipOpen(updateVisualStates: true, calledFronIsOpneChanged: false);
		}

		private void OnHasValidationErrorChanged()
		{
			if (_templatedParent == null || !Validation.GetHasError(_templatedParent))
			{
				ClearErrorState();
				return;
			}
			ReadOnlyObservableCollection<ValidationError> errors = Validation.GetErrors(_templatedParent);
			UpdateForValidationError(errors[errors.Count - 1]);
			UpdateVisualStates(transition: false);
		}

		private void UpdateForValidationError(ValidationError error)
		{
			if (error != null)
			{
				HasError = true;
				ErrorContent = error.ErrorContent;
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(HasErrorPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(ErrorContentPropertyKey);
			}
			VerifyIsTooltipOpen(updateVisualStates: false, calledFronIsOpneChanged: false);
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStates(bool transition)
		{
			if (HasError)
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, transition, "Error");
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, transition, "NoError");
			}
			if (IsToolTipOpen)
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, transition, "Open");
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, transition, "Closed");
			}
		}

		private void VerifyIsTooltipOpen(bool updateVisualStates, bool calledFronIsOpneChanged)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (PresentationUtilities.GetElementWithKeyboardFocus() is FrameworkElement frameworkElement && (_templatedParent == frameworkElement || PresentationUtilities.IsAncestorOf(_templatedParent, frameworkElement)))
			{
				flag = HasError;
			}
			if (flag || !calledFronIsOpneChanged)
			{
				IsToolTipOpen = flag;
			}
			if (updateVisualStates)
			{
				UpdateVisualStates(transition: true);
			}
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("Converters")]
	public class ValueConverterGroup : ValueConverterBase
	{
		private List<IValueConverter> _converters;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public List<IValueConverter> Converters => _converters;

		public ValueConverterGroup()
		{
			_converters = new List<IValueConverter>();
		}

		public override object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			object obj = DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			foreach (IValueConverter converter in _converters)
			{
				obj = converter.Convert(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
				if (obj != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			object obj = DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			foreach (IValueConverter converter in _converters)
			{
				obj = converter.ConvertBack(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
				if (obj != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}

		{

			{
				textBox.TextChanged += TextBoxTextChanged;
			}

			private static void TextBoxTextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (sender is DependencyObject)
				{
					BindingExpression bindingExpression = BindingOperations.GetBindingExpression(sender as DependencyObject, System.Windows.Controls.TextBox.TextProperty);
					if (bindingExpression != null && (bindingExpression.ParentBinding.Mode == BindingMode.Default || bindingExpression.ParentBinding.Mode == BindingMode.TwoWay || bindingExpression.ParentBinding.Mode == BindingMode.OneWayToSource))
					{
						bindingExpression.UpdateSource();
					}
				}
			}
		}

	public class BoolToVisibilityConverter : ValueConverterBase
	{
		public override object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (value is bool)
			{
				flag = (bool)value;
			}
			else if (value is bool? flag2)
			{
				flag = flag2.HasValue && flag2.Value;
			}
			bool flag3 = parameter is bool && (bool)parameter;
			return (flag != !flag3) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public override object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is Visibility)
			{
				bool flag = (Visibility)value == Visibility.Visible;
				bool flag2 = parameter is bool && (bool)parameter;
				return flag == !flag2;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class DoubleToStringConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is double)
			{
				return value.ToString();
			}
			if (value is double? num)
			{
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					return num.Value.ToString();
				}
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (double.TryParse(value as string, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "ExpansionIndicator", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	[TemplateVisualState(GroupName = "ExpansionStates", Name = "Expanded")]
	[TemplateVisualState(GroupName = "ExpansionStates", Name = "Collapsed")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "MouseOver", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Normal", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Disabled", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class ExpansionIndicator : ContentControl
	{
		private const string StateMouseOver = "MouseOver";

		private const string StateNormal = "Normal";

		private const string StateDiabled = "Disabled";

		private bool _isMouseOver;

		private FrameworkElement _expansionIndicator;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsExpandedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IndicatorVisibilityProperty;

		public bool IsExpanded
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsExpandedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Expanded", useTransitions: true);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Collapsed", useTransitions: true);
				}
				SetValue(IsExpandedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Visibility IndicatorVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				return (Visibility)GetValue(IndicatorVisibilityProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IndicatorVisibilityProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected FrameworkElement IndicatorElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _expansionIndicator;
			}
			set
			{
				_expansionIndicator = value;
			}
		}

		static ExpansionIndicator()
		{
			IsExpandedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsExpanded", typeof(bool), typeof(ExpansionIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(IsExpandedChanged));
			IndicatorVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IndicatorVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(ExpansionIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(Visibility.Visible, IndicatorVisibilityChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ExpansionIndicator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ExpansionIndicator)));
		}

		public ExpansionIndicator()
		{
			base.IsTabStop = false;
			base.IsEnabledChanged += ExpansionIndicator_IsEnabledChanged;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (_expansionIndicator != null)
			{
				_expansionIndicator.MouseLeftButtonDown -= ExpansionIndicator_MouseDown;
			}
			_expansionIndicator = GetTemplateChild("ExpansionIndicator") as FrameworkElement;
			if (_expansionIndicator != null)
			{
				_expansionIndicator.MouseLeftButtonDown += ExpansionIndicator_MouseDown;
				_expansionIndicator.Visibility = IndicatorVisibility;
			}
			UpdateVisualState(useTransistions: false, IsExpanded);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new ExpansionIndicatorAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseEnter();
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseLeave();
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
		}

		private static void IsExpandedChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ExpansionIndicator expansionIndicator = (ExpansionIndicator)obj;
			expansionIndicator.UpdateVisualState(useTransistions: false, expansionIndicator.IsExpanded);
		}

		private static void IndicatorVisibilityChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ExpansionIndicator expansionIndicator = (ExpansionIndicator)obj;
			if (expansionIndicator._expansionIndicator != null)
			{
				expansionIndicator._expansionIndicator.Visibility = (Visibility)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState(bool useTransistions, bool isExpanded)
		{
			if (base.IsEnabled)
			{
				if (_isMouseOver)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver", useTransistions);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransistions);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled", useTransistions);
			}
			if (isExpanded)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Expanded", useTransistions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Collapsed", useTransistions);
			}
		}

		internal void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			_isMouseOver = true;
			UpdateVisualState(useTransistions: true, IsExpanded);
		}

		internal void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			_isMouseOver = false;
			UpdateVisualState(useTransistions: true, IsExpanded);
		}

		private void ExpansionIndicator_MouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransistions: true, !IsExpanded);
			IsExpanded = !IsExpanded;
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void ExpansionIndicator_IsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransistions: false, IsExpanded);
		}
	}
	public class InverseBooleanConverter : ValueConverterBase
	{
		public override object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is bool)
			{
				return !(bool)value;
			}
			if (value is bool? flag)
			{
				if (!flag.HasValue)
				{
					if (typeof(bool?).Equals(targetType))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return !flag.Value;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("Trying to convert a non boolean value with the InverseBooleanConverter");
		}

		public override object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return Convert(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class PopupResizer : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		private FrameworkElement _resizeElem;

		private bool _isMouseDown;

		private bool _isResizing;

		private System.Windows.Point _offsetPoint;

		private System.Windows.Size _originalSize;

		private double _originalTop;

		private int _multiplier = 1;

		private PropertyValueTracker _flowDirectionTracker;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ResizeElementProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PopupProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PositionProperty;

		public FrameworkElement ResizeElement
		{
			get
			{
				return (FrameworkElement)GetValue(ResizeElementProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ResizeElementProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Popup Popup
		{
			get
			{
				return (Popup)GetValue(PopupProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PopupProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ResizerPosition Position
		{
			get
			{
				return (ResizerPosition)GetValue(PositionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PositionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<CancelEventArgs> PopupResizing;

		public event EventHandler PopupResized;

		static PopupResizer()
		{
			ResizeElementProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ResizeElement", typeof(FrameworkElement), typeof(PopupResizer), new PropertyMetadata(ResizeElementChanged));
			PopupProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Popup", typeof(Popup), typeof(PopupResizer), new PropertyMetadata(PopupChanged));
			PositionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Position", typeof(ResizerPosition), typeof(PopupResizer), new PropertyMetadata(ResizerPosition.Below, PositionChanged));
			Style style = new Style();
			style.Seal();
			FrameworkElement.FocusVisualStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(PopupResizer), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(style));
		}

		public PopupResizer()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(PopupResizer);
			base.IsTabStop = false;
		}

		private static void ResizeElementChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private static void PopupChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private static void PositionChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PopupResizer popupResizer = (PopupResizer)obj;
			popupResizer.EnsureVisualStates();
		}

		protected virtual void EndResize(bool cancel)
		{
			_isMouseDown = false;
			_isResizing = false;
			_resizeElem.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			if (cancel && ResizeElement != null)
			{
				ResizeElement.Height = _originalSize.Height;
				ResizeElement.Width = _originalSize.Width;
			}
			OnPopupResized();
		}

		protected virtual void EnsureVisualStates()
		{
			bool flag = Position == ResizerPosition.Above;
			if (flag)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Above", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Below", useTransitions: false);
			}
			if ((ResizeElement != null) ? (ResizeElement.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight) : (base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "AboveLTR", useTransitions: false);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "LTR", useTransitions: false);
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "AboveRTL", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "RTL", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		private void FlowDirectionChanged()
		{
			EnsureVisualStates();
			_multiplier *= -1;
		}

		private double CheckAndFixDiffWidth(double originalWidth, double diffWidth)
		{
			double x = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(ResizeElement, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0)).X;
			Screen currentScreen = GetCurrentScreen();
			if (DoesGoBeyoundScreenBoundaries(originalWidth, diffWidth, currentScreen))
			{
				double screensWidth = GetScreensWidth(currentScreen);
				diffWidth = screensWidth - (x + originalWidth);
			}
			return diffWidth;
		}

		private double GetScreensWidth(Screen currentScr)
		{
			int num = 0;
			Screen screen = Screen.AllScreens[num];
			double num2 = screen.WorkingArea.Width;
			while (!screen.Equals(currentScr))
			{
				screen = Screen.AllScreens[++num];
				num2 += (double)screen.WorkingArea.Width;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private Screen GetCurrentScreen()
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(ResizeElement, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
			return Screen.FromPoint(new System.Drawing.Point((int)point.X, (int)point.Y));
		}

		private bool DoesGoBeyoundScreenBoundaries(double originalWidth, double diffWidth, Screen currentScreen)
		{
			double x = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(ResizeElement, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0)).X;
			double num = currentScreen.WorkingArea.Width;
			x -= (double)currentScreen.WorkingArea.X;
			return x + originalWidth + diffWidth >= num;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (_resizeElem != null)
			{
				_resizeElem.LostMouseCapture -= ResizableElement_LostMouseCapture;
				_resizeElem.MouseLeftButtonUp -= ResizableElement_MouseLeftButtonUp;
				_resizeElem.MouseLeftButtonDown -= ResizableElement_MouseLeftButtonDown;
				_resizeElem.MouseMove -= ResizableElement_MouseMove;
			}
			_flowDirectionTracker = null;
			_resizeElem = GetTemplateChild("ResizeElem") as FrameworkElement;
			if (_resizeElem != null)
			{
				_resizeElem.LostMouseCapture += ResizableElement_LostMouseCapture;
				_resizeElem.MouseLeftButtonUp += ResizableElement_MouseLeftButtonUp;
				_resizeElem.MouseLeftButtonDown += ResizableElement_MouseLeftButtonDown;
				_resizeElem.MouseMove += ResizableElement_MouseMove;
				_flowDirectionTracker = new PropertyValueTracker(ResizeElement, "FlowDirection", FlowDirectionChanged);
			}
			EnsureVisualStates();
		}

		private void ResizableElement_LostMouseCapture(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			EndResize(cancel: false);
		}

		private void ResizableElement_MouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			EndResize(cancel: false);
		}

		private void ResizableElement_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ResizeElement != null && !OnPopupResizing())
			{
				_isMouseDown = ((UIElement)sender).CaptureMouse();
				e.Handled = _isMouseDown;
			}
		}

		private void ResizableElement_MouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_isMouseDown)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = Popup;
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				uIElement = PlatformProxy.GetRootVisual(ResizeElement);
			}
			if (!_isResizing)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				num = ResizeElement.ActualHeight;
				num2 = ResizeElement.ActualWidth;
				if (double.IsNaN(num2) || double.IsNaN(num) || (num2 == 0.0 && num == 0.0))
				{
					return;
				}
				_isResizing = true;
				_offsetPoint = e.GetPosition(uIElement);
				_originalSize = new System.Windows.Size(num2, num);
				if (Popup != null)
				{
					_originalTop = Popup.VerticalOffset;
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(uIElement);
			double x = position.X - _offsetPoint.X;
			double y = position.Y - _offsetPoint.Y;
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(x, y);
			point.X = CheckAndFixDiffWidth(_originalSize.Width, point.X);
			System.Windows.Size size = default(System.Windows.Size);
			size.Width = Math.Max(_originalSize.Width - point.X, ResizeElement.MinWidth);
			size.Width = Math.Min(size.Width, ResizeElement.MaxWidth);
			size.Height = Math.Max(_originalSize.Height - point.Y, ResizeElement.MinHeight);
			size.Height = Math.Min(size.Height, ResizeElement.MaxHeight);
			System.Windows.Size size2 = default(System.Windows.Size);
			size2.Width = Math.Max(_originalSize.Width + point.X, ResizeElement.MinWidth);
			size2.Width = Math.Max(Math.Min(size2.Width, ResizeElement.MaxWidth), ResizeElement.MinWidth);
			size2.Height = Math.Max(_originalSize.Height + point.Y, ResizeElement.MinHeight);
			size2.Height = Math.Min(size2.Height, ResizeElement.MaxHeight);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(_originalSize.Width - size.Width, _originalSize.Height - size.Height);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = default(System.Windows.Point);
			ResizeElement.Width = size2.Width;
			if (Popup != null)
			{
				if (SystemParameters.IsMenuDropRightAligned)
				{
					if (ResizeElement != null && ResizeElement.MinWidth <= size2.Width && size2.Width > 0.0)
					{
						Popup.HorizontalOffset = size2.Width;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Popup.HorizontalOffset = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (Position == ResizerPosition.Above)
			{
				if (Popup != null)
				{
					if (size.Height != ResizeElement.MinHeight)
					{
						point2.Y = _originalTop + point.Y;
						if (point2.Y == 0.0)
						{
							size.Height = ResizeElement.ActualHeight;
						}
						else if (size.Height < ResizeElement.MinHeight)
						{
							size.Height = ResizeElement.MinHeight;
							double num3 = ResizeElement.MinHeight - (_originalSize.Height - point.Y);
							point2.Y = _originalTop + point.Y - num3;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						double num4 = ResizeElement.MinHeight - (_originalSize.Height - point.Y);
						point2.Y = _originalTop + point.Y - num4;
					}
					Popup.VerticalOffset = point2.Y;
				}
				ResizeElement.Height = size.Height;
			}
			else
			{
				ResizeElement.Height = size2.Height;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool OnPopupResizing()
		{
			if (this.PopupResizing != null)
			{
				CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
				this.PopupResizing(this, e);
				return e.Cancel;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void OnPopupResized()
		{
			if (this.PopupResized != null)
			{
				this.PopupResized(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}
	public enum ResizerPosition
	{
		Above,
		Below
	}
	public class BindingProxy : Freezable
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DataProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Data", typeof(object), typeof(BindingProxy), new UIPropertyMetadata(null));

		public object Data
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(DataProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DataProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new BindingProxy();
		}
	}
	public class BoolToHiddenConverter : ValueConverterBase
	{
		public override object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (value is bool)
			{
				flag = (bool)value;
			}
			else if (value is bool? flag2)
			{
				flag = flag2.HasValue && flag2.Value;
			}
			bool flag3 = parameter is bool && (bool)parameter;
			return (flag != !flag3) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public override object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is Visibility)
			{
				bool flag = (Visibility)value == Visibility.Visible;
				bool flag2 = parameter is bool && (bool)parameter;
				return flag == !flag2;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Controls.Core
{
	internal class CommandMap
	{
		internal class Requirement
		{
			internal readonly LongValue DisallowedState;

			internal readonly LongValue RequiredState;

			internal Requirement(LongValue disallowedState, LongValue requiredState)
			{
				DisallowedState = disallowedState;
				RequiredState = requiredState;
			}
		}

		internal class KeyMapping
		{
			internal readonly int Id;

			internal Requirement _minimumRequiredState;

			internal readonly LongValue DisallowedState;

			internal readonly LongValue RequiredState;

			internal readonly Key Key;

			internal readonly ModifierKeys RequiredModifiers;

			internal readonly ModifierKeys DisallowedModifiers;

			internal KeyMapping(int command, LongValue disallowedState, LongValue requiredState, Key key, ModifierKeys requiredModifiers, ModifierKeys disallowedModifiers = ModifierKeys.None)
			{
				Id = command;
				DisallowedState = disallowedState;
				RequiredState = requiredState;
				Key = key;
				RequiredModifiers = requiredModifiers;
				DisallowedModifiers = disallowedModifiers;
			}

			internal bool DoesKeyMatch(Key key, ModifierKeys modifierKeys)
			{
				if (Key == key && RequiredModifiers == (RequiredModifiers & modifierKeys))
				{
					return (DisallowedModifiers & modifierKeys) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal bool DoesStateMatch(LongValue controlState)
			{
				if (controlState.IsMatch(DisallowedState, RequiredState))
				{
					if (_minimumRequiredState != null)
					{
						return controlState.IsMatch(_minimumRequiredState.DisallowedState, _minimumRequiredState.RequiredState);
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private KeyMapping[] _commands;

		private Dictionary<int, Requirement> _minimumRequiredStates;

		internal const ModifierKeys AllModifiers = ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift | ModifierKeys.Windows;

		internal const ModifierKeys AltModifier = ModifierKeys.Alt;

		public CommandMap(KeyMapping[] commands, Dictionary<int, Requirement> minimumRequiredStates)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(commands, "commands");
			_commands = commands;
			if (minimumRequiredStates == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyMapping keyMapping in commands)
			{
				if (minimumRequiredStates.TryGetValue(keyMapping.Id, out var value))
				{
					keyMapping._minimumRequiredState = value;
				}
			}
			_minimumRequiredStates = minimumRequiredStates;
		}

		public bool DoesMinimumStateMatch(int commandId, LongValue controlState)
		{
			Requirement definition = GetDefinition(commandId);
			if (definition != null)
			{
				return controlState.IsMatch(definition.DisallowedState, definition.RequiredState);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public IEnumerable<int> GetMatchingCommands(Key key, ModifierKeys modifierKeys, LongValue controlState)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < _commands.Length; i++)
			{
				KeyMapping keyMapping = _commands[i];
				if (keyMapping.DoesKeyMatch(key, modifierKeys) && keyMapping.DoesStateMatch(controlState))
				{
					list.Add(keyMapping.Id);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal Requirement GetDefinition(int commandId)
		{
			_minimumRequiredStates.TryGetValue(commandId, out var value);
			return value;
		}
	}
}
